Combine System Overrides and your Augments to create powerful synergies! Enjoy this thrilling variant with friends or sophisticated AI.

details.title: The BridgeMancer
details.short_description: Harness the power of Bridgemancy in this wholesome puzzle adventure. To rescue the citizens of Dolion, you must salvage materials, conjure bridges, and create escape routes for the townspeople. Just be sure not to block their path! Can you muster the magic, logic, and wit needed to save the kingdom?

details.title: Rich PaPa
details.short_description: Rich PaPa - Short Description Rich PaPa is a third-person action shooter where you literally shoot money. Blast through hordes of zombies, bank ricochet shots off the environment, and spin the roulette for risky upgrades while balancing survival against the cash you have left.

details.title: SYSTEM 21
details.short_description: Manipulate a blackjack game from the inside as a dealer subroutine in this minimalist roguelike deckbuilder. Read the visible card's queue, execute illegal code exploits to alter the upcoming cards, and fleece high-rolling patrons before the system anti-cheat detects your anomaly.

details.title: Tip-Top Tortoise Truck
details.short_description: Tip-Top Tortoise Truck is a grid-based puzzle game where you rescue toppled tortoises and send them home while keeping track of your fuel! Venture through the arid desert, drive through portals, and find your lost lunchboxes. Will you find out exactly who tipped all the tortoises over?

details.title: Homicide Squad: Hidden Objects
details.short_description: Find hidden objects and solve criminal cases in a thrilling detective game!

details.title: Exoset
details.short_description: An inventory-management airship-building auto-battler. Design your battlecruiser, pack its hull with powerful weapons, and arrange support systems to create synergies that multiply its firepower from hundreds to millions, then watch it battle ever-escalating threats.

details.title: Sneaker Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run a collectibles store and keep fakes off your shelves. Check sneakers, jerseys, tees, skateboards, bats and lighters against the Brand Book before you buy. Haggle with sellers and customers, bid on rare pairs at auction and grow a store collectors trust.

details.title: Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan
details.short_description: A classic Asian drama series is reborn in anime style, and you’re the director with power to guide the clash between rival families! Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan puts you in control of the narrative, allowing you to guide the beloved characters to endings from the original show.

details.title: Dreams to Studio
details.short_description: Build your dream career from a small room to your own gaming empire! Create content, stream, develop games, upgrade your equipment and shape your future in an open-ended life and management simulation where every decision matters.

details.title: Quiet Bloom
details.short_description: Quiet Bloom is a cozy idle game. Awaken the wind, dig wells, and call the rain to tend your land for you. Gather wood, stone, and water, raise wind vanes and solar panels, and watch a cracked desert slowly bloom into a luxuriant green oasis.

details.title: Sheeple
details.short_description: Cast cards to turn the tides of the battlefield, gather your army, and fight to regain The Original Sheep! Sheeple is a grand real time Auto battler with roguelike and deck-building elements.

details.title: Valkyrie Match
details.short_description: Gather the star-gems that can restore the fallen sky citadel. Match gems, awaken your Valkyrie cards, and outplay your rival turn by turn in this fantasy puzzle card battler.

details.title: Uncle Tony's Spooky Toyland
details.short_description: Tidy a messy toy store by day, then grab your ghost vacuum when midnight strikes! Sort thousands of toys onto the right shelves, vacuum slime, catch cute ghosts and return them to snow globes.

details.title: Mombo Combo Legacy
details.short_description: The most tongue-tastic hero is back! Jump, fight, and complete MOMBO COMBOS in a new journey packed with action, intense challenges, and monstrous bosses. Explore new worlds in this 2D platformer with powerful forms and a mighty army of pets! The world needs our little purple hero once again!

details.title: Idle Pixel Battle
details.short_description: Build your hero party in a fantasy idle auto battler packed with loot and progression. Collect powerful artifacts, unlock more than 200 upgrades, automate your runs, and take on new challenges.

details.title: Sam, We Talked About This
details.short_description: Every sentence, image and video on the internet will feed Sam's bottomless hunger! Train your models, grow your subscribers, buy new hardware and scrape even more data, all to build a super-duper artificial intelligence and leave every rival behind.

details.title: Cecilia
details.short_description: Cecilia is a Zelda-like action-adventure with Game Boy Color–inspired pixel art. As a royal guard, venture through puzzle-filled dungeons, find items that open new paths, and face challenging bosses to bring the kidnapped Prince Erick home.

details.title: Unfriendly Friend
details.short_description: Go on an adventure with your friends to the abandoned St. Mercy Hospital and uncover its secrets. Can you save your friends or at least save yourself from the horror that awaits?

details.title: Night Machine
details.short_description: We’ve just learned the Moon is a giant alien doomsday factory, which is kind of a bummer. You've been chosen to operate a spaceship into the core and destroy it for us. Think fast, adapt under pressure, and deploy powerful combinations as you fight your way through in this real-time card battler.

details.title: Buy the Dip, Milady
details.short_description: Let the maids fight. You handle the money! Mine silver, summon maids, and buy or short stocks while battle rages. Your profits might turn the tide. Your losses? Back to the pickaxe. Build your team for story battles, the Endless Tower, and ranked Steam PvP. No paid pulls.

name: No, I'm Not Addicted to Opening Packs

details.title: No, I'm Not Addicted to Opening Packs
details.short_description: Rip open packs in this incremental trading card game! Collect hundreds of unique cards across themed sets, upgrade your packs, sacrifice cards for rewards and complete challenges to earn stars for permanent upgrades. Chase the rarest pulls and build your ultimate collection!

details.title: Tidy Up The Backrooms
details.short_description: A store's items have gone missing in the Backrooms, and it's your job to bring it back. Explore the endless yellow halls using your tech and tools, restock the store and solve the mystery of what really happened to the store. Don't like scares? Turn the horror off and enjoy a cozy tidy!

details.title: Dog Eat Fly
details.short_description: Dog Eat Fly is a colorful 2D roguelite platformer where you run, jump, dash and eat flies. Build powerful combinations of upgrades, survive increasingly chaotic challenges, and push your run further with every attempt.

details.title: Cielle is Not Happy
details.short_description: Cielle is Not Happy is a psychological horror RPG in which you play as a girl named Cielle, who encounters erratic events throughout her journey, leading her to uncover cryptic secrets about herself and the world around her.

details.title: KOMMUNALKA
details.short_description: KOMMUNALKA is an atmospheric Point & Click horror game. Immerse yourself in a grim story set inside a dilapidated post-Soviet communal apartment. Will you be able to escape?

details.title: STEP THEATER
details.short_description: WELCOME TO THE “STEP THEATER” :) “STEP THEATER” is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!

details.title: Phantom Fumes
details.short_description: A noir visual novel where you tie your memories back together to solve the mystery. Help him on his journey to uncover the secrets of this case. Find clues and evidence and draw the strings together with them to find a red thread straight to the truth. There will be jokes, hopes and plenty of smoke.

name: Tidy Wizard: A Place For Every Plate

details.title: Tidy Wizard: A Place For Every Plate
details.short_description: A relaxing organizing simulator set in a massive wizarding dining hall. Collect over 2,000 hand-crafted plates, wash them in an enchanted water sphere, and sort them onto shelves by family crest, color, and material. Unlock new spells to help organize the chaos at your pace!

details.title: The Lantern Spirits
details.short_description: Wield a magic lantern in this roguelite shooter and guide the lost spirits home. Combine 100 unique lantern upgrades, unlock a massive skill tree, and leave a glimmer of light behind with every death. Made by four brothers and set to a 25-track original soundtrack composed in-house.

details.title: STASIS VOXEL
details.short_description: A top-down voxel bullet-hell roguelite. Freeze bullets in mid-air with Stasis, socket rare support gems, and blast through 50 procedurally generated floors as enemies shatter into thousands of flying voxels.

details.title: Pack it! Part-Time Master
details.short_description: Scan! Stack! The ultimate basket-packing challenge! Become a part-time master!

details.title: EXOSECTOR
details.short_description: A space 3D MMORPG on a colossal scale. Up to 100,000 players simultaneously in one persistent, seamless game universe of 10,000 star systems.

details.title: AWZ Wrestling : THE VIDEO GAME
details.short_description: PLAY THE LIFE OF THE WRESTLERS! Featuring over 25 real wrestlers! Travel the world! Playable in airports, on the streets, at the gym… A complete wrestler experience. Discover a wrestling game different any other you've ever played!

details.title: Horror In Neverland
details.short_description: Third person horror shooter game where player controls cyborg whose mission is to kill different zombies and find pentagram at levels

details.title: Blind Descent
details.short_description: Blind Descent is an open-world survival adventure into the mysteries of the Martian depths. Play solo or with friends in 4-player co-op as you search for the missing team. Adapt to survive by building custom tools, upgrading your base, and/or mutating in this bizarre alien world.

details.title: Deep Space Observatory
details.short_description: Scan the stars, unlock technologies, automate data collection, and build an ever more efficient observatory.

details.title: Kinetic Conundrum
details.short_description: What if Rube Goldberg machine was a game? Kinetic Conundrum is a casual puzzle-platformer where you use a cue ball to wrangle target balls through a puzzle and use physics-inspired machines to overcome obstacles.

details.title: Pokremental
details.short_description: Pokremental is an incremental game where you flip poker cards to earn money. Buy cards and upgrades to earn more money, or hire helpers to automate the process. Gamble at the casino or on the skill tree to progress faster.

details.title: Little St. Files Mayhem
details.short_description: The Oval Office has a paperwork problem. Sort case folders, decipher damaged labels and put the archive in order alone or with up to 3 friends. Pass audits and upgrade your skills in a first-person filing game where every folder needs a home.

details.title: Skiing Red
details.short_description: A physics-based rage game about skiing to the bottom of a mountain. Control your skis individually, dodge questionable obstacles and try not to crash.. You will crash.. A lot.

details.title: Fieldmade
details.short_description: Everything in this world is something you drew. Sketch a hoe and till the soil with it. Sketch an axe, a watering can, a fishing rod... and they become real, working tools with real stats. You can draw literally anything you want.

details.title: Vanta
details.short_description: A noir murder-mystery where you type your own questions. Interrogate a rain-soaked street of suspects, catch their lies with the evidence you find, and prove when, how and why a man died at 2:13, before the day shift charges the wrong suspect at six.

details.title: Ink Escape: Coven Conundrum
details.short_description: Ink Escape: Coven Conundrum is a puzzle-based escape room. Solve puzzles and discover the stories of your ancestors in the books you have inherited.

details.title: Horde Reapers
details.short_description: Face hordes and bosses, solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Shape your build with weapons, items, and elemental powers, then bring resources back to rebuild your village and unlock permanent upgrades.

details.title: Rune Tale
details.short_description: Rune Tale is an incremental auto exploration game where you harvest and utilize rune energy by matching sets on an expanding grid to level up and become an all powerful wizard. Small game window doesn't take much space on your desktop so you can focus on other things.

details.title: Mini Monuments
details.short_description: Mini Monuments is a calming diorama restoration game where you dig, clean, and rebuild handcrafted miniature ruins. Use tactile tools at your own pace and watch as each scene comes back to life piece by piece.

details.title: LEVELS
details.short_description: Explore the first true open-world Backrooms: one infinite, procedurally generated world full of unique biomes, shared by every online player. (And the entities live here too!)

details.title: Apple Crumble
details.short_description: It’s your grandma’s 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and don’t worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.

details.title: Cats Around Us: Yarn Ball
details.short_description: This is a very short game 🥳 We've hidden 200 cats inside a silent comic about a calico cat chasing a yarn ball all around the house. Can you find them all? 🔎🙀

name: Fracht rollt - Kein Auftrag bleibt liegen

details.title: Fracht rollt - Kein Auftrag bleibt liegen
details.short_description: Build and manage your own haulage company. Dispatch jobs across 245 cities in 39 countries, balance truck capacity by weight, volume, pallets and loading metres, plan driver rest periods and meet delivery deadlines while growing your fleet.

details.title: Gravith
details.short_description: Gravith is a high-difficulty score attack game. Use the gravity of your mouse cursor (planet) to alter the path of incoming missiles and destroy targets. However, if a missile hits your planet, it's an instant game over. Experience high-risk gameplay where one slip-up ends it all.

name: Demigod Islands: A Puzzle to Die For

details.title: Demigod Islands: A Puzzle to Die For
details.short_description: Vicious demigods demand sacrifices! Take control of captive creatures, explore mysterious islands and solve 50+ mind-bending puzzles in story mode or 20+ unique levels in two-player online co-op. The twist? To please the demigods and uncover their secrets, you must kill yourselves!

details.title: Daimyo Reign
details.short_description: Unify Medieval Japan in this real-time tactical grand strategy game. Build your domain, recruit armies, plan your attack, and fracture your enemies with rebellions to win!

details.title: Flakeparty
details.short_description: Build the perfect cereal bowl and reach extremely high scores in this relaxing roguelike deckbuilder. Scoop up cereals, craft powerful synergies by placing them well, earn toys by playing rule-twisting minigames and eat tasty snacks to improve your cereals as you reach the highest scores!

name: The Attic: A Mystery Puzzle Game

details.title: The Attic: A Mystery Puzzle Game
details.short_description: Help Jess to organize, repair and restore retro objects - cassettes, cartridges, cameras - while you solve riddles and puzzles hidden in an attic full of memories. A cozy story with hints of mystery where you'll unveil who Matt really was and who Destiny was.

details.title: MANIFESTO: The Capitalism Roguelike
details.short_description: Hire employees. Arrange your office. Turn burnout into profit. MANIFESTO is a corporate roguelike auto battler. Combine worker abilities, stack upgrades, and replace exhausted staff to meet totally unrealistic sales targets. Good luck, CEO. The shareholders expect results.

details.title: Drunk Woodcutter
details.short_description: Chop wood, drink beer, hack yourself in the kneecap. A short physics-based incremental sim about splitting firewood, increasingly ridiculous equipment, and bad judgment.

details.title: Hans in the Internetz
details.short_description: Hans in the Internetz is a first-/third-person meme platform adventure game. His dream to become a wizard lays deep within the internet and you, as his apprentice must do the dirty work and “figure thiz out” Expect puzzles, toilet humour and legal drugs!

details.title: Fishing Fever
details.short_description: An incremental roguelike fishing game. Start with one tool, end with five. Draft, upgrade and stack them, then hunt 75 species across eight oceans until the whole sea is biting at once. Rivals steal your cards. Something in the dark already knows your name. One more round. Always one more round.

details.title: Goeland: Seagull Adventure
details.short_description: You're a seagull. The island is your playground. Everyone on it is your problem to solve, bother, or befriend. Explore freely, solve things your way, mess with everything, and create absurd moments worth sharing.

details.title: The Veil Express
details.short_description: A cosy management game on a hidden magical train, where you build rooms and workshops for goblins, witches, fairies, ghosts and vampires. Keep the Five Houses happy and spend the Veil wisely: the same magic that powers your train and keeps it hidden.

details.title: Dragon's Treasure Tidy Up
details.short_description: Dragon's Treasure is a cozy organizing simulator where you tidy up over 100,000 items across the various treasure rooms of the great dragon Brimwald. Tidy, learn spells and abilities to help you along your journey and return the lair to its former glory.

details.title: Warehouse Drink Sorting Simulator
details.short_description: Nearly 300,000 drinks in one mountain. Work through six halls, starting with a handful at a time. Earn money for bigger totes, carts, a lift and a giant scoop, then hire robot cats to pick and stack with you. No timers, no fail states.

details.title: Pistara
details.short_description: There's been a murder and no one left the house. Place every suspect on the floor plan using the clues and the rules, and the culprit is revealed: whoever was alone with the victim. A deduction game where you don't guess who did it; you work out where everyone was.

details.title: We Have a Robot Problem
details.short_description: Every robot in the vault has wandered off its charging rack. Catch them, stack them in your arms and put each one back in its own spot. Thousands of robots with hats and costumes, handy tools and a Workshop full of upgrades. A cosy, silly tidy up game.

details.title: Walk Hero
details.short_description: Go forward. Kill enemies. Collect loot. Get stronger. And again. An unusual mix of genres will allow you to focus solely on the choice of equipment and upgrades.

details.title: Colonials
details.short_description: Pixelart Auto Battler about turning one expendable trooper into an army of Space Colony. You give the orders. They fight the bugs.

details.title: Odysseus' 13th Ship
details.short_description: Paddle a canoe up a mountain of abstract geometric shapes with your friends, as the forgotten 13th Ship of Odysseus. Online multiplayer only, with the goal of reaching Ithaca.

details.title: Cannon Keep
details.short_description: Build your city block by block and defeat waves of mechs in this tower defense roguelike! Combine powerful cannons with unique effects to survive the unforgiving wasteland and explore the underground to gather resources and find powerful relics.

details.title: Sandpipers! The Sea-Quell
details.short_description: The King Crab smashed the moon to break the tides and drown the sandpipers, and his criminal empire is loving it. Gather your flock, lead them beak-first through brick, bombs and steel, and bring the moon back one piece at a time. 80 levels of pure bird chaos. Beak first. Questions later.

details.title: Eight Legs, Seven Nights
details.short_description: Aunt Margit hasn't read your messages in nine days. At her house, a note asks you to look after her thirteen spiders for a week. You are terrified of spiders. Then the snow closes the roads. Feed them, mist them, keep them alive, and get through seven nights in a house that isn't empty.

details.title: FIRMWARE
details.short_description: FIRMWARE is an assembly programming puzzle game. Challenge yourself with hundreds of puzzles and different game types: Multi-core systems with shared buses and I/O pins, programming microcontrollers driving circuits, shuffling instructions to fix programs, and large programs for encoding messages.

details.title: Deathfall
details.short_description: A fast-paced pixel-art roguelike where every run gets more chaotic. Fight endless enemy waves, upgrade your build, and see how far you can survive.

details.title: Ascension Trail: Idle Crusade
details.short_description: Your heroes fight. You choose the path. Recruit a party from nine roles, gear them up, and pair clashing elements for devastating combos.

details.title: Pegs & Sorcery
details.short_description: Aim your orbs. Power your party. Build your deck. In this pachinko roguelike deckbuilder, bounce through pegs to earn mana, then unleash cards in turn-based battles. Combine heroes, cards, and upgrades as you choose your path through each run.

details.title: Wolf Plot
details.short_description: Wolf Plot is a tricky puzzle-platformer. Help your wolves catch the sheep in over 100 levels. Use a variety of tools to control your wolves: rockets, fans, bombs, bridges, and more.

details.title: Possessed Kingdom
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder. Play cards to balance your economy, defenses and army. Read the enemy, draw your army’s route, and choose when to strike.

details.title: Fall Up
details.short_description: Take a leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with our adorable Labi! You need to traverse this cartoonish world with a variety of jumps and moves, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots and reveal the secrets of this world.

details.title: Plamo Kits
details.short_description: Plamo is Japanese for plastic model kits. Snip parts from the runner, snap them together, and finish them with paint, panel lining, edge highlights, decals, and weathering. Build 30+ original kits, from mechs and racers to spacecraft and jets, then pose them, set up dioramas, and fill your shelves.

details.title: Alex's Sketchbook World
details.short_description: The RPG where you fight enemies by drawing and coloring them.

details.title: Vanguard Valiants
details.short_description: Reclaim the lands taken by the Zahar. Build and lead armies to recover the villages seized by the enemy. Acquire better weapons and manage your soldiers throughout the liberation campaign.

details.title: Santa's Shop Tidy Up
details.short_description: Bring festive order to Santa's magical Christmas shop! 🎄 Sort gifts, arrange toys, and organize charming holiday shelves in this cozy and relaxing sorting game. Enjoy the Christmas atmosphere and discover the simple joy of putting everything in its perfect place! 🎁

details.title: Neonovista
details.short_description: Build a neon city, add unique landmarks and drive through your creation in this relaxing voxel sandbox. Connect winding roads, slopes and overpasses; switch between third-person and cockpit views, or roam endlessly through city streets, sunset coasts and roads beneath Saturn's rings.

details.title: Ultra Cleaner Corp.
details.short_description: It’s been 300 years of life in space after the Earth exploded. All fake-oxygen-breathing humans remain immortal thanks to devices called the Chip Needles, made by Ultra Clean Corp. The story follows the Spaceship-000-009 crew as one of their crew members disagrees with her imposed immortality.

details.title: Zombie Warz
details.short_description: Zombie Warz is a tower defense RTS game with rogue-lite gameplay elements. Play as the king of a kingdom under siege by zombies and survive to discover their origins.

details.title: Chrome Circuit
details.short_description: A twin-stick roguelite in a 2086 cyber-dystopia. Chain kill-streaks for massive rewards, sign cursed loot contracts with brutal downsides, and stack upgrades into a new monster build every run.

details.title: N.E.O.N. HORIZON
details.short_description: Build your own ship from the hull up. Arm it, install a variety of systems, break the rules — then survive relentless waves of escalating threats in this sci-fi roguelite shooter. Experiment with weapons, relics and powerful synergies. Reach Horizon.

details.title: Animal Fights Together
details.short_description: Run a animal fight club with up to 3 friends. Strap absurd weapons onto farm animals, train them up, then watch their cinematic auto-fights together, bet on every match and yell at the screen. A goat with a minigun. A chicken with a katana.

details.title: God, Save the Queens!
details.short_description: You are God. The king’s five daughters have been taken. Fight thousands of enemies, unlock powerful skills, and defeat the evil wizard Zaharad in this brutal 2.5D roguelike!

details.title: RIP ME!
details.short_description: RIP ME! is a pixel-art booster pack incremental. Rip packs, pull shiny hits, clean and grade your best cards, then show them off in your display case. Build a Rip Bot, chase God Packs and misprints across an ever-growing lineup of series, and hunt the legendary Grails.

details.title: PACKFISH
details.short_description: Packfish is a cozy pack-opening incremental game about collecting fish. Tear open packs, flip the cards and chase shiny Golden and Prism editions. Build living aquariums that earn while you're away, breed secret hybrids and complete a collection of 97 species. Just one more pack...

details.title: Last Card
details.short_description: A card roguelike played across the table from a masked dealer. Chain cards by color, number or symbol to stack chips and multipliers and beat the night's target. Miss it and a candle goes out. When the last one goes out, the house wins.

details.title: Fantasy Blacksmith Simulator
details.short_description: Become a Master Blacksmith in this cozy fantasy simulator. Restore and upgrade your workshop, forge magical weapons and armor, craft jewelry, and enchant powerful gear. Meet magical creatures and mysterious figures as you enjoy a relaxing crafting experience, solo or with friends in co-op.

details.title: LETS GO HUNTING
details.short_description: Hunt silly animals with up to 3 friends in a colourful low-poly world. Track them down, drag the loot home on a sled or in a truck, sell it at camp, upgrade your gear and take on the mighty Wolpertinger King.

details.title: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar
details.short_description: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar is an action RPG-roguelike set in the mythic world of the Classic of Mountains and Seas, where ancient gods, demons, and forgotten powers collide.

details.title: Coaches Box 27
details.short_description: Take charge of an Australian rules football club. Trade, draft and game plan your way to a premiership. Make tactical changes from the box, manage your squad and make the hard decisions to build your dynasty. Play singleplayer or multiplayer with up to 8 friends.

details.title: Water is Heavy
details.short_description: Become an ordinary fish descending endlessly into the pitch-black abyss. In this 3D marine roguelite, master bubble attacks and combine diverse skills and powerful items to survive the crushing pressure of swarming enemies. At the end of the harsh abyss, what belief will you ultimately forge?

details.title: Bring It
details.short_description: A stylized retro arcade game about a motor courier hustling through the city to deliver meals, coffee and groceries with skill and style. Chain boosts, drifts, air dashes and double jumps, then spend your earnings on home upgrades,new licenses and bikes with unique abilities for the next day’s rush.

details.title: Plink Lab
details.short_description: A satisfying active plinko incremental where you drop and bounce fantastic creatures (tiny humans for starters) to clear pegs and earn a trillion $! Wacky balls, massive tech tree, total physics-based chaos, and a very chatty goblin shop owner.

details.title: MANIC MINER
details.short_description: Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! This reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

details.title: Waltz and Jam
details.short_description: Waltz and Jam is a single-player action-adventure platformer following the adventures of Waltz, a pure soul, and Jam, his lovable dog companion. It is set in an afterlife born from a unique reimagination of the Seven Deadly Sins.

details.title: GemSlasher
details.short_description: GemSlasher is an action roguelite where every attack is built from gems. Combine Main Gems with Support Gems, merge duplicate gems to increase their star level, and create powerful builds capable of tearing through relentless waves of monsters.

details.title: Mine of despair
details.short_description: Sentenced to death, then pardoned... into a mining sentence. 1-8 player co-op with proximity voice: dig, pay the prison, come back up alive. You do not kill the monsters here: you understand them, or you die. And something down there blows out the torches, one by one.

details.title: Bloomies
details.short_description: A cozy incremental creature collector that lives on your taskbar! Plant seeds, hatch eggs and raise over 70 unique Bloomies while you work or play. Unlock skills until it all runs itself, defeat bosses for new seeds and hunt rare Sparkle variants to complete your collection.

details.title: Edge of Memories
details.short_description: The population of Avaris is ravaged by the Corrosion, a terrible affliction that mutates all it infects into grotesque abominations. Play as Eline, a young nomad, and lead fierce battles alongside your allies to save the world from extinction.

details.title: Flag Boom! Chronicles
details.short_description: Plant your flag on a fort and your WHOLE ARMY DOUBLES! A pixel-art RTS where hundreds of archers, spearmen and cavalry clash in a rock-paper-scissors war. Pick a unit type, march, seize forts and watch your army explode. 20 stages, 4 giant bosses.

details.title: TOGISHI - Katana Polishing Simulator
details.short_description: Polish the rust from a blade and wake the hamon sleeping beneath it. Switch stones, clear the rust, bring up the luster. But every stroke thins the steel. Where you stop is yours to decide. A stage-based polishing simulator across 32 blades.

details.title: ECHIDNA
details.short_description: A dead god drifts in the dark. Build a salvage fleet that carves it apart cell by cell, and watch a colossal carcass melt into a storm of flying debris and climbing numbers. Strip it to the bone then evolve and start again on something bigger.

details.title: 28 Days Train Wreck Survivor
details.short_description: A hardcore first-person survival simulator. Explore a wrecked freight train, loot containers, hunt, gather resources, craft weapons and gear, and manage hunger, thirst, fatigue, and warmth to make it through 28 days of cold and predators.

details.title: 胡来！文字麻将
details.short_description: What if mahjong was less about strategy and more about pure nonsense? Draw, steal, and discard character tiles, then force them into the wildest sentence you can. Exes become emperors, bosses elope at midnight, zombies clock in for work. If you can make the nonsense make sense, you can win.

name: Liminal Space But You Have to Kabaddi

details.title: Liminal Space But You Have to Kabaddi
details.short_description: “Kabaddi, kabaddi…” Stop chanting, and your health starts to drain. Liminal Space But You Have to Kabaddi is an online co-op horror game where you explore mysterious spaces while chanting “kabaddi” into your microphone.

details.title: HUNGER
details.short_description: HUNGER throws you into the chaos of plague-ravaged Napoleonic Europe. This multiplayer extraction RPG blends brutal melee and ranged combat with deep long term character progression, questing and crafting. Scavenge for resources, battle unspeakable horrors, and outlast rival Living.

details.title: Gate Rogue
details.short_description: Cards in hand, into the unknown Gate. A classic turn-based roguelike RPG played one move at a time on a grid. Skills, magic and healing: the cards in your hand clear the way. Master 6 classes, conquer 20 ever-changing labyrinths, and rescue the childhood friend who vanished into the depths.

details.title: Idle Agency
details.short_description: Steam Community Market ➕ a solo idle looter: set lineup and positions on a 4×4 board, heroes auto-battle, and resources and gear pile up even offline. Build and research in the Fortress, sell at the Market, buy back what you lack as prices move, and test your limits in the Trial Tower.

details.title: Red Timewarp: Beyond Reality
details.short_description: Blast through enemy hordes, grab powerful upgrades, and become stronger with every run in a challenging Bullet Heaven roguelite. Choose one of 4 red panda heroes with unique abilities, build them your way, and battle through time solo or with friends in online co-op.

details.title: GLIMWARD
details.short_description: A day-and-night tower defense. By day, build inside your light; by night, thousands of shadow creatures surge toward the sun core from every side. Shape your tower layout, alternate red, green and blue light to trigger spectral reactions, and hold the last light.

details.title: Lords of Pain
details.short_description: Lead a party of adventurers who explore and fight on their own in this fantasy auto-battler RPG. Shape their builds, craft equipment, manage supplies, and climb 100 floors to challenge the Lord of Pain.

details.title: Noblefold: Kingdoms of Chance
details.short_description: A broke king wins back the crown at the blackjack table. Stack side-bet combos, cheat with Crown cards before suspicion catches you, and pledge villages, mines and keeps to five creditors, the Devil included. Build a kingdom worth losing.

details.title: FreeStyle Football 2
details.short_description: Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game. Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team. Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.

details.title: TAKEN
details.short_description: A first-person found-footage horror FMV game across five chapters. Answer the riddles. Complete the rituals. Satisfy the cult. Eight endings are waiting. Most of them are not escape.

details.title: Baggage Belt
details.short_description: Grow a tiny pixel-art airport all the way to the stars in this cozy idle game. Check in bags, hire the crew and book routes that multiply your income. Every airport has its own minigame, and the belt keeps running while you're away. Your crew chief is a corgi called Biscuit.

details.title: The First Pixel
details.short_description: In the beginning there is a white screen and one black pixel. Click it, and it wakes. Grow it into pattern, memory and meaning, hunt 100 lost relics across erased worlds, and discover what a pixel sees once it has gathered everything. A quiet, mysterious incremental.

details.title: ManaPop!
details.short_description: ManaPop! is a new kind of competitive falling-block puzzle game where you solve puzzles while battling with magic! Clear the falling mana, build up magic power, cast spells, and fight for victory! Japanese only.

details.title: Şehri Racon
details.short_description: Şehr-i Racon is a humorous 2D side-scrolling beat 'em up inspired by the streets of Istanbul. Fight colorful enemies, unleash powerful special moves, use unusual weapons, explore vibrant locations, and face challenging bosses!

details.title: Supermarket in Order
details.short_description: Tidy up to 10,000 objects across 17 supermarket sections. Pick up products, restock shelves and unlock upgrades in this cozy first-person tidying game. Play at your own pace and turn scattered goods into a neatly organized store.

details.title: Welcome to Fox Cafe
details.short_description: Join Miru, a little fox, in a forest cafe. Dodge enemy swarms and combine weapons and abilities in Continuous Survival or Rounds + Shop. After the main story, gather ingredients, make tea and snacks, and serve guests. A prequel to the Fox Cafe comic.

details.title: Rune Deep
details.short_description: A hundred floors of dungeon lie beneath a town built on ancient relics. Lead a party of four from six classes, unleash weapon skills and elemental reactions to carve through swarming hordes, and dig up gear that makes every build stronger in this 3D voxel hack & slash.

details.title: Gridbound
details.short_description: GRIDBOUND is a co-op arcade action game on a shifting LED floor. Dodge red hazards, activate blue objectives, and reach green safe tiles. Coordinate with your teammates, react fast, and stay alive as the grid changes around you.

details.title: ZOO CATCHER / SUNSHARD FARM
details.short_description: A two-game indie collection featuring ZOO CATCHER, a keyboard typing game, and SUNSHARD FARM, a farming adventure with real-time combat. Enjoy two different ways to play in one collection.

details.title: We’re In Trouble
details.short_description: A CO-OP stealth game about a problem that can’t wait until morning. 🕵️‍♂️ An empty office, a body, and absolute silence. Work together, avoid guards and cameras, handle unpredictable physics, and escape unnoticed. One mistake can ruin everything.

details.title: CitaDrill
details.short_description: Captain a giant drill-city in this roguelite citybuilder. Dig deep into an infested planet, collect resources, expand your city under the dome, upgrade your drill, and protect yourself against waves of fearsome creatures together with your mettle and paw-some cat crew.

details.title: Deliwhere?
details.short_description: Run a chaotic air cargo business across floating islands in 1-4 player co-op or solo! Pick from 4 unique roles, board your flying platform, dodge incoming rockets and aerial mines, upgrade your hangar, and deliver packages to pay off your massive bank loan!

details.title: 돌깨
details.short_description: Break rocks, uncover minerals, and build up your pixel-art mining workshop. Upgrade tools, automate the work, and start fresh with permanent abilities. Chase rare finds and jackpot rewards in this single-player incremental game.

details.title: Nothing Unusual
details.short_description: Nothing Unusual is a Backpack Battles-style inventory builder meets Brotato-style horde survival, for 1–4 players. Grab a branch, a thermos and a frozen hairtail, mix fire, ice, shock and poison, and outlast 20 waves of Rule Tales until dark. Then stack Retrograde modifiers or go endless.

details.title: Bounty Hunters
details.short_description: Bounty Hunters is a competitive stealth game for four players. Blend into the crowd, identify your target, and strike while avoiding your own pursuer. Use disguises, poison, and detection abilities to outsmart your opponents in eight-minute matches online or over LAN.

details.title: Gravity well
details.short_description: Explore vast galaxies through gravity wells and realistic physics. Launch and combine celestial bodies to uncover mysterious stories hidden in space. Race friends and players worldwide for the top spot, or slow down and enjoy a tranquil deep-space atmosphere beneath the stars.

details.title: Muchi
details.short_description: Meet Muchi, a free-to-play desktop pet who makes your screen feel cozier. Show him affection, offer food and water, tend a little garden, or take a break with minigames while he wanders, plays, and rests alongside your day. No rush, no pressure.

details.title: Factory In Progress
details.short_description: A semi-idle factory management game. Mine ore, craft components, then research and automate your way to launching a rocket. There is no world to route resources through. Buildings pull from and deposit into one global pool. Even when you are gone, you still have a Factory In Progress.

details.title: La Famiglia
details.short_description: A painted noir mafia saga: plan the week, rule the city, found a dynasty.

details.title: AI Startup Simulator
details.short_description: AI Startup Simulator is a first-person business management simulation. Start in a cramped storefront, assemble your own servers, and turn client work into a growing AI business.

details.title: Hope Timbre
details.short_description: Guide a mysterious creature through imaginary realm at night, or help two siblings awaken their broken world during the day. In dreams, you traverse the colorful environments and solve puzzles to find various hope instruments. Later, use them to summon the spring and escape the never-ending cycle.

details.title: Project: C.E.L.L.
details.short_description: An arcade incremental where you break glucose, trigger explosive chain reactions, and turn ATP into powerful upgrades. Experiment with different builds, discover powerful combinations, and push a retro-futuristic cell simulation to its limits.

details.title: Diamond District: Jewelry Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Buy gold, catch the fakes and flip the real pieces in your own jewelry shop in New York’s Diamond District. Start with $1,000 and one dusty room, stock your cases, haggle at the counter, craft custom pieces and film celebrities for views. Solo or online co-op for 1 to 4.

details.title: Mandatory Overtime | 強制残業
details.short_description: A psychological horror game set in a Japanese company with a toxic work environment. On your first day at work, your boss forces you to work overtime, leaving you alone in the office late at night. However, strange things begin to happen in the supposedly empty office...

details.title: Rayman Legends Retold
details.short_description: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or in up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

details.title: Desktop Doodle
details.short_description: Draw a desktop companion or import a PSD file to create one automatically. Give it your voice, feed it, interact with it, and watch it react to your PC activity while you work, study, or play. Share creations and find new friends on Steam Workshop.

details.title: OPEN UP! IT'S ME
details.short_description: You're ten years old and home alone. Guests are arriving, but not everyone can be trusted. Look through the peephole, ask questions, search for clues, and decide who to let in. Not every guest belongs at your holiday table.

details.title: Formula First Manager
details.short_description: Take on the role of a Team Principal and build your career in a living paddock. Recruit, develop your car, negotiate, manage your team and face the consequences of your decisions across multiple seasons.

details.title: Who?
details.short_description: Who? is a game of deduction and chaos among friends. Each player uploads any photo from their computer, which is assigned to another participant. Everyone can see the others’ images, but not their own, and asks questions that can only be answered with “yes” or “no” to discover who—or what—they are.

details.title: Hammer & Harvest: Dwarven Roots
details.short_description: A dwarf farm sim! The days of dragons'-fire have ended, and now the Dwarf King has commissioned you to reclaim the ancient halls. Grow crops, harvest crystals, mine ores, and craft works of awe & wonder. Enrich your home beneath the mountains before the Dwarf King returns to judge your progress...

details.title: E.S.D.E
details.short_description: Humanity is nearly extinct, and the few who remain have become soulless anomalies. Enter deadly zones, scavenge valuable loot, sell it, and upgrade your gear to investigate the horrors humanity has become.

details.title: Dirty Scallywags
details.short_description: Board your ship, sail the seas and accidentally dismember your friends! There are ships to loot, enemies to defeat and physics to disobey. If you get lonely, invite your friends and start plundering the seas together!

details.title: 1,000,000 Lentils & Ashes
details.short_description: Separate lentils from ash. By hand. One million items, two sorting pits, and you. A minimalist first-person game where every correctly sorted item brings you slightly closer to the end. Good luck.

details.title: Sect Master
details.short_description: Train disciples, build your sect, and rise from humble beginnings to greatness!

details.title: Love Locks
details.short_description: Love is forever. Until you bring bolt cutters. Remove 100,000 love locks solo or near friends in this relaxing cleanup game. Fish for keys with a magnet in the Seine in Paris, unlock tools from lockpicks to lasers, and turn romantic gestures into scrap metal 🔐

details.title: Maneki Mania Land: Clicker Park
details.short_description: Pet the lucky cat, build a Japanese festival park lot by lot, then step up and play every machine yourself: claw, koi pond, pachinko, Daruma wheel and the giant Maneki Grand Slot. In-game koban only, no microtransactions.

details.title: Pawtings! Hidden Dogs
details.short_description: Find hidden dogs in real museum paintings. Explore dozens of artworks, spot the hand-drawn dogs hiding in the details, and watch the color come back into each canvas. Play solo or hunt with up to three friends in a split screen or online. Enjoy a relaxing hidden-object game set to classical music.

details.title: Quadrillion Carrots
details.short_description: 🥕Harvest an absurd number of carrots! Start with your bare hands, unlock powerful tools and helper robots, explore six farming zones, catch living carrots, survive explosive ones, and turn manual labor into harvesting chaos. 🤖

details.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
details.short_description: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

details.title: Corner Cutters
details.short_description: Top-down racing for people who love a good fight for a corner. AI drivers defend and make mistakes. Tyres wear and grip best when warm. Rubber builds up on the line, and in changing weather the track dries where the cars drive. Best played with a controller. Race a season or go online.

details.title: Void Skirmisher
details.short_description: VOID SKIRMISHER is an arcade co-op shooter for up to 8 players: jump the warp gate, hold off endless waves of hostile fleets far past any front line, and drop in or out whenever you like.

details.title: math is hard
details.short_description: math is hard is a sokoban-style puzzle game where the numbers are blocks you push around until the math works out. Line them up into equations, hit the target value, and master special blocks that change the rules.

details.title: Classroom 3B
details.short_description: Investigate an abandoned Indian school where the truth was buried — literally. Manage a failing power system, monitor live CCTV feeds, and piece together a tragedy through documents, audio logs, and authentic Hindi work in this psychological horror investigation.

details.title: PactSworn
details.short_description: Fight through hordes of eldritch monsters to purge the source of the corruption! Earn gold, buy weapons, and level up to create unique and powerful builds to cut through the chaos. Unlock different warlocks and weapon sets to explore all the different ways to play!

details.title: The Sea Is Broken
details.short_description: Sail a cursed, ever-changing sea in this pirate roguelite for 1–4 players. Explore islands, grab loot, upgrade your ship, and battle bizarre enemies. Work together to steer, fire cannons, and patch holes. Someone should probably grab a bucket.

details.title: Helios Horizon
details.short_description: Annihilate endless hordes of aliens in this action-packed sci-fi rogue-lite. Acquire a variety of firearms and upgrade your equipment to fulfill your mission.

details.title: Aeterna Lucis
details.short_description: Aeterna Lucis is our purest metroidvania yet and the sequel to Aeterna Noctis. Become the Queen of Light, explore a vast, hand-drawn interconnected world, awaken new powers and face epic bosses to stop the Supreme God Chaos.

details.title: Micron Survivor
details.short_description: Micron Survivor is a bullet heaven game where you play as alien microorganisms under the microscope. Evolve, unlock research objectives, find symbiotic weapons, upgrade your builds, and fight hordes of terrestrial organisms to rule the microcosm.

details.title: Trucker Joe 2
details.short_description: Transport various goods to companies with your truck! Expand your fleet with trucks and trailers to keep the industry running. In this mix of simulation and strategy, you decide where companies are built—plan wisely, shorten your routes, and dominate the logistics market!

details.title: Spirits: Wake Up!
details.short_description: SPIRITS: WAKE UP! is a 2–8 player online horror party game. Speak into your mic to chase as a Hunter, or float through retro sewers, complete tasks, and rescue friends as a Ghost. Just don't let your screams give you away!

details.title: Tidy Up the Christmas Market
details.short_description: It was supposed to be the best Christmas market of the year. But a fierce winter storm has thrown everything into disarray! Now it's up to you and your four-legged friend Frosty, to tidy up the mess and give the little village its Christmas back.

details.title: PULLFINITY
details.short_description: Open a pack, sell the cards, buy a faster machine. PULLFINITY is a pack-opening incremental with 300 cards in five sets. It starts with one pack on a felt table and ends with 500 packs in a single batch, and nothing you have pulled ever leaves your collection.

name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World

details.title: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
details.short_description: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

details.title: Square Seller!
details.short_description: Square Seller! is a relaxing incremental game where you run a tiny town square. Sell newspapers, grow your income, build new shops and unlock a huge skill tree to make your Square thrive.

details.title: UnepicTale
details.short_description: The dragon stole the princess, and now your path leads through dark forests and eerie swamps, teeming with fairy-tale creatures. Flip the card and prove you can handle the choice in the card game UnepicTale!

details.title: Escape the Walls
details.short_description: You're surrounded by walls. All you have on you is your hands. You have to punch your way through, no other choice.

details.title: Depthforged
details.short_description: Forge gear at the anvil, fit it into your heroes' packs, and send them down into the dark. A relaxing incremental dungeon crawler where every item reacts to its neighbours: place it well and your party grows stronger.

details.title: Hetero-Genesis
details.short_description: Build a living weapon in this deep-sea action roguelite. Choose your species, graft organs, and combine melee strikes, ranged fire, and strange synergies. Protect vital parts, survive waves and bosses, and evolve your body during each dive.

details.title: Get-Out-Hoomanz
details.short_description: A chaotic 2-4 player dungeon crawler! Sabotage your friends' dungeons with deadly traps, loot everything in sight, and escape the show alive. Can you survive your friends' hazards or just another human snack?

details.title: Crease
details.short_description: Fold the paper into shape. A cozy grid puzzler about creasing a sheet of paper until it matches the target exactly. 100+ levels, with fun mechanics.

details.title: Click Bait
details.short_description: Fight the internet’s worst monsters in a rhythm roguelite. Time your clicks on a spinning wheel to attack, block and survive chaotic minigames

details.title: Starforge Pirate
details.short_description: Starforge Pirate is a fast-paced arcade roguelite in which you will battle cosmic enemies, forge wild weapons, manage weapon heat, upgrade your ship, face deadly bosses, and chase the perfect run.

details.title: The Journey Home
details.short_description: Some answers can only be found by going within. In a world beyond the boundaries of time and space, your journey awaits. A stress-free atmospheric side-scrolling adventure.

details.title: All Rats on Deck
details.short_description: All Rats on Deck is an online co-op adventure game where you must navigate a paddle steam boat through dangerous waters. Forced to leave your home, you must work together to operate the boat, scour for resources, and overcome obstacles to reach the ocean.

details.title: SOMBRAS: negative frames
details.short_description: ‘SOMBRAS: negative frames’ is a first person narrative game with a focus on photography and light horror elements. Follow Shiomi, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, as she is spirited away in a dark mirror of her 2000s Japanese town and must confront fragments of her own psyche.

details.title: Sort Cats Together
details.short_description: A toy store full of cats needs sorting! Play solo or team up with friends in this cozy 1–4 player co-op game. Find 200 different cat designs, sort 4,000 toys onto their matching shelves, and unlock upgrades to turn a mountain of cats into a tidy collection.

details.title: Leave Them Outside
details.short_description: A life sim. Except you're in the real world. After the bombs fall, Shelter 38 beneath Kadıköy is yours to run. You decide who gets in, and you do whatever it takes to keep everyone inside alive. Multiple endings, shaped by your choices.

details.title: Blindfold Bash
details.short_description: Don't make a sound! Blindfold Bash is a hide-and-seek party game where the seeker is blindfolded and hunts by ear. Every creaky floorboard, squeaky toy and badly timed fart lights up their screen. Stay quiet, fool the seeker, sacrifice a friend. Play with friends or in public matches, 2-20 players.

details.title: THROWAWAY
details.short_description: Five people posted about their night shifts on an anonymous forum. Every one of them stopped posting at 3:17 AM. Work their shifts yourself in this PS1-style horror anthology and keep to the rules they left behind. Then someone starts a thread about you.

details.title: Alice: Defense
details.short_description: Alice: Defense is a roguelike tower defense game where heroes fight on their own. Recruit them with gold, place them on the board, and hold back waves of monsters. Uncover why the World Tree has changed in Story Mode, then push your limits in Infinity Mode with Relics, Augments and Abyss Contracts.

details.title: Mystical II: Forgotten Knowledge
details.short_description: Forgotten knowledge sleeps in five mystical realms. Buy the falling objects for a gold coin each, gather trios and pairs in your bag, then reveal them with the magnifier before a column overflows. 50 stages, 216 painted objects: a medieval puzzle game.

details.title: Clumsy Robot
details.short_description: A clumsy robot wants to prove he's useful. Walk him through 33 physics-based obstacle courses, from farms and offices to airports and banks. Carry fragile cargo, compete against ridiculous rivals, and fall in hilarious ways. Then challenge up to 7 friends in online races!

details.title: Snowcraft Multiplayer
details.short_description: The naughty elves' red team against Santa's blue team in a 20 v 20 online snowball battle! Wind up, throw, duck behind the snow walls and pack more snowballs. Play over Steam with friends from anywhere, or practise alone. Winter war has never been this fun!

details.title: Hair Stylist Simulator
details.short_description: Every client brings a photo. Match it with your scissors and clippers before time runs out, then shampoo, blow-dry and sweep up. Run your own salon, cut 8 different styles for 8 clients, and earn five stars. Cut too much and you can't put it back!

details.title: Food Fight Online
details.short_description: Join a team of food and wage war on a giant kitchen counter. Rev up, let go and splat your enemies with throws, or capture regions to take over the map. Pineapples, watermelons and more battle online in chaotic deathmatch and capture modes. Last team splatting wins!

details.title: Rail Rush Multiplayer
details.short_description: Dodge the trains. Ride the roofs. Never stop running. Race through a living city in a fast endless runner and go online with up to 50 players at once. Collect coins, upgrade your runner, complete challenges and see how far you can get before the next train hits.

details.title: Pimple Pop
details.short_description: Get up close. Really, really close. Squeeze pimples, scrape plaque, roll out earwax, pluck nose hairs and trim nails in 21 levels of ultra-detailed close-up work. Be gentle, be precise, and never touch the eardrum. Earn 3 stars on every level and unlock them all.

details.title: Chief? About That File...
details.short_description: Step into an atmospheric 1990s police archive. Inspect, classify, and organize 3,360 unique criminal dossiers, crack safes, and uncover crime syndicates in this immersive first-person archival detective simulator.

details.title: Clanker Town
details.short_description: A first-person horde shooter with an incremental upgrade tree. Tens of thousands of smart-home robots want your trailer. Shoot them down, sell their scrap off Dale's tailgate, and grow one nail gun into hubcaps, Black Cats, a propane slingshot and a lawnmower minigun.

details.title: Polish Liquor Store Tidy Up
details.short_description: Turn a chaotic delivery into neatly stocked shelves in a cozy Polish liquor store. Sort bottles, snacks and Christmas trinkets, tune the radio, befriend a ginger cat and uncover the little stories behind the shop. Take your time. One item at a time.

details.title: Stray Cloud: An Overcast Story
details.short_description: You are a cloud. A fairly small one, and the other clouds think that's hilarious. Swallow them, rain to buy upgrades and grow from one field to the whole Earth. Then drift on through the solar system, world by world, until you cover the Sun. A cozy, fully narrated incremental.

details.title: Titan Crew
details.short_description: Up to four players bring the MULE back into service: a 27-meter walking machine left in its depot for ten years. You cold-start it and fix it by hand, then walk it across an abandoned valley to move what its people cannot carry.

details.title: SimFarm
details.short_description: A 3D farm management game where crops grow with the weather and the soil. Choose how tight money gets: play relaxed, or face real costs, loans and the risk of going broke. You give the orders; tractors and harvesters do the work. Rotate cows, sheep and horses through paddocks.

details.title: Dumpster Gang
details.short_description: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

details.title: Holy Nest
details.short_description: Deep underground, where light has never been, live blind beetles. They know the world by sound, and by sound they know their god. A god game and colony sim with indirect control: the swarms live on their own, and you guide them with sound, touch and miracles. Your deeds decide what god you are.

details.title: KIRA: Composition for One Player
details.short_description: A 2D platformer where you explore an enchanted world, collect fragments of lost music, and piece them together into a composition. Help Kira bring music back to a city that has fallen silent.

name: Jewel Match Solitaire Winterscapes 4 - Collector's Edition

details.title: Jewel Match Solitaire Winterscapes 4 - Collector's Edition
details.short_description: Winter magic is in the cards! Bundle up for a Solitaire adventure across countless crafted levels and restore a glittering kingdom of ice and frost. Stand up to a scheming snowman, outrun a quick-footed hare and grab your mallet and pick to crack thick pack ice.

details.title: Ad Astra, Inc.
details.short_description: The hardest part about interstellar expansion isn't the technical cost, its the people. Exploit ecosystems, manipulate the masses, and conquer the intergalactic shadow market. Growth is mandatory -- ethics are not.

details.title: The Wrong Way Round
details.short_description: You’re trapped in a town where every way out brings you back from the other side. Explore with up to 5 friends, uncover the mystery and find a way home before the freezing fog takes over.

details.title: Dread of the Deep
details.short_description: Aim your beam, fire, and choose which side to leave in the dark. Fight overwhelming hordes and combine weapons into powerful builds. Shape your lighthouse with a sprawling talent tree, and uncover what waits beneath the waves.

details.title: The Cup: Creature Card Battler
details.short_description: A free creature card battler and roguelike deckbuilder with the dice printed on the cards. Draft real North American animals and a few cryptids, take THE ROAD alone or with the House at your side, or fight live 1v1 while the booth calls every roll.

details.title: San Bernardino
details.short_description: Join the San Bernardino neighborhood watch as you try to save your overpriced house from zombies and dinosaurs.

details.title: INDOORS: Trespasser
details.short_description: May 7th, 1951. Five days after the Alston family vanished inside their manor. Local policeman Lucas Smith, never returned from his investigation. Now, his son breaks in to continue the investigation in this short horror and detective escape room.

details.title: Tunnelborn
details.short_description: Dig for fossils under a volcano, one tile at a time. Nothing moves until you do — but then the lava creeps closer, your lamp burns lower, and something in the dark takes another step towards you…

name: Lost Key - The Path of Illumination

details.title: Lost Key - The Path of Illumination
details.short_description: An ancient order that protects a secret, kept hidden for centuries. An unexpected crime that causes you to be accused of the murder of a friend. Solve the mysteries and puzzles of a story full of esotericism to prove the truth about your innocence and hold the real murderer responsible.

details.title: While 1
details.short_description: Don't touch the walls. While 1 is a minimalist mouse-only action game centered around this simple concept. Create a loop around the level while avoiding obstacles synchronized to the music.

details.title: Rastergeist
details.short_description: A scrolling shooter where you build your own ship from a grid of parts, and every part can be shot off. Collect salvage, research heavier weapons, and fly two branching campaigns of 53 stages, or grow a ship one drafted part at a time in Endless Run, a roguelite with a daily leaderboard.

details.title: Minesweeper 2007
details.short_description: The future of minesweeper games we were promised. Minesweeper 2007 is a mine flagging puzzle game with new mechanics and a nostalgic 2000’s Frutiger Aero aesthetic. Flag your way through dozens of original puzzles, relax, and pretend it's still 2007…

details.title: One More Tower
details.short_description: This is a horde survival tower defense, I hope you'll like it! Expand the board, build towers, and hold out against the onslaught of enemies. How long can you survive? >:3

name: 第二公主的魔塔The magic tower of the second princess

details.title: 第二公主的魔塔The magic tower of the second princess
details.short_description: A minimalist portrait roguelike built for lightweight PC gaming. Build tag combos while enjoying mini-games like fishing, blind chess, and brawls. Play P2P duels with friends. Ultra-lightweight, code-drawn visuals, playable with just a mouse. Easy to learn, deeply strategic.

details.title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
details.short_description: The shadows are your ally. Return to the city as Garrett, master thief, in this remastered classic by Nightdive Studios. Pickpocket, prowl, and outsmart in a world where trust is a luxury and every stolen secret comes at a price.

name: Click the Stone: Active Incremental and Idler

details.title: Click the Stone: Active Incremental and Idler
details.short_description: Click the Stone is an incremental game about clicking a stone to receive rocks and coins that deliver incredible rewards. Build game-changing upgrade combos, and let your tribespeople join the fun. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

details.title: Debtrize
details.short_description: You're a debt collector tasked with tracking down everyone who owes a debt in the afterlife. Journey through grim lands full of dangerous creatures and old debts long overdue. Hunt. Kill. Negotiate. Not even death can save you from your debts.

details.title: FREDERICA: The Empty Altar
details.short_description: Meet Frederica, a young philosophy professor who challenges faith and authority in a Victorian-inspired fantasy empire. In this philosophical visual novel, debate the Goddess, morality, and civilization. She remembers what you say.

details.title: Office TD
details.short_description: Foil your co-worker's attempts to make you as useless as they are by arranging hapless teammates and ordinary office equipment in devious cubicle layouts to engineer the ultimate defense.

details.title: Whispering Eclipsia
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror detective thriller. Play as Inspector Keshav, investigate a mysterious murder, interrogate suspects, uncover disturbing evidence, and confront the terrifying secrets hidden within Woods Lane. But beware—some truths are better left buried.

details.title: Debauchery & Magic
details.short_description: In Haven, magic thrives and debauchery is strictly forbidden. Defy a ruthless new ruler as you and your friends quest, loot, party, and battle your way across the kingdom to bring freedom back to its people.

details.title: DeadPoly Desert
details.short_description: Use resources from the teleportation islands to build back in the desert, and attempt to reach even more distant worlds.

details.title: Amazing Slot Survivor (A.S.S.)
details.short_description: Spin the slot machine and see how powerful you'll become! Luck shapes your arsenal, but only skill keeps you alive in this high-stakes bullet heaven roguelite. Master unique weapons and destroy the Spawners summoning endless hordes, and push your luck to the limit.

details.title: Drift After Dark
details.short_description: Inspired by the golden era of Japanese street drifting and classic driving games, Drift After Dark is a laid-back, arcade-style downhill drifting experience built around one simple idea: enjoying the drive.

details.title: Jetski TD
details.short_description: Race against your friends in this PvP tower defense. Build and upgrade towers, ride your Monkey Jetski to haul gold from fish nodes, help other players defend — or quietly make things worse. First to clear a wave sets the pace for everyone.

details.title: Orbrix
details.short_description: Orbrix is a bullet heaven where you craft a unique build to defend against a swarm of bricks. Discover devastating synergies across 60+ upgrades. Survive 10 waves and bosses, then push your build to absurd limits in endless mode. Plus, there are alien pets!

name: Wanderer Wheels - A Road Trip Trading Game

details.title: Wanderer Wheels - A Road Trip Trading Game
details.short_description: Take a cozy road trip home in your van, turning it into a mobile shop to trade goods along the way. Explore scenic roads, discover charming small towns, eat, refuel, and camp as you travel. Trade and earn enough money to pay for your wife's treatment before you reach home.

details.title: Contrail Blazer
details.short_description: A side-view airplane game. Circle items or enemy attacks with your contrail to make them yours. A planet slowly freezing over. Fly at a relaxed pace through rusted ruins and winter landscapes. Missions run about 3 minutes, controller only. Free to play.

details.title: Akashic Slingshot
details.short_description: One weapon. One health. One ███.

details.title: No Such Person
details.short_description: 一款以清末民初的上海为时代背景的社会派推理游戏。你在一台历史悬案核查终端前接手这项任务：为墙中无名遗骸重建家族谱系。翻阅泛黄的婚书、讣告与老照片，看清旧秩序崩塌之际每个人的选择与挣扎。

details.title: Ex Death Game
details.short_description: 100 ex-boyfriends. One luxury cruise. A deadly reckoning at sea. Play as Su Wei, design lethal trials, and decide each ex’s punishment. As Chopin’s waltzes play, expose their lies, watch alliances crumble, and make every betrayal come due.

details.title: Billiard Cat
details.short_description: Cats love knocking things off tables. What if it's a pool table? Missed a shot? A cat might just nudge the ball in for you. Then again, it might get in your way. Between turns, pet them, play with a cat teaser, or let one nap on your lap. 8-ball, 9-ball, and snooker for 1–4 players.

details.title: Cat Chaos Tidy Up
details.short_description: Cat Chaos Tidy Up is a cozy organizing game support 1-4 players coop! Pick up 4,800 adorable cat toys, sort them onto the right shelves, earn money, and unlock powerful abilities to tidy up the entire shop.

details.title: Space Supermarket Chaos
details.short_description: Gravity clocked out. You didn't. Tidy a zero-gravity supermarket solo or in co-op with up to 8 players. Catch floating goods, sort them onto shelves, and unlock and upgrade sci-fi tools. Turn drifting clutter into satisfying order, one item at a time.

details.title: Diggems
details.short_description: Diggems is a first-person incremental mining game. Smash gems into chain reactions, turn the loot into better gear, and watch your Grand Hall fill up as your pets haul it all home.

details.title: Dice Brawl
details.short_description: Dice Brawl is a dice customization roguelite map crawler game. Progress through different areas defeating enemies to unlock additional customization options. With different die face actions, rarities, and modifiers, dice customization has never been so rewarding. Roll for your destiny!

details.title: Ad Iterum
details.short_description: Ad Iterum is a turn-based top-down 2D roguelike set in a decaying, ever-shifting world. Flesh is fragile, but you can hack it. Enhance your body, embrace mutations, or form ancient blood pacts. Descend into the depths, scavenge what’s left of humanity, and crawl back...if you can. Kill. Die. Repeat.

details.title: Sooooooooooo: Strike, Scream, Run!
details.short_description: Your microphone is your weapon! Play online with up to 8 players, scream to attack, kick your friends, dodge your rivals, and unleash chaos with ridiculous power-ups and unpredictable matches. Grab your mic and let out your best Sooooooooooo!

details.title: Hexa-Gone
details.short_description: Pieces are falling, and you need to do something about it! Match like colors together to clear them, and if you make a shape, you’ll earn some points. Points are your score in Singleplayer modes, and are used as a currency in Multiplayer modes. Use them to buy Power-Ups and make a comeback!

details.title: SearchBattle
details.short_description: Search, turned into a battle. SearchBattle is a word party game for 1–8 players on a real search engine. Everyone searches one word for the same topic; hit counts and results decide the winner. Across many rules, what's tested isn't knowledge but "search power." What would you search?

details.title: Duck Duck Shoot!
details.short_description: A top-down 2D Survivors-like where you play as a chicken! Face hordes of menacing poultry and collect powerful upgrades in an attempt to get stronger. Fight bosses, choose your own upgrades, and bring a couple together? Get ready to Duck Duck Shoot!

details.title: FallChess: Wizard's Chess
details.short_description: Mount, move, and command chess pieces in a fully 3D duel. Choose your character, ride your piece across the board, and face your opponents up close. Capture pieces, outmaneuver your enemies, and experience chess like never before, brought to life in first-person action.

details.title: Endless War: Defense
details.short_description: Endless War: Defense returns with new missions, improved UI and modern resolutions support. Take command of fortified positions across WWII’s most iconic battlefields. Build defenses, deploy reinforcements, and let your army do the job or take direct control of any unit to turn the tide.

details.title: The Heroic Tale of Illumina: 0
details.short_description: The great world tree, Yggdrasil, has long stood watch over the world, providing shelter and bounty for its people. However, the arrival of Dark Lord Asmodeus has Yggdrasil and the world at large on the brink of ruin.

details.title: Universe of the Damned
details.short_description: The Year is 2150 and Earth is on the brink of collapse. Humans have resorted to colonizing other planets to prevent their demise. The EFS received a distress call from one of their colonies on Mars. An elite unit is sent down to the surface to find out what has happened.

details.title: BONKABIND
details.short_description: Ever forgotten how to shoot in the middle of a gunfight? In BONKABIND, players can swap each other's keyboard and mouse controls! One round you're a sharpshooter. The next, you're running backward, crouching by accident, and wondering where your shoot button went.

details.title: Fate Dungeon
details.short_description: Chained inside pitch-black torture chambers with only a dying lantern. Listen to the dark, learn each entity's deadly taboo—flash light to repel, douse it to hide, bleed your own wrist for oil, and counter-strike to shatter your chains across five distinct cultural nightmares.

details.title: 桂冠之人 Laureate
details.short_description: “世间仅此一件的视觉小说，一件没什么用，却又独一无二的艺术品。”

details.title: Baked Blocks
details.short_description: 《Baked Blocks》 is a single-player grid-based puzzle game with an animal cookie theme. It features 210 puzzles across seven chapters, 30 of which have two or three different ways to solve them, allowing you to create different finished photos from the same box of cookies.

details.title: 九州之士
details.short_description: 战国时代背景，剧情向 RPG 为主，融合大战略玩法。战国时代九州大地列国纷争，百姓流离，原本一介庶民的你，陷入了一场巨大的阴谋中，被亲情、友情与仇恨交织裹挟，踏上了拯救自己与万民苍生的旅途。

details.title: Tilemancer
details.short_description: Build a deck of the dead, solve battles disguised as tactical board puzzles, and defeat an even more evil version of yourself, again and again.

details.title: Farmed & Dangerous
details.short_description: Not another farming game. Plant by night, then defend your crops from dawn to dusk in a first-person roguelite shooter, solo or in 3-player online co-op. Blast crop-hungry crows out of the sky with shotguns, turrets, air strikes and the occasional RPG. Miss the truck's order and the run is over.

details.title: Prison Queen
details.short_description: In a world ruled by sharp tongues, one slip of the lip lands young Odette behind bars. Steal words from your fellow inmates, chain them into razor-sharp sentences, and talk your way up the prison food chain. Here, every sentence is a weapon.

details.title: Et le grain mourut
details.short_description: A visual novel set in 1920s Paris. As summer draws near, young students are revising their end-of-year exams. Olivier is one of them.

details.title: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival
details.short_description: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival is a cultivation survival game built around card-based interactions. Trapped in a mysterious realm that drains your lifespan but brims with spirit power, you must cultivate, survive, fight, and find a way to escape.

details.title: PLANETOON
details.short_description: Grab planets, place them into orbit, and grow a galaxy in this space puzzle game. Watch life and civilizations emerge, encounter UFOs and black holes, and discover over 60 endings across 12 billion years of cosmic surprises.

details.title: ODD HAUL
details.short_description: Pack your bag, discover powerful item synergies, and chase higher scores in a cozy, cat-filled strategy game. Arrange your loot, unlock clever combinations, shop for upgrades, and see how far your journey takes you!

details.title: The Aether Project TD
details.short_description: Place and upgrade towers to defend your objective. Use abilities and the terrain to hold back advancing enemies.

details.title: Sea Beast Odyssey
details.short_description: An incremental action adventure across the seas. Lead 5 Heroes into battle, upgrade your team and mounts, unlock 16 powerful skills, and build your Skill Tree across 35 levels of sea monsters. Defeat giant bosses and tame them as mounts!

details.title: Fishy Business
details.short_description: A story-driven adventure where you captain a fishing boat. Explore a strange island, catch fish, trade and collect records of classical music.

details.title: Board Kingdom
details.short_description: 24 board games in one kingdom. Play Chess, Go, Xiangqi, Shogi, Reversi, Mancala and more against computer opponents. Learn new rules, pick your challenger and build a record in every game.

details.title: MEMOLOGY: THE 2000's
details.short_description: MEMOLOGY: THE 2000's is a quiz about the objects and events we’ll never forget. Test how well you remember the games, internet culture, music, technology, memes, and other symbols of that unforgettable era.

details.title: The Last Opening
details.short_description: You are dead. To return, you must survive 40 nights in the woods, making brutal choices by day and playing chess against Death each night. The forest is cold. The nights are long. Win, and you may see the dawn. Lose… and the world forgets you.

details.title: Christmas TCG Tidy Up Together
details.short_description: Tidy up nearly 5,000 festive trading cards scattered across the floor of a Christmas TCG store, solo or with up to two friends online. Clean your finds and complete 15 festive sets in regular and holo finishes. Earn coins for boosters packs, hunt for exclusive rare cards.
