A few of you work the night shift as janitors, chefs, and more, and have until the clock runs out to catch everyone.

details.title: Guns of Eschaton
details.short_description: This soulslike FPS pulls you into an apocalyptic Western by the legendary Viktor Antonov: a land of dust, blood, and horror. Study your enemies, count your bullets, forge your own style with gunpowder and prayers. Solo or in co-op—go West, gunslinger, go West and die with the country!

details.title: Infinity Card Battle
details.short_description: A card duel in deep space – free forever: 140+ cards, five factions, one market table. Build your fleet, buy and scrap cards, charge abilities and break the enemy hull. 1v1, 3+ or campaign. Alpha – feedback welcome.

details.title: Buttracers
details.short_description: Race gigantic, jiggling butts with tiny jockeys clinging on for dear life in this kart racer. Blast rivals with plunger missiles, compete in 4-player split-screen, then dress, wash and oil your champion in the Full Service Bay. It's cheek-to-cheek competition.

details.title: Worker: 7549
details.short_description: 7549 was produced as one of the worker-class servants. It continued to take orders from the humans who created it until the mine transformed from a peaceful workplace into a stronghold of rebellion.

details.title: Pipfiend: The Demonic Domino Deckbuilder
details.short_description: Build a deck of dominoes, chain together powerful combos, and break the rules in Pipfiend, a roguelike deckbuilder packed with strange enemies, dangerous synergies, and countless ways to shape your run.

details.title: Tiny Industry
details.short_description: A relaxing automation game where building a factory stays simple. Create production lines, connect your buildings, and unlock new technologies without worrying about ratios. Just ask yourself one question: What does this item need?

details.title: Always With You: Meow & Mystery
details.short_description: "Always with you" is a cute and relaxing action-puzzle game. Switch freely between controlling a girl and a cat, solve clever puzzles, explore the ancient Alto civilization, and defeat unruly guardians. Embark on an exciting adventure with three cats to find your mother!

details.title: SNAKEPIT [USA]
details.short_description: A short puzzle game about comparing URL vs. IRL

details.title: Town of Puzzles
details.short_description: A cozy match-3 puzzle RPG. Drag one gem, chain the colors and watch the board go off like fireworks while 42 neighbors with psychic Echo powers fight the creatures crawling out of the fracture in the middle of town.

details.title: King Dies Rich
details.short_description: Defend your throne against undead hordes in a pixel-art siege roguelite. Aim your attacks without leaving your seat, hunt legendary gear, and combine seven schools of power. Turn your spoils into permanent kingdom upgrades. The king will not survive the siege. His gold will.

details.title: Mochi Cats
details.short_description: Rotate and drop pairs of squishy cats, merge matching cats into bigger chonks, and keep grumpy cats apart in this cozy physics puzzle. Chase high scores, unlock new looks, or compete in Battle Mode with friends and players online.

details.title: Go Long!
details.short_description: A 1-8 player floppy physics sports game. Play catch with your friends, then ruin the friendship in four 3v3 ball sports with banana peels, a very nosy dog and a giant boss at halftime. Win fake money. Gamble it on hats.

details.title: FlowerBots
details.short_description: Flowerbots is an incremental game you can play in active or idle modes. Upgrade bots. Balance harvesting and planting. Explore synergies. Crush anomalies. And watch your plan unfold as the numbers go up.

details.title: Whispers Of The Shadow
details.short_description: After a report comes in about Detective Grace Lawson’s missing stepsister, Amy, two officers head to an abandoned house. When Grace arrives, she finds one of them dead and suddenly becomes trapped inside. But something else is waiting for her.

details.title: Bonded in Darkness
details.short_description: Fall in love with your worst enemy in this gothic vampire romance BL visual novel about two men pushed to the edges of society learning to trust each other.

details.title: Rule of Iron: Dark Age
details.short_description: Build your realm in a turn-based campaign. Command your armies in real-time battles.

details.title: Plinko Mining
details.short_description: Drop pickaxes, mine resources, and grow your mining empire! Plinko Mining is a relaxing incremental idle game where axes bounce through rocks, extracting valuable resources with every hit. Unlock new axes, increase your production, and expand your Skill Tree to become a mining master!

details.title: The Glued
details.short_description: The peg doll faces from your childhood bedroom reappear at every turn. Struggle to find a path forward through your own personal hell in this bleak visual novel with light puzzles and point-and-click elements.

details.title: Ittzy Fearless
details.short_description: Ittzy Fearless is a difficult physics-based action game. Play as Ittzy the fire spirit and use your swift moves and devastating strikes to tackle chaotic waves of enemies, projectiles and explosions.

details.title: BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy
details.short_description: Listen up, comrade! Tired of feeling like a terrible chess player? Ditch the flashy modern tools. My routine is simple: I teach you a sharp concept, you apply it in a puzzle, then I unveil the secret twist. Survive my training, and become a true Chess Master!

details.title: Barnburners
details.short_description: Old school 5 on 5 Arcade hockey! Lay big hits, deke through the defense, and score top shelf! Pick from 24 teams, build your Franchise, create your own Pro, or play against your friends locally or online!

details.title: CATLINES
details.short_description: You're part of the sorting service, it's your final day on the job! Build your way through different worlds, use your skills, and deliver 8,196 cat-boxes to their owners. Drink milk, enjoy chocolate mint, sort every last cat-box

details.title: Okerum
details.short_description: Okerum is a fantasy card game of melds, bluffs and abilities. Play five modes (Okerum, Okerum 101, Slapi, Solus and ReFa) against friends, online rivals or clever bots, and turn the table with powers like Freeze, Shield and Energy Thief.

details.title: Elements Destiny
details.short_description: Use the power of the elements and face your destiny. Elements Destiny is a 2D Fantasy RPG with pixelated retro visuals. An emotional journey with a deep story, challenging turn based combat and handcrafted artworks. And yes, the soundtrack is massive!

details.title: Duckload
details.short_description: 1,000,000 rubber ducks have been dumped deep in a mountain forest. Alone. Scared. Squeaky. Ship every last duck downstream for cash. Start with your bare hands and scale up across a massive upgrade tree to increase your duck harvesting power!

details.title: Deck Forge
details.short_description: Forge a deck, carve your path. A dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder: five classes, 375+ original cards, deadly relics, branching trails that never play out the same way twice, and online co-op for up to four. Every run is a new gauntlet — die, learn, build deadlier.

details.title: Knock Twice
details.short_description: Queens, 1974. Something in Garland Court knocks twice, and it can only come in if you answer. It wears your neighbours' voices. Check the peephole, count the shadows, keep the chain on. Five apartments, three years of the building's past, thirty-two endings.

details.title: Beyond The Blight
details.short_description: A short first person, 2.5d incremental dungeon-crawler where you loot, upgrade, and grow stronger on the quest to find and defeat the source of the blight.

details.title: Circuit Brakers
details.short_description: Circuit Brakers is a kart racing game about robots, physics and a lot of customisation. Build a robot, choose your items, and race with up to 8 players across a variety of bizarre tracks! With mechanics that are easy to learn but hard to master, can you become the champion robot racer?

details.title: Desktop Buddy
details.short_description: Desktop buddy is an active sandbox companion game where you can paint, shoot, crush and decorate your very own ragdoll on your desktop. Use familiar paint tools to fully customize your desktop buddy to your liking so you can treat it well, or don't.

details.title: Dead Hand
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are both your actions and your resources. Play them to act now, keep them to last longer. There is never enough for both.

details.title: Don't Fret
details.short_description: A sentient guitar trapped inside a nightmare music school. Hide, distract, and survive horrifying creatures as you tune your way through musical puzzles and fractured memories to uncover the truth.

details.title: FotFoot
details.short_description: Run a football club your way: sign stars, set your tactics and change the game from the touchline as the big moments play out live on a 2D pitch. Over 4,200 clubs, 110,000 players and 158 countries, from the lowest divisions to the world stage, in a world that never stops moving.

details.title: Pick The Suspect
details.short_description: A cozy puzzle game about finding one person in a crowd. Read the note, check the clues and wave at the right person. Pick the wrong one and they just wave back. 100 levels across 10 places, from a quiet town square to a busy night carnival.

details.title: Click or Wait
details.short_description: An idle and clicker game about a machine that is never finished. Build seesaws and mills and let items fall through them: every single piece with real physics. Decide for yourself whether you click, wait or let the machines work. Plus a Teamwork mode with a shared monthly goal.

details.title: A Gift for Everyone
details.short_description: New Year's is almost here! A mountain of gifts is piled up under a giant Christmas tree, with a toy in every box. Start with your bare mittens, sell the toys to Father Frost, hire a dwarf and mechanical arms, bring up to three friends and keep going until the last box is open. All 100,000 of them.

details.title: RATS
details.short_description: Hide from your friends in the dark. Find the parts, feed the terminal and get out, while one or two of them hunt you by sound as one of nine killers. No markers, no waypoints: only your torch, your phone and what you hear.

details.title: SqueeGee: Window Cleaning Simulator
details.short_description: SqueeGee is a cozy window cleaning game where you ride a gondola up towering skyscrapers and make every pane sparkle. Spray, squeegee and scrape away the grime, upgrade your gear, unlock abilities and robot helpers, and spot sightings from the top in a no pressure, no rush world.

details.title: Pickle Factory
details.short_description: Grow cucumbers, pickle them and sell jars to tourists from Warsaw, then ship them by the pallet. A first-person business sim from rural Poland. Your uncle left you a pickle works, a radio stuck on disco polo and a 400 zloty debt to Rysiek. Due Friday.

details.title: AI Says
details.short_description: A rage game where you control your character only through an AI chat. No WASD. The AI can't see the deadly test chambers, but you can. Give precise instructions or die trying.

details.title: Chad Billionaire
details.short_description: Start broke. Work terrible jobs. Put that cash to work in real estate, businesses, stocks, acquisitions, and crypto until working for money becomes somebody else's problem. The numbers are exaggerated. The financial logic underneath them isn't.

details.title: Elf Delivery
details.short_description: Wrap gifts, load Santa's sleigh and sneak presents down chimneys – while waves of soot goblins try to steal Christmas. A cute but chaotic third-person action game with candy canes, rifles, a candy rocket launcher and one score that lasts the whole run.

details.title: Siege of Akanor
details.short_description: A castle defense you fight in person. Between waves you spend your gold on swordsmen, archers, traps and barricades; when the horn sounds you take the field yourself, sword and bow in hand. Solo, in co-op for up to four, or from the horde's side.

details.title: Motkin
details.short_description: Charge pistons, grow bridges, and turn gravity sideways. Guide Motkin, a one-wheeled maintenance robot, through 75 handcrafted physics puzzles by clicking the machinery around him and figuring out how its parts work together.

details.title: Club XV: Rugby Manager
details.short_description: Take charge of a rugby club in a management simulation. Recruit players, develop young talent, manage your squad and shape your tactics. Watch your team compete in 3D matches as you build your club for long-term success.

details.title: Rocco’s Card Shop
details.short_description: Rip open packs, pull Golden cards and turn Rocco's tiny card shop into an empire. Flip cards on a live market, grade your best, run the auction house, dodge the loan shark, then close up shop and come back bigger. One more pack. Just one more.

details.title: Just One More Load
details.short_description: Swing a magnet crane over a cartoon scrapyard, grab as much junk as your battery allows and drop it in the press for combo cash. Grow a 250-node skill tree, collect 17 magnet heads, clear five yards and tell yourself: just one more load.

details.title: Unknown Caller
details.short_description: The ghost never lies. Your friends do. Answer the phone, hear what she wants, then lie your way out of it. Mystery boxes, bombs, poisoned wine and terrible luck. 2-8 players with voice chat. Last one alive wins.

details.title: IRONWOUND
details.short_description: The colony is still working. It just doesn't need humans. IRONWOUND is a dark sci-fi run-and-gun with brutal weapons, biomechanical bosses, and 21 combat operations. Burn through the swarm, fight aboard an armored train, and take to the skies with a metal-and-phonk soundtrack.

details.title: The Altar Boy Adventures
details.short_description: Step into the shoes of Józef, a young man and altar server in a Polish village. Repair electronic equipment, prepare the sacristy for Mass, and help your neighbors. Experience a unique and moving adventure centered around liturgical service.

details.title: Crash Sequence
details.short_description: Crash-landed alone on an alien world, you survive by sequencing alien bacteria, building custom plasmids, and engineering living cultures for oxygen, food and power. A turn-based sci-fi RPG / strategy simulation where your choices shape how the story ends.

details.title: Mercenary Survivors
details.short_description: Your mercenaries are your weapons in this horde-survival action game. Dodge monsters while your company fights, then hire, train and promote with each level. Lead 22 careers through 30 stages, defeat their guardians and build lasting strength with 28 relics.

details.title: CTRL+ALT+BURN
details.short_description: Keep the company online. Avoid the boss. CTRL+ALT+BURN is a chaotic co-op IT game for 1 to 6 players: reboot crashed servers, swap dead disks, answer the helpdesk, put out the microwave fire and climb a 60-floor office tower, one shift at a time.

name: BOO & BONES: Bring the Village Back to Life

details.title: BOO & BONES: Bring the Village Back to Life
details.short_description: A relaxing first-person game about sorting bones and bringing a ghost village back to life. Rebuild skeletons, awaken spectral powers and watch your growing community organise its own games, dances and celebrations.

details.title: Immortum
details.short_description: A story-driven sci-fi horror inspired by classic horror. Trapped in a decaying spaceship, escape mind-bending traps, navigate shifting realities, solve puzzles, and uncover an impossible truth — as Romi, a mother desperate to find her dying child. Can you discover the truth before you’re erased?

details.title: Pubes
details.short_description: A 3D action game where you control a strand of body hair and move around a 3D room! Use the unique fluffy floating and sticking abilities of body hair to safely reach your destination!

details.title: Pachinko Mayhem
details.short_description: Pachinko Mayhem brings arcade ball-drops and Japanese pachinko to your screen with wild roguelite builds: a serious machine full of chaotic balls. Early Access launches with 3 core machines, expanding to 6 bespoke physical toys. Cash out safely, or break the bank?

details.title: Miraclawns
details.short_description: A unique roguelite strategy where you strengthen slimes through gambling. As the Demon King, use fate-altering bets to boost your small slimes' stats and deploy them to the frontlines. Will your judgment or overwhelming "luck" overcome the brutal battlefield?

details.title: Temple of Glyphs
details.short_description: No text, no tutorials—only glyphs and puzzles. Decipher the true meaning behind every enigmatic symbol, connect tiles to reshape the world, and uncover the secrets of the ancient temple.

details.title: Blacksmith of sword master ~ IDLE ~
details.short_description: ■ Your Own Little Forge, Right on Your Desktop[BoS] Blacksmith of Sword Master ~IDLE~ is an idle RPG that runs in a small corner of your desktop.No matter what you're doing, the training never stops.Start with a humble forge and rise to become the greatest martial arts master!

details.title: Old School Golf
details.short_description: Master the swing, shape your shots, and sink the putt in a retro arcade golf game featuring 14 unique courses, dynamic weather, tournaments, and a full season career.

details.title: Definitely Safe
details.short_description: Put rockets together from scrap parts, pack the powder, cut the fuse and see what happens. Film every flight. Upload your footage, chase views, and climb the charts. Totally legal. Definitely safe.

details.title: Achievement Clicker Pro
details.short_description: Unlock 100 achievements as you smash targets, reduce their health, and upgrade your hammer! Keep clicking, get stronger, and collect them all in Achievement Clicker 2026 Pro!

details.title: Dragon Guardians
details.short_description: Raise and evolve your own dragons in this roguelike action RPG. Build a deck of rare power cards, defeat epic bosses across dangerous lands and protect your village from the Dark Lord. Every run makes your dragon stronger.

details.title: ASANA Visual Novel
details.short_description: A sci-fi dark comedy visual novel with English voices. Build your stats, choose branching routes, and try live AI conversations and persuasion challenges as Captain Asana. N.E.K.O., your judgmental cat-shaped ship AI, has opinions. He is still not impressed.

details.title: Perfectly Folded
details.short_description: Perfectly Folded is a cozy organizing game in a clothing store the cats have wrecked. Fold, hang and shelve every shirt, hat and shoe, catch the cats hiding in plain sight, then hire them to help you tidy up.

details.title: GAEKGWI
details.short_description: A first-person horror game rooted in Korean folklore. Navigate a village whose paths change with each visit. Learn how its ghosts hunt, conserve your lantern oil, and use charms and ritual tools to escape danger—or fight back.

details.title: Moon Zero
details.short_description: Moon Zero is a fast-paced 2D space runner where you pilot a rocket through 18 increasingly difficult stages. Dodge dangerous obstacles, collect coins, unlock rocket skins, compete on leaderboards, and create your own maps. Can you survive the 2,000,000-mile journey?

details.title: SUPERPANEL
details.short_description: SUPERPANEL is a hardcore tactical shooter with high lethality for solo players or groups of friends. Customize your gear and squads, take on dangerous missions through urban labyrinths, and fight your way to the heart of Megaslavia. Enemies are both humans and monsters.

details.title: Rock Racer GOLD
details.short_description: Rock Racer GOLD, Is A (1 To 4 Player), Old-school Battle Racer Game. challenge your friends to the ultimate race circuit, and see who is the best racer. Then verify you are still the best whenever the challenge arises with infinite replay ability.

details.title: Abyss Haul
details.short_description: A relaxing incremental fishing simulation, until you dive too deep. Catch fish, sell haul, and upgrade your gear as you descend through glowing waters. Track down legendary creatures, explore increasingly strange depths, collect absurd treasures. It's just a game, no real animal were harmed.

details.title: Meowward
details.short_description: Build a tower to rescue a cat stranded on the Moon! Chop trees, turn logs into wooden blocks and upgrade your equipment. Play solo or with friends, climb onto each other's shoulders and carve your own decorations. A cozy building sandbox with one very important cat.

details.title: MAR: Millions Are Rising
details.short_description: Millions of monsters are escaping the hole. Stop them with a unique arsenal of towers, nukes, and deep upgrades in this incremental tower defense game.

details.title: Pages of Tomorrow
details.short_description: Challenge fate in this psychological visual novel about a juvenile psych ward patient who discovers a book that can predict the future.

details.title: InOut
details.short_description: A minimalist puzzle platformer where each level is more than they seem. Change your perspective on levels to discover new areas. Explore the world to unearth its hidden secrets.

details.title: Tiny RTS
details.short_description: Tiny RTS is a Real-time strategy in crisp pixel art. Lead humans, orcs, elves or dwarves through three ages, raise heroes, clear monster camps for relics and fight online, with friends or against the computer. Build your own maps, scenarios and campaigns in the editor.

details.title: Wonderfall
details.short_description: Paris, 1920. The city is collapsing into sand. Play as Léon, an orphan able to manipulate sand, as you explore a reimagined Paris consumed by Entropy. A story-rich narrative adventure where exploration reveals what happened to the city and what still lies beneath its ruins.

details.title: HavenCraft
details.short_description: Build a Safe Haven! An alchemy accident has devastated the mainland and the people are looking for a new home. Take the lead and rebuild society, house by house. HavenCraft is a third-person town builder and management game, playable in single- and multiplayer.

details.title: Iwanu Ga Hana
details.short_description: Everyone in Shiomachi has a line they swallowed. At midnight, time stops and those words become monsters. Live a whole school year, forge 17 bonds, and in the Mute Hour fight to make your friends say what they never could. A stylish JRPG about the things we don't say.

details.title: Vestige Idle
details.short_description: Kill monsters, get loot & level up in Vestige Idle - a fantasy ARPG in Idle form. Build your character by obtaining powerful and unique items, by leveling up and spending Skill Points across multiple trees and by unlocking major systems like The Forge, The Guild, The Market and more.

details.title: A Chat with Naila
details.short_description: A Chat with Naila is a psychological horror visual novel disguised as a casual encounter. Grab a warm cup of coffee, sit down, and enjoy a nice conversation. Sounds great, right? I mean, what could go wrong anyway...?

details.title: A-Train 9 PRIME LINE
details.short_description: The ultimate edition of the city-building simulation game A-Train 9! As the president of a railway company, build the city of your dreams through city building and railway management. A-Train 9 PRIME LINE takes city building beyond evolution, delivering the ultimate city-building experience.

details.title: Sugar Lies
details.short_description: That love tastes like a sweet lie. A young man who hates lies. A girl who lives by them. A short visual novel about a classic summer boy-meets-girl romance.

details.title: FEDA : The Emblem of Justice
details.short_description: Three classic titles released by Yanoman in the early 1990s return for the modern era! Features tactical RPG FEDA, exhilarating action game Trinea, and classic RPG Song Master. Enjoy their iconic pixel art and sound with enhanced, smooth gameplay. A must-have collection for retro fans!

details.title: Trinea
details.short_description: Three classic titles released by Yanoman in the early 1990s return for the modern era! Features tactical RPG FEDA, exhilarating action game Trinea, and classic RPG Song Master. Enjoy their iconic pixel art and sound with enhanced, smooth gameplay. A must-have collection for retro fans!

details.title: Song Master
details.short_description: Three classic titles released by Yanoman in the early 1990s return for the modern era! Features tactical RPG FEDA, exhilarating action game Trinea, and classic RPG Song Master. Enjoy their iconic pixel art and sound with enhanced, smooth gameplay. A must-have collection for retro fans!

details.title: Dwarfspire
details.short_description: Dwarfspire is an idle shopkeeper that sits on the edge of your screen. Manage a shop of hand crafted gear while sending expeditions of dwarves up mountains to gather rare materials and forge new items. Mine ore, craft items and become a master shopkeeper!

details.title: Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded
details.short_description: Throw, hit, and brawl! The legendary 90s arcade beat 'em up combining baseball and martial arts returns in HD! Packed with new characters, modes, stages, and music, plus up to 4-player co-op!

details.title: Adventures in tower defence land
details.short_description: Go on an epic tower defence adventure, collect rare parts, and craft the ultimate combination of towers, while meeting silly characters on your way.

name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam

details.title: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
details.short_description: A new adventure in Professor Layton, the puzzle-filled fantasy adventure series that has sold over 20 million copies worldwide. Professor Layton and Luke find themselves drawn into a mysterious case in Steam Bison, a remarkable town of invention powered by steam engine technology.

details.title: uaanb mous : Figure Skating
details.short_description: Grow your skater and present a stage that is all your own. Choose your skills, dress for the ice and perform across rinks around the world, alone or with friends.

details.title: NICO DRAW
details.short_description: Your doodle just got up and ran. Draw legs, arms or wings with limited ink and take your creation through 45 stages in a hand-drawn 2D puzzle platformer. Play solo, with two on one PC, or with up to four online.

details.title: Table Tennis Manager 27
details.short_description: A table tennis management game. Take a small club from the bottom of the league to a world title: run the league team that pays the bills and the players chasing the World Tour, read every match stroke by stroke, and raise a fifteen-year-old into a world champion.

details.title: Debt Crystal Adventure
details.short_description: Fear creates strong will—and “they” are watching. They offer contracts: wishes come true, but debt follows. Meow Meow signed out of fear of poverty; Awo Awo chose the chains. No call to save the world—just an adventurer repaying debt, uncovering deeper rules through quests and choices.

details.title: AFTERMATH: Bunker Trader
details.short_description: A simulation game where your bunker becomes the safe space survivors need. Trade and craft items - organize them in storage. Scavenge the surface yourself and hire personnel to send on expeditions. Become the ultimate trading hub in this post-apocalyptic world.

details.title: shatAAAAp!
details.short_description: Exponentially bigger waves of cute animals require increasingly absurd means of destruction. Shoot, burn, electrocute, explode... and make sure no one ever helps you.

name: Braveforce: The Lost Dominion of the Void

details.title: Braveforce: The Lost Dominion of the Void
details.short_description: A retro-inspired RPG that blends classic simplicity with modern convenience.

details.title: How to Hunt
details.short_description: A 1-4 player physics-based hunting simulator. While relaxing and off-roading at camp, you suddenly trash your ride deep in the wilderness. To upgrade your gear and work your way back home, you have to learn How to Hunt.

details.title: Gutter Scrap
details.short_description: Bolt a war machine together from trash in this mech shooter. Then take your city back from the scrap dealer who crowned himself General. Nine districts, nine bosses, 41 parts to mix and match, and a mech that can dance.

details.title: Chicken Origins
details.short_description: Chicken Origins is a cozy incremental game about one very special chicken. Wash eggs for double the price, build coops and barns, hire sellers and catch Golden Eggs for big bonuses, watch every building you buy appear on your farm, and reach the stars! Multiple endings are waiting for you!

details.title: OneMore
details.short_description: Can you tell which definitions are fake and which aren't? OneMore combines traditional word-building games with rounds where you try to pick the one true definition out of four - three of them built by an AI.

details.title: Ultracapitalism
details.short_description: Ultracapitalism is a company-building roguelike autobattler where cash is your health and debt is your weapon. Assemble a 10-slot board of corporate assets, customize synergies with buzzwords, and auto-battle rival founders in deterministic asynchronous boardroom combat.

details.title: Deeper Still
details.short_description: A hard immersive sim set in a dystopian and nihilistic world. To complete each level, start with a plan by choosing weapons, paths and abilities. Die. Find a better plan. Die again. Repeat until you finish the level. Then replay the levels to find new creative ways to beat them. Co-op mode included.

details.title: Books & Blood
details.short_description: Survive in a post-apocalyptic bookstore in this horror game. Fetch books for your customers to complete your daily quota. Explore the abandoned bookstore, and don't get caught by the horrors stalking the shelves.

details.title: World League Football
details.short_description: A football manager with stands that remember you. Take over a club, or start with its youth or second team. Protest on the touchline, face the press, get sent to the stands. Chase the 128-club World League or play Classic leagues and cups.

details.title: Protect the President
details.short_description: A night-time tower defense auto-battler where you protect the President at all costs. Draft cards to deploy defenses, switch to night vision or thermal, take over a gun and fire it yourself, and grow your command between runs.

details.title: Borderfall
details.short_description: Pick any country and fight a real time war on a real world map, solo or in online multiplayer with friends and strangers. Push the front, build, sign pacts, take vassals and trade hydrogen bombs. Play through plenty of historical scenarios while bots chase goals of their own.

details.title: Trebuchet Hold’em
details.short_description: Conquer castles with poker in this medieval roguelike deckbuilder. Your deck is your army: soldiers gain experience, get wounded and fall. Play poker hands against walls and garrisons, collect war banners, march through three regions and storm the Royal City.

details.title: Theatre of War: Rearmed
details.short_description: Command real-time WWII battles across the complete Theatre of War series, unified on the latest version of its original engine. Experience deep tactical combat, realistic ballistics, and over 100 missions, enhanced for modern systems.

details.title: Wish Upon A Llama
details.short_description: Wish Upon A Llama is a cozy life sim RPG for animal lovers! As Llama Town's rancher, breed and raise adorable furry friends while rekindling a forgotten bond between the community and animals. Get to know the townsfolk, build lasting friendships, and perhaps discover romance. Adventure awaits!

details.title: March of the Kingdom
details.short_description: A party-management roguelite RPG auto-battler where you explore diverse lands, hunt the enemies of the kingdom, and face unpredictable encounters. Build your team, level up, and collect powerful weapons, artifacts, and relics to aid you on your journey.

details.title: We Need More Nails
details.short_description: 1-4 friends with sticky tongues. A wobbly minecart that needs to get to the other side of the canyon. Loose wood and a limited number of nails. That’s all you get! Now only questionable engineering skills (and friendly sabotage) stand between you and ancient treasure.

details.title: Screenbreak
details.short_description: Screenbreak is an action roguelike RPG set inside a corrupted computer system overrun by a dangerous virus. Fight through glitching programs, broken files, infected security systems, and unstable digital worlds as you uncover the truth behind the infection.

details.title: FPV Military Kamikaze Drone Simulator
details.short_description: FPV Military Kamikaze Drone Simulator is an advanced and realistic sim with physics-based flight, analog video, kamikaze strikes, grenade drops, heavy bombers, night vision and thermal. Fly with keyboard, gamepad or your own EdgeTX/OpenTX radio: RadioMaster, Jumper, BetaFPV and more.

details.title: Drawnsters
details.short_description: Drawnsters is a party game where you and your friends make up monster cards and battle them to the death!! The monster cards, not the friends.

details.title: Sweetie's Motel
details.short_description: A free co-op horror game for 1-4 players about exploring an endless motel, running from scary things, and collecting room service trays.

details.title: The Extractors
details.short_description: A co-op horror experience where you and your team explore dangerous environments, collect valuable items, and fight to survive. Work together, take risks, and make it back before it’s too late.

details.title: Knit Knit Tidy Up Together
details.short_description: Start your adventure by gathering the 20,000 colorful yarns scattered across the floor! Wind them onto the correct spools to clear the mess, then use the spooled yarn to knit the store's clothes from scratch, stitch by stitch.

details.title: Four Seasons Store: Tidy Up
details.short_description: Turn chaos into a cozy seasonal paradise! Sort 5000+ misplaced items, find their perfect spots, and transform a cluttered store into beautiful displays celebrating spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Find matching pieces, assemble objects, and enjoy the satisfaction of putting everything in order.

details.title: Ninmarch
details.short_description: Hold the border. Seal the rift. Ninmarch is a hand-painted 3D tower defense in the spirit of classic fantasy RTS: build and branch six towers, lead a hero with four skills into battle, and stop 39 kinds of abyssal foes — 12 bosses among them — across 12 handcrafted levels.

details.title: Rig'n'Roll: GOLD
details.short_description: Hit the highways of California in the most complete edition of the classic truck-driving simulator! Build your trucking empire, compete with rival drivers, explore an expanded world, and enjoy the complete Monster Cup expansion, additional trucks, and over 140 side missions.

details.title: 登神长阶
details.short_description: An idle xianxia looter with fully automated combat. Build the ultimate character and climb the Myriad Demon Tower: 17 skills per class, 10 gear modifications, artifacts, talismans, inner arts and skill variations to mix freely. Farm gear, roll affixes, brew pills, break realms, bond with acolytes...

details.title: Tinker's Ascent
details.short_description: Explore floating islands in Tinker's Ascent, a cozy open-world platformer and crafting adventure. Run, jump, and dive through the skies, gather resources, craft tools, and build structures as you discover a world high up in the clouds.

details.title: FIND ALL 10: Greece
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in Find All 10: Greece. You will explore an ancient Greek city, the colorful streets of a historic town and the unique scenery of a modern Greek city. Look for hidden objects and color this mysterious painted world.

name: ATTENTION DEFICIT - A story about ADHD

details.title: ATTENTION DEFICIT - A story about ADHD
details.short_description: An abstract visual novel about a girl dealing with the challenges of having ADHD while trying to complete a school assignment before the deadline.

details.title: The Shop on Linden Street
details.short_description: Grandma left you her little shop on Linden Street. Stock the shelves, work the till, befriend the neighbours, then expand: open shops across town and grow that one small counter into a hypermarket of your own.

details.title: Inn Over Your Head
details.short_description: An incremental game where you run a tavern with a deadly secret beneath it. Serve ale, expand your tavern, dig deeper into the dungeon below, and lure adventurers to their doom with irresistible treasure. Then harvest their souls to do it all over again. Ready to get Inn Over Your Head?

details.title: Gold, Guns & Grudges
details.short_description: Blast ore with a pistol, forge stronger weapons, and build a dwarven settlement. Survive quarry ruptures and fill your trophy room with the spoils of your rise.

details.title: Moove
details.short_description: Saddle up with your friends and drive a herd of cows across a wild frontier. Cowboys, lassos, tornadoes, wolves and a lot of shouting. Lose as few cows as you can, or die trying and come back as one.

details.title: Winter Whiskers
details.short_description: In this short, cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!

details.title: Raftcraft
details.short_description: A 4-player co-op adventure where goblins build a fragile makeshift vessel, hunt for loot across dangerous lands, and use their Mage Hands to grab, swing, pull, and thoroughly inconvenience each other.

name: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend

details.title: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
details.short_description: Build your player's basketball career in a single-player management sim. Manage training and recovery, develop skills, weigh contract offers and build relationships with your team. Earn a starting spot and follow simulated games in 2D with play-by-play and stats, or use quick simulation.
developers: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
publishers: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend

details.title: Seven Nights Ghost 2
details.short_description: "This Love, This Curse — Only 7 Days Left" Live together with a flashy ghost girl for seven days—and survive her over-the-top love attacks. A stylish, slightly dark, yet heartfelt horror romance about youth, fear, and self-control.

details.title: An-pêng: Still Here
details.short_description: After China's air raids, everyone in Anping was evacuated. You stayed. A ten-floor apartment with no power, someone who couldn't be bothered to leave, and a fridge of food gone bad. Cards decide where the time goes: search, move, eat, sleep. No base to hold, no breaking out. Just one more day.

details.title: The City of Endless
details.short_description: A run-based auto-battler with asynchronous PvP. Each run you build your board as you ride the rails of an infinite city, arranging items and skills into powerful combos. How long can you keep your life on the rails?

details.title: Attack on Titan 3 / A.O.T. 3
details.short_description: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.

details.title: Hyogoslavia Chronicles
details.short_description: A classic turn-based JRPG set in five rival nations inspired by Hyogo, Japan (home of Kobe). Guide a hesitant prince through a land where every nation has its own idea of justice, explore far and wide, and find your way to the true ending. Fully playable in English.

details.title: CATastraffic
details.short_description: Your pet cats are playing in your miniature town, napping in the road and messing with buildings. As traffic manager, work traffic lights, railroad crossings, taxis and gas stations in real time to keep cars and people moving. A real-time strategy game across 32 stages!

name: DAN DAN THE TIER LIST TOGETHER!

details.title: DAN DAN THE TIER LIST TOGETHER!
details.short_description: A co-op party game about tier lists. Only the host needs a copy; up to 111 guests join free in a browser on a phone or PC. Guess secret ranks and add words or images as your list grows. Build lists with no right or wrong answers in Tier Together!, or play solo with “My Tier!”.

details.title: Merry Crisis
details.short_description: Three loves. One week. Merry Crisis is an intimate, character-driven romance visual novel about love, loss, and belonging—is home what you left behind, or where you're headed?

details.title: Welcome, [Employee Name]
details.short_description: Welcome, [Employee Name]! You are our new space station controller. We trust you to make all the right decisions and keep the people of the HonkyTonk space station safe. Process as many trucks as possible but be careful, mistakes have consequences.Welcome to the Honky Tonk Family!

details.title: Dungeon: The Lantern Bearer
details.short_description: Dungeon: Lanternbearer is a RPG built around loot and buildcraft. Take up your lantern and delve into dungeons lost to the Dark Erosion. Slay monsters, gather loot, and combine Arts and gear into your own build. Recover memories of your sister A-Ning and bring her home before the world forgets her.

details.title: PATTY STATE
details.short_description: Across five cities mapped from real geographic data, run a restaurant chain: open locations, develop products, set prices and manage cash flow. Make decisions week by week, expand abroad and acquire companies. Grow one restaurant into an international chain.

details.title: The Way Home 퇴근길
details.short_description: Endless rain falls over Seoul, and strange anomalies appear on familiar streets. Observe your surroundings, report anything unusual, and continue your journey when everything seems normal. Can you make it home safely after seven days?

details.title: MistTower
details.short_description: Every battle has a cost. MistTower is a grid-based strategy RPG where you preview damage, plan routes, and weigh every key, coin, and upgrade. Bypass stronger enemies, return when ready, and conquer four seasonal towers without spending your last strength before the boss.

details.title: Not My Dad
details.short_description: Something is stealing people's skin. And your dad might be one of the victims... In Not My Dad, a first-person psychological horror game, complete your daily tasks while trying to live with the disturbing presence of "DAD".

details.title: Darkest Darkness
details.short_description: Darkest Darkness is a roguelike deck-building game with extraction elements. Choose your identity and venture into a Lovecraftian town. Craft every card yourself—collect materials, build powerful cards, plan your route, or extract with your gathered materials to gain an edge in your next run.

details.title: Andrea
details.short_description: Andrea is a crafting-driven roguelike RPG, featuring a unique equipment crafting system and a highly variable talent tree. Your goal is simple: grow as strong as you can and defeat the final boss. Survive if you can — death resets everything, but every run stays with you.

details.title: Torii: Beyond The Gates
details.short_description: The spirit realm has broken. Your brother has gone missing. Forge the path you were destined for. Explore the gates and find out why the links inside the spirit realm have been broken. Battle, discover and find the secrets, and make new connections in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D style.

details.title: Idle War Legion: WW2
details.short_description: Recruit soldiers, tanks, artillery and planes into an auto-battling WW2 army of up to 10 slots. Upgrade it and set the formation; it fights on while you're away, or in a desktop mini window as you work. Face 14 themed Bosses, the Infinite Cyber War Tower, 20 vs 20 Grand Army Battles and more.

details.title: Retro Party
details.short_description: Nostalgia for '90s games: 25+ mini-games in a single party. Play online with up to 8 people, or 4 on the same screen. Every game is its own kind of chaos: racing, shooting, a battle of wills, and plenty more. A chance to relive the good old days with your friends.

details.title: Fall, Fall, Fall for you
details.short_description: "Fall, Fall, Fall for you" is a challenging ball physics platformer about falling over and over again to prove your love for Daisy. She laughs every time you fall, calling you a dumb idiot. B-But... maybe she doesn't mean it. Who knows?

details.title: Pixel Life
details.short_description: A cozy pixel-art life sim. Start in a tiny studio, make friends with twelve townsfolk, adopt a dog, climb eight careers, collect cards for a full card game inside the game, and decide what to do with your money at the bank. Your life, your way.

details.title: Parallax: Axis
details.short_description: AXIS is a 3D spatial puzzle where your route becomes music. Move along a cube’s X/Y/Z axes, collect stars and rings, dodge obstacles and reach the gate. Each move changes rhythm, pitch and resonance. Explore 150 stages in six Halls as guides fade and your path leaves a trace in sound and form.

details.title: Colony on the Run
details.short_description: Start as a single bacterium, multiply into a colony, and race through the human body! Escape white blood cells, evolve, adapt to each organ, and survive the massive antibiotic wave after three minutes in this roguelite action-strategy game.

details.title: Liar's Poker
details.short_description: A bluffing card game for four. Claim a hand that might be hiding in everyone's cards or call the last player a liar and turn the whole table over. Invite friends, practice against bots or an AI opponent, or climb the ranked ladder. About ten minutes a game.

details.title: Boxing Tycoon
details.short_description: Run your own boxing promotion. Scout and sign fighters, negotiate every contract, face the press, build fight cards and beat rival promoters to the biggest nights. Watch your fighters go to war in full 3D and turn them into world champions.

details.title: Hero of the Sealed Labyrinth
details.short_description: An auto-battle RPG about collecting gear and growing stronger. Support your hero with click attacks, unlock sword skills and magic, and upgrade equipment at the blacksmith. Push deeper into the labyrinth or repeat floors to prepare. Rethink your build and challenge enemies again.

details.title: Penguin Trails Together
details.short_description: It all starts with a line. Draw a ramp and send Pengu soaring toward the stars on a sled. Or team up with up to three friends, build a track full of loops, and see who sticks the landing.

name: Feathered Fortune: Medieval Post Simulator - Prologue

details.title: Feathered Fortune: Medieval Post Simulator - Prologue
details.short_description: Run a medieval pigeon post, raise your flock, and take your first steps toward rebuilding the war-torn Kingdom of Melthoria.

details.title: Embrasure
details.short_description: Run a nation at war, from the steel up. Mix and heat-treat armour steel, design tanks plate by plate, lay out the factories that build them, then command them on battlefields cut from real terrain. Hand any branch to an AI chief. Three eras: 1941, 1985 and 2024. Built on published real-world data.

details.title: 999 Seconds! Survivors
details.short_description: Reject boring stat stacking! We've restructured the gameplay with limited talent resources—talent combinations are just as important as character selection! With 300+ items and 40+ pieces of equipment, what insane builds can you create? —Depth! Difficulty! And high replay value!

details.title: 4:AM
details.short_description: Hide. Solve. Run. Survive. Aila must avoid detection and find their way to a new future in a world ravaged by the Yellow. 4:AM is a dystopian cinematic puzzle adventure where you rely on nanobots to duplicate objects and find unique solutions.

details.title: Tidal Life
details.short_description: Tidal Life is a first person open world exploration game. On this vast and boundless island, you must survive through diving, fishing, and beachcombing. Use the resources you gather to upgrade your equipment, complete the illustrated guide, enrich your island. collect or defeat them all !

name: IRON RAIL GIRLS : Last Train Draisine

details.title: IRON RAIL GIRLS : Last Train Draisine
details.short_description: While converting the armored train (or is it a trolley?) “Draisine” into the “world's mightiest moving fortress,” they embark on a one-way journey (a breakthrough battle) back to their hometown. A 2D side-scrolling, top-down train shooting game.

details.title: Impferno
details.short_description: An online co-op game for up to 8 players. Explore the Circles of Hell in search of monsters and collect their souls before time runs out. Work and fight together to survive. But never forget: trust has no place among demons!

details.title: PAPERWORKS
details.short_description: Scan books, shred the originals, and burn humanity's knowledge for cash in this first-person incremental game. Upgrade machines and automate your work—but why is the office empty, and who's giving orders through the terminals? Uncover the conspiracy before humanity burns.

details.title: Just Until Morning
details.short_description: Rural 17, eleven at night. A gas station in the fog, and the lamps are going out one at a time. A slow-burn first-person horror about a small place after dark, and the night shift that has to keep it lit. Just until morning.

details.title: Moscow Lizards vs Aliens
details.short_description: Long, long ago, lizard-folk settled near Moscow. They grew fond of all things Russian: *kosovorotka* shirts, *ushanka* fur hats, pickled cucumbers, and, of course, vodka. For centuries, they quietly guarded the land of Rus’… until aliens arrived from the planet Nibiru.

details.title: Gop-Stop Increment: Defend the Block
details.short_description: A clicker-meets-tower-defense game set in the meme-filled 90s. Hustle vodka, snap up kiosks and video rental shops, and use sunflower seeds to build your entryway defenses—think a granny with a stool, a boombox blasting *shanson* (Russian outlaw folk music), and a chained-up bear.

details.title: Ember
details.short_description: A tiny fire sorcerer lives on your desktop. Chat with him (he remembers you), cast spells on any text —translate, summarize, explain—, ask your documents with citations, and defeat spectres by typing. 100% local AI on your NVIDIA RTX 4060+ GPU. No cloud, no account.

details.title: Railway End
details.short_description: This is a hidden object puzzle game with a railway theme. Compare photos and correct differences in the scene, interspersed with a few puzzles. There is no text in the game.

details.title: The Deepest Shift
details.short_description: Barents Sea, 1987. Your friend Belov is missing. As a chemist on the offshore platform Sarja-7, you follow his trail from a fissure deep underwater to the tap in your lab. A first-person psychological horror game.

details.title: DIBARO CryptoHunter Dice Battle Royal
details.short_description: Online battles for up to 6 players. Roll dice, command Fire, Water, Earth and Wind mana, and clash on a hex board where six factions fight at once. Affinity settles every attack, and reordering your mana is deckbuilding. Raise over 60 Hunters across Challenge, Survival and hidden-role Demon & Hero.

details.title: United Skies FlightSimulator
details.short_description: Get in the pilot seat and explore the United States from coast to coast. Skim the canyon floor in the Grand Canyon, pull off daring aerobatics over Los Angeles, or simply cruise along and watch the country unfold beneath your wings. The sky is yours.

details.title: Norselings
details.short_description: Guide your Norse clan from Helheim to Asgard through runestone strikes and the rise of a Norseling settlement.

details.title: Red Door - Horror Maze
details.short_description: Close your eyes and play the old sleepover game. Wake up in a maze that changes every time you enter. Find the key, hide from dangers, open a door and face whoever waits behind it. Only one way back to life...

details.title: SuperCitycon
details.short_description: A city builder with a retro-inspired look and the freedom to shape your world. Build roads, railways and entire neighborhoods in a creative sandbox. Customize buildings, vehicles and more with SCC Studio, the in-game voxel editor, and share your creations through Steam Workshop.

details.title: PSYCHOTRIP
details.short_description: A new, unforgettable level of experience ✨ Tons of effects, 3D sound. Just try it 🤪

name: All You Can Love: Hotel Paradiso

details.title: All You Can Love: Hotel Paradiso
details.short_description: Leave your worries at reception. Tom’s romantic getaway has become a holiday for one. Explore a sunny seaside hotel with more charm than stars, solve puzzles and flirt your way into trouble in a classic point-and-click comedy. The women of Hotel Paradiso have plans of their own.

details.title: Winter Resort Simulator 3
details.short_description: Run your own ski resort in Winter Resort Simulator 3. Operate ropeways, groom slopes and manage snow. Explore the biggest world in the series alone or with friends. Whether you're operating lifts, grooming slopes, or preparing for the next busy season, WRS 3 puts you in charge of the mountain.

details.title: The Story of Mikagoyama
details.short_description: This is an RPG where you explore a mountain called Mikagoyama. The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.Th

details.title: Saimin Gakuen: Intrusion Edition
details.short_description: A classic title from renowned Japanese visual novel developers Fudegaki Soft! What kind of unexpected encounters await the seemingly ordinary protagonist in his professional journey...?

details.title: Worm Overworld
details.short_description: A 360° tank-defense shooter. Giant worms burst out of Pit B-7 from every side: spin your turret, time your shockwave, skill and ultimate, call in your squad, and fight through 20 boss stages and 3 secret nests to reach the Worm Queen.

details.title: Kingside Break
details.short_description: A chess game where you lead a customizable fantasy army through 1,500 levels of curated puzzles and real chess matches. Face checkpoint commanders, recruit new races, and customize your hero and army. Key chess concepts encountered are logged in a Sage Ledger for education and future reference.

details.title: Breeder Protocol
details.short_description: Drop into a living alien hive with up to three friends. Reach the stranded crew before the breeders do, bring the uplinks online and fight your way to extraction. A twin-stick co-op roguelite where every hive is new and every run builds a deadlier squad.

details.title: Bloody Cleanup TOGETHER
details.short_description: Clean up the aftermath of terrible events in Bloody Cleanup Together, a co-op horror cleaning sim for up to 4 players. Remove blood, hide evidence, carry bodies, and restore every detail before anything is discovered.

details.title: Airsoft Online
details.short_description: Airsoft Online offers a realistic virtual airsoft experience for veterans of the community and beginners alike. Take part in team-based multiplayer battles, with customizable weapons and realistic physics.

details.title: beautiful freaks of the desert
details.short_description: A hyper brutal SPEEDRUN-FPS with a stylized boomer-shooter aesthetic and a heart of gold, that requires lightning fast reactions as well as strategic thinking in mapping out the best run through the bite-sized levels. But all of this is just the surface of the trip...

details.title: Parasite Core
details.short_description: Buy time to harvest resources in this incremental tower defense game where you defend your core from the native species that want you off their home! Play actively and unleash your abilities, or idle and let your turrets take care of the pests.

details.title: Letter Dragon
details.short_description: You're a bumblebee dragon with a delivery service. Explore an open world full of tropical islands while you deliver mail in this short adventure!

details.title: Chibi Prison: Tidy Up Together
details.short_description: Panic! There's been a Prison Break and all the Chibi Felons are loose. Don't let their cuteness fool you - these guys are real rascals! It's up to you, the Fat Cat Cops, to sort through the rabble and lock them back in their cells.

details.title: Dark Age Dinos
details.short_description: A multiplayer tactical roguelike for 1-4 players set in a medieval world of sword wielding dinosaurs. Strategize your way through short adventures where teamwork is the key to success!

details.title: CrossPieces Arena
details.short_description: Arrange chess, shogi, and other pieces into your own starting formation in this turn-based board tactics game. Capture the enemy Royal to win. Test your setup against the CPU, play two-player matches on the same PC, or face friends and other players online.

details.title: Following the Shadow
details.short_description: «Following the Shadow» is a fantasy visual novel. Join Jacob, a young alchemist, and his screech-owl companion on a perilous journey through the realm of mists and will-o'-the-wisp!

details.title: The Reaper -Links Quartz Chapter 2-
details.short_description: A 2D action game featuring scythe combat and character-driven dialogue.

details.title: Rekisen TCG
details.short_description: With its signature "Rekisen Summoning" system, this snappy arcade card game offers a unique experience with 80 carefully balanced cards. Play your favorite modes, earn gold, and open booster packs to collect cards and build custom decks.

details.title: 10 Million Cubes
details.short_description: Break through 10 million voxels to find the Prismatic Cube. A short incremental game about satisfying destruction with really bouncy balls.

details.title: One More Chest!
details.short_description: One More Chest! is an active incremental game about smashing chests that walk, bite and explode. Hover and your hammer swings for you: chain lightning across the desk, set off bombs, spread lava, unlock six hammers and prestige until one swing sets off the whole table.

name: Fashion Kid: From School to Cool

details.title: Fashion Kid: From School to Cool
details.short_description: By day, Sarah is the invisible girl from class 9b. In secret, she's Fashion Kid, the designer everyone is talking about. A fully voiced comic story as rich as a YA novel, with choices, two paths, 30 sewing and fashion minigames and your very own design studio.

details.title: Desktop Plinko
details.short_description: An idle incremental plinko game that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.

details.title: Not Alive Enough - Prologue
details.short_description: A new wave of refugees is flooding the checkpoint. Inspect every survivor, identify the infected before they turn, and stop the outbreak from spreading to the outside world in this tense zombie apocalypse screening simulator.

details.title: Hallbound Baseball Life
details.short_description: Live a whole baseball life in this baseball career RPG. Hear your name on draft day, ride the buses through the minors, earn the call to the Grand League, play your own at-bats and pitches, raise a family and chase the Hall of Fame. Then life after baseball begins.

details.title: Panzer Planet
details.short_description: The ultimate fast-paced twin-stick shooter roguelite where you command tanks on spherical mini-planets battling hordes of aliens, zombies, and monstrous insects! Strap in, gear up, and prepare for chaotic arena survival action packed with explosive upgrades, weapons, and non-stop bullet-hell mayhem.

details.title: Pradera
details.short_description: Pradera is a first-person psychological horror. You play as Clarice, an ambitious lawyer taking on an impossible case. Nine people were decapitated. The bodies remain. The heads are gone. A gamble for fame becomes a real nightmare.

name: Star Archive: Tidying Up Is a Kind of Magic

details.title: Star Archive: Tidying Up Is a Kind of Magic
details.short_description: The library's a mess, and it won't let you leave. Sort and stack books at your own pace in this cozy first-person game. Cast spells to send books back to their shelves, open new wings, and carry permanent upgrades into the next time loop.

details.title: Tinker Islands
details.short_description: Gather your friends and sail a vast ocean filled with wonders and danger in this cozy Caribbean sandbox. Discover islands, gather resources, upgrade your gear, make a new home, and see what's waiting over the next horizon.

details.title: Harmony Of Tea
details.short_description: Small relaxing puzzle game where you need to find the right place for tea on a shelf. Travel from Yunnan Province to Shanghai as a tea courier, explore charming provinces and discover unique tea flavors.

details.title: International Football Manager 27
details.short_description: Football doesn't follow a script… and neither does International Football Manager 27. Make decisions, face the consequences, and experience a more exciting, authentic, and unpredictable simulation as you lead your football team to the top.

details.title: Army Factory
details.short_description: Build your settlement into a war machine. Gather resources, raise massive armies, prepare your regiments, and watch your battle plan unfold as thousands of soldiers clash.

details.title: Block Dash
details.short_description: A short, fast-paced action game where you move and dash your way through an abstract obstacle course. Encounter a wide variety of blocks that all pose different challenges. Will you be able to make your way through and see what lies at the end of it all?

details.title: Meltdown Crew
details.short_description: Run a barely-stable nuclear reactor with your friends in this online co-op physics chaos game. Fix broken systems, manage radiation, survive power outages, and prevent a total meltdown before everything goes horribly wrong.

details.title: Frogball
details.short_description: Classic 90's GameBoy style Pinball... this time with frogs! Super cute retro fantasy pinball, packed to the gills with old-school fun.

details.title: SEND MORE MEN
details.short_description: A sandbox of battles up to 1,000 men where every soldier thinks for himself. Pick any army from any era, from Roman legions to orcs to sci-fi squads, set them on any field, then watch the lines hold and break, or take control of one man and fight it yourself.

details.title: Cash & Stash: A Vaultkeeper Story
details.short_description: After a failed robbery attempt, the bank has been torn apart and left in complete chaos. Now, as the Vaultkeeper, you must sort through more than 16,000 scattered items, return everything to its proper place, and uncover the stories behind the bank’s clients and their valuables.

details.title: Citystate Metropolis
details.short_description: The creative, pragmatic, limitless city builder. Engineer a masterpiece of urban design, a small sustainable town or a futuristic metropolis. With procedurally generated buildings, grid-less zoning and powerful editor tools, everything is customizable: the city is yours.

details.title: Shape Shards
details.short_description: Shape Shards is a casual incremental game where you shoot bullets to destroy geometric enemies, collect shards to upgrade, and every upgrade brings a whole new experience!

details.title: UPG Cubed
details.short_description: A fast-paced minimalist platformer where precision is everything. Master jumping, wall-jumping and dashing, collect diamonds, beat challenging levels and push your skills to the limit. And create your own levels in UPG Cubed

details.title: Trivia Arena: The Grand Stage
details.short_description: A party trivia game show on a grand velvet stage. Up to 8 friends join with their phones as controllers: no app, just scan the QR code. Answer wrong and your plush drops through a trapdoor. Three game modes, thousands of questions, seasonal events and online play with friends.

details.title: MazeParty
details.short_description: Ruin your friends' plans and turn the tables in MazeParty, a 4-player online board party game. Roll dice together, navigate a maze in first person, and get in each other's way with items. Earn gold in 20 minigames and collect keys to chase the final victory.

details.title: Cave Crawler
details.short_description: Embark on an adventure inspired by Gameboy era games. Explore, fight bosses, and earn resources! Travel across islands and towns to engage in subtle, lore rich story.

details.title: Dorifto!
details.short_description: Push your car to the limit of grip and chase perfect lap times on winding back roads where drifting isn't just a technique, it's the only way to drive! Settle rivalries and prove your skill in online multiplayer and local split-screen.

name: WHO THE HELL OPENED THE PORTAL?!

details.title: WHO THE HELL OPENED THE PORTAL?!
details.short_description: A funny pixel art roguelite strategy. You manage a fantasy island kingdom connected by magical portals. By day — build, gather resources, hire heroes, and dive through portals to expand into new lands. By night — defend! The same portals unleash hordes of demons straight from Hell.

details.title: Tiny Fortress
details.short_description: [Previously called "Tiny Towers"] A short incremental game about defending your tiny fortress from hordes of tiny mobs. Place towers, gain resources by defeating enemies, and unlock new upgrades in the skill tree to strengthen your goblin stronghold.

details.title: Night of the Living Toys
details.short_description: A cozy co-op toy sorting game. Play with three friends or solo. Two modes to choose from: dig through a huge pile of toys or open boxes and complete sets. Fill every shelf before the store opens and keep its secret!

details.title: Outcity
details.short_description: Tired of big city life, you move to Outcity to start fresh in the countryside. Build your farm your way in a cozy sandbox where imagination has no limits and friendly villagers help your homestead grow into a thriving village. Gather your determination, your creativity, and get to work!

details.title: Jumplife
details.short_description: Jumplife is a minimalistic platformer with lots of wall jumping and wall sliding.

details.title: DataCenter Tycoon
details.short_description: Build your own Data Center, from a single rack in a garage to a hall full of the latest Hardware. Wire power, cooling and network by hand, keep the machines running, vibe code Products and launch your own AI platform to finance the whole thing. Solo or in online co-op with up to three friends.

details.title: PRESIDENT
details.short_description: Become President… or end up the Asshole! PRESIDENT brings the famous card game to life with 11 modes, five AI difficulty levels and multiplayer. Challenge your friends or compete in tournaments with up to 16 participants to claim the crown!

details.title: Calibration Sequence
details.short_description: Calibration Sequence is a bullet hell game where you play as a nanobot undergoing its factory calibration.

details.title: Royal Bomb Squad POP!
details.short_description: Blast colorful jawbreakers in this cartoon bubble shooter! Eight delightful weirdos with eight different playstyles, across Story, Score Attack, Time Attack, and head-to-head VS modes - on the couch or online with Remote Play Together! The Dream Kingdom is counting on you!

details.title: An Eggcellent Sorting Game
details.short_description: Sort thousands of colorful eggs by matching their patterns in this relaxing organizing game. Turn a giant mess into satisfying order, level up 8 skills, meet quirky characters, and complete quests. No rush, no pressure. Just you and an eggnormous pile of eggs!

details.title: That Damn Grass
details.short_description: A co-op lawn game where you start with a nail cutter. Play as a budget robot, cut an enormous lawn, collect the clippings and earn better tools while searching for a lost wedding ring. Work alone or with up to three friends. Yes, scissors are an upgrade.

details.title: That Mountain Needs to Fall
details.short_description: An incremental game about dwarves and mining. Send your dwarves against the mountain, watch the ore fly and turn a single house into an army of different dwarves. Call the heroes of Ragnarok, conquer the mountain, unleash Ragnarok and start over stronger with Odin's blessings.

details.title: STAGE TOUR
details.short_description: Build your band, hit the stage, and go on tour in Stage Tour, the next evolution of music rhythm games. Rock over 90 officially licensed tracks, unlock over 180 authentic Gibson®, Epiphone® and Kramer® guitars, and experience five game modes, including the all-new roguelite Tour Mode.

details.title: Neuronz
details.short_description: An incremental game where you train a real neural network to read handwritten digits. Buy upgrades, then recompile into a bigger, better network you design yourself. At the end, test it on an unseen dataset and compete against others to create the best model.

details.title: Wintermarkt
details.short_description: Build a cosy German Christmas market from Advent to Christmas Eve. Place mulled wine, bratwurst and gingerbread stands, open an Advent door every few days for a new card, and earn enough to pay the town's lease. Each season plays out differently.

details.title: Slaysurge
details.short_description: The world shattered and its shards rose into the sky. You are the last Warden. Leadyour company across eight floating realms, march through the Firmament and ride asteam citadel into the Gorges in a fast, never-stalling idle RPG.

details.title: Sortman
details.short_description: A Swiss sorting hall buried under a million letters and parcels. Sort by hand, weigh, throw, load the vans, answer furious customers, then build a chain of belts and machines that fills the vans by itself. Solo or up to four players, no timer.

details.title: Dustronauts
details.short_description: Clean up dusty alien worlds alone or with up to 16 players in this relaxing space cleaning simulator! Vacuum endless dust, upgrade your equipment, automate your operations, and build your own space cleaning empire with friends.

details.title: Era of Shadows
details.short_description: Era of Shadows is a tower defense game with exploration elements. Explore and build. Defend your base from an increasing amount of deadly enemies by night. Learn new talents, level up your skills and defenses. The game is currently in early access.

details.title: Cry( ) Still
details.short_description: In Cry ( ) Still you explore frozen ruins where heat is a limited resource. You must find heat sources, avoid enemies that detect sound and suck the heat out of you, solve puzzles to unlock your path forwards. All in order to find your way out of the ancient temple.

details.title: Neural Defense
details.short_description: Neural Defense is a sci-fi Tower Defense where you can sync with any of your towers and take manual control in third-person to defend your base against waves of corporate drones.

details.title: DIEATHLON
details.short_description: Chart a course down dangerous mountain slopes with only your shotgun and your reflexes to keep you alive. Blast through obstacles, fend off deadly monsters, and make split-second decisions. Explore multiple routes, each filled with unique hazards and challenges.

details.title: Ardent Arcana
details.short_description: Solo or with up to three friends online, take on the beasts of French folklore in this co-op dungeon roguelite. Wield 14 weapons, master the 22 Major Arcana and fight your way down five procedural dungeons to the boss waiting at the bottom.

details.title: Red Rising
details.short_description: Fight for dominance with up to 6 players in the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game. Assemble a hand of followers, chain together powerful combos, and lead your house to victory in this clash of cards set in the dystopian world of Red Rising.

details.title: Geareo
details.short_description: Real gears that don't slip in a mechanical invention sandbox. Build freely with resizable parts and shapes, overcome physics challenges, and follow kit instructions. Unleash your engineering creativity with precision machines and intricate clockwork contraptions.

details.title: Dragon's Brew
details.short_description: Run the board game cafe of your dreams! Craft food and drink, deliver orders to the townsfolk, collect board games, and customise your space, your way!

details.title: Grass and Cash
details.short_description: Bad news: you're in debt. Good news: there's cash buried in the grass. Worse news: you're starting with nail scissors. Start mowing.

details.title: The Crooked Table
details.short_description: Four players. Three secret sides. One table full of liars. Play every card face down, claim whatever you like, and bet your chips that someone else is lying. Help your team, sabotage the table, or play everyone for yourself. Just don’t get caught.

details.title: Grindhouse Theater Simulator
details.short_description: September 1983. Eighty seats, one projector, your choice of double bill. Run the Rialto in a first-person theater sim: book genre films, sell tickets and popcorn, hire the Grindhouse Gang and keep the show running when the print snaps and the crowd loses patience.

details.title: Home Before Dusk
details.short_description: Farm, cook and fall in love in a fenced town at the end of the world. Once a week, a helicopter flies you out to abandoned towns for fuel, medicine and parts. Search fast and get back on board before dusk: the pilots don't wait for anyone.

details.title: Vault Traitors
details.short_description: Social deduction with MOBA-style abilities, 25+ roles, 50+ unique items, an arsenal of weapons and air that's running out. 16 players are sealed in an underground vault with traitors among them. Lock your door - and survive the night.

details.title: Bonkaboo
details.short_description: Bonk your friends off the table in this online physics party game for 1-8. Get knocked off and you come back as a ghost, dropping fans, bumpers and boulders on whoever’s still standing.

details.title: Broken Contract
details.short_description: An online co-op horror game built around mechanics of contracts and betrayal. Before each shift, every player signs a contract known only to them, while the company’s objectives remain the same for everyone. You and your friends decide for yourselves what rules to play by.

details.title: We Made Gods
details.short_description: 2040. A rogue AI has seized the world's war factories. Lead human veterans, machine-fused soldiers or the AI itself in a real-time strategy game of three asymmetric factions, a story campaign, skirmish against the AI and online multiplayer.

details.title: PinDOS
details.short_description: Play your own copies of Epic Pinball, Silver Ball, Silver Ball 2 Plus and Extreme Pinball in a new front end: the whole table on one tall screen with no scrolling, 2-4 players online or on your home network, and a full virtual pinball cabinet mode. The games are not included.

details.title: Demuck
details.short_description: You work the wash bay at an iron-ore mine in Australia's Pilbara, blasting caked red mud off haul trucks, excavators and dozers. The mud is simulated, so it comes off in slabs and runs down the drains.

details.title: Surviveroids
details.short_description: Surviveroids is an solo or local co-op arcade styled survival game, with totally optional roguelite elements. Thrust through an asteroid field that fights back, dodge saucers, mines, lasers, and black holes, and pick upgrades.

details.title: MOONWRIGHT
details.short_description: A lunar mining sim where the time lag is part of the game. A new Gold Rush has begun, and you are one of the first prospectors on the Moon. Drive a rover, find and mine lunar ores, and sell what you mine. Use money to upgrade the rover and Moon base. Receive new missions and try your luck there.

details.title: Galaxization
details.short_description: A galaxy and civilization simulator on your Windows wallpaper. While you work, civilizations sprout, rise, trade, fight and fall among 200,000 stars. Pick the view: the whole galaxy, the black hole, a star system, or the sky from a planet's surface. Built in Rust: light on CPU and battery.

details.title: Wrapocalypse
details.short_description: 1,000,000 boxes! You start with bare hands: scan, wrap and upgrade your factory until it runs itself! Team up in co-op crews of up to 5, online or split screen, and become the kings of warehouse automation! Slapping sleeping coworkers is allowed!

details.title: Basileia
details.short_description: A classic city-builder in Byzantium, 330–562 AD. Gather resources, trade, raise great churches and fight off the Huns, then walk among citizens who each live their own life.

details.title: R.Football - Online Football
details.short_description: A fast, physics-based online football game where you sprint, shoot and bend the ball with curve shots.

details.title: Spray to Grail
details.short_description: Spray-paint sneakers layer by layer, finish fast orders, and turn a scrappy bootleg studio into a rare-drop machine. Unlock wild grails, upgrade your gear, fill your collection wall, and chase the perfect pair in this juicy incremental game.

details.title: Undying Knights
details.short_description: Undying Knights is a couch and online party game that fuses strategy and reflexes. Enjoy quick rounds with flexible team fights, unique weapons and deadly traps, all with a handicap option that keeps every battle fair.

details.title: MineMergeMatic
details.short_description: Mine, merge, and automate! Combine ores into valuable resources, build compact production chains, unlock powerful machinery, and expand your cave into a bustling mining factory.

details.title: Petri Party
details.short_description: Petri Party is a frantic, physics-driven party platformer where disposable slimes battle it out across a playful laboratory micro-world. Grab a friend (or seventeen), pick your weapon, and dive into fast, high-skill rounds full of grappling, wall-walking and gloriously accidental victories.

details.title: Down to Floor Zero
