details.short_description: Build a candy factory on a cake island floating in the clouds. Mould candies, flavour them, top them and send them by road to the Candy Carousel. Chain 59 works into ever sweeter recipes, spin the reward machine, weather gumball storms and sugar quakes, and finish the carousel in five ages.

details.title: Keystrike
details.short_description: Craft powerful synergies and overcome game-changing drawbacks in this bullet-hell roguelike where the enemies evolve with you.

details.title: Bakery Simulator Online
details.short_description: Open your own bakery and manage every part of the working day. Prepare dough, bake a variety of goods, stock your displays and serve customers. Play Bakery Simulator solo or team up with friends in online co-op for up to 4 players.

details.title: Reconstruction: The Myth of Lincoln
details.short_description: April 1865: Booth's shot misses and Lincoln lives. In this turn-based political strategy game, you count votes in Congress, send troops South and face the Supreme Court, but Lincoln keeps his own mind. In the end, two verdicts: his legend, and what the freedpeople received.

details.title: Wish In One Hand
details.short_description: Shovel [REDACTED] into a hole until you die! Use your wits, grit and supreme spirit to clean up [REDACTED] as it arrives in a strange room. [REDACTED], chunks of [REDACTED] and liquid [REDACTED] all generate STENCH. Generate too much STENCH for too long and you will be judged!!

details.title: Outpost Survivors
details.short_description: Build your defenses, recruit survivors, and fight relentless zombie hordes! Upgrade weapons, manage resources, command your team, or take direct control of a survivor. Battle through dangerous environments, survive special events, and face increasingly powerful enemies and bosses.

details.title: Cinder Scav: 2381
details.short_description: Built 100% end-to-end by AI agents in Unreal Engine 5.8, Cinder Scav: 2381 is a 30+ km² seamless open-world Top-Down & Third-Person Shooter (TPS). Explore all 148 completed hand-crafted-grade POIs, command 50 drivable wasteland vehicles, step inside the 8-plate Bulwark Mk III Power Armor, and survive 150+ zombie hordes!

details.title: Freeway Fever
details.short_description: Very fast-paced arcade street racing with crashes and chaos. Risk is rewarded: trail closely behind traffic vehicles for a huge slipstream boost, but be careful not to crash! Featuring a curated 97 event championship, plus arcade mode with virtually unlimited procedurally-generated track layouts.

details.title: Void Demolition Co.
details.short_description: A cozy incremental demolition roguelite. Hold the left mouse button to tear tiny voxel cities apart block by block and feed every fragment to a black hole. Pick 1 of 3 upgrades, awaken wild weapon transmutations, and keep smashing until the void swallows the whole city.

details.title: Talebinder
details.short_description: Fairy-tale villains are breaking out of sealed books. As the tower's librarian, gather spellbooks that fight on their own, slot in charms, and evolve them into your own ultimate build. A bullet heaven roguelite where bosses telegraph their big attacks. Tough, but read them and you can win.

details.title: My Summer, Your Silence
details.short_description: Linus thought a new city could leave the past behind. But summer lingers: a heartbeat sounds in the woods, an old school lies beneath the water, and a girl says she has been waiting for him. A story-driven visual novel of school days, surreal repetition, and buried memories.

name: This Game Is Not For You: It's For AI

details.title: This Game Is Not For You: It's For AI
details.short_description: Hands off WASD - this game is NOT for humans to play manually! Built on Unreal Engine 5 by Dr. Wang, this 30-in-1 AI Esports Colosseum pits 15 AI model families across 30 competitive games and 90 maps. Craft smarter Strategy Prompts, deploy isolated AI workers, and watch AI battle for ELO supremacy!

details.title: Punching a Dirty Wizard
details.short_description: The Dirty Wizard wants you to punch him, he wants you to kill him. One strike at a time.

details.title: LiarGame : Canvas
details.short_description: Spot the liar in this online drawing party game for 3–8 players! Draw clues if you know the secret word, or bluff with your drawings if you're the liar. Decide who to trust amid suspicious sketches and convincing excuses. Customize your character and enjoy hilarious mind games with friends!

details.title: Gulovacka
details.short_description: Snowballs knock you back so hard that you will be flying. Your friends having a blast watching it happen. Put on a snowsuit of your choice and dive into chaotic snowball fight in Gulovacka.

details.title: Haul Yeah!
details.short_description: Load it, strap it, drive it. A colourful delivery-driving sandbox for one or two players. Stack real physics cargo, tighten the straps and haul it across a mountain county in split-screen co-op or solo. Build your business with better trucks, custom parts and bigger jobs.

details.title: Silent Fright
details.short_description: A co-op survival horror game for up to six players. You are a crew of elves sent to save a space station knocked out of orbit. Gather dark matter to power your gear, but stay quiet, because something is sleeping in the dark. Wake it and it hunts you. Charge up, and hunt it back.

details.title: Sewer Rat
details.short_description: Sewer Rat is a split screen multiplayer rat experience / passion project that explores the hidden lives of rats and their unique social construct. A mix of realism, silliness and straight up rat propaganda. It's currently in the alpha stages of development.

details.title: Dismal Night
details.short_description: A story-driven 2D folk-horror mystery set in 1990s Poland. A man has vanished near a house in the woods that should be empty, yet someone still tends its flowers. Search for clues, keep them in your police notebook and solve puzzles to uncover old crimes and village secrets.

details.title: Boat Trip
details.short_description: Pilot your boat through swarming schools of fish in this naval action roguelite. Combine weapons, upgrade your ship and face colossal bosses, solo or in 1~4 online co-op.

details.title: A Game About Games
details.short_description: The cosy video game stacking sim. Sort the chaos and race the clock! Grab and hurl game cases onto shelves, then upgrade your speed, reach, and throw. Can you conquer small, medium, large, and totally randomised procedural store layouts?

details.title: Demon With A Candy Crisis
details.short_description: A quick and easy 3d platformer playing as a demon that needs to quench its thirst for candy. Travel through hell to get to the surface to find someone's secret stash of candy.

details.title: MASA
details.short_description: In a world where magic lives through the power of the spirits, you are a mage of the battlefield. MASA is a strategy card game set in a fantasy world. Use the power of the elements and magic to earn the most victory points across five battles.

details.title: Cratebreaker: Wasteland Workshop
details.short_description: Cratebreaker: Wasteland Workshop is a post-apocalyptic idle clicker and strategy game about smashing crates, salvaging relics, building vehicles, running factories, scanning radio signals, and raiding bandit bases to rebuild your place in the wasteland.

details.title: Our Light Affliction: Spider's Covenant
details.short_description: A dark fantasy/yandere otome game about a girl who can see spirits, the spider apparition who tricks her into a contract, and the exorcist who is after them. Decide who to trust, and whether you'll fix them, or make them worse...

details.title: Royal Triple Defense
details.short_description: Build a thriving fantasy kingdom on one side of the screen and hold the gate on the other. Merge three units into one, send it across the bridge, and place it where your line needs it. Each night brings a deadlier horde, and you choose which monsters join it. Survive until dawn.

details.title: Slay the GoblinZ
details.short_description: The Princess has been kidnapped! Play as a knight hired to rescue Her Highness in this short fantasy incremental game. Craft unique equipment, experiment with deadly builds, and unlock dozens of powerful upgrades.

details.title: Not Alive Enough
details.short_description: A new wave of refugees is flooding the checkpoint. Inspect every survivor, identify the infected before they turn, and stop the outbreak from spreading to the outside world in this tense zombie apocalypse screening simulator.

details.title: Hoodies Squad: Alcoholypse
details.short_description: In Grochów, something strange is causing the residents to behave abnormally. Three inseparable buddies must restore balance by discovering the causes of this confusion and heading deep into the mysterious Alcoholypse. Will they succeed in restoring normalcy before the neighborhood collapses?

details.title: Online Boxing 3D
details.short_description: A physics-driven boxing simulation where every punch is calculated in real time. Master timing, positioning, and footwork to outbox your opponent.

details.title: THE FIRST ZOMBIE
details.short_description: You are the walking dead—literally! In this casual action game, play as a cute zombie and take over the streets of Tokyo! Take down humans and animals, turn them into zombies, then build an ever-growing zombie horde!
developers: THE FIRST ZOMBIE 製作委員会
publishers: THE FIRST ZOMBIE 製作委員会

details.title: Idle Slot Machine
details.short_description: Build a bustling pixel-art casino in this idle management game. Hire monkeys to spin your slots, combine machines and chain reactions, shape your skill tree, and prestige for lasting progress. Collect cosmetics and take on challenges beyond the casino floor.

details.title: Smile Thief
details.short_description: Join Eva, a young apprentice minstrel, on her mission to save her village’s joy in Trimeria - The Thief of Smiles. This graphic adventure invites you to explore a magical world, face unique challenges, and unravel the mystery of the demon threatening to steal all smiles.

details.title: Chop Loop
details.short_description: A 3D incremental lumberjack game where every tree changes the way you play. Unlock unique tree mechanics, control which trees appear with runes and upgrade beavers to automate your harvest.

details.title: Hardpack Rally
details.short_description: An arcade rally career that starts with an old two-door and a note from Vern. Learn four cars on woodland bends, mountain passes and snowy roads, beat Vern’s stage times, chase your ghost and build rally stages of your own.

details.title: OVERSPRAY
details.short_description: OVERSPRAY is a free-to-play tactical 4v4 paintball shooter. Buy your gear every round and fight over a single flag in the middle of the map. Nobody dies — everybody gets soaked.

details.title: Night At The Mall
details.short_description: A psychological horror job sim. Complete security maintenance in a sprawling, desolate mall while surviving creeping, unpredictable threats. Manage electrical systems, monitor CCTV cameras, and survive a night shift where you never know what is lurking in the dark.

details.title: Station KHE-7
details.short_description: Arm your ship, repair your home station, and face vast hordes of vassals serving hostile powers. Every cell counts. Every component can be your key to victory or the harbinger of your downfall. In this roguelite, you decide what your enemies learn to fear.

details.title: Tidy Solve
details.short_description: Tidy Solve is a cozy puzzle game about tidying piles of books, candles and more. Use the power of math to bring order to the mess. Easy to learn, with 1500+ puzzles to solve.

details.title: Fakutori
details.short_description: Fakutori is a laid-back automation game with a lot more going on beneath the surface. Combine elements, build sprawling production lines, and chase down the Legendary Blocks that only the most dedicated builders ever find. All at your own pace.

details.title: Gloosh!
details.short_description: Run, jump and dash through a momentum-driven 3D platformer with incremental progression. Record runs, let clones earn income, buy upgrades and return faster. Refine your routes, collect stars and chase better course times in Gloosh!

details.title: Hexwell
details.short_description: Hexwell is a top-down action roguelite where you use powerful magic spells to fight off hordes of arcane machines. Choose your path through the dungeon, fuse your spells together, create unique builds, and become the ultimate mage. Play solo or local co-op with up to 4 players!

details.title: Wreckingball Warriors
details.short_description: Turn an entire island into your pinball table and smash through the Neon Legion in a wrecking ball! Every warrior you recruit brings a signature move you can mix and match with the rest of your crew’s moves on each run.

details.title: 50 Trillion Grains Of Sand
details.short_description: Dig through 50 trillion grains of sand in a first-person incremental digging sim. Start with a spoon, buy bigger tools, and put machines and Egyptian gods to work as you uncover a buried pyramid and discover the treasure hidden in its tomb.

details.title: One More Pop
details.short_description: A cozy first-person incremental game about popping one million balloons. Shoot pins across a sunny meadow, chain combos and lightning, grow a constellation of 50 upgrades and watch the sky turn from sunrise to a starry night.

details.title: Pull It Together
details.short_description: Pull your weight and your wagon as a crew of up to 4 on this cooperative adventure. Gather supplies, keep your wagon rolling, and band together to face unpredictable events before the storm closes in! Each journey will have different trails, different troubles, but the same trusty wagon.

details.title: Groder Reborn
details.short_description: Turn a low-poly town into your physics playground. Shove, grab and tumble with friends, drive manual cars, handle weapons and magazines, and patch up injured limbs. Spawn your own chaos in Sandbox or join a server and see what happens next.

details.title: Spare Parts: Episode 3
details.short_description: Unit 02 wants nothing more than to hide away in the basement, passing the days doing nothing of consequence with Unit 04. But Unit 03—now Melanie—seeks to run a cafe for humans upstairs, and it's only a matter of time before their secret is out and their lives are ruined. Where can 02 find peace?

details.title: Primal Nights
details.short_description: You wake up in empty facility, blood on the floor, and dinosaurs hunting you down, with a green Primal Fog engulfing the facility, trapping you there. Rescue is five nights away. Use your security measures to fend off the bloodthirsty ancient predators and survive until help arrives.

details.title: Neverwake
details.short_description: You won't survive your first adventure. Probably not your second, either. Explore a retro pixel art fantasy world, fight monsters in turn-based battles, collect loot, and unlock permanent RPG upgrades. Die, learn, grow stronger, and push further with every new run.

details.title: Did You See That?
details.short_description: A 2 Player Anomaly Horror game where not every player sees the same reality. Explore a carnival trapped in an endless transformation, detect anomalies, verify with your friend if they see the same thing and make the right decisions before the clown Bobby loses his temper...

details.title: The White Lamb: No Shelter
details.short_description: Psychological horror meets fast-paced FPS combat. Play as the Ego, traverse the looping nightmarish Persona Storm realm of Id (Red Cloak) and Superego (Blue Cloak). Fight twisted trauma echoes, make fateful choices to forge reconciliation, unearth chilling truth in fractured memory.

details.title: The Adventurer's Guild Idler
details.short_description: Manage your adventurer's guild and send your party to the frontlines against demon foot soldiers and powerful commanders. Watch your tank, warrior, mage and ranger battle monsters, collect loot, train, grow stronger and set out again.

name: Sakura no Uta -To Dance Over the Cherry Blossoms-

details.title: Sakura no Uta -To Dance Over the Cherry Blossoms-
details.short_description: SCA-DI's award-winning visual novel masterpiece is finally available in English and in full HD! Sakura no Uta is a story of those whose paths stop short—and of those who walk on.

details.title: Puzzling Boxes
details.short_description: 4 Puzzling Boxes await for you. Can you complete them all?

details.title: Kaiju Princess: Super Survivor Showdown
details.short_description: Explore a phantasmic realm! Pulverize your enemies! Don't die! Ah... But don't forget to find a way out! Choose from a variety of weapons, skills, and items to complement your character's traits and customize the optimal combat style for survival. Get ready for a fast-paced roguelike survival game!

details.title: PupRacers
details.short_description: 🐕 Race on hoverboards as cute dogs in Hawaiian shirts! 🏄 Complete quests, explore tropical islands, destroy alien Troll oil rigs, and save the planet 🌍 Solo story, online multiplayer, cross-platform. Free to play, no ads!

details.title: Most Games Flop
details.short_description: You’re 12. It’s 2006. You’ve got the family laptop and one dream: make a hit on Studz. Plan every month, build games, chase the algorithm and survive copycats for 20 years. Most games flop. Try anyway. Then do it again with up to 7 friends online.

details.title: SacriFrogos
details.short_description: A roguelike strategy and survival game where ever-growing sacrifices are required to keep the mysterious Eternal Flame alive. Build a colony of Frogos and create unique builds every run.

details.title: Sam Buku Per
details.short_description: hardcore piloting simulator with romantic elements. You will have to balance between the laws of physics and the laws of gravity. Every extra maneuver burns fuel, which separates you from the base... and from a kiss.

details.title: Last Rites
details.short_description: You're ten years old and live with your grandparents. Father Aldous has come to read your grandmother her last rites. Now he says the house must be cleansed of sin. Stay out of sight.

details.title: Meat Engine
details.short_description: Meat Engine is a Sci-Fi boomer shooter inspired by Scorn, Quake, Dusk and Doom. The game is set in a dark and distant future stricken with war and death. Featuring fast and brutal retro combat.

details.title: Realistic Football Career
details.short_description: Realistic Football Career is a text-based football career simulation where you start as an unknown prospect and try to reach the top. Train, improve your attributes, make decisions on the pitch, earn transfers, and build a career where success is never guaranteed.

details.title: DULL ACHE
details.short_description: A horrifying JRPG-inspired adventure follows a sequence of events that multiple people experience after one fateful day... Find their wills to live throughout a multi-chapter story.

details.title: TinkerTale: Diorama Maker
details.short_description: TinkerTale: Diorama Maker is an easy to use sandbox toy that lets you build any world in VR. Choose from thousands of objects and create your own world.

details.title: Aqua Factory Simulator
details.short_description: Harvest and farm aquatic commodities, build and automate your factory, and turn the commodities into valuable products. Run the store automatically, expand your operation, optimize your production, and team up with friends in co-op to build and manage your growing aquatic business.

details.title: School Owner Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run a secondary school from scratch. Plan classrooms and facilities, manage staff and daily schedules, support student development, and improve your school through stronger performance, better results, and growing reputation.

details.title: Islandry
details.short_description: Turn a wild island into a thriving, self-running production network. Gather resources, build farms and machines, automate with drones and conveyor belts, process goods, manage interconnected production, earn profits from trading, and ship your products across the sea in this cozy automation game.

details.title: Sticker Chaos
details.short_description: Sticker Chaos is a relaxing first-person game. Peel thousands of sticky notes, explore locations, find secrets, earn money, upgrade your skills, play mini-games, and even draw on stickers!

details.title: Collectible Cars Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Build the ultimate die-cast car model shop! Find, buy, and sell rare miniatures, customize and expand your store, create racing tracks, and grow a small local shop into a world-famous destination for collectors.

details.title: Throw The Snot
details.short_description: Aim, charge, and flick a sticky booger onto crazy obstacles! Your goal is simple: launch the booger, hit the target, and hold on for 2 agonizing seconds without slipping off. Easy controls, wobbly soft-body physics, and pure rage-inducing gameplay

details.title: CHEW YOUR FOOD
details.short_description: It didn't chew you properly. Escape its stomach by crawling, solving puzzles, listening carefully, and avoiding monsters in this survival horror.

details.title: Oceans - Survival
details.short_description: Oceans - Survival is set in an endless procedurally generated ocean filled with tropical islands to discover and explore. Discover treasure on islands, different flora and fauna and ocean currents that take you anywhere and everywhere.

name: さくらいろプリズム Beyond the Bloom

details.title: さくらいろプリズム Beyond the Bloom
details.short_description: A coming-of-age romance visual novel set in a disbanded high school photography club. Three fully voiced heroines — a childhood friend, a playful junior, a mysterious senior. As love refracts like a prism, what will Hikaru's camera capture? A remake of Sakurairo Prism. "You can always start over."

details.title: Couch Potato
details.short_description: A collection of party games for up to sixteen people on one TV, with the phones already in your pockets as controllers. Hop on the couch, scan the code and you're in. Fight, fish, feast, hop and scrum, and unlock new weapons, arenas, pets and rods as the night goes on.

details.title: Sorting Waifu Figures!
details.short_description: Sorting Waifu Figures is a cozy anime figure sorting game for solo play or a group of friends. Discover over 2500 cute figures, shelves to tidy up, and a pleasant atmosphere with beautiful music!

details.title: CUTROOM: Fashion Designer
details.short_description: Design couture gowns stitch by stitch, paint makeup layer by layer and create jewelled nail art in CUTROOM, a luxurious fashion and beauty studio. Hand-paint fabrics, pipe every seam, add lace, gems and bows, then style and save your finished look.

details.title: My Unicorn Ranch
details.short_description: Your unicorns are waiting for you! Pamper your magical friends, create your own unicorn paradise and explore dreamy landscapes. Saddle up for exciting tournaments, fun contests with friends and enchanting adventures!

details.title: 仙路烟尘
details.short_description: Path of Immortal Dust is a text-based cultivation sim. Train your techniques, break through realms, and explore a world of sect politics and turn-based combat. Every action costs time. Every choice shapes your fate. Immortality is but a thought away.

details.title: Greed, the dice game
details.short_description: One more roll could change everything. Play with up to three friends or take on bots in a dice game of risky choices, devilish bargains, and playful table mischief. Bank your points, push your luck, and make the table your own.

details.title: Little Hamster: Find and Organize
details.short_description: After a long journey, a little hamster returns home to his familiar daily routine. Yet even everyday tasks are full of adventure. Join him as you search for lost items, clean up, and organize the space in a new journey taking you from a forest little house to a lively town.

details.title: Tasty Business
details.short_description: In Tasty Business, turn small restaurants into a culinary empire. Manage your businesses, source fresh ingredients, and attract customers as you expand your empire. Challenges, flavors, and new connections await. Are you ready to become the culinary mogul?

details.title: 无双屠龙
details.short_description: 《无双屠龙》是一款回归纯粹打宝与PK的微变传奇。所有装备全爆，地图无VIP限制，散人友好。核心玩法包括：多大陆解锁、四象神装、元神、八门、灵器等深度养成系统。特色属性包含百分比切割、斩杀、鞭尸，大幅提升BOSS击杀效率。通过沙城捐献、首充双倍、VIP超值礼包快速成长，限时首爆奖励灵符，平民也能霸服。超多BOSS、混沌之地、封魔录等挑战等你来战。

details.title: Gnome Cottage Cleanup!
details.short_description: A whimsical organizing simulator about tracking down thousands of Gnomes, Plants, Books, Potions and more! Use magical abilities and upgrades on your quest to sort 4,060 items scattered across the Gnome Cottage. Just pure exploration, organizing, and collecting with no time limits or pressure.

details.title: DYNASTY: Silk & Blood
details.short_description: 1980. You have $5 million and a family name. Build companies, conquer markets, marry, raise your heirs. Rival dynasties never rest and the world never waits. You will die. Your dynasty must not.

details.title: Launch Hazard
details.short_description: Launch Hazard is a single-player physics score attack game. Send a rocket-powered athlete crashing through arenas, steer mid-crash to chain targets, and complete objectives to score higher and earn better ranks in 90-second runs.

details.title: Wesley Smith's Repair Game
details.short_description: Collect items, craft weapons and defeat your opponents in this frustratingly funny arcade game. Compete against the merciless bots or up to three friends in couch co-op mode to become the master blacksmith!

details.title: Click to Medieval Roguelite
details.short_description: Don't want to play a massive complex campaign? Grow your medieval province with just a few clicks, sell your meager hamlet/kingdom then unlock auto hire workers with incremental upgrades for a more idle playstyle, watch your kingdom grow wealthy and powerful with ease.

details.title: ARCHIVIST: Tidy Up & Sort
details.short_description: A first-person archive work simulator. Sort through boxes of documents, arrange files on the shelves, and bring order to the archive by following its filing rules. Handle stacks of records, keep each section organized, and enjoy the satisfying process of restoring order step by step.

details.title: Robokitties: MEGASTRUCTURE
details.short_description: Explore a dying megastructure with your friends as tiny robokitties. Scavenge dangerous loot, survive evil machines, and get back to the lift before the power runs out.

details.title: Neko Narabe
details.short_description: Line up adorable cats in this score-attack puzzle game! Match five cats of the same color horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to clear lines, trigger combos, and aim for the high score!

name: Car Rental Simulator: Prologue - Early Days

details.title: Car Rental Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
details.short_description: Free introduction to the full Car Rental Simulator game puts you behind the desk of a small-town rental office in Winston Springs. Manage customers, grow your fleet, and deal with surprises along the way

details.title: Archi Vista
details.short_description: Dig, wash, and uncover the lost artifacts in Archi Vista, a relaxing first-person excavation game. Break through layers of earth, clean forgotten ruins, find hidden treasures, and restore extraordinary places one satisfying discovery at a time.

name: 不一样的合成：生生不息 Genesis: From Water to Stars

details.title: 不一样的合成：生生不息 Genesis: From Water to Stars
details.short_description: Combine cards in a resource management and automation game with a meta twist. Start with water, wind, earth, and stone. Discover recipes, assign workers, and connect production lines as your civilization reaches for the stars. Your world comes alive, and your narrator reacts to your experiments.

details.title: MOTHERLODE
details.short_description: Dig into a persistent world of prospecting, mining and industrial engineering. Discover finite deposits, excavate real material, process it through machines, build power, water and logistics networks, sell your haul, upgrade your operation, and expand your claims alone or with friends.

details.title: FrontierCraft
details.short_description: FrontierCraft is a massively multiplayer sandbox set on one vast, fully destructible planet. Twenty kingdoms, thousands of ruins, and every player in the same world. Mine, build, trade and fight. Help kingdoms rise or fall, raise your clan's banner and carve out your place on the frontier.

details.title: ONSIGHT
details.short_description: ONSIGHT is a fast-paced, top-down multiplayer shooter with intense Deathmatch and Survival modes. Grab weapons, upgrade your abilities and unleash chaos against players or bots. With limited vision, obstructed sightlines and directional sound, every encounter is unpredictable.

details.title: Revasion
details.short_description: Breakout, turned inside out. Spin a glowing ring of blocks around a ball that always curves back to the centre. Break every block, survive the bullet-storm Evade phases, and hold on as the whole game speeds up.

details.title: PBA Pro Bowling 2027
details.short_description: Dominate the lanes in the most realistic bowling game ever! Enhanced true-to-life ball and pin physics make every shot feel real. Forge your legacy in PBA Tour Mode, then dominate Online Leagues, Ranked Play, and Online Tournaments to defend your title. This is where champions are made.

details.title: Drone Horizon: Force & Effect
details.short_description: Design, build and configure your own drones. Brace yourself for challenging environments, discover capabilities and limitations of your vehicle, learn how to overcome them. Experiment with different configurations, flight modes, and control techniques to find the right approach for every mission.

details.title: Rat Cleaning Crew
details.short_description: One of your friends is the rat. Four cleaners grab their brooms and have ten minutes to sweep it into the box, before its bites make the whole crew too sick to stand. A chaotic 5-player online party chase with voice chat.

details.title: Napoleon at War
details.short_description: Six of Napoleon's greatest battles, from Marengo to Waterloo, in a digital edition of SPI's classic hex-and-counter wargames. Twelve scenarios, fog of war, a computer opponent for either side, hotseat and ranked online play.

details.title: Phantom Shapes
details.short_description: An online co-op horror party game for 2 to 7 players. The Phantom hides a cursed shape that looks like a normal object and protects it. Up to 6 Workers search the map, argue about which thing is fake and confirm it before the Phantom catches them all. No microtransactions.

details.title: Hundred Tower
details.short_description: Climb a hundred-floor tower in a painterly action roguelite. Chain wall jumps, dash through enemies. Shift gravity, and cut through strange creatures with sword and paint. Choose your upgrades, face the bosses, and work your way up to find out the mystery of the tower.

details.title: One Mote
details.short_description: Grow a glowing web from a single mote of light. Every crystal you reach feeds the core, and the light plays a song. Collapse your web into a star, fill constellations, wake whole galaxies, then fold them back into one mote. An incremental game you can watch grow.

details.title: Cyber Maze
details.short_description: A retro-futuristic 3D maze game with traps and enemies

details.title: Slender Island
details.short_description: Slender Island is a first-person survival horror game where you find yourself on an abandoned island with a goal of stealing all the treasures hidden in its dungeons. However, Slender Mouse and other monsters won't give them up without a fight.

details.title: Solo Chudding
details.short_description: Society has fallen. BILLIONS must die. Do you have what it takes to save the world from the soypocalypse or will nothing ever happen again?

details.title: Orbital Battlefront Eclipse
details.short_description: Command massive fleets, build planetary strongholds, and fight for orbital supremacy in Orbital Battlefront Eclipse. Expand your economy, fortify contested worlds, and outmaneuver enemy forces in large-scale real-time space battles.

details.title: Adventure Reznara
details.short_description: Choose your path in a pixel-art text RPG roguelike. Pick a class, travel six regions by road and sea, and settle every encounter with a card choice: fight, flee, or steal the soul of what you meet. Normal or Permadeath.

details.title: Fable of: Hero's Army
details.short_description: Fable of: Hero's Army is a dark fantasy auto battler card game with roguelite runs and over 200,000 possible card combinations. Choose one of six heroes, gather allies and gear in the tavern, and travel through seven lands. Every run writes a new page.

details.title: i love you
details.short_description: 放学后的校园里，好友失踪、旧楼传来异响，在寻找真相的途中，逐渐发现一段关于青春、秘密与“我爱你”的故事。

details.title: Neptune Melters
details.short_description: Earth is running dry. You're on Neptune with a lighter and a contract. Melt the planet's ice, sell every litre, launch it home by rocket and work your way up to sleds, giant rovers, pumps, drones and conveyor belts, until the whole frozen world is gone.

details.title: Stakeroom: The Final
details.short_description: A turn-based gambling game where every round brings a different threat: poison, electricity, and more. One player, one table, and the same rules every time. How much are you willing to risk?

details.title: This Arcade Is Broken
details.short_description: This Arcade Is Broken is a short incremental game about a kid with a screwdriver secretly rewiring three classic arcade cabinets until they print tokens on their own. Upgrade their circuit boards, build helper paddles and drones, unleash fever mode... and don’t let the grumpy owner catch you.

details.title: Nedi Multiplayer TD
details.short_description: Build a maze, line it with towers and grow it for weeks. Collect creature cards and send them in one ordered wave into other players' mazes, then defend yours while you are away. Beat the weekly World Boss, climb the Sky Race and wake Nedi, the stone titan.

details.title: Dirty Derby
details.short_description: Dirty Derby is a multiplayer party game for 2-4 players. Read the animals that line up differently each round, and shape the finish order your contract demands. Grab your gear and jump onto the track — knock down anyone in your way. Only results remain: outdo the rest and prove yourself.

details.title: HAUL
details.short_description: From broke and jobless to full-time flipper — source, clean, and resell your way through thrift stores, blue bins, and sketchy meetups in a small-town hustle sim.

name: White Line North: Dog Sled Racing

details.title: White Line North: Dog Sled Racing
details.short_description: A fresh new adventure. Build your kennel. Find your perfect eight. Race across 16 different snow, ice and mountain trails in this cozy dog sled racing and management game. Breed and care for your dogs, upgrade your gear, and work your way from the Village Derby to the Great Northern Tour.

details.title: Path & Match
details.short_description: Path & Match is a strategic puzzle game where you must clear a path by matching spheres. Earn moves, overcome traps, obstacles and enemies, and adapt your route to reach the exit in time. Analyze the board and plan your moves.

details.title: Metal Soldiers 3D
details.short_description: Blast through a rebel army across 50+ levels in this side-scrolling run-and-gun. Pilot tanks and mechs, upgrade your weapons, and take down powerful bosses in a 2.5D arcade action adventure.

details.title: Walk in PENUMBRA
details.short_description: An alien who commands the shadows. His goal: to destroy that star hanging in the sky…? Stretch the shadows. Hide in them. Strike from them. A top-down roguelite shooter.

details.title: Never Stop Climbing
details.short_description: Fulfill the biological imperative of a hamster with your friends in up to 8 player co-op. Parkour and climb through multiple uniquely themed and nostalgic levels inspired by classic platforming games. Ascend into space but watch your step! One wrong move and you'll plummet down to Earth!

details.title: BLOODSONG: ECLIPSED!
details.short_description: Amongst all else that is you resides a gaping absence. One way or another, BLOODSONG will make you whole. A surreal, psych-horror visual novel.

details.title: Karesansui
details.short_description: Karesansui is a zen garden meditative sandbox. Rake and decorate your desktop garden as you listen to the calming sounds of nature. Experiment with different patterns, lighting, and materials, and share the perfect photos with your friends.

details.title: Bio-Breaker
details.short_description: Fight against over 30+ different types of enemies in my super epic top-down retro wave shooter; Bio-Breaker! Buy weapons to upgrade, active abilities and passive perks to survive against the hordes!

details.title: Engria, The Twisted Carnival
details.short_description: Step into the paws of Kuros, the shapeshifting cat, in the strange world of Engria where death and mayhem are everyday occurrences alongside tea and biscuits.

details.title: Sovia: Box & Order
details.short_description: Run a busy little paper warehouse. Shelve chilled, fragile and bulky goods, pack the right boxes, rest a tired crew and chain their skills into an ensemble. Follow eight stops to recover a lost route book, then reshape any warehouse in the level editor.

details.title: Gunshot Arcade
details.short_description: Gunshot Arcade combines the action of a classic arcade shoot 'em up with the meta-progression of a roguelike. Buy some weapons, upgrade your gear and survive as long as you can. Unlock much stronger guns from wave to wave and reach a new record, good luck.

details.title: Sad Virus Mythic Land
details.short_description: Sad virus third person simulation adventure game series continue now in small map which include forest and castle themed adventure where mission avoid traps and collect bottles

name: Drunken Hog: Dystopian Pub & Brewing Simulator

details.title: Drunken Hog: Dystopian Pub & Brewing Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own pub in this atmospheric and story-rich job simulator. Featuring a full brewing pipeline, dynamic NPCs, side quests, bar upgrades and expansions, branching dialogue, a freely explorable city, and a deep narrative set in dystopian Napolis City.

details.title: Twilight Pretender
details.short_description: His ex-girlfriend returns the day after their breakup—but she is now a “pretender,” a creature that devours and mimics humans. To save the real Chise, Hiroto must become her fake girlfriend’s boyfriend—for a limited time. But when a fake romance becomes real… Can he still call her a monster?

details.title: Time Survivor
details.short_description: Time drains your life away. Dodge, dash, and blast through enemies and brutal bosses. Collect resources to stay alive and grow stronger through a massive skill tree, unlocking a lot of new mechanics to master. Fight Time and its Time Keepers. How long can you last?

details.title: Falafel El Assad
details.short_description: Do you have what it takes to serve the best Falafel in Moscow? Defy the elements in this whacky cooking sim and earn money to gain power-ups. Test your skills, and improve them to prepare for the final boss battle that will shake your world!

details.title: Escape to Ariah
details.short_description: Master deep skill trees, forge god-tier gear, and carve through relentless hordes in this dark fantasy ARPG. Endless build variety, thrilling boss fights, and endgame adventures await you.

details.title: Emoji Battlefield - Island Warfare
details.short_description: A chaotic rogue-like FPS set on a mysterious island where ancient tiki emojis rise to attack! Choose modifiers, unlock new arenas, and survive endless waves of emoji warriors. Dash, jump, shoot, and use jungle traps or temple hazards to outsmart the swarm.

details.title: Lich Lords
details.short_description: A Lovecraftian roguelite where you wake up as a Lich with no memory, trapped in a world where everything wants to kill you. Forge deadly builds, slay rival Liches and monstrous horrors, and uncover the truth behind this strange new world.

details.title: The Millionth Ticket
details.short_description: The Millionth Ticket is a lottery simulator: Buy tickets, pick numbers and watch live draws on TV. Manage your money and pay rent so your asshole landlord won't kick you out. Hit the jackpot and escape your shitty life to spend your days drinking and watching TV.

details.title: FD's Industry Tycoon
details.short_description: Build a global industrial empire from a 1990s desktop. A retro business management sim, hand-drawn in pixel art. Alone or in MP: open factories worldwide, broker supply deals across continents, and acquire rivals when they falter. Markets shift, empires grow, and the CRT flickers.

details.title: The Industrial Council
details.short_description: A cozy AI driven game where you play a journalist in a steampunk fantasy city. Change is coming to Raversul, and with the help of your imp and your newspaper you will play a powerful role in shaping it. Solve mysteries, uncover stories, and shape politics in this revolutionary new game.

details.title: Death & Taxes Multiplayer RPG
details.short_description: Become a trader, a hero, a legend...even a god. In Death & Taxes you can pursue anything...but only two things are certain.

details.title: My Empire MUST Grow
details.short_description: Your village is tiny, and that is a problem, because it MUST become an empire. Three neighbouring kingdoms disagree. Gather, build, raise the walls, hold the waves and finish the Wonder before they burn it all down.

name: HEIRS OF VARNA 灰冠の継承者

details.title: HEIRS OF VARNA 灰冠の継承者
details.short_description: Command Aster and her companions in a turn-based tactical RPG told across 24 chapters. Read enemy ranges, choose who crosses first, and make good on a promise to a child waiting at the border gate.

details.title: Ukraine Under Fire
details.short_description: Command Ukrainian or Russian forces in a 3D turn-based strategy game. Capture cities, defend river crossings, dig trenches and coordinate land, air and naval units on a hex map of Ukraine. Each turn brings new decisions—and another day of war.

details.title: Life Overhaul
details.short_description: Design, build, and live the ultimate garage life. Create vehicles, trailers, and homes from scratch, customize every detail, and shape your own open world. Play solo or host friends in a growing community-driven sandbox of creativity and craftsmanship.

details.title: Sincognito
details.short_description: A social deduction investigation horror game where one of you is secretly possessed by a Deadly Sin. Use stealth and proximity chat to cooperate or deceive as you gather clues and compare findings to deduce which Sin is haunting the castle.

details.title: The Lonely Meadow
details.short_description: In The Lonely Meadow, you are a wandering spirit in a silent world. Glide over yellow plains to spark vibrant life in your wake and seek out 16 shattered landmarks. Reassemble the past to restore colour, sound, and soul to this forgotten sanctuary. Will you wake the meadow?

details.title: 30 Days: The Last Melody
details.short_description: 30 Days: The Last Melody invites you into the journey of a young man living out his final 30 days. Experience a warm and emotional journey brought to life through beautiful hand-painted visuals, soothing music, and engaging mini-games as you reflect on love, hope, and the value of every moment.

details.title: Broadcast Storm
details.short_description: Fight your way through the corporate ladder in 'Broadcast Storm.' An office based brawler / beat 'em up style game. Where you play as Chuck, a System Administrator trying to save the company from an unknown threat. Play through single player campaign or online multiplayer survival mode!

details.title: Stay Live: Ghost Viewers
details.short_description: Every stream from this closed hospital ward cut out before the roof. Tonight, you go live, and every floor looks like the last. Spot the anomalies and film them, follow clues to unlock the way forward, and survive what hunts you in this first-person survival horror game. Chat is watching.

details.title: Ant Mill Inc
details.short_description: Feed the nest. Grow the swarm. Devour the world. A dark incremental ant colony game where one ant becomes thousands. Gather food, upgrade the nest, uncover strange offerings, and fight for survival. Face the HUNGER - or become it...

details.title: Dragon Up! Together
details.short_description: Combine the Baby Dragon's versatility with the Young Dragon's strength to overcome challenges and guide this team of Dragons back home. Play solo with both Dragons or team up with friends to jump, solve puzzles, dodge hazards and glide your way to safety. Just make sure they don't fall all at once!

details.title: Through the Varnish
details.short_description: A love letter to art. Walk into fifteen of the most beloved paintings ever made, explore them as living 3D worlds, and meet the people who live inside them.

details.title: Dominoir
details.short_description: Dominoir is a domino roguelike set in a noir casino. Match tiles to build chains, loop them back on themselves, and combine Schemes and Marks to chase huge scores. The House changes the rules, so your strategy has to keep up. Think Balatro meets dominoes.

details.title: Guns & Gargoyles
details.short_description: Eight children are missing in the Black Forest. A disgraced monster hunter walks in after them, carrying a torch, a family name and a grudge. A grimdark open world RPG where the folklore was true, and it has been waiting for company.

details.title: Crest: Climb Together
details.short_description: Climb a massive mountain with up to 4 friends in this physics-based co-op adventure. Explore dangerous trails, discover useful gear, and help each other survive unpredictable challenges on the way to the summit.

details.title: Is This the Way
details.short_description: Is This The Way is a chaotic 1–4 player online co-op survival game. Escape adaptive robot enemies, conquer physics-based parkour, and respawn to try again as teamwork turns into hilarious sabotage in unpredictable, fast-paced matches.

details.title: Game of Warriors
details.short_description: Defend your city, conquer enemy lands, and build a powerful empire in this unique tower defense strategy game. Upgrade defenses and technolgy, command troops, and face massive waves, siege weapons, and war elephants as you expand across the map.

details.title: Byeway
details.short_description: A short first-person ghost story about the last bus of the day, and the old man who drives it.

details.title: Noir Tycoon
details.short_description: Build your criminal empire in the turbulent 1960s, manage rackets, outsmart rival gangs, and rise from the streets to the top of the underworld.

name: Swish and Flick: Tidy Up Together

details.title: Swish and Flick: Tidy Up Together
details.short_description: A wizard duel has wrecked the wand shop: thousands of magical objects lie scattered across its rooms. Sort wands, potions, runes and candles back where they belong, cast tidying spells, and watch every room wake up in a burst of magic. Play solo or with up to three friends.

details.title: Sort In Silence
details.short_description: Shelve up to 8,500 books in a pitch-dark university library while Mika reads at her desk. Work too fast or too loud and she transforms and hunts you. Hide, keep the lights on, buy upgrades, and play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

details.title: Chain Detonator
details.short_description: Set mines, lure robots into your trap and trigger explosive chain reactions—then escape the blast. A top-down action-puzzle game with 50 campaign levels, solo challenges, local PvP for 2–4 players and online PvP for up to 16 on dedicated servers.

details.title: Sovia: Five Year Plan
details.short_description: A cozy competitive card game in Sovia's broadcast station. Race to complete five plans, hand your building resources to rivals, scout their cards, and survive disasters. Six seats by default, with computer players and friend rooms.

details.title: ClickiBrick
details.short_description: In ClickiBrick matching is the name of the game. Match at least 4 colors together to break them, chain them, and score points! See how high you can get! Easy to get into, and hard to put down.

details.title: Incremental Defense
details.short_description: Optimize, automate, and scale your defense to survive increasingly challenging waves in this addictive incremental tower defense.

name: Tribal Towers - Siege of the Shifting Fortress

details.title: Tribal Towers - Siege of the Shifting Fortress
details.short_description: 8 Player Online Co-op. Summoned by a magical tree to free the villagers and root out the evil wizard from the shifting fortress. Fight through crypts, fire, swamp, earth and air dungeons, loot gear and gain skills. Challenge bosses, rescue allies, take the wizard down.

details.title: Us Against Wood
details.short_description: Us Against Wood is a co-op casual game where you and your friends share one simple goal: chop down a single enormous tree. Work together or alone to carve deeper into the trunk.

details.title: Bloom & Dine
details.short_description: Bloom & Dine is a cooking game with a rare mechanic where cozy meets chaos. Match ingredients to light up the stove, fit each dish onto the board and serve it before your cat guests lose patience. Run five kitchens across 99 days, from a tiny pizzeria to a grill terrace by the sea.

details.title: Rage Trip
details.short_description: A difficult pixel-art platformer where the game roasts every mistake. Play solo, race friends, or try Shared Fate: 2–4 players, and one death resets the whole team. Beat your best times, clear a level together, earn animated skins. Free demo available - wishlist the full game.

details.title: Mars Gardener
details.short_description: Madame Odette, 74, hired for her hedges, must grow a posh suburban lawn on Mars. Sow, water, mow perfect stripes, sell your turf bricks to rich colonists, and weather dust storms, moles and −80 °C nights. The Red Planet will be green.

details.title: The Divided
details.short_description: Co-op extraction action-RPG for 1–4 players. Take missions from the hideout, drop into hostile zones, and fight or sneak past the infected. Loot what you can carry and extract — or die and leave it all behind. Melee is the smart play. Guns invite the horde. Craft, trade, gear up. Bring friends.

details.title: Neptune
details.short_description: Neptune is a short, chapter-based, dropper and precision platformer game. Soar and explore through abandoned architecture, receive gruesome mutations, enjoy the atmosphere and banging OST, and figure out the truth of what happened on Neptune all those years ago...

details.title: Dokimon Frontier
details.short_description: The first FREE Dokimon experience: A Monster-Tamer Roguelike! Collect monsters, discover rare items, and battle to your heart's content.

details.title: Astonia Forever
details.short_description: Astonia Forever is a classic fantasy MMORPG. Explore towns and dangerous dungeons, complete quests, develop your skills and spells, collect powerful equipment, trade with other players, and join clans in a persistent online world.

details.title: DeadLoop
details.short_description: DeadLoop is an underwater sandbox set in a miniature ocean inside a glass cube. Raise a flock of water sheep, discover rare breeds and colors, and keep your coral reef thriving. Then summon a storm or a whirlpool and see how your flock reacts.

details.title: Last Tank Standing
details.short_description: Last Tank Standing is a real-time tank tactics game where armour has a front, sides and a rear. A heavy tank shrugs off shells from the front and dies to almost anything from behind. Your job is to get round it.

details.title: Scratch It! Lucky Cards
details.short_description: Scratch tickets, uncover hidden rewards, and upgrade your abilities in this relaxing casual game. Discover unique themes, collect treasures, and build your luck one scratch at a time.

details.title: SpaceRabbit
details.short_description: A space bunny working for a ruthless delivery company! Dodge asteroids, collect stars, customize your rocket, and compete with players worldwide. Survive the harsh life of a space courier!

details.title: TheDowsing / ダウジング
details.short_description: You have entered a sealed gold mine, dreaming of a fortune. All you can rely on is your dowsing rod. Is it gold that lies beyond your reaction, or is it......?

details.title: Ashes of the Swarm
details.short_description: Ashes of the Swarm is a cute open-ended puzzle game about creating explosive chain reactions with insect cowboys (and girls), that tries to reinvent itself in some unexpected ways.

details.title: DineInn
details.short_description: DineInn is a cozy horror restoration sim where you clean, repair, cook, farm, explore, and manage a forgotten diner and inn to restore it for profit. Uncover its buried secrets while maintaining your sanity, or the horror will begin. (Single dev project)

details.title: Iron Trails
details.short_description: Build a railway across a living valley, then run it by the book. Survey grades, plant signals, line routes from the CTC board, and switch industries with air brakes and coupler slack you can feel. You are the dispatcher and the engineer.

details.title: Out of Body
details.short_description: James wakes up one morning—and his physical body is gone. Even worse, no one seems to notice he’s disappeared. After drifting through 1993 San Francisco for months unseen, he eventually stumbles onto what he must do to get his body back and live a life worth knowing.

details.title: Night Portable
details.short_description: Night Portable is a night-shift survival horror set in a used game store. Clean, restock, and hide from ■■■ until 6 AM. Play three retro handheld games and cash out for items—or risk losing them. Manage light, noise, and resources as a side-scrolling adventure uncovers the past behind the curse.

details.title: Spin Cycle
details.short_description: A roguelite strategy game where you keep the books for the criminal underworld. Take contracts from cartels and sanctioned regimes, build money routes across dozens of jurisdictions, play the market of sanctioned coins. And try not to annoy Interpol.

details.title: Incralife
details.short_description: Live an unpredictable life shaped by evolving choices, random opportunities, and the habits you build over decades. Grow your skills, build wealth, form relationships, and discover which unique Life Archetype your story becomes.

details.title: Rainbow Tower Defense
details.short_description: Your towers don't fire a single shot. You block the horde with the lines between them. Deploy the right towers and mix diverse line synergies to craft your winning strategy. Classic tower defense, completely reinvented. Test your tactical limits against escalating waves.

details.title: Song of Ashes
details.short_description: Song of Ashes is a fantasy war action game. Fight through massive battles with powerful Musou attacks, command your troops, move seamlessly from the world map into combat, advance your units, and make camp between encounters.

details.title: Cry Wolf
details.short_description: Cry Wolf is a multiplayer social deduction game inspired by Werewolf, where secret alliances, risky bets, and new roles turn the classic rules upside down. Face 5 to 19 other players over voice chat across varied maps and unmask the wolves before it's too late.

details.title: Donkey Jump: In the Loop
details.short_description: A cult donkey hops around a tiny island. You build the loop it hops on, play Rite cards mid-jump and dress it for the end of the world. Fill six quotas before the Ritual Candle burns out and Krakhaw, the donkey-kraken of the deep, rises to carry you into the sunset.

details.title: Final Buzzer : Idle Basketball Manager 🏀
details.short_description: Basketballs rain onto your street court and every shot that drops earns you cash. Spend it on a 196-node skill tree, grow your squad to 30 shooters, and play real 5v5 pixel-art matches to climb seven leagues. An idle basketball game you can actually watch.

details.title: Highway Station Simulator
details.short_description: Run a highway gas station with up to four friends. Pump the fuel by hand, stock the shelves, punch card payments into the register and try to keep the place from catching fire. A first-person co-op management sim about one very long shift.

details.title: Tiny Desktop Terrarium
details.short_description: Tiny Desktop Terrarium is a glass world that lives on your desktop. You build it however you want, add creatures and inhabitants then watch it grow and flourish while you use your computer and go about your day. Pop in whenever you want to see how things are evolving!

name: Fuwamee: Sheep’s New Year! - Out Now

details.title: Fuwamee: Sheep’s New Year! - Out Now
details.short_description: 2027 is the Year of the Sheep! Float a woolly sheep up to the New Year's dawn, count sheep to the beat, herd your flock home before midnight, and more. Eleven bite-sized sheep minigames, each playable in minutes - some with a friend, versus or co-op - plus high scores and leaderboards to chase.

details.title: Devour & Evolve
details.short_description: Born at the bottom of the food chain in a first-person labyrinth. Devour what you weaken and keep one of its skills or traits, or bind it and breed it at home: its egg is your next body. The blood remembers. Train what you eat, fuse it into new arts, and evolve into branches your line never had.

details.title: The Dark Signal
details.short_description: The Dark Signal is a gothic roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a transmission. Build a deadly deck, command summons, manage Debt and Fury, uncover forbidden signals, and survive three floors before facing the entity known as The Last Hand.

details.title: Oceanarium Fishing
details.short_description: Fish, explore and survive in a co-op horror adventure for 1–4 players. Brave the ocean, upgrade your boat and build your aquarium. But save enough of your catch to feed the island’s Keeper: its daily quota is growing, and the water hides more than fish.

details.title: Textures Not Found
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious facility where colors have vanished. Restore the world piece by piece, uncover hidden secrets, and navigate unique environments guided by a sarcastic AI companion in this atmospheric narrative experience.

details.title: Birdflop
details.short_description: An intense platformer with a unique one-button control. You've fallen from your nest, and you're just learning how to fly. Can you make it back to the top?

details.title: Please, let me fish.
details.short_description: All you want is to fish, but the Tide has other plans. Hold off endless swarms of cute monsters on tiny planets, collect 60 Devices, fuse them into Overclocks, and grow strong enough to face the Tide Lords! Then maybe you’ll cast your line again...

details.title: After 9:59
details.short_description: After 9:59 is a psychological horror game set on Halloween night, you're alone in your new apartment. A list of strange rules may be your only protection once 9:59 PM passes and the knocking begins.

details.title: Tower Fight
details.short_description: Build a defense that outlasts your rivals. Choose heroes, combine towers, runes and relics, and battle recorded rival defenses in roguelike runs across four kingdoms. Every round puts your strategy to the test.

details.title: IdleBound - 2D Idle MMORPG
details.short_description: Explore a colorful 2D pixel MMORPG. Choose your class, learn skills, hunt monsters, and quest across meadows, seaside paths, and snowy peaks. Party up with friends, trade your loot, gear up, and make your mark on a shared online world.

details.title: Fat Cat Cruz
details.short_description: Free-to-play third-person robot action with RTS elements. Pilot giant machines, command allies, and fight 1v5, 2v5, or five-way free-for-all battles across 11 maps. Robots are sold separately. Online multiplayer and cross-platform play are coming soon. Out December 21, 2026.

details.title: Fishing Up
details.short_description: Catch 48 unique fish and complete collections in a relaxing fishing game. Explore different locations, use various baits and rods, and enjoy a peaceful angling experience.

details.title: JUST SHOVEL IT!
details.short_description: A cozy Christmas game about shoveling snow. It snowed all night, and the snow is not going anywhere on its own. Clear the yard before Christmas, feed the furnace, hang the lights, and take your time.

details.title: Homeguard
details.short_description: A 1-4 player strategy game. Build your fortress by day and defend it by night.

details.title: Legacy of Mind
details.short_description: Legacy of Mind is the first gothic soulslike FPS where nightmares and reality have merged. Face colossal Monarchs that rule over the world overrun by living nightmares. Unlock otherworldy powers hidden within your mind, but with every power unlocked, something in the dark wakes with you...

details.title: ORION
details.short_description: ORION is a real-time sci-fi 4X grand strategy game where you explore a procedurally generated galaxy, build an interstellar empire, shape its society, design powerful fleets, and conquer, unite, or outlast your rivals.

details.title: Kill Or Be Killed
details.short_description: Kill Or Be Killed is a fast-paced action combat game where deadly combos and quick thinking decide who survives. Outsmart your opponents, punish their mistakes, and master your next move in multiplayer PvP or sharpen your skills solo against bots.

details.title: Butt Brawl: Survival
details.short_description: Butt Brawl: Survival is a high-energy bullet-heaven where uniquely powerful butt heroes battle endless hordes of toilet-themed enemies. Play solo or local co-op, insane upgrade combinations, defeat massive bosses, unlock permanent abilities, and chase glory across increasingly brutal difficulties.

details.title: Caramba Caballeros
details.short_description: Caramba Caballeros is a first-person pirate roguelike for 1–4 players. Explore islands and hunt for treasure by day. Defend your ship from enemy waves by night. Battle other pirates in a battle royale, solo or in teams, with matchmaking and custom lobbies.

details.title: LOOT MULE
details.short_description: A turn-based dungeon roguelite. Dive deep, grab all you can carry, and make it back alive. The deeper you go and the more you take, the more the dungeon notices you, until its Warden comes hunting. Die, and you lose everything you carried.

details.title: Pan, Please!
details.short_description: Grab. Sizzle on the beat. Serve. Pay the debt. A rhythm cooking roguelite where one frying pan grows a broke little shop into a fully automated kitchen storm — three pans, flying plates and GOLDEN TIME that never ends. Drag the pan, feel the beat.

details.title: Dungeon Town Life
details.short_description: Your Adventure, Your Dungeon, Your Home! A cozy 3D anime dungeon crawler with village life. Fight through dungeons by day, then return to forge weapons, grow healing herbs, brew potions and decorate your home. Play solo or with friends.

details.title: Hero of the Kingdom: Echoes
details.short_description: Experience a lovely adventuring RPG as a humble herbalist whose home is threatened by an unknown blight. Explore ancient ruins and mysterious depths, brew potent potions, and help people in need. Enjoy the deeply gratifying feeling of gradually restoring the entire realm.

details.title: Lanternfall
details.short_description: Draft gladiator champions, place them on the sand and watch them fight. Lanternfall is a comic-book roguelite autobattler: forge weapons, roll dice that rewrite the rules of the run, and rebuild a ruined town between bloody nights in the arena.

details.title: Snow and Loathing
details.short_description: You wake up on a sofa in a snowy wasteland. Beside you: an old camper. Ahead: a road disappearing into the fog. Find fuel, earn money, and keep moving, alone or with a friend. The further you travel, the stranger everything becomes.

details.title: DeckTerra
details.short_description: DeckTerra is a 4X strategy game built around cards. Explore procedurally generated maps, research new technologies, develop your settlements, and raise armies all while building a deck that complements your strategy.

details.title: The Gastarbeiters
details.short_description: The Gastarbeiters is a 1-5 player co-op game about building when the whole world is against you. Build a house through explosions, assaults, and raging storms. Will you complete the construction and survive?

details.title: Wildseed
details.short_description: Wildseed is a relaxing game where you grow plants and build your garden into a haven for cute animals. Keep your animals happy and your plants healthy, find rare variants, and discover the ancient secrets your garden holds - one seed at a time.

details.title: Bubbits
details.short_description: Pop your way to victory in a colorful next generation Bubble Shooter! Beat 24 other players in battle royale, play VS mode with friends or go on a singleplayer adventure. Bubbits is packed with cute customization, explosive power ups and crazy battle events to shake up the game!

details.title: Please, Tell Me Why?
details.short_description: You live alone. At least, you’re supposed to. Go live. Explore your apartment. Talk to your viewers. Everything seems normal - until little things stop making sense. A first-person psychological thriller about identity, isolation, and the terrifying price of confronting the truth.

details.title: Demolition Expert 拆迁专家
details.short_description: Blast through walls, destroy pillars, and enjoy the moment of collapse. This game lets you destroy buildings in any way you want!

details.title: Farm of the unseen
details.short_description: Something is wrong on this farm. Shadows and horrors lurk in its corners, waiting as you uncover buried secrets and solve twisted puzzles. Explore lakes, stables, and fields. Wander through mazes and cursed chambers. The unseen are waiting. They have always known you were coming.

details.title: Fantasy Wars: Endless Heroes
details.short_description: Sandbox tactics with permadeath. Build a party in a randomly generated world.

details.title: Gutting Goblins! 2
details.short_description: Adventurers return to their village to find it burned down by a tribe of nearby goblins. It is time to return to slaughtering goblins in this next installment of Gutting Goblins!, with far more features and fun to be had! The indie hack and slash game is back!

details.title: Kamigami: Spirits of the Nature
details.short_description: Get ready for another card battling adventure on Kamigami! Easy to play, hard to master, collect brand new cards, face over 80 opponents, build your strategies and restore peace to the gods!

details.title: Hit Snooze
details.short_description: Alarms must be smashed. Sleep must be had. Stretch your arm out from under the blanket and smash every ringing alarm before you wake up! Pay off your sleep debt, upgrade your bedroom and snooze your way past roosters, phones and MONDAY itself in this cozy, chaotic active incremental.

name: Clean Those Carpets! - Carpet Cleaning Simulator

details.title: Clean Those Carpets! - Carpet Cleaning Simulator
details.short_description: Ever seen a video of someone cleaning a really filthy carpet? This game is exactly that! A satisfying process of cleaning a carpet from filthy to perfectly spotless.

details.title: Silent Authority: Blood & Bourbon
details.short_description: Strategy meets action RPG in the 1920s New York criminal underworld. Build your empire through front businesses and bootlegging, lead your crew in brutal top-down tactical combat, and rule the city through cunning diplomacy or pure bloodshed.

details.title: Shake
details.short_description: A Revolutionary Fillet Action Game! Control a salmon fillet, something you never knew you wanted—until now.

details.title: Penguin Pirates
details.short_description: Penguin Pirates is a chaotic sailing party game where you catch the wind and shoot your cannons at the same time. Collect power-ups, dodge sharks, and sink your friends to prove you are the best pirate ever, arrr!

details.title: Angry Cleaner VR
details.short_description: The night shift has gone wrong. In Angry Cleaner VR, you’re the janitor in an office full of secrets. Move quietly, take them down one by one, and leave no one behind.

details.title: Out of Delivery
details.short_description: You’re a courier robot. Grab packages, race to the drop point, and throw cargo at rivals to steal their loot. Scooters, hacking, contracts and seven package types. Deliver fast. Hit hard. Get rich!

details.title: F-2 MISSIONS: CASE ONE
details.short_description: A physics-based flight sim with authentic handling: the JASDF's F-2 over a true-to-scale Japan. As a rookie on a special course, train from takeoffs to valley runs, formation, refueling and US carrier traps, then fly alert scrambles and ops training against simulated SAMs. On a monitor or in VR.

details.title: Tamer Survivors
details.short_description: Team up with adorable animal companions and combine their abilities to defeat hordes of trash monsters! Evolve a variety of weapons, create a new build with every run, and cleanse a polluted world in this casual roguelite survival action game.

name: Save The Shapes: Chapter 2 - Diamond's Revenge

details.title: Save The Shapes: Chapter 2 - Diamond's Revenge
details.short_description: In Save The Shapes: Chapter 2, the Shapes thought their troubles were finally over... They were wrong. Diamond is back! With old friends returning and some new Shapes joining the chaos, you’ll have to survive new dangers, strange places, and whatever Diamond has planned for his revenge.

details.title: PenguinIsland
details.short_description: A cozy survival-and-fishing adventure with a PlayStation 2 soul. Crash-land on a tropical island, fish with a lock-pick timing wheel, trade with Mr. Crabby, and rebuild a wrecked bomber into a raft. Then the sea has other plans…

name: Catgirl Fantasy: Oath of the Night Sky

details.title: Catgirl Fantasy: Oath of the Night Sky
details.short_description: A classic turn-based RPG with feline companions. Explore a pixel-art world, uncover the red moon's curse, and plan each move in command-based battles. Grow stronger with every weapon and spell you use, follow keywords from conversations, and discover hidden dungeons.

details.title: VERDANT — Forest Archer
details.short_description: Turn one arrow into a storm. Dodge attacks, scoop up gold, and build a bow that fires piercing, ricocheting volleys in this top-down incremental action game. Choose from three archers and fight your way through five areas, one short round at a time.

details.title: 驱邪师
details.short_description: Exorcist is a first-person horror role-playing game where players step into the shoes of an exorcist, visit haunted locations, follow clues, complete specific tasks, and gradually uncover the truth behind the haunting

details.title: Sponge Bridges
details.short_description: G-City has fallen. Survivors are hiding in scattered corners of the city, and food, and everyday supplies are scarce. You make a living delivering cargo for others—and, along the way, try to find out what happened here. For now... just get the cargo delivered. And try not to starve on the way.

details.title: Bros of Bench
details.short_description: Bros of Bench is a minimalist cooperative platformer in which two players form a dumbbell connected by an adjustable bar. Take turns lifting each other and using the jetpack. Mastering coordination, physics, and timing will be key to winning!

details.title: Gold Seller
details.short_description: All you have is a game account. Farm gold, sell it for cash in a shady group chat, and keep up with rent, a PC installment and an AI subscription. Get paid first, or send the gold first? One bad call and a day of grinding is gone.

details.title: Up & Up: Pinball & Pachinko
details.short_description: A unique combination of pinball and pachinko. Collect pachinko balls, fight your way to the top, and unlock the pachinko board where a hail of points awaits! Play pinball to unlock pachinko. Play pachinko to set a new high score!

details.title: No Return Address
details.short_description: Night shift at a distribution center. Ordinary packages go forward, strange ones go to reject. Just don’t make a mistake when the boxes start containing things that should never be there.

details.title: Hyper Drill
details.short_description: Hyper Drill is a speedrunning runner game, where you fly at hyper speed. Drill through any obstacle, master your timing, learn level layouts, and jump between different galaxies.

details.title: The Mortal
details.short_description: 《下凡》是一款俯视角角色扮演模拟经营游戏。怀揣憧憬，你告别故土踏入喧嚣陌生的大城。前路万千，没有唯一的活法：务工谋生、寻玉赌石、卜算吉凶、赶海远航，在市井烟火与机缘变数里，邂逅羁绊，书写属于你的人间际遇。

details.title: PHILSEQUE DIVISION
details.short_description: Pilot powerful combat ships in this 3D space action roguelite. Face ever-growing enemy hordes, collect experience, install modules, create devastating builds, and survive intense battles against minibosses and bosses across hostile regions of space.

details.title: Tiny Winterville
details.short_description: Create your own little winter world in a cozy sandbox. Shape the snow, build with ice and wood, and decorate with trees, lanterns, and more. Bring your village to life with animals and fish, and enjoy watching your creation come together.

details.title: LOOPR
details.short_description: A fast-paced puzzle platformer where you must loop through variations of the same level in order to win! Collect artifacts to make the previously impossible actually possible.

details.title: Farm Bang
details.short_description: Raise living ammo, blast monsters, haul massive loot, and survive the debt collectors in this chaotic top-down farming shooter.

details.title: The Lower Worlds I: Valenfeld
details.short_description: Valenfeld is a Co-Op RPG with a procedurally generated Open World and Dungeons. Combine Warrior, Rogue, Wizard, Cleric, Druid, and Necromancer into custom classes, with in depth talent trees and combinations. Join a living world of factions, monsters and war where your choices matter.

details.title: Dendron 64
details.short_description: With the help of a custom emulator, a lost 90s puzzle platformer game has finally been restored. Explore the secrets of the dam, find out what happened to your friends, and save the valley from the monster lying in its depths.

details.title: La Bidouillerie
details.short_description: A real electronics simulator: build robots, a 1970s pinball table and a 1980s dart machine from real parts (solenoids, gears, connecting rods, relays, transistors). Wire the circuit, switch on, find out why it won't run: every current is computed, every fault has a cause.

details.title: Canyon Gliding
details.short_description: Endless Paper Plane Throwing

details.title: EMPTYLAND
details.short_description: EMPTY LAND is a cinematic single-player survival horror game featuring atmospheric exploration, psychological horror, mystery, puzzles, and survival gameplay. The full game will contain additional levels, locations, story content, enemies, puzzles, and cinematic sequences.

details.title: Fire Crew Simulator
details.short_description: A co-op firefighting sim for up to 4 players. Fly helicopters with water buckets and drive the fire engine against a forest fire that spreads tree by tree, all on the same map. Or run the lookout tower campaign on your own.

details.title: TechRunners
details.short_description: TechRunners is an open-world 2.5D MMORPG set in the city of New Haven, where survival means climbing to the top. Start from nothing, build your empire, and take on rival TechRunners and Megacorporations. Form a crew to take control of the city or use your talents to climb the arena rankings.

details.title: Tower of Elyndium
details.short_description: Tower of Elyndium is a single-player action RPG featuring souls-like combat, where you ascend a mysterious tower. Face challenging enemies and bosses while exploring puzzle-filled floors and uncovering the secrets hidden at the tower’s peak.

name: Help! I'm Stuck In A Fractal!

details.title: Help! I'm Stuck In A Fractal!
details.short_description: (As seen on CodeTV S3 E7!) Thank you for calling the Higher Dimensional Manifold Escape Hotline. Your call is very important to us, and will be answered in the order in which it was received. In the meantime, please do not attempt to modify the fractals, or move through higher dimensions.

details.title: Rose Guns Days -Season 3-
details.short_description: In 1944, unprecedented disaster struck Japan, forcing it to accept an unconditional ceasefire from its enemy nations in World War 2. As a result, the Japanese have become a people without a nation, but they still come together and do whatever it takes to live without giving up...

details.title: Mongolian Wind Script 1: Chongzheng Academy
details.short_description: A historical visual novel set in early-20th-century Inner Mongolia. Make choices for Saran, a girl placed in the real Chongzheng Academy, and branch her story toward five true endings. Featuring native vertical Mongolian script rendering and reimagined period music.

name: The Echo of MeMe-For You Adrift in the Sea of Reveries

details.title: The Echo of MeMe-For You Adrift in the Sea of Reveries
details.short_description: Welcome to the Meme Space—a dream of scattered fragments. Cross the plains, descend to the deep-sea city, link time, and ride to the Silver River. A denpa-style roaming text adventure, made for you.

details.title: DRAMAtical Murder re:code NITRO ARCHIVE
details.short_description: NITRO CHiRAL's hit BL adventure game DRAMAtical Murder re:code is now available on Steam! Aoba, our protagonist, spends his days working part-time at Hum-Drum Junk. All he ever wanted was to live a peaceful life. However, strange events have begun transpiring in places beyond his fathoming.

name: I Refuse the Bad Ending for fear of Muscle Loss

details.title: I Refuse the Bad Ending for fear of Muscle Loss
details.short_description: A 530,000 combat SHSL personal trainer is reincarnated as a villainess?! “Guillotine in a year? I’ll tank it with my traps.”A chaotic gain-seeking survival comedy romance fantasy visual novel about a character who fears muscle loss more than death.

details.title: Caution! Platforming Ahead
