details.short_description: Caution! Platforming Ahead is an abstract precision platformer starring Platformo. Run, jump, and blaze throughout the ether of a mysterious dimension utilizing incredible energy to defy gravity. Twenty scenes of classic platforming action await.

name: 新生：若能好好长大 Rebirth: If Only I Had Grown Up Right

details.title: 新生：若能好好长大 Rebirth: If Only I Had Grown Up Right
details.short_description: This is a simulation game that emphasizes the long-term impact of choices. Players take on the role of a Chinese woman born in the 2000s who has experienced trauma from her family of origin and must raise her newborn child until adulthood, ensuring the child's mental and physical well-being.

details.title: Caspian's Quest
details.short_description: The world of Caspian’s Quest is built around travel. Your wagon is more than transportation — it is your storage, shelter, lifeline, and symbol of progress. Preparation matters. The right meal, tool, potion, or crafted item can make the difference between a safe journey or an untimely end.

details.title: Cartomancy
details.short_description: Turn-based RPG style experience with emphasis on RNG and hints of team building strategy. Uncover a metaphysical mystery from an unlikely inheritance. Cipher the code and face the powers that may be. This isn't just a game, It's an initiation.

details.title: Five Crazy Nights
details.short_description: Five Crazy Nights is a tense survival horror game starring Axel Ross, trapped on the night shift as the animatronics close in. Each night, Augustus Glutes calls to taunt you. Watch the cameras, manage your defenses, and survive until 6 AM...

details.title: Pogo Together
details.short_description: Pogo Together is a multiplayer hardcore parkour game where you and your friends try to reach the top using pogo sticks. Your character never stops jumping, You just control the movement and timing. Kick your friends, laugh together and race to the finish line!

details.title: Church Tycoon
details.short_description: Become the priest of a small village parish and turn it into a church famous across the region. Celebrate Mass, hear confessions, visit every home, expand the church and presbytery, furnish it pew by pew and climb the ranks – all the way to the Vatican. A cozy pixel-art parish management sim.

details.title: Bifröst: Prelude to the Storm
details.short_description: Bifröst: Prelude to the Storm is a BL visual novel set in an epic fantasy world — told through 8 POV characters, 30+ fully illustrated cast members, accompanied with 40+ soundtracks and 50+ event CG's. The story branches based on your decisions, shaping relationships, loyalties, and personal fates.

details.title: Revenge For Two
details.short_description: Revenge For Two is a narrative-driven 3D action-adventure game featuring platforming and puzzle elements, with two unique playable characters between whom the player can switch at almost any time.

details.title: Brass & Brine
details.short_description: Command a steam-driven ironclad across three legs of hostile sea. Fit your guns, take a refit after every wave, chart your route and sink the bosses that rule each ocean, alone or with up to four captains online or in split-screen co-op.

details.title: Shardfall
details.short_description: A classic real-time strategy war for the crystal that fell from the sky. Build a base, harvest Vitrium and command the Concordat, the Ascendancy or the alien Harrow through three campaigns, then wake the Mandate. Fight five levels of AI in skirmish, or battle your friends online.

details.title: Crown & Claw
details.short_description: War looms over a world divided by five powerful factions. In Crown & Claw, an epic 8-bit fantasy RPG, follow a Holy Knight whose journey uncovers ancient secrets, challenges centuries of hatred, and reveals a dark truth that could change the fate of humans and monsters alike.

details.title: Towers for Hire
details.short_description: A pixel-art roguelite tower defense game. Monsters are swarming toward the village, and you play as the captain of a band of mercenaries, building towers, sending out guards and holding the line with skills and traps. Mix and match over 100 cards and treasures to shape a company that's truly yours.

details.title: Asteroid Patrol
details.short_description: An incremental arena shooter where asteroids rain down and bounce back for more. Blast them apart, dash through creature swarms, protect the settlement’s houses and watch your numbers explode as you upgrade, beat bosses and push into new biomes.

details.title: Silent Hunt: Horror Escape
details.short_description: Investigate a house marked by a massacre, solve puzzles, and uncover what lurks in the darkness. But be careful… you're not alone.

details.title: Lumiere Express
details.short_description: Every conductor in Europe ate the bad mussels, so the railways send for you: 93, retired, and nearly blind. Drive a steam train through thirteen towns from France to Iceland, and at every junction pick the one clear line, even though you only see where it goes at the last second.

details.title: NULL
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about grief, obsession, and love. Sleep to enter dreams, take control of them, and descend into deeper layers where time moves slower. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the mystery of a grieving father who created a world frozen in time.

details.title: Saint Hallow
details.short_description: An nice little adventure game with a SPRINKLE of horror on top, this Cat and Mouse game is a steady paced, action oriented experience! Gather coins, find notes, and escape the claws of the Traeger Wolf. Be sure to utilize your powers, they may come in handy later.

details.title: Lawless Streets
details.short_description: Build your own criminal empire and dominate the city’s underworld. Command your soldiers, capture territories, expand your businesses, and make choices that will shape your future.

details.title: Alderun
details.short_description: A MOBA game with a hero at its heart and many different battlegrounds to choose from. Level your champion, gear it at the merchants and lead an army through sieges, tower defense, 5v5 lane battles and 10v10 valley wars, online against real players or solo against the AI.

name: Lumi: A Cat in the Mist

details.title: Lumi: A Cat in the Mist
details.short_description: Lumi returns to find her village lost in mist. Ghosts linger where the villagers once lived. Creep through bushes, scramble over rooftops and let your magic amulet lead you into trouble. Solve puzzles to help lost spirits find peace. Keep out of reach of the rest.

name: 時渡りの論破屋 ～江戸城無血開城を死守せよ！～

details.title: 時渡りの論破屋 ～江戸城無血開城を死守せよ！～
details.short_description: Explore Edo, gather testimony and evidence, and expose lies that could rewrite history. Join high school student Ren and his time-repair companion Chrono in a historical mystery adventure. Connect clues and solve puzzles to protect the meeting between Katsu Kaishu and Saigo Takamori.

details.title: Train Keeper
details.short_description: A cozy first-person organizing simulator aboard a night train. Make beds, set tables and sort up to 2,443 objects across 22 cars before the train reaches the station. Unlock helpful skills, restore order at your own pace, or race the clock in Hardcore mode.

details.title: The Gods' Tower
details.short_description: Climb a cursed voxel tower with up to six friends. Every champion who dies stays behind as a Fallen, still carrying all their gear, until you beat it or pay to bring the body home. Fight the Wardens, find the secrets and see what waits at the top.

details.title: Xmas Squad
details.short_description: Physics co-op comedy for up to 4 players: deliver presents, steal cookies and save your friends from monsters. One more house and we're outta here. Promise.

details.title: Wishknot
details.short_description: Swing, saw and squash your way through a procedurally generated world in this medieval physics soulslike. You've fallen down an endless wishing well with nothing but a rope and far too much momentum.

details.title: Regnum Last Sanctum
details.short_description: Regnum Last Sanctum begins with Saga I — Combat: Wrath of the Goblins. An dark epic, Action RPG, Regnum's Quest to defend its last sanctum against the invading goblins. Master skill-based combat, fight clever foes, and progress in the realm of Regnum where death has consequences. Will you survive?

details.title: VIZZA
details.short_description: Set particles dancing to your favorite songs. Infect your desktop with immortal mold. the waves of time at your fingertips. Your one way ticket to the trip dimension.

details.title: BROKE.EXE
details.short_description: BROKE.EXE is a satirical trading simulator inside a fictional desktop OS. Earn cash in minigame jobs, then trade simulated stocks and crypto - long, short, leverage, stop-losses. Build passive income, run mining rigs and trading bots, and climb from $0 to $10,000,000. No real money involved.

details.title: Slice the Mountain
details.short_description: A relaxing incremental game about a red panda girl who wants to slice a mountain.

details.title: CURSECADE: Pachinko Roguelite
details.short_description: Build explosive chain reactions with balls, pegs, and cards inside a cursed arcade machine. Place and upgrade special pegs, master physics-driven bounces, and survive stages and bosses that keep rewriting the rules.

details.title: Oekaki Golf
details.short_description: Storybook-style physics golf: hit the ball and draw crayon lines to make platforms! Play the same hole with up to 12 players at once. Help friends with your lines or sabotage rivals with special crayons. Enjoy chaotic fun, solo or together!

details.title: Pixel defender
details.short_description: An idle tower defense you play in a corner of your desktop. Defend your castle from the oncoming enemy army!! Train your soldiers, grow your town, and build the mightiest army of all!!

details.title: Eudia of the Sky City
details.short_description: Split across six dimensions, the planet “Kunepas” stands on the brink of destruction. To save it from the crisis, a lone girl awakens...!

details.title: Nonogram Kingdom
details.short_description: Turn numbers into pictures. Solve 1,400 color nonograms across 28 themes, choose a board you like, and watch each finished picture rise from the grid.

details.title: Paw Pop Breakout
details.short_description: Paw Pop Breakout is a fast-paced brick-breaking deckbuilding roguelike. Smash bricks and collect shards before time runs out. Your deck determines which bricks, power-ups, and obstacles appear. Build unique synergies, face random challenges, and break through the ever-increasing difficulty!

details.title: Senti Metrica
details.short_description: “If you are not loved, you won’t survive—” A girl slowly turning into a monster, and the “Metrica” who hunt her. A survival otome game where you waver between reason and instinct.

details.title: FishInc
details.short_description: A minimalist incremental fishing game about mastering the sea. Time your strikes, chain perfect hits, build your boat, and design powerful trophy loadouts to survive increasingly chaotic runs.

details.title: Tactical Tile Breaker Incremental
details.short_description: A synthwave neon space tile‑breaker. Hit the ball. Stack Power Ups at the right moments to clear the screen in the fastest time. Or just chill and space out to the synthwave soundtrack beats.

details.title: Plobania 47/B
details.short_description: Immortality is not a blessing, it is a burden. As Milton Clarke, you work at the 47/B Mandatory Sleep Hospital, review documents, surf the internet, and decide who will no longer exist. You don’t kill anyone. You only “put them to sleep.” The rules are clear. Every decision has consequences.

details.title: Void Strike
details.short_description: Shred endless waves of hostile spaceships in a 1-bit arcade survival roguelite. Build absurd weapon combos, unlock pilots, upgrade your fighter, and survive escalating dogfights against swarms, elite enemies, and colossal bosses.

details.title: Hexball
details.short_description: Six teams, one hex pitch, and metal balls everywhere. Hire warriors from across history, see the odds of every block, dodge and pass before you commit, then live with the roll. Your players level up, get hurt and can be lost for good. Up to six players on one PC, or against computer coaches.

details.title: The Offering
details.short_description: The Offering is an incremental game where you grab creatures to collect offerings, buy upgrades and defend your shrine at night. Stack boons, forge weapons, catch goblins and ascend through worlds!

details.title: Fire To Mine
details.short_description: You find yourself stranded alone on an island, and the first thing you see is a massive wall coming straight toward you. Blast your way through it, unlock upgrades, and try to make it farther every time.

details.title: Soul Of Sin
details.short_description: One spear. Seven Sins. A single hit ends each phase, for them and for you. Climb a ruined cathedral as the Penitent, face the Sins one by one, and watch your body change with every Sin you slay.

details.title: Bound By Fate - Cursed Soulmates
details.short_description: Break the cycle and find new love, or embrace your handsome (but creepy) Yandere soulmate in this horror romance visual novel.

details.title: LAST SLIME
details.short_description: When and where will you leave each slime behind? Guide a linked caravan of slimes, detach them to make paths, hold switches, and block hazards, then collect every LOVE on the board. Plan around each slime's color and your caravan's order in this turn-based grid puzzle.

details.title: Project: Summer Ice Bowling Online
details.short_description: A Christian-themed, story driven, anime-styled bowling video game in the Project: Summer Ice franchise!

details.title: Data Breach Inc.
details.short_description: Pilot a breach rig into hostile corporate infrastructure. Mine the firewall, crack daemon cores, extract your haul, and buy permanent upgrades between sorties.

details.title: DUSTBLOOM
details.short_description: Team up with up to 3 friends and turn a dead red planet green. Mine, build and automate, haul ore with your truck, push the green frontier into high-pressure lands, and hold your base against the husks that come at night, while you uncover what happened to the lost 14th team.

details.title: Delivery Survivors
details.short_description: Delivery Survivors is a survivor-like action roguelite game. Gather powerful relics and weapons, level up your character, create unique builds and slaughter your way through endless minions and bosses in the dungeon.

details.title: LATENT – Fragment 01
details.short_description: You wake up in a rotting clinic. No one is here. Almost no one. LATENT – Fragment 01 is an anime-style survival horror game.

details.title: Overbooked
details.short_description: In this Roguelike deckbuilder, arrange rooms for eccentric animal guests under overbooking pressure to meet KPIs. Upgrade rooms with furniture, and squeeze in your freeloading Panda Manager at peak capacity.

details.title: RecycleShopECO
details.short_description: 3-Match Puzzle × Human Observation × Horror Novel Recycle Shop ECO is a binary art style 3-match puzzle and horror novel game. Fulfill customers' requests, gather information about them, and explore a hidden world of horror.

details.title: Giant's Heart
details.short_description: A mysterious journey across a collapsing island. Reforge a lost blade, defeat ancient giants, and uncover the truth about your past. Save the island before it’s too late.

details.title: Tatakabu-Do: Hammer and Helmet
details.short_description: A simple, fast-paced versus party game starring Fang the bunny and friends. Bonk with a hammer or block with a helmet. One hit wins a round. First to five wins a match. Play side by side on one PC, or online. There's a story mode and CPU battles for solo players.

details.title: HolEvade
details.short_description: HolEvade is a challenging, physics-based 3D platformer where precision is everything. Tilt and control the platforms high above the clouds to guide your ball, navigate tight paths, and test your reflexes in a vibrant, stylized world!

details.title: Crimson Ark
details.short_description: Forge your own magic build in Crimson Ark, a single-player dark fantasy action RPG. Choose from three heroines, hunt for gear, and refine it through upgrades and reforging. Grow through auto-hunting, take direct control against bosses, and journey with Maria through a world of endless night.

details.title: Talescape: Write. Branch. Play.
details.short_description: Play well-crafted interactive stories shaped by mood and choice, or create your own branching story without coding.

details.title: Starship vs Everything
details.short_description: Start fragile. Earn every upgrade. Turn one battered starship into a storm of fire in this demanding bullet-hell roguelite. Dodge deliberate patterns, build devastating weapon combinations, and salvage permanent upgrades for the next run.

details.title: Escape From Worker
details.short_description: Escape From Worker is a third-person action shooter about a worker who refuses to clock in. Battle hordes of zombies, grow stronger, and evolve as you fight to escape the daily grind. Explore dangerous locations and face tougher enemies on your path to freedom. Clock out. Fight back. Evolve.

details.title: Tiara
details.short_description: Tiara is an exploration-focused narrative game where you play through days (and dream through nights) to uncover the story of Tiara's life.

details.title: Honel's Identification
details.short_description: A document inspection sim in a fantasy republic gripped by reform. Check papers from humans, elves, orcs, trolls, and beastfolk against rules that change every day. Follow the law, or your conscience? Every issuance has a cost.

details.title: REAVEN WOOD HOTEL : ROOM 207
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set inside a mysterious mountain hotel. Explore the dark halls of Reaven Wood Hotel and uncover the terrifying secrets hidden behind Room 207.

details.title: Desktop Farm
details.short_description: Desktop Farm is a farm management game that lives on your desktop. Plant crops, raise animals, fish, mine, and run a little stall. Tuck it away when you're busy, and press Alt+W to return when you're free. It stays out of your way and quietly keeps you company.

details.title: Zombie Siege
details.short_description: Protect the last 10 survivors in a top-down tower defense game. Build defenses, hunt for gear with random affixes, and customize towers with skill cards. Pick one of three upgrades each level-up and turn a makeshift camp into a firing line against hordes and siege beasts.

details.title: Wander Her Way VR
details.short_description: Explore incredible interactive locations with your gorgeous companion. A sandbox VR experience with mini-games. Shoot enemies, destroy objects, drive a car, dance with an amazing girl, defend a tower, catch mischievous kittens, watch a fireworks show. Realistic female character, advanced physics

details.title: Rose in the Mist
details.short_description: A fantasy adventure visual novel featuring choices that shape the heroine's personality and the ultimate ending she will reach. Meet the residents of the Mist Witch's estate and grow closer to her mysterious guests. Love, friendship, and hatred in a captivating story.

details.title: WHERE IS MABEL?
details.short_description: Help Mabel find her sister! Explore the library, interact with characters and solve puzzles and collect the necessary notes to uncover the truth behind everything in this single player 2.5D adventure game.

details.title: Dragon Eggs: Survivors
details.short_description: Bullets that spawn more bullets! Collect dragons to fight with you. Level up and merge them. Create unique builds to survive hordes of enemies in this 3D roguelike bullet hell survival game!

details.title: BIRDS HUNTING
details.short_description: A chaotic 1–4 player first-person bird hunt. Blast incoming flocks, send your dogs to retrieve, earn cash for better gear, and chase golden ducks and a flying rainbow unicorn. Friendly fire is optional. Trusting your friends isn't.

details.title: Kit Keeper
details.short_description: Be the Kit Keeper of a football shirt shop. A truck dumps 540 shirts on the floor. Read the badge and number, find the player in the Kit Catalog, print the name and hang the shirt where it belongs. A cozy first-person sorting game.

details.title: Crown Control
details.short_description: RPG Roguelike Deckbuilder: play solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Choose your character, level up your class, collect and play cards to attack, defend, heal, summon allies, place traps, and alter the terrain in turn-based isometric battles to overthrow a tyrant king.

details.title: ARIA
details.short_description: An AI. A fly brain. An underwater facility. Wake alone in first-person survival horror: bring ARIA back online, rewire a flooding station and open the capsule yourself. Then lure the specimen hunting you into quarantine—if ARIA's memory can be trusted.

details.title: Juice Board
details.short_description: Add some juice to your typing with custom carets, satisfying effects, and reactive word combos that work across multiple desktop applications.

details.title: Chess of the Hidden Gates
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a Chinese chess move: the horse leaps, the cannon fires over a screen, the pawn crosses the river and never turns back. Every enemy strike marks its target square first. Step aside and it misses. Breach the Eight Gates. Play, or be taken.

details.title: Train Cargo: NightShift
details.short_description: October 21, 1998. You are the night clerk at Hollow Pine freight yard. Weigh the crates, check the seals, sign the manifests. Follow the rules on the board in the booth. When the signal is red, do not move. Do not look at the train that is not on the schedule.

details.title: 任意杂货铺
details.short_description: Stock up, arrange the trays, set your prices—make every hand reaching over the counter scramble to pay in Spirit Stones. Set out from the “Anywhere Door,” travel through a dozen-plus sects opening shops and doing business; Solve puzzles, rescue the elders, become a sect’s divine beast.

details.title: Tower of Sequence
details.short_description: Tower of Sequence is a beginner-friendly anime-style DBG developed by a solo developer.

details.title: Crystal Surge
details.short_description: Crystal Surge is a top-down extraction shooter with roguelite elements. Scavenge ruins, combine gear and random blessings, plan routes and deploy turrets. Fight with guns and powers, then extract to trade loot and grow stronger. Leave now or face a boss? Die and lose everything you carry.

details.title: Zup! C
details.short_description: Minimal physical puzzle with explosions

details.title: Alice’s Archive
details.short_description: Alice's Archive is an atmospheric found-footage puzzle game. As a young archivist, uncover the dark secret of a psychiatric hospital where everyone vanished in 1984. Examine over 70 eerie, hand-drawn pictures by a patient, break the seals, and reveal the supernatural truth.

details.title: Cats And Pillows
details.short_description: Run a cozy cat shelter where every whiskered guest has their own needs! Place shy cats in quiet corners, sleepy cats on soft pillows, playful cats near fun spots, and stinky cats away from sensitive noses. Each level brings a new cozy setting and a fresh puzzle full of picky little paws.

details.title: Computer Manufacturer
details.short_description: Develop your computer empire, control costs, and increase profits. Decide whether to develop hardware in-house or purchase it, and whether to prioritize cost-effectiveness or pursue higher profits. The choices are all up to you.

details.title: Apparatus Inspector
details.short_description: Apparatus Inspector is a retro OS horror simulation where you are locked underground evaluating synthetic AI robots for anomalies. Chat with infected bots, execute commands, deliver judgement, and hide from physical threats to survive your 5-day shift.

details.title: Meka Gakuen
details.short_description: Run an independent military academy above the Shigure reservoir. Get to know 100 hand-written cadets through the years, and lead them in turn-based battles against flesh demons where every loss is permanent. Build the academy. Bring them home.

details.title: AFK Throne
details.short_description: A chibi dark-fantasy squad idle looter that lives at the bottom of your desktop. Between work and study, spend your idle earnings to power up and push further, team up with other players against bosses, or duel them. With luck, you'll find rare tradable items to sell on the Steam Community Market.

details.title: Seabreeze Atelier
details.short_description: Seabreeze Atelier is a cozy island-building game. Shape coastlines, carve rivers, and connect gardens and cottages with paths and bridges. Cast a line from your pier, then turn the island you built into a live Windows wallpaper and watch the boats drift by.

details.title: Operation Together VR
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op military VR simulation. Complete tactical operations, neutralize terrorist threats, and rescue civilians.

details.title: Dimension Contortion Lover!!
details.short_description: 由CRYSTALiA开发的最新力作，一款近未来风格的战斗恋爱视觉小说。 你将扮演魔术师后代的男主人公“崩月槐”潜入“学园”，探寻真相。

details.title: Infected Zone Survival
details.short_description: "Infected Zone Survival" is an open world zombie apocalypse survival game. The game is mainly based on third person action shooting, and can be searched, disguised, built, made, cultivated, fished,hunted, recruited NPCs, simulated management, etc.

details.title: Ayakashi Profile
details.short_description: One button per ally. Chain four fighters’ attacks, special attacks, and spells into launches, follow-ups, and devastating ultimates in this Japanese fantasy battle RPG. Meet a cast of nine, build a party of four, and try the free First Gate demo.

details.title: DoumyakuOnline
details.short_description: DoumyakuOnline is a turn-based 1v1 game where you take turns flipping face-down cards and compete to survive or finish with more cash. The next card could turn the match in your favor or cost you your life.

details.title: Unending Watch - Dead Man's Fingers
details.short_description: A steampunk extraction survival game built on brutal melee combat and constant tension. No guns—only heavy strikes, smart counters, and raw survival. Enemies hunt, adapt, and ambush. The world shifts mid-run. Extract with loot… or be claimed by the dark.

details.title: The American Dream: Past Due
details.short_description: The American Dream: Past Due is a realistic choice-driven sim. Play as a suddenly laid-off middle-aged man keeping up appearances. Balance family finances and emotions while facing mounting bills... Can you get your life back on track before your family falls apart?

details.title: Slip Angle
details.short_description: Arcade drift racing where being sideways is almost mandatory! Find the perfect balance between speed and angle to clear objectives and slide your way through multiple game modes - enjoy the drift flow state or challenge yourself to be one of the best, the choice is yours.

details.title: The Six Dragons
details.short_description: Welcome to The Six Dragons Discover 256km2 of Open-World full of surprises, escape 1 billion dungeons, craft and enchant items

details.title: Cross Reverie
details.short_description: Follow the story of Eight of the land of Xylera’s bravest combatants and their descent into the madness known only as The Trial of Nightmare in this JRPG-inspired title featuring turn-based combat and a character-focused narrative.

details.title: Deslot
details.short_description: A realistic miniature racing game featuring Die-Cast, Slot, and Mini-RC cars. Master momentum, throttle, and precision driving across handcrafted and procedurally generated diorama tracks. Build your own circuits, customize your cars, and race through Career, Challenges, and Multiplayer.

details.title: Banneret
details.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilding meets tactical auto-battling in this party building strategy game! Recruit and upgrade fighters, customize your deck, explore treacherous lands and battle fierce enemies.

details.title: Let's Drive - learn driving simulator
details.short_description: There are 1.3 billion cars in the world. But how many good drivers are there? Is every one of them trained and competent? Find out while playing Let's Drive, a driving school simulator that shows you hazardous situations on the road and puts you right in them.

details.title: Mike goes on hike
details.short_description: Leave the city behind in a first-person hiking adventure. Explore mountain trails, take photographs, and fill Mike’s travel journal with memories — from a thrilling zipline ride to a quiet evening by the campfire.

details.title: Mamma Mia
details.short_description: Play in co-op as the staff of Italy’s worst restaurant. Your kitchen is falling apart, customers’ safety barely makes the list, and weird things happen in the back alley.

details.title: SKAZ: Shadow of the Tsar
details.short_description: An isometric action-RPG where memory is your weapon and four fractured realms shape your fate. Wake without a name — and survive. As long as you’re remembered, you live.

details.title: Glitchphobia
details.short_description: Immerse yourself into unstable reality. In order to get out you must exploit glitch in a world around you. You can be sure of one thing, any rules you known no longer exist!! Do you have a courage to dip in it?

details.title: Jupiter Moons: Mecha🦾
details.short_description: Choose your mech, customize your loadout, and build your perfect deck. Experiment with cards to find powerful combinations as you enjoy the tactical combat and deckbuilding in this roguelike adventure!

details.title: Quarantine Cutz
details.short_description: A hilarious cartoon simulation where you're absolutely terrible at cutting hair. Can you overcome your nerves and total pop culture ignorance to give your family a haircut that won't crush their dreams? Probably not, but you're gonna give it your best shot!

details.title: Rules of Alchemy
details.short_description: Defy fate as you blast your way through a procedural open world, in this spell combo roguelike with thousands of items and hundreds of spells.

details.title: Epic of Gilgamesh
details.short_description: History's first hero — Gilgamesh, who would not bow to death. Tablets fell silent; bones still speak. With wild Enkidu, cunning Ursanabi and wise healer Bau, walk from Eridu to Uruk. Take up your weapon, learn ancient spells; defy beasts, gods, and death itself.

details.title: Tales of the Realm: Arisen
details.short_description: A story rich and action packed fantasy game, that takes place in the fictional kingdom of Mythuras. Defend the kingdom against the ruthless undead in this retro-styled adventure game.

details.title: Gravity Blasters
details.short_description: Gravity Blasters is a real-time multiplayer game that recreates the classic artillery style of aiming and shooting by adjusting the angle and power. A game that mixes artillery games like Worms and Angry Birds with MOBAs like League of Legends or Dota.

details.title: Tales of Anturia: Farathan
details.short_description: Explore, fight and discover the great conspiracy lingering in the shadows. In this third-person RPG. Pick one of three sides and enjoy the open world.

details.title: Project Hypnagogia
details.short_description: An experiment set up by a mad scientist called "Hypnagogia" to reveal absolute fear by revealing the subject's most terrifying images into reality. The line between dream and reality is blurred. It's not easy to find a way out when there's only one scary dream going on around you.

details.title: Midnight Laundry
details.short_description: Midnight Laundry is a short first-person horror game where a long night at the laundromat takes an unexpected turn.

name: Be My Mom - maternity simulator, take care of your child

details.title: Be My Mom - maternity simulator, take care of your child
details.short_description: Become a mother and experience the best of maternity. The game is for future mothers, so they know what to expect, and also for their partners, so they can experience things their women do. The adventure begins just as you see the pregnancy test is positive.

details.title: Still Rooms
details.short_description: A cozy, pixel-art decorating game where you design and furnish unique homes across 7 themed locations — from modern apartments and rustic houses to retro 80’s interiors, student rooms, rooftops, and even a spaceship.

details.title: Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story
details.short_description: "Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story" is an action-adventure platformer following the story of a failing musician named Sondro, who must seek and recover the wish-granting Mystic Orbs to repay his debt to the mysterious Masked Man. Can he find them before the many rogues of Sunova beat him to the punch?

details.title: Bedtime Horror Stories
details.short_description: Late night. A young man called Sam is home alone. He finds a mystical book that takes him into a world of horror stories that come alive. Start reading, but you must not break the most important rule. Once you have started the book, you must finish it!

details.title: Gowf: A Golf Adventure
details.short_description: Gowf is an arcade style golf game featuring a single player adventure mode and 8 player online multiplayer. Win tournaments, complete side quests, level up, and take on friends in a variety of courses and game modes!

details.title: Abyss Delvers
details.short_description: Abyss Delvers is an Online Hack'n'Slash Action RPG. Adventure out alone or party up with your friends on an epic journey and fight the monstrous hordes of the Abyss. Featuring randomly generated campaigns, dungeons, items and more!

details.title: Your place
details.short_description: A cozy solitude simulator where a rainy night, a computer, and music create an atmosphere of calm and relaxation. Play an arcade game, explore the internet through an in-game browser, and import your own music to create the perfect atmosphere to unwind.

details.title: Past Visiting Hours
details.short_description: Past Visiting Hours is a 1v3 asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. Diagnose cursed patients, survive the hospital's monstrous inhabitants, or take control as The Board and turn the hospital into a living nightmare. Your shift is about to get a whole lot worse.

details.title: Everstorm
details.short_description: Classic MOBA combat meets battle royale PVP, with roguelite elements. Fight other players, customize your abilities and survive hordes of monsters long enough to face the final boss. The last team standing wins. Earn permanent upgrades in between matches, then dive back in for more.

details.title: DOLYA'
details.short_description: Atmospheric fantasy 2D-RPG. In a world where everything has a Plot, Fate, and a Name. Your role is to save Fate. To find that Name that was erased from reality.

details.title: TRYPAN
details.short_description: TRYPAN - A exploration based survival horror FPS. Return to Stagmon, the city where your father disappeared. Fight intelligent enemies. Improvise and use limited resources to defeat them.

details.title: Saveseeker
details.short_description: Embark on a quest to overwrite save points in Saveseeker, a turn-based RPG about a time-traveling girl who must save the world from her father.

details.title: SkyCraft
details.short_description: Skycraft is an open-world survival game for 1-10 players, set in infinite procedurally-generated floating islands.

name: JUST A GUY :  Online Multiplayer Ragdoll Game

details.title: JUST A GUY :  Online Multiplayer Ragdoll Game
details.short_description: JUST A GUY is an online multiplayer ragdoll game. Play with physics, explore small open worlds, drive vehicles, use fun items and complete objectives to earn new cosmetic outfits!

details.title: Riot Control Simulator
details.short_description: Take on the role of a Riot Control officer and control a riot. You can either brutally deal with the crowd or use more reasonable options. Will you decide to support a nascent dictatorship?

details.title: Oasis the Great
details.short_description: Ever imagine you could play with your fellows in Online co-op , discover a tremendous world,find the treasures,build freely,do some farming,fight with others,party around ! also there are other mini games.And all these happen in a physics based oasis!! (￣▽￣)~❤

details.title: Cursed Night
details.short_description: Cursed Night is a multiplayer horror game for 1-5 players. Use your magic abilities to defeat the devil, or become the devil and seek revenge. Find talismans, collect power, release spirits, or choose the dark side and kill everyone.

details.title: BLEAK Remastered
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in the dystopian world of Pinnacle with BLEAK Remastered. Experience stunning new artwork and enhanced gameplay in this dark adventure. Can you navigate the relentless hostile world and save your sister, Asha?

details.title: The Ump Show
details.short_description: The Ump Show is a baseball umpire simulator where you balance making accurate calls and enforcing your will on the game. Make accurate calls, cheat when you need to, and build your way up to the highest levels!

details.title: DOPAMINER
details.short_description: DOPAMINER is a short and intense incremental mining game. Delve deep into the mine to blast rocks, gather gems and artifacts, and unlock powerful new abilities in the skill tree.

details.title: Neon Auto Party
details.short_description: Build a party to auto-battle through waves of enemies in a futuristic fantasy setting. Each unit has its deck of cards that determines its performance in battle. Find and buy items while leveling up units to take advantage of powerful synergies and reach the end of the dungeon!

details.title: PocoDoro
details.short_description: PocoDoro is a tiny virtual pet that lives on your desktop. Hatch a squishy slime, then poke it, stretch it and toss it around. Feed it, play with it, put it to bed and clean up after it. It lives in real time, and how you raise it shapes who it becomes.

details.title: Dungeons Deep
details.short_description: Plunge into the Dungeons Deep! A dark-fantasy ARPG featuring vast underworlds full of horrifying monsters and ancient treasures. Liberate the plagued lands of Antioch for those who still remain.

details.title: Whispers of the sands
details.short_description: Listen to the whispers of the sands in this meditative journey. Seek the light of the desert and confront its shadow in meditation. Uncover echoes of lost souls as you survive a boundless sea of dunes.

details.title: Code5erpent
details.short_description: The game where numbers are a weapon. On a simulated Earth, add, multiply, or combine the numbers which comprise the matrix's code, and take advantage of a rich equipment system of weapons and scrolls in order to come up with devastating combos to annihilate your enemies.

details.title: Angry Mother Earth
details.short_description: Angry Mother Earth offers a one-of-a-kind strategy experience within an fully simulated world. Wield and merge a variety of abilities to release cataclysmic forces—ranging from hurricanes and earthquakes to blizzards—upon the world of humans. But be warned: humanity won't go down without a fight!

details.title: Reports from Vera Cruz
details.short_description: Investigate the country of Vera Cruz in this journalistic first-person adventure! Solve puzzles, take photos of clues and report news exposing the horrific truths behind General Galba and his bizarre government!

details.title: Stuck with Bob
details.short_description: Kidnapped & trapped in a basement. Escape by drawing 7 JOKERS from 40 cards. Grind coins from jokers to buy upgrades, earn more per flip, speed up shuffles, and remove bad cards until victory is guaranteed.

details.title: Where The Weather Takes You
details.short_description: Elliot Thunder embarks on an adventure of self-discovery and exploration. Travel between towns, explore dungeons, solve puzzles, and use your weather-related powers to help those in need.

name: Detective Bass 2: The Case of the Stolen Pearls

details.title: Detective Bass 2: The Case of the Stolen Pearls
details.short_description: Crime never rests... but thankfully, neither does Detective Bass! Put on your detective hat and help Detective Bass get to the bottom of a robbery, in this witty, narrative-driven detective game!

details.title: Ooga
details.short_description: Help Ooga to retrieve his stolen food stockpile in this fast-paced, spear-based parkour platformer. Play the first world and a half in the free demo, secrets included!

name: Gossip & Potions: Tales from the Witch Shop

details.title: Gossip & Potions: Tales from the Witch Shop
details.short_description: Gossip & Potions is a potion-brewing and gossip-listening simulator about a witch named Owi, the small town she just moved to, and the very specific potions its very specific inhabitants need. Help them. Or don't. Watch what happens.

details.title: Teacher Seduction
details.short_description: Math is such a boring thing... Unless you have a hot teacher! In this case, even her angry boyfriend might not be a big problem.

details.title: Hyperspace Nebula
details.short_description: Explore an ever-changing galaxy, upgrade your ship, and face cosmic challenges in this thrilling 2D roguelike adventure. Become a legend of the galaxy in Hyperspace Nebula.

details.title: Unguided
details.short_description: Escape a digital prison, upload yourself back into the real world, and get revenge on the ones who framed you in this fast-paced, challenging roguelike slasher. [RUN], [suffer], [EOL], [RUN]

details.title: DreamVision Studio
details.short_description: "DreamVision Studio" is a Studio/World maker for content creators in real time that uses the webcam to generate an avatar that can interact with the customizable world. Its the definitive content creation playground that can be used as a tool.

details.title: Tank Arena
details.short_description: Tank Arena is a chaotic top-down multiplayer tank shooter built for fast, explosive battles with friends. Jump into the arena, blast each other with shells, and see who survives the longest.

details.title: Hexoria
details.short_description: Harness the power of magical cards and become a master strategist in Hexoria, a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder game. Explore a dangerous world, build and expand your village, gather resources, and use your cards to gain obedience. Survive the unknown and lead your cult to glory!

details.title: Family Land - Farmer Simulator
details.short_description: Family Land - Farmer Simulator. Renew an old farm. Give new life to the farmland. Take care of the animals. Convince Old Bill that together you can do more. A humorous story about the struggles of a townie who decided to become a farmer.

details.title: Subway Nomads
details.short_description: Survive in a post-apocalyptic metro system. Explore dark tunnels, battle zombies, and build your mobile base. Play solo or team up with friends in multiplayer co-op. Will you escape to the surface or thrive in the underground?

details.title: VISK
details.short_description: Enter the bleak world of VISK, an online co-op horror game for 1-2 players. You and your friend are sent to a desolate village. Uncover the dark secrets of this place and cautiously explore your surroundings. After all, you might not be alone…

details.title: Echoes of the Anvil
details.short_description: A simulation and management game about a blacksmith exiled for defying an empire. Gather resources, forge tools, pay taxes, and choose between helping the people or serving the power that rules the world.

details.title: Iron Defect
details.short_description: You were built to work. The AI labeled you a defect and sent everything to shut you down. Survive. Build. Prove it wrong

details.title: Poop with Friends
details.short_description: Poop with friends is a desktop pet. Typing, pressing buttons or any input will cause a bowel movement. These inputs give you points which you can use to customize your stall with stickers, patterns and colors. Hang out with friends. play mini-games and support each other!

details.title: CIRCLE = CIRCLE
details.short_description: "CIRCLE = CIRCLE" is a simulation adventure game where you participate in a doujinshi sale event. Have fun selling books, drawing in your sketchbook, and talking with unique characters.

details.title: Warfare Ultimatum
details.short_description: Modern FPS/RTS hybrid, Large-scale battles from the depth of the sea all the way to space! Either play the standard 64-player non-stop battle using Air/Land/Sea vehicles or drop in a thriller, long game of Diplomacy Warfare, experience sabotage, betrayal, war crime, organized operations and more

details.title: Rebirth x Reverse Mana
details.short_description: Card Board RPG like "Soulmaster". The story of a boy and a girl newly enrolled in a magick school, who get involved in and confront incidents that occur in the world of sorcerers. With the help of the spirits of the four elements and mana, they fight monsters and the same sorcerers and grow up.

details.title: Glitch Gears
details.short_description: In Glitch Gears, dodge, boost, and outmaneuver in a driving experience inspired by old-school arcade games, with fresh mechanics from auto shooters. Stay ahead of relentless pursuers and master endless, traffic-filled roads in this high-speed battle for freedom.

details.title: Elderwood Online
details.short_description: Dive back into the golden age of MMORPGs. Leveling is the journey, not a sprint: every level is earned, builds take real thought, and the world grows wider, never taller. No auto-play, no shortcuts to endgame, no pay-to-win. Made by a solo indie developer for those who love the long climb.

details.title: Mystical Tactics
details.short_description: Mystical Tactics is a turn-based tactical-RPG roguelike in which you control a squad of adventurers in a mystical world. Train your heroes in fast-paced tactical battles, equip them with powerful items and lead them to repel the Dark Lord and his legions.

details.title: Wizavior
details.short_description: 3D platformer that will pull you into a whirlwind of adventure! Step into the shoes of the powerful Zavior a retired wizard who, with humor and determination, sets out once again to save the world from evil.

details.title: Thalassophobia
details.short_description: Thalassophobia is a 4-player co-op horror diving game set in the crushing darkness of the deep ocean. Complete high-risk objectives and uncover long-forgotten secrets. The further you descend, the less safe you are.

details.title: Sleepy Cat
details.short_description: Who says cats are just for show? Cute can be deadly! A Roguelite ARPG featuring Day/Night cycles, Elemental counters, Skill learning, and Magic evolution—all in a fresh, vibrant art style! Become Laila the "Sleepy Cat" and uncover the vast, mysterious lore behind the Seven Valleys.

details.title: Skylark 64
details.short_description: A 64-bit 3D Collect-a-thon Platformer where you play as A flying squirrel who can glide, run, jump and roll in open non-linear levels collecting Acorns, Soul Leaves and 7 pieces of armor with unique power-ups! You can even play with a friend in Split-Screen Co-op!

details.title: Shop Crush
details.short_description: Shop Crush is a shop-owner simulator and visual novel set in the early 2000s. Stock a wide variety of goods, haggle with shoppers, and manage your reputation. Get to know your regulars and peel back the illusions tied to each persona as you slowly uncover the horrifying truth.

details.title: Galactic Tavern
details.short_description: Embark on a cosmic journey as you build and manage your space tavern! Craft unique cocktails, and create a bustling atmosphere with live music performances. Explore the depths of space and become the ultimate entrepreneur in this management simulation adventure!

name: Three Kingdoms: The Legend of Zhuge Kongming HD2D

details.title: Three Kingdoms: The Legend of Zhuge Kongming HD2D
details.short_description: This HD-2D role-playing game pays tribute to the beloved Three Kingdoms RPGs of the classic console era. Follow the journey of Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, and Zhuge Liang as you recruit legendary heroes, travel across ancient China, and experience a grand tale of war, loyalty, and ambition.

details.title: Sakagura Life
details.short_description: In a quiet town nestled among rice paddies, you’ve bought an old sake brewery for a bargain. Craft premium sake, build friendships with locals and friendly Yokai, and battle hostile spirits while solving puzzles in this unique blend of life sim, adventure, and brewing.

details.title: Nova Dawn: Overload
details.short_description: Take up arms and take care of robot buddies in this co-op action roguelite. Hunt giant hostile robots that have stolen the sun to harvest their mechanical parts, upgrade the machinery you can build and strengthen the bond between you and your Nova robot buddies!

details.title: House Of Slendrina Remake
details.short_description: House of Slendrina is a spine-chilling first-person psychological horror game where danger lurks in every dark corner. You find yourself trapped inside an ancient, decaying family residence but you are far from alone.

details.title: Dark & Quispy
details.short_description: A Fantasy Rogue-Like game with Paper thin graphics. Cut through waves of enemies and collect their souls to increase your power! Encounter a variety of enemies and events as you make your way through the DARK.

details.title: Echo of Prypiat
details.short_description: "Echo of Prypiat" is an exciting walking simulator that immerses the player in the atmosphere of the Chernobyl exclusion zone, conveying all the horrors and fears of people left in this forgotten land. The game is created to allow the player to feel the soul of this mysterious place.

details.title: CPA:Reports Bousy
details.short_description: Experience the constant fear and loneliness surrounded by the decrepit old walls of an abandoned house with a tragic story, while feeling the true horror of being hunted by a creature created from a strong friendship. Try to survive and escape the house!

details.title: ULTRA MUSHROOM
details.short_description: Hey! Wanna rise to the top at a festival stall? "Ultra Mushroom" is a high-energy game where you run a mushroom stall at a three-day festival and see how much you can earn. Gather mushrooms in the mountains by day and sell them at night. The key? Rhythmic banter and ultra mushrooms that bring joy!

details.title: Revelation of Decay
details.short_description: Revelation of Decay is a zombie survival game that’s less “scary” and even a bit lively. Explore this pixelated world full of bizarre anomalies, awaken supernatural powers, and, amid endless zombie hordes and mutated monsters, gradually uncover the truth behind the invasion.

details.title: Necro Factory
details.short_description: Necro Factory is an exhilarating, stress-relieving idle game focused on mass troop spawning. On this perilous continent, you will gradually build your very own skeleton army.
developers: Xiamen Hearthfire Network Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Xiamen Hearthfire Network Technology Co., Ltd.

details.title: Nightmare in the Old Mansion
details.short_description: Dive into the first-person horror of Nightmare in the Old Mansion and follow John, a real estate agent called to inspect an old mansion. Amid dark corridors and hidden secrets, you must make crucial choices to escape alive.

details.title: RHYTHMETRIC
details.short_description: A pseudo-rhythm top-down shooter game, where your actions will loop to fight geometric foes!

details.title: Children's Garden
details.short_description: Welcome to the Reincarnation Ethics Program "Children's Garden." This is a puzzle game where you seek eternal rest.

details.title: Playable Alpha
details.short_description: As researcher with great ambitions, and lack of talent, you are sent to a newly discovered planet far away from civilization. In this VR first person survival, you will need to build an outpost and survive the hostile environment. While exploring the planet, unveiling its secrets.

details.title: 后室迷失之境Backrooms：The Lost
details.short_description: A [Puzzle game] + [escape room] backrooms game;You are FBI agent Tommy.Unfortunately, he fell into the back room during a disappearance case.Random mazes, physical dangers, and the pressure of liminal spaces,Can you escape safely?

details.title: Magengaard
details.short_description: Magengaard is a 3D PvP arena game where spells are cast by drawing glyphs. Explore the fantasy world of the Academy, meet its inhabitants, uncover its mysteries, and master your skills in the arena.

details.title: Nuclear Sub: Prologue
details.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. A realistic nuclear submarine simulator will allow you to take command of your crew and battle your fiercest enemies. Arm yourself with missiles, dive into the ocean and fight for your country

details.title: Split Decision
details.short_description: In a dying town where boxing is the last stand of entertainment, you hold the judge’s pen. Bribes, threats, and loyalties will decide whether you live to judge another day… Or get knocked out cold. Split Decision is a tense narrative game where every point makes a difference.

details.title: ForgeCraft
details.short_description: Explore, craft, fight and develop an automated technological civilization complete with airships and robotic drones!

details.title: FESTERED
details.short_description: Brave the terrors of a contaminated research facility, where every step could be your last. PSX style survival horror game.

details.title: SHARDFALL
details.short_description: SHARDFALL is a real base-building real-time strategy game. Build your base, harvest Shard crystals, and lead the Aegis Coalition or the Veil to victory. Campaign and skirmish are free, run offline and show no ads. Play ranked online duels, join clans and climb the leagues.

details.title: Match Tree
details.short_description: Match Tree is a breathtaking puzzle experience (...it's actually a match 3 game). Embark on an epic journey with pixie, gnome and witch full of adventure, mystery (huh?) and sheep. Become the master of combination and create magnificent mansions from trees, flowers and carrots (I swear, it's fun!).

details.title: Fatal Dopamine/ 致命多巴胺
details.short_description: Play as a nameless gambler who arrives at a mysterious gambling table, constantly challenging different opponents. At this table, the stakes are not money but life itself.

details.title: Eversiege
details.short_description: Eversiege is a roguelike, tower defense in which you'll defend a castle in procedurally generated terrain. Establish a production, build defending buildings and survive waves of enemies coming from everywhere! After defeat, buy new buildings, unlock new leaders and prepare to fight again.

details.title: The Walls
details.short_description: A story of escape filled with nightmares, trapped within a simulation universe that is reality itself. Markus, dragged into a deep psychological pit by the pain of losing his family, finds himself confronting his nightmares in this simulation universe.

details.title: Into Oblivion
details.short_description: Into Oblivion is an immerse interactive novel where your choices shape the story. Set in the far-future, explore a galaxy on the brink of crisis with dynamic companions. So, settle your mind and pray you have what it takes to fly Into Oblivion.

details.title: Endless Tactics
details.short_description: A turn-based tactics roguelite about defending a planetary mining expedition, upgrading your starship, and extracting before alien hordes overrun you.

name: Archery Pro with James Jean Trickshots

details.title: Archery Pro with James Jean Trickshots
details.short_description: Archery Pro brings life-like, competitive archery straight to your living room through VR! There’s no need for archery equipment to experience the fun of Olympics style Archery with Archery Pro. Simply pop on your headset and experience all the thrills of real-life archery.

details.title: Don't Peek Out
details.short_description: An asymmetrical survival game where strategy, and trust collide. Players navigate a mazed house, gather objects and seal ancient runes before dawn breaks. Something hunts them in the dark and it won’t stop until every player is caught. Will you outsmart the monster, or embrace the shadows as one?

details.title: Lost Call
details.short_description: Lost Call is a top down pixel art 2D Zelda inspired game with a metroidvania style map. Take off on a quest through an abandoned and ruined town to stop your phone from ringing all the time, and learn more about the characters who still remain within it.

details.title: Peerless Destiny 绝世天命
details.short_description: A 3D ARPG.Millennia later, you wake in a dying shell. Darkness rules, demons reign. The path of cultivation is now myth.You smile, eyes cold.A mechanical voice echoes:[Invincible Cultivation System rebooted][Energy 1%… Identity: Ancient Human Immortal][Privilege unlocked: Reignite cultivation]

details.title: 魔法少女パラノイド
details.short_description: 引きこもり気味の高校2年生、主人公の『夢宮める』はある日魔法使いである『ミュリィ』に助けられ、魔法少女になることに。 人々の心を悪に変える『バグ』と戦う魔法少女となっためるはこの世界の『悪』と対峙する事になる。 『バグ』と呼ばれる怪物と戦う、かわいくて不穏な魔法少女RPG。

details.title: CYBRID: Survivor
details.short_description: CYBRID: Survivor - is a single-player shooter with survival elements. Use your entire arsenal, fight hordes of robots, mine resources and unlock powerful upgrades as you clean up the streets at night. You are alone, against everyone!

details.title: PSYCHExFUSE
details.short_description: CONQUER YOUR SELF and escape the nostalgia-fueled nightmare in PSYCHExFUSE, a brand new RPG horror filled with mystery, challenges and terror. Unite your past selves and save a troubled world in an interdimensional adventure into the deepest depths of your mind!

details.title: Lagrange Front
details.short_description: Lagrange Front is a team-based sci-fi FPS. Fight on foot, in zero gravity and in vehicles for a moving hill, haul a payload into the enemy flagship, or storm a ground map with tanks and walkers. Up to 48 players per match, with AI bots filling empty slots.

details.title: Pico Garden
details.short_description: On a cozy corner of your desktop, build a miniature world that is uniquely yours. Watch diverse creatures arrive and thrive, with the gentle rhythm of nature keeping you company as you study, work, and relax.

details.title: KAI
details.short_description: KAI is a game of Exploration and Adventure between the sidereal space and underwater depths. Skillfully lure and guide groups of fish to solve puzzles, access new areas and uncover the truth behind the mission entrusted to you, Akira, and the other crew members aboard the ship.

details.title: STREAM STRATOS
details.short_description: "StreamStratos" is a 3D action game.

details.title: Candela: Colorless Dreams
details.short_description: Manipulate colours and solve challenging puzzles in this mysterious 2D platformer set in a post-apocalyptic world. Explore the overworld, uncover hidden secrets, and bring light to this dark, desolate land

details.title: Rot Forever
details.short_description: Rot Forever is a surreal FPS horror game, set in a decaying megastructure.

details.title: Hammam Simulator
details.short_description: Hammam Simulator lets you experience the authentic rituals of a traditional bathhouse. Scrub, foam, and cleanse as you manage the daily operations of a bustling hammam. Feel the warmth of marble, hear the soothing sound of water, and immerse yourself in a world of relaxation and tradition.

details.title: A.V.E.N.A.
details.short_description: Pilot disposable combat drones through the Primal Portal in a sci-fi action roguelike. Customize your drone, fight through various missions, recover research data and alien technology to enhance your drone setup for the next session.

details.title: Blitzpoint
details.short_description: A minimalist modern military strategy tower defense game where you build and defend a forward operating base. Strategically place defenses, manage resources, and repel relentless waves of enemies. Build by day, defend by night, and command your forces in fast-paced, action-packed gameplay.

details.title: Blood Vow: Survive the Night
details.short_description: Defend the people of Sodermark from the hordes of darkness. Fight as an army of one, or online with up to four-player PvE multiplayer in this wave-based, action-survival game.

details.title: Hathor's Peak
details.short_description: Hathor's Peak is a roguelike solitaire, reach the needed score before being out of cards. Progress through the levels, some of which will be boss battles that impose special rules and require you to use your action cards wisely.

details.title: Click Click Chicken
details.short_description: A short incremental game about catching chickens, pigs, cows and sheep.

details.title: TohoKids
details.short_description: Shinjuku doesn't forgive. A village panda chasing neon lights. Join the legendary TohoKids, hack your enemies, and remember: here, your data is worth more than your life. How far will you go to avoid becoming just "meat for the slaughter"?

details.title: Con Clicker
details.short_description: Con Clicker is an incremental game about building your evil TV infomercial empire. Scam your way to fortune by running outrageous ads, selling ridiculous products, and automating your operation for exponential growth. It's satire, scams, and endless clicking fun!

details.title: Project Roy
details.short_description: Project Roy is a fast-paced FPS roguelike where you play as a rogue AI that survives by hijacking enemy robots. Combine abilities, adapt mid combat, and fight your way through a sci-fi facility to escape and defeat a powerful experimental war machine.

details.title: Potion in Motion
details.short_description: Brew potions, cast spells, and master alchemy in a fast-paced potion shop where magic and language intertwine. Experiment with weird ingredients, and manage quirky customers while avoiding failures! Every potion is a puzzle, but will you perfect your craft or turn your shop into a disaster zone?

details.title: ELISSA ：Body in the bedroom
details.short_description: Detective novelist MEL Gideon, whose career is facing difficulties, receives a strange letter claiming someone is in trouble and needs her help. Intrigued, she decides to investigate. As she digs deeper, she starts to realize that her past is far more complicated than she ever imagined...

details.title: Awen
details.short_description: Awen is a large Open world fantasy VR RPG. When creating Awen we aimed to make every aspect of the gameplay uncompromised, from movement to combat. Combat is visceral and satisfying. Exploration and progress is open-ended. Come explore the world of Awen.

details.title: Paddle Cats
details.short_description: Paddle Cats is a cozy two-player couch co-op fishing adventure where two cats share one boat. Paddle together, explore the waters, catch fish and bring your haul back to camp.

details.title: B-Type: Space Builder
details.short_description: A base builder shoot'em up in Deep Space. Explore the galaxy aboard your B-Type Star Ship. Shoot down your foes to expand your territory. Build planetary facilities, collect resources and raise an Intergalactic Defense Force. Can you save the world from a robotic alien invasion across dimensions?

details.title: Outer Express
details.short_description: 500 years after Earth's destruction, humanity scours desolate planets for resources. As a Star Scavenger, lead your team on dangerous expeditions to collect valuable scrap within a limited time. Race against the clock, outwit deadly aliens, and work together to survive and complete the mission.

details.title: The Search
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic sci-fi adventure where players harness magic and advanced weaponry to battle enemies in an open world. Engage in intense combat, explore desolate landscapes, and uncover hidden secrets while mastering both supernatural powers and tactical shooting.

details.title: Rage Platformer
details.short_description: Rage Platformer (formerly Keni Adventure) is a hardcore platformer featuring difficult levels and challenging puzzles. Master timing, patience, and skill to progress, and unlock achievements to personalize your Steam profile.

details.title: Underworld
details.short_description: Underworld is a co-op roguelike FPS with waves of monsters, boss fights, and procedurally generated levels. Upgrade your gear, buy weapons, stack buffs, and go deeper into the Underworld to discover its secrets. PC & VR Cross-play.

name: My Little Sister Is an Angel

details.title: My Little Sister Is an Angel
details.short_description: "Hey, wanna try becoming a god?" After saving an angel, introvert Yuki gets pulled into divine training, and the Archangel moves in as his “little sister” to guide him. A warm supernatural romance VN where your choices lead to 4 endings.

details.title: The Last Worlds : Crossed Souls
details.short_description: 3D Action Open World RPG set on the alien planet Ness-444. Explore this world on the brink of ruin with your inseparable companion Lupio. Fight or tame countless nessky, fantastic creatures now blinded by darkness. Survive to learn the truth of this world and find out where other like you have gone.

details.title: Bully Ball Brigade
details.short_description: Simple mini games for all, roguelike for the experienced.

details.title: Cozy Cooking: Lo-fi Beats
details.short_description: Cozy Cooking: Lo-fi Beats is a casual, anime-inspired cooking simulation game. Prepare your favorite meals in real-time, accompanied by soothing lo-fi music and ASMR-soundscapes. Personalize your space while gazing at calming views outside the window.

details.title: Chibi Ninja Shino-kun 2
details.short_description: The Chibi Ninja is back! Use your ninja skills to run up walls and along ceilings, launch yourself around with your hookshot, and kick demon butts inspired by Japanese folklore!

details.title: Lode Builder
details.short_description: Lode Builder is the evolution of the classic Lode Runner. Collect all the gold using new tactical tools. Need to climb? Build a ladder. Pit ahead? Stretch a chain. Tired of Robots? Burn them ALL! Gather resources across the map and don't waste a single one.

name: ザワークラウトの中で自転車を漕ぐ

details.title: ザワークラウトの中で自転車を漕ぐ
details.short_description: Juvenile/Suspense Visual Novel Heading Towards Decadence

details.title: Star Life
details.short_description: Star Life is a space sandbox RPG where you start on a planet and carve your own path. Develop skills through "learn by doing," influence dynamic economies, schedule your life with the "Life Planner," and face the challenges of space. Balance risk and survival in a universe shaped by your choices.

details.title: VoidWalker: Call of Insomnia
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of dreams and discover its secrets, enjoying every moment thanks to photorealistic graphics

details.title: Break Shot Hero
details.short_description: Collect characters and roll them into billiards-style combat! Recruit conquered foes to build your party, customizing your skills and skins. Balls to the walls action for 1-4 players!

details.title: Helrift
details.short_description: Helrift is a free-to-play old-school MMORPG, built around the war between Aresden and Elvine. Shape your build through stats, weapons and spells. Hunt monsters, gather materials and craft your supplies, then join your allies in open-world PvP and battle for dominance in server-wide events.

details.title: Dual Cores
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic team-based sword-and-sorcery action RPG with tons of overlapping choices you can use to design your ideal battlemage.

details.title: Gobby Island
details.short_description: Gobbies, punches, and retrowave

details.title: For The Hive
details.short_description: Survive as a tiny insect in a big harsh world. Fight your way to the top of the food chain. Build a strong colony that stands the test of time and become the ruler of the insect world.

details.title: Jianghu Simulator
details.short_description: Simulated Jianghu is a role-playing game that blends sect-management mechanics with multiple playthroughs, high player freedom, and a gritty street-level wuxia style. A mobile-first launch is planned for 2025.

details.title: RunMan Turbo
details.short_description: The Indie Legend Returns: Bounce, slide, and run fast as heck through high speed levels in five unique zones. Each time you run a level it will look and play different, requiring you to master your instincts to beat record times, earn medals, unlock secrets, and be the world's fastest! Wishlist Now!

details.title: Tri-Ger
details.short_description: TRI-GER is a top-down rouge-like SHMUP with technicolor vector based graphics. Fight endless waves of enemies, and be sure to match your color to get a high score!

details.title: Road Warriors
details.short_description: Survive on the road in this post apocalyptic world! Road Warriors is a casual game with rogue-lite elements where your goal is to create the strongest build in one run!

details.title: DearMyFriend
details.short_description: Set off to the unknown world Stargather Land now. The shadow of chaos is shrouding here for so long, a girl from another world shoulders the responsibility of saving this land. Travel with the power of elements until the end of destiny, only fight will lead her to the finish.

details.title: Born64
details.short_description: You are Slayer, a Hunter dispatched to a village where the townsfolk are transforming into monsters. None of the previous Hunters ever returned. Explore 64-bit dungeons, solve puzzles, and survive what the past tried to bury.

details.title: Factory Island
details.short_description: Factory Island is an experimental game built to display 3D worlds inside a 2D renderer. Explore procedurally generated maps, build voxel structures, invite your friends to multiplayer, experiment with water and simple electronics, fight creatures and create mods for this game-engine project.

details.title: Love In a Bottle
details.short_description: Ankora the Love Demon only has a month to prove she can make it on her own! Can she settle down and find love?!

details.title: Void Inside
details.short_description: In a world devastated by radiation, the surface of the Earth has turned into a lifeless wasteland. People long ago sought refuge in underground shelters, but even there, death caught up with them through disease. The protagonist is the last survivor in his shelter

details.title: Humankind in a nutshell
details.short_description: Spin the slot and decide the fate of your civilization. From seeds to kingdoms, from stone to steel. From the very first turn to a thousand years later, every choice becomes history. From the first spark of fire to a forest of skyscrapers. How long can your people survive?

details.title: KEEPERS 1477
details.short_description: A story-driven action RPG set in medieval Ottoman Istanbul, featuring authentic Ottoman and Turkish miniature art. Explore the city, complete quests, master brutal melee combat, cast powerful spells, discover hidden secrets, and battle hordes of undead and demons to protect the capital.

details.title: Salticidae Story
details.short_description: A cosy jumping-spider keeping game. Feed them, mist them, and help them through every moult. Breed lines through a 120-trait genome and six species, catch wild jumping spiders, beetles, roaches and mantises, dress your Keeper, and play online with friends.

details.title: Aurora: Firebreak
details.short_description: Break through self-replicating warforms in fast neon expeditions, evolve a new ship build every flight, recover lost technology, and rebuild humanity's last uncorrupted fleet across a branching campaign for survival.

details.title: Split Drive
details.short_description: Split Drive is a roguelite arena shooter where you have to find your way home through a hostile galaxy, numerous locations and a variety of bosses, all generated procedurally.

details.title: Cartoon Craft: Rise of Mutation
details.short_description: A story-driven real-time strategy game inspired by classic RTS. Experience a mission campaign filled with memorable characters, unexpected alliances, and humor. Build your kingdom, command Humans and Orcs, create custom maps, and share your battles with the world.

details.title: Copter Besieged
details.short_description: Copter Besieged is a multi-copter survival arena shooter. Realistic multi-copter flight with arcade style weapons, items, powerups and escalating monster waves. Dodge incoming attacks, shoot monsters, collect coins, level up your copter. Or race against your friends ghosts on the flight courses.

details.title: Dart Career Manager
details.short_description: Rise from a pub amateur to darts world champion. Train your trebles and doubles, throw every dart yourself or simulate, earn your tour card at Q-School and battle the stars on the Pro Tour. Manage money, staff, sponsors and rivals in a deep darts career manager.

details.title: Mental Salvo
details.short_description: Mental Salvo is a surreal top down art game with a procedural open world. A blank sandbox where you can explode your head, talk to weird entities, and perhaps find out if androids dream of electric sheep.

details.title: CUBOID
details.short_description: CUBOID is a challenging spatial puzzle game with minimalist design, where you progress through a labyrinth of levels using a unique mechanic of merging with world blocks.

details.title: In Stone
details.short_description: A sculptor is confined in a monastery asylum.

details.title: Evil Dungeon
details.short_description: ¡Fight the heroes trying to conquer your dungeon! Choose a class and fight along your comrades to stop invaders, level up, pick up loot, buy upgrades and become the greatest anti-hero

details.title: Unwound
details.short_description: Earthquakes are threatening idyllic Candy Island! Pull yourself together and get to the bottom of what’s troubling the island and its eccentric residents before your whole world breaks apart. UNWOUND is a rollicking yarn: a narrative RPG where people are objects and candy is currency.

details.title: 反击战
details.short_description: Enter Counterattack, and instantly travel back to the smoke-filled southern border battlefield of 1979. Every detail here echoes the historical authenticity, immersing you in the thick of battle.

details.title: Dawn of the Zombies: Survivors
details.short_description: Face the horde in a world of shifting light and rainy nights. Choose from 4 heroes and 3 weapons to survive 2 deadly maps. Customize your run with 100+ nodes. Play solo or split-screen across 3 difficulties. Start at 6 AM. When the colors fade to gray, the real fight begins.

details.title: Blood Peace
details.short_description: Blood Peace is a fast-paced rogue-lite dungeon crawler where you embody a cybernetic warrior with extraordinary abilities. Engage in epic battles against a diverse bestiary across 7 unique biomes. Each playthrough generates a procedurally created world, ensuring infinite replayability.

details.title: Vangaro Tactics
details.short_description: Command your cartoon army against pointy-nosed officers in this colorful turn-based strategy game with asymmetric factions, mining, and tactical Stealth Missions. Capture buildings, recruit exclusive troops, and use each commander's Power to advance through the Vangaro War.

details.title: Afterschool Adventurers Club
details.short_description: Oh no! An evil Game Master has taken over the school's tabletop role playing club and is terrorizing its members with twisted dungeons and strict rulings! As the new kid in town, do you have what it takes to stop the tyran and bring peace back to the Afterschool Adventurers Club?

details.title: Nuclear Sub
details.short_description: A realistic nuclear submarine simulator will allow you to take command of your crew and battle your fiercest enemies. Arm yourself with missiles, dive into the ocean and fight for your country

details.title: Meritaton
details.short_description: The story of a pharaoh's daughter who decides to challenge her destiny. The mysterious and fragile world of Ancient Egypt hides more than meets the eye.

details.title: Deaded
details.short_description: Build your defences, scavenge for loots and survive the zombie infested city saturated with a mysterious fog. Survivors will ask for help but its up to you to save them, or leave them for dead. How long will you survive before you become... Deaded...

details.title: Steam Punks
details.short_description: inspired by SNES 90's classic like Mega Man X 1-3, Super Metroid & Link to the past, Steam Punks mixes elements from the classics into a lore rich adventure with some modern twists! Unlock items & power-ups and discover secrets & lore!

details.title: Heat Division: Rescue Team
details.short_description: Rescue civilians from natural and man-made disasters in this Speedrunning 2D Platformer. Featuring 4 playable characters: Jack Red, John Blue, Jane Orange & Chief Green

details.title: City Of Corals
details.short_description: Save the coral reef city in this cute tiny adventure game! Meet the colourful residents of this underwater city, explore the streets, befriend different species of fish and help them restore the corals to their former glory!

details.title: Rich Dad Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own chain of markets. Start from a small shop to the biggest business in town. Manage staff, control inventory, set prices, and keep customers happy. Build new locations and expand your retail empire. Can you succeed and become the king of retail?

details.title: Evergrind
details.short_description: Evergrind is an idle adventure like you've never experienced before! Discover unknown regions, face dangerous creatures, and create the ultimate loot loop. Master skills, process rare resources, and forge powerful gear on your journey to absolute perfection!

details.title: President Noir
details.short_description: The ultimate "President" card game app! Packed with tons of unique house rules and features cross-platform online multiplayer.

details.title: Red & Blue
details.short_description: Play as two housecats causing chaos while their owners are gone! Jump on each other, get chained to each other, and help each other solve color-coded puzzles.

details.title: Agent Panda
