details.short_description: You are Agent Panda - a fearless detective trying to solve the mystery of Puzzle Islands. You must solve many puzzles and interview many quirky witnesses in order to find the mastermind! Who has been setting up all the puzzles? A light-hearted detective puzzle game with character.

details.title: Mindbound
details.short_description: Mindbound is a short single-player horror game that revolves around uncovering what has happened. After a business trip, Marty returns home eagerly anticipating seeing his wife and daughter. But, things turn out differently than expected. The game emphasizes a deep atmosphere.

details.title: 悪夢祓いのアリス
details.short_description: Defeat enemies in a real-time card battle using magical energy that builds over time. Unlike turn-based games, enjoy the dynamic thrill of real-time strategy. Adapt to a constantly changing deck and discover your own optimal solutions.

details.title: Wanted 3D: Dead or Alive
details.short_description: Grab your bandolier and saddle up for Wanted 3D, a UZDoom-powered Spaghetti Western FPS! It's time to settle the score with your former gang and reclaim what is rightfully yours. Are you ready for the wildest showdown the Wild West has to offer?

details.title: Somnicore
details.short_description: When you wake up on the subway, you experience a strange sensation: you’re still asleep, and your brain is just playing tricks on your mind! Here, you’ll have to find your way out of your own dream. Observe, listen, explore, and figure things out. Perhaps you’ll manage to find yourself...

name: The Town That Died In The Night

details.title: The Town That Died In The Night
details.short_description: You must escape the town, while trying to beat 2 clocks. An incoming nuke, and a viral infection. Can you make it out in time?

details.title: Billy the Hero
details.short_description: Billy woke up on Hell Island as a bear. No memories. No regrets. Apparently, this is just who he is now. A Dark Fantasy Turn-Based RPG where math kills, heroines are unhinged, and the truth about Billy is the one thing the game won't hand you easily.

details.title: The Last Resourcer
details.short_description: Survive a hostile world with your droid. Build your base, automate with robots, and manage the energy that keeps you alive. Beware. The tech you rely on may save your life – or destroy it.

details.title: Shuttle Mining
details.short_description: Shuttle Mining is a Noita- and Terraria-inspired cozy & chaotic mining game. Craft your own unique lasers, burn, taze, and make things explode. The goal is to craft new batteries so you can use stronger lasers and dig deeper...

details.title: Critter Cosmos
details.short_description: A cozy 3D adventure where you play as a Capybara Astronaut, hopping from planet to planet, befriending cute animal pals, saving communities, and building a new home together.

details.title: Ultimate Gym Simulator
details.short_description: Build your dream gym with Ultimate Gym Simulator

details.title: Reviving An Angel
details.short_description: How do you revive an angel? Reviving An Angel is a turn-based RPG set in a world where Archangels, the greatest creations of the Almighty, are in a path of war. Wanting to revive his beloved, Harold, a young Fallen Hunter, saw himself facing an Archangel as he challenged the limits of his mortality.

details.title: 秋之轻语
details.short_description: VN.Your neighbor died in a fall — yet the very next day, she appeared inside your mind, as if an unseen hand were pulling every string. Everything feels dreamlike, unreal. You seem to have boarded a train that accelerates beyond control; in the chaos, you clutch at something — perhaps the truth.

details.title: [REDACTED]
details.short_description: You're a government officer. Documents hit your desk, you scrub out the secrets, and you hope nothing leaks. Miss a word? Maybe it's fine. Miss a few? Well, ██████████. You've got limited ink, limited time, and frankly, limited ████████████. Cheaper than a ████████████.

details.title: Safety Check YOSHI!
details.short_description: This is a game where you earn points by identifying hazards (near-miss incidents). If you successfully point them out, say, "Safety check, YOSHI!"

details.title: CAT-A-STROPHIC
details.short_description: CAT-A-STROPHIC is a goofy 3D rogue-like city destruction game where you play as Bluu, a colossal kaiju cat, rampaging through different cities to rescue your precious kittens! Embrace the purr-fect blend of chaos and relaxation as you level multiple towns and cities.

details.title: Kanji Grinder
details.short_description: Kanji Grinder is a spaced repetition flashcard system, purpose-built for Steam Deck. Designed for immersion learners who want a no-nonsense way to drill Kanji vocabulary, your daily reviews will be a breeze. Plus, for those who enjoy quiz games or flexing their skills, plenty of challenges await!

details.title: Pirate Pillage and Plunder
details.short_description: PIRATE PILLAGE & PLUNDER is the unique blend of card game and auto battler, wrapped together in a neat roguelike package. Choose your faction, amass an army from thousands of "willing" participants, and lead them to greatness! (or agonizing defeat)

details.title: ROCKABILLYHOSTEL
details.short_description: ROCKABILLY HOSTEL is a simple walking simulator based on pixel art. It is just a game to walking around and look around the beautiful abandoned buildings and the scenery. There is nothing more about this game but it is OK as long as the girls and the graphics are pretty.

details.title: Tunnel Baby
details.short_description: On one rainy morning, Steve found a baby in a utility tunnel. He is not alone. Navigate eerie locales, solve puzzles, and face bizarre creatures to uncover a cosmic mystery in Tunnel Baby.

name: Geo Land - The Dream Traveler Remastered

details.title: Geo Land - The Dream Traveler Remastered
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious world and battle the nightmares born from your own fears in this puzzle-driven turn-based RPG.

details.title: Kinetic Response
details.short_description: In the far future you will die on a distant world, piloting a heap of iron held together by hopes and dreams of a bygone time, for there is no salvation in this godless hegelian nightmare at the end of history.

details.title: Determinant
details.short_description: Realistic physics-based open-world survival game set in the future. Survival, crafting, exploration and base building are the main focus. Hunt for food and water and survive against environmental hazards. Combat is possible, but more defensive in nature.

details.title: FPS Pro Team Manager
details.short_description: Recruit and manage the team of FPS players of your dreams, create your own strategies and rise to the top of the world's elite.

details.title: Sliced
details.short_description: "Sliced" is an exhilarating PvP game where players engage in deadly combat, wielding axes and spears to strategically dismember opponents in a fierce arena. Master the lethal art of combat in this relentless, blood-soaked death fest.

details.title: GALLANT: Arena of the Alchemist
details.short_description: GALLANT is a multiplayer platform shooter for 2-10 players. Throw vials, draw cards between rounds, and adapt your strategy as your powers evolve. When skill meets luck across the many arenas, only one can claim the title of Grand Alchemist of Fortune!

details.title: Haunted House
details.short_description: You wake up in an eerie mansion, beside the one you love. To take her home, you face six lost souls — not enemies, but tragedies to understand. Each room hides a love never spoken. But when you think you've finally escaped, some truths only appear once you walk out the door.

details.title: Summit Smash
details.short_description: Drop your opponents in the narrowing upward field, watch out for traps and overcome challenging obstacles to come first!

details.title: VariVaRevenge
details.short_description: Dodge or parry the bullets, and attack the enemy directly! This is a new type of game that adds 2D action elements to a bullet-hell game!

details.title: Dark Laws
details.short_description: Dark Laws is a medieval fantasy extraction looter with melee, ranged, and spell-based combat. Choose one of 9 mercenaries, mount a dragon alone or with a friend, and survive the brutality of enemies on Telos Island.

details.title: VERY IMPORTANT NEEDS
details.short_description: A chaotic heist game about characters with needs that are a little too “important,” repeatedly breaking into the same neighbors’ buildings and grabbing anything valuable. One goal: leave only walls and doors behind. (Walls optional.)

details.title: Permanent: Hope & Vacuum
details.short_description: Psychological horror, puzzles, platforming, adventure, dungeons, action, intrigue and a terrifying story are all terms that should be used to try to define the essence of «Permanent: Hope & Vacuum».

details.title: Factory Tower
details.short_description: Factory Tower is an isometric sci-fi puzzle game inspired by Sokoban. Guide a robot courier through the abandoned towers of the TERRA complex, move cargo, operate machinery, and plan every move carefully.

details.title: Fumble Peak
details.short_description: One body. Four limbs. Every limb controlled by a different friend. Climb a cartoon mountain in chaotic online co-op while goats headbutt you, monkeys throw banana peels and your arms burn out. If one friend lets go too early... everyone falls.

details.title: Orkendale: The Scarred Land
details.short_description: Orkendale: The Scarred Land is an open-world role-playing game in which the fate of an entire continent is in your hands. Whether the orcs will be able to take over the continent or humanity will defeat them will depend only on your decisions...

details.title: ICE on the EDGE
details.short_description: Become a coach in ICE on the EDGE, a figure skating simulation game. Train your athlete, master skills, and craft the perfect routine to win. Face fierce rivals and experience a dramatic story carved on the ice. Can your guidance lead them to the highest stage?

details.title: Flowering Void
details.short_description: Alone and newly awakened, uncover the secrets of this dark and unusual world by fighting and defending against the cruel environment.

details.title: Master Thief
details.short_description: Become the ultimate burglar in this witty 1-4 player co-op heist game. Craft your character, hone your skills, and pull off daring thefts as you rise from small-time crook to Master Thief!

details.title: Bilingual Crosswords
details.short_description: Learn languages by solving crosswords. Solve crosswords → encounter new words → review with spaced repetition → repeat → learn.

details.title: FOREX GAMING FX
details.short_description: We offer a special program that allows you to improve your skills with just 10 minutes of training per day through high-speed training using currency charts. There are three courses to choose from: one for beginners, one for advanced traders, and one for AI automated trading.

details.title: Infinitory
details.short_description: Infinitory mixes city-building, automation, and tower defense in a in a rogue-lite top-down game. Expand your base vertically in limited space, a strategic planning challenge. Automate resources to produce ammunition and upgrades, crucial for stopping waves of enemies on procedurally generated maps.

details.title: Don't Die, Dummy!
details.short_description: Who knew the secret to robot destruction was the perfect spin kick? Dance now, explain later!

details.title: Magic Cells
details.short_description: A life-or-death war between cells and germs! 20+ bosses lead 100+ minions to invade—cunning, multiplying, mutating, and parasitizing your turf! Summon 24+ magic cells, wield 100+ tech cards to fight back, and harness 9 divine powers to win!

details.title: Deliver Together
details.short_description: In Deliver Together, You control either (or both) of the two trucks attached to the same loooong trailer. And who's driving? Oh, just you. Or you and a friend. Or maybe eight of you, all screaming different directions at once. Your goal is to reach the finish line in chaotic tracks.

details.title: Dark Dungeon Feminized
details.short_description: This FPS game has dark and beautiful art style. A tragic accident turns the strict laboratory into a dark dungeon. You are trying to escape from here with wisdom and strategy, and discover its unknown dark secrets.（Has Customizable female villain with costume damage）

details.title: The Mirrion
details.short_description: Dive into a harsh open world where every choice can mean the difference between life and death. Explore untamed lands, build shelters, hunt, craft tools, and defend yourself from threats. Nature, weather, and unexpected events will test your will to survive.

details.title: SuperHookGirl Ultra Challenge!!
details.short_description: Soar through the skies with your mouse! Experience high-speed hook-swinging action in Super Hook Girl Ultra Challenge!! Simple controls — but tough to master! Hook onto anything to discover shortcuts and advanced movement techniques!

details.title: LATITUDE OF THE CULT
details.short_description: Christmas Eve, 1997. A Michigan town sells its Dogman legend to tourists. It never speaks of the cult , or the song beneath the frozen lake. This winter, all three came back. Seventeen walked into the fog and never returned. The sheriff has vanished. Survive the night. Find out what the town buried.

details.title: Kumori Village
details.short_description: Shine your flashlight into the darkness and navigate a survival horror experience where you must evade monsters. Use, equip, and combine randomly spawned items to uncover the village's mysteries and survive.

details.title: Brownie's Adventure: The Final Resolution
details.short_description: An incompetent wizard is tasked with stopping a recently awakened evil entity that just so happens to be trapped inside a (deeply suspiciously heavy) spoon. What follows is a sprawling, absurd 1990s-style point-and-click comedy adventure across bizarre fantasy realms and also North Derbyshire.

details.title: The Abyss Break
details.short_description: Hardcore first-person co-op horror game. Explore the worlds beyond the Abyss alone or with a team, gather what you need to survive, and discover how far consciousness can change before it is no longer your own.

details.title: Slimy Timey
details.short_description: Slimy Timey is a simple 2D platformer where you play as a slime that can jump and attach to walls. Jump, slide, avoid all the dangerous traps, reach the end, and get all the stars!

details.title: BitBeasts
details.short_description: Can you survive humanity's deadliest drones? Build your ship, evolve alien Beasts, unlock powerful talents, and fight through an ultra-hard roguelite space shooter where every run is different.

details.title: Five Heads
details.short_description: Five prisoners each have a visible-to-others card on their forehead. Across three rounds, they logically deduce and rank their cards from lowest to highest. On the final round, each guesses their exact card, using every prior guess as a clue. A single mistake can doom them—can you solve it?

details.title: CHARK
details.short_description: Chess and deckbuilding collide in a compact 5×5 roguelike battlefield of risk and reward. Build momentum from a lone King: stack small advantages, gamble on bold moves, and watch the rules bend as your King snowballs to victory. Short, intense runs how far can you go?

details.title: Marble Havoc
details.short_description: Marble Havoc is a 3D action game. Bring your marble to the goal in different levels. Unfriendly marbles try to kick you away. Friendly marbles assist you.

details.title: Social Warfare
details.short_description: Be a troll-for-hire on social media! You will serve in the Social Warfare battalion and promote loyalty to the Great Kingdom of Eternia, while disrupting society in the enemy nation.

details.title: Dawn Girl
details.short_description: Dawn Girl is a third person 3D anime beauty girl shooting zombie survival game, which takes you into a world attacked by zombies. Players will play as a lonely girl, searching for hope and survival in this shattered world.

details.title: Can't Even See the Sky
details.short_description: Your character is a man with a troubled past who finds himself trapped in a city on the brink of civil war. Look for ways to get out of the city and make peace with the past. Will you pull yourself together or drown in the abyss of despair?

details.title: Tangles 2 تشابك
details.short_description: On the remote island of Scirine, Majed, a young biology intern, arrives at Al-Bayan Research Center, expecting scientific breakthroughs. But his journey turns into a descent into mystery as he uncovers terrifying truths, where reality blends with illusions, revealing more secrets with every step.

details.title: Rich Flavors
details.short_description: Rich Flavors is a game in which you deliver "goods" to "customers" and get paid in "coupons". Can you collect enough to buy your dream cake before your contract ends?

details.title: Nocky el Armadillo
details.short_description: Nocky El Armadillo is a love letter to the 16-bit generation of challenging 2d platformers. Avoid traps and evade enemies while mastering the controls.

details.title: Plush Party
details.short_description: Get ready to challenge family and friends in PLUSH PARTY, the ultimate party game for all ages! Customize your cat, escape the claw, and be the last plushie standing!

details.title: Digopolis
details.short_description: Explore, dig and gather treasures to fuel your evergrowing lust for wealth.

details.title: Through Hell and Back
details.short_description: Through Hell and Back is a timeline based roguelike deckbuilding game. Place your spells on the Timeline to outsmart your enemies. Choose your power ups carefully, trade spells and upgrade the Timeline to unleash devastating combos.

details.title: Brink of Broken
details.short_description: A turn-based RPG in a world already ruined! The weapons you pick up are plentiful but fragile, you must break your foes before your weapons shatter! Explore the land in search of permanent power-ups, or win your battles with strategy alone!

details.title: High Tide
details.short_description: A story-driven adventure where Doug accidentally unleashes an ancient curse across a tropical island. Explore, solve environmental puzzles, battle corrupted creatures, help strange locals, and uncover how to bring the missing people back.

details.title: Beyond Faded Voices
details.short_description: Experience moments in a third-person story about my passed away parents and my british cat Zeus. It's a mix of adventure, cat simulator and even Tower Defence and first person bodycam. Be the cat - sleep, sharp your claws, eat, be petted by parents and misbehave in a few hours!!

details.title: Kodas Nereus
details.short_description: Don your VR headset and descend into the abyss. Kodas Nereus combines true-to-life oceanographic data with hyper-realistic diving mechanics. Navigate pitch-black wrecks, monitor living reefs, and uncover history preserved on the seafloor. No fantasy monsters—just you, your rebreather, and the deep.

details.title: SatW Guesser
details.short_description: SatW Guesser is a geography-based quiz game that challenges your knowledge of world flags and country locations. You’ll be shown a flag or a highlighted country on a world map, and your task is to pick which country it belongs to.

name: Chronos Bound: How We Became Heroes

details.title: Chronos Bound: How We Became Heroes
details.short_description: Pilot a lone ship through a collapsing orbital station in a modern 2.5D shoot ’em up. Block bullets with a 360° directional shield, destroy grotesque wreck-born enemies, defeat colossal bosses, and build new upgrade paths with every run — a love letter to classic shoot ’em ups.

details.title: Dungeon Directive
details.short_description: You’ve taken over the guild hall in the center of town near a mysterious dungeon portal. With a small roster of heroes and limited resources, it’s your job to rebuild the guild, send parties into the depths, and shape a legacy that lasts for generations. What future will your choices create?

details.title: PONG EMOTIONAL
details.short_description: Legendary classic game "PONG" returns with stunning visuals and emotionally stirring sound! A high-performance AI precisely predicts the ball's trajectory and counters with calculated moves. If you can clear STAGE 30, you're a true super player!

details.title: Aerosurge
details.short_description: Perform daring aerial stunts, destroy your enemies and weave through hazardous environments to complete your missions before the time runs out! Upgrade your weapons and abilities between objectives, before taking out enemies across a variety of landscapes and planets

details.title: Finally a Florist
details.short_description: Finally a Florist is a cozy, slice-of-life game where you gather flowers to arrange beautiful bouquets. Explore peaceful landscapes, befriend animals, and fill heartfelt requests from the local villagers as you finally become a florist.

details.title: Phantom Containment
details.short_description: Survive the Planet, a massive open-world containment world filled with dangerous entities, anomaly outbreaks, hostile factions, and hidden secrets. Build, investigate, scavenge, and uncover the truth behind an experiment that never ended.

details.title: The Great Hatch
details.short_description: Help goblins take down a giant floating egg

details.title: Space Revolver
details.short_description: SPACE REVOLVER is a puzzle adventure game that follows the journey of a protagonist caught in a catastrophic black hole accident. With your spaceship critically damaged, you must explore uncharted planets, solve puzzles, repair your ship, and find your way back home.

details.title: Cannabiz: Weed Shop Owner
details.short_description: Build, customise, and grow your cannabis empire from a tiny shop to a booming city-wide business! 🌿💼

details.title: Corpse Burger
details.short_description: Grind humans into “tofu” burgers, keep your customers hooked, and fight or avoid twisted mutants. Manage your secret meat supply, don't get caught, and deliver the most addictive meals in town.

details.title: Becut - An Impostor Game
details.short_description: Dive into this social deduction party game for 4 to 12 players. Collaborate to prepare the ogre's feast and identify the traitors hiding among you. Your sense of direction and memory will be key assets to avoid getting lost in this randomly generated castle.

details.title: Answer Campus: First Semester
details.short_description: Answer Campus: First Semester is a comic book style narrative adventure about identity, belonging, and the moments that define us. Make your way through the first semester of college as you make new connections, experience high stakes encounters, and settle in to your new life.

details.title: HyperTyper 2000
details.short_description: Type, dodge, parry, and survive in HyperTyper 2000! A hybrid typing/bullet hell roguelike where both halves of the action are nonstop! Test your typing skills with one hand on half the keyboard and dodge with the other hand.

details.title: Wayfarer Of Hydrangea
details.short_description: 一名离职原画师，驾驶着豪车的网约车司机江芊华；外表单纯可爱，自称辣妹可爱却粘人，为了追上芊华不顾一切的少女南绣玉。围绕着VTB“紫阳”，一个美丽动人，正如盛放的绣球花般的恋爱故事即将展开。以视觉小说方式呈现的多个结局，描绘极致的百合恋爱，欢迎来到热烈的7月——

details.title: Whimpact!
details.short_description: Collect, care for, and adventure alongside your Whims, who grant you incredible powers. Then dive into the fast-paced, cooperative arena to find and reclaim the world’s missing Starcane energy.

details.title: Ser Chub's Adventure
details.short_description: Join Ser Chubs as they adventure through an exciting world full of slimes, skeletons, and... robots? A fantasy, sci-fi action-adventure game the likes of which is rarely seen. The world of Ser Chubs is not as it seems on first glance. Fight enemies, solve puzzles, and most importantly have fun!

details.title: 双魂のデュアリスト
details.short_description: "Dual Souls Dualist" is a deckbuilding roguelike game where you combine two decks to create endless strategies. Charge up the cards you draw, unleash powerful attacks, and conquer the evil corporation's skyscraper stronghold while defeating enemies along the way.．

details.title: Peregrine Point
details.short_description: Peregrine Point is a single-player story driven game about life, death, and what comes next. Maintain the lighthouse, keep the lamp filled with oil and help guide recently departed cats get to where the need to be.

details.title: The Blue Cut Hook
details.short_description: The Blue Cut Hook blends cozy tavern management with subtle adventure. You're no hero, just a humble tavern keeper, but your food, gear, and advice quietly shape the adventurers who pass through. They make the choices, take the glory, and face the danger, but your influence might keeps them alive.

details.title: EggRoyale
details.short_description: Adorable birds are battling over eggs! Strategically guide your allies to fend off enemies in this simple yet deep 3D real-time strategy game. Enjoy easy controls, thrilling combat, and the heartwarming charm of hardworking birds. Dive into their delightful world and lead your team to victory!

details.title: Monstrobus Quiz
details.short_description: Monstrobus Quiz is an online trivia game for 2-16 players! Answer questions and use tricks or boosts on yourself or others. Create custom question packs to keep each game session unique. Gather your friends and dive into the Monstrobus Quiz fun!

details.title: Astra Sentinel
details.short_description: Astra Sentinel is a wave-based survival RTS where endless alien hordes relentlessly assault your planets. Build defenses, colonize planets and manage resources under constant pressure. Will you be able to recover the control of the galaxy?

details.title: The Backwars
details.short_description: The Backwars is a survival horror game where you gather resources, craft, and hide from lurking terrors. Play solo, co-op, or versus in a hauntingly realistic world where anything can interact with anything. Trust no one, and do whatever it takes to survive.

details.title: Get It Up!
details.short_description: Can you make it to the top while balancing the stick on your head?ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ ㅤㅤ...probably not. It's pretty hard.

details.title: Ramen Crisis
details.short_description: It’s a wacky ramen delivery action game! Hop on your scooter and deliver towering stacks of ramen without toppling them! Hurry up before the soup gets cold!

details.title: Waddle & Rescue
details.short_description: Waddle & Rescue is a sliding puzzle logic 3D game, where you'll take control of Teo the Penguin, a cute but brave adventurer, in his mission to rescue all the lost penguins around the world. Waddle your way across different biomes, sliding and solving puzzles in order to find his lost pals.

details.title: Too Big To Fail
details.short_description: Welcome to the firm. You and your friends get the worst desks in the building and one account between you. Trade, deal, cheat, invest, gamble. The market was made to be exploited. Do well and the firm will be yours, then the world, eventually.

details.title: PhantomZone SemiDeus
details.short_description: "A dragon survivor, a rarity in these times." That's what she called herself. Mysterious, bizarre biographical tales unfold in a retro-futuristic world.

details.title: Saintless
details.short_description: Explore the halls of the underground cult of The Open Hand. Experience the test rooms setup for your initiation in this psychological horror exploration game. Never forget....they are always watching.

details.title: Feodika
details.short_description: Live your own story in a world of the early Middle Ages! Lead a dynasty, expand your domain, help your subjects, and don’t forget to leave an heir! Thy Kingdom Come!

details.title: LIMINAL CAT
details.short_description: A cat wakes up in a beautiful yet eerie world. In search of an exit, it wanders, beginning its lonely adventure. This is an adventure game featuring a cat influenced by various liminal spaces.

details.title: Mini Gears: Mayhem
details.short_description: Mini Gears: Mayhem is a single player Rogue-like where you do the aiming. Take control of a little tank on a blueprint, fighting waves of supposedly evil slimes. Gain experience, level up, and upgrade your tank in each run.

details.title: Breezevale
details.short_description: Start a new life on a forgotten farm. Meet fantastical residents—elf, beastkin, demon, mermaid, ghost, and more! Restore the farm, find love, raise magical creatures, explore dungeons, and uncover the mystery behind the withering World Tree.

details.title: Mini Racer: Mini 4WD
details.short_description: Build, tune, and race Mini 4WD cars in this thrilling sim! Customize motors, tires, and more, design wild tracks, and manage your shop. Race in epic PVE and PVP battles. Inspired by 90s Japanese iconic hobby, it’s a gearhead’s dream. Add to your wishlist now and join the world of Mini 4WD racing!

details.title: SIGMA COALESCE: Suika Game Roguelike
details.short_description: "SIGMA COALESCE" is a deck-building puzzle roguelike blending "Suika Game" and "Slay the Spire". Merge same-colored items to launch attacks and activate special effects that unlock powerful synergies to vanquish foes. Explore dungeons brimming with unique items, relics, events, and giant bosses.

details.title: Show Quiz
details.short_description: Show Quiz is a dynamic quiz game that tests your knowledge and reflexes! Chain together questions, climb levels and improve your rank to impress Jack Pot, your supercharged presenter.Over 5000 questions await you in this game!

name: Mech Assembler: Model Kit builder Simulator

details.title: Mech Assembler: Model Kit builder Simulator
details.short_description: Welcome to Mech Assembler, a relaxing puzzle game inspired by model kit (Gunpla) construction. You'll experience the relaxing process of building a model. Once assembled, you can paint it with Spry. Earn points based on your accuracy and unlock new elements.

details.title: Coin War
details.short_description: A new twist on the StS-like genre: the cards you play transform into units on a grid-based board for several turns! Coin War delivers unique mechanics, tactical combat, endless synergies, and immense strategic depth. Craving a new challenge in the StS-like genre? Give this one a try.

details.title: Directive: Intercept
details.short_description: Protect Earth's last cities from an alien fleet in fast-paced aerial combat. Upgrade and customize your aircraft to dominate the skies.

details.title: SPIDER HOTEL
details.short_description: Misfit bugs vs. Giant Spider in an asymmetrical game of tag! Cooperate to survive, or become the spider and hunt! The spider crawls on walls to capture prey. The bugs must rescue friends using teamwork. Escape the trap-filled hotel in a thrilling, hilarious survival game!

name: レビィのスライムファクトリー

details.title: レビィのスライムファクトリー
details.short_description: なぜかスライムになってしまったししょーを元に戻すため、みならい錬金術師レビィが日夜奮闘！スライムと錬金術の不思議な世界で繰り広げるカラフルで魅力的なパズルゲーム。

details.title: Martian Elevator
details.short_description: Travel the world as a cute ufo and ruin everybody's day! Unlock new methods of mischief in over 30 levels, each with unique setting and objectives. This is an cartoonish UFO simulator!

details.title: Herbalist Roman
details.short_description: Step into the role of a medieval herbalist. Study your herbal book, craft macerations, and help your clients by easing their ailments. Christianity is reaching the Slavic village of Drebor, and your choices will determine whether these changes unfold in peace.

details.title: The Julian
details.short_description: Work at a supermarket, pack groceries into your inventory, and spend your wages on shopping and cooking to survive. Manage satiety and sanity while building friendships that set the story in motion. Your choices lead to multiple endings. A survival simulation fusing puzzle, daily life, and narrative

details.title: Short Short Fictions
details.short_description: A short short mix tape of one story that connects three shorter stories. On the NewWave, a magical game console that is retro but new, enjoy DON'T SAY YES, TO:NORTH, and a secret tale nobody yet knows. Welcome to a slightly fantastical and nostalgic world of painful, toilful, and beautiful stories!

details.title: Aberrate Inc.
details.short_description: Guide N.T.R.N., a curious little maintenance robot, through cozy logic puzzles by splitting, moving, and combining red and blue boxes to power doors, platforms, and odd office machines. Winner of SXSW Sydney’s Best Student Game Award 2025.

details.title: Sci Wars
details.short_description: Sci Wars is an exploration survival shooter set in a hostile alien desert. Use your jetpack, powerful weapons, and scavenged resources to survive deadly creatures and defeat powerful bosses.

details.title: The Grand Planto Heists
details.short_description: The neighborhood will never be the same! Play as a raccoon obsessed with the front gardens of The Grand Planto Heights in this 3D digging adventure, dodging Animal Control with your woodland critter friends and stealing whatever you can scamper away with in your paws & jaws!

details.title: Trick Eight
details.short_description: On a remote village shrouded in bloody tradition, a centuries-old ritual endures. You are a detective with unique skills, yet branded as a traitor. Will you surrender your limbs to ascend like an immortal? Or risk everything at the edge of science and plunge into the abyss of truth?

details.title: INNERWHY
details.short_description: You just dissociated from reality. Unfortunately, the imaginary world you've landed in is as disturbed as your mental state. Gather your courage and confront your darkest thoughts in this 8-bit psychological horror RPG.

details.title: Loot, Dungeons and Riches
details.short_description: Manage a party of adventurers and delve into the dungeon. As you progress, you will meet new enemies, new gear, a variety of dungeon systems.

details.title: Hexora
details.short_description: Hexora is a unique and innovative strategy puzzle game that combines the classic mine-sweeping gameplay with a godly perspective and city-building elements. Embark on an exciting adventure to unveil the unknown and guide your people to prosperity.

details.title: Anne & Mary's Hunt for Booty
details.short_description: Anne and Mary's Hunt for Booty is a fast-paced 2D beat 'em up. Play as historical pirates Anne Bonny and/or Mary Read, shoot and slash through the British fleet, and save the cowardly captain from a nasty privateer! Features swashbucklin' beats, local co-op, and art stylized by '90s cartoons.

details.title: Slopeside Kings
details.short_description: Slopeside Kings is a multiplayer snowboarding combat racer for up to four players, where you shred the slopes, catch big air, and pull off tricks to build boost. Pickup and use chaotic items along the slopes to battle your way to the finish line!

details.title: Cave Trek
details.short_description: Dig passages, build footholds, and find your way past monsters and traps in CaveTrek, a single-player roguelike platformer. Explore randomized pixel caves, gather treasure, and spend it on supplies. Every shovel use counts. How much will you risk on the way to the exit?

details.title: COTS
details.short_description: Step into a chicken-themed tower-defense roguelike where you build and upgrade your coop, think up strategies during the day, and hope to survive when night falls. Wild predators lurk in the dark, ready to tear down your defenses! COTS is action, strategy, collectible cards…and of course, CHICKENS!

details.title: One Summer Holiday
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in a nostalgic summer vacation of rural comfort. A timeless place of natural beauty, rich conversations, quiet occurrences and indulgent detail and delight awaits you in One Summer Holiday.

details.title: Vironics
details.short_description: Control a Nanite body from a space station to gather Nanite resources on Earth, seized by a rogue AI. Build and fortify your dropbase with turrets and defenses, fight waves of robotic enemies, and collect Nanites for extraction, balancing fast FPS combat with strategic tower placement.

details.title: Car Rental Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own car rental lot in this detailed simulator. Manage reservations, clean and service vehicles, and keep customers happy. With time-based tasks, strategy elements, and high replayability, every day brings a new challenge.

details.title: GTL Schedule
details.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world where food has become contraband and hope is on the brink of extinction, you quietly ignite a revolution to warm the world with a spatula and love.

details.title: COLDNIGHTS
details.short_description: Learn how to survive, craft and build the essentials, find source of food and construct necessary shelter before the snow starts falling. And may be someday, after building a bridge, you will find your way back home. Keep building bridges.

details.title: Dealer Shift
details.short_description: Get your hands dirty in an immersive open-world crime simulator. Mix, grind, dissolve, and package every product yourself, build hidden labs, outsmart the police, smuggle shipments through checkpoints, and grow from a small-time dealer into an underground kingpin.

details.title: Delta
details.short_description: Delta is a first-person movement-heavy platformer game focused on physics-based traversal, speedrunning, and mechanical mastery. And somewhere ahead, the one you lost is still waiting.

details.title: Hello Space
details.short_description: Dive into a 2D action game where you control a spaceship, defeat enemies and overcome deadly traps. Extend your arsenal by collecting new weapons and technologies for your ship that you will need to conquer four different dungeon-like worlds, all connected by an open space full of surprises.

details.title: Project SARA
details.short_description: A man who has lost his wife and seeks to escape loneliness and grief begins working as a firewatch in a forest. He meets a girl named Sarah and encounters strange occurrences while uncovering deep family secrets. He learns that not every voice is human and not every farewell signifies an end.

name: Tainted by the Stars: The Dead Among Us

details.title: Tainted by the Stars: The Dead Among Us
details.short_description: A tactical 3D top-down zombie shooter with an innovative Field-of-View system. Tasked by researchers, you must uncover the cause of the zombie outbreak while managing scarce ammo, using tactics, melee, and grenades to survive endless waves.

details.title: Proxima B
details.short_description: A short Sci-fi adventure game made for the Game Boy Color in GB Studio! Solve puzzles, collect energy for your weapons, and fight the alien Ackloids to claim the planet Proxima B for the humans!

details.title: Deckanism: Singularity Island
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder meets auto-battler where every fight is a puzzle. Build mechanisms, counter enemies and unleash your perfect combo!

details.title: SiegeBorn
details.short_description: SiegeBorn is a top-down action RTS. Lead your troops, command powerful siege engines, and defeat the enemies!

details.title: Soul Catcher: The Moon Coliseum
details.short_description: Soul Catcher: The Moon Coliseum is a fast-paced Rogue-Like First Person Arena fighter. Battle through hordes of enemies. In this cruel coliseum, it's a free-for-all. You choose where to fight and who to fight at the right moment, with the aid of Magic Crystals that give single use weapons and tools.

details.title: Donut Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Choose the right products, make your own donuts, work as a cashier, hire cashiers, handle deliveries and make your small shop a big success by keeping your customers happy!

details.title: Starforce Rangers
details.short_description: A small online Space RPG. Made to enter space! Fly around with others and level up. Battle against other ships or do other missions.

details.title: Honeycomb Coins
details.short_description: Honeycomb Coins is a free-to-play, coin-fighting, 1vs1 turn-based strategy board game. Online support. Win the game to get coins and collect coins of various designs!

details.title: V/V
details.short_description: A fast paced 2d Precision Platformer game where you must move dash and jump your way through platforms that begin to decay after you touch them.

details.title: Bugboy
details.short_description: Catch, train and battle creepy crawlies and uncover the secrets of Spider Town in this retro Gameboy-style RPG.

details.title: Bomber Hero
details.short_description: BomberHero is a thrilling multiplayer game inspired by Bomberman. Up to 4 players can join online battles or play against bots. Customize your hero, collect power-ups, and dominate diverse arenas. Are you ready for explosive fun? Join the action on Steam!

details.title: Coming Home, Little Oak
details.short_description: As a little oak, your life was turned upside down when you were kidnapped from your village and family by giant robots. Survive, overcome the challenges, and find your way back home!

details.title: R.E.A.P.E.R. Corp.
details.short_description: EARTH is mutated and destroyed. You are a R.E.A.P.E.R, one of the lucky humans tasked with preparing earth for the return of humanity! Collect valuable loot and S.C.I.E.N.C.E! Travel from the REAPER space station to the infested, ancient ruins of EARTH with your fellow REAPERS.

details.title: Adventure Paws
details.short_description: Adventure Paws is a pixel-style 2D side-scrolling adventure game where you and your friend will play as two cats, embarking on an exciting journey across a mysterious and unknown continent. Join the black and white cats and set off on this journey full of challenges and surprises!

details.title: Hyper Hadron Racing
details.short_description: Hyper Hadron Racing is a futuristic racing game set in space. Choose your spacecraft and battle your way to first place across a multitude of tracks and environments rich with power-ups, features and hazards! Or create your own unique tracks to share and compete online.

details.title: The Lonely Tree
details.short_description: A serene, narrative-driven experience where you document important life events as diary entries, watching your personal tree grow and connect with others' stories. Explore the evolving environment and form connections with anonymous players based on shared experiences.

details.title: 地球勇者 Earth Fighter
details.short_description: “Knights of Earth Realm” is a 2D platform shooter action light rogue game. Synthesize various homemade or advanced weapon equipment, lead your pet, and fight against human looters, out-of-control mech, evil insectoids, and other threats on the post-disaster wasteland.

details.title: Magtong
details.short_description: Airhockey meets magnets! Magtong is a fast-paced, physics-driven sports game where magnetic mayhem rules the rink. Play solo or in teams, locally or online, and outmaneuver your opponents with skill and polarity!

details.title: Bat Galaxy
details.short_description: Half on-rails shooter, half exploration-driven adventure. Zoom into a world where billions of bullets surround you and your handy punch feature can send enemies flying.

details.title: THE MOST GIGACHAD SURVIVORS
details.short_description: Dive into a giga-action roguelike about GigaChad who have spent his entire lives in the gym and are stepping outside for the first time! Explore the unfamiliar world, fight the city's inhabitants, and complete wild quests. Help the GigaChad discover this complex world and understand himself!

details.title: Nuclear Apocalypse Merchant Simulator
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic single-player simulator where you sell resources to survivors to withstand internal and external threats. Work with scavengers to gather supplies, keep your shelter secure, and uncover the secrets of the bunker.

details.title: Newma Holiday
details.short_description: On a rare holiday, Newty's plans were disrupted by an urgent deadline. His computer was infected with a virus, and his desktop pet Ema, now self-aware, asked for help to fix it. Newty and Ema teamed up to solve puzzles and remove the virus.

details.title: Toilet Zone 2
details.short_description: Toilet Zone 2 is a 2.5D momentum based platformer, starring a duck (in a toilet). Use water-powered flight to navigate past obstacles, and master the controls.

details.title: TechStop Simulator
details.short_description: Prepare for an immersive retro arcade & game shop management experience. Take control of your very own TechStop! Stock your shelves with games and arcade classics, set prices, manage payments, hire staff, expand & design your store to attract more customers. Stay ahead in competitive local market!

details.title: Manipulus - A Deck Building Odyssey
details.short_description: Manipulus is a thrilling deck-building, choose-your-own-adventure game with rogue-like mechanics and perma-death. Trapped by mysterious forces, you are made to relive your past, guiding a band of survivors through perilous times. It's time to FORM THE MANIPULUS!

details.title: Aetherian Chronicles
details.short_description: Aetherian Chronicles is a 3D Casual SideScroller MMORPG focused on interaction with AI controlled players. Explore, train, party up, make friends and trade with real people or AI controlled players! Customize your character to your hearts content and choose your own way to experience your adventure!

details.title: Desktop Pet Engine
details.short_description: Place your favorite characters on your desktop!A desktop idle game for work, study, and fun. Summon cute companions to keep you company, vent stress, or collect characters. Quickly access productivity tools like notepads, Pomodoro timers, and task lists—making your desktop lively and efficient!

details.title: Neon Dash
details.short_description: Neon Dash is a Retro-Futurism style rhythm platformer game. Get past challenging obstacles to the music's beat, and journey back to the dreamy 80s to push your limits!

details.title: Hookah Simulator
details.short_description: Start with a small cozy hookah lounge and turn it into the most popular spot in the city! Your goal is to craft perfect hookahs, satisfying even the most demanding customers.

details.title: Out On The Water
details.short_description: Out On The Water is a short, meditative journey through memory and grief that tells the story of an inattentive father and his last chance to connect with his children. Set adrift in quiet waters that represent each child, catch strange memory fish to uncover the past and face regrets.

details.title: Starlight Blade
details.short_description: An adventure-packed slasher where you play as the heir to a legendary blade, crushing armies of faded stars and battling the very creators of the universe.

details.title: One Matter, One Hexagram
details.short_description: A little ink-turtle lives on your desktop. Ask one question, tap the coin jar, and watch it cast six throws. A woodblock-printed leaf slides in - tear it off, keep it, or export it. Fully offline.

details.title: Androfoco
details.short_description: An FPS with SHOOTING COMBAT! Shooting your enemies a few times will not do! You must hit them with everything you've got so that they can never make it back to the stage. That is where the big money is!

details.title: Pawn City
details.short_description: From A Single Store To A Monopoly - Buy Sell And Trade Anything That Comes Through Your Door. Expand Your Business, Hire Employees, Bid For Storage Units, Don't Get Scammed, And Take Over The City !

details.title: Lost Hellden
details.short_description: Resist your Sin. Reclaim your fate. Lost Hellden is an action JRPG from a team of genre veterans, featuring a gorgeous hand-painted 3D art style, a vast world to explore, and a unique phased battle system that blends turn-based and real-time combat.

details.title: Arisen Force: Vonimir
details.short_description: Gather allies, fight the shadows, and uncover the secrets of Vonimir. In a land of pixel beauty and epic battles, your legend begins.

details.title: World of Anterra
details.short_description: The prophecy foretold your coming, Traveller, but are you here to save Anterra or yourself? Explore an expansive living world, with thriving towns, wild animals, and monster filled dungeons. Discover secrets, lore and mysteries, and uncover the truth about the Eye to become Anterra's Champion.

details.title: NO STRAIGHT ROADS 2
details.short_description: Metronomik and Shueisha Games are thrilled to announce NSR2 – the explosive sequel to the hit action-music adventure NO STRAIGHT ROADS – coming to Steam in 2026.

details.title: 100 Astro Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: 100 Barcelona Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: 100 Lisbon Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: 100 Amsterdam Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: Rabona
details.short_description: Rabona is an online multiplayer soccer game with physics-based gameplay. Take total ball control with precise touches. Join the real football action with your friends. Feel the game.

details.title: Tired of Being the Hero
details.short_description: You saved the realm. Now you just want to chop wood, but monsters won't let you retire. Train your villagers, pull them out of harm's way, unlock new abilities to outlast the next assault, and try to remember why you became a Hero. Hold the line together in this short, story-rich, fantasy action RPG

details.title: 687 Days on Mars
details.short_description: 687 Days on Mars is a survival game where you are stranded alone on Mars - your task is to manage resources, build a base from scratch, grow food, and explore the red planet in search of supplies and other hidden challenges. Every breath and decision counts - can you survive on the Red Planet?

details.title: About Fishing
details.short_description: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

details.title: Furniture Restoration Simulator: Garage Edition
details.short_description: Step into your own garage workshop and breathe new life into forgotten furniture. In this immersive first-person simulation, sand away decades of wear, apply vibrant paints, and polish each piece to a showroom finish—one satisfying restoration at a time.

details.title: Stick A Round
details.short_description: Relive the joy of your childhood in Stick A Round! Find uniquely generated sticks that transform into weapons based on their real-world shapes. Battle friends in combat, play action packed or relaxing minigames, and explore a changing world where your imagination sets the rules.

name: Summer☆Dash: Our Track Team's Summer Training Trip

details.title: Summer☆Dash: Our Track Team's Summer Training Trip
details.short_description: As coach of the girls' track team, go on an exciting retreat in the countryside with the three best girls of your team, where you'll help them overcome their struggles and unlock their full potential!

name: The Magic World 2: Curse of the Ancients

details.title: The Magic World 2: Curse of the Ancients
details.short_description: Party role-playing game. You control a squad of characters moving through an open game world. Collect items, complete quests, communicate with NPCs, try to survive, destroy enemies with various magic and weapons.

details.title: Weeny Wise
details.short_description: A Co-Op Adventure, Puzzle-Platformer game. Embark on your adventure with your companion in the magical world of Weeny Wise.Invite a friend to join for free with Friend’s Pass to solve puzzles together, cross platforms, and stand against creatures enchanted by Ragna.

details.title: Antidote city hall
details.short_description: A noir pixel-art adventure where you explore the city, engage in dialogues with choices and skill checks, face tough moral decisions, and shape the story’s outcome.

details.title: MUDANG: Two Hearts
details.short_description: In a unified Korea, masked terrorists strike at the heart of Seoul. Ji Jeongtae, a soldier sent in to stop the attacks, stumbles upon a K-Pop star named Gavi at the center of the unfolding crisis. As their stories intertwine, a chilling truth begins to take shape.

details.title: DigSite: Archeology in Egypt
details.short_description: DigSite is open-world archeology sandbox game located in Egypt where you dig, clean and document artifacts you find. Donate rare artifacts to a museum and build your legacy as a legendary archeologist.

details.title: Ritual Tides
details.short_description: Ritual Tides is a story rich, psychological horror game set on the dark, atmospheric, isolated British island of Hortus. Explore the island, uncover its dark past, loot food, ammunition and supplies, evade the cult of the Fallow Parish, as you fight for survival against Lovecraftian horrors.

details.title: better.game
details.short_description: A game without lag or ping advantage. Client-side customizable. Players can see and hear different things. Moving spherical zone. Build, fight, or just go to zone. Jetpack, glide, grapple, ascend, teleport or drive across the map. Lose, view an instant replay, then reboot and get back in the fight.

details.title: UnGodly
details.short_description: Ungodly is a dark fantasy RPG where visceral real-time combat meets collectible hero strategy. Build your roster, chain elemental powers through seamless team swapping, and forge bonds that unlock devastating synergies in a world on the edge of ruin.

details.title: Woe Reigns Unending
details.short_description: Lead a cursed party through a ruined world in this grimdark side-scrolling RPG. Build your team, master tactical combat, and unleash forbidden powers to survive an endless parade of nightmares. Decide what, if anything, is worth salvaging from a world that has been reduced to ashes.

details.title: Five Laps at Freddy's
details.short_description: Welcome to Five Laps at Freddy's, The premier animatronic kart racing circuit featuring your favorite and lovable Fazbear friends! Sponsored by Fazbear Entertainment

details.title: Fate Trigger
details.short_description: Fate Trigger is a 3D Anime-style, hero-based tactical shooter powered by UE5, available across multiple platforms. Dive into a dynamic world of floating islands, become a sharpshooter with extraordinary special skills, and engage in thrilling, spectacular life-or-death showdowns!

details.title: Expedition: Into Darkness
details.short_description: Brave forbidden dungeons in a quest for knowledge and treasure in this medieval PvE co-op extraction looter. Craft weapons, customise gear and join forces with up to four allies. Survive the ruins together—or lose everything you carry.

details.title: Solaria
details.short_description: Collect various androids known as "Pvas" on the futuristic colony planet named "Solaria", deploy them for battles, construction, farming, crafting; pilot your own mobile base to explore the vast world. This is a brand-new, single player open-world survival and crafting game.

details.title: Verse Project
details.short_description: In this multiplayer game you have to explore the Solar System in real scale. Control spaceships of the near future, explore planets, moons and asteroids, mine resources, fight for space domination and build the future of the universe.

details.title: Echoes Below
details.short_description: Echoes Below is a tactical first-person shooter set in an unforgiving open-world survival environment. Build and fortify your base, craft essential gear, and recruit companions to fight alongside you. Explore a hostile archipelago, hunt for resources and engage in intense firefights.

details.title: Melt Away
details.short_description: People end up forgetting about the dead.

details.title: Age of Respair
details.short_description: Age of Respair is a medieval strategy castle-builder. Build massive castles with fortifications while managing resources and production chains. Assemble a large army and lay siege to enemy castles. Lead your people and bring respair to your kingdom🏰⚔️

details.title: METACRAFT: Arena
details.short_description: METACRAFT: Arena — an online action RPG with a wide selection of melee and ranged weapons, PvE and PvP raids, leveling and build customization, clan activities, base upgrades, crafting, player trading, and much more!

details.title: Crystal Cub
details.short_description: Crystal Cub is a retro inspired cozy exploration game. Assume the role of Biggie the Bear who stumbles upon a magical library and discovers all of its secrets!

details.title: Dream Walker
details.short_description: "Dream Walker" is an RPG game that combines survival, scavenging for extraction, and turn-based combat. Every time you explore within the dream, you might acquire valuable treasures, but you could also lose everything.

details.title: Red Rust Pioneers
details.short_description: Build a new life in the Wild West open world of Red Rust Valley, alone or with up to 4 players in co-op. Hunt, farm, raise animals and craft through the changing seasons in this survival game as your camp grows from a canvas tent to a homestead. Free land, open skies, and a world worth exploring.

details.title: 02:17 AM
details.short_description: A remote forest lookout fell silent at 02:17 AM. Follow the missing keeper’s trail, restore the radio and piece together the clues in an atmospheric first-person mystery. No combat or jump scares.

details.title: Touhou Dream Duel
details.short_description: Battle your way through a beautifully drawn Gensokyo in this unique fighting game inspired by the classics from the Touhou Project franchise.

details.title: Mulerun – Retro Bootlegger Simulator
details.short_description: Build a moonshine empire in the 1980s. Brew, bottle, deliver, and protect your cargo as you grow from a dusty village to Mulerun City. Outsmart your ankle monitor, take risky deals, and smuggle by land, sea, and air while caught between the CIA and the cartel. Solo or 4-player co-op.

details.title: Ultimate Gym Simulator: Prologue
details.short_description: Build your dream gym with Ultimate Gym Simulator: Prologue

details.title: Kisaragi
details.short_description: A third-person shooter horror game inspired by the unsettling Japanese legend of the non-existent Kisaragi Station.

details.title: Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror
details.short_description: Run a cozy little soup shop haunted by unsettling stories. In Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror, uncover hidden mysteries and unlock every secret recipe. Serve the right soup from the Super Soup 2000.

details.title: Dragon survival
details.short_description: Stranded on a mysterious island with a baby dragon, survive and grow stronger. Gather resources, build your base, and overcome trials left behind by ancient explorers. An open-world survival RPG blending exploration, crafting, combat, and dragon growth.

details.title: Detective Fantasia: EXCALIMURDER
details.short_description: EXCALIMURDER is a nonlinear murder mystery game inspired by the sword in the stone legend. Explore an orphanage, meet weird people and solve logic puzzles, all in a colorful pixel art world. Bonus: Excalibur is the murder weapon.

details.title: Autonomous Anarchy
details.short_description: A retro twin-stick bullet-hell where you fight hordes of enemies, collect powerful weapons and upgrades, and go head to head with menacing mechanical bosses. Take on the hordes solo or with a friend in local co-op!

details.title: Chessire
details.short_description: A roguelike tactical auto-battler where you build an army of chess pieces infused with items and magical abilities. Assemble an army, discover synergies and master the combat system. Guide your army's strategy and watch it auto-battle or take command and control your pieces in turn-based combat!

details.title: Ginger Snap: Islands of Rot
details.short_description: Two games in one! GingerSnap: an action platformer with a unique ability combination system. YMIR: a non-linear puzzle platformer with collectable upgrades.

details.title: 100 Cats Greece
details.short_description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Greece! Can you find them all? 😺

details.title: 100 Cats Pakistan
details.short_description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Pakistan! Can you find them all? 😺

details.title: 100 Cats Argentina
details.short_description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Argentina! Can you find them all? 😺

details.title: Hop'n & Bop'n
details.short_description: Dive into a rhythmic adventure in this dynamic 3D platformer! Navigate over 30 levels filled with challenging obstacles that trigger in sync with the music. Run, jump, slide, and slam your way through, uncovering secrets and grabbing collectibles in a uniquely musical experience.

details.title: Combo Haven
details.short_description: Combo Haven is a platform fighter inspired single-player game where your only task is to perform the sickest combos possible. Progress through a variety of levels and compete for high scores. Uncover new mechanics, abilities and characters along the way.

details.title: Celestial Seekers
details.short_description: Defend your base from relentless enemy hordes—solo or with friends! Discover unique planets, uncover the mystery of your mission, and unlock powerful items to help you survive.

details.title: The Indoors
details.short_description: Days after your daughter vanishes, an anonymous note says she’s trapped in an abandoned indoor playground. You break in. It’s dark, rotten, silent. As you search the ruins, something watches you. You’re not alone and it knows you’re there.

details.title: T-Ghoul :: Dorobou Yameta Youkei Poppu!
details.short_description: A mischievous Thai ghoul trades haunting for farming in this 2D isometric horror-comedy. Steal, sell, or raise chickens, avoid shamans, and decide your fate in a ghost-filled village. Survive, thrive… or devour.

name: Bamboo Spring: A Story Cast in Bronze

details.title: Bamboo Spring: A Story Cast in Bronze
details.short_description: After saving an exiled prince of the fallen State of Wei, you are granted an abandoned homestead. Farm the land, raise livestock, fish and hunt, forge bonds with the townsfolk, build a militia, and defend your home against invading forces.

details.title: Choking Hazard
details.short_description: Build giant toy sets with up to 3 friends, online or split-screen. One enormous pop-up manual, no adult supervision. Argue over step 8 together, or take it slow on your own. Finish a set and watch it spring to life. In Creative mode, build your own sets and share them on the Workshop.

details.title: Survival Of Runt
details.short_description: An open-world PvPvE survival shooter where cooperation and betrayal coexist. Choose between Chaos and Order to claim victory, and if you fall, revive as a formidable Mutant Player to hunt down the remaining survivors.

details.title: CrisisX
details.short_description: Immerse yourself into a realistic open world experience and find your way out in the ruins of a dying world. Survive the threats from the Infected, the living and most importantly, the wilderness. Fight or cooperate with others, and establish your territory. Build your own new post-apocalyptic world

details.title: The Heirloom
details.short_description: Uncover the secrets of your family and your grandfather's old lighthouse as you seek the truth behind the unusual happenings in The Heirloom, a mysterious thriller adventure inspired by the atmosphere of the Hebrides and Scottish folklore!

details.title: Love Nest
details.short_description: 《爱之巢》是一场关于血肉、爱与救赎、恨与纠缠的冒险。密室逃脱也好、视觉小说也好、电子宠物也好……这些都只是这场冒险的冰山一角。唯一重要的只有……属于你的少女——『晴』，永远在你们的《爱之巢》，微笑着等着你。

details.title: L.OD
details.short_description: 2D exploratory adventure

details.title: Purble Place 3D
details.short_description: This is Purble Place 3D! - three exciting adventures in an updated classic! Create and win, just like in the good old days!

details.title: FSA DRIVING
details.short_description: Delivery, trading, racing—showcase your superb driving skills in Nijnait City, modeled after Tianjin. Customize your vehicle, drift through corners, perform stunt drives, and glide over the city with a wingsuit. Explore streets, uncover the fastest routes, and save precious time for your clients.

details.title: Handshakes: Hands On
details.short_description: Handshakes: Hands On is a wholesome puzzle game all about shaking hands. With puzzles designed to foster discovery and gently guide the player towards their own solution, you can play alone or with a friend and get your hands dirty in this simple and surprising puzzler.

details.title: Toxic Crusaders
details.short_description: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville and beyond, one radioactive menace at a time!

details.title: Mainland
details.short_description: Enter a cooperative medieval realm, forge alliances, lead armies, and engage in epic battles. Shape history with dynamic politics, or test your mettle against others in fierce player-vs-player combat.

details.title: Orc Warchief: Prologue
details.short_description: Prologue version of Orc Warchief. Become an Orc warchief and fight for survival of your race. Rebuild your village and train your warriors. Gather resources and craft your weapons. Raise your warbanner and gather The Horde.

details.title: CRETE
details.short_description: Fight against the Ancestors and other biopunk creatures. Use their DNA to build your own procedural weapons, find a friend and combine your skills to be even more powerful. The further you go, the better rewards you will get for the next run. It is up to you to reveal what is up there in the north.

details.title: Detained: Too Good for School
details.short_description: ☆A 2D action RPG delinquent schoolgirl simulator!★ Take control of a delinquent schoolgirl freshly liberated after half a year behind bars. Attend classes, fight gangsters, work various part-time jobs, and cause all manner of mischief however you choose in this gorgeous 2D action RPG!

details.title: Task Bar Isekai
details.short_description: Kenta worked himself to death at 3:47 AM… and was reborn under your taskbar. An idle ARPG that fights while you work: loot, forge to +15, beat bosses that break out onto your desktop, and seal your best drops as real Steam items to trade or sell on the Steam Community Market.

name: CrocApoca!! Crocodile maiden at the End of the World

details.title: CrocApoca!! Crocodile maiden at the End of the World
details.short_description: Take care of a cute crocodile girl and make it through the Apocalypse while your bossy step-sister and some mysterious organizations are getting in your way!

details.title: Life After End
details.short_description: Dive into the harsh world of post-apocalyptic Siberia. Extreme climate, limited resources, wild animals, and other players - all this is part of the daily struggle, where only the strongest survive. Are you ready to find out what life is like after the end?

details.title: SacriFire
details.short_description: SacriFire is an upcoming RPG boasting a unique combat system, elaborate pixel art, and music by genre legend Motoi Sakuraba. Ezekiel Ridan, a young priest, struggles to keep his faith as the world he loves is threatened by a war between gods and demons. The adventure begins!

details.title: Island of Winds
details.short_description: Journey through a mystical 17th century Iceland inspired by authentic folklore and mythology. Play as Brynhildur, a young Balance Keeper who uses magic, empathy, and puzzle-solving to uncover ancient secrets and restore harmony to a fractured world.

details.title: Project OutFox
details.short_description: Project OutFox is mod friendly, cross-platform rhythm game engine based on StepMania, featuring 21 different modes simulating different dance, sensor, instrument and key-based rhythm games. Play your way through 25+ years of community content and relive your nostalgia and try to outfox your friends!

details.title: FortressCraft : Phoenix
details.short_description: The third iteration of the game that invented the Factory genre, FortressCraft :Phoenix takes the over-the-top base building and survival gameplay and cranks it up a hundred times. Build your mining base with hundreds of thousands of machines in it, explore alien landscape, heading deep underground.

details.title: SYNTHALGIA: Retro Arcade Racing
details.short_description: No checkpoint timers — FUEL is your clock. Speed and danger keep you alive. Chase down tankers and cargo trucks to refuel and upgrade. Score big across miles of scenic highways and become #1 on the leaderboard!

details.title: Leadville
details.short_description: Leadville is a grid-based hidden movement strategy game. Each turn, players secretly plan the movement and shot direction of their crew, trying to outmaneuver their rivals.

details.title: Ragnarok Mining Co.
details.short_description: Ragnarok Mining Co. is a satisfying planet demolition interval clicker set in a dystopian future where you are just a number in the corporate world. Scan for hotspots, fire your probes, and destroy worlds.

details.title: Defend Your Fish
details.short_description: An Arcade style strategy game where you must protect your bucket of fish from crabs, seagulls, and other such enemies. The goal is to survive as long as possible to build up your score, earn coins to unlock cosmetics and upgrades to help your future runs!

details.title: DECASTLE
details.short_description: A turn-based medieval fantasy deck-building game where every card shapes how you break enemy castles. Build your deck, plan your strategy, and unleash powerful actions to collapse fortifications in stylized, physics-driven battles.

details.title: Reefdeck
details.short_description: What if your deck was made of fish? Reefdeck is a cartoon underwater auto-battler roguelike where you collect, deploy, and battle absurd sea creatures. Crack open coral packs, build your roster, and survive bullet hell chaos beneath the waves.

details.title: MEMORY DEALER
details.short_description: You are a memory trafficker. Harvest stolen memories from captive minds and sell them to BRN CORP. Buy neural implants with your credits, but don't get addicted to your own supply, or you'll lose those memories forever. A shady cyberpunk idle game on your desktop.

details.title: Chrongrid
details.short_description: Chrongrid is an AI-driven narrative experience. Inside an author's story blueprint, you make your own choices and the world responds in its own way — every choice echoes, no two journeys alike. Built-in blueprints are the start; play others' stories or write your own, in any language.

details.title: PAWTENTIAL DISASTER
details.short_description: A chaotic physics co-op game where a pack of dogs must get one very unlucky baby back home and a avoid Pawtential Disaster.

details.title: 小岛之门 Vaulx
details.short_description: Vaulx is a voxel-style 3D puzzle adventure game. Braving the thick mist, you finally set foot on the legendary treasure isle, where a fun and fantastic adventure begins.

details.title: Void Raid
details.short_description: A cooperative space horror about raiding derelict ships: breach compartments, grab the loot, and make it back to your own vessel before the oxygen runs out — or before something lurking in the dark gets to you.

details.title: The Fake Freedom
details.short_description: The Fake Free is a short interactive visual novel game. Enter the inner world of a young scholar suffering from mental illness, and experience a struggle between despair and hope in a grotesque and unique style, and witness the different endings of the story through the power of “choice”.

details.title: 广东爱情故事
details.short_description: 2010 年代深圳，你持二本毕业证成为「广漂」，出租屋旧风扇、城中村烟火、薪水追不上房租的落差，撞开青春与现实的序章。​这场跨十余年的成长里，你从职场新人蜕变为奋斗者，亲历移动互联网普及、电商爆发、P2P 暴雷、房价飞涨、疫情等时代节点。在写字楼与大排档间，每个选择皆有重量：为晋升失约恋人，或守片刻温暖？留一线，或归故土？​三段情感各有滋味，粤语老歌、缴费单、地铁站相拥，都是青春注脚。​作为聚焦普通人的视觉互动游戏，无开挂人生，只有真实挣扎与觉醒。在压力与理想间拉扯，于时代与选择中徘徊，终会明白：归宿从非某座城，而是漂泊中寻得的自己。

details.title: Eclipsed Realms
details.short_description: Journey through fractured realms in a rich, immersive world. Solve intricate puzzles, battle deadly foes, and uncover lost lore. Teleport between parallel realities to alter environments, unlock secrets, and conquer challenges across shifting, surreal landscapes.

details.title: Celestial Lumina
details.short_description: Forge your own path by finding temporary tools or permanent abilities. Celestial Lumina is a 2D Pixel-Art Metroidvania where you ascend from the depths as the heir of a fallen underworld, to awaken radiant abilities & uncover the truth behind a heavenly world full of dystopian secrets.

details.title: A Baby CEO?!
details.short_description: A struggling book company has decided to hire you, a baby, to be the new CEO? All you need to do is manage the budget, keep the company brand strong and make the employees happy. You can't talk? No problem! Give a thumbs up or down and try your best.

details.title: Moonlight Cradle
details.short_description: This is a traditional simulation management and raising game with multiple endings featuring beautiful girls.

details.title: Pill After Pill
details.short_description: You’re a pill-dependent driver with paranoid schizophrenia, forced to escort a skeletal mafia boss across hostile territory. DRIVE, SHOOT, RAM, EXPLODE, DRINK BEER, TAKE PILL AFTER PILL AFTER PILL AFTER PILL AFTER PILL>...

details.title: Still Hope
details.short_description: An investigation becomes a nightmare when Sam searches for missing Jess. Explore a private research facility and confront his story-rich, emotional journey into psychological horror.

details.title: 卡恩特村
details.short_description: As war erupts between the Dominion and the Kingdom Iori, from the borderlands, is drawn into the chaos This is a story-driven traditional turn-based RPG, where players embark on an adventure across a war-torn continent, and witness conflicts that will change the fate of the entire world

details.title: Right As Rain
details.short_description: Right as Rain is a weather themed head-to-head bullet-hell. Control the projectile deluge by means of a boss character, or be the one to dodge the oncoming raindrops, collect pun-ishing powerups and fight for the Right to Reign.

details.title: Astro Company
details.short_description: Build the path. Defend the Core. Combine towers, cards, and artifacts into broken synergies in an endless tower defense roguelike.

details.title: The Bespoke Cards
details.short_description: A deck-builder RPG where you customize the attributes, abilities, and aesthetics of your cards and form unique strategies based on your deck's strengths and weaknesses.

details.title: Survival Menu Live
details.short_description: A chaotic Co-op survival cooking game! Team up with friends to gather ingredients, cook, serve dishes, survive monsters, and upgrade your gear to keep your deadly kitchen alive.

details.title: CactusLamp
details.short_description: Take on the seven deadly sins in CactusLamp, an intense 2D action-platformer centered around unforgiving boss battles. Each sin is embodied as an epic boss inspired by Brazilian culture, requiring precision and fast reflexes to be victorious in this unique pixel art world.

name: Magical Girl Mina ~Battle of the Twin Demons~

details.title: Magical Girl Mina ~Battle of the Twin Demons~
details.short_description: This is a stage-based 3D action game starring the cute magical girl Mina. Use various costumes with different skills to clear stages and defeat the boss at the very end!

details.title: Cell 413 : Mine & Survive
details.short_description: A survival game in the life of a prisoner digging a hole to escape. Explore the procedurally generated underground, outsmart the guards, build your base, craft tools and find a way out of there!

details.title: STACK'EM!
details.short_description: Stack cards together, create unique creatures, experiment with wild combos! Prove your creativity in this highly strategic, turn-based deckbuilder against toys.

details.title: Drone Soccer
details.short_description: Drone Soccer is a 5v5 full-contact aerial sport. Pilot a caged drone as the Striker to score through the goal hoop, or play Defender and smash opponents out of the sky to clear the lane. Compete in online multiplayer or sharpen your flying in solo practice.

details.title: My Little Coffee Shop
details.short_description: Open your own coffee shop, brew coffee and desserts, serve customers, decorate the interior, and grow your business.

details.title: Please, Spin
details.short_description: The wheel of fate roguelike where you spin for your life. Customize your wheel, discover game-breaking relics, survive twisted side events, and outsmart rigged bosses to beat the lunatic host and escape the broadcast!

details.title: Dittomatic
details.short_description: A turn-based photocopier roguelike about copying the copy of a copy. Box up stamps, copy them and press them back onto the page. Copies grow stronger, matches fuse and mismatches misprint. Build a page worth printing, then watch the score cascade past quota.

details.title: Frog Up!
details.short_description: Jump, Rise, and Pose! This 3D action game challenges you to climb steps from a third-person view. Score points with each jump and aim to reach the goal—but don’t fall into the water! You can strike a cool pose to get special items. The cooler the pose, the better the rewards. How high can you go?

details.title: GraviTech
details.short_description: In this 3D puzzle you will need to turn your perception of the world. After all, the actions of the game take place in the laboratory on the study of gravity changes. Forget about the attraction to the ground.

details.title: Death of a Dungslinger
