details.short_description: Abruptly reincarnated as a dung beetle, you’ll battle a colorful cast of the neighborhood’s baddest bugs as you scoot, scuttle, and shoot your way through charming 3D worlds. Ball up whatever material you can find, then sling it at your foes—or hop on and ride it around to outmaneuver them!

details.title: Creature Containment
details.short_description: Creature Containment is a hardcore base-building Action RPG. As a fresh Militia Commander, you've been tasked with infiltrating and wiping out an underground goblin infestation. Manage your base, equip your Operators, and fight hordes of creatures in the depths below...

details.title: Rebels of the Realm
details.short_description: Grab your friends, pick your class, and raid dungeons in this lighthearted co-op fantasy RPG, where chaotic spells and hilariously bad ragdoll deaths keep the realm unpredictable.

details.title: Blood Curse Legions
details.short_description: This is a RTS game where you primarily control cavalry units in battle. Utilize the vampire's abilities to command in battle, develop unique vampire heroes based on the game's evolving situation, and form a powerful Blood Curse Legion to dominate the world and establish a vampire nation.

details.title: Die Meeple
details.short_description: Die Meeple is a roguelite dice deckbuilder where classic board games have risen in revolt. Reclaim forgotten boards, battle their rebellious pieces, and unlock new dice, upgrades, and artifacts.

details.title: The Lightkeeper Is Gone
details.short_description: The Lightkeeper Is Gone is a retro-styled horror adventure set in the 1930's on a lone island. Take on the job of keeping the lighthouse while discovering the story of those that came before.

details.title: Abyss Lord
details.short_description: What awaits the young man in the future? A long and happy life next to loved ones? Losses and suffering leading to an inglorious death? The throne of the enemy of humanity? A harem of all sorts of races, from pretty goblins to graceful vampires? The one and only love until death?

details.title: GU Fighters
details.short_description: GU Fighters is an action roguelike where you unlock and upgrade new abilities after every round of combat. Play with up to 4 players locally or online to create your own unique build and be the first to win, or go solo/co-op to traverse varying environments and defeat hordes of enemies.

details.title: Shadow Dash
details.short_description: Shadow Dash is a retro 2D action platformer with pixel-art characters on oil painting backgrounds and changing game controls.

details.title: Lost Ground
details.short_description: 3x3 grid turn-based battle and the exquisite encounter of the rogue-lite deck building! Place multiple heroes on the 3x3 grid to strategically defeat your enemies. Customize and grow your heroes with various combinations of gears, cards, and relics. Defeat the demons to reclaim lost ground!

details.title: Fishing Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Catch fish, build your store, and sell your catches! Explore a mysterious world to find new areas, and new fish to catch. Decorate to get wealthier customers to buy your big catches. As you build up your store, a town will evolve around you!

details.title: Our Ephemeral Nights
details.short_description: As he enters his final semester of college, Kev continues to wonder if there’s something more to the future he’s carving out for himself. After a chance encounter with Vivi, an aspiring voice actor also in her final semester, he experiences the beautiful and fleeting days before his graduation.

details.title: Cryptage
details.short_description: A real-time action roguelite, you are a wizard venturing into a crypt full of monsters and buying new staffs and skins to improve yourself! The game has endless mode.

details.title: Raiders Rise
details.short_description: Explore hostile planets, face endless hordes of devourers, collect crystals, and upgrade your equipment. Choose the hero that best suits your playstyle, cooperate with your allies to survive… or betray the other team at the perfect moment and claim victory.

details.title: Chinese Strange Stories
details.short_description: Step into a living Chinese painting that blends the mystical, supernatural, and the struggles of daily life in the final years of the Ming dynasty. Experience a unique mix of classic turn-based RPG mechanics and dynamic card battling, where strategy and fate intertwine.

details.title: Wildlife Sports : Untamed
details.short_description: Join your friends in a silly sports Showdown! Choose your totem animal and compete in wacky games. With simple yet entertaining gameplay, enjoy quick matches or all-night sessions of endless fun and laughter. Who will reign supreme?

details.title: The Mystery of Doomsday Valley
details.short_description: Mind-controlled squirrels! Alien abductions! Monsters in the forest! Are the rumors true - or is it just an elaborate hoax? Help Maya Harper unravel this comedy point 'n click mystery and escape Doomsday Valley alive.

details.title: Funny Rummy
details.short_description: A Rummy roguelike set in a surreal, hand-drawn world that blends daydream and reality. Visit the Junk Drawer between rounds to bend the rules with wild cards and sub-suits that unlock new strategies. Experiment with new decks and trinkets to build power against ever-increasing scoring goals.

details.title: 拉克夏家的女仆
details.short_description: 「The Maid of Luxia」is an otome visual novel.Rebirth. Redemption. Rewriting tragedy. Facing the truth of the heart.Experience not only the twisted love of seven masters poured upon you at once, but also a journey of self-growth.

details.title: Bad AI
details.short_description: Rapid advances in AI have sparked a wave of unemployment—and you are one of those left without a job. Your story begins at a black market, where you meet an outdated AI destined for destruction. Left behind by a changing world, humans and AIs find warmth in one another and slowly become a family.

details.title: SPLATTER KING
details.short_description: Smash through horned demons as you plunge ever downward to save the Queen. The deeper you descend, the deadlier the enemies become. Only those strong enough to survive can reclaim their throne.

details.title: Pebble'z
details.short_description: Pebble'z is an online FPS arena shooter set in a medieval fantasy universe. You play as one of Great Wizard Geoffrus' golems. Now freed from his evil reign, you can finally fight your stone-headed brothers and see which golem is the best!

details.title: Ruin Blade
details.short_description: “Ruin Blade” is a top‑down melee‑focused action RPG. You descend into ancient ruins long forgotten by the world. Face waves of relentless creatures and carve your path by steel, instinct, and the will to survive.

details.title: 中国棋牌博物馆
details.short_description: Welcome to Chinese Board & Card Games Museum. Step back into 1980s–90s China and play Dou Di Zhu, Guandan, Sichuan Mahjong, Ka Wu Xing, and more in 3D hometown scenes lit by your own clock. Practice against AI and rewind any move. Buy once, no ads.

details.title: F.A.G.E.N.
details.short_description: F.A.G.E.N. is a 2–4 player co-op comedy-horror game where every sound you make affects your nose. Run a bizarre restaurant by day, collect the F.A.G.E.N. resources demanded by your boss at night, and try to reach the goals they set before you get fired.

details.title: Degrowth
details.short_description: Unbuild various cities in order to convince citizens of the benefits of cloud based living! Perform demolition using our simple one-click interface, but be careful not to delete the homes of citizens who are still employed! Your work is complete when everyone's brain is uploaded to the cloud!

details.title: Trapper
details.short_description: An animal-catching game made both for and against the hardcore collectors.

details.title: 門 GATE
details.short_description: A Japanese psychological horror game set in 1980s Japan. Travel to the past after a nuclear war and prepare for the coming battle against AI machines using cursed powers, strange devices, and experimental technology.

details.title: Two Ants
details.short_description: Two slacker ants, one mysterious ball, and a brutally unforgiving climb. Coordinate your movement, master precise jumps, and drag this thing to the top before your friendship implodes.

details.title: AQUA FALL
details.short_description: Slide, fly, and crash in! Aqua Fall is a chaotic party race where up to 8 players tear down a water slide. Shortcuts off the course are the key to victory. Dive into the pool at the finish and compete for first place! Public matches and bot battles are easy to jump into.

details.title: Cunning Stunt Racer
details.short_description: Inspired by the legendary Stunt Car Racer, Cunning Stunt Racer brings back the raw intensity of high-risk, high-reward racing — rebuilt with retro visuals with a modern twist, modern physics, and competitive gameplay.

details.title: LUBA
details.short_description: LUBA is a walking simulator with platforming elements. Explore a mysterious place and find your way using light and shadow.

details.title: Brave Legends
details.short_description: Collect equipment and skill books to build your own unique build.

details.title: Mindreaders
details.short_description: How well do you actually know your friends? Mindreaders is a social party game about syncing up. One player hints, the rest guess where on the Wheel they meant. Easy to learn, endlessly replayable, perfect for couch nights or Discord calls.

details.title: Typing "New Folder (2)"Solo Dev on Desktop
details.short_description: An idle sim living on your desktop. Play as a cat developer where your typing and clicks are turned into progress. Conquer bugs and deadlines to turn “New Folder (2)” into a Steam hit. Check your scores, read the comments, and aim for that elusive +1 Wishlist!

details.title: Bingo Bingle
details.short_description: Spin your way to fortune by cranking a bingo drum and building powerful combinations of balls and cards.

details.title: Kidnapped Simulator
details.short_description: Kidnapped Simulator is a first-person psychological horror game where you write your own replies to the serial killer holding you captive. Your words shape the encounter as you search for a way out.

details.title: JUNK CONNECT
details.short_description: Falling-block puzzle x Electronic circuit design! New to electronics? No problem. Our real-time navigation visualizes exactly where the current is flowing. Even with zero prior knowledge, you’ll discover the joy of "making it work" through play.

details.title: Frame by Frame
details.short_description: Step directly into the film reel in Frame by Frame, an award-winning 2.5D puzzle-platformer. Restore a damaged documentary about the dawn of Italian cinema by solving environmental puzzles, repairing film splices, and bringing cinematic history back to life, one frame at a time.

details.title: Echo of Memory -AI Profiler-
details.short_description: Echoe of Memory: AI Profiler is a mystery adventure where you reopen cold cases with your AI partner, ECHO. As investigator Makoto Kuroiwa, search crime scene photos, social media, and police DBs, expose contradictions, and uncover the truth behind the official record’s lies!

name: Super Magic Ball ! Home Run Derby

details.title: Super Magic Ball ! Home Run Derby
details.short_description: Read the unpredictable breaking balls and hit a home run!!! You can create your own original breaking balls and compete against others in an online mode!!!

details.title: Midnight Scour
details.short_description: Escape a rural nightmare in this atmospheric first-person horror game. You are hunted by a cunning killer. He lives, sleeps, and actively hunts based on your actions . Use stealth to navigate the house, solve puzzles, and complete one of the exits.

details.title: Izaav:Darkness from Beyond
details.short_description: A 2D platform shooter ,where you fight against monsters and nature itself — everything standing between you and what you hold dear. A young boy, armed with weapons and determination, faces growing darkness. The deeper he goes, the harsher it becomes — but not impossible.

details.title: Feline Fury 3D
details.short_description: Hunt down the mouse invasion as a chunky cat with claws, bombs, and lightning. Feline Fury is a fast roguelite where every run reshapes the woods, the desert, the tundra, and the volcano around you. Build a deck of abilities, chase community milestones, climb the Furmament.

details.title: Formula 2027: Grand Prix Legends
details.short_description: Take the wheel in Formula 2027: Grand Prix Legends, a single-player open-wheel racing game. Master 18 track configurations, compete against AI rivals, and upgrade your car through a 22-event career. Chase faster laps, earn medals, and race your way to the top.

name: 灯台の見守り — Lighthouse's Vigil

details.title: 灯台の見守り — Lighthouse's Vigil
details.short_description: On a dreary night, a lighthouse keeper must sweep their beam to guide lost souls ashore, and burn back the dark creeping from within.

details.title: NowLoading Forever
details.short_description: Can you actually “play” this game!? Before you can play "FINAL TALES QUEST", you must first load the game data.

details.title: Grim Dice
details.short_description: Dark medieval times. Face off in an online PvP Farkle-like duel where dice combos become damage and greed can cost you victory. Choose a hero, collect items, and defeat your opponent. Risk, strategy, and luck decide who survives.

details.title: AIRSKIPPER
details.short_description: Run through stages in this fast-paced action precision platformer. Rack up a combo and maintain it throughout the stage to score big at the end, or create your own stages and share them with others!

details.title: A Sweet Treat for Nona
details.short_description: Your Nona lost all the rolling pins, go find them! Explore levels full of crazy sweets, where each introduces into a new unexpected mechanic. Mix ingredients, discover abilities, and face challenges in this pixel-art puzzle platformer.

details.title: Penance
details.short_description: A top-down action game about a crusader spending his final hours paying for the sins that ravaged everything he cherished. Fight through waves of powerful, high ranking imperial soldiers, with a Flame Meter that drains constantly and never refills.

details.title: SEO or Die
details.short_description: Start with a single website and build a sprawling online empire. Grow traffic, manage clients, expand your team, and survive fifteen years of internet evolution in a life sim and business management RPG where every decision can lead to fortune or failure.

details.title: Celestial Oath
details.short_description: Easy to Learn. Instantly Accessible. Simple Mechanics. Endless Possibilities. Epic Dungeons. Diverse Character Builds. Enter a world of ancient myths, legendary heroes, and timeless traditions. Join players from around the globe and discover the epic legends of the East.

details.title: Hustle On High
details.short_description: A fast paced game where you play as Kaz and you enter human labs and defeat loads of strange creatures and creations, will you make it to the end only time will tell

details.title: ANGLE
details.short_description: A disturbing psychological horror experience that unfolds as only the echo of your footsteps accompanies you through the dark corridors, where you move along the fragile edges of your own perception.

details.title: That's Not My Cat!
details.short_description: Adopt a tiny cat that lives on top of your desktop. It hops across your windows, naps on your taskbar, and earns its hats one cuddle at a time. Name it. Love it. Never close it.

details.title: Hexagon Soup
details.short_description: A keyboard-first traditional roguelike on an isometric hex grid—turn-based, permadeath, and ruthless decision-making. Your class emerges from the skills you pick, not a menu. Manage scarce resources, out-position enemies, claim Hex Runes, then survive the climb back out.

details.title: 100 Anomaly Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: Appetite for Destruction
details.short_description: Co-op in a fully destructible world. Meet the quota faster than your friends - or stop them from doing it. Use physics and tools to survive the escalating chaos, or switch to Sandbox mode with no limits.

details.title: Leach
details.short_description: A top-down pixel-art survival game set in a dead, dark town. Scavenge gear, strike from the shadows, and stay alive — alone or in co-op. What you carry is who you are

details.title: Gods vs Steam
details.short_description: Turn enemies into weapons in a challenging, physics-driven horde-survival roguelite. Shape your build through deep skill trees and overcome brutal bosses on your path to divine power.

details.title: Cozy Against Humanity
details.short_description: Cozy Against Humanity is a roguelike tower defense game where the coziest things imaginable turn against you. Adapt, resist, and survive the soft apocalypse.

details.title: Till & Toast
details.short_description: In this cozy organizing and management simulator, sort 3,600 freshly baked breads and pastries onto the correct shelves, open your bakery for business, earn coins, upgrade convenience abilities, and unlock adorable food-themed assistants and decorations to build your own bakery.

details.title: fibbtry
details.short_description: A Poolcore atmospheric exploration game. Wander freely, drift in thought, until you're ready to wake and carry this rain back into the real world.

details.title: potato_milki's The TRIALISTS
details.short_description: The TRIALISTS is a Time Attack 4-Player Co-op FPS that has an emphasis on fast-paced movement, precise gunplay, and absolutely ZERO hand-holding. Featuring an Art Style that resembles B-Games of the 2010s.

details.title: Unregret
details.short_description: An angry office worker named Butch snaps and sets off on a brutal journey toward his dream of becoming a Hollywood actor. Fight through hordes of enemies in a fast-paced 2D beat ‘em up, using combo-based combat and any weapons you can find - from bare fists to automatic rifles.

details.title: Seasonal Lockdown
details.short_description: An anxiety inducing survival game where you must balance removing anomalies while keeping unstable robotics under control. You are an undercover agent discovering the dark secrets an establishment owner is hiding from the government.

details.title: Star Seed Protocol
details.short_description: Star Seed Protocol is a bullet-heaven horde survival shooter where you aim your own weapons, deploy turrets and drones, reshape your build with implants, research new technology, and fight through alien swarms across varied mission types.

details.title: 回声 E.C.H.O.S
details.short_description: E.C.H.O.S is a narrative-driven first-person sci-fi game. Several centuries after Earth’s civilization was destroyed by an unknown cosmic force, humanity begins to awaken. Journey through virtual and real worlds, uncover the truth of a new age, and decide the future of civilization.

details.title: Kepler Protocol
details.short_description: Kepler-186e. An Imperial colony on a world that wants it gone. Turn-based strategy and hard survival: secure water and Flux power, keep the supply lines alive and hold out against a swarm steered by stimulus and pheromone.

details.title: Smash Them All
details.short_description: A highly dynamic top-down action game where the car serves as both a weapon and the primary tool for survival.

details.title: MUGENDUNGEON
details.short_description: “MUGENDUNGEON” is a top-down roguelike action game where players explore procedurally generated dungeons. Collect keys, reach the goal, clear each floor, upgrade gear in the shop, and dive deeper in this single-player adventure.

details.title: Eleven Legends
details.short_description: Eleven Legends blends football management, character growth, and strategic matches. You are not just a manager on the sidelines, nor just one player on the pitch. Plan each week, build bonds, find mentors, and lead your team to victory.

details.title: Beyond Orbit
details.short_description: A tab-target space MMO inspired by Earth & Beyond. Choose between three classes, Warrior, Explorer or Trader and make your way through the galaxy. Fight, mine, haul and craft with other pilots.

details.title: Jett Rider - Mini Hero
details.short_description: Jett Rider Mini H.E.R.O. is a classic Game Boy-style adventure set in the Jett Rider universe. A small mission. A big heart. A true handheld hero.

details.title: VoidHue
details.short_description: VoidHue is a top-down puzzle game that fuses classic sokoban mechanics with colorful light mechanics. Mix and match colors to phase through gates, activate light-based mechanisms and solve vibrant puzzles to bring back the color to the world.

name: This is not just a farm

details.title: This is not just a farm
details.short_description: This Is Not Just a Farm is an idle farming simulator with horror elements where you can make progress while doing other things on your computer.

details.title: What Remains
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a childhood home. Explore, uncover four days of missing memory, and survive something that has been listening since you arrived.

details.title: Sign It
details.short_description: Monteririo, a city steeped in violence and vice, welcomes a young examining magistrate. An appointment from the Crown has effectively exiled you to this southern outpost, a thousand leagues from home. Tell me—is there truly a way back to the North for you?

details.title: Chihuahua Racing
details.short_description: Arcade combat racing on planet Chihuahua! Twenty dogs race for the championship across 20 tracks with homing missiles, bombs, 20 wild supers and 26 random events. Build your own tracks, then race them alone or split screen with a friend, even tied together by a rope.

details.title: (Debt Feeds Debt
details.short_description: A turn-based bond card strategy game. Buy bonds, fulfill orders, build FEVER combos, and push progress to 100 before decay—and the demonic contract—catch up.

details.title: Factor Zoo
details.short_description: Factor Zoo is a strategy puzzle game blending Sudoku and betting. Pick 5 lucky cells before each round, then solve the board with Sudoku techniques. Revealed numbers form hands—pairs, straights, or five of a kind—to earn multiplier rewards.

details.title: Unregistered Scene
details.short_description: Unregistered Scene is a Minesweeper-style anomaly deduction game. As Agent 03, an insurance company agent, investigate scenes where records no longer match reality. Work with a mysterious assistant to identify anomalies and uncover hidden rules.

details.title: Misplaced
details.short_description: Misplaced is a historical detective puzzle game about sorting case files and uncovering hidden connections. Read letters, witness statements, and official records, figure out where each document belongs, and piece together the truth behind a murder case inspired by real events.

details.title: Chief Bubble Officer
details.short_description: Chief Bubble Officer is a Roll-and-Write strategy game. In every match, aim to score as many points as possible within limited actions. Each turn, draw random number cards and fill distinct charts. Every chart features unique rules, with a wild range of fill requirements and scoring systems.

details.title: SAMURAI BRINGER - RAMPAGE -
details.short_description: SAMURAI BRINGER - RAMPAGE - is a deck-building auto battler where you strategically form your squad by arranging samurai units and combining weapons and abilities to suit your tactics. Build your own unique formation and unite the land under your rule!

details.title: Winter Hunts Us
details.short_description: Lead a prehistoric clan across a brutal hex map in a turn-based survival roguelite. Outrun the glacier, fight hunger, face strange events, and defy extinction.

details.title: ICU - Intensive Care Unit 8
details.short_description: ICU – Intensive Care Unit 8 is a single-player horror game where you’re trapped in a looping hospital corridor and must spot anomalies to find a way out.

details.title: Bounty Gunman
details.short_description: Control the line of fire. Take the shot. A retro pixel-art 1v1 western shooter focused on positioning and mind games.

details.title: Remaining Kingdom
details.short_description: Remaining Kingdom combines deckbuilding, roguelike progression, and real-time tower defense into one dark fantasy experience where each Lord changes the way you fight.

details.title: Psyai
details.short_description: A cyberpunk point-and-click detective adventure. Investigate a neon-soaked city, hack corporate networks, and diagnose broken AI minds. Inspired by Policenauts and Snatcher.

details.title: Unfallen Bastion
details.short_description: Protect your Bastion one card at a time in this roguelike tower defense deckbuilder. Deploy turrets, cast spells, and craft devastating combos to hold back bloodthirsty monsters and remain Unfallen.

details.title: Stray Service
details.short_description: What's cheaper than cheap labor? Cats! Play as Tub and Bub - two very committed felines on the clock to bus tables, wash dishes, and mop up every mess before the restaurant goes under. Solo or with a friend, it's chaotic, it's frantic, and someone's definitely knocking over a stack of plates.

details.title: Last One Breathing
details.short_description: Scavenge ruined locations, manage a grid backpack, barter, craft, and keep your shelter standing through the night in a survival adventure where every item you carry can change the run.

details.title: NIGHTMARE OF THE FOREST
details.short_description: Join Johnny on a desperate search for his missing daughter in a mysterious forest. Confront the shadows and the presence of Marcus in this immersive horror experience.

details.title: Sonnet
details.short_description: Transport a magical flower across scenic lands, encounter strange travelers, and uncover the kingdom’s secrets in this sprawling medieval roadtrip.

details.title: Breakkaboom
details.short_description: Discover a weird fireworks shop. Buy some ridiculous fireworks. Break stuff with them and just enjoy a fun playground! You can also explore mysterious simulation worlds, but when you see hordes of strange creatures, you can hide or run! Or just go wild. Go Kaboom!

details.title: CARGO CRUSH ZERO
details.short_description: Push blocks. Crush enemies. Survive the void. CARGO CRUSH ZERO is a roguelite grid-action game set aboard a derelict space station. Outmaneuver alien creatures by sliding cargo blocks across a zero-gravity field — one wrong move and you're cornered.

details.title: Exile of Arcadia
details.short_description: A high-octane platformer utilizing a teleporting dagger to traverse through a futuristic city!

name: Gensokyo Survivors: Return of the Scarlet Devil

details.title: Gensokyo Survivors: Return of the Scarlet Devil
details.short_description: A high-intensity, Touhou Project survivor-like action game set in Gensokyo, playable in just 5–10 minutes! Break through overwhelming enemy hordes and bullet hell attacks using your own unique builds and pure player skill.

name: Bubble Shooter but In Space and Incremental

details.title: Bubble Shooter but In Space and Incremental
details.short_description: A short, satisfying incremental game about flying through space, popping bubbles, and harvesting Bubble Matter. Build combos, land skillshots for massive multipliers, and spend your loot in a sprawling upgrade shop.

details.title: Take Profit
details.short_description: Step into the role of elite Spec Ops agent Lucy “Talent” Lawson as she dismantles a global crime syndicate to rescue her kidnapped sister. Hunt down The Trust, eliminate its leaders, and seize their profits in this intense, story-driven third-person shooter.

details.title: Spruce Falls
details.short_description: You're locked in a diner! But for a good reason. Someone chopped down the Grand Spruce, and the collateral damage is Big News. Figure out which of the many suspicious characters murdered the town's journalist by essentially bugging everybody.

details.title: Lantern
details.short_description: A mysterious exploration adventure set on a transformed Mars. At the controls of LANTERN, a forgotten rover, explore, drift, jump, and photograph the strange. Every discovery updates its BIOS, revealing new objectives and new leads to follow.

details.title: Dopamine Fuel
details.short_description: Parkour through a procedurally generated city to avoid the rats, sentient trash, robot pigeons, and more! Pick abilities and items to make a build capable of fighting off the swarm! In style of course.

details.title: Black Resonance: Obelisk Siege
details.short_description: A dark 2.5D combat roguelite with arena-defense elements where a rock musician turns sound into a weapon, builds defenses around an ancient obelisk, and holds back waves of monstrous enemies in a gothic world of darkness and metal.

details.title: Desktop Planet
details.short_description: Desktop Planet is a sci-fi building game centered on automated production lines. Start with mining, smelting and manufacturing, plan your logistics and power supply, then assemble a fleet to explore new planets.

details.title: UFO Craft
details.short_description: You are a UFO. Your target: anything that moves and isn't properly secured. Pilot the UFO, sow chaos, and abduct everything! Equipped with a powerful gravity beam, destruction physics, and deep ship upgrades. Abduct cows, cars, and people in this insane cosmic abduction simulator. Earth isn't ready!

details.title: DT.O: Hanes
details.short_description: When a woodcutter is hired to map the ancient forest of Ethrna, a mysterious substance called ■■■■■ shatters his reality. Face a world of forgotten memories and a past that shouldn't exist...? Can Phabius find the truth within his mind?

name: SHIFT: A Game Made to Be Broken

details.title: SHIFT: A Game Made to Be Broken
details.short_description: A puzzle platformer that starts by teaching you the rules—then dares you to break them. Bend mechanics, exploit systems, and discover solutions the game never intended.

details.title: Stack the Spells
details.short_description: Stack the Spells is a fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a step toward your survival. Scale a shifting, procedurally generated path, outsmart grim monstrosities in tactical turn-based combat, and forge a legendary deck to solve the mysteries of a world in ruin.

details.title: Your Mother Disgusts Me
details.short_description: Your Mother Disgusts Me is a yuri horror visual novel about 3 women taking refuge in a shipping container during the apocalypse. A mother, a stranger and a daughter have to hash out their differences, lest they attract the attention of the disgusting Parasites infecting humanity.

details.title: Table of Fates
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder set in a medieval tavern. Build your deck through tactical card play. Create powerful combos, make risky deals, and know when to walk away. Karma remembers every choice!

details.title: DeskFarm: Idle Garden
details.short_description: A desktop-optimized idle farm that stays by your side. Use built-in pin and hide features to grow your pixel garden without interrupting your workflow. Strategically secure rare seeds from the rotating shop and upgrade your way to discover increasingly valuable crop tiers.

details.title: Pocket Paradise Restaurant
details.short_description: Run your restaurant on the paradise island of Isla Sabor ! Dive in the ocean to get food, design and expand your restaurant, buy supplies and cook meals for your clients !

details.title: The Defective One
details.short_description: This is a visual novel set against the backdrop of a high school student band. It is a fierce collision between gender identity, the concept of freedom, and traditional views. You will play as the band's bassist, choose your answers to these issues, and experience the story of this special band.

details.title: PIGGO
details.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party card game where players race to collect four matching cards, bluff their friends, and react at the perfect moment. Play with 2-4 players through fast unpredictable rounds. In PIGGO, it’s never just the cards.

details.title: Crooklock
details.short_description: You're in a stolen ship, your turret is stuck in one position, and you have the entire Galactic Federation breathing down your neck. An 80's styled shmup that has you shooting and running from the law across fifty nail-biting stages. Can you beat the odds... and your high score?

details.title: Exo Helljumper: Descent X
details.short_description: Enter the chaotic world of Exo Helljumper: Descent X, filled with mutated foes and lurking dangers. Combine items and strategy to conquer relentless levels. Face unique foes and formidable bosses, test your cunning and skills, and feel the thrill of battle as you push beyond your limits!

details.title: Sweets'Devil
details.short_description: 《Sweets' Devil》is a Top-View action adventure game that emphasizes one shot kill and roaming. Engage in level battles and boss challenges in a humorous and entertaining fairy tale style , ‌fight against various sweets legions that treat human as the devil in their legend .

details.title: Oakley the Leafbug
details.short_description: Your best friend is going to make a horrible mistake that brings on the end of the world. Race across the Earth in this 2.5D platformer to find her, before it's too late!

details.title: Vibes TCG
details.short_description: A quirky Penguin-filled Trading Card Game.

details.title: Rico's Theater
details.short_description: Rico's Theater is an extremely intense first-person online multiplayer horror game. Choose multiple classes that vary in weapons & abilities & work together with friends in fighting dangerous entities.

details.title: Chill Chess
details.short_description: Relax, strategize, and master chess in a sleek 3D sci-fi world. Play against friends or other players online, or challenge smart AI.

details.title: SHOCK
details.short_description: With only a wheelchair for mobility, Jack, a disabled war veteran, must use stealth, solve puzzles, and crawl into tight spaces to escape a cybernetic creature. Explore a psychological survival horror experience in third person and uncover the truth behind this nightmare.

details.title: Sweep City
details.short_description: Keep your streets clean and discover hidden treasures in this relaxing street sweeper adventure. Drive through procedurally generated neighborhoods, uncover rare finds, and upgrade your sweeper with unique specializations. Cruise to your own tunes while keeping the city spotless.

details.title: Witchbound
details.short_description: Witchbound is a first-person reverse horror game where you play as Callisto Coven, a powerful witch defending her mansion from villagers and priests who seek to destroy the cursed relics binding her to it. Hunt them, terrify them, and become the horror they fear.

name: Hellspawn Trials: how many toddlers can you beat in a fight?

details.title: Hellspawn Trials: how many toddlers can you beat in a fight?
details.short_description: The Hellspawn Trials is an endless top down shooter where you choose from a variety of dynamic weapons and Faustian upgrades with unique side effects so you can become powerful enough to discover the answer to the ultimate question: How many toddlers can you beat in a fight?

details.title: MICROVERSE
details.short_description: MICROVERSE is a sci-fi action/adventure game. It includes weapons such as laser pistols, melee weapons and a 'merchant center' where you use in-game credits to buy new weapons and upgrades.

details.title: CLIMB IT!
details.short_description: Take on the challenge and conquer the mountain! Test your coordination and resilience as you scale sheer cliffs and navigate through mountain caves - where every misstep can come at a high cost. Join this thrilling adventure and prove your skill!

details.title: Bunny Jump Jump
details.short_description: Journey up through the sewers, across lakes and up the tallest tree to catch the fleeting blue butterfly. Hop through challenging platforming challenges as a cute bunny and see beautifully handmade and cozy world!

details.title: ODDLI: A satisfying game
details.short_description: ODDLI is a casual puzzle game about creating satisfying loops. Solve moving puzzles where the only obstacle is your past self. Reach the goal with your character, avoid your previous movements and watch it repeat your path. Continue reaching goals, while creating mesmerizing choreographies!

details.title: Ultakia
details.short_description: Ultakia is a turn-based space 4X strategy game with distinctive resource management. Explore exotic systems and acquire powerful technologies. Exploit your planets, trade with other races and destroy those who stand in your way.

details.title: One Last Sacrifice
details.short_description: Most autobattlers reset after every match. One Last Sacrifice doesn't. Unlock skills across a branching skill tree. Build a deck. Improve creatures by crafting. Compete in 1v1 duels or 8-player elimination tournaments - sync and async play supported.

details.title: Wanderer's Deck
details.short_description: “Wanderer’s Deck is a dark fantasy roguelike deck-building game. Every choice reshapes your fate: build your deck, step through mysterious doors, battle deadly foes, and face powerful bosses lurking in the dungeons.”

details.title: Wheelie Bad
details.short_description: Grab the wheels solo or sync up in co-op. Race a high-speed wheelchair through deadly tracks, dodge brutal hazards, and restart on every hit. Push your reflexes, beat the timer, and claim 3 stars on every stage.

details.title: Hellborn: No Survivors
details.short_description: Hellborn: No Survivors is a cute, unique survivors-like/bullet heaven where you descend into hell and slay hordes of undead, demonic creatures. Balance risk versus reward, master the flames of hell, collect powerful relics and evolve to unlock your potential and take on endless waves of the wicked.

details.title: Neon Dreams
details.short_description: Live the life of an aspiring arms dealer in a Cyberpunk city. Complete thrilling bullet-hell combat simulations with your trusty battle mech, while managing your high-stakes business. Drink coffee, buy weapons, collect stickers, and overcome difficult battle modifiers.

details.title: INNOCENTS - The Lost Echoes
details.short_description: An open-world detective action-adventure. Switch between a fox's investigation and a wolf's combat to solve gruesome cases in a dystopian animal city and uncover a dark conspiracy by venturing deeper into a surreal psychological mind maze.

details.title: They Come in Fives
details.short_description: You are the Reaper on Lucifer's payroll. Hand over souls, keep the bodies. Build an army of empty vessels on Earth, then risk them all in brutal permadeath runs through Hell. Overthrow the Boss. Claim the Throne.

details.title: Shadows Across The Sun
details.short_description: You are one of the last to fight back — a scavenger, a soldier, a changeling — surviving run after run across the wreckage orbiting the dying star. Each attempt takes you closer to the truth buried at its core.

details.title: CONTRAXIS
details.short_description: Contraxis is a fast-paced 2.5D arcade action game where you trace, capture, and command escaped prisoners in the prison city of Axis. Master quick reflexes, summon assists, and survive escalating bosses to chase the highest score.

details.title: Last Watchtower
details.short_description: A short tower defense game where you gather resources and survive waves of monsters. Spend your resources on a variety of upgrades to incrementally grow stronger. Experiment with different builds and discover powerful synergies.

details.title: OVERTYPE
details.short_description: Overtype is a roguelike typing action game set in a neon-drenched post-apocalypse. Type to fight, dodge, and survive against waves of cyborgs and corrupted machines. Every keystroke is your weapon master speed and precision to uncover Zyra’s legacy and type out humanity’s last hope.

details.title: Hadal
details.short_description: Guide a Nereid Freight submarine crew through Nadir’s hostile under-ice oceans. Deliver essential cargo, salvage wrecks, repair failing stations, hunt dangerous lifeforms, and survive in the crushing darkness where every dive carries risk — and nothing stays quiet for long.

details.title: Dissonant Frames
details.short_description: Congratulations, Mark! You’ve been selected as our new gallery night staff. Your duty: patrol the halls and ensure artworks stay in place. Should you notice hallucinations, injuries, strange events, or blackouts—no you didn’t. Welcome aboard. You start Monday.

details.title: Mango & Berry's Sorbet Syndicate
details.short_description: Fruit is outlawed, and Mango and Berry are aspiring fruit lords! Manage a criminal, underground sorbet shop solo or online co-op. Smuggle goods, upgrade your shop, trade fruit or grow your own underground supply. Will Mango & Berry rise to power? Or are they headed for a tragic downfall?

details.title: ListenUp!
details.short_description: ListenUp: detective sim with strategy and meta-progression. You’re a radio station owner ruined by a false accusation. So be it! Rule the airwaves, investigate, and adapt to a shifting world after every death. Drive your station to success and clear your name.

details.title: Combined Arms Brigade
details.short_description: Combined Arms Brigade is a military FPS featuring in-game AI and roles such as riflemen, machine gunners and designated marksmen. Experience infantry squad combat. Grab your rifle and get ready for battle!

details.title: The C0RE
details.short_description: Welcome aboard The C0RE! A fun, fast action dodger in space where you have to deflect bullets and capture as many powerups as you can! The C0RE has POWERUPS, MODES, A SKIN SHOP, LEADERBOARDS, and soooo much more!

details.title: Beast Reality
details.short_description: 3d Smash Bros inspired fighting game where animals in the distant future need to fight for entertainment.

details.title: The Bone Dancer's Bane
details.short_description: A 700,000-word epic fantasy interactive novel.

name: Brave Old World: Tower of Cards

details.title: Brave Old World: Tower of Cards
details.short_description: A text-based RPG adventure. Uncover an epic story of decay and rebirth in a new world, 200 years after humanity's arrival. Guide multiple protagonists through an immersive narrative, diverse gameplay, and a dynamic art style. An unforgettable experience awaits!

details.title: Trivia Fantasy
details.short_description: TRIVIA FANTASY is a trivia-based adventure with RPG progression. Crawl your way through a decayed tower filled with forgotten knowledge and defeat the dying deity that that awaits at the summit!

details.title: Frog Odyssey
details.short_description: A turn-based strategic auto-battler where you buy ingredients, craft special dishes, and feed them to your frog adventurers to unlock powerful bonuses! Embark on a heroic journey to confront those causing chaos across the realm.

details.title: TomaDO!
details.short_description: TomaDO! is a fast, quirky multiplayer platformer where tomato heroes race through floating obstacle courses, dodge hazards, and respawn at checkpoints. Jump, dash, and explore golf and other modes to reach the finish first.

details.title: Demondemon Demon Tamer
details.short_description: Demondemon Demon Tamer combines swarm-survivor and monster raising. Manage, take care, and train your demons during the day. Survive the swarm of attacking demons at night. Raise your reputation among three factions of demon tamers, and unravel their hidden motives in this doomed city, Laknakarta.

details.title: Devoid
details.short_description: Devoid is an immersive journey into the medieval world of vampires who feed on human souls. You will have to put an end to their power with the help of sword and magic. Use an arsenal of tools and magical abilities on your way to defeat the most ancient evil.

details.title: Dungeons and Diners
details.short_description: Dungeon and Diners: A Culinary Adventure Awaits! Dive into dungeons with your friends, hunting for exotic ingredients to bring back to your bustling diner. Choose to team up with up to 4 players or enlist the help of adventurers for both dungeon delving and diner duties.

details.title: Star of Games
details.short_description: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends.

details.title: VTumbler
details.short_description: Dive into the vibrant world of VTubers in an unparalleled free-to-play arcade puzzle fighting spectacle in VTumbler!

details.title: Tide Fall
details.short_description: Explore dangerous islands, build and defend your base, sail the seas, and raid rival crews in this open-world pirate survival game.

details.title: Spinbot
details.short_description: A roguelite drenched in 00's competitive shooter vibes. In Spinbot, you trade your soul for cheats. Wipe out waves of bots and upgrade your "wordprocessor.exe" with some amazing features.

details.title: HAIGLA
details.short_description: Confined to a wheelchair, explore a hospital pulled into a distorted world beneath reality. A slow psychological horror focused on exploration, tension, and the unsettling atmosphere of this place.

details.title: Between Worlds: challenging puzzles
details.short_description: "Between Worlds" is a 2D puzzle game where you reshape the boundary between two intertwined worlds to reach the goal. Turn characters into terrain to create paths, but every change affects both sides of the world. Use logic, shifting gravity, and creative thinking to solve complex puzzles.

details.title: Monsters Awaiting Parcels
details.short_description: Parcels arrive every day — along with those who want to claim them. Find the parcels, make decisions, and don’t make mistakes, because if something goes wrong, the consequences can be… unpleasant.

details.title: Beeline
details.short_description: Slash and dash through tens of thousands of enemies per run in this base building horde-survival roguelite. Call in the hive for support, wield up to five weapons, evolve devastating builds, and combine powerful abilities. Rescue and hatch unique bees, build your Hive, and retake your bee empire.

details.title: The Letter
details.short_description: The Letter is a narrative-driven psychological adventure set in a forgotten town. Explore abandoned streets, follow scattered notes and hidden messages, and uncover fragments of a story inspired by real events as you piece together a mystery buried in the past.

details.title: Paralegal
details.short_description: Jump into the stress of the working world, as [Law firm's name here]'s newest Paralegal with this 2d side-scroller! Do important and fulfilling tasks, such as bringing coffee, sorting decades old files and letting a client scream at you, all while the clock is ticking in the Background.

details.title: 澄心大学
details.short_description: 《澄心大学》是一款校园题材剧情向视觉小说。在鲜活而平静的大学日常中，走近四位拥有不同故事的女主角，并通过选择与分支推动人物关系，走向属于你的青春结局。

details.title: Aliens Go Home ReRun
details.short_description: Brick-breaking and SHMUP elements combine in this 2.5D remake of the 2017 title Aliens Go Home Run, with new stages, characters, and more! Play ball... Again!

details.title: Mass Edge - Gravity Ball
details.short_description: Mass Edge is a vibrant 3D puzzle-platformer that challenges your perception of movement, space, and timing. Built around a unique physics-based rolling mechanic, players must navigate intricate 3D environments by carefully controlling momentum, balance, and spatial awareness.

details.title: Breath of Digital God
details.short_description: Become a digital god in a fast-paced meditative bullet hell. Freeze time, reverse reality, and survive waves of chaotic energy synced to music. Master your abilities and reach the highest level of reality.

details.title: NETRUN
details.short_description: With dual grappling hooks in hand, swing, thrust, and dash your way to victory in this fast, momentum-based precision platformer packed with traps, enemies, and physics-based challenges.

name: DARK・PLANETARIUM~ダーク・プラネタリウム〜

details.title: DARK・PLANETARIUM~ダーク・プラネタリウム〜
details.short_description: 『DARK・PLANETARIUM』PLANETARIUM×HORROR GAME.Girl &deformed head get lost in a dark planetarium an a dying planet and travel through space. 「Don't forget. This planet」It features antique pixel art with a space theme.

details.title: Undead Yet Again
details.short_description: You are patient zero. Punch humans. Spread the undead. Mutate your zombie horde into an unstoppable vessel of apocalypse. And then do it all over again.

details.title: NANOTINKER
details.short_description: Nanotinker is an isometric 3D plateformer. Use your tools and your mind to evolve in an abstract universe that blends known plateformer and puzzle features. Unriddle environmental puzzles, progress and outsmart traps to unravel a mysterious story.

details.title: Sunrise Isles
details.short_description: Drive goods, chop wood, catch fish, cook food, design clothes, or just chill in a spacious island with your friends!

details.title: Ward Zero
details.short_description: Enter a chilling psychological horror solo or with up to 4 co-op investigators. Track a missing persons case through twisting mazes, tense puzzles, and hidden evidence. Uncover dark experiments, confront hostile entities, and fight to survive as routine turns deadly.

details.title: Scuffed Stick Arena
details.short_description: Top down 2D 'stick arena' type shooter. Keyboard keys to move, get a weapon and click to aim and shoot!

details.title: Stonecall
details.short_description: Stonecall is a permadeath action roguelike where every room tests your skill. Dodge, reposition, and time your shots while building powerful synergies to survive the deadly challenges of the Stone Vault.

details.title: God's Game
details.short_description: A young woman is reborn as a princess in a fantasy world. Haunted by memories of her past, she feels out of place and detached, but at least there is peace... until the death game begins once again.

details.title: Pure College Football
details.short_description: Build your college football dynasty and compete for control. Master NIL recruiting, develop your coaching staff, and manage demanding boosters. Play solo or battle in online dynasties with up to 32 real players.

details.title: Wonderking WD
details.short_description: WonderKing WD is a 2D side-scrolling MMORPG featuring a unique Transformation System that lets you transform and use skills in battle. Explore a colorful fantasy world, challenge powerful bosses, and develop your character through exciting adventures.

details.title: Shadow & Steel
details.short_description: Shadow & Steel is a top-down hack-and-slash arena shooter set in a fantasy world. Battle hordes of undead, demons, and living nightmares designed to push your combat skills to the limit. Strike up close with your blade and weave arcane spells from a distance.

details.title: Zebulon 3D
details.short_description: Meet Zebulon once more in a new adventure now in 3D and crispy voxels! Jump, dash, explore, and gather back your siblings in this new exciting game about purpose and family.

details.title: Hey, Focus!
details.short_description: Hey, Focus! is a productivity game featuring light visual novel elements. Xiaoning, a girl who loves gaming and anime, is here to accompany you while you work and study. Complete focus timers to unlock over 200 voiced interactions, personalized outfits, and perhaps... a few hidden secrets?

details.title: Air Hockey: Magical Heroes
details.short_description: A magical roguelite twist on air hockey! Battle forest animals, collect power-ups, and survive a series of intense air hockey matches.

details.title: The Oath of Runeveil
details.short_description: An online-enabled 3D action RPG set in a vast world to explore. Centered on real-time battles and character progression, it can be enjoyed both solo and in cooperative play.

details.title: Dali's Adventure: Lost Worlds
details.short_description: A mysterious vortex pulls you out of reality. Play as Max, trapped between unknown worlds. Explore, observe, and solve puzzles to progress… but something may try to stop you. 🎮 Demo available — add it to your wishlist.

name: Blood Arena Path of Steel: Prologue

details.title: Blood Arena Path of Steel: Prologue
details.short_description: Fight your way through brutal medieval arenas in this free prologue featuring physics-driven melee combat, effective armor systems, and violent consequences.

details.title: Silentia
details.short_description: In Silentia, the monster is blind. It sees only what it hears. Hunt as Krav, a creature that grows stronger with every sound, or survive as one of the many, escaping in total silence. Make a sound, and it finds you.

name: The Man of Iron: Shadows of Haensburg

details.title: The Man of Iron: Shadows of Haensburg
details.short_description: Step into the boots of a guard in the dark megapolis of Haensburg. Master first-person combat and exploration in a striking 2D-in-3D stylized world. Caught between powerful factions, your decisions will shape the city's fate. Will you uphold the law or survive the shadows?

details.title: Quackoban
details.short_description: In Quackoban you will push blocks that fuse into shapes, teleport and move in groups. A new and challenging twist on the Sokoban block-pushing classic, bringing it to new dimensions where you have to think in shapes.

details.title: VeriData Inc.
details.short_description: Solve spreadsheet-based puzzles and handle crazy coworkers in a normal day's work at VeriData Inc.

name: A Game About Launching A Ball

details.title: A Game About Launching A Ball
details.short_description: A challenging game about launching a ball to collect stars. Collect the stars as fast as you can, discover the secrets, upgrade your ball, and unlock the awards. Grab a friend to play online or split screen!

details.title: Shogi: AI’s Forbidden Move
details.short_description: A groundbreaking shogi game created entirely without a game engine. From rule design to thinking algorithms, everything has been conceived and built by AI. Experience a unique worldview and gameplay that sets it apart from any shogi game before.

details.title: Investment Fund Game
details.short_description: Investment Fund Game is a singleplayer sandbox simulation where you become the manager of an investment fund. Buy stocks, bonds, commodities. Test different investment strategies, track your performance, and compete with AI-driven funds using their own approaches.

details.title: Bar Master
details.short_description: Bar Master is a management game where you play as a bar owner and must develop your business. Start by serving beers in a simple bar, hire waiters, unlock new drinks, expand your bar, and buy new bars in the city!

details.title: Endless Harvest
details.short_description: Endless Harvest is relaxing yet strategic incremental farming game where every crop you place changes the efficiency of your growing plot of land. Grow crops, unlock upgrades, and optimize your farm as much as possible!

details.title: HellFactory Inc.
details.short_description: Run a factory in Hell. Automate production lines, hit monthly revenue targets, bribe the board of Seven Deadly Sins, and skim slush funds to seize control — before they terminate you. A roguelike fusion of factory automation and boardroom politics.

details.title: Project ACCIPITER
details.short_description: "We’re elite, undefeated, and ready for anything. But UOOHHH~ zombies?! Nobody trained us for this!" Join Squad ACCIPITER in their story and face the chaos in this isometric zombie apocalypse!

details.title: The Life You Missed
details.short_description: The Life You Missed — you achieved success, but lost yourself along the way. In an old house, you uncover someone else’s life — and your own. Relive memories and face choices in your dreams. Every decision shapes the ending.

details.title: PAWSTRONAUTS
details.short_description: A co-op pixel art platformer about 10 animal astronauts crash-landed on a hostile alien planet. Every character is a life. Stomp, grab, and throw enemies through 6 worlds and epic boss fights. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op.

name: Exit Liquidity: Wall Street Trading Sim

details.title: Exit Liquidity: Wall Street Trading Sim
details.short_description: You have a few dollars and a hunger for more. Navigate decades of economic booms, tech revolutions, and devastating crashes in this deep turn-based simulation. Will you build a legacy through meticulous analysis, or seize power through hostile takeovers and political shadow-play?

details.title: Long Rescue
details.short_description: Long Rescue is a Survival Roguelite where you battle waves of enemies across multiple worlds in pursuit of the villain who stole your dog. Build and customize your character with crazy ability combinations to grow into a powerful force capable of defeating your nemesis. Will you rescue your dog?

details.title: Historarium
details.short_description: Shape continents, civilizations, and see the rise and fall of empires. Follow individual characters as they rise to power. Or as mighty rulers fall to irrelevance. Create nations and see them evolve through the centuries. Or destroy it all and watch civilization react to your actions.

details.title: Papers or Death ⏱️
details.short_description: Screen travelers in a post-war world where lies are common. Check documents, spot inconsistencies, and decide who passes. Take bribes or stay honest—your choices shape the outcome. No action, just tension, tough calls, and hidden truths.

details.title: Feast for Frogs
details.short_description: Leap into this incremental game about frogs with strange abilities. Upgrade your abilities, get more powerful frogs, and eat more bugs!

details.title: Melody Teacher
details.short_description: Melody Teacher is a cozy hidden object & rhythm game. Explore relaxing scenes, collect hidden musicians, and play their melodies to build the soundtrack one layer at a time.

details.title: Debts & Jackpots
details.short_description: Start broke, crack safes, chase jackpots, and build your fortune. Upgrade your operation, hunt for rare treasures, and fight your way out of crushing debt!

name: The Shaman: What's in Your House?

details.title: The Shaman: What's in Your House?
details.short_description: "Something is in your house." As a Shaman, you are the only one who can face the unknown. Investigate haunted homes, uncover secrets, and exorcise malevolent spirits. Your choices determine the client's fate. Experience a chilling K-horror story where every decision matters.

details.title: Dawn's Wake
details.short_description: Awaken as a memory-stripped supreme master in a twisted jianghu. Shatter the world's cursed formations, master strategic wuxia combat where one right technique turns the tide, and reclaim your lost throne — while idle progress and a living martial world carry on even when your sword rests.

details.title: Mini Survival: final adventure
details.short_description: Build a shelter in a world overrun by zombies. Recruit survivors, grow food, craft equipment and venture into dangerous regions for supplies. Fortify your base, defend against zombie waves and bring rescued pets along on your next expedition.

details.title: 天机：大唐重构
details.short_description: Tianji: Reforging Tang is a 2D side-view deckbuilding rogue-like set in an alternate late Tang Dynasty. Play as a modern science student, build Physics and Chemistry decks, break enemy armor, read hidden intents, and reshape the fate of Tang.

details.title: Cook Cook Village ~!
details.short_description: 《Cook Cook Village》 is a deck-building roguelike where you run shops using resource tokens to gain certain amount of fullness. Operate your shops day by day, earn rewards from villagers, and build a deck that leads to big success.

details.title: Caravanserai Simulator
details.short_description: Build, manage, and expand your own trading outpost on the harsh Silk Road. Draw water from the well, care for merchants' camels, trade goods, and upgrade your caravanserai from a dusty camp into a thriving desert empire.

details.title: Memory Farm
details.short_description: Memory Farm is a nostalgic farming mobile game. Return to childhood: farm, raise poultry, gather wood and harvest. Unlock shops as the main house upgrades to cook. Complete tasks for upgrade resources. With various gameplay, renovate the barren courtyard into a thriving one.

details.title: Snackrifice
details.short_description: Satisfy your ravenous appetite by slaying the Old Gods of a ruined, forsaken realm, and use their corpses as ingredients for the ultimate divine sandwich! Master your skills, timing and determination to deflect their unique and challenging attacks in this Boss Rush.

details.title: Index 1391
details.short_description: In this techno-gothic roguelike deckbuilder, journey to the heart of a twisted Sanctum to destroy the VIRUS infecting your faith. Wield sacred cards to defeat corrupted foes, build a powerful deck, and equip rule-altering Doctrines that reshape the rules of combat.

details.title: Tileburg
details.short_description: Tileburg is a game where each tile played has direct effects as well as powerful combos that trigger as soon as the conditions are met. Transform the landscape and develop your city while scoring points. Each turn, the city expands on a random tile!

details.title: ComboCraft Legendary
details.short_description: An Idle incremental clicker focused on crafting symbols, merging combinations, and building automated production. Reset your run to unlock permanent upgrades and grow stronger each cycle.

details.title: Clash of Worlds
details.short_description: Clash of Worlds is a turn-based strategic card game. Similar gameplay mechanics to Yu-Gi-Oh!. Featuring multiple supported formats and a developer who cares about fun. All gameplay is manual, as if playing "in real life". Join the Stoat server for help or questions. Stoat: https://stt.gg/K8jk6Dxd

details.title: Orbital Upgrade
details.short_description: You are Orbital OS 3.0, the new software controlling workbots aboard a space station. Program your bots, solve challenging logistics puzzles and optimise your workflows. Prove your capabilities to a sceptical station technician – no coding experience required.

details.title: Alone After Dark: Head Practitioner
details.short_description: Attend to patients and fill out paperwork as 22-year-old Kimora Jackson on her first shift after graduating nursing school. Draw blood, administer medications, and try not to lose your head in the chilling hallways of Coldrock Medical Center.

details.title: City of Hunger
details.short_description: Survive a deadly parasite outbreak in immersive virtual reality. Fight for your life, uncover the truth behind Dr. Summers' experiments, and escape before it's too late.

details.title: Turbo Ziggurat
details.short_description: You are a tiny creature in a living human city. Talk to NPCs out loud to find clues, track down crystal balls, and steal them before the enemy team does. A chaotic team PvP game.

details.title: 蛊道The Reverend's Path
details.short_description: An innovative roguelite real-time combat game of one-handed, effortless spell programming. Wield arcane Gu, pick it up intuitively, and carve out your supreme Path of Gu across two layers: the Killer Move Board (build your skills) and the Condition Pool (set when they fire).

details.title: Loginnnnnn
details.short_description: Team up with up to 3 friends in online co-op to breach 10 ultra-realistic login screens with Physics-Driven Cursors! To unlock the final mini game, you must use fectly log into 10 fictional online services without a single mistake. Do you ready to get stuck at the login page???

details.title: Coffin Hunter
details.short_description: You owe the Helix a very specific soul. Hunt for coffins, harvest rare souls, and build the ultimate killing machine in this fast-paced roguelite. Survive faction wars, hunt bounty hunters, and find a way to reach the Kingpin in the lawless Marupto Rift.

details.title: Cube Sweeper
details.short_description: Cube Sweeper is a casual relaxing puzzle game. All you have to do is work out which cubes are red and which cubes are empty. Numbers show how many adjacent cubes are red and from that information you can solve all the levels in the game without guessing.

name: Privacy Not Included - A Motel Simulator

details.title: Privacy Not Included - A Motel Simulator
details.short_description: You're a night clerk at a roadside motel in 1997, working off a court sentence. Check guests in, clean up after them, and once you get a hidden camera, decide what to do with whatever it catches on tape.

details.title: Pun Chan Pop
details.short_description: Think fast, match faster! Chain 5 pieces in any direction to win, or use the Square-Merge to turn 2x2 clusters into massive, high-scoring blocks before clearing them. Battle cute animals to a pulsing Bitpop soundtrack in this frantic puzzle showdown!

name: Find Bunny : A Little Hidden Journey

details.title: Find Bunny : A Little Hidden Journey
details.short_description: Find Bunny is a cozy hidden-object game where you peel stickers to find and collect hidden pictures. Join Coco and Matcha on a journey to uncover the secret of the misbehaving crops. Cross the sea, ride the train, fill your album with stickers, and help new friends bring peace back to the farm!

details.title: 夢酔のバーテンダー
details.short_description: A hazy, dreamlike visual novel with a touch of the surreal. Step behind the bar of a mysterious, ethereal space. Craft cocktails, share quiet conversations, and connect with your guests' hearts. Mix drinks as you please, and lose yourself in this gentle, dreamlike world.

details.title: Sea Pets: Match & Merge
details.short_description: Drop adorable sea creatures into the ocean and merge them into bigger ones in this relaxing yet addictive physics puzzle. How long can you keep the ocean under control?

details.title: Bad Tides
details.short_description: BAD TIDES is a chaotic 4 player co-op pirate adventure! Explore the seven seas, dive for treasure, upgrade your trustworthy vessel, and fight creatures of myth.

details.title: Delete The Hypercube
details.short_description: Delete The Hypercube is a chill active incremental which tasks you with destroying an extradimensional cube that feeds on Earth's core.

details.title: AntiMatcher
details.short_description: Merge, pop, burst and... annihilate?! Play with bubbles and antibubbles to discover their strange properties in this abstract puzzle game.

details.title: Amalu, Wells between worlds
details.short_description: Amalu: Wells Between Worlds is a pixel-art 2D platformer, and Metroidvania blending Atmospheric exploration, Spell-casting puzzle mechanics, Amazigh/North African mythology and an emotional storytelling

details.title: Rifles & Runes
details.short_description: A real-time strategy game blending extraction, cards, and fantasy exploration. Lead a modern army through a portal, scout unknown lands, build mines and radar, repel counterattacks, hold your outposts, and extract before the world’s attention overwhelms you.

details.title: Cardcraft
details.short_description: Make the card you wish you had. Choose its cost, stats and skills, build a 30-card deck, and test your combinations against AI or in online PvP. Explore the five-act Endless Workshop and share your cards and decks on Steam Workshop. No card packs required.

details.title: Dust
details.short_description: DUST is an online survival shooter. Gather, build and lock down your base, then raid your enemies with C4, RPGs and a rocket launch site. Talk with proximity voice, fight in x1000 and Battle Royale, survive the infected. Everything you build can be lost.

details.title: 政通人和
details.short_description: "Peace and Prosperity" is a independently developed ink-wash style historical strategy game set in an alternate pre-Qin period of China. Starting from a small village of just a few hundred people, and conquer all sides to gradually build their own vassal state with millions of people.

name: 八長調といにしえの楽譜

details.title: 八長調といにしえの楽譜
details.short_description: Shirabe Hatcho and Ancient Music Score is a puzzle-solving ADV game where you solve the puzzles by ear. Listen to audio, read music, and play an instrument. Use your sense of pitch to solve the mystery and prevent the phantom thief from committing his crimes as a member of the detective agency.

details.title: The Last Shot: Underworld
details.short_description: The Last Shot: Underworld casts players in the role of an aging scientist who, by a sinister twist of fate, finds himself deep in the dungeons of Metropolis. Build, explore and survive!

details.title: Tom Lander: The Exiled King
details.short_description: Pilot wacky aerial vehicles with silly key-based controls through an epic action packed campaign. Struggle to stay airborne while performing deliveries, rescues, firefighting missions, bombing runs, and chaotic dogfights. This game will remind you that flying is hard, but landing is harder.

details.title: HaCo
details.short_description: "Deliver or Destroy? The choice is yours!" High-speed jet action meets heist mechanics in this up to 4-player online co-op. Pilot rusty robots, master the inertia, and dodge missiles to steal packages. Can you meet the quota before time runs out?

details.title: Typeoids
details.short_description: Wield your keyboard and destroy incoming asteroids by typing their words before they crush you. Typeoids is a fast arcade-style typing game inspired by Asteroids to sharpen your typing skill and mental focus with different game modes.

details.title: Blood Arena Path of Steel
details.short_description: Fight your way through brutal medieval arenas with physics-driven melee combat, effective armor systems, and violent consequences. Master swords, maces, and shields as you rise from fighter to champion.

details.title: Supernatural Haven
details.short_description: 1 or 4-player online co-op horror survival game featuring supernatural entity capture and search-fight-retreat gameplay loops.

details.title: Checkpoint '38
details.short_description: You're a German border guard in 1938. Check passports, catch forged papers, and decide who crosses as the rules tighten. Then go home and face your family. Your job is to obey. Your conscience says otherwise. Free demo on Steam.

details.title: Mine Climbers
details.short_description: Mine Climbers is a vertical platformer where you'll be dashing and jumping your way out of a collapsing mineshaft while avoiding the falling rubble. An unlikely mix of falling block puzzle gameplay and traditional platforming.

details.title: Slotlander
details.short_description: A short incremental game about a gambling addict whose trip to rehab goes wrong. After a plane crash, you wake up alone on a tropical island with a broken slot machine on the beach. One wish brings it to life. Spins are free. No penalties. No one telling you to stop.

details.title: KADI: Ottoman Judge
details.short_description: You are a kadı in 1300s Ottoman Empire. Judge cases rooted in real history across ten provinces, from Gemlik to Damascus. Grow wise through knowledge or fall to bribery the balance is yours. Marry, raise a child, and choose between conscience and a never-ending purse. Every ruling shapes your fate.

details.title: The Gauntlet
details.short_description: Fight a diverse cast of characters each harder than the last! A boss rush game where you face many bosses back to back until you beat them all. Will you survive The Gauntlet?

name: Alone After Dark: A Short Drive

details.title: Alone After Dark: A Short Drive
details.short_description: Experience the chilling solitude of a nighttime drive through the woods. You are not the only person—or thing—on the road tonight. Drive carefully and try to stay calm behind the wheel. Can you make it to the sunrise?

details.title: Bullet Time Agent
details.short_description: Bullet Time Agent is a sci-fi action-adventure bullet hell. Slow time and dodge storms of bullets as you punch your way through robot-filled arenas. Leap past laser obstacles with super-powered jumps. Take down increasingly intense bosses as you rewind your own death...again.

details.title: Flywheel
details.short_description: Flywheel is a 2D action game where you dash through the skies using jumps and flight. Each run challenges you with ever-changing terrain. With retro pixel art, nostalgic sound, and simple controls, the game is easy to pick up and enjoy.

details.title: SheepHoundra
details.short_description: A sorting action game where you expose goats disguised as sheep with a blower and use stolen ink to dye sheep for shipment. Create "Rare Sheep" in specified colors within the time limit and aim for maximum profit!

details.title: Crime Empire Idle
details.short_description: Build your criminal dynasty in a deep idle/incremental game. Run crimes, launder dirty cash, upgrade your empire, use the black market, craft weapons & gear to fight criminal opponents while you balance heat and notoriety.

details.title: Pale Cure
details.short_description: A first-person survival horror game where you explore a mutating house, evade a delusional family, and live through the nightmare.

details.title: What the House Remembers
details.short_description: A narrative-driven psychological horror game where a secluded house twists memory into reality. As your sanity deteriorates, uncover a buried truth hidden within its walls before the house reveals what you've tried to forget.

details.title: Kiosk 199X
details.short_description: Run a tiny 90s kiosk in a chaotic Eastern country - Kolkhozland. Serve quirky customers, survive inspections, pick a side in a local power struggle, and uncover a hidden conspiracy - all in a story-driven retro management sim full of humor and choices.

details.title: Gothic Steel
details.short_description: Gothic Steel is a grimdark, retro, survivor-like, wave shooter. Command a heavily armed tank against the horde, assemble your crew, and forge an unstoppable war machine.

details.title: Golem Paradox
details.short_description: Earth is dying and the Central AI needs resources. Build an automated factory, mine distant planets and defend them from the Golems you awaken by digging. Every new weapon breeds a stronger enemy. Can you break the paradox?

details.title: LOVEKO
details.short_description: Aha… so you want to know what real love is, huh? Then maybe… try this RPG.

details.title: The Interpreter
details.short_description: You are The Interpreter. Use voice recognition to interogate suspects and find out if they have been tainted. Explore the dystopian world of B26, controlling technology with your voice. Be the judge, jury and executioner.

name: CHOP CHOP FOR THE OLD GOD

details.title: CHOP CHOP FOR THE OLD GOD
details.short_description: Chop trees, throw logs into a wormhole, unlock upgrades, brew potions, find teleporters, unveil the map, and explore multiple endings.

details.title: Droste Detective
details.short_description: A recursive anomaly and psychological horror where you wake up stuck in an office corridor and find out there is a framed photo of the corridor on the wall. There is something very strange about this picture...

details.title: 水浒女神录
details.short_description: Every word you say will directly touch the hearts of Liangshan heroes through advanced AI technology, awaken their dormant star power, and even change their fate trajectory.

details.title: Moon Reader
details.short_description: Become a Fortune Teller in this Narrative Life-sim set in a Neo-futuristic Moon Colony. Read Tarot Cards and influence people, manage your Time and Money, Pay your Bills, and Make Decisions that would change your life and the lives of the people around you.

details.title: PapyPanic
details.short_description: Dive into the chaos! Play as an object in a wacky Prop Hunt with friends, or try to survive behind the wheel of a brake-less "Grandpa-mobile" with unforgiving physics. The twist? Your Twitch chat controls the action in real time. Will you survive your viewers?

details.title: INORIGAMI HACK DOWN
details.short_description: A point-and-click horror adventure where you battle evil spirits to escape. You take a part-time job at the "House of Saschiumi," a place said to grant happiness through prayer. Instead, you find yourself hacking into the vengeful spirits' data to survive.

details.title: 奉先勇者:我爹是魔王?
details.short_description: In this world of swords and magic, a new chapter in the tale of the Demon King and the Hero is about to unfold...

details.title: HUSH
details.short_description: A co-op horror game where you and your friends break into monsters’ homes and wreck their stuff. Smash everything you can and escape the crime scene before they catch you — they hear every sound.

details.title: Veil of Despair - Episode 1
details.short_description: Veil of Despair is an episodic psychological horror series set in a fractured mirror world born from grief and suffering. Episode 1: Death's Reach is completely free and kicks off a descent into loss, trauma and raw emotional pain through suffocating atmosphere and intense psychological tension.

details.title: Hold & Advance
details.short_description: 2D action sandbox about exploring an underground world, crafting and tactically defending alien stations. Build turrets, combine modules and repel enemy waves to unlock powerful upgrades that radically change your playstyle.

details.title: KILL BREACH
details.short_description: KILL BREACH is a brutal, fast-paced roguelite FPS where relentless horde shooting meets infinite weapon upgrades. Break into a randomly generated facility where no two runs are the same. Turn yourself into a machine of mass destruction, and RIP apart anything that moves.

details.title: Terra: The Voracious
details.short_description: "Terra: The Voracious", also known as "TTV", is a Furry-Vore RPG, using simple turn-based combat to defeat and escape stomachs, pouches, and much more!

details.title: Skatebound
details.short_description: An action-packed 2.5D skateboarding RPG with stats, progression, and skate spots galore

details.title: Tower Of Hope
