details.short_description: 30 years ago, heroes sealed an Evil God within the Tower of Hope. Now the barrier is broken. You are an adventurer seeking glory, but the truth of what really happened waits inside.

details.title: Lost in Art
details.short_description: Explore a surreal, twisted version of real-world art gallery in this atmospheric puzzle adventure inspired by classic survival horror. Use creative thinking and a mysterious power to solve puzzles, evade a sinister threat, and uncover the secret of a cursed artwork; before it traps you for good.

details.title: TAMITOS: Tale of Understanding
details.short_description: A story-driven platformer where you experience the world through autistic and neurotypical perspectives. Explore a magical world, rescue Tamitos frog creatures representing emotions, and solve meaningful puzzles that teach empathy, understanding, and the beauty of seeing the world differently.

details.title: HAE Stack
details.short_description: In the far future year of 2025, society is dominated by a handful of global megacorporations that surveil everyone, everywhere, at all times. They know where you go, who you know, what you like, and sell that information to anyone willing to pay. But you need a job, and one of them is hiring.

details.title: Flow - The Tidal Whispers
details.short_description: A challenging narrative platformer built for the NES, where kindness shapes the journey.

name: SlidefyingBadaBoom Penguin through a Slipstream: Rise of the Penguins 3

details.title: SlidefyingBadaBoom Penguin through a Slipstream: Rise of the Penguins 3
details.short_description: Slide, trick, and throw snowballs in this fast-paced 3D platformer inspired by Ninja Gaiden and Sonic. Play solo or local co‑op as you battle enemies, discover perks, and master icy challenges in Rise of the Penguins 3.

details.title: Dig n Fight
details.short_description: Dig for treasures, build powerful backpack synergies, and defeat all enemies.

details.title: LastRoll
details.short_description: Post-apocalyptic tactical roguelike. Assemble a crew of 4, roll dice to fuel your skills and fight your way to the final boss. One lost battle means starting over. No cards. No mercy. Just dice.

details.title: Infinigama
details.short_description: Explore a universe of diverse worlds. Jump between adventures, trade, craft, and meet other players. Each world offers unique challenges, while a shared economy and evolving environments let your actions ripple across the entire connected universe.

details.title: RelicFairy
details.short_description: Abyss is a roguelike action RPG where players build powerful synergy blocks using equipment and skill items. Combine abilities, create unique builds, and fight your way deeper into a dangerous dungeon filled with unpredictable challenges.

name: 郑成功传 Clash of Armadas: Koxinga

details.title: 郑成功传 Clash of Armadas: Koxinga
details.short_description: Auto Chess +Tower Defense + Naval Battle Choose from the legendary captains of the Age of Sail – Blackbeard, Francis Drake, Horatio Nelson, Zheng Chenggong… and more. Command 10+ ships. Position your fleet. Broadside fire. Enemies come in waves on fixed routes.

details.title: Incredigble
details.short_description: Uncover dinosaur fossils as you mine through rocks, earn money and upgrade your abilities! Fill your museum with your discoveries to reach the goal of becoming world renowned!

details.title: 裸辞修仙传
details.short_description: Fed up with the corporate grind? A portal to another world just appeared by your desk! Hop in! As a mere mortal, step into a strangely familiar realm, follow the legendary "First Cultivator," and explore a vibrant world of immortality in this Roguelite RPG.

details.title: 盲心：伪装的幻想
details.short_description: Blind Heart: Disguised Fantasy is an AVG game——At some point, my ordinary life stopped being ordinary… The doppelgängers I’d only read about in online horror stories had appeared in the real world. Before I could even process this, my lover, Lin Shiyu, knocked on my door.

details.title: Echoes
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in a first-person psychological horror experience where every choice matters. Confront the echoes of a forgotten past and uncover the truth behind your lost identity.

details.title: PSYCORP
details.short_description: Three siblings are given AI-Powered cybernetics by their dying CEO father to permanently bring out the worst in them. How much of your mind are you willing to lose to control your family's company, and the future of surveillance in this narrative driven AI corporate dystopia?

details.title: CTRLR.CLUB
details.short_description: The controller arcade game that hits different. Hack the board, route signals, purge the virus, and trigger cascades while your hands keep levelling up.

details.title: SeverSoul XOOKEEPER
details.short_description: Keep the entities fed, pacified and contained every night within a dark decaying facility. Can you survive each shift in this intense point & click horror?

details.title: Redneck Mayhem
details.short_description: Redneck Mayhem is a hilarious, physics-based slingshot game where small-town grit takes on the modern world. Follow three fed-up local heroes as they lock, load, and launch random junk, and eventually themselves at the professions that drive them crazy. The Mission: Unleash the Mayhem.

details.title: Feed or Flee
details.short_description: A co-op horror game for 1-5 players. You're the pet-sitters hired to keep Wobbles, a glowing and very hungry little creature, fed through the night, every night. Scavenge the woods and the abandoned buildings around the treehouse, and run when something out there notices you.

details.title: Forbidden buttons
details.short_description: Press the forbidden button to rewrite each room. Freeze gravity, make everything bounce, and teleport to objects you throw in a bright first-person puzzle game built around fast, clever aha moments.

details.title: Chip Away
details.short_description: A roulette game with roguelike progression. Bet, unlock upgrades and face a roulette that changes every run with random modifiers. How much can you earn?

details.title: Sector Scavengers: Signal & Salvage
details.short_description: Deck-building roguelike built on top of a basebuilding RPG. Wake into debt. Scavenge derelicts. Play risky cards. Die a lot. Every collapse unlocks new cards and perks. Can you pay off the Company, or will you be booted out the nearest airlock when the next bill comes due?

details.title: Whispers of the Tallgrass
details.short_description: An atmospheric first-person survival horror set in an abandoned industrial wasteland overtaken by tall grass. Listen closely to the mysterious sounds of the night, hide from a relentless predator, scavenge for key items, uncover the secrets of this place, and find a way to escape.

details.title: Gods With Guns
details.short_description: In Valhalla, heroes pull the trigger to defy Ragnarok! Rogue-like shooting game. 8 mythological heroes + 36 guns + 26 types of ammo + 60 Cards.

details.title: DRONECOM
details.short_description: A real-time naval sensor-warfare game where EMCON is everything: every emission that finds the enemy helps the enemy find you. Design your own drones: subs, ships, aircraft, missiles, and launch them from carriers. Physically modelled radar, sonar, IR and ESM in a moddable CIC sandbox.

details.title: Zero Point
details.short_description: Mine ore, draw water from a spring, and harvest greens on an alien world. Craft gear, expand your outpost, and set up defenses for the night. Help three stranded friends find a way home in this single-player sci-fi survival crafting adventure.

details.title: Dark March
details.short_description: Dark March - is a casual, humorous, single-player pixel adventure game set in a fantasy setting. You are a lich! You must rid your lands of corruption, restore order, and bring peace to those in need! Summon helpers, use magic, explore the world, and defeat your enemies!

details.title: Jingle Blocks
details.short_description: Jingle blocks is a Christmas themed incremental in which you have to make enough toys for the whole world ! Collect ressources, craft unique hand made pixel-art toys, rebuild your village and prepare each year for the best Christmas

details.title: Overcommit: Class Inheritance
details.short_description: Manage chaos, people, and impossible expectations in a satirical corporate world. Turn stress into progress, survive absurd workflows, and keep your sanity intact. How much can you handle before everything falls apart?

details.title: Forge In Hand
details.short_description: Forge in Hand is a poker roguelike deckbuilder where you craft your own luck. Change ranks and suits with cheat cards, combine relics and enchantments, and chase powerful hands. Scoring consumes cards from your deck, so every big play comes at a cost. How far can your deck take you?

details.title: Seven Relics
details.short_description: This is a card adventure game where you can choose 4 characters to form a team, select different routes to defeat enemies, and earn gold and experience points. Enemies will attack, and you can level up characters, purchase equipment, upgrade, enhance, and forge your cards to defeat powerful foes.

details.title: Hecatomb
details.short_description: Hecatomb is a mythic deckbuilding roguelike that tests how much you're willing to sacrifice. Every action produces Offerings, which can be relinquished to the Gods in exchange for powerful effects. But which Gods you worship and which you scorn have lasting effects on your journey to the Underworld.

details.title: Chonkstars
details.short_description: Chonkstars is the ultimate multiplayer showdown where food is your weapon and being hefty is your greatest strength! In this arena, you'll be tossing pizzas, slinging fish, throwing eggs, and serving up absolute chaos. Gear up, because the fight to become the heavyweight champion has just begun!

details.title: Arena 2006
details.short_description: A sci-fi shooter inspired by the golden '06 era: a story campaign, arena modes with bots or online play, drivable cars and rocket jumps. No waiting queues, no microtransactions, no 60 GB patches. We're here to frag.

details.title: Memoware
details.short_description: MEMOWARE! A small adventure, exploration and puzzle game where you must record the history of civilizations that vanished without a trace in a mountain with no name. Collect all the MEMORIES and organize them in each book of each civilization in chronological order.

details.title: Sleighers
details.short_description: A festive anthro-themed hero shooter set in the atmospheric and whimsical Arctic Circle. Choose your class, and help your team decorate and dominate in this more festive twist on the Domination game mode, but watch out for Old Man Winter and his periodic blizzards!

details.title: Hello Mayor
details.short_description: You are not merely building a city—you are governing it. Plan districts, balance the budget, investigate local problems, chair government meetings, appoint officials, negotiate with investors, and watch every decision travel from public concern to policy, implementation, and consequence.

details.title: Space Fighter
details.short_description: Experience the unique mix of modern fast-paced multiplayer action with intuitive twin-stick controls and a retro pixelart look. Battle against other pilots in quick PvP sessions of classic versus and space racing - or team up with friends in Co-op to defend against aliens and hunt difficult bosses.

details.title: Hyakki Yagyō: Endless Nights
details.short_description: A roguelike dungeon defense game inspired by Dungeon Maker. Recruit mercenaries, set traps, and fortify against nightly yokai hordes. Romance your allies, unleash cinematic ultimate skills, and survive as long as you can — or fall to the Hyakki Yagyo.

details.title: TAILS GEAR HD
details.short_description: A revamped version of "Tales Gear," originally released in 2007, featuring high-resolution support, new systems, and rearranged background music. A full-fledged 2.5D vertical-scrolling shooter characterized by the Tail Pod, an optional weapon that combines offense and defense.

details.title: Always Summer Out Here
details.short_description: Always Summer Out Here is a visual novel about life in a small post-soviet town with management elements. Atmospheric locations, soulful dialogues, non-linear questlines, and tough decisions that shape the game world await you. Welcome to the Province!

name: Five Nights at Bowl City High School

details.title: Five Nights at Bowl City High School
details.short_description: You've just been hired at Bowl City High School, but its not what it seems... Use your flashlight to light up the office and look for lurking teachers, locate hiding spots to survive, and block off vents to stop them from getting into your office. Most importantly, however, you must stop Mr. Gut...

details.title: The Encroaching
details.short_description: The Encroaching is a digital board game for 1–4 players where you build a map one tile at a time then confront the threats that follow those choices. Hidden roles, secret objectives and a corruption creeping through the city means every placement counts, and not everyone may be who they claim to be.

details.title: Mana Reactor
details.short_description: From stone tools to modern weapons and giant mechs — survive, craft, and conquer another world.

details.title: Under Review
details.short_description: Welcome to the heart of a 1980s bureaucracy. Review applicant files, cross-check records, and make heavy moral decisions. Amidst strange rumors of an unidentified illness, will you uncover the dark truth or become an accomplice to the system?

details.title: The Havoc Channel
details.short_description: A mystery comedy visual novel game told strictly through the eyes of a news anchor. Learn about the city of Brookside, report the news as best you can, and guide the citizens toward a happy ending.

details.title: Pokorama
details.short_description: Run a boutique decorating studio where every client has unique tastes, quirks and expectations. Experiment with paints, fabrics and textures to create interiors your clients will love (or not), build your reputation, and unlock beautiful materials and interiors as your studio grows.

details.title: Junkyard Stories: Rebirth
details.short_description: A dystopian sci-fi adventure where you're a broken robot carrying the consciousness of a legendary hacker. Cross landscapes shaped by war, scavenge supplies, hack systems and solve puzzles as your battery drains. Infiltrate Block-07 to find the person who can save your mind before it’s lost forever.

details.title: Islandustry
details.short_description: Find the best island, outbid your rivals and start exploiting it. Automate your production and watch the market to sell your goods at the right price. Use your profits to buy upgrades and make your production chain even faster.

name: Rashin Detective Chronicles CASE01 : The Final Page

details.title: Rashin Detective Chronicles CASE01 : The Final Page
details.short_description: A strange request arrives at the detective agency, concerning a missing homeowner. Explore a silent mansion and unravel the intricate puzzles hidden throughout its rooms. Why did the homeowner vanish? A mystery adventure where you pursue the truth.

details.title: BIT-HOLE: Neon Incremental
details.short_description: BIT HOLE: NEON Incremental is a compact, straightforward incremental experience. Eliminate viruses, collect data fragments, and unlock massive power spikes by decrypting legendary malware like the "I Love You" worm. A focused cyber-power trip designed for a short, satisfying session.

details.title: Baby Carbonara
details.short_description: THE BABY IS HUNGRY! Cook rats! Chop mushrooms! Handle raw uranium fuel rods??? Smoke cigarettes! FEED YOUR GLORIOUS BABY LEADER TODAY. Total VR Carbonara immersion. Absolute kino.

details.title: Stacko
details.short_description: In Stacko, remember your childhood while earning awesome prizes that change the way you play. Your goal is simple: stack the blocks as high as you can! Earn cards to modify the machine and plushies with powerful bonuses, all while playing this unique twist on the classic arcade experience.

details.title: JetBound
details.short_description: JetBound is a difficult game about flying. Stranded in space with a jetpack, upgrade your abilities and navigate deadly unique zones that constantly introduce new mechanics. No jumping. Pure physics-based flight with branching paths and high replayability.

details.title: Trouble in Potion High
details.short_description: Something went terribly wrong at Potion High. The school fell into the "Non-Dimension" and was placed under quarantine. If you don't break this lockdown, you'll be stuck here forever. Your wits are your weapon. Solve twisted environmental puzzles and get out of this place.

details.title: Nifland
details.short_description: Nifland is a surreal multiplayer horror game with social deduction, set inside a paranormal dream beneath the ocean. Maintain a decaying deep-sea station, survive the entities roaming its halls, and uncover the traitor hiding among your crew before the dream consumes you all.

details.title: 危ノコ
details.short_description: Control a mushroom and climb toward the summit while avoiding dangerous “Abunoko.” Overcome various obstacles and carefully make your way upward. A single mistake can send you falling far back down. The higher you climb, the more dangers await, testing both your skill and patience.

details.title: Kircles
details.short_description: Kircles is a designer-driven tower defense game where players can combine 18 different turrets to create unique mechanics and prevent “bugs” from reaching the exit. 60+ levels in three campaigns. Every level can be solved with different approaches optimizing resource spending.

name: There's Something Wrong with the Hero's Choices

details.title: There's Something Wrong with the Hero's Choices
details.short_description: 「その選択肢、正気か？」シンプルなノベルゲームのはずなのに、とにかく“選択肢”がおかしい！？ 予想を超える展開が待ち受ける、奇想天外なテキストアドベンチャーゲーム！

details.title: ACT LIKE TOYS! (A.L.T.)
details.short_description: Rescue abandoned toys and find your way back to your owner in this thrilling co-op action adventure! Evade those who seek to break or discard you by using the ultimate survival tactic: stop moving and 'Act Like Toys!' to blend in.

details.title: ガッチャ！サバイバー
details.short_description: A roguelike action game where you absorb bullets to fight. Switch between Light and Dark, turn bullets into energy, and unleash powerful bursts! Build your skills and survive the overwhelming bullet storm.

details.title: Racetrack Tycoon
details.short_description: Build race tracks, expand your venue, attract racing series. Host everything from amateur club meets to world championship events in a true 1:1 scale simulation. Racetrack Tycoon challenges you to manage your budget, meet demanding series requirements, and entertain tens of thousands of fans.

details.title: Fieldwork
details.short_description: Your editor sent you to explore an abandoned ship graveyard. Photograph the evidence, stay quiet and get out alive.

details.title: Broken Masks
details.short_description: Enter an abandoned orphanage, solve unsettling puzzles, and uncover its terrible secrets. Living toys, dark presences, and haunted corridors will push your sanity to the limit. Can you survive the horror lurking within?

details.title: Singulost
details.short_description: Singulost is an exploratory interplanetary adventure. Explore forgotten worlds, pilot a spaceship, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery of the most ancient civilization that was here before you.

details.title: ShardSpace
details.short_description: Shard Space is a minimalist strategy game. In the distant future, you awaken from a long slumber. Guided by a loyal lieutenant, you must rebuild your drone fleet and embark on a journey to uncover the ultimate truth of the universe.

name: 献祭浮木！我无限复活！（魔王传说）

details.title: 献祭浮木！我无限复活！（魔王传说）
details.short_description: A unique fusion of Roguelike, Deckbuilding, and Tower Defense! Play as the Reborn Demon King, deploy Chibi-style units, and use strategic Talent Cards to conquer the continent. Featuring the innovative "Story Card" system for uninterrupted combat.

details.title: ASHEN SEA
details.short_description: Ashen Sea is a first-person narrative experience for AXISRAY. Play as BASH, a party robot repairing arcades and tuning jukeboxes via terminal on a derelict spaceship. No combat, no time limits—explore freely. When a shuttle is the only way down, the party’s meaning blurs.

details.title: Final Assembly
details.short_description: Run a chaotic factory with up to 8 players. Earn enough cash before time runs out—while a hidden saboteur quietly breaks everything from within. No voting. A rotating Leader decides who lives or dies.

details.title: Road From Horno
details.short_description: Road From Horno is a tactical narrative shooter where precision, stealth, and tactical decision-making are essential to survive as you fight to protect the people you once hunted.

details.title: Barely Correct
details.short_description: Barely Correct blends arithmetic duels with romance. Numbers aren't just brain teasers—they're weapons for control. Win 1v1 calculation battles to strip away your opponent’s defenses layer by layer. Reach the tipping point to reveal the truth hidden beneath their surface.

details.title: Hunter: Into the Abyss
details.short_description: Fight through ever-changing dungeons in this fast-paced action rogue-like, mastering brutal combat, powerful upgrades, and epic boss battles. Hunt the Elders of the Abyss and stop them from rising

details.title: DOSMIC
details.short_description: In a world teeming with colossal beings, a boy named Nero sets out to find the missing girl Snoa. Use a range of movement abilities, solve mysterious puzzles and sometimes fight otherworldly horrors in DOSMIC, a cinematic puzzle platformer.

details.title: Social Hook
details.short_description: Catch powerful monster cards with your fishing rod and battle against other players in exciting duels.

details.title: Chemical-Burn
details.short_description: Chemical-Burn is a first person shooter action-adventure set in Hazard City—one of the last few cities on Earth, where the remaining human populations have been placed. Engage in thrilling first person combat as Cindy using a variety of weapons & your dog Buddy. Plan. Execute. Survive. Repeat.

details.title: Pack and Ship: Warehouse Simulator
details.short_description: Build your logistics empire from the ground up. Choose the most profitable contracts, optimize your warehouse layout for maximum efficiency, and upgrade your equipment. Balance risk and reward as you adapt your strategy to a shifting market. Every lift, every pallet, and every decision counts.

name: The Last Wizard - A Goblin Detective Mystery

details.title: The Last Wizard - A Goblin Detective Mystery
details.short_description: Investigate a murder as the first goblin detective in a comedic fantasy world without magic...where a wizard is the prime suspect!

details.title: Gustav Mlha: Záhada Krkonoš
details.short_description: The Giant Mountains hide a mystery! Krakonoš's elite squadron has vanished, and private detective Gustav Mlha is on the case. Explore more than 30 locations in a pixel-art point-and-click adventure packed with oddball locals, quirky puzzles, Czech voice acting, and offbeat humor.

details.title: Agaric
details.short_description: Agaric is a 2D Action-RPG game, about a sole mushroom set on an quest to resolve an imminent problem, only to find themselves in the midst of more conflict

details.title: Merchanteer
details.short_description: Set sail in the Southern Isles where every action shapes the world. Trade cargo, build ships, fight pirates, liberate ports and explore hand-crafted islands - alone or together with friends.

details.title: Power Of The Sun
details.short_description: Empower the sun and drive forward the engine of creation of the universe. Collect cosmic resources, generate energy, and evolve through a galaxy of upgrades. Burn brighter and radiate light into the universe!

details.title: Function SUE
details.short_description: Welcome to the world of “maSUEmatics”! Draw equations, shape the world, and roll Sue to the goal in this free-form physics puzzle.

name: A Game About a King Saving a Dragon

details.title: A Game About a King Saving a Dragon
details.short_description: Help a mighty dragon restore its power in this relaxing incremental game. Gather resources, summon workers, construct buildings, and unlock powerful upgrades as you progress.

details.title: KuLaLa Catcher
details.short_description: Multiplayer "claw machine" party game! Use that unreliable claw to battle in various game modes. It's party time! Party like KuLaLa~! Catch 'em like KuLaLa~!!

name: College Crisis: The Tuition Survival Game

details.title: College Crisis: The Tuition Survival Game
details.short_description: College Crisis is a darkly comedic, turn based survival sim about surviving college inside a broken system. Progress week by week managing money, energy, sanity, dormmates, and scholarships that vanish without warning as subtle cosmic anomalies creep into campus life.

name: 我喜欢的白毛美少女不可能是凶手

details.title: 我喜欢的白毛美少女不可能是凶手
details.short_description: “为什么我什么都做不到!这样的现实，由我亲手撕烂!这一次我不会再让任何人伤害你!” —— 本游戏为单女主剧情作 属于悬疑恋爱类文字冒险游戏，主角将通过一个个选项来了解一场凶杀案背后的真相，其中有很多线索和不一样的结局来提供游戏趣味性。 『没有人能拒绝白毛异瞳的杀伤力!』 这是如梦幻般的故事。 无法忘怀，也不能忘怀的爱与回忆!!!

details.title: Cozy Pixel Painter
details.short_description: A cozy pixel painting game where you relax, color cute pixel art, and unwind at your own pace

details.title: The Last Lighthouse
details.short_description: Tend a Magical Lighthouse at the edge of the cosmos. Gather and refine resources, maintain and upgrade the Lighthouse Engine, and aid incoming ships while an unsettling fog closes in.

details.title: 绯想觅剑录 TenshiSwordQuest
details.short_description: This is a 2D horizontal board platform puzzle game about finding one's own Sword Of Scarlet Perception by the Hinanawi Tenshi. She use her ability to manipulate stones to overcome numerous obstacles and find the unclaimed Sword Of Scarlet Perception.

details.title: 耶耶耶一周
details.short_description: A dog-raising simulation game where you can make dog food, play with dogs, go out and meet friendly dogs, experiencing the joys and troubles of lively puppies.

details.title: Trapped on the FlipSide
details.short_description: In this Puzzle Platformer, follow the narrative of three explorers, kidnapped by a mechanical megastructure. Play as their assistant spherical robot in an effort to save them from this brutal place. By powering up the system, area by area, the secretive past and dark truth may make itself known.

details.title: No More Pesticide
details.short_description: No More Pesticide is an active incremental game about a cute frog exterminating swarms of mutant bugs and taking down an evil pesticide manufacturer.

details.title: Whispers of Appalachia
details.short_description: An atmospheric horror walking simulator inspired by Appalachian folklore. Explore a hostile forest, survive multiple nights, and avoid the creatures that roam within. No puzzles. No combat. Just you, the forest, and what hunts inside it.

details.title: As Duty Demands
details.short_description: A first-person narrative psychological horror game focused on exploration and environmental storytelling, set in a decaying naval retirement home ruled by a tyrannical former admiral, where you play as Coral, a newly hired nurse who must navigate shifting environments and uncover hidden truths.

details.title: The Cold Cases: Remembering Jory
details.short_description: The Cold Cases: Remembering Jory is a story rich, investigative mystery game where your only tools are your contacts and the people you can find and get to talk to you. Read through old internet archives, pick out what is important, and solve the mystery of the 10 year old cold case.

details.title: 凉面爱情故事
details.short_description: This is a light-hearted and enjoyable short visual novel.You will guide the male protagonist to different endings through various choices. Xu Bu, who was originally a graduate student in history, became a teacher after giving up his studies. Then,the new stroy will begin.

details.title: Apu's frenlyquest
details.short_description: Play as Apu on his quest to save his friends from monsters! Apu's frenlyquest is a top down shooter RPG, with section based progression, dungeons filled with strange enemies and bosses, and the chance to explore and discover! Help Apu on his quest to save his world from a hidden meddling evil!

details.title: Taking Today Off
details.short_description: Taking Today Off is a light-hearted roguelike deck-builder about managing modern life states. Draw cards, place them on the board, add stickers and tools, and build playful combos. Easy to learn, with fresh choices and strategies every run.

details.title: Cozywood Creek
details.short_description: A gentle idle game with a living stream flowing quietly at the bottom of your screen. Terraform the land and watch as animals arrive to make Cozywood their home. Cultivate the surrounding area and bring this cozy ecosystem to life.

details.title: Break Protocol
details.short_description: The protocol has called… and it’s time to destroy everything! BREAK PROTOCOL reinvents the brick-breaker roguelike: build powerful combos, exploit card synergies, and face unique enemies and bosses across increasingly dangerous sectors.

details.title: A Game of Masks
details.short_description: A 2D point and click adventure where you get to interact with everyone from the street food vendor to the mob boss (and everyone in between) to carry out your assignment for your pompous but powerful politician.

details.title: SGS Vietnam War
details.short_description: The Vietnam War remains one of the most emblematic conflicts of the Cold War era. Relive, on each side, the epic fight for dominance in this key Southeast Asia conflict from US intervention in 1965 till the Fall of Saigon in 1975.

details.title: Magic Cards Duel
details.short_description: A wild party card game for 2-4 players. Jumpscare, stun, and blur your friends, but watch out: they can counter, reflect, or even steal your attacks. Chain epic combos and outplay everyone!

details.title: Unburden
details.short_description: UNBURDEN is a casual, adventure game in which you guide Mark on a journey to shed his heavy burden of precious possessions while helping others he meets along the way. All in an effort to restore the vibrancy and lightness life once held.

details.title: Send In The Vampires
details.short_description: Maniacs have taken over the asylum. Restore order with your fists in the ultimate gothic arcade beat em up. Supports up to 4 players in couch coop/remote play.

details.title: 往事：戒网瘾治抑郁
details.short_description: 《往事：戒网瘾治抑郁》是一款沉浸式叙事驱动型文字冒险游戏。玩家将扮演一名被强制送入“戒网瘾学校”的青少年，在一个以“治疗”为名的压抑系统中被洗脑的故事。

details.title: Pocket Chef: Asia
details.short_description: Pocket Chef: Asia is a cozy, hand-drawn ramen shop game. Start at a little Japanese street cart, make every bowl with your own hands, crack riddle orders, count out the change and keep your quirky customers happy. In the full game, the journey continues across Asia.

details.title: Eclipstation
details.short_description: Explore the station rooms, gather resources, hide from dangerous creatures, and combine the items you find. Crafting can help you survive… or create a new threat.

details.title: The Wicked Isles
details.short_description: An exploration puzzle rogue-like of Risk and Deduction. Combine powers of artifacts, unlock new characters and find your way out of the cursed archipelago. Flip many a hex on the way.

details.title: Serenade of the Soul
details.short_description: 7 days granted at life's end. "The night air is pleasant, isn't it?" A story as calm as the evening breeze, shared with a fairy found in despair. A classic romance brought to life through full Korean voice acting and lyrical New Age music.

details.title: 奥卡米亚的骑士
details.short_description: A fantasy RPG themed around chemistry and alchemy. You trigger effective attacks by choosing the correct answers to chemistry questions .Explore mazes, collect materials, and craft quest items using chemical equations. Upgrade your skills, and finally complete the protagonist’s legendary story.

details.title: Redast
details.short_description: Secure the area, detect the anomalies, solve the ritual, and reach the extraction point at all costs. A multiplayer operation combining tactical FPS dynamics with supernatural hunting.

details.title: Static Shift
details.short_description: A Lovecraftian, psychological co-op horror where the powers from above are tormenting you and your co-workers, warping reality with anomalies and using any means necessary to stop you from leaving or finding out the truth: Can you do it? (co-op not included in demo version)

details.title: Recycle Quest
details.short_description: Recycle Quest is a Sokoban puzzle game where you control Jake to help cleaning the city

details.title: Crabgrass
details.short_description: Crabgrass is a cozy narrative management game where players get the satisfying experience of yard maintenance with none of the real world consequences like sore muscles or a lawn that simply just won’t grow no matter what you do.

details.title: RoboCatPush
details.short_description: 《RoboCatPush》is a lighthearted puzzle game. Play as a cute cat robot and solve puzzles in beautiful levels. In this 3D box world, vertical stacking is key. Step by step, solve carefully crafted puzzles and push special boxes to the finish.

details.title: Fractaloid Attacks!
details.short_description: Aim better. Destroy smarter. Explore and use Technologies. Pinball × breakout × platformer = ricochets, combos, fun! Fractaloids have taken over the system — crystalline trees grown from living code. Knowledge comes through destruction.

details.title: Click Click Universe
details.short_description: Click Click Universe is a relaxing and delightful top-down 3D clicker game. Players are free to explore an open world made up of polyhedral shapes, where they can collect items, trigger interactions, and observe how everything changes with each click.

details.title: Allegedly Innocent: Justice for Sale
details.short_description: 팀 관포지교가 선보이는 가장 유쾌한 피카레스크! 진실보다는 현실을 좇는 변호사가 되어 반성의 여지 없는 의뢰인을 변호하는 게임입니다. 사건의 단서를 모아 '입맛대로' 진상을 재구성하고, 누가 봐도 죄가 깊은 의뢰인을 무죄로 만들어줍시다.

details.title: Chain Reaction: Breakshot
details.short_description: Chain Reaction: Breakshot combines the precise aiming of classic billiards with the strategic deckbuilding of roguelikes. Within a retro CRT visual style, combining various mechanics turns every shot into a feast of strategy and fun.

details.title: Vesper Hollow
details.short_description: A veteran salvager. A dead mining station. A routine job that was anything but. Explore Vesper Hollow — a sci-fi horror roguelite where oxygen is always draining and the station's secrets run deeper than you think.

details.title: Companions' Chronicles
details.short_description: This AI sandbox RPG features diverse world themes for instant immersive adventures. Customize world rules, character sheets and stories; share or import player-created themes. The full version adds dynamic backgrounds, emotion avatars and personal AI chat API support.

details.title: Bato Battle
details.short_description: Bato Battle is a chaotic submarine party combat game for 2-8 players. Pilot a whale, ram a shark, dive like a dolphin, and torpedo your friends across a pile of ridiculous gamemodes and maps!

details.title: Seikyu Let’s Go!
details.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op campervan trip through the yokai-filled wilderness. Snap photos of elusive creatures, decorate your van together, and help the locals you meet along the way. Camp, cook, and clamber across diverse biomes, from misty swamps to snowy mountains. Adventure awaits, so Let’s Go!

details.title: Wiener Rumble
details.short_description: A fast first-person arena brawler! Try to get other players out of the arena with a weapon that shoots different items. Enjoy multiple game modes and maps, and customize your character. Prove your skills in the ultimate chaos and be the last one standing!

details.title: Knights vs. Dinosaurs
details.short_description: An isometric co-op action romp: charge in as a knight — or a kangaroo — against hordes of hungry dinosaurs. Explore a farm overworld and procedural dungeons, smash barrels for chocolate coins, gear up in the shop, and topple bosses in online co-op. Fast, chaotic, gleefully absurd.

details.title: Incremental Magic
details.short_description: A 2D action clicker where you click, drag, and scroll to hunt monsters yourself with your mouse. Aim your skills to break the bosses of 8 dungeons, and grow your skill tree into a build of your own. Not idle — aim, shoot, smash.

details.title: Whisker Cat Shelter
details.short_description: Welcome to Whisker Village! Run a cozy cat shelter, welcome cats brought in by villagers, care for new arrivals, and help them find loving forever homes, solo or with a friend.

details.title: Cindocu: The Omens
details.short_description: Follow in the footsteps of Persia Kelborn - heir to the oldest dynasty on the continent of Ferrum. Uncover the dark secrets hidden within his family for centuries, and witness events that began long before he was born...

details.title: Bumper Buddies
details.short_description: Join your friends online for the hilarious, addictive party racer where you race, shove, and betray your buddies. Team up 1v1 to 3v3 across physics-fueled minigames. Paint your car however you like.

details.title: Priest Amore
details.short_description: Priest Amore is a cartoon-style, casual puzzle game. Players will take on the role of Amor, a priest working in the fictional institution "Palace of Love," experiencing her day in the life while encountering a mundane yet meaningful adventure about love and understanding.

details.title: Triox
details.short_description: A short indie horror blending Sokoban puzzles with tense resource management. Deep inside a hostile mining facility, you remotely pilot a pushing machine. The world's oxygen is depleting, but a volatile new form of cyclic ozone has been discovered. Excavate it. It's humanity's only hope.

details.title: New Trivia Unlocked!
details.short_description: A knowledge Q&A party game with Steam Workshop support! Featuring hundreds of quirky, mind-bending, and bizarre questions—from everyday facts to counterintuitive trivia and pure luck challenges. Play online with your friends to find out who the true "know-it-all" is!

details.title: Until somewhere
details.short_description: WARNING! This game is harder than it looks – you’ll need to be a real go-getter. The aim is to build your shuttle and upgrade it so you can venture into the unknown depths of interstellar space. With only Lina, your faithful companion, by your side, will you have enough patience?

details.title: Empirestead
details.short_description: Make a home at Grey Croft in a medieval pixel-art farming sim. Grow crops through four seasons, raise animals, and get to know the neighbors at Ashford's Sunday market. Fish, cook, and build up your farm solo or with a friend in two-player local co-op.

details.title: Voidlights
details.short_description: Voidlights is a Neon-lit 2D top-down roguelight shooter. Auto-fire through escalating void swarms, stack modules and systems, survive storms and bosses. Play solo with save/continue, or dive into Steam co-op with up to 6 players.

details.title: SoulPurge
details.short_description: SoulPurge is a psychological horror mystery. Explore an old abandoned mansion. Find clues to solve the mystery. Discover how and why its former inhabitants lost their lives. Evade the horrors that wander the mansion halls. Free their tortured souls in an attempt to redeem yours.

details.title: Crashborn
details.short_description: Lost and with no memories, cross a solar system to get back home. Tear through each planet's hordes to recharge your ship's energy and take off before the world turns lethal. Combine weapons, implants and anomalies until nothing can stop you. Every death rewrites your reality and your memory.

details.title: Still Pines: watchtower
details.short_description: Still Pines: Watchtower is a first-person psychological horror mystery where you play as Claire, a college student trapped at an isolated winter watchtower. Explore a semi-open snowy forest, uncover clues about a missing ranger, survive the thing watching from the trees, and follow story objectives.

details.title: Backrooms With Friends!
details.short_description: A 1-5 player co-op horror game where you and your friends noclip into an endless maze also known as the Backrooms. Explore procedurally generated levels and avoid the Entities that stalk the halls. Get separated and you might not make it back. Get caught and you won't make it out at all...

details.title: Deck of Empires
details.short_description: A multiplayer RTS game where you are dealt cards every 60 seconds, and you use strategy to place cards, and command your units to create and grow a powerful empire to defeat your foes!

details.title: DUAT
details.short_description: DUAT is a first-person survival horror game blending exploration, puzzles and psychological horror inside ancient Egyptian pyramids. Explore forgotten tombs, solve deadly mechanisms, uncover ancient secrets, evade relentless horrors, and survive the darkness.

details.title: Whale Simulator
details.short_description: A livestream management sim. Lead your streamers all the way up — numbers climbing — until they stand on the national-champion stage. You're more than the operator behind the curtain. When the mood hits, you can jump in yourself, throw gifts, and fight the whole room for that number-one spot.

details.title: The Backrooms : Threshold
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op investigation horror game where you enter the Backrooms through an experimental gateway. Explore procedurally generated environments, document anomalies, recover valuable artifacts, and survive the unknown.

details.title: CASHKET
details.short_description: Make a fortune off the dead. Open stolen coffins for an evil company, sell the loot, and gamble your finds for bigger rewards. Automate the dirty work, unlock the coffins of giants and titans, and crack open rocks to uncover ancient fossils.

name: Little Witch’s Lodge A Cozy Magical Cleanup Game

details.title: Little Witch’s Lodge A Cozy Magical Cleanup Game
details.short_description: A young witch has accidentally cast the wrong spell and turned her cozy lodge into complete chaos. Books, potions, bottles, and magical objects are scattered everywhere. Your task is simple: explore the lodge, collect every item, and return it to the correct place.

details.title: Aunt Hattie's Quilts
details.short_description: Grow your own cotton, gather natural materials, and craft beautiful quilts to delight your customers. Create lasting friendships within the community, and they might just reward you with new quilting templates! Expand your collection to unlock new designs and express your creativity.

details.title: Etched
details.short_description: A top-down action roguelite about a little mage who carves lightning itself. Etch engravings into your spells to reshape how they behave, weave engraving synergies into your own build, mow down monster packs, hunt buffed elites, and descend into ever-deeper arenas. What's carved cannot be undone.

details.title: ByteBuddies
details.short_description: Explore the depths of an abandoned world and figure out what is happening while you survive 5 nights fighting for your life.

details.title: Digging Up
details.short_description: Digging Up is a 1-4 player co-op digging adventure where you drill through a destructible alien planet, gather valuable resources, upgrade your gear, explore underground biomes, and dig your way back to the surface.

details.title: Reaper GoStop
details.short_description: You are dead. At the gates of the afterlife, judgment is settled over a game of Hwatu. Real Korean flower cards and authentic Go-Stop rules meet runaway score-multiplier deckbuilding. The hand you draw is the life you lived. Outplay the Reaper to pass, or fall to hell and face the gate again.

details.title: Loss Prevention: Prologue
details.short_description: Loss Prevention is a social deduction game where you can shoplift your local grocery store with up to five friends. Experience the joy of petty crime as a shoplifter, or keep your eyes peeled for suspicious activity as the shopkeeper. Can you grab all the items on the shopping list?

details.title: Respawn | 2020
details.short_description: Come join us at Respawn where you can play with friends, make friends, create whole worlds, become a content creator, become an artist and so much more all at Respawn!

details.title: Buckaroo
details.short_description: A creature-breeding sim where you catch wild critters in an open world and breed them into absurd creations, with over 60 million combinations. Then take your critter down to the rodeo or the racetrack and climb the ranked circuit.

details.title: The Little Stomping Girl
details.short_description: Tiny stomps. Explosive combos! Mine ore before your match burns out in this incremental mining game. Fit gear into limited equipment slots, collect unique items, and combine skills to turn a little girl's stomps into powerful chain reactions. Light another match, grow stronger, and dig deeper!

details.title: Fairy's Hero
details.short_description: Fairy's Hero is an auto-battler game with rogue-lite elements and incremental meta progression. While your hero is fighting enemies, you manage their inventory, skill tree, assist in boss fights, and collect rewards. Take your Hero on a quest across the kingdom, to fulfill their purpose!

details.title: MusicDamage
details.short_description: MusicDamage is a top-down multiplayer music shooter. Move, aim and fire to your weapon's rhythm in team battles and casual matches. Use cover and hazards, and enable optional fragment progression to collect rhythm fragments and upgrades that change how you play and build.

details.title: BoardboundHeroes
details.short_description: Recruit heroes, forge their gear, line them up—then watch them fight. A roguelike autobattler of deep dungeon dives: build parties around classes and trait synergies, draft reward cards to shape each run. Your army and gear persist as lasting assets. Play hands-on or let auto-farming grind for you.

details.title: AirGap
details.short_description: A first-person stealth roguelite about breaking into a floating AI datacenter and blasting it apart in every way imagineable. Learn the patrols, sabotage machines, steal keycards, cut the power, plant charges. Leave clean and the damage stays; get caught and the fortress heals and adapts.

details.title: MOTHERWARD
details.short_description: MOTHERWARD is a single-player psychological horror anomaly game. You are searching for your mother in an abandoned hospital. To find her, you must remember everything, uncover what you see...or don't see, and make a choice. But remember, every choice has consequences.

details.title: Lords: Ivory Tower Defence
details.short_description: Pioneering the bold new genre of "Ivory Tower Defence" Lords blends loot-based Tower Defence exploration, a unique quiz mechanic, and a painfully overwritten narrative about meaning in the age of AI.

details.title: AutomaticBox
details.short_description: A bunch of boxes move on their own. All you can do is watch them move and reset them. It's a box-pushing game without a main character. You need to use the order and direction of the boxes to guide them to stand on the destinations at the same time. Hope it gives you a relaxing brain massage.

details.title: Scale A Building
details.short_description: A game about scaling a building

details.title: Real Zombie Survivors
details.short_description: Real Zombie Survivors is a co-op top-down arena shooter where you fight relentless hordes of zombies on real-world maps generated from OpenStreetMap data. Choose unique classes, upgrade your arsenal, call in combat robots, and survive the apocalypse solo or with friends on Steam!

details.title: Digital Hunger
details.short_description: A true-crime investigation inside a killer's 1999 desktop. Dig through his files, crack his secrets, and answer a call that rings on your real phone. English subtitles, Hebrew voice. 3 endings.

details.title: Slacker Hero
details.short_description: A stay-resident RPG whose hero fights all by himself. He does the fighting — but when he gets bored he climbs out of the game window to wander around your desktop and take naps. Send him back, let him rest, or let him scavenge. A comedic little roguelite RPG.

details.title: I am the Dungeon Boss
details.short_description: Descend a cursed dungeon where every victory leaves a scar. Dethrone the boss, and your legend rises as the next guardian — an echo that waits in the dark. Roguelike permadeath, shifting floors, and optional ranked play against other players’ legacies.

details.title: Find All Things: Vacation
details.short_description: Find All Things: Vacation is a relaxing collection of puzzle games set in a world of travel and summer adventures. Search for hidden objects, solve puzzles, and spot differences across sunny beaches, water parks, and more. Escape the daily routine and enjoy a peaceful, relaxing atmosphere.

details.title: Beat Ten
details.short_description: Across the Rhythm Multiverse, anomalies are disrupting the Beat. Your mission: repair the Beat using YOUR music, one track at a time. Welcome to Beat Ten, where you can play to music you stream!

details.title: CACTBOY
details.short_description: Put on your sheriff hat and load your revolver! CACTBOY is a hilarious and chaotic Western multiplayer party game for up to 4 players. From split-second quick-draw duels to absurd brawls, master a variety of minigames and prove who the true CACTBOY is!

details.title: Neon Armada - Solar Storm
details.short_description: A top-down arena roguelite you can learn in one wave and spend a hundred hours mastering. Waves close in from every edge; the shop between them decides what you become. 32 ships, 28 weapons, 115 mods to combine — then endless mode, where the caps come off.

details.title: SheepFall
details.short_description: Build, fight and save the sheep in SheepFall, a strategy game with direct hero control. Face cunning enemies with distinct behaviors, outsmart them with your tactics, conquer dangerous biomes and climb the online leaderboard. Think you can handle it?

name: WICK: Wizards Into Cards that Kill

details.title: WICK: Wizards Into Cards that Kill
details.short_description: A real-time, first-person wizard duel where your spells are cards. Throw fireballs, raise walls, summon a Phoenix or turn into a bear. Build your deck, duel friends online, climb the ranks, rip open packs and level your cards

details.title: BAIKAL LICKING SIMULATOR
details.short_description: An amazing immersive simulator that transports you to a small town on the shores of Lake Baikal, where you can express your love for the greatest, coolest, and freshest lake on Earth — Baikal! How exactly? The answer is obvious: lick it, and then lick it again!

details.title: Australian Hunter
details.short_description: Australia is facing a wildlife overpopulation crisis. You will play as a hunter, surviving, hunting, and working in the Australian wilderness to help the Australian people solve this ecological disaster.

details.title: WEAPONS FREE
details.short_description: WEAPONS FREE is a tactical CQB shooter in the bodycam and helmetcam perspectives. This game prioritizes challenging AI, unpredictable scenarios, and immersion. WEAPONS FREE includes realistic combat, true-to-life bodycam, interaction with civilians, and multiple levels with their own unique feel.

details.title: POLIS
details.short_description: Become mayor of a small Greek town and govern for 17 years. Citizens write you letters for years, the opposition never sleeps, and every promise is remembered. A satirical political city sim where the town never forgets.

details.title: Backrooms: Emergency Exit
details.short_description: Backrooms: Emergency Exit is an Online-Coop Horror experience for 1–4 players. Survive in the face of horrifying entities and dangerous hazards. Uncover the mysteries and secrets hidden deep within the Backrooms to find the exit. And most importantly: Stay alive.

details.title: DDD: Deep Dungeon Descent
details.short_description: A top-down precision platformer in 1-bit pixel art. Your jump is your everything — weapon, escape, and only tool. Descend 100 floors of spikes, crumbling ground and enemies. Die, restart the floor instantly, race the clock.

details.title: Pay the House
details.short_description: You owe The House, and the only trade you have is cigarette cards. Rip packs, complete sets, and cover a payment that doubles every third time. Pawn what you need, borrow from the shark, keep opening. A Prohibition-era pack-opening roguelike about a debt that grows every time you pay it off.

details.title: Dead Tube
details.short_description: DEAD TUBE is a single-player auto-simulation and behind-the-scenes intervention game built around a closed survival battle royale featuring 12 contestants.When a sole survivor emerges, add her to your collection, or let her carry her scars, reputation, and combat record into the next challenge.

details.title: Chief Endurance Officer
details.short_description: Nothing beats a company-paid holiday! Perfect attendance earned you an unlimited vacation—100% savings on hotels and restaurants, because there are none. Give up and crawl back to work, or survive the wild. A cozy desktop idle survival game. Endure your way to the top.

details.title: GIGASTRIKER
details.short_description: GIGASTRIKER is a 3D football survivors-like where every goal sends enemies flying. Your striker kicks automatically as you dodge swarms, slide-tackle through crowds and stack upgrades into devastating builds. Recruit teammates, take down bosses and unlock new strikers for your next run.

details.title: NyanDrop
details.short_description: NyanDrop is a physics puzzle: connect four or more blocks with the same pattern to clear them. Stack cleverly and aim for chain reactions. One more round with the cats!

details.title: Red Ball 4
details.short_description: The legendary physics platformer with more than 350 million downloads comes to Steam! Roll, jump and bounce through 75 levels packed with traps, puzzles and boss battles — and unlock 80 Steam Achievements along the way.

details.title: Denpa Virus
details.short_description: A "Dark x Engineering" visual novel. A story of brain-docking with four girls infected by "Denpa Virus".

details.title: Card Collector Battle
details.short_description: A 2D turn-based auto-battler about collecting gods. Summon 432 guardians from Korean, Chinese, Japanese, Egyptian, Norse and Greek mythology, then fuse duplicates into the copies you own to raise their borders from silver to celestial. Your deck decides the fight.

details.title: PAWN SHIFT
details.short_description: You're working the night shift at a pawn shop on an isolated road. Haggle with every customer who walks in, inspect what they bring you, and decide what goes on your shelf. Some of it should not be here. Nothing is supernatural, and that is the scariest part. A PSX-style horror shift.

details.title: Diaper Wars
details.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where unruly babies battle, compete, and unleash mayhem with ridiculous weapons, explosive combat, and wild obstacle courses.

details.title: Shrine Full of Anomalies
details.short_description: Play as Reimu Hakurei, Youmu Konpaku, Fujiwara no Mokou, and Marisa Kirisame in this Touhou Project fangame. Search four locations for anomalies, turn back if something is wrong, and escape by choosing the correct action.

details.title: Open Headcount: A Corporate-Hell Roguelike
details.short_description: A corporate-hell roguelike auto-battler. Hire a disposable worker, build game-breaking combos out of office junk, and send them up the corporate ladder through the circles of Limbo Corp. When they burn out, open a new headcount. The only way out is up.

details.title: Dronerush
details.short_description: Dronerush is an idle, incremental strategy game about discovering drone synergies and mining ore.

details.title: Breathtoll
details.short_description: Your breath keeps you human. Explore a prison tower in first person, face threats in its corridors, and fight through turn-based card battles. Manage your equipment and dwindling breath in this single-player horror RPG.

details.title: ChickenScratch: Cluck & Code
details.short_description: You don't steer the chicken. You program it. Write real scripts in a fake desktop OS and send your bird into fields that reseed every run, so hardcoded coordinates work exactly once. Upgrades aren't +1% damage: they're if statements, for loops, and the memory to hold a list.

details.title: RepCell
details.short_description: What if attention became the most valuable thing in society? And everyone who lost it was sent to a container suspended above the ocean until they became visible again?

details.title: Group Commander
details.short_description: Take command of a World War II heavy bomber group over occupied Europe. Read the field order, weigh the target against the men, and send your forts. A player-paced command sim where every mission is a decision and every empty bunk is one you signed for.

details.title: Too Many Pieces
details.short_description: Why are puzzle pieces scattered everywhere? Who wrote the letters guiding Mei? And most importantly, why is she here? Explore 9 strangely familiar rooms, recover the scattered pieces, complete 34 hand-illustrated puzzles, and put the space back together.

name: The Last Home : Curse of Lanna

details.title: The Last Home : Curse of Lanna
details.short_description: The Last Home: Curse of Lanna is an FMV horror game that takes players into the mysterious land of Lanna, filled with supernatural tales. Featuring cinematic 4K visuals and immersive sound, it delivers a chilling, movie-like experience.

details.title: PawTop Cats
details.short_description: PawTop Cats is a cozy app with animated cats that live on top of your windows. Choose different skins, interact with your fluffy assistants, and add a little cute chaos to your desktop.

details.title: PROTOCOL: VOID
details.short_description: PROTOCOL: VOID CONTRACT is a cyberpunk top-down action RPG for 1–4 players. Take on dangerous contracts, fight hostile systems, collect randomized weapons and cyberware, shape powerful builds, and upgrade your gear to survive deadlier missions.

details.title: Primal
details.short_description: You will become a primitive man who hunts and tames dinosaurs, survives, and builds a home.

details.title: Sanitarium Enhanced
details.short_description: The timeless psychological horror point-and-click adventure Sanitarium™ returns with new enhancements. Originally released in 1998 and named Adventure Game of the Year, Sanitarium Enhanced adds full controller support, quality of life improvements, and never-before-seen bonus materials.

details.title: Robot Vacuum Simulator
details.short_description: Take the controls of a tiny robot vacuum in a first-person cleaning sim. Cut clean paths through grime, steer around furniture, grab and sort clutter, scrub dishes, chase fresh pawprints, and put new tools to work on bigger jobs.

details.title: ADVENTURES OF MOR̂ABOB
details.short_description: MORABOB is a 90s-inspired action-adventure side-scroller heavily focused on giant boss battles. Survive, attack, and fight titan bosses hundreds of times your size, each with surprising, unique attacks. Meet the mysterious evil in fog and rescue the kidnapped adventurous girl, Asaly

details.title: Card Idler
details.short_description: An incremental card idler about collecting cards and expanding your deck. Farm, mine gems, kill monsters and cook meals to help your progression. Unlock new upgrades and merge your cards into their ultimate form. Will you complete your collection?

details.title: Interlude
details.short_description: A roguelike dungeon crawler where each room is a different world inspired by classical painting. Dying brings you back to your starting point, but the upgrades you unlock, the friends you make, and the secrets you uncover will help you explore further each time.

details.title: The Demon Wins
details.short_description: Build each mercenary from the ground up in a permadeath dark fantasy auto-battler where there are no classes - only combinations. Find powerful loot, mutate attacks, combine skills, choose paths, and turn what you find into the power to win.

details.title: A (tiny) Slime Quest
details.short_description: A short and cozy top-down adventure. Exiled to a hidden village after one final defeat, explore your surroundings and help fellow banished monsters by solving their unique troubles. Whether you long to return to combat or wish to discover a new path, it's your time to shine!

details.title: Chess Pit
details.short_description: Two teams. One giant chessboard. Every kill earns your team a move, then you climb inside a hundred-foot chess piece and drive it across the arena, crushing anyone where it lands. Real-time chess with no turns, no waiting, and a whole lot of gunfire. Take the enemy king to win.

details.title: One Neck Ahead
details.short_description: In One Neck Ahead, you play as Kid Giraffe on a journey towards the heart of the forest, where dreams come true. Carry your own ground, create your own platforms, and meet a cast of memorable characters, each introducing a new twist to the adventure.

details.title: You Got Me Killed!
details.short_description: Two players share one body: one controls the legs, the other the arms. Survive endless monster hordes, evolve your skills, summon bosses and blame each other for every death in this co-op roguelite bullet heaven.

details.title: Keep It Checked
details.short_description: Trapped in a looping corridor of an anomaly research facility, you must watch every detail. Spot an anomaly? Turn back. Everything normal? Keep walking. Make the right call eleven rooms in a row to find the exit and break the loop.

details.title: The Hope Incident
details.short_description: In The Hope Incident, you take on the role of a nighttime supermarket employee. What starts as a regular shift quickly turns into a terrifying test of your skills. Serve suspicious customers, deal with the devastating effects of underground anomalies, and uncover the mysteries of GSO-7.

details.title: Baron Local
details.short_description: Rise from ordinary citizen to political kingmaker in a pixel-art political life simulator inspired by Romania. Build alliances, launch projects, survive scandals, and navigate corruption as you climb from local politics toward national power.

details.title: Nostos
details.short_description: A mint-tin sci-fi survival horror dungeon crawler involving dice, cards and nerve. Generate nailbiting stories in short runs that fit around your life. Lead a salvage crew through a derelict stalked by a predatory Endoparasite. Push your luck, scavenge to survive, and reach the evac in one piece.

details.title: Ancestral Trace : Singkawang
details.short_description: Ancestral Trace: Singkawang is a cozy 2D point-and-click puzzle adventure where you help Lie Jun Hao, a young man who returns to his childhood city after eleven years away, uncover the story his family left behind.

details.title: Cardfight: Conspiracy
details.short_description: A story-rich RPG told from multiple perspectives. A fusion of turn-based card battling and quick-time defense. Six classmates, each with their own decks - and their own secrets. Your name is SPARTAN JACK, your new friends are part of a deadly secret society, and you have a conspiracy to uncover.

details.title: Together in Pieces: Jigsaw Puzzles
details.short_description: A cozy jigsaw puzzle game for solo play or online co-op with up to 8 players. Turn your own images into puzzles, assemble them together in real time, discover community creations, and share yours through the Steam Workshop.

details.title: Touhou Mushroom Defense
details.short_description: Touhou Mushroom Defense is a Touhou Project fan-made game. It’s a defense game where Marisa turns mushrooms into towers to defeat enemies. In the game, you need to gather materials to build towers and construct towers to block the enemy’s path.

details.title: Ultima Cenere
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder in a Mediterranean Italy after the end. Every run reshapes you: flesh mutates, body parts are traded for implants. You don't heal — you trade. Four classes, one journey to the last enclave. No loot boxes, no pay-to-win.

details.title: Kernel Override
details.short_description: INFILTRATE THE SYSTEM! Kernel Override is a fast-paced cyberpunk bullet heaven. SURVIVE intense 10-minute rounds against escalating waves of anti-virus software, MODIFY your malicious code with powerful upgrades, and UNLOCK permanent meta-progression to crack the core.

details.title: They Were Us
details.short_description: You're in for an exciting adventure about the main character Blake, who faces a ton of challenges before she uncovers the terrifying truth about this area. Various creepy creatures will appear along the way, as well as the surviving locals.

details.title: AJ's Anomaly
details.short_description: Short narrative driven horror. Play as Amelia Jalisco, a fashion designer locked in her apartment. Hangout with your imaginary boyfriend, use your anomaly therapy device, and explore your dreamlike surroundings.

details.title: Card Flipper
details.short_description: Flip cards, stack cash, and chase the jackpot until your fortune snowballs out of control! Card Flipper is a casual casino game with idle elements, where every flip pays, golden cards spark Frenzies, and even the bad habits make you richer. Flip, Frenzy & Fortune!

details.title: FlyMuse  2
details.short_description: FlyMuse 2 takes a “semi-conscious” electronic lifeform, based on a real fruit fly brain, on an adventure. Observe brain activity, tune neural circuits, and reshape the environment as you follow clues through homes, streets, and the underground world.

details.title: Cidle Online
details.short_description: Build your castle, gather resources, and raid neighbors in a shared idle world. Recruit soldiers, hunt dragons and krakens, complete daily quests - all while progress ticks forward whether you're online or away.

details.title: Hauntasy
details.short_description: Do you believe in ghosts? You and your chosen partner are top influencers invited to survive seven nights inside a haunted ancestral estate for $1,000,000. Monitor the rooms, manage your candles, and uncover what the Baron and Baroness are hiding before 4 AM in this psychological fantasy horror.

details.title: Party Executable
details.short_description: Trapped within the walls of Fauxidy Manor, you are forced to continue downwards into the horrors below in order to find the truth and make your escape. It's not all bad though! You get to talk with some wacky characters along the way and collect some cool stuff!

details.title: ReDead Frontline
details.short_description: ReDead Frontline is a post-apocalyptic idle defense game where the zombie outbreak has already won. Trapped in a time loop, you hold the line, recruit survivors, upgrade weapons, deploy drones, study enemies, and reset after each defeat to return stronger and break the cycle.

details.title: Study Nook
details.short_description: Study tools included: Pomodoro timer To-do list Built-in media player with a hand-picked selection of lofi, ambient, and orchestral music Internet browser to stream any audio (Full Version) Play fetch with your companion dog Tend to your garden

details.title: The Hollowing
details.short_description: You’ve taken a maintenance job, flying between the inter-settlement comms towers in the megastructure. Land, fix, on to the next job. What could go wrong? The Hollowing is a narrative first-person horror flight sim from the creator of Lorn's Lure.

details.title: Wrong Landing: Reborn
details.short_description: Wrong Landing: Reborn is a new, improved open-world survival game. Explore a mysterious island full of surprises alone or with friends! Discover its rich story, fight hunger, extreme cold, and try to stay alive.

name: 渔港日记 Fishing Port Diary

details.title: 渔港日记 Fishing Port Diary
details.short_description: A cozy fishing port management game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Grow your fishing port, fish, build, and craft alongside adorable animal companions while enjoying a relaxing harbor life that keeps you company throughout your day.

name: Sea Land Air: Four Nations War

details.title: Sea Land Air: Four Nations War
details.short_description: Read the board. Read your opponents. A military board game of hidden information, bluffing and land, sea and air tactics. Play 4-player 2v2, draw identities and guess allegiances in 6-player 3v3, or face an opponent in a land duel.

details.title: Axis Flip
details.short_description: Physics based Arena Shooter. Up is down. Adapt or die.

details.title: Last Rail
details.short_description: Lead a train carrying the last survivors of humanity across a frozen world. Manage resources, explore abandoned locations, and make difficult decisions that will determine the future of Convoy 07.

details.title: Project Matter
details.short_description: Project Matter is a 2D factory automation game about turning raw inputs into an ever-expanding production web. Place buildings on an infinite grid, draw connections between them, and research new processing chains, waste recovery loops, and advanced materials.

details.title: Burn Tree Burn
details.short_description: An incremental about burning down a forest. Drag a flame across the trees, watch the fire chain from grove to grove, and bank charcoal to make every burn hotter, hungrier and in a larger forest.

details.title: Super Interactive Cats - Desktop Pets
details.short_description: Let adorable cats make your desktop their home! Adopt different breeds, care for them, play with toys, prepare meals, and send them on adventures. Whether you’re working or relaxing, enjoy their lively company throughout the day.

details.title: Save Me, Hero!
details.short_description: Explore an eerie world, gather loot, and fuse cards through devouring. Save Me, Hero! is a first-person card RPG. Forge gear and combine talents to craft your own build. Find an opening in turn-based battles and decide who lives as cries for help echo around you.

details.title: FrontierLord
details.short_description: FrontierLord is a pixel strategy game to build and guard frontier forts. As lord, build villages, collect wood and ore for production. Place siege gear and wall traps, train troops to repel raiders. Balance building and defense, craft your fort and create your frontier legend.

details.title: The Lost City of Gold
details.short_description: The discovery of an adventurer's journal starts you on an unforgettable journey into the heart of an uncharted wilderness in search of the legendary Lost City of Gold. A relaxing, first-person adventure with light puzzles and platforming across 15 levels.

details.title: The Last Call
details.short_description: Every run starts the same. Never ends that way. Arena, corrupted monsters, zero grind. The Last Call throws you in and lets you figure it out. Tactical combat, short sessions, honest difficulty. Only your skill matters.

details.title: VoxMancer
details.short_description: VoxMancer is a voice-driven 3D magic PvP game where players shout their own incantations in battle. Magic is imagination made real: invoke elemental and arcane forces, shape magic with your words, and unleash dramatic, ridiculous, or panicked ideas as powerful spells or spectacular misfires.

details.title: Delete: E.A.D Core
details.short_description: Delete: E.A.D CORE is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game. Enter an underground data facility, destroy data disks in the correct systems, and escape from whatever is still inside.

details.title: Santa's Escape
details.short_description: Christmas Eve, 2003. Mid-delivery, the chimney gives way and Santa falls into a dark, silent house in Cedar Hollow, North Carolina. He isn't alone. Search the rooms, uncover what happened to the Stier family, and find a way out of the house that won't let him go.

details.title: The Serena Villa Files
details.short_description: 'FMV Queen' Wang Han's First K-FMV! At your new job as a security guard in a women's only residence, feelings blossom between you and the charming residents, but strange events also haunt you from your first day. What mystery awaits you and the five ladies of Serena Villa?

details.title: Crossfall
details.short_description: Crossfall is a cozy single-player top-down RPG with turn-based combat, developed by a solo creator. Explore a tile-based world, take part in dialogues, complete quests, craft items, go fishing, and gather herbs. Improve your skills and shape your own build.

details.title: Severwood
details.short_description: Forge runes into your beast, chain glyph combos into screen-clearing chaos, and evolve through a cursed dark-fantasy forest. A roguelite deckbuilder where every socket is a choice and every run rewrites your power. Hunt down the Soul Lord. Descend deeper. Die hungrier.

details.title: Lofi Drive
details.short_description: Relax and unwind in an endless procedurally generated cruise. Unlock new lofi songs, vehicles, biomes, and features by simply stopping at intersections and road signs. No timers, no traffic, no pressure. Just you, the road, and the journey. No MTX, No gatcha, just relaxing and soothing game-play.

details.title: Portal Time Traveller
details.short_description: As Subject 247 of a mysterious laboratory, you are tasked with stepping through time portals to retrieve requested artifacts. Hunt dinosaurs, survive empire of Middle Ages, gather critical materials in streets and navigate a neon lit dystopia. Will you obey scientists or start your own rebellion?

details.title: Legends of Companion
details.short_description: Legends of Companion is a strategic auto-battling ARPG roguelite where every choice is yours. Pick from 4 classes, build deep skill trees, forge loot, recruit a battle pet, and chart paths across diverse worlds. Master skills, gear, and team combos to turn one spark into an unstoppable legend.

details.title: Vector Noir
details.short_description: A twin-stick arena roguelite. The Moonlight Sonata drives the choreography. Enemies spawn placed by beat, by hand. Hard on purpose, you will hate Beethoven.

details.title: End of War: Global Front
details.short_description: Build towers, defend two sectors and your shared reactor against endless machine waves—alone or in online co-op. Every battle matters: In THE GREAT WAR, the global frontline shaped by all players grants unique bonuses and penalties in every match.

details.title: CodePhantom
details.short_description: "CodePhantom" is a 3D action game where you pilot the humanoid combat mech PHANTOM and take on a variety of missions. Experience the thrill of controlling a powerful mech with smooth, responsive gameplay. Enjoy intense, no-nonsense mech action designed for fans of authentic robotic combat.

details.title: On The Hook
details.short_description: You owe the casino boss a debt you can never repay—one that snowballs with compounding interest, growing heavier by the night. Several young female agents, themselves ensnared in the trap, are ready to take your orders. Make it out of the casino before the debt buries you alive.

details.title: Lifebearers
details.short_description: In a battlefield under heavy fire, your only mission is to save lives! Lifebearers is a 2-player co-op rescue game. Step into the boots of medics with a friend: find wounded soldiers, carry them on a stretcher, and reach the safe zone. Coming out in one piece demands tight coordination!

details.title: Stellar Harvest
details.short_description: Harvest energy across the solar system. Build generators on alien worlds, prestige for Dark Energy, and construct a Dyson Sphere around the Sun. Ten planets. Infinite power. One way home.

details.title: Digital Druid
details.short_description: Build synergistic Gardens in this abstract roguelike deckbuilder. Push your luck and find the balance between growth and corruption. The Garden must Bloom.

details.title: Nothing Goes Right: Bad Business
details.short_description: A co-op restaurant management game where every successful day creates bigger problems. Cook, serve, survive chaos, pay the bills, and see how long your business can stay alive.

details.title: Thousand Ward
details.short_description: Thousand Ward is a tactical collector RPG where you build a 3x3 Band of Wardens, master turn-based Hold, Break, and Surge combat, conquer 1,000 levels across 10 realms, collect 200+ Wardens, and climb ranked online battles through strategy, synergy, and smart play.

details.title: Feastfall
details.short_description: Feastfall is a cooking roguelike deckbuilder. Plate ingredient cards into recipes, stack game-breaking charm synergies, and feed ravenous monsters. This is not a kitchen sim. It's a life-or-death gamble at the dinner table — and the house is starving.

details.title: Cute & Dead
details.short_description: A fast, absurd VR arcade shooter about a nerd, a zombie apocalypse, and thirty girls who need rescuing. Ridiculous weapons, a very good dog, and a dance floor waiting at the end of every run.

details.title: Climb the Fools
details.short_description: An insanely difficult climbing game begins here. Knocking others down—it is truly a world of survival of the fittest. There can be only one winner.

details.title: AscendiA
details.short_description: For anyone who ever dreamed of being a shonen manga hero. You wake in a strange forest, left with only a tower and one word: “Climb.” Ascendia is a pixel action roguelike where the powers you choose awaken as new skills and hidden secrets as Astras. The path you walk becomes your own ending.

details.title: Barkyard Blitz
details.short_description: Herd sheep, steal points, and blast your rivals with weaponized barking! Gain unique abilities, defend your base, survive chaotic events, and play different roles in the ultimate farmyard battle.

details.title: Buzzoria
details.short_description: A cozy excavation and colony-building game about bees, buried relics, and the mysterious Watcher. Dig through the remains of a vanished civilization, recover valuable finds, grow your colony, and uncover the truth one discovery at a time.

details.title: Linked Wheels
