details.short_description: Drive a cart through chaotic physics-based obstacle courses, alone or in online co-op. Coordinate both sides, jump, crouch, and survive deadly traps without destroying your friendship.

details.title: The Kingdom's Merchant
details.short_description: Build your fortune in a living medieval kingdom. Establish shops, manage caravans, master a dynamic economy, and outmaneuver rival merchant houses in single-player or competitive multiplayer as you build the realm's greatest trading empire.

details.title: Quantum Gomoku
details.short_description: A stone's color isn't decided until you "observe" it—a competitive five-in-a-row puzzle in flux. Black or white is drawn the instant you observe, and knowing when to spend your limited observations decides the match. A fresh take on strategy where luck meets mind games.

name: おやすみ冒険隊-ボクと最後の夏休み-

details.title: おやすみ冒険隊-ボクと最後の夏休み-
details.short_description: 懐かしくて温かくてちょっぴり切ない…… 少年少女たちによる、ひと夏のジュブナイルRPG！

details.title: Next Level: Tower Defense
details.short_description: Race-based tower defense. Build your army, defend your king, and send waves at your rivals. Up to 8-player FFA, 2v2 & 4v4 teams, and singleplayer. Crossplay on Windows, Linux, macOS & Steam Deck.

details.title: Groundwork
details.short_description: The humans are coming. Someone has to get the place ready. Scan what grows here, gather and mine. Repair the robots from crashed ships, and they'll teach you new recipes and take over jobs. Build a new home for the humans, and a home for the robots you found. No combat, no timer, no fail screen.

details.title: BONKER LADS
details.short_description: BONKER LADS is a sandbox chaos battle simulator where you can build armies, set up battles, and watch fighters and military vehicles clash.

details.title: 失序的我与乐园
details.short_description: This is an adventure that takes place in an amusement park. Players will explore strange scenes, meet mysterious companions, and uncover the truth behind the 'Disorderly Park' program through turn-based battles and story choices.

details.title: 大收藏家
details.short_description: "The Collector" is a multiplayer auction game of sealed bids and hidden information. Face three players in five-round auctions for a container of unknown treasures. Use cards to uncover clues, place secret bids, and compete for the highest profit margin. Spend less, earn more.

details.title: Cats Out
details.short_description: The cats are out. They are everywhere, being a mess, stealing everything. Call your friends or if you're brave enough, take them on alone. Get your brooms ready, aim your slippers and go to War with those hungry little thieves!

details.title: Ashioto Kyōfu | Footsteps Terror
details.short_description: Touka Saeki, a former journalist and owner of the online video channel “Footsteps Terror”, travels to an abandoned mountain village where a school drama club mysteriously disappeared to cover that place in her next video. Her arrival awakens a long-buried curse...

details.title: Department 98
details.short_description: Your placement is confirmed. Report to District Intake, desk seven. The previous occupant's effects have been cleared. An idle game inside a fake 1990s office OS about paperwork, promotion, and a job going very well.

details.title: Can't Escape It
details.short_description: Can't Escape It is a first-person, found-footage, psychological horror game. You are trapped in a looping apartment. Search for clues to solve puzzles and find a way out, evade a clown that chases you, navigate the dark using your night vision, and manage your batteries. CAN YOU ESCAPE IT?

details.title: Ravenian Conquerors
details.short_description: A real-time sandbox strategy game across the vast archipelago of Ravenia, with a new island every play. Lead a faction, raise armies, and seize cities as you evolve through four ages. Prepare for a cosmic crisis that could end everything. Stand against it, or become the crisis itself.

details.title: Crooked Derby
details.short_description: Bet on one horse. Tell everyone you backed another. Crooked Derby is a party game of secret bets and public lies: rig the race with face-up cards, call your rivals’ bluffs, and get away with it. Play with friends online or solo against lying bots

details.title: Sewer Crawler
details.short_description: Survive horrific creatures and collect treasure in underground mazes, talk to eccentric characters, and manage your resources in a first-person survival horror experience.

details.title: Project OC
details.short_description: Project OC is a multiplayer online desktop idle game. Unlock 1000+ customization options through idle gameplay and freely mix appearances, outfits, expressions, and actions to create your unique OC. Invite friends to join and let their OCs live on your desktop!

details.title: Frost Muscle
details.short_description: Get good at sliding your muscle car on snow. Earth is freezing and only your driving save it.

name: That Probably Belongs in a Museum

details.title: That Probably Belongs in a Museum
details.short_description: That Probably Belongs in a Museum is a chill and cozy tidy up organizing game about cataloging and curating an enormous amount of ancient artifacts! Your job is simple: Catalog ancient artifacts, uncover bizarre stories, and help build a collection of artifacts that probably belong in a Museum!

details.title: You Are ¿Not? A Dentist
details.short_description: Brush their teeth. Accept their gifts. Pay your rent. Explore many towns in this first person brush-em-up adventure about an aspiring dentist pursuing their dreams. You can heal the world, and even support yourself, if you try!

details.title: Spatial Puzzle 3D
details.short_description: This is a casual puzzle game that combines spatial logic and brain-teasing challenges.The game features simple controls and a relaxed pace with a satisfying level of challenge. It is designed for players who enjoy Sudoku, Rubik’s Cube, and other spatial logic puzzles.

details.title: Infiniterra
details.short_description: A voxel sandbox focused on atmosphere and contrast. Explore layered worlds, survive eerie nights, and uncover what lies beneath the surface.

details.title: Incrawler
details.short_description: An incremental dungeon crawler where you slay enemies, collect loot, and build powerful hero synergies. Master skill trees, invest in unique traits, and prestige to push deeper and defeat challenging bosses.

details.title: Three Kingdoms Stratagem
details.short_description: A retro-inspired, narrative-driven turn-based tactics RPG. Enemies telegraph their attacks before executing them, and it's up to you to disrupt them. Lead your heroes to victory to restore the Han dynasty!

details.title: 技能贪吃蛇 , Skill Snake
details.short_description: "Skill Snake" is an innovative casual game that adds skills and new mechanisms to the traditional Snake game and combines it with simulation management.

details.title: Clinical Memory
details.short_description: Clinical Memory is a first-person psychological horror game set in the abandoned Ward 7B hospital. Experience distorted memory cycles, explore a changing environment, and make choices that may bring you closer to the truth or send you back to the beginning.

details.title: Evidentia
details.short_description: Evidentia is a cooperative detective card game for friends. Each deck is a unique case. Analyze evidence, take risks, question everything — and find out if you can solve it before the final reveal.

details.title: CARDaCOMBS
details.short_description: A retro roguelike deckbuilder where cards cost more than just energy. Descend the CARDaCOMBS, defeat monsters, and upgrade your deck with cards that cost energy, discards, blood, and MORE!!!

details.title: STILL WATCHING: The Night Caregiver
details.short_description: Your real smartphone is your only weapon... Sync your phone with the game and pray it doesn't ring while you're hiding in the closet.

details.title: NoOneKnowsME.
details.short_description: You are not human—and no one can ever find out. NoOneKnowsME. is a psychological horror adventure set aboard a spaceship. Complete daily tasks, survive tense conversations, and hide your true identity for seven days as you make your way back to Earth.
developers: 箱詰めプロダクション

details.title: Is Gambling Bad For Business?
details.short_description: Grow a company from one tiny office into a billion dollar HQ tower, then bet it on a coin flip. Hire from CVs, survive crises, keep the board happy and don't go bankrupt. Build only with gambling winnings. Then go online: buy land from cities and conquer other players' plots at blackjack.

details.title: The Falling Skies
details.short_description: Explore a cursed forest where the past refuses to die. As a new forest ranger, uncover the truth behind a forgotten tragedy, navigate shifting paths, and face mysterious distortions that blur the line between reality and nightmare.

details.title: DRAWCERY
details.short_description: Draw your spells. Command the elements. DRAWCERY is an online PvP spell-summoning game with unique, draw-to-cast combat. Sketch elemental symbols in the heat of battle to unleash real-time magic and outplay your rivals like a true wizard.

details.title: HeroesSagaZero
details.short_description: A muscle wizard who beats foes with a staff, a meathead tank who won't protect allies, a healer who only casts offensive spells. Break every RPG rule! Mix gear, stats, and skills to dream up builds even when you're not playing. A strategic hack-and-slash roguelite RPG with 2.5D pixel-art battles.

details.title: Crosstalk
details.short_description: Juna Park's broken implant shuts down every device around her, and the city wants her gone. You play Cal Rowe, the PI keeping her alive. She can say stop. Whether you listen decides how much she trusts you, and every one of the ten endings costs something.

details.title: Ants Megapolis
details.short_description: Command a colony on the brink in Ants Megapolis. Survive an unforgiving world by forging your unique Pheromone, a weapon that dictates your evolution. Carve out an empire from the dirt as an interactive narrator chronicles your savage, epic story of survival.

details.title: Spellbroker
details.short_description: Become a master Spellbroker — wield magic and money in a fast-paced, isometric pixel art marketplace. Buy low, sell high, and bend the market to your will as you build your fortune in a world where profit is pure magic.

details.title: Cut the Strings
details.short_description: It's a battle to become a sacrifice. A TPS where the bride <sacrifice> girl shoots down abandoned synthetic soldiers on the battlefield. A fictional post-war world, a corrupt city, unreasonable fate and choices. Explore vast fields, enhance your body and weapons, and carve out her path.

details.title: Posse of 3
details.short_description: Posse of Three is an RPG Maker game that takes place in a wild west setting with heavy fantasy elements! You will play as 3 main characters. Sammy a young settler, Ahiga a native man, and Fennic a wild fawn. Expect traditional turn based rpg combat with a gripping wild west story.

details.title: 回圈Loop
details.short_description: You awaken alone on a deep-sea rig. Your only companion is a decaying AI: LUMEN. In 20 minutes, everything explodes. Die. Wake. Remember. Escape this psychological horror loop—but do you really want to know the truth?

details.title: Triad: Elemental Saga
details.short_description: A tactical card battler with dynamic decks. Pick three heroes, each channeling Fire, Water, Earth, or Air, each chasing a personal quest. Complete in-match quests to earn resources, and unlock epic items and spells from your Archives.

details.title: Neon Arcade
details.short_description: There is a place where arcade machines never die and the desktop never sleeps. RiderOS is your portal to 30+ neon-soaked games across every genre, all breathing the same electric air. Log in. Pick a window. Lose the evening.

details.title: Fearless Crew
details.short_description: Fearless Crew is a monster-hunter co-op game where you and up to 3 friends hunt monsters and bring them back to the ship. Each monster is caught in a unique way, with different tools - so be smart about what items you use and when. Even you might get caught off guard by the very tools you use

details.title: Treug Dispute: Tabletop Interpretation
details.short_description: In this single-player board game, you take control of the city of Treug and overcome the crises that befell it. Balance resources and develop the city. But most importantly: find out how this story truly ended.

details.title: Exipath
details.short_description: Uncover memories, decipher clues, and evade the darkness in Exipath, a survival horror game following the story of Scarlett Shinohara as she falls into the abyss of her greatest nightmares in search of a brighter future.

details.title: Block Machine
details.short_description: Block Machine is an elimination-style Roguelike game inspired by Tetris and slot machines. Pull down the lever. You will complete the elimination through random choices again and again, obtaining more items and achieving higher scores.

details.title: On Time In Full
details.short_description: Manage dev teams. Hit deadlines. Deliver quality. OTIF is a kanban board simulation where every hire, every card, and every decision has a cost — and the client is watching.

details.title: War for Ylinthia
details.short_description: Based on the “Ylinthian Chronicles” novel series by M.J. Macourek, this easy to play PVE combination of Real Time Strategy and tabletop games allows for infinite replayability.

details.title: CRIKEYMAS
details.short_description: CRIKEYMAS is a chaotic platformer SUPER HAMMER ACTION GAME where everything is possible with your trusty hammer. Help Mr. SANTER's errand boy reindeer to smash through delightfully devilish levels!

details.title: Tax On Dice
details.short_description: Help Gibo to collect the King's taxes. Every season, roll dice to send Gibo in corresponding towns and collect their resources. In your downtime, buy dice and town upgrades to satisfy the ever-growing King's greed.

details.title: Synapse Idle
details.short_description: Grow a 3D neural network from a single neuron. Workers haul energy along radiant paths, buildings amplify every passing signal, and a 100-node skill tree reshapes how your synapse evolves. A calm, incremental idle game about watching complexity bloom — tinted in whatever colors you choose.

details.title: Victoria Kopernik: Monastery
details.short_description: Occult influencer Victoria Kopernik explores a cursed monastery in this short survival horror experience.

details.title: Greebly Gambit
details.short_description: Greebly Gambit is a chaotic fantasy smash-and-grab-style game where you play as a goblin trying to steal everything not nailed down in order to help revive the god of hope.

details.title: Game Show But Evil
details.short_description: A quiz show...but different!

details.title: SOS! Love~Controlled
details.short_description: [SOS! Love~Controlled] is a live-action interactive romance game. You wander into a bar called "SOS" and meet three girls: Hiyori, a rich closet otaku; Naomi, the gentle yet dangerous owner; and Ruina, a withdrawn lolita. A casual night out slowly turns into something far more mysterious.

details.title: Rune Tavern
details.short_description: This is an asynchronous PVP auto chess game. Arrange your runes and components, use energy transfer to activate as many rune skills as possible, and build a powerful lineup! In the face of randomly matched opponents, be the first to smash the enemy's elemental blocks and win more!

details.title: Mobius
details.short_description: If space has no end, where is the exit? Mobius is a gravity-flipping puzzle-platformer set in a looping realm. Cross screen edges to invert gravity and find hidden paths in symmetrical spaces. Solve physical puzzles to reach the mysterious door—what secrets await on the other side?

details.title: Grandpa Needs Fish
details.short_description: Grandpa Needs Fish is a cozy idle clicker game where fortune rides the waves. You are Abraham and you have one mission: catch as many fish as possible. Every cast brings new rewards and every upgrade makes you stronger. Hover, catch, upgrade, and repeat in this satisfying idle incremental adventure.

details.title: GranEndeSaga
details.short_description: Find the legendary hero Neo and reclaim your identity!

details.title: The Sons of Earth
details.short_description: An asymmetric hex wargame about occupation and insurgency. Command the alien Verkhan Empire pacifying a human world — or the fractured Sons of Earth fighting to reclaim it.

details.title: Reach The Banana
details.short_description: A chaotic two-player climbing game where you control one monkey together, one arm each, and battle physics, panic, terrible coordination, mistimed grabs, desperate recoveries, and an endless chain of bad decisions on every climb.

details.title: AllWheelDrive
details.short_description: Drive a single vehicle together, literally. In this chaotic co-op experience, gather up to four friends and share the every control of a single RV or, drive in chaos. Coordinate, argue, and try to stay on the road as things quickly spiral out of control. Fullfill your grandpa's last wish.

details.title: sh2dow cat
details.short_description: A feline game of light and shadow! sh2dow cat is a puzzle platformer that combines two 2D perspectives. Switch between a physical white cat and a shadow cat, and use the light to find your way through the levels.

details.title: ZAIBALY
details.short_description: Horror-comedy boomer shooter, fantastic reimagining of a real-life experience of living under the constant threat of aerial assault

details.title: The Plus-One Kingdom
details.short_description: In The Plus One Kingdom, you are the ruler of a fragile, crumbling domain. Time is relentless—1 real-world second equals 1 in-game day. Seasons change every 90 seconds. Winter is approaching, and if you’re unprepared, everyone will perish.

details.title: Absolute Sumo: Chonk Arena
details.short_description: A silly online party game where you play a chubby meme animal in a tiny sumo belt and shove everyone else out of the ring. Win rounds to grow from a cute little wobbler into a giant slab of muscle, dodge shifting arenas, and fight over who gets to push who.

details.title: Shrimp Method
details.short_description: Shrimp Method is a deliciously addictive shrimp-themed incremental game, where you can watch your shrimp slosh around into full grown crustaceans, vacuumed up by Shrimp Co.'s industrial vacuum network and turned into sweet sweet money!

details.title: Konbini Shift
details.short_description: A shop-sim puzzle game about running a Japanese convenience store. Drag runs of matching goods off the shelves to fill orders, then cook what you sell in the kitchen out back. VIPs and the panic clock force you to spend powerups wisely and clock out with the day banked and your manager's ask filled.

details.title: Million Ball Pit
details.short_description: A giant ball pit with one million colorful balls is waiting to be emptied. Sort balls by hand, bucket and vacuum, dig up lost treasures, unlock upgrades and finally build your own sorting machine with conveyor belts, switches and robot arms.

details.title: Kingdom's Destiny: Warlords
details.short_description: Defend the realms from tyrannical warlords, then recruit them! Command epic turn-based battles to defend the land from oppression. When pirates invade the small kingdom of Forestgrove they awaken military leaders who rise against cruelty and subjugation.

details.title: SALT SWEEPER
details.short_description: SALT SWEEPER is a roguelite twist on minesweeper. Sweep corrupted desert mines, fight enemies in turn-based combat, and grow more powerful with weapons and spells you find along the way.

details.title: Precinct 2099
details.short_description: NeoTokyo, 2099. The man who sold immortality is dead in a penthouse sealed from the inside. You are detective Kade Katano: scan the scene, read people, roll the dice and decide which truth closes the file. A noir visual novel — one complete case, three endings.

details.title: The Proxy
details.short_description: The Proxy is a narrative political simulation game set in a fictional nation, Leviah. The president is dead, and the office is yours. Sign papers that decide the fate of your nation, trade on secrets only you know, and juggle the ones who all want something. Protect the country, or protect yourself?

details.title: Golfever
details.short_description: Create, share and play endless unique 2D pixel-art minigolf courses. Powerful level editor, community maps, easy to learn controls but hard to master. The Steam launch includes multiplayer and expanded content!

details.title: Federal Cadet
details.short_description: Federal Cadet is a single-player police simulation and investigation game. Start as a cadet in Pinewood, patrol the town, question witnesses and suspects, analyze evidence, and rise through the department ranks.

details.title: Budget Defense
details.short_description: During the day, he personally drove the war vehicle to attack the enemy. At night, he extracted oil to sell and use the money to build defense towers, working together to protect the base.

details.title: Fast Charging Tycoon
details.short_description: Run an electric vehicle charging company. Choose your locations, design sites, schedule repairs, apply for loans and grants, vote on industry initiatives, hire executives, maintain reputation and site driver experience ratings, and claim one of four victories to build a fast charging tycoon.

details.title: Jack's Last Show
details.short_description: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to Jack’s Last Show, a short co-op horror game for 1–4 players. Wind up the music boxes, start each act of Jack’s final performance, and try to escape before the house becomes his stage.

details.title: Spellhoard
details.short_description: An autobattler where nothing you buy is ever benched. Every spell stays active, your whole spellbook fights as one machine, and your opponents are real players' builds.

details.title: Locked Inside
details.short_description: Locked inside a sealed underground bunker, you must solve intricate mechanical puzzles and restore power to escape while being relentlessly hunted in the dark by an entity that reacts to your every sound.

details.title: Dinosaur Apocalypse
details.short_description: Dinosaurs took over the Earth, and humans were almost wiped out. How would you survive?

details.title: Nordic
details.short_description: Nordic is a PS1-aesthetic "foddylike" cross-country skiing game that can be online or single player. Nordic captures what makes cross-country skiing great; rhythm & cadence, the calm of nature and exploring the natural world with your friends! Race, ski and discover the beauty of winter.

details.title: AstroPoly
details.short_description: A pixel-art space mining game. Dig into procedurally generated planets, chart your own route across the star map, collect rare ores, level up your gear, and grow your fortune by investing in the market.

details.title: Road to FIRE
details.short_description: Survive a series of mysterious games and claim a fortune. Analyze the rules of seemingly unwinnable games, uncover hidden winning strategies, and overcome every challenge in this high-difficulty death game–style puzzle game.

details.title: Nightveld
details.short_description: A bullet heaven (a reverse bullet hell) where your only weapon is the light you see with. Widen the beam to see the swarm coming, or focus it to burn what's close, and go blind everywhere else. Survive to dawn, pick a power, and face a longer, hungrier Night. How many can you last?

details.title: Night Train Simulator: Blackout
details.short_description: A slow-burn psychological horror train simulator. Drive the train. Follow the schedule. Ignore what's outside.

details.title: Ripple Lane 101 : Moments With You
details.short_description: Share quiet campus dorm life with Yiling in an idle companion game. Focus with a Pomodoro timer, track plans and ideas, relax to Lofi and white noise, and choose outfits and decor. Explore her future world through stories fully voiced in Chinese, and uncover secrets about yourself.

details.title: OnlyCats
details.short_description: Pet cats, earn love, buy more cats. OnlyCats is a cozy incremental idle game where hovering over adorable pixel cats fills your coin and love stash. Unlock new cats, grow your collection, and discover more upgrades.

name: One More Release: Indie Studio Tycoon

details.title: One More Release: Indie Studio Tycoon
details.short_description: Build your dream indie game studio from a tiny office into an industry legend. Hire developers, create games, research engines, survive reviews, fight bugs, decorate your office, and make one more release.

details.title: Draw It, Forget It
details.short_description: Draw prompts in seconds, clear your memory with quick distractions, then decipher your own wonderfully confusing sketches. Play solo or join friends over LAN for voting, shared drawing challenges, and hilarious chains of drawings that drift farther from the original idea.

details.title: Oniro
details.short_description: Slay demonic hordes in a dark fantasy Action RPG with fast-paced combat. Hunt legendary loot and create your own build through a deep multiclass skill tree.

details.title: Shoot Some Rocks
details.short_description: A bullet hell roguelite about a lonely worker drinking alone in space on Christmas Eve. Survive waves of cosmic chaos, get a cold beer, and face five massive bosses inspired by real space calamities.

details.title: Chaos Conquest
details.short_description: Chaos Conquest is a casual incremental auto-battler set in a fantasy world. Mine gold, grow your army from a lone soldier into a mighty battalion, and watch as your soldiers defeat hordes of quirky enemies!

details.title: Face Your Fate
details.short_description: A pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder where your deck spins the reels. Chain elemental patterns, stack your Fates into one huge hand, and fight your way up to the gods of Chinese myth.

details.title: Beach Manager Simulator
details.short_description: Clean, rent, build, and play! Run your own beach in this first-person management sim. Earn money from gear rentals, expand your facilities, hire staff, and tow banana boats full of guests. Go fishing, dig up treasure, and make the beach your own.

details.title: PlatAttack
details.short_description: PlatAttack is a precision 3D platformer: clay worlds, tight jumps, medals, and a clock that never lies. Race your ghost, climb the boards, and build your own maps.

details.title: Afterwork Apocalypse
details.short_description: A horde-survival roguelite set in an office tower after hours. You fight with the stapler and the office coffee while keeping your colleagues from quitting mid-fight, and the elevator takes you up through four buildings, floor by floor.

details.title: Dao Without End
details.short_description: Enjoy continuous, automated progression through idle cultivation in your Pocket Realm. Train Mind Arts, practice alchemy, forge gear, and enter fully automated turn-based battles driven by action gauges. Defeat monsters and bosses, collect powerful loot, refine your build, and reach higher realms.

details.title: Between the notes
details.short_description: A mystical psychological thriller set in the quiet village of Klavishne. Talk to the locals, learn stories, enjoy the atmosphere, pick up the pieces. But find out: who is the woman in the portrait and what happened to her?

details.title: 72 Seconds
details.short_description: 72 Seconds is a fast-paced isometric action RTS where tactical squad micro meets ARPG progression. Command specialized units, build defenses, upgrade skill trees, and battle hostile alien threats. Adapt to randomized enemy affixes and survive high-stakes campaign permadeath.

details.title: StoryRealm: AI Interactive Story Games
details.short_description: Create, edit, and play real-time AI-generated dialogue-based interactive games and visual novels.

details.title: Super Piotr Deluxe
details.short_description: Piotr got flushed into a test world built by a scientist who won't let him leave. Jump from platform to platform while your weapons fire on their own, survive enemy waves and bosses, and push your run through five worlds as far as you can.

details.title: Dawnbar Fantasy
details.short_description: The RPG that lives on the edge of your screen. Your hero and party fight, level, and loot in a slim battle bar docked above your taskbar — while you work, code, or browse.. Expand the window to forge gear, advance your class, Collapse it and get back to work. The adventure never stops.

details.title: ARCHIVE ZERO
details.short_description: In Cold War Britain, you will work through lost reports, photographs, letters, and artifacts as they arrive at the archive. Most seem routine. Some don’t. Follow the details, connect the cases, and decide what is worth digging into.

details.title: NO CLEAN, NO EXIT
details.short_description: A 1-4 player online co-op horror game about cleaning. Scrub the floors, haul out the trash and exterminate the man-eating bugs nesting in an abandoned house. The truck does not leave until the place is spotless.

details.title: Folder Folder Folder
details.short_description: A relaxing incremental game about cleaning up your desktop. Sort files into folders, meet the locals, upgrade your tools, and go from manually sorting files one by one to cleaning up hundreds at a time. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of tranquility where no one will hurt you. No one.

details.title: Beneath Europa
details.short_description: Dive into the eerie depths of Europa to find extraterrestrial life. Are you ready to take the next step?

details.title: Swarmkeeper
details.short_description: Exploit an abomination of bees to destroy your adversaries. Swarmkeeper is a 2D linear Zelda-like, with a twist of Cult of the Lamb, that follows a tale as old as time: Your former business partners have dropped your services and you must seek revenge. You’ll never forget your first sting.

details.title: INNER EKO
details.short_description: A dreamlike first-person platformer about the thoughts you can't let go of. Explore a strange world, meet mysterious beings, and face yourself.

details.title: Unstrung
details.short_description: In Unstrung, a 2.5D narrative puzzle game, you take center stage in a visionary puppeteer’s masterpiece—a dark retelling of Hansel and Gretel. But disobedience is strictly off-script…

details.title: Touhou Sky Cruiser
details.short_description: Run a sky cruiser built by Tenshi. Expand it room by room with new floors and terraces, offer dining and entertainment, and carry guests from port to port as you grow your business above the clouds.

details.title: Click & Loot
details.short_description: Click & Loot is a short autobattle incremental clicker about looting dungeons. Level up, upgrade your gear and delve into the dungeons to pay off your ever increasing debt. And don't forget to renew your dungeon license!

details.title: Meat Wall
details.short_description: IF IT MOVES, SHOOT IT. IF IT STOPS, BUILD WITH IT. MEAT WALL is a darkly comedic tower defense where the horde becomes the map. Pile ’em high, build with ’em, burn ’em, grind ’em, or blast a path through ’em. Shape the battlefield. Change your strategy. EVERY WALL CHANGES THE WAR.

details.title: Syncope
details.short_description: Delve into the depths of your subconscious in this psychological isometric action game, and face your greatest fears made manifest. Fight, trade, and venture deeper into the madness of the mindscape. Can you confront the dangers and move forward towards a better future? The real battle is within.

details.title: TDG: Tower Defense
details.short_description: TDG is a single-player military tower defense game. Hold a 30-wave campaign or an endless run on procedural maps, place and upgrade six tower types, meet Siege Carrier bosses, and adapt when new paths open. Sell or repair between fights. Early Access: full runs now, more content and polish ahead.

details.title: Three Kingdoms Story
details.short_description: Choose a faction, recruit officers, raise troops, and conquer rival strongholds across board-style maps in large-scale real-time battles.

details.title: Hearth Fable
details.short_description: Hearth Fable is an ink-wash city-building management sim. Start with a blank scroll: gather wood, build trades, govern people, raise exotic beasts, and repel invaders as you paint your mountain-and-sea scroll step by step toward a paradise of your dreams.

details.title: Fungus Co.
details.short_description: Grow and spread mycelium from spores across a dark substrate in this relaxing incremental.

details.title: First-Person Jigsaw
details.short_description: Play jigsaw puzzles from a first-person perspective! Sort, organize, and assemble huge piles of pieces at your own pace. Chill out solo or play online with up to 16 players. Import your own images to create custom puzzles, then play them yourself or share them online.

details.title: Angry Tanks
details.short_description: Angry Tanks is an arcade tank shooter. Move forward, performing front flips and destroying enemy tanks.

details.title: Morpheus
details.short_description: Locked, loaded, on the beat — reclaim the boy's lost memories! Morpheus is a futuristic arcade rhythm game built around heavyweight impact.

details.title: Pinebrook Ski Resort
details.short_description: Run a ski resort as a real business. Shape trails on the mountain, string up lifts, and set prices against weather, snow and weekend crowds. Keep lifts running, skiers safe and the books in the black, from a gentle beginner hill to desert dunes and a volcano.

details.title: Beyond The Grey
details.short_description: Beyond the Grey is a cosy island life sim. Farm, mine, craft and keep bees at whatever pace suits you, trade at a market that opens once a week, and get to know some neighbours who notice when you come back. You left the city. Nothing here is in a hurry.

details.title: Don't Fear
details.short_description: Endure a recurring nightmare and search for scattered fragments of memory. Distinguish between the entities that approach you in different ways, and confront the traces of emotions long kept hidden in this first-person psychological horror game.

details.title: May, Be Dead
details.short_description: May, Be Dead is a first-person surrealist adventure game about walking through endless hexagonal rooms of memory and repeatedly killing May, a mysterious figure you shared an intimate yet ambiguous relationship with.

details.title: Sound & Shoal
details.short_description: A surreal first-person narrative adventure about memory, loss, and the stories we tell ourselves. Explore an ever-changing world where reality and fantasy blur in search of meaning.

details.title: Apocalypse Train
details.short_description: Command a heavily armed, constantly moving train through a hostile post-apocalyptic wasteland. Manage your crew's hunger, mine for resources, upgrade your mobile base, and defend relentless monster attacks.

details.title: No More Turtles
details.short_description: No More Turtles is a plastic-producing incremental game. Start cranking grandpa's machine, loot abandoned warehouses, and pollute your way to saving a world overrun by turtles!

details.title: Operation: Doomed Peter
details.short_description: OPERATION : Doomed Peter is a dungeon crawler heavily inspired by the 80's and 90's games like rogue. Weapons include guns, voodoo magic, melee, and even thrown weapons! Fight through hordes of monsters consisting of over 35 uniqe encounters and 3 bosses!

details.title: Review Responder
details.short_description: As a review responder for an e-commerce store, you face various customer complaints and must make critical decisions. Will you sincerely apologize, firmly refute, or skillfully defuse the situation? Every choice impacts your store's performance and determines the course of your career.

details.title: DEGEN DROOLS
details.short_description: An autobattler where degenerate marshmallows fight automatically. Stick them with darts, roast them together, stack them on top of one another for more power, and gamble everything. THE ONLY THING TO BEWARE IS YOURSELF!

details.title: Starfall Samurai
details.short_description: Starfall Samurai blends slash-based action with incremental progression. Drag the mouse to aim your slash, then release as asteroids cluster together. Clear the screen in one strike, collect carrots, hone your sword techniques, and venture ever deeper into space.

details.title: Lean Into The Swarm
details.short_description: Direct a growing swarm of harvesters as it consumes procedurally generated worlds tile by tile. Upgrade your operation, steer the frontier, use Scorch, and carry permanent Salvage perks into each larger world.

details.title: CampSight
details.short_description: CampSight is a co-op horror photography roguelike where you explore a haunted campground, photograph strange wildlife, and earn enough to meet your quota. Search abandoned camps, caves, cabins, and dark trails but beware: some creatures run, some stalk you, and some should never be watched too long

name: Spirit Companion: My AI Roommate Can't Be This Adorable

details.title: Spirit Companion: My AI Roommate Can't Be This Adorable
details.short_description: Bansing is a 3D healing-style companion game deeply integrated with AI. There are no fixed scripted characters; players can create a friend or family member who understands their preferences and habits, always by their side.
developers: 深圳市心翎科技有限公司
publishers: 深圳市心翎科技有限公司

details.title: Blame Echoes
details.short_description: Blame Echoes is a first-person psychological horror under a frozen planet in alien ruins. Playing as pilot Adam Lorn, you explore a forgotten complex for your missing wife while facing a presence that somehow already knows you.

name: 三国模拟器之我有一个妙计

details.title: 三国模拟器之我有一个妙计
details.short_description: In a parallel universe text-based dialogue adventure game, a brand-new Three Kingdoms era is constructed. Players can freely choose to play as classic warriors, and each dialogue choice will lead to distinct and surprising events.

details.title: Nexaris: Starweb Dominion
details.short_description: Lead a living star network in this real-time 3D sci-fi strategy game. Expand from one stellar core, link orbital nodes, secure resources, and launch coordinated assaults as every connection reshapes your economy, defenses, and territorial control.

details.title: Crack the Stone
details.short_description: Minimalist desktop idle game that lives in the corner of your screen. Upgrade the water flow from a single drop to a steady stream and keep wearing the stone down. Someday it will crack. Patience always wins.

details.title: Glooky: Cursors in the City
details.short_description: In this co-op adventure game, play as cursors able to take control of various hosts in the decrepit city of Glooky. Make your way through puzzles, discover picturesque neighbourhoods and their peculiar inhabitants, and uncover the secret behind the sprawling metropolis…

details.short_description: The last train is gone, and Track 7 won't let you leave. Watch for anomalies: if something is wrong, turn back; if not, keep walking. One mistake and you start over. A short spot-the-anomaly horror in an eerily real Japanese station, from a series with over 100,000 copies sold.

Explore an infected city as Alex, search for your daughter, investigate clues, solve simple puzzles, and make critical choices. Recruit talented players, train rising stars, build your dream team, compete in leagues and tournaments, and lead your club to championship glory.

details.short_description: Run your dream pub, solo or with up to 4 friends. Pour pints, sling snacks, and keep the customers happy as service descends into chaos. Dive bar, sports bar, or village pub. Build and decorate it your way with new ways to play every run. How long can you keep the doors open?

details.short_description: Four Seasons Restaurant "is a restaurant management game that combines classic simulation management with a warm and healing art style. Whether you're reliving the classic joys of the past or experiencing the refreshing gameplay of the four seasons, this place will be your culinary sanctuary.

details.title: Pedal Pedal Pedal
details.short_description: A chaotic physics racer where two tiny riders share one oversized BMX. Each pumps, steers and brakes, and the bike only goes where you both agree. Race a friend on one keyboard or online, or ride solo and control both riders yourself.

details.short_description: ――My curfew is 8 PM. Having a helicopter mom is annoying, but it's not a big deal.

details.title: Cozy Farm Life Simulator
details.short_description: Turn a quiet patch of land into a cozy farm. Grow and sell crops, raise animals, evolve helpful pets, upgrade your equipment, and expand at your own pace in a relaxing first-person farming experience.

details.title: Town Hall
details.short_description: The town is half empty, but the town hall still opens at nine. You are the clerk. Whatever your stamp approves becomes true — permits, licenses, names, deaths. Everyone who reaches your desk brings a reason, and most bring money. In the basement, a file explains why the town emptied.

details.title: Bounced Out!
details.short_description: In Bounced Out! go it alone or team up with a friend to staff The Pound, a chaotic nightclub owned by "Mad Dog". As bouncers: check IDs, defuse situations, fight customers and make as much money as you can to avoid being fired by the boss!

details.short_description: The Seeker is a three-character roguelike deckbuilder with a separate furry LGBT visual novel. Combine characters and classes into one shared deck, choose your route, collect cards and Tarot Blessings, and earn rewards to unlock stories and new build options.

details.title: One with the Unicycleverse

details.short_description: Fight the Occupation Forces with Unique Super Powers! Destroy Helicopters, Drones, and Armored Vehicles. Explore "The Strip," protect its people, and rebuild a war-torn world. Welcome to Special Case

details.title: 帰宅 -kitaku-
details.short_description: I want to go home! Such a chilling experience awaits you.This is an exploration-based action horror game depicting the terrifying experience of a newly hired salaryman in an underground parking garage.

details.title: Rebel Sector

details.title: GAMING RAIDING
details.short_description: Third-person shooter games

details.title: Rotten Sails
details.short_description: A co-op horror about looting cursed islands for a cartel that won't go ashore itself. 1–4 players, in-game proximity chat, no weapons.

name: Sweet Order: Candy Shop Tidy Up!

details.title: Sweet Order: Candy Shop Tidy Up!
details.short_description: A magical candy shop is a sticky mess! Play as an adorable marshmallow in this cozy first-person cleaning and organizing sim. Vacuum up gummies, scrape away syrup, and sort colorful candies to perfection. No timers, no stress, just pure satisfaction!

details.title: Ecliptic
details.short_description: Ecliptic is a 3D Puzzle Adventure Game set in the Stars! Inspired by the mythological figures of the horoscope, embark on the hero's journey with the mysterious protagonist on a journey of identity and discovery.

details.short_description: Mawang: Dark Lord Defense is a real-time tactical tower defense game. As Princess Lua, defend the demon realm against the hero alliance. Build unique towers, manage unit morale, and use tactical pauses to repel invasions. Your strategy decides the demon realm's fate.

details.title: GrappleBurger
details.short_description: GrappleBurger is a high-management cooking game where multitasking is the only way to get your orders out. Master the chaos of the kitchen as you fry, blend, grill, and craft your way up the leaderboards! Do you have what it takes to be a top chef?

details.title: Threshold 15
details.short_description: Threshold 15 is an atmospheric mix of anomaly hunting and escape-room puzzles set in a looping bunker hallway. Identify disturbances and piece together an unsettling story as each loop pulls you deeper into the mystery. You will sign the contract.

details.title: The Embassy
details.short_description: Uncover the secrets of a government building that mysteriously still has power weeks after total societal collapse. This short narrative-driven horror game is a prequel for a DayZ map mod.

details.title: Varslo Tactics
details.short_description: Prove your worth as a commander in this turn-based tactical game with RPG elements! Level up your units to unlock traits and abilities to specialize their tactical usage. Fight to survive as war erupts across the continent!

details.title: Over the Radio

details.title: Optix: Cinematography Masterclass
details.short_description: Optix is a virtual workshop and sandpit that teaches you key concepts and techniques in lighting, camera, and composition. Play through 29 interactive lessons, design shots for clients in endless procedurally-generated scenarios, or experiment freely by building your own scenes from scratch!

details.title: Interwoven Dream
details.short_description: 《Interwoven Dream》 is a Victorian-era visual novel with multiple POVs. In 1884 London, four friends reunite after a string of disappearances, each with their own motives. Together, they dive into the city's darkest secrets, where dreams and reality blur.

details.title: Bet Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run the neighborhood betting shop! Print bet slips, count out change and watch the match with your customers. A goal shakes the whole shop, a losing slip gets a TV smashed. Clean up, decorate, expand.

details.title: Salt and Spice
details.short_description: From Mogadishu to Calcutta, master the bustling trade networks of the Indian Ocean during the golden age of maritime commerce.

details.title: Sushi Sewers
details.short_description: A fast-paced cyberpunk bullet-heaven where neon chaos, dark power, and endless enemy swarms collide. Survive the waves, create the strongest builds, and become unstoppable.

details.short_description: Fulfill your dream of becoming a glamour photographer, meet beautiful women from different cultures and backgrounds, and maybe even marry one of them!

details.title: 洛希极限 Roche Limit
details.short_description: ​Roche Limit​ is a 2D pixel sci-fi action roguelite, blending high-speed aerial combat with ARPG builds. Choose a mecha-girl, build her skills on the battle, and face the cosmic legion. Between runs, bond with the girls for more skill possibles and stories. Prevent cataclysm before the moon falls.

details.title: Reinvaders
details.short_description: Reinvaders is a short retro sci-fi shooter. Fight through four levels, dash past alien fire, and take down bosses in a tight arcade-style campaign.

details.title: Dreamsink

details.short_description: Become a master gunsmith. Repair, restore, customize, and test firearms in a detailed workshop simulator: buy parts, craft components, renovate classic weapons, and take them to the shooting range to prove your work

details.short_description: Seconded is a strategy-driven tavern management game about assigning the right companion to the right problem under pressure and uncertainty. Each request hides its true requirements, forcing you to read situations carefully rather than rely on explicit instructions.

details.title: Goldfish Gunner
details.short_description: Become the most wanted outlaw by taking on the role of Goldfish, a gunner robbing every bank in the Wild West. Escape across challenging, obstacle-filled landscapes where your only way to move is by firing your weapon and riding the recoil.

details.short_description: This is an innovative game that combines strategy, action and character development. David to the frontlines of the plant-animal alliance. Engage in fierce defensive battles against the powerful zombie horde, and uncover the fascinating stories behind every precious character in this world.

details.short_description: In Pepo Sort Master, take on high-speed sorting puzzles in a whimsical factory. Among the mysterious creatures called "Pepo" streaming down the line, "Pepo Imposters" are hiding in the mix. Master the art of Pepo inspection and earn your title as a certified Master Pepo!

name: Iron Offensive: Helmet Cam Extraction Shooter

details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about a young woman whose ordinary evening slowly descends into a nightmare. Uncover the truth, make the right choices, and survive the night.

details.title: Character House -Desktop Companion-
details.short_description: Character House: Desktop Companion is an idle collection game. Mix and match parts to create a companion that sits with you as you work, syncing with keystrokes, or watches from a corner. Earn rewards offline: pull and craft accessories,, shape its personality, and visit friends online!

details.short_description: Do Not Open This Box is a 3D first-person room escape game where players solve puzzles to escape after opening a forbidden box. Find, repair, and manipulate objects among antiques such as toys, books, and wine bottles. The space subtly changes as each puzzle is solved.

name: Nine Lives to Immortality: Did Kitty Break Through Today?

Train feline disciples, send them into secluded cultivation, breed kittens that inherit stronger talents and looks, then enter dungeons to fight, loot gear, farm skill stones, build skills, and challenge higher-realm foes.
