Explore the city as a tourist pigeon to spot elusive 'Kim Pigeons' hiding in the flock. Spot their unique features, snap a polaroid, and fill your scrapbook!

details.title: Homeless Survival
details.short_description: "Homeless: Survival" — a gritty survival sim where you play as a drifter clawing your way up from the streets. Take odd jobs, learn skills, scavenge rare items, and risk it all—even in the supernatural—to earn your citizenship and start over. Every choice writes your story of redemption.

details.title: Pet that Dog
details.short_description: Pet and collect 50+ breeds of dogs in our doggy dress up desktop companion! Every tap or click is a pet for your pup! If you pet your dog enough, they might dig up fun accessories you can use to dress them up!

name: Bungou Catharsis 文豪カタルシス

details.title: Bungou Catharsis 文豪カタルシス
details.short_description: Fall in love, and rewrite literary history. Romance legendary Japanese authors—including Osamu Dazai, Ryunosuke Akutagawa, Kenji Miyazawa, and Natsume Soseki—in a literary mystery visual novel. Your choices shape not only your romance, but also the fate of literary history itself.

details.title: Chronoform
details.short_description: A sci-fi precision puzzle-platformer where every death becomes a tool. Replay ghost echoes of your past runs to manipulate machinery, solve intricate timing puzzles, and escape a deadly research facility.

details.title: We Grow Together
details.short_description: Defend your starship in this endless sci-fi tower defense game! Form your ultimate squad of 2D heroes, permanently upgrade your spaceship's hull and defenses, and unleash powerful ultimate abilities to survive relentless waves of cosmic alien invaders in the vast void.

details.title: DANCING ZOMBIE
details.short_description: A sudden zombie outbreak has swept the city. You barely make it to a shelter, only to discover that five Host Dancing Zombies are hiding among the survivors, disguised as humans. Want to find them and take them down? Then, DANCE!

details.title: Cell Defense
details.short_description: Cell Defense is an incremental tower defense set inside the body. One antibody holds the center as endless waves of viruses and bacteria close in. Survive, earn, and spend it on weapons, build-defining cards, and upgrades that keep paying out while you idle.

details.title: Myrenvale Idle
details.short_description: Battle through Myrenvale in an incremental idle RPG. Defeat monsters, earn gold and experience, collect gear, train your hero, upgrade buildings, unlock talents, and rebirth for lasting power as each run pushes deeper into new regions.

details.title: Plonk! A 4D Puzzle
details.short_description: Plonk! A 4D Puzzle is a VR jigsaw where you piece together animated puzzles

details.title: GOD CORE
details.short_description: A hardcore shoot 'em up that takes you back to the golden age of arcades. As the rogue Martian fleet brings the chill of doomsday, the GOD CORE plunges into battle alone. One striker. One chance. Unleash everything. Hold nothing back.

details.title: Resound
details.short_description: "Echoes" is a science fiction narrative game. Players will take on the role of a member of the "Scientific Ethics Research Department", completing missions, battling enemies, and seeking out like-minded companions in a world devoid of anomalous management departments and containment organizations.

name: 你来定股价 You chart the stock price

details.title: 你来定股价 You chart the stock price
details.short_description: Want to pick up real-world financial knowledge while having fun? Driven by simulated financial data including the S&P 500, VIX, and bond yields, every decision you make ultimately draws your own one-of-a-kind stock price curve. How high will yours climb?

details.title: Gallop Diva: Ladies' Jockey Academy
details.short_description: Gallop Diva blends realistic horse racing physics with a deep story simulation. Master high-stakes horse racing and deep visual novel choices in a world where speed meets true human nature. Ride your horses, navigate choices, and outrun dark rules of the racetrack politics.

details.title: Holoplanet Architect
details.short_description: Try your hand as holoplanet architect! Place tetris-like pieces on the 3D grid of a planet hologram in a relaxed, lo-fi atmosphere to unlock new biomes and increase your highscore.

details.title: Turbowheels
details.short_description: Turbowheels is a dynamic car party game where you compete against your friends in a series of crazy game modes. Get behind the wheel, step on the gas, and prove your skills in a variety of challenges, ranging from frantic racing to total demolition chaos.

details.title: Kronopunk GP
details.short_description: Kronopunk GP is a VR motorcycle racing experience with a cyberpunk aesthetic, inspired by sim racing. Riding focuses on precision and flow rather than arcade-style handling. You control the bike using both head movement and hand positioning, while the heads up display provides information.

details.title: On the Green: Endless Golf
details.short_description: The golf roguelike. On the Green is a deckbuilder for the back nine. Your bag is the deck. Every swing rolls a die. Stack the deck, work the course, bury your rivals in the sand. One shot, one roll, one trophy at a time. Tee it up!

details.title: Reflections at Frostkorn
details.short_description: On the early morning he comes of age, Yu begins the sacred journey to the foothill of Mountain Frostkorn.

details.title: Finish Your Meatballs!
details.short_description: Finish Your Meatballs! is a galactic double stick shooter inspired in old classic arcade games. ¡Defeat multiple enemies and surpass your friends and THE WORLD with your best scores in various game modes!

details.title: Black Hole Idle
details.short_description: Start as a tiny black hole and grow by consuming asteroids, planets, and star systems. Automate your power, unlock upgrades, and devour the universe in this relaxing space idle incremental game.

details.title: Winds of Bounty
details.short_description: Winds of Bounty is a casual, fast-paced single and network multi player, competitive sailing exploration and treasure hunting game, featuring multiple game modes, including Treasure Hunt, Monster Hunt, Orb Hunt, Race, Arena, and Treasure Gallery!

details.title: Desktop Dice Ranch
details.short_description: Dice Ranch is a desktop idle game built around dice. Roll for coins, collect dice in all kinds of styles, breed their offspring on your ranch, unlock combos and talent skills, and go on expeditions to defeat powerful foes. Build the ultimate dice ranch of your own.

details.title: SUPERUSER
details.short_description: An ASCII bullet-heaven roguelite where you stack weapon modifiers, evolve your arsenal, and fight towering bosses. Turn bullets, blades, and fireballs into cascading destruction. Experiment with powerful combinations as enemies flood the arena.

details.title: SZKELETAL: Estrogen Dracul's Potato Hunger
details.short_description: Play as estrogen-fueled Dracul in this parodic roguelite 'yet another Vampire Survivors clone'. Fight off hordes of bums, haters, and similar ludolols, collect delicious potatoes, and upgrade your trashy arsenal. Survive this boring clunker, pee in the sink, and become the hobo of game scholarship!

name: ねこ巫女怪猫仕置ノ絵巻 -Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki-

details.title: ねこ巫女怪猫仕置ノ絵巻 -Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki-
details.short_description: "Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki" is an arcade-style action game where both allies and enemies are cats. Control the cat shrine maiden and her cat companions with the joystick, and run through the stages while defending against the fierce attacks of the monstrous cats with your feline companions.

name: 何以情堪·飞翔五十二里

details.title: 何以情堪·飞翔五十二里
details.short_description: 在一个本该平凡的周五，您与念白请假从西安前往广州参加婚礼，在前往高铁站的地铁上，似乎因为早上吃了不怎么干净的食物，导致有些腹泻，恰好站站有厕所，于是你们开启了“飞翔五十二里”的旅程。念白看似状态良好，但她似乎在隐瞒什么？当“从韦曲南8到北客站”真实上演，您能否掌控全局，带领念白平安抵达北客站呢？

details.title: WHIPLASH
details.short_description: WHIPLASH is a speedrunning FPS where game-changing weapon mods turn ordinary guns into overpowered builds. Craft the perfect loadout, master each course, and chase the perfect run.

details.title: Beats & Brains
details.short_description: Beats & Brains is a co-op rhythm beat 'em up game. Fight zombies to the beat as Mona and Lu to rescue your bandmate in the apocalyptic Toronto subways. Play co-op, stay in sync, and jam against the living dead. Compatible with classic guitar and drum controllers!

details.title: Anomaly Sweepers
details.short_description: Join a starship cleanup crew and take on bizarre jobs across space. Memorize each site before anomalies appear, then spot what changed and hold to remove it before time runs out. From a salon where hair regrows as fast as you cut it to a tango hall that won't stop dancing, 20 strange sites await.

details.title: Gridiron Football GM
details.short_description: Take over a fictional pro football team as its head coach and turn it into a dynasty. Set the game plan, call the plays, manage the cap, make trades, sign free agents and draft from a 130-program college league simulated alongside the pros.

details.title: Just A Watermelon
details.short_description: Put aside all the responsibilities, bills, and stress that come with being human. You’re just a watermelon.

details.title: X Calibur
details.short_description: X Calibur is a top-down hack-and-slash roguelike! Every run starts with building your own dungeon-crawler path. Collect sword parts, forge powerful builds, and become unstoppable! No checkpoints to save you from the robots. Do you have what it takes to reach the end?

details.title: Kinbound
details.short_description: Kinbound is a survival roguelike where you combine familiars, trigger synergies, and build completely absurd teams to survive hordes of enemies and bosses. Collect XP, choose your upgrades, strengthen your build, and survive as long as you can.

details.title: Scraw's Blooms
details.short_description: Design sunflower fields, control cross-pollination, and scale your harvest with careful or chaotic management. As the field's scarecrow, Scraw awaits perfect blooms while scaring off those pesky crows. What new varieties will you grow?

details.title: Hostile Process
details.short_description: A fast-paced top-down shooter where aiming is controlled by rotating the camera. Use your character’s enhanced abilities to carve the fastest route through each level. Chase faster times, earn ranks, and unlock new challenges.

details.title: Long Carnage
details.short_description: Long Carnage is a first-person cooperative horror game for up to 4 players. Explore an isolated house, find resources, restore power, and survive unique killers with their own mechanics in dynamic and unpredictable matches.

details.title: Quilt
details.short_description: Create a beautiful quilt one patch at a time. Solve handcrafted puzzles inspired by picross, minesweeper, and jigsaw puzzles, and uncover the hidden rules of the world through logic and experimentation.

details.title: Neural Drift
details.short_description: Play as an emerging AI inside a motherboard grid. Buy, place, and combine programs to make money, build powerful synergies, and decide whether the AI becomes ethical or ruthless.

details.title: MSO FreeCell Arena
details.short_description: Real-time multiplayer FreeCell. Same deal, real rivals: everyone gets the same shuffle and races to solve it, every race timed to the millisecond. Race the nightly Arena Hour, take the worldwide Daily Challenge, and try to beat the dev. Free to download and play. No microtransactions.

details.title: Idle Chest
details.short_description: Idle Chest is a simple incremental game where you open many chests, normal chests, golden chests, magic chests and other mysterious chests. Open chests, improve your chests, complete quests and loot rare equipments.

details.title: Vampires of the 99th Night
details.short_description: You are a cute vampire. There will be blood. Survive a grueling 99-night gauntlet of fast-paced hack-and-slash action, expand your dark domain, and decide who lives and who becomes your next meal. Death is inevitable, but your castle is eternal. Can you make it to the 99th night?

details.title: Zero Station: Interval
details.short_description: New employee wanted. Join the "Interval"—an interdimensional subway system. Armed with a ritual spear, navigate bureaucratic madness and eliminate anomalies threatening the multiverse. Uncover the cause of the system failure before the void claims you.

details.title: contract of the ninja
details.short_description: Contract of the Ninja is a stealth arcade game. Study enemy routes, strike with precision, and escape without being seen. Master precise controls, optimize your path, and complete contracts with maximum efficiency in fast, challenging stages.

details.title: SECTOR LOCKDOWN
details.short_description: Sector Lockdown is a fast-paced vehicle roguelite where the entire world hunts you down. Fight through hostile sectors, upgrade your car, unleash powerful weapons, and survive escalating pursuit levels in a neon-drenched world with no safe roads.

details.title: FocusScape: Lofi Productivity
details.short_description: FocusScape: Lofi Productivity is a minimalist productivity game where you manage tasks and daily objectives, focus with a built-in Pomodoro timer, customize ambient sounds and music, and earn levels to unlock regions of Midreach and uncover quiet journal entries along the way.

details.title: Misguided Remastered
details.short_description: Misguided Remastered: Third-person action-horror. Silvia, high school girl trapped in otherworld nightmare. Desperately search for missing best friend & mom's cherished letter her only memory. Survive Indonesian folklore horrors with axe/knife combat, solve puzzles, uncover dark secrets!

name: The Academy of the Cosmic Realm

details.title: The Academy of the Cosmic Realm
details.short_description: The Academy of the Cosmic Realm is a short first-person horror game where you explore an old abandoned academy to discover what terrible event led to it's closure.

details.title: Rhythm Rumble
details.short_description: Rhythm Rumble is a colorful, adventurous, and high-energy rhythm game. Feel the groove of the music as you dance your way around enemy attacks—then strike back and finish them!

details.title: Sunset Sprinters '98
details.short_description: Relive the glory days of 1998 in this high-speed precision runner. You have no health bar—only a Snack Meter that drains constantly. Smash obstacles, collect aluminum cans for rental money, find CDs for your SpinDisk, and sprint from the Middle School to MegaHits Video before the sun sets.

details.title: Zombie Craft
details.short_description: Zombie Craft is an open-world survival, farming, ranching, factory-building, and trading game inspired by many beloved classics. Explore the continent freely, rebuild villages, and earn your fortune. And whatever you do—prepare for the night. They are coming.

details.title: Rogualik
details.short_description: Rogualik is a rogue-like dungeon crawler where you uncover dark, scary secrets of a surrealistic sweet-filled world. Use ridiculous makeshift kitchen weapons, upgrade your croissant with "Mise en place" assets and defeat all the crumbs that stand in your way!

details.title: GO BLO
details.short_description: Lead a crowd of little men through clever tactical puzzles, tricky obstacles, and unexpected twists. Solve handcrafted levels, play community creations, and build your own challenges with a level editor.

details.title: Cosmic Gold Rush
details.short_description: You’re not the ship—you’re a fragile prospector with a jetpack. Haul gold, deploy robots and defend your operation from meteor storms, aliens and pirates. Gear up between expeditions—but mine fast: a rival can take the claim while you’re still alive.

details.title: TowerMancer II
details.short_description: TowerMancer II is a deckbuilder where you build medieval towers under constant assault from invaders, using cards to gather resources, deploy rooms and creatures, and discover synergies that transform a simple structure into an improbably powerful fortress.

details.title: Rodent Rampage
details.short_description: Rodent Rampage is a third-person hero shooter. Combine nitrous boosted ground maneuvers, soda powered aerial attacks, and quirky in game power ups in a one-of-a-kind, PvP combat experience.

details.title: You Can (Not) Do It!!
details.short_description: A fast-paced pixel art 2D platformer focused on high-skill parkour, where you dodge traps, clear tight gaps, and master abilities like wall sliding and double jumps across short, intense levels.

details.title: UNFATED
details.short_description: A realistic first-person action shooter set in an open-world post-apocalyptic setting. Survive, resist, and conquer a world devastated by invaders. Team up, explore the terrain, and reclaim the fate of humanity.

details.title: Shadow Runner
details.short_description: The first FPS where enemies are invisible? You see only their shadows. To fight, you must follow the light—control it, even create it. With one gun, fireflies, and fireworks, survive a little longer. A minimalist system with unexpected depth. An FPS poem about light, shadow, architecture, and memory

details.title: Mira - Shadow of the Past
details.short_description: Travel. Go back. Erase your regrets.

details.title: Roll For Damage!
details.short_description: A light dice-based dungeon crawl. Roll numerous dice and see fortunes expand across various distinct stages.

details.title: Paranormal Research Society
details.short_description: Build a career as a paranormal field researcher in an exciting horror comedy about finally getting a job and gunning down ghosts while performing menial labor for your infuriating boss.

details.title: Recovered Occurrence
details.short_description: A new home owner documents his experience moving to Frailrock, unaware of the many unsetting events he would begin to witness there.

details.title: On Sight
details.short_description: On Sight is a love letter to classic shooters that drops players into high energy gunfights in arenas across the galaxy. Play with friends, strangers, or solo with bot support on every map.

details.title: Escape from Ashville
details.short_description: Loot, fight and extract — or lose everything. A high-risk extraction shooter focused on survival, tactical combat, and meaningful decisions.

name: Reunions with you billions of times

details.title: Reunions with you billions of times
details.short_description: This is a short, romance-focused visual novel where you play as a student. As you fall in love with your classmate Qiu, you become trapped in a time loop and die again and again. Together with Qiu, you must search for a way to break the loop, with your choices leading to different endings.

details.title: ZHITEN
details.short_description: Some villages aren't just abandoned, they are cursed. Zhiten, a victim of clashing cults, awakens from its slumber with Nikolay's return. While Nikolay searches for traces of the past, he will be forced to meet the village's new owners.

details.title: Mad MOJO
details.short_description: Mad MOJO is a monster-catching deckbuilder with a deep, fourth-wall-breaking meta game hidden beneath the surface. Hunt for the legendary Prime MOJO with poker-inspired hands. Break the game by tackling puzzles in an in-game PC. But beware of the MOJO hiding just beyond your reach...

details.title: 6RAVITY CUBE
details.short_description: “Novel 6-direction gravity puzzle‑action game!” Packed with diverse gimmicks — experience intuitive yet strategically deep puzzle‑solving!

details.title: Reaction
details.short_description: Fly your ship though a derelict space station in this action/puzzle 2D platformer as you avoid hazards, repair your ship back to working condition and uncover the mysteries within. What awaits inside and can you get out again?

details.title: Humanity's Fall
details.short_description: Explore the world of Humanity's Fall, a fantasy farming sim. Interact and build a community with the world's next apex lifeform. Build your farm and rediscover lost flora as you discover the world's lore.

details.title: Crosstown
details.short_description: An overload of 8-bit-style action mayhem, Crosstown hands you a toga and a gun, and lets you loose in an ever-changing maze full of monsters and explosions! 40 levels, up to 4 players, and an endless mode!

details.title: Serenity
details.short_description: A zen gliding and exploration game with procedurally generated music

details.title: Subway Story
details.short_description: A narrative-driven exploration game set in the New York City subway, where you ride trains, interact with strangers, and make choices that shape how the city's underbelly responds.

details.title: For the Glory of Wilson
details.short_description: For the Glory of Wilson is an action roguelite where you recruit allies who fight alongside you and influence every battle.

details.title: Pumpkin Survivor
details.short_description: Pumpkin Survivor is a whimsical cartoon-style survival game where you’ll experiment with countless weapon builds to defend against relentless enemy waves. Mix and match abilities, upgrade your pumpkin hero, and survive as long as possible in this roguelike adventure!"

details.title: Booost!! CleanSweep
details.short_description: Take control of the 'Cleaning Cart' and clean up a filthy city! But beware of the Litterbugs who scatter trash everywhere! Faster, cleaner, better. This is a score-attack car action game.

details.title: Which Sea Is This?
details.short_description: Which Sea Is This? is a local co-op sea adventure where you control a single ship together. Trade, explore, pirate, and argue about directions — because nobody knows where you are.

details.title: Dwarven Mining Company
details.short_description: Manage your own dwarven mine. Give orders to miners excavating ore and builders providing them with ladders to get deeper and deeper into the underground. Mine iron, copper and even mithrill to satisfy the needs of the dwarven kingdom for the price of a single coffee.

details.title: Lost Dude
details.short_description: Lost Dude is an atmospheric 2D platform-adventure game that follows a character who sets out on a journey to find their lost friend, experiences various events along the way, and embarks on new adventures together after reuniting.

details.title: Type The Rhythm
details.short_description: A rhythm typing trainer where you type real words to a variety of musical styles. Augmented proprioception lets you move the grooves between your brain and fingers for faster, cleaner typing. From hunt-and-peck to 150 WPM blindfolded, Type The Rhythm moves you forward.

details.title: Gunfort
details.short_description: Gunfort is a tower defense game where your army is competent and well-funded. The city is surrounded, and horrors are coming down every road. Build turrets, call in commanders, and hold the line. Watch your brilliant strategy unfold or discover exactly how much government money you can waste.

details.title: DepotDash
details.short_description: Fast-paced top-down construction yard simulator where you manage deliveries, move materials with heavy machines, and keep suppliers happy before your depot overflows.

details.title: NightMeer
details.short_description: NightMeer is a 2D exploration adventure about the nights you can't sleep. Wrapped in the pressure of having to fall asleep now, Noah drifts through her darkened room. Guide her with a click, and slowly let the tension leave her body and mind. How she gets through this night is up to you.

details.title: Alien Idolz: Rhythmic Idler
details.short_description: Alien Idolz is a 4-lane rhythm game with an incremental twist. Hit the notes, harvest love from your alien stans, and exploit the skill tree to break the stats and clear increasingly difficult tracks.

details.title: Infinite Crosswalk
details.short_description: Infinite Crosswalk is a psychedelic walking simulator and horror game in retro 3D style. You get hit on a zebra crossing and trapped in limbo. Uncover the victims' tragic stories to escape — or pay with parts of your own body.

details.title: BROMS: Battle Royale Management Simulator
details.short_description: A management simulation game where you run a battle royale. Host matches to increase revenue from gacha requests, expand the map, and place objects to improve the environment. You can also play on the maps you create yourself.

details.title: Charon 卡戎
details.short_description: A point-and-click narrative puzzle game with a delicate art style and soothing pace. In this Underworld at the end of all things, guide souls who lost their memories and speech safely across the Styx. Luckily, our protagonist is about to face the most restless bunch of them all...

details.title: Ants Took the Kitchen
details.short_description: In Ants Took the Kitchen, you lead a small colony of ants determined to take over the kitchen. Collect crumbs, carry increasingly larger pieces of food, buy upgrades for each area, automate the collection process, and turn a simple corner of the floor into a hungry swarm.

details.title: Dice Knight
details.short_description: Dice knight is a dice builder rouge like. Roll for numbers and use those numbers on different actions. Discover food items of power, and become the Dice Knight!

details.title: Eclipse Island Primal Odyssey
details.short_description: Survive on a mysterious island where every choice shapes your journey. Explore ancient ruins, gather resources, craft essential tools, battle dangerous wildlife, and uncover the secrets hidden deep within Eclipse Island in this immersive story-driven survival adventure.

name: How To Get A Goth GF: 101

details.title: How To Get A Goth GF: 101
details.short_description: You’re down bad, your rizz is questionable, but goth girls are about to become your entire personality. Indigo’s evening course will teach you how to treat a goth girl right. Pass her lessons, survive the red flags, and pull a goth mommy - or get left on read in this chaotic dating-sim.

details.title: DJINN SCROLLS
details.short_description: Djinn Scrolls is an action roguelike set in a dark world inspired by ancient Jinn folklore. Wield elemental magic and Prime Scrolls that unleash spells through conditional triggers. Craft deadly synergies, adapt your build mid-run, and survive relentless enemies and cursed bosses.

details.title: The Pyroxene Ages
details.short_description: This is a top-down, loot-based RogueLite game. You can build a town, craft weapons and socket them with various gems, then embark on adventures across maps you construct yourself.

details.title: New Game+ - Game Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run the game store you never wanted to leave, from the late ’90s to today. Buy, sell and repair games, haggle over trade-ins, and hunt for rare finds. Customize your shop and fill your shelves with parodies that make you laugh, cringe, or remember the games you grew up with.

details.title: Oath for Glory
details.short_description: Join the tournament as a lowly knight of a small village. A skill-based boss fighting game built around directional combat. Learn, adapt, and master precise melee mechanics where player skill determines victory.

details.title: Wanderfolk
details.short_description: A farming RPG where villagers remember everything. Grow crops, forage, and explore a procedurally generated world, then talk to AI-powered NPCs who form real opinions about you. Build friendships, pursue romance, fight monsters (or stay peaceful), and become part of a living village community.

details.title: Seal The Breach
details.short_description: A 3D survival experience set within a cramped one-man submarine exploring a hostile ocean trench.

details.title: AI VS ARTISTS
details.short_description: Prove the power of human artists in this narrative-driven story game! Do you have what it takes to dethrone Scylla Corporation?

details.title: One Billion Ducks
details.short_description: An incremental journey about duck hunting with your canine companions. Shoot rare ducks, sell them, upgrade your abilities, and collect one billion ducks to combat world hunger!

details.title: 你离开之后
details.short_description: 《你离开之后》是一款文字互动类乙女向游戏，再次醒来时你发现自已似乎已经是一缕魂魄了，你的爱人在你离开后变得敏感脆弱，而你的行为将会或直接或间接的影响到他，最终走向不同的结局。 一款美味的鳏夫文学，你的冷漠与无视会让向来冷静矜持的爱人在你面前发疯变得歇斯底里，你的捉弄会让他在梦里情难自已，你的一举一动都会让他改变，你离开之后，他活成了你的样子，或是你想要的样子。

details.title: PWC Simulator
details.short_description: PWC Simulator is a jet ski simulator with online racing, freestyle, and mod support. Ride stand-up and sit-down skis with simulated water, hull and rider weight. Customize your rider and ski, race buoy courses or freeride in surf and flatwater, or flip and do tricks on flip skis.

details.title: HOLO-KINGDOM
details.short_description: This is a 3D action game where you control Hololive members and fight your way through enemies to clear each stage.Carefully read enemy attacks and overcome challenging trials using parries and evasive maneuvers.This game requires keyboard and mouse controls.

details.title: Marmorea
details.short_description: Venture into the Tuscan village of Pietralba to solve the mystery of your brother’s disappearance. Uncover the dark secrets buried within the marble quarries and your own family's past.

details.title: D-Extinction
details.short_description: D-Extinction is a first-person investigative horror game. A secret experiment went too far. Now the pre-historic predators are loose. Explore, investigate, and survive in a immersive horror experience where one mistake can kill.

details.title: Bus Terminal Simulator
details.short_description: Experience an immersive terminal management simulator. Manage passengers, organize schedules, inspect luggage, catch smugglers, and prevent illegal activities. Not every passenger is innocent — some will try to trick you or smuggle illegal items. Stay alert and run your terminal efficiently.

details.title: Beyond Yardwork Simulator
details.short_description: Gardening has never been this rewarding! Use a full arsenal of tools – from lawnmowers to pressure washers – to transform properties and earn money to renovate your own home. With intuitive mechanics and beautiful visuals, it’s the perfect stress-free relaxation for everyone.

details.title: Curse Of The Abandoned Floor
details.short_description: Curse Of The Abandoned Floor is a first-person Chinese horror game. It starts with a paranormal video about an urban legend: "Beware the non-existent elevator mezzanine. If you enter it, you will be trapped forever."

details.title: Skylane: Airline Tycoon Sim
details.short_description: Run an airline the competent way you wish they were like in real life. Open routes, buy aircraft, build the weekly schedule, and hire crew qualified to fly it. No cockpits, no cutscenes. Just the network, the numbers, and fierce rivals aiming to take a cut of your market share.

details.title: Bounce Rush 跟你爆了
details.short_description: A pinball-action × roguelike strategy game. Launch balls to smash enemies, equip turrets and skills, and craft your own build from hundreds of combinations. Three modes: turn-based tactics, real-time combat, and stage-based challenges.

details.title: Tactical Commanders R
details.short_description: Tactical Commanders R revives the classic large-scale sci-fi strategy warfare of the original Tactical Commanders. Command your forces, control the battlefield, and experience intense real-time strategic combat once again.

details.title: Backframes: Escape Together
details.short_description: Backframes: Escape Together is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Explore dark levels, solve dangerous puzzles, and escape from sinister entities. Use your voice to interact with objects, uncovering unexpected paths to survival.

details.title: ZOPHARION
details.short_description: They react to your every move. Fight, run, or disappear. Every decision buys time. Every mistake gets you killed.

name: You Said I Could Nap After This

details.title: You Said I Could Nap After This
details.short_description: A cat's nap can wait. Hunt mice with your pointer, spend gold on stronger paws, and turn small attacks into screen-filling chain reactions in this incremental game. Unlock new attacks and mouse types, enter Fever mode, and crack reward orbs for gold and toys.

details.title: Who Killed Mr X
details.short_description: You wake up locked up in an unknown place with 8 strangers. Who are these people ? Why are you here ? You have a bad feeling. But suddenly, the phone rings, and it's up to you : Will you dare answer and go deeper in this mysterious plot ? Will you reveal the horrible truth... and survive it ?

details.title: Road Meal
details.short_description: A driving game. A cursed artifact. Race to complete deliveries on behalf of a company with roots deeper than human tools can cut.

details.title: Beyond the Rain Sound
details.short_description: You are the player, exploring a hospital that appears in your dreams while collecting fragments of memory and discovering what happened to you in this psychological horror game. As the story progresses, you will be forced to confront yourself. What awaits you beyond that...

details.title: 花散る社のハナビメ
details.short_description: Hanachiru Shrine no Hanabime is a Japanese-inspired sorting and idle game where you gather faith by discerning people's wishes and restore a once-abandoned sacred shrine. Enjoy a unique blend of peaceful, relaxing moments and fast-paced shrine duties as you rebuild the divine sanctuary.
developers: ハナビメプロジェクト
publishers: ハナビメプロジェクト

details.title: Pinball Millionaire
details.short_description: A physics pinball incremental game where every bounce earns money, triggers upgrades, and turns your board into a chaotic money-making machine.

details.title: Fetidity
details.short_description: Dive into the mysterious and terrifying world of Fetidity and help Mark solve all the puzzles and discover the secret of this place.

details.title: Open Skies
details.short_description: The deep Aerobiz successor. Build a turn-based airline empire across 175 real cities, painted like the 90s Koei classics: court sixty patrons, hire executives, make the Herald's front page, and outplay rivals that follow your rules and play to win.

details.title: Diavento of Skyroar
details.short_description: The only weapon is the “Blade.” This is a bullet-hell action game that emphasizes the thrill of attacking. There are no attacks you can just fire off indiscriminately. Pilot the combat robot “Diavento,” dodge enemy attacks to build up energy, and turn the tide with a single strike.

details.title: SWIFTALE PLAYER
details.short_description: [Japanese language only] Solo TTRPG powered by your own LLM. All in-game text and player input are in Japanese; there is no English support.

details.title: Project Miasma: Prelude
details.short_description: A first-person sci-fi survival horror game. Board abandoned ships, explore their dark corridors, uncover what happened to their crews, and survive threats you cannot fight as something watches from the dark.

details.title: LIMINAL
details.short_description: You arrive skinless in an endless, fogbound world. Cross into 47 impossible realms, kill what lives there, and take gifts that mutate your body until you are worse than anything hunting you. Stay too long and the ground dissolves beneath you.

details.title: Heatline
details.short_description: Heatline is a single-player open-world cops-and-racers game. Race as an outlaw, escape police pursuits, and unlock a police career to hunt down rivals. Customize your cars, equip pursuit tech, and decide when to push for bigger rewards or return to base to bank your earnings.

details.title: Succubus Busy Line
details.short_description: #Urban Fantasy Visual Novel Game#1v2 Demon Romance (BL)# You're a low-ranking succubus who just came of age in Demon City. All you want is to work hard and live a peaceful life, but two extraordinary demons keep stirring up trouble in your world...

details.title: Routes and Forges
details.short_description: A unique blend of RTS, Tycoon, and Tower Defense, where you are the architect, mayor, and commander of a growing village (and conurbation of villages). Your goals are simple: build a prosperous community, optimize production chains, and survive the horrors that emerge from the dark.

details.title: Arithmancy
details.short_description: Um dungeon crawler em primeira pessoa onde sua única arma é uma calculadora de bolso. Toda porta quer um número. Toda tecla que você aperta se desgasta. E quando o relógio do andar acaba, você vai ouvir passinhos.

details.title: Angel Ascension Exam: RE
details.short_description: The Angel Ascension Test. Join Marie, an apprentice angel, and take on brutal challenges with precise drag-jump controls in this hardcore platformer. Claim your place among the angels!

details.title: Kindling Wilds: Symbiotic Wasteland
details.short_description: Ember: Symbiotic Wilderness is a 2D pixel-art co-op survival game set in a living wilderness shaped by temperature, weather, seasons, and ecology. Start with a single fire, divide the work with your team, and build a camp that can endure.

details.title: Global Supremacy
details.short_description: A vast, real-time geopolitical simulation where 196 nations live and breathe at once. Economy, finance, monetary policy, trade, energy, military, diplomacy, nuclear strategy, politics, society — every lever that moves a nation is in your hands. The clock never stops — until you stop it.

details.title: Auto Empire Tycoon
details.short_description: Start in the 1950s with a small factory and a single dealership. Research new technologies, design cars, manage production, keep your dealerships stocked, and outpace your rivals to build your own automotive empire in this isometric tycoon simulation.

details.title: Neuro Cell
details.short_description: A survival horror game set in a dark, foggy city. Survive against fast, aggressive enemies whose brains are controlled by a rogue computer network. Manage your low ammo, explore dangerous streets, and stop the system before it hunts you down.

details.title: Project RESONANCE
details.short_description: Recruit AI bandmates with their own looks and stories, run a maid café together, and turn everyday moments into songs. Every album is generated live for your story—no two bands sound alike. Take music that's yours alone from a street-corner livehouse to the city's biggest stage.

details.title: Once Apond a Time
details.short_description: You crash down in a giant pond during a terrible storm. As you seek help for your broken wing, you'll meet new friends, explore the islands, and collect & craft items. Discover a heartfelt story about friendship and healing, all in a cosy 2.5D style.

details.title: Pawns into the Dark
details.short_description: Everything is visible but the Dark. Reveal tiles beside your pawns, step by step, in an 8×8 board-game-inspired tactical puzzler. Uncertain exploration meets deterministic combat. No misses, no critical hits: 3 ATK defeats a pawn with 3 HP. Read what's visible, use limited resources, and survive.

details.title: Slash And Dash
details.short_description: Step into the shoes of a shape-shifting hero and dash through random realms in this pixel-art action runner rogue-lite! Can you defeat powerful bosses and save the world? Collect diamonds, upgrade your stats, and prepare for the ultimate showdown!!!

details.title: Not Quite Trash
details.short_description: Dig through one giant pile of junk, organize your finds, and sell them in your own shop! Meet quirky customers, discover ridiculous items, upgrade your business, and turn trash into profit, one day at a time.

details.title: Wuxing Zodiac
details.short_description: Wuxing Zodiac is a roguelite deckbuilding game where cards inspired by the Five Elements and Zodiac Signs create endless strategic possibilities. Build powerful combos, score big, and overcome the mysterious Cursed Chips.

details.title: Hearthside: Your Custom Fireplace
details.short_description: A cozy, customizable fireplace simulator and desktop companion. Relax to soothing soundscapes and crackling flames, personalize the hearth with your own art and wall text, or boost focus with built-in productivity widgets like Pomodoro, to-dos, and Lo-Fi beats.

name: Garuya and the Kaleidoscope of Syzygy

details.title: Garuya and the Kaleidoscope of Syzygy
details.short_description: Explore and fight as Garuya, a rabbit mage who seeks to destroy an ancient relic hidden in a vast and dangerous ruined kingdom. Cast spells, reshape the environment and fight under the light of three moons.

details.title: Frutiger Aero Horror Alpha 2
details.short_description: You flip PCs as a hobby. An unbelievable flea market find from 2015 turns into a nightmare. The moment you boot this Windows 7 setup, a blinding force sucks you straight into the monitor. Now you are trapped in the strange futuristic world of Frutiger Aero. No soul is in sight. Or so it seems...

details.title: Echoes In Static
details.short_description: This is an animatronic horror experience where machines are superior and humans are inferior.

details.title: Oshi Trade Simulator
details.short_description: A simulation game about oshi merch collecting and trading culture. Pull from the gacha, trade on the board, and build your dream collection. Unlock skills for an addictive collecting rush that keeps your favs piling up!

details.title: ST UNLIMITED
details.short_description: 《ST UNLIMITED》 A free and hilarious 2D pixel exploration RPG. You are the Dream Voyager. Worlds await.

details.title: Escape from Gridlock
details.short_description: A single-player turn-based pixel-art tactical extraction game. Enter the sealed-off zone, scavenge supplies, complete tasks, fight enemies, and extract before things fall apart. Bring loot back to your base, craft gear, unlock weapon skills, and prepare for the next expedition.

details.title: Desert Survival
details.short_description: Survive 15 minutes in a desert that wants you dead. Fight swarms out of Arabian folklore, forge elemental builds and weapon evolutions, answer daily contracts, and grow stronger between runs with deep skill trees. Free to play - every run tells a different story.

details.title: The Last Lunch
details.short_description: A psychological cooking horror game set in a post-Soviet school. Cook meals, explore the school and its surroundings, and uncover the disturbing story hidden behind an ordinary cafeteria shift.

details.title: Midnight Haunting
details.short_description: The road home is never safe. Midnight Haunting is a 2D survival action game that demands the deliberate controls of a classic cinematic platformer. Survive a haunting, twisted midnight street riddled with deadly traps to reach the safety of your front door. Your next step could always be your last.

details.title: Sort the Tapes!
details.short_description: Sort the Tapes! is a cozy organization sim set in a small-town American video rental store in the 2000s. Sort 3,030 VHS tapes by genre, handle customer returns, watch tapes on the VCR, and find audio cassettes to play on the boombox.

details.title: Holy Relic Shop Simulator
details.short_description: A medieval shopkeeping sim about appraising holy relics. Examine bone, metal, wood and documents in your pilgrim city, find the detail that doesn't fit, pass your verdict — then decide what to do with the truth. A mother begs for a miracle you know is fake. What do you sell?

details.title: Normal Human Jobs
details.short_description: A first-person incremental shooter about eight regular office jobs disguised as an evil robot experiment. Sweep, sort, shoot and buy upgrades until the job runs itself. Finish all eight and the CEO chair is yours.

details.title: KISI: The Deja Vu
details.short_description: 〈KISI: The Deja Vu〉 is a 3D anomaly-detection psychological horror adventure game based on the eerie sense of familiarity felt in a sanity-bending experimental facility—the phenomenon known as "Déjà Vu."

details.title: Across the Dark
details.short_description: A perilous quest to the Demon Lord's castle, where one mistake means death. Conquer foes using 4 heroes—Bloodslayer, IronGuard, GrandMage, SwiftHealer—and 8-slot card synergies. No fast reflexes required. Only your meticulous deck building and health management will save you.

details.title: Colosseum Infection
details.short_description: "Build your unique strategy stress-free, with zero time pressure! Combine synergies, augments, and items to form an unstoppable army. Step into immersive unit-view combat, taking direct control with manual movement and tactical potion throws to reverse the odds in this strategic auto-battler."

details.title: Towerburst
details.short_description: An incremental tower defense game where you fight enemies using unique tower combinations. Gather resources from fallen enemies, unlock and upgrade your towers, discover new tower synergies and defeat every enemy before your towers run out of shots.

details.title: Rewind Together
details.short_description: Join your brother on an epic time-travel adventure! Solve puzzles together across Ancient Egypt, the Middle Ages, and the Wild West to find your way back home. Don't forget to take photos!

details.title: SubQuest
details.short_description: SubQuest is a productivity game that grows with you, right on your desktop. Cute characters, endless adventures, and a diorama where your heroes rest between quests — decorate it however you like! Notes, to-dos, Time-Quests — get your work done side by side with your hero party!

details.title: VORA
details.short_description: Seeking shelter from the bitter cold after a car accident, you take refuge in an old cave. What seemed like salvation quickly turns into a nightmare.

details.title: Doodle Figure
details.short_description: Doodle Figure is a VR party game for one headset and a room full of phones.

details.title: Jingle Balls
details.short_description: Santa is injured and the gift list is gone. Jingle Balls is a first-person co-op horror game for 1–4 players. Search each house for clues, choose the right gift, and leave it without being seen. House layouts change between visits. Face different enemies and use a range of items.

details.title: Fort Synergy Demo
details.short_description: A funny co-op tower defense game where you and your friends need to work together to defend yourselves against all the incoming waves of monsters! Decide whether to roam the map or stay near the towers!

details.title: Thieving Together
details.short_description: You and your crew have one goal: break in, grab everything, and get out before sunrise. Thieving Together is a chaotic physics PvP & co-op heist party game. Drag loot, dodge rivals, stack the van fast. Everything wobbles. Everyone steals. Biggest haul by sunrise wins.

details.title: GearGrave
details.short_description: 2D side-scrolling strategy game. Spawn units, fight, and destroy. Your choices decide victory or defeat.

details.title: 字走三国
details.short_description: Hidden within the words lies a chilling killing intent; the chess pieces radiate a boundless fighting spirit. Tiny words weave the Three Kingdoms narrative, yet aspire to contain profound emotions.

details.title: Radical Tower Defense
details.short_description: In Radical Tower Defense, harness shifting core chips to forge a unique steel defense. Each choice reshapes your combat style. Unlock architectures, explore chip synergies, ignite tactical reactions. Don’t just defend—become a blade to break formations, strike the heartland, crush the enemy lair!

details.title: HOLER!
details.short_description: Dig, dig, and DIG! One meter deeper, one second longer. A relentless mining action game where you plunge into an endless underground world! Your only rival is your past self. The eternal challenge to shatter your own "Best Record" begins now!

details.title: Hidden Streets
details.short_description: Find cats and hidden objects in illustrated streets full of detail.

details.title: 夏飢聲（なきごえ）
details.short_description: A first-person horror adventure game featuring a side story (spin-off) scenario based on “Kyoso Musebiya” by “Obaken.” Guided to Musebiya, the protagonist ventures into a mysterious underground space. What choices will they make, and what fate awaits them…?

details.title: Planet Sweep Company
details.short_description: Clean up the danger zone on an undeveloped planet and find hidden landmines! Planet Sweep Company is a game that brings the familiar fun of Minesweeper into 3D space. Analyze the number hints to deduce landmines, plant flags to clear dangerous zones, and build up your achievements!

details.title: Fantasy Mountains
details.short_description: Paper Mountain is the first chapter in Fantasy Mountains. A casual, friendly, single‑player VR climbing game. Enter a fantasy paper world. Meet and interact with the mountain creatures along the path. Collect useful and less useful items. Find your way to the mountaintop.

details.title: Tyrants Must Fall
details.short_description: In this turn-based tactical roguelike, build an army to triumph in fast-paced battles. Deploy your troops, plan your attack, and watch as the action plays out simultaneously. Unlock powerful formations and guide the Hero of Destiny as he topples the Tyrant King!

details.title: Sunny Hollow
details.short_description: Move to a magical city to live with your grandmother and make it your home. Explore vibrant districts, build relationships with 100+ villagers who remember how you treat them, help with errands and jobs, fish at the waterways, customize your home, and discover the stories throughout Sunny Hollow.

details.title: Astral Bloom
details.short_description: Grow a living alien world in this incremental base-builder. Cultivate strange plants, command loyal wisps, and reshape the sky with powerful wishes. Automate and expand your ecosystem as you uncover lost memories. As your sanctuary grows, will you stay... or leave in search of something more?

name: I Want To Be a Child

details.title: I Want To Be a Child
details.short_description: Family is the most precious thing you have. No matter what, right

details.title: Confessional: Reality TV Manager
details.short_description: A reality TV production management game. Cast, create or download contestants, design your season, and watch drama unfold in the most complex relationship sim ever created. Scout hidden talent, manage moods, watch challenges play out, and survive dramatic tribal councils. Build your franchise.

details.title: Min5 Min - Party Edition
details.short_description: "Fast, competitive, and sugar-coated! Min5 Min is designed for those looking for intense action in a short amount of time. Equipped with a variety of characters and powerful weapons, you have a minimum of 5 minutes to survive in this stylized world!"

details.title: EIDOL
details.short_description: Craft living statues from Oak, Stone, and Steel. Infiltrate a corrupt guild as you rise through the ranks in this hand-drawn dark fantasy card game set in an ancient world. Every eidol you build is a reflection of your mastery.

name: The Ghost Protocol: Echoes of Steel

details.title: The Ghost Protocol: Echoes of Steel
details.short_description: Command a squad of broken survivors on a planet that hunts you. A tactical mech-action game, you must build your base, defend against crystalline swarms, and manage the "Icarus Drift"—a neural link that grants god-like power but costs your humanity. Will you break the enemy, or become part of it?

details.title: Z Drive
details.short_description: Drive, explore, search for resources, and craft! And drive! Do it for as long as you can! This FPS takes place in a rough world after a zombie attack. Prepare your wheeled fortress for every possible adventure! Explore the dead world and search for the remnants of civilization.

details.title: Spooky Lord
details.short_description: Become the Lord of Fear! Command a team of spooky spirits, each with unique powers, to haunt or outwit humans in this tactical ghost game. Choose your approach, master your minions, and control the world of the living!

details.title: Incremental Heaven
details.short_description: Start as a tiny mech, spread as a cosmic parasite, or rewrite reality as a living cursor. Destroy enemies, unlock hundreds of upgrades, evolve through massive transformations, and grow from scrapyard survivor to universe-shaping power.

details.title: Runic Tower
details.short_description: Stand as the last guardian of the god-bound Runic Tower in a groundbreaking 3rd-person roguelike tower defense experience. Command evolving powers, confront relentless invading factions, and utilize strategic planning to overcome your foes!

details.title: Slingbox
details.short_description: A minimalist physics platformer built on momentum. Dash, tether, and launch through a decaying simulation: zero gravity first, then gravity and corruption. Beat the clock, earn medals, perfect every route.

details.title: By The Orchid
details.short_description: 中式原生家庭环境下，少年找寻存在方式的故事。

details.title: Snack Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own snack shop where eating snacks makes you stronger! Order 45+ treats online, stock shelves, feed employees, serve customers, or hire a team to help you. Build your business, boost your power, and create the ultimate snack heaven!

details.title: Your Judgment, Inquisitor
details.short_description: Medieval Spain. You serve as an Inquisitor in the shadow of the dreaded Tomás de Torquemada. Cast out demons from the possessed. Burn heretics. Spare the innocent or condemn them. Every wrong choice will bring you closer to the wrath of the Church… or the fury of the mob.

details.title: Paccarat
details.short_description: The 10-rats-in-a-trenchcoat roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit a rag-tag team of rats, craft a curated deck for each, and discover devastating multi-deck combos. Build your team & masterfully pilot multiple unique decks to take down increasingly difficult enemies.

details.title: This Is Not A Dungeon
details.short_description: TINAD is a unique tower defense game where you defend your retirement home from overeager heroes. Play as the dungeon itself. Deploy traps, summon minions, and prove you’re just trying to enjoy your golden years in peace against heroes who can’t read the sign and assume every dungeon is evil.

details.title: Crime & Anomaly
details.short_description: Fight to keep your mind in the shadow of crime and the unknown. Crime & Anomaly is an indie psychological horror that drags you through the dark corridors of 1860s Saint Petersburg. Inspired by Dostoevsky’s Crime and Punishment, every creaking floorboard and flicker of light can shatter your sanity.

details.title: Warrior Is Just Going
details.short_description: There is no retreat. It is a game that tells the story of a mysterious journey of a warrior who only moves forward.

details.title: Multitales: Hood, Gun & Contraband
details.short_description: Red Riding Hood takes up a shotgun and explosive pies to find her missing father. Beneath the bright fairytale lies a dark story of fear, betrayal, and choices made when there’s nothing left to lose.

details.title: Pledged to a Princess
details.short_description: A cute and wholesome yuri visual about a young princess, Katarina Mikhailovna Vassilieva, who (finally!) gets to meet her online friend and fellow anime fan, Audrey McMahon. Is the power of cute girls enough to bring a princess and a pauper together?

details.title: Spheromania
details.short_description: Bounce, blast, and outlast in Spheromania. A fast-paced arena shooter where drones duel with blasters, mines, and mid-air hops. Manage your energy, dodge the shrinking arena, and be the last sphere hovering. Solo mode or online multiplayer.

details.title: Protocol Paradox
details.short_description: Protocol Paradox is a fast-paced roguelike shooter blending twin-stick combat, anomaly-based weapons and branching lore. Survive procedural sectors, customize builds with weapons and passives, face concept-driven bosses, and replay for new revelations.

details.title: Legal Beagll: Justice is Argued
details.short_description: Legal Beagll: Justice is Argued is a courtroom simulation RPG where every trial is a battle of wits. You’ll take on the role of Harold Beagll, a golden retriever attorney navigating a legal system filled with sharp-tongued rivals, eccentric clients, and unpredictable witnesses.

details.title: SPARK! -PHOTON BLAST-
details.short_description: "SPARK! -PHOTON BLAST-" is a sports action game where players face off in a futuristic stadium, rendered with stunningly beautiful photorealistic graphics. Your goal is to score by launching a sphere into your opponent's goal. Enjoy the heart-pounding, high-octane action where every second counts!

details.title: War of Blobs
details.short_description: Massive multiplayer slasher combat, reduced to circles and sticks. Directional swings, real parries, two hits to die...and 60+ other blobs in the lobby trying to kill you first. Everything that doesn't sharpen the fight has been cut.

details.title: Falcon Fall™
details.short_description: Dropped deep in hostile territory with no backup and no way out but through. Every street is a kill zone, every shadow a threat. Built in UE5 by seasoned VR devs and combat vets, Falcon Fall™ delivers the most unforgiving tactical VR combat experience. Wishlist now - deployment scheduled for 2026.

details.title: SCP 1985
details.short_description: Welcome to Site 78 in 1985 where the foundation would experience one of its first major breaches. Escape the facility and survive the scps.

details.title: Road Tycoon
details.short_description: Road Tycoon is an idle incremental racing game with custom-built tracks, prestige layers, and vehicle ascensions. Build the perfect track, let your cars race, and push your numbers into infinity.

details.title: Gunfire & Magic - Desktop Co-op Extraction!
details.short_description: A co-op idle minimalist desktop extraction game you can play with friends! In a city destroyed by a strange force, many factions covet advanced science and magic—and you step into this land of opportunity. Fight, search, extract, grow stronger, build your camp, and uncover your origins!

details.title: AstroBoost
details.short_description: Fast-paced side-scrolling arcade action. Tap to jump, hold to boost, destroy obstacles, and survive the dangers of deep space.

details.title: Rift Crashers
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op bullet-heaven survivor. Pick from 8 characters, stack 18 weapons, and fight through 5 dark fantasy biomes before crashing the Rift itself. Build broken loadouts, survive escalating chaos, and take on a multi-boss gauntlet finale.

details.title: Stardust Protocol
details.short_description: Blast through bullet hell in a sci-fi roguelite shooter. Chart a branching star map, combine scatter shots, missiles, homing fire and lasers, and build your arsenal with upgrades and items. Weigh risks at black markets and unknown events. Face colossal mechanical bosses. Play the free demo.

details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: 100 Native Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: 100 Raft Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: 100 Chess Cats
details.short_description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

details.title: Vicelock - Tactical Roguelite RPG
details.short_description: Build a team, loot gear in turn-based tactical combat, then extract or push deeper and risk losing it all. Forge, craft and trade your haul on a real player-driven market. A tactical roguelite where your loot actually has value.

details.title: Buried Life
details.short_description: 1997. After a sudden mine collapse, you find yourself trapped inside an abandoned Soviet research complex where classified experiments were once conducted. Explore underground laboratories, uncover forgotten secrets, and discover why the facility was buried along with everything it contained.

details.title: HER VOICE BEHIND
details.short_description: A magician wakes with no memory of the woman he loved... or how she died. Explore a circus that rearranges itself behind you, evade the witness in the rafters, and uncover what really happened during "The Final Show." An atmospheric first-person psychological horror game.

details.title: Atout
details.short_description: Classic Card Games & more: 23 card games in one, from Tarot to Hanafuda, plus Rummy, Belote, Poker and Solitaire. Three AI difficulty levels, local and online multiplayer, 24 variants, six languages. A warm pixel-art take on the classics — play solo or with friends.

details.title: Hypercube
details.short_description: An exhilarating FPS-style combat game featuring fully destructible arenas. The more you fight on, the less of the level you have left to fight in!

details.title: Deadclaim
details.short_description: A hardcore third-person extraction shooter on a persistent post-collapse Frontier. Carry in what you dare, fight raiders and AI for loot, and extract — or your kit drops on your corpse. Your progression stays safe; build an outpost, host your own server. No pay-to-win.

details.title: BOKOSUKA WARS II
details.short_description: Bokosuka Wars won the 1984 ASCII Software Contest; a pioneering simulation RPG. This sequel by the original creator features ideas and systems not realized on the original. Two-Player Co-op play recommended!

details.title: FishingMaster: Catch Giants Together
details.short_description: Fishing Master: Catch Giants Together is a first-person fishing simulation focused on realistic float fishing. Cast your line, watch the float, set the hook, and fight powerful fish. Control your rod angle, manage line tension, and enjoy peaceful lakeside scenery between thrilling catches.

details.title: Cube Party
details.short_description: Cube Party is a 2-8 player co-op puzzle and adventure game! Team up with friends, stack your box characters into walls, solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and find the key to clear 40+ unique levels!

details.title: 残阳 1645/1937
details.short_description: As a Ming officer in 1645’s Yangzhou & Jiangyin massacres, shield a girl from shouma fate while obeying orders. In 1937’s Battle of Yangzhou, protect a war journalist returned from Japan. Your choices decide their survival and shape their fates across 300 years.

name: 港警成雙：來自城寨 Dual Fire Walled City

details.title: 港警成雙：來自城寨 Dual Fire Walled City
details.short_description: Dual Fire Walled City is a story-driven co-op game for two players. Featuring close friends who grew up together in the Kowloon Walled City, only to be pulled onto vastly different life paths by a twist of fate. Get ready to immerse yourself in a classic Hong Kong-style movie.

details.title: Asteroid Boom Cosmic Courier
details.short_description: Work off your corporate debt as a low-tier space courier. Deliver antimatter devices to E.L.E. asteroids, recover classified data, and tackle hazardous space operations in a chaotic 4-player physics platformer. Drop the payload, share the oxygen, and survive the shift.

details.title: Otaku Love Story
details.short_description: Behind the keyboard, you're a struggling web novelist. In reality, a socially anxious shut-in. Your life is a simple loop of writing, gaming, and binge-watching, until four very different girls crash into your world—right through the internet.

details.title: Sumalia
details.short_description: Foreign trawlers are emptying your sea and dumping their waste on your shore. Nobody is coming to help. Grab three friends, a skiff and whatever fuel you can scrape together, and go reclaim what once was yours, and then some. 4-player co-op piracy with proximity voice.

details.title: Goreticulture
details.short_description: Nurture a visceral garden as you clean up a bloody aftermath. Mop, water, and shear your way through retro levels. Use every drop to grow plants that earn piles of coins. Turn your green thumb red in Goreticulture, where doom meets bloom!

details.title: Desserted
details.short_description: Desserted is a 1-6 player co-op survival horror game. Explore procedurally generated map in your mobile food truck. Gather, cook, and defend your power grid from sabotaging monsters. Complete sacrifices and survive the deadly Blackout when the lights go out!

details.title: Tornado Hunter
details.short_description: Become a Tornado Hunter! Join the thrilling race across the American plains to predict, track, and document the deadliest storms of the century. Risk everything in pursuit of perfect data, but be careful: one wrong move and you'll become a storm victim.

name: Something is Wrong with the Library

details.title: Something is Wrong with the Library
details.short_description: Shelve hundreds of real books in a library haunted by blood and meat. A spooky narrative organizing simulator by the studio behind I Am Your Beast and Clickolding.

details.title: Escape from Ruin: Greymart Simulator
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic loot-fight-extract survival game with escape-style raids by day and black-market shop management by night. Fans of Tarkov-like gameplay — and players who love running management sims — will feel right at home.

name: You Sure You Wanna Drink This?

details.title: You Sure You Wanna Drink This?
details.short_description: A charming picture-book style interactive story with light puzzles and turn-based combat. After the Pharmacist’s knowledge vanishes, experiment on your partner to learn! Analyze potion effects to deduce ingredient properties. Enjoy vibrant art and story. Reclaim your lost knowledge!

details.title: Ruins of The Titan
details.short_description: A 2D Rougelike action game with pixel art style. You are a summoned "hero", in exhilarating combat, smooth action and dazzling combo, defeat and execute enemies. Build from 100+ skills! Blending adventure, action, and strategic builds, the journey offers endless possibilities in every fight.

details.title: Planet Party Time
details.short_description: "Planet Party Time" combines social sim & party games. As an alien, team with robot PADI to restore a planet via unique recruits. Become a Cube Galaxy Hero Candidate: explore space, play minigames for rewards. Build custom minigames via intuitive editor & host parties!

details.title: My Fairy Princess
details.short_description: In My Fairy Princess, you raise a daughter in a vibrant world of multiple endings. Plan her life and journey beside her through a fabled realm of humans, yaoguai, and immortals. Your choices shape not only the life she leads, but the one she comes to love.

details.title: Chronicles of Humanity
details.short_description: Chronicles of Humanity is an expanding anthology of historical visual novels. Enter different eras, weigh conflicting testimony under political and personal pressure, and shape who is protected, what is recorded, and how each life is remembered. Complete stories are released as separate DLC.

details.title: Tempus Triad
details.short_description: In Tempus Triad, dive into an ancient first-person horror scenario where a scientist is thrust into an era where huge predators dominate the land.

details.title: Venusville
details.short_description: Guide pioneering settlers among Venusian clouds in this space colonisation city builder. Grow food, collect energy, mine resources, balance buoyancy and weight to stay afloat in the treacherous Venusian atmosphere, and build a self-sufficient colony while navigating storms and acidic clouds.

details.title: Serial World
details.short_description: Something strange is happening in Bricktown, and Milo’s on a mission to get to the bottom of it! Leave your home behind as you explore a series of dungeons with the help of your Anima - unusual creatures with unique personalities, abilities, and evolutions - to solve this mystery once and for all.

name: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Sister

details.title: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Sister
details.short_description: A fully animated and voiced sister life-sim with roguelite runs. Find a cure for Mio’s illness. Share meals and quiet nights at home, then enter the Abyss each day to fight, loot, and push deeper to protect your simple life together.

details.title: Karting of Banban
details.short_description: Grip your steering wheel and join your favorite Banban characters in the race of a lifetime! Drift around tight corners and zoom through locations both old and new. Use power-ups and boosts to dodge your opponents and claim first place!

details.title: Brawlers of the West
details.short_description: A brutal physics-based Western brawler featuring realistic melee combat, ragdoll chaos, and violent close-quarters fights in the Wild West.

details.title: Clayground
details.short_description: Welcome to Clayground—the next-gen multiplayer VR experience where imagination knows no bounds! Whether you're a VR veteran or stepping into virtual reality for the first time, Clayground invites you to a playground like no other.

details.title: Bharat Police
details.short_description: > Lead a police department in India where officers grow and react to how you use them. Develop their skills, shape your squad through perks, and manage the buffs and setbacks they pick up on duty. Choose your team, plan each response, and keep your officers ready for the next call.

details.title: TOWER KING
details.short_description: Building Management Simulation x Rogue-lite!You are a rookie hired CEO.Endure unreasonable demands from your boss and achieve your goals!However, the orders keep escalating…!?Overcome countless hardships and aim to become a tycoon!!

details.title: Misty Garden
details.short_description: Build the garden, fulfilling requests from the cute visitors, and even recruit them to create items! Decorate your misty garden to welcome cute little creatures, provide a place to help them relax!

details.title: CatLands
details.short_description: CatLands is a relaxing, cozy puzzle game. Move blocks to bring landscapes back together. Collect cats, build a village or just have fun with friends in online co-op.

details.title: GoopUpClassic
details.short_description: A vibrant and mysterious world filled with enchanted hats, oozing clumps of slime, hidden pathways, and a terrible king. Follow the trail of adventure to defeat the king and save the world from his tyrannical rule! Fight your companions after the trial is done!

details.title: Looters Inc.
details.short_description: Looters Inc is a physics-based co-op heist game. Break into houses, clinics and banks with your friends. And steal the most valuable items you can find. But be careful, the residents are violent, maybe even more violent than you.

details.title: Ember of Origins
details.short_description: Ember of Origins is a dark fantasy 2D side-scrolling pixel action shooter. Explore the ruins of a world consumed by infernal flames, scavenge resources, upgrade powerful weapons, and battle demonic hordes as you embark on a dangerous journey to rescue your missing companion.

details.title: Songs of the Shore
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious island full of musical shells and secrets to discover in this point-and-click 3D collectathon. Immerse yourself in an ambient and serene soundtrack which is remixed as you collect more shells.

details.title: Stone of Adventure
details.short_description: Fuse CCGs, roguelikes, and hex-grid tactics. Scavenge cards & artifacts. Master the interactive battlefield: topple trees onto foes and shove them off cliffs. Your clashes bridge shattered worlds to avert catastrophe. Forge your path home!

details.title: RitualRX
details.short_description: RitualRX is a brutally violent, blisteringly fast, adrenaline-filled shooter set within a pastel paradise ruled by cults. Control excommunicated sinners as you shoot, slash, and slaughter your way through a city where ritual is prescribed and the only treatment administered is an overdose of lead.

details.title: Wizard Hand
details.short_description: Wizard Hand is a magical deckbuilder game where solitaire meets roguelike. You play solitaire by using your magical cards to uncover dazzling combos and accumulate magical points with the help of enchantments, crafting, and a collection of powerful artifacts.

details.title: Knightmared
details.short_description: Auto-attack roguelike where you forge a knight into an unstoppable demon slayer. Survive 15 minutes, build devastating synergies, master your weapons.

details.title: Idle Bones Magic
details.short_description: Raise hordes of zombies and other un-dead beings to automate your dreams of conquest in this idle incremental game. Make your armies grow and snowball and then sit back and watch them take over the world.

details.title: Marble Run Maker
details.short_description: Build marble runs in a room with realistic physics. Stack random objects to make a wobbly track and watch the ball roll down! Explore puzzles with unlimited solutions.

details.title: Birdoo
details.short_description: Birdoo: Feathered Fury is an indie action game were you assume the role of a bird embarking on a quest for revenge against the humans who wronged him. No longer will you tolerate being called a "flying rat" or being shooed away. It's time to exact your revenge!

details.title: Almamon
details.short_description: Bond with mons and uncover a clash of cosmic powers in this turn based RPG. Choose to battle with deep strategic moment to moment decisions or as a chill autobattler.

details.title: Frontiers of the Realms
details.short_description: Build a realm and a deck to match. Grow villages into cities, shape production chains and play cards for supplies, expansion and tactical support. A turn-based strategy game where rivals act in the same round. Play against AI or challenge friends online.

details.title: Wheels Echo: The Winter Chronicle
details.short_description: Wheels Echo is a winter survival story where your thoughts shape the journey. As Fred Walker, explore a silent frozen world, write down clues in your notebook, uncover mysteries, survive the cold, and piece together what happened to everyone — and to you.

name: 挂机后花园.放置牧场AFK back garden.idlepasture

details.title: 挂机后花园.放置牧场AFK back garden.idlepasture
details.short_description: Create your personal oasis in the corner of your desktop.​ This is a laid-back idle simulation game where simple clicks allow you to grow plants and feed adorable animals. Watch them thrive and multiply, receive surprise letters and gifts, and let the serene ambiance of nature fill your screen.
developers: 她山之石Stones from Other Hills
publishers: 她山之石Stones from Other Hills

details.title: AENIGMA
details.short_description: Set in the year 4XXX, humanity lives disconnected inside underground megastructures to escape the threat of the ever-expanding silicon-based lifeforms.

details.title: Lounge Café
details.short_description: Lounge Café is an atmospheric coffee shop simulator where you play as Sara from Lucerne, running a small café in Binoville. Choose beans, craft drinks, and compete in the city’s major coffee tournament to become the best.

details.title: Fast Food Wars
details.short_description: Fast Food Wars is a bullet-hell shoot'em up rogue-lite game in a procedural generated restaurant with random power ups, weapons. You play as a burger fighting to claim back all the invaded burger restaurant from other fast foods

details.title: Sepium
details.short_description: Investigate and localize abnormal activities in this 1-4 players survival horror game. Find your way to various locations where something odd is happening, while trying hard to keep your crew alive.

details.title: Mars Base Alley
details.short_description: Mars Base Alley is a cozy city-builder about creating the perfect little corner of humanity on the red planet—one alley at a time.

details.title: Path of Glory
details.short_description: Path of Glory is a deck-building, roguelite game, set in a post-apocalyptic world. Offering endless replayability, unlockable characters with unique tree skills and card deck's. Fight all beast on your path to become a Hero.

details.title: FOTR
details.short_description: A quasi-documentary trip that leads to a phone booth in 2002, where feelings of nostalgia and pain from broken parental relationships intertwine.

details.title: Santa's Burnout
details.short_description: Santa has officially quit. The kids are too spoiled, and the magic is gone. This year, the Toy Factory has been converted into a strip mine. Click rocks, crush hope, and manage a cynical coal mining operation in this dark industrial idle game. Your goal? Ensure everyone gets coal for Christmas.

details.title: Broken Race
details.short_description: Have you ever tried driving without sleeping? In Broken Race, being tired makes reality look strange and turns every race into a fight to stay sane. Get upgrades, survive the enemies, and reach the finish line before your brain decides that the laws of physics are just a suggestion.

details.title: Cute Away: Paws Caretaker Simulator
details.short_description: Run the town’s coziest cat caretaking home! Renovate and upgrade your house, manage inventory and order supplies online. Fulfill specific feline requests with specialized furniture and engaging toys. Play with cats, keep them happy, and optimize your layout to create the perfect daily workflow.

details.title: World without Time
details.short_description: World without Time is an atmospheric adventure about a fire alicorn exploring a ruined world, using magic, and confronting their past self. Experience exploration, flight, light combat, and choices that shape the fate of the protagonist.

details.title: Veldrak: Dark Revenant
details.short_description: A multiplayer action RPG of dark survival. Customize your warrior, infuse magic through alchemy, tame wild beasts, and lead autonomous NPCs to build and defend your settlement against rank 1 to 5 demons.

details.title: Twilight Gallery
details.short_description: A point-and-click game inspired by early internet flash games. A mysterious company has induced you into a year-long coma and is curating your dreams. Free the trapped souls of artists from their exhibits to escape.

details.title: Chicago 4th of July
