details.short_description: Chicago 4th of July is an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in a near-future Chicago — a glamorous yet oppressive megacity wrapped in a mysterious Veil. Uncover the truth behind the Veil, navigate a world ruled by power and rise against a system built to keep you blind.

details.title: StoryMode
details.short_description: StoryMode is a reading tool completely built around idle/incremental gameplay and progression. Add manga and books, earn experience, levels, and rewards as you read. Complete quests, discover companions, and personalize your reading experience with customizable themes and animated backgrounds.

details.title: Akina
details.short_description: Akina is an arcade drift game set in early-90s Japan. Drift down mountain passes, race friends online, and explore a peaceful summer countryside shaped by the golden age of Japanese street-racing culture.🗾🎌

details.title: Shadowstone
details.short_description: Play solo or with up to 4 players. Plan your turns together, chain your heroes’ skills into combinations that break the run open, and fight your way out of a labyrinth that changes every time. A turn-based tactical roguelite about what your party can do together.

details.title: Too Deep To Quit
details.short_description: Grab your gear and your friends for a hilarious, golden-age co-op adventure! Dive into cursed temples, hunt for the ultimate treasure, and work together to stay alive. Beware of everything and everyone... after all, only the survivors get to split the gold!

details.title: 164: Fragile Ascent
details.short_description: 164 Floors. The ultimate test of mind and body. The ascent is simple, mechanical, yet unforgiving. Every step brings you closer to the summit… or your own annihilation. 164: Fragile Ascent is a first-person rhythm challenge where the certainty of the machine clashes with the fragility of the mind.

details.title: Meaningless Random Numbers
details.short_description: Meaningless Random Numbers is an Incremental Horror Game about earning money through Random Number Generators but be cautious, God is Watching...

details.title: Road 88
details.short_description: Road 88 is a car anomaly game where you must spot the differences on an endless road loop and avoid deadly hazards.

details.title: Autobahn Police Simulator 4
details.short_description: Experience daily police duty on Germany's Autobahn like never before and keep the peace in a living open world. From traffic stops to high-speed pursuits: every call is yours to answer.

details.title: Alea
details.short_description: A PvP brawler where every hero is two fighters in one. Human to werewolf. Fire to ice. Shield to greatsword. Swap mid-fight to outplay a rival in a 1v1 duel, or team up for 2v2 and 3v3 clashes.

details.title: BLACKMURK: Shuffling Man
details.short_description: Fear is real. Sometimes tragedy needs nothing more than that. 💀 A short visual novel based on the story of the same name — about the silence that lets something shuffling into your home. 👁️👁️

details.title: Flip & Shop Simulator
details.short_description: All simulators in one game! A cooperative city simulator where you and your friends manage businesses in a single large world. Open stores, earn money, and develop the shared city - together or separately.

details.title: Atana
details.short_description: Atana is a female-led romance visual novel set in late 20th-century America, where you grow alongside your creator, Atana, as an AI.

details.title: SHORE
details.short_description: Stuck in the middle of the ocean, survive together on a fragile physics-based raft. Fight storms, tsunamis, sharks, and starvation as you find your way back home in SHORE, a 1-4-player co-op survival adventure.

details.title: Cults of the Endtimes
details.short_description: The world is in agony. The only salvation is faith. Forge a god from the fears and hopes of a dying humanity. Spread your ideas like a virus, mutate dogmas, and battle other egregores for the last souls on Earth. A strategy game about manipulating consciousness without direct control.

details.title: Blades & Trades
details.short_description: Forge your legacy as both merchant and hero. Explore Zoldar, battle monsters for rare materials, and craft epic gear. Team up with friends to build a thriving shop in the village markets or arm yourselves to conquer the dangerous depths of the wild.

details.title: Autobus - The Card Game
details.short_description: Race to empty your main pile in this fast-paced multiplayer card game for 2–4 players. Stack cards on shared build piles, outmaneuver your opponents, and be the first to go out. Play solo or online via Steam.

details.title: DANJIRI RAMPAGE
details.short_description: Ride the danjiri and carve every corner in this full-throttle Japanese festival action game. Master your balance atop traditional festival floats, nail razor-sharp drifts on steep slopes, and chase high scores with your festival spirit. All set to high-energy enka music.

details.title: PuzzlePlants
details.short_description: In this post-apocalyptic gardening puzzle game players travel from island to island to help the inhabitants put food on the table. While placing plants, they have to consider their needs and avoid bad matches. Players face increasingly difficult puzzles due to sunlight, wind, rain or soil quality.

details.title: Cold Contours: Intake
details.short_description: You find yourself inside a frozen industrial megastructure. Its corridors are silent, its machinery locked in ice. Yet the pipes still breathe steam, and something at its very heart is waiting. The path to it is a puzzle of ice and metal, but all you have is a pair of magnets.

details.title: Turtles on Crocodiles
details.short_description: The world out there is full of wonders. Explore it at a turtle’s pace. Take your time. Along the pilgrimage, friendships may bloom. And sometimes, even sweet, sweet love.

name: Costella Maid Cafe♡ : The 5 Love Recipe for you

details.title: Costella Maid Cafe♡ : The 5 Love Recipe for you
details.short_description: 실존 코스튬 플레이어 5인이 직접 등장하는, 실사 비주얼 기반 연애 시뮬레이션. 옛날부터 알고 지내던 누나의 부탁으로 작은 메이드 카페 「코스텔라」의 임시 매니저가 된 당신. 라강, 아희, 보미, 아소, 린땅 — 다섯 명의 메이드와 함께하는 예상치 못한 일상 속에서, 다섯 가지 마음의 이야기가 시작됩니다.

details.title: Cthulhu Go Teaching
details.short_description: Go has never been so accessible! With Lord Cthulhu to guide you, playing Go becomes much more enjoyable. Whether you want to get started with Go, improve your skills, or tackle Life and death problems, Lord Cthulhu will keep you company forever!

details.title: Heroes Must Die
details.short_description: A cyber-theocracy RPG with bullet hell shooting. You are a resistance member. In a dark world of cyberpunk and theocratic rule, hunt down church-controlled heroes, rescue the goddess drained of her power, and uncover a 500-year-old lie.

details.title: Ravenhollow Hotel
details.short_description: A psychological horror game set in a mysterious hotel where every room hides a forgotten truth. Explore, survive, and uncover what really happened beneath Ravenhollow.

details.title: Plank Wars
details.short_description: Planks Wars is a fast, irreverent cross-platform PvP card battler where 200-foot-tall sorcerers use kidnapped adventurers as tournament pawns. Build your strategy with CCG-style deckbuilding, command your puppets... I mean, heroes, and climb the ranks.

details.title: 哥布林狂想曲
details.short_description: 化身获得人形变身药水的哥布林开启奇幻 2D 肉鸽冒险！深入随机生成的地牢副本斩杀魔物，拾取海量随机装备、技能词条搭建独属于你的战斗 Build；局外养成角色、解锁温柔羁绊剧情，拯救各族少女伙伴，反复挑战高难度地牢，同时感受肉鸽闯关的爽快随机乐趣与长线角色养成的治愈体验。

details.title: The Current Past
details.short_description: A fading seaside town, a dark secret lurking beneath the waves, and a plot that will test your powers of deduction... Use logic, observation and your trusty notebook to untangle your way to the truth in this puzzling mystery.

details.title: Worldrift: Unscripted Narrative RPG
details.short_description: Unscripted narrative RPG. Pick a world, meet its cast, and say anything — a live AI narrator writes the story around your choices while real game systems track wounds, skills and money underneath. Worlds remember what you did, and you can carry your story from one world into the next.

details.title: REDHOOD: CONTRACT ASSAULT ACTION
details.short_description: A desperate ex-soldier accepts deadly contracts from an anonymous employer. Hunt 4 random targets, fight through hostile locations, and reach a random extraction point in this fast-paced PS2-inspired and early 2000s PC Games shooter.

name: こっくりさんのいうとおり

details.title: こっくりさんのいうとおり
details.short_description: A 3D horror game where movement is prohibited. (Japanese Only) 3D一人称視点「移動禁止」ホラーゲーム。観察・会話・こっくりさんが鍵。

details.title: Blind Dog
details.short_description: You are a detective who is slowly going blind. The only faces you can still see clearly belong to those who are about to die. A visual novel investigation where every choice affects the fate of Tokyo and leads you either closer to the truth or deeper into darkness.

details.title: Hold My Winch!
details.short_description: A co-op survival adventure about driving, climbing, and winching your way across a deadly island to reach & repair its antenna.

details.title: Ranch Revolution
details.short_description: A piglet kidnapped by a vile butcher. Dive into a gory field of vengeance, rescue the piglet, and bring it home!

details.title: Pharmacy 24
details.short_description: Pharmacy 24 is a horror simulator game where you take on the role of a pharmacist, serving customers and taking care of the Pharmacy... Who knows, maybe one day it will accept you.

details.title: Card Storm Idle HD
details.short_description: Card Storm Idle HD is a Free to Play incremental game that blends idle and active play. Explore and build your card deck, master three attack modes to earn tons of resources! Summon Heroes to your aid, build up your power, and see how far you can go. Unleash a card storm on paper monsters!

details.title: Breakrooms
details.short_description: You wake in the seams of a world that shouldn't exist. Breakrooms is a sci-fi horror adventure set in an alternate dimension that will make you question your own reality.

details.title: Shoot till you meet Death
details.short_description: You can’t outrun Death — but you can make him wait. Shoot till you meet Death is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter. Survive endless waves, forge powerful bullet synergies, and push your limits until you finally meet DEATH himself.

details.title: SimpliCity: A Desktop Companion
details.short_description: A relaxing city builder on the bottom of your screen. Place homes, create services, maximize your population happiness. Grow your city at your own pace.

details.title: HERD
details.short_description: HERD is a co-op adventure game about shepherding sheep. 1–4 friends play as young shepherds, disguised with wool mustaches, tasked with delivering sheep to distant villages for their father. He definitely should not have trusted kids with this job.

details.title: Mutagenic 2
details.short_description: An online ARPG made for players who love theorycrafting, great loot, and zero filler. Build freely across 6 classes, 31 specializations, and a massive passive tree, shape your own endgame rifts, and trade offline or face-to-face—solo, SSF, Hardcore, or in co-op.

details.title: CoinClave
details.short_description: Summon humans through coin tosses and engage in intense battles — a Coin Toss × Card Battle game. Whether you can summon them depends on luck. Manipulate that luck with strategy and seize victory.

details.title: Magic Array Defense
details.short_description: A 2D tower defense inspired by Taoist array arts. Design arrays before battle, enhance them with Magic Array Runes, guide monsters using Rune Blocks, empower puppets in overlapping areas, and activate the Ancient Forbidden Array—watch monsters burn within the heavenly scheme you’ve laid.

details.title: To Be Connected
details.short_description: To Be Connected is a relaxing, minimalist puzzle/strategy game where you shape the land, complete clusters to earn stations, and connect them with railways across a harmonious landscape. Build a world that expands forever, or try recreate real-world railway networks.

details.title: Sunsave
details.short_description: Sunsave is a relaxing incremental game with a vaporwave and minimalist vibe. Destroy meteors, collect resources, and evolve the Sun with upgrades that unlock new mechanics!

details.title: Neural Drive
details.short_description: Neural Drive is a cyberpunk action rogue-lite. Use acceleration powers to reflect bullets, dodge attacks, and counter enemies. Master weapons and upgrade your skills to overcome relentless enemies and deadly bosses.

details.title: C.H.I.M.P.
details.short_description: C.H.I.M.P. is a cooperative multiplayer game where players work together to control a spaceship. On the spaceship, each player must perform their assigned role, such as piloting, shooting, or reloading. Can you reach your destination without fighting with your crewmates?

details.title: Stream Survivors
details.short_description: Build a growing camp in a fresh take on the incremental genre. Farm endlessly spawning resource nodes, unlock upgrades and new buildings, and climb multiple leaderboards designed for both idle and active players. Play solo or in multiplayer with full Twitch integration.

details.title: Gray Space
details.short_description: Light is a luxury. Sanity is vital. Group up with your friends to escape a crumbling medical organization in GRAY SPACE. Scavenge for tools and resources. Run and hide from fear entities and other anomalies that lurk. Extract the antidote at all costs. A lo-fi first-person survival horror nightmare.

details.title: Reel Tiny
details.short_description: Become the fisherman you were always meant to be in Reel Tiny. Experience life as a tiny creature in a big world as you catch fish and make friends. Trade with the town to upgrade your lures and fishing rod. Earn new fishing licenses to explore new sections of the creek and become an angling legend!

details.title: SWOM
details.short_description: SWOM — a game where you survive after memory loss, using magic based on basic laws you discover during gameplay. Build shelters, explore the unexplored world, collect items and resources to survive and understand why you are here.

details.title: Feast of the Beast Unleashed
details.short_description: "Top-down action and survival shooter, playable solo or cooperatively. Explore Valachia with your brother and face off against humans, lycanthropes, and rival vampiric clans as you advance toward the origin of TOX-Z, the toxin that is consuming the world."

details.title: Real Life: Dorm Affairs
details.short_description: Mike’s new job at a women’s dorm leads him into unexpected bonds, rising danger, and tough choices as local gangs target vulnerable students. Protect the girls, navigate romance, and face the city’s hidden threats.

details.title: Scratch your Luck
details.short_description: Scratch tickets, upgrade your odds, and pay deadlines before you go broke.

details.title: Twilight Haven
details.short_description: Twilight Haven is based in a wonderful, magical but also strange and dangerous place hidden far north of the country known as Hazeldawn. It is not a place you will find on any map, nor in any book, it is hidden from the eyes and minds of all those but the few souls that it chooses to bring home.

details.title: Dungeon of Departure
details.short_description: Trapped in a mysterious cave system, four dungeon explorers struggle to find a way out before the light fades forever... Navigate a mysterious underground as you navigate through multiple story paths in this text-based, pixel-art, dark fantasy rpg, visual novel computer game

details.title: FingBlade
details.short_description: Fingblade is a physics-driven Rogue-lite action game. Swing your mouse to control the weapon's real inertia, slashing through endless waves of enemies. Unlock 4 unique weapons, master Chain Lightning and Necromancy builds, and collect gems for permanent upgrades. If the blade breaks, you die.

details.title: soupsoup
details.short_description: Explore diverse illustration magazines in soupsoup, a hidden object game filled with unique artistic visions. Experience over 200 creative stages featuring relaxing healing sounds. Collect stars to unlock new magazines and immerse yourself in beautiful worlds created by talented artists.

details.title: WING-IT
details.short_description: Adapt or crash! WING-IT is a 2.5D shooter where your arsenal is a slot machine. Shoot down drones to trigger the Toy Box Gacha and swap weapons on the fly. Fight through Medy's house, survive the bullet hell, and defeat the mechanical monstrosities ruling the house.

details.title: Childrens Story
details.short_description: Childrens Story is an Anthology Game that presents a growing collection of stories on VHS Tapes. Each tape contains a one-off story with unique plot and setting elements that evoke fear, wonder, and live entertainment. Tune-in Next Time!

details.title: Liar's Lift
details.short_description: Liar's Lift is a 3-8 player social competition. Use the elevator's emergency phone to communicate and solve challenges. Lie or play fair to earn points across multiple rounds. No one dies, but only one winner exits. In this lift, your reputation is the only thing at stake.

details.title: Maum
details.short_description: An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Collect potions and spells, use them wisely against enemies for protection or fun.

details.title: Midnight Cleaner YOKOHAMA Bay Beats
details.short_description: Dark Story Rhythm Game

details.title: Legend Of Asha
details.short_description: Enter the Kingdom of Ngoma in the Legend of Asha, a Top-Down adventure set in a unique and vibrant Afro-Fantasy setting. Explore unique and beautiful landscapes, use and upgrade powerful elemental abilities, fight off enemies and defeat Thonarka the Ravager to restore balance to the land.

details.title: 2P连接中
details.short_description: In the virtual world known as MoMoLand, bugs are no longer glitches but the tools you rely on for survival and breaking the rules. Your goal is to navigate through limited, sandbox-style maps, using various bugs to evade patrolling service robots and ultimately reach the exit.

details.title: Aether Soul
details.short_description: A pixel-art roguelite metroidvania. You are Ves, a construct of threads rewoven by the Great Loom after every death. Cross eight regions of a world torn by the Fracture, defeat six guardians and decide the fate of the Loom.

details.title: Frog Racing League
details.short_description: Recruit frogs, and turn them into champion racing frogs! Kit them out with hats and potions, then read the odds and bet your way to the top of the league. A pixel-art frog management sim that will satisfy your inner frog manager.

details.title: Glaring Flaw
details.short_description: Glaring Flaw is a narrative puzzle adventure built around shifting perspectives. Unlock new camera angles, reveal hidden paths and clues, and explore a rural family estate threatened by both natural disaster and an approaching new era.

details.title: Elsewhere
details.short_description: “When humans dream, they visit actual universes.” Elsewhere is an atmospheric puzzle and magical combat game where you embark on a journey across a breathtaking dream universe. Work with a dragon named Wonder to restore the passage between worlds and figure out why the universe is decaying.

details.title: Mym's Sword
details.short_description: Defeat powerful foes and discover a colorful world full of mystery and wonder in this exploratory action platformer! A wandering beast discovers a magic sword, but can she uncover the truth of its origins, and resist the powers that created it?

details.title: Skillpoint Warrior
details.short_description: Slay, upgrade, conquer! In Skillpoint Warrior, every defeated enemy fuels your ascent to power. Harvest skill points to infinitely boost your stats, hunt for game-changing loot, and crush formidable bosses as you battle your way through diverse, unforgiving worlds.

details.title: Timberheim
details.short_description: Timberheim is a cozy Viking lumberjack game: swing your axe to chop down trees, carry the logs through the deep snow to feed the ever-burning fire, and watch the village rise one log at a time.

details.title: False Hope
details.short_description: One winter. Four survivors, and a wounded stranger who won't last the night without you. To the east lies a missile, the one chance left to end the war for good, if you can hold the camp together long enough to reach it. Every choice may costs someone.

details.title: SELF//FORK
details.short_description: A physics-driven cyberpunk incremental. Fork yourself into data packets, bounce through a hostile mainframe's defense matrix, and reunite the fragments to break free.

details.title: Severed Souls — Chapter I
details.short_description: Above, a floating golden city promises utopia. Below lies an abyss of poverty and despair. In this parallel narrative RPG, guide two brothers separated at birth: a royal heir and a slum orphan raised by a stray dog. Will you bridge their severed worlds, or doom them to a fatal collision?

details.title: Flagship Down
details.short_description: Tactical roguelike auto-battler. Assemble your fleet and equip your flagship with modules and weapons. Recruit and assign crew members to your ships. Start the round and watch your strategy unfold in fully automated battles.

details.title: Pirates Dig Deeper
details.short_description: Dig with your crew. Defend with your cannons. Pirates Dig Deeper is a co-op blend of digging and tower defense. Descend into the island, fight off rival pirates, and unseal the ancient temple to steal the elixir of immortality.

details.title: Follow like a shadow
details.short_description: Two characters, one player! 'Follow like a shadow' is a minimalist two-character puzzle game. The player controls both the black and white shadows simultaneously — move one, and the other automatically mirrors the movement.

details.title: Keyboard Curse
details.short_description: Keyboard Curse is a 2D rage-platformer where every key you press spawns a physical keycap into the level. Jump, run, panic, and try not to trap yourself — because every press makes it worse.

details.title: Card Traveler
details.short_description: A single-player card strategy game built around creature combat, minion evolution, source synergies, and color-based energy deckbuilding.

details.title: Break Point: Brace & Breach
details.short_description: [Hero-Building] + [Frontline Tower Defense]｜Hold against multi-lane assaults｜Adjust positions, facing, skill builds, and formations to create a unique defense｜Push the front, seize resources, and strengthen your heroes｜Let the enemy tide shatter against your masterpiece

details.title: Cat Guardians(캣 가디언즈)
details.short_description: A crisis arrives while the owner is away on a trip! A warning from mice trying to steal the premium cheese! Build defenses, jump in as one of 4 cats, and draft a card every wave to save the premium cheese. Solo or 4-player online co-op.

details.title: Rescue Incoming
details.short_description: Survive escalating zombie attacks while scavenging supplies and upgrading your gear. Hold out until rescue arrives... if you can.

details.title: Karnage: The Legend Grows
details.short_description: A challenging, heavy metal–infused rogue-lite where you battle hordes, build powerful weapon synergies, and rise to challenge the great wyrms across a dark fantasy world.

details.title: Loreth
details.short_description: A Roguelike strategy game set in the Loreth Academy, where you play as a student god researching civilizations, ecosystems, heroes, demons, and the laws of the world through powerful symbol-building simulations.

details.title: Alchemist Chronicles
details.short_description: Brew remedies, heal the sick, and face impossible choices. You are the only healer in a small village — but sometimes you must choose who lives and who doesn't.

details.title: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Manage your own football card shop! Open card packs to discover rare football player cards, stock your shelves with football merchandise, sell to customers, expand your store, and build the ultimate football card shop.

details.title: Hip to be Squared
details.short_description: Hip to be Squared is a fast paced, bullet hell dungeon crawler where you create insane builds to clear an ever changing dungeon filled with abstract enemies. All enemies in Hip to be Squared attack in sync with the music. The only path to success is to choose your upgrades wisely.

details.title: Sunder
details.short_description: Sunder is an orbital-artillery RTS in a living star system. Every world is a gun platform on a moving orbit: bend shots around the sun, shove planets off their rails, and crack rival worlds to the core. Draft your arsenal as you fight — solo skirmishes or online war with up to 8 players.

details.title: Orbit Crisis
details.short_description: Master orbital navigation to protect Earth in this atmospheric space simulation, where careful timing, experimentation, and patience matter more than quick reactions.

details.title: Aptacris : Dipolos Anomalia
details.short_description: Aptacris: Dipolos Anomalia is a puzzle adventure game set in a solarpunk dystopian world where memories become puzzle worlds. Switch between two perception states to reveal hidden paths, overcome shifting obstacles, and solve puzzles. Play as Ai'Lynn, searching for a fragment within her own mind.

details.title: Green Space
details.short_description: You're Blobby, the new Warden of Impact Park. Recycle trash into Blobbers, upgrade the park, talk to the locals, or don't — every choice you make changes how your fellow Blobs treat you. A cozy park-management game with mystery and heart.

details.title: Squeak
details.short_description: Squeak is a cooperative tactical game for 2 players about the symbiosis of Spirit and Human. Choose your role, unlocking unique ways to interact with the world. Combine your abilities and act as one to overcome the trials.

details.title: runz
details.short_description: RUNZ is a top-down roguelite arena shooter where every bullet in your magazine matters. Draft bullets like an auto-battler, combine three of a kind, stack synergies and upgrade your gun to survive 20 waves.

details.title: The Veiled Moon: Tengu
details.short_description: Harness elemental physics to restore the Star-Stone in a mystical Zen world.

details.title: Beer Baron: The Brewery Tycoon
details.short_description: From backyard to beer baron! Build your 19th-century brewing empire: grow hops, perfect recipes, sign contracts with taverns, and outsmart cunning AI rivals. An atmospheric turn-based economy tycoon with rich Belle Époque charm.

details.title: Junebug
details.short_description: Junebug is a cat companion and cozy building game. Create charming little spaces, make them your own, then experience what you’ve built through your cat. Explore, play, relax, and enjoy the little moments you create together.

details.title: Making the Cut
details.short_description: A deep golf career simulation. Build a player from unknown rookie to world #1 across a 20-year career. Manage your form, your team, your reputation, and your schedule as you climb the world rankings. Inspired by Football Manager and Out of the Park Baseball.

details.title: Furniture Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own furniture and home decor store. Place sofas, style showrooms, set prices, and watch customers react to how you decorate. A beautiful display isn't just pretty — it sells.

details.title: Robot&Gun&Magic
details.short_description: Guns and magic intertwine — carve your way through the apocalypse. Play as an awakened robot warrior, wielding firearms and magic power to scavenge, fight, and survive in a world stripped bare of resources. Ammo is scarce, mana is precious, and every battle is a fight for survival.

details.title: BricksPhilosophorum
details.short_description: [点金方块]BricksPhilosophorum is an automated game that uses an assembly line to study alchemy. The game starts with collecting minerals, purchasing land, unlocking technology, and building automated production lines.

details.title: Starship Contractor: Galactic Tycoon
details.short_description: Shape the Galactic Arms Race. As CEO of a private space arms company, design modular ships, research breakthrough tech, and win faction tenders. Outmaneuver rivals in prototype races and make critical choices that make every playthrough unique, from a startup to galactic dominance.

details.title: Peace by Piece
details.short_description: Restore peace - one piece at a time. Start a rebellion with a handful of loyalists in this chess roguelike, and grow your army as you free a war-torn kingdom. Gain banners that bend the rules and build devastating synergies as you race to topple a tyrant before his army returns!

details.title: Tutsak
details.short_description: Tutsak is a 1–4 player co-op horror game where you complete objectives and escape before the creature catches you. Caught? You're locked in a cell until your friends break you out. Sometimes, you can sell out a teammate instead.

details.title: 犯人当てラジオ
details.short_description: This is a mystery novel game where you read short mystery stories and identify the culprit. The game features a total of six scenarios. Read through various mystery stories set in different times and places, and use cards and charts to deduce the answer.

details.title: AKASHA
details.short_description: Welcome to AKASHA. This zen-puzzle platformer will have you questioning your every move. Discover the abilities of the Soul Sphere, solve abstract puzzles, and reunite the Lost Eidolons to reconstruct the pieces of your inner self.

details.title: Too Many Flies
details.short_description: Too Many Flies is an incremental game about exterminating many many flies, exploring a mysterious house and getting that sweet sweet cash.

details.title: Bloomvale: Bouquets & Scents
details.short_description: Bloomvale: Bouquets & Scents is a cozy 2D game where you grow flowers, craft beautiful bouquets, and blend fragrant perfumes for your customers. A relaxing experience focused on gentle progression, creativity, and cozy daily routines. 🌸🌿

details.title: Edroseph's Tower
details.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based roguelike RPG with 25 classes and deep buildcraft. Climb the tower solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players, combine talents and equipment, and adapt your party to every run.

details.title: AstroFrame
details.short_description: Take a seat, engineer! AstroFrame is a 2D sci-fi roguelike that challenges your strategic planning, adaptability, and spaceship designing skills. The cosmos is hostile and your survival depends on your ingenuity in an ever-changing galaxy.

details.title: Gecko: Wall Hacker
details.short_description: A stealth action-puzzle game where you climb walls and ceilings, blend into surface materials, and hack security systems. Use full-surface movement, adaptive camouflage, and spatial positioning to infiltrate guarded environments.

details.title: 找勺子LOOKING for MYSPOON
details.short_description: A horror walking simulator play as a character searching for a lost spoon in a fantastical world You will experience a surreal world, from diverse swimming pools to strange houses. I hope you enjoy it.

details.title: Lyden Lys
details.short_description: Lyden Lys is a knowledge-based metroidvania about an existential journey through a lost homeland. Control the surroundings through music, explore a smoldering world, discover what happened to your people, decide the fate of your successors, and find yourself.

details.title: Realm's Last Stand
details.short_description: An unforgiving tower defence game focused on strategic placement, unique enemy mechanics and progressively demanding levels

details.title: Rectangle Dudes
details.short_description: Prepare to be one of the dudes! Challenge yourself in one of the best, precise yet silly, skill-based platformers. Built for co-op fun, mastery solo... or absolute chaos in party mode! Take a trip back to the age of classic platforming, with awesome secrets, arcade energy, and satisfying challenges.

name: Throw a Barrel Down a Hill

details.title: Throw a Barrel Down a Hill
details.short_description: Throw a barrel down a hill. Buy upgrades. Throw it again. That's the whole game.

details.title: Africa Survival
details.short_description: As an explorer, you travel to Africa, hunt in the savanna, Avoid attacks from various ferocious beasts, gather resources, build shelter, and survive.

details.title: 9号台球馆：心动搭档
details.short_description: No. 9 Pool Hall blends playable eight-ball, character stories, roguelike builds, and Steam friend matches. Practice aiming and position play, meet distinctive partners, and survive nine strange nights. AI assisted art, audio, writing, code, and testing; no AI runs during play or sends player data.

details.title: Mapborn
details.short_description: Your map is the world. Mapborn is a real-time grand strategy sandbox played directly on your original artwork. Add cities and nations, choose one to rule, and shape its history through war, diplomacy, politics, and rebellion.

details.title: Mining Mike
details.short_description: Mikey Minerals owes the Shimigu Mining Corporation TRILLIONS in college debt. His sentence: the remote planet Dirt. Strap into a mech-themed roguelike mining tower defense survivor. Battle hordes, build a base, MINE and make money for the COMPANY.

details.title: Kito: Lost Trail
details.short_description: Kito: Lost Trail is a cozy 3D platforming adventure where you play as Kito, a young leopard searching for his missing mother. Explore wild environments, overcome platforming challenges, discover hidden collectibles, and grow your abilities along the way.

details.title: Solarise
details.short_description: A short and sweet game that aims to be a love letter to solar panel production and the crisis of the modern century for Europe as it grapples with reindustrialisation. Manage your factory, power needs, politics, and just ordinary people, in order to lower costs and outcompete your global rivals.

details.title: Time Traveler: Divergence
details.short_description: A systemic medieval RPG where you play a stranded traveler from the future. Rebuild your device, replicate technology, shape a living kingdom through trade, diplomacy or force, and beware: its people — and History itself — will remember what you do.

details.title: The City Knows
details.short_description: A story-driven deduction game set in Okayama, Japan, where everyone has an answer—but you need evidence. Examine evidence and records, cross-reference witness accounts, reconstruct timelines, and separate plausible theories from provable facts across six murder investigations.

details.title: 罐头成长计划
details.short_description: 一款养成游戏，在游戏中，你将扮演妈妈，收养一只来自孤儿院的小罐头生物，前往罐头小镇抚养它，通过各种方式的培养来引导小罐成长为不同性格和职业，形成不同的人际关系 9名有感情线路的角色，游戏内包含钓鱼，换装，喂食，打工，战斗，抽卡机，五子棋，阵营选择，npc小任务等游玩方式 ·养成游戏 ·自由选择多结局

details.title: Item TD
details.short_description: Every Tower Is a Backpack! Item TD combines Tower Defense and Inventory Management in a strategy game featuring 15 stages, 3 difficulty levels. Arrange weapons and support items in your character's and Towers' inventories to maximize their synergies and fend off waves of monsters.

details.title: meowtopia
details.short_description: See the world through a cat’s eyes and explore your home! From sunny balconies to cozy bedrooms, unlock new rooms, collect items, and solve light puzzles. Play mini-games and grow daily to turn this cozy house into a true "Meowtopia." Pure immersion and heartwarming companionship await.

details.title: Elixir of Immortality
details.short_description: A cultivation incremental game where alchemy is the key to survival. Recruit minions, manage your alchemy room, seek elixirs to extend your lifespan, and reincarnate when your time runs out. Reincarnate again and again on your path to immortality.

details.title: Buzzle
details.short_description: Move the blocks around the field to assemble the exact shape required for each level. Move them into the correct positions and see if you can advance to the next level.

name: My Oshi, the Supernatural, and Livestreaming

details.title: My Oshi, the Supernatural, and Livestreaming
details.short_description: In this horror adventure game, the player takes on the role of a viewer who watches Sana Okuizumi’s live stream, issues instructions, and experiences firsthand how she overcomes various crises.

details.title: Who Pressed It?!
details.short_description: A chaotic 2–4 player co-op puzzle game. Work together to solve test rooms, interact with giant buttons, and try not to press the wrong thing. Every mistake sends the facility further into chaos!

details.title: Trigger-Happy Chainsaw Girl
details.short_description: Konoko Kobazaki is a deadbeat shut-in. Saddled with multiple debts, he heads to an abandoned building with the naive hope of turning his life around by becoming a "paranormal YouTuber." Will he actually manage to pay off his debts?

details.title: The Night Kitchen
details.short_description: The Night Kitchen is a psychological horror game. You just started a new job - the night shift in a kitchen. Grill, oven, deep fryer. Take orders, prepare the food, talk to the customer. Simple work. Seven nights. Each one stranger than the last.

details.title: 2027 毕业生工作
details.short_description: Where should the Class of 2027 go? (This game is only in Simplified Chinese)

details.title: Genuine Article
details.short_description: Vienna, 1901. A bureau that authenticates antiques: without your certificate the piece is worth nothing. Silver, paintings, watches, papers — each carries a truth and a lie about its history. A predecessor’s debt makes bribes tempting. And you won’t get this right every time — mistakes cost.

details.title: T-Shirt Kingdom
details.short_description: Driven by boundless creativity, this is an idle game where every visual element—from the storefront to the battlefield—is yours to design. Paired with a deep strategic core that spawns endless idle and combat builds, T-Shirt Kingdom places the art of creation and warfare entirely in your hands.

details.title: ODYSSEY: Wine-Dark Sea
details.short_description: Troy has fallen. Home is an angry sea away. Lead a crew of named men through the myths of the Odyssey — ration food, bargain with gods, decide who lives. In the myth he came home alone. Can you do better? A story-rich roguelite where every voyage ends in an epic Song about your choices.

details.title: 飞鸟的日记
details.short_description: "theDIARY" is a post-apocalyptic supernatural AVG with multiple endings. Play as Raven, navigate choices and stats, and uncover the dark truth behind humanity's angels to find the source of the tragedy.

details.title: Forgotten Possessions
details.short_description: Find and collect items that tell a dark story in an abandoned log cabin, but watch out for what lurks behind you. You sneak through dark rooms against a relentless, adaptive creature. Experience a dynamic world with randomized item locations and a reactive environment.

details.title: Path of Broken Builds
details.short_description: You don't control the hero. You control the skill tree. Grow an endless, procedural passive tree in real time while your hero fights the dungeon alone — every point you spend lands as a hit. Chain keystones and ultimates into a build broken enough to break the game itself.

details.title: 虞州的罪羊
details.short_description: A multi ending narrative AVG.When nightmares and hallucinations alternate,you have to find the only truth among the many possible endings.

details.title: Carrot Count Sheep
details.short_description: Play as Carrot, a little bug who dives into The Dream of 100 Sheep in this cozy rpg puzzle adventure. Solve not-too-hard puzzles, meet interesting and unique characters, and uncover the mystery behind nightmares that are appearing across this once cozy dream. Whose dream is this, anyway?

details.title: Depth ReCharged!
details.short_description: Sink the subs before they sink you! A fast single-screen arcade shooter inspired by the 1970s classic Depth Charge. Dodge mines and torpedoes, grab power-ups, survive ever-harder waves and chase the high score. Built for Steam Deck, great on desktop too.

details.title: TBF: Task Bar Fishing
details.short_description: A story of a girl fishing and exploring in a submerged world. Let her fish automatically in the corner of your desktop, and step in only for key events. Gather money and gear through fishing to continue your journey and uncover the truth of this world!

details.title: The Varitav
details.short_description: A top-down pixel art survivor roguelike. Play as a little fox, craft a powerful build against endless enemy waves, and survive across three distinct biomes. No permanent upgrades. You start from scratch every run. As the swarm grows stronger, surviving gets pretty hard.

details.title: The Buried Light
details.short_description: Cast into an abyss by a cosmic god, ancient forests have mutated into living botanical warships. In this mythic bullet-hell RPG, shift between four active combat modes, breed your skill tree, and craft modular ammunition across five slots to survive 150+ hand-authored phases and reclaim the sun.
publishers: Red Apple Swimming In The Green River Games

details.title: Raceway Sparks
details.short_description: Racing game in crazy world with futuristic cars and ai bots.

details.title: Treecension
details.short_description: Small Crow Man climbs big evil tree to save the world

details.title: Good Night
details.short_description: A good night's sleep is for one person only. Roll, squirm, and shove your friends off the bed in this 2-4 player ragdoll party game.

details.title: Flightopedia: Legacy Wings
details.short_description: Master the skies in a mission-driven, third-person flight simulator. Take control across 12 structured levels featuring a diverse fleet from commercial airliners to military aircraft.
developers: Yash Future Tech Solutions Private Limited
publishers: Yash Future Tech Solutions Private Limited

details.title: DodgeBaller
details.short_description: Dodgeball is a martial art. Challenge your friends up to 4 players locally or online! Play as unique characters with varied styles and prove you are the ultimate Dodgeballer Artist.

details.title: Speed RPG
details.short_description: Play one card, discard one — both sides commit in secret, then everything resolves at once. Read your opponent on a 13x8 grid, build twin Move and Action decks, and climb the 100-Man Kumite, where turn timers shrink to 6 seconds. Short matches, fast decisions, one more run. Solo-dev alpha, JP/EN.

details.title: The Previous Owner
details.short_description: Run a secondhand bookshop in London, 1994. Every book remembers who owned it before — pressed flowers, letters, notes in the margins. Across books that should never have met, the same hand keeps writing. You inherited the rules with the shop: shelve carefully, and do not read the margins.

name: It's Just a Rescue, Bro! — Idle Hell RPG

details.title: It's Just a Rescue, Bro! — Idle Hell RPG
details.short_description: An idle ARPG for loot goblins. Slaughter monsters automatically, hunt build-changing gear, craft ridiculous builds, unlock new classes, then rebirth and do it all again—stronger.

details.title: AshSpire
details.short_description: A first-person roguelite horde-shooter. Shoot, slice, explode, trample and disco ball to death a metric ton of enemies. Also you get a grapple ability, so you're welcome!

details.title: Built Brick by Brick
details.short_description: A life simulation and construction game set in rural Argentina. You start with a plot of land and the idea of your dream home. Work to earn money and achieve your goals.

details.title: All (Too) Good Things
details.short_description: Your job is to make humanity happy. Observe the people living in your assigned district and make the best choices to ensure everyone's happiness.

details.title: Khachapuri
details.short_description: Sunset rays, Smooth Jazz, a Cozy place and Wine... How about making a romantic dinner with nice company, huh? Today you're preparing a Khachapuri! Come on! Take a bite of this short but yummy story.😋

details.title: REVOLVER
details.short_description: Tired of immortality, the Demoness has lured you into a trap and asks for a favor: remove the curse from her revolver, bet your life and rip the lost soul of suffering. This rendezvous will make you take full risks. But remember: once you sign the Act of Blood, no chance to turn it back.

details.title: Fallen Valkyries: Prologue
details.short_description: An Anime Wave-based Arena Shooter, Kill Goblin > Collect Bounty > Buy Upgrade > Survive

details.title: Lumber Plumber
details.short_description: Lumber Plumber is a game about tree felling, water plumbing, ore mining, rock crushing, metal bending, resource exploring, and wonder assembling. Transport lumber across long distances using steam locomotives and conveyor belts.

details.title: Fluffy Fighters - Tactical
details.short_description: Fluffy Fighters - Tactical is a turn-based tactical RPG set in a medieval fantasy world populated by cats. Create your feline fighter, build your team, explore a free-roaming world and lead your cats through tactical battles full of choices, equipment and strategy.

details.title: Adeline's story
details.short_description: «Adeline’s Story» — a psychological-horror visual novel about a girl who moves from a bustling city to a godforsaken village, where the nighttime silence is ripped apart by inhuman screams and people vanish one by one.

details.title: Slammer Caps Xtreme
details.short_description: Slammer Caps Xtreme is a nostalgic RPG featuring physics-based battles, '90s wackiness playground energy and a dash of schoolyard. Blending impact simulation with collectibles and psychological duels, the game turns caps battles into rituals of power, identity and maybe something even crazier.

details.title: KaiKi
details.short_description: This is a walking simulator-style adventure game where you walk along the beach from a first-person perspective. Take photos along the beach and reminisce about the protagonist's precious memories. When you reach your destination, the ending will change depending on the number of memories you have.

name: Signal Lost: The Silence Between Words

details.title: Signal Lost: The Silence Between Words
details.short_description: Tune the radio. Silence the voices. Escape the dark. Signal Lost is a psychological horror experience where every sound matters. Lost in an abandoned underground relay station, your only link to reality is the static between transmissions.

details.title: Mimic Sleuth
details.short_description: No chest is safe in this logic puzzle roguelite! These mimic-filled dungeons are just waiting to be looted... but only the most observant and clever adventurers will make it out alive.

details.title: Pax Astralis
details.short_description: A real-time strategy game in retro vector graphics. Settle an eleven-world star system where no single world can feed an army, ship ore and troops along the orbits, and storm the Imperial Palace on Imperia, throne world of the Empire.

details.title: Inuyo High: Lesson 1
details.short_description: Welcome to Inuyo Academy, an all-ages school once filled with joy. Something terrible happened after the school’s mascot staff was revealed to the public, and it’s your job as an officer to investigate the abandoned building, in search of evidence to figure out the truth.

details.title: SPEEDING
details.short_description: An arcade-style racing game — experience the thrill of speeding on over 30 tracks! Drive over 30 cars and explore over 5 different game modes! Linear difficulty progression, from easy to hard — each stage brings a new challenge.

details.title: Akashic
details.short_description: Akashic is an AI-powered interactive storybook game that blends Roguelite elements with role-playing narrative. Every adventure is unique — driven by AI-generated dialogues and dynamic worldbuilding, where your choices, emotions, and conversations shape the unfolding story.

details.title: CubeMate
details.short_description: Chess meets the Rubik's Cube. Rotate a 3D cube until every face satisfies a chess challenge: check, checkmate, advantage, equality or a classic solve. A 34-level campaign tree from 2×2 to 7×7, Free Play, a Daily puzzle and shareable seeds.

details.title: Bottom-Up Beatdown: Hostile Takeover
details.short_description: Bottom-Up Beatdown: Hostile Takeover is an intense 2D beat em' up set in a world dominated by corporations led by monsters! The only way out is up! Begin your freelance kaiju career in campaign mode, or play with friends in the traditional, challenging arcade mode!

details.title: Chronal Chain
details.short_description: "TIME CONTROL" bullet hell action. Overcome impossible odds by slowing, stopping and rewinding time!

details.title: Ta-Miu
details.short_description: Play as a cat chosen by the goddess Bastet. Solve ancient puzzles, unlock magical powers, and uncover the secrets of Egypt filled with myths, temples, and tombs. Embark on a mystical adventure and stop an ancient evil!

name: シェオルの森　- 黄昏の魔獣使い -

details.title: シェオルの森　- 黄昏の魔獣使い -
details.short_description: 古代中国から伝わる呪術「蟲毒」に着想を得た、「蟲毒×魔獣錬成×落ちものパズル」それが、「シェオルの森-黄昏の魔獣使い-」です。魔獣を使い魔にし、魔獣と戦わせ、使い魔同士を融合し巨大な魔獣を錬成しましょう！

details.title: Shrouded Siege
details.short_description: Design dastardly mazes in this co-op roguelike tower defense set in Irish mythology. Combine divine boons to make unstoppable towers and sculpt the terrain to make the ultimate death traps for your enemies.

details.title: Car-Nudge
details.short_description: Car-Nudge is a party game with cars. Play locally or online with up to 8 players, through different minigames and levels. Demolish your friends (or enemies) to win and unlock new customizations and cars to play with.

details.title: Chicken Jump, Puppy Jump
details.short_description: An online multiplayer party game for 4–8 players. Build your crew of robo-animal thieves, roam across insane locations to snatch treasures, or simply STEAL goodies from rival players — all to become the MOST WANTED crew on the Bounty Board!

details.title: The Calling
details.short_description: An anime-inspired free-to-play PvP arena shooter where every match is shaped by your build, strategy, and creativity. Customize your abilities, adapt to dynamic weather and day-night cycles, and outplay the competition in fast-paced battles.

details.title: Smash Simulator
details.short_description: Inherit a failing company and transform it into a destruction empire! Build and manage your own Rage Rooms, let clients smash objects to relieve stress… and turn it all into profit!

details.title: Aftershock
details.short_description: An earthquake has just struck the building you’re in — and caught off guard, you’ll have only moments to react. Every step could mean the difference between life and death.

details.title: Chest & Blade
details.short_description: A dark fantasy idle RPG where the fighting happens on its own. The deciding doesn't: open chests, compare gear, salvage the rest, then spend it on skills, runes and three-card augments until the wall you were stuck on breaks. Offline progress keeps it moving.

details.title: The Friendliest Skunk
details.short_description: Skunk is the friendliest critter in the forest — but his natural scent makes making friends a bit… tricky. Help Skunk traverse a musical forest, in this charming rhythm-based platformer! Meet adorable forest friends, outwit hungry predators, and prove that kindness (+ good timing) conquers all!

details.title: HOTLIME
details.short_description: Chaotic PvP party game for 2–4 players. Citrus fighters battle to the death in a hellish skyscraper — one hit decides everything. Escape, if the bartender lets you!

details.title: DIVINE CRAFTING WORKSHOP
details.short_description: Ancient China handcraft sim with shadow puppet art & multiple endings. As a craftsman, take orders, craft works, unlock dynasty stories. Full version: 7 dynasties, 28 categories, 110+ collectible handicrafts, 300+ event/40+ main endings, 50+ panda events & letters—immerse in traditional crafts.

details.title: Terrafarmer
details.short_description: A roguelite farming strategy game where every tile matters. Choose from randomly offered polyomino crop tiles, arrange them for powerful synergies, and terraform a dead planet before your debt catches up.

details.title: Chibi Engine
details.short_description: Make your desktop a lively place with cute chibi characters. Pet them, talk to them, give them gifts, and decorate your workspace with image or GIF stickers. Join our community on Steam Workshop to share your own characters and discover what others create

details.title: 问仙程
details.short_description: 《问仙程》是一款追寻鲜活修仙体验的开放世界角色扮演游戏。你将踏上一段修仙之旅，体验不同寻常的修仙境界、凝练法相真身。与百态角色互动，触发丰富事件——结交仙友、争夺奇遇秘境。你的抉择将深刻改变众生命运，这片开放天地中，是救世之道还是灭世之途？全凭你一念之间！

details.title: Wild Wordopia
details.short_description: Language x roguelike. The incarnations of an ancient language (Proto-Indo-European) that is said to have existed about 6,000 years ago are reborn as "Wild Words"!

details.title: Lushlands Adventure
details.short_description: Reach the finish without being seen in a cozy top-down stealth puzzle adventure. Sneak past guards, use distractions, push objects, and explore colorful pixel-art areas from farms and forests to caves and snowy villages.

details.title: ObeyE
details.short_description: In ObeyE, you will play the role of a [Fake] New-Order priest. Roguelike combat, build your fortifications while planting magical plants. Craft and shoot all the Enemy you see!

details.title: FalseGods Gambit
details.short_description: "FalseGod's Gambit" is a Roquelike deck-building game (DBG) infused with our unique ideas, set against a backdrop of Norsemytholoay, Plavers will step into the boots of veteran soldier Rod, embarking on his final mission before retirement!

details.title: 永恒少女和天使
details.short_description: A cute shota game that heals both your body and mind

details.title: Mini Shopkeeper
details.short_description: Run your cozy little shop from the bottom of your screen, decorate to attract unique customers, hire assistants, and send adventurers for rare treasures - all in a lively, charming management sim!

details.title: Tokyo Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run your second-hand shop under Tokyo’s neon lights! 🏮 Find, buy, and sell unique Japanese goods and grow your store! 💰🎎

details.title: Rustmire
details.short_description: In this side-view pixel-art world, you captain a landship—survive by combat and scavenging, and grow your modular vessel into your own city. Among roaming cities and underground enclaves, records and wreckage hint at why people live this way… or how you become wreckage.

details.title: Still Stars Echo
details.short_description: An atmospheric science-fiction journey across distant alien landscapes. Traverse monolithic structures, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the story of a lost civilization written among the stars.

details.title: Stackatalbi
details.short_description: Stackatalbi is a survival game where you stack cards to collect resources and craft new items. Drag your hero over an open world, hunt, fish, farm and grow stronger to fight new foes. Play solo or online co-op with a friend.

details.title: Pilipka
details.short_description: A hand-drawn adventure based on Belarusian mythology and folklore. Pilipka just wanted to finish his shift at karchma and come home for dinner. And then so much happened that now he has to go on a trip to get Fern Flower in the company of his friend, a talking mouse.

details.title: Desire City
details.short_description: *City of Desire* is an idle strategy RPG set in an alternate-world, cyberpunk-inspired universe.

details.title: Bust Out
details.short_description: Bust Out is a chaotic co-op casino sandbox for 1 to 8 friends. Gamble at real tables, party at the bar, brawl with security and if you dare, sneak past the guards and clean out the vault. No timers, no pressure: every decision is a bet.

details.title: Seeking Immortality in the Sect
details.short_description: A seasonal multiplayer cultivation game. Join one of four sects, master unique arts, and shape your build. Fight World Bosses, explore realms, raise spirit pets, grow herbs, and brew pills. Seasons reset your progress, but pets, titles, and select rewards endure. Choose a new path each season.

details.title: Please Stay Dead
details.short_description: Please Stay Dead is an endless 2D tower defense against the undead. Build turrets, seal tunnels, burn corpses and face bosses with nasty tricks. Every run feeds a huge talent tree, so you come back stronger and hold out longer each time.

details.title: 平远县衙：从一
details.short_description: A historical mystery VN of ancient Chinese litigation. As an unranked legal advisor in Northern Song Pingyuan County, collect evidence, expose contradictory testimonies and debate in court. Every choice shapes branching endings, where written law often struggles to keep pace with human feelings.

details.title: Slap the Curse
details.short_description: A co-op horror game about a curse you pass on with a slap. Only the marked one can see what is walking towards them. Find the cursed doll and burn it before dawn - in a town that is different every night.

details.title: Knockstep
details.short_description: Knock on anything! A cozy little rhythm game where you knock real stuff around you—mugs, desks, even your belly. Your mic listens to every beat while the town animals get to work. Drop in your own songs and they become brand-new stages.

details.title: UNDERFED
details.short_description: An underground survival game built on proximity voice chat. Every sound in the dark is another person. The deeper you go, the harder it is to get back out.

details.title: Beyond the First Star
details.short_description: Beyond the First Star is a fast-paced 2D side-scrolling shoot 'em up. Choose your pilot, shoot down supply carriers for weapon cards, stack up to four support weapons that fire all at once, and take on handcrafted stages and bosses with unique attack patterns.

details.title: Horror Mahjong
details.short_description: Expect the unexpected! Play mahjong and stay alive in a haunted tea house. Pretend you can't see them—good thing you're well armed. Stock up, shoot, throw tiles, revive friends, and win your hand to get up and cover them. Survive until dawn and escape together, or keep watch with paper tablemates.

details.title: The Helios Accord
details.short_description: The Helios Accord is a post-scarcity science-fiction grand strategy game. Govern by consent, set doctrine, negotiate with civilizations, and send Citizen Minds beyond known space. Then Serenity of Dawn disappears. No wreckage. No distress call. Only an impossible signal that changes when observed.

details.title: Iron Grave:Planet 9
details.short_description: Iron Grave: Planet 9 is a sci-fi mech survivor game. Pilot multiple mechs with unique skills and evolution, slaughter enemies, unlock upgrades. Set on the ninth planet over a century from now, fight alongside your squad and become a hero.

details.title: Human Echoes
details.short_description: One day, a disaster known as "The Great Blank Event" erased every artwork in the world. As AI came to dominate art, science, politics, and society, you—a painter—lost an art competition to an AI and abandoned your passion. Everything changes when a mysterious black-haired maid appears at your door.

details.title: OutGraft
details.short_description: A high speed runner action game where you're always being chased. Vent your heat to knock enemies back, and survive with the power of parasites.

details.title: Bow Warfare: Multiplayer Combat
details.short_description: Step into a fast-paced archery arena where timing and precision mean everything. Outmaneuver rival players, adjust to changing battlegrounds, and make every arrow count. Ready your bow and dominate the field.

details.title: Beneath the Snow
details.short_description: One walk home becomes a journey through a fractured reality. Shift between two intertwined dimensions, where mirrors reveal another world, impossible spaces hide forgotten paths, and some routes only exist in the reflection.

details.title: Casanova Simulator
details.short_description: This is a visual novel game where players step into the shoes of a charismatic young man, building emotional connections through thoughtful choices. Your decisions directly influence affection levels, shaping your romantic interactions and delivering an engaging romance experience.

details.title: Floating Paradise
details.short_description: Spin, zoom, and explore a handcrafted 3D floating island to find cleverly hidden objects. Floating Paradise is a cozy, free-to-play hidden object game with smooth 360° camera controls, no timers, and a relaxing lo-fi soundtrack.

details.title: Albedo Carta
details.short_description: You awaken in a manor with no memory of who you are. Lead a loyal doll and a band of insolent servants through a snowbound land consumed by madness, in search of your lost self. A mesmerizing twist on fairy tales beloved for generations... Märchen Dark Fantasy RPG

details.title: Deadstate Heroes
details.short_description: Build a squad of 40+ unique heroes, combine their abilities, classes, and factions, and find effective strategies for fully automated battles. Develop your heroes and settlement in a world overrun by the undead.

details.title: Pixel Metropolis
details.short_description: Guide Paris through 10,000 years of history in a cosy city builder where your people build their own homes. Lay roads, provide services, shape society, and watch a tiny prehistoric settlement grow into a bustling modern metropolis.

details.title: FacePunch
details.short_description: Face Punch is a 2D fighting game where you create unique fighters from a photo. Customize their look, voice, and personality, then choose skills and design a signature ultimate. Create yourself, friends, or anyone you imagine—and take them into the arena.

details.title: 小小军团：合战三国
details.short_description: 《小小军团：合战三国》（也许是最讲究的战争策略游戏） 千人同屏史诗战场，开疆扩土城市经营。点燃指尖全战，智造掌上三国。

details.title: NERIS ZERO
details.short_description: A fast, hard-hitting quarter-view katana roguelite. Cut in three-hit combos, dash in and out, raise your shield. Rewrite how your blade strikes, swing found weapons or turn them into buffs, and chain burn, venom and shock into new swordplay every run. Fall, grow stronger in town, go again.

details.title: Footbik
details.short_description: Fast-paced tactical mini-football for true strategists. Plan your moves, and dominate the pitch with beautiful visuals and realistic ball physics. Every pass matters in this team-based football game.

details.title: GRAVE SLIDE
details.short_description: GRAVE SLIDE is a dark-fantasy puzzle roguelike. You have died more times than you can count, and beyond the gates at the top of the Tower you can finally die for good. Slide through rooms built from five ages of the dead, plan every route, and meet the legends who never found their way out.

details.title: Board Games
details.short_description: A board-game collection with dozens of different games from around the world. Create online rooms, play locally, or challenge the AI—pick a board and start.

details.title: DwarVein
details.short_description: Welcome to DwarVein, a world where you a trusty dwarf venture forth into inhabited caves on the search for valuable Gems. Careful though, there are creatures lurking in the dark abyss. They have stolen your trusted companions and hid them within the caves! Will you achieve the highest score!?

name: 别人家孩子都筑基了！ You Can Do Better!

details.title: 别人家孩子都筑基了！ You Can Do Better!
details.short_description: Cultivate, study, and work through a modern-day life. Choose techniques and set their order before automatic battles. When a life ends, leave a final wish and pass your legacy to the next generation. How many generations will it take to ascend? A demo is available now.

details.title: Math Defense Protocol
details.short_description: Deploy characters across a fractured mind, combine numbers and operators into equations, and turn every result into firepower. Build your squad, trigger bonds, and defend the last memories through story battles and endless challenges.
developers: 日食网络 Solar Eclipse studio
publishers: 日食网络 Solar Eclipse studio

details.title: Touhou: Cirno's Snowball
details.short_description: Nobody's buying Cirno's bingsu because it's too small, so she's rolling a snowball around Gensokyo to fix it. Strawberries stick. So do crates, rocks and frogs. See what kind of bingsu you can make.

details.title: Spear Dive
details.short_description: Hunt 80+ fish species in a first-person freediving sim. Learn their habits and manage oxygen and body heat. Gear up with spears, fins and wetsuits to dive deeper. Explore seas with daily changes in temperature, murkiness and waves, fill your fish encyclopedia and unlock new fishing grounds.

details.title: Arcade Together
details.short_description: Run the arcade. Play the arcade. Together. Team up with friends to run your very own arcade! From classic cabinets to extreme experiences, from a corner shop to a grand entertainment center — build your arcade empire, side by side!

details.title: Dungeon Typist
details.short_description: Dungeon Typist is a typing-driven dungeon roguelite where every word becomes an action. Type words to move, attack, and cast abilities while enemies act in real time. Dodge danger, collect gear, and build powerful combinations as you venture deeper into the dungeon.

details.title: The Off-Season
details.short_description: The seaside hotel is shut from October to March, and the winter caretaker is you. The owner's rules are pinned beside the key board: no guests. Somebody knocks anyway, after the last bus, in the rain, with cash and no booking. You decide who gets a key, and which room.

name: Tidy & Bright: Together at the Christmas Market

details.title: Tidy & Bright: Together at the Christmas Market
details.short_description: Cozy first-person co-op organizing and cleaning simulator! Sort gifts, sweets, decorations, toys and festive treats. Tidy up the Christmas market, earn points and restore order before the holiday crowds arrive!

details.title: Arcane Circuit
details.short_description: ARCANE CIRCUIT is a dark fantasy deck-building roguelite. Socket Core Cards into Emitters, chain Modules together, and create fully automated arcane circuits. Explore the wastelands, collect powerful Relics, and build your very own spell-slinging machine gun!

details.title: Re:Red
details.short_description: Stay on the path, Little Red. Spot anomalies in an uncanny, looping forest to reach Grandma’s house with your basket of goodies intact. If safe, press forward. If not, turn back immediately. Trust your paper map, explore strange new areas, and most of all, watch out for the Big Bad Wolf.

details.title: Me VS Demonking?Seriously?
details.short_description: This is a proper auto-battler game... right? Aside from the characters being a bit odd, the equipment a bit bizarre, and the skills a bit baffling... everything else seems pretty normal.

details.title: Let's Play Catch!
details.short_description: Throw. Catch. Repeat — and somehow it never gets old. Play a relaxed game of catch with the CPU or up to 4 friends online across a variety of stages. Try different pitches and balls, or jump into minigames like target practice, horse racing, ball toss, darts and bowling.

details.title: Tavern Game Night
details.short_description: Gather 2–8 players for seven online party games in a cozy fantasy tavern. Compete in word games, trivia, dice, drawing and deduction, then put those skills to use in Tavern Race, where challenges can move several players toward victory.

details.title: BEACON 09
details.short_description: You're a prisoner sentenced to work at a crumbling lighthouse. Every night, you race against the clock, repairing whatever fails before your explosive collar decides your time is up. Repair, explore, survive in this terrifying first-person horror game.

details.title: Backrooms: Misstep
details.short_description: Backrooms: Misstep is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore unsettling liminal levels, complete unique objectives, survive deadly entities, and uncover a path through environments where every wrong turn could be your last.

details.title: New Babylon
details.short_description: A massively multiplayer voxel sandbox set in a true-scale, procedurally generated solar system. One persistent shared universe, no levels or tech-tree gates — build, mine, craft, and survive on a Darwinian frontier where every planet and moon exists at real 1:1 scale.

details.title: Interpolate
details.short_description: A Dark day follows every night. Nothing will stop the world's cycle; it's your choice to change the outcome. Some days are easier than the last, but the strong face the challenge.

name: They’ll Hang You for That Face

details.title: They’ll Hang You for That Face
details.short_description: Tomorrow, you burn at the stake as a "Werewolf". To save your family, you gladly accept a false execution. But after death, you witness them being ravaged in a living hell. Through a time loop triggered by your absolute despair, you must weave the world's kindest lie.

details.title: MURABO
details.short_description: SOLITAIRE + ROGUELIKE + 90s LATE NIGHT FEVER DREAMS = MURABO

details.title: Arvel
details.short_description: Arvel — Action RPG + hybrid RTS. Build a squad of mercenaries, clear dungeons for loot, raise an army, and fight over the Arkon. Solo, with friends, or 1v1 up to 3v3.

details.title: Golden Bay: Desktop Aquarium
details.short_description: Golden Bay: Desktop Aquarium is a cozy ocean-themed desktop idle management game. Place a transparent bay at the bottom of your screen, raise fish and corals, welcome diving visitors, and care for a changing ecosystem. Earn income, upgrade your bay, and enjoy a peaceful companion while you work.

details.title: Utaburg
details.short_description: Utaburg is an open-world MMORPG. Join a world that puts a strong emphasis on immersion. Combat is dynamic. Choose one of four unique classes, then at level 40 choose a second class that complements your first. Fight, explore, create guilds, shape the economy - you decide.

details.title: CartWare
details.short_description: An incremental game where you go from a single-product online store up to global e-commerce domination. Manage your inventory, fulfill and ship customer orders, deal with suppliers, and expand your storefront across a retro desktop operating system, and become the world's #1 online retailer.

name: Fishing Cat - An Incremental Fishing Game

details.title: Fishing Cat - An Incremental Fishing Game
details.short_description: Fishing Cat - An Incremental Fishing Game is an active incremental game where you cast your line, reel in the big catches, and build your fortune one fish at a time.

details.title: Zone Rush: Floating Medieval Hamlet
details.short_description: A knight robbed of her floating home, left with only a sword. Capture Zones for more time, combo through Vikings, and topple the Fire Golems guarding them. Fall, and you lose score and drop to level 1. A fast-paced single-player action game: race across a multi-level village and beat your best.

details.title: Final Armada
details.short_description: Build ships block by block, command your fleet in real-time space battles, and choose your path through a roguelike campaign. Upgrade your ships, watch them break apart in combat, and uncover what happened to the galaxy around you.

name: お洒落無限ループ　すごろくドリフター

details.title: お洒落無限ループ　すごろくドリフター
details.short_description: Stylish Infinite Loop! Sugoroku Drifter is a roguelike where you build the board itself as your deck and aim for each stage's target score. Customize pieces, collect Relics from bosses, and find powerful combinations to overcome ever-tougher goals!

details.title: Linwu: Spirit Beast Ranch
details.short_description: Summon a spirit beast, raise it week by week, and take it up the tournament cups. It has a mind of its own, and every choice shapes how long you get together. A monster-raising sim drawn from Chinese myth. Free demo out now.

details.title: Blades and Hunger
details.short_description: A dark-fantasy text-based rpg with a detailed combat model built to simulate decision making in fencing, and a world delivered entirely in prose.

details.title: Verdict
details.short_description: Trapped in a high-stakes interrogation room, you must defend your innocence against an adaptive AI detective. Every answer is evaluated in real time—watch your words, because your own claims can convict you.

details.title: Evil Among Shadows: Hollow Creek
details.short_description: After Kevin's disappearance, Sam stays with her aunt and uncle to support them after the loss of their son. She and her friend Anthony soon stumble down the same rabbit hole as her cousin did, growing increasingly obsessed with proving there is a serial killer lurking in Hollow Creek.

details.title: Toast Cat: Scratch & Win
details.short_description: Raise a Toast Cat on your desktop that spits out all sorts of scratch cards. Whatever you're doing, it hops along with you; once it's earned enough affection, it'll pull out a scratch card just for you. No need to watch it constantly — scratch one in a spare moment and unwind.

details.title: Redraft FC
details.short_description: A football management game about hindsight. Inherit a real club exactly as it was, tear the squad up, and sign the players you now know were going to be great - at what they cost then. Play it forward season by season. Seven ways to play, from managing a club to being a pundit.

details.title: BROODHOUSE
details.short_description: Your deck is alive and it breeds. A creature card hits for its whole strain's population, so your power sits in the cards you never draw. Push past carrying capacity and the overflow turns feral in your hands. A roguelike deckbuilder about a colony that grows faster than you can hold it.

details.title: Wheel Street
details.short_description: Wheel Street is a roguelike deckbuilder on a circular board. Move and merge assets, combine strategy cards, and build a money-making machine. Grow on down days, cash in on up days, and unleash combos to beat rising weekly targets.

details.title: Panda Gambler
details.short_description: In this post-apocalyptic survival challenge, your goal is to earn money on a slot machine to stay alive and rescue more refugees. Every winning streak lets you save one extra refugee. While scavenging for supplies, beware of the mutant zombies lurking in the city.

details.title: Industeria
details.short_description: Build and defend a growing industrial colony on a hostile alien world. Mine resources, automate production lines, expand a massive factory, and protect your territory from relentless alien attacks in this top-down 3D strategy game.

details.title: The Cozy Tree Co.
details.short_description: The Cozy Tree Co. is a relaxing game about chopping, decorating and selling Christmas trees. Search the winter wonderland for the perfect tree, get creative with your decorating, and sell your creations to spread holiday cheer!

details.title: Monkey With A Gun
details.short_description: You're a monkey with a gun — but the gun is only for jumping. Shoot the floor to launch yourself up a wobbly, hilarious climb out of the zoo, where one bad shot sends you plummeting all the way back down. Rage-inducing by design. Easy mode included.

details.title: Drop Rate
details.short_description: A short incremental game about hunting monsters for rare loot by upgrading a resurrecting horde of unpaid interns. Warp the odds. Earn eternal retirement. All with zero labor cost.

details.title: WhiskersOS: Click and Survive
details.short_description: Your family computer has been infected! In this survivor-like roguelite, battle through hordes of viruses using your desktop applications as weapons. Recover corrupted data to level up, then upgrade your apps and drivers to purge the infection for good.

name: All Pool Players Go To Hell

details.title: All Pool Players Go To Hell
details.short_description: All Pool Players Go to Hell is a physics-based combat roguelite where your pool balls are your weapons, your deck determines your options, and every shot can send a carefully laid plan completely off the rails. Build your deck, line up your shots, and use real-time physics to survive.

details.title: Fish World
details.short_description: Eat or be eaten! Survive this endless oceanic survival action game! Start as a weak fish. Devour smaller prey to grow massive, and flee bigger predators! Evolve from a mackerel to a shark or legendary deep-sea fish. Feast to your limits and top the online "Global Ocean Rankings"!

details.title: Bells Of Velmora
details.short_description: The bells of Velmora have cracked, and the dead are getting up. Pick a hero, alone or with a friend, and descend through crypts, swamp and frozen peaks. Stack elemental rituals on the same button until it becomes a war machine, fall, grow stronger, and go again.

details.title: Doodle Academy
details.short_description: Doodle Academy is a card autobattler set in a school where students settle scores with card duels. Spend gold to recruit and upgrade cards, then arrange your team for automatic battles. Uncover the academy’s secrets in the solo campaign or test your lineup against other players’ teams.

details.title: Rap Or Die
details.short_description: Nobody knows your name. Your studio is small. Your ambition isn't. Create beats, write lyrics, record tracks, start beefs, and build your underground rap empire from the ground up.

name: Cats Must Be Petted! - An Incremental Game About Petting Cats

details.title: Cats Must Be Petted! - An Incremental Game About Petting Cats
details.short_description: Cats have one simple demand. They must be petted. Step onto a little patch of grass, find a cat, and give it some attention. Tap to get a cat's attention, then keep petting when it rolls over and reveals its belly. Fill its satisfaction meter and watch it happily run off...

details.title: Stockroom Syndrome
details.short_description: Build flatpack furniture and decorate showroom displays during the night shift in a giant Scandinavian furniture store, while demonic creatures hunt you through its ever-changing halls. HØLM. Build the room. Survive the store.

name: AI 位面旅者：无限世界

details.title: AI 位面旅者：无限世界
details.short_description: 《AI 位面旅者：无限世界》是一款由 AI 实时驱动的团队冒险 RPG。你带着队伍在位面之间穿梭：探索区域、完成任务、打怪、升级、招募同伴；也可以在信标塔手填世界观、区域、角色与部队，造一个完全属于自己的位面。剧情、敌人、事件全部由 AI 现场生成，没有两次冒险是一样的。每个角色都有自己的记忆与打算，会按自己的目标行动；你不在的时候，区域里的角色仍在自行流动。角色、装备、技能、血统分 D 到 SSS 品级，敌人与友军部队是成建制的单位；回合制战斗可手动指挥每一次出手。买断制，需自备 AI 服务商 API Key 驱动剧情。

details.title: Driver Survivor
