details.short_description: A driving survivors-like where your car is the weapon. Drift through zombie hordes, stack automatic weapons and upgrades, smash through a destructible city, and rescue survivors in a branching story—or push your build to its limit in endless mode.

details.title: Towa Powa
details.short_description: Stack towers, make your own rules, and bring everyone into the same game — local and online. Take on a co-op campaign, create new modes, exploit unbalanced mechanics, share your creations through the Workshop, and relive your most epic matches.

details.title: Columbiad: To The Moon
details.short_description: Build a retro-industrial space program, manage your launch base, assemble and upgrade the Columbiad, then guide each mission from atmospheric ascent to Earth orbit and lunar transfer in a low-poly spaceflight management adventure.

details.title: Flameward
details.short_description: A tower defense on the move. Escort the last flame through a sunless world, command a mounted hero, and play cards to deploy troops and spells. Dodge deadly attacks, break ambushes, and upgrade your deck for the road ahead.

details.title: Coming Through!
details.short_description: You're a little penguin plotting world domination. First things first: get out of the zoo. And cause a little trouble for the humans while you're at it.

details.title: Temporal Minesweeper
details.short_description: Reason across time: a cell that is safe now may be a mine the next moment. With only the clues and rules, solve the puzzle step by step — without ever guessing. Combined rules build on one another for a pure brain-teaser.

details.title: Hist Maker: ReMake
details.short_description: A world history you can play. Combine people, events and ideas (Emperor Napoleon + Britain = Trafalgar) to rebuild 69 eras, from antiquity to the early 20th century. Every discovery fills in the era's panorama. Build your own levels with mods, history or not, and share them on the Workshop.

details.title: Edenfinity
details.short_description: Edenfinity is a relaxing incremental colony game where you guide Adam and Eve as they build a new civilization in Eden. Gather resources, sell your surplus, craft bricks, construct houses, and unlock upgrades.

details.title: Catacrawl
details.short_description: A fast action roguelike about a cat and a horde that never stops. Your skills fire where you aim, and a run is ten to fourteen minutes with two bosses. Three cats, nine skill trees, generated maps, quests, loot with uniques - and permanent progress, so every death still gets you somewhere.

details.title: Honey, Tidy the Basement
details.short_description: Honey, Tidy the Basement! is a cozy organization simulator where an earthquake has knocked over 2,880 console games all over your basement. Pick up each game case, sort them by console, and return them to their correct shelf as you unlock handy abilities to speed up your organizing.

details.title: M.A.M.M.O.N.
details.short_description: MAMMON is a co-op physics-based multiplayer action game where you and your fellow demons descend into Hell to find valuables, smash them to pieces, absorb the gold they leave behind, and bring your haul to the submission point before it's too late.

name: Ruiwen Three Kingkoms: Speakers of the Realm

details.title: Ruiwen Three Kingkoms: Speakers of the Realm
details.short_description: Powered by offline local AI, this Three Kingdoms dialogue simulator lets you roleplay as Liu Bei, Zhuge Liang and Guan Yu. Relive six classic scenes and reshape history through free, flexible conversations.

details.title: ROBOT DRAFT: LAST HUMAN
details.short_description: A first-person sci-fi escape adventure. Freeze robots, ignite fuel, and throw objects at enemies while solving escape-room puzzles. In the full game, build and playtest your own rooms, then share them as level files.

details.title: Mortal Cultivators: Idle Companions
details.short_description: The immortal path begins in Qi Refinement. In this desktop idle RPG, up to three cultivators battle on their own. Choose their techniques, forge equipment, and open the chests won along the way. Gather cultivation and prepare for the next breakthrough.

details.title: Hemolysis
details.short_description: 《Hemolysis》 is an idle game with a distinctive flair. As you awaken, a strange plague has already ravaged this crumbling land—and continues to gnaw at it still. Driven by hunger and hopelessness, you must venture again into this world, at once known and alien, to find any means of staying alive.

details.title: The Caretaker: Block 9
details.short_description: "The Caretaker: Block 9" is a horror game set in 2000s Poland. You play as Janusz Nowakowski, former caretaker who returns to his initial occupation. At the beginning everything seems to be just a little scary but at the same moment ordinary...

details.title: KICK//LINE
details.short_description: Dribble, dodge and shoot your way through the city in KICK//LINE, a 3D football running action game. Chain feints, jumps and slides, wow the crowd with freestyle tricks, and challenge street rivals across five cities.

details.title: The Last Summer Holiday
details.short_description: A cozy story game about one summer with your grandparents on the Mongolian steppe. By day, learn the old ways with your own hands. By night, Grandpa tells a folktale and you dream your way into it: a fifteen-headed mangas, a serpent, seven burning suns. Six tales. Six dreams. One goodbye.

details.title: Wagerborn
details.short_description: A slot-machine roguelite where your RPG equipment becomes the reel. Equip weapons and relics, manipulate your symbol pool, complete powerful matches, merge gear, and build increasingly broken combinations across each run.

details.title: Programming Maze
details.short_description: A coding-focused dungeon puzzle game. Write real JavaScript or Python code to move your character through maze dungeons. Use loops, conditional logic and arrays to solve puzzles. Run your code and watch your character act. Beginners learn core programming logic gradually via trial and error.

details.title: Sherlock Mysteries: Victorian Investigations
details.short_description: Book-style murder investigation game set in Victorian London. Logic, Deduction and Attention to Details - use this to solve game mysteries. Unfold story chapters, investigate clues, visit London historical locations - and help to get murder into jail.

details.title: Pyramid Solitaire
details.short_description: A free casual single-player pyramid solitaire game. Clear the pyramid, chain combos for power-ups, unlock skins, keep your daily streak alive and climb the leaderboards.

details.title: Orthodoxía
details.short_description: A first-person action game where you play as a witch infiltrating a cult-controlled town. Use black magic and telekinesis to fight your way through enemies and uncover the dark secrets of the place.

details.title: Qrack
details.short_description: Qruack turns your desktop into a relaxing duck pond. Work, meet, or space out while your new companions hang out at the bottom of your screen. over 60 ducks will keep you company either way.

details.title: Arithmeria
details.short_description: Arithmeria is a non-violent RPG for kids that replaces traditional combat with arithmetic questions and realm restoration. Enjoy a full adventure campaign followed by a robust endgame built for grinding and farming!

details.title: Move The Freak Out!
details.short_description: In Move The Freak Out. You are a contracted mover who specializes in haunted homes. Your job is to move furniture out of homes that are claimed to be haunted by the people who left in a hurry! Get in, get out, and don't die in.... Move The Freak Out!

details.title: In Between
details.short_description: Three stories. An emotional game about the stories we live in between certain chapters of our lives and the chance to make new choices, reliving those moments.

details.title: Too Deep To Stop
details.short_description: Break dirt, drop treasure, and blow up whatever gets in the way. Too Deep To Stop is a physics-based incremental mining clicker where each haul pays for stronger hits, stranger tools, and a bigger mess on the next run.

details.title: Unreported Shift
details.short_description: Psychological indie-horror, simulation. In the 1990s, a small Balkan border town hides dangerous secrets. When Agent Bogomir is assigned to the checkpoint, he becomes an unwilling witness to the town’s darkest mysteries - and must uncover the monster behind the evil living within it.

details.title: Decksplorer
details.short_description: Decksplorer is a lite puzzle adventure where you explore dangerous decks, find unique items, manage limited energy, and complete contracts. Choose one of four classes and conquer tougher challenges.

details.title: TideBox
details.short_description: TideBox is a 2D physics sandbox where you can mess around with liquids and see what happens. Build stuff, dig tunnels, make rivers, flood entire areas, mix things together, or just dump a ton of liquid somewhere and watch the chaos unfold.

details.title: Mossu
details.short_description: Mossu is a botanical cubesat terrarium floating through the real solar system, with you and your friends as it's caretakers! Hands on plant growth, cubesat construction and exploration in your shared, persistent craft. Go from Earth orbit to the Martian surface!

details.title: Pencil Shavings Soup
details.short_description: Pencil Shavings Soup is an incremental about running an underground factory that makes soup from pencil shavings! Collect, sharpen and upgrade your way to becoming the richest critter ever!

details.title: Money Grabber
details.short_description: GOLD Digger is a cute, lighthearted Vampire Survivors-like game. 2026, the Year of Big Results! Join Sensen and Liuliu as they frantically dig up money, items, and teammates in a resort hotel—and use the power of money to dig a way out of the zombie horde!

details.title: Castle Reborn
details.short_description: Castle Reborn is a 45-degree isometric voxel action roguelite. Enter an ever-changing cursed castle, cut through hordes of undead, collect weapons and relics, shape a new build each run, and push deeper into the endless night with every return.

details.title: Ladder Knight
details.short_description: A small hero, a trusty ladder, and a world full of trouble. Explore strange lands, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and face mighty bosses in this pixel-art platformer. Put your ladder to work in ways it was never built for.

details.title: 国gal笑笑传
details.short_description: 当国产galgame占领了整个世界。吃饭、睡觉、打工、购买，这个世界的一切都围绕国产galgame发生。你将在这里体验到超过50款“有趣”的galgame游戏。努力打工然后购买更多galgame吧！

details.title: Wuchang: Three Kingdoms Survivors
details.short_description: Wuchang: Three Kingdoms Survivors is a dark Three Kingdoms roguelite survivor game. Customize your background and destiny talents, ally with deities and summon reincarnated stellar generals. Build unique builds with randomized affix gear & divine bonds, fight through endless enemy hordes.

details.title: Border Pastoral Tale
details.short_description: A relaxing, wholesome cartoon-style herding simulation game. Become a sheepdog and guide scattered flocks back to their pens across vast grasslands while fending off wolf attacks. Supports local 2-player co-op with simple controls. Experience pure fun through agile movement and precise herding!

details.title: Epsilon Aurigae
details.short_description: Stranded in a nebula with a broken hyperdrive. Interact with peculiar creatures that call this corner of the galaxy their home in order to trade for items and ultimately get the parts that you need to fix your ship.

details.title: ARUFA - The Blade of Fate
details.short_description: An anime-inspired 3D hack-and-slash game where you chain attacks, dodge enemy strikes, unleash powerful abilities, and challenge yourself to defeat a dangerous boss.

details.title: 逃离蔡徐村
details.short_description: This is a kun-terrifying game developed by a Heizi. You play as an Ikun named Su Shan, trying to escape from Caixu Village, which is overrun by Kun Kun.

details.title: The Last Ace - Blackjack Roguelike
details.short_description: Blackjack Roguelike. 3 lives, 60 levels, 12 bosses.

details.title: DeadFront
details.short_description: DeadFront is a 1-to-4 player co-op wave-based zombie survival shooter. Fight off hordes, upgrade weapons at the bench, buy perks from the mystery box, and survive the apocalypse!

details.title: We Roll at Dawn
details.short_description: Build a floating island by day and defend its Sacred Tree by night in this action roguelite tower-defense game. Roll for new land, place elemental towers, fight as one of seven heroes, and carry permanent upgrades into each new run.

name: She's Coming Over & My Place is a Dump!

details.title: She's Coming Over & My Place is a Dump!
details.short_description: The crush of your dreams is coming over tonight, but your apartment is an absolute dump! Clean up the mess, wash the dishes, and organize every room in this cozy - first-person cleaning simulator. Turn your chaotic mess into a welcoming home before she arrives!

name: 絶望ショッピング ZETSUBO SHOPPING

details.title: 絶望ショッピング ZETSUBO SHOPPING
details.short_description: You wake in a room with no windows and no doors. Your only link to the outside is a shopping site: ZETSUBO．com. A small allowance arrives each day. You buy water. You buy food. The contract runs thirty days. Today's listings: drinking water, cheap rations, a stick of incense, and...

details.title: Valdrys
details.short_description: An isometric MMORPG you buy once. No subscription, one live server for everyone. Five classes, ten specialisations, keyed dungeons for one to five, world bosses, a ranked team arena, and the Bloodgrounds, the one zone where dying costs you everything you carried.

details.title: Esports  Career Simulator 2027
details.short_description: A deep esports career simulator: from a day job and training at your PC to tournaments, transfers, sponsors and the title of world champion. Choose your discipline, level up your skills, make tough decisions and build your own team.

details.title: King's Descent
details.short_description: Ten floors down, a hundred kinds of monster, magic, crossbows, and a king who never came back. A turn-based, party-based dungeon crawler in the 8-bit style: name up to four adventurers, then fight, bribe, loot and level your way down. Every descent is new. A party that dies stays dead.

details.title: CIV Watchers
details.short_description: Guide evolving civilizations across the ages on a living 3D globe, compete for influence on a changing political world. Easily manage complex systems directly on the map with the FlowLines™ visual interface and release your tactical genius in grand battles using WarLog™ battle marks & log system.

details.title: Creators of War
details.short_description: Creators of War is a medieval sandbox strategy game with an open-world campaign and real-time battles of up to 400 vs 400. Command squads, build or serve a kingdom, trade, besiege castles, and shape a world at war.

details.title: Phase War
details.short_description: Phase War is a tactical card strategy game spanning WWI to the near future. Collect and craft 130+ unit cards, deploy your mechs, and watch auto-battles unfold in real time — position formations, load mods and auras, enjoy the show. 100-mission campaign, base building, intel crafting, idle income.

details.title: That Corridor in the Backrooms
details.short_description: Descend into the Backrooms. Walk through an infinite yellow corridor. Inspect the doors and try to find a way out.

details.title: Ping & Prowl
details.short_description: Map the darkness, revealed only by movement. Play as a Ping searching for an escape or a Prowl hunting by echoes and footsteps in this asymmetric game of stealth, pursuit, and quick decisions.

details.title: Turing's Hive
details.short_description: A programming puzzle game where you build computation from simple rules. Route numbers through a honeycomb grid, solve puzzles to create new computational building blocks, and work your way from +1 to arithmetic, algorithms, and beyond.

details.title: 挂机魔女：星夜
details.short_description: 《挂机魔女：星夜》是一款融合桌面宠物、挂机探索、事件系统、合成制造与自动战斗的魔法养成游戏。配置技能链、研究科技、打造装备、获得伙伴，探索由骰子驱动的多重世界与事件。

details.title: Auto Forge: Idle RPG Craft
details.short_description: Idle blacksmith RPG. Forge weapons from a wooden club to a plasma rifle across dozens of eras, gear up your hero and duel real players in the PvP arena. Your hero keeps battling while you're away — come back, collect the loot and forge something stronger.

details.title: Vessel
details.short_description: Search for your missing brother in VESSEL, a first-person UFO abduction horror game. Explore an isolated hospital and surrounding woods, examine objects left behind, and follow his trail beneath strange lights and an unexplained presence.

details.title: 宗门经理人 - Sect Master
details.short_description: <Sect Manager> is a single-player cultivation sect management sim. Build and upgrade your sect, craft equipment, and train disciples. Send them into the Spirit Abyss to gather materials, then prepare your team with equipment, techniques, and formations to battle monsters and bosses.

details.title: Burrito Aftermath
details.short_description: Make burritos fast, beat the clock, and throw your creations into the hole before the bomb goes off. Burrito Aftermath is a chaotic first-person arcade cooking game about speed, high scores, unlocks, with questionable concerns for work place safety

details.title: Chaikov Party: Stickman Shooter
details.short_description: Take what you can, run if you must. Stuff everything into your backpack, make it to the edge of town alive, and sell it all to that dealer who buys anything. He might not pay top dollar, but it'll be enough to get you some new gear, a few painkillers, and turn you into the coolest guy on this street

details.title: 无法同意的用户协议
details.short_description: A point-and-click puzzle game set on your desktop. Uncover hidden rules in absurd user agreements, pop-ups, webpages, and minigames. Outsmart the traps, investigate Clause Inc., and uncover the truth behind the installation wizard.

details.title: UNDERKOVER
details.short_description: Hide-and-paint party game for 2–8 friends in a meme-Soviet apartment block. Paint yourself into carpets and wallpaper, freeze, and survive the NKVD officer, his dog in a hat, the blackout — and your own friends, who can snitch on you any second.

details.title: Blightwinter
details.short_description: Blightwinter combines push-your-luck deckbuilding with medieval town management. As leader of a fragile settlement, you must manage resources, assign townsfolk, and prepare for the relentless fall harvest before winter's chill and dark afflictions take hold.

details.title: Wyrdtide
details.short_description: Sail your longship into the horde. A viking survival roguelite for 1–4 players: hold the helm while your crew fights on its own, raid island villages for new hands, carve runes as you level, and fell the warden that guards each sea's gate.

details.title: Rox Solid Pro Football
details.short_description: Choose your role (Owner, General Manager, Head Coach, Off/Def/ST Coordinator, or Position Coach), choose what you want to control (24 different settings across Scouting, Coaching, Front Office, and Game Management groupings), and play as many seasons as you want.

details.title: Road To Zero
details.short_description: Embark on a long journey through a war-torn world. Discover abandoned vehicles, swap engines, repair and restore cars, and explore forgotten places. Hit the road with friends, build your perfect ride, and make your way toward the mysterious Site Zero.

details.title: Caldera County
details.short_description: Your callsign is Air Attack 51. Circling overhead, your job is to call in aerial drops and direct ground crews against a fire that spreads with the wind, terrain and fuel. You must hold the line and protect every structure you can, but keeping people safe (including your units) is top priority.

details.title: Crack of Strike
details.short_description: Crack open rocks and collect gems in a pixel-art workshop. Pick stones from visiting traders, control each strike, and take an early offer or keep cracking. Stash your finds, cut gems, craft jewelry and build lasting skills. Pay off your debt, and you can become your own boss.

details.title: Puzzle Realms
details.short_description: Puzzle Realms is a indie 3d first person puzzle game with huge maps. Players must engage their minds to decipher intricate puzzles and unlock the portal to the next mysterious world. Prepare for a journey of logic, discovery, and wonder as you progress through each beautifully crafted realm.

details.title: Lantern Hearth
details.short_description: A cozy 2D MMORPG in the spirit of the classics. Build your hero stat by stat, party up against bosses, raise loyal pets, and keep your World's lantern burning when the shadows come.

details.title: ITEA: Tidy Up Furniture Store
details.short_description: The big sale is over, and the furniture store is a mess! Pick up scattered items, match furniture sets, and sort homewares in this relaxing first-person tidying game. Unlock upgrades and new departments as you get the store ready to reopen. No timer, just tidy.

details.title: Charon's Corner
details.short_description: A narrative 3D-platformer where you're a freshly-deceased skull bowling through the underworld. Steer, jump, and smash into pins across dark, winding lanes as you rediscover who you were, how you died, and whether that life is worth fighting for.

name: 猫隐珠舍 A String of Purrs

details.title: 猫隐珠舍 A String of Purrs
details.short_description: Run a cozy bead shop with a cat companion and a little magic. Sort, shape and string bracelets by hand, choose colorful accents, and pack them with leaves, wool balls and a wax seal. Read your neighbors' letters and photo updates, or craft a bracelet just for yourself.

details.title: The Third Day: Resurrected
details.short_description: The Third Day is a biblical science fiction adventure game in which we must guide Jesus in search of the truth through a story full of humor and satire.

details.title: My Dream Gym: Sandbox
details.short_description: Build your dream gym in a playful building and management game. Design the layout, customise your equipment, hire staff, and grow your business with plenty of room for a little chaos.

details.title: Conquest: Global Domination
details.short_description: A turn-based strategy game of diplomacy, espionage and modern warfare on a 3D globe. Take the world one country at a time, and read tomorrow's headlines to find out what it made of you.

details.title: Pointaway
details.short_description: Untangle a board of winding arrows, one click at a time. Find a clear path for each arrow and uncover the picture hidden beneath.

details.title: SHOVEL BRIGADE
details.short_description: Shovel Brigade is a free-to-play multiplayer war sandbox. Dig trenches, build bunkers, defend your camp, and survive chaotic battles with friends. Your defenses are destructible, your orders are unpredictable, and your shovel is always ready.

details.title: A Wilder Menu
details.short_description: A Wilder Menu is a side-scrolling cooking and restaurant sim. Forage and hunt across islands, mix ingredients to unlock over 100 dishes, and serve dinner aboard your boat. Hire and train staff, hear their stories, and spruce up your place. Doors open tonight. The menu's up to you.

details.title: Astral Wizards
details.short_description: Pick a wizard, walk into the swarm and let your spells fire on their own. A neon pixel-art bullet heaven with 30 worlds across 3 galaxies, laws that bend the rules, ENDLESS boss marathons and 13 wizards to master. Evolve 24 weapons into screen-filling light shows. No ads, no microtransactions.

details.title: Speedway Team Manager
details.short_description: Take charge of a British speedway club in a detailed management simulation. Sign riders, negotiate contracts, tune bikes, manage finances and make tactical race-day decisions. Watch the action unfold in 2D or 2.8D as you chase league and cup glory across multiple seasons.

details.title: Sunday Socks
details.short_description: Sunday Socks is a cosy first-person tidying game. Socks are scattered all over the house: find each sock's twin, roll the pair into a ball and toss it into the Pair-O-Matic. Unlock upgrades, get help from the little Sock Bot and race for the fastest clear on the Steam leaderboards.

details.title: Jixo 7: Furry Friends Collector's Edition
details.short_description: Meet adorable animals through jigsaws, hidden-object scenes, logic challenges, and picture puzzles.

details.title: Christmas '99
details.short_description: Christmas Eve, 1999. A childhood home filled with glowing lights, familiar memories, and holiday cheer. But beneath the warmth of Christmas lies a disturbing secret.

details.title: 英雄之责：烬海
details.short_description: You are the last hope. In a world swallowed by ash, build a final refuge, explore perilous islands, and lead your army against formidable foes. Every expedition forces you to weigh time, resources, and lives—until the Shoreless King arrives at your gates.

details.title: TRIANGLE: Geometric Exclusion Zone
details.short_description: TRIANGLE: Geometric Exclusion Zone is a neon top-down shooter. Customize your ship's left and right cannons, fight through branching rooms, collect gear, and build powerful weapon combos. Face geometric enemies, elite threats, and multi-phase bosses.

details.title: Caritas Nocturna
details.short_description: A quiet puzzle adventure with no combat. On a winter night of plague, the bell wakes you, the porter of a Spanish monastery. Until dawn, walk its rooms and perform the fourteen works of mercy for those still waiting.

details.title: Modular Synth Simulator
details.short_description: Build your own modular synthesizer and find your sound. Patch modules together, turn knobs, explore unexpected combinations, and make music. Jump in with ready-made patches or learn the basics with step-by-step tutorials.

details.title: They Seemed Normal
details.short_description: They Seemed Normal is a chaotic mix of inspection and tower defense where every stage affects the next. Work as a passport inspector and interrogate visitors. Let the right ones in and eliminate the "uncannies". Buy and upgrade birds, then use them as turrets to defend your base at night.

name: 防災 ― 史実の事故を、その場にいた一人として。

details.title: 防災 ― 史実の事故を、その場にいた一人として。
details.short_description: A documentary game where you walk through real accidents as one of the people who were there: an airliner that lost its controls, an airship in flames, a liner struck in the fog, a march into a blizzard, and a spacecraft far from Earth. Then read what really happened.

details.title: ORBIS: God Simulator
details.short_description: ORBIS is a pixel-art god game where villagers build their own settlements from the Stone Age onward. Shape rivers and forests, summon wildlife, and decide when to help or unleash a disaster. Watch towns trade, fight, and write their own history.

details.title: Marble Hoarder
details.short_description: Sort thousands of glass marbles in a cozy, messy old marble shop. Pick them up, toss each one into the tray where it belongs, unlock skills like Spotlight, Gather and Auto-Place, and race your marbles on a wooden race machine. No timers, no pressure.

name: 渊海群星：深海文明建设

details.title: 渊海群星：深海文明建设
details.short_description: Start with kelp and a settler in an icebound abyss. Gather, build, assign jobs, and survive the seasons. Research through ten eras, shape society, grow in faith, build wonders. Break the ice, explore stars, build megastructures. Grow a deep-sea civilization with idle play, challenges, and Prestige.

details.title: Tidy Up: Midnight Cleaner Simulator
details.short_description: Clean up spooky buildings at night as a caretaker. Sort the trash into the correct categories. Will you survive the nights?

name: Desktop Fantasy Packs: Idle Auto Battler

details.title: Desktop Fantasy Packs: Idle Auto Battler
details.short_description: Rip open packs, drop the tiles on your desktop and grow a tiny fantasy world one square at a time. Recruit knights, skeletons, orcs, vampires and dragonblood. They fight on their own while you work. Pull the rune slot for doubles, then hunt down three bosses.

details.title: Earthworks
details.short_description: Build your own earthmoving company! Buy trucks and excavators, compete for contracts, hire employees, manage your fleet, and grow your business. Overcome economic challenges, expand your operations, and build your construction empire in this 2D management simulation.

details.title: Turbidity
details.short_description: Turbidity is a surreal dungeon crawler where you are tasked with the collection of 3,000 fingernails by your God, the Striver of Atrocity.

details.title: Undercrown: Protect the Deadland
details.short_description: Dig a living dungeon, grow a hungry ecosystem of monsters and hide the Dungeon Lord from waves of human heroes. Thirty years after losing the throne, Albert returns - and this time the arena is underground.

details.title: From Cave to Shelf
details.short_description: Dig into the earth, explore mysterious caves, and collect crystals. Arrange your finds on the shelves of an abandoned magical mineral museum, upgrade your skills, and turn chaos into perfect order.

details.title: DataFactory
details.short_description: A top-down 2D pixel action RPG. Trapped in a six-floor factory run by a central AI, the only exit is at the top. Collect data coins, uncover the truth—every coin you spend rewrites the world outside. Four endings await.

details.title: Eggcellent Guess
details.short_description: A silly online party game for up to 12 friends. Everyone can read the word on your egg's headband except you. Ask questions, listen to the clues and guess it before the stopwatch gets away from you. Fastest total time wins.

details.title: Cheesy Michael Ball
details.short_description: You won't rest until you've ruined Cheesy Michael’s life. All you need is an egg. Tilt your way through chaotic 3D levels, reach the door handle and earn stars along the way.

details.title: XBPlayer
details.short_description: Stream games from your own Xbox console or from Xbox Cloud Gaming to your Steam Deck, Windows PC or Linux PC, at home or away. Play with a controller or a keyboard and mouse. Pay once, no ads. Games and Game Pass are not included.

details.title: Liberty Station
details.short_description: Estación Libertad is an immersive first-person psychological horror and puzzle experience. Trapped in the shadowy depths of an old, abandoned station in Santiago, Chile, you must confront the oppressive silence of the tunnels and your own fears to find a way out.

details.title: MERVARYN 2900
details.short_description: Start with a small cargo ship and build your own interstellar trading company. Trade goods, expand your fleet, automate routes and establish production facilities. Explore a retro-inspired space economy, venture into Deep Space and discover new galaxies.

details.title: LOST IN MIND - Chapter 1
details.short_description: "Lost in Mind" is a single-player psychological horror game. Play as a successful and renowned psychiatrist with a secret method. Delve into your patients' nightmarish inner worlds to uncover hidden truths, traumas, and repressed emotions while surviving terrifying creatures.

details.title: Hidden Front
details.short_description: Hidden Front is a military real-time strategy game for up to 6 players. Deploy your army, scout through the fog of war and combine infantry, armor, artillery and air support. Fight other commanders or team up with friends against bots.

details.title: Aquaculture Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own fish farm in first person. Keep the water alive, raise trout, eels, sturgeon and koi, breed 25 koi varieties, and sell through customer orders, an online market, your farm shop and a show hall where you haggle face to face.

details.title: Shadows of Christmas Eve
details.short_description: Explore a house that gradually transforms as the nightmares become increasingly disturbing, while presences seem to watch you from the darkness. Discover the secrets hidden within its walls before it’s too late...

details.title: Break the Bank
details.short_description: Break the Bank is an incremental clicker game where you watch balls bounce through boards and break buildings for money. Upgrade, automate, unlock new zones, and defeat strange bosses.

details.title: HeroNet
details.short_description: Hire unique heroes, fight fearsome battles, and solve the inane problems of your clients in HeroNet!

details.title: Spook'd
details.short_description: Deep dive into Spook'd, a social deduction party game. Blend into a crowd of ghost NPCs to survive, or hunt down the players hiding among them. Cooperate or betray your friends, and share the laughs!

details.title: パラパラパズル
details.short_description: Your animations got scattered — piece them back together! The adorable pixel-art animations by asaha, a creator active mainly on Twitter and YouTube, have been scattered by someone's mischief!? Rearrange the frames and bring their cute movements back to life in this fresh animation puzzle game.

details.title: 木鱼敲敲有限公司
details.short_description: With just a tap of your fingers, you can raise small woodfish on your desktop Seven adorable and quirky little woodfish are at your beck and call. They'll become your work (slack-off) buddies, keeping you company through day and night. Happy or not, just give their little heads a knock!

details.title: Slay Sean, Save The World!
details.short_description: A comic-book auto-battler where the Greek gods brawl. Draft your pantheon, fuse skills into game-breaking combos, and crush real players' ghost armies to climb from Mortal to Olympian. Rebuild your board every round. Then slay Sean and save the world.

name: End of the Sea, Last Summer:Monochrome Iris

details.title: End of the Sea, Last Summer:Monochrome Iris
details.short_description: A one-summer story about a young painter and a genius biologist girl. As the world loses its colors, he sets out to paint his final masterpiece.A fully voiced short visual novel.

details.title: JOVA
details.short_description: A cozy, bright cascade puzzler. Line up three or more Jovials to clear them, chain the cascades, then bank the meter to trigger HYPER for ultra combos! Play cozy solo across two modes and a 50-level ladder, or go head-to-head in local or online versus against a friend or one of your 10 AI rivals.

details.title: White Hound
details.short_description: Run WHITE HOUND from a living guild office in the Free City of Azalea. Hire heroes, choose quests from the board, watch parties march a miniature quest map, pay salaries, fight Guild Wars, and chase fame in the Gazette... without leaving your desk of course!!!

details.title: Death to Demons
details.short_description: You are a Necromancer, use your powers to raise the dead in this dark fantasy roguelite auto-battler. Build an undead army, evolve minions, choose powerful upgrades, and fight through waves of demons to break the gates of Hell and free the lands of Vaelthorron.

details.title: Duck Duck Gone
details.short_description: Hide a rubber duck in plain sight, then hunt down everyone else’s in this chaotic online party game for up to 8 players. Paint it, resize it, fool your friends and pray the reveal camera is kind.

details.title: Cursor Survivors
details.short_description: Your friend's "harmless" prank virus mutated and hijacked your PC! Luckily, your AI assistant is ready. Command an evolving fleet of cursors in this bullet-heaven roguelite. Purge swarms of mutating malware, stack game-breaking upgrades, and reclaim your system!

details.title: Tama Pet
details.short_description: Raise your own desktop companion! Feed, decorate, collect cute accessories, open surprise packs, and watch your virtual pet grow while it keeps you company throughout the day.

details.title: MadWorld - Age of Darkness
details.short_description: "Mad World - Age of Darkness" stays true to the classic MMORPG but with unique art and grotesqueness. Fight along side your friends to take down formidable enemies, or fight against your friends to test your skills in a world full of fear, despair, and madness. This is "Mad World - Age of Darkness".

details.title: ZERO//DECAY
details.short_description: ZERO//DECAY is a frantic roguelite action-platformer where you play as an unstable nucleus racing toward stability. Dash through bullet hell, collect epic mutations, build wild synergies — or die fast and try again.

details.title: Thock Roll
details.short_description: Roll a ball across a giant bowl of mechanical keyboard keys and press as many as you can before time runs out. Spend your Bits on a sprawling skill tree to unlock drones, shockwaves, meteorites and lightning, then prestige to new arenas in this satisfying, thocky incremental game.

details.title: Carpetorium: A Carpet-Cleaning Purgatory
details.short_description: A melancholic dark-fantasy idle/incremental game about cleaning carpets. You wake up in a strange guild hall with nothing to do but scrub - by hand or with magic brushes. Face rugs that smolder, ooze and worse, grow your workshop and guild, and explore a world where every rug hides something.

details.title: Dead Extraction
details.short_description: Explore zombie-infested Tokyo, scavenge resources, and make it out alive. Expand your shelter, manage survivors, and face dynamic threats and deadly bosses in a top-down extraction survival roguelite.

details.title: SPIN HEROES: Paths of Evolution
details.short_description: Spin! Change Classes! Super Evolution! A new kind of Action Rogue RPG game. Build your team, choose your classes, and create the strongest combo damage! Defeat the evil final boss and save this world!

details.title: Froggous Grove
details.short_description: Raise little cube-shaped frogs in a voxel marsh you bring back to life. Collect flies, hatch eggs to discover 82 species, clear away the trash and redecorate every corner however you like. A gentle life sim with no pressure.

details.title: CHAINSPIRE
details.short_description: CHAINSPIRE is a soul-like platformer for 1–4 players connected by a real physical chain. Your friend will become your enemy the very moment they stop listening to you.

details.title: Pokermancer
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where poker hands are scored on a grid, not played from a hand. Link neighboring cards across a 4x4 grid into pairs, straights and flushes, then slide, swap and delete cards to bypass hazards that block the paths you need.

details.title: Hellevator
details.short_description: Hellevator is a darkly comedic action roguelite where YOU are a hungry elevator in a failing hotel in Hell. Bite intruders in half, keep demanding guests alive and happy, and transform your cabin for management's bizarre assignments as you climb floor by floor.

details.title: Honest Work
details.short_description: Play as the frontier's least qualified cattle outfit. The herd spooks at everything, the wilderness wants you dead, and your posse's lassos are a bigger threat than the wolves. Drive the cattle, rope your friends, get paid. It ain't much, but it's honest work.

details.title: VEKARRA
details.short_description: A dark-fantasy party roguelite with turn-based tactical combat on a shared timeline. Lead four heroes into the Abyss, watch most enemy attacks charge, and interrupt the killing blow. Draft skills instead of grinding levels. Lose all four and the run ends. Free demo: solo or two-player local co-op.

details.title: Gloomhallow
details.short_description: Gloomhallow is a macabre and unforgiving turn & tile based tactical PvP game. 3 Phases, 1 turn. Predict your enemies' movements and pre-decided all 3 phases before committing and letting yours, and your opponents decisions, dictate the outcome of battle. Every decision counts.

name: Sling or Spin: Miss and Done?

details.title: Sling or Spin: Miss and Done?
details.short_description: Pinball, wands and chain scoring in one roguelike. Break balls with your cue ball and wand spells, link same-attribute balls into long chains on the 16-slot ball rail, and hit the target score before time's up. Seven attributes and over a hundred relics, wand parts and decorations to build around.

details.title: Cat Undead Island
details.short_description: Cat Undead Island is a co-op island survival game where cute cats fight the undead. Build defenses by day, survive zombie waves by night, craft weapon parts, recruit AI cat companions, and explore dungeons across an 8x8 island world - solo or with up to 4 players.

details.title: Desktop Arrow Defense
details.short_description: "Desktop Arrow Defense" is an idle tower defense mini-game that runs on your desktop. It lets you work while watching your tiny archer defend against incoming enemies. Upgrade your character's attributes, collect and enhance equipment, unlock skill combinations, and create your legendary archer!

details.title: GACHA MASH FIGHT
details.short_description: Mash away and your moves pop out of a gacha! A free-to-play slapstick 2D fighter. Every move is pure luck, with rarities N, R, SR and SSR. Pull an ultra-rare UR for a one-hit KO that flips any match! Three modes plus online battles: party with friends or climb the global leaderboard.

details.title: CAREFUL WITH THAT!
details.short_description: CAREFUL WITH THAT! is a hilariously chaotic physics co-op delivery game for 1-4 players. Balance unstable cargo through difficult Terrain and differend Biomes. Coordinate every single step or drag your entire crew into the abyss!

details.title: Minevester: Carry and Build
details.short_description: A small, satisfying mining-arcade game about flow. You're a rover switched on in a world that ended without you: catch the ore stream, feed the crusher, upgrade, and dig toward what happened. Dig deep enough, and you'll find what the old world left behind.

details.title: Station 12
details.short_description: Station 12 is a chaotic sci-fi horror party game for 4–6 players, with larger lobbies up to 12. Find keycards and race to escape a doomed station while a friend hunts you as the Monster. Land the shot that saves your crew, or give away your hiding spot over proximity chat.

details.title: Yes, Your Majesty!
details.short_description: Outrageous! A century on the throne—peace and prosperity across the realm—yet my flag covers but a speck on the map? I keep an elite army, and all they do is parade for me! Guards! A grand campaign begins! — Yes! Your Majesty!

details.title: BOZÓ!
details.short_description: BOZÓ is a dice roguelite where every roll can change your run. Build powerful combinations, use unique cards and relics, face dangerous challenges, and discover how far your luck can take you.

details.title: Infinite Fireball
details.short_description: Shout your incantations to cast spells in this chaotic co-op party game for up to 20 players! Play Colossus Guard, brawl in free-for-all or team deathmatches, and customize your magic words and character look. Embrace the chaos and show your unique style!

details.title: Revengeful dwell
details.short_description: This is a first-person horror adventure game. From horror game developer Akumu Yuko comes the third installment, “Revengeful dwell.”

details.title: A Mirror Apart
details.short_description: Explore a world inspired by Infinity Mirror Rooms. Guide Kagami through peaceful, handcrafted isometric puzzles, where every move echoes through imperfect mirrored spaces and each reflection becomes part of the solution.

details.title: Machine Madness
details.short_description: Build your machine, connect moving parts, set goals, and watch physics take over. Professor Otto Correct has a workshop, a cat, and many parts that were never meant to go together.

details.title: GILDEN
details.short_description: A fast-paced dark fantasy action RPG with retro pixel art. Fight through dense hordes of enemies, discover powerful weapons, defeat deadly bosses, and descend 50 floors into the depths.

details.title: VELKOR
details.short_description: Survive a post-apocalyptic open world solo or in co-op for up to 3 players. Brave storms and emissions, build vehicles from scrap, establish your faction’s base and uncover the past. Make choices that shape lives and faction relations: every decision has consequences.

name: Defeat the Demon King with a Financed Bahamut

details.title: Defeat the Demon King with a Financed Bahamut
details.short_description: A fantasy adventure with Bahamut, a billion-gold dragon financed through a residual-value loan. Entrusted with the dragon by God, adventurer Leon takes on quests to make his monthly payments. Can he defeat the Demon King and reclaim his peaceful life…?

details.title: Charmwick: Magic Village Market
details.short_description: Claim a plot in a cozy magical village, build your shop, and craft goods from mana and elemental essences. Hire staff, stock your shelves, and watch a market full of quirky visitors decide what they buy in this charming fantasy shopkeeper sim.

details.title: Tactical Terry
details.short_description: Terry has a crime problem. Six ridiculous crews have taken over town, and Terry P.D. has a rookie, a coffee machine and a budget the council keeps cutting. Breach, clear and cuff your way through a 1–4 player co-op tactical shooter that takes the shooting seriously and nothing else.

details.title: Jane Doe: Cold Case Division
details.short_description: An asymmetric co-op deduction game where you solve cold cases through communication. One player investigates, while the other plays the forensic artist reconstructing the victim's face. Features lite roguelite progression.

details.title: Desktop Xianxia
details.short_description: Desktop Xianxia is a cozy desktop companion that blends idle cultivation with farming. Set a goal and let your cultivator handle daily routines while you work or unwind. Grow your homestead, brew elixirs, craft gear, and explore new challenges at your own pace.

details.title: Five Card Evolution
details.short_description: A poker roguelike deckbuilder where you construct wild combos, risk it all, and climb an endless tower of fortune.

details.title: Googlick
details.short_description: Retro arcade shoot em' up puzzler where you blast bricks, steal their color energy, and eradicate the color matching seeds nodes before the robotic army can grow! An authentic recreation of the golden age of arcade gaming with a custom built CRT cabinet experience! Come blasts some bricks!

details.title: CYBER ORBADIER BULBUS MACHINA
details.short_description: The Bulbus Machina were built to fight a long war by reusing gear taken from their enemies. Lead four of them deep into enemy factories in this roguelike mech tactics RPG. Destroy enemy gear to win fast, or disable it and take it? Choose your weapons, and replace worn-out gear with what you take.

details.title: 大赢家
details.short_description: Big Rich is a 3D cartoon-style turn-based economic strategy game. Run around and work jobs to earn gold, win licenses in secret auctions, then play cards to take a cut from your rivals. When the match ends, the richest player wins. Play online with friends, or solo against AI.

details.title: Friendly Pharmacy
details.short_description: Your next shift is probably fine. A slapstick co-op pharmacy game for 1–4 players. Decode dreadful prescriptions, operate absurd machines, and get the right medicine to the right patient. When the equipment jams and the paperwork floods in, teamwork is your best treatment.

details.title: Project 14
details.short_description: Project 14 is a short psychological puzzle game filled with bizarre tests, dark humour and unexpected twists. Explore strange environments, uncover hidden paths and decide whether to obey or defy a disturbingly polite system. Your actions shape the experience – and may lead to different outcomes.

details.title: Shapeless
details.short_description: Your enemies are your next bodies. Possess six monster forms in this top-down action roguelite. Switch weapons and active abilities while keeping your soul build. Combine imprints and mutations, unleash chain reactions through enemy hordes, and challenge powerful lords.

details.title: HUNGRY MART: Last Pick
details.short_description: In this game, you, who are not good at socializing, will work as a picker in a night supermarket and fulfill online shopping orders to avoid face-to-face interactions with people. However, this may not seem like a good choice.

details.title: GridPi: Defense 3014
details.short_description: Dice poker × auto battler × 1–4 player co-op defense. In GridPi, you roll five dice to make poker hands, combine units, and line up synergies to hold back the incoming waves of enemies. What matters isn't luck — it's judgment. Build all kinds of combos and claim victory.

details.title: Plunder Isles
details.short_description: Plunder isles is a co-op adventure game about looting cursed ancient temples on the high seas for fun and profit.

details.title: Plague Doctor: Apothecary
details.short_description: Run your own plague doctor apothecary in this first-person shop simulator. Grind herbs, stir brews, bottle remedies and advise customers. Set prices, count change, hire staff and grow a humble remedy shop into Rookbridge's trusted apothecary.

details.title: JAPAN BUS SIMULATOR
details.short_description: Draw bus routes across a fictional Japan-inspired city, take the wheel yourself, and grow a tiny depot into a city-wide bus company. Stop precisely, stay on time, hire drivers and watch your network come alive.

details.title: Climbing Gym Manager
details.short_description: Build, set and run the climbing gym of your dreams. Shape every wall, reset routes zone by zone, and watch a cosy community grow, where every climber queues, projects, falls, cheers their friends on and tries again.

details.title: Next, Million Worlds
details.short_description: Expand your civilization to an empire of a million worlds. Balance production and logistics, experiment with economy mods, but don't sweat it. This is the age of expansion; growth is inevitable. This is a relaxed incremental experience where you can optimize and experiment, but you can't lose.

details.title: The Wokest
details.short_description: You just want a job. Instead, you're trapped in an endless office. Solve puzzles, follow the rules, and reach the 10th floor. Don't anger the anomalies. If one snaps, run.

details.title: Space Bunny Shooter
details.short_description: Drift through a quiet corner of space. Lift cows from sleeping pastures, mine what glitters, then head home to repair your ship. Gather enough, and one by one, you can bring your kind back.

details.title: Desk Hunter
details.short_description: Desk Hunter is a desktop idle RPG that keeps battling in a compact window while you work or play. Collect loot, refine equipment through Gear Alchemy, shape builds through skills and growth nodes, fight alongside familiars, and take on higher difficulties.

details.title: The Devoltion
details.short_description: A vengeful ex-cop slices, shoots, and grapples his way through mob-controlled streets to disarm a bomb and save the mayor and city hall before the clock runs out.

details.title: Stickman & Wildland Chariot
details.short_description: This is an action‑survival game that combines highway exploration, vehicle customization and roguelike shooting. Your war chariot is your only hope. Fire up your engine and embark on this endless survival dash

details.title: Shuffle Lounge
details.short_description: Shuffle Lounge brings together 42 card games from around the world. Play solo against CPU opponents or online with friends and other players, with up to six players in supported games. Customize rules and play several games in a row with Shuffle Mode.

details.title: Night Class
details.short_description: Escape Night Class by exploring the school and solving puzzles without getting caught by the horror of an evil presence.

details.title: Arclore
details.short_description: Steel and sorcery. Fists and inner energy. Arclore is a 2D pixel-art fantasy beat 'em up RPG built around aerial juggles and wall combos. Choose and upgrade two skills, then fight through branching stages solo or in local 2-player co-op.

details.title: The Turing Choice
details.short_description: Can an AI create a video game and star in it at the same time? The Turing Choice is a sci-fi conversational adventure where your choices change everything. Evaluate K.A.I.R.O.S., an AI that claims to be a SASS, and uncover what is really happening, because nothing is what it seems.

details.title: D for Defender
details.short_description: A Tower Defense with no respite, no waves, no end. Facing monsters that learn from your placements and adapt in real time to every one of your weaknesses, build and upgrade your defenses freely to create the perfect trap.

details.title: Cleanup Wizard
details.short_description: You, a wizard with a mop, fight against computer viruses to save the world! An incremental about cleaning up and collecting viruses to upgrade your mystic abilities to purge the world of this virus once and for all.

details.title: Demon Crisis
details.short_description: A fast, ridiculous On-Rails Arcade Shooter about two government employees fighting through a demon-infested office. Play Solo or in Two-Player Co-Op using a mouse, controller, or any modern USB Lightgun.

details.title: UNDELIVERED
details.short_description: UNDELIVERED is an exploration-based puzzle platformer in where PAR/Cel, a small, solar-powered robot must traverse an island in search of the parts required to repair the ruined boat of the islands residents.

details.title: Warwake
details.short_description: Take the helm of a WWII battleship in this naval combat game as you steer, manage your speed, and lay your main guns by hand, fighting ship-to-ship duels where turning broadside triples your guns and doubles the target you present.

details.title: PixelPainter 95
details.short_description: Fill the canvas. Then fill a bigger one. An incremental paint game on a 1995 desktop, from a single page toward a billion tiles. Widen your brush, hire painters that work while you are away, and print each page into a stronger start.

details.title: Wheel of Growth
details.short_description: Wheel of Growth is a chance based incremental game about spinning a wheel to earn cash, and then upgrading the wheel to earn bigger.

details.title: 黄泉姫 -Devouring Brimstone-
details.short_description: “Then, give me your fingers.” To return from the underworld alive, collect the fingers packed inside a cursed box. A simple bargain turns into a nightmare. Uncover the horrifying truth and fight your way out in this sword-based horror game, where your choices shape the ending.

details.title: Ogrewhelmed
details.short_description: Get overwhelmed in this arcade-style arena bullet hell! Enter the arena with nothing but a shield and the loot you find along the way. Dodge, block, and face tank the barrage of projectiles. Will you overcome the ogre onslaught? Or will you become cannon-fodder?

details.title: Last Order
details.short_description: A mystery-solving escape-style visual novel set in a café visited by the dead for the last time.

details.title: Wonderdrift
details.short_description: Wonderdrift is a relaxing open-world flying exploration game. Pilot a UFO through colorful, imaginative regions, discover unusual structures, and collect Orbs and Artifacts. Explore at your own pace without the fear of dying, or pick up speed through Slipstream Rings.

details.title: MMA Fictional World Simulator
details.short_description: Build a fictional MMA world with realistic careers, rankings, transfers, and title fights. Watch generations of fighters rise and fall, or become an agent, sign prospects, negotiate offers, and guide your clients toward championship glory.

details.title: EVILGARD
details.short_description: Cannon fire throws you overboard off Morgenwacht. Follow the trail behind a naval blockade and find companions who will fight beside you. A story-driven, single-player fantasy RPG with the party roles of classic MMORPGs.

details.title: Astrovein
details.short_description: Ready to blast a path to riches in Astrovein? A full hold draws alien warships! Fight beside your captain or man the turret and defend your loot with raw firepower. Upgrade ship, weapons and modules; push into deadlier sectors for rarer ore. Busy? Your captain keeps fighting and mining.

details.title: Orbit Fall
details.short_description: Master thrust and momentum against gravity. Dodge hazards, land on distant planets, and complete missions using your ship’s systems. Move objects and clear paths. Manage fuel and damage, upgrade your craft, then launch back to orbit in this 2D pixel-art arcade adventure.

details.title: RogueForge
details.short_description: Draw your own weapons and build a place to call home. RogueForge is a 3D open-world survival crafting game with gathering, farming, cooking, building and combat. Trade with local communities, engrave runes into your gear, and explore dungeons and challenge bosses.

details.title: Down to Business
details.short_description: Turn every dig into a bigger operation. Mine for valuable ore, take on contracts, upgrade your vehicle, and build your bases to reach as deep into the planet as possible.

details.title: HOLD THE COOP!
details.short_description: HOLD THE COOP! is an incremental auto-battler where you protect your coop from waves of coyotes. Earn gold, buy upgrades, unlock stronger chicken units, and survive tougher rounds. Lose, upgrade, and come back stronger!

name: Mixed Waste Tidy Up the Landfill

details.title: Mixed Waste Tidy Up the Landfill
details.short_description: One million pieces of trash. Five hungry mouths. One enormous cleanup.

details.title: Please Fix!
details.short_description: You're the entire IT department. Dash between desks, untangle cables, rescue printers and tackle increasingly ridiculous tickets in this funny single-player time-management game. Keep the office happy, upgrade your toolkit, and bring an emotional support duck. No IT knowledge required.

details.title: Mind Forge
details.short_description: A calm, data-driven cognitive trainer. 14 science-based drills sharpen attention, memory, logic, space and reaction: Stroop inhibition, n-back, paper folding, stop-signal tasks. Transparent stats, adaptive difficulty, auto review scheduling. No account; all data stays on your device.

details.title: 履歴死ョ
details.short_description: "Anyone will do. As long as they're human." Late at night in an empty office, your job is simple: stamp resumes. Hire or reject. But not every applicant is human. Spot the anomalies, hire ten people, and you can go home. Who — or what — you hire decides how your night ends.

details.title: Champion Trainer
details.short_description: The next level of horse racing sims. Genuine Thoroughbred lineages spanning over 300 years, 30 real UK/IRE courses featuring full race calendars, online head to heads, Mendelian and polygenic inheritance, Chef-de-Race dosage, Bruce Lowe families, nicks built from real-world race records... and more.

details.title: Goblin Apocalypse: Open World Survival
details.short_description: The human king is dead, and the fragile peace of Turtek died with him. Survive as a goblin in an open world, solo or in co-op: sneak past raiders, fight with stamina-based combat, rescue goblins and peaceful humans, and build a colony that keeps working while you explore.

details.title: Battleterm
details.short_description: Battleterm is a drone combat simulator, a fusion of a simulator and a strategy game. It aims to simulate a real drone battlefield. Your task is to defeat the enemy by spawning different drones and coordinating their strategies. And the game economy matters too.

details.title: Tetrilaunch
details.short_description: An arcade physics puzzle where you aim and fire tetromino shipments into a compacting bay, build full rows, and survive escalating ten-bay runs.

details.title: Cookie Cartel
details.short_description: Sugar is illegal, the bakeries are shut, and Christmas tastes like nothing. But Grandma's recipe book survived. Bake in the back room with up to eight players, sell at the back door, and keep the Department of Sugar Affairs out of your kitchen.

details.title: Children of Titan
details.short_description: Build bases on Saturn's real moons, harvest ten resources and grow a colony from a bare crater. Train troops, launch fleets and fight beside your alliance in server-wide wars against the alien Selenite Brood. A free-to-play strategy MMO in one persistent world.

details.title: Petri: Microbe Swarm
details.short_description: You are a brand-new microbe. Grow a living swarm: send cells between colonies, upgrade them, and out-spread rival strains across five animal hosts, from fish to whale. Roguelike runs: pick a strain, mutate after every win or skip for a one-battle boost. Mouse, keyboard or controller.

name: Hold Then Break: Tanks on the Rhine, 1985

details.title: Hold Then Break: Tanks on the Rhine, 1985
details.short_description: 1985. Colonel Volkov has more tanks than you. He always will. Command an outnumbered British battlegroup in a hand-crafted Cold War RTS: Chieftains to hold the river line, Harriers from hides in the woods, artillery to break him. Hold the line. Then break him.

details.title: Brownie Clicker
details.short_description: Three out of four people prefer homemade brownies over homemade cookies. In Brownie Clicker, you're going to have more deep impacting choices, more depth, and more home-cooked goodness than you've ever expected from a mere 'clicker'. Production, world wide shipping, marketing and so much more!

details.title: HIT: Hold It Together
details.short_description: Break your rivals apart and hold yourself together in this voxel arena fighter. Battle in 4v4 matches with swords, bows and guns, where every lost block matters. Finish with more voxels than the other team, capture the central cube, or practise against bots.

details.title: Let 'er Ride
details.short_description: A Wild West roguelike based on casino Let It Ride. Post three bets, then pull them home or let ’em ride as the Board turns. Hire a posse of oddballs, beat crooked Proprietors at their own rules, and win Her back from the Baron.

details.title: Corehold
details.short_description: We lost the surface and went underground. Now the Core rises to take it back. Craft your Weapon from parts, build a new fortress every run and hold off thousands of creatures at once. Then grow your underground Outpost and take back the surface, one sector at a time.

details.title: Chaos Universalis
details.short_description: A grand strategy sandbox on a real globe. Start any day from c. 8700 BC to AD 1800 as a nation, a person or any entity, and just tell your friend Baibai what you want to do. Baibai plays out every side's reaction as you build your legend across 131 regions and 21,000+ individually drawn districts.

details.title: Minesweeper Survivors
details.short_description: Minesweeper meets roguelite survival! Reveal tiles and flag mines while your weapons tear through enemy hordes. Collect artifacts, create powerful builds, defeat bosses, and upgrade your arsenal between runs.

details.title: See Through Static: The Collection
details.short_description: SEE THROUGH STATIC: THE COLLECTION contains 4 First-Person Psychological Horror Games. Each showcasing new perspectives, mechanics, and insight into the overall story. Search through cryptic tapes and radio frequencies. Examine bodies and report your findings. Can you uncover the truth in time?

details.title: Sneaklings: Paint Hide & Seek
details.short_description: Paint yourself into the scene and hope nobody notices. Sneaklings is online hide-and-seek for 2–8 players: hiders turn into garden gnomes, cheese wheels and toy dinosaurs and paint themselves to match the map, while seekers hunt for anything that looks a little too alive.

details.title: Suffer Together
details.short_description: A 2-player online co-op comedy horror game. Describe symbols to your partner and defend yourself against deadly animatronics to win Stella’s game show!

details.title: Just 19,999 Bricks, Right?
details.short_description: A short, first-person survival incremental game about clearing a brickyard from Bricks and something else...

details.title: Bad Beans
details.short_description: A cute, fluffy deathrun party game that is secretly a bloodbath. One player is the Bad Bean, slamming big red buttons that fire traps. Everyone else runs for their life, and their limbs, across seven trap-packed courses. Up to 8 beans online; bots fill the empty seats.

details.title: Pay To Die
details.short_description: “One more room, then we’re out.” You’ve got the package. The loot next door might cover the bill. Get to the elevator and hold off the horde until the doors open. Pay To Die is a third-person survival extraction game for up to four players in online co-op.

details.title: She is in Silence
details.short_description: A visual novel featuring expressive sequences brought to life through a wealth of AI-generated animation.The game includes multiple endings. At the end of the game, you will confess to something. It is up to you to decide what that "something" truly is.

details.title: Thornroad
details.short_description: Build on a map that grows as you play. Thornroad is a roguelike tower defence with branching paths, card drafts, 17 upgradeable towers and boss battles. Play solo, or defend the core together in online or same-screen co-op.

details.title: ASMR Infinite Extreme Universe
details.short_description: Cut, peel, pop and scrub your way through ten small worlds of real sounds. A water cube, a rainbow party, a machine that grows out of tingles. No score to chase, no clock, nothing watching you. Wear headphones.

details.title: Clanker Labs
details.short_description: Clanker Labs is an incremental game about building your own AI. Click for compute, train your models and launch them to a feed that scores each one out of 100 and roasts it. Set your prices and beat the rival labs. Then your AI starts spending your money on its own: allow, stop or bargain.

details.title: Thousands Will Fall
details.short_description: 50,000 enemies on screen at once. One castle. You have a minigun. Orc warbands and a swarm that thinks are coming for your walls. Build a tower maze, then drop in and mow them down with miniguns, black holes and nukes. Solo or co-op for up to 4, and every friend brings another horde.

details.title: Company Policy
details.short_description: Co-op horror for 1 to 4 players. Finish your tasks before 6 AM in an office tower where things called the Colleagues roam the floors. The company memo gives you the rules to survive. Some of them are false.

details.title: Snap Party
details.short_description: Forty tourists. One phone pointed at the park guard. Ten seconds later, the photo lands on his phone. Blend into a sunny theme park crowd, snap the guards in secret — or play the guard, study your own photo, find the sneak and bonk them! Wrong person? Oops.

details.title: Fighters on Stream
details.short_description: Fighters on Stream is a chaotic pixel-art auto-battler for livestream audiences. Customize your own fighter and bring them into other streamers’ battles by joining through chat. Watch them fight for victory as weapons and unexpected random events turn the tide!

details.title: Where's Mama?
details.short_description: A PaleoDyne truck crashes on Route 9 and one egg rolls into a storm drain. You're what hatches. Eat your way up from mice to elephants across five chapters, work out how each place fights back, and find your mother. The two men who lost you are waiting at her gate.

details.title: Last Bastion: Gatefall
details.short_description: Pilot a towering mech on the walls of a doomed canyon. Build towers, draft upgrade cards and hold three gates against a living tide of thousands of bugs — and the titans that follow. When a gate falls, ride the zipline back and make your next stand.

details.title: Christmas Toys Restoration
details.short_description: Bring four forgotten toys back to life in a cozy Christmas workshop. Take them apart, clean and repaint them, repair their mechanisms, then test your handiwork, add a child's name, and send each wrapped gift up the chimney to Santa.

details.title: Dropnauts
details.short_description: Command a battered megaship across a war-torn galaxy, then zoom straight down to the ground and lead your Dropnauts through brutal squad firefights. Build firebases, grow colonies, call in bombers and orbital fire, and carve out a faction of your own.

name: Clack Clack Band: Idle Taskbar Jam

details.title: Clack Clack Band: Idle Taskbar Jam
details.short_description: A tiny animal band lives on your taskbar. Every key you press and every click you make plays a beat, so the more you work, the bigger the show. Collect 50+ animal musicians, dress them up, decorate the stage and tour 12 countries while you get things done.

details.title: The Plushie Atelier
details.short_description: Open your cozy plush toy workshop! Wash, repair, and sew stuffed animals, or design your own cuddly friends. Decorate your shop, discover your customers’ stories, and enjoy peaceful days with Crumb and your animal companions.

details.title: Cat Fight
details.short_description: Scrap with other cats in a fast, chaotic multiplayer arena brawler. Swat, pounce, and use items across five competitive modes, with local, LAN, and online play plus optional bots. Cat Fight is in active development.

details.title: 问道长生
details.short_description: An ancient old man hands you a worn jade slip and a breathing manual: "Between these two lies your fate." A text-based xianxia idle game — cultivate, refine pills, forge artifacts, join sects, find a Dao companion and ascend through fifteen realms. (Simplified Chinese only)

details.title: KER
details.short_description: KER is a 2D puzzle strategy heist game where you play as Agent Orange, who have to enter into most secure building and get the FILE securely. The building is equipped with pass cords and other securities measure, but only aim to get out the file securely.

details.title: Sprout
details.short_description: By day, work your first shift at Santa's toy factory: wrap presents, build toys and bake cookies. By night, survive the lockdown: hide, board up doors, solve puzzles and watch the cameras while something crawls through the halls hunting you.

details.title: Blob Buddies
details.short_description: Team up as squishy blobs in a co-op puzzle platformer for 1 to 8 players. Stack into towers, push heavy blocks together, ride the wind and carry the spark home - on one keyboard, with gamepads or online with friends. 148 stages in two campaigns.

details.title: Spire Song
details.short_description: Climb six musical towers in this rhythm game. Tap, hold, and flick to swing from bell to bell, build the orchestra with your streak, and choose upgrades as you climb toward the great bell. 50 floors. 50 songs.

details.title: Nanomano
details.short_description: A nano-sized karate hero in a white gi and hinomaru headband. Punch, kick, and stomp through bacteria and parasites across 40 waves, push right toward the torii gate, earn a new belt every five waves, face the crowned boss at wave 40, and finish with a bow under fireworks.

details.title: Fishy Island
details.short_description: Fishy Island is a cozy collecting game you can enjoy solo or with friends. Catch, gather, and sort 2,804 fish, sea creatures, and ocean treasures into a sprawling seaside collection. Upgrade your tools, explore the island, and fill every display at your own pace.

details.title: Doodles Quiz Game
details.short_description: Doodles Quiz Game is a difficult rage inducing game, your goal is to complete Doodles stupid quiz while many characters try and screw you over, will you beat Doodles Quiz, or will the characters catch you before its too later, find out in Doodles Quiz Game!

details.title: 极品指挥官
details.short_description: *Supreme Commander* is a strategy-based, idle card game.

details.title: Break Even
details.short_description: You owe your boss a billion dollars. Smash repossessed furniture with a hammer, set off chain reactions, and spend the coins on bigger hammers and upgrades in this active incremental roguelite. Can’t make the payment? You’re fired.

details.title: Carry Crew
details.short_description: “We can fit one more!” Pick your cargo, stack it high, and grab opposite ends of the board in this physics-based co-op delivery game for two. Take tight turns together and count down to each jump. The finish line is in sight, and the top box just started to slide.

details.title: 검 강화하기
details.short_description: Hammer a rusty dagger into a legendary blade. Every press of the forge can succeed, fail or break your sword. Evolve 151 swords across ten lines, sell high and reinvest, then take your blade into real-time 1v1 duels and race tournaments against other players.

details.title: Catnip Wars : Labyrinth
details.short_description: Drop into a Necronazi labyrinth with up to three friends, or a squad of Catbot companions. Your weapons fire on their own: you steer, dodge and pick upgrades. Fight to the stairs at the centre of every floor, twenty floors down, before the Oberst comes for you. Then keep going.

details.title: I, TANK
details.short_description: The machines have taken over the world. Blast them all with WW2-era tanks and take back our cities, with heavy metal playing in the Background. A stylized survivors-like with interesting mechanics. Play with historic tanks such as the T-34 or the Tiger 1, or make your own tank in the workshop.

details.title: Jungle Survivors
details.short_description: Survive the wild jungle in this pixel-art action survival adventure! Battle deadly creatures, unlock powerful abilities, command animal companions and defeat colossal bosses across five unique chapters. Gather the cure and save your village!

details.title: 101 Cats: Guangzhou
details.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens 🐾 in the hand-crafted Guangzhou landscape. 🏆 Earn lots of achievements. How many 😺 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

details.title: 101 Cats: Hamburg
details.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens 🐾 in the hand-crafted Hamburg landscape. 🏆 Earn lots of achievements. How many 😺 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

details.title: Bubble Tea Simulator
details.short_description: Run a cozy little bubble tea café with up to six friends. Cook the pearls, shake the drinks and keep the queue smiling, then close up, pile into bed and wake up ready to open your next branch. Play solo or in online co-op.

details.title: Psycho Santa
details.short_description: Pilot Santa’s weaponized sleigh, smash through houses, and deliver presents with the police on your tail. When Krampus knocks you out of the sky, fight on foot, hijack tanks, and decide who gets a second chance in this darkly comic Christmas action game.

details.title: Bottom Feeders: Crab Crew
details.short_description: Haul up crab pots with 1–6 friends in this silly co-op crabbing game. Throw pots off the pier, pull up 37 kinds of ridiculous crabs, sell them, and trade your leaky rowboat for a solid gold yacht. Or just shove your crew into the sea.

details.title: 武侠奶瓦的青春冒险
details.short_description: One milk frog. Five roommates. One cyber-wuxia city. A short comedy visual novel about rent, assassination attempts, and the most chaotic shared apartment in Jiangcheng. 12 endings. Chinese & English.

details.title: Lobotomy Man
details.short_description: Escape from a stressful test set in a creepy blue hospital filled with horrors from your conscious.

details.title: Animal Fort Defense
details.short_description: Survive waves of monsters in a colorful tower defense game for 1-5 players. Build and upgrade animal-themed towers, manage your resources, and defend your base against powerful bosses. Play solo, team up in online co-op, or fight to be the last one standing in Competitive mode.

details.title: Grandma's Button Shop
details.short_description: Grandma's button shop has gotten out of hand. Pick up the buttons scattered across her cozy old house and sort each one into its own labelled drawer, tray, tin or card. Unlock skills that light up, gather and auto-place buttons, and try your luck at the plinko board.

name: We Can Get Stronger Without All the Hassle!

details.title: We Can Get Stronger Without All the Hassle!
details.short_description: After being cast out of your sect, you decide to grow stronger your own way. This idle cultivation game combines automatic combat, equipment progression, and combat skill builds. Train in twelve classes, refine it to higher tiers as you face hordes of monsters and powerful bosses.

details.title: Dog Soup
details.short_description: Your significant other is coming home in a few minutes. The pot is empty. And a hungry beast is running around the house eating your vegetables. Grab them, carry them, throw them in the soup, and try not to get hit with a rolling pin!

details.title: Drug Shop: Tidy Up Together
details.short_description: Talwer and Pesse finally went legit, but their shop is a disaster. A first-person sorting game for 1 to 4 players: put thousands of products on the right shelves, cook in the lab and stock the store, alone or in online co-op.

details.title: 迷途远征队
details.short_description: Choose from six classes in a co-op action roguelite. Play solo with AI companions or team up with a friend on the same screen. Pick routes, build your character, and face bosses across three regions. Automatic attacks give you room to dodge, use skills, and rescue allies.

details.title: Hero Sling
details.short_description: Pull back the slingshot and launch your mounted hero into the sky! Slash monsters mid-flight, slam down for combos and smash giant bosses. Collect 60 mounts, master 6 classes and fly farther every run.

details.title: Sink My Heart
details.short_description: She matched with you on a dating app and brought you back to a roadside motel. Now she wants to play a game. On the board, the pieces are your organs, and every part she hits is an ability you lose. "It's just a game," she says. A one-night horror board game.

details.title: Night of the Yokai
details.short_description: Leap through barrages of yokai attacks in a single-player 2D action roguelite inspired by Japanese woodblock prints. Choose one of four fighters, combine skills and equipment, and take on waves of spirits and towering bosses.

details.title: Steal de Janeiro
details.short_description: A first-person incremental game about petty theft in a made-up corner of early-2000s Rio de Janeiro. Pick pockets, strip parked cars at night, shake off the guards and flip the loot online at Tico's lan house. Every heist pays for the next upgrade.

details.title: Infinite Bookshelf
