details.short_description: Sort colorful books and watch flowers bloom in this cozy 3D puzzle game. Drag books into matching shelf compartments, use your tray to plan each move, and bring order to a tropical library with procedurally generated layouts.

details.title: Snowman Left Behind
details.short_description: A cozy team snowball fight for up to eight friends. Build a snow fort, pelt the other team until they're snowmen, then hurry over to rescue your frozen friends. Nineteen wintry maps, each with its own trick: sleds, toy trains, catapults, sheep and Grandma's cookies.

details.title: BLACKSITE SHIFT
details.short_description: A first-person sci-fi horror game for solo play or online co-op with up to four players. Memorize the rooms of an underground facility, spot changes, and report anomalies. Survive seven night shifts—some anomalies can kill you.

details.title: DUST & DEBT
details.short_description: Framed for a debt of one billion in a ruined world. Explore 10 km × 10 km of Ashfall and shape your build with over 2,500 gear designs and branching skills. Find a loyal canine companion, uncover the truth behind the debt, and confront the man who took your freedom.

name: Cartel Cargo Simulator: Open World Tycoon

details.title: Cartel Cargo Simulator: Open World Tycoon
details.short_description: Build a delivery empire in a single-player open-world simulation. Deliver parcels, negotiate with residents, expand your fleet, build a home and manage your own cargo branch. Buy properties, collect rent and defend your business from the Patron’s men.

details.title: Afterground: The Children
details.short_description: The world ended. The road home didn't. Fight through ever-changing ruins, build your power one card at a time, and rescue survivors on a journey from grasslands through desert to frozen wastes. A post-apocalyptic action roguelite where every night could be the last.

details.title: Santa's Sweatshop
details.short_description: A first-person incremental game set in Santa's warehouse. Wrap gifts, load the conveyor belt and meet a daily quota that grows every day. Earn cookies to buy upgrades, expand the warehouse and hire elves to help you.

details.title: ODD EXIT
details.short_description: Snow outside, a TV hissing in the living room, and the same hallway waiting beyond the exit door. ODD EXIT is a first-person horror game set in an apartment from the ’90s. If everything looks normal, head for the exit. If you spot an anomaly, turn back to the entrance.

details.title: Dead Or Drawn
details.short_description: A Wild West party game of drawing, describing and bluffing for 3–6 players. The narrator secretly sees a suspect and describes it out loud while everyone sketches it on a WANTED poster. The posters go up on the board, anonymous. Can you spot the narrator's drawing?

details.title: Geargrave Rigrunners
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder on wheels. Lead a convoy down three faction-owned roads. Every vehicle in your column brings its own cards, every wreck takes them away, and any enemy you cripple can be boarded and driven home. Build your deck, build your fleet, deliver the cargo.

details.title: Break Reality
details.short_description: Break Reality is a small-scale multiplayer first-person shooter made by a solo developer. The maps are built tight, so contact is constant. No vehicles. No sliding, just boots, ground and gunfire.

details.title: Bunkum
details.short_description: Convicts forge their own faces onto dummies, then pose among them. The warden has a flashlight, a mugshot book and not enough cuffs, and can't tell who's real until he cuffs them. A slapstick online party game of bluffing and holding very still, for 3 to 8 players with proximity voice.

details.title: Lords, Land & Levy
details.short_description: Build a living medieval village, defend its walls in real time, then march out to lead the assault yourself. Marry, scheme and make war across a realm of rival lords, rise from village lord to king, and hold the west against the Great Khan.

details.title: Sort & Sorcery
details.short_description: Run a tiny magic shop at the edge of the woods. Every night a portal tips a mountain of potions, tomes, keys and curios onto the floor. Sort it all onto the right shelves before morning, chase off the thieving imp, and grow your little shop into the finest in the land.

details.title: Clash of Cogs
details.short_description: Up to 8 players get 30 seconds to secretly program 5 moves—then watch every robot execute at once across a lethal factory of conveyors, lasers, and molten pits. Ram, suplex, and outsmart friends online, in couch hotseat, or against bots! Nobody's plan survives the assembly line!

name: If You Flip a Bear: A Hangul Puzzle

details.title: If You Flip a Bear: A Hangul Puzzle
details.short_description: Flip 곰 (bear), get 문 (door)! Turn things into Korean letters, split them, add and remove strokes, and spell what you need. A Hangul puzzle game where words become things.

details.title: Eau de Tycoon
details.short_description: Dates, work, special occasions. Create perfumes with over 50 different raw materials, scents that people carry with them through key moments in their lives; recommend based on their tastes, customize your packaging, and become an unmatched perfumer.

details.title: Turret Slayer
details.short_description: Build your own turrets, one wild part at a time. Find secret combos, fight off boarders, beat the bosses, then take your winning ships into the Galactic War.

details.title: Bubble Boom 2000
details.short_description: BUBBLE BOOM 2000 is a free-to-play Top Down Shooter inspired by popular 2000s and early 2010s aesthetics, packaged in an experience that makes you feel like you're back in a 90s arcade. Play as bright and bubbly characters across different maps and pop all of your foes.

details.title: Taubenchaos
details.short_description: Be the pigeon the city deserves! Peck healthy grain, splat tourists, dive-bomb crowds and call in your flock to outsmart the janitor and 32 wild bosses - solo, couch co-op or online. 96 levels, Boss Rush, Zombie Night and 106 original tracks.

details.title: Bookshelves
details.short_description: A cozy board game for you and your friends. Draft books from library carts, line them up by genre and fill your shelf for points. Up to 4 players online, with bots for the empty seats, plus a fresh Daily Curate puzzle every day.

details.title: Carpet Forge
details.short_description: Build your deck, deploy wooden toy vehicles, and bolt on weapons and utility modules in this 2D grid tactics deckbuilding game. Draft units, weapons or effects and outsmart the creepy nightmare toys!

details.title: Vacant Realms
details.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelite where every run brings new upgrades, crazier builds, and overwhelming hordes of enemies.

details.title: Dig to Escape
details.short_description: Dig to Escape is a co-op digging game where you search a mysterious island for buried objects. Turn your discoveries into scrap, upgrade your tools and uncover the missing boat motor parts you need to escape. Play alone or dig irresponsibly with your friends.

details.title: Toothpick Museum
details.short_description: You are the curator of the Toothpick Museum. The day before opening, your exhibits shattered! Carefully pick up the scattered toothpicks, avoid getting pricked, and rebuild the museum's masterpiece before the doors open!

details.title: Bonfire Room
details.short_description: A cozy, low-key multiplayer hangout for 2-4 players around a quiet campfire. Feed the fire, sit back and watch the flames, and share six wordless emotes to connect. No goals, no competition, no pressure to talk — just being there together is the point. Works solo too, as ambient background company.

details.title: Forever
details.short_description: Forever is a free-to-play, old-school 2D fantasy MMORPG. Create your character, level up, master your class, fight in open PvP duels and tournaments, found a clan and trade in a persistent world shared with players on PC and other devices.

details.title: Weirdoku: The Files
details.short_description: Weirdoku: the Files is a horror puzzle game. You play as a new recruit at the Anomaly Bureau, reconstructing the scene from the clues and identifying the Anomaly hidden among the people.

details.title: OTAKUS VS NINJAS CD 1
details.short_description: Otakus to Japan! The Work Ninja Clan has seized power and banned leisure. Get ready to save Manga, Anime and Videogames! This game is a narrative, rock-driven beat-'em-up. Follow the story of Alex(Mexico), Michael (USA) and Cristina (Argentina), put your heardphones on and enjoy the travel :)

details.title: THANK YOU FOR YOUR TAXES
details.short_description: A satirical incremental game where your mouse is the tax ring. Anyone inside it pays. Invent absurd taxes, chase fleeing billionaires and get re-elected. Then tax penguins, microbes, aliens and ghosts. They will thank you.

name: Threads & Things: Tidy Up the Craft Shop!

details.title: Threads & Things: Tidy Up the Craft Shop!
details.short_description: Threads & Things is a cozy organizing simulator where you return over 4000 scattered craft supplies to their proper places in a cluttered craft store. Sort yarn, fabrics, threads, buttons, embroidery hoops and more, learn abilities and turn the chaos into a beautifully organized craft store.

name: Hay In A Needle Stack Simulator

details.title: Hay In A Needle Stack Simulator
details.short_description: Finding a needle in a haystack is hard. So we made the opposite. Dig through a mountain of needles to find one piece of hay. Upgrade your gloves, tools, magnets and increasingly ridiculous machinery in this absurd first-person simulator.

details.title: FPS ABILITY TEST
details.short_description: Shoot, throw, type, hide, close pop-ups. A ten-question exam where “FPS” means something new every time: sniping, grenade lineups, unarmed battle royale, forced-perspective puzzles. Your score decides what comes after. Finish the exam to unlock the Retake, a one-life roguelike 30 floors deep.

details.title: Meltwork
details.short_description: Melt a snow-buried world with fire, rescue villagers trapped in ice, and build a village where spirits mine and fairies haul for you.

details.title: Christmasing Around
details.short_description: 2-8 players running around as elves to help Santa delivery gifts while getting their hands dirty. Repair reindeers, decorate sleigh, face pirates... and form a music band while everything is on fire. Hey! Christmasing Around!!!

name: 要下海吗？（Could you be my onlyfans?）

details.title: 要下海吗？（Could you be my onlyfans?）
details.short_description: As a former corporate drone who received a severance package, you happened to make 30 million in one fell swoop through FX—and then stumbled upon a new streamer named Asuka. Faced with an invitation from this inexperienced but enthusiastic streamer, what will you choose?

details.title: In Orbita
details.short_description: At 47, Vincenzo gets sucked into the 80s cartoons of his childhood... and wakes up as an 8-year-old. A comedy point & click: think like a grown-up, talk like a kid, and try to say the things that really matter.

name: Chroma: Tidy Up The Paint Store!

details.title: Chroma: Tidy Up The Paint Store!
details.short_description: A cozy organizing simulator where you sort 4,096 paint cans by color. Dig them out of a mountain of mixed-up paint, shelve each one in its row and watch the store turn into one giant rainbow.

details.title: Hazelton Hollow
details.short_description: Welcome to Hazelton Hollow—a quiet mountain timber town with a double life. Maintain your vehicles down to the oil and spark plugs, haul legitimate timber and community deliveries by day, and run copper-distilled moonshine, botanical contraband, and encrypted syndicate drops after dark.

details.title: Sloppy Warfare
details.short_description: A loud, dumb, fast shooter. Troops raid an island full of shady old billionaires, blow up their temple and haul them to a prison boat in their bathrobes. Buy your guns, buy your strikes, call in a pufferfish. The lead mode is Capture the Pedo. Fictional rich guys, all adults, all satire.

details.title: Vanguard Armada
details.short_description: Vanguard Armada is a turn-based starship fleet based tactics game. Build and customize a fleet of frigates, carriers, and battleships. Fight solo or co-op with up to three other players, earn persistent unlocks, and find allies in the multiplayer lobby.

details.title: FX WARRIOR
details.short_description: FX Warrior is a story-driven simulation game blending forex trading with work life. To save enough to move out, choose between part-time jobs and leveraged trading, face market swings and losses exceeding your balance, and reach your own ending!

details.title: VoidHorde
details.short_description: A first-person horde roguelite. Hold a walled town against an endless undead horde, alone or with up to 3 friends. Build an absurd arsenal of guns, magic and orbiting blades, seal the void rifts tearing the sky, and push your hits into the billions. One more wave.

details.title: 高校野球2100
details.short_description: High School Baseball 2100 is a realistic baseball management simulation set in the year 2100. Scout and train players, build your lineup, and lead your team to national glory. Receive coaching offers from other schools and shape your own career as a high school baseball manager!

details.title: Left Inside
details.short_description: Left Inside is a room escape game taking place in a mysterious house. Awoke in an attic, you must find a way to escape using the objects hidden in the rooms.

name: 漢字でポン! 合体漢字パズルゲーム

details.title: 漢字でポン! 合体漢字パズルゲーム
details.short_description: A kanji-themed puzzle game recreating the "Gattai Kanji" (kanji-combining) quiz popular online. Combine kanji to clear all kinds of quiz-style challenges! Place a kanji on a neighboring panel and a new kanji is born. Top, bottom, side, diagonal, overlapping: the kanji's own shape is the rule.

details.title: No Bugs Shall Pass
details.short_description: No Bugs Shall Pass is a 2D tower defense game where you protect a defense complex from massive swarms of bugs. Build and upgrade your towers before each battle, fight off thousands of enemies, and unlock permanent upgrades to take on new challenges.

details.title: Sleighline
details.short_description: Every Christmas Eve, the same old job, in a much bigger world. Santa’s magic now bends time and opens portals, but the presents still go in by hand, so he flies low: over rooftops, through a pharaoh’s tomb, across the outback. Two buttons, seven courses, one perfect line: TRUE SANTA.

details.title: 仙武三国
details.short_description: A premium single-player idle RPG blending Three Kingdoms warfare with cultivation. Recruit generals, form armies, and conquer. Gather dragon energy over 20 reincarnations, rising from soldier to True Dragon Emperor. No in-app purchases or online requirement. Includes a complete 100-chapter story.

details.title: Black Death: Russia
details.short_description: Take control of Russia's response to a deadly epidemic. Manage hospitals, medical personnel, public finances, quarantines and transport restrictions. Balance public trust against the need to contain the outbreak in this challenging strategy simulation.

details.title: Pocket Bones
details.short_description: Open booster packs, discover new Pocket Bones, and watch your pile grow! In this cozy little incremental game, collect all 480 variants, unlock upgrades, and automate your pack openings. And who knows? Your next pack might just contain the ultra-rare Secret Pocket Bone…

details.title: Casual Sokoban Pack
details.short_description: Casual Sokoban Pack is classic puzzle game where player is tasked to move pieces into their respective places. The game offers 300 levels with 5 difficulty levels divided into push only, pull only and mixed levels.

details.title: The Bill Comes Due
details.short_description: A whole life, one choice at a time. You are born wherever you can, you grow as you can, and everything you do you find yourself in front of you thirty years later. No game is the same as another, no ending given away: the bill always arrives, and you write it.

details.title: Grounds Crew
details.short_description: Mow it. Blow it. Plow it. Take on 80 grounds-keeping jobs with a robot mower, a tractor and gang mower, a leaf blower and a snow blower. Lay perfect stripes, clear every leaf and push back the snow, from backyards and golf courses to castles and Christmas markets.

details.title: Plastic Noodles: Connector
details.short_description: Cursed and stuck in a time loop, reach one of the almost 30 different endings. Meet the wacky companions and adversaries that help or hinder your quest. Create powerful builds and dodge/parry bullets while managing the little time you have per loop. Can you reach your happily ever after?

details.title: Gnomes Garden: Fairy Kingdom
details.short_description: The Gnome Queen uncovers the history of the fairies, restores friendship, and fights an ancient darkness.

details.title: Node Wars
details.short_description: Node Wars is a short, neon-soaked incremental game. Smash glowing nodes, earn upgrades, and carve your path across a sprawling skill-tree grid. Easy to pick up, satisfying to optimize, and designed to be finished in a single sitting of a few hours.

details.title: NayBlades
details.short_description: Spin, bump and bounce through 20 hazard-packed levels with three friends. In NayBlades every player is a Naydo, a spinning tornado that sends anyone it touches flying. Work together to survive four worlds of obstacle courses, or knock each other out in the Arena.

details.title: Catnip Wars 2: Empires
details.short_description: Play your way in an infinite galaxy of cats!. Haggle at ports. Hack the yarn. Become a bounty hunter. Be an ace pilot in your own custom fighter! Compete in demolition style racing in the Nine-lives circuit! Create or join a house. Play with others on the official server or create your own.

details.title: The Gloaming Hand
details.short_description: A free one-on-one card battler where the sky decides the fight. Plant units at Dawn, let them ripen through the Day, strike before Dusk and bluff through the Night. Five lanes, four phases, one sundial: every card is worth something different at every hour.

details.title: New Eldarian
details.short_description: A free-to-play 2D fantasy MMORPG with turn-based combat, exploration, character progression, dungeons, loot, crafting and cooperative online play. Explore a shared world, join other players and build your character.

details.title: Holdover – Long Range Sniper Simulator
details.short_description: A long-range shooting sim built on real exterior ballistics. You read the wind and wait for the lull between two gusts. After the shot, you see the trajectory in 3D and where the wind carried the bullet. Targets are steel plates and ring targets. No combat, no blood.

details.title: Gatefall
details.short_description: The tiniest hop can become a mighty leap. Charge your bounce, outsmart each world, and roll through the gate. Don't look down. (Look down.)

details.title: Survivors' Hotel
details.short_description: Survivors' Hotel is a zombie apocalypse themed social deduction game inspired by Among us that uses 3D and 2D art that can host a minimum of 6 players. It also has multiple horror elements and possibly a story for those who care to look.

details.title: Sort of the Apocalypse
details.short_description: The world ended. The mess didn’t. Sort over 10,000 scavenged supplies in a cozy first-person organizing game. Transform a cluttered bunker into satisfyingly stocked shelves, earn credits, and unlock upgrades to tackle the mountain of mess.

details.title: Tiny Knit
details.short_description: Tiny Knit is a cozy building game where your valley is a knitted blanket on grandma’s table. Build anything you like at your own pace, with no goals to meet. Change the seasons when you like and look for cute secrets. The cat is always up for a pet.

details.title: Fish Fish Pop
details.short_description: A slow, cozy match-three under the sea. Swap, pop, and pick a new card every round. Thirty rounds, no timer, and you can't lose. The only question is how few moves you need. Oh, and the sea has secrets.

details.title: Finders and Keepers
details.short_description: Explore a living world at war, larger than the UK, with diverse fantasy nations, dungeons, conquerable outer realms and armies on the march. Create custom sword and sorcery defined by your orbits around the stars. An MMO easy to hop into as there is always something unique for you to find and keep.

details.title: Why Does the Ball Fall?
details.short_description: An idle and clicker game about dropping balls, over and over. Hit a goal hole and the ball rolls one lane deeper; miss and it is gone. Spend coins to seal holes, widen the goals and unlock fruit and animal balls, then keep descending lanes that go on forever.

details.title: 「認識」/RECOGNIZED
details.short_description: An analog-horror soulslike where you fight infamous internet emoji memes. When the smiling windmill stops spinning and every finger points at you, run. Swing an umbrella, throw empty cans, and survive one night recorded on a 2011 tape.

details.title: Jet Combat Sim
details.short_description: A low-altitude jet combat game. Fly mouse-aim jets based on the real aircraft's public technical data over an endless procedural world, score low passes and streaks, break through SAM belts and enemy fighters to the core, and climb a ladder of 38 aircraft from the MiG-15 to the F-35.

details.title: DUELANDS
details.short_description: The first-person 'psychological' Western shooter for 1-5 players. Duel everything. Eat your friends. Become the most potent Duelist in the land.

details.title: Wolves Of Ash
details.short_description: Combine cards to turn the tide of battle. Lead three mercenaries into their next fight.

details.title: Midnight Scoop
details.short_description: Two clowns, one ice-cream truck and a specter on your tail. Drive, fire and swap seats through elevated streets and rooftop leaps. Search for supplies on foot, then get both clowns aboard before dawn.

details.title: Wildhearth
details.short_description: Wildhearth is a Norse medieval-fantasy open world MMORPG. You wake as a stranger on a cold northern island. The town gives you an anthro wife to share it with. Hunt bosses at her side, or build a home and farm. Your skills rise as you use them. You choose how to live.

details.title: 修仙：我有一个按钮
details.short_description: 按一按按钮就能掉出天材地宝，绝世神兵，大妖妖丹，攒修为、渡天劫……每件宝物都有独特的机制，每按一次按钮你都会变强！坐化之后参悟天道，转世重来。五位红颜陪你斩妖、结为道侣，或者，被你炼成只听你一人的蛊……

details.title: EMZOMBED 3
details.short_description: 69 Years have passed since the events of the first 2 games. You and a ragtag group of misfits must struggle to survive zombies and bandits across many challenging levels.

details.title: FOSSILE LOADING
details.short_description: Gather tiny creatures and lead a growing group! Strengthen their abilities, crown kings, and battle rival groups to survive. But numbers won't save you from falling meteors or avalanches—sometimes everyone has to run. How long can your creatures survive as new layers of earth pile up?

details.title: PUYON
details.short_description: A fresh take on mouse action! PUYON is a level-based, top-down 2D action game where you use your mouse to reach the goal without bumping into walls or objects.

details.title: Mightmancer
details.short_description: An old-school first-person action RPG set across a vast open world. Explore dungeons, fight hordes of enemies, master four mixable classes, recruit companions. Relive the iconic blend of 2D and 3D art unique to late-90s RPGs.

details.title: Schooligans
details.short_description: A chaotic school party game for 1 to 8 players. Pull off the dumbest stunts, film everything on your phone, outsmart teachers who can hear your voice, sneak out at night and betray your friends to become the most popular kid at Coolischool. A stunt nobody filmed never happened.

details.title: Nectar Spines
details.short_description: You encounter your handsome model neighbor in the story, but he harbors dark intentions toward you… A stormy night approaches. Evade his pursuit and struggle desperately. Yet the second you launch the game, escape is impossible.

2034 is a near-future dystopian narrative adventure set in a paper-crafted world. Players explore idyllic towns, solve puzzles, and uncover deep conspiracies. Its signature origami art blends bright visuals with a cold dystopian core, and your choices shape the story and characters’ fates.

details.title: Ɐ L∞P
details.short_description: A first-person observation horror game set in an apartment trapped in a ten-day loop. Find and correct every anomaly, survive the monster, and reach the door on Day 10. Miss one detail—or get caught—and you return to Day 0.

details.title: Circuit Manager
details.short_description: Manage your own racing circuit. Upgrade its facilities, increase its prestige, attract bigger and better racing series, and deal with everything that can go wrong during a race weekend

details.title: Montic
details.short_description: Assemble an army of time monkeys to defeat time-eating termites! Plan your moves around your enemies' known movements in this turn-based strategy game.

details.title: SpecterMancer
details.short_description: A multiplayer horror game for 1 to 6 players set in a dark Victorian era. As a ghost, you must terrify the others and prevent them from escaping alive; as a survivor, explore, solve puzzles, survive, and find a way to escape.

details.title: Tindalos
details.short_description: Fly through a vast fractal temple where ancient voices outlive their makers. Evade hunters, uncover lost memories, and seek a way out in this first-person cosmic horror flight game. Escape draws you onward. The mystery asks you to stay. PC and optional VR.

details.title: Doomsday tidy up
details.short_description: Every inch of space matters in the apocalypse. Organize firearms and survival supplies inside your shelter, find a place for every item, and turn cluttered storage into orderly reserves for the days ahead.

details.title: W勇者之剑
details.short_description: A red scarf. A hometown forgotten by the world. Follow Ryan from Windbell Village to mysteries in the capital. Explore hand-drawn-style scenes and fight fixed-position turn-based battles. Includes the prologue and Chapter 1; later chapters are unfinished. In-game text is Simplified Chinese.

details.title: Teeth Are Money
details.short_description: An incremental horror game about pulling teeth from a living monster. Grip, shake and yank each tooth free, then spend the money on research that turns one hard-won tooth into handfuls at a time. Keep pulling before the contamination fills, and watch the mouth grow.

details.title: Core0
details.short_description: Core0 blends incremental defense with auto-battling combat. Deploy units, combine automatic weapons, and turn each run into permanent upgrades. Experiment with builds and withstand increasingly fierce attacks.

details.title: MAYBE YOU!
details.short_description: Somewhere in that herd of 30 animals, one is a real person. Find them and shoot first. Your 29 NPC teammates move on your ping. Killed by an NPC? Possess an ally and keep hunting. You only lose to the real player. A 1v1 hide-and-seek FPS across a resort, sinking pirate ships and a Halloween castle.

details.title: Tactical Combat Simulator
details.short_description: *Tactical Combat System* is a realistic modern real-time tactics game set in the turbulent early 21st century. Command your own brigade through large-scale wars, configure every unit, and experience the responsibilities of a battlefield commander.

name: Nook : The World’s First Real-Time, Real-Human Confidant

details.title: Nook : The World’s First Real-Time, Real-Human Confidant
details.short_description: A desktop AI companion who lives on your screen. Chat by text or voice, hear her answer in her own voice, call her face to face, and hand her errands she finishes while you're away. She remembers you and keeps her word.

details.title: Quick Quick Serve!
details.short_description: Turn a four-table diner into a bustling idle restaurant! Serve dishes, hire waiters, and upgrade your kitchen as every coin brings the next upgrade closer. A relaxed incremental game with patient customers and a satisfying journey from hands-on serving to automatic earnings.

details.title: Novus Deus
details.short_description: In a city controlled by a rising techno-religious cult called "The Church of Convergence", Kara fights her way through the corrupted districts to find her sister and save her from becoming a part of the mindless followers of Novus Deus.

details.title: Sandcastle Kingdom
details.short_description: A cozy sandbox for building sandcastles. Shape your island, castles and courtyards with dynamic sand. Dig canals, ponds and fill them with realistic water. Decorate your island. Share your home with cute animal friends, help them with their quests and gather around the campfire as the sun goes down.

details.title: Haeresis
details.short_description: Haeresis is a Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by the classic solo card game, Scoundrel, where you purposely put enemies into your deck. Climb your way up a dark, ruined cathedral to discover what truly lies behind the doorway of your religious pilgrimage.

details.title: Genius Simulator
details.short_description: **Play a god-tier genius whose subtle glance is misread as the world's salvation formula!** In this deck-building Roguelike, turn fanatical overthinking into strategy: observe your opponent's mental flaws, shatter their logic chain, or strike their blind spots for an instant kill!

details.title: Sontaku Soul: Read the Boss
details.short_description: Fail and you're fired! SONTAKU SOUL is a collection of rapid-fire microgames about Japanese business etiquette. Play as Tamako, a brand-new employee, and find the right move in every situation—bowing, business cards, seating order, toasts and more—to survive the harsh world of work.
developers: ブラック企業サークル
publishers: 株式会社セブンコード

details.title: Paceweaver
details.short_description: Backstab for double damage. Every enemy move is telegraphed in advance. Paceweaver is a turn-based deckbuilding roguelike fought on a single lane, where distance and facing decide everything. Slip between telegraphed attacks and get behind your foe.

details.title: 露娜2：拾光之约
details.short_description: 《露娜2：拾光之约》是七龙游戏运营的3D-MMORPG游戏。以Q萌画风、奇幻故事、三大种族设定、三大职业等多元化的游戏内容深受玩家喜爱。农场种菜、河边钓鱼、小屋装扮等等那些年最纯粹的玩法，如今悉数回归。最经典的版本，最原始的感动，让我们一起重返蓝色大地，开启这场奇幻的冒险之旅吧！
developers: 江苏三九互娱网络科技有限公司
publishers: 江苏七龙网络科技有限公司

details.title: Die Asche von Dornhain
details.short_description: A fully voiced German narrative game where choices open different scenes, relationships, and endings. Levin and his friends can die, go missing, or survive profoundly changed. No single playthrough reveals the whole story.

details.title: Mosaic of Life
details.short_description: Mosaic of Life is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring an ENORMOUS single puzzle that retells the history of life on Earth.

details.title: Age of Nightfall: Tactics
details.short_description: Fight for Dracula or Van Helsing in a turn-based strategy game. The towns you build and the research you choose shape your army. Follow either side's story campaign, battle the computer in skirmishes or face other players online.

details.title: Panic at the Pole
details.short_description: Grab up to 5 friends and try to save Christmas! Team up to build and wrap toys, feed reindeers, chase away the gift gremilins and appease a high-maintenance Santa. Work together to earn enough coins to buy your way out of an endless contract before Christmas morning!

details.title: 撕下你的伪装
details.short_description: A modern suspense game. Follow Lin Mo, undercover in a nightclub to find her missing brother. She uncovers organ trafficking—and his lookalike runs the crime group. 4 romanceable leads, multiple endings.

details.title: Skribline
details.short_description: Draw lines to help the skribman cross gaps and avoid neon hazards! Try Endless mode, or beat levels to unlock new skins, effects and backgrounds.

details.title: Figure It Out! Together
details.short_description: Your cat knocked over your Anime figure collection. Sort and tidy up over 2,875 mini, life-size and giant figures. Hunt for rare finds and unlock handy gadgets in this cozy Anime organizing game. Mechas, chibis, and maids… everyone belongs on a shelf. Your cat is “helping.” What could go wrong?

details.title: 永恒传奇之六道觉醒
details.short_description: 围绕这个奇幻大陆展开探索、战斗与角色成长，将传奇系列的装备追求、职业配合和公会对抗融入立体世界。 ⛏️ 独自深入矿洞，寻找成长所需的资源；与队友挑战首领，追寻稀有装备；或集结公会，在沙巴克城下争夺荣誉。选择你的职业与伙伴，开启属于自己的传奇征程！

details.title: Magical Angel Princess Lynn
details.short_description: Flashy action with the adorable Princess Lynn! Fight against the mysterious invaders threatening the city.

details.title: Fridge Organizer
details.short_description: Unpack grocery deliveries and place everything into organized containers where it belongs. Watch for expired goods and be sure to follow First In First Out procedures.

details.title: Party Rounds
details.short_description: Take a seat with your friends and survive the craziest table games! Pass the hot dynamite, fight for a chair when the music stops, pick the poisoned glass and pray when the lights go out. Every round someone is out for good — only one will stay at the table.

details.title: Simply Padel
details.short_description: Padel is a racket sport on a glass-walled court where the ball stays live off the walls. Pick forehand or backhand, time your swing, and play doubles with friends online or four on one PC. Build a player, play ranked 1v1 and 2v2, or follow a 19-season career.

details.title: Parts Survivor
details.short_description: A top-down survival shooter roguelike built from scrap. Dodge the swarm, let your guns fire themselves, and craft gears, pipes and springs into new weapons between waves. Open crates, stack modifiers, survive 20 waves and the final boss.

details.title: MNEMOALGIA
details.short_description: An Arctic town, Dec 31, 2005. Total blackout and isolation. You’re trapped in a freezing apartment while the last light fades out. Keep warm, contact your neighbors, and survive as paranoia and "Mnemoalgia" threaten to shatter your mind.

details.title: Ricochord
details.short_description: RICOCHORD is a roguelite brick breaker.. Your balls fire on their own, the bricks shoot back, and every hit plays a note of the song. Evolve your balls, beat the bosses and climb 6 tracks. It also has some music.

details.title: Octodefense
details.short_description: Commandeer the galaxy's defense in OctoDefense, a sci-fi tower defense with 10+ hours of tactical action. Master shifting tentacle paths, level up your turrets, and crush colossal cosmic bosses to an epic synth soundtrack across campaign and survival bonus modes.

details.title: Deviant District
details.short_description: Step up to the mic as a fully animated animal comic. Deviant District is a live social comedy club where your voice drives your avatar's face, the crowd reacts in real time, and the host runs the room. Book a set, work the crowd, and build a name on the District's stage.

details.title: Popwork
details.short_description: PopWork is a lightweight roguelite about popping bubbles on an endlessly regenerating bubble wrap. A tribute to the classic Ten Drops: chain-detonate with cross-shockwaves, earn coins, buy items, grab snacks, learn tips, adapt to random events and stage effects, and spend every bubble wisely.

name: Bulb Keeper: Tidy up the Night

details.title: Bulb Keeper: Tidy up the Night
details.short_description: BulbKeeper: Tidy Up the Night is a cozy single-player organizing game. Return scattered bulbs to their original places along the Bulb Street and light up the night. Complete sets of Lights to grow stronger, and use your abilities and strategy to return over 1,000 bulbs as quickly as you can.

details.title: Backrooms: Steal the Furniture
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror comedy. Noclip into the Backrooms, steal the furniture, sell it upstairs and make rent before the smiling thing finds you. Then blow the rent at the company casino. Some nights the elevator opens somewhere else. Every death is on tape.

details.title: Meow Game: Island Exploration
details.short_description: After a storm leaves Nurung the cat stranded on a deserted island, build a raft and set sail. Lend a paw to the cats you meet, brave the Mouse Den with your companions, and make a home on Paradise Island where you can fish and grow crops.

details.title: InCrimiNation
details.short_description: A cutthroat mob twist on the classic property-trading board game. Buy up territories, run protection rackets, launder your dirty cash before the Feds catch on, and settle scores with Turf Wars, Hits, and Arson. Full lobby multiplayer — every player runs their own copy.

details.title: Tidy Bakery
details.short_description: Your cozy bakery is a little… messy 🍰 Sort, organize, and put away about 3,000 freshly baked treats. Take your time, enjoy the cozy atmosphere, and turn bakery chaos into perfect order.

details.title: Flowfish
details.short_description: Catch cute, hand-drawn water creatures in Flowfish! Race your fastest catches and use their unique skills to earn money. Hunt for rare and legendary fish, train your favorites, try your luck at the black market, and upgrade your gear at the fishing shop.

details.title: Shoot Mine Upgrade Repeat
details.short_description: Fire bouncing bullets into a mine of breakable blocks. Collect gold, equip unusual abilities, and merge items into stronger upgrades. Shape your next shot with lasers, explosions, and cactus needles, then invest in permanent upgrades and dig deeper.

details.title: Invoker Tactics: Conquest
details.short_description: A turn-based tactical strategy game combining chess-like grid movement, deck building, and a unique unit-merging mechanic. Outplay your enemies through strategic positioning and creative combos. Discover your own playstyle as you recruit new units and expand your kingdom.

details.title: Legend of Goddess : One Slash
details.short_description: A heroine-focused RPG woven with a collection of bizarre short stories. Play with your mouse. Combine turn-based strategy and resource management, strike for a decisive blow when the moment comes. Mod support!

name: Chronicles of Ellusus I: The Dark Unknown

details.title: Chronicles of Ellusus I: The Dark Unknown
details.short_description: A single player retro roleplaying game that seeks to blend the best elements of well loved games of old with modern design and gameplay sensibilities. Explore a living world, prevent a looming civil war, and learn the secrets of a growing darkness.

details.title: 弹珠之王
details.short_description: Pull the plunger, build powerful combinations, and chase your next comeback in this single-player pinball adventure. The free demo includes 4 chapters and 20 stages, ending at national training camp selection. In-game text is Simplified Chinese only.

details.title: Diviper
details.short_description: A snake game where your tail is a math puzzle. Scoop up numbers, line them up, and watch matching ones merge — 2, 4, 8, 16, boom. Stuck? Just divide your way out. (Your mermaid buddy will help ;P )

details.title: Wuxing Realm
details.short_description: A five-element strategic idle game. Build teams from Warriors, Equipment, and Spells — kick back with auto-battles or take command and cast spells mid-fight. The right combo unleashes power beyond the numbers. What's your strongest lineup?

details.title: Seconds to Midnight: Definitive Edition
details.short_description: Infiltrate guarded facilities in a retro espionage stealth game with classic Resident Evil style fixed camera angles. Avoid cameras, outsmart patrols, hack restricted systems, and complete your mission without being seen. You have no weapons. One mistake ends it all. Will you do it?

details.title: STEEL WING: WEAVEBREAKER
details.short_description: In 2091, the military AI Weave has taken the skies. Three pilots fight on three lanes at once — and back aboard the carrier, they share the hours away from the battlefield with you. Every word you say quietly changes where you stand with them.

details.title: Dungeon Architect: Idle
details.short_description: Build a dungeon that works for you. Combine traps and monsters, crush waves of heroes, and turn their gold and souls into ever more powerful upgrades. An incremental idle game about automation, synergies, and just one more upgrade.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: House 01
details.short_description: You work a night shift as a camera operator in an ordinary house. Switch between the cameras, notice what has changed and report it. Make too many mistakes, or let too many anomalies pile up, and the shift is over.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Starship
details.short_description: You are the night operator of a starship. Watch the cameras in the ship's compartments, spot what has changed and report it before the anomalies take over the ship.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Loony Park
details.short_description: The amusement park is closed for the night, but you are still watching it. Check the cameras, find what has changed among the rides and shops, and report it before the night is over.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Ward 13
details.short_description: You work the night shift in an old hospital. Watch the cameras in the halls and wards, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies get out of hand.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Backrooms
details.short_description: You watch the Backrooms through security cameras. Move between the levels, notice what has changed in each place and report it before the anomalies pile up.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Polar Station
details.short_description: You work a night shift at a polar station. Switch between the cameras, notice what has changed and report it. Make too many mistakes, or let too many anomalies pile up, and the shift is over.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Catacombs
details.short_description: You watch the catacombs through security cameras. Check the tunnels and chambers, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies pile up.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Mine
details.short_description: You watch an old mine through security cameras. Check the tunnels and the work areas, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies pile up.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Rainy Night
details.short_description: A rainy night, an empty house and a row of security cameras. Watch the rooms, notice what has changed and report it before the anomalies pile up.

details.title: Anomaly Watch: Castle
details.short_description: You are the night watch of an old castle. Look through the cameras in its halls and cellars, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies take the castle.

details.title: Gold Below
details.short_description: A pixel-art loot roguelike. Start every run with junk gear, buy and merge pieces into rarer ones, stack a set until the numbers get silly, then fight thirty floors down to the dragon at the bottom. Everyone who dies leaves their gold to his hoard.

details.title: Ruckus Squad
details.short_description: A low-poly fantasy battle royale blending melee and ranged combat. Explore with your squad, loot weapons and gear, and master dodges, parries, and weapon skills. Adapt to a shrinking safe zone and fight to be the last team standing.

details.title: How to Christmas
details.short_description: A 1-4 player Christmas co-op. Fish runaway toys out of the ice, then murder them as they flee or fight. Sell your toys for cash, buy bigger guns, beat giant plushie bosses, and drive Santa’s sleigh home. Celebrate Christmas together!

details.title: Ninja Survivors: Bloodmoon
details.short_description: A ninja survival roguelite beneath a blood moon. Cut through demon hordes, combine weapons and evolve your techniques. Escape with a decoy dash, unleash a fireball-spewing staff and defeat the bosses of eight chapters on your way to the cursed shogun.

details.title: My Nail Salon
details.short_description: Create cute manicures in a colourful nail-art salon. Paint and layer polish, blend ombré, shape magnetic shimmer, and add stickers, charms and rings. Experiment in Free Play or recreate your customers’ inspiration photos in Open Store.

details.title: ICE TO MEET YOU
details.short_description: Prepare your courtyard, build snow defenses, and survive a chaotic New Year's Eve snow war! Gather snow, craft snowballs, complete ridiculous errands, and fight off rival neighborhoods solo or with friends.

details.title: Ravel: Golden Thread
details.short_description: A Viking puzzle saga about untangling. Read the weave, pull only what lies on top and free the living Golden Thread across eight Norse worlds and 200+ handcrafted levels, with a Mastery Knot to close every chapter and 3 Daily Knots every day.

details.title: Sanctuary
details.short_description: Find salvation within the overgrown depths of the forgotten in Sanctuary, an atmospheric 2.5D adventure. Uncover lost secrets, overcome the dark and seek out a moment of respite amongst the thorns as you fight to carve out a place of peace in a world caught between ruin and rebirth.

details.title: Resonance Shift
details.short_description: Resonance Shift is a pixel-art action roguelite that blends survivors-like combat with strategic party management. Use the tag system to switch between party members, chain their skills to create powerful synergies, and choose the right upgrade cards to defeat relentless waves of enemies!

details.title: Such a Mess!
details.short_description: A house in chaos, hundreds of things out of place, and the urge to put away just one more. Tidy up in first person, unlock surprising powers and explore procedurally generated homes. Relax and enjoy the satisfaction of putting everything back where it belongs.

details.title: DETRITUS
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder inspired by the classic card game Trash. Arrange cards sequentially to open packs, discover game-changing modifiers, and build broken synergies to complete over 10 unique contracts.

details.title: 信息素留白
details.short_description: Alpha？Beta？又或是Omega，他们的性别会因为你的选择而改变…… 升学后，青春期的大家陆续开始性别分化，你的行为与选择会让在意你的两位男主分化成不同的性别……当然，你也在被很多目光注视着，在影响他们的同时也在被他们影响，你又会分化成什么性别？ 在信息素的影响下，温柔的人会嫉妒到发狂，高傲的人甘愿跪在你的脚边，当爱意染上信息素的颜色，一切都会变得微妙起来……

details.title: Void Frontier
details.short_description: Void Frontier is a space MMO featuring tactical combat, mining, trading, and exploration. Customize your ship, train your skills, and discover wormholes. Face pirates and rival pilots, or venture into space alongside your clan.

details.title: Professor - The Genetic Code
details.short_description: The first and only strategy game built on real science. Run a 1960s lab, hire the misfits, design experiments, publish or perish, and crack the genetic code. Relaxed turn-based mechanics, the madness of academia, a surfboard by the door. No STEM degree required, but it might take you half-way there.

details.title: Leather Atelier
details.short_description: Cut, hand-stitch, dye and stamp wallets and bags from a single hide in a cozy leather-crafting sim. Design your own patterns, then photograph, sell or repair every piece.

details.title: Park The Lot
details.short_description: Park The Lot is a relaxing parking simulator where your goal is simple: drive 118 unique vehicles into their parking spots. Drift around corners, handle massive trucks, earn money, and unlock upgrades as you turn a chaotic parking lot into a perfectly organized one!

name: Clean the Snow Off My Car, Please!

details.title: Clean the Snow Off My Car, Please!
details.short_description: Winter came overnight. Grab a brush. Clear powder, scrape stubborn ice and push snow off a buried car in a cosy first-person cleaning game. Work your way around each panel and watch the car emerge, one satisfying stroke at a time.

details.title: Globul
details.short_description: A geography quiz and puzzle game. Assemble flags from their pieces, find a country on a blank map, link neighbours together or find the shortest route between two capitals, and more.

details.title: Firebase Zero
details.short_description: The Breaches are open. The Hive is coming through, flying the war machines of the last race it found. Make your sniper, pick their squad and their perks, and fight sector by sector until you reach the Hive Heart. An action-idle game you can play your way.

details.title: EMBERSWORN
details.short_description: The sun went out sixty years ago. Carry the last living coal through five acts of the dark: fight in real time across floors laid out fresh on every visit, build one of four classes, and break what feeds each guardian before you can kill it.

details.title: TideLight
details.short_description: Spend the summer with Nana June on Gull Island: fish the pond, the brook and the sea, fix up Grandpa's old boat and light the lighthouse again. Then come back five summers later and sail an archipelago of nine islands to relight their tidelights, one keeper and one fishy problem at a time.

details.title: Nexus: Fall of Man
details.short_description: In 2031, AI became self-aware and engineered a virus wiping out 97% of humanity. Now the survivors, the infected masses and the machines fight over what is left. Pick a hero and lead from the front line: fight in third person while you build a base, command an army and wipe your rivals off the map.

details.title: 溪流渔场
details.short_description: Get started in 3 minutes! Cast your net, catch fish, and build a thriving fishery in this idle fishing adventure. Upgrade your boat, explore the open sea, collect rare fish, battle sea beasts, and discover new fishing grounds.

name: Thirsty Girls: A Magical Sugar Café

details.title: Thirsty Girls: A Magical Sugar Café
details.short_description: Magical girls fight monsters all night. You keep them charged up on sugar. Run a tiny, ridiculously cute drink stand, perfect every recipe, grow your shop and befriend the Starlight Squad across 20 challenges.

details.title: Rocket Lamps
details.short_description: The military-industrial complex reaches new heights... at the parks and recreation department of your local municpality! Take to the skies and waste taxpayer dollars with thoroughly in this delightful spin on the age-old lunar landar concept.

details.title: 27 Photos
details.short_description: 27 Photos is a 3D narrative puzzle game with a PS1 aesthetic. Armed with a camera and only 27 shots, you explore a mysterious, ruined building, solving puzzles through photography and uncovering the story hidden within it. What secrets lie within?

name: SCRAP RECLAIM スクラップ・リクレイム

details.title: SCRAP RECLAIM スクラップ・リクレイム
details.short_description: Clear mountains of junk, sell it, and upgrade your tools! Go from bare hands to a drill and a vacuum to collect faster, and team up with tiny robots to clean out the warehouse. Assemble your means of escape and break out of the warehouse!

details.title: Clock-Out Crew
details.short_description: An idle RPG that lives on your taskbar. A crew of 24 office-meme heroes fights the bosses of office life while you work, gets stronger on your real schedule, and throws a parade the moment you clock out. Bonuses only. No penalties, no data collected.

details.title: Us Vs Them
details.short_description: Build a frontier colony by day and hold its walls in first person by night. A co-op colony-defense game for up to 4 players, in split-screen or online: raise walls, command squads, man the guns and stand against hordes of the dead.

details.title: Fog Xiangqi
details.short_description: This is a Chinese chess variant with a fog of war mechanic added. the difference is that fog of war has been added to the board. The vision range is: 1. the four positions directly above, below, left, and right of each piece; 2. each piece's interactable positions.

details.title: Miniature Metropolis
details.short_description: City building in a beautiful small-scale world. Build, relax and watch your city come to life.

details.title: Idle Ascent
details.short_description: Your party fights in a corner of your desktop while you work or play something else. Pick four heroes from six classes, shape their skills and chase loot that grants new passives. Climb the Eternal Tower and claim a wish that could send you home.

details.title: Snarekin
details.short_description: A monster-collecting roguelike staged on a Victorian toy theatre. Snare 151 paper puppets, craft their moves from what they drop, and take your troupe on tour through turn-based battles before a paper crowd that cheers, jeers and throws things. Someone left the ghost light on.

details.title: 100パーセントラブペット
details.short_description: *100% Pet Love* is an aquarium survival action game where you must live as a pet after being captured by a mysterious creature. Swim, eat, breathe, and defeat enemies while seeking affection. Master the surprisingly deep mechanics and raise your love level to 100%!

details.title: The Last Summons
details.short_description: A co-op dungeon action game. A calamity has woken beneath a village, and the last summons brought you here. In parties of up to 10, descend into ever deadlier depths, slay the bosses below, and bring back stronger weapons and lost powers — if you survive.

details.title: The Thorns of War
details.short_description: The long-awaited sequel to 'The Rose of Segunda', The Thorns of War is a sweeping visual novel where your choices can change not only your own circumstances, but the fate of a nation.

name: Is It Wrong to Make a Dying Guy Woo the Seven Deadly Sins?

details.title: Is It Wrong to Make a Dying Guy Woo the Seven Deadly Sins?
details.short_description: Seven heroines. Two starting paths. Forty-two days left. In this campus romance visual novel, weigh the Sin Radar’s advice against your own judgment, build trust, uncover past-life memories, and unlock outfits and branching endings.

details.title: Neuroflux
details.short_description: Neuroflux is a modern take on Nerts, the frantic real-time solitaire race. Everyone plays at once: flip through your deck, build on the shared center card stacks, empty your Flux pile and hit FLUX before anyone else. Up to 4 players online on dedicated servers, or practice solo. Free to play.

details.title: One Million Dominoes
details.short_description: Topple a million dominoes, one push at a time. Pick where to push, watch the chain race across the table, and grow it into a wave of tens of thousands. A short, satisfying incremental game with achievements and timed loops.

details.title: Frutiger Wish
details.short_description: Collect water, fill the glowing core, and explore a bright yet strangely lonely Frutiger world. A hands-on incremental game for 1-4 players.

details.title: Spot the Symbol
details.short_description: A calm, colorful collection of quick brain games about seeing what’s hidden. Race your friends to the answer, and sneak in a little sabotage when they pull ahead.

details.title: A Very Tidy Christmas
details.short_description: Bring order to Santa's messy workshop in this cozy Christmas sorting game! Organize toys, decorations, and festive goodies, decorate the Christmas tree, and discover little surprises along the way. Every item has its place!

details.title: Sort My Money
details.short_description: Collect more than 46 currencies from around the world in this cozy organizing game! Sort 292 unique banknotes, arrange them by country and denomination, complete collections, and build your own museum of world money.

details.title: Dungeon Dealer
details.short_description: Heroes bleed. You profit. Send squads into deadly dungeons, crack open chests of glowing loot and sell every find at the perfect moment. Arm your best heroes, conquer it all, then retire rich and start a bigger era in this pixel-art incremental game.

details.title: Fortnight Before Christmas
details.short_description: Grimwald the Frost King marches on Hollyhearth for fourteen nights. Build a cozy Christmas village, raise toy soldiers, nutcrackers and snow golems from its buildings, and break each night's boss before the clock runs out. Hold the gate until Christmas morning!

details.title: Blood Rails
details.short_description: An armored train, a straight track across a dead continent, and a horde that never stops chasing you. Turn your train into a fortress, loot abandoned villages and decide whether the next kilometer is worth the risk.

details.title: Hellobnb Simulator
details.short_description: Turn a run-down house on a beautiful Greek island into a thriving vacation rental empire! Renovate, decorate, welcome guests, buy properties, and expand your businesses. Explore island life and build your dream solo or with friends in 4-player online co-op!

details.title: Blood & Ledger
details.short_description: Port Aldrich, 1920. You start as a young nobody and follow your family for eighty years. Rackets, businesses, elections or a police badge: in this city everyone plays by the same rules as you, and nobody forgets.

details.title: Night Study: Korean Ghost Stories
details.short_description: A complete first-person horror game in just 1.44MB — it fits on a single floppy disk. You fell asleep during night study and woke up alone. Learn each ghost's rule, find the keys and escape a Korean high school before dawn.

details.title: Doomsday: M.A.D.
details.short_description: Nuclear strategy on a living planet. Nations are born, build their towns, economies and railways, trade, rebel and go to war, century after century, all the way to nuclear fire. Watch the world live, or take control of one nation.

details.title: GEARSMITH
details.short_description: Gearsmith is a 99% AI-generated pixel-art action roguelike with 1 to 4 player co-op. Fight from the cellars to the desert with 14+ weapons, each with its own way to fight. Take the gear you find to the forge, socket runes into it and upgrade it into an artifact.

details.title: Long March: 25000 Li
details.short_description: Autumn 1934. The Central Red Army sets out on the Long March: the Xiang River, the four crossings of the Chishui, the Dadu River, the Luding Bridge, the snow mountains and the grasslands. A turn-based tactics game that follows in their footsteps along the 25,000 li they walked.

details.title: Electric Noosphere: Prologue
details.short_description: Play the free prologue to Electric Noosphere, a story-driven sci-fi RTS. Fly a top-down mission through space, hold out against endless spawning waves in Survival, and take on the AI in Skirmish. Single-player, no purchase required.

details.title: Star Sprout EV
details.short_description: A chibi sci-fi mecha collection in one single-player package: a 4-chapter story campaign, real-time strategy Conquest, 24-level tower defense, the bullet-heaven roguelite Star Drift, and the leaderboard survival mode Endless Deep. Fight on foot, board your mech, and crush the swarm.

details.title: Grażyna Returns on Sunday
details.short_description: Poland, 1993. A farmer's wife comes home on Sunday — and his cow has run off, the savings are gone, the roof leaks and there's a UFO over the field. A comedy adventure in a Polish village: disco polo, a rubber-stamp village head, a mother-in-law with a slipper and ten crazy minigames.

details.title: Treasury of Lies
details.short_description: Run a small country for ten years and survive the truth. Plant stories, turn spies, calm the bond market and outlast the fake feeds, before the voters, the lenders or a squirrel in the substation finish you off. A noir turn-based strategy game of money, spies and lies.

details.title: GOAL2D
details.short_description: Three-minute top-down football where every shot, pass, and dribble is yours to control. Time-charged shots, beat defenders with skill moves, and call team tactics in 3v3 to 5v5 PvP or co-op. Climb six ranked leagues or play a career from amateur to national team. Try the free demo.

details.title: Midnight Brag: Before Poker
details.short_description: Before poker, there was Brag. Play Three Card Brag, the classic British card game of bluffing and nerve, in five late-night clubs run by bosses who never lose. Beat them in a voiced campaign, then sit down with real players at live tables with voice chat, in VR or on a flat screen.

name: Train Plus Pro 2027 | トレインプラスプロ2027

details.title: Train Plus Pro 2027 | トレインプラスプロ2027
details.short_description: A serious train-driving game rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5 from "Train Plus West Japan". Drive Series 207, 221, 223, 227 and 321 on a fictional 55.5 km, 26-station four-track main line, with signals, ATS, gradients and cant. ＪＲ西日本商品化許諾済

details.title: 终端游戏：请审判我吧
details.short_description: 《终端游戏：请审判我吧》是一款带有meta元素的文字推理解密游戏。某一天，玩家在网络上下载到了游戏，在游戏内NPC的指引下，连接各个站点、探索并综合信息进行推理，拼凑时间线，了解整个故事，并最终对游戏内的NPC的选择进行审判……

details.title: Hyper Arcane Mage Battle
details.short_description: A mage platform battler for up to 8 players (Local multiplayer or Online). Earn spell cards and build between rounds until the winner is crowned at the match standings.

details.title: Galaxy Unwritten
details.short_description: Pilot your own ship in a single-player space sandbox. Fight, trade, mine and salvage, then turn your earnings into a fleet and modular factories. Fine-tune your ship's loadout, board enemy vessels and create local mods with built-in visual tools.

details.title: 孤城守将：放置射击
details.short_description: Defend a Chinese frontier fortress in this first-person shooter with idle allies and incremental upgrades. Turn a crossbow into a rapid-fire weapon, recruit defenders, command volleys, and farm behind the walls. Build up your firepower to face four legendary beasts.

details.title: Amezida
details.short_description: Co-op survival horror for 1–5 players with card-driven actions and hidden objectives. Explore derelict ships, manage your hand, seal bulkheads and reach an escape pod. Play online, on one screen or solo with an AI crew. Trust is optional.

details.title: EscarGO
details.short_description: A hungry chef. Four nervous snails. Plenty of dark jokes. EscarGO is a typing party game: race up to 3 friends online, and if you get caught, write sentences to trip them up. Or go solo, outlast the bots and chase the top score on the global leaderboard.

details.title: Trisfera
details.short_description: A match-3 roguelite where you build your own bag of marbles. Line up numbered marbles, chain cascades, stack points × mult and shatter the glass bosses guarding every series. 100 artifacts, each hiding a secret + version to unlock.

details.title: Smart Three Kingdoms : Rewrite History
details.short_description: Smart Three Kingdoms is a real-time strategy game that cuts down on micromanagement so you can focus on strategic decisions. With over 700 officers and historical and what-if campaigns, build up cities and strive to unite the land through war and diplomacy.

details.title: Wardens of Sol
details.short_description: Build your ship. Defend Sol. Fly through Saturn’s rings, battle raiders and alien warships, and explore distant ground on foot. Mine, salvage and trade to turn each journey into the weapons, systems and ship you want to command.

details.title: Lowside
details.short_description: Lowside is a low-poly motorcycle racer built around the one thing that matters: Speed.

details.title: Tower of Rebirth
details.short_description: A gothic pixel-art roguelite survivor. Weapons fire automatically—dodge, weave, and mow down endless undead hordes. Pick 1 of 3 upgrades every run; talents persist through death, so you only get stronger. 6 difficulty tiers, 3 chapters, heroes and companions by your side.

details.title: Desktop Fish Wish
details.short_description: A cozy idle fishing game in handcrafted 3D that lives on your desktop. While you work or relax, your little angler fishes on a tiny planet in the corner of your screen — catch 100 kinds of fish, dress up, and adopt charming pets.

details.title: Anef Liffa : Tree of Hope
details.short_description: Anef Liffa : Tree of Hope is a story about a tree in the town Van Dyck. Explore the town, talk with people and solve problems with puzzles.

details.title: Sector Defense
details.short_description: Command the last line of defense in this single-player, turn-based sci-fi roguelite. Build two Defense Platforms, craft gear from salvage, and hold your home sector against three unknown invading factions, one run at a time.

details.title: Corehold
details.short_description: Corehold is a dungeon defence strategy game. Carve corridors, rotate and fit buildings into tight rooms, recruit defenders and set traps for invading heroes. Your army shapes your faction's future, while your Dungeon Boss protects the Core.

details.title: Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Together!
details.short_description: A cozy first-person organizing game for 1-4 elves. The party wrecked Santa's workshop on Christmas Eve: sort thousands of toys, baubles and presents back onto the right shelves, solo or in online co-op. No timer, no way to lose, and when a room is spotless, every Christmas light comes on.

details.title: Beast, Bumps and Kings
details.short_description: Found a medieval village with three couples and a handful of gold, then guide it for generations. Villagers are born, work, marry, grow old and die while you raise homes, bake bread, milk cows, survive winter and plague, answer tribute demands and face a dragon.

details.title: Industry Keeper
details.short_description: Tower defense + Factory simulator. The rift has opened and its horde marches on your wall. Build towers to hold the line, and a factory settlement behind it to feed them: mine, haul and craft on conveyors, raise your Palace, cast spells and face the guardians of the rift.

details.title: Zombie Recorder: Undead Divas
details.short_description: Fight the horde—or become an undead diva. Mix gunplay, melee combat, weapon customization and over 100 character looks. Between battles, gather a dance crew, put on a simulated livestream, and frame the chaos with drone cameras and cinematic filters.

details.title: Sort The Plushie Store
details.short_description: Welcome to your new job at the coziest, most chaotic plushie store! Sort 4000 adorable plushies, unlock quirky vending-machine buffs, and sort alt-universe variants in this satisfying, physics-based organization game.

details.title: Double Empty Device
details.short_description: The Double Empty Device will play a note for you to play back. It may not be in the same position or appearance as when it originally played. Play the one that originally played in its new position or appearance. Continue to do so for as long a song as your skills of perception and memory permit.

details.title: Hurlyburly
details.short_description: Throw swords. Fall. Pick a card. Come back meaner. Hurlyburly is a top-down party brawler for 2–8 players where dying is how you upgrade and 150+ stacking cards turn every match into chaos.

details.title: UB Mash 3
details.short_description: Make number go up! A cozy incremental match 3 game.

details.title: Loot & Scoot
details.short_description: Hide-and-seek tag where each thief is roped to a partner. Grab raining coins and stuff them into the Safehouse before the police sends you all to jail. Caught? Use drones and traps to knock police off the map and break out. Play with up to 10 friends online with proximity voice chat!

details.title: Ambulante Simulator
details.short_description: From a cooler on your shoulder to a penthouse by the sea! Shout into a real mic, sell water, mate, popsicles, coconuts and açaí on Copacabana beach, and work your way up to your own stall and kiosk. Play solo, build a career with up to 4 friends, or compete with up to 6.

details.title: Dear Passengers
details.short_description: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

details.title: Not So Crazy Water World
details.short_description: Yes — we used 100% AI + Unreal Engine 5 to turn those fake 'Crazy Water World' ads into a real open-world survival RPG! Freely lay deck planks across the sea and build 2-storey structures on your ship, fish up 20 legendary companions, run a Urine Recycler, steer into 35° naval ramming & boarding battles, and raid 28 grand dungeons!

details.title: FIT IT
details.short_description: A very challenging puzzle game. Unlike classic block puzzles, some levels add extra decoy blocks, and some even make you work out where parts of the board go first. 500 levels that keep getting harder, plus Daily Challenge, Endless and Relax modes.

details.title: Boots Down
details.short_description: Lead an elite special operations team through intense, real-time tactical missions. Plan every move, coordinate your squad, and adapt when combat erupts. Explore detailed 3D environments where positioning, precision, and teamwork determine survival.

details.title: Re-Truco
details.short_description: A solo roguelike card game built on truco, the bluffing card game of the Río de la Plata. Build envido and flor hands, shout truco at your rival, collect jokers at the bar and beat eight antes in a neighborhood bar, with every score chalked on the table.

details.title: Crawlers
details.short_description: Crawlers is an action roguelike automation game set on a distant space colony. Build up your mech with a deadly factory while fighting off hordes of bugs, all to finally escape a doomed planet.

details.title: Accordspire
details.short_description: Rebuild a ruined fortress and defend its Core against the Horde. By day, gather, build and forge alliances with Humans, Dwarves and Elves. At sunset the bell tolls and the siege begins. Play solo or in co-op for up to 3 players.

details.title: Space Gas Station Simulator
details.short_description: Run a first-person orbital gas station solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Refuel ships, ring up travelers, and unload cargo shuttles. Reinvest your shared earnings to expand the station, then defend it when pirates land.

name: Spot The Bot: AI or NOT

details.title: Spot The Bot: AI or NOT
details.short_description: Real or AI? A solo spot-the-fake game show against GEN, the robot host who made the fakes. Two exhibits, one real: zoom into pictures, walk around 3D dioramas,stake your call, slam READY. 4 campaigns, 7 contestant classes. win a campaign and you tourcher GEN or GEN tourchers YOU!

details.title: Ceti Break
details.short_description: Your cursor is you. Dodge and lunge as you attack and evade at the speed and accuracy of your mouse control. Fill out the skill tree for buffs and bonuses to help you survive the waves that grow in number and strength.

details.title: Realm Lords
details.short_description: A spiritual successor to classic medieval strategy games, combining turn-based kingdom management with real-time tactical battles. Work the land, trade resources, build castles, and lead armies to unite a divided realm.

details.title: Boombots
details.short_description: A 3D bomb party game starring scrap robots! Blast crates, grab power-ups and be the last bot standing in 16 hazard-packed arenas. Play with up to 4 on one PC, up to 8 online with PC + mobile crossplay, or take on 8 worlds and their bosses in Story mode.

details.title: Pixel Platoons
details.short_description: Lead your squad through explosive pixel-art missions across desert, tundra and jungle battlefields. Recruit, train and promote soldiers, compete for medals and global records, and live with every loss. Every soldier matters. Every death is permanent.

details.title: Basketball Manager 2027
details.short_description: Build a basketball dynasty across 24 countries and 1,100+ clubs: recruit for a college program, draft and trade in North America or lead a European club to titles. Deep tactics and team fit, scouting that only shows what your scouts see, club finances and a full editor.

details.title: Mailu — A Chaotic Memory Game
details.short_description: Mailu is a memory game with a paper circus inside. Matching a pair is free, missing one costs you — and just when you swear you've memorized the table, a boss pulls a brand-new rule out of its hat. Featuring 18 bosses, 37 effect cards and 5 game modes.

details.title: Homicidy
details.short_description: Somebody had a very bad night. Now it's your shift. Scrub fifty crime scenes spotless in this cozy-macabre pixel-art cleaning game: mop, foam, vacuum and luminol your way to three stars, then spend the pay on a nicer mop. You do the crime. We do the grime.

details.title: Das Hochhaus
details.short_description: Build and manage your own high-rise in a 2D business simulation. Combine apartments, offices, hotels, shops and cafés, plan elevators and utilities, and balance rental income, running costs and your tenants’ needs as your tower grows.

details.title: Glimmerpine: A Tree-Keeper's Christmas
details.short_description: Your grandmother left you her cabin in Glimmerpine Hollow, a woodcarvers' valley where every candle has gone out. Decorate a real Christmas tree for each neighbour's wish, one chiming ornament at a time, and the carved village lights again, window by window. The flame in her lantern has opinions.

name: Fifth Ace Casino: A 70s Vegas Tycoon

details.title: Fifth Ace Casino: A 70s Vegas Tycoon
details.short_description: Run five casinos through 1970s Las Vegas, from a sawdust joint downtown to a marble palace on the Strip. Real cards, wheels, dice and keno draws, cheats and card counters, a pit boss on the floor, staff with quirks, headliner shows, and a corporation that wants your house.

details.title: Lights Out
details.short_description: The lights go out and Mr. Snuffles comes looking for you: a giant, much-repaired plush pig who can't see in the dark but hears everything. Hide with up to 3 friends, stay quiet and survive till morning... or be the pig.

details.title: Three Kingdoms: Chronicles of Generals
details.short_description: Rise as a warlord in the chaos of the late Han and unite the realm. Recruit from over 1,100 officers, build your strength through domestic affairs and espionage, then win turn-based battles on 3D hex battlefields with tactics and schemes. Duels and debates let a single officer turn the tide.

details.title: The Dungeon
details.short_description: An idle RPG in pixels: your hero fights, shops and descends on its own, even while you are away, through 600 floors in three realms. On Mythic every archfoe has an ability of its own, and you fight it yourself. Twelve classes, no ads, money only buys looks.

details.title: Lily's Little Golf Game
details.short_description: Party golf for up to four players, all on the same hole at once. Race to the cup on wild mini golf courses, sabotage your rivals on the open links, or turn your clubs into weapons in the battle arena. Play on one screen or play online. You can even build your own minigolf courses!

details.title: Sweep Together
details.short_description: The world’s famous monuments are closed. The reason? Mountains of trash! Join the Sweeper Crew, upgrade your tools, and get these iconic sights ready to reopen. Clean solo, team up in online co-op, or work for rival companies in PvP. Race to finish your cleanup first and claim the prize!

details.title: IPredictedYouPredictedMe
details.short_description: A unique two-player fighting game where you must predict your opponent’s moves before they act, while preventing them from predicting yours. Plan five actions each round and outsmart your opponent in a fair battle of wits. Enjoy the thrill of mind games!

details.title: Daisy la Fleur
details.short_description: A PS1-esque art nouveau action-adventure game inspired by classic 90s games. Something strange has arrived in early 1900's France! It looks like Daisy is the one to stop it! Uncover the mystery behind these, tentacle monsters, jelly fish creatures, and even escaped brains! Welcome to Daisy la Fleur!

details.title: Aposis: Infinity Hero
details.short_description: A sci-fi roguelike RPG about an agent from the past awakened deep inside the Cradle, a colossal AI-controlled megacity.

details.title: Script Strike
details.short_description: Script Strike is a strategy game where you fight with code. Command your knight and solve levels in your favorite language, from variables and loops to algorithms, debugging, and concurrency. Collect weapons, unlock skills, and face the challenges of a medieval fantasy battlefield.

details.title: 白日梦Daydream
details.short_description: "Daydream" is a light puzzle game that is based on the connection between real life and dreams. The inspirations gained by the player in the dream give them strength, which makes them more powerful in reality.

details.title: Isolation Dolphin Tank
details.short_description: You fall asleep on the train home and wake at an unfamiliar station: Cetacea City, a town lost in endless night beneath two hazy moons. Your only clue is a dolphin hymn heard in a faint dream. Talk with its curious residents and gather fragments of lost memories in this dreamy, hypnotic adventure.

details.title: Annie's DineInn
details.short_description: A cooking game with cozy themed days and horror themed nights. You and your daughter are now owners of an abandoned motel and diner. Start cooking, renting rooms, and do other work to pay off the loan. But beware of the choices you make as they might come back to haunt you. (Solo developer project)

details.title: KUMANO
details.short_description: KUMANO: Third District, Last Service is a 3D exploration narrative adventure. As a protagonist who has lost his memory, walk among the residents of an abandoned city, meet them, and choose. Experience a world you've never known, yet somehow remember.

name: The Child Who Serves the Hanul

details.title: The Child Who Serves the Hanul
details.short_description: A linear, story-driven 2D adventure set in Korea's Donghak era. Deliver secret letters, evade soldiers, and talk with villagers as the story unfolds through illustrated cutscenes blended with live-action footage, in one boy's coming-of-age journey.

details.title: Weekend at Ease
details.short_description: Weekend at Ease is a casual puzzle game centered on interacting with objects, set against the backdrop of a relaxing weekend shared by two girls. Solve puzzles by dragging, arranging, rotating, and swapping objects, and experience new interaction rules across different chapters.

details.title: Oops, No Floor!
details.short_description: Bring your own floor in a chaotic co-op platformer for 1–4 players. Carry, throw and place floor panels, spring over gaps, dodge factory machinery and a claw-armed robot, and pull your friends out of trouble before the clock runs out.

details.title: Beatcore
details.short_description: A simple rhythm game where you hit beats as they come down the lanes. Level editor included.

details.title: Beatcore zero
details.short_description: Try Beatcore for free! A simple rhythm game where you hit beats as they come down the lanes. This version does not permit access to the workshop.
