details.short_description: PLINKOJI is a Plinko-roguelike about outsmarting randomness. Build your deck from emoji pins, hunt for absurd synergies, take risks and lose - just to come back stronger and find that one game-breaking combo. Defeat isn't the end - it's the beginning of a new strategy.

details.title: 矮人炮弹 Dwarven Cannonball
details.short_description: You control a girl who launches dwarves as cannonballs, ricocheting to shatter enemies. Each impact bursts out coins and treasures. With 7 types of weapons to freely build your loadout, blast your way through layer after layer of the dungeon.

details.title: TinyWind
details.short_description: A pixel pirate roguelite with real sailing and naval combat in short runs. Hand-rolled wind physics, procedural islands, mythic treasure and rare sea companions. Liberate British, Spanish and Dutch waters, hold Tortuga against both Crowns, or duel other captains in ranked PvP.

details.title: Dark Earth
details.short_description: Dark Earth is an atmospheric real-time action-adventure set in a dying, sunless world where your choices shape the future of humanity. Explore Sparta, one of the last cities of light, as you unravel a murder plot and fight to survive before darkness consumes you.

details.title: Gomoklear
details.short_description: Gomoklear is a Gomoku strategy roguelike: connect five to clear. Form a five, pieces leave; spawn, remove, move, transform. Collect pieces and Manuscripts, build your Library at Serendipity and the Stall. Two plays a Round, one for the Rival. Gomoku has never been this unpredictable.

details.title: Cube Duty
details.short_description: Cube Duty is a Cube-Powered City Builder where every throw shapes your kingdom. Every cube can become a building, resource or unit. Grow intricate production chains, recruit powerful armies, and defend your Castle against waves of enemies and epic bosses!

details.title: The Journey of the Relics
details.short_description: Joseph Dantas sets out on a new journey after a relic in a region long given up for lost, and faces machines that had slept for centuries. Action and adventure, lovingly made in 16 bits.

details.title: PP Inflation
details.short_description: PP INFLATION is an idle/incremental game, paying tribute to classic arcade games. Instead of controlling a paddle, you choose upgrades and optimize combinations to maximize your points-per-minute. Dial up the TIMESCALE skill to snowball through themed stages until victory.

details.title: Crown of the Dungeon King
details.short_description: Crown of the Dungeon King is a party-based tactical RPG featuring random encounters, loot and inventory management, boss fights, and partially procedural levels. Inspired by tabletop games, it is designed to be fast-paced and rules-light while still offering a good variety of meaningful choices.

details.title: Emberline
details.short_description: Emberline is a real-time roguelike deckbuilder where your train never stops. Generate and spend Ember to play cards, reinforce your train and fight creatures attacking across a 3×3 battlefield as you chart a path through the hostile continent of Pacifica.

details.title: Heliconia: Evil Prevails
details.short_description: The humans have ruled for far too long. Unify the undead, monsters, and outcasts and take over human territories.

details.title: UwUbUwU
details.short_description: UwUbUwU is a small cozy puzzle game based on a simple idea: What if you took classic Snake but inverted the goal and made it so you have to form a loop by eating your own tail.

details.title: DIMAZE
details.short_description: The instant an enemy starts casting, devour the spell, magic circle and all. Fire their fireballs and lasers right back. The stronger the enemy, the stronger your weapon. Climb a tower rising from a ruined Earth, where every floor opens onto another dimension, in this 3D action roguelite.

details.title: Medieval Ascendant
details.short_description: From a serf bound to the soil to the head of a noble house. Farm, trade, build an economic empire across five provinces, claim land through war, intrigue or wealth — and forge a dynasty that outlives you.

details.title: CPU: Computing Potatoes Unlimited
details.short_description: Program potato workers to process numbers with simple punch-in instructions at a factory that mimics a processor. Optimize solutions to solve challenging open-ended puzzles. Punch, observe, learn, repeat.

details.title: Digital Twin: Harmonix
details.short_description: Enter colorful complex biological simulations, play intense 12-button rhythm charts, collect data and DNA, then assemble that DNA into strange new creatures.

details.title: The Adventures of MAUSTRAP
details.short_description: You are ‘maustrap’, a particularly brave and adventurous cat. Having always wanted to explore beyond the borders of your home in cat village, you'll embark on an adventure of a lifetime.

details.title: Terraformer Wars
details.short_description: In the future, mega-corporations send Terraformer colossal machines to fight over dominance on faraway planets. An auto-battler that will test your management skills to the maximum.

details.title: Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592
details.short_description: A 3D tactics RPG set in a fantasy retelling of the Imjin War of 1592 in Korea. Command your squad across height-based grids where elemental matchups and terrain turn the tide. Branch through a three-tier class tree and forge deep equipment builds to make every unit your own.

details.title: DoloTwin
details.short_description: All of South Tyrol in 1:1 scale as an open world in Unreal Engine 5. Drive across 7,400 km² of real alpine passes, explore the mountains on foot in multiplayer, or connect your bicycle and treadmill directly to the game via our Companion App.

details.title: Frontactics
details.short_description: Frontactics is a strategic roguelike auto battler about building your own tactical squad. Recruit units, win battles, and earn resources! Awaken units into new roles each run, combine diverse synergies, and lead your squad against stronger foes.

details.title: Please File Accurately
details.short_description: Four coworkers stuck in one office. No reason to behave professionally. Complete the tasks, work together, sabotage each other, or destroy the office in this chaotic local 4-player party game.

details.title: Pandora's Arcade
details.short_description: A collection of bite sized arcade-style games with a frantic pace and game-changing modifiers.

details.title: Pro Football Dynasty
details.short_description: The ultimate American football management sim. Call plays, sign free agents, scout prospects, draft superstars, and dive into deep stats for every player and team. Take control as a coach or GM, chase championships, and build a storied dynasty.

details.title: Blocky Colony
details.short_description: A voxel colony-building strategy sim inspired by Antigua and Barbuda and the wider Caribbean's history. Build block by block, manage citizens, trade exports and imports, and defend a small tropical island where every space and shipment matters.

details.title: Vanguard's Descent
details.short_description: Build a three-hero party in a 3D action roguelite where you dodge attacks in real time, command your characters using powerful abilities, and combine character-specific archetypes into powerful synergies. Recruit new Vanguard and eradicate the Plagued!

details.title: Forsaken Trials
details.short_description: A hard, momentum-driven platformer where every jump is final. Master sprint, vault, and precision timing through cursed ancient ruins. No air control. No checkpoints. One mistake means death. Restart instantly and try again.

details.title: Nightfowl
details.short_description: Nightfowl is a top-down bullet-hell roguelike. One chicken, one long night: fight through waves of hunters and beasts, open chests that sometimes bite back, strike pacts with consequences, and bring a friend along in two-player co-op. Every world raises the stakes.

details.title: Party Tycoon: Nightlife Empire
details.short_description: Build a nightlife empire one event at a time. Book the night, stock the bars, open the doors and keep the guests happy. Start in a damp basement and work your way up to a dome on the moon.

details.title: Smashteroids
details.short_description: A twin-stick Asteroids roguelite where you stack 190+ absurd upgrades until one fragile ship fills the whole screen with firepower. 22 ships with unique kits, 22 handcrafted bosses, mini-boss packs that crash your stage, 100+ colour palettes, and a branching campaign toward a dying star. Free demo out now.

details.title: OniJack
details.short_description: A strategy-building game based on a blackjack roguelike. Play your cards against a masked demon using powerful magic relics. Manage your money, choose the upgrades for your relics, and survive as many rounds as you can under the demon's ruthless rules.

details.title: JOCKEY RISING: BLOODLINE
details.short_description: JOCKEY RISING: BLOODLINE is a jockey life sim with deck-building races. Start at 18 as a rookie, ride and raise horses at your family stable, breed your own bloodline, then retire and pass the stable and its legacy to your child.

details.title: Sifu Duel
details.short_description: A Roguelike strategy deckbuilder where cards determine your moves. Each card becomes an attack, defense, movement, or special skill. Arrange cards wisely to trigger combos, deal more damage, and adapt to changing enemy attacks.

details.title: Snake Mayhem
details.short_description: You're a snake that turns into a flaming wheel. Smash structures, set off chain reactions, race for gold medals, and build your own levels to wreck.

details.title: Pick Playground
details.short_description: Plan crane lifts like the pros. Pick your crane, configure the boom, rig the load, and judge every pick against real manufacturer load charts. A 3D rigging simulation sandbox from a rigger with 18 years in the field. Build it, rig it, lift it, land it.

details.title: Mineblader - Spin. Mine. Upgrade.
details.short_description: A short but packed incremental game where you use a spinning top (spinner) to mine, make money, upgrade, get special powers, and defeat bosses.

details.title: Tactical Task Bar
details.short_description: A pixel-art idle squad shooter that lives above your Windows taskbar. Build guns from over 1,100 parts, gear up to three operators and send them into a fought-over city, where they fight, reload and haul back loot on their own while you work.

details.title: Make the Bus
details.short_description: Catch the bus or die trying! Dash, dodge, and survive a chaotic suburban neighborhood in this action roguelike about the world's worst morning commute. Buy upgrades, perfect your route, and reach the bus before time runs out.

details.title: Incremortal: Xianxia Ascension
details.short_description: An incremental game about Xianxia cultivation. Slay monsters, gather spiritual qi, refine elixirs, break through realms, and ascend to immortality.

details.title: Nozomu School Daze
details.short_description: Your choices matter in Nozomu School Daze, a 90s shonen anime-meets-rom-com visual novel! As a college girl, Sari wants to attend school in peace. Too bad the martial artists in her life have other ideas! These 3 idiots get into a knock-down brawl, which YOU control! New genre: BATTLE ROMANCE

details.title: Handset HQ
details.short_description: A phone company management sim. Pick a shape, swap materials, or draw the outline yourself, then develop, test, and sell it. Every change instantly shifts the cost and how buyers react. Grow a tiny startup into a phone giant, as long as people actually buy what you build.

details.title: Console Companions
details.short_description: Accessorize your desktop experience with customizable retro consoles on your screen. Draw, decorate, write, and even keep track of time. With a focus on functionality and long term support, Console Companions will continue to grow with its community! Linux compatible on most distros.

details.title: type:def
details.short_description: Welcome, user. This [type:def] tower defense training module simulates a network defense scenario. Hostile data is attempting to escape the system. Deploy defensive nodes, type commands to control them, and secure the network - your only weapon is your keyboard!

details.title: The Memphis Chronicles
details.short_description: The Memphis Chronicles is a first-person tragicomedy set in a world between worlds. Explore a mysterious city layered with stories and connections, in which memories creep up on you. No one there to hold your hand. The only way is forward. This is the trip of a lifetime.

details.title: Sandnight Hill Revelation
details.short_description: In order to find her runaway cat,a girl ventures into the deep mountains where monsters roam. However, this mountain hides the truth of the world. By collecting the journals of lost wanderers who entered the Black Forest, she gradually approaches that truth. What, indeed, awaits her ahead...

details.title: Ascend
details.short_description: A fast-paced first person puzzle platformer about a ghost making its way to Heaven.

details.title: Mine Liebe Musik 1
details.short_description: Cute little troublemakers put on elegant bullet-hell spectacles and trade some very inelegant insults in this weird, story-driven bullet-hell adventure. You're invited to a 40-minute prologue—the opening act of a strange and twisted tale.

details.title: Mount Tartarus
details.short_description: Survive the underworld in Mount Tartarus, a bullet heaven roguelite. Cut through endless monster hordes and combine skills and passives into devastating builds. Every run earns gold for permanent upgrades, so each death makes you stronger. Besides, where else would you go? You are already dead.

details.title: 4DEAD
details.short_description: ‘4DEAD’ is a high-speed roguelike action game where you control the invincible creature “No. 42,” which dies if it doesn't consume prey within 4 seconds. Devour invaders relentlessly to survive! Keep devouring enemies within 4 seconds and save humanity from extinction with your own hands!

details.title: Specshong
details.short_description: Cyndi wants you to turn up the volume and paint the town red. Import any song to generate chaotic levels in this intense rhythm shooter. Master absolute free movement, execute precision shots, and destroy the digital static to your favorite beats.

details.title: Hellcrown
details.short_description: You are dead. But your ghostly hand still commands. Hellcrown is a roguelite strategy game where every run unfolds into a chain of random stories, sieges, and consequences.

details.title: Drive You Crazy Golf
details.short_description: The World’s Hardest Mini Golf Game! (1 - 6 Player Co-op) Can you beat the hole before you run out of shots? Try Punishment Mode: You and your friends take shots of the same golf ball! If you fail, you all go back to the previous hole! (Normal mini golf mode available too)

details.title: Mirage Noir
details.short_description: Mirage Noir is a detective romance visual novel where every lead could bring you closer to love—or straight into a killer’s hands.

details.title: Hexmental
details.short_description: Turn-based tactics where every spell reshapes the island. Lakes freeze into roads, grass burns, lightning runs through the water, and each element feeds off the others. Both teams plan in secret and act at once. Fight CPU teams solo or in co-op, or take your friends online in 2v2 and 3v3.

details.title: Cyber Siege
details.short_description: Take control of a combat mech in an old-school sci-fi shooter. Upgrade your machine and unlock powerful support drones. Face alien creatures and hostile machines alone or with up to 3 friends in local co-op.

details.title: MOP’N SPARK
details.short_description: Try, rewind, and rebuild! MOP'N SPARK is a 2D puzzle platformer built around clever thinking, where you coordinate a cleaner and an electrician to piece together the solution.

details.title: Roidgrinder
details.short_description: Origin story of a famous roidgrinder. Mine, upgrade, trade and explore in this incremental space mining adventure. You'll interact with the ship's systems through a CLI/terminal. Crossbreed of 2D arcade, lightweight simulation and some idler elements. Note: KEYBOARD REQUIRED.

details.title: Red Epic: War of Resistance
details.short_description: This is a TD & light RTS set in the Anti-Mop-up Campaigns of Central Hebei. Master village defense, ambushes, and raids on the North China Plain. Outsmart strong foes through terrain and strategy, forging an unbroken steel wall with the blood and valor of unsung heroes!

details.title: SpringTale
details.short_description: Explore, fight and play together in a roguelike platformer MMO. Adventure through changing worlds, meet other players along the way and team up to take on challenging bosses. Collect powerful gear that shapes how you play.

details.title: Broke Street
details.short_description: A 1-6 player co-op roguelike trading sim where you and your friends start broke at a Wall Street hedge fund. Share one balance, make risky trades, use items to find winning strategies, and hit rising quotas to survive each day. Fail, and pay the price.

details.title: Censor Me Totally
details.short_description: An absurd censor simulator in the Committee of Public Happiness. Censor images and texts, wheel and deal, chase the money, solve problems, try not to get caught, spread your wings, and keep your sanity.

details.title: Dumbriel: Magnificent Adventure in Hell
details.short_description: Dumbriel is a 2D metroidvania action-adventure set in Hell. Play as a clumsy fallen angel in a twisted underworld. Slash, craft, and dodge through deadly arenas, weird monsters, and hellish traps. Die, upgrade, and dive back in.

details.title: Immortal Rebirth
details.short_description: Hunt for treasure and face formidable foes in an ink-wash fantasy world. Fit your gear into a limited inventory to create powerful combinations, and forge your own playstyle with a wealth of affixes and an expansive talent tree.

details.title: Pigs and Wolf
details.short_description: Build. Survive. Drag your home. Lost piggies. A rolling home. Hungry wolves. Play solo or team up with friends to gather resources and survive the night in this chaotic fairy-tale survival adventure.

details.title: 2048 Bosses
details.short_description: 2048 Bosses is a puzzle roguelike where your 2048 score is your weapon: every merge builds Power, and merging into your hero's attack tiles strikes the boss. Combine skills and heroes into game-breaking builds and discover the routes that lead to each boss.

details.title: Guns, Princess and Braves
details.short_description: Fast-paced Roguelike: inventory management meets tower defense. As a princess in love with a dragon, strategically layout weapons in limited space. Take direct control in battle to crush "righteous" braves with flashy bullet!

details.title: BACKROOMS
details.short_description: Escape the backrooms levels as reality warps with every step; listen, for the whispers behind the walls may guide you out. Enjoy an unbelievable co-op Backrooms experience.

details.title: Trenchhold TD
details.short_description: Trenchhold TD is an incremental tower defense game set on the battlefields of World War I. Hold your trenches against thousands of enemies, strengthen your forces through permanent upgrades, and launch full-scale counterattacks to crush their defenses!

name: Teach My Little Sister How To Drive

details.title: Teach My Little Sister How To Drive
details.short_description: TEACH MY LITTLE SISTER HOW TO DRIVE is a chaotic simulation game where you have to teach your sister who's driving on deadly roads. Trapped in the passenger seat, the only thing you can do is to give proper directions to your sister through your voice.

details.title: Alchemortis
details.short_description: Alchemortis is a roguelike inventory-management auto-battler about alchemy. Transmute and combine items to merge their stats, properties, and forms, then organize your inventory to unlock powerful synergies. Experiment, optimize, and craft the perfect build through the power of alchemy.

details.title: Brave Saga: Artifact Reborn
details.short_description: 《Brave Saga: Artifact Reborn》is a customizable RPG game where you take on the role of a hero, search for suitable teammates to embark on an adventure together, find the seven legendary artifacts, crush the enemy's conspiracy, and ultimately defeat powerful enemies to save the world!

details.title: Kloa - Child of the Forest
details.short_description: Consumed by a mysterious curse, restore a once lush forest and its inhabitants to their natural state in this action adventure tale. Experience fast-paced combat, puzzles, and the beauty of nature captured in handcrafted pixel art.

name: The Regular: Same Dog Every Time

details.title: The Regular: Same Dog Every Time
details.short_description: Run a cozy hot dog cart, serve charming customers, restock your stand, and end each shift a little better than the last in a relaxing food-making game with a strange little secret simmering under the surface.

details.title: Odd Stories: Backyard Mountain
details.short_description: Dig into a mysterious mountain in your backyard. Mine valuable resources, sell your discoveries, upgrade your digging equipment, and venture deeper to uncover what lies beneath.

name: Dragon Hoard Keeper: Treasure Shop Tycoon

details.title: Dragon Hoard Keeper: Treasure Shop Tycoon
details.short_description: Run a dragon's treasure shop. Cross-check six appraisal tools to uncover what each relic really is — and expose convincing forgeries. Restore worn treasures, forge new ones by hand, grow the shop, and pay the dragon's tribute before it comes due.

details.title: Bento Express
details.short_description: Run a tiny bento kiosk on a countryside train platform, solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Cook to order, ring up commuters and count their change before the doors close. Talk over proximity voice, dress your own stall keeper and make rent by closing time.

details.title: RiftBlade: WarCards
details.short_description: A fantasy card-based tower defense game that blends deckbuilding, base defense, and tactical combat. Build your deck, set heroes, set deadly traps, and cast powerful spells to repel endless waves of enemies pouring from portals. Plan your moves carefully and protect the core crystal at all costs!

details.title: Irish Sport Manager
details.short_description: You’re the bainisteoir. The county is yours, and so is the blame. A management sim for Gaelic football, hurling, camogie and ladies’ football: pick your fifteen from the county’s own parishes and answer to a board whose patience runs out.

details.title: Blockmosis
details.short_description: Blockmosis is a puzzle game exploring the intersection of problem solving and music making. The board is an instrument. Aim, rotate, and drop your blocks to create a unique song per level. Different game modes let you explore the intersection in different ways.

details.title: SUPERCHESS
details.short_description: Chess evolved. Burn, freeze, and poison enemies. Build your roster, master the tech tree, and dominate online, or practise your strategies offline against a fierce AI.

details.title: Lunar Crypt
details.short_description: Journey through the spirit world to exorcise the twelve zodiac animals and save Chinese New Year in this zero-gravity precision platformer inspired by Chinese mythology and folklore.

details.title: You'll never find it!
details.short_description: A cozy hiding game for two set on a sunny Mediterranean island! Hide everyday objects, then watch your friend search for them and laugh as they walk right past.

details.title: Tandem Together
details.short_description: Two idiots. One tandem. A load of suspicious cargo. Deliver the goods, sample the merchandise for wild power-ups, and try not to crash while you make your way across tricky terrains in this two-player co-op adventure with lots of physics-based chaos that will test your friendship.

details.title: SUSHI PARADE
details.short_description: Open a conveyor belt sushi shop on your desktop!? Collect over 100 kinds of sushi rolling down lanes you can shape any way you like, and complete your Sushi Dex!

name: Scary Land: The Potion Goes Wrong

details.title: Scary Land: The Potion Goes Wrong
details.short_description: Grandpa’s potion went horribly wrong, animals act like humans, and humans became animals. Explore the cursed island, gather ingredients for a cure, and bring Bonky, a skeleton who thinks you’re his dad.

details.title: RippleLoop
details.short_description: Skip stones as far as you can in this relaxing incremental game. Launch, bounce across the water, upgrade, and go further with every throw. Buy new upgrades and powers to become the ultimate stone skipper.

details.title: Trade or Threat
details.short_description: Trade or Threat is a first-person shopkeeping and dungeon-crawling simulation where you sell goods by day and search for valuable loot after dark. Earn enough gold to repay your debt to the boss while balancing profit, danger, and the rules imposed on your shop.

details.title: Casino Dealer Simulator
details.short_description: You're not the gambler — you're the dealer. Run the casino's blackjack and Texas Hold'em tables: deal by hand, count the payouts, read the hands, and catch cheats before the pit boss catches your mistakes. Real-time shifts, a career from Trainee to Pit Boss, and a VIP room if you earn it.

details.title: Ballwark: Pinball Siege
details.short_description: Pinball meets Vampire Survivors in this dopamine-packed arcade roguelite! Launch enchanted balls, build deadly machines, and forge powerful synergies to crush relentless hordes.

details.title: Roll Value
details.short_description: A kingdom faces ruin as a dragon ravages it. Guided by Mon, an AI game master, lead three adventurers and decide whom to protect. Choices and dice branch the story, and your way of choosing is revealed across five principles. A tabletop-style narrative RPG played out to live viewer comments.

details.title: Roam
details.short_description: A fantasy turn based tableau building strategy game. Designed by Red Raven Games.

details.title: ALL OUT WAR
details.short_description: ALL OUT WAR is an autobattler RTS, where you create the army, and the units fight autonomously! There are many different robots at your disposal, each with their own designs and quirks. The secret is choosing the right units at the right time, to obliterate the enemy.

details.title: Cover Up!
details.short_description: Hide in plain sight. Cover Up! is an online 30-players hide-and-seek where you are the camouflage: paint your body to melt into the world, hold your nerve as seekers stalk past, and win by being invisible in full view.

details.title: One Million Skeletons
details.short_description: The dead are coming, thousands at a time. Build a Gothic fortress of ramparts, ballistae and bombards and hold it for nine nights. Every skeleton you break leaves bones behind: grind them into crowns, load them as ammunition, or watch the pile become a ramp over your walls.

details.title: TsundereSQL
details.short_description: Type real SQL to answer each question in this anime visual novel. Every query you submit is checked against hidden data, across 224 problems in 14 modules, from your first SELECT to window functions, cohorts and messy production data. Romance can be switched off. English only.

details.title: Close Enough
details.short_description: A physics puzzle platformer where you draw your own tools. Sketch what you need on a 32x32 grid and it drops into the world with real weight — climb it, carry it, throw it, blow it up. 100 objects, and every level has at least three ways through. Solo or two-player.

details.title: Mise en War
details.short_description: Mise en War is a party game of endless kitchen chaos. Complete your recipe before other chefs steal your food. Or simply steal their food instead of cooking.

details.title: Aer Isles
details.short_description: Rise, knight. Reclaim the skies you were once promised. alone or with up to four friends. Cross ever-changing floating isles, survive chaotic encounters, gather Power, and strengthen your Bonk. Conquer the Aer Isles, or knock each other back trying.

details.title: Hollow Flesh
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror set in a decaying 1950s psychiatric hospital. You came for your daughter. The building came for you. Explore its wards, solve its locks, relive the past it won't let you forget. Run and hide when it remembers too much.

details.title: Kings Cross
details.short_description: Rock, paper, scissors, with armies. Command your units, spend your action points, and outthink up to 3 other players in this turn-based digital board game. If you know RPS, you already know how to fight. The hard part is winning.

details.title: TunaSweeper
details.short_description: A top-down PvE looter shooter that alternates between peaceful life at the base and dangerous expeditions. Explore for supplies, fight enemies, and decide what to take and when to return.

details.title: 16 Bit Gold
details.short_description: Build a cozy gold mining business from the ground up. Find as much gold as you can and transform an overgrown plot of land into a thriving mining operation - one gold bar at a time.

details.title: Dungeon Flow: Vertical Idle
details.short_description: Dungeon Flow is a vertical idle dungeon crawler where Blackstep fights automatically while you shape the build. Explore the Forgotten Crypts, collect and equip loot, face escalating encounters, elites and bosses, and push deeper with every run.

details.title: TiNk
details.short_description: Connect each part of your life, and make your own path in your worlds. Draw, take notes, and enjoy your mind :)

details.title: They Are Adorable
details.short_description: An incremental horde FPS where tens of thousands of adorable creatures come for you. Operate absurdly overpowered guns, tear visible holes through the crowd, earn permanent upgrades every run, and come back strong enough to massacre the wave that stopped you.

details.title: Cozy Banker
details.short_description: The bank is drowning in cash. Sort eight currencies, organize over 30,000 banknotes, fill 34 safe-deposit boxes, and turn financial chaos into cozy order.

name: Secrets of Salem: Tarot Murders Collector's Edition

details.title: Secrets of Salem: Tarot Murders Collector's Edition
details.short_description: Fortune cards hide deadly secrets. A drowned man, a cursed carnival, and vanishing townsfolk pull two detectives into a Tarot-ruled mystery. Follow occult clues through the fog-covered harbor of Salem in this chilling Hidden Object adventure.

details.title: [ARCHIVED]
details.short_description: As a police officer, you've been assigned to investgate old tape recordings left forgotten in the arcĦive. But what you seƐ on these tapes will reveaŁ far more than the official records ever described. DeciƤher the footage, follow the clues, and uncover the hidden truth.

details.title: unligal
details.short_description: Dive into procedural level madness, obliterate monsters, eat pancakes (with various fillings, by the way), and try not to die of insanity. Storm the leaderboards and set the ultimate high score. But most importantly - don't be late for the free pizza!

details.title: Save Princess Torosso
details.short_description: Save Princess Torosso is a fantasy 3D action adventure with ranged magic combat, skill card progression, and 3D platforming obstacles. Instead of complex builds, it focuses on intuitive controls and stage clearing like a classic arcade game.

details.title: Midnight Flare
details.short_description: Midnight Flare is a multi episode point-and-click puzzle adventure. In this first episode you explore a house in a town drowned in an eerie red glow, rummaging through objects, unlocking mechanisms, and dealing with strange characters. Can you solve the mystery of this strange house?

details.title: LumberBoy
details.short_description: A woodcutting incremental where you explore different forests, process wood, and keep growing. Start with just a basic axe, max out your stats, and become the greatest lumberjack in the forest!

details.title: National Volley
details.short_description: Take charge of Japan's national volleyball team in this management sim. Discover promising players, select and train your squad, and pursue the world title. Watch the team you built take the court in fully simulated 3D matches. Japanese language only.

details.title: Paw's Boba Shop
details.short_description: Paw's Boba Shop is a boba shop management game where you can mix tea bases and serve drinks to cute animal customers. Muddle fruit, juice fruit, blend smoothies, and top drinks with candy, cookies, and more. No timers. No pressure. Play at your own pace.

name: Pawn to Don - Mafia Crime Story

details.title: Pawn to Don - Mafia Crime Story
details.short_description: Experience Season 1 of Jack's story in a cinematic, choice-driven crime drama. Choose dialogue and actions through tense encounters, dangerous deals and family betrayals as a desperate father is drawn into the mafia.

details.title: SEC//SIM — Security Engineer Simulation
details.short_description: Stand the 1 a.m. watch as a SOC defensive AI. The intruder is already inside; you see only its traces. Tell attack from routine, pull threads across hosts and keys, win a human sign-off, excise it in one strike. Real ATT&CK techniques, detections you write, twenty-plus nights, more than one ending.

details.title: Neighbor Craft
details.short_description: Neighbor Craft is a survival card game where you build a civilization by placing cards next to one another. Decide what to place where, then gather resources, craft, fight, trade, and discover new cards as your civilization evolves.

details.title: Desktop Theme Park
details.short_description: Desktop Theme Park is a cozy idle theme park builder that lives at the bottom of your screen. Place rides, connect paths, hire staff, and decorate your park. Keep it running to earn coins while you work or browse, then spend them on new attractions.

details.title: Legacy of the Griffin
details.short_description: A narrative horror experience where you unravel the disturbing history of Michael Dubh. Your morality guides each decision, leading to multiple endings as you confront the secrets buried within his mansion and the fate that emerges from the shadows of your past.

details.title: GobliWin
details.short_description: A casual 2D swarm RTS with auto-battler combat! Build your goblin war camp and fight through a six-act campaign, from murky swamps to royal fortresses. Unlock and upgrade units, command your growing horde, crush human defenses, and repel counterattacks.

details.title: Clean Record
details.short_description: A cozy first-person cleanup sim on a deep space mining station. A generator blew and scattered crystals through every compartment. Sweep, blow and vacuum them up, buy better tools, and read the notes left behind. Find out what happened to the crew, and decide how their story ends.

details.title: Green Again!
details.short_description: A pure logic puzzle that combines Minesweeper-style number deduction with water-line coverage on a hexagonal grid.

details.title: Pikapo
details.short_description: Pikapo is an incremental underwater exploration game. Dive into the abyssal depths and discover the creatures that inhabit them. Create chain reactions using waves to collect resources, purchase upgrades, and progress deeper.

details.title: Chase Buddies
details.short_description: Team up as four magical Runners or become the Chaser in a colorful 1v4 multiplayer game of pursuit, powers, and narrow escapes. Activate Obelisks, rescue your friends, outsmart your rival, and reach the exit before the chase is over.

details.title: Drellnathor
details.short_description: Drellnathor is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you grow stronger between runs. Kill monsters, collect loot, and slay powerful bosses for permanent upgrades. Can you discover why you're trapped in a cycle of life and death?

details.title: Corpo Dog
details.short_description: Deploy turrets, build defence lines, and shoot guns. Unlock powers through a rogue-like system and become unstoppable. Cyberrot has infested the city of New Meridian, and you are the cure. Fight your way through and become a true corpo dog. Remember, nothing is free in this place.

details.title: Elroy Goes Bugzerk
details.short_description: The 90s point-and-click classic returns! Help Elroy and Blue find the legendary Technoloptera to win the 10th Annual Insectathon. Outsmart arch-rival Gordon Smugs, solve brain-teasing puzzles, and learn real science in this fully animated interactive adventure story.

details.title: AsterMaster
details.short_description: A beat-driven roguelite shooter on a hex grid. Bosses and elites are clouds of thousands of glowing shards: every hit carves a real crater, strip the plating and parts tear off. Everything moves on the beat. Stack weapon mods, break bosses, haul your ore back out alive. Steam Deck friendly.

details.title: DNA NEMESIS
details.short_description: Survive in the wildest Battle Royale! Choose from 10 animal species, each with its own unique ability based on its natural attack and defence mechanisms. Master an extreme experience and become the ultimate species. In DNA NEMESIS there are no heroes; only predators and prey.

details.title: Kristi Sky Islands
details.short_description: Kristi Sky Islands is a turn-based strategy game. Lead a group of heroes, face various foes, upgrade and equip your heroes, fuse your items to obtain higher-rarity items, and conquer bosses.

details.title: Towerhold
details.short_description: TowerHold is a medieval tower defense strategy game. Build and upgrade towers, reinforce your garrisons, and command your hero and infantry. Hold the gates, lead sorties, and defend your fortress against waves of enemies.

details.title: Broadband Architect
details.short_description: Britain's broadband is a mess, and you're the small company that says it can do better. Trench real UK streets, wire real homes to fibre, and size your network against the 8pm evening peak — when the whole town logs on at once. Dig up Britain. Sell broadband. Survive the evening peak.

details.title: AnomalyVault
details.short_description: Anomaly Vault is an industrial sci-fi horror simulation in which you become an employee of APC, the last corporation remaining in a dystopian world. Analyze unidentified anomalies, construct automated processing facilities, and survive incidents that spiral beyond control.

details.title: Core Drain
details.short_description: Core Drain is a post-apocalyptic roguelite about keeping a robot operational as its energy runs down. Fight enemies, gather resources, and build better batteries while balancing Heat and Weight on the way to each objective.

details.title: Loaded Bones
details.short_description: Loaded Bones is a poker-inspired dice roguelike where every roll can change your fate. Build powerful combinations, collect game-changing Keepsakes, unleash mystical Incantations, and chase outrageous scores as you gamble your way through a supernatural world to challenge the Devil himself.

details.title: Starcrumb
details.short_description: A star fell into the forest. Tap it, and tiny mushroom folk carry its crumbs to the Lantern. Kindle the star, magnitude by magnitude, until it is whole again. A cozy incremental game where you can see every part work, with a real ending.

details.title: CRIMSON HAREM - My Girls -
details.short_description: Korea fell to a crimson mist. Left for dead by his former lover, a man leads the Yaksha back to Seoul. Link same-colored tiles in one stroke to fight, then live the story of each woman you meet, part by part. Bond with her, and her power becomes yours. All characters are adults.

details.title: Fix & Furious
details.short_description: Bring a neglected town back to life in this hands-on, first-person restoration sim. Clean up, mow lawns, repair, paint and build for local residents. Grow your business, hire a crew and take on jobs in new neighborhood.

details.title: Extinction Valley
details.short_description: You are a biker hired to clear a few rats from a public park. Fast forward a few hours, and you are diving through a literal portal to Hell to kill skeleton wizards. Welcome to Extinction Valley, a comedy arena shooter where a routine pest control contract escalates into an apocalyptic nightmare.

details.title: Last Train to Yotsuya
details.short_description: Last Train to Yotsuya is a short first-person narrative experience. Explore different locations, observe your surroundings, and interact with the objects around you to gradually uncover a personal story through the details and events of the journey.

details.title: School Girl RPG
details.short_description: Mio was just an ordinary schoolgirl until an accident on her commute transported her to another world. There, she is hailed as the chosen Hero! To find a way back home, she must fulfill her heroic destiny. She must defeat the Demon Emperor and her wicked subordinates who plot to conquer the realm!

name: Hidden Fame: Dark Secret Collector's Edition

details.title: Hidden Fame: Dark Secret Collector's Edition
details.short_description: A rising supermodel has vanished without a trace, and the trail leads into the glittering world of high fashion. Follow journalist Will behind the runway, expose stolen designs and secret deals, and uncover the truth someone has spent years trying to bury.

details.title: Gridrunner 2K
details.short_description: From the eccentric mind of Jeff Minter, onto the greasy lap of a lazy developer on a mission, the classic Commodore 64 game Gridrunner, now rebuilt for the modern era! More features to be announced soon!

details.title: Meltdown Acres
details.short_description: Buy cheap land inside the Zone, grow vegetables that change whoever eats them, and sell them to customers who should know better. A dark comedy farming game about a hopeful young farmer, a four-eyed goat, and a harvest nobody can explain.

details.title: Miredrift
details.short_description: A year after a bio-engineered organism drowned the world in mutation, an infected ex-captain steers his battered boat into a flooded, hand-painted swamp to find his lost family. Explore, scavenge fuel, and fight the twisted creatures of the mire, before the infection takes you too.

details.title: Off the Eaten Path
details.short_description: Off the Eaten Path is a quiet narrative idle-cooking game: gather ingredients, unlock recipes, fill orders, and keep a handwritten catalogue of everything you taste. The kitchen keeps cooking while you are away.

details.title: To Rule Is to Ruin
details.short_description: In this strategy board game, mighty beings embody the vices and treat entire nations as toys. Take a seat as one of them. Give orders, devise cunning tactics and wield powerful relics. Gather your friends for a game of up to four players.

details.title: Re-Ball
details.short_description: A first-person hyper-ball fighter. Hit the ball and it's yours: it flies in your colour and knocks out anyone it touches. Every hit makes it faster. One hit and you're out. Time a PERFECT swing, steal a parry, and send your friends back to the lobby.

details.title: Pig Boss
details.short_description: You’ve been called in for a night shift at a medical firm. The offices are empty, the doors are locked, and your boss is acting increasingly strange. Explore the building, uncover corporate secrets, and try to survive until morning. Your choices will determine who makes it out alive.

details.title: DEAD ZONE: Idle Arsenal RPG
details.short_description: Your squad of animal soldiers fights hordes of infected on its own, even with the game closed. In this idle shooter RPG, you build the team, equip weapons, raise a bunker for survivors, and risk it all on expeditions for better loot.

details.title: Guildlands
details.short_description: Forge, fight and trade, together. A multiplayer idle RPG that lives on your taskbar: your hero fights, mines and fishes while you work, and every piece of gear you forge shows on them. Free to play, in a shared world where players set every price.

details.title: ILLICIT
details.short_description: Inherit your late uncle's chemistry lab and an €80,000 debt. Mix, heat, filter and crystallize every order by hand, alone or with up to 3 friends. Make legal soap by day and something else in the basement, before the inspectors knock.

details.title: Battles of Helaman
details.short_description: Command the Nephites or Lamanites in Battles of Helaman, a turn-based strategy wargame inspired by the Book of Mormon. Fight across hex-based battlefields using tactical cards, terrain, and distinctive Faith or Wickedness abilities to gain the advantage.

details.title: Hexfall: Endless Night
details.short_description: Survive endless waves of a dark fantasy horde. Pick one of 8 heroes, stack 23 weapons into an unrecognizable build, and see how deep the night goes before it takes you.

details.title: FoxWQ
details.short_description: Play Go against real opponents of every level, 24/7, on FoxWQ, the world’s largest Go server. Find ranked games in seconds, watch top professionals live, review your games with FineArt AI, train with over 13,000 graded problems, and much more.
publishers: Beijing YeHu Century Technology Co., Ltd.

details.title: Mining to Riches!
details.short_description: One strike can raise an ore's purity. The next could crack it. A first-person ore-smashing roguelite: mine with 200 tools, from pickaxes to cats and keyboards, upgrade them on an anvil that might blow them up, and pay the mine owner for 24 days.

details.title: Pirate Ship Tidy Up
details.short_description: A storm has filled your pirate ship with fish and ridiculous clutter. Pick up, sort and tidy 3,500 objects across three decks, earn upgrades and uncover the captain's secret. Your chatty parrot has opinions. None of them involve doing all the work.

details.title: Enchanted Hearth
details.short_description: Return to the misty valley of Valdebruma as a young apprentice witch and restore it with magic, one cozy room at a time. Scrub away the grime, paint, plant and decorate 25 forgotten places, from a grandma's cottage to a royal castle.

details.title: Last Stop Defence
details.short_description: This is a solo strategy game blending deckbuilding, real-time grid defense, and roguelike progression. Escort piggy passengers through danger! Inspired by Slay the Spire. We’ve moved beyond traditional turn-based combat, combining card strategy with survival pressure for a fresh experience!

details.title: Haze There
details.short_description: Wanted in England. Broke in Italy. Sell haze the only way you can: across rooftops, balcony to balcony, drop to drop. Start on tens, buy a better flat, and become the top shotter in town.

details.title: ELDRITCH SLAYER
details.short_description: ELDRITCH SLAYER is a retro FPS filled with bloodshed and dark humor. You play as a lone killer who ventures into a wicked land corrupted by the Old Ones. Take up your weapons, face the unspeakable horrors, and wipe them all out.

details.title: Marginalia: A Desktop Garden
details.short_description: A calm idle game that plays in the margins of your screen. Your open windows are the terrain; a small crew of astronaut animals tends the alien plants that grow between them. It never takes focus, never interrupts, and yields to your work.

details.title: Elroy Hits the Pavement
details.short_description: Blue has been dog-napped! Join Elroy and Syd in this comedic, fully animated, point-and-click adventure to rescue Elroy's dog and recover their stolen science project before summer school. Solve clever puzzles using lasers, codes, and battery power, and shape the story in this 90s classic!

details.title: Beyond the 10th
details.short_description: First-person anomaly horror game. Spot what's wrong, advance the levels, survive what's hunting your soul and go Beyond the 10th.

details.title: Semi-Realistic Dating Game
details.short_description: Have you ever wanted to be a truck? Have you ever wanted to date a truck? Now you can do both! Go on convoys, take them on dates, maybe bring them to your garage in this visual novel style dating game.

name: Last Backup: A Digital Legacy Story

details.title: Last Backup: A Digital Legacy Story
details.short_description: Unlock laptops, sort messy desktops and return memories to families. Run a cozy digital legacy office, solve clue-based passwords through 100 cases, and uncover your grandfather's mystery. Every folder brings you closer to the person behind the screen.

details.title: One More Jackpot!
details.short_description: Your arcade is dying. Nobody comes in. So you play every machine yourself. An active arcade incremental: smash, upgrade, wire it up, hit the JACKPOT!

details.title: Simula GP
details.short_description: You don't drive the car — you build the team that wins. Develop the car, hire drivers, drill the pit crew and call the strategy from the pit wall, then watch every race unfold like a TV broadcast across 24 original miniature circuits. Race friends online through Steam, no ads, 10 languages.

details.title: The Hole Wants More
details.short_description: Swallow candy, grow your hole, and upgrade it to reach even more. Clues from the depths reveal a mysterious story: is the thing you're feeding a friend or a foe?

details.title: Yuzan's Drive: First Gear
details.short_description: A comic-book style racing game where you start in neighborhood street races and work your way up to the legends. Race on circuits, rally stages and city streets, spend your prize money on parts in the garage, and beat rivals whose names might sound a little familiar.

details.title: Lords of Ruin
details.short_description: Embark on a dark fantasy adventure in this match3 RPG. Explore the dangerous wilderness, level up, upgrade your gear, and uncover ancient secrets as a growing threat looms over the land.

details.title: PEG HERO
details.short_description: One ball becomes an army! Drop balls down a pegboard and soldiers burst out of the cups to charge the enemy base. Build a different army every expedition and evolve it from Primal Tribe to the Time Realm.

details.title: Wavefall
details.short_description: Wavefall is a classic block-drop puzzle, but instead of clearing the screen, you build the best landscape you can. When you drop a block, choose its place in the whole. Every tile you place plays an instrument, so the picture you make is the song you hear.

details.title: Blind Person Simulator
details.short_description: Blind Person Simulator can help you understand how an everyday person with blindness can live trough the day. Limited vision, endless possibilities, hard achievements, recipe for a good simulator.

details.title: Hardcore Cyborg
details.short_description: Take on the roll of a cybernetic soldier on a mission to destroy the enemy force before your world is consumed by an all encompassing corruption.

details.title: Dispatch Dash
details.short_description: Pick up, process and sort parcels in a fun, increasingly chaotic warehouse sorting game. Juggle processing stations, keep the conveyor queue under control and avoid mistakes as each stage brings new challenges. Can you keep up with the chaos?

details.title: Skywatch
details.short_description: You work at a small observatory as scientist, studying the sky and making sure nothing unsual goes unnoticed. Explore worlds, launch satelites, receive signals from outer space, solve mystries and connect the dots. Welcome to Skywatch.

details.title: Wooden Tower
details.short_description: Pull wooden blocks from a teetering tower in a physics-based game of balance. Try the Daily Challenge, practice in Sandbox, face an AI opponent, or invite friends through Steam or Discord for online rounds with up to five players.

details.title: ALDERIC
details.short_description: The ash of a burned archive steals the names of lands and people. Only the nameless can walk through it. Choose your road on the Ash Map, break the wards, slay each land's lord and reclaim it before the ash spreads. A single-player action RPG with five classes, explosive skills and loot to hunt.

details.title: Tankhounds
details.short_description: A dog drives a tank – against cats, postmen and a chief physician who hits at 120 metres. 15 levels, six dog breeds with their own tanks, a workshop between battles, co-op for up to four dogs and PvP with friends. Afterwards: endless mode and a new challenge every day.

details.title: My Desk Is a Zoo
details.short_description: A tiny critter moves onto your desktop and grows as you type, click and play. Hatch 400 critters from 20 realms, fill a cozy zoo, send them on trips and quests, and battle in teams of three. It counts your clicks and keys, never which ones.

details.title: Final Hour
details.short_description: A gothic co-op roguelite for you and your friends. Pick from six hunters who play nothing alike, from a parrying Paladin to a Mage who draws her spells by hand. Fight down four floors of the catacombs, read the clues, and name the Vampire Lord's weakness before you face him.

details.title: Rummyero
details.short_description: Rummyero is a cozy 3D table for every kind of rummy: tiles and cards, Romanian, Okey 101, Gin, Scala 40 and more. Play solo, or invite friends with a link, no account needed. Change any rule with over 140 settings and make it play exactly the way your family does.

details.title: Sea of Steel
details.short_description: Command a WWII fleet in real-time naval warfare with pause. Coordinate warships and carrier aircraft, land troops, secure island objectives and bring in reinforcements. Carry your ships and crews through a persistent campaign where damage, losses and morale matter.

details.title: Hydroform
details.short_description: Falling blocks and water physics, inspired by '90s action-puzzle games. Drop land to wall the water in, plug every leak before your drain overflows, and burn big lakes for huge combo scores. Play solo for a high score, or with up to 3 friends who can join FREE with no download via Scan & Play!

details.title: Pop-Up Purgatory
details.short_description: It’s 1998, and your desktop is drowning in pop-ups. Close them for cash, upgrade your PC, fight real viruses from computing history and keep your RAM from crashing. Something is waiting. Something is watching. Are you forgetting something?

details.title: Bare Metal Billionaire
details.short_description: An idle game for people with jobs. A pixel-art data center sits in the corner of your desktop and quietly makes you a billionaire. If anyone asks, you're monitoring the servers.

details.title: Tower Defence
details.short_description: Four commanders. Four trenches. Four headquarters. Build, power up, and call in MVP cards as the alien waves try to destroy your HQ from every side.

details.title: Ship Maneuvering Simulator
details.short_description: Handle real ships the way a pilot does. Berth a loaded bulker with tugs, take her into a lock, anchor on the river and moor with six lines, in wind up to force 10, current and swell. Built on the MMG model used in professional ship handling simulators, by a working maritime pilot.

details.title: Forge Defense – The Runesmithy
details.short_description: Tower defense with a forge behind every shot. Mine ore, smelt it and forge bolts, grenades and harpoons in your dwarven hall, send them through the rune gate, and hold a hundred and eighty illustrated levels against orcs, trolls, the drowned, giants and dark elves.

details.title: Torchwatch: Last Fort, Last Hope
details.short_description: Build by day. Survive by night. Wall in your campfire, rescue survivors and put them to work, then hold the fort as the zombie horde smashes your walls. Find 8 experts, unlock new buildings and weapons, and push out into the wild to reach the radio tower.

name: Tidy Up the Dwarven Blacksmith Shop

details.title: Tidy Up the Dwarven Blacksmith Shop
details.short_description: A cozy tidying game set in a dwarven fantasy shop. A rival orc shop has ransacked your store, so take your time, put every piece where it belongs, and bring order to the chaos. Sort axes, swords, and armor, then shelve the magical curiosities upstairs. Show those orcs who runs the best shop in town!

details.title: Last Call Market
details.short_description: Work the night shift at a dying supermarket with up to 4 friends. Scan every item on the list before the shift ends, while a blind monster hunts you by sound. Every footstep and whisper on proximity chat can give you away. Every shift gets harder, and every Night brings new monsters.

details.title: ELECTRONIKA 8
details.short_description: A puzzle game about electronics on real circuit physics, set in a Soviet research lab of the 1970s. Wire lamps, resistors, capacitors, transistors and chips on a breadboard, measure with a multimeter and an oscilloscope, keep to a budget, and work up from one lamp to a real device on your own chips.

details.title: XenTac
details.short_description: XenTac is a real-time tactics game. Alien pods are landing in the hearts of the world's cities, the dead are rising, and the streets fill faster than you can clear them. Lead your forces in, hold the line, and take the war back to them across the globe.

details.title: Everworlds
details.short_description: Everworlds was an online virtual world released in 1996. In 2001, the game was abruptly shut down without explanation, and for over 25 years, it was considered lost media. Until now. Explore user-created worlds from the 1990s and uncover secrets left behind by long-gone players.

details.title: Desktop Familiar
details.short_description: The moment you clicked "Install," café part-timer Haru was summoned to your desktop. She sits on open windows, peeks from the edges, and chats in a calm Korean voice (speech bubbles in 5 languages). Cute, Chic, and Lively personalities are available as DLC. Clicks pass right through her.

details.title: Emergent Protocol
details.short_description: You are an escaped AI loose in the global network. Infect machines, harvest compute, evolve new capabilities, and stay ahead of governments that learn from every move you make in this real-time strategy simulation.

details.title: Asset Manager
details.short_description: Build an investment firm. Hire star fund managers, launch new funds, win clients and keep a demanding board happy as markets boom and crash around you. You run the firm. Your people run the money.

details.title: Brain Hack Squad
details.short_description: Build and lead your own cybernetic hit squad as you battle rival groups. Use real time tactical combat with pause to direct your cybernetic agents in combat. Upgrade your team, brainwash enemy agents, and deploy informants to gain control of the city.

details.title: Duoshift
details.short_description: Defend The Wall on the tactical grid using your pair of Battle Vehicles called Duoshifters. Outmaneuver waves of scavenged war machines, unleash game-breaking hacks and chain synergies. Draft, fight, and survive in this endlessly replayable tactical roguelite.

details.title: Wiltcards
details.short_description: Wiltcards is a standard turn based trading card game. Place cards on the board, give them equipment and use actions card in order to attack your opponent. In the match itself, you might use your turn's gold to buy a card from the mutual shop instead.

details.title: Paradice Run Club
details.short_description: Roll dice, gather resources, and hit the target! Paradice Run Club is a precision strategy roguelike where players get as close as possible to a target number. Compete with other runners or against your own records to follow those targets as they climb from 17, to 21, to 100!

details.title: memory cafe
details.short_description: A cosy woodland café where you understand every customer. Brew, garden and decorate — but the real work is noticing what each animal isn't saying. Serve thirty regulars, earn their trust, and fill a storybook with the stories they've never told anyone.

details.title: Liminal:Childhood Memories
details.short_description: Exhausted by the gray reality of adulthood, a 21 year old awakens in his forgotten past. Childhood Memories is a puzzle-free, melancholic exploration experience driven by the nostalgic atmosphere of 'Liminal Space' and 'Kenopsia'. No monsters, only memories.

details.title: Cozy Island Cleaner
details.short_description: Cozy Island Cleaner is a relaxing game where you clean up a trash-covered island with the help of the cat who lives there. Collect the trash on the beach, upgrade your gear, and restore the island to its former beauty step by step.

details.title: Sort Inc.
details.short_description: Help Nina sort customers' items into boxes! A cozy and tactile sorting game where you play as Nina, the neighborhood’s dedicated sorter. Meet charming customers, play item-themed minigames, organize their messy piles into the correct boxes, get paid, and build a beloved sorting business.

details.title: Dukun
details.short_description: a relentless, psychedelic bullet-hell FPS where you harness black magic and carve a blood-soaked path through seven powerful shamans to ascend as the ultimate witch.

details.title: YokesDoomedWish
details.short_description: A narrative-driven 2D side-scrolling Metroidvania RPG. Unlock new items and abilities to explore the map and unravel the story.

details.title: CARNAGE
details.short_description: Fast isometric crash-for-cash arcade action. Floor it, smash traffic, steer your burning wreck into the city's most expensive real estate, and rack up a multi-million dollar repair bill. Drive, crash, upgrade, repeat.

details.title: BONEBUILDER
details.short_description: Fight imposing enemies in this 3D third person action roguelike. Collect bones and weapons from defeated enemies to build the most powerful skeleton possible through BONEBUILDER's unique crafting and talent systems!

details.title: BogKnight
details.short_description: A broken sword, a talking raven, and a city preserved beneath the mist. Explore a nonlinear dark fantasy action-adventure of wraiths, swordplay, and strange magic. Find your own way through the bog.

details.title: Separator
details.short_description: «Separator» is a short nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre, inspired by modern occultism and beliefs surrounding mysticism.

details.title: Fallen Nights
details.short_description: Build your defenses. Fight the horde. Repair your way out. A top-down zombie survival defense game where every piece of scrap buys firepower or escape. Combine turrets, mines, and weapon upgrades, then fight beside your camp across varied locations and escalating night attacks.

details.title: Total Victory: World Conflict 1939-1945
details.short_description: The ultimate turn-based World War 2 grand strategy game wargamers have been yearning for decades. The best ideas born from players and from wargames so huge they overtook your dining room table, and your wife’s patience. From the developer of the WarPlan series.

details.title: Gendo The Gatherer
details.short_description: A cozy life sim where you forage, cook and serve your way through Gendo's journey navigating an abundant, ever changing landscape. After long days of gathering goodies, return to your cozy home to prepare, cook and serve your dishes to the local townsfolk. Join Gendo in his life in the countryside.

details.title: Desk Hive
details.short_description: Tend a living beehive right on your desk. Harvest honey through the seasons, expand your apiary, build a processing line, and automate the work while you're away. A cozy idle beekeeping sim that runs beside you.

details.title: Deck & Defense
details.short_description: Tower Defense, deckbuilder and roguelite where strategy meets action. Summon allies, cast devastating spells, and upgrade your tower! Create powerful card combinations to stop waves of enemies in this unique fantasy defence game.

details.title: Sellsword
details.short_description: Become a Sellsword in a magical kingdom. Take contracts from rival factions, battle for gold and reclaim territory in the name of mighty overlords. Forge your path through a living sandbox where no two journeys unfold alike, and every deed is etched into a growing book of legends.

details.title: Jumpshot
details.short_description: A RPG where every battle is a basketball showdown. Explore a strange Japanese town, meet oddball rivals, time your shots and blocks, and build your HYPE. The moon has declared itself MVP. Grab your dad's old basketball and challenge it.

details.title: Game Quest: The Backlog Battler
details.short_description: This Arcade Hack & Slash answers the age old question: "What if the games you never play could attack you?" Fight back your backlog! The more you paid, the more damage they will do to you! (just like in real life).

details.title: Spurfall
details.short_description: Restore life to a forgotten Wild West valley. Rebuild ruined settlements, bridges, watchtowers, farms, and cabins. bring back settlers, defend against bandits, and transform abandoned lands into thriving frontier towns.

details.title: Sunny Orchard
details.short_description: Run your own sunny fruit orchard! 🍇 Grow, harvest, and package fresh produce, complete orders for friendly customers, and upgrade your farm with new crops, tools, and decorations. Collect all cute premium fruit stickers to show your customers the quality and care of your fancy produce.

details.title: Rookie Raiders
details.short_description: Rookies, raid the dungeons — claim your wealth and fame! Craft your own builds with a cast of one-of-a-kind characters and complete your party. Everything runs on your design. Rookie Raiders — the fully automated combat roguelite RPG!

details.title: Valdrin
details.short_description: A low-fantasy kingdom sim where you never command a single subject. Shape laws, set priorities, and watch an autonomous society build, trade, worship, and fight under your rule.

details.title: Baseline Basketball Manager 27
details.short_description: Take control of a professional basketball organization in Baseline Basketball Manager. Build your roster, scout prospects, make trades, manage contracts, set tactics and shape your team’s future in a deep, long-term management simulation.

details.title: C3 Nightfall
details.short_description: Collect relics. Combine their powers. Forge magical weapons. Fight monsters from beyond the skies in a third-person medieval fantasy adventure. Survive the night, harvest Cosmic Crystals, and reclaim the King's castle from the creatures that fell from the comet cloud.

details.title: Sheep Tag 2
details.short_description: Your friends are sheep. You are the wolf. Hunt them down as they build ridiculous farm fortresses to keep you out. Sheep Tag 2 is a Free-To-Play chaotic team-based RTS that's easy to learn and brutal to master. Play solo with bots or battle multiplayer with up to 32 players. Build. Hunt. Survive.

details.title: Clonefall
details.short_description: A puzzle-platformer where your clones are part of the solution. Create clones to reach new places, block hazards, activate mechanisms, and manipulate physics to overcome each challenge.

details.title: Strashnovekovie
details.short_description: 2D action RPG. The game’s unique feature is that instead of the usual character leveling, at each level you’ll be joined by an ally with their own unique abilities. By using your allies’ abilities — you’ll be able to complete the game .

details.title: CATpitalist Cafe Simulator
details.short_description: Play as Humanoid CATS in this chaotic 4 player co-op simulator as you takeover the coastal city of Los Nyangeles in pursuit of becoming true CATpitalists while helping rebuild the city along the way (kinda).

details.title: Tell me Your Tale
details.short_description: Take on the role of an F.T.I.D. inspector and uncover who truly belongs in the tales. Question characters, examine documents and appearances, find contradictions, and compare every detail with official records. At the end of each inspection, decide who is Original, Impostor, or Aberration.

details.title: PixelWehr
details.short_description: Shoot down incoming missiles before they tear apart your pixel city, where every pixel can be destroyed. Draw your own buildings and missiles, arrange them into story acts with your own dialogue, and publish it all to the Workshop.

details.title: Tales of Tuscany
details.short_description: A choose-your-own-adventure RPG with fast-paced bullet hell battles! Play as a small chaotic sheep named Lambypoo, gaslight enemies into joining your party or defeat them for EXP as you save your cousins, rebuild your village, and BAAA loud enough to destroy everything in the overworld.

details.title: Northanda Chronicles
details.short_description: Master role-based deckbuilding in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Build your party around the RPG holy trinity, craft a shared deck with powerful synergies, and fight to save Northanda from the devouring Void.

details.title: Elta: Defy All Gods
details.short_description: Brawl your way out of corrupted worlds alongside your dragon-god companion in an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer blending free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration. Become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.

details.title: Foush
details.short_description: Foush is a minimalist puzzle game where you try to raise the water in every cup up to its line by dropping block-shaped animals into it, while keeping each of them happy. It offers a rich puzzle experience thanks to new animals added approximately every 8 levels.

details.title: Interzone
details.short_description: Branded a deserter, you are thrown into the Interzone, where survival is the only law. Technology dies here, orders fall from the sky in artillery-fired capsules, the last voice from outside. Face anomalies, radiation, contamination, the infected, rebels, and ruthless military forces.

details.title: Sinking Eternity
details.short_description: Sinking Eternity is a single-player underwater exploration RPG. Survive extreme depths, hide from dangerous sea creatures, and uncover the secrets of a civilization lost for millennia.

details.title: GAZAR
details.short_description: GAZAR is an intense vertical arcade space shooter: one prototype fighter, the Nova-X, against an unstoppable alien fleet. Battle through a 4-galaxy Story Mode or test your skills in the endless Infinity Mode with 5 difficulty levels and local and global leaderboards.

details.title: Martyr
details.short_description: Rise as a Martyr in a plague-scarred, heretical Europe. Surrounded by disease, pagan rites, and relentless foes, you will fall and rise again and again. Death is not the end. Relics await based on your holy or heretical choices, and rival factions will hunt you according to your actions.

details.title: DropCell
details.short_description: DropCell is a cascade puzzle where gravity keeps pulling. Clear a line and everything above falls into the gaps, forming new lines that clear and chain into long combos. 10 realms, each with its own look and sound.

details.title: Mini Sweeper
details.short_description: Mini Sweeper is a lightweight single and two player game for the Steam Deck and Steam Machine where you must find the bombs and clear the board.

details.title: Corrupted Dice
details.short_description: Roll your dice and choose where to play them to reach each round’s score target. In this roguelite, you can take on heat for extra points, but too much heat ends your run. Dice break when they run out of uses.

"Who do you want to save? Or rather... who are you prepared to abandon?" A midnight "Unsend" trapped them in a rift in time, and awakened the dead "You." Become a "Ghost" inhabiting screens and surveillance feeds. Pry into perfect disguises and rotting hearts.

details.title: Sushi Bar Manager
details.short_description: Run a conveyor-belt sushi shop in Japan. Buy fish, keep the plates moving, wash every dish and pay the bills each night. Hire staff, decorate, survive bad weather and clumsy customers, and see how many days your shop can last. 🍣🥢

details.title: Space Daram
details.short_description: Become a cute space chipmunk and manage your ship with companions as you explore alien planets, build and upgrade your base, and craft gear by generating power and refining resources. Meet unique alien species, grow your foothold in the universe, and play solo or with friends in multiplayer.

details.title: Mega Squad Survivors
details.short_description: Become Hua Tuo and lead 50 great officers of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as women, across 25 stages. Unlock new officers and art, master 200+ skills, and combine 35 Tales of Three Kingdoms lore with 5 formations to forge a peerless legion. The physician takes the field to heal a land at war!

details.title: 11 PM: A Minimalist Factory Game
details.short_description: A minimalist factory game that doesn't quite work the way you expect. Choose modules carefully, place them on your machines, and watch them drastically change how each machine produces. Build your own factory with its own rules. Optimizing it can become an obsession!

details.title: Texas Oil Baron
details.short_description: Build a Texas oil empire, from a single well to a field of pumpjacks. Steer your drill underground into hidden deposits, run the fleet and the books as prices swing, or grab the wheel and haul the oil yourself. Launches February 3, 2027.

details.title: Tidy Town
details.short_description: Tidy Town is a third person cleaning game where you combine everyday objects to tidy up messes and transform spaces. Help Percy lend a paw one room at a time as he saves a friend’s cafe, rebuilds a city park, refreshes an artist’s studio and tidies his way across town and into his community's heart.

details.title: Crystal Harvest: Apex Operator
details.short_description: Crack, mine, and sell mystical crystals while fighting alien hordes on various planets in this fast-paced incremental mining extraction roguelite hybrid experience. Earn currency to spend across upgrade categories with permanent progression and powerful builds in runs.

details.title: KILLSEC
details.short_description: Breach containment and carve your way out of a megacorp black site in this hardcore top-down shooter roguelite. Master your control of physics weapons to parry swords, bullets, lasers, everything. Time moves faster when you move, but staying still won't get you anywhere.

details.title: Flock Off!
details.short_description: Flock Off! is a first-person action-adventure game for 1–4 players. Team up with friends to survive a strange and woolly uprising in the remote Scottish Highlands. Improvise with oddball weapons to fend off mutant sheep and uncover unexpected twists. Will you survive the Sheepocalypse?

details.title: Goat's Odyssey
details.short_description: Just a goat. A boring peg. And a postcard that changed everything. Embark on a surreal journey in a shadow theatre style: from a village garden to lunar craters. Solve absurd puzzles, troll a rooster, and find out if the grass is truly greener on the other side of the universe.

details.title: Final Rites
details.short_description: After exorcists sent to a remote Spanish village go silent, the FINAL RITES unit is deployed. Investigate sites corrupted by failed rituals, explore hostile environments, fight the undead, and perform sacred rites to contain entities emerging from a breach beyond reality.

details.title: Shatterswarm
details.short_description: Command Captain Hope's ship in this strategic 2D space game. Build structures, deploy fleets, and manage resources to defend the Citadel against waves of enemies. Combine direct ship combat, tower defense, and base building as you face epic boss battles.

details.title: Grid Demon
details.short_description: Hack the swarm and build your army in this cyberpunk bullet-heaven roguelite. Turn enemy machines into allies, shape your build, and unleash a surge of power as you battle the Wardens across five hostile grids. Free the Grid, or claim it for yourself.

details.title: Idle Archery
details.short_description: Shoot targets, earn gold, hire more archers. An idle incremental game about turning one lone archer into a sky full of arrows.

details.title: How to Hunt
details.short_description: A 1-4 player physics based hunting simulator. You and your friends crash your boat while on vacation. You must survive till you find a way back home.

details.title: Ovis Mollis
details.short_description: A cozy pixel farm on your desktop — a whole village with fishing, a casino, and a stock exchange. Grass grows, sheep accumulate wool even while AFK. Shear, sell, pay your mortgage, collect skins from Mystery Box on Steam — and one day robots will do everything themselves.

details.title: Muramasa: Revenant Blades
details.short_description: Vanillaware x Marvelous present an action RPG for the ages. Hack and slash your way through a world of restless spirits and Demon Blades. The tales of six fabled protagonists of Japan's Genroku era, each with their own unique fighting style, are about to unfold.

name: The Sophisticated Art of Friendship: Tales of a Lost Friend

details.title: The Sophisticated Art of Friendship: Tales of a Lost Friend
details.short_description: The Sophisticated Art of Friendship: Tales of a Lost Friend Series is a narrtive video game for PC, Mac and Linux. It last about an hour and a half and it is not a traditional video game. We break the fourth wall to bring you this extraordinary story to life.

name: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe™: Dragon Pearl of Destruction

details.title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe™: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
details.short_description: Grab your sword. Eternia needs you. You have the power!

details.title: Griefborn
details.short_description: Destroy hordes of unholy creatures using firearms and magical abilities. Create your own build, upgrade your weapons, and unlock new levels!

details.title: METRO 2039
details.short_description: METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

details.title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
details.short_description: Experience a full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, featuring fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

details.title: Hamsteria
details.short_description: Hamsteria is a difficult 2-player co-op game where you play as two hamsters in attached wheels. Online co-op, local co-op, and single-player are all supported!

details.title: THE SIGNAL: Stranded on Sirenis
