details.short_description: Crash-landed on the alien world of Sirenis, you must survive, build a base and search for your missing brother. Gather, research and craft your way across a hostile planet of strange creatures, ancient ruins and a mystery far bigger than your crash.

details.title: Ashen Throne
details.short_description: A free-to-play, top-down action MMORPG. Play as a Warrior, Wizard or Taoist, explore dungeons and hunt bosses with friends. Find and craft equipment, develop your skills, and join your guild in battles for territory and Ashen Castle.

details.title: Don't Drain The Lake
details.short_description: Grandpa left you his cabin and one rule: whatever happens, don't drain the lake. A cozy first-person incremental: empty a mountain reservoir by bucket, pump and siphon, fish for the mill's cook, and watch the sun follow the water down while the valley gives back what it kept.

details.title: Ceasefire Line
details.short_description: An isometric RTS in a fictional war-torn coastal city. Command one of three asymmetric forces, build a base, and take the city block by block. Buildings collapse piece by piece with real physics, and every civilian caught between the lines is counted against you.

details.title: Farming Sweeper
details.short_description: Build, manage and grow your farm in a unique way: Solving puzzles with traditional minesweeper mechanics and managing your business finances in a relaxing game with great replay factor.

name: It Was Supposed to Be a Vacation!

details.title: It Was Supposed to Be a Vacation!
details.short_description: 说好只来旅游，怎么连每一顿饭、每一段闲聊都想留下？这是一款以成都旅行为主题的单机互动影像游戏。跟随镜头走进街头巷尾，在剧情节点选择出行方式、品尝当地美食、回应陌生人的热情，让日常小事成为旅途中的意外惊喜。你的选择会留下不同的旅行印记，影响日终手记与睡前故事的解锁。通过分支图回看另一种可能，在旅行记录中收藏照片与经历；也可以使用自动保存和已看内容快速回看，按自己的节奏体验这段旅程。写下属于你的成都记忆。

details.title: Sagas of Lumin
details.short_description: Sagas of Lumin is a single-player, semi-open-world action RPG. Master dragon riding as you soar across the skies, engage in thrilling aerial battles, and explore a vast world. Seamlessly switch to ground combat with swords, spells, and firearms. Find your path in this fallen realm.

name: Marble Saga - The Curse of the Sun Temple

details.title: Marble Saga - The Curse of the Sun Temple
details.short_description: Follow Amara into a cursed sun temple in this story-driven marble shooter. Pop the color chains before they reach the temple heart, and clear each level to unlock the next story beat.

details.title: Fancy Farm Brawl
details.short_description: Farm by day, fight by night! Fancy Farm Brawl blends top-down action combat, tower-defense challenges, light farming, and a quirky island adventure. Plant crops, earn coins, meet colorful residents, overcome obstacle courses, and unleash powerful attacks to defend your home on Qilin Island.

details.title: The Split Layer
details.short_description: Step into The Split Layer, psychological horror game set within a liminal world where familiar places no longer reveal the whole truth. Your only reliable tool is a tablet that uncovers another layer of reality.

details.title: Fables of the Kingdom Remastered
details.short_description: Help the brave hero Kevin restore a beautiful kingdom ruined by the evil sorcerer Balen and rescue the kidnapped princess! Clear roads, gather resources, construct buildings, and wield magic in this remastered, fast-paced time-management strategy game.

details.title: Rainfusor
details.short_description: COMBINE ELEMENTS into bizarre playstyles. Rip and devour segmented bugs in rooms in a side-scroller mayhem-physics rogue-arcade. No tiny stat boosts/platforming/permadeath. Instead, unlock extreme, double-edged characters, runes, spell combos and synergies to become whole again, through sacrifice

details.title: Soup's Tail
details.short_description: Find out what it means to be dead. Explore the mystery of the afterlife, meet new characters, pet the cat, find cards, and earn collectables in this single player, narrative-driven game. As the story unfolds, play cards with those you meet along the way.

details.title: Backrooms Anomaly: Pools
details.short_description: An anomaly-spotting horror game set in looping liminal poolrooms. Study your surroundings and identify changes ranging from subtle details to terrifying entities. Turn back if something has changed, continue if everything seems normal, and then use your camera to document the anomalies.

details.title: Aevalore 2
details.short_description: Fight through the world of Aevalore II, a fast action roguelike. Pick your hero, build your skills, defeat giant bosses, and survive alone or with friends in online co-op

details.title: Sign My Petition
details.short_description: Sign My Petition is a beat-’em-up adventure about a mouse trying to save their tribe from extermination. Explore bizarre neighboring apartments, fight off strange enemies and bosses, and meet oddball characters along the way.

details.title: Outward 2
details.short_description: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements, focusing around a grounded experience. There’s no hand-holding, no scaled encounters, no divine blessings to make you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: an unforgiving, rewarding adventure awaits.

details.title: マジカルラプチャー
details.short_description: A 2D fighting game featuring magical girls with comical moves! Unleash magic on your opponents using simple controls—no complex command inputs required. Manage your magic gauge as you battle, employing unique tactics to outplay your rivals!

details.title: Foul
details.short_description: Foul is an adventure survival game where an otherworldly fog mutated and turned all creatures hostile. Fight back, save your family and piece together the truth.

details.title: Lexiclue
details.short_description: Video game trivia crosswords. Items, NPCs, locations, mechanics, designers, and terms pulled out of hundreds of worlds; the vocabulary that comes with playing and lore. Built for gamers who notice the minutiae in their games.

details.title: An Unreasonable Number of Zombies
details.short_description: Push your luck in a city overrun by zombies. Every district is a different fight, with its own rules and its own way to lose. The longer a run goes, the more you can earn.... and the worse things get.

details.title: Pocket Adventurer
details.short_description: Your desktop's tiniest hero. A cozy idle RPG that lives above your taskbar: heroes delve dungeons and haul loot home while you work, companions fill your camp, and every retired legend makes the next hero stronger.

details.title: Deadball DX
details.short_description: DeadBall DX is a brick-breaking action roguelite where you battle robot rivals, upgrade your paddle and ball, combine items, and tackle trap-filled platforming challenges to blast your CPU opponents. If features high scores, tons of unlocks, and is a love-letter to the 90s PC hit: DX Ball.

details.title: Machikado Roastery
details.short_description: Roast coffee across Japan, right from your taskbar. Run a tiny corner roastery along the bottom of your screen: roast beans, stock the display case, hire staff, and move your shop from Tokyo’s backstreets to snowy Sapporo as the seasons turn.

details.title: increTower
details.short_description: A short incremental tower defense game. Upgrade your tower, upgrade your enemies, repeat!

details.title: Nijoaju
details.short_description: Two characters. One goal. Think as one. In Nijoaju, control a powerful stone creature and an agile water creature, combining their unique abilities to solve challenging puzzles, overcome obstacles, and prove that only by working together can you move forward.

details.title: Children of the Forest
details.short_description: Iki and Tika live deep within a mysterious forest. Follow their enchanting journey as they find themselves amidst an imminent new threat. Children of the Forest is a story-driven adventure game about two siblings venturing through a land filled with extraordinary remnants from an ancient past.

details.title: Just ONE more window
details.short_description: A cozy first-person incremental game about cleaning the windows of a skyscraper that just keeps going. Scrub the glass, earn a dollar, buy better gear and little robot helpers, and climb: past the pigeons, past the clouds, past where the air runs out. Solo or co-op with a friend.

details.title: Dunar: Dimension Two
details.short_description: A traditional turn-based JRPG featuring unique moments and a fascinating story centered around the forgotten past of the Purple Light, blending fantasy with inspirations from Himba culture and Indian aesthetics.

details.title: The Coven
details.short_description: Choose from five elemental witches in a single-player action roguelite. Explore a candlelit, 16-floor tower, shape your build with talents, gear and rune sets, and face familiar people turned into bosses. Time rewinds when you fall, but some growth and treasures endure.

details.title: Animals League Unite
details.short_description: Stack up, slap around and fall together. Up to 8 friends climb on each other to reach the key, in planes, minecarts and outer space. Your friends are the ladder, the bridge and the reason you fell. Play online, on one couch or both, then build levels to trap them again.

details.title: Encryptid
details.short_description: Encryptid is a short FMV horror game about hunting and catching cryptids. Use real-world footage recorded exclusively via the Gameboy Camera to identify, locate and capture iconic creatures of myth and folklore.

name: Japan Stigmatized Property4 -日本事故物件監視協会-

details.title: Japan Stigmatized Property4 -日本事故物件監視協会-
details.short_description: A night-shift notice from the Japan Stigmatized Property Association. Review surveillance footage from real properties in Japan, including the famous haunted attraction "Senritsu Meikyu" and the abandoned Niigata Russian Village, and report every anomaly. Two staff members may monitor together.
developers: 日本事故物件監視協会
publishers: 日本事故物件監視協会

details.title: Knightstones
details.short_description: Build your medieval Order in this atmospheric autobattler. Deploy your elite warriors on the war table, face off against the mighty Lords of the Inquisition, and invest your rewards to rebuild your fallen Order. Be prepared… or perish in the final battle.

details.title: Chesstris
details.short_description: Chess meets Tetris in a series of handcrafted puzzles. Drop chess pieces to checkmate rival kings while avoiding checkmating your own. Become a beloved champion or a despised victor, find true love or ruin friendships. In Chesstris, your choices in and out of puzzles shape your destiny!

details.title: Robot Vacuum Cleaner Quest
details.short_description: Robot Vacuum Cleaner Quest is an exploration adventure game. Reveal the house of Detectif Poirry as a robot vacuum cleaner, bump its inhabitants for stories, and clean your way to victory.

name: 豆カスちゃん ～豆知識とカスみたいな嘘をランダムに語る少女～

details.title: 豆カスちゃん ～豆知識とカスみたいな嘘をランダムに語る少女～
details.short_description: 意外な豆知識とカスみたいな嘘を見分けながら、謎の少女「豆カスちゃん」の秘密に近づいていくADV。

details.title: Sir, We Have 100 Million Rocks!
details.short_description: Start with a rusty spoon and crush your way through 100 million rocks! Mine, sell, upgrade, hire goblins, and unleash outrageous abilities in this first-person mining adventure. Play solo or with up to 8 players, topple giant golems, and dig toward the heart of the planet.

details.title: Let's Build a Dungeon
details.short_description: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

details.title: Spyder: Agent 8
details.short_description: Save the world as Agent 8, a robot spider superspy! Crawl across walls, ceilings, and floors, and use built-in gadgets to solve fun environmental puzzles in this brand-new, family-friendly adventure from the BAFTA Award-winning studio Sumo Digital.

details.title: Dreams of Suffering
details.short_description: A cinematic psychological horror game where you explore a haunting dream world, investigate mysterious environments, solve surreal puzzles, and face unknown entities. Experience a deeply atmospheric journey where sound, fear, and instinct guide you through the darkness.

details.title: Fleshinsane
details.short_description: Fleshinsane is a narrative-driven, top-down biopunk roguelike shooter set inside a living, decaying spaceship. Kill, die, upgrade, repeat. Will you survive long enough to escape the flesh?

details.title: Bouncy Balloonist
details.short_description: Bouncy Balloonist is a cute and colorful 2D Arena Platformer. You fly, pop balloons, and guard your own! In this endless arcade adventure, how high will you score?

details.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
details.short_description: Experience a stunning reimagining of Lara Croft’s debut adventure to discover the lost secrets of Atlantis with jaw-dropping visuals, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

details.title: GermShake
details.short_description: A pixel-art roguelike where you play a germ spreading through Shake City one handshake at a time. Mutate, dodge the immune system, and survive the sink.

details.title: Rome
details.short_description: The year is 27 BC, and you have become emperor and the absolute ruler of the Roman Empire. Fight in battles, engage in diplomacy and governance, and destroy all of Rome’s enemies. Or you can simply travel freely throughout the Mediterranean and marvel at the beauty of the ancient world.

details.title: THE GREEN HOOK FIGHTER
details.short_description: THE GREEN HOOK FIGHTER finally lands on Steam with intense battles, unique characters, and indie soul. Get ready for electrifying 3D fights in a universe full of style, personality, and urban legend inspiration.

details.title: System Status: SuperCritical
details.short_description: Defend your base by placing towers strategically, forming interconnected systems that depend on one another. Adapt your strategy to different environments and enemy waves, exploiting their weaknesses. In System Status: SuperCritical, resources are scarce and critical failure is always an option.

name: I WILL BE THERE: Remastered Edition

details.title: I WILL BE THERE: Remastered Edition
details.short_description: The definitive version of the beloved post-apocalyptic road trip. Fully remastered visuals, redesigned soundtrack, complete gamepad support. Tyler's journey begins again.

details.title: Shroud of Gloom
details.short_description: Shroud of Gloom is a point-and-click horror adventure. Investigate an old manor, gather items and clues to solve environmental puzzles and discover dark secrets. Can you uncover the mystery… and make it out alive?

details.title: Lucky Rabbit
details.short_description: GAMBLE to pay off your debts! Buy power ups (drugs) to increase profit and see how large your bankroll can get! Play Slots, Casino Classics, and more! Remember: Fortune favors the bold, go all in!

details.title: Inherited Shadows
details.short_description: Amanda, a young woman haunted by her mother's absence, travels to the remote mining town of Cinder Hollow in search of answers, unaware that a sinister legacy awaits her. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the mysteries surrounding her past.

details.title: Hunting Contract
details.short_description: A co-op horror game for 1–4 players about hunting monsters to meet a company's quota. Kill the beast, seal it in a coffin and drag it back to the truck—while your friends scream in proximity voice chat.

details.title: Grimmloch
details.short_description: A persistent text-based MMORPG where NPCs remember your secrets and shape a living world rooted in European folklore. Turn-based tactical combat, criminal gameplay, and collaborative storytelling that writes itself into canon. Built by Role-players for Role-players.

details.title: Voices from the Vase
details.short_description: Voices from the Vase is a story-driven psychological horror game about a young couple forced to take odd jobs to make ends meet. But some jobs come with a price far greater than money.

details.title: Space Combat Simulator
details.short_description: Fly as a fighter pilot of the Coalition carrier Defiance, pick your ship and weapons in the hangar and take apart enemy capital ships piece by piece. Two story campaigns with 30 missions, free battles, split-screen and LAN duels.

details.title: The Passion
details.short_description: Long for a sleep you never wake from.

details.title: TROUBLE SHOOTERS
details.short_description: Four WARDEN contractors against an alien incursion. A 2D roguelite run-and-gun: procedurally assembled zones, stacking gear that gets out of hand, and five bosses that fill the screen. Solo or 2-4 player co-op.

details.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX
details.short_description: A new semester begins as fan-favorite RPG card game Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 is reborn as Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX with modern visuals, enhanced Dueling, and nostalgic cards from the Yu-Gi-Oh! GX anime era.

details.title: Arcane Survivors
details.short_description: Write your own spells by joining a verb to a noun. ArcaneSurvivors is a horde-survival roguelite set in a library that is falling apart. Build from 1,008 combinations, gamble your sanity for stronger runes, and survive 20 minutes.

details.title: G.E.M. Grab & Exit
details.short_description: Hand-Drawn Twin-Stick Shooter in space where one must survive the robotic ships onslaught and extract with the loot to exchange for ship upgrades.

details.title: Orc Warchief: Strategy Story
details.short_description: Carve a war camp out of an ancient forest. Grab, drop and rally an unruly Horde with the Hand of the Warchief. Rescue goblins, claim forgotten sites and storm human castles. Every conquest brings new power and a Kingdom eager for revenge.

details.title: If you die, you die!
details.short_description: A one-life horror game inside the corpse of God. Photograph what lives in the dark. Die, and you can never play again.

details.title: Dark Roll 2
details.short_description: A physics-driven 3D precision platformer where you roll, bounce, dodge traps, snatch gems, and race against other players’ ghosts through a dark-fantasy gauntlet designed to make “one more try” a deeply questionable life choice.

details.title: Scrap Together
details.short_description: Scrap Together is a satisfying co op salvage yard sim. Pick through a mountain of scrap, blast away the rust to reveal what you've found, then melt it down or sell it on. Stack bars, fill pallets, buy bigger machines and automate the yard with cranes and belts until the heap is gone.

details.title: OutRune
details.short_description: A fast-paced, psychedelic room-clearing action game blending mystery and memory. Battle relentless enemies, discover and upgrade powerful items, and help Orillia survive long enough to uncover her past… and ESCAPE!

details.title: Simple Football League Manager
details.short_description: A football management game for people who love football but don't want to spend hours on every detail. Choose from 5,909 clubs, build your team, play in leagues and cups, and get insights from your assistant Rob. Includes 2 difficulty modes, local multiplayer and a customizable database.

details.title: Gohan Quest
details.short_description: Gohan Quest is a humorous adventure RPG that takes place in modern Eastern Europe. Play as anime girls, explore the typical russian town, beat the shit out of gopniks and find the missing "children"! Inspired by golden age JRPGs, from fans to fans.

details.title: Rebirth of Arcadia
details.short_description: Rebirth of Arcadia is a story-rich turn-based tactics JRPG. Experience the journey of two groups of people working together to escape from the Abyss. Explore, defeat monsters, and harness the power of runestones to uncover the secrets of the Abyss.

name: Climb using controls not designed for humans.

details.title: Climb using controls not designed for humans.
details.short_description: This is an action-climbing game with controls not designed for human beings. Can you handle them?

details.title: Count The Draw
details.short_description: Count The Draw is a time-loop western mystery where every decision, conversation, and discovery could change your chances of surviving the final duel. You have twelve hours. Explore the town, learn its secrets, and prepare for the man waiting for you at sunset.

details.title: Potions & Passions: Therapist for Monsters
details.short_description: Run a shady potion shop for dysfunctional monsters! Brew custom elixirs, manipulate toxic relationships, collect bizarre ingredients, and turn every monster's misery into profit.

details.title: Cloudpaws
details.short_description: CloudPaws is a cozy sky trading adventure where you sail an airship, trade goods, farm, fish, and explore floating islands while helping locals and uncovering their mystery✨

details.title: Among Us Story: On Guard
details.short_description: Live life as a Crewmate in this dangerous narrative adventure through space. As Guard, you're in charge of shipwide security and everything is fine. Until there's a MURDER?! Prove your innocence before the Impostor gets to the rest of the crew... and you.

details.title: Persona 4 Revival
details.short_description: Step into a Supernatural Turn-Based RPG Adventure Solve Mysteries, Strengthen Bonds, and Awaken Your Persona

details.title: Chimp!
details.short_description: A monkey dreams of owning his own hair salon. To make his dream come true, help him to collect gold. The gold is locked behind doors ... the keys are protected by whimsical and absurd animal enemies. Fight them with bananas, get the keys and steam the golden coins.

details.title: Paint Gang
details.short_description: Mix colors by eye, race across a giant canvas, and try not to step in the wet paint. Paint Gang is a chaotic online co-op game for 1–4 painters where every masterpiece becomes a team-made disaster.

details.title: SnorQ
details.short_description: SnorQ is a dark fantasy pixel art action roguelite. Explore levels generated in ever changing sequences. Collect crystals, unlock abilities, choose bonuses. Survive the monsters and face SnorQ, your own deformed self who wants to keep you in oblivion. Local coop for up to 2 players.

details.title: Mechanical Keyboard Building Simulator
details.short_description: Create and expand your own mechanical keyboard venture as you master the art of maintenance, repairs, and custom builds. With real-life components and realistic hardware, refine your skills, ignite your creativity, and craft a keyboard that truly resonates with you.

details.title: Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game
details.short_description: A surreal corporate horror deckbuilder where you gamble your life for cash, dodge murderous JERRY cards, and “maximise synergies” to climb the company ladder in Mr Magpie’s office nightmare.

details.title: Cleaning Raccrew
details.short_description: Bonk your friends and knock them away to become the proud owner of the coveted Golden Broom in Cleaning Raccrew! Cleaning Raccrew is a multiplayer game, both online and local, inspired in games like sumo, where you must knock your opponents out of an area to win, using wacky powerups!

details.title: Save To Kill
details.short_description: Save to Kill delivers a unique blend of bullet hell and resource management. Experience rewarding character progression with permanent upgrades with challenging Hardcore and Endless Modes. Featuring tons of unlockables.

details.title: RalphGame
details.short_description: A handcrafted action-comedy RPG packed with fresh mechanics and surprises. After your friends are mysteriously kidnapped at sea, it's up to you to bring them home.

name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow

details.title: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
details.short_description: The Road of Dust and Sorrow is a tense, story-driven pixel art horror inspired by ’90s classics. Survive a world gone wrong and protect what matters most: your daughter.

details.title: ReEvolution Project
details.short_description: A singleplayer story-driven horror game set in a desolate post-apocalyptic world. Explore a decaying abandoned house, scavenging for supplies and uncovering fragments of its story. Solve environmental puzzles that challenge your perception, and decide how deep you're willing to dig.

details.title: Raiders Of Below
details.short_description: Create absurd builds, discover powerful item synergies, discover secrets, challenge the dungeon alone or with up to 4 players.

details.title: Zodiac: Story of the Guardian
details.short_description: Explore a cavernous, retro pixel asteroid to save Earth from impending disaster!

details.title: Man in the Mocha
details.short_description: An active incremental game where you own a coffee shop, but your hidden agenda is to hack the customers who connect to your WiFi. Buy upgrades and grow your business!

details.title: Bytes and Knights - Adventure
details.short_description: Bytes and Knights is a full-scale TCG set within an RPG world, with deep strategy and unique mechanics. Explore the streets, collect cards, build your deck, and battle increasingly difficult opponents. Each new card brings you closer to uncovering what really lies hidden beneath the city.

details.title: Malkin Tower
details.short_description: Climb Malkin Tower, one floor at a time, in a cozy cat-filled idle adventure. Every floor brings new mechanics, upgrades, and surprises.

details.title: Corrupted Wings
details.short_description: Pilot a spaceship through a dark alien world in this third-person flying roguelite shooter. Tear through monstrous enemies, combine powerful MODs and items, and take down evolving bosses. Keep moving as pollution drives each region into a frenzy—and build the firepower to break through.

details.title: SeedGod
details.short_description: In SeedGod, your mission is to strategically plant in a field full of bugs. Choose the best positions, and you can discover unique plants, capture bugs, find tools, and access areas that will challenge your survival tactics.

details.title: Necromania
details.short_description: A top-down roguelite with souls-like combat, set in a monster-infested Victorian mansion. Play as members of the necromantic Greville family. Master stamina-based attacks and perfectly timed dodges. Explore ever-changing rooms filled with strange treasures, deadly enemies, and unique weapons.

details.title: Fable
details.short_description: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

details.title: Orbit Anglerz
details.short_description: Slingshot your lure through gravity wells to catch fish that evolve — on a night archipelago where the science program is closing in on what's wrong with the water.

details.title: Celestial Pawnshop
details.short_description: You run an ancient cultivation-world pawnshop trapped in a time loop. Read customers, appraise goods, haggle, and expose fakes. Each life you remember more: which pill is fake, which customer dies on the seventh day, and who locked the shop in the loop.

details.title: Steam Colony
details.short_description: Build a steampunk colony, put robots to work and connect a growing network of steam-powered machines. Mine resources, research new technology and defend your Steam Core when night falls. Play solo or join friends in online co-op.

name: デモンキルデモン ～黄泉１９８４～

details.title: デモンキルデモン ～黄泉１９８４～
details.short_description: Form your team with character creation. Gather and upgrade equipment, and challenge the otherworldly realm of Yomi. Explore, fight, collect, and train over and over in this dystopian dungeon RPG.

details.title: HardLuck
details.short_description: A 100-player turn-based Battle Royale where dice decide your fate. Roll, move across a shrinking grid arena, grab weapons and gear, aim & fire all in simultaneous timed turns. Outsmart, out-position & outlast 99 rivals. Just sharp Strategy with Lucky rolls. "Fight your enemies, Fight your HardLuck"

name: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories

details.title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
details.short_description: Atelier Karia tells the story of an adventurer with no memories as she faces her past. New features add to the depth of battles and alchemy. Synthesized items take on new roles during exploration, and ingredients can be eaten to gain effects.

details.title: Gray Planet
details.short_description: Explore a open world set in a post-apocalyptic background, gather resources to craft various equipment and build your base. Defeat different types of monsters while investigating what happened on this planet.

details.title: Sky Safari: FPV Drone
details.short_description: Take to the skies with a high-speed FPV drone and become a wildlife photographer. Track lions, bears, crocodiles and more across a breathtaking open world, master realistic flight physics and capture the perfect shot – without scaring them away.

details.title: Ball-Aqua
details.short_description: A speedy physics ball platformer inspired by Sonic Adventure and Ballance. Spin Dash, grind rails, and roll through a sunny Frutiger Aero world, solo or in online co-op. Free demo available now.

details.title: Soft 17
details.short_description: A blackjack roguelite, then a poker one. Every winning hand scores chips × MULT, and your items push the MULT higher. Beat four casinos, furnish your cellar, then cheat at the tables of four poker houses under the dealers' eyes. Solo, or up to four players online.

details.title: Titanic
details.short_description: A simulator of the operation of the most famous ship Titanic. Become the owner and captain of the Titanic, sail around the world! Carry passengers and cargo, make money and prosper!

details.title: Gnomebody Told You To Climb
details.short_description: Climb with a fire axe. Sit in a watering can. Try to look like this was your plan.

details.title: SANKAN
details.short_description: Kill the customer the voice in your head names. Clean up the blood and bury the body before dawn. Or refuse the voice, and it starts hunting you. A story-driven co-op horror for 1-3 players: the night shift at a mountain gas station, Japan, 1999.

details.title: Point In Time
details.short_description: Use time travel to cooperate with your past self and conquer seemingly impossible puzzles. Can you craft the perfect timeline without altering history? Design your own escape.

details.title: Sengoku Fields of Empire 2
details.short_description: ⛩️ Sengoku Fields of Empire 2 You ride out from a Tokugawa castle. Behind you lies the province you are responsible for. Ahead begins the territory of another Daimyō.

details.title: Wrath
details.short_description: As a soul who wakes up stuck in hell, you must kill the 7 Deadly Sins to escape! In this melee third person boss rush game you will have to collect upgrades to stand a chance at defeating the devils who keep you trapped, let alone the one who trapped you here in the first place...

details.title: ARIA - Origin Paradox
details.short_description: Explore a ruined future with Aria, an android learning what it means to feel. A sci-fi dungeon RPG and narrative adventure combining first-person, grid-based exploration with turn-based battles. Direct Aria in combat and uncover the records of a lost world.

details.title: CRT TD
details.short_description: Use your retro gadget weapons to defend against the mutated tech bros. On your turn, position your gadget weapons, prepare your defensive gadgets and grow your economy. Test your strategy and your build against encounters in procedurally generated levels.

details.title: Tears of Sulfuria
details.short_description: Tears of Sulfuria is an emotional visual novel about two sisters in a dark fantasy world that rejects them. Marília and Adka must survive at any cost—and their choices may scar Sulfuria itself. Sacrifice yourself, lose your sanity, and do the unforgivable to move forward.

details.title: Tennis & Padel Shop Simulator
details.short_description: In Tennis & Padel Shop Simulator, run your own racket store! Stock shelves, string rackets, serve customers at the till and haggle over bulk deals. Keep the court in shape so club players book it by the hour, and grow a small shop into the town's favourite racket club. Enjoy padel and tennis!

details.title: STUCK
details.short_description: Shake, kick, and upgrade a stubborn vending machine in this first-person incremental game. Collect coins, sell unexpected objects, and build increasingly ridiculous machinery to recover the one bag of chips you paid for.

name: Blossoming Yandere 満開 ヤンデレ

details.title: Blossoming Yandere 満開 ヤンデレ
details.short_description: A girl was sleeping in the garbage outside of Kazuki's apartment, until he decided to take her in. Now a home for two, he must remember that all actions have consequences, and words can be laced with poison. But you know that all too well, don't you?

details.title: Little Girls Escapeventures
details.short_description: The girls face some slightly dangerous and perilous situations. Use your wits to overcome them. But it won't be easy, you know? Now, witness the fate of these slightly retro girls with your own hands.

details.title: Cumin
details.short_description: Run a convenience store inside a train station in this hands-on, first-person management game. Order stock, fill the shelves and serve customers at the register. Experiment with your product range and prices to grow your profits.

details.title: BOC: Birth of Cultures
details.short_description: The 4X where you shape 50,000 years of human history across planet-scale worlds.

details.title: WiccAtriX
details.short_description: Wiccatrix is a story driven ARPG with a spellcrafting system that allows the player to create custom spells to use in combat and to solve puzzles. Your goal is to explore the lands of Terra and help restore the elemental order back to harmony.

details.title: Randomly Jerk Simulator
details.short_description: "Randomly Jerk Simulator" is a roguelite simulation game that uses a slot machine to simulate the parasitic behavior of a jerk who relies on his parents. This game does not contain any gambling behavior or cash transactions.

details.title: tower sequence KNIGHT LOBSTER
details.short_description: YOU WILL LOSE EVERYTHING. YOU WILL GAIN EVERYTHING. THIS WORLD WILL REACH PEACE, AT ANY COST. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. THIS WORLD WILL REACH PEACE, AT ANY COST. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. THIS WORLD WILL REACH PEACE, AT ANY COST. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP.

details.title: Delusional
details.short_description: Delusional is a chaotic top-down roguelike shooter where you battle absurd enemies with hundreds of ridiculous weapons, all in a desperate bid to defeat the eccentric artiste who created you.

details.title: Dimension L
details.short_description: Dimension L is an online turn-based strategy RPG set in a world where dinosaurs have evolved, mastering elemental powers. Join the Duty Cup, a tournament where the mightiest L warriors earn the honor of fighting to save their homeland.

details.title: From Basement with Love
details.short_description: Conduct a high-stakes espionage operation at the height of the Cold War. Intercept and decipher classified intelligence to uncover a hidden threat. Break codes, cover your tracks, and escape before it’s too late.

details.title: Vertigo Enigma
details.short_description: Congratulations! You have been chosen for Vertigo Enigma. A narrative puzzle experiment where your logic and observation are the test. Until it glitches. Until you understand what "chosen" means...

details.title: Sculptor
details.short_description: Create and paint statues of beautiful women, improve your skills and follow the kinetic novel of a sculptor who fell in love with his creation. The game is inspired by the Greek myth of Pygmalion.

details.title: Hoard's LLC: Limited Labyrinth Corporation
details.short_description: Rotate, slide, and explode your way through more than 60 levels of corporate labyrinths in this story-rich puzzler! Find a path for Barry to meet with all his monstrous coworkers and learn about their struggles. Defeat the evils of poor management with the power of unionization!

details.title: Aftershock
details.short_description: When your own mind becomes the enemy, can you protect the one who matters most?

details.title: Wild Island
details.short_description: You are stranded on a mysterious island, trying to escape. A sandbox where you stack items, craft synergies, and turn simple weapons into pure power. Experiment with runes, accessories, and pets. Discover the island’s mysteries and rebuild your sanctuary to uncover what the island truly wants.

details.title: Throw A Life!
details.short_description: "Throw A Life!" is a chaotic party survival game for up to four players! Work together to mine, craft, build, and hunt on a dangerous island. Divide roles to survive efficiently—or embrace the chaos and have fun with friends!

details.title: SHEEP
details.short_description: SHEEP is a surreal first-person action-adventure. When an eclipse darkens the farm, you set out with your flock and a ghost sheep named Woolsworth. Beyond the pastures, living crystals rise from fallen stones, while a celestial entity lies in waiting.

details.title: Missing body
details.short_description: One body, 6 parts. Find them all! Missing body is a team-based multiplayer horror game where investigators recover a victim's remains while the murderers hunt them down. Proximity chat, unique abilities, and murderers in the dark.

details.title: Swifty
details.short_description: A fast-paced 2D platformer where speed, precision, and perfect timing are key. Dodge traps, master challenging levels, and become the ultimate "Swifty".

details.title: Spellburst!
details.short_description: Spellburst is a co-op action game of elemental magic. Cast from six schools, chain spells into devastating combos and fight corrupted creatures through procedurally generated dungeons with up to four players. Beat the boss, then extract alive.

details.title: Dungeons and Tiles
details.short_description: An Action Role-Playing dungeon crawler, with randomly generated dungeons and challenging bosses to defeat for loot and glory.

details.title: Vowless Blade: A Fleeting Hope
details.short_description: A wuxia roguelike deckbuilder with loot and extraction. Turn martial arts into card tactics: strikes beat feints, feints beat guards, and guards beat strikes. Outsmart your foes, refine your deck, and steadily build a powerful band of heroes. Victory rewards strategy, not reflexes!

details.title: TrackShot
details.short_description: TrackShot is a fast-paced tank PvP game where doing tricks earns you ammo. Grind rails, perform some flips, and land clean to load your shells, then fire them at your mates. Battle it out across a bunch of arenas and modes as you compete for air superiority.

details.title: Dwarf Boozter
details.short_description: Return Dwarven ale legacy Brawler-action with roguelite elements about Dwarf adventures through fantasy taverns. Loot, fight and upgrade.

details.title: Chaos The Devil
details.short_description: Ps1 era inspired 3D platformer. Run, jump and fly your way through a new adventure, done the old way. A multi-year solo passion project, handcrafted from scratch.

details.title: Analog - MIRROR
details.short_description: An unopened 90s shooter game offers an unexpected distraction during a quiet weekend at home. What seems like a harmless way to pass the time may lead to consequences you never expected.

details.title: PROTOCOL: Zero-day
details.short_description: Dive into a brutal isometric Action-Roguelite set in a cyber-apocalyptic world. Master fast-paced Hack'n'Slash combat during intense 5-to-8-minute incursions. Face infected hordes, optimize your build, and break the loop. Death is part of the protocol.

details.title: Turbo Loop
details.short_description: Turbo Loop is a casual slot car racing game focused on simple, fun gameplay - easy to learn, but hard to master. Challenge AI opponents or race a friend in head-to-head matches, unlock and customize cars, compete across dozens of tournament tracks, or create your own with the track editor!

details.title: Trenchblocks
details.short_description: Dig, build, and destroy in a cute yet violent voxel shooter! Battle in Capture the Flag where you construct forts, dig trenches, or tunnel under enemy bases with full voxel destruction.

details.title: Runan Ritual
details.short_description: In Runan Ritual, you step into the boots of Vitz, a warrior caught in the crossfire of a planetary invasion. After a devastating encounter with the Runan, Vitz is left changed no longer fully human, but not quite one of them. Fight back against the shadows!.

details.title: Pluffy Nightmare
details.short_description: Blast through a surreal nightmare in this fast-paced roguelike FPS with funny weapons! In Pluffy Nightmare, your mind is dragged into a doll´s body to battle possessed plushies, dolls, and toys in bizarre fantasy worlds.

details.title: Haramball
details.short_description: Haramball is a multiplayer football tactics card strategy game where you pick the players, merge their attributes, set up the best formations and then watch your tactics unfold in real-time. Will you play beautiful football or become the football terrorist you were always meant to be ? You decide.

details.title: Miracle Mage: Awakened Elements
details.short_description: "Awakened Elements" is a match-three strategy RPG where chaos spreads as the Demon King shatters elemental balance. As a young mage, awaken lost powers, rally elven allies, and battle through thorny paths to restore order before darkness consumes the world.

details.title: WIZARDS NEVER LIE
details.short_description: Four chairs, four wizards, one rule: wizards never lie. A 4-player online social deduction game with your face live on camera above your chair. Bluff through Revolvers, Hidden Figures, Cards and Poison, spend your Checks wisely and catch the liars at the table.

details.title: Echophobia
details.short_description: Echophobia is a multiplayer game where sound is your only vision. A blind Hunter hunts through sound and microphone detection, while Runners navigate complete darkness to complete objectives and escape before being caught.

details.title: Long Way Gnome
details.short_description: Grab up to 3 friends for a chaotic co-op kart road trip home! Drift through hordes of monsters, scavenge powerful items, and tow fallen friends back to safety. Can you survive the journey together?

details.title: Contract Cleaner
details.short_description: Contract Cleaner is a 2D pixel-art top-down cleaning simulator. Take on nightly contracts as Hank Bucket, clean messy locations, upgrade your tools, and build your cleaning business.

details.title: AstroDiner Manager
details.short_description: Become a manager for your own diner on a lonely asteroid. Order snacks and drinks, cook dishes, and serve them to quirky alien slimes. Talk, hire, investigate, and keep an eye on the visitors to reveal the hidden mystery behind this place.

details.title: These Roads are Terminal
details.short_description: Step into the shoes of a wage-slave and work the graveyard delivery shift at Vito's! It's not glamorous, but it pays rent. Leave the safety of your car and step into the streets of a decaying suburbia. Deliver to peculiar customers while trying to ignore that feeling of being watched...

details.title: Void Eaters
details.short_description: Play as a powerful mage shaping an army of mythical creatures in this semi-idle incremental game. Destroy enemies and gather resources by casting spells or simply watch your army at work. Explore, upgrade, craft, and customize your forces to fit your strategy.

name: Sexy Chicken Girl Kisses Rotten Rabbit Man

details.title: Sexy Chicken Girl Kisses Rotten Rabbit Man
details.short_description: Win over a hot girl in a silly point-and-click parody game! Explore her bedroom, solve clever puzzles, survive chaotic minigames, and discover unique relationship-based endings, from wholesome romance to ~youre in control~. A unofficial silly game made for the FNAF community, it's up to you.

details.title: GTJ: Grand Theft Japan
details.short_description: Become an untouchable U.S. military soldier in Japan! Combine the wild, chaotic humor of Goat Simulator with the lawless street action of Saints Row. Smash rogue ninjas, unleash chaos, and turn the city into your ultimate playground!

details.title: Ghost Hunter
details.short_description: Ghost Hunter is a co-op horror escape game for 1–4 players. As the owner of a supernatural agency, you accept ghost-related cases and carry out cleansings. You’ll need to choose your gear wisely, and you can tackle the cases solo or team up with others to survive and succeed.

details.title: Static Line
details.short_description: Take control of an airborne mecha and fight your way home in a side-view action roguelite. Break through enemy lines, defend key positions, and turn the tide alongside allied forces—then rebuild your machine with interchangeable parts, weapons, and movement styles.

details.title: World of Slime
details.short_description: World of Slime is a casual MMORPG where you capture, collect, and grow with all kinds of slimes. Find new slimes through field capture, synthesis, and fishing, then take them with you into battles, exploration, and puzzles.

details.title: Grilluminati
details.short_description: Start a cult with friends and summon one of three rivalling gods. Sacrifice customers, perform dark rituals and work together to bring an ancient evil being into the world, all under the cover of a steakhouse.

details.title: Demi and the Fractured Dream
details.short_description: In this action adventure, play as Demi and venture through the wondrous world of Somnus. Tasked by a mysterious voice, you must destroy the legendary Accursed Beasts to save the world. Use your attacks and abilities to slay enemies, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind an ancient history.

details.title: Bramble Bay
details.short_description: A cozy mail delivery adventure where you explore a quiet town, gather clues from its people, and deliver letters to their intended recipients.

details.title: A Court of Seven Crowns
details.short_description: Navigate a web of intrigue and assassination to make peace among warring fae! The fate of their realms and yours is in your hands! A text-based interactive novel.

details.title: Odds Chronicles
details.short_description: Defy impossible odds in a tactical roguelite RPG where every dice roll shapes your fate. Master grid-based battles, forge powerful builds, and uncover a world inspired by tabletop adventures.

details.title: Golden Retriever Simple Life
details.short_description: A cozy pet simulation game starring a REAL dog! Share your days with Pichu, an adorable real-life Golden Retriever. Discover new walk locations, train, and play together as your bond grows stronger every day.

details.title: Kaori
details.short_description: Kaori is a first-person puzzle and adventure game. Explore ancient ruins on a sun-drenched archipelago and uncover the many mysteries of a lost civilization.

details.title: Task Force Barbro
details.short_description: Task Force Barbro is real-time tactical infiltration in an alternate Cold War Sweden. Build the ultimate Stay-Behind unit, and take up the fight against occupiers and traitors. Guns, stealth or subversion.. the choice is yours!

details.title: Captain Capy - Roguelike Space Crafter
details.short_description: Blast through a cosmic junkyard as an intrepid capybara astronaut in this cozy yet action-packed 2D space shooter roguelike. Salvage scrap, craft upgrades, and outsmart a rogue AI amid the stars.

details.title: Strange Finds
details.short_description: Discover the ancient Archipelago as the director of the archaeological excavation of the century. Dig up ruins, restore your finds, and answer research questions to piece together the timeline of a lost civilization.

details.title: Screams Echo
details.short_description: Screams Echo is a dark top-down action roguelike where you must fight through hordes of mutants in a procedurally generated underground complex. Find powerful items that can completely change the course of a run, combine them with weapons and hero abilities, and build insane synergies that turn desperate survival into total chaos.

details.title: Isekai HKV
details.short_description: Enter another world with a VTuber ally. Move, dodge, collect magic and items, and survive the monster waves. Your VTuber ally can protect, break you out, revive you, and change how each fight plays.

details.title: Midnight Video Store
details.short_description: Midnight Video Store is an idle game where you play as Jeff, the sole employee of a retro video store. One night, the video store is attacked by a horde of monsters. Make Jeff more powerful with the help of a gigantic and monstrous talent tree !

details.title: Echoes Below
details.short_description: Descend into the depths of the ocean and explore an underwater world alongside a mysterious octopus. Together, you will discover marine creatures and uncover the mysteries that await at the bottom of the sea…

details.title: A Taste of Heat
details.short_description: In your restaurant kitchen, will love simmer, or will lust boil over? Sharpen your ambition, create decadent recipes, and light the flames of passion. A text-based interactive romance novel, 500,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

details.title: Idle Mining Manager
details.short_description: An idle asteroid mining management simulator. Earn credits and advance through corporate tiers to expand your range of mining tools, policy upgrades and resource efficiency. Unlock the history of interstellar mining since the NofVS and, with a little help, uncover the truth behind the propaganda.

details.title: Tight Tactics
details.short_description: Be ready for turn-based combat in this roguelite to kick off with the enemy opening fire on you first, trying to keep you from regrouping, and one bad decision leading to the death of your entire upgraded squad

details.title: LOTTERY
details.short_description: The only game in the world to bring the joy of tactical FPS games into the single-player experience. Fight the entire world with superpowers gifted to you by sheer luck as you wipe out thousands of the world's most elite defenses while they try predicting, learning, and adapting to your every move.

details.title: Ikigai - Party Game
details.short_description: Grab, shove and flail your way through a gauntlet of physics-driven party games. Up to 8 players, wobbly ragdoll limbs and a fresh minigame every round — sumo showdowns, chaotic football and frantic fishing, wrapped in Japanese folk charm.

details.title: Necromancer´s Ruins
details.short_description: A hand-painted 2D roguelike platformer about treasure hunting, magic, and dangerous ruins. Fight monsters, collect upgrades, and try to go further each run.

details.title: BLACKROT
details.short_description: BLACKROT is a fast-paced top-down action game of brutal dashes, parried bullets and random generated levels. Time only runs when you move. Dash through enemies, keep your combo going and paint the walls red.

details.title: DuskLand
details.short_description: Poker Roguelike RPG. DuskLand is a unique roguelike RPG where you deal heavy damage using poker hands and optimize character-specific inventories. Discover explosive synergies, find the best layout, and unleash powerful combos!

details.title: TRACE
details.short_description: TRACE is a rhythm game combining arcade-style elements with the precision and competitiveness of PC rhythm games. Follow the music and experience the full energy of an arcade in the comfort of your own home!

details.title: One Man Guerrilla
details.short_description: One Man Guerrilla is a stealth action game where you play as Bento, a rebel agent fighting a brutal dictatorship. Infiltrate diverse Brazilian cities on deadly missions where being seen means practically death, and face powerful bosses that will push your skills to the limit.

name: Crunch Time VTuber: One Week ‘til Deadline

details.title: Crunch Time VTuber: One Week ‘til Deadline
details.short_description: “Never do today what you can put off till tomorrow!” VTubers who live by that creed have their backs against the wall, and today they plunge into scheduling hell once again. Allocate your resources wisely and survive the one week until the deadline. A last-minute, task-crunching roguelite!

details.title: Don't Get Attracted
details.short_description: Shoot magnets, not bullets. Magnetise anything - crates, girders, the friend next to you - then watch matching poles blast apart and opposites slam together. An 8-player online party platformer about climbing one enormous tower, right up until somebody decides you'd look better falling off it.

details.title: NO FISHING!
details.short_description: An incremental autobattler about fishing where you're not allowed to fish. Sell your catch, upgrade your boat, and destroy the navy before they take you down.

details.title: Per My Last Email
details.short_description: You are the new hire. The account you inherited is not new — it belonged to E. Vale, who is no longer with the company. Ten business days of email in which you choose what you say, then choose who sees it. The routing is permanent. Someone is still reading.

details.title: Daughter of Dawn
details.short_description: Only you can shape her destiny. Raise and guide the last princess of a fallen kingdom. Through friendship, love, growth, and loss, your choices determine her future. An emotional life simulation RPG with dozens of endings.

details.title: LOVE D3ATH LOVE
details.short_description: In 2222, your AI secretly sends over 3,000 job applications worldwide without you knowing. Soon after, three powerful women appear, each insisting you belong with her. You’re thrown into a growing crisis, their ambitions colliding endlessly. What do they actually want from you?

details.title: Spill The Ink
details.short_description: Draw one continuous line, then watch gravity turn your ink into the solution. Guide the paper ball through handcrafted chambers, chase three-star clears, and build, test, and share your own puzzles.

details.title: Dream Cola
details.short_description: A short PSX-style horror game featuring light scares, humor, and a mysterious story. Supports Arabic and English And no Music In This Game

details.title: DEEP RESET
details.short_description: Dig through destructible terrain and defeat enemies in this top-down 2D looter shooter. Craft your own build and venture ever deeper.

details.title: OxyDungeon
details.short_description: You wake up in a bizarre pop-art world, armed with a baseball bat and only four buttons: Up, Down, Left, and Right. Input dance-game-style arrow combos to create items, then smash and launch them with your bat to obliterate enemies and survive the chaos!

details.title: High Typer
details.short_description: High Typer is an intense typing roguelike where every keystroke, word, and mistake feeds a physics-based scoring system. Build your run, improve your flow, and chase better results through sharper, faster typing.

details.title: God of Stock
details.short_description: God of Stock is deck-building roguelike. You play as a trader, use god-blessed cards to trade stocks, manipulate prices, and make money in a chaotic market. Build a unique deck, collect powerful artifacts and treasures, and eventually become the God of Stock.

details.title: Daemon Doors
details.short_description: Defeat all Daemon Guardians through the Doors of the Daemon Server. Your only job is to choose the best Doors. Use inventory management and risk taking choices to enhance your buffs and prevent a Weak late game.

details.title: INROOMS
details.short_description: A cooperative psychological horror experience up to four players where you and your friends must survive the deepest, most distorted liminal spaces of the Inrooms, the deepest levels of the Backrooms.

details.title: Reforge Eden: Overlord
details.short_description: An open-world game blending RTS and RPG elements, set in a medieval fantasy and steampunk world. Train armies, recruit diverse races, explore dungeons, build a kingdom from nothing, develop cities and industry, manage population and professions, and construct wonders and devastating superweapons.

details.title: Alia Domus
details.short_description: Explore and colonize an unknown planet in this pixel art survival RPG. Collect resources, complete quests, and craft technologies from different eras of humanity to turn Alia Domus into a home. Start with basic survival and reach civilizational splendor.

details.title: Blackbeam
details.short_description: BLACKBEAM is a light top-down sci-fi action adventure. Drive a rover, smash crystals, battle alien wildlife, expand your base, and venture ever farther. Explore more freely by day. At night, darkness, energy demands, and hostile creatures raise the stakes.

details.title: Listening Post: Typing Tower Defense
details.short_description: Master English listening with the ultimate dictation challenge! This real-time tower defense game lets you build and upgrade defenses by typing what you hear. Use 12 tower branches and the Fever system to sharpen your intuition. The faster you listen and type, the stronger your defense!

details.title: Giusto
details.short_description: Bidding for tricks in the forest. Be perfect, or be punished. Giusto is a tabletop, turn-based, strategy card game that rewards how well a player can predict the outcome of their hand BEFORE each round starts. Players are scored based on the accuracy of their pre-game predictions. Low score wins.

details.title: THE BUTCHER WARD
details.short_description: Your night shift was supposed to be simple: restore power to an abandoned hospital. Repair electrical systems, explore the darkened wards, and survive the monstrous butcher stalking its halls.

details.title: No Truce With The Groceries
details.short_description: Can you shop for groceries? In 🗽America🗽? In this economy? No Truce With The Groceries is a Disco-lite narrative point-and-click adventure that seeks answers to these questions and more.

details.title: Idle Commander
details.short_description: Build your own path in Idle Commander. Discover powerful gear, experiment with wild builds, and reshape your strategy with every drop.

details.title: Ant
details.short_description: Build a living ant colony that can stay on your desktop while you work. Hatch unusual ants, place nest and food rooms, collect coins, and expand from a glass habitat into drawers, pipes, walls, roots, and the forgotten depths below.

details.title: The Needle
details.short_description: The Needle is a SciFi RPG roguelike game like nothing you've ever seen. In the tradition of FTL, Crying Suns, and others, it's a deep and immersive space combat sim, with the presentation of a movie....... That you can talk to. Fight your way to the alien homeworld, by speaking aloud.

details.title: Athletics 99
details.short_description: Run! Jump! Throw! Compete in the Athletics World Cup through 18 different events, and represent your country against worldwide athletes. Who knows, you might even break some World Records...

details.title: Ante Inferno
details.short_description: The poker RPG. ANTE INFERNO is a roguelite card battler where you play poker hands as attacks, tear through hell with forty class abilities, and stack boons until the damage counter gives up on digits.

details.title: CRADLE PLANT: First Year Operations
details.short_description: Run a childcare plant where babies spend their first year in automated care. Build conveyor networks for feeding, sleep, hygiene, and play. As babies grow, their needs change. Keep your factory efficient while adapting to each child's unique reactions.

details.title: Hive Xenotype
details.short_description: Take command of the last remaining posthumans. Adapt to a harsh and forgotten planet, but keep the local ecosystem in balance — otherwise the last of humanity is doomed. Will you assimilate this world, or lead your people to extinction?

details.title: 萌塔物语
details.short_description: Monster girls are adorable—collect them all! Defeat monsters, possess their bodies, or capture them for your Body Vault. Switch forms to conquer the tower, then fuse, evolve, and teach skills to grow stronger bodies. Hunt rare, mutated, and prismatic variants. Start with a tower. Take every body!

details.title: MUTINY!
details.short_description: MUTINY! is a multiplayer platformer fighter game that allows up to 10 players per round! Using different kinds of bombs and the power of physics, ensure your victory as the last man standing on pirate ships, treacherous waters, and other dynamic maps that aren't exactly on your side either.

details.title: Exchange Alley
details.short_description: Trade shares, spread rumours, exploit bubbles and chase your fortune in the chaotic coffee houses of 18th-century London, birthplace of the modern stock market.

details.title: The Alleyway
details.short_description: Trapped within in a looping British alleyway, you must complete disturbing tasks for a demonic rubbish bin while surviving murderous children's TV puppets known as, Huggles and Friends. A surreal and macabre first-person horror based on the Seven Deadly Sins. Welcome to the Eternal Darkness.

details.title: Dragonaute
details.short_description: A fantasy flight action game where you are the dragon. Launch from cliffs, dive between hundreds of floating islands, race your ghost for Steam leaderboard records and set entire fleets ablaze with your fire breath, solo or with up to four players in online co-op.

details.title: Magehold Wanderlight
details.short_description: A black storm of living ink is swallowing the world. Gather a small crew, build a cozy house on giant legs, and walk ahead of it. Harvest, trade and grow your walker by day, defend it by lamplight at night, until you are strong enough to turn around and face the storm.

details.title: Guide to Dating Monsters
details.short_description: What happens when a fantasy world enters the modern era? Monsters & humans hook up! Guide to Dating Monsters is a highly interactive RPG-styled dating sim. Smooch cuddly and/or murderous foes!

details.title: DOMAIN RUSH - MONSTERS, DICE & DOMAINS
details.short_description: Roll. Claim. Mutate. Ruin friendships. A high-stakes 30-minute clash of territory control and roguelike card fusion on a tight 14-tile board. Built for intense human rivalry—hop onto Steam Remote Play Together, unleash game-breaking monstrosities, and bankrupt your best friends!

details.title: Cat Tower Desktop
details.short_description: Make room for cats on your desktop. Meet different cats, decorate their rooms, and expand your home for up to eight at once. Pet them, play together, and keep photos and diaries of your days together in this cozy pixel-art desktop game.

details.title: Finistry
details.short_description: Build a living aquarium in a world changed by a mysterious pandemic. Breed fish, discover species, manage water quality, fulfil research orders, and respond to unexpected events in this relaxing aquarium management game.

details.title: Reach The Beat 2
details.short_description: Take target constellations apart to the beat. Shoot through rock and electronic tracks in reactive arenas — from concert lights to an alien nightscape and the ocean depths. Play on a monitor, in PC VR or in 3D SBS.

name: 未春节 Festival of Unborn Spring

details.title: 未春节 Festival of Unborn Spring
details.short_description: In Kunming, Yunnan, during her first winter break after entering high school, a fifteen-year-old artistic girl is melancholy with longing, but unexpectedly gets drawn into a wondrous adventure born of myth—behind it all lie her forgotten memories and a wager.

details.title: Closed Case
details.short_description: Team up with a friend and help Marcus and Cloe escape in this co-op point-and-click puzzle game! In Closed Case, you and your partner must solve a variety of riddles to escape the mysterious house while uncovering the identity of its enigmatic owner.

details.title: Your New Family
details.short_description: They offer you a bed, a seat at the table and a new family. All you have to do is stay. A narrative psychological horror adventure in a community where everyone is kind and nobody quite answers your questions.

details.title: EVICTIO
details.short_description: You've been hired to clear a haunted house. Read the briefing, complete your tasks and make it back out alive. Every creature inside behaves differently, and a single mistake in the wrong room can cost you everything.

details.title: SPIDERBOT EXTINCTION
details.short_description: The spiderbot horde doesn't march in lines — it flows like a flood. Place turrets freely, then use gunfire, mortar blasts, flame and more to push, split and redirect the swarm before it drowns humanity's last strongholds. Tower defense meets pest control at the end of the world.

details.title: 弥莎莉尔的救赎
details.short_description: Guide Misa through a dreamlike world in a single-player story and card-battling adventure. Shape your deck with helms, accessories and new cards, plan actions across three combat phases, and choose your path along a road of sacrifice.

details.title: You Go First!
details.short_description: A 4–12 player multiplayer deathrun about surviving deadly obstacle courses while one of you secretly controls the traps.

details.title: Somewhere Else
details.short_description: A cozy 2-player co-op puzzle platformer. Play as Chimp and Chip on one couch or online with Remote Play Together, explore six strange and beautiful worlds, solve puzzles that need both of you, beat bosses and find your way back home.

details.title: Seolhwa Dungeon
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelike where you fight monsters from Korean folktales, and they act the way they do in the stories. Let the Imugi live too long and it becomes a dragon. If the reaper sees you for three turns, he calls your name. When you die, you start over in a new dungeon.

details.title: Taboo Eternal Life
details.short_description: An Incremental Idle Exploration Game, Awaken in a silent, blood-soaked medieval vampire palace—where your kin lay dead. Who slaughtered them all? Uncover the chilling truth, break the endless loop of immortality, or sacrifice everything to restart the taboo cycle.

details.title: Merciless Mines
details.short_description: A hardcore 2D multiplayer extraction RPG featuring PvP/PvE, proximity chat, unique spells and classes, raid bosses, GAMBLING, and much more. Party up with friends, break terrain, and explore a dangerous open world filled with monsters, rival explorers, and loot worth fighting for.

name: There Is Not A Clown Here

details.title: There Is Not A Clown Here
details.short_description: A First Person Horror game. Learn individual behaviors for various different entities. Learn the intricacies of a unique, bizzare space.

details.title: Lines of Conquest
details.short_description: Take control of a nation and conquer Europe one base at a time. Move your armies, attack enemy territory, upgrade your bases and manage your resources as you continue to expand your territory.

details.title: INKarnation
details.short_description: Turn your doodles into fighters! Draw your own characters in INKarnation, then battle online, race through Time Attack, test your drawing skills in Sketch Rush, or trade explosive throws in Ink Bomb. No art skills needed—just imagination.

details.title: Lunar Eclipse ~ Vol. 0
details.short_description: Tread lightly or perish! In this pixel style Action RPG, slash and dodge through grueling foes as a dreary elven swordsman and a conniving feline assassin, discover hidden secrets in expansive environments, and survive in a world healing from war.

details.title: Worlda
details.short_description: Worlda is a 2D top down pixel-art sandbox adventure where you play as young grizzly bear Jonas as he sets forth into a charming, infinite world, battling brutal bosses and building beautiful bungalows. Will you make it through the night, or will you bear-ly survive?

details.title: Kill the Thing
details.short_description: Kill The Thing is a challenging turn-based tactical RPG. Keep the corruption under control while searching for its origin. Undertake missions across four distinct regions, targeting key resources, upgrading your base, and building your roster of heroes. For the final confrontation.

details.title: Smokey Mike
details.short_description: In stand-up, talent isn't always enough. In this point and click adventure you have to improvise, survive and fail with style until you craft the five minutes that could change everything.

details.title: Spin Sacrifice Survive
details.short_description: Break the system. Test your luck. Spot the lies. Experience the thrill of gambling for your survival. Optimize your strategy to pay an crushing debt, grow your power, and survive ten nights of paranoia.

details.title: Idleplace
details.short_description: Place hovering land on your sky island. Close a region to construct your buildings, then muster an army to fight the invaders landing. Collect gear from bosses as well as gaining gear in village. In battle turn on auto and your island fights on while you're idle, even floating on your desktop.

details.title: On The Come Up
details.short_description: Start small and work your way up in On The Come Up, a co-op crime game about making money, stealing cars, dodging police, and building a home for your crew. Follow a story that gets personal, or take a break from the missions and see what you can get away with around the city.

details.title: Toy or Not ?
details.short_description: Toy or Not ? is an online hide-and-seek party game for up to 8 players. Sneak around as a toy, collect batteries, and rescue your teammates—or play as a kid, spot suspicious toys, and send them back to the toy box. Turn an ordinary room into a playground of sneaky tricks and surprises!

details.title: Hardware Pirates
details.short_description: Your PC was a pirate ship all along. Turn monitors into Digital Sails, RAM into ramming power and USB ports into gunports. Explore the Corrupted Caribbean, upgrade your ship and master ballistic naval combat. Sail solo or join friends in online co-op and PvP.

details.title: Evidence of Grace
details.short_description: Evidence of Grace is a vertical shoot 'em up up with experimental gameplay focused on defense and shooting.

details.title: Imprint
details.short_description: A counterfeiting sim in a small harbor town. Print and cut fake bills, slip them past cashiers, bartenders and the casino cage, and hope nobody looks too closely. Expand your print shop, dodge the police, crack the bank vault, and run the racket solo or in online co-op with friends.

details.title: Literally A Flying Brick
details.short_description: "Literally A Flying Brick" is a spaceship-building 2.5D action-shooter game. The year is 2088, and humanity is at war with AI and aliens in space. Triumph in intense battles using your own fully customizable spaceship and a strategic skill deck!

details.title: Remnant Afterglow Tower Defense
details.short_description: This is a creative and challenging real-time strategy tower defense game where players need to constantly expand, build complex battle lines on the map, and fight against groups of enemies. The game has unique rules and beautiful pixel style, with each level filled with tense and exciting battles.

details.title: The Paint Atelier: Replica Co.
details.short_description: The Paint Atelier: Replica Co. is a fun 2D art & management sim. Paint what’s in the minds of quirky customers with top accuracy, showcase your art in the gallery, sell it at auctions, and compete online with friends!

details.title: Dent & Paint: Body Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own body shop and fix cars by hand. Inspect, quote and win the job, then strip, cut out rot, weld, fill, sand, mask, mix and spray the paint, polish and wash. Deliver on time, earn good reviews and work your way up from apprentice to foreman.

details.title: Off-Road With Your Friends
details.short_description: Pack your friends into boxy 4x4s and head into the wild. Up to 8 players drive one convoy through autumn forests, rivers and snowy passes, get stuck in the mud, winch each other out, change flat tyres and camp at dusk. Nobody gets left behind.

details.title: Bedtime Battalion
details.short_description: When the house falls asleep, the toys go to war! Command wobbly toy soldiers across a child's bedroom and six ages of history, from cavemen to tanks, in physics battles where a vacuum cleaner, a giant ball or the lights going out can turn any fight.

details.title: Cosmic Inferno
details.short_description: Explore 100 star systems, battle pirates, trade, mine asteroids, and salvage wrecks. Buy and customize spaceships, upgrade your weapons, and chart your own course. Your onboard computer A.R.E.S. is always by your side. Whether you like it or not.

details.title: Timber Together
details.short_description: Grab up to seven friends and build a logging company in a stylized forest valley. Fell trees, buck them into logs, haul them through mud and rivers in 11 vehicles, and sell to the buyers who pay best. Buy land, hire loggers, grow your company.

details.title: True Vikings
details.short_description: Choose your own path: become a powerful jarl or a legendary king, or perhaps switch sides and follow the path of a knight, reliving the story of the Duke of Normandy.

details.title: Hegemony
details.short_description: 214 states, thousands of regions, and limitless strategic possibilities! Manage your economy, shape politics, forge diplomatic ties, strengthen your military, and shift the global balance of power. Establish your own world order and leave your mark on history!

details.title: Meowgic Laundry
details.short_description: Run a magical laundry on the verge of chaos! Toss single-use detergents into a physics-driven washer, chain collisions into escalating scores, buy machine parts, sign contracts, and survive nine rounds of increasingly unruly laundry.

details.title: Fawn's Gambit
details.short_description: Guided by fate, you enter a mysterious card-and-board battle. Collect monster cards, build your deck, defeat legendary heroes, and uncover buried secrets. When the truth emerges, you will fight alongside heroes of old against the darkness.

details.title: Tailgun
details.short_description: A minimalist snake-survivor roguelite. Steer through enemy swarms, build your arsenal with weapons and upgrades, and unlock new content with every run.

details.title: ボンドセレクション
details.short_description: 「きんかんなまなま」が楽しめるのは、ともゆき先生のゲームだけ！新種の接着剤を開発し品評会で最優秀金賞を目指せ！石川県珠洲市狼煙町を舞台に新種の接着剤の開発にかける者たちの苦悩を描く調合RPG（体験版）。ご当地ネタ満載！石川県の事が気になっていたけど、クラスの友達に噂されると恥ずかしいから……気にせずプレーして良し！言葉遊びが面白いゲームをやってみたい……？テキストが面白いゲームをやってみたい……？ここに、あるぞ！読み応えしかない……ッ！ 純文学を読んだような読後感！自称世界で2番目に面白いモンスター図鑑を搭載！圧倒的クオリジナリティー（クオリティー+オリジナリティー）殆ど神ゲーここに、あるぞ！
developers: ともゆき（紀元前 幹部）
publishers: ともゆき（紀元前 幹部）

details.title: Outdraft
details.short_description: Lead an esports team in a MOBA discipline, draft heroes, manage players, and guide your organization to championship glory in a strategic autobattler with deep management elements.

details.title: Habitus
details.short_description: Detective RPG • TTRPG-Style Interrogation • Dark Political Thriller In Zehergrad, crime is a disease. As Inspector Mehmed Başar, break suspects in brutal interrogations and make the political choices that will decide the city's fate.

details.title: The Last Reel
details.short_description: Escape a Japanese nightmare in this 2D rubber-hose horror adventure. Play as a protagonist living with depression, manage his sanity, solve puzzles, and survive monstrous encounters, deadly traps, car chases, and airplane pursuits.

details.title: Lattice Defense
details.short_description: A tower defense game meets top-down shooter. Build a maze of walls and elemental towers by day. Defend yourself by night. Dash, build, and blast your way until dawn. Play solo or in online co-op.

details.title: Spin & Win: Casino Business Sim
details.short_description: Their luck. Your business. Build your casino, work the floor, and hire a crew to keep the cash flowing. Draw crowds with live shows, then join your guests for poker, blackjack, or a spin on the slots.

details.title: Assassins for Hire
details.short_description: Four mercenaries, six contracts, one plan. Sneak, distract, knife and sabotage your way through guarded compounds in a real-time tactics game in the classic style, solo or with up to four players in online co-op.

details.title: Witchhammer
details.short_description: Face relentless hordes of enemies and overthrow the Inquisition in our gripping real-time deckbuilding roguelike. Harness the magic of your tarot deck to shape your destiny and avenge your fate. The future lies in the cards, witch!

details.title: Caliban
details.short_description: A strategic blackjack roguelike. Stack drinks, runes, and gems into game-breaking combos. Beat cursed bosses. Chase the leaderboard. One deck. One dealer. Infinite builds.

details.title: Ascend from Dis
details.short_description: A comic-ink roguelike deckbuilder where noise is a resource. Scavenge loud and the horde answers in waves — or fight quiet and stay poor. Outplay enemies that run decks of their own: peek, steal, and sabotage their next move while an infection ticks toward turning you.

details.title: Kaput
details.short_description: KAPUT is a chaotic co-op horror comedy game for up to 6 players. Explore abandoned places, repair failing machinery, and salvage high-value scrap while avoiding terrifying anomalies. Work together, handle hazardous breakdown events, and escape with your loot before everything goes kaput!

details.title: Who's the Biggest Degen?
details.short_description: You and 3 friends owe Tony the Octopus a lot of money. Gamble on 30 casino games across 8 floors, slap, rob and sabotage each other, and pay Tony every night, or he takes your stuff, pants included. After 5 nights, only one of you is the Biggest Degen.

details.title: Crash Agency
details.short_description: Crash Agency is a ragdoll comedy about staged accidents. Set the scene, throw yourself in front of cars, off ramps and under pianos, break bones in slow-motion X-ray and file the claim. 105 jobs in a busy town and a snowy mountain village.

details.title: NecroMerc
details.short_description: Play as X a mercenary whose job is being replaced by robots and is reskilling into necromancy.

details.title: Ocean Ark: 100 Below
