details.short_description: Tag, push and parkour your friends off the map. Chicks vs Ducks is a 2–10 player online party game: team hunts, free-for-all brawls on rising lava, and co-op egg heists against sharks. Wall-run, dash, grapple and get back up, or drag a friend up with you.

details.title: Utopia: Haven
details.short_description: Explore three distant planets in this retro-inspired 2D metroidvania, developed for the Game Boy Color. Face mysterious creatures, discover powerful upgrades and uncover lost secrets. The fate of humanity is in your hands!

details.title: Pocket Pilot
details.short_description: Pilot planes, helicopters, and drones to clean, restore, and rebuild multiple unique islands. Water crops, power-wash monuments, airlift cargo, and clear toxic smog at your own pace in this cozy aerial restoration simulator.

details.title: Unpatched
details.short_description: "Unpatched" is an action-RPG in the isekai genre. Play as a QA tester trapped in the body of an undead assassin inside the MMORPG he's testing. Your raid boss is in danger, the heroes are already close. Your weapons are blades and knowledge of unfixed bugs. Fight hordes of players and save your boss

details.title: Voxel Throne
details.short_description: Voxel Throne is a voxel-based action adventure RPG. Explore a beautiful world, alone or with friends! Help townsfolk, defeat enemies, loot powerful items and create your ultimate build!

details.title: Picker Magnate Simulator
details.short_description: Buy junk, hunt for rare treasures, and turn it all into profit in your own resale shop. Haggle with sellers, repair antiques yourself or through hired workers, craft handmade, and level up your skills to carry and sell more. If you hate hauling heavy stuff, buy a vehicle. Build your resale empire.

details.title: La Cosa Nostra
details.short_description: La Cosa Nostra is a story focused, cinematic 2.5D side-scrolling action game set in 1920s Prohibition era US. Play as Johnny, an Italian American immigrant forced into a life of crime, combining melee combat and shooter gameplay within a noir mafia themed narrative.

details.title: Tombbound
details.short_description: Welcome to the afterlife’s most dangerous internship. In this co-op extraction horror, you serve Anubis. Raid cursed tombs, dodge mythological horrors, and collect enough cursed relics to meet the God of Death's quota. Remember: The scales of justice do not tolerate lighter wallets.

details.title: Orbit to Riches
details.short_description: Orbit to Riches is a short, relaxing incremental space game where you mine asteroids, upgrade ships, and grow stronger over multiple runs - no timers, no rush.

details.title: Asteroid Rodeo
details.short_description: Asteroids are worth trillions. They're also spinning at 200 meters per second. You are a Wrangler—harpoon tumbling rocks, wrestle them to a dead stop with your custom-built ship, and mine them for credits. The pay is good. The survival rate is a conversation people avoid.

details.title: MEATBALLS GARDEN
details.short_description: Meatballs Farm is a fast-paced first-person farming game. Farm, fish, and gather by day. Monsters come at night. You have only 30 days to pay your debt to the King. Miss the payment, and you’re dead.

details.title: Mental Break
details.short_description: Manage our AI girlfriend product as the newest engagement lead at Bigger Tech Corp. Make the tough choices for Alice as she slowly drives her user insane. A satirical choose-your-own-adventure with beautiful pixel art and widely branching narrative.

details.title: The Trial of Progress
details.short_description: A fast-paced city-building experience inspired by the concept of civilization. As you advance your technologies and attract some of the greatest historical figures, you will face the trial of progress and strive to create a lasting legacy.

details.title: Monkeys Don't Fear Hell
details.short_description: A cozy farming and building sim by day, a demon-slaying gauntlet by night - grow crops, raise a town and then descend to battle waves of demons and towering bosses. DOOM & Vampire Survivors meets Stardew Valley.

details.title: Grass
details.short_description: Turn overgrown yards into freshly cut lawns in this cozy lawn care simulator. Play solo or team up with friends to mow, trim, water, and clear debris. Finish jobs, earn rewards, and build your reputation one satisfying transformation at a time.

details.title: Fruit Auto Fighters
details.short_description: A fruit-themed async PvP auto battler. Pick a gardener, choose your fruits, and grow a team that can take down other players before your fruit starts rotting. Play at your own pace, try new team combos, and pair fertilizer effects with weapons to find synergies that break the game.

details.title: BREAKOUT BABY
details.short_description: BREAKOUT BABY is a blood-pumping, Pac-Man–infused, first-person horror roguelike where you must help a poor baby escape to the surface. Run from creatures, scoop up pellets, and shake your baby to survive.

details.title: Fruit Slicer
details.short_description: Slice fruit with precision - using your mouse or real hand! Dodge bombs, master combos, and push your reflexes to the limit in this fast-paced arcade slicer.

details.title: Reverie Eclipse
details.short_description: You are the president of the student council at a high school. Six lovely girls are ready to help you! Spending time with them... is it as easy as it seems?

details.title: Spin, Baby, Spin!
details.short_description: Spin, Baby, Spin! is a short incremental game about slot machines. Spin the reels, upgrade your income and drop chances, craft new slot machines, and collect powerful artifacts. Choose your talent cards and earn enough chips to buy back your soul from a demonic clown!

details.title: Crow Hunts Worms
details.short_description: An Action Incremental/Roguelite Puzzle where you Aim, Shoot, and utilize Gun Skills to annihilate worms! Upgrade your guns and get temporary upgrades while playing and clear infested areas OR play endlessly!

details.title: Auredis: Vaelen's Requiem
details.short_description: The sun is dead. In the golden capital of Sol-Nihil, flesh fuses with stone. As the Unfused Champion, you alone can move through the stagnation. Breach the walls, slay the Puppet King, and destroy the Lich Lord in this punishing, hand-crafted Action RPG.

details.title: Dont Stop Walking
details.short_description: A co-op survival extraction game for 1 to 6 players. A purple storm is coming down the canyon and it never stops. Walk, scavenge, craft from grass to iron, fight what lives in five abandoned places, and get your haul home to your floating outpost before the storm takes it all.

details.title: Be Positive!
details.short_description: Move Mr Positve around the arena by converting the cubes around him to reach his goal, Ms. Negative. Play on desktop or in VR.

details.title: Your Maid
details.short_description: A desktop companion simulation featuring a charming 3D character living on your screen. Drag, rotate, and pose your companion. Collect poses across rarity tiers, unlock costumes, play 7 mini-games, and set alarms while your fantasy friend keeps you company throughout your workday.

details.title: Stellar Frontline
details.short_description: A unique tower defense game where you build and upgrade defenses by placing hex tiles. Protect your rocket from hostile spaceships to unlock new tiles after each defeated wave.

details.title: Slay the Slime
details.short_description: An incremental game where you slay thousands of slimes in an epic power fantasy. Stack upgrades, master unique classes, equip powerful relics and defeat mighty bosses on your way from rookie to the guild's top adventurer.

details.title: Gee, Tea, Eh, Seven?
details.short_description: In a single night, your family's boba tea empire AND family were taken out by rivals. Take revenge as Seven, the tragic sole survivor. Build up your power base by brewing the best drinks and retaking the town... or, you know, by *fixing* the competition through sabotage, subterfuge and violence.

details.title: Chrono Vanguard: Primal Survival - Dinosaur
details.short_description: Cut through relentless dinosaur hordes, unlock powerful heroines, and survive long enough to become unstoppable.

details.title: Lacustris - The War over Water
details.short_description: An innovative, realistic point-and-click game where you step into the shoes of a mysterious character in search of his identity and a shocking truth. Puzzles to solve, complex dialogue, and realistic graphics are the focus of this engaging game.

details.title: Cute Country
details.short_description: The world's first simulation management single-player game with an alternate world theme! The world's first city-building RPG game!Build a home with a catgirl, farm with a dragon maid, and embark on an otherworldly adventure you've never experienced before! You absolutely cannot miss out on Curry!

details.title: Asa's Ascended
details.short_description: Dodge through custom battles made by the community through the editor! Enjoy multiplayer, leaderboards, unique abilities, and a campaign!

details.title: Runeline
details.short_description: Design, build, and code a factory within the magical world of Runeline! Work on producing increasingly complex products, which will require you to write not just functional but optimized code, all within the simple instructions of the machine core.

details.title: Party Time Bowling
details.short_description: Strike up the neon-soaked fun in this competitive party sports game for up to 8 players. Bowl, roll, and battle it out in Air Hockey, unlock 100+ ball skins and custom pins with Alley Bucks, and keep the good times rolling.

details.title: Killware: Under Review
details.short_description: Adrenaline-fuelling, gory, arcade-style roguelite shooter where survival is mandatory. Outlast escalating waves, grow stronger with each run, and defy the Content Compliance Police in a dystopian future that’s watching your every move.

details.title: Thieves Guild Master
details.short_description: Run a thieves’ guild in Arathia, a medieval fantasy city of scheming nobles, hardworking people and rival gangs. Recruit thieves, take risky contracts, and expand your shadow empire in this turn-based guild management strategy game.

details.title: Forgefolk
details.short_description: Forge weapons and tools by hand, repair what others have broken, and uncover the stories buried in old steel. In Forgefolk, every scar means something — and what you find may force an old master smith to face the one thing he never managed to fix: his past.

details.title: Abyss Chamber
details.short_description: Maintain an underground research facility full of abyss entities. Fulfill their needs and survive long enough to solve all of the mysteries. Abyss Chamber is a lore-rich, first-person psychological Horror game.

details.title: 鱼干集团那些事：征途
details.short_description: 《Furry Journey in Other World》 IP Furry Anime 2D Role-Playing Visual Novel GameYou will take control of the protagonist — HuiYuan — and continue writing the story of Yugan Group in this sci-fi world. Embark on an epic journey together with your friends and comrades-in-arms.

details.title: KUBIKA
details.short_description: KUBIKA is a Sokoban-like puzzle adventure. Manipulate gravity and guide charming little cubes across three-dimensional, perspective-twisting puzzles. Master each world’s unique mechanics, build and share your own puzzles using the built-in Level Editor. Free Demo available today !

details.title: Magic Moon
details.short_description: Welcome to Magic Moon, a cozy mystery life sim set on a peaceful island where the air is fresh, the waters sparkle, and the ground hums with forgotten magic. You play as Hana, a magical girl starting over on a remote island full of charm, curiosity, and just a little mystery.

details.title: Bulgasari: Blocks & Bullets
details.short_description: Bulgasari: Blocks & Bullets is a multitasking action roguelike where combat and block puzzle happen at the same time. Devour scrap to grow stronger, create your own build, and survive against endless machine hordes.

details.title: The Missing Threads
details.short_description: [DEMO available now!] Erased memories, scattered clues. What will you uncover, and what will you leave buried?As an amnesiac detective, investigate crime scenes with limited focus. You can't analyze everything. Strategically choose your leads to shape the case and reclaim your lost past.

details.title: The Endemic : Best Mates
details.short_description: Endemic: GONGWAN is a cozy farming game inspired by a CCC comic. Taiwanese foods like Gongwan and dumplings come to life as cute creatures called Endemics. Play as a researcher, rebuild the park, farm the land, and befriend unique companions.

details.title: Reflectory
details.short_description: An idle incremental game about bouncing balls that lives in the corner of your screen.

details.title: Depono
details.short_description: Play against your friends in this fast paced, competitive card game. Bet, scheme and bluff your way to victory. Craft your deck with secret cards, change the playing field with items and become unstoppable.

details.title: Zombies & Battery
details.short_description: Zombies hunt by the sound of your heartbeat, and only static from a government radio can hide it. Keep the battery alive, drive your camper van to the safe zone, and scavenge, sneak and revive fallen friends in casual co-op zombie survival for 1–4 players.

details.title: Dungeon Trader
details.short_description: Become a Dungeon Trader and climb from Beginner to Legendary Trader! Buy, Sell, Negotiate risky deals, Play unique Mini-Games, Unlock strange visitors, customize your appearance, and uncover hidden secrets lurking beneath the Dungeon.

details.title: Interstitial
details.short_description: Interstitial is a first-person psychological horror game that dives into the unease of liminal spaces, blending environmental storytelling, exploration-driven gameplay, and slow-burning dread to create an experience where the world itself becomes the threat.

details.title: Band Stage
details.short_description: Step onto a vibrant, colorful stage and unleash your musical magic with a variety of instruments. Featuring a curated collection of classic hits, our soundtrack spans Pop, Rock, Classical, Electronic, and beyond—guaranteed to hit every note of your musical imagination.

details.title: AVROPOLIS
details.short_description: VR action-adventure with fully physics-based movement. Climb ruins, fight mysterious creatures and enemies, survive deadly traps, solve ancient puzzles, and manage your gear as Leonardo uncovers the lost civilization of AVROPOLIS. Story-driven campaign with strong accessibility options.

details.title: Crimson Skyline
details.short_description: Set the skies ablaze in this aerial combat bullet hell! Target enemy carriers to cripple fleets, dodge relentless anti-air battleships, and outmaneuver fighter jet squadrons. As a Phoenix Squadron pilot, you are the final rampart against tyranny and your nation’s last hope to rise from the ashes.

details.title: Catena
details.short_description: Catena is a deck-building roguelite where the freedom to customize your allies feels as powerful as programming. Dive into strategic, grid-based battles and create tactics uniquely your own to conquer the mysterious island and defeat the formidable enemies that await.

details.title: Crystal Rail
details.short_description: All aboard the Crystal Rail - a train game set in a crystalpunk fantasy world of extinct animals, hand-painted environments, and political revolution!

details.title: Cappy & Tappy: Temples of Peril
details.short_description: Follow Cappy & Tappy through their block-stacking, platforming, worldwide adventure! Stack massive blocks as Tappy to help Cappy explore, survive and escape. Play with a friend or juggle both roles solo to escape crumbling temples packed with devious traps, colossal bosses, and mysterious idols.

details.title: Addie Shen
details.short_description: Addie Shen is a math based puzzle shooter. Play solo, team up in co-op, or practice your skills to stop the evil PEMDAS minions. Can you save the world with math?

details.title: Bread & Bravery
details.short_description: Return to the era of knights and castles in a uniquely satisfying mix of Settlement Building, RTS and Castle Simulation genres. Manage complex and realistic medieval production chains, build your army and defences, satisfy the King and lead your people to prosperity. Will you succeed as a new lord?

details.title: Falafel King
details.short_description: Take orders, fry falafel and fill pitas, solo or with up to three friends, at a quiet stand in Tel Aviv's Carmel Market. Do it well and word gets around: more customers, more dishes, and a lunch rush you'll need every hand for.

details.title: Grid Gladiators
details.short_description: Grid Gladiators is a roguelike deck builder on a 2D grid that borrows mechanics from FTL and Slay the Spire. Dodge attacks and use terrain to your advantage in battle, then race the boss across each act's map, drafting cards and upgrading relics. Play solo or online co-op with up to 4 players.

details.title: Dwarven Village
details.short_description: Place your dwarves directly on the enemy paths. Keep them alive, level them up, equip them with powerful items, and build towers around them to create your perfect defense.

details.title: MECHBORN
details.short_description: A fresh roguelike deckbuilder where YOUR MECH IS YOUR DECK – With 7 cards always in play on a conveyor belt victory is down to skill and not luck. Master pilot skills and unlock Mech parts to reveal powerful cards, as you carve your path across 3 ever-changing continents to repel the Kaiju invasion.

details.title: Tesera
details.short_description: Beyond the familiar lies a world of uncharted lands, strange creatures, and the remnants of a lost civilization. Explore, gather, craft, build, and fight - make this alien world your own, solo or with friends.

details.title: Dodgeball Blast
details.short_description: Dodgeball Blast is a colorful 3D action-adventure where dodgeball is your greatest weapon! Explore a wild overworld, battle 10 massive bosses, master 9 wacky minigames, unlock new abilities, discover secrets, and play solo or with friends on your quest to become the Dodgeball Master!

details.title: The Gambit Lost to Time
details.short_description: Become a time-travelling goddess entrusted with saving the world in this tactical RPG! With powers capable of altering time and terrain - serve one of three distinct, warring factions, and unite them over many timelines to break free from a time loop of doom.

details.title: Seal of Solitomb
details.short_description: A deck-building roguelike that takes solitaire and puts it in a dungeon. Stack cards into poker hands and rid your deck of the monsters within. Assemble an invincible build and beat the demon threatening the kingdom - at least until the next run!

details.title: Backroom Cleaners
details.short_description: Purge the unknown Backrooms in this 4-player co-op TPS roguelike. Experience endless combat with fresh build combinations every run.

details.title: Eisenkiefer
details.short_description: Eisenkiefer is an asymmetrical horror multiplayer game for quick sessions with friends. Play as a Pig, hide, sabotage a giant meat grinder, and rescue your teammates – or become the Butcher and process the Pigs before they destroy your machine.

details.title: MODULE:BERSERK (모듈 버서크)
details.short_description: MODULE:BERSERK is a 2D pixel "hard-boiled" action game with steampunk-inspired world of endless desertification and corruption. Play as a butler-styled automaton. Track down the suspect that caused terrifying event to the family you serve. And protect the only survivor, 'lady' from upcoming dangers.

details.title: Marsbound
details.short_description: MARSBOUND is a survival game in sci-fi setting which combines elements of economic strategy and psychological thriller. The player assumes the role of an AI manager who must create the first Martian colony from scratch with Earth's brightest minds under their command.

details.title: Dark Queen of Samobor
details.short_description: Experience a thrilling adventure through the dark and atmospheric world of medieval Croatia where an evil queen rules from the shadows and her haunted guardians await you. Venture into a dark fantasy tale wrapped in a cinematic action side-scroller with a unique 2.5D style.

details.title: Extinction Force
details.short_description: Battle across time to save humanity from giant arachnids in this multiplayer third-person action shooter.

details.title: Drop Dead Party
details.short_description: Drop Dead Party is a 2–4 PvP multiplayer bomb tag party game that you can only play with your Steam friends. Pass the ticking bomb, sabotage everyone with power-ups, and be the last one standing. No public lobbies, so every betrayal is personal. Invite your friends, ruin the friendship!

details.title: Slacker
details.short_description: Collect shopping carts, ignore customers, and complete To-Do lists that encourage mischief and mayhem. Fight a chicken mascot, prevent an alien invasion, learn to breakdance, crash a forklift, and more. How much can you get away with and still keep your job?

details.title: Knight life tavern
details.short_description: Cook and brew endlessly, desperately trying to serve a never ending stream of customers with a temper. The medieval knight is hard to please and very vocal about his disdain for goblins and the like. Make sure everyone enjoys eachother's company, and kick the trouble makers through the front door!

details.title: Merchant Miles
details.short_description: A good merchant knows what to sell. A great one knows where, when, how, and to whom. Fill your cart with wares, haggle your way through towns, and keep an eye on the shifting market in this travelling merchant strategy game. Just be wary that today’s bargain could be tomorrow’s loss.

details.title: Ruling Horsestown
details.short_description: Be a horse mayor! Make the best choices in this casual comedy management game, try not to lose, and govern the chaotic city of Horsestown where new absurd decisions and eccentric characters await you.

details.title: Shrine Protectors
details.short_description: Deckbuilder Tower Defense meets rogue-lite RTS strategy. Lead your army, crush waves of enemies, and unlock powerful upgrades and passive spells. Combine deckbuilding strategy with tactical army management in this relentless bullet heaven.

details.title: FIGHT-QUEST
details.short_description: Punch, slash, and blast through hordes of fairy-tale creatures in this first-person action roguelite. Stack absurd abilities, conquer deadly arenas, and bank your hard-earned gold for new unlocks.

details.title: Evolution Of The Ancients
details.short_description: Survive as a vulnerable hatchling, grow into a fierce predator and lead your own herd. Craft armour from the bones of your prey, recruit NPC companions and join other players to defend your nesting grounds. In a world where dinosaurs never went extinct, build a future worth fighting for.

details.title: Ultimate Lemon Basket
details.short_description: 🍋 A Speed-Running platformer where you can’t drop any lemons.🍋 Between you and the goal are Ghosts, Cows, Acid Rain Clouds, Monster Trucks, Hopes, Dreams and other things AS WELL!! There are leaderboards.

details.title: Spinning My Wheel
details.short_description: Build a physics‑powered hamster‑wheel, master rocket‑boosted moves, to lead a brain chipped enhanced hamster through puzzles, mining, and laboratory‑runner mayhem.

details.title: Meat Market
details.short_description: Outside the last human city, you keep a butcher shop. Your customers shamble in at dusk. Stock comes from the city beyond. Village is home - they tolerate you because you keep the dead calm. And somewhere in that city is the one who took your daughter.

details.title: Phatastrophe
details.short_description: Turn the pond into a warzone in this chaotic action roguelike! Dual-wield outrageous weapons, unleash devastating back-mounted firepower and create wild builds as a Phrog, Chrab or Phlai. Survive solo, team up in co-op or blast your friends in online battles.

details.title: Crusaders Quest : Tactics
details.short_description: Crusaders Quest: Tactics is a roguelike auto battler where you build a party of charming pixel art heroes. Recruit heroes from Shasha's shop, promote them, and craft Soulbound Weapons. Find the right hero synergies and take on bosses across five acts.

details.title: SOKO 1977: Anti-Terror Task Force
details.short_description: Take command of a special police task force in 1970s Germany. Uncover terrorist networks, coordinate operations, and make far-reaching decisions. Experience an intense, historically inspired scenario that explores the balance between security, freedom, and the rule of law.

details.title: Cuzuco
details.short_description: Challenge yourself and demonstrate your precise high-speed hand control to help our little armadillo get back home as fast as possible in this fair but unforgiving platformer game.

details.title: Hexabot Stranded: Defend Or Die
details.short_description: Action tower defense with physics & couch co-op: carry your turrets, hurl objects, and survive swarm attacks.

details.title: Aphasia
details.short_description: Have you ever wondered what happens when we fall into a coma? Why do only some make it back? Aphasia is a first-person horror where you’re trapped inside your own mind, with no memory of who you are. As you explore your fractured memories, your sense of guilt won’t let you escape...

details.title: First Layer: 3D Printing Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run your own 3D printing business, from a single garage printer to a full print farm. Slice models, keep all printers running, paint your prints and fix your machines. Fill orders online and in your own store, manage filament stock, grow your business layer by layer.

details.title: Pay Your Space Debt
details.short_description: An incremental survivor-lite where you must earn your way out of debt by mining entire asteroid fields, upgrading your spaceship and surviving the debt collectors.

details.title: Lightbound : A Rolling Ball Game
details.short_description: A racing platformer. Take control of a ball and set off on a wildly dangerous adventure. Master your momentum, chain power-ups, outwit the enemies on your tail, and whatever you do — don't fall. Solo or split-screen for up to 4 players.

details.title: Whale Life Simulator
details.short_description: Experience the life of a whale. Hit the streets, earn cash, and pour massive amounts of money into an online game. Use your maxed-out account to crush other players!

details.title: The Facility
details.short_description: You look different today. Yesterday, you looked different too. Which one is really you? A psychological horror game about paranoia, identity, and the fear of trusting the wrong person.

details.title: Immortal Coil
details.short_description: Build powerful decks to confront the Gods in this lane-based, strategy card game. Play the Roguelike Adventure Mode or ascend the Tower of Battle in Gauntlet Mode. Discover wild deckbuilding synergies to unleash spectacular combos against formidable foes.

details.title: Kosmosis
details.short_description: Two xenobiologists find themselves stranded on a mysterious planet that appears intent on their anihilation.

details.title: Gunnar Malakor
details.short_description: A FULLY BLIND-ACCESSIBLE AUDIO ADVENTURE You are Gunnar Malakor: thief, failed mercenary and escape artist. Sentenced to death in the dungeons of Lysanthir castle, you'll need cunning, improvisation and a little luck to break out and leave the kingdom.

details.title: project; VIRAI: DOOMER’s LIFE ESCAPE
details.short_description: A psychological horror RPG with visual novel elements, where you live the life of Hicha, a shut-in hikikomori trapped in an endless cycle of depression, anxiety, and routine.

details.title: SAGE
details.short_description: SAGE is a multiplayer adventure game about frog wizards. Play solo or with friends on a journey to master elemental magic, explore a corrupted world, rebuild mushroom villages, and share tea with other frogs.

details.title: Multi Deck Hero
details.short_description: Multi Deck Hero is a roguelike deckbuilder where you command three unique decks to create powerful synergies. Strategically combine cards, unlock game-changing charms, and battle against increasingly powerful enemies. Will you master the perfect deck or fall to the challenge?

details.title: Queen's Vanguard
details.short_description: Chess meets tower defense, and you're the Queen. Defend your King against waves of enemy pieces. Place your own pieces where they hit hardest, upgrade them wisely, and turn the tide with the Queen's skills. Beat all 100 levels to become the ultimate Grandmaster!

details.title: Eye of Khaos
details.short_description: Slay your enemies in this sword and sorcery roguelike! Ancient dungeons, fallen ruins and cyclopean towers and their primordial denizens present a tactical and deadly challenge that can only be overcome by the most resourceful heroes.

details.title: Subjectivation
details.short_description: Subjectivation is a first person horror adventure game set in a snow-covered town frozen in time. Solve puzzles, manage your body heat, and defend yourself from the warped inhabitants of the frostbitten city. Explore the town’s past - and shape its future with your actions.

details.title: Echoes of the Core
details.short_description: Echoes of the Core is a third-person platformer set in the planet's deepest reaches, where every descent is a mission, every step could be your last, and every discovery could change everything.

details.title: Tamabuki
details.short_description: A survival horror where your key to making it through the Depths is taking care of the Homunculus housed within your Tamabuki. Devastating abilities are powered by this dwarf within the chassis, but forget to feed them and they might just end up eating you.

details.title: FISH³: FISHTASTIC FISHING FISHSCAPES
details.short_description: FISH³ is high-octane, surreal speed-fishing adventure where your boat is powered by fish! Engage in time-attack stages, dual-rod fishing, and underwater spear-fishing in a dreamlike world teeming with bizarre aquatic creatures.

details.title: Zjawa: Bloodstained Soul
details.short_description: Zjawa: Bloodstained Soul is a 2D Survival Horror RPG mixing turn-based combat with real-time elements and hand-drawn art, set in 13th century France during a crusade against heresy. Slash, parry, and collect items to survive to see the end, whatever it may be. Find absolution or damnation.

details.title: Detachment Crew
details.short_description: Control a crew of outcasts and try to destroy the mining tower that is corrupting the environment. Many tried before, many failed. Surely this is a good idea. A sci-fi dungeon crawling game with handmade visuals, real time combat and unique exploration options.

details.title: Star Pulse:The War
details.short_description: Star Pulse: The War is an independent real-time strategy game that merges science fiction with fantasy. Players will command a sci-fi faction, harnessing the power of star pulse to gather resources, construct buildings, train troops, and nurture heroes in the fight against invading magical forces.

details.title: Kung Fu Addiction
details.short_description: An auto-battler RPG where anticipation is everything. Predict your enemies' moves, shape your hero's progression, and channel the souls of ancient warriors to resurrect with a new fighting style as you overcome escalating challenges across multiple combat modes.

details.title: Apprentice of Darkness
details.short_description: Play as a dark magician, gather your party of all sorts of evil, unspeakable creatures and spread darkness! A hand-drawn, turn-based rogue-like experience! Sacrifice your enemies to Evil Gods, unlock new powers and recruits, build your Tower of Darkness to spread corruption throughout the continent.

details.title: My Eerie Lair
details.short_description: A dark cozy ‘Romantasy’ furnishing game where a vampire kidnaps his beloved and tries to win her heart by turning his eerie castle into their dream home.

details.title: Study Abroad Simulator
details.short_description: Four years abroad. A whole new life. Take on college in near-future America! Ace your classes, earn your keep, fall in love, and play your cards right. Then start again to uncover a hidden conspiracy. Your next big decision could change more than your future—it could change the world.

details.title: Cooking Stories: Fun Cafe Game
details.short_description: Play Cooking Stories — a fun time-management cooking game! 🍳 Manage your café, upgrade and decorate restaurants, create delicious dishes, and help your star chef shine. 🌟 Explore cooking, design, and strategy in one tasty adventure. Download now and start cooking! 🔥

details.title: MoonBurn
details.short_description: Hand drawn. Fire fueled. MoonBurn is a twin stick shooter where you carve through hostile creatures, shape your weapon to match your style, and push deeper into a strange alien world.

details.title: HAKONIWA DEFENSE
details.short_description: "HAKONIWA DEFENSE" is a tower defense game in which the protagonist, who has lost his memory, cooperates with the girls to progress. Defeat enemies to regain your memory.

details.title: Dino Cleanup
details.short_description: Clean giant dinosaurs and save cute prehistoric friends in a world flooded with goop! Unlock vacuum overdrive abilities for new ways to play and collect tons of hats in this nostalgic 3D platformer.

details.title: Loot Goblin Inc.
details.short_description: Break into homes, steal valuables, and sell them online to make big cash money! Join the corporate goblin world in this very cool Loot Goblin Simulation!

details.title: Blood Dice
details.short_description: Roll or hold dice to get patterns and reach blood quotas. Modify dice, buy items and sign some suspicious pacts to escape. Craft your build, and test it against the odds or lose it all.

details.title: Worlds Explorers
details.short_description: Explore alien planets with carefully designed ecosystems, weather, resources, dangers and unique phenomena. Hunt animals for food and collect resources to craft equipment and repair devices on your ship. Escape each unique planet and unlock crew members and new ships.

details.title: Untitled 2D Isometric RPG
details.short_description: Explore a dynamic 2D isometric fantasy RPG with procedurally generated worlds, adaptive AI, deep crafting, and story-driven quests. Shape your destiny through choices, combat intelligent foes, and forge legendary gear in an ever-evolving, immersive adventure.

details.title: Ayre Battles: Heritage Academy
details.short_description: A tactical card fighter where reactions, timing, prediction, and momentum matter. Build a 30-card deck, outplay your opponent with fighting game-inspired mechanics, and master strategic battles against an adaptive CPU or other players.

details.title: Everforge Legacy
details.short_description: Single-player action RPG inspired by Final Fantasy XI. Six Jobs, weapon skills, skillchains, elemental days, and Named hunts, rebuilt for one hero, with up to two Trusts at your side. Three origin stories through a complete Chapter 1 storyline.

details.title: Prohibition Panic!
details.short_description: Run a dusty speakeasy, alone or with 3 other players, determined to become the next underground sensation! Serve your patrons the booze and carry their drunk butts out of the parlor, all while hiding from the law, ready to take you in… or take some “gifts” from you.

details.title: Guardians of the Wall
details.short_description: Guardians of the Wall is a co-op action RPG where players fight through hordes and bosses beyond humanity’s last fortress. Fast hack-and-slash combat, unique heroes, and dynamic progression await.

details.title: Slime to Me
details.short_description: Guide your brother's soul, trapped inside a slime, by interacting with mana sources. Solve puzzles and find the path to the portals to bring his soul back home and return it to his body. Can you find the solution with the fewest clicks in each level?

details.title: XGA SPECIAL EDITION
details.short_description: Survive the nightmare of XGA! Trapped in the rotting corpse of a space station, you must explore, fight and hide in this intense Horror-Metroidvania! But remember, XGA is hunting you.... PROUDLY USING NO GENERATIVE AI

name: Master of Chaos: Beat or Break the Game

details.title: Master of Chaos: Beat or Break the Game
details.short_description: Pulverize your enemies for underestimating this cute little wizard by counter attacks, deflecting projectiles, unleashing face-melting ultimate abilities and building insane combos boosting your power until you are strong enough to beat the boss or break the game - Either way you win.

details.title: Branch by Branch
details.short_description: Branch by Branch is a co-op game where you build your way up an impossibly large tree, all the way to the moon! Build, collect and upgrade your way up through different environments and challenges, with up to 3 of your bestest pals.

details.title: Brawling Beetles
details.short_description: Die. Adapt. Fight Back. In this faced-paced top down multiplayer beetle brawler, every death makes you stronger. Choose between abilites, classes and weapons. Battle in matches with up to 4 players, fight PvE enemies, collect loot, and unleash powerful ultimates to claim victory.

details.title: Masked Up
details.short_description: Online Rogue-like Game. Choose a various characters and masks to defeat your enemies.

details.title: DEAD BLIND
details.short_description: DEAD BLIND is a 2–4 player dark gambling party game where you have 60 seconds to loot an abandoned lab, then risk your haul against your friends in a winner-take-all game of Texas Hold’em. The winner takes the cash. The rest hang.

name: Fairy Comedy: A Love Hard To Find

details.title: Fairy Comedy: A Love Hard To Find
details.short_description: 只能复述别人话语的鹦鹉精灵，该怎样向喜欢的女孩表达心意？扮演不谙世事的李素武，收集语句卡牌，在约会中努力接上她的话，也可能一不小心说出令人啼笑皆非的怪话！在这段融入轻度卡牌互动的恋爱视觉小说中，与徐清茗从相识走向相恋，在欢笑、心动与成长中，寻找属于自己的幸福。

details.title: Protocol Non-Human
details.short_description: A realistic first-person horror deduction game. Identify NON-HUMAN entities and navigate critical decisions within the Zone. Earn your survival, upgrade your booth, and-above all-don't let the NON-HUMANS in.

details.title: Croak
details.short_description: Tongue-grapple and pinball-bounce the frog prince across levels to reach the Witch’s Banquet in this hand-drawn 2D platformer. Each whimsical world has its own wacky boss, hidden collectibles, and a unique traversal ability. Grit your teeth! You're gonna CROAK. -DEMO OUT NOW!-

details.title: Death By Misstep
details.short_description: The robots can hear you breathe. Match your breathing to the music, stay out of sight and find a way off the Samos, a luxury cruise turned into a massacre. First-person horror and stealth where every breath can give you away.

details.title: Roam
details.short_description: "Roam" is a 2D Action-RPG platformer set in a procedurally generated world. Explore the surrounding lands and delve into the depths of mysterious caves that have lain hidden for centuries beneath the Azure Lake.

details.title: Feed Your T-Rex: Desktop Companion
details.short_description: A tiny T-Rex lives at the bottom of your screen while you work. Feed it rabbits, chickens and other critters. Once it's big enough, you can even feed it... humans! Decorate its Containment, keep it happy, and when it dies, use its DNA to breed an even better one.

details.title: Tearoom of Terror
details.short_description: Congratulations on your inheritance: one tearoom, one murdered aunt, 22 regulars who know where the *ahem* bodies are buried. Brew tea, bake treats and try to solve the mystery of your aunt's murder before Halloween - or end up on the menu yourself.

details.title: Wild Wild Eden
details.short_description: Survive a primitive fantasy world in Wild Wild Eden, an open-world survival crafting game where monsters are family. Pet, feed, and protect your companions. As a tribal chief, raise your monster friends, build a thriving base, and explore a harsh yet heartwarming world together.

details.title: Moochy
details.short_description: Your coins are your health. Spend them on guns, or hold onto them and stay alive longer — your call. Dumb co-op for 1 to 4.

details.title: Nox Mortalis
details.short_description: Nox Mortalis is a retro-style open world survival game where you must gather resources, craft essential gear, and explore sinister dungeons. Face hellish creatures and fight to survive in this world.

details.title: Little Cheese Works
details.short_description: [Co-op Action × Voice Chat] Work together to carry cheese without waking the cat! Use voice chat—but be careful, even small sounds can alert it. As overworked mice in a shady company, can you overcome traps and escape to a peaceful life?

details.title: Red Dust Colony
details.short_description: The spirit of the space race lives on in this Mars based colony sim. Mine, craft and research in order to build up your initial lander into a self sustaining colony. Keep oxygen levels high and CO₂ levels low. Discover and grow a variety of plants to balance out colonist nutrition.

details.title: Fantastic Haven
details.short_description: Restore the equilibrium of magic by saving endangered fantasy creatures. Build your shelter to welcome and protect them, explore unique regions, rally neighboring populations to your cause and rehabilitate creatures in their natural environment.

details.title: Centuries
details.short_description: Grow a small camp into a thriving medieval settlement. Shape its expansion, develop its economy and care for the households that call it home. Balance your ambitions with the everyday needs of a growing community.

details.title: SetPoint Volleyball
details.short_description: Build your athlete and hit the sand! SetPoint Volleyball blends arcade beach volleyball with competitive matches online or on the same couch. Serve, spike, block, challenge your friends and climb the ranked ladder. Just watch out for the seagulls.

details.title: Kardaviik
details.short_description: Kardaviik is a 3D factory automation game set in a voxel asteroid belt. Your mission: harness energy, ascend the Kardashev Scale, and save Earth. Conquer the expansive procedurally generated belt by harvesting resources and extracting fuel, and build your ultimate space factory!

details.title: As One We Survive
details.short_description: Survive in a harsh post-apocalyptic world. Scavenge resources, build up a homestead, form a community, and defend yourself against a lawless world in a challenging survival sandbox.

details.title: Martial Law: Our Spring
details.short_description: Grey blocks of flat, Militia and tanks on the streets, the desire for a better tomorrow and your drunk buddy on the bench. Welcome to Martial Law: Our Spring.

details.title: 14:  Overmind
details.short_description: 14: Overmind is a first-person survival adventure in a cosmos where anomalies warp space and gravity. Mine ore on asteroids, cut open wrecks with a laser, outfit your base, and upgrade your exosuit to uncover what caused the catastrophe and unravel the mystery of your origins.

details.title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2027
details.short_description: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!

details.title: Ascent: Rivals
details.short_description: Ascent Rivals is an Award-Winning Indie Combat Racer. Race. Shoot. Upgrade. Outplay Your Rivals.

details.title: Paleokin
details.short_description: Paleokin is a brutal prehistoric survival game set in an infinite procedural world. Fight mammoths and dinosaurs, build a settlement, farm the land, breed your own dinos, and stay alive. Alone or with friends.

details.title: A Little Less Desperation
details.short_description: When a peaceful farmer is abducted by an alien, he cannot imagine how this experience will turn him into a hero that needs to save the galaxy. Suddenly, alien abduction is funny again.

details.title: Unconventional Fantasy
details.short_description: I have blended card game and action game genres to create this unique deck-building game. Craft your one-of-a-kind deck, encounter quirky NPCs, discover powerful cards, make choices at every turn, uncover the secrets of this world bit by bit, and embark on an adventure in this otherworld!

details.title: INFINITE CHUMP
details.short_description: INFINITE CHUMP is an ultra-fast, boomer shooter roguelite tripfest where you graft spell-casting arms to your body. Put rings on your new fingers to create spells on the fly. Inspired by 90's FPS games with a trippy twist.

details.title: Another Door
details.short_description: Another Door is a multiplayer, turn-based roguelike with monsters, despair, risk and betrayal. Hide your intentions, bluff to survive and bet on your luck. Will you back out, or venture through Another Door?

details.title: Redneck Redemption
details.short_description: 100% authentic redneck alien hunting simulator. Drink, fight, stalk and piss your way through an alien invasion.

details.title: Car Rental Simulator
details.short_description: Car Rental Simulator tests your skills in management, marketing, and fulfilling customers' unexpected needs. Solo or in co-op! Grow a small rental company into a true empire in Winston Springs.

details.title: LightSup!
details.short_description: LightSup is a chaotic 1–4 player couch co-op adventure where darkness drains sanity while the Altar of Light keeps you alive. Battle monsters, gain powerful Blessings, endure dangerous Curses, and choose your path to save the world from an eternal eclipse.

details.title: BECROWNED
details.short_description: A non-linear survival horror drawing inspiration from the surrealist dark satire of VHS-era Horror and lurid atmosphere of classic Grindhouse cinema. Step into Richard Torrance's shoes and survive a complex web of relationships as you phase between industrial ruins and a tragic fantasy kingdom.

details.title: Stars of Icarus
details.short_description: From the devs of Guns of Icarus comes the ultimate spaceship PvP experience. Captain frigates, pilot fighters, and man the guns. In the forgotten arenas of space, communication with your crew is key. Victory or death, together.

details.title: Metropolis 1998
details.short_description: A fresh, modern city builder with charming aesthetics. Detailed agent-based simulation and scheduling. See inside buildings. Design and customize almost anything. Business-specific zoning, and mixed use zones too!

details.title: Fantasy Boy
details.short_description: Fantasy Boy is a 2D platformer that follows the adventures of Boy. Explore a fantasy world, battle numerous enemies, and most importantly, have FUN!

details.title: Legends of Castile
details.short_description: To fulfill her dream of becoming a nun, María de Salazar must outsmart the creatures of Castilian folklore using her wit and a mysterious bestiary in this comic fantasy point‑and‑click adventure set in 19th‑century Spain.

details.title: NAME OF THE WILL
details.short_description: You are trapped in HOPE, a masked cult where pain is salvation. Every thought is tallied. Every smile is a lie. Conform for happiness, or face your guilt to escape.

name: Burial for a Butterfly - a Singing World

details.title: Burial for a Butterfly - a Singing World
details.short_description: Learn to listen to the melody of this singing world and explore an ongoing slice of life story of my personal experience seeking refuge in the woods, befriending trees, talking with mysterious doomer owls, burying a butterfly and grieving the dying of species and forests.

details.title: Decurion
details.short_description: Decurion is a skill-based, top-down shooter about scoring under a one-shot, one-kill rule. You get the score via combo chaining while trying to defend your base.

details.title: Glowfall
details.short_description: Glowfall is a co-op survival shooter for 1–4 players. Head into an abandoned laboratory, fight off failed experiments, grab what loot you can and make it out alive — then sell your haul, gear up and go back in.

details.title: Project Polygon
details.short_description: 32 players. 5 rounds. Nobody is ever eliminated. Race, dive and tumble through a chaotic TV game show armed with Goat Launchers, Chicken Rays and Black Hole Bombs. Get knocked over, bounce back up and climb the scoreboard – the Final counts double!

details.title: Dungeon Man
details.short_description: A bullet-hell dungeon game where you use colored gems to match the enemy in order to deal damage. Each enemy type has a unique attack style. Shoot and Dodge as you search for the evil toilet snake which lies deep within the dungeon.

name: How Many Cockroaches Can You Kill?

details.title: How Many Cockroaches Can You Kill?
details.short_description: How many cockroaches can you kill before your stamina runs out? Before the Queen crawls out? Before the whole city is infested? Squash 50 roach species, grab the coins, upgrade, unlock bombs, lightning, meteors and a giant slipper, and find out in this fast incremental clicker.

details.title: The Button Effect
details.short_description: Every button has a purpose. In this short, minimalist first-person puzzler you explore a dense, interwoven architecture – a museum, full of hidden connections and spatial insights.

details.title: Titan: The Ascension
details.short_description: Titan: The Ascension is a colony management strategy game on Saturn’s moon Titan. Build and expand an off-world industrial colony, extract ice to produce water for Earth, trade resources, and defend against ancient automated systems that react to technology growth. Will you prevail?

details.title: Helmscape
details.short_description: Lead a party of fantasy heroes in action-packed battles...in SNAKE formation! Choose your party and venture forth into an ever-changing world as you discover new heroes and find better loot to keep gearing up.

details.title: Dungeon Roll
details.short_description: Descend beneath your family estate to uncover the truth about the crusader heroes of your bloodline, re-rolling your path floor by floor through a labyrinth built on real Crusades history. The souls of legendary crusaders grant you boons and the seven deadly sins guard the way down.

details.title: Razgovor Online
details.short_description: Razgovor Online is a Social MMORPG-Lite open world game, providing ways to explore, socialise, and grow, with Jobs, Mini-Games and player housing, or even taking long drives with your friends, the freedom is yours!

details.title: Dreaming Worlds
details.short_description: Dive into the dreaming worlds of the four dream keepers and find out why they don't answer anymore. Rescue the trapped inhabitants of the dream worlds, change the dreams back to good and discover mysterious places and puzzles. But something dark will stand in your way.

details.title: ForMind
details.short_description: A horror shooter set in the ZiroTech underwater complex, where every sector is a fight for life. Battle the infected, use the environment, hack terminals, and learn from mistakes. A time anomaly gives you a second chance — don't waste it.

details.title: CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134
details.short_description: CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134 is an intense horror/puzzle adventure game for PC and VR, set in an abandoned Soviet bunker. Seek safety by restoring power, lights, and machinery. Learn about the long-gone personnel, solve sinister riddles, and find a way to escape. But stay quiet... You’re not alone.

details.title: End Of World - Story
details.short_description: Colony Sim meets 2D Sci-fi Action RPG in End Of World - Story. Manage your space farm and recruit colonists among Space Apes, Sentient Penguins, Humans or Cyborg Beasts. Go on missions to exotic locations armed with quantum bombs, find the relic and triumph. Inspired by Among Us, Cult of the Lamb.

details.title: ecoSYSTEMS
details.short_description: Shape a living planet, study its shifting seasons, and build a resilient society across a world defined by climate, resources, and risk. Every civilization begins with understanding the world beneath it. Make thoughtful compromises and build a world that can withstand the scope of human impact.

details.title: Wick & Slate
details.short_description: Descend into a malice-soaked underworld in this intensely oppressive single-player "loot, fight, extract" roguelite deckbuilder. Play as a Stone Folk hero, battling monsters in a grotesque gamble. Build your deck mid-run, scavenge eyeballs and skulls, dissect bosses for mystery rewards.

details.title: 仙侠涤尘箓
details.short_description: 《Xian Xia Di Chen Lu》is an open world ARPG game that includes real-time combat, dating development, and multiple plot side options. Its unique feature is that the combat system adopts a rare move mode in RPG genre, hoping to bring players a different experience.
developers: 常州市华蓝德软件科技有限公司
publishers: 常州市华蓝德软件科技有限公司

details.title: Stop the Crawl
details.short_description: Stop the Crawl is a roguelike autobattler where you assemble a deck of monsters to defeat the invading heroes. Discover which monsters work well together, strengthen them with items, and create an unstoppable team.

details.title: Card To Conquer
details.short_description: Conquer your enemies in this roguelike deckbuilder. Win by upgrading your deck, purchasing powerful items and combining your cards in battle to find overpowered synergies.

details.title: RoomRun
details.short_description: Roomrun is a simple yet action-packed local multiplayer retro-style running game for one to four players. Run through trap-filled rooms, use the environment to your advantage, play safe and slow or fast and risky and try to reach the finish line before your friends do!

details.title: Hellsplit: Labyrinth
details.short_description: A rogue-like VR action RPG with brutal, physics-driven medieval combat. Collect seven crystal shards across procedural dungeons. You get one life. No second chances.

details.title: Insect Worlds
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of insects. Explore fascinating forests and learn about their way of life. Complete quests and mini-games, fight or collect resources and cards. Admire the microcosm from a completely different perspective and learn new facts about plants and insects.

details.title: Gap Year
details.short_description: Gap Year is a story-focused point & click adventure played through comic book panels that reconfigure as you explore Vera Novak’s one-bedroom apartment. Vera is a bright young scientist, but the arrival of an unexpected guest and a strange fixation with a cosmonaut may derail her academic pursuits.

details.title: SHUNYA
details.short_description: One moves, one draws—you control both at once. In this pixel-art puzzle game, draw Earth, Water, Fire, and Wind magic cubes to reshape the environment. Bound by a magical chain, a girl and a floating cat must escape the mysterious Otherworld and find their way home.

details.title: Ninkyo Dantai
details.short_description: Ninkyo Dantai is a 3D top-down, role-playing video game developed by TeamCS1. It is the first mainline title in the Ninkyo Dantai franchise developed as a turn-based RPG.

details.title: Wishbound
details.short_description: An ancient djinn has awakened but some bonds are stronger than magic! Help Erika and her friends face the supernatural together in this story-driven turn-based RPG. Explore the city, customise your party and uncover mysteries. Every moment brings you closer to saving the city - and each other.

details.title: BURN IT ALL DOWN
details.short_description: Sneak around and BURN IT ALL DOWN! Use everything at your disposal to target key political figures and structures as you fight to free the people of New London from the oppressive grip of the Puppet Master in this Orwellian-inspired VR immersive sim.

details.title: Dunderbeck
details.short_description: Cincinatti: The Queen City, the Paris of America, Porkopolis. This city is a mess, Dunderbeck. Your job is to fight that mess, build with that mess and - I'm sorry to say - eat that mess. It's a dirty job, but that's how the sausage is made.

details.title: Alpine Lake
details.short_description: Build, decorate, and customize every detail of your inn to welcome guests to your cozy escape in the woods. Entertain tourists, farm, cook meals, research wildlife, and ski, all while helping a colorful cast of townspeople save the struggling mountain town from a hostile takeover.

details.title: Shrooms
details.short_description: Explore a dark isometric forest alone or in 1–4 player co-op. Gather and test hundreds of ingredients, brew potions and monster oils, build a home, and uncover why a dwarf village has held exactly thirty-four souls for two centuries.

details.title: Demon Spore
details.short_description: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.

details.title: Into The Haunted Land
details.short_description: An online co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Team up with your friends to explore ruins, loot cursed items, hide from monsters and extract safely. Do whatever it takes to meet the Guild’s quota.

details.title: Vampire Rancher
details.short_description: Rancher by day, Vampire by night. Manage your time and resources to restore your sleepy little town to its former glory, all while satisfying your vampire needs for blood. Oversee shops and saloons, farm crops and humans, and explore ancient vampiric ruins in the Weird Wild West!

details.title: Sirens
details.short_description: Become a deadly Siren and hunt down the most dangerous sea creatures that have ever swim in the depths of the oceans! Experience a fascinating journey through the world as seen from the perspective of Sirens at various stages of their evolution.

details.title: Hexforger
details.short_description: Craft your spells in ONLINE CO-OP with your friends in this SURVIVORS-LIKE! Slaughter monsters, gain gold, upgrade your spells to infinite heights. Crush challenges and unlock new spells, upgrades, pickups, realms. Up to 4 players in this unique twist on the survivors-like formula!

details.title: Highreach
details.short_description: When calamity struck, the world of Highreach was shattered. In this open-world survival game, build encampments, rescue survivors, and soar across the skies on your airship to explore a lost world and uncover the truth.

name: Path of Ambition: The Sun Rise

details.title: Path of Ambition: The Sun Rise
details.short_description: 《異麒麟：初入江湖》是一款以東漢末年為背景的高自由度武俠 CRPG。 你將扮演一位與妹妹相依為命的流民少年，在黃巾之亂尚未爆發的邊境安身立命。從一無所有開始，學武、謀生、遊歷城鎮與荒野，結交形形色色的江湖人物，也在一次次對話、事件、檢定與抉擇中，決定自己要如何在這個時代活下去！

details.title: Mist Of Time
details.short_description: Embark on a thrilling, historically accurate medieval adventure in this point-and-click MMORPG! Enjoy a simple yet addicting experience with an old-school vibe, rich content, and realistic gameplay. Dive into a unique world where casual clicking leads to endless discoveries, battles, and rewards!

details.title: Star Wrath
details.short_description: Star Wrath is a multiplayer space extraction-action where you design your own ship and fight other players for resources in intense PvP and PvE battles.

details.title: Police Stories 2
details.short_description: Serve the law. Protect the innocent. Command the grittiest precinct in town in Police Stories 2 - a brutal tactical top-down shooter where arrest is the goal, force is the last resort, and every decision has an outcome.

name: The Big Cleanup: Hotel Palm Beach

details.title: The Big Cleanup: Hotel Palm Beach
details.short_description: A physics-driven cleanup simulator. Put 1,000+ scattered objects where they belong using physics and your trusty van. Decorate however you want. Throw it. Organize it. Clean it. Help your aunt clean up this mess! Oh, and don’t forget your aunt’s grumpy chicken. She’s not exactly in the mood to help.

details.title: Ice Cream Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run a seaside ice cream shop solo or in co-op with up to 6 players. Make ice cream, serve unpredictable customers, earn money, unlock new equipment, and expand and customize your shop as each day gets more chaotic.

details.title: Abelina
details.short_description: A surreal, hand-crafted adventure platformer. Vasily died and woke up in Abelina, a settlement in the afterlife. Now he’s heading into the frontier with his companions following behind. No combat, just a vast world to explore and a mature story about carrying life’s baggage into the afterlife.

details.title: Village vs Rock
details.short_description: Village vs Rock is a physics based incremental game about crushing mountains. Raise your village of orcs to wage war against the rock that keeps popping up in your backyard. Hurl mammoths, unleash spells, and upgrade everything to DESTROY THE ROCK!

details.title: Lost Arsenal
details.short_description: Lost Arsenal is a challenging movement-heavy melee action game. Stylishly maneuver through areas by teleporting to your thrown weapons, and use each weapon's unique power to carve your way through a summoner's invasion.

details.title: Blue Book
details.short_description: Blue Book is a sci-fi detective quest with point'n'click elements, where there are no hints, there are false clues and only your conclusion. Analyze testimonies, find inconsistencies, follow the logic. Become an FBI agent and unravel a chain of mysterious disappearances in a quiet American town.

details.title: The Mirage Project
details.short_description: A first-person sci-fi horror game where you explore an abandoned research facility, travel through different timelines using a broken time machine, and uncover shifting, liminal spaces created by the Mirage. Survive evolving shadow-like entities and uncover the facility’s dark secrets.

details.title: Hextalia
details.short_description: Build the path. Then defend it. Hextalia is a hex-based tower defense where you control the battlefield. Shape enemy routes with your towers, combine abilities to discover your own build combinations, and survive levels that punish careless builds.

details.title: Pact, Passion, Puchimon!
details.short_description: Journey across a continent teeming with diverse monsters! Capture them through intense bullet-hell battles and grow stronger together. With an in-depth nurturing system, you can build bonds with your "Puchimon" to unlock exclusive storylines and turn them into your ultimate battle partners!

details.title: Crypts Of Carith
details.short_description: Explore the village of Carith, dank sewers, forgotten cellars, and ancient tombs, battle deadly creatures, and uncover powerful loot in this classic party-based dungeon crawling RPG built on a familiar D20 system.

details.title: Five More Minutes
details.short_description: Build your deck and strategize to defeat foes as you traverse videogame worlds. Choose between 3 unique starting genres, and combine them to create unstoppable combos! Five more minutes is a love letter to growing up with the emotional support of our best friend: videogames.

details.title: Nighthold
details.short_description: Sandbox survival RPG where days are for preparation and nights are for survival. Gather resources, build and fortify your shelter, fight the Rot and raiders - solo or with friends in online co-op.

details.title: Black Flame Tactics
details.short_description: A dark fantasy autobattler roguelike. Build your party and lead it to the bottom of the world, where the Black Flame burns. Every run brings new heroes, relics, mysterious events, bosses, ancient pacts and more. Brave the descent solo or with a friend in online co-op.

details.title: Broken Relic
details.short_description: On his first day as an archive intern, Tim unleashes an ancient conqueror and gets fired. Now the boss who fired him is relying on him to save the world. A fully voiced fantasy point-and-click comedy.

details.title: SLAMTOWN - Brawl Together
details.short_description: SLAMTOWN is a co-op beat 'em up arcade style 2.5D game for 1–4 players — punch, kick and throw enemies at your teammates for devastating chain combos. Slam bosses with powerful and unique arena movements and make your way through a city where wrestling is the only law.

details.title: JOIN US
details.short_description: Start a doomsday cult of your very own! Recruit followers, build your compound, customize your cult’s beliefs, and defeat enemies in this 1-4 player co-op, action-packed, open-world survival experience. Can you survive the Apocalypse?

details.title: Teamcrafter
details.short_description: Gather resources, craft powerful gear, and build the perfect adventuring party in Teamcrafter, a cozy crafting roguelite where your heroes fight the battles, but you craft the victories. Explore serene procedural biomes, optimize your team’s build load out, and uncover the mystery of the Portals.

details.title: Mushroom Hunter Simulator
details.short_description: A relaxing mushroom-foraging simulator. Explore the forest, discover rare mushrooms, appraise their worth, then dry or pickle your finds. Enjoy enchanting nature and relax far from the bustle of the city.

details.title: Lemonade Apocalypse
details.short_description: Make money selling lemonade. Optimise your product. Build your workforce. Sell, sell, sell. But money is not enough. Become president! Fuel climate change! Manipulate geopolitical events! Lemonade Apocalypse is an incremental game about business decisions that are technically legal.

details.title: Helcast
details.short_description: Fight your way from the Underworld to the gates of Asgard in a turn-based, merge-puzzle roguelite deckbuilder rooted in Norse mythology. Assemble godslaying builds and battle the unleashed dead by combining weapons, weighing velocity and mass with every shot to chain physics-driven merge combos.

details.title: Elemency Island
details.short_description: Elemency Island is a cozy farm and automation game in coop multiplayer. Plant, raise animals, sell your ressources to unlock technologies and automate your entire farm. Alone, or with your friends, come discover this island full of surprises and unknown creatures.

details.title: We Build Below
details.short_description: Get rich or get eaten. Build underground factories, automate production and defend against parasites in this 1-3 player co-op roguelite.

name: Road Survival: Bigger on the Inside

details.title: Road Survival: Bigger on the Inside
details.short_description: In a toxic, zombie-ridden wasteland, survival is brutal. Upgrade your RV into a foldable-space mobile base—farm, craft, gather resources, and fend off the undead to build your last safe haven.

details.title: The Immolation Apartment
details.short_description: An ancient cult lurks in an old apartment; a mother sacrifices her daughter. A decade later, her son enters the Netherworld to save his family from a deity’s torment, evading spirits to reach "Penglai Island" and destroy the Soul-Refining Furnace. Uncanny Abode blends 1990s Taiwan with cult horror.

details.title: Cruise Control
details.short_description: Manage a cruise ship in this time-management strategy game! Build the dream cruise experience for your guests, work fast to solve problems, keep up with demand, upgrade your offerings to make every voyage even better, and keep the chaos from going overboard!

details.title: Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter
details.short_description: Beat up punks in fast isometric combat, then win them over with burgers from your food truck. Brawl through the city, upgrade your kitchen, learn combat moves, and unlock new neighbourhoods. Grab your spatula and take back the streets!

details.title: Diatonic
details.short_description: Diatonic is a piano roguelike that sharpens your sight-reading. Learn songs one run at a time, no matter your skill level. Best played with a MIDI keyboard.

details.title: Shit-Stealing Gnomes
details.short_description: Co-op adventure in which you play as little gnomes robbing houses. Be stealthy and steal the dirtiest things you can find.

details.title: INTERVOID
details.short_description: A co-op horror game for 2–4 players. You have been brought back from the dead to uncover what happened in an underground complex. Solve its puzzles, survive its trials, and stop the one who killed you.

details.title: TFZP: The F*ing Zombie Project
details.short_description: Endless waves. Endless zombies. Team up in this co-op survival shooter: grab new guns, upgrade the ones you already have, and unlock even deadlier firepower. The horde grows every round, make sure your last stand counts.

details.title: Deeper
details.short_description: Your mission is to recover lost and forgotten artifacts. Set out with your crew on underwater expeditions ever more hostile, ever darker, ever deeper...

details.title: Glintland
details.short_description: Glintland is a magical factory-building card puzzler. Place tiles from a deck to build enchanting production chains, light up the land, and discover a cozy world full of secrets. Each Glint is a short, satisfying journey of automation and alchemy.

details.title: Never Be Alone
details.short_description: Never Be Alone is an open-world zombie survival game for solo play and seamless co-op. Explore a world reclaimed by nature, protect a fragile safezone, and uncover the truth behind your forgotten past 10 years after the outbreak.

details.title: Underground: World War
details.short_description: A brand new game inspired by the Def Jam series. Create your own fighter or play as some of your favorite rappers in this over the top fighting game.

details.title: Come to my party!
details.short_description: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming-of-age story where every choice carries weight.

details.title: Shine On, My Little Sun
details.short_description: When the Sun fell, darkness covered the world. In the snowy wasteland, the town of Svargo thrived under its faint light. But the Sun did not go out. The small Sun sleeps atop a grim lighthouse. What happens when the Sun awakens, seeking a few days of simple childhood?

details.title: Thalassomania
details.short_description: A PS1-style co-op horror game for 1–4 players. Set at sea, you run a fishing trawler with your crew. Haul, gut, steer and repair while something lurks in the shadows. Keep the ship alive. Get home. You're not alone out there.

details.title: MR. RECORDS
details.short_description: ​Meet George, an old dreamer with an extraordinary gift that lets him transcend through music. After a lifetime of standing still, he breaks free from routine and opens the store he always wished for. ​

details.title: ON ANY JOURNEY
details.short_description: Designed exclusively for two players, < On Any Journey > is a co-op adventure packed with varied gameplay challenges that call for teamwork, coordination and a healthy dose of sabotage. Play locally or online with a friend!

details.title: Starfinder: Afterlight
details.short_description: Starfinder: Afterlight is a party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well, save the galaxy while you're at it!

details.title: Deserter
details.short_description: An immersive isometric stealth RPG about a thief surviving in a decaying totalitarian city. Plan every move, evade traps, and pull off daring heists right under the Party's nose.

details.title: Uncanny Valley: Checkpoint
details.short_description: Pass. Quarantine. Kill. Run a Soviet checkpoint together in co-op after a nuclear meltdown unleashes a viral mutagen. Inspect papers, spot lies, and judge twisted bodies while battling radiation, paranoia, and the deadly cost of every mistake.

details.title: Bit by Bit
details.short_description: Build a ridiculous game with your friends in minutes, then jump in and play it together. Draw the weapons & items, record the sound effects, draw the world, modify the rules and see what kind of cursed game your group creates.

details.title: SPACE WALK
details.short_description: SPACE WALK is a hands-on first-person astronaut simulation where you operate an orbital station and conduct surface expeditions across the Moon.

details.title: Shepherd's Plan
details.short_description: An office point-and-click puzzle game mixed with visual novel-style storytelling set in a noir-fabled world. As you are fired from the job, to save yourself from a collapsing dream, it’s time to investigate, discover the black company’s secrets, and take sweet revenge for the money you deserve.

details.title: Roguebound Pirates
details.short_description: Loot, upgrade & dominate! Your inventory IS your ship in this action roguelike. Customize weapons, create game-breaking synergies, and claim your place as the most overpowered pirate across the seas!

name: おばけなんて怖くないJK　VS　学校迷宮

details.title: おばけなんて怖くないJK　VS　学校迷宮
details.short_description: Curious about horror but bad with scary things? This is a not-so-scary horror game made by a developer who feels the same way, created for players who want to enjoy horror without being truly frightened. A pixel-art side-scrolling action adventure with puzzles and light action elements.

name: Air War General - WW2 Air Force Wargame

details.title: Air War General - WW2 Air Force Wargame
details.short_description: WW2 turn-based aircraft war game that puts you in the USAAF/USAF, RAF or Luftwaffe air operations HQs. Build your squadrons, wings, air bases & pilots. Engage in bombing missions, dogfights & interceptions over Britain, N. Africa & Europe. Historical & what-if fighter/bomber airplane game scenarios

details.title: Gearomancer
details.short_description: Step into the mechanical apocalypse in Gearomancer, a fast-paced twin-stick action roguelite. Play as elite V.E.R.T.E.X. agents to dodge brutal bullet hells and obliterate elemental horrors. Harvest Arcane crystals, forge permanent upgrades at your hub, and die to return stronger than ever.

details.title: SKEW
details.short_description: A first-person atmospheric exploration game set in dreamlike liminal spaces, with no monsters, combat, or jump scares.

details.title: No One Returns
details.short_description: Have you ever wondered what happens if you wake up and everyone is simply gone? No One Returns is a third-person survival horror game. Play as Denis, search a chillingly silent city for clues about your missing family while fighting the frightening zombies swarming the streets.

details.title: Map Roleplay Maker
details.short_description: Map Roleplay Maker is a simulation program designed for players to create worlds, simulate them, and use them for external roleplaying purposes. Design maps, customize nations, and use a variety of species to spice up your own world!

details.title: Boopie Island
details.short_description: Build a cozy village for your Boopies! Keep them happy with swings, flowers, and plenty of cozy surprises. Assign professions to them and enjoy watching your village grow.

details.title: MÁG
details.short_description: Be a mage, a God of control. Learn to to solve combat situations with a wide variety of spells. Summon minions, paralyze enemies, wall them off, burn them, poison them, and more. If you die, you lose all that you carry. Some enemies are dumb and easy to fight, some will make you cry.

details.title: Dig to Mole Dorado
details.short_description: Burrow deep into the earth in this short incremental digging game. Hunt for treasure, upgrade your powers and experience the low-key story of a mole and his dad on a grand adventure.

details.title: Cyberwars
details.short_description: A turn-based tactics roguelike where you run a mercenary company. Draft and deploy a deck of soldiers and vehicles, hire new mercenaries in the field, take territory against an AI opponent or your friends on hand-built maps, and clear contracts before the week timer ticks to zero and the run ends.

details.title: Spiretela
details.short_description: Climb the tower, defeat powerful enemies, and uncover the cause of a cosmic instability in this intense roguelike adventure.

details.title: Syntherion
details.short_description: Syntherion is a top-down space shooter in which each level is built around a single song. The weapons, enemies, environment, and objectives are all derived from that licensed track. The library spans 20+ artists that have signed on, and is still growing.

details.title: Orb in the Deep Waters
details.short_description: A dark underwater roguelite built around sound and darkness. Use your sonar to navigate the abyss, hunt fragments, and survive what lurks in the deep. Fail. Learn. Descend again.

details.title: Wandering Dice
details.short_description: Wandering Dice is a Wuxia Roguelike deckbuilder where every strike is a die. Waking in a snowy valley, even peerless kungfu requires a lucky roll. Every battle is a high-stakes gamble; life and death hinge on a single toss. Can you sever the threads of fate in this vast Jianghu?

details.title: Cubalance
details.short_description: In this physics-based puzzler, color matching is only half the battle. Balance scales or launch cubes across the screen with weight-shifting chain reactions. Do you think you’re a master of logic? Meet Gravity. Let’s see how you handle the pressure when the floor starts tipping.

details.title: Dough it Yourself
details.short_description: Run a cozy bakery where every ingredient comes from your own farm. Grow crops, raise animals, and turn your harvest into flour, butter and jam. Bake fresh bread, serve hungry customers, get to know the regulars, and grow your bakery one step at a time.

details.title: Parry the Bullet
details.short_description: Parry the Bullet is a fast-paced one-hit-kill top-down action. Parry, slash and shoot your way through an army of gunslinger crows as a chicken knight seeking revenge.

details.title: Build To The Moon
details.short_description: A relaxing incremental tower builder—until hundreds of tiny workers turn it into complete chaos.

details.title: Dreadmark Outlaws
details.short_description: The West is dead. You’re not. Yet. Enter a grim Wild West overrun by the undead, build deadly defenses and turn every last stand into glorious chaos — alone or with your friends. Survive the night. Become an outlaw legend.

details.title: LAG KILLS
