details.short_description: Desperate and out of options, you break into what you thought was an empty house, but little do you know the owner is home, and you're his prey. LOOT, HIDE, SURVIVE and ESCAPE alone or with a friend.

details.title: Untamed Ehizia
details.short_description: Untamed Ehizia is a sandbox MMORPG with unusual game mechanics built around cooperation and social interactions. Come with friends or find new ones, and tame the world of Ehizia together.

details.title: Top Drifters
details.short_description: A minimalistic top-down racer with simple old-school arcade controls, Experience physics-based, drift-focused driving at ultra-high-speed. Master 10+ different cars with unique driving stats. Challenge your friends online in 20+ semi-destructible, chaotic races and become the world's "Top Drifter".

details.title: RUNE GUNNER
details.short_description: RUNE GUNNER is a 1-4 player co-op roguelite shooter where you combine guns and magic to create game-breaking synergies. Each room hits harder, so you must mix classes mid-run and collect runes to become overpowered.

details.title: Contract Cafe
details.short_description: A letter from your Master brings a mysterious girl into your life. But the first thing you need to face is a café that could go out of business at any moment. Amidst your efforts to rescue the café and navigate peculiar customers, secrets about the shop begin to surface...

details.title: Rebel Roar
details.short_description: Build two decks at once in REBEL ROAR, a tactical deckbuilding roguelike where each rebel unlocks a different way to play. Combine an animal deck with a class deck to create Ninja Cats, Hacker Opossums, and hundreds of unique builds as you lead the rebellion through a cyberpunk animal world.

details.title: Codebreakers VR
details.short_description: Codebreakers is a chaotic VR Action Shooter that takes place in a dystopian future where various organizations are fighting for control of the world order.As a breaker, you will have to infiltrate, defeat enemies and avoid security systems to extract data.

details.title: The Disappearance of Emily Crowe
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror built on stealth and dread. Raise your real phone to reveal what your screen can't — hidden threats, impossible paths, and the truth about a sister who vanished 15 years ago. What took Emily never left, and it remembers you.

details.title: Greedspire
details.short_description: Build powerful gear combos in a push-your-luck roguelike auto-battler. Enchant your gear to +20 or watch it shatter. Move to the next floor, or risk your entire run for richer loot in deadlier rooms. 100 floors. One life. How greedy will you get?

details.title: H.A.I.N
details.short_description: H.A.I.N: Heir of the Ancient Immortal Necromancer is an asymmetrical co-op horror/thriller game for 1–4 players. Explore hostile regions, collect ancient artifacts, and begin the final ritual. But one of you will become H.A.I.N, the betrayer, and trust will collapse.

details.title: Bosslife Office Manager
details.short_description: Set up your own office. Expand your office as you wish. Transform from a small office to a large company.Don't forget to make your employees happy too.

details.title: Nonolith
details.short_description: The NONOLITH consumes you. Copy and paste the world around you to discover the secrets of this ancient, enigmatic structure. You are very powerful, you just don't know it yet.

details.title: BeNormal
details.short_description: Be Normal is a comedy simulation game where you send an agent to infiltrate human society and pave the way for an alien invasion. From the cockpit of your spaceship, you can give your agent voice commands. The key is to convince the earthlings that you're a perfectly normal human.

details.title: Creep Tank
details.short_description: Build and customize your own arcane aquarium in this cozy collection/idler game. Use your magic to summon juvenile cute creepy fish. Tend to them and watch them grow. Make discoveries, expand your collection, decorate your tanks with art and plants.

details.title: Call Of Resistance
details.short_description: Call of Resistance is a real-time tactics game where you lead a group of resistance fighters in occupied France during World War II. Step into the shoes of shadowy heroes and discover the sacrifices and strategies needed to stand against the enemy

details.title: Crafters Heaven
details.short_description: Crafters Heaven is a lowpoly RPG sandbox where you design and build your own items piece by piece. Create unique weapons, tools and equipment, build your base, fight wild creatures, and explore an open world full of secrets! Demo coming soon!

details.title: Bygoner
details.short_description: A medieval road-movie parable blending rogue-lite action and journey management, wrapped in vintage cinema aesthetics. Follow a nameless knight through the southern lands of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania (modern-day Ukraine) at the beginning of the 16th century.

details.title: Punch Punch!
details.short_description: 在节奏明快的夏日小镇中参与单词挑战！输入单词、连续出拳，把敌人痛快击飞！与小镇居民轻松互动，通过基于记忆曲线的复习机制，让背单词更有趣，也记得更加牢固。

details.title: Lots at Stake
details.short_description: Build a property development company from the ground up. Find undervalued land, negotiate acquisitions, design profitable estates, navigate planning and construction, finance your projects and sell into a changing property market where every decision affects your return.

details.title: Grav My Balls
details.short_description: Grav your balls and let them fly! You are trapped and must escape with the help of the strange tech built into your hands. Launch your balls to change gravity on objects blocking your path. Use your mind and your new powers to solve gravity and mind bending puzzles.

details.title: Drudgemark
details.short_description: The dark marches on the King's Realm and you stand at its border. Forge steel, build up your keep and command your soldiers in formation. Then draw your own blade and fight beside them in first person, alone or with your friends in co-op.

details.title: The Alchemist Of Alderglen
details.short_description: The Alchemist of Alderglen is an alchemist simulator where you nurture rare plants, harvest exotic ingredients, and brew potions using your recipe book and alchemy tools. Unlock new plants, upgrade your workspace and run a thriving potion shop.

details.title: WorldWasGray
details.short_description: A relaxing game about painting a gray world back to life.

details.title: Kwad
details.short_description: Kwad is a snappy, grid-based puzzle game where you play as a square. Jump, snap, and merge with other Kwads to morph your way through clever spatial challenges.

details.title: Shuffle Farm
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where farming meets the arcane. Build powerful synergies, master production chains, explore uncharted lands, and face formidable challenges - all with the help of a mysterious god. Or just chill and plant some crops... you can do that too!

details.title: Hidengen
details.short_description: Hidengen is an atmospheric PvP shooter featuring stealth and vertical combat. Only one will survive. Victory requires not just strength, but cunning. Use your jetpack, shadows, height, and weather conditions to your advantage.

details.title: SONDER: Embrace The World
details.short_description: Time flows back and forth in this narrative, open-world cavern, harbouring a young research civilisation in the face of disaster. Embrace environmental clues that add up to an interwoven story of fear, resolve and a constant sense of discovery, defying the laws of time and space.

details.title: FriendOS
details.short_description: FriendOS is a 1-3 player action RPG where viruses must die! Strike and batter your opponents in Cartoon Sports Combat, and create the virtual animal avatar of your dreams. Hang out in lobbies with up to 12 friends and team up to protect the world of FriendOS from virus corruption.

details.title: Forest Keeper Lookout
details.short_description: Take a temporary job as a forest ranger deep in the mountains. Complete daily tasks, maintain equipment, and enjoy the quiet, until strange things start to happen.

details.title: First Age
details.short_description: A turn-based strategy card game set in the Neolithic Age. Sacrifice villagers, tame mammoths, and build powerful card synergies to lead your tribe through the threat of the Dark Ages. Will your people stand the test of time?

details.title: Battlecaster 2
details.short_description: Battlecaster 2 is an intense top-down action roguelite. Descend to the center of a hostile world where control, precision, and aggression decide every fight. Push forward and dismantle enemy pressure through skillful play. Shape powerful, expressive builds as danger rises.

details.title: My Axion Shop
details.short_description: Build your own Axion shop, collect rare parts, create powerful combinations, and battle your way to becoming a Pro Axioner! My Axion Shop offers a unique gaming experience blending strategy, trading, and collection elements.

details.title: Bookie
details.short_description: The horse racing roguelike, with cards. Bookie is a fast paced deckbuilder game, in which you build your own stable of horses and try to figure out which one will win the race. Manipulate the odds by modifying the cards and buying game-changing charms that will help you get all the trophies!

details.title: The Mighty Wizard's Tale
details.short_description: Retro party-based, turn-based, grid-based RPG like games from the 80's and early 90's. Combat similar to the Bard's Tale with stat scaling like Might and Magic, and optional roguelike gameplay.

details.title: Bonds of the Zodiac
details.short_description: Rei, a grieving girl, is drawn into a mystical realm where the Zodiac spirits are bound by the Jade Emperor. Mediate their inner struggles and guide them toward freedom in a first-person journey steeped in myth, conflict, and emotion.

details.title: Rookie Taoist
details.short_description: A co-op survival horror game rooted in Chinese folk traditions. Team up with 1–4 players to survive haunted locations, use ritual tools, uncover hidden truths, and escape the grip of evil. But beware—your arrival may only be the beginning of a greater nightmare...

details.title: Reng Azure Requiem
details.short_description: No jumping. Only 4-way teleportation. Travel through eras, collect Skill Gravestones, defeat bosses, explore armor sets, and choose your final act in search of resurrection in this 2D pixel art Metroidvania.

details.title: PC Versus
details.short_description: The first ever competitive PC building game. Go head to head with another player on the same task and budget, pick from 800+ real components and overclock for an edge. Push too hard and your build crashes. Free to play.

details.title: Ultra Damage
details.short_description: Ultra Damage is a hand-drawn Boomer Shooter packed with humor and action, featuring hand-crafted visuals and a story blending gritty detective work with absurd comedy. Each level is a wild ride. Unravel the mystery, find hidden clues, and deal ultra damage to save humanity!

details.title: Small Living World 2
details.short_description: Is a peaceful ecosystem simulator, bringing every aspect of nature to life. From the water cycle and plant growth, to animal behaviors and reproduction, observe your small living world evolve. All the tools are at your disposal to create your perfect forest.

details.title: Margin of Error
details.short_description: Princess Elyra is bound to a cursed grimoire. Lead her party through six monster-filled regions in this deckb-building roguelite RPG, where every attack is a numbers puzzle: play number and operation cards to hit each enemy’s exact target. Miss it, and the monster makes you pay.

details.title: Rollout Rally
details.short_description: Race solo or with friends in Rollout Rally, a physics-based marble racing party game. Play with up to 4 players in split-screen on one PC, or up to 6 online or over LAN. Team up in 3v3 races, steer, boost, shove rivals with Pulse, block hits with Shield and roll to victory!

details.title: Yatai Master
details.short_description: Run Neko Ramen, the street food stall you inherited in Fukuoka, for one last year. Shop at the markets, cook more than 100 dishes by hand, and get to know 40 regulars who come back night after night with their own stories.

details.title: Hunt for the Lost Folktales
details.short_description: A folklore hunting, turn-based battling, creature collector adventure where you follow trails to hunt escaped folktale beasts, engage in strategic tactical battles where fear is your strength, and capture the lost folktales so they may live on in memory. Will you be another folktale to be written?

details.title: Pinkwilds
details.short_description: A sci-fi multiplayer survival RPG with no guns - fight with weapons and magic instead. Explore an alien world, gather resources, craft gear, and build your base. Trade, form alliances, raid, or betray other players to survive.

details.title: Born Without Rights
details.short_description: Born Without Rights is a third-person, story-driven action-adventure with stealth, gunfights, and exploration. Inspired by The Last of Us and Max Payne, experience a tense linear story of survival and resistance in a world without freedom.

details.title: Shapesetter
details.short_description: An open-ended puzzle game about building machines that make modernist art. Program mechanical arms to paint, cut and weld shapes into finished pieces, then refine your machine to be faster, smaller or cheaper.

details.title: Astrobound
details.short_description: Survive and explore space in Astrobound! Visit strange planets, encounter cosmic calamities, and keep your crew alive as you journey through the stars in a retro-inspired whimsical space adventure.

name: Karakam: Call of The Dark Manor

details.title: Karakam: Call of The Dark Manor
details.short_description: Karakam: Call of the Dark Manor is a first person psychological horror game where you explore a cursed manor of a long forgotten bloodline. Solve riddles, explore the grounds and discover the horror stories hidden within the horror story. Dark Manor summons you, how will you answer it?

details.title: 骤雨终日
details.short_description: "Endless Rain"is a pixel plot game driven by dialogue that incorporates elements of suspense, crime, humor, and more. Players will explore the truth behind a murder case in two different time and space, gradually uncovering the true face of a small town shrouded in the haze of the past.

details.title: Humanity Echo: Cyberpunk Tactical RPG
details.short_description: Humanity Echo is a turn-based tactical RPG set in cyberpunk Odesa, 2044. Lead a squad as an engineer: prepare for every contract, fight from cover, overload transformers, set off explosive barrels, loot better gear, and make choices the people around you will remember.

details.title: Auto Grind: Dungeons
details.short_description: AUTO GRIND: DUNGEONS is a singleplayer auto-attack dungeon crawler that fuses party management with snap decisions. Build your party, synergize skills and masteries, discover unique relics, craft items and adapt your allies' combat tactics in real time as you fight your way through enemy hordes!

details.title: Ascend and Fall
details.short_description: Ascend and Fall is a dark-fantasy multiplayer autobattler where the order of your spells decides the outcome. Build your spell loadout, fight monsters for loot, and unleash powerful arcane combos against rival players. Sequence your magic right to rise while they fall.

details.title: Rhea of the Remnant
details.short_description: “Rhea of the Remnant” is a mecha Tactical RPG where you command a small group of allies to take on a powerful enemy force. Anticipate enemy moves, combine your allies' abilities, and devise the best strategy to secure victory!

details.title: Liar-for-hire
details.short_description: Follow the new worker of the disinformation agency day by day. Decide how to oppose news and people through the use of fake scandals and redirections. Ensure a win for your employers - or find some conscience after all.

details.title: ExoDomia
details.short_description: Exodomia is a narrative-driven, action-adventure game set on the robotic world of Salakar V! In this fast-paced combat experience, you will encounter many dangerous creatures and enemies as you navigate a story of struggle and survival.

details.title: Mewts
details.short_description: Handcrafted party Clayhem! A PvP game full of chaos and innocent violence. Fight your friends or challenge bots. Play as Mewts, cute, wiggly creatures. Use your body as a slingshot and hit each other! Play a variety of game modes in handcrafted clay arenas!

details.title: Woodland Werewolf
details.short_description: The mist came without warning. One morning, the residents of the village woke to find their lakeside settlement wrapped in an impenetrable fog—thick, cold, and utterly wrong. Within hours, people began to vanish. No screams. No signs of struggle. Just empty spaces where lives used to be.

details.title: Drowned in the Light：Gloom
details.short_description: Drowned in the Light: Gloom is a high-difficulty, real-time turn-based, story-driven character development game. Players will explore the unknown world.

details.title: Teddy Won't Help
details.short_description: One night, your plushies whisper a warning: Three monsters from under the bed will come for you before dawn. The only way to survive is to play their games… and win. Fail, and you won’t live to see the morning.

details.title: Necromancer's Workshop
details.short_description: Necromancer’s Workshop is a fantasy tycoon game. Craft zombies, work the land. Build a cozy countryside business, worth waking the dead for.

details.title: Shrine Raider
details.short_description: Help Regina recover an important relic that was stolen from her shrine, while saving her sister and stopping a secret organization from creating the ultimate weapon in this unique danmaku adventure!

details.title: Anomaly Hours: Forest Cabin
details.short_description: Anomaly Hour: Forest Cabin is a tense observation horror game where you monitor rooms through security cameras to spot strange and shifting anomalies. Each replay reveals new, unpredictable events as you uncover the haunting mystery behind the Kinley family’s forest cabin.

details.title: Farming & Defense - Farmfence
details.short_description: Supermarket Simulator meets Farming Simulator—with zombies. Build your store, grow crops, and survive nightly undead attacks in this fast-paced farming defence game. Harvest, sell, and fight to keep your business and farm alive.

details.title: Not My Base!
details.short_description: Build, defend, adapt… or just watch your base burn. Not My Base! is a Tower Defense game where you build up your defenses and fight through various levels. Strengthen your fortifications, choose your upgrades, and craft new strategies to withstand the chaos and havoc unleashed by angry armies.

details.title: Wilds - Night Zookeeper
details.short_description: Let your imagination run Wilds! From the BAFTA nominated team at Night Zookeeper, Wilds is an online adventure bound only by the limits of your creativity. Create characters, bring them to life, and embark on your own adventure in fast paced multiplayer action.

details.title: KACHIN!
details.short_description: Din Dino, the mob's top ex-hitman, runs away from their past to pursue their true passion: selling custom t-shirts. Design T-shirts, get to know your clients and confront your past!

details.title: Golfadillo
details.short_description: Hurl yourself across vast landscapes filled with coins and obstacles in this action incremental game! Upgrade your skills and unlock abilities so you can travel even further and reach blazing speeds!

details.title: Program Penguin
details.short_description: Program Penguin is a humorous, tightly paced action-adventure game with an unforgettable cast. Think classic Zelda meets Club Penguin all rolled up in a classic retro style.

details.title: FEARSFROMARS
details.short_description: You are a space hunter from Mars. Hunt with friends, capture bizarre aliens alive, and sell them to the highest bidder. In this galaxy, alien or not, they all share one fear... FEARSFROMARS.

details.title: Neo Bananas
details.short_description: In this sci-fi speedrun-platformer, destroy every neo bananas, get the S+ ranks, and uncover why you're the last gorilla on Earth. Go fast. Go wild. Go bananas!

details.title: White Noise: Ghost Signal
details.short_description: You are the new caretaker of a polar station. The assignment came unexpectedly, but you accepted it without hesitation. A lonely outpost in the middle of an endless frozen wasteland — a place where you must simply survive, follow the instructions… and keep your mind from breaking.

details.title: Donjon: The Dark Fantasy
details.short_description: Can the Hero reach the donjon of the dark castle looming over the village he once called home? An immersive first-person RPG with old-school graphics.

details.title: Rift Tavern
details.short_description: Gather materials, cook meals, serve patrons, and defeat foes! Welcome to your new life as the owner of the 'Rift Tavern'. Restore the former glory of your run-down tavern by night, and explore the depths of dangerous portal zones by day!

name: A Game About Breaking A Cube

details.title: A Game About Breaking A Cube
details.short_description: Take on the role of a factory worker oppressed by an evil corporation. Break stranger and stranger cubes in pursuit of ore and truth. Upgrade your tools, explore the underground facility and learn the secret of NullCorp. Later, relax at home with a cold can of drinkable meat.

details.title: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals
details.short_description: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals is a cozy desktop companion that blends witchy aesthetics and real productivity tools. Plan your day, care for plants, read fortunes, pet magical familiars, customize your desk and avatar, and play minigames during your breaks.

details.title: Little Guy Friday
details.short_description: Enter the Uncool Underground and face the Leet 14 in this irreverent creature collecting roguelike! Gather your ragtag team of silly Little Guys and guide them towards ascension... or just crash out and try another run!

details.title: A Day with Wuki
details.short_description: Wuki is a real cat, and today the whole neighborhood is his. Slip through open windows, push mugs off tables, hunt mice, complete little cat mischief in every house and collect polaroids of the real Wuki. Or just nap in the sun.

details.title: The Rules Kaidan: Night Watch
details.short_description: In this side-scrolling horror adventure game, explore multiple eerie spaces rooted in Rules Kaidan. Every adventure, you will encounter all kinds of terrifying beings born from kaidan legends. Follow and memorize every rule — however conflicting or bizarre — to survive each trial.

details.title: Pip & Bones
details.short_description: Pip & Bones is a score-based deckbuilder roguelike with domino rules. Connect really long chains, score a lot of points, forge your perfect deck, enchant tiles, unlock new strategies with powerful idols and win the title of Tavern Champion!

details.title: Fireworks Incremental
details.short_description: Bad Wizard covered the land with a Magical Dome and the only way to destroy it is with fireworks! Hire units, unlock buildings, buy upgrades, discover powerful synergies, turn a few tiny explosions into a ridiculous spectacle and ultimately defeat The Bad Wizard himself!

details.title: Shadowbound
details.short_description: Shadowbound is a minimalist 3D platforming and puzzle journey where light is your enemy and shadow your only ally. Overcome short challenges, manipulate light, and recover lost colors to rebuild the memories of a lifetime.

details.title: Knight Paths
details.short_description: A free, chess-inspired strategy duel where every square can be used only once. Control a single knight, outmaneuver your opponent in online PvP, or challenge five AI difficulty levels offline. Simple rules. Every move matters.

details.title: Zombies Hate to Die
details.short_description: Precise character slashing, scavenge resources along the way, and upgrade absurd gear. In this Roguelite loop, every escape is a brand-new journey.

details.title: Shifting Chambers
details.short_description: Shifting Chambers is a solo / co-op survival horror game where you need to escape from a mansion where rooms shift when the bell rings. Explore the rooms, reorient yourself, solve puzzles and survive the unpredictably intelligent guardians.

details.title: Coloratura
details.short_description: A narrative experience designed to be played without sight. Navigate using 3D audio, solve musical puzzles and discover a world where listening becomes your way forward.

details.title: Rogue Reigns
details.short_description: Rogue Reigns is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder about trust and sacrifice. Lead selfish antiheroes through a world where death is no more, and something still hunts them. Build synergies that bind them or rivalries that break them. Nobody dies, some are sacrificed, but everybody is condemned.

details.title: DomeLand
details.short_description: Leaving the city behind, driving a pickup truck to a remote wilderness to build a dome farm from scratch. Hand-fabricating components, erecting shelters, growing crops, and running an aquaponics system, then bringing the harvest straight to the farm table.

details.title: The Ignition Protocol
details.short_description: The Ignition Protocol is a slow-paced, top-down incremental asteroid-mining game. Fly your ship in zero-g, mine and tow asteroids, transport resources, automate your base, and ignite a new star - the last light in a fading universe.

details.title: It Could Be Worse
details.short_description: Speed bends time. Build momentum with weapons designed for movement to slow the world around you and tear through enemies at superhuman velocity.

details.title: Payday Poker
details.short_description: Play a fresh spin on traditional Poker centered around receiving a payout to bet with at the beginning of the round instead of betting real money! Play as one of several outlaws all wagering their own cut of the spoils as you duke it out to take the entire stack home. Are you ready? NOW DRAW!

details.title: Lethal Tournament
details.short_description: Lethal Tournament is a deckbuilding roguelike set in a dystopian megastructure. Build a deck, reshape it with Items, and bend the rules with Charms as you fight your way up the Tournament to find out what it's actually for.

details.title: Hex & Tonic
details.short_description: A poker-hand roguelike deckbuilder about brewing potions. Draw reagents, brew reactions, stack catalysts until the numbers get silly — then break the Hex. Six covens, fifty hidden recipes, a Daily Brew and an Endless cauldron. Fair odds, shown to you. No hidden RNG.

details.title: Can Collector Simulator
details.short_description: Pick up piles of scattered cans in a casual first-person collecting sim. Recycle your haul at reverse vending machines, cash out printed receipts, upgrade your pickup speed and capacity, and look for oversized prize pull tabs hidden in the mess.

details.title: Wilds of Lumithra
details.short_description: Explore the hand-crafted open-world of Wilds of Lumithra, where every cliff, chasm, and hidden path is yours to discover. Turn natural obstacles into shortcuts as you gather, craft, build, and fight your way to survival - solo or online with friends.

details.title: My Beautiful Aquarium
details.short_description: A fish tank that lives on your screen. Real species, and every fish is an individual you can name. In Cozy mode nothing can die, so you can leave it running all day. Challenge mode is proper fishkeeping: water types, breeding, sickness, mistakes. Play it, or just let it swim.

details.title: Steps To The Stars
details.short_description: A single player puzzle game following the journey of two stars as they climb to return to the constellation from which they have fallen.

details.title: B.O.D.E. (Beast Of Despair Exiled)
details.short_description: A crazy roguelite straight from Hell! B.O.D.E. (Beast Of Despair Exiled) is a wild 2D shooter with chaotic movement mechanics.

details.title: Destruction Brothers
details.short_description: A demolition game where every wall, plank and joint is accurately modeled. Enjoy four-player co-op sandbox chaos or progress through a solo career. An innovative, fully deterministic physics engine means when you knock out a building's supports, every brick lands in the same spot on every screen.

details.title: 这活你来！
details.short_description: Your first job as a project manager: get an office moving. Nobody acts without instructions. Turn actions you have already given into employee handbooks, share copies, and finish each delivery with fewer instructions. A single-player pixel-art puzzle game.

details.title: Just a Stupid Room
details.short_description: A first-person 3D puzzle adventure escape room game for logic fans. Explore 30 standalone rooms filled with mystery and original puzzles. Observe, experiment, and doubt the obvious in this unique exploration challenge. The door won't open itself.

details.title: Gamercury World Engine
details.short_description: Turn one idea into a playable AI world. Gamercury World Engine helps creators build detective mysteries, dress-up dramas, simulation games, and cinematic interactive stories with AI-generated plots, quests, character dialogue, voice, cutscenes, and 3D scenes.

details.title: Mars Inc 98
details.short_description: Mars Inc 98 is a retro Windows 98 styled incremental game about terraforming Mars. Mine ore, craft parts, build machines and launch rockets to turn the Red Planet from a dusty wasteland into a habitable world.

details.title: Cheesteroids
details.short_description: Steal cheese from the Cat Empire in an incremental bullet hell. Dodge deadly bullet patterns, collect resources, and invest your haul in permanent upgrades. Unlock dozens of weapons and perks, experiment with powerful builds, and take on increasingly dangerous bosses.

details.title: Rockblaze
details.short_description: Rockblaze is a 2.5D physics-based puzzle platformer. Move with thrusters or weapon recoil as you pilot your ship through a simulated futuristic prison. Upgrade your ship, experiment with builds, learn from failure, and uncover the secrets of the simulation.

details.title: Frank and Stein
details.short_description: Trapped in one stitched body, Frank & Stein must swap heads to survive this gloomy Metroidvania. Wield light and psychic powers to explore a castle shrouded in darkness, solve puzzles and reveal the unseen. Discover abilities and secrets, but beware of threats lurking in these twisted corridors...

details.title: Witchland: Trinity Blight
details.short_description: Lead an Inquisition expedition into a land consumed by corruption. Choose your missions, manage precious time, build your company, and survive brutal turn-based tactical battles as the world grows more dangerous around you.

details.title: Khinkills
details.short_description: As a cute khinkali dumpling, fight over the last piece of cake through fast paced and chaotic arenas. Smash your frenemies, steal their candies and kick everyone’s butt in this cute’n gore world.

details.title: Thothic
details.short_description: Thothic is a logic puzzle game where you land stones on their glowing targets. But all stones move together, in the same direction — so you'll need to find the one path that brings every stone home at once.

details.title: WOLFOUT
details.short_description: A Wild West social deduction game. You and your gang of outlaw coyotes have one goal: crack safes, rob the bank, and loot the saloon before time runs out. But some of you are secretly sheriffs. Same look, same gang - opposite mission.

details.title: Paradox Tower
details.short_description: Explore Paradox Tower and save your future. Only your wits and your loyal demon cat are able to throw down the Coven. Grow stronger, pick your battles, and make smart moves. And if you don't? Travel back in time!

details.title: Atomic Blastman
details.short_description: Remember those epic LAN afternoons with your dad or friends? Atomic Blastman brings them back. Pick a color, suit up, and blast your way through huge arenas. Power-ups, sudden death, chaos, and laughs guaranteed. Just... please... don’t blow yourself up! Chaos and madness, guaranteed.

details.title: Ramen://protocol
details.short_description: 🍜🃏 Ramen://protocol is a cyberpunk ramen-stall roguelite deckbuilder. Push your toppings to their limits, then rev them up even further with skills. Master countless synergies and serve bowls so good they're synapse-frying. Chase the one bowl that will cut you free from your past.

details.title: Picatso
details.short_description: Play as Picatso, a calico cat painter searching for a creative spark. Navigate through underground ruins with his ability to paint the environment which allow him to advance in this platforming adventure!

details.title: The Grant Grover Anthology
details.short_description: In Neo Naarm in the 22nd century, augmentation technology has run amok. Combining deduction, visual novel and point and click gameplay, play as Grant Grover, private detective, one of the only remaining citizens without augmentations, as he solves crimes across the city.

details.title: KLITTER
details.short_description: KLITTER fuses the precision of arena combat with the chaos of glitchcore and the flow of a movement-driven brawler. Every dash, every shot, every kill defines your rhythm - stop moving and you die, flow perfectly and the system collapses. PURE FLOW. ZERO MERCY.

details.title: Ducks in Disguise 2: Mythology
details.short_description: Hidden ducks are back in a world of myths and legends! Find hundreds of rubber ducks in cartoon-style mythic scenes, from Egyptian palaces to Norse halls and Japanese temples. Watch each sketch burst into color and collect ducks dressed as heroes, monsters and gods in a relaxing hidden object game.

details.title: So Stoked
details.short_description: A chill and cozy surf game about timing, flow, and discovery. Travel between islands, ride clean waves, and enjoy a calm, skill-driven ride with light RPG-style tasks and progression.

details.title: Zoomalia
details.short_description: In a world conquered by Zealotory harvesters, Zoomalia’s survival rests in your hands. Build a team of over 100 unique creatures, then fuse, evolve, and mutate them into powerful forms. Adapt your strategy, destroy obelisks, and reclaim the planet in this strategic roguelite.

details.title: Dice chess
details.short_description: A new-age chess game combined with math. Free to play with your bro offline, your friends or any players online.

details.title: Anna's Bakery Shop
details.short_description: You’re Anna, a young woman who ditches the boring city life to open a cozy bakery in a small town. Along with your animate mannequin friend Can Doe, you will embark on a delicious journey, decorate your beautiful shop and meet locals who are curious about the new bakery in their town.

details.title: Life Balance
details.short_description: A physics ragdoll climber where life choices become literal baggage. Climb a tower in the sky alone or in 2-player split-screen co-op: give each other a leg-up, grab each other, and share the load. Can you reach the top, or will your responsibilities drag you down?

details.title: The Final Like
details.short_description: THE FINAL LIKE. A fruit machine with a mind of its own. An authentic UK AWP simulator built around the world of social media - where the machine’s AI is watching, and has no intention of letting you walk away a winner.

details.title: Charming Blood: Twelve days
details.short_description: Embrace darkness as an unwitting vampire in this choice-driven romance. Navigate ancient powers, brewing conflicts, and passionate relationships with four captivating vampires who could become your greatest allies – or something more. When night falls, will you surrender to its dangers?

details.title: Possums
details.short_description: Possums is an NPC-driven co-op heist game for 2-6 players where every character reacts to your actions. Distract them, use them, or stay out of their way — loot their city to pay the forest taxes.

details.title: Dithered
details.short_description: DĪȾĦɆꞦɆĐ invites you to a realm forsaken by the clock—a surreal nightmare where you must platform through the jagged shards of a protagonist's trauma. Guided by two bickering birds and hunted by a ticking horror, you must fight your way through a glitching reality…

details.title: Idle Transporter
details.short_description: Idle Transporter is a fun incremental game to have running while you work on something else. Build your own little company and watch the cars zoom around the screen while you are in a zoom call.

details.title: I can offer you Flowers
details.short_description: ‘To propose to my boyfriend... what flowers would you recommend?’ Arrange bouquets in this cozy puzzly game! Discover flowers, meet new people, and become the Atrium Botanique community center florist!

details.title: Lone Tower
details.short_description: Defend one tower. Face endless waves. Build synergies, unlock permanent upgrades, and survive the chaos.

details.title: Pinball Realm
details.short_description: A pinball Roguelite where the board is yours to build. Fortify your defenses, stack outrageous synergies, and unleash game-breaking combos as you save the kingdom from endless waves of monsters!

details.title: Terrafactory: Idle Planet
details.short_description: The idle planet creation game that sits anywhere on your desktop. Watch the birth of a planet, upgrade the Catalyst, discover new biomes, and shape your own solar system while you work or relax.

details.title: Hauntworks
details.short_description: Run a haunted attraction where you scare guests, harvest their emotions, automate production chains, and manage a team of monsters. Hide evidence of "accidents" before the supernatural bureau comes looking.

details.title: Chronicles Meteorfall
details.short_description: A semi-open world turn based RPG with detailed class-based and skill building mechanics, deep worldbuilding and lore, and genuine LGBT+ representation.

details.title: The Bed Above My Head
details.short_description: You’re playing a game in the dark. Something in your room is not. In this Sit & Survive type psychological horror game, you're a child playing on your console, while something roams your room. Observe your surroundings, listen carefully and manage your stress to survive this nightmarish night.

details.title: Fig and Totems™
details.short_description: Capture-the-flag meets hide-and-seek in this online party game (2-4 players). In 2min30, everyone hides a totem then hunts everyone else's. Listen closely to find them, or ambush and steal from your friends before they score. Win by throwing the most totems in the box, the fastest! Bonus if unfound.

details.title: 园区物语
details.short_description: You play as a tourist trapped in a scam compound. fight to survive, sneak around and seize escape chances. Gather hidden clues, master scam skills reluctantly to survive, meet captives stuck here for various reasons, dig out its dark secrets, and choose between escaping the den or ruling it.

details.title: AGX GP
details.short_description: AGX is a heart thumpingly fast, Anti-Gravity racing game. It's lightning‑fast action and Xtreme ability‑based gameplay, will push your reactions and skills to the limit! Welcome To AGX!

details.title: Maledictum
details.short_description: In Maledictum (1–4 co-op), you’re not a ghost hunter you’re an Investigator of Guilt. Identify the entity, uncover the victim/culprit/cause, and decide a final ritual to free or condemn a spirit that reacts to your voice.

details.title: Scrapfall
details.short_description: Classic falling-block gameplay pushed to the edge in a fast-paced action roguelite of escalating gravity, unstable physics, and cascading systems.

details.title: Economic Biathlon
details.short_description: Test your wits in an arcade quiz. React quickly and overcome tricky challenges. You can set new records and compete in Economic Biathlon.

details.title: As We Planned
details.short_description: Stealth PVE heist with friends. Steal valuables, solve puzzles, use tools, upgrade your base, and complete quests. You can go quiet or loud — the choice is yours. Up to 4 players. Every raid is unique!

details.title: Project Lighthouse
details.short_description: Trapped inside a scientific anomaly, solve puzzles with evolving teleportation tech and uncover the fate of the vanished “keepers”. Built alongside our community, props we made for Project Lighthouse are free for other game developers.

details.title: 5th ERA
details.short_description: A techno-fantasy JRPG inspired by 16-bit classics. Explore Helgon, the city on the comet, and build your ideal team from a roster of 9 distinct characters, each with their own classes. Engage in strategic turn-based combat against the deadly Brightlings to uncover the truth behind the white portals.

details.title: Pearls of Wisdom
details.short_description: A relaxing card game with real-world side quests. Match inspiring and reflective quotes, combine special effect emblems, do out of game side quests and build your deck to get high scores. Reflect, relax, and walk away feeling good after you've finished playing.

details.title: Picasho
details.short_description: Become a rich and famous artist with your friends by painting wild creations, completing commissions, and exhibiting your art. Unlock all kinds of unusual tools, turn everyday objects into art, expand your gallery, and rise to riches in 1–4 player co-op!

details.title: Timberflow: Sawmill Simulator
details.short_description: From a single tree to an entire industry! Manage and automate your lumber business in this relaxing, yet challenging Sawmill Simulator. Start small, grow rich, dominate the market.

details.title: Auspicious Clouds
details.short_description: A unique turn-based game featuring Auspicious Cloud Cards. Wield the power of the Five Elements to unleash skills and vanquish foes. Unlock a vast roster of character skills, collect Cultivation Orbs, and devise your own one-of-a-kind tactics to conquer every opponent.

details.title: Ghost Justice
details.short_description: Lead elite operatives against ruthless cartels in a brutal narco conflict. Coordinate multiple tactical teams, plan ambushes, gather intelligence, and eliminate high-value targets through stealth-driven turn-based combat.

details.title: Dungeon Potato
details.short_description: Dungeon Potato is a fast-paced, top-down action roguelike where your loadout shapes the story. Survive unpredictable encounters, forge unique builds, and battle through a perilous labyrinth. Will you rise as a servant of the Potato God or rebel against it?

details.title: Friendgeist
details.short_description: An online co-op horror comedy for up to 5 players. You wake up trapped in a house haunted by the Friendgeist, a spirit that takes the shape of a friend to deceive and possess you. Find the way out. If one of you gets possessed, exorcise them before it's too late. Or escape, if they let you.

details.title: Midnight Manhunt
details.short_description: Hunt down a hidden target through a cyberpunk city in this turn-based game of cat and mouse. Coordinate four Grid Runners to eliminate his escape routes one by one, deduce his position and close the net before he completes his mission. Or become the Ghost, laying false trails to survive the night.

details.title: Tiny Desk Pot
details.short_description: Grow and nourish your own vegetables in a tiny desk pot! Let your leafy companion grow idle in a corner of your desktop while you do your things. Discover new soils, unlock new types of vegetables, and customize your pot with cute stickers. Relaxing music included!

details.title: Quack Ball!
details.short_description: Defend your goal as a rubber ducky in chaotic 4-player 3D pong! Battle friends in local multiplayer across wacky arenas. Lose a round? Draw a power-up card. Stack synergizing cards into wild builds and quack your way back to victory.

details.title: Fatemender
details.short_description: A Tarot puzzle adventure where you collect cards, cast spells, and place paths to reshape an ever-shifting Labyrinth. Outsmart the Fates, collect powerful Artifacts, and attempt the impossible—escape Purgatory.

details.title: Life of a Cockroach
details.short_description: Yes, you’re a cockroach, so your top priority now is to survive. Explore an urban environment from a whole new perspective in this open-world 3D adventure filled with challenges, tasks, and dangers. Discover hidden places, master your skills, and become the ultimate survivor insect!

details.title: Necromancer’s Domain
details.short_description: A dark fantasy dungeon management game where you rule as a necromancer. Build and defend your dungeon, resurrect fallen enemies as undead soldiers and workers, research forbidden magic, and expand your domain across the world.

details.title: Trials of Liberation
details.short_description: Imprisoned by the king, you must earn your freedom by completing his puzzle trials. A top-down 2D puzzle game focused on logic, planning, limited items, and clever solutions.

details.title: 众星入海
details.short_description: 大学毕业正在苦于找工作的平凡男生时寻，在奔波中遇到了一位穿着战术服的少女陈枫实。 陈枫实声称自己是末日时期的搜救人员，目的就是拯救世界上最后的幸存者。 时寻望着周围熙熙攘攘的街道，陈枫实望着周围残破的废墟，同时发觉了对方已经疯了的事实。两人抱着对对方的同情，开启了独属于他们的故事。
developers: 失业者联盟游戏制作组

details.title: Cursed Gas Station
details.short_description: At an isolated gas station in the 1990s, Cole takes a night-shift job that comes with a room to stay in. As you serve customers, unexplained events begin to unfold in this psychological horror game.

details.title: MILES 27: Look Like You
details.short_description: MILES27 is a psychological horror game told through self-contained stories inspired by disturbing real-life cases. Each episode presents a short but intense experience focused on atmosphere and tension. The game is designed to make players feel watched, unsafe, and uncertain about what is real.

details.title: Bodzin
details.short_description: Step into the boots of a forgotten space legend. In this retro top-down shooter, stop a galactic villain from corrupting ancient wisdom into ultimate power. Correct your past mistake, rescue the Keepers, and rewrite destiny.

details.title: Ghost in the Cloud
details.short_description: Dive deep into the Net, build the ultimate deck, install busted plugins, and fight ever more powerful Bots and Avatars in fast-paced tactical combat that combines turn based and real time mechanics, all to realize your wish, or perish trying.

details.title: Desktop sticker
details.short_description: This is a game that allows you to freely decorate your computer desktop. Have you ever thought about setting your desktop in a unique way? Come on, let's get started and design and decorate your desktop together! Accompany you in your work and study!

details.title: Marzu
details.short_description: Something ancient lives in these ruins, and it already knows you're here. Flee through shifting halls, tunnels, and forests as unseen entities hunt your every move. Solve environmental puzzles, evade ancient horrors, and uncover a truth that unravels reality itself.

details.title: Fusil
details.short_description: An action-adventure set in a weird fantasy world. Face levels where every shot counts: move silently to backstab enemies, use spells to unlock paths, and explore non-linear environments with multiple solutions. Choose your path, manage your ammo, and survive.

details.title: Roadside Reseal
details.short_description: A roadside store where the night never feels safe. Flickering lights, endless aisles, whispers from the dark. Each task feels like research into fear—you restock, you lock, you fight to keep the seal closed.The silence breaks, the air is heavy, and every moment is research into survival.

details.title: Mysteries of Black Hollow
details.short_description: The shop is yours by day. The dark belongs to something else. Raid the abandoned houses of a cursed town, drag your loot home before your lantern gives out, and spend everything you earn on rituals that might just save it or you.

details.title: Pillow Punk
details.short_description: Fight waves of enemies and towering bosses in a third-person action roguelite. Spend the points you earn on the Patch Board to build your own fighting style. Play solo or bring up to three friends into online co-op.

details.title: BattleSpinners
details.short_description: A fast-paced, spinning-tops versus game. Build your spinner, launch it into the arena, and defeat your opponents by knocking them out of the ring, or by tearing them apart. Brawl against or alongside your friends, use your skills and unleash powerful abilities to dominate the arena (1-4 players)

details.title: Mars Incremental
details.short_description: A short incremental game about terraforming Mars. Build, automate, and deploy drones to harvest power, gas and water, then watch a quiet, red planet wake into a living world, one horizon at a time. Just follow the instructions: step one, change the entire planet.

details.title: Monarchs at Play
details.short_description: Turn-based 4X strategy in just one hour. Place buildings, chain adjacency bonuses, optimize resources, and outsmart rival monarchs through trade or war to earn the most Glory - solo or multiplayer.

details.title: Wares & Wonders: Fantasy Shop Simulator
details.short_description: A cozy first-person fantasy shop simulator. Every customer has a profession, a budget, and a reason to stop by today. Choose what to stock, arrange your displays, take on quests, and run the shop solo or with friends. Everything is physical. Everything can be broken.

details.title: Taiyi Saga
details.short_description: Taiyi Saga is a deck-building roguelike set in Chinese mythology. Pulled into a god's private realm, you build your deck, battle rival gods' invaders, and collect relics forged from ancient beasts — fighting your way toward the truth, and a way home.

details.title: Little Frontier
details.short_description: A story-rich Western tactical RPG set in 1836. Lead three mountain men across the vast, untamed American frontier. Explore the wilderness, engage in tactical turn-based combat, and navigate dangerous encounters where your decisions shape the story and the fate of your companions.

details.title: DORM
details.short_description: First-person horror. An old student dormitory in a provincial Eastern European town, strange residents, brutal encounters, blood, dark humor, and explicit scenes.

details.title: STARLET☆DISORDER
details.short_description: Join STARLET☆DISORDER, the reality show: get famous, loved, watched. Live with rivals. Perform love. Survive confessionals. Go viral. Truth is ammunition. But there’s no clean truth. Broadcast turns your week into a story that never happened. Go live and swear you didn't mean it. It’s all recorded.

details.title: Gambition
details.short_description: A chess-inspired tactical roguelike where every battle becomes a puzzle of sacrifice and manipulation. Evolve chess pieces, build powerful armies, and turn clever sacrifices into devastating synergies.

name: 幻霓绮岛 Phantasmal Neon Island

details.title: 幻霓绮岛 Phantasmal Neon Island
details.short_description: Welcome to Phantasmal Neon Island! In this sleepless city, you inherit your father’s legendary host club after his accident. Manage debts, recruit new hosts, and survive rent hikes and rival clubs. Will you build a nightlife empire—or fall in love and lose it all?

details.title: Auto Ball Arena
details.short_description: Strategy meets physics autobattler. Bounce, spin, and slice your way through nail-biting PvP battles at your own pace.

details.title: Infini Orbis
details.short_description: A sci-fi automation game with deep RPG progression and RTS fleet combat. Command humanity's last ark, Mothership, on a desperate mission back in time to build a fleet powerful enough to change the destiny of the galaxy. Automate local and interstellar supply networks to purge cosmic threats.

details.title: Really Illegal Golf
details.short_description: Golf, but make it illegal. Defy your membership ban and wreak havoc with friends in co-op, or tee off for a high score. Evade security, defend yourself with a customizable arsenal and take your games to the most outrageous places. Who said a tower crane wasn't the perfect place for a hole-in-one?

details.title: Bad Beat: Dark Fantasy Roguelike
details.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based strategy roguelike. Slide rows and columns of a cursed grid, line up winning combos and chain effects to defeat the casino's Dealers. Every turn is a gamble. Every bet costs a piece of your soul.

details.title: Gonzalo the Chicken
details.short_description: This chicken is crossing the road... to blow up everything on the other side! Throw Gonzalo's loud-mouthed explosive sidekick Azzar at the Crocogator horde, and then use a magic glove to retrieve him. He holds on tight while you flutter through mountains and beaches and forests, oh my!

details.title: Fast & Fractured
details.short_description: Step into typical Spanish sun-baked places and prepare for Fast & Fractured experience, a frenetic physics-based driving shooter for up to 8 contenders— in a chaotic multiplayer battle royale. Choose from 4 colorful elderly characters and battle in stereotypical Spanish maps

details.title: Beyond Lost Planets
details.short_description: Beyond Lost Planets is an intense Roguelike Dungeon Crawler Bullet Hell. Fight through enemies and bosses across procedural worlds. Everything from weapons and bullets to powerup and companions is represented with cards. Grow absurdly powerful and create wild, unique synergies every run!

details.title: Veiled Shadows
details.short_description: Live a month in a rural mountain town, build bonds, and hunt a mystery across two worlds. Manage your days, explore dungeons, and fight turn-based battles to recover what's been lost.

details.title: Cosmic Plague
details.short_description: A plague is silencing the galaxy one world at a time. Command a small ship and a frightened crew in this roguelike about outrunning it. Trade, fight and keep your ship alive as systems go dark behind you. Reach the Ark before it leaves, and pray you pass the scan. It only takes clean ships.

details.title: One Wrong Step
details.short_description: One wrong move can change everything... Explore trapped rooms in this tactical roguelite inspired by Minesweeper. Every square is a risk. Every exit, a choice. Think carefully... or start again.

details.title: Unwilling Executioner
details.short_description: A sadistic killer is forcing you to choose who lives and dies. Investigate and find clues scattered around The Bunker to save your family. Double check every detail before time runs out, because one wrong pick and you’ve killed someone you love.

details.title: Car World
details.short_description: Car World is a realistic 2D driving and life simulator focused on true car ownership and maintenance. Drive, repair, and tune your vehicles, take jobs or trade them for profit. Every car system is simulated down to the smallest detail. Can you prove yourself as a true car enthusiast?

details.title: DEORUM
details.short_description: Descend into the forsaken dungeon and fight the horrors in the dark. Gather occult materials, craft nightmarish coins, and settle your debt to the cosmic powers. Obey the Divine Festival.

details.title: Adventurer’s Guild Manager
details.short_description: Take charge of your own adventurers' guild in a cozy low-poly world. Write contracts, craft scrolls, trade with adventurers and help your guild grow.

details.title: Voidboy
details.short_description: A roguelite platformer filled with speed, action, and bullets! Shoot down all the enemies, upgrade your run, and take them all down. With your trusted grappling hook the game never stands still, and with the fast bullets and big explosions, you won't want it to.

details.title: Wind's Heartbeat
details.short_description: In this semi-open world, cozy horse game, form a deep bond with your horse while you explore, forage, and craft. Using training techniques and knowledge passed down through the ages, tame a wild horse to ride through and discover the land's rich natural history in 1800s Idaho.

details.title: Under the Eye
details.short_description: You are a prisoner. The Major wants names from the resistance and she is willing to play cards for them. Win a hand and your next lie holds up better. Get caught three times and she kills you. You can always save yourself with the truth, but every name you give her buys another execution.

details.title: No Clean Start
details.short_description: No Clean Start is a first-person survival horror with roguelite elements set in a hostile underground facility. Explore dangerous sectors, scavenge for weapons and supplies, manage resources, and fight or avoid deadly enemies. Complete objectives, adapt your strategy, and survive each expedition.

details.title: Shipping and Handling
details.short_description: A chaotic co-op delivery game about traversal and teamwork. Get a shared payload through hostile environments while navigating terrain hazards, managing limited resources, and dealing with enemies along the way. AND DONT FALL OVER!

details.title: 6-7 In-A-Row
details.short_description: A strategic board showdown for 2-4 players. Race to connect six, time your blocks to earn extra tokens, and build lines for power-ups. Play locally, online with friends, or against AI. Every turn pits your plan against everyone else’s. Six wins... technically! Seven earns bragging rights.

details.title: Bakkal Simulator
details.short_description: Hang up your degree and take over your grandfather's corner shop. Step into a deep narrative simulation where your choices shape the neighborhood, your reputation defines your path, and every interaction crafts a unique story.

details.title: Rock From Home
details.short_description: Type emails in the 90s to buy tiny hats for your pet rock! Handle strange workplace situations, and choose how you respond. Spend your hard-earned money on silly stuff like your weekly bills, and things that truly matter: ridiculous accessories for your rock.

details.title: Late Night Manifest
details.short_description: As Marco, you wake up to a reality where the world is shrouded in darkness, forcing you to fight for survival while seeking answers in abandoned darkness.

details.title: Rush Tower
details.short_description: Rush Tower is a Tower Defense game where new paths are procedurally added over the course of the game. Can you keep up as the enemy builds more paths in this ever more hectic war?

details.title: Alchemist
details.short_description: A magic-focused action battle* RPG where research and alchemy shape your path through combat encounters, puzzles, and challenges across diverse locations.

details.title: Breaking News Live
details.short_description: When the truth and business are at odds, money prevails. Shape the reality of others by curating which news are worth telling and which are worth altering.

details.title: Karusel
details.short_description: 1984. Denis is trapped in a never-ending summer day in a Soviet village. The sun is frozen at its zenith, and familiar paths lead to dark secrets. Uncover the nature of this anomaly and discover: what price must you pay to finally reach tomorrow?

details.title: FENDERSHOT
details.short_description: A lawless street racing league with the fiercest rivals and the latest Race Tech™. Can you and your crew handle the heat? Included in the box: Wild sense of speed. Split-Screen local multiplayer. Underglow Neons. 60+ FPS on Steam Deck.

details.title: War Tactics
details.short_description: 《War Tactics》is a turn-based tactical game inspired by "Advance Wars". Command military units on square grids in modern warfare scenarios. Features deep tactics, intuitive controls, rich unit variety, complex terrain interactions, and single-player campaigns. Plan and conquer with your intellect.

details.title: Spell Fist
details.short_description: Unleash fists of arcane fury in this boss-rush brawler. Punch, parry, and steal spells as a broke wizard fighting rival mages to escape crushing debt.

details.title: COREDUMP: 口口口口
details.short_description: COREDUMP: 口口口口 is a Metroidvania inspired puzzle platformer where you recover lost colliders, switch between phasing through walls and charged bouncing, and uncover hidden paths across an interconnected world.

details.title: Koimori
details.short_description: Turn your desktop into a living pond with this peaceful idle overlay. Let koi drift around while you work or relax, drop snacks to see them gather, and unlock rare koi patterns as you spend more time with your little friends.

details.title: VIRUS_31.EXE
details.short_description: Minimalist survivors-like built for short, snack-sized sessions. Pop enemies, earn bits, get stronger.

details.title: Son Of A Dealer
details.short_description: Turn forgotten treasures into a thriving business in this narrative-driven second-hand shop simulator. Haggle for the best prices, uncover the stories behind every item, and build deep relationships with the townsfolk. Your choices shape not just your shop, but your life.

details.title: Curse of Cards
details.short_description: Battle through a shifting cosmic library in this roguelike card-crawler. Combine satisfying card strategy with first-person exploration. Unleash ancient creatures of British folklore, gather relics, collect powerful cards, and fight to shape your own story escaping the cursed library’s grasp.

details.title: Construcubes
details.short_description: Grab, move, rotate and connect bricks to build many cute objects ! Follow instructions to build things such as a flower, a robot or a well-known building, or make your own models and share them with others ! Available for PC, and for VR with Oculus Quest 2 and 3.

details.title: Hantu and Hunted
details.short_description: Morph into props to survive as a human or hunt as the legendary ghosts of Southeast Asian folklore. Asymmetric horror prop hunt with proximity voice chat. Hide, hunt and escape.

details.title: Kindred Pieces
details.short_description: Kindred Pieces is a relaxing world-builder where you shape beautiful landscapes one hex tile at a time. Discover 6 unique biomes, unlock cute characters, and master a subtle layer of strategy to build the biggest world imaginable.

details.title: Last Floor: Paradox
details.short_description: An elevator that doesn't obey the laws of space. Descend through impossible places, spot anomalies, follow the rules, and survive whatever waits on the Last Floor.

details.title: Mother ZERO
details.short_description: In Mother ZERO, a cyberpunk action-adventure game, fight your way through a decaying world full of mysteries and threats. Explore deep underground bunkers, battle corrupted creatures, and encounter bizarre characters.

details.title: Burnt Out
details.short_description: A chain-reaction roguelike in a corporate fever dream. Smash a keycap, watch the combo rip across the hex grid, hit quota, outplay bosses you've worked with, and build a Skill Deck broken enough to dismantle the org chart before the company terminates you.

details.title: Her Name Was April
details.short_description: Her Name Was April is a 3D platform game developed by a single developer. It aims to stand out with its story and visuals, while also not being overly difficult.

details.title: Animal Clicking
details.short_description: Animal Clicking is a cute, cozy island builder that blends farming, automation, and resource management with the addictive gameplay loop of clicker games into a completely new sandbox experience.

details.title: MeowRig
details.short_description: MeowRig is a mining-themed incremental game. Follow Me(ow) and search for Meow God's great treasure.

details.title: Mafia Boss Simulator
details.short_description: They shot you on your own driveway. Now dig your way back. MAFIA BOSS SIMULATOR is a cinematic crime saga from 1920s Sicily to 1950s New York — stealth, driving, shootouts, and a story of loyalty, betrayal, and the price of the crown. Welcome to the Family.

details.title: Hotel Paraíso
details.short_description: Explore a surreal hotel overrun by ghosts in this mellow yet haunting 2.5D RPG. Battles play like tactical puzzles: match colors, chain combos and stop the ghosts before they cross the board. Meet its animal guests and uncover what tore the worlds apart.

details.title: Just a Clicker Game
details.short_description: Acquire energy. Build a city. Consume the universe. Just a Clicker Game is a darkly humorous incremental experience where your quest for efficiency might just break reality. Manage simulation instability, unlock the massive Neural Tree, and remember: the Ducky Council is always watching.

details.title: Foxy Dumplings
details.short_description: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your customers, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

details.title: Sail On
details.short_description: A stylized pirate roguelite with asynchronous run-based PVP, where you combine projectile properties to create devastating combos and dominate the seas even after your run ends. Die loud, rebuild louder and "Sail On"!

details.title: Time To Waste
details.short_description: Drive your little trash compacting robot across a ruined world, collect mountains of trash, and upgrade everything — until your one small bot becomes an unstoppable cleaning fleet. An active incremental about quiet, endless purpose.

details.title: Groove Core
details.short_description: Groove Core is a rhythm-based bullet heaven roguelike shooter where you arrange your weapons on a sequencer. Mix and match 200+ items, build your ship, and flood the cosmos with bullet storms as deadly as they are beautiful.

details.title: Earth Atlantis Abyss
details.short_description: A shoot 'em up roguelike where light, space and safety are things you trade away. Descend as Pypher, a lone captain chasing her grandfather's lost legacy into a drowned world. Anyone who seeks answers knows that the deeper you go, the darker it gets...

details.title: Mini Sushi Factory
details.short_description: Manage your very own sushi factory in this cozy automation game. Deliver batches of Bento Boxes during shifts, then upgrade your production lines, receive emails from customers, and get new recipes in the management room.

name: The Prime Minister's Crest: Path to Power

details.title: The Prime Minister's Crest: Path to Power
details.short_description: A political simulation visual novel set in a severe post-bubble economic crisis. As newly elected governor Kazuma Oriki, allocate tight budgets to resolve economic, security, and welfare issues. Navigate complex factional politics and ultimately forge your path to the Prime Minister's seat.

details.title: Court Vision
details.short_description: Run a basketball franchise from the front office. Draft and develop players, negotiate contracts, make trades, and manage lineups. Every decision determines your legacy.

details.title: Gravity Witch
details.short_description: Master gravity as a witch whose mana has been stolen. With no elemental spells left, use your creativity to manipulate the weight of the world, solve puzzles, and face dangers. Reclaim your power in an action-adventure journey where gravity is your only and greatest ally.

details.title: Courier Beware
details.short_description: Deliver to haunted places, solve paranormal mysteries, and struggle through the daily grind in this horror life sim adventure.

details.title: Caravan Bazar
details.short_description: Caravan Bazar is a chaotic co-op physics adventure in a procedurally generated world. Find precious loot, load it into your cart, punch gnomes, fight trolls, repair broken wheels. Try to survive and reach the end. Complete missions, fly on gliders and live the life of a goblin.

name: WE DIDN’T KNOW WHAT TO CALL THIS GAME [So... we just left it like this!]

details.title: WE DIDN’T KNOW WHAT TO CALL THIS GAME [So... we just left it like this!]
details.short_description: A comedic meta Visual Novel with a cinematic presentation and an interactive world where everything responds to your clicks, while you and the characters constantly blur the boundaries between the story, the creative process, and reality itself.

details.title: My Demon Academia
details.short_description: Raise a runt into the King of Demons, battle its siblings and overthrow the Demon King. Power is earned. Family is optional.

details.title: Perplexicube
details.short_description: Perplexicube is a challenging isometric puzzler where you must work together with your past and future selves. You'll have to think ahead as you create loops backwards in time to set your futures selves up for success.

details.title: import robots
details.short_description: Program robots in Python to collect the resources scattered across each planet. You never control them directly. You write the code, hit run, and watch it work. No programming experience needed, just learn as you play.

details.title: RED RESET
details.short_description: RED RESET a thrilling fast-paced combat, story-driven adventure where you come across memorable characters in a world where not everything is as it seems. Experience a history filled with secrets only the keen-eyed will unveil. Following chapters will be available for purchase soon.

details.title: Kabsa Spilled?
details.short_description: Spill Kabsa everywhere in this chaotic co-op physics game. Grab a buddy and lead the adventure of two chefs delivering the Kabsa plate through deadly firepits, tricky platforms, angry vendors and much worse things that will DEFINITELY make your friendship better.

details.title: Looplash
details.short_description: Looplash is a fast-paced arcade action roguelite where your skills rotate around you in a constant loop. Move to control timing, position yourself precisely, and survive the chaos. Push the system to create builds that bend the rules.

details.title: Jackpot Colosseum
details.short_description: Your slot machine is the weapon. Spin to load guns and bullets, then unload the whole build when it hurts most. Bet bigger for stronger symbols, gamble the gold you need to survive, and climb five leagues of the colosseum. A turn-based reel-building roguelike.

details.title: Mind The Gap
details.short_description: Mind The Gap is a puzzle platformer game where you and your unlikely companion work together to create your own path to freedom. Featuring 80+ handcrafted levels, unique bosses, and hidden collectables, each stage introduces new mechanics that push your abilities further.

details.title: Mentiss Werewolf: Human vs AI
details.short_description: Play Werewolf with AI players that argue, bluff and vote on their own. Hunt the wolves with the village or lie your way to a wolf win, solo or with friends while AI fills the empty seats. Watch Mode, Parallel Mode, replays and post-game Review. Free Games every day.

name: They Stop for Gas at Night

details.title: They Stop for Gas at Night
details.short_description: A first-person horror simulation game. You owe money. So you work nights at a gas station in the middle of nowhere. Serve whoever shows up, and try not to think about what's watching from the dark. Something ancient is watching, and it isn't planning to leave.

details.title: The Blinking Room
details.short_description: One night, young Lily wakes from a nightmare — unaware that her real nightmares are only just beginning. Uncover the secrets hidden behind closed eyes.

details.title: Zoti's Train Workshop
details.short_description: Rotate pipes, restore steam flow, and repair stubborn old trains in this cozy hand-drawn puzzle game from the world of Sly Crow.

details.title: Pollex
details.short_description: Enter the pit. Bet your fingers. Survive the thumb war. Pollex is a first-person horror game set in an underground thumb war fight pit. You owe a debt you can’t pay. The only way out is through the ring ,where every match is played for keeps, and the house always takes a cut.

details.title: Packlore
details.short_description: Packlore is a cozy incremental TCG where you open magical booster packs! Earn money from cards, upgrade, and hire helpers. Can you complete the collection and uncover the mystery of the secret page?

details.title: THE IRON GAMES
details.short_description: The Iron Games is a medieval battle royale where 24 players fight to the death. Loot armor and weapons, build unique combinations to become as strong as possible, and fight to be the last team alive.

details.title: COILBREAKER
details.short_description: A survivor roguelite where you steer a scrap-metal snake through hordes of machines. Its weapons fire on their own, and where they sit on the head, body or tail changes how they fire.

details.title: Folder Escape
details.short_description: "Wait, this is a game?" A puzzle game played inside a file explorer. Rename files, change extensions, show hidden items and switch view modes to escape each folder your own way. 30 stages, and every fifth one is a .zip that demands all of it at once.

details.title: Leila's Adventure
details.short_description: Join Leila on a colourful 3D platforming adventure inspired by collectathons of the 90s. Explore vibrant levels, collect treasures, overcome obstacles and uncover secrets as you journey across unique worlds.

details.title: Incremental Dungeoncrawler
details.short_description: An Incremental Party-Based RPG inside an endless ASCII dungeon. Command a squad of 4 unique heroes, crawl through procedurally generated grids, and strategically unlock massive, custom skill trees. No mindless backtracking! Only forward progression, permanent prestige, and numbers going up!

details.title: Archemyst: Alchemy Shop
details.short_description: An incremental game of spell-driven gathering and alchemy shopkeeping. Summon skeletons and goblins, gather materials, craft goods and run your shop. Unlock recipes, expand the shop and follow the talent tree to relearn elemental magic and regain your powers as an archmage.

details.title: Desk Sushi Idle
details.short_description: Desk Sushi Idle is a cozy animal sushi shop at the bottom of your screen. Keep working while guests grab plates, check out, and your restaurant grows. Build belts and stations, unlock dishes, and expand at your own pace—an idle desktop companion with real conveyor-sushi charm.

name: 横浜機動暴走族 ROCK 'N' ROLL SUICIDE

details.title: 横浜機動暴走族 ROCK 'N' ROLL SUICIDE
details.short_description: Explore Yokohama through real-world photographs and brawl with biker gangs in giant robots! A dramatic action-adventure following a coup led by the city’s “Mobile Biker Gangs.”

details.title: Flat Earth Runner
details.short_description: Endless runner. Sentient Yowie. Antarctic ice wall. The New World Order really does not want you finishing the lap. A PS1-style comedy about the dumbest possible way to prove the earth is flat.

details.title: Graveheart
details.short_description: A retro FPS where William Wallace is back from the dead, Scotland is invading England, and your cursed weapons keep switching themselves at the worst possible moment.

details.title: GraveFeast
details.short_description: The curse drains your life with every passing second. The only cure is blood. Charge into the horde, gather them, and tear them apart to drink deep. In GraveFeast, low health isn't a reason to run. It's a reason to go deeper.

details.title: We Will Die For You
details.short_description: Destroy & defeat disease in an incremental action game where you guide a white blood cell through the human body. Fight disease, earn Protein, die, and buy permanent upgrades for the cells that follow. Unlock powerful abilities and confront disease bosses. EVERY CELL DIES. YOUR BODY REMEMBERS.

details.title: Hell and Back
details.short_description: Step through the gates of hell and descend into darkness. Use blades and magic against dangerous enemies and challenging bosses, collect better loot, grow stronger, and fight your way out of hell. See how far you can survive into hell.

details.title: From Misfortune Comes
details.short_description: A broke high-school senior tries to rebuild his life, while secretly exploiting a supernatural second world to acquire money, power and opportunities that transform his ordinary existence.

details.title: Kindred Ills
details.short_description: Kindred Ills is a dark, loot-focused tile-based dungeon crawler. Build a party of mercenaries, discover powerful spells and items, and fight your way through dangerous biomes where death is permanent. Find rare loot, and push your party further with increasingly brutal difficulties and modifiers.

details.title: Roadside Egg Stand
details.short_description: Bring the residents of Reine the freshest, finest eggs! Raise cute chickens, collect their eggs, and sell them at roadside egg stands scattered throughout the village. Decorate your egg stand, collect your daily earnings, restock with fresh eggs, and read the heartfelt letters from the villagers.

details.title: Easy Drive Together
details.short_description: An easy and fun drive with a friend.

details.title: Supreme Heroes
details.short_description: Highschool sophomore Jacob suddenly discovers he has super powers and must team up with his best friends to become the 'Elect Few', but convincing them to embrace their powers and save the world is all but easy. Events bring Jacob to battle villainous factions in order to bring peace to the nation.

details.title: AKEGARASU: Journey to the Underworld
details.short_description: Cut Down Enemies to Keep the Clock Running! Race through deadly trials and reach the end of the Underworld in this ultimate-speed hardcore runner.
publishers: Pujia8 Studio (Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan)

details.title: Pepper the Giant Purple Dog
details.short_description: In this twist on a harmless pet simulator, take care of Pepper, who happens to be a giant purple dog. But when things go awry, you will have to decide: how many lives is one good boy worth?

details.title: Laser Guy
details.short_description: A twin-stick anti-shooter where you’re maneuvering your laser around coworkers trying not to blast anyone. Just another day in the gamedev office!

details.title: DeckWrecking Pirates
details.short_description: A tactical roguelike deckbuilder where you roll dice, command your pirate crew, and even control your enemies. Build your deck… and wreck theirs!

details.title: Polly's Puzzle Box
