details.short_description: As a small flea, explore a strange puzzle box full of secrets. Gather shapes and combine them to reveal hidden abilities. Polly is always watching… Can you escape?

details.title: By Sword & Road
details.short_description: Minimalistic RTS game about logistics and war! On this battlefield, supply lines are everything - cut them off and your enemies will wither, or use special abilities to gain the advantage. The game features an original story campaign and skirmish challenges. Conquer your enemies by Sword & Road!

details.title: Beetle Battle Bros
details.short_description: Chaotic 1v1 physics-based beetle sumo fights. Play against your friend in this easy-to-pick-up 3D fighter where beetles battle in sumo-style arenas - the rule is simple: knock your opponent off for a silly, fun time. Plus a Rocket League-style Beetle Ball mode!

details.title: Fragments
details.short_description: Your mind is shattered. Step into a first-person psychological horror where you must relive your deepest trauma, uncover fragments of your past, piece them back together and face the tormentors that haunt your mind.

details.title: Freshly Folded: Laundry Shop
details.short_description: Run your own dry cleaning shop in a charming, cozy small town. Wash, dry, and press clothes to perfection, serve quirky customers, invest in new machines and upgrades for faster service, and stay organized to carefully complete each order. Mend rips, remove stains, and more.

name: Super Egg & TCG Card Shop Simulator

details.title: Super Egg & TCG Card Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own TCG Card Shop! Crack open surprise eggs, collect rare cards and toy parts, and raise birds to produce eggs on your farm. Stock shelves, set prices, and serve customers as you grow your store in this shop simulator.

details.title: Everything Store
details.short_description: Everything Store is a game where you can manage your own thrift shop! Buy items, fit them into your store and sell them by negotiating with customers!

details.title: Last Draft
details.short_description: Complete your last draft before sunrise while enduring increasing paranormal activities and relentless monster stalks. Use your typing skills to progress and your instincts to hide, surviving 7 days of pure psychological horror.

details.title: Wilderness Strike: Survivor
details.short_description: Players take on the role of a survivor trapped in an endless battlefield. Face massive waves of enemies swarming from all directions, gain experience by defeating foes, level up and select skills to build your unique combat build, then break through the siege and claim victory!

details.title: Tomo Cafe
details.short_description: Tomo Cafe is a Pomodoro Timer and cafe simulator game. Run a study cafe, work through your actual to-do list beside the regulars, decorate the place, and unlock the next chapter of heartwarming stories.

details.title: The Wrong Ones
details.short_description: The Wrong Ones is a single-player social deduction game where you study characters dialogue, detect contradictions, and uncover Skinwalkers hiding in plain sight. Analyze each claim carefully and decide who can be trusted before making your final accusation.

details.title: CYBER SCOUTS
details.short_description: Cyber Scouts is a space simulator. Build your ship block by block, script your autopilot in Lua, and battle the rogue AI NEXUS in a story campaign. Play solo or co-op with up to 10 friends — no accounts, no global servers.

details.title: STAFFUP
details.short_description: Two friends turn their new startup into a quadrillionaire corp by hunting candidates in this local co-op cozy incremental top-down shooters. Suck candidates, collect blueprints, register patents, and renovate the office into a massive corporate cashing machine while firing employees along the way.

details.title: Miner Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Miner Shop Simulator is a hands-on mining and shop management sim. Dig for resources, refine raw ore into valuable goods, stock your shelves, serve customers, and grow a small mining shop into a thriving business.

details.title: Stellar Office
details.short_description: Stellar Office is a room‑based point‑and‑click exploration game centered on observing and researching almost everything in the room. Through association and interaction with objects, as well as analysis aided by external tools, players will continuously deduce the hidden logic behind phenomena.

details.title: The Murder Of Yesterday
details.short_description: A psychological horror crime experience featuring Story mode and Anomaly mode. Where time is your only weapon.. travel back through fractured moments to stop a brutal crime before it happens uncover the truth, alter the outcome, and face the consequences of changing fate in a haunting reality.

details.title: A Proof Apart
details.short_description: A Proof Apart is a first-person psychological horror game. Step into the shattered mind of a mathematician. Rely on your destructive addiction to bend reality, explore ever-changing environments, and hide from the terrifying manifestations of your grief. Truth and lies are a sip apart.

details.title: Train 404
details.short_description: A first-person co-op horror game where you collect coins, find the Golden Ticket, and race back to the train while monsters close in.

details.title: SpellFast
details.short_description: A fast-paced multiplayer word game. Chain letters across a shared board, bank coins, and spend them on abilities that swap, change, or shuffle tiles. Race the clock in Bullet, take your time in Rapid, or host a private lobby with friends. In English and Spanish.

details.title: EREBUS: The Northwest Passage
details.short_description: Lead the doomed 1845 Franklin Expedition through the Arctic in a survival strategy game where every month, order, resource, officer, and event can decide the fate of HMS Erebus and her crew.

details.title: Serenity In Surrender
details.short_description: Daisy's the brilliant and beautiful girl-next-door. You haven't gone outside in a week. Still, you're determined to win her heart and if you make the right choices, you might learn to fall in love along the way.

details.title: Czar Ry
details.short_description: Physically interactive adventure where you must escape a strange abyssal structure inside a batholith by learning its secrets. Use fully interactive physical hands: reach, grab, drag, hold. No action buttons, no clicks, no hotkeys. Every door, lever, and chain requires your hands to move further.

details.title: COOKBOT
details.short_description: You've been placed as a standard model COOKBOT on the transit ship ZIMA. Cook, bake, pour, freeze, cut and mix food while following recipes. Complete orders from crew members and listen to their stories. But remember - you're not human. The cake is there for company morale.

details.title: True Confession
details.short_description: Henry, a religious young man, witnesses violent shootouts and fragments of his past at night in his dreams. In reality, he’s just an ordinary man, visiting his pastor while struggling with anger and guilt. Fight inside his dreams in this isometric pixel-art shooter to experience his True Confession.

name: Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur

details.title: Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur
details.short_description: Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur is a first-person psychological horror game about a lonely man trapped in a surreal dream loop. Explore strange levels, solve eerie puzzles, survive terrifying chases, and uncover why Sahur keeps appearing in your nightmare.

details.title: DeckDEX - TCG Live Simulator
details.short_description: Buy low, read the room, flip it. DeckDEX is a card-flipping market tycoon: hunt underpriced cards on a live player economy, rip packs, forge duplicates into rarities, complete sets, and build a cardboard empire.

details.title: Unclaimed: Loot or Junk
details.short_description: Unbox. Sort. Collect. Become a master of discovery by exploring unclaimed packages. Complete every set, from vintage gadgets to "Golden Junk". Sell piles of everyday items to buy new shipments and hunt for truly rare treasures. What will you find in the next box?

details.title: Anachronistic Survivors
details.short_description: Something shattered time. Survivors from every era fight waves of temporal aberrations in a dark arena. Combine weapons from across history to forge powerful fusions. 9 base weapons. 36 fusions. 6 characters. Every run is different.

name: ABYSS: The Shadows of Elder Cities

details.title: ABYSS: The Shadows of Elder Cities
details.short_description: A signal was buried in 1985. Now it's calling you back. Descend into wireframe cities steeped in cosmic horror, rendered in haunting ZX Spectrum aesthetics. Campaign, roguelike, and 2-player versus modes.

details.title: Hexroads
details.short_description: Build a small kingdom by day and survive the night. Hexroads is a fantasy city-builder RTS where you capture towns, grow your economy, command defenders, cast spells, and choose new rewards each dawn.

details.title: Fractured: Snowpine Strangers
details.short_description: Matt was called for a long freight haul deep into Snowpine State. He didn't know he was rolling straight into a nightmare

details.title: Souls Divided
details.short_description: A single-player puzzle game where you divide your soul into two forms, each perceiving a different dimension. Switch between them, manipulate ancient instruments, and solve layered puzzles across overlapping realities in a mysterious astral world left behind by a failed civilization.

details.title: Moorhaven: Cozy Canal Life
details.short_description: Customise a narrowboat, live aboard, and slow right down. Fish, forage, befriend a floating community and build your dream floating home with - one very needy cat along for the ride. A heartwarming life sim about shaping your perfect floating home and community.

details.title: The Hollow Archive
details.short_description: Dive into cursed grimoires in this isometric hack-and-slash roguelike. Chain devastating skill builds, fight through shifting dungeons, and recruit rescued mythic characters to expand your library.

name: How 2D Girl Ends Up in Siberia

details.title: How 2D Girl Ends Up in Siberia
details.short_description: What terrible luck for a 2D anime girl to end up in our world, and in Siberia of all places... Or was it no coincidence?..

details.title: Remain At Your Desk
details.short_description: Incremental hacker about faking productivity while stealing from your employer. Sell intel for credits or keep it and raise suspicion. One bad audit and you’re back to Intern.

details.title: The Great Hebrew Rescue
details.short_description: The Great Hebrew Rescue is a 2D action platformer with puzzle elements, hack and slash your way through ancient forces as Abram the Hebrew. Solve Riddles, answer questions, complete quests, level up! Craft your supplies and master movement as you navigate your way through ancient Canaan.

details.title: Afterschool Brawl Club
details.short_description: After school, clubs clash for supremacy! Afterschool Brawl Club is an AutoBattle card game set in a vibrant academy city. Easy to play, hard to master. Each round choose your allies, decide which cards to keep or cut, and adapt to survive. Step into their stories and claim the top in your own way.

details.title: Shiki Tea House
details.short_description: Grow tea, brew drinks, bake desserts, and serve customers in your very own cozy tea house. Decorate and grow your shop, explore a charming semi open world, meet the locals, and discover fun side activities and hidden surprises along the way.

details.title: Aether Oblivion
details.short_description: Aether Oblivion is a story-driven, tactical turn based strategy game set in 2490 during the rule of the Stellconian Empire. Command your fleet, manage resources, and lead High Admiral Caelus on his mission to uncover the conspiracy behind the late Emperor's demise.

details.title: The Manaworks
details.short_description: Click, build, upgrade and automate! Click to gain resources, build to increase resource gathering potential, automate to get more and more, faster and faster, both passively and actively. Upgrade buildings, stats, and see the numbers go up!

details.title: Under a Turning Sky
details.short_description: A calm, meditative celestial puzzle game where you rotate planets along orbit rings, align them, and guide a signal across the stars. Solve thoughtful, zen-like logic puzzles at your own pace, accompanied by a transporting, relaxing soundtrack.

details.title: Did a Monkey Write This?
details.short_description: A cozy incremental management game. You're a failed author with a troop of cute monkey writers. Level up and build, play the publishing slot machine, race around plot holes and ski the slopes of ever-changing trends.

details.title: Tombslayers
details.short_description: Carve through undead hordes in dark tombs. Clear waves, rebuild in the shop, and snowball into broken loadouts. A fast, dark roguelike survivor.

details.title: HASSO
details.short_description: A single-player samurai card game where you don't collect cards, you learn techniques. Each turn you build a chain of blades and decide when to stop; between duels you choose what you learn, which paths you prove and which katana you forge, until the style is yours.

details.title: Hallowed Empire
details.short_description: Hallowed Empire is a real-time strategy game of kingdoms, war, and corruption. Build your empire, upgrade your warriors, forge alliances with rival factions, and decide the fate of the undead. Will you destroy them, embrace them, or turn their power against your enemies?

details.title: Burnout Bistro
details.short_description: Run a restaurant, manage your stock, staff, recipe selection and more. Decide how much you want to sacrifice for your career, as not taking care of your personal needs will leave you completely burnt out. How long can you keep everything together?

details.title: YellowJacket
details.short_description: This is a 2D platformer adventure game set in a world that has lost its color, where you retrieve scattered jackets to color the world again. Discover the rules of color and begin your journey to restore the lost colors.

details.title: Whisker Tinkers
details.short_description: Dig through boxes filled with junk, organize them in your warehouse and fulfill client orders by crafting their desired items from your gathered materials. Protect your shiny treasures from sneaky raccoons and prepare your store for inspections. Don't forget to hide what you don't want to be seen...

details.title: Coindrop Dungeon
details.short_description: Coindrop Dungeon is a Pachinko inspired dungeon crawler. Your coins and pegs from the board are your inventory. Explore builds, create synergies and break the curse that keeps you in the ever changing dungeon.

details.title: Sails of Salt
details.short_description: Set sail and become a pirate legend in this roguelite sandbox. Every voyage, a new sea: plunder, capture ships, lead your fleet and shape your crew. Greed makes you rich. Or dead. How much will you risk?

details.title: Hendichen
details.short_description: Chaotic co-op cooking for 2 or 3 players, with real recipes and a real kitchen. THE CHEF knows every recipe but has one working hand. MUFFLES barely hears you. WOBBLES reads every order as a different dish. Talk to each other, or the kitchen burns.

details.title: Touhou: Marisa! Cook It!
details.short_description: Reimu praised Sakuya's cooking one time too many, so Marisa announced she would handle the next banquet herself. Build a deck of ingredients, pour it into her magic cauldron, and watch the collisions and danmaku chain out of control. A physics-based deckbuilding roguelike.

details.title: Bestseller Tycoon
details.short_description: Build a publishing house, one book at a time. Discover authors, shape manuscripts and decide which stories deserve a place on your list. Balance literary ambition with the cost of keeping the business alive in this publishing management sim.

details.title: Anthill Wars: Ant Colony Sim
details.short_description: Grow an ant colony from a single queen into a thriving empire. Raid rival anthills, steal their brood, and strengthen your colony with captured ants. Defend your territory from giant insects and expand your nest. When the time comes, release a swarm of winged queens and begin again in distant lands.

details.title: Pupmancer
details.short_description: Pupmancer is a top-down 3D action roguelite where you fight through dangerous dungeons as a magic-wielding pup. Discover powerful spells, loot, craft potions, and build your pup’s abilities to survive each run. Adventure solo or team up online with friends to take on enemies or fight in PvP battles.

details.title: Genome Fracture
details.short_description: A fast-paced bullet heaven roguelite where reality fractures every 2 minutes. Evolve powerful mutation families, unleash devastating synergies, and create game-breaking builds as the battlefield transforms around you. Can you survive the Convergence?

details.title: Forgotten Grounds
details.short_description: Survive alone in a pixel-art wilderness where daylight can kill you. Scavenge abandoned shelters, craft essential tools, and face predators. Plan your expeditions around the sun and weather, because staying indoors won't keep you alive forever.

details.title: Omenweald : Les Erres
details.short_description: An ARPG where you build the adventure you fight through. Spin a crazy one-armed bandit, roguelite style, to win better pieces of your adventure, room after room, until the final one.

details.title: Maiden Escape
details.short_description: Play as a paranormal investigator and escape from a ghost's nightmare. A horror adventure with 168 box-pushing puzzles and 2 endings.

details.title: Liquidity
details.short_description: It's 1995 and the bank is yours. Set rates, approve loans, take deposits, deal in stocks, satisfy the regulator, and try not to break too many rules. A deep banking and finance management sim wrapped in a mid-1990’s desktop.

name: Restfield: Tidy Up the Pet Cemetery

details.title: Restfield: Tidy Up the Pet Cemetery
details.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game in a pet cemetery. Sort 1,093 headstones by animal and cross-reference photographs to put every stone back where it belongs. No timers, no penalties. Just you, the quiet, and a lot of pets somebody loved.

details.title: Ball Game
details.short_description: Ball Game is a game about making weaponified balls face each other using physics. Choose between many powerful cards, go through the rounds and watch slowly as the destruction rises!

details.title: Dour Tower
details.short_description: Stomp your way through floor after floor of a monster infested tower to reach the vampire king who stole all your blood and get it back.

details.title: Pawper: Desktop Pet
details.short_description: A virtual pet that lives on your desktop, not in a window. Pet him, feed him and throw the ball while you work. Clean up his messes for coins, then spend them on toys, outfits and furniture. He grows in real time, ages forever and never dies.

details.title: Dodgeball Disorder
details.short_description: Dodgeball Disorder is a chaotic online multiplayer dodgeball game where throwing, dodging and staying on your feet are equally important. Score hits, survive ridiculous ragdoll physics and compete across multiple game modes in a school gym with questionable supervision and crazy face expressions.

details.title: Iteration Protocol
details.short_description: Escape deadly mazes, recover fragmented memories, and restore a forgotten archive. Every run brings you closer to uncovering the truth behind the Iteration Protocol.

details.title: Steal This Station
details.short_description: Build your station. Defend it. Invade theirs. A sci-fi action RPG where you design a deadly space station filled with traps and enemies, then fight through what other players built to steal their loot. Every station is a target, including yours.

details.title: Replacement Heroes
details.short_description: The usual renowned heroes have been captured, and it's up to the backup squad to save them! Create your protagonist, recruit a team of replacement heroes, and navigate through maze-like caves in this turn-based JRPG dungeon crawler.

details.title: Belt Zero: The Long Drift
details.short_description: Stranded in the asteroid belt with a broken ship and one working drill. Repair the ship part by part, mine your way back to the stars and grow a lifeboat into an empire. Offline counts exactly like online — no timers, no microtransactions, buy once.

details.title: Silk Feast
details.short_description: Spin your web, feed a very hungry spider and watch it grow. A cozy incremental game: catch insects in the morning dew, wrap gate bosses in silk, grow your web ring by ring from a dawn garden to a moonlit meadow – and turn into six real spider species.

details.title: Ombre
details.short_description: A VR narrative sci-fi horror game. Trapped in an alien prison, you explore, investigate objects, and talk your way through an escape with Isaak, a survivor stranded in orbit who can only reach you by radio. Every conversation choice shapes what he tells you and what he keeps to himself.

details.title: Blind Seek
details.short_description: Blind Seek is a chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek party game where the hiders are invisible, but definitely not silent. Complete tasks, grab ridiculous power-ups, and escape before the seeker hears your footsteps or catches you yapping in voice chat with you friends!

details.title: Machines vs Monsters
details.short_description: Machines vs Monsters is a roguelite tower defense in space. Build turrets to defeat the monsters that each wave sends at you, choose where the map grows next, and hold your Command Center. Supply drops deal rewards between waves. Every run makes the next one stronger, and each run is unique.

details.title: OVC
details.short_description: A grid-based tower defense. Upgrade, specialize, and outfit your bases with advanced augmentations. Use weapons and research to survive the endless onslaught of enemies as they become stronger and more advanced with each level.

details.title: GridCraft
details.short_description: Shape an entire grid-based world with your mouse. Gather, craft, farm, cook, tame animals, automate production, and battle powerful bosses. Every item, machine, and creature is yours to pick up, place, and combine.

details.title: Rampartloom: PvP Tower Defense
details.short_description: Build a maze. Send an army. Win as a team. Rampartloom is a free-to-play 3v3 tower defense game where every attack grows your income. Draft a faction, defend your lane, and coordinate assaults to break the enemy team’s defenses. Play the free demo.

details.title: Magic Shop Chaos
details.short_description: A fun co-op organization simulator for 1-4 players. Team up as witches to bring order to a chaotic shop by sorting 6,000+ magical items back to their rightful places. Serve incoming customers, level up unique magical skills, and transform magical chaos into perfect order!

details.title: DOG LIVES: Space Pirates War
details.short_description: The year is 2083. As the galactic space pirate crisis reaches its breaking point, you—a "dog of the military"—must pilot a humanoid Powered Metal Frame (MF), subdue rival captains, unite them under your banner, and emerge victorious in the ultimate Pirate War!

details.title: Volleyball Sports Game
details.short_description: A sports game about Volleyball. Experience as a manager as you lead your team towards World Champion.

details.title: GyroMon: The Seekers
details.short_description: GyroMon: The Seekers is a turn-based monster-collecting RPG with a roguelite heart. Pick your starter, build your team, and push through branching maps full of trainers, events, quests, campfires, merchants, and zone bosses. Every run is different. Every team is yours.

name: Bahamut3-The Fall of the Dragon God's Child

details.title: Bahamut3-The Fall of the Dragon God's Child
details.short_description: Bahamut 3: Fall of the Dragon God's Child is a dark fantasy JRPG where every choice shapes the hero’s fate. Fight tactical battles using positioning, attack ranges, and Action Points, recruit companions tied to the Seven Deadly Sins, and manage weapons, hunger, time, and resources.

details.title: RuneEra
details.short_description: RuneEra is a fantasy colony-management RPG where you build a guild settlement, automate work and production, equip powerful runes and lead parties through a procedurally generated world of quests, factions, dangerous biomes and dungeons.

details.title: CivDle
details.short_description: A relaxing idle city-builder where a single hut grows into a sprawl of millions. Build production chains, let your civilisation expand while you're away, and Ascend to push the whole world up an order of magnitude.

details.title: When Stars Rest
details.short_description: Stars are out of energy. The black hole is hungry! Charge stars that fall on your island to earn coins. Will you upgrade weapons, unlock powerful items, and put Tesla coils and UFOs to work—or feed that black hole's growing appetite? It's all up to you!

details.title: CRIMSON PANDEMIC
details.short_description: CRIMSON PANDEMIC: A tale of the 'Rubrum'—a crimson light that mutates living beings into entities driven by resentment—and 'Belle,' a girl who has lost her dreams, embarking on a journey of promise aboard a Ark.

details.title: Burnknowe Golf Club
details.short_description: A cosy golf club tycoon in a painted Scottish landscape. Design the course, sculpt the ground, keep the greens perfect and your members happy, and grow your club from a handful of holes into a destination worth the trip.

details.title: Frostmason
details.short_description: Hunt monsters for their body parts. Assemble them into a full specimen as part of a Cold War project

details.title: Phantom of Orion
details.short_description: A WW2 submarine sim in space. Alone in an unfinished stealth prototype, run cold and dark through alien convoy lanes, strike from cloak, then vanish before the swarm sweeps back. The cloak that hides you also blinds you.

details.title: How Much For It?
details.short_description: Run a second-hand shop. Hear out your customers, value strange items, and make your offer. Some lie, some hide important details, and some deals may bring more into your shop than you bargained for.

details.title: 时装工坊
details.short_description: You are a fashion designer and run your own fashion design room. An ordinary template can be made into anything you imagine. You can also design clothes for pets and put on your own clothes to wear after the design is completed. Match the scenes and actions and take a photo of your work.

details.title: TrueClash
details.short_description: An emotional visual novel following the journeys of several fighters. Your choices shape their lives and dictate how the story unfolds. These characters have souls of their own—will you bring yours into the mix?

details.title: Parcel Point Simulator
details.short_description: Sort, Scan, Deliver and Grow — Turn a corner parcel point into a fully-automized money machine, and build your logistic empire.

details.title: CatBall
details.short_description: CatBall is a physics-based roguelite builder: arm your cat, toss it into battle, watch it roll, crash, and swing on its own, and switch weapons at the right moment to send enemies flying.

details.title: Nightmare Delivery
details.short_description: Enter distorted minds and deliver packages to the darkness within. Play alone or in online co-op for up to 4 players, explore nightmarish locations, solve environmental puzzles, outsmart dangerous entities, and escape alive.

details.title: INFAZ
details.short_description: Fight your way through tense tactical firefights. Plant or defuse the bomb, take on the opposing team, or test your aim in solo matches. Use your weapons, grenades, sound awareness, and the minimap to gain the advantage

details.title: Dead Sector: Rogue
details.short_description: Pick a core, rewrite how you fight. Reload and meteors fall. Ice spikes rise, dash to shatter them. Sprint and lightning strikes. Fight in style to climb from D to S rank and make it all strike more often. A fast FPS roguelite with two guns, a combat dog and a station stuck in a time loop

details.title: Farm Hand
details.short_description: A brain-bending deckbuilder about setting up huge harvest combos! Enhance your deck, discover game-changing synergies, and plan your harvests to maximize your score. Every crop has a timer. Every harvest is a puzzle. Every combo feels incredible.

details.title: Blindstep
details.short_description: A robot with no forward vision. You can only walk backwards and the moment you turn to look where you're going, the screen goes black. Ten sectors of collapsing floors, hydraulic presses and things that patrol the dark. Every jump is taken blind.

details.title: Delphyr: The Deep Whispers
details.short_description: Dig to the last living core of a dead world. Delphyr is a 2D action roguelite where every death sends you home to the family whose bond the Deep cannot break — upgrade with them, then dig deeper. Hand-crafted spells, a grapnel, telekinetic mining magic, and titan bosses await below.

details.title: LockLine
details.short_description: LockLine is a tense turn-based tactics game. Think 3-in-a-row, but lining up your units calls down an orbital strike. Outthink an enemy trying to do the same to you. Grab jetpacks and shields, pin enemies, drop barriers and smoke screens, and face boss commanders who change the rules.

details.title: Saving San Martino
details.short_description: A stealth adventure where you spray graffiti to reclaim Sicily from the mafia. Pick locks, tag turf, and build your base on the Mediterranean coast.

details.title: Plasma Sky
details.short_description: This week, every pilot on Earth flies the same new seeded run: identical enemies, identical drops, pure skill. Flow through alien formations, arm your wingmen, and power up when you can. Out-score your friends in Plasma Sky, an arcade shmup with over 100 handcrafted levels. Blast into the neon sky!

details.title: Astral Bounty
details.short_description: Astral Bounty is a demanding 2D arcade side-scroller straight out of the ’90s. Blast through hand-built enemy waves, hunt four bounties, earn credits and blow them on beefy upgrades in the shop. You’re going to need them. 3 difficulty levels, 4 ships, mercy optional.

details.title: Roma Eterna Sons of Mars
details.short_description: Gather your legions, build defenses, and conquer territory for ROME! Explore a doomed world, research new technologies, and uncover the legacy of Mars. "Roma Eterna: Sons of Mars" is a strategy and tower defense game. ROME WILL NEVER FALL!

details.title: WerkstattManager – Uncle Karl's Legacy
details.short_description: Take over Uncle Karl's run-down backstreet garage. Investigate symptoms, spend precious time on tests—or trust your hunch—then prepare a quote, repair the car, and rebuild your reputation in this warm, nostalgic management game.

details.title: Third Surveillance Bureau
details.short_description: Watch the monitors, spot anomalies, and protect citizens in the dead of night. The Third Surveillance Bureau is a 2D horror game centered on surveillance. Cycle through camera feeds, report irregularities in time, and uncover a reality far more terrifying than monsters.

details.title: Fifth Tier
details.short_description: Fast, readable football management. You don't just pick the XI — you own the club. Take a small side from the fourth tier of a five-tier pyramid towards the top: tactics, wages, stands, academy, shares. Then sell up and buy a bigger club. A whole season can be played in an evening.

details.title: Mercenary Galactic
details.short_description: Synergize your fleet and fight your way toward the notorious Blackstar! Mercenary Galactic is a starship autobattler featuring rogue-lite elements and powerful fleet customization. Upgrade, recruit, and optimize your way through the Velle galaxy and beyond.

details.title: POP ‘EM ALL
details.short_description: One million balloons. One tiny pin. Pop them all in a satisfying balloon-popping game! Who left them here, and why? Keep popping to uncover the mystery.

details.title: Dice Roll Society
details.short_description: The dice crafting roguelite where every roll scores. Build your scoring machine and craft five dice face by face. Beat bosses and steal their dice before your rolls run out.

details.title: Solar Arena
details.short_description: A 2D top-down versus shooter set in a wraparound space arena. Steer and boost your constantly moving craft, block attacks with a barrier, and fight in battles from 1-on-1 to 1-on-3. Customize your pilot’s appearance, with your chosen look reflected throughout the game.

details.title: UNSEAM
details.short_description: An action platformer set in a world stitched shut. Ride the cracks your attacks leave for high-speed movement, carve terrain that falls the way you cut it, and journey to recover the memories of a girl who woke from her coffin.

details.title: Death Elephant: The Manor
details.short_description: Death Elephant: The Manor is a first-person psychological horror game set in a mysterious Vietnamese estate. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover dark historical secrets, and evade terrifying entities to survive. Can you face the dark?

details.title: 02:17 The Trader’s Path
details.short_description: Build your path from an unknown trader to the top of the game in a story-driven trading experience. Trade simulated markets, manage risk, make choices that shape your journey, and uncover the story and mystery hidden behind 02:17.

details.title: NOYAKI — CONTROLLED BURN
details.short_description: A casual puzzle game about controlled burning! Fire obeys the land and wind: racing uphill, fading downhill, stopping at cliffs and rivers. You choose only when and where to light it. Read the slopes, read the wind, cut firebreaks, move the livestock, and burn the grassland exactly as you meant to.

details.title: Chainball
details.short_description: Chainball is a physics-driven couch sports brawler for up to four players, where animal champions swing, throw, and reel in chained flails to smash the ball into the opposing goal... and each other!

details.title: Herd League
details.short_description: Grow a small herd into a thriving ranch in this farming strategy game. Breed and exchange animals, manage your pasture, expand your land, protect your herd from wolves, and race other ranchers to reach the cow goal first. Play solo or online.

details.title: SPOTREP
details.short_description: SPOTREP features MILSIM game mechanics, each dynamically changing how you play. Spotted a stationary target? Call in a GRG based CALL FOR FIRE including method of control and number of rounds. Your AI or player teammates are down? Call in a 4 liner MEDEVAC!

details.title: Dynasty Basketball Manager
details.short_description: Win 3 titles in 5 seasons—or the run ends. A roguelite basketball GM where the right mix of player styles unlocks tactics, like TFT synergies. Draft, trade and shop between games, then call the shots when the clock stops. Pick one of 16 franchises; a full run takes about four hours.

details.title: Chef Boss Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own fast food shop in a chaotic first-person cooking simulator. Grill, fry, stack and serve every order yourself, then spend the takings on new stations, drink stands, staff and a floor you lay out and repaint yourself. You hire the crew, but you are always the chef.

details.title: Orbit Anomaly
details.short_description: Orbit Anomaly is a cooperative sci-fi horror game about robots exploring abandoned space facilities, scavenging scrap to upgrade their base, and trying not to become prey for the monsters lurking within.

name: A Normal Quiz Game where you try to solve questions but the questions have tricks and gimmicks and if you get them wrong you have to beat a wacky punishment but they are kinda fun so you lowkey wanna do them even if it means getting the question wrong.

details.title: A Normal Quiz Game where you try to solve questions but the questions have tricks and gimmicks and if you get them wrong you have to beat a wacky punishment but they are kinda fun so you lowkey wanna do them even if it means getting the question wrong.
details.short_description: Solve puzzles, test your reflexes, and do your taxes in this normal quiz game that is actually quite unusual.

details.title: Armada Ascendant
details.short_description: Command modular fleets in a top-down tactics game where every shot is aimed by hand. Build warships socket by socket, flick projectiles across drifting battlefields, and carry damage, veterans, and hard choices through a 60-mission campaign.

details.title: Driver Wars
details.short_description: A chaotic and satirical late-stage capitalistic driving simulator. In this low-poly 3D world, live out the fantasies and nightmares of countless commuters gridlocked in traffic as you ram, blow up, set ablaze, toss donuts at, honk, grapple, and total hordes of terrible and aggressive NPC drivers.

details.title: Ledger of Names
details.short_description: You've taken over your uncle's shop for 100 days. Stock up from your suppliers, read what customers really need, and set your own prices. Follow the town's news, grow your trade partners, and keep the shelves ready. As the fog thickens, one sale today can change someone's tomorrow.

details.title: Trinity Descent
details.short_description: A dark idle RPG about descending into the deep: assemble a party from ten classes, pick your route through branching zones and let them fight on their own. Bank your loot in time or lose it all. Enhance your gear, forge the great sets and climb down the Endless Mine.

details.title: Neon Gamble Trail
details.short_description: Cyberpunk roguelike slot game. Enter a neon tavern. Roll three numbers 1–9 for winning combos to battle rivals. Collect numbers and tokens to strengthen your build. Explore branching paths, encounter random events, and recover at supply stops. Strategize, spin reels, and create an unbeatable lineup.

details.title: Pray & Slay
details.short_description: Wipe out hordes of monsters with holy magic in this action-packed incremental game. Multiply your gold with darts and grow stronger with every run. Corrupt your holy spells to unleash devastating dark powers.

details.title: SOGUL: Den of the Deep
details.short_description: Fight with your right hand, keep the beat with your left. Every note you land sharpens your strike — and every enemy blow can be parried on rhythm. Descend 50 floors to the Lich below with four companions you named yourself, in this rhythm-driven turn-based roguelite.

details.title: Horror Club: Grandpa's House
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where you stay with your grandfather for a few days after he starts acting strangely. Help him with everyday tasks, follow his unusual rules, and experience unsettling events around the house as the story unfolds.

details.title: Labyrinth: The Descent
details.short_description: The maze is alive. The gold is bait. You're the meal. A permadeath dungeon crawler where the dungeon is keeping score: ten floors, one rogue, turn-based tactics on a grid. When you die that's it for the run — but your grave heals the next hero who finds it.

details.title: Carry On
details.short_description: Carry On is a chaotic 1-4 player local co-op baggage handling game. Grab, wash, wrap and hurl colour-coded luggage down the conveyors to fill every departing flight's manifest before the clock runs out. Miss the plane and the whole terminal pays for it.

details.title: Murder Sudoku
details.short_description: A single-player logic puzzle game. A series of mysterious murders that seem unrelated are, in fact, connected by countless threads. Use Sudoku-style logical deduction to organize suspects, evidence, and clues, and uncover the secrets behind the cases.

details.title: Dungeonhand
details.short_description: A single-player horror game about being hunted while you work. The contractors have given you ten nights to dig your debt out of an ancient dungeon. Everything you are carrying is lost when you die, and every death costs you one of the nights.

details.title: Circuitra
details.short_description: Circuitra is a challenging visual logic puzzle game about building increasingly complex circuit boards. Limited inputs, tight board space and changing contract constraints force you to debug and rethink your designs in order to grow your circuit-design business.

details.title: Forklift Logistics Simulator
details.short_description: Take control of a physics-based forklift as you move pallets, stack cargo and load trucks through increasingly challenging warehouse missions. Precision, balance and careful handling are at the heart of the experience.

details.title: Operation Blackwaste
details.short_description: Scavenge, fight, and survive in a zombie-ravaged wasteland. Build your safe house, take quests, manage hunger and thirst, craft your build with gear and ability trees, clear wave-based Purge stages — or let auto-combat grind for you. Every sortie and extraction makes you stronger.

details.title: Warcaste TCG
details.short_description: The Warcaste TCG is a tactical sci-fi digital trading card game where battlefield positioning matters. Choose a Doctrine, command your fleet, and outmaneuver your enemy across a 3 zone battlefield. Play in story mode, solo play, or online PvP.

details.title: Highways & Co.
details.short_description: Do you hate building cities but love managing traffic? Design the perfect road network in this traffic simulator. Build interchanges, roundabouts, bridges, and tunnels with powerful road-building tools. Keep traffic flowing, solve congestion, and avoid a pile-up!

details.title: Potion Drifter
details.short_description: A cozy first-person alchemy game with hands-on physics. Cast out of the city of alchemists, travel from village to village with a fold-out cart. Throw herbs into your cauldron, pour water, and grind ingredients to brew potions for people you meet. Discover recipes, explore, and grow as an alchemist.

details.title: Super Kanji Flash
details.short_description: A cute anime action runner where you fight off ink aliens by reading the kanji they stole. Answer each one with a single press mid-run, and your brush strikes the alien down. Learn 6,000+ kanji, from zero to JLPT N1 and beyond. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 8.

details.title: Everything We Brought Here
details.short_description: A last-stand auto-battler on a dead magic world. Choose your heroes, upgrade their abilities, and try to hold on one more night.

details.title: Five to Fire
details.short_description: A showdown of quick hands! The instant the table holds exactly five bullets, hit the lever and load your revolver. Shoot down every rival and survive as a gunslinging legend. A real-time multiplayer party game for 2-6 players.

details.title: Bake It Tight
details.short_description: A cute, real-time cookie factory puzzle. Animal customers keep pouring in, but you only have a few machines. Place them, link them to the ovens with rails, and bake the cookies your customers want. Can you fill every order on time?

details.title: Cargo Tempo
details.short_description: Turn delivery chaos into a plan that works. Assign orders, optimize routes and build your fleet in this route-planning management game. Plan at your own pace, then watch your vehicles put your decisions to the test across short, multi-day runs.

details.title: The Painting War: Three Thrones
details.short_description: A grid-based formation-building autobattler set in the Three Kingdoms. Lay paper, scenery, and illustrated warriors onto a limited board, then rotate, merge, and connect them into an army. Your units fight automatically from their original tiles—study the outcome and rebuild for the next battle.

details.title: Farmer=nil
details.short_description: Farmer = nil is a programming-based automation farm right on your computer screen! Write scripts for your robots, collect resources, unlock tech, and build the most efficient farm.

details.title: Projekt Gartenzwerg
details.short_description: Projekt Gartenzwerg is a co-op horde defense FPS for 1 to 4 players. Night falls, and thousands of ceramic garden gnomes march on your position. Grab a WW2 arsenal, build your defenses and hold the line until dawn, alone or with your friends.

details.title: Strategic Command: Korea
details.short_description: Command United Nations or Communist forces in the first major conflict of the Cold War. Fight across a vast, highly detailed map of Korea, master new units and mechanics, and reshape the course of the war from the Pusan Perimeter to the Chosin Reservoir and beyond.

details.title: Seaside Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Grow your very own seaside shop! Sell products, earn profits, expand your store, plan the layout, and experience the journey of building a successful business from the ground up.

details.title: Kaartel
details.short_description: Hunt a moving thief across Europe. Ask questions, eliminate cities, predict their next move, block escape routes, and intercept them before they get away.

details.title: Ramen Haven
details.short_description: Turn a humble ramen cart into the shop of your dreams in this cozy cooking and management game. Prepare delicious ramen, delight customers, unlock new recipes, upgrade and decorate your space, and grow your small business into a thriving restaurant.

details.title: SOULLOOP
details.short_description: A steampunk roguelite FPS with deckbuilding. Draft a card after every floor: your revolver chains lightning, your saw thrower freezes enemies. Combine powerful builds, bank your souls when you die, and spend them to make your next descent stronger. Free demo out now.

details.title: UNCUT
details.short_description: UNCUT is a tactical police raid shooter seen through a bodycam. Shout real orders into your mic and suspects react: some comply, some run, some open fire. Clear houses solo with two NPC officers or in co-op with up to 4 players. No raid plays out the same.

name: Lomiya: Do LLMs Dream of Modern Poetry?

details.title: Lomiya: Do LLMs Dream of Modern Poetry?
details.short_description: A near-future visual novel — No androids. No cyberware. Only an LLM girl, the world, and you.

details.title: Slipstreak
details.short_description: A free-for-all arcade shooter where speed is your damage. Bhop, wallrun, slide and rocket-jump to fill your streak and hit harder, then beat everyone to the big guns on the map. 2–8 players over Steam or LAN, with bots and time-trial courses. The movement is the whole game.

details.title: COMETROX!
details.short_description: Nobody told the keyboard it wasn't a guitar.

details.title: Graveline
details.short_description: A first-person survival horror operation sim. Drive a steam locomotive through one night. Feed the boiler, read signals, and hold the deadman's lever while something advances car by car. Kill the light to hide and lose your gauges. Make noise to survive and it hears you. One life.

details.title: Drone Operations
details.short_description: Pilot combat drones through diverse missions with realistic FPV flight simulation. Scout targets, drop grenades, launch explosive strikes and fire mounted weapons against enemies who flee, seek shelter or escape in vehicles. Earn stars to unlock new operations, drones and upgrades.

details.title: MODice
details.short_description: MODice is a dice-building roguelike. Roll five dice, then rearrange them for higher scores! Socket gems and combine sets to turn scores into board movement. Choose your landing spot, build and upgrade, and shape a stronger build to overcome changing Boss rules before your rolls run out.

details.title: Nightfreight
details.short_description: A single-player body-horror roguelite auto-battler. Draft vat-grown mutants, pay for power in flesh, arrange your squad on a train-car grid, then hit DEPART. Fights resolve automatically. Most upgrades corrupt their host; a unit pushed too far mutates, seizes up, or turns on its own squad.

details.title: Lively
details.short_description: Lively is a puzzle-platformer where two rival creatures fight for control of the planet. Use ever-changing powers to make your way through a unique world !

details.title: Doll Arena
details.short_description: A dark 2D metroidvania steeped in Slavic folklore. Play as a red motanka doll with button eyes, armed only with needles – stab, throw, parry, reclaim. Explore an interconnected hand-drawn world, then battle up to 3 friends in local or LAN PvP arenas

details.title: Song of Larithea
details.short_description: Larithea is a cute anime RPG about friendship, trust, revenge, and finding your way back from the darkness. Craft your own spells from sigils, then lead a team of five young mages through turn-based battles on a grid. Others have walked their road before. Few found their way back.

details.title: Mayhematic
details.short_description: Mayhematic is a bullet heaven where the next door is always worth the trouble behind it. Blast through cartoon hordes solo or in 4-player online co-op, spend your kills on doors that go deeper, build something ridiculous and put your name on the leaderboard.

details.title: Mercenary Guild Manager
details.short_description: Raise a banner and run a mercenary guild in a grim medieval fantasy realm. Recruit and read your blades, negotiate contracts, send them into procedural missions, and survive a living political web where every payday bites and nothing is ever certain.

details.title: Fallen Crowns
details.short_description: Gear up at the inn, then raid a fallen king's castle with up to eight other players. Monsters, rival parties and traps stand between you and its treasure. Grab what you can carry and reach a portal before the grave-rot rises. Fall, and whoever finds your body keeps your gear.

details.title: Dieabolic
details.short_description: A retro rogue-lite dice-builder. Roll your dice to fight. Upgrade your dice to get stronger. Battle through the 9 levels of Dante’s inferno

details.title: Fleshgrinder
details.short_description: Fleshgrinder is an isometric post-apocalyptic Action-RPG. Take on the desperate mission to stop the Fleshgrinder from causing planetary extinction by harvesting the infected population. Loot, equip and level up your characters, interact with npcs in a persistent world filled with quests and danger.

details.title: AI TYCOON
details.short_description: Found your AI company in the wildest gold rush of the century. Source quality training data, race to new architectures, and turn research into revenue. Balance burn rate against breakthroughs, outmaneuver rivals, and build a tech empire. A deep management sim.

details.title: YinShu
details.short_description: Played The Message? YinShu is a free online social deduction card game inspired by it, for 4–8 players. Everyone hides a faction and passes intel; read friend from foe in who accepts and who refuses. Intercept, see through and swap intel with character skills. Collect three of your color to win.

details.title: StrongGirls Tactics
details.short_description: Turn-based tactics RPG where your girls grow muscles as they get stronger. Recruit 18 girls, each with their personal stories and struggles. As your bonds deepen, they grow stronger and more muscular. Wrapped in a Norse themed world where you fight to reclaim the kingdom.

details.title: Gate Logic
details.short_description: Gate Logic lets you build any logic circuit made up from the Boolean logic gates NOT, AND, OR, NOR, XOR and XNOR on an infinite, grid based canvas.

details.title: Earth Tourist
details.short_description: Find yourself in an endless open world and journey from the Stone Age to quantum immortality. Advance technologies, build cities and rockets, manage a dynasty, and conquer space in a massive Sci-Fi sandbox with total freedom of action!

details.title: Treehouse
details.short_description: An aesthetically pleasing treehouse toy. Build up and out, and the branches support your structures. Connect rooms with ladders and walkways, or carve footpaths through the grassy glen to interactable ponds. Create the ambient orchestral soundtrack with your treehouse, and set the perfect lighting.

details.title: GO, my pretties!
details.short_description: Go My Pretties is a game about commanding a small army of cute robots. Fight through procedurally generated dungeons to collect resources, craft upgrades and get stronger.

details.title: HEARTHWATCH
details.short_description: HEARTHWATCH is a roguelite tower defense where the map tears open mid-battle. Guard your village's last fire across a branching Stone Age campaign: build elemental towers, bond them into hybrids, draw cards from your run's deck, and hold the new lane when the ground splits.

details.title: Taskbar Garden
details.short_description: Grow a living procedural garden along your desktop while you work or relax. Harvest plants for profit, breed plants, fuse genetic seeds, and discover rare mutations as every seed grows into a completely unique plant.

details.title: Plastic
details.short_description: You're a plastic soldier battling on 5 acres of backyard. Fight on foot, crew tanks, fly helicopters, and command bots in a combined-arms shooter. Capture toy cities, requisition equipment, and establish defenses as you advance toward the enemy base.

details.title: Dark Tidings Online
details.short_description: A classic, Tiny-MMORPG experience. From a penniless nobody dropped with no memories into an unknown world, to a hero ... or a villain? Join a faction of your choice and learn a wide array of skills. Help out villagers in need, battle in the wilds and explore dungeons. Alone or with friends!

details.title: Full Stretch
details.short_description: Intuitive goalkeeper controls. Do not think. All you have to do is make the save.

details.title: Dream Loop
details.short_description: A first-person music-puzzle adventure. Wander surreal dreamscapes, record the world around you, and mix what you find into original tracks. Turn up your headphones and drop out.
developers: The Mad Men of Oopsy Daisy, Inc
publishers: The Mad Men of Oopsy Daisy, Inc

details.title: Snap Quest
details.short_description: A Photo Collection Adventure Game. Complete your research notebook, solve creature puzzles, earn research grant money. Buy upgrades for your camera, rebuild the town, bond with the locals, and reveal the paranormal mystery of Star Island.

details.title: Fire and Brim Co.
details.short_description: Embark on a wild and wacky adventure in this top-down action RPG! Take on the role of Ned, a disgruntled demon employee seeking to restore Hell's former glory. Fight your way through the corporate ladder of Fire and Brim Co., to confront its leaders and its evil CEO Satan!

details.title: Glitch Core
details.short_description: In the far future where AI has been deemed too dangerous and sent to the moon, you play as a rogue AI agent fighting through battle simulations to unravel the true purpose of your design in this tactical, immersive, procedural FPS rogue lite with split screen co-op where the code FIGHTS BACK!

details.title: Iterum: Incremental Boss Rush
details.short_description: Fight your way through bosses, Level up stats and unlock new areas and features, a boss rush with an incremental twist.

details.title: Joga Bonito: Football Roguelike
details.short_description: A football roguelike deckbuilder. You pick the plays, then step in when it counts: take the penalties and free kicks, settle the duels, call a time-out and fire three powers on Q, W and E. Before every kickoff a roulette draws one rule for the whole match, from giants to a bowling ball.

details.title: Squid Grid
details.short_description: Each puzzle reveals a ray of light scattered across this moody hand-inked Steampunk Ocean. Can you crack the peculiar yet (eventually) obvious logic of the Squid Grid?

details.title: Tiles of War
details.short_description: A turn-based tactics game, where every tile can be captured to become part of your territories. More territories, more money, better troops. Finish the three campaigns or become number one in competitive multiplayer with an Elo ranking system! Don’t worry, there is also a skirmish mode.

details.title: Lexomancy
details.short_description: A fantastical deckbuilding rouguelike, all packed into a traditional word game. Play as a Lexomancer, a magic user who can channel their power through Runic Tiles, and venture fourth on a quest to find the ever elusive Necrolexicon

details.title: Undercroft
details.short_description: A first-person pixel-art roguelite. Climb a dead king's castle from its sewers to his throne as one of three heroes, through rooms laid out fresh every run. Read each enemy's tell, take what relics you find, and when you fall, start again from the camp.

details.title: Ants in Space!
details.short_description: A roguelike strategy game where you evolve and mutate your space ants to repel an invasion of asteroid termites! Combine fast-paced exploration of tiny planets with spaceship travel across the galaxy. Find the ultimate ant DNA combination to withstand the unstoppable force.

details.title: Unnatural Worlds
details.short_description: Innovative yet familiar real-time strategy game in development. Grand-scale RTS game played on maps/planets of any 3D shape. It emphasizes strategy, base building, logistics, and reduces micro-management of individual units.

details.title: BaulaQuest
details.short_description: Local middle school teacher fights angry orange bald man army with marbles and furry creatures. Baula. Quest. BaulaQuest.

details.title: r:STRIKE
details.short_description: Get ready for a thrilling shooter racing experience. Feel the immense power and speed from your tank as you liberate a stunning city from it's deadly drone invaders.

details.title: 304 Seconds
details.short_description: As Kuroya, you wake up in an unfamiliar place together with your trusty partner, Nicole, and soon learn that your memories have been tampered with. Can you overcome the trials in this mystery visual novel?

details.title: RANGER COMMANDO
details.short_description: Nostalgic '80s-inspired isometric tactical shooter. Explore randomly generated missions, assassinate officers, free hostages, blow stuff up. No handholding, but easy to pick up!

details.title: Elemdian
details.short_description: A mystical action-adventure where you shift between human and wolf, combining elemental powers to cast powerful spells. Explore islands alongside a fairy survivor, and uncover the connection between a mysterious attack and a spreading Dark Mist.

details.title: Hell Games
details.short_description: Get ready for Hell Games: In this action packed player vs player arena brawler 4 fallen athletes, once cheaters and dopers, battle it out in the depths of hell. Knock out opponents with sports gear, power up, and strive to be the last one standing.

details.title: Omnivael: Chronicles of the realm
details.short_description: Free sandbox RPG at kingdom scale: trade, craft, fight, buy land, raise a family, and leave a legacy in Year 1500 Omnivael. No main quest — Early Access starts in Mystria.

details.title: Medimon
details.short_description: Medimon is a medical-themed monster-taming RPG. Capture, battle, and evolve creatures symbolizing medical concepts, turning intricate organ systems and diseases into an interactive and captivating game experience. Dive in and make medicine an adventure!

details.title: Long Trip
details.short_description: Long Trip is a dark fantasy VR action RPG where you explore the shattered lands aboard the skyship The Dust, battle bosses, ride legendary mounts, summon allies, and uncover ancient secrets across a world scarred by war.

details.title: Zero Hero
details.short_description: Zero Hero is a fast, endless roguelike shooter. Jump through a broken timeline, stack wild weapon upgrades, and survive waves of monsters and bosses. Bank your loot or risk it all. A free demo is available now — wishlist the full game on Steam!

details.title: The Milgram Experiment
details.short_description: A single-player moral dilemma simulator where you are judge, jury, and executioner. Investigate subjects through their personal items such as phones, diaries, and voice logs and uncover their darkest secrets. Judge if they fit a mysterious figure's new secret society. Terminate the unworthy.

details.title: Hyper Fin
details.short_description: Hyper Fin is a High-Speed Arena Fighter where you Out-Maneuver your enemies and Bash into their weak points.

details.title: BEATVISTA
details.short_description: For little ones and hardcore players alike. BEATVISTA is a rhythm game where every track, with music and video from AI video creators, gets a stage of its own. Play one-button mini-games or hammer through HELL charts on four keys, and rewind any tricky passage to practice.

details.title: Tactics And Cards
details.short_description: Feel like a hero in a classic RTS! Build your army and crush the enemy team with spells, incremental upgrades, and tactics! Battle it out in a quick match against bots or friends in a 2D battle in the best traditions of auto-battlers, Tower Defense, and Castle Fight!

details.title: Astro
details.short_description: Astro is a team-based multiplayer FPS that explores the exhilarating feeling of combat in zero gravity. Master a roster of innovative weapons and abilities that make strategy and speed just as deadly as your aim.

details.title: Folder Dungeon
details.short_description: What if your desktop was a dungeon? Explore folders, slay bugs, collect relics, modify them and create broken combos in this OS-themed roguelike dungeon crawler!

details.title: Beencremental
details.short_description: Beencremental is a colorful incremental game where you guide the Queen Bee, forage pollen and turn every drop into honey. Upgrade your hive, grow an unstoppable swarm, and conquer four changing seasons as your production climbs from a few bees to a buzzing empire.

name: Escape from Planet Pan: Scam Center

details.title: Escape from Planet Pan: Scam Center
details.short_description: A fake job offer traps you inside the notorious Planet Pan Scam Center. Enduring daily abuse from guards, you are forced to scam strangers into fake investments while secretly planning an escape. A unique Butterfly Effect system brings past characters into future runs so you can change their fate.

details.title: Song of Maka
details.short_description: Enter the wholesome Kingdom of Birds in Song of Maka. As a newborn bird, explore beautiful sky islands through song and flight. Uncover charming stories, hatch adorable companions, or simply relax to soothing melodies and breathtaking views.

details.title: Back of Beyond
details.short_description: Eldritch cult meets roguelite deckbuilding. Something stirs in a misty town... Recruit cute animal townsfolk, build your cult's deck, and grow your secret cult. Place buildings, pair them with townsfolk, and turn faith and devotion into forbidden power. Can you resist the Eldritch Gods' corruption?

details.title: Charlatan
details.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilder, but you don't trust luck, you CHEAT it. Rig a haunted slot machine and snowball numbers into a nice dopamine Jackpot!

details.title: Animal Bakery
details.short_description: Manage a cozy subway bakery in an underground animal city - run by a "retired" gangster you're secretly investigating. Serve cute locals, expand the bakery, prepare for festivals, meet strange visitors and explore the subway after hours for fun stories and special rewards!

details.title: Vale's Echo
details.short_description: Death isn’t the end - it’s your last chance. Solve haunting puzzles and make choices that matter as you guide Vale across the underworld. Will regret follow her into eternity?

details.title: Valerie
details.short_description: Follow Valerie on a charming 2D adventure where you'll jump, slide, bounce and boost your way through dense forests and dreamscapes using her bubble powers.

details.title: Edge of Madness
details.short_description: Edge of Madness is a Lovecraftian RPG with tactical card-based combat. Explore the grounds around the Marsh Estate, find equipment, combat cards, and combine them with character skills. Find a way to defeat your enemies without losing your sanity.

details.title: Deus Exia
details.short_description: “Before your planet gets blown into smithereens, take this sword and protect yourself.” Embark on a colorful 2D pixel action adventure in Deus Exia! Slash, parry and combo through four distinct lands. Collect cards and skills to craft powerful builds — then overcome deadly enemies and bosses.

details.title: Whisk
details.short_description: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.

details.title: Bladesmith Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Rule the anvil! Harness magic-infused ores brimming with otherworldly effects to forge legendary weapons. Stock a thriving smithy, scour wild lands for epic loot, and outsmith fierce rivals in grand tournaments to crown yourself the continent's ultimate bladesmith tycoon!

details.title: HYPERyuki: Snowboard Syndicate
details.short_description: Race, trick, and explore across vibrant slopes with a cast of unique riders. Master speed, style, and control in this fast-paced arcade snowboarder. Prove it where it counts, split-screen with friends or head-to-head online multiplayer. Shred the mountain. Rip the competition.

details.title: Gods, Death & Reapers
details.short_description: An innovative ExtrAction RPG set in an afterlife where mythology is real and the gods are dead. Fight through PvPvE, PvE, or as a party to claim valuable loot and bring balance to the shattered realms.

details.title: HELLCARD II
details.short_description: Hellcard II is a unique co-op deck-builder roguelike game. Descend into the paper dungeons on your own or invite friends to fast-paced tactical card battles against hordes of evil and dragons. Lots of dragons!

details.title: Red Recon: 1944
details.short_description: Red Recon is an isometric real-time tactics game with stealth elements, where you command a squad of Soviet scouts deployed into East Prussia in the autumn of 1944, on the eve of the Red Army’s strategic offensive. Be the first in the enemy’s lair!

details.title: Project:Null Hypothesis
details.short_description: You will play as Elias found recordings, exploring the anomalous space with him. Uncover the sinister secrets of the Backrooms as you wander through endless corridors and frighteningly familiar rooms.

details.title: Reply All
details.short_description: A single player roguelite deckbuilder where emails are turn-based combat and you build a deck of devastating responses that will bring even your most passive-aggressive coworker to their knees.

details.title: Project SEVER
details.short_description: Project Sever is an adventure submarine simulator with a touch of horror. Master the controls of an old Project "Sever" submarine and learn to maintain it in working order to escape a deadly underwater trap and solve the mystery of the Anomalous Zone.

details.title: Army of the Potomac
details.short_description: A digital version of the grand tactical wargame published by GMT Games and designed by Mark Herman. Second in the Civil War Heritage Series, this game includes scenarios for five individual battles covering the period of 1862 to 1864, and two campaign scenarios using eight maps from the boardgame.

details.title: The Unfinished Melody: Prologue
details.short_description: Some things can never be made whole, and some melodies are never meant to be played. Pursue a lost song, unspoken feelings, and precious memories as you step into a mysterious fantasy world of light, shadow, and dreamlike adventure.

details.title: Find the Ojisan
details.short_description: You must not overlook coworkers hiding to work overtime—a surreal horror clocking-out simulator where you try to leave a strange office safely, day after day.

details.title: Rescue Drone Simulator: Second Chance
details.short_description: Pilot drones into burning buildings, frozen landmarks, and collapsing tunnels. Rescue survivors, build and customize your fleet, and lead a team of specialists who never got a second chance - until now.

details.title: Rust & Dust
details.short_description: Rust & Dust is A fast-paced 2D roguelike Shooter about two twin mice fighting through a ruined world. Instantly switch between them, combine their powers, and turn positioning into a weapon. Master the chaos or be overrun!

details.title: The Polar Darkness
details.short_description: A Lovecraftian folk horror mystery set during the polar night of 1980s northern Finland. When a child preacher disappears during a revival sermon, a journalist becomes trapped in an isolated village where something ancient is beginning to awaken.

details.title: The Refuge
details.short_description: Build and upgrade your refuge, gear up, and take on dangerous missions alone or with up to 3 players. Recover valuable resources, expand your camp, and choose your contracts wisely: the greater the reward, the greater the risk.

details.title: COVR
details.short_description: COVR is a high-stakes tactical VR shooter built around next-gen visuals, grounded realism, and tense CQB. Deploy solo or in co-op, complete classic tactical objectives, adapt to unpredictable missions, and make every decision count. Coming in 2026.

details.title: Linkisa
details.short_description: Linkisa is a hand-drawn Metroidvania set in a world inspired by Malagasy folklore and steampunk aesthetics. Play as General Linkisa, stripped of his memories, and explore the rain-soaked regions of the Empire of Orana in search of your past and the restoration of order. Masina ny orana.

details.title: CounterMind
details.short_description: A planetary RTS against an adaptive enemy that learns how you play. Lead machine legions or the hive swarm across ground, sea, air, and space. The enemy doesn't cheat. It plays smarter. Can you outsmart the opposing minds?

details.title: Fuman Ghoul
details.short_description: A two-week story about a girl whose stress summons monsters. Dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and make it to school on time in this fast-paced action adventure.

details.title: Blob Wars
details.short_description: Blob Wars is a turn-based tactics game where efficiency is key. Use each Blob’s unique abilities to defeat the enemy army in as few turns as possible, the fewer turns you take, the greater the reward. Traverse a branching world map and carve your own path through this replayable experience.

details.title: Qamar
details.short_description: Roll a planet through an ink-and-wash world in this physics-based precision platformer. Build momentum, ride walls, glide across gaps, and use sidespin to nail your landings. Dodge catapult fire, brave huge drops, and chase your perfect run.

details.title: Meet Mary
details.short_description: Meet Mary is a 1-4 player co-op horror story puzzle game. Interact with strange characters as you explore your way through strange visions & a dubious bunker. Solve puzzles to move forward into the unknown and experience 19 unique handcrafted levels with a story that will be sure to stay with you.

details.title: Firewall: Defend The Grid
details.short_description: Become a hacker building cyber defense systems in this retro-futuristic strategy tower defense game. Build your firewall using limited compute power and sector space, connect mods, fight along your defenses running programs and expand to new sectors to protect the Grid from ever-growing chaos.

details.title: Trial of Ember
details.short_description: Assemble a band of forest allies to defend your woodland home in this roguelike auto-battler. Level your hero, recover artifacts, upgrade allies and learn spells to build powerful synergies. Strategically deploy your forces to repel the rising flame and complete the Trial of Ember.

details.title: The Amazing Bird Miner
details.short_description: The Amazing Bird Miner is a unique incremental game where you mine ore and capture birds to live with you in your bird grotto. Equip and upgrade your gear to become a better miner. Scavenge for materials and choose your specialization as you save the planet as The Amazing Bird Miner!

details.title: Hollowbound
details.short_description: A co-op puzzle adventure for exactly two players. One of you finds the clue, the other has to act on it. Pull levers, crack rune puzzles, brew potions and outrun a collapsing mine together – every puzzle needs both of you.

details.title: The Archivist
details.short_description: A psychological horror experience set in the Backrooms. Explore a failed government facility, hack corrupted systems, and descend into a story where memory and reality collapse.

details.title: RunIn: Encounters
details.short_description: RunIn: Encounters is a competitive fantasy PvP experience focused on tactical teamplay, skill-based combat, evolving builds, and intense round-based multiplayer encounters.

details.title: Augment Protocol
details.short_description: Enter a retro-futuristic nightmare of failed human augmentation. Fight relentless hordes, earn Bio-Credits, unlock quarantined facility sectors, and eradicate the grotesque experiments NeuraCorp left behind.

details.title: Particle Collectotron
details.short_description: Click and collect energy in this short, active incremental. Upgrade your reactor, tune injector payload and trajectories, unlock exotic matter, and push the experiment past its limits.

details.title: Rise Under the Warstorm
details.short_description: Build the production lines that power your defense. An automated economy supports your army as you command it against enemy waves. Upgrade cards and the technologies shape your strategy for the battles ahead.

details.title: The Necessary Evil
details.short_description: The Necessary Evil is a tactical RPG about making difficult decisions and preparing for the unpredictable. Lead "volunteers" into the dark and rotting recesses of the collective unconscious, colonized and industrialized and plundered for profit. Every decision matters, and every choice has a cost.

details.title: Mech Support
details.short_description: Mech Support is an action focused, multitasking game, featuring frantic tower defense elements. Up to four players take control of "US Inc" engineers, tasked with defending military outposts and crafting powerful ammunition, in order to destroy waves of dastardly "THEM Co" enemy mechs.

details.title: Kitman
details.short_description: KITMAN is a 1-4 player job simulator set in the backrooms of a football stadium. Run the team by running the locker room. Clean the team’s boots, patch jerseys, mop floors, and when no-one is looking… sneak into the gaffer’s office and fix the game plan!

details.title: Nekome: Nazi Hunter
details.short_description: Hunt and kill Nazis in a stealthy single-player campaign with bloody and brutal melee combat. Study your enemies, confirm your approach, and become an unexpected assassin fueled by violent revenge.

details.title: Static Between Stations
details.short_description: Static Between Stations is a narrative-driven RPG in the dying city of Patchwater. Explore, negotiate, scavenge, craft or try your best to avoid conflict. In a fight for survival adaptability is your only advantage.

details.title: ABISMO
details.short_description: ABISMO is a co-op deep-sea horror game set on the abyssal floor of an alien planet. Descend alone or with up to 4 players into shifting trenches, explore derelict facilities, and recover what you need to survive while uncovering an analog-horror mystery hidden in corrupted VHS tapes.

details.title: QUIET
details.short_description: Your ship crashed, your crew is stranded, and this house is somehow your best chance of survival. Search for ship parts while every movement and real-world sound risks alerting whatever lurks nearby. Stay QUIET, keep your flock together, and try not to quack under pressure.

details.title: Infant God
details.short_description: You are the guardian of an infant god. Guide Aistalt through the toxic ruins of the internet. Debate with random users, harvest their ideologies, and sculpt her personality matrix. Will you raise a benevolent savior or a tyrant who deletes humanity?

details.title: The Granny Detective Society
details.short_description: Play as Madeleine, a retired granny recruited by the Granny Detective Society (basically the FBI… but add dentures). Investigate your neighbors, figure out their names and professions, and uncover all their secrets in this no-murder detective game full of white hair and mugs of tea.

details.title: DreadHaven: The Last Colony
details.short_description: Build by day. Survive by night. Each day, use a limited number of actions to expand your city, manage resources, reinforce defenses, and prepare for what’s coming. Each night, unleash the power of your towers against the ever-growing zombie hordes.

details.title: Leafborn
details.short_description: Leafborn is a fast-paced action game where you command a being made of thousands of leaves. Explore a universe of floating islands, discover new abilities, shapeshift, and mercilessly tear apart Nulls robots draining this world's life energy!

details.title: Letters Past
details.short_description: Play as a postman delivering a letter over a quiet mountain path. See the sights, journal your observations, discover secrets and piece together a story you can't experience all at once.

details.title: Hollow Faces
details.short_description: Hollow Faces is an atmospheric narrative horror where you step into the role of creators documenting paranormal phenomena. The game blends an intense walking simulator with environmental observation, careful listening, and reacting to threats.

details.title: We Are So Cooked
details.short_description: You and your friends are in trouble. Big trouble. You’ve accidentally killed someone, and now you have to get rid of the evidence. "We Are So Cooked" is a 1-4 player co-op physics-stealth game where the objective is simple: Get the body to the exit. The execution? That’s the hard part.

details.title: Minutes to Meltdown
details.short_description: Everything breaks on your 6 minute shift in this 1960s nuclear power plant. You and up to 3 colleagues keep the power flowing, the town lit, and the reactor from melting down. Push for one more shift, or clock out while you're ahead?

details.title: Cafe Life Simulator
