details.short_description: Manage your dream cafe, but don't stop there. In this comprehensive simulation, explore a living city! Drive cars, build relationships, work side jobs, and build your empire. From brewing coffee to becoming the most famous name in town—how will you live your cafe life?

details.title: Crooked Cooks
details.short_description: Crooked Cooks is a chaotic co-op game where you and your crew run a restaurant as a front for the Boss’ criminal jobs, mixing fast-paced cooking with shady business.

details.title: LOVE WMC
details.short_description: "Love wmc" is a visual novel game based on music games. It tells a series of stories about the protagonist who came to a small county town to study alone due to family conflicts, and accidentally got involved with four female protagonists because of an arcade music game.

details.title: Shutter Story
details.short_description: Examine a family's photo album to reveal signs of the paranormal, as the horror unfolds in the house around you. Their fate is in your hands.

details.title: Cassette Beasts 2002
details.short_description: Record, battle, and fuse with 250+ beasts as you adventure alongside diverse companions in this monster-collecting RPG. Set in London in 2002, play in single-player or online to unmask an enigmatic occultist who threatens the realms of man and beast! When worlds collide, take the leap beyond!

details.title: miniopolis
details.short_description: Create, shape, and customize a miniature metropolis with intuitive and satisfying tools. Construct towering cityscapes, fine-tune their look and layout, and give every structure its own distinctive character. Build the way you want in this resource-free city-building sandbox.

details.title: Decision Point: Battlegroup Operational Simulator
details.short_description: Plans meet friction in Decision Point, a wargame where you issue NATO-standard orders, observe AI execution in real time, and adapt as the battlefield evolves. At key Decision Points, the action pauses—giving you time to reassess, redirect your forces, and outmanoeuvre the enemy.

details.title: Uncivilized
details.short_description: A short-form empire building strategy game. Explore the planet and grow your colony, while attempting to negotiate with the many characterful rival factions. Make friends, break allegiances, or just drop nukes on them.

details.title: Ignitement
details.short_description: Shape your flame in this explosive roguelite and survivorslike inferno. Craft unique fire magic, unlock new masks and abilities, collect ancestral loot, and incinerate hordes of enemies in a never-ending battle against your inner demons.

details.title: 时漏界限-edge-
details.short_description: 一场神秘的“梦”，打破了你平静的生活。横贯两个世界的旅程，却总是遭遇同一场危机。你遇到了意味不明的茶味男，看起来很好说话的异瞳少年，突然出现的神秘妹妹头，呆傻的美丽学长，好久不见突然变成金色的幼驯染。你们的故事打破了两个世界，人们的命运就此交织…… 《时漏界限-edge-》是一款文字avg乙女冒险游戏，正式版包含4位可攻略男主角，一位隐藏可攻略男主角。正式版游戏文本量在50w字以上，拥有50张以上精美cg。 在游戏中，你将扮演一名即将毕业的大学生，在穿越两个世界的旅途中寻找世界的真相，并作出自己的选择。游戏拥有多个分支结局，等待你在游玩过程中逐步解锁。

details.title: Tattered Banners
details.short_description: Lead a mercenary company in a turn-based tactics RPG set in a dynamic, simulated world shaped by your actions. Recruit, equip, and evolve your warband to survive a medieval-fantasy realm where cities rise and fall, noble houses pursue personal agendas, and the land bears the scars of your decisions.

details.title: Zodiac Legion
details.short_description: Zodiac Legion is a turn-based tactical RPG where you take command of an arcane chivalric order. Launch daring raids through ancient ruins and treacherous dungeons. Advance in steadfast formations to disrupt enemy ranks with cunning stratagems. Hold your ground in a world of reawakening cosmic magic.

details.title: No Humanity - Internship
details.short_description: No Humanity - InternShip is a chaotic physics-based space survival game where interns swing, smash, and build their way to survival. Use rope mechanics to collect resources, battle enemies, and expand your space colony. Explore humorous cave biomes and survive absurd corporate tasks in deep space.

details.title: Halve
details.short_description: Two spirits wake up separated in a broken world, with no memory of what they once were. Control them simultaneously in an atmospheric, immersive journey about separation, memory, and the hope of becoming whole again.

details.title: Barkour
details.short_description: BARKOUR is a fast-paced action platformer with a stealthy twist, starring Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R. - a tail-wagging master of parkour, high-tech gadgets and getting into trouble. Jump, sneak and fight your way through a spy adventure packed with action, canine chaos and delightfully absurd surprises.

details.title: Fools, Maniacs and Liars
details.short_description: A narrative-driven game of suspense, crime, and dark humor. Amid exquisitely crafted art and a gripping story, the Wushan Great Buddha's demise unfolds.

details.title: Echoes of the Stars
details.short_description: Confront fate and the gods themselves in Echoes of the Stars, a 2D Handpainted Action RPG. Explore diverse biomes, gain new skills, fight challenging foes, unlock new abilities, play mini-games, and unfold the epic journey of Eldric and Rin.

details.title: Huni Kuin: Beya Xinã Bena
details.short_description: A 2D platform game that comes to life through the myths of the Huni Kuin people. Overcome challenges in the Amazon, use the knowledge of the shamans and explore the world of spirits in this adventure illustrated by indigenous artists.

details.title: 8 More Lives
details.short_description: A challenging turn-based tactical RPG. Lead a mercenary company of outcast cats through a gritty procedural open world. Take contracts, count coin, bury the dead. Battle rival warbands and night horrors. You have 8 more lives - try not to waste them all.

details.title: Biryado
details.short_description: Biryado is a billiards roguelike deckbuilder where rules are made to be broken. Collect Billy’s bizarre artefacts, customize your balls with wild abilities and combine their effects into absurd combos. Master shifting tables, overcome eccentric bosses, and send your score into another dimension!

details.title: Horns
details.short_description: Horns is an evolving dark fantasy RPG inspired by retro ARPG adventures of the late ‘90s. Join Lyssandra on her search for the king in a collapsed, magical world as she grows more grotesque on her trek for truth. Fight the darkness — or become it — and watch the world react accordingly.

details.title: Void Nebula
details.short_description: Create, customize and fuse every card in this sci-fi roguelite deckbuilder where you battle foes, stack absurd items, and drag your handmade deck to the heart of the Nebula.

details.title: Nuclear Engineer Tycoon
details.short_description: Build a nuclear power plant and manage reactors, generators, and turbines, producing energy to keep the city lit and prevent reactor explosions. Earn resources, research nuclear technologies, build larger and more modern reactors, refine uranium, and create a nuclear energy empire.

details.title: BugoPhobia
details.short_description: BugoPhobia is an indie survival horror game where you explore haunted places, avoid ghosts during ghost hunts, collect clues, and correctly identify the type of ghost

details.title: DJ till Dawn
details.short_description: Be a cool DJ and battle crowds in a rhythm roguelite where every beat is a weapon. Build your DJ loadout, unlock new tracks and keep the party alive till dawn to win!

details.title: Pripyat 0
details.short_description: Chernobyl has broken down. As radiation rains down upon you, the world starts rapidly mutating. You've gotten stuck in a nightmarish loop. Can you correctly spot the anomalies on time and get to safety? Or will you become one with the zone?

name: Top of That Thing Called Mountain

details.title: Top of That Thing Called Mountain
details.short_description: Who would you go with on the toughest adventure? Team up with a friend in this 2-player, 2D co-op platformer and guide two dolphins up an impossible mountain. Shoot harpoons, blast air cannons, and swing your way up. Every climb demands perfect teamwork, and one wrong move sends you both tumbling.

details.title: interViolence
details.short_description: Help a teenage supervillain move out of his one and only home. Mop spills, pack clothes and disarm lethal machines. Think about your past, and his uncertain future. A short RPGMaker visual novel about nostalgia, grief, and the things you miss when they're gone forever.

details.title: Red Nox
details.short_description: Red Nox is a horror roguelike deckbuilder with realistic graphics and a liminal space aesthetic. Gamble, explore, and create your own synergy of cards and relics to survive against the uncanny abominations within the Forbidden Lands.

details.title: Please fix the mess
details.short_description: Clean up chaotic interiors, remove trash, repaint walls, and redecorate messy spaces, sometimes with a few suspiciously bodies lying around.

details.title: Catching Breaks
details.short_description: In this first-person office comedy, you fix busted microwaves and put out fires while coworkers try to stop you for a chat. Use the right tool for the job, or slap a machine and see if it holds until the end of your shift.

details.title: VILLAIN – Path of the Necromancer
details.short_description: You are an Osteurgo, a lesser necromancer risen from the ashes of the Dark Lord. Raise your empire among desolate mountains, subjugate savage tribes, and spread corruption. Build, conquer, withstand enemy hordes, and claim the empty throne of evil.

details.title: Chess Club Manager
details.short_description: Tycoon game to build and manage your own chess club from the ground up. Balance training, sponsors, tournaments and turn a tiny local club into a global success.

details.title: Magnet Agent
details.short_description: Magnet Agent is a puzzle adventure game based on “magnetic power”. Magnet Agent N-52 and his robot vacuum, Dustino, use their shockingly cool magnetic spy kit to explore the world and thwart Magnet Empress's evil plan before it's too late. They are drawn to danger, are you?

details.title: SUS!
details.short_description: One of them is a thief. Blend into the crowd, steal, knock out your targets and escape, but you have to cough now and then. Spies watch the streets through CCTV, scan the crowd and get one clean stun shot. Stun an innocent and it costs you. Online PvP for 2 to 10 players, or play against bots.

details.title: Rondo's Romp
details.short_description: Join Rondo, a cheerful Akita pup, as he explores 6 whimsical worlds, digging up coins, items, and throwable objects to solve puzzles, battle enemies, and uncover secrets... all with the charm and challenge of a classic 2D platformer!

details.title: Po10tions: Silver Path
details.short_description: Po10tions: Silver Path is a deck-building business simulation game. Start your business in a magic world in the 18th-century. Produce 3 types of goods and sell them. Play cards to produce more, trade for better prices, or stop your opponents. Make money faster to win!

details.title: DORSAL
details.short_description: A football RPG: live a footballer's entire career, from age 16 to retirement. Negotiate with the dice in plain sight, play the moments that decide a match in 3D, and watch what you say to the press and on social media. Write your own story.

details.title: Memory Audit
details.short_description: Strapped to an observation desk in Sublevel B3, you must audit the extracted memories of crime suspects on a CRT monitor. Cross-reference the case file, incinerate fabricated memories, and keep the patient in the cell next door sedated before they break free.

details.title: City Together
details.short_description: Build a city together. Up to four friends share one city, each on their own PC: lay the roads, zone homes, shops, and offices, bring power, water, and transit, and grow from a hamlet to a world city, through storms, floods, and fires, on hand-made maps.

details.title: Mushrooms: Quiet Hunt
details.short_description: Explore a lifelike forest in a relaxing first-person mushroom-hunting adventure. Find real mushroom species, discover hidden places, complete foraging requests, and make your woodland cabin feel like home.

details.title: UNCAGED
details.short_description: Ride a T-rex in an armored control rig through a top-down shooter. Knock riders out of the saddle, steal their beasts and hop from one to the next mid-fight. Tear the rigs off captive animals and they fight on your side.

details.title: Hidden Layer
details.short_description: See how AI really works by building it. Buffalo, 1958: the Navy has paid for a machine that learns. Write the Python that teaches it, from the first perceptron through backpropagation and deep learning to attention, the idea inside today's chatbots. A programming puzzle game about machine learning.

details.title: It's a Montage
details.short_description: A pixel-art training game with no opponents, where every level you gain shows on your character and the world around you. Once you outgrow the dojo, you train at a waterfall, on the open sea, on the moon, on a star and at the edge of a black hole.

details.title: Warband Incremental
details.short_description: Start with two footmen and build a warband of humans, orcs, elves, and undead in this voxel incremental auto-battler. Shape your formation, equip heroes, and unlock a vast tech tree. Battle through four chapters and giant bosses, then rebirth with your gear and unlocked factions intact.

details.title: Waterscape Atlas
details.short_description: Not a lake, not a river: the sea, fished the Japanese way. Surf, breakwaters, island rocks and boats on one life-size coast. 40 ways to fish from sabiki to squid jigging, 40+ species, real tackle logic, and every bite through a vibrating controller. Five dioramas included.

details.title: Saw Down
details.short_description: Turn a tiny robot with a saw into a machine that grinds through mountains of scrap. Gather resources, choose your upgrades, and unleash explosions, flying sawblades, and chain lightning. Grow stronger with every haul and cut your way deeper.

details.title: 三国：群英演义
details.short_description: You are no famed general or warlord. A nameless commoner, you enter a broken land with five villagers. Recruit and arm them; farmers become veterans beside you. These are no mere numbers. Old heroes are gone. Your story is unwritten. March on: legend, or footnote?

details.title: Kesselgrid
details.short_description: Turn-based grand strategy on a hex map, set in the First and Second World Wars. Run a nation's industry, politics and diplomacy, command its armies, fleets and air force, and break the enemy front. Play alone against the AI, in co-op or online against your friends.

details.title: Sprinkle Gnomes
details.short_description: Sprinkle Gnomes is a cozy first-person co-op game about bringing the scorched badlands back to life. Find hidden wells, build watering automations and ride camels across the dry land until grass springs up again. Play solo or team up with friends and turn every dusty corner green.

details.title: Secret of Nox
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in this action roguelike game, turn defeated enemies into your minions. Explore 12+ unique classes, endless playstyles, battle through 50+ maps, epic bosses and discover the Secret of Nox.

details.title: I Missed the Apocalypse 2
details.short_description: You missed the apocalypse. Now it’s up to you to take back the Earth. Gather, craft and build your base with your flying companion Eddy, survive Alien attacks every night, free mind controlled humans and smash every Alien Heart, from Scandinavia to the whole world.

details.title: Someone Else's Number
details.short_description: Your new phone number used to belong to someone else. At 2:14 AM, a stranger still writes to it. A romance played entirely on your phone in 2011: make friends, fall for someone, and decide what to do with a secret that was never meant for you.

details.title: Fishlings: A Cozy Fish Collector
details.short_description: A cozy idle aquarium where every fish comes out of a card pack. Rip packs, flip cards, chase the 1-in-1,000 Prismatic and collect 80+ odd little fish in four variants. Your tank keeps growing and earning while you're away, or swims in a tiny window on your desktop while you work.

details.title: Heartwood TD
details.short_description: A maze tower defense roguelite where every tower is also a wall. Plant Wardens to shape the path the nightmares walk, combine their powers into chain reactions, and grow a stronger maze with every run.

details.title: Full Bleed
details.short_description: A knight doodled in the margin of a cursed bestiary wakes unarmed in a plague abbey overrun by its monsters. Cleave, shoot and bleed through four episodes of fast, gory boomer-shooter carnage, drawn in heavy stylized comic ink and dither, where blood is the reddest thing on the page.

details.title: Stampers
details.short_description: Six against six in hand-built 1930s warplanes over a roaring stadium, with a live commentary booth calling every kill. Free to play, with bots in every empty seat, so a match is always ready. The most kills wins.

details.title: LapbyLap
details.short_description: LapbyLap is a Racing Management/Simulator. Manage the strategy, be the driver, do both or none. The ultimate true simulation sandbox with soft-body damage and fully editable tracks generated from scratch. No pre baked lines. No ghost cars. No rubber banding.

details.title: The Unasked Pawnshop
details.short_description: At the bottom of a cultivators' market sits a pawnshop that asks no questions. Customers pawn relics, elixirs and heirlooms of dubious origin, sometimes their fate with them. Appraise, haggle, and buy out the shop before the rent buries you. Every item you accept ties you to someone's karma.

details.title: Amberia
details.short_description: A side-scrolling pixel MMORPG set in a miniature world lit at dusk. Become a warrior, mage or thief, level up with friends, take on bosses together, and light the amber lamps that brighten the whole land for everyone. Free to play.

details.title: Compound Seven
details.short_description: Compound Seven is a horror-infused drug production roguelite. Grow, process, package and sell illicit substances to meet ever-increasing quotas. Upgrade your equipment, automate production and survive seven nights in a basement where you're never truly alone.

details.title: The Bell Must Ring
details.short_description: Every bell begins another game—and another nightmare. The Bell Must Ring is a first-person psychological horror game set in a Japanese school. Trapped inside, obey the mysterious voice, survive deadly games, and return to the control room. But something in this school remembers you.

details.title: Stitch & Trigger
details.short_description: A fast-paced bullet-hell roguelike where discarded toys fight back against a Factory Recall. Flip tables for cover, cotton-roll through enemy fire, fuse 70 toy guns, 74 items & 25 combos, unlock 48 skins & playable Hero Pasts, and conquer 37 custom boss encounters across 10 escalating floors.

details.title: Remix Lolita
details.short_description: An avant-garde, charming multi-mode rhythm game. Dodge and dash, side-scrolling parkour, classic lane-based play, and more! 24 original tracks across three concept albums, each with a handcrafted stage for a captivating audiovisual experience.

details.title: I Cast Die!
details.short_description: I Cast Die! is a physics-based action roguelike where you throw dice to cast spells. Forge custom dice, combine elements, and unleash six-dice combos against waves of enemies. Experiment with different shapes, materials, and upgrades to build a new strategy every run.

details.title: Thruster Car Delivery Co.
details.short_description: Every car has thrusters and every customer has a deadline. Jump, flip, swing and wall-ride brand-new cars across canyons, jungles, freight trains and rooftops to the drop-off, then read what the customer thinks. A physics-driven 2.5D stunt driving game about delivering cars the hard way.

details.title: Incwreckmental
details.short_description: Smash a voxel toy city for the council, twenty seconds a shift. Knock out the supports and drop towers onto their neighbours, cut steel frames with the welder, and turn the salvage into rockets, lightning and meteors. The work orders get stranger every day. Doug doesn't mind.

details.title: raster.ctl
details.short_description: raster.ctl is a puzzle roguelite where you place blocks and build a variety of strategies. Shape the board your way, try out different playstyles, and discover powerful synergies to push your score beyond its limits!

details.title: Vyrnhal
details.short_description: A dark fantasy idle RPG. Forge your own gear, shape your hero across two talent trees and build a fortress that keeps working while you are away. Raise an army, conquer seven regions, raid the Ash Citadel and climb the leaderboards in Hardcore mode.

details.title: Profound Souls
details.short_description: Samuel, a young seminarian, goes into a cemetery at midnight to take a dead priest's bones. Every door is locked, and every lock is a puzzle you solve with logic, never by guessing. A first-person escape game made by someone who builds real escape rooms.

details.title: Jester Under Pressure
details.short_description: Diskarte, jester of the high castle, has one job: entertaining the queen. This would be easy except Queen Bahaghari has a penchant for magically exploding the heads of subjects falling below her exacting standards. Can Diskarte avoid this frightening fate?

details.title: YiShi Contagion: Versus
details.short_description: Plague Hunters 🏹☣️ Join the hunt with your friends in the world of YiShi Contagion, a fast-paced 1v1 action game where you fight through enemy waves, collect power-ups, build your character, and race your rival to defeat the final boss first 💥

details.title: Paragon Colonists
details.short_description: Settle uncharted lands in Paragon Colonists, an economy-focused, turn-based 4X strategy game. Build thriving colonies, meet local Orc clans, defy the Ashen Horde and break with the Paragons to fulfill your dream of an empire of your own - solo or in asynchronous multiplayer!

details.title: Working From Home
details.short_description: You went freelance the week before lockdown. Now stuck at home with no boss and no office, your days are your own. Work enough to pay the bills, manage your needs, blow your wages on gambling, shopping, and vapes, and try to survive the lockdown that never ends.

details.title: Exile Era
details.short_description: In the wasteland ruled by AI, a weekly exile game unfolds.Will you choose to survive alone, lingering in the shadow of zombies and mutated creatures? Or rally your companions and build a haven of hope for old humanity on this desolate island with your own hands?

details.title: Castle Wars: Legacy
details.short_description: A fast-paced card strategy game with deck building, PvP, tournaments, and a campaign, inspired by the classic Castle Wars flash game

details.title: Homunculeye: Seer’s Ascent
details.short_description: Climb a merciless ascent where every mistake sends you falling. In this brutal rage-platformer, claim the power of those who stand in your way to discover the truth.

details.title: Hop Slash
details.short_description: Jump, slash and collect with Hop, the non-stop hopping Bunny Knight in this 3D platformer in the spirit of the N64 and PS1 classics, with a twist: he won't stand still, so chain your moves across the floating islands of Celestina.

details.title: Choo Choo Kingdom
details.short_description: The Rift has swallowed the kingdom. Grow one archer’s carriage into a 16-carriage war-train that auto-battles endless hordes. Place troops beside supports for synergy, upgrade a deep skill tree, chase each boss through town and free the kingdom village by village.

details.title: Quillzyra
details.short_description: Create persistent AI characters, shape their personalities and relationships, and chat privately on your own device. Three conversation quality levels are included. Add local portrait generation with the optional NVIDIA DLC.

details.title: Drumk
details.short_description: DRUMK is a physics-based pirate action game where you command a fully interactive ship, battle enemy crews, and survive roguelite runs solo or with up to 6 players.

details.title: Cauldron: Haunted Harvest
details.short_description: Haunted Harvest is a farming spinoff set in the Cauldron universe. Play three evolving minigames, grow some magical crops, and restore a corrupted village to its former glory. If your favorite plant is still an upgrade tree, then grab your watering can and start the harvest!

details.title: Shoes in the fridge
details.short_description: You wake up on a normal day - except maybe a little late, everything feels normal... until you realize... your shoes are in the fridge. Shoes in the Fridge is an achievement hunting game with multiple funny endings. Will you ever make it to work?

details.title: Die for the Rat King
details.short_description: Reclaim the Rat King’s realm in this dice-driven deckbuilder. Forge your dice, empower your rings, and find your best combos as you descend into a monster-infested underground.

details.title: Beyond the Mountains II
details.short_description: Uncover a vast land filled with secrets, monsters, and ancient myth in BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS II, a direct sequel to BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS. Stranded in a foreign land and armed only with your wits and curiosity, you will collect items, unlock secrets, and fight monsters to save the Oracle.

details.title: National Park Tycoon
details.short_description: Build a beautiful national park where campers roast marshmallows, hikers explore trails, and wildlife roams free. What could possibly go wrong? Enter: raging wildfires, contagious animal diseases, and curious hungry bears. Keep it cozy or cause absolute chaos in this 2D park management simulation!

details.title: Frontier Wars: Online
details.short_description: An old-school MMORPG featuring multiple NPC factions vying for control over territory. Explore the chaotic frontier of Zagros and fight in tactical turn-based battles with other players and NPC allies. Build your own character and fight against enemy factions to gain loot, EXP, and power.

details.title: TowerBound
details.short_description: There is no luck in this tower. Every monster, item, and locked door is deterministic. Fifty floors from the original game form one giant logic puzzle. Spend HP, gold, and keys in exactly the right order, or seal your own way forward. A pixel-art puzzle-RPG in the Tower of the Sorcerer tradition.

details.title: Obscuroid
details.short_description: Obscuroid is a psychological horror puzzle game where you use a changing non-Euclidean environment to solve puzzles. Venture through a mind-bending liminal realm, use Polaroids to manipulate your surroundings, conjure your escape, or be consumed by whatever might wander the realm's vacant halls.

details.title: Marriage in Withdrawal
details.short_description: A dark otome VN where you will walk a perilous tightrope between desire and morality. Will you melt the ice of your frozen husband, or fall into the gentle trap of the boy next door? Will you sink into a tangled, three-way descent, or break free from everything to claim your ultimate freedom?

details.title: LYRA BLADE
details.short_description: Sinners. Neutrals. Saints. 15 factions. 3 unique currencies. Immense opportunities for interaction and a unique gaming experience in a richly developed universe. Which adventure will you choose?

details.title: Treasure Chest Master
details.short_description: Have you ever thought about who collects chests for heroes? No, they don't appear on their own, each of the chests has its own Master! Immerse yourself in the story of the Chest Master, in which your job is to fill chests with loot!

details.title: FoulKick Soccer
details.short_description: Six-a-side arcade football with nobody in a black shirt keeping score of your crimes. Charge a super shot mid-jump, put the opponent on the grass with a harsh tackle, and spin a tornado kick into a loose ball. Six players on one couch, or take it online.

details.title: Black Lily Inmortal
details.short_description: Experience this 2D Top-Down combat game featuring tragic yuri and dark fantasy. Step into the rusty armor of Marliese Haugen as she traverses a bleak, desolate world to reach the one she loves.

details.title: Die First
details.short_description: A physics-based party game where the first player dead wins! Race to hurl yourself into saws, lasers, and more, combine items for creative deaths, and throw your friends to safety before they beat you to it! Up to 4 players, online or local. WARNING: Contains friendship-ruining mechanics.

details.title: Good Morning [Employee Name] VR
details.short_description: A seated VR mystery in an office that never moved past tape and brass. You're the new hire at Consolidated Dynamics. Play the morning cassette, work the switchboard, stamp the forms. Twelve days on the job. Try not to wonder what the work is for.

details.title: Idle PC
details.short_description: Collect materials, craft, fight, and upgrade! Alongside, you unlock new applications and upgrade your gear to become even stronger. Your Idle PC collects resources even when you are not there!

details.title: Ambience
details.short_description: Ambience is a first-person spatial puzzle, where you combine lights and colors to access new dimensions and shape the minimalistic world around you.

details.title: The Sinkhole
details.short_description: Experience claustrophobic cave horror powered by your webcam. In this psychological nightmare, a massive underground sinkhole hides a sinister entity. Ditch the mouse—your real head movements control your view, and your actual hands are used to climb, grab, and scramble through the dark.

details.title: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS
details.short_description: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS is a 2D PvPvE animal extraction shooter set after humanity’s extinction. Venture into ruined cities and dangerous laboratories, search for valuable supplies, and return safely to your shelter with your loot.

details.title: ATC: Tower & Ground
details.short_description: Real Spanish air traffic control. Vector arrivals through storms and windshear, run the taxiways, and keep your nerve when an engine fails on the takeoff roll. Real procedures, real data, pilots that answer back. All of Spain, one airport at a time.

details.title: Yokai Mart
details.short_description: Yokai Mart is a cozy shop simulation game full of mysterious stories. Help your grandmother run her konbini. The supernatural visitors who come at night and the customers from the village need your help. Little by little, you’ll get to know the place and improve the lives of your guests.

details.title: MEATBALL THE MITE
details.short_description: MEATBALL THE MITE is a Metroid-inspired platforming game where you explore the colossal, labyrinthian remains of a decaying creature. Collect upgrades, go toe-to-toe with gnarly threats, and claim victory over the rot on your quest to grow stronger. Do you got the guts to survive in these guts?

details.title: Shadows of Chroma Tower
details.short_description: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

details.title: Coming Forth by Day
details.short_description: Journey through the Egyptian afterlife in this roguelike deck builder. Use the rules to your advantage, or break them, to outwit supernatural foes in an ancient Egyptian board game. Prepare yourself, pharaoh: the Duat awaits.

details.title: Vertepnyky: Prologue
details.short_description: Travel to a remote snowy island where everything is not what it seems! Interact with the locals, unravel the prophecy, and prepare for a "holiday" with Helga Burevis in an action-packed visual novel where every choice matters. The only rule: trust no one. ESPECIALLY mirrors, masks, and musicians.

details.title: Trap Side
details.short_description: Jump into the arena in Trap Side, a fast-paced multiplayer party game where cute faces meet brutal chaos! Dodge deadly saws, grab spears, outsmart your friends, and survive the pixel-blood-soaked mayhem. Trust no one, not even the ground you stand on!

details.title: Soul Savior
details.short_description: Blast monster hordes with elemental spells, lay traps between waves and protect your gold in this action roguelite tower defense. Save the villagers' souls or sacrifice them for power, solo or in online co-op.

details.title: InCyanSpace
details.short_description: IncyanSpace follows the story of Li, an artificial human, who sets out to find his long-lost original human brother Yuan. Together with surviving New Humans, they stand against Xystem, a dominant force of mechanical lifeforms that controls the surface world.

details.title: Dear Polder
details.short_description: The sea took half your fields. Dear Polder is a cozy farming life sim in a Dutch polder village, solo or in 4-player online co-op. Mend the dike, let your windmill pump the land dry, then befriend 40 villagers and dance under the lanterns on festival nights.

details.title: TappyCat
details.short_description: TappyCat is a cute pixel kitty who settles onto your desktop and turns work and study into a warm, cozy ritual. It's a desktop pet, a Pomodoro timer, and a smart productivity tracker all at once - all in one little cat.

details.title: FREEWAVE
details.short_description: FREEWAVE is an epic spaceship action-adventure. Explore a vast, tattered city in search of answers. Fly between crumbling buildings and become a master pilot. Fight against the oppressive tech regime ULTRASOFT and defend yourself against rotten monsters. All hand drawn with pen and watercolor.

details.title: Global Parity
details.short_description: Lead one of 15 nations from 1999 to 2019. Balance the budget, pass laws through parliament, win elections, sign treaties and fight on a moving front line, while AI nations build, trade and go to war around you.

details.title: HALFLIGHT
details.short_description: A survival horror roguelite about a house that erases itself behind you. Learn to read doors, solve puzzles, and survive things you cannot fight. Every step is permanent, there is no way back. Find the way out.

details.title: Bonsai Island
details.short_description: Grow, shape, and sell your own fully simulated bonsai trees to adorable animal customers! Turn your humble little bonsai cart into a thriving business on a cozy island.

details.title: Mereni
details.short_description: A casual Hexcells-like puzzle game where you reveal hidden drawings among the stars.

details.title: Anomaly Cafe
details.short_description: Manage a quaint coffee shop hidden deep in an unknown forest. Brew daily cups for ordinary travelers, but be prepared to adapt your service when unusual and anomalous entities start lining up for their caffeine fix.

details.title: Not Monsters
details.short_description: A medieval themed party game for 4-15 players where social deduction becomes ragdoll combat and monsters hide in plain sight.

details.title: IVORY
details.short_description: IVORY is a story-rich, cold weather survival game with cosmic-horror elements. Enjoy the twists and turns of its gripping, dark narrative and rich lore as you explore two open-world locations dripping with psychological terror. Play as a man driven toward his grim fate by cowardice and greed.

details.title: Idle Dig
details.short_description: Idle Dig is an idle mining game that sits on your desktop and plays on its own. Collect 125 unique gems and items, unlock 15 skins, complete quests, and uncover the mystery at the heart of the planet.

details.title: Family Gambling
details.short_description: A first-person narrative resource management game where you gamble with your son's organs to survive. Pay your debts, manage your home, and decide how much of your family you're willing to sacrifice.

details.title: DigiDuels
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder card game that will make you remember the classic TCGs: learn the game across a classroom desk, then ride the metro into a branching run of rivals, shops, and big choices.

details.title: Expedition Bonk
details.short_description: A short turn-based RPG where three F-tier heroines set out to defeat the Goblin King. Time your attacks and blocks, make every skill count, and power up your party through a shared incremental skill tree. Built to be beaten in about 4 hours.

details.title: KICKSHIFT
details.short_description: An alternate Rocket League-like game if you are looking for a unique take on the genre, that's built with Rollback netcode.

details.title: Ruler of Empires
details.short_description: Command a nation through the age of steel and empire. Ruler of Empires is a turn-based grand strategy game. Seize a nation, rewrite the century, and conquer province by province across lands. Save an empire doomed to fall, or bring the whole world under a single flag.

details.title: TEKUTEKU: Discovery Notebook
details.short_description: From a corner of your screen, TEKUTEKU wanders Tokyo, finding small sparkling things for its notebook. Pack its lunchbox and the journey shifts. It scribbles along as you type, and may leave a letter if you stay a while. A hand-drawn, cozy desktop game of discovery and collection.

details.title: Gökbörü
details.short_description: Draw a line, close the loop, crush every demon caught inside. A 3D arcade action roguelite born from Turkic mythology — every open line is a gamble. Power up with divine Boons, face 10 mythic bosses and chase the high score.

details.title: Borrowed Flesh
details.short_description: A body-horror deckbuilding roguelike where your whole party shares one deck. Pick 3 of 5 broken souls, and when one falls, every card they carried dies with them. Survive permanent mutilation and descend as far as your flesh can bear.

details.title: 5-Star Taxi
details.short_description: A fast-paced arcade taxi game where time is your greatest enemy - find shortcuts, deliver passengers, tear through a destructible city, escape the police, and earn a perfect 5-star rating before your shift ends.

details.title: Stay On Track
details.short_description: A 3d physics based platformer where you play as marble in a marble race that must jump, boost and dodge the onslaught of other marbles to discover if there's more to explore outside the life they're used to.

details.title: Void Inc
details.short_description: Survive corporate horror in this surreal startup simulator. A dark comedy, where you drink coffee, plan, get through the day, grow the startup, manage staff and explore the company and it's dark secrets.

details.title: The Uncovering
details.short_description: In a modern city's daily life, become detective Xiquan, interview suspects face-to-face, catch cracks in their words, use evidence to shatter composure. Shift between viewpoints, gather fragments, trace connections, peel away twisted lies and fixations—until the truth surfaces.

details.title: NIGHTRAIN POOL HALL
details.short_description: Break and bend the rules of pool in this billiards roguelike deckbuilder! Tilt the table, swap and levitate balls, and build powerful combos. Not everything will be smooth sailing, the table itself fights back with stone balls, rising walls and gravity vortices that pull shots off course.

details.title: RISE99
details.short_description: Rise and strike, mindhacker! RISE99 is a cinematic VR surfer-slasher-shooter. Surf a flying hoverboard and infiltrate lavish high-security sky castles. Blast enemy drones and slash incoming projectiles with saberguns. Can you hack through the bullet heavens and bring down the system of mind control?

details.title: Pipefall
details.short_description: Pipefall is a fast-paced falling-block puzzle game where every piece is part of a pipeline. Connect pipes, guide the flow and keep building as the pressure rises. Play solo, cooperate with a friend or compete head-to-head in local multiplayer.

name: Daily Life With The Herb Girl

details.title: Daily Life With The Herb Girl
details.short_description: A slice-of-life visual novel steeped in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Befriend Linglan, a girl manifested from medicinal herbs, learn herbal properties, and guide her through the modern world. Features Live2D.

details.title: [ABERRATION] Yes, Jerry!
details.short_description: Mike is an ordinary man, tired of everything. Then he meets Jerry, a huge, purple creature who starts making his life better. Until...

details.title: Still Breathing
details.short_description: Keep your family alive in an underground bunker after the world collapses. Manage scarce resources, explore the ruined city, and make brutal decisions when desperate strangers start knocking on your door.

details.title: The Ninth Legion
details.short_description: The Ninth Legion is an RTS narrative strategy game, set during the fateful final campaign of the LEGIO IX HISPANA, Rome's famous missing legion.

details.title: Synapse
details.short_description: A cyberpunk point-and-click thriller where your emotional score determines everything. Explore a city under constant surveillance, hack its systems, build dangerous connections, and make choices that decide your access - and whether you survive the night.

details.title: Who's Got the Legs
details.short_description: Control a single character together in this chaotic co-op platformer where each player handles a different action. Coordination i key... or everything falls apart

details.title: A Game About Shooting Targets
details.short_description: Complete challenging missions across diverse shooting ranges, build your custom arsenal with unique weapons and attachments and defeat all blacklist members in order to take your place in the most prestigious squad of the army in this Game About Shooting Targets!

details.title: Valken
details.short_description: VALKEN is a realistic tactical solo shooter where you play as a lone agent infiltrating a secretive military organization. Explore varied environments, make hard choices, and face the brutal consequences in an intense, unforgiving campaign.

details.title: God of Stocks
details.short_description: Trade stocks with divine powers in this incremental game. Copy winning trades and trigger Blessing combos with one click to manipulate stock prices. Sell at the right time and watch your profits snowball. Unlock new stock markets and diversify your portfolio as you progress.

details.title: Dungeonery
details.short_description: Crawl your way through the dungeon in this roguelike autobattler. Equip your heroes with epic loot and test their might in battle! Your team might uncover game-breaking synergies and conquer the dungeon… or get wiped out. Probably will, actually. No biggie, there’s always more where they came from.

details.title: Green Mist over Portland
details.short_description: A detective noir puzzle deduction game. Explore a non-linear timeline during the cold war on a globe-trotting adventure following a trail of spies from a quiet English harbour town to a frozen Finnish fishing village and the corridors of an intelligence service rotten at its core.

details.title: Train Set Code
details.short_description: Aim for a high score by creating complex train set layouts. Program points and signals to direct trains and keep them moving. Run more and more trains… but don’t let them crash!

details.title: Blooming Canvas
details.short_description: This is a visual novel game themed around "painting" and "romance." The story begins with a mysterious girl and her damaged painting. As the art exhibition approaches, you will build a bond with the girl, complete her commission, and uncover the truth behind the painting.

details.title: Underking
details.short_description: A first-person mining incremental game. Enter the cave to mine and extract valuable ores. Convert ores into coins and spend them on upgrades to extend your runs to reach deeper into the mountain.

details.title: Coldline: Disconnect
details.short_description: It's not who you are, it's what you do that matters! As an agent inside the enemy base, repair devices by solving puzzles! Plant your bug in the correct device! Listen on the radio at night and transmit critical intel. You are entirely alone in every decision, but your choices will affect everyone.

details.title: Disaster Crew
details.short_description: Disaster Crew is a co-op action-adventure for up to four players. Take on unusual contracts, explore locations packed with traps and obstacles, and share an adventure filled with unexpected dangers and spectacular events..

details.title: Volcano Watch
details.short_description: Discover an open-world volcano-monitoring game grounded in accurate volcanology and authentic phenomena. Step into the role of a lone scientist facing an active volcano, and lead the adventure at your own pace, free to follow the story or carve your own path.

details.title: Kill to Zero
details.short_description: Seek revenge in a frantic top-down hack and slash! Cut enemies in half, master the Parry, and take down a cyberpunk megacorporation!

details.title: Most Scuffed Golf
details.short_description: Tired of the same old mini-golf courses? In Most Scuffed Golf, you and up to 3 friends build a course that’s entirely your own! Complete with windmills, ramps, funnels, and the occasional visit from a whale. The longer the round goes on, the bigger and more chaotic the course gets.

details.title: The Infinite Library
details.short_description: A narrative incremental where the UI tells the story. Discover rare Words, craft Phrases, fill shelves until reality buckles. Each prestige resets the world, but the Library remembers.

details.title: Standard Procedure
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op espionage experience where you and your friends do dirty jobs for the government.

details.title: Geometry Rift: Apocalypse
details.short_description: The ultimate arcade chaos unfolds in this explosive bullet hell roguelite. Survive thousands of geometric enemies on screen, combine weapons and powers to create absurdly overpowered builds, and blast your way through colossal bosses solo or with a friend.

details.title: DEEPWARD
details.short_description: Choose three heroes from a roster of six and switch between them instantly during combat. Each has their own health, weapon and ability. DEEPWARD is a fast horror FPS roguelite set in an alternate 1920s, where keeping your squad alive means fighting through the madness. Hero death is permanent.

details.title: ai.ai
details.short_description: The CEO of ai.ai has passed away, and his final word was "bubble." Uncover the meaning of his final word in this comedy mystery satirizing Silicon Valley.

details.title: Violent Sky
details.short_description: Chase, forecast, and document powerful storms in an open world of cities, suburbs, rural communities, and open plains. Track developing weather, capture dangerous events, and survive tornadoes, hail, and destructive winds.

details.title: Pizzapoly
details.short_description: PIZZAPOLY is a chaotic co-op pizza restaurant game where you cook, serve, make deliveries, and survive the rush in a lively city. Run your pizzeria with friends, keep your customers happy, and grow your small shop into a local favorite.

details.title: Unclouded
details.short_description: Unclouded builds upon the simplicity of a minesweeper with some basic resource-management mechanics to create an engaging, replayable, singleplayer experience that feels both fresh and familiar.

details.title: King's Chess
details.short_description: Awaken your army! King's Chess blends RTS strategy with board game depth. In fast 15-minute matches, focus on deck building and physics, not tedious clicking. Smash defenses and manipulate the environment. No numbers game here—just pure physical warfare.

details.title: Fear Tall Grass
details.short_description: Dark creature-collecting roguelite where humanity enslaves their old gods. Command evolving monsters on the board of Humanity’s final crusade.

details.title: Bureaucromancer
details.short_description: Bureaucromancer is a turn-based tactical shooter set in a floating records office in the sky. A medieval fantasy where rather than magic, they discovered the awesome power of bureaucracy.

details.title: Runemoria - Blades of Memory
details.short_description: Flip cards, uncover pairs, and command your squad in a tactical memory RPG. Equip weapons, unlock powerful skills, and battle enemies or other players in strategic single-player and PvP combat.

details.title: Cursed Carts
details.short_description: A PvPvE horror game playable with 2–6 players. Compete against each other with your alien team split into two groups. In a massive mansion filled with creatures, the team that collects the most loot within the time limit wins.

details.title: Smash Hit
details.short_description: Smash Hit is an online party brawler for up to 12 players. Grab a random loadout of ridiculous weapons, knock your friends off the stage and play to the crowd. Climb to the top of the scoreboard and become TV's next SMASH HIT!

details.title: Lost Floor — Not My World
details.short_description: An auto-battler dungeon crawler with visual novel elements. A tired office worker got off on the wrong floor and ended up in another world. The locals look suspiciously like his coworkers, and to get out, he'll have to do some work.

details.title: PERKS
details.short_description: A chaotic 1-6 player physics brawler where you battle your friends with game-breaking perk synergies. Stack wild abilities to fire homing multishots, bounce rapid-fire lasers off walls, or summon an orbital cannon inside a swirling twister. Steal the best perks and turn the tide!

details.title: Slimestronauts: Burst Strike
details.short_description: A Sci-fi Falling Block and Color Matching in Space with Slimes! Slimestronauts: Burst Strike demands you keep cool under pressure just like the good old days! Unlike the good old days; there Obstacles, Enemies, to overcome, help of Ability Enhancing PWUPS, and even Custom Game Mode!

details.title: Watch Out: Shark!
details.short_description: Survive in the ocean by feeding on smaller fish, dodging predators, and facing various dangers in this relaxing, challenging, and super fun retro arcade game—all hand-drawn in pixel art style. Dive into this adventure solo or in multiplayer mode. But remember: watch out for the shark!

details.title: They're Gonna Get In
details.short_description: "They're Gonna Get In" is an RTS/Roguelite where you play as an advisor to the ruler of a failing kingdom. Your enemy mirrors you. A wall will fall. The only question is whose breaks first.

details.title: VIGNETTE
details.short_description: A first-person point-and-click psychological horror game. Only the areas illuminated by your flashlight change in appearance. The game progresses through quiet unease and puzzle-solving, without relying on jump scares. A demo is now available (approx. 20 minutes).

details.title: Into The Deep
details.short_description: Into the Deep is a tactical adventure RPG where you lead a troop of dwarves through a lost city. Plan turn-based battles, recruit survivors, explore catacombs, solve puzzles, and defeat dark forces to save the city.

details.title: XGUN
details.short_description: A co-op zombie extraction shooter set on a drowned Persian Gulf resort island. Loot the flooded hotels, survive the infected, and reach extraction before dark. Play online, solo offline, or split-screen on one couch - no server required.

name: Primland The Magus -プリムランド　ザ　メイガス-

details.title: Primland The Magus -プリムランド　ザ　メイガス-
details.short_description: A dark fantasy 2D action game that revolves around the mysterious girl Magus and a desolate island which was turned into hell! Collect mementos and acquire skills. Dive into a thrilling world of action as you face mysteries and tough foes!

details.title: Monsterest
details.short_description: Manage a monster-friendly inn. Chop down trees to make furniture and decorate the rooms. Catch fish, hunt, and prepare meals. Befriend your guests, and they'll join you as companions. What kind of monster guest will visit today?

details.title: Your Usual
details.short_description: A small bar, one bartender, and a conversation that picks up where you left it. Mara runs the place, pours what you ask for, and remembers you between visits — all of it running on your own machine. No account, no cloud, no one else listening in.

details.title: Desmarchon
details.short_description: Drag a chain through drifting Anomalies and let go to burst them. Build around longer chains, drones, or automatic weapons in this sci-fi survivor-like. Fly 16 Campaign operations, then take your ship into 30 Deep Space destinations, including endless Shardwake.

details.title: Robots To Scrap
details.short_description: Design the paths your enemies take in this loot-focused tower defense game. Your paths and defenses stay in place between waves. Pull enemies in, push them back, and concentrate your firepower. Combine upgrades, gear, and specializations to keep building your defenses.

details.title: K17 ARACHNE
details.short_description: You came to K17 looking for answers. Now you need to escape. Explore an abandoned military facility, uncover the truth behind Project ARACHNE, and hide from the creatures lurking in its corridors in this atmospheric first-person survival horror game.

details.title: Honey or Else
details.short_description: Honey or Else is an incremental game about bees forced to make honey for their bear captors - while secretly plotting to free their Queen. Plant flowers, hire bees and upgrade the hive. Sweet, sticky, cute and quietly rebellious.

details.title: Doug's Playground
details.short_description: JOIN THE FIGHT AGAINST WATER! For generations, the Muck have suffered under the tyranny of water. Now Doug’s patented Playground Protocol lets you simulate war scenarios to assist those in the field. Support your Muck troops today!

details.title: ZAPLOOPA 4040
details.short_description: ZAPLOOPA is a post-apocalyptic dark humor competition game show. Set in 4040, in space. You are the contestants. An online 3D party game for up to 8 players: complete outrageous fill-in-the-blank sentences, vote for the funniest, sabotage your rivals with jokers. No place for snowflakes here.

details.title: RIPPLES
details.short_description: Gather the group. Negotiate. Take risks. Rule the board. RIPPLES is an online board game for up to 6 players where strategy, negotiation, and luck collide every match.

details.title: K-Real Estate Tycoon
details.short_description: From one run-down villa to a skyline of apartment towers. K-Real Estate Tycoon is a management sim built on Korea's real housing market: jeonse, loans, interest rates and taxes. Choose the floors and units yourself, consult your local realtor, and survive a market that swings with every headline.

details.title: Polliwoggle
details.short_description: A pixel-art roguelite where you're a frog going on a fishing trip. Roll and allocate dice to catch the biggest fish. Draft trinkets and stickers to help you out on your journey and race the clock to get a train ticket and continue your fishing trip.

details.title: RenewCity
details.short_description: Small budget. Hard choices. No perfect fixes. Revitalize real neighborhoods in Detroit, Seoul, and Leipzig, and find out whether you helped the people who live there or replaced them.

details.title: Wheel You Drive?
details.short_description: Grab a friend and take control of the same RC car in this chaotic 2-player co-op game! Each player controls a different part of the car, so you'll need to communicate, coordinate your movement, and somehow make it through every obstacle together.

details.title: The Inkwell
details.short_description: Monitor. Identify. Purge. Watch haunted cartoon feeds, identify entities by the anomalies they leave behind, and perform precise exorcisms. Keep the corruption contained, or the broadcast will claim you next.

details.title: Goblins Gotta Go
details.short_description: Goblins Gotta Go is a toon inspired incremental where you smash goblins in the name of the Kingdom. Fill in your quota with your many skills, upgrades and items before time runs out or the King may just demand your head!

details.title: Ministry of Time
details.short_description: A time-traveling customs officer has one job: inspect every traveler, verify their documents, and keep the timeline intact. Spot anomalies, catch timeline violations, and decide who gets through before history falls apart.

details.title: SkinJack
details.short_description: In this sci-fi multiplayer game, six Parasites hide among eighteen NPCs, while one Overseer watches from above. Infiltrate, impersonate, and outsmart your opponents in this asymmetric multiplayer game of deception, surveillance, and deduction.

details.title: Corner Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run the last independent store on a street with two rivals who undercut you daily. Every product has its own breaking point — one markup never works. Order stock, stack shelves, set prices, and count the till at close. Beat them, or watch them take your street.

details.title: Cozy Cups VR : Barista Simulator
details.short_description: Enjoy the career of a barista in VR. Manage your own custom cafe, brew 15+ hot and cold drinks, decorate every corner, and make the entire city your customer!

details.title: Backrooms: Forget Me Not
details.short_description: A co-op horror game set in the Backrooms and Poolrooms. Explore shifting levels, complete objectives, and deal with whatever is waiting inside.

details.title: Geoscape
details.short_description: Explore Earth and beyond at full scale in this cozy retro sandbox. Every city, coast, and mountain rebuilt for you to discover by car, bike, boat, plane, foot, wingsuit & more. Embark on expeditions, beat challenges, race friends, build a career, or follow the road while blasting music.

details.title: The Bakery
details.short_description: Create your own bakery on your own or with up to 3 of your friends. Unlock new recepies, kitchen furniture, Decoration and more. Keep your bakery running as long as you can, the more reputation your bakery gains the more popular it becomes, will you be able to handle the demand?

details.title: Inside your hole
details.short_description: Chaotic multiplayer mini golf for up to 8 friends: tornadoes, black holes, falling TNT and a course editor to build your own holes. Plus a co-op story mode where you get reincarnated as a mini golf ball.

name: The Retired Mage's Apprentice: Tidy Up the Magic Tower

details.title: The Retired Mage's Apprentice: Tidy Up the Magic Tower
details.short_description: A relaxing organization game where you play as a retired mage's apprentice. Tidy up a magical tower, discover hidden secrets, and slowly learn magic along the way.

details.title: Pawnage
details.short_description: A chess-fighting game where nothing is captured for free. Every capture drops both pieces into a 3D arena for a real-time 1v1 duel: attack with melee, cast spells, grab powerups! Only the survivor takes the square! An old school, fast-paced 1v1 PVP experience both in local couch-mode or via Steam!

details.title: Drink Tea Fight Monsters
details.short_description: Drink Tea Fight Monsters is a story-rich roguelike deckbuilder where you fight blighted beasts and bandits up a failing mountain, sit down with villagers for tea to hear their tales, and make choices that shape their lives.

details.title: BID: Blood Is Due
details.short_description: BID: Blood Is Due is a psychological horror roguelite where you face four deadly games of chance. Roll the dice, build your deck, manage Blood, exploit Dealer passives, choose your route, and risk more for greater rewards.

details.title: Taco Truck Simulator
details.short_description: You will run your own food truck: take orders, cook fresh ingredients, and quickly assemble delicious tacos while hungry customers wait in line. But running a food truck is about more than speed: source supplies wisely, maintain steady cash flow, and win over diners with every satisfying bite

details.title: CARTACLYSM
details.short_description: A chaotic, physics-based party game. Compete against your friends. Sabotage your opponents with power-ups, physics and pure pettiness. Honk your way towards your rightful spot as the Top Goose.

details.title: Super Doodle Mega War
details.short_description: Bring your notebook doodles to life! Build an army of scribbled soldiers, upgrade and merge your auto-battling troops, and unleash skills against overwhelming enemy hordes. A roguelite auto-battler where one little doodle becomes a mighty army.

details.title: CULET
details.short_description: Strike a glowing crystal monolith until it shatters. Every click cracks it further, shards break off and become currency, and upgrades carry you through twelve crystals, from Amethyst to Diamond. A focused, finite clicker about one beautiful object and the joy of breaking it.

details.title: SEAM VR
details.short_description: SEAM is a VR voxel survival sandbox where your hands reshape the world. Use gravity gloves to gather resources, dig into the landscape, and build a home block by block. Explore, craft, and turn the wilderness into a place of your own.

details.title: Fastfood Burger Stories
details.short_description: Manage your own fast-food restaurant: take orders, cook meals, serve customers, and hire staff. Furnish and customize your restaurant, manage supplies, upgrade equipment, and grow a small burger joint into a large restaurant.

name: Crimson Nova: The Star Gear Jobs

details.title: Crimson Nova: The Star Gear Jobs
details.short_description: A masked hero for hire. A starship crew who need his ship far more than his opinions. Six jobs that were all meant to be easy, in a fully voiced sci-fi comedy visual novel with animated characters and choices the crew remember.

details.title: How Deep
details.short_description: A co-op extraction mining game for 1-4 players. Ride the elevator down into procedurally generated caves, dig up treasure, fight off what lurks in the dark, then decide whether to head back to the surface or risk going deeper.

details.title: Jenoria
details.short_description: Create your own Jeno companions, lead them into battle, and build a town together. Explore a voxel sandbox action RPG where you can storm forts, delve into dungeons, and sail the skies in a custom-built airship. Shape your companions, your army, and the world you call home.

details.title: Omega Transmission
details.short_description: Omega Transmission is a short PSX-styled action-platformer, set in a dystopian future where AI has taken over civilization. Humanity's last chance is a secret network deployed through antennas on the tallest skyscrapers of the Megalopolis. Activate the antenna in each city to enable the revolution.

details.title: Terminal Depth
details.short_description: An incremental digging game where buried salvage fuels a growing excavation to unearth ancient artifacts and piece together a lost history with every layer you uncover. Upgrade your tools, unlock automated helpers, and blast through tougher layers with powerful abilities.

name: Take Your Time - A Relaxing Collection of Minigames

details.title: Take Your Time - A Relaxing Collection of Minigames
details.short_description: The most hectic relaxing game you'll ever play

details.title: Arena Shooter
details.short_description: Hop in a tank. Call in a nuke. Flatten the fortress. Battle your friends and bots in a top-down arena shooter with 20 unique maps and modes, 60+ vehicle types, 40+ perks, zombie hordes and a classic Zombie Boss, in a fully destructible world where everything goes.

details.title: Re:act
details.short_description: Every stone, every pane of ice, every turn lands on the beat, so the music tells you what’s coming. Crash, rewind, try again, until it clicks and you know it by heart. Every mode is a different way to answer the music. No note highway. The level is the song.

details.title: BOBA:3
details.short_description: A cozy merge puzzle in a boba cup. Drop kawaii animal pearls, merge matching pairs into bigger (and weirder) lil guys, and don't let the cup overflow. Survive chaotic modifier pearls and unlock new boba flavors as your high score climbs.

details.title: WANGZHA: Dou Dizhu Roguelike
details.short_description: WANGZHA is a roguelike deckbuilder built on Dou Dizhu, the Chinese shedding game (think President or Big Two) where a 2 beats an Ace. Play straights, planes and bombs against landlords who keep raising the rent. Multipliers aren't drawn here, they're grown, one hand at a time.

details.title: Gravitonia
details.short_description: Build and pilot custom war machines in space. Shred enemy ships, installations, and terrain pixel by pixel. Capture fortresses, upgrade your arsenal, and refit at Spacedocks. Conquer a single-player campaign, then create and share war machines, maps, and custom campaigns with the community.

details.title: ALL HANDS LOST
details.short_description: A top-down mercenary space shooter. Take contracts across the Cassian Expanse, command a wing of fighters and drones, and hunt the pirate warlord Captain Bastard. Death costs your gear, cargo and half your credits; your data cores, ships and star charts carry on.

details.title: Cook Or Get Cooked
details.short_description: A first-person cooking game on a television contest. Fetch, wash, chop, fry and plate real dishes against a clock, then hand them to a judge who eats them in front of you and marks them out of a hundred. Lowest mark of the round goes home.

details.title: MINES SET!
details.short_description: The roguelike minesweeper. MINES SET! is a satisfying puzzle game where you open an endless board, find game-changing sponsors and set off huge combos.

details.title: Merchants Demise
details.short_description: A dark roguelike trading RPG where you lead a caravan through a dangerous kingdom, buy low, sell high, recruit a crew, survive brutal encounters, and gamble everything on one more, profitable journey.

details.title: Toad Roller
details.short_description: A timed nervous arcade platformer where a punk toad spirals his way up rotating towers. 3 worlds, 30 towers, 3 stars per tower to earn against the clock, local and world best times, and a level editor to build your own towers.

details.title: Incremaze
details.short_description: A pop-up later and something is loose in the machine. Deploy INCREMAZE antivirus into corrupted drives to do its work. Incremaze is an idle game about automation, escalation, and a cure you may come to regret.

details.title: Vaporware EX
details.short_description: It's 199X. Your four-person studio has a cartridge to fill and a deadline to hit. Build games feature by feature, squash bugs in rapid-fire microgames, haggle with publishers and climb from a regional game jam to Game of the Century in this cozy 16-bit game dev sim.

details.title: Dance With Time
details.short_description: SUPER-WEIRD time manipulation puzzle game. Change the map with your movements, calculate 3 steps ahead and reach the spiral. Even if you fail try again. After all, TIME IS ALL YOU HAVE.

details.title: Kinghold
details.short_description: You are the king and the spawn point in this frantic real-time tower defense roguelite. Play cards to summon autonomous troops, construct buildings, and set traps as you scramble to defend your castle against escalating enemy hordes.

details.title: HotlaneX
details.short_description: Outdrive, outsmart, outlast. HotlaneX throws you into arenas full of enemies that chase, predict, and ambush. No guns, no combat menus, just your car and your instincts. Simple to drive. Brutal to survive.

details.title: Treasure Simulator
details.short_description: Search the world for hidden treasures with untapped potential. Haggle, restore, or even forge items to turn a profit. Upgrade your skills, expand your shop, hire employees, and rise to become a master treasure hunter. Survive amid the escalating conflict between the government and rebel forces.

details.title: Kingdoms Assemble
details.short_description: Kingdoms Assemble is a fantasy async PvP auto-battler. Start from a small plot: buy tiles, plan your layout, expand territory, and conquer kingdoms on the world map. Your pre-arranged lineup automatically produces and strengthens your army. Forge a unique war kingdom and conquer the continent!

name: I Want to Play the Villain!

details.title: I Want to Play the Villain!
details.short_description: I Want to Play the Villain! is a theatre-themed logic puzzle game. To create the perfect show, you must match actors to their roles. But every actor has their own ambitions, fears, and wishes. Rearrange the cast, change the story, and use your logic to make everyone happy!

name: The Bastard Who Rewrote The Empire Season 1

details.title: The Bastard Who Rewrote The Empire Season 1
details.short_description: Fully voiced in Cantonese. Free demo with the full Chapter 1 out already! You wake as a bastard prince facing execution—and you can read more than what people say. Use Inner Voice, Sincerity, Appraisal, and X-Ray Vision to expose lies and secrets, win allies, and rewrite a kingdom’s fate.

details.title: Star Curve
details.short_description: Star Curve is a single-player logic puzzle game. Explore an old observatory in a seaside town, examine the puzzles on its walls, infer their rules, and solve a series of carefully designed logic puzzles at your own pace.

details.title: Beat Juicer
details.short_description: Crunch beats, upgrade your build, and craft the ultimate song. Beat Juicer is a short incremental game that blends arcade action with a music sandbox to create a satisfying symphony of sights and sounds.

details.title: Wish I Could Fly
details.short_description: Burn your life to fly, go higher, this is a game I made on my own, hold W to spray energy and fly up, A and D turn her instead of walking, wobble your way up a tower in the sea floor by floor, someone she knows waits on each one, the demo is chapter one with six floors plus an endless mode

details.title: Desert Sweepers
details.short_description: In this relaxing first-person cleaning sim, the Bureau has declared the desert too sandy. Start with a spoon, get paid by the kilo, and earn your way to sweeper trucks and hauling robots. Leave a clean trail through the dunes at your own pace. Play solo or in online co-op from launch.

details.title: Banana Airways
details.short_description: Feed your passengers. Or they'll eat each other. Run an airline with cannibal chickens, radioactive passengers and screaming babies you can throw off the plane. Fly, serve, repair and try to land. Play solo or with up to five friends.

details.title: The Chains Of Yme
details.short_description: In this tactical roguelike you control five adventurers as you explore procedurally generated ruins to reach and conquer a Titan. Fight deadly monsters, utilize power-ups, and improvise while your knowledge of the world deepens. Persist when your adventurers are left behind, killed, or sacrificed.

details.title: Sprout's Meadow
details.short_description: Manage a team of adorable Sproutlings in this cozy farming adventure! Assign tasks, automate chores, and turn forgotten land into a lively home. Grow crops, raise animals, and craft goods, then take to the skies in your hot air balloon to trade. Watch your little farm come alive!

details.title: Heroll: IF
details.short_description: Roll the dice, survive the chaos, and rebuild a broken world in this roguelite board-game RPG. Battle through unpredictable loops, recruit adorable pets, face wild events, and grow stronger with every roll.

details.title: My Mom Says I’m Fine
details.short_description: A creepy survivors-like played on a child's tabletop. Fight swarms as a tiny toy while a giant Kid looms over the battle. Pick level-up cards, merge your powers and build a ridiculous arsenal. Mom says he's fine. You'll see.

details.title: Eatery At Ridge Station
details.short_description: A short, cozy, and heartful narrative experience with cooking elements. Play as Felix Cook, the elderly owner of an eatery, on his last week in town sponsoring the restoration of his favorite park. Cook up a new menu, say farewell to regular customers, and attend the grand reopening of Mabel’s Park.

details.title: A Trans-Siberian Tea
details.short_description: Snowbound for decades, a Trans-Siberian train holds its passengers exactly as they died. Talk to the frozen dead, uncover the identity of a legendary thief, and decide how far you're willing to go for the truth.

details.title: Eldritch Boyfriend
details.short_description: Eldritch Boyfriend is the only skill-based visual novel dating sim where your sanity—or lack thereof—turns the very act of choosing the right dialogue options into a series of challenging mini-games.

details.title: Amelia
details.short_description: In this first-person narrative experience, you step into the shoes of a young girl. Explore a rural farmhouse and witness everyday family life through her eyes. Across 13 consecutive days, you'll realize that your family is not what it seems. Will you notice what everyone else leaves unsaid?

details.title: Subsector Zero
details.short_description: A liminal space horror game inspired by the backrooms, with levels actually being infinitely long.

details.title: Minipia
details.short_description: Minipia is a cozy desktop idle game. Make a tiny island your own, right in the corner of your screen, while you work or relax. Decorate freely, collect cute animals, discover their stories, and unlock new islands.

details.title: Sound Agent
details.short_description: Sound Agent is a narrative puzzle game where you solve cold cases by listening. Use the sound device to rewind to crime scenes, listen to the sounds at the scene, and uncover truths hidden in plain sound.

details.title: Milling Machine Simulator 2: Machine Shop
details.short_description: Step into your own machine shop. Operate manual mills and lathes, write CNC G-code, and turn raw stock into finished parts with real-time material removal. Experiment in Free Play or put your machining skills to work in Career mode.

details.title: GtFckd: Planet Survivors
details.short_description: Survive the horde on a tiny planet, alone or with up to 3 friends. Pick one of 8 ridiculous champions, stack spells that cast themselves, gamble on slot-machine chests, bargain with shrines, and slay the Rift Tyrant before the planet gets you first.

details.title: Rotten Batch: Bear Inspector
details.short_description: Inspect Fruit Patch Bears for defects, decide which category they belong to, and keep the line moving. Make sure you identify the cursed ones if you want to keep your job...and your life.

details.title: Blek and the Endless Keep
details.short_description: Guide Blek through the twisting grey halls of the Endless Keep as they work to get their memories back! Fight back the Keep's monstrous spawn, meet it's unique denizens, and make thorough use of the art of cat necromancy to find your way back home! The Keep can't truly be Endless, can it?

details.title: Bullets & Boletes
details.short_description: Single-player tactical FPS extraction game where you loot materials and mission items that help you progress through a mysterious main story.

details.title: Squabblin Goblins
details.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer deckbuilding PvP with GOBLINS. Grab items, throw them at your friends, and craft a goblin so broken your friends will hate you.

details.title: Chodd
details.short_description: The council of gods has no ruler, and you intend to keep it that way. A Difficult Coop roguelike: march your Warp Core across a hostile world, command your goons in real time, and play scheming gods against each other so none grow strong enough to stop you.

details.title: JAWED
details.short_description: Jawed is a psychological horror game where you play as Adam, a man muzzled by a life of silent torture since the disappearance of his fiancée. Presented with evidence that she may be alive, Adam must confront their strained relationship and face the only thing that can truly set him free: the truth.

details.title: Zombie Hospital : Abandoned
details.short_description: [Zombie Hospital : Abandoned] is a survival horror game that combines exploration, puzzle-solving, and crafting. You set out alone to investigate a disappearance that occurred in an abandoned hospital. Craft tools and medicine from limited resources and fight to survive against zombies.

details.title: Mesozoic Protocol
details.short_description: The dinosaurs evolve against whatever you over-build. Defend outposts with towers and your armed HQ. Pilot a mech, then adapt as each wave pushes back. Single-player tower defense with Breach and Containment challenges.

details.title: Thiccfoot
details.short_description: A relaxing camping trip becomes a desperate struggle for survival. Will you survive? Will your friends?

details.title: wormin
details.short_description: Synchronize Wormins with ancient glyphs in a mysterious world of signs and snakes. Discover strange rules, clever interactions, and puzzles hidden beneath the surface.

details.title: I Don't Do Quests Anymore...
details.short_description: Be the quest giver in this casual guild management game! Tired of doing all these quests for random NPCs? This time, you can be this NPC! Take your place in your very own adventurers guild and distribute quests to heroes. brew potions, craft gear and make smart choices to help them survive!

details.title: Rain of Lead
details.short_description: Every hit is lethal, with no room for error. Switch between sword and pistol to tear through soldiers, artillery pieces, tanks — and even destroy an entire army. You awaken without memories. A queen claiming to be your wife asks you to fight for her. Will you stand with her to the end?

details.title: Mecha Wars: Kitbash Rebuilt
details.short_description: One day, young Lumina accidentally witnesses a shady incident and gets dragged straight into the crossfire. From that moment on, she’s forced into a desperate war against the evil organization “Tenfold Piercing Arrow”. To crush her enemies, she must scavenge parts and forge an even stronger mecha.

details.title: Cube Colony
details.short_description: Grow a colony one cube at a time and keep Industry, Nature and Science in balance. Your colonists have opinions. Your balance bar has limits. Push it too far, and it all comes crashing down.

details.title: Imperium of the Stars
details.short_description: Rebuild a scattered empire in a Gothic galaxy of distant beacons and lost colonies. A real-time 4X with four distinct playable factions, empire-wide command, and Living Sagas shaped by how you govern and conquer up to 10,000 star systems.
