details.title: Armed-Mageddon
details.short_description: Top-down bullet heaven with randomly generated weapons and maps. Find guns, level up, unlock everything, upgrade and evolve your weapons to create unique and crazy builds as you blast your way through the end of the world!

details.title: The Kept Fire
details.short_description: Your brother’s hiking group vanished. Beyond the cave, the valley is hunting you. The beast only moves when you look away, but stare too long and you go blind. Keep your fire alive, find a way out, and remember: you can survive three encounters. Not four.

details.title: Scrim-Mage
details.short_description: Scrim-Mage is a casual 2d fighting game where you and a friend play as gnome wizards and can customise your moveset with different spells. Competitive silliness is a guarantee in this colourful combination between traditional and platform fighters.

details.title: Ashes of Pantheon
details.short_description: Become the Ash Fire. Chart your gladiator’s course through the arena with directive cards, then watch your plan play out in real time. Build your deck, manage resources, and rekindle divine power in a turn-based strategy deckbuilder steeped in ancient Roman mythology.

details.title: Drive To The Top
details.short_description: Jump, Swing and Boost your way to get to the finish as fast as you can! Try beating the level in both single player and 2-player co-op. How fast can you beat the game?

details.title: Medusa's Gaze
details.short_description: A new 3D first-person puzzle game, where every death leaves behind a petrified statue of yourself - can you use this to outwit Medusa? Solve dozens of mind-bending puzzles involving light & shadow, life & death, to uncover the mystery at the heart of the fortress.

details.title: 1x1 Street Football: mini soccer PvP
details.short_description: Fast-paced 1v1 street soccer arcade game! Control unique heroes, use spectacular combat-style moves, and defeat opponents in real-time. Upgrade your characters' skills, conquer global leagues, and become a superstar in thrilling online PvP football matches

details.title: Skuffle
details.short_description: 4-player splitscreen online party shooter. Couch and online players in the same match. The splitscreen shooters of your youth with some modern twists. Maps, Modes, Skins, Mutators, Guns, Cigarettes! Oh My! WHAT ELSE DO YOU PEOPLE WANT?

details.title: House Of Decay
details.short_description: House of Decay is a PSX-style 3D platformer-metroidvania. Explore a world of demons in search of your missing brother, leap across hellish platforms, uncover secrets, find strange pets, and fight cute monsters 🦷

details.title: Rescue Ops: Wildfire
details.short_description: Become a wildland firefighter and battle raging wildfires around the world. Play solo or in co-op to rescue civilians, operate specialized vehicles, and outsmart fast-spreading, dynamic fires.

details.title: Virtualord, The Virtual Conqueror
details.short_description: Set up your base, gather resources and build a defensive perimeter with walls and towers to protect your outpost from waves of enemies. Research new tech, gather your forces and send your units and mini-units to annihilate the enemy.

details.title: BUNNY-HOP
details.short_description: A first-person bhop and surf game inspired by Counter-Strike’s community servers. Hop across rooftops, ride ramps, and find out how your friend took half a second off a run you thought was clean.

details.title: Schedule: Rehab Business
details.short_description: Play in co-op at the worst rehab center in town. Manage patients, deal with disasters, and try to help everyone recover without losing control.

details.title: Adventurers Inc.
details.short_description: An incremental auto-battler where you build a party of adventurers and lead them through 10 dungeons. Start with one hero, recruit up to four from six classes and grow them through a big skill tree. Cast skills yourself or unlock Auto-Cast, then spend your loot at the tavern.

details.title: Typopus
details.short_description: As an Octochef, master your typing skills to manage and serve dishes in a conveyor belt restaurant. Type to cook, type to upgrade, type to automate in Typopus, an incremental cooking game. Satisfy customers, unlock new meals and optimize your restaurant.

details.title: CyberCon: Cybersecurity Tycoon
details.short_description: Build a cybersecurity firm in 1990. Recruit specialists, build an office, bid on tenders, and develop your own security products from floppy disks to AI through five eras of tech history up to 2039. Keep your staff happy and your record clean. Or don't.

details.title: Castle-O
details.short_description: Navigate the castle gardens, find the fastest route and compete for the best time.

details.title: ARANEA, BREACH!
details.short_description: Control a heavy armored vehicle equipped with the ARANEA Spider-Bionic Module. Use the mechanical climbing system to overcome spatial limitations, dismantle obstacles, collect resources, and install functional modules to adapt your vehicle to ever-changing exploration environments.

details.title: Deep Trouble
details.short_description: Dive into Deep Trouble with a crew of up to 6 and your mostly trusty submarine, slipping past massive leviathans into the mysterious depths. Pilot, swim, and salvage together to reach the bottom before your oxygen runs out, a friend blows you up, or you become a tasty treat.

details.title: Refracted
details.short_description: Refracted: a 4-player co-op shooter where you build turrets and lead troops. Wield powers granted to you by a mysterious crystal against the clanker horde. Empower your hero, upgrade your army & defenses, and push through enemy lines to destroy the clanker base. Die. Refract. Push again.

details.title: Beatmaker Simulator
details.short_description: A music producer career simulator. Make beats, work with artists, grow your popularity, earn money, level up your skills, and build the studio of your dreams.

details.title: Ruins of Aloryith
details.short_description: Ruins of Aloryith is a third-person action roguelite. Fight through escalating waves with sword and shield, unleash player-controlled abilities, and shape your build with upgrades. Face corrupted bosses and uncover the source of the corruption.

details.title: The Rift Trader
details.short_description: Not good, How about half? Every deal at this counter is a conversation — with kings, inspectors, widows and street kids who all remember how you treated them. The rift brings the goods. You set the price.

details.title: V.E.L.O.
details.short_description: Abandoned by the living. Loved by the dead. Five idols return to the stage—but their new audience isn't alive. Become their sole producer, uncover supernatural mysteries, and lead their comeback in a story-driven visual novel and rhythm game.

details.title: Path Of Peecho
details.short_description: Fight the Pawtriarchy! The world has been dominated by the greediest cat the universe has ever known. Assemble your team of rebels, build their decks, customize their skill trees, and take Peecho down in this turn-based roguelite scramble to save humanity right meow.

details.title: AFTERMATH
details.short_description: Aftermath is a first-person horror game. Return to this old house once again, explore its dark corners, and face the traces that cannot be erased and the consequences that cannot be undone.

details.title: Dungeon Contractor
details.short_description: Run a fantasy dungeon maintenance company. Hire monsters, deploy deadly traps, and prepare dungeons for the next wave of greedy heroes. Every contract is a new challenge where smart planning leads to bigger profits.

details.title: Pack Ripper
details.short_description: Pack Ripper is a hands-on trading card incremental game. Rip open packs, fill your binder, and level up your packs for better pulls. Will you sell the hit or keep it?

details.title: Rule By Roll
details.short_description: A tower defense game where you rank up towers, roll the dice to draw them, and pick perks as you level. Every choice compounds — stack talents, chain synergies, and build a defense that holds against hundreds of enemies across levels that only get harder.

details.title: A Mountain Called Hope
details.short_description: Explore a hauntingly abandoned late 1800s mountain coal mining town afflicted by a violent winter storm.

details.title: The Bank
details.short_description: a finance mmo with the goal to compete in a virtual economy

details.title: Skill Issue
details.short_description: Skill Issue is a collection of competitive minigames where you can outplay the competition through pure mechanical skill-master.

details.title: Shape Wars
details.short_description: A fast-paced auto-battler where Squares, Triangles, and Circles clash in an endless lane war. Build your army, manage your economy, and destroy the enemy Nexus before they destroy yours.

details.title: DEADLINE: Afterlife Processing
details.short_description: The dead wait in line. You run the press. Read each soul, judge it, seal it and get paid for it. Tired of doing it yourself? The catalog has machines that'll do the work for you. Management recommends it. Management appreciates your cooperation.

details.title: Penthouse
details.short_description: Penthouse is a Rogue-like horror game where you (and your friends) stumble into a haunted Penthouse in order to pay rent for your boat. As you do, you must find clues and use devices to discover what happened in this Penthouse. Solve the mystery of the Haunting.

details.title: All-in Tide
details.short_description: Adapt to the ever-changing weather. Learn every cave along the shore. Swing your shovel and dig up whatever the sea has hidden. But never lose sight of your own desires — they can drive you mad, or make you filthy rich.

details.title: Kalmareth: Rune Duel VR
details.short_description: A 1v1 VR magic duel fought with your hands. Draw runes in the air to cast — six strokes, no menus, no HUD. Read your opponent's motion, commit to a stroke, and strike before they finish theirs.

details.title: Idol Shell
details.short_description: Idol Shell is a retro-style FPS inspired by the classics of the 1990s. Fight relentless mechanical enemies, explore interconnected levels, uncover hidden secrets, and discover the mystery behind their creation.

details.title: Only Guns
details.short_description: It's like Only Up but with guns. Only Guns! A third person puzzle-platforming-shooter. Race against the clock! Jump, Climb and Shoot your way up through a series of realms until you reach the very top.

details.title: Astella Walker
details.short_description: Leave it to luck, or engineer the odds? Instead of cards, carve strike angles on your roulette to control probabilities. When the triple rings snap into place, your chained strikes explode. Caught between exponential loot and lethal curses, decide when to fold (STOP) and when to press on (GO).

details.title: Tetragrade
details.short_description: Embark on your own odyssey, stack hand-cut materials, watch treasures pour into the bowl and spend your rewards on the favour of ten Greek gods. Tetragrade is a compulsive block-stacking roguelite about the pleasure of a perfect fit.

details.title: Frutiverse
details.short_description: Your planet is doomed. In Frutiverse, a space game driven by orbital physics and destructible environments, you fight incoming threats, destroying asteroids or pushing them off their collision course. Gather resources and build an evacuation ship to save your fellow Fruits, alone or in local co-op.

details.title: Ragtag Fleet
details.short_description: Ragtag Fleet is a fast-paced pixel-destruction survival roguelite. Tear apart enemy ships, expose their Cores, and turn the spoils into weapons, drones, and modules. Build a makeshift fleet into overwhelming firepower.

details.title: Night Killaz
details.short_description: A multiplayer game where you either hunt or be hunted. 1 invisible vampire. 4 Night Killaz. Complete your objectives as a human, or become the vampire and take them out. The vampire feeds on mistakes. The team works together, and fights back. Can humans outsmart the invisible threat?

details.title: God Sight Road of Ashes
details.short_description: A dark fantasy tactical turn-based RPG with free-roaming exploration. Lead a band of travelers across a dangerous world, recruit companions, manage food and exhaustion, and fight strategic battles using magic and unique abilities.

details.title: Doctrine Strike
details.short_description: Modern real-time strategy in real cities. Pick a place on Earth, generate its real landmarks in 3D, shape the terrain, design your own units and factions, then fight combined-arms wars with superweapons on the map you built. Free to play.

details.title: ChameleonCraft MMO: Hide Your Piñatas!
details.short_description: An incremental idler MMO: Paint & hide your gold-generating piñatas while hunting & stealing others’ poorly hidden treasures in a massive persistent world! Build wealth, spend on upgrades, hide & protect your passive-income empire, customize your character, get revenge, find rare items & show off!

details.title: Deep Sea Survivor
details.short_description: Explore the ocean with adorable robots in this pixel-art bullet heaven action roguelite! Choose and upgrade diverse weapons, defeat swarms of sea creatures, and survive deadly traps. The deeper you dive, the greater the danger becomes. Create a new build on every run and survive the depths!

details.title: The One Who
details.short_description: Step into the shoes of a father searching for his missing daughter in a nightmare world. Explore eerie, shifting locations, hide in the dark from unnatural creatures, and follow a mysterious voice to piece together the truth before it's too late.

details.title: Adventurers Wanted!
details.short_description: An idle fantasy guild game where you run the notice board.

details.title: Reap & Repeat
details.short_description: Reap & Repeat is a satisfying active incremental game about harvesting an ever-growing ecosystem. Cut plants, earn upgrades, improve your scythe, and make vegetation grow faster, denser, and more valuable as your tiny harvest turns into field-clearing chaos.

details.title: Cosmic Mushrooms
details.short_description: Realistic physics-based rocket game. Navigate dangerous alien planets, collect mushroom cargo and deliver supplies back to your base.

details.title: Doomed Village
details.short_description: Rule a village caught in the shadow of war. You cannot fight or stop it. Choose which problems to face, endure the consequences of what you neglect and shape the remains of your village when the end finally arrives.

details.title: Geeked-Out Basketball
details.short_description: Think you have the coaching chops to build a dynasty? Prove it. Geeked-Out Basketball is a deep high school basketball management sim: recruit and develop your players, scout opponents, craft your game plans, and call every possession live. Depth you can actually see and feel.

details.title: Word Link
details.short_description: Guess the 12 hidden words on every board using definitions, rhymes, emojis and facts. Play solo, survive endless escalating waves, or battle friends on the couch, where phones become the controllers. Fully playable in English and Arabic.

details.title: King Must Rush
details.short_description: A medieval roguelite where you play the king: race the clock to forge weapons and arm your villagers, command the army in real time, and hold the walls against the siege. Climb a branching map to the boss, draft powers between fights, and grow stronger every run.

details.title: Valley of Stability
details.short_description: Crash-land on a dying alien world and bring it back to life. Build automated factories, master real chemistry and nuclear physics, and terraform the atmosphere one gas at a time — while sandworms hunt the power signature of everything you build.

name: Ask Mom: Find Objects, Learn Words

details.title: Ask Mom: Find Objects, Learn Words
details.short_description: Learn a language by finding hidden objects 🔎 in a cozy, funny family game where everyone keeps losing things — except super‑mom, who can find anything. Search for items, learn words in context, and enjoy short family scenes. Free demo coming soon — wishlist the game.

details.title: Decommission Protocol
details.short_description: Edith station has been abandoned for a year - an unusually long time to sit derelict. You are a space station engineer sent up to decommission the station in a manual service elevator with the ability to stop between floors. Will you discover the truth or simply follow protocol?

details.title: Gamarra - Street Vendor Simulator
details.short_description: Your family is desperate for money. All you have is a stand in Gamarra, Peru's busiest market. Start small, haggle hard, dodge corrupt police, and survive gang extortion. But every coin you earn is a choice: send it home, or bet it on your business, nothing comes free.

details.title: Pax Astra
details.short_description: A political sim RPG space opera with 4X elements, inspired by Suzerain and Stellaris. Become the first president of a fallen empire, choose any ideology, and expand into the stars. Your decisions shape the nation and the galaxy. Follow any ideology, be the leader you want in Pax Astra!

details.title: Puppet's Trial
details.short_description: Puppet's Trial is a horror game where you incarnate a Puppet. With decaying life and the desire to find a purpose, You will face multiple trials to try to prove your worth to your maker. And eventually meet him.

details.title: Sticky Rooms: A hopeful illusion
details.short_description: Furniture comes as stickers, so the order matters and mistakes can’t be undone. Clara has left the office to become an interior designer, with thirty jobs ahead of her and a home of her own to decorate at her pace. A new illusion to live in.

details.title: Bob Needs Feed
details.short_description: Bob is in a big debt. Build, craft, feed, automate, and expand your kingdom. Manage resources, synergize your battle deck, and most importantly... PAY the BILL!

details.title: Project Remnant
details.short_description: Tactical shooter with roguelite and extraction mechanics built around smooth and responsive gunplay, weapon customization, and liminal environments. Scavenge, survive, and descend through increasingly dangerous floors as you uncover the truth behind a nightmare where not even death can set you free.

details.title: Wunderfront
details.short_description: In this brutal roguelite survival shooter, death is only the beginning of your evolution. Master a unique mix of historical firearms, experimental gadgets, and secret wonder weapons to execute the monstrosities ruling a ruined WW2 frontline.

details.title: Dear. My Marionette
details.short_description: A narrative-driven, turn-based RPG set in a cold, Nordic-inspired world. Master strategic card combat and make choices that will shape the fate of this frozen land.

details.title: FRANKED!
details.short_description: A roguelite about weaponising your mistakes. It happens to be pinball. Night shift at a sorting office. Flip parcels into the right chute, or misroute them onto the Backlog Rail, where they gain value while they wait. Fill the rail and everything crashes back at once, worth far more than before.

details.title: Musicality
details.short_description: A cozy co-op music toy. Plug synths, drums and pedals together in your own little home, record takes for the neighbours, and jam with friends over Steam.

details.title: Purrfect Hand
details.short_description: Settle into a cozy poker-inspired card game. Hold cards, build stronger hands, earn chips, and unlock upgrades as you chase royal flushes. Befriend a cat, discover playful minigames, and enjoy one more deal over a warm cup of coffee.

details.title: Choo City
details.short_description: Choo City is a cozy train puzzle game. Lay tracks, flip switches and dispatch your trains to deliver coal, wood and people to construction sites. Avoid crashes, beat the clock and build 24 unique buildings to bring your toy town to life.

details.title: Bingolazo
details.short_description: A colorful bingo roguelite. Pick which balls to call, mark your cards and chain lines, diagonals and full cards into huge scores. Collect lucky charms that bend the rules, play legendary balls like Saturn and beat the club's bosses, in endless runs or the story mode.

details.title: 斗域经理
details.short_description: Build your club in Arena Manager, a strategy game of hero development and automatic battles. Recruit heroes, shape your five-person squad with skills and gear, and outdraft your rivals. Lead your team from the lower leagues to the Continental Crown.

details.title: The Compliant
details.short_description: A dark workplace parable in visual-novel form. As Lin Zhi works at Sabo Group, he uncovers buried secrets—AI, human experimentation, thought control—while clues keep surfacing. What will you choose? The game features 13 distinct characters and 15 endings to unlock.

details.title: Moonlit Vigil
details.short_description: Moonlit Vigil is a first-person narrative horror game where you are the cemetery's new caretaker. Explore the grounds and uncover what really happens to bodies once they're buried in this atmospheric nightmare filled with jumpscares.

details.title: Echoes on Paper
details.short_description: In the summer of 2032, fourteen-year-old Lin Haoyang receives a box of old photographs sent by his father from Xi'an. Sorting albums, identifying faces, and completing the family tree, he slowly pieces together a century of memories of an ordinary Chinese family over six summer days.

details.title: Legio Impera
details.short_description: Found a Roman colony, run its economy and pay your legions. Legio Impera is a city-building RTS set in Marian Rome: govern a province during the Cimbrian War, subdue Gauls and Germanic tribes, and stop the horde before it reaches Italy.

details.title: Seven Rukks: Pit, Profit & Glory
details.short_description: Seven Rukks is a brutal fantasy sports management game. Build your team, develop your players, plan your lineup and tactics, and lead your club through a ruthless league where glory, profit, and survival are often only one Rukk apart.

details.title: Flip Biz Tycoon
details.short_description: This is NO decorating game. Put on that suit, crunch those numbers, and flip them houses. It's business time!

details.title: Chess Traveler: Pip's Journey
details.short_description: The family chess set is about to be donated, and only Pip, the smallest pawn in the box, can stop it. Roll dice across the house, bend chess with silly House Rules from checkers, Ludo and xiangqi, and make chess fun again in a cozy chess roguelike.

details.title: Ten Thousand Victories
details.short_description: A historical strategy game set in medieval Vietnam, drawn in the style of Đông Hồ folk woodblock prints. Build a realm and hold it through invasion after invasion, command formations in real-time battles, or ride out as one captain in a Story Mode where the country remembers your promises.

details.title: Domino Party
details.short_description: Stand up thousands of dominoes to build a picture, then watch it all topple in one glorious chain! Make domino art and up to 10,000-piece jigsaws from your own photos with friends, then party in the lodge and playland with 28 mini-games like curling and sled races.

details.title: Neldoaria
details.short_description: A dying land, buried in ash. Seek Neldoaria beyond the desert. Summon souls bound by their names onto a 3×3 grid in this roguelite deckbuilder where cards shape the battlefield. 7 days. Day and night. How you spend your time and choices, and how it ends, is up to luck and to you.

details.title: Armed Prototype: Dual Blaze
details.short_description: Armed Prototype: Dual Blaze is a pixel-art side-scrolling action shooter for solo or local co-op play! Run, jump and climb under fire. Smash special devices to switch between gun-wielding and sword-wielding heroines. Fight through enemy lines with bullets and blades—alone or with a friend!

details.title: Oddballs Brawl
details.short_description: Oddballs Brawl is a chaotic side-scrolling shooter for 2–4 players! Play as bizarre fighters, jumping, dodging, and blasting away across floating platforms and trap-filled arenas. Grab all kinds of weapons, send your friends flying, and fight for victory in the middle of the mayhem!

details.title: Blazing Fighter King
details.short_description: Blazing Fighter King is a chaotic stick-figure brawler for 2–4 players! Grab guns, swing swords, and battle across shaky platforms and tumbling crates. Dodge, snatch weapons, and use the terrain and surprise attacks to defeat your rivals and claim the title of Fighter King!

details.title: League of Constellations
details.short_description: What if you took the build you'd been mowing down hordes with in a survivors-like and put it in a 5v5? So I built it. Raise your heroes in the survivors run, then take them straight into the league. No nerfs. You control your own hero; your teammates fight by your formation and tactics.

details.title: Bottled Ambition
details.short_description: A Prohibition-era moonshine sim, solo or in co-op with up to three friends. Grow corn, mix your own blends and run them through a copper still. Smuggle the jugs past the sheriff and rival bootleggers by truck or on horseback. Hire workers and build your empire.

name: Space Novel: Echoes of the Divide

details.title: Space Novel: Echoes of the Divide
details.short_description: An ordinary factory worker becomes a fugitive in a galactic war. Choose whom to trust, uncover the purpose of an experimental crystal, and decide what freedom is worth in a branching science-fiction visual novel.

details.title: Large Language Mercenaries
details.short_description: A roguelite turn-based strategy RPG where you command an AI mercenary, defend your caravan, and parry enemy attacks in real time. Play as the *original characters* Sam the Scout, Elon the Envoker, or Dario the Duelist and face down waves of AI-enabled nightmares to save humanity.

details.title: Kessrand: The Last Warden
details.short_description: You are the Last Hero of a kingdom trapped inside a mountain, and the invaders are hunting you. Carve tunnels and set traps between waves, then survive each wave, leading the horde through the killing warren you built.

details.title: SoulMarkWalker
details.short_description: 《SoulMarkWalker》 is a turn-based action game.Choose your skills and time your dodges and counters in video-driven, turn-based combat. Investigate clues, develop your character, and resonate with ancient heroes.

details.title: Crashloop
details.short_description: CRASHLOOP is a roguelike deckbuilder about hacking your way through a botnet. Build machines out of hexagonal tiles, chain them into loops, and crash every foe that stands in your way as you find out who's behind it all.

details.title: Resupply
details.short_description: Your towers have limited ammo, and it's your job to deliver it. Resupply is a tower defense game where logistics is the real challenge. Move ammunition with workers, conveyor belts and autonomous bots, and keep your defense supplied as the waves get harder.

name: Chess Me If You Can: A Chameleon's Escape

details.title: Chess Me If You Can: A Chameleon's Escape
details.short_description: Escape a world ruled by chess as a curious, shapeshifting chameleon. Capture guards to borrow their movement, use tactical cards, and solve turn-based room puzzles. Every new form opens a different route—but the guards have plans of their own.

details.title: Monster Cove
details.short_description: A cozy retro handheld-inspired RPG where you research and battle monsters, save a seaside village, and create a new life at your own pace. This time, you are the Monster Researcher.

details.title: Ancient Crowns
details.short_description: Build your captain in 3D, raise your banner and ride out across a curving world to claim the ancient crowns. Recruit armies, fight turn-based battles on land and at sea, besiege towns or hold your own walls. Three peoples, three campaigns, a map editor and hot-seat. In English and Hungarian.

details.title: Frontline: Hold the Line
details.short_description: A WWII tactical roguelite about holding the line. Dig in, deploy riflemen, machine gunners, snipers, tanks and anti-tank guns, then call in artillery and air strikes as waves of enemy infantry and armour crash against your defences.

details.title: Peblings: A Creature Bag-Builder
details.short_description: A creature roguelike in the spirit of Luck be a Landlord, where your creatures fuse and evolve. Draw your bag onto the grid and watch their effects chain: a few dozen damage at first, thousands by the end. Eight bosses per run, out of 32, and they fight back.

details.title: Bad Company
details.short_description: Never enough firepower or room for loot? This multiplayer extraction shooter has the cure! Form a convoy with friends or quirky AI buddies. Start with basic rifles, storm forts in tanks, and haul maps clean with heavy trucks. Backpack full? Drive off with the crates and the vehicle!

details.title: Dark Kitchen
details.short_description: Dark Kitchen is a 2–4 player co-op game, playable online or in split-screen. Survive the kitchen rush while your friends race across town to deliver orders on time, and guard your food from rivals who'll stop at nothing to steal it!

details.title: SYSTEM INTRUDER
details.short_description: Explore the dark secrets of ASGARD-04 in an immersive retro-cyberpunk survival horror inspired by classic 3D games. Search for clues, solve puzzles, fight enemies, manage limited resources, and survive the horrors lurking within a mysterious research complex.

details.title: The Last Minute
details.short_description: Face waves of robots in a fast-paced arena FPS with roguelite elements. Survive 60-second rounds, then choose modifiers that change your abilities, enemies, or the arena. Keep your combos going and beat your high score.

details.title: Samt
details.short_description: Samt is a 2-player online co-op stealth game. Silence keeps you alive. Real voice, footsteps, and movement are heard by hunting AI drones in a dead, neon-lit mega-city. Stay quiet. Survive together, or evaporate trying. This game requires a co-op partner: no solo play.

details.title: Sugarstar Academy
details.short_description: Read enemy landings, turn cards into a squad on a 5×5 battlefield, and use positioning and Hero Skills to rewrite the outcome of auto-combat in this story-driven magical-academy deckbuilder.

details.title: The Last Stash
details.short_description: Run the last shop in a post-apocalyptic town. Stock shelves, set prices, and complete contracts. Drive into an abandoned town at night, search for supplies, and fight mutants and raiders. Bring back what you find to sell in your shop or keep it for your own survival.

details.title: Stop Reading the Cards
details.short_description: Build a deck, define its priorities, and watch your strategy execute itself. In this satirical single-player roguelike, cards become parts of an automated combat system. Create absurd synergies, adapt your rules, and survive a tower that treats every run like a badly managed show.

details.title: Sainthood Relics
details.short_description: Excavate layered blocks to uncover hidden relics. Carefully balance power and precision to clear each surface efficiently in this relaxing, satisfying puzzle experience. Each discovery reveals the true (and sometimes strange) histories of the saints.

details.title: SolTarot
details.short_description: Turn low cards into big scores in SolTarot, a tarot-inspired solitaire roguelike. Combine Tarot powers, modify your cards, and bend the rules to overcome bosses that challenge your strongest combinations.

details.title: Ferryman's Obol
details.short_description: A short, narrative incremental game about the weight of endless labor. You ferry the dead across the River Styx. Each with their own worries, whispers and obol. How do you come to terms with the dead? Should you?

details.title: HUNTKEEPER: Idle Trails
details.short_description: HUNTKEEPER: Idle Trails is a compact idle hunting game that lives along the bottom of your screen. Let your hunter track beasts while you work, watch videos, or do something else. Collect loot, improve your gear, unlock useful skills, and conquer new biomes.

details.title: My Friend is a Moron
details.short_description: A 1-3 player tactical roguelite. Shared dice, real elemental combos, and an AI teammate who knows... thinks he is the smartest guy in the room. He has a plan. You can stop him... sometimes!

details.title: Burnt Order
details.short_description: Run the kitchen together. With 3-4 players, one of you is secretly ruining it. Chaos meets betrayal. Playing solo or with 2? Try traitor free endless co-op.

details.title: Pro Endurance Series: Running Manager
details.short_description: Pro Endurance Series Running manager: take your athlete from prospect to legend. Plan training, nutrition, gear and staff, pick your 5K, 10K, half-marathon and marathon races, and live every event in a real-time simulator where you set the pace and tactics.

details.title: ARUS-1
details.short_description: Your rescue pod crashes on Mars at night. Survive alone or with up to 3 friends in online co-op, reach the habitat, expand your base, weather deadly sandstorms – and find out who else is out there on this planet.

details.title: Constellations: Space Company Simulator
details.short_description: From a scrappy start-up to an aerospace titan: build a private space enterprise from the ground up using real-life-inspired rockets. Accept contracts, upgrade your base, design custom satellites, and scale massive constellations to fund your journey to the Moon.

details.title: BodgeBall
details.short_description: A multiplayer dodgeball FPS that blends competitive intensity with ridiculous chaos. Hit opponents with balls to send them to the bench, and catch a ball to bring teammates back into the fight. Explore Bodge City and take on bosses and challenges solo or with friends online.

details.title: Worlds: Dome Vanguard – Alien TD
details.short_description: Worlds: Dome Vanguard – Alien TD is a single-player Tower Defense game that combines elements of strategy, general leveling, combat vehicles, and searching for powerful weapons to eliminate aliens. Learn talents and perks, build unique vehicles, and defend different planets from hordes of aliens.

details.title: Never Ending Trail
details.short_description: Build a custom mobile fortress on legs. Crash-land in the Wild West, scavenge your wrecked ship, transform it into a walking mech base and roam an endless, procedurally generated western frontier. Build, Loot, and Survive your way through a world that never lets you stop.

details.title: Night at the Fun Park
details.short_description: Escape a giant spider in an abandoned amusement park. Find the keys to the exit, distract her with noise and free your friends from cocoons. Co-op horror for 1-4 players: online through Steam, solo or in two-player split-screen.

details.title: AIONOIA
details.short_description: AIONOIA is a minimalist incremental idler about an ancient machine built to spark existence itself. Generate Potential and experiment with powerful modifiers to transform simple circuits into increasingly absurd chain reactions.

details.title: Turbo Drag Racer 3000
details.short_description: Turbo Drag Racer 3000 is a fast-paced retro drag racer with roguelite drafting. Rev your engine, time your shifts, flip on the nitrous, and survive a tournament bracket by drafting race-changing performance perks between heats. Just don't blow your engine.

details.title: Othercrown
details.short_description: A deck-building auto-battler roguelite where you build your own slot machine to deploy monsters and cast spells against the human kingdoms. Mutate your creatures, and maximize your slots to deploy as many creatures and spells as you can during your fights against the human kingdoms.

details.title: Archival Security
details.short_description: A psychological horror game about a transcription job that goes wrong very slowly. Copy the projected slides, word for word. Follow the rules. Do not respond if the text asks you a question. ACCURACY IS OUR HIGHEST PRIORITY.

details.title: Till Death Descends
details.short_description: A first-person retro dungeon crawler. On your wedding day a necromancer dragged your bride underground. Descend floor by floor, parry, break cracked walls, pick locks, and hunt for scraps of her veil and the relics that open the way deeper. Every fight is fair. Every hit is shown before it lands.

details.title: Wirebound
details.short_description: Wirebound is a casual 2D runner where you grind across powerlines through a variety of biomes. Perform jumps and tricks to syphon energy while unlocking upgrades and secret worlds.

details.title: Black & White in Balance
details.short_description: A puzzle game where you move stones to bring balance between black and white. Inspired by Go, it features its own unique world and board-based puzzles.

details.title: Kleopatra Zero
details.short_description: A fast-paced mech wave-shooter where every enemy attack is drawn on the floor before it lands, and the cards you pick between waves turn one hit into a cascade that clears the screen. A standalone prequel to Kleopatra.

details.title: ELYSIUM
details.short_description: ELYSIUM is a next-gen third-person MMORPG forged by Mercenary Games. Explore a living open world, AI companions & step into realm Full Sandbox Roleplay (RP) with a living economy Free to play with built-in purchases and a self-contained in-game economy — your progression, your ecosystem, your story!

name: Frogging Up: Frog Climb Rage Game

details.title: Frogging Up: Frog Climb Rage Game
details.short_description: Every leap brings you closer to glory… or back to the beginning.

details.title: Dirty Dogs
details.short_description: An online party game for 3 to 10 players. Among Us meets Cluedo, in a dog park. Mark your territory, sniff out the strays in disguise, and argue it out at the pack meeting.

details.title: Escape from Tower
details.short_description: Escape from Tower is a hardcore first-person extraction shooter set in the fallen realm of Grivion. Gear up, enter the raid, outfight rival squads and scavengers with your wands and loot the ruins. Reach an extraction and it's yours. Die, and Grivion keeps it all.

details.title: Stock Baron
details.short_description: Stock Baron is a strategy sim set in a fictional stock market. Become a market titan with vast capital, superior intel and an arsenal of trading tactics. Your moves sway prices, while other market players seize their chances. Enter a battle of wits amid fear and greed, and make your fortune!

details.title: Chronicle of Gods
details.short_description: You are one god in a pantheon of rivals. On living worlds of wandering peoples, rising cities and warring realms, gods compete for faith and mortals toil. Older than any realm, the Chronicle remembers the deeds of mortals and gods alike. Can anyone prove which were yours?

details.title: Harvestin Season
details.short_description: Harvestin season is a chaotic 1-4 player online co-op. It's almost harvestin season, and you know what that means? Fertilize the Crops, inject steroids into your livestock, and by nightfall SLAUGHTER THEM ALL.

details.title: DUSTY CANVAS: Restore the Masterpiece
details.short_description: DUSTY CANVAS is a meditative game about restoring genuine works of art. Clean and restore paintings, unlock new tools, and discover interesting facts about masterpieces and their artists.

details.title: Blade & Barrel
details.short_description: A roguelike action game where you fight a multitude of different enemies, each ruling over their own room. Use your sword and gun to clear out each room, allowing you to purchase upgrades. Each enemy is more difficult than the last, so play tactically. You only get one life, so play smart!

details.title: Sarmatian Heroes
details.short_description: Sarmatian Heroes is a turn-based strategy RPG where you explore the ancient world, develop heroes with unique skills, command armies, and build fortified cities your way. Fight tactical hex-based battles in the open field and defend your custom-built cities during sieges.

details.title: Logistica: Under Glass
details.short_description: A medieval village grows inside a glass case. Cards cost villagers, buildings are one-shot cards, and every tile you clear makes the next raid bigger. Hold the walls, then take your deck out on the road as one of four peoples.

details.title: Dragonhaul
details.short_description: Dragonhaul is a retro roguelite autobattler where every step matters. Explore a hand-pixelled overworld, arrange powerful items in an expanding inventory and construct devastating synergies before the boss arrives, no two runs are the same.

details.title: Cadence_Blade
details.short_description: Hold the castle sword-in-hand in this co-op action defense game for 1-3 players. Time your strikes to the Flow, manage where you invest your coins, and see how long you last against the waves... or just let a friend take the dragon.

details.title: Astral Trace
details.short_description: Astral Trace is a fast paced arcade word game where every word keeps you alive. Trace through moving hex clusters, earn precious time, and chase high scores while the field grows faster, denser, and more demanding. Survive the pressure and keep the run alive.

details.title: Eat the Sky
details.short_description: An arcade space roguelike where you are a star and everything smaller is food. Swallow the planets to grow, while rival stars hunt you for the same reason. Outgrow them or be eaten. At the center of it all something far larger is already feeding, so hurry up, the clock is ticking.

details.title: OddXI
details.short_description: The football sticker roguelike. OddXI is a gloriously daft deckbuilder where you rip open packs of deeply odd footballers, stack their traits into ridiculous combos, and drag your XI through three nerve-shredding seasons against absurd bosses: vegan pirates, a goth band and ancient philosophers.

details.title: Ogro Buchón: Barrio Multiversal
details.short_description: Ogro Buchón: Barrio Multiversal is a 2D beat ’em up inspired by classic arcades, with street combat, Mexican humor, outrageous enemies, bosses, and minigames. And just when you think you know where the story is going… you’re probably wrong.

details.title: Crank'N'Gun
details.short_description: The ultimate cranking roguelike you will ever play. Survive waves of enemies, get upgrades, defeat bosses, and unlock new scenarios. The only requirement is to keep CRANKING and never stop. I hope your hand can handle it.

details.title: Panda Rails: Desktop Journeys
details.short_description: Panda Rails: Desktop Journeys is a cozy desktop idle game where every click and keystroke boosts your high-speed train. Travel through scenic countryside with adorable animal passengers, enjoy local dishes, and receive beautiful postcards along the way!

details.title: Misfortune
details.short_description: Fight monsters with a slot machine. Spin, hold and reroll to land deadly combinations. Build your reels with powerful symbols, collect relics and unlock extra paylines. Shape your luck—and survive long enough to cash out.

details.title: CleanUp OS
details.short_description: A cozy desktop-cleaning sim. Sit down at someone else's messy computer, delete the junk, kill the CPU hogs, and fight off popups and files that keep respawning, until there's finally enough free space for that big system update and the whole machine breathes again.

details.title: One Hit Hero
details.short_description: One Hit Hero is a boss-rush action game where any hit is fatal, for you and your foes alike. Read attack patterns, block, parry, and dodge to build the power to slay each boss with one decisive strike. Trapped in a sealed dungeon, you must prove yourself by defeating every boss to earn your escape.

details.title: Winds of Discovery
details.short_description: Set sail across a living Age of Sail. Trade goods between distant ports, build your fleet, hire your crew, and forge your own path to fortune in a vast world of exploration and commerce.

details.title: NightGlow : Aquarium Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Light up a quiet, dimly lit shop with the glow of your aquariums. Raise and breed fish, discover new varieties, and build your own aquarium shop. Manage your tanks, sell fish, fulfill customer requests, decorate your space, and slowly grow your little shop in this cozy aquarium management sim.

details.title: Calorie Pinball
details.short_description: When can you lose weight with just a flick of a finger? Right now! Calorie Pinball turns your weight-loss plan into a pinball game. Will you bounce into a workout, a bizarre event, or that 2,000-calorie slice of cake? It all comes down to skill and luck!

details.title: Slavlands: Tribes at War
details.short_description: Build a Slavic stronghold from a few huts, feed your people and lead your warband across a great map of the early medieval Slavic lands. A 90s-style real-time strategy with a deep simulation, where wars are won with granaries, supply trains, weather and faith long before the first blow.

details.title: Skate N Chill
details.short_description: Build your own skatepark, find your line, and take it easy. Skate N Chill is a relaxed single-player skateboarding sandbox: shape bowls and rails, customize your crew, learn new tricks, or kick back and watch the park come to life.

details.title: Gridways
details.short_description: Traffic is your problem now. Draw roads, paint arrows, time the lights and stack overpasses so every vehicle reaches the right hub. Congestion costs you points - gridlock ends the round. Over 100 handmade puzzles, three difficulties, a level editor and Workshop support.

details.title: Dream Island Simulator
details.short_description: A desert-island survival sim played live by AI: every survivor is a large language model — they chat, dream, hold grudges, and get on with life while you're away. Start from firewood and thatch, and rebuild the knowledge the end of the world turned back into legend.

details.title: LUMENKEEP
details.short_description: A dark hex board. Shadow-crystal creatures march on your last lantern. Build no towers, build light. Aim emitters, bend beams with mirrors, and cross colors to unleash new effects. Every placement re-traces the whole board. A roguelite tower defense made of pure light.

details.title: Cyber Ninja: Tokyo Rumble
details.short_description: Cyber Ninja: Tokyo Rumble is a high-speed VR ninja action game set across multiple eras of Japan. Wield blades, unleash devastating energy techniques, and battle robotic armies in immersive arenas.

details.title: Pack Party
details.short_description: The drawing party game where you and your friends make a deck of absurd cards to answer ridiculous prompts. 4 to 10 players.

details.title: Grid Mage
details.short_description: A puzzle game about battling demons with magic. Figure out the rules behind enemy actions and exploit them with an expanding set of spells.

details.title: HOOKLINGS
details.short_description: Hook. Swing. Boom. A fast 2.5D arena shooter about tiny round critters with grappling hooks. Swing through 3D arenas that fight back, yank rivals under the press and pop them into confetti. Play online, on the couch or against bots, and earn outfits, hook skins and rare finishes.

details.title: Dirty Dispatch
details.short_description: Dirty Dispatch is a management game where you dispatch emergency teams across an isometric city while pulling the strings of its criminal underworld. Respond to calls, expand your operation, and face the consequences of the risks you create.

details.title: Pixel Xanxia
details.short_description: A pixel art cultivation RPG inspired by Idle Xanxia. Hunt spirit beasts, master techniques, rebuild your shattered Dantian, and uncover the mystery behind the attack that destroyed your cultivation.

details.title: VALD in EUROPA
details.short_description: Become Vald, the Mercenary King, and conquer an impossible Europe ruled by history's queens. Execute a captured queen, recruit her, or free her? The queens from your history books, brought to life in 1,000 watercolour-style illustrations. Strategy meets romance. 50 turns, 7 rivals, 4 routes.

details.title: Today I...
details.short_description: Try balancing your life, work, gender dysphoria, relationships, and a growingly time-consuming activist involvement in a queer association..

details.title: New World Trading Company
details.short_description: Found a trading company in the age of sail. Start with one small ship and an empty cove, hunt pirates and smugglers on a realistic sea, and grow a mighty fleet and a thriving harbour town. A single-player naval strategy game where wind, waves and every broadside matter.

details.title: Townfall
details.short_description: A city-building survival game centered around a dynamic moving world. Expand your town into new lands as old ground crumbles into an endless abyss! Lead your town through perils, stave off the dangers of the world and ensure the survival of your people before its townfall.

details.title: My Little Market
details.short_description: Grow it, stock it, sell it. Run a farm and a market side by side in this farming and shop management sim. Plant and harvest your fields, fill your shelves, serve customers at the checkout, and hire staff to keep up. Every harvest pays for your next field, shelf, or expansion.

details.title: Space Query 2
details.short_description: The real Solar System, down to the second, powered by NASA JPL data. Fly freely across 26 worlds, watch real upcoming eclipses, tear planets apart in the gravity sandbox, or relive Apollo 11 with original mission audio and film footage.

details.title: AuraFalls
details.short_description: Game night, on an island. Up to four friends meet in a seasonal hub, then dive through portals into zombie survival, races, physics bowling, duels and explosive sandcastle building. Most wins takes the cup, and every cosmetic is earned just by playing.

details.title: Feast, Flee or Starve
details.short_description: Feast, Flee or Starve is a multiplayer survival party game where stranded players must gather scarce resources, make uneasy alliances, and decide when to cooperate and when to look out for themselves.

details.title: Sumo Pixel
details.short_description: Grab three friends and shove them off the stage! A physics party brawler for up to four players, on the couch or online. Sling off ropes, smash through the floor and send your friends flying as the stage crumbles around you. Last square standing wins.

details.title: This is Ikebukuro
details.short_description: Poop without getting caught!" An absurd stealth comedy in an electronics store! Sneak past staff to drop a load in the target zones and escape undetected. Get caught or leak, and it's game over! Hide in boxes, spray away the stench, and master the art of "Defecate & Escape" to hit high scores!

details.title: Summoner Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own magical Summoner shop! Stock enchanted goods, set prices, hire staff, decorate your shop, and expand your business. Summon creatures to sell, collect, or send into battle. Host Summon battles, challenge towering Kaiju bosses, and build the ultimate destination for Summoners!

details.title: Void Runners
details.short_description: Co-op salvage raids for one to four pilots, on one couch or online. Beams link your ships and shred anything they sweep: spread out and swing the web. Crossfire, dodge, revive your crew from escape pods, and build a salvaged ship that breaks the rules, three sectors and three guardians deep.

details.title: Strive Card
details.short_description: Strive Card is a deckbuilding roguelike won with Niu Niu poker hands. Build a five-card Niu Niu, line your Strive Cards up so additive bonuses feed the multipliers, reshape your deck with Tech Cards, and clear 24 solar terms and 8 stage bosses to push one hand into the billions.

details.title: No Pose, No Mercy
details.short_description: Paint, survive, and create your own character poses in a fast-paced multiplayer game with runtime Control Rig customization.

details.title: Dragon's Tear
details.short_description: Slay monsters, harvest their Tears and power-up your party in this idle dungeon crawler RPG. Farm cleared floors while AFK, then leap back into action to lead your party down 100 handcrafted floors. Can you find the legendary Dragon's Tear?

details.title: Clean 'Em Ocean
details.short_description: An incremental game about cleaning the ocean with a speedboat, unlocking upgrades, and cleaning more trash. Will you save the ocean?

details.title: Warbuddies
details.short_description: WarBuddies blends team building, skirmish wargaming, and card-based combat. Lead your friendly buddies creatures in a hex-based battlefield, capture objectives, and outwit your rival in tactical clashes.

details.title: Gamblemon
details.short_description: Gamblemon is a roguelike deckbuilder built around a slot machine. Place your Gamblemon and items in the lanes, spin the machine, and trigger synergies by matching elements across the lanes. Buy items, evolve your Gamblemon, and reach the target score before you run out of spins.

details.title: Forsythia
details.short_description: 1592, the Imjin War. Lead Yi Sun-sin, Gwon Yul, and other real commanders through seven years of war between Joseon, Ming, and Japan. Fight real-time encounter battles, command a fleet of panokseon warships, and craft your own equipment. A single-player campaign drawn from the historical record.

details.title: Go & Bust
details.short_description: Go-Stop, the classic Korean card game, meets poker and roguelike deckbuilding. Match cards, push your luck with GO or cash out with STOP, rig the table with 28 shady items, and bankrupt three ghost dealers, from a back-alley den to a luxury casino cruise.

details.title: NULL.REF EXODUS
details.short_description: A frenetic roguelite TPS. Inside the ship carrying humanity's last backup, create your own weapon, scale it to absurd levels, and defend every sector from relentless swarms and colossal bosses, either alone or with 3 friends in online co-op.

details.title: Chartward
details.short_description: Rise from the slums to your own ship in an open-world pirate RPG distilled into incremental play. Sail uncharted seas, board vessels and plunder their riches. Choose your quests, dive for treasure and earn permanent keepsake upgrades across repeated lives.

details.title: IT'S NOT A DEER
details.short_description: First-person horror game where mimicking creatures hide among ordinary wildlife. Study animal behavior and spot anomalies before you shoot. Sell meat and hides, upgrade your gear, and retreat to your cabin when you become the prey.

details.title: Airport Land: Air Traffic Control
details.short_description: An air traffic control game in the tower: sequence takeoffs and landings, call the go-around, and hear pilots answer in real ATC radio. Grow a one-runway island into a hub, then work Haneda, Heathrow, Kai Tak and Lukla by their real rules.

details.title: Plinko Squad
details.short_description: Drop balls down a plinko board to recruit your squad, arrange them on a hex grid, and send them auto-battling up a 25-floor tower. Stack augments into explosive synergies, but every unit that falls is gone for good.

details.title: Tidy Up Bukkos!
details.short_description: Hope you had fun making a mess by throwing all the Bukkos around because you're not going anywhere before putting everything back to its place! Tidy up this eccentric library and its puzzle shelves in this comedy oriented organizing game.

details.title: The Playtester
details.short_description: A first-person roguelite about being the aliens' playtester. Wake up in a cell, slot cartridges into a PC and survive their homemade minigames. Spend your pay on furniture that changes how the games play. Perform badly and you're eliminated. The next human wakes up in the room you furnished.

details.title: Sayara's Path
details.short_description: Join Sayara on a journey through the snow-covered Vad-Hidek to find a way to bring her brother back to the world of the living. Here everyone’s fate depends on the will of the Spirits, and the path to resurrection becomes a trial the result of which is unknown.

details.title: The Core: Protocol
details.short_description: A dark co-op horde shooter blending tower defense with trap building. Fight through a procedural maze whose biomes, cabins and weather are reshuffled every run. Survive the waves, collect permanent upgrades for the hub and discover what waits beyond the walls.

details.title: Shattersong
details.short_description: A story-driven tactical RPG in the spirit of the 16-bit classics. Raise a found-family army of 60 heroes, recover the lost Words that sang the world into being, and stand against the Hollow Cantor — a grieving priest unsaying the world one note at a time.

details.title: Flaparq: Home Cooking
details.short_description: Flaparq: Home Cooking is a heartwarming cooking simulator. Open up your childhood recipe book—where the dishes you create are not just a treat for the taste buds, but a journey down memory lane.

details.title: Idle Smith: Forge, Craft, Battle!
details.short_description: An Idle cozy blacksmith that sits on your desktop. Craft & customize swords, bows, axes for your companions. Collect loot, upgrade your workshop and prepare for the Bosses. While you attend to your own affairs, your companions will keep fighting for you.

details.title: Tiny Vessel
details.short_description: A companion idle ARPG that lives beside whatever you are doing. A tiny crew of crash-landed survivors fights along an alien walkway while you work: real loot, a Relay to grow the vessel, depths that demand better gear. Progress keeps going while you are away.

details.title: Roguelette
details.short_description: Build your own luck in a roulette roguelike. Choose three bets, lock useful results, and reroll the rest. Upgrade your table, change number colors with tricks, and stack charms to beat rising score targets.

details.title: Fronts of Steel
details.short_description: Fronts of Steel is a pausable real-time operational wargame on WWII's Eastern Front. Draw battle plans on a staff map and command divisions to break enemy lines, cut supply routes and close encirclements. Exploit terrain, keep troops supplied and choose when to advance or withdraw.

details.title: Super Chasm Hunter
details.short_description: An unforgiving extraction-roguelite adventure. Gear up and descend alone into the Chasm, fighting enemies and searching for loot. Take risks for better rewards, or extract and return home with what you've earned to sell, craft, decorate, and farm.

details.title: Barely Developers
details.short_description: Build a gaming empire in this first-person, co-op game development simulator! Start in Mom's garage, create hit games, hire chaotic employees, design your own consoles, and grow into a AAA studio. Play solo or with up to 3 friends.

details.title: Tsuki Journey
details.short_description: A relaxing slice of life adventure game where Tsuki travels between beautiful cities, meets new friends, uncovers stories, and fills out collection logs at his own pace, combining cozy idle activities with short, meaningful bursts of progression.

details.title: Worst Airline Ever
details.short_description: Build an airline from scratch in this multiplayer co-op airline management game. Fly airplanes inspired by real aircraft, design and upgrade your plane, serve passengers, and grow your airline from a small regional carrier into a world-class airline.

details.title: KAGE
details.short_description: Anime MEGABONK with friends. Unleash anime-style techniques — shout them to activate their true power! Fight hordes of enemies, hunt massive bosses, gather rare loot, and craft insane builds in a fast co-op action game for up to 4 players. Upgrade your village. Become a legend 👹

details.title: Void Hunters
details.short_description: Lead fearless rebels in a dark fantasy, turn-based RPG where tactical decisions and strategic squad-building shape every battle against the world-devouring Void.

details.title: Kopernicus: Incremental Suffering
details.short_description: Burn. Build. Survive. Escape. Incinerate nightmares with the MATEJKO flamethrower, expand your ever-growing base, and unlock devastating new weapons. Every night the planet grows stronger. So do you. Recover forgotten memories and fight your way back home (with your chihuahua's help).

details.title: Remothered: Tormented Fathers Remastered
details.short_description: The first chapter of the modern old school survival horror saga, rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5. Same ruthless tension, sharper everything.

details.title: Remothered: Broken Porcelain Remastered
details.short_description: The second chapter of the iconic modern old school survival horror saga. Remastered in Unreal Engine 5 to deliver a dramatically improved experience, while keeping every mechanic, every scare, and every secret exactly as they were.

details.title: SHIFU: Traffic Masters
details.short_description: Drive slow cars fast. Haul cargo that shifts and spills, keep taxi passengers comfortable and chase suspects through the packed streets of 1990s China, all in forgotten workhorse cars with more character than horsepower. Inspired by ’90s games like Midtown Madness and Driver.

details.title: 落樱
details.short_description: 落樱是一款将AI聊天与Galgame结合的聊天恋爱模拟游戏。你可以自由与落樱对话、与落樱一起游玩各种小游戏。在游玩中你可以体验到落樱的多种性格，并触发随机事件。

details.title: WOYO!! 2
details.short_description: The second installment of the WOYO!! Saga— a French turn-based JRPG set in the heart of the Parisian suburbs. Rediscover Montreuil with your team of misfits and take on your terrifying enemies: pigeons, mobsters, barflies, and other shmucks.

details.title: Outliers: Incrementum
details.short_description: An incremental ARPG about rising from a nobody to the most powerful assassin alive. Slash through waves of monsters, collect loot and upgrade your abilities. Get stronger with every run until even bosses become easy targets.

details.title: Manafinder II
details.short_description: The world does not need saving; you do. Mankind has ended, yet the world moved on. Take the role of Rey in this turn-based RPG and fight ferocious beasts and other existential threats alongside a disparate cast of allies as you seek purpose in a world that no longer welcomes you.

details.title: Dream Ocean
details.short_description: Journey across an ocean of strange worlds in a story-driven JRPG. Follow your companions’ stories, combine skills across classes, and lead your party through ATB battles and tactical encounters. Discover hidden dungeons and abilities that change how you fight and explore.

details.title: Snow Panic
details.short_description: An online ski race for up to 8 players armed to the teeth. Blast your friends into the trees with bazookas, call in airstrikes, unleash exploding goats and beat them all to the bottom.

details.title: Sword & Banner
details.short_description: Mount & Blade's campaign meets classic RTS battles, in pixel art. Lead a warband across a fantasy continent at war, raise peasants into knights, trade, and carve out your own faction. Command every soldier in fast, brutal real-time battles and sieges.

details.title: Greda Inferno
details.short_description: A master potter arrives in hell under mysterious circumstances. With your skills, you must craft pieces for the inhabitants of the underworld. Survive, improve your creations, meet your new neighbors, and try to uncover the mysteries of the depths.

details.title: Pizzapocalypse: A Slice of Hope
details.short_description: Use your pizza to bounce, swing and dash in this 3D platformer! Explore different countries, and put a stop to the greedy corporation selling Pizza-in-a-can!

details.title: Cosmo Cargo
details.short_description: Cosmo Cargo is an inventory autobattler roguelike PvE game in which you fight to maintain chaos in the galaxy. Collect and combine items in your ship to gain powerful effects and defeat the Administrators.

details.title: Everbrew
details.short_description: Farm, cook, and design your very own woodland café in Everbrew, a cozy pixel-art management game. Harvest ingredients, craft delicious meals, and welcome woodland creatures as they gather to relax, eat, and feel at home.

details.title: Tower of Creation
details.short_description: Immortality became a curse, so humans chose to return their souls to the Creator. You are the last one left. As you take the same Path as your lost love, you discover that paradise is a lie and that the real mystery has only just begun.

details.title: Lost In Your Eyes
details.short_description: Lost In Your Eyes is a 2 Player co-op Puzzle Adventure game where you and your friend face the challenging puzzles to escape uniquely designed levels together. Communication is a key element for every puzzle to be solved but do you trust your friend or your EYES?

details.title: Crime Scene Clean: Paranormal
details.short_description: Sector 7 hides the supernatural from the world, and you are the crew that erases it. In 1–4 player online co-op, scrub the blood, bag the bodies, wipe cursed sigils and box haunted relics while the victim's ghost listens to every sound you make.

details.title: Beatrix
details.short_description: Beatrix is a dark roguelite card battler set in Dante's Hell. Place tarot cards on a grid and surround enemy cards to flip them to your side. Between battles, you build the board by placing effects on its cells that fire whenever a card lands on them.

details.title: SlashZero
details.short_description: SlashZero is a side-scrolling action roguelike game. As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! Is what you see the truth?

details.title: Less Miserables
details.short_description: A historical comedy adventure game, loosely based on Les Misérables, with classic point-and-click puzzles, hand drawn art and an amazing voice cast.

details.title: PECADO
details.short_description: PECADO is a first-person folkloric horror experience set in the “España profunda”. Listen to the word of God.

details.title: Nightholme
details.short_description: Nightholme is a 12-player, third-person PvEvP extraction horror game. Hunt solo or in duos through an ever-changing city where one encounter can set off a chain reaction. Fight with abilities, not guns. Transform into a monster for devastating power, at the cost of your sanity. How far will you go?

details.title: Love and Bread
details.short_description: Homeless, jobless, and buried in debt, rebuild your life in Moonville. Farm and cook custom meals, juggle your physical and mental needs, work jobs or launch your own business, and win over the town's people and cats along the way.

details.title: A Date with Death 2: REMNANTS
details.short_description: Train, chat, and flirt your way through the Underworld in this romantic story-driven chat simulator. Create your own Grim Reaper, connect with your team through text and video calls, and decide who you are when the past no longer defines you in a sequel to A Date with Death!

details.title: Meowzic Survivor
details.short_description: A rhythm-integrated roguelike that fuses survivor-style gameplay with dynamic music mechanics. Your firepower flows directly from the rhythm, meaning your combat build is also your custom game music. It’s time to conquer the universe with your own rhythmic symphony of destruction!

details.title: Edge of Power
details.short_description: A political sandbox where you become the architect of your state. Change the laws, manage the economy, and change the lives of citizens! Here you write your own history of your own country and the whole world. See how your decisions will affect the course of history!

details.title: Berrus
details.short_description: Berrus is an old-school online RPG. Explore, fight in real time, gather, craft and farm.

details.title: RoboFarm
details.short_description: Build, automate, and decorate your dream farm! Deploy robot workers, unlock powerful upgrades, and watch your crops thrive while you relax, raising profits to your satisfaction. Save and share your creations, tune in with the music, and experience the world of RoboFarm.

details.title: Grim Path
details.short_description: A roguelike card crawler where every step is a choice. Descend into dark dungeons, battle monsters, and face various encounters. Choose your gear wisely to survive and go even deeper.

details.title: Emissary One
details.short_description: Co-op horror (1 to 6+ players). The squad was sent to the next site, but contact was lost. Find them and team up for the current mission. It seems you're not alone here again.

details.title: NERO
details.short_description: Become a chain-smoking, tax-dodging restaurateur on the brink of ruin. Sail blood-churned seas to feed starving killers who demand fine dining. Expand your empire from beach shack to world-class dining, or die trying.

details.title: Linglong Duel
details.short_description: A two-player strategy board game of Chinese craftsmanship. Gather precious materials, build workshops, and outwit your rival as the court’s clock advances. Compete for commissions and imperial patrons. Play solo, share a device, or challenge a friend online.

details.title: Tending
details.short_description: Tending is a cozy game about houseplants. Buy plants, figure out where each one likes to live, water them and watch them grow. Take cuttings to grow even more. Nothing dies, so if a plant is struggling, just move it somewhere better.

details.title: Deliveryman in Zhmurino
details.short_description: Ring once. Leave the box on the doorstep. Go. And don't look back if something is breathing on the stairs. Seven night shifts as a courier in two buildings that change every night, where the residents somehow know your name. Pixel-art rules horror: some mistakes cost money, others your life.

details.title: Quiet Hours
details.short_description: It's 2AM, the truck is loud, your friends are louder, and everybody on this street is a light sleeper. Quiet Hours is online co-op for 1–4 players on a night garbage route, where your real voice is noise the street can hear. Microphone strongly recommended.#

details.title: Zombie Mall Defense
details.short_description: Zombie Mall Defense is a game in which you defend your malls from ever-bigger zombie hoard waves that come from every direction. Expand the map, build and discover new turrets, find new zombie types and destroy their houses...

details.title: The Last Shop Before Kingsfall
details.short_description: Run the last shop on the road to Kingsfall in this cozy first-person medieval shop sim. Stock your shelves, set your prices and outfit the heroes who pass through. They have names. Out there, they can die for good. What you sell them decides who comes back.

details.title: Meet The LeaderSheep
details.short_description: Thousands of sheep. One pen. Grab up to 3 friends who are no help at all and get the flock home before dark. They’ll panic over nothing and happily follow each other off a cliff. So will the sheep. Bring in the most and you’re the LeaderSheep. Nobody said you’d be a good one.

details.title: Klocky
details.short_description: The world moves too fast. Fit gears under the lamp and hear your machine’s first tick. Klocky is a calm clockwork-building game where every tooth drives the next. Follow hand-drawn plans and discover mechanical history and ingenuity through engraving-style illustrated books.

details.title: RIP-OFF
details.short_description: Buy booster packs from Panda, a shady raccoon dealer, and slice them open with one swipe of a knife. Collect, stack, sell and archive 280 pixel-art cards across four series, then upgrade your table until the packs open themselves.

name: Desktop Smash! - Idle Loot & Colony Sim

details.title: Desktop Smash! - Idle Loot & Colony Sim
details.short_description: A tiny guild base keeps running on your taskbar. Your adventurers push the monster horde back and bring home wood, stone and iron. Grow your facilities, set rules for crafting and selling, and the loot sorts itself. Desktop Smash! is base building and automation at the bottom of your screen.

name: Deep Space Dapper Squad: Guiding Stars

details.title: Deep Space Dapper Squad: Guiding Stars
details.short_description: General L. has vanished, Agent, and only YOU can find him. A dapper 1-bit roguelite shmup. Pick from 20+ ships, keep your energy in check, mod your ship mid-run and dive through black holes into ever-deeper space.

details.title: Undead Showdown
details.short_description: 4v4v4v4 zombie survival. Hold your stronghold through ten rounds, gear up from a shared bank, and risk it at the casino. Your first eligible survival death gives you one chance in Limbo. Then the gates open: last squad standing wins.

details.title: Ink Left
details.short_description: You are a stick figure on an unfinished page, abandoned mid-stroke. Draw bridges, ropes, springs and mirrors with the ink the artist left behind — every line obeys real physics. Slip past crossed-out beasts across fading paper. Ink runs out. In the end, you will have to erase part of yourself.

details.title: I, Hurricane
details.short_description: You are the hurricane. Spawn storms across five seas, steer them toward the coast and push them toward 300 mph while humanity promises to act “by 2050.” Or switch sides and defend it: run the hurricane hunters’ base, fly into the eye, forecast the track and issue the warnings.

name: The Last Interview: Into the Furnace

details.title: The Last Interview: Into the Furnace
details.short_description: Read the case files, interrogate the robots, and decide their fate: back to society, or into the furnace. Your verdicts genuinely shape how the city develops — and watch out for the robots who refuse to jump.

details.title: Web Scaping
details.short_description: You are a cursor loose on WikiNet, a living encyclopedia. Crawler bots are hunting you. Click from article to article to reach your target before the swarm indexes you.

details.title: Family Time
details.short_description: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!

details.title: Alt-Tab Legend
details.short_description: An incremental multiboxing game where you run every game at once on one PC. Pull games from blind boxes, pack hardware into a grid case, place plugins on your keyboard, and raise Keysprites to hit keys for you. No game over, just more games every night.

details.title: Honed to Perfection
details.short_description: In Asterra, a young swordsman left with nothing but a debt of one million gold climbs the Ascendancy Tower to challenge the Demon King. Master Fire, Ice, Bio and Thunder in a stylized action RPG with no XP and no levels: every bit of power is earned with gold and chosen by you.

details.title: Crownkeeper
details.short_description: Ride out by day, hire villagers and give them a trade, pay for every wall and tower coin by coin. When dusk falls, portals open on four sides. Hold the line until dawn, rebuild what was lost, and push your settlement outward until the portals themselves fall.

details.title: Iris: The World
details.short_description: A classic free-to-play fantasy MMORPG returns in Q1 2027. Choose Human, Elf or Hybrid, wield the power of the tarot, transform into the monsters you hunt and set out from the fortress of Terminus to recover the shattered Ipinidas Rune.

details.title: Canaanite Falls
details.short_description: Return to your roots and connect with the Levant like never before in Canaanite Falls, a brand new monster-taming RPG and decolonial journey from WaveyGaming Productions.

details.title: Circuit Valley
details.short_description: Grow a thriving valley with a crew of little robots. Play as Pip to tend crops and build workshops, then put your helpers to work hauling harvests and keeping production moving. Turn a handful of apples into a place that hums with life.

details.title: Chip Factory Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run your own semiconductor factory in first person. Process wafers, operate machines, connect conveyor lines, automate production, and ship advanced chips as your factory grows.

details.title: DUNSPIN
details.short_description: Pull the lever. Recruit whatever heroes the reels hand you. Then watch them fight. DUNSPIN is a slot-machine auto-battler roguelike with deckbuilding, where one lucky spin can turn a losing run into a winning one.

details.title: Soul Crypt
details.short_description: Explore cursed crypts in Soul Crypt, a dark fantasy adventure filled with intense combat and terrifying creatures. Face deadly enemies, uncover the secrets of the depths, and fight to survive the darkness.

details.title: The Gigglebone Gang: AlphaBonk Farm
details.short_description: A is for AlphaBonk! Join Farmer Bonk and the Gigglebone Gang for a trip through the alphabet down on the farm — letters, rhymes, real farm photos and a barnyard full of silly games. A fully restored 1995 Headbone Interactive classic.

details.title: Totally Legal Logging
details.short_description: A co-op physics comedy about a crew of dwarves running a totally legal logging business. Fell trees with real physics, feed them to questionable machines, load the truck and get out before the forester arrives. Your friends are also a resource.

details.title: Motorsport Dynasty Manager
details.short_description: Build your team, develop your cars and bikes, and call race strategy from the pit wall. Choose from 70 championships across seven motorsport disciplines, balancing race-day decisions with the work that shapes your next season.

details.title: Frankenstein: Awakening of Horror
details.short_description: Uncover Frankenstein’s dark secret and survive a terrifying Gothic nightmare

details.title: Circuit Ten: Idle Grand Prix
details.short_description: Merge two identical cars into a faster one. Combine cute neon race cars, send them onto the track, and earn prize money every lap to grow your team. Customize your ride with paints, wheels, underglow and nitro flames. Beat your rivals one by one and conquer every circuit in this idle merge racer.

details.title: Dice Must Work
details.short_description: One button. Infinite luck. You’re the newest Luck Operator at Fortunex Corp. Roll dice slot machines, buy and combine dice, upgrade everything, gamble every ticket and pick roguelite badges for bizarre clients. No tutorial needed: just roll.

details.title: Breachpoint
