details.short_description: Plan the route, set the go-codes, kick the door. BREACHPOINT is a top-down pixel-art SWAT tactics game for PC and Mac: a 25-chapter story campaign, a roguelite Operations mode, animal-masked gangsters and a multi-storey map editor. Fully offline single player.

details.title: The Peninsula's Downfall
details.short_description: After a brutal civil war in the 2020s, the nation once called the "Republic of Korea" is finally gone. On the divided peninsula of 2030, lead a nation with a fate of its own: command your divisions, build your economy, and decide whether to return to Seoul's rule or break with the past forever.

details.title: Goblins Go North
details.short_description: A fantasy auto-battler where Goblins raid the Viking North! Recruit and customize goblins, equip them with found loot, build your formation, and watch your horde crush the enemy. Conquer settlements, collect legendary gear, and fight your way to the Jarl’s Hall!

details.title: Leeway: Lightkeeper
details.short_description: The lighthouse has reopened after years, and you are the strait's only watchman. Ships are lining up: read their papers, verify the data, talk over the radio, and decide who gets through. A quiet job in clear weather. Not once the rain starts, and you can't trust your instruments either.

details.title: Greatest President Ever
details.short_description: You are President John D. Morron, and term limits say you have to leave. You have 15 days to collect seven signatures on the amendment that lets you stay. Stamp laws, black out leaked photos, launder cash and lean on politicians while the FBI gets closer.

details.title: Souls of Avelor
details.short_description: Slay monsters as a forgotten soul, gather the Souls they carry and reawaken the silent Portals of Avelor. An idle runner RPG that keeps playing while you're away: upgrade at the Forge, Awaken to grow stronger, collect runes, raise a Skeleton Legion and explore dark-fantasy realms.

details.title: By the Coast
details.short_description: Build a coastal village, then watch it come to life. Watch neighbours settle in, children play, cats wander the streets, and seabirds circle overhead as your little village grows. No goals, no timers, just relaxing creativity.

details.title: Pawlosseum
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelite of duo battles. Climb a 100-floor fighting tower with your elemental siblings: act by speed, boost your strikes, chain combo attacks and play to the crowd. Cheers raise your pay, boos cut it. Every run, a new path from the Pit to the Crown.

details.title: Hard Recall
details.short_description: Los Ceniza, after midnight. Halvorsen's household androids have turned on their owners, and Meridian Mutual pays on every recall. Lead a squad of claims operators, solo or with up to three friends, through rain-soaked neon streets in a twin-stick noir shooter where every block is new.

details.title: Woolfall
details.short_description: A physics sandbox about mining with sheep. Dig a mine, route your flock past glowing caves for finer wool, then flood it, burn it or blow it up. Sheep go poof and drift home. That’s normal. Solo, or co-op with up to three friends to blame.

details.title: Space Industry
details.short_description: Build and automate your own modular space fleet in this sandbox base-building game. Mine asteroids, expand your ship, fight enemies, explore new star systems, and uncover the deepest secrets of the universe.

details.title: Porcelain
details.short_description: Porcelain is a first-person stealth extraction game set in a dark steampunk city. Infiltrate guarded districts, stay hidden, recover mysterious Reveries, and escape before you are caught. No guns. No easy way out.

details.title: Mombasa Conspiracy
details.short_description: Join Connor O'Ryan and his inseparable friend Brian Moloney in a classic Point & Click thriller that will take them from the gloomy streets of Dublin to the sweltering heat of Kenya, where they will become embroiled in a conspiracy hidden in time.

details.title: Where's my order?
details.short_description: Deliver food across town, solo or with friends, in a chaotic world of physics-based vehicles, flying food and ragdolls. The competition is fierce and the police are watching, but customers are hungry and the money won't make itself.

details.title: Raccoon Inc.
details.short_description: Bin Dive is tired of eating from the trash! Help this enterprising raccoon build a business up from flipping junk to a sprawling mega corporation unlike the world has ever seen. Start businesses, upgrade them, hire animals to help you, sit back and watch the money flow in this idler tycoon.

details.title: Conversation Simulator
details.short_description: Conversation Simulator is the practice tool for interviews, negotiations, difficult talks, and language skills. AI characters run entirely on your computer. No internet needed during play. Open source, fairly priced.

details.title: Bandidos em Brasilia
details.short_description: Brazil has fallen. A dictatorship has seized power, and the files that could bring it down are hidden inside an abandoned mansion — with someone inside who doesn't want you to find them.

details.title: Greenrise
details.short_description: Greenrise is a short and cozy incremental game about chopping wood, breaking stones and mining gold to buy upgrades and grow your island.

details.title: Lifers
details.short_description: Life's not so bad on the cell block. A multiplayer hangout game where you talk with friends & strangers, while playing chill card games. Play games, win cigarettes, use cigarettes to buy new gear.

details.title: Folklore War Game
details.short_description: The folklore war. Build a deck, pick a folklore, and settle the fights the legends never had. A roguelike deckbuilder about dying, rebuilding, and one more run.

details.title: Project Poker
details.short_description: Project Poker is a single-player poker experience with smart opponents, memorable personalities, and tons of quality-of-life features. Build your bankroll in Career Mode, master four poker variants, and play your way with game speeds, fast-forward, quick betting, full controller support, and more.

details.title: Zodiac Tale
details.short_description: Zodiac Tale is a roguelite deckbuilder auto-battler where you clear dungeon after dungeon across many worlds. Stronger enemies, a shop that pays interest, side quests: every dungeon adds new rules. Shape your shop to get the zodiac animals you want, and tailor explosive synergies to fit those rules.

details.title: Bureau of Hero Affairs
details.short_description: Bureau of Hero Affairs is a simulation game about processing paperwork in an obsolete office system and digging up what it buried. As a journalist working undercover inside the Bureau, uncover the truth of a disaster twenty years ago. Follow the regulations, or report the truth.

details.title: Floors of Fury
details.short_description: Floors of Fury is a fast-paced 2.5D beat ’em up roguelite. Fight through crowds, slam enemies into walls or each other, collect upgrades, shape your build, and punch your way from the bottom of the company to the top.

details.title: Sudokucide
details.short_description: Experience a new, fast-paced game inspired by Sudoku combined with action reminiscent of late-nights spent in the arcades of the 90s. Sudokucide brings the traditional game into the 21st century with exciting new mechanics and pumps the action up to 11. Face the challenge or commit Sudokucide.

details.title: NightClub Manager Simulator
details.short_description: As the boss, evaluate the proposals that come your way. Manage your nightclub’s reputation. Beat up thieves and put out fires.

details.title: Soul Shine
details.short_description: Prohibition ruined your brewery job. So you started a moonshine business. Expand and automate your empire by harvesting souls, trafficking organs, selling to addicts, and serving strange gods.

details.title: Taskbar Chickens
details.short_description: A cozy desktop companion where chickens live on your taskbar. Breed your chickens to hatch a brand new one with its own unique look, and grow your collection while you work on other stuff on your PC! Plant crops, sell eggs and build a tiny farm that flourishes on top of your taskbar!

details.title: The Last Tenant
details.short_description: The Last Tenant is a short first-person horror game. Explore, find keys, read scattered notes to uncover what happened, and try to escape through tense, atmospheric scares. There is no combat: just you, the dark, and about two hours of dread.

details.title: Gulf Strike
details.short_description: Gulf Strike is a top-down helicopter shooter from 1991. A rogue nation is threatening the oil industry in the middle east! Complete the 6 sandbox campaigns by destroying enemy units while searching for supplies. It's time for another strike in the desert!

details.title: Pull the Lever
details.short_description: Pull the lever, send a tiny train hauling cargo. Click storms and breakdowns mid-run to protect the take. Chase jackpots, hire staff to automate the dull runs, and grow a living model railroad. You won't know the payout until it arrives.

details.title: Nookmaker
details.short_description: You're the new interior designer in a small town. Read your clients' letters, decorate their rooms and discover hidden furniture combos along the way. Then spend what you earn on your own little home, where nobody asks for anything.

details.title: Wreck & Profit
details.short_description: Swing a wrecking ball, knock down buildings, and get paid for every brick. Buy machines that do the swinging for you, sell the company, and take on a bigger city. A short incremental game with real physics & some automation with an actual ending.

details.title: Hollow Sector
details.short_description: A space logistics game that keeps running when you don't. Haul freight, mine the belts, hunt raiders, and smuggle contraband across an abandoned star system. Play full screen, or dock it to the edge of your screen while you work. You don't fly the ships. You run the fleet.

details.title: Circusar
details.short_description: Circusar is an action roguelite where you play a clown battling waves of enemies while balancing on a unicycle. Two core tensions drive the game: physical balance and crowd rating. Build item synergies, entertain the crowd, and don't fall!

details.title: Quackyard
details.short_description: A cozy incremental farming sim about helping your duck friend clean out their backyard. Dig, mine and farm your way to clearing up the space so that a tea party with friends can be hosted.

details.title: Wyrm Warrior
details.short_description: WYRM WARRIOR is a brand new JRPG in retro style. Step into the shoes of a hero fighting for justice in an unfamiliar land! Brave a world full of monsters, bosses, dungeons, NPCs, and loot! Grow stronger through fighting and exploration! Can you defeat THE WYRMLORD?

details.title: Cage Legacy
details.short_description: Build a struggling MMA gym into a title-winning empire. Scout fighters, negotiate contracts, run training camps, survive the drama, balance every dollar, and work the corner live during fully simulated fight nights. A single-player pixel-art management sim.

details.title: Deck Beasts
details.short_description: Creature-collecting auto-battler roguelike. Draft pixel-art beasts, teach them ability cards, gear them with items and relics, then watch your squad fight other players' teams. 100+ beasts, hundreds of abilities and items, billions of builds.

details.title: Popo and the Moonlit Shop
details.short_description: A magical shop simulator where you gather materials with your Popos, craft goods, and keep display stands full while fulfilling your customers' requests. Customise the shop to fit your aesthetic, and travel between worlds to open new branches of your Moonlit Shop!

details.title: Retro Club Manager
details.short_description: Manage your club through fast-paced football seasons in a retro-inspired management simulation. Build your squad, scout the transfer market, manage finances, shape your tactics and experience procedurally generated stories in every career.

details.title: After Green
details.short_description: A survivors-like where you build towers. Suit up in ridiculous outfits, gun down cute zombie hordes, drop turrets in their path, and stack absurd relic-and-tower synergies. Pick your route across a branching map to the Horde King, solo or online co-op. Die, and your Last Wish carries you back.

details.title: Grim Gambit
details.short_description: A card-puzzle roguelite where every card you place on a dungeon grid is a higher-or-lower bet. Guess wrong and part of your board explodes. Poker hands heal you, counting cards is encouraged, and the Grim Reaper runs the table. One standard 52-card deck. Fill the grid. Cheat death.

details.title: Dawn Of The Realm
details.short_description: Dawn Of The Realm is a medieval real-time strategy game. Build cities, manage resources and raise armies. Zoom straight out to a strategy map of the whole continent and back down to the battlefield, with no loading and no separate mode. Up to 10 players.

details.title: Plushie Party
details.short_description: Win mini-games, survive the show, and watch your friends turn into stuffing as you crush their hopes and dreams in this collection of slightly violent party games!

details.title: Dungeon's Gambit
details.short_description: Dungeon’s Gambit is a real-turn chess dungeon crawler that mixes real-time environments with turn-based combat. Customize your pawn, unlock new skills to find powerful synergies, defeat challenging bosses, and fight your way through the Black Castle to take down the Throne.

details.title: Planet INC
details.short_description: Planet-colonizing deckbuilder roguelike! Contract with galactic megacorps for blueprints, drop onto uncharted worlds, and extract maximum profit. Harvest resources from alien terrains and creatures, skyrocket planetary value, and flip the world to the highest bidder!

details.title: Pawnshop Together
details.short_description: Run your own pawn shop solo or with up to 3 friends! Buy, negotiate, inspect, repair, and sell items to build your business and find new ways to make money around town.

name: I Stole My Boss' Boy Toy

details.title: I Stole My Boss' Boy Toy
details.short_description: You find a terrified young man hiding in your apartment hallway. The twist? He just escaped from your sadistic boss. Desperate for college tuition, this brilliant art student was tricked by a shady agency. Now, hide him, protect him and plot your revenge. Your choices dictate his fate!

details.title: Color Factory
details.short_description: Connect nodes to generate, transform, and blend colors in a relaxing factory automation game. Discover new recipes, unlock powerful nodes through research, and design increasingly efficient production networks as your color factory grows.

details.title: TOWN of HIDDEN MURDERS
details.short_description: The tranquility of Peaceville was shattered by a single gunshot. In a back alley, a reporter was found shot and killed. Meanwhile, Detective Song Sun had been investigating a series of murders—but what was the truth he uncovered...?

details.title: Tactical Dungeon Slayers
details.short_description: Slay the Spire-style roguelite deckbuilding meets high-mobility tactical combat and terrain strategy. Find the perfect position to unleash powerful deck combos and AoE attacks, wiping out enemies while avoiding the enemy’s kill zones.

details.title: Filthy Fly: Horde Survivor
details.short_description: A gross-out horde-survivor where you play the pest. Buzz over picnic tables and sewer guts, stack six revolting weapons, evolve them into screen-clearing monstrosities, and outlive the entire insect kingdom. Die, mutate at The Heap, and go again.

details.title: Hotel Stardust
details.short_description: Would you like to win $1,000,000? Survive the night at the Hotel Stardust, capture every anomaly on camera, and the prize is yours. Be careful, some anomalies aren't very friendly.

details.title: A Pile of Tile
details.short_description: A Pile of Tile is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about Loki, a cute little cat who recently graduated from art school and started his first job in a tiles shop. Loki faces multiple challenges in his new job, your goal is to help him make the tiles for customers and keep his job.

details.title: Arithmetrick
details.short_description: Arithmetrick is a math-based deckbuilding roguelite. Arrange operation cards into equation chains — addition,subtraction, multiplication, division — to hit escalating target scores. Collect a permanent deck across runs and mixthree color factions to discover deep card synergies

details.title: Productive Plants
details.short_description: Productive Plants is an idle desktop game about growing and collecting house plants that rewards productivity.

details.title: Armory Doctrine
details.short_description: Armory Doctrine is a real-time grand strategy game where you run a private arms empire and fight your own wars in a modern world sliding toward war. Expand your factory, master the global weapons market, and decide the fate of every shipment: sell it for profit, equip your own forces or arm a proxy.

details.title: RingOut
details.short_description: A 3D arena shooter inspired by Super Smash Bros.: no health bars. Every shot heats enemies up, raising their temperature in degrees (°). The hotter they are, the farther they fly: launch them off the arena to win. 23 fighters, 13 weapons, 29 arenas, 6 modes. Solo vs bots or online.

details.title: OAN
details.short_description: A Vietnamese folk horror in pixel art. Return alone to the abandoned family house for your grandfather's death-anniversary vigil. Light three sticks of incense before dawn, and keep the oil lamp burning. Something folded from paper is already in the house, and it does not want the rite finished.

details.title: Kill The Hero
details.short_description: A Dungeon Builder, Autobattler and Deckbuilder in one. They call themselves “heroes”. You call them gold suppliers. Dig your domain, build deadly traps, place guards and play powerful cards as ever-stronger “heroes” invade your dungeon. Take their gold and build the World Domination Machine.

details.title: Paper Tower: Idle Overlay
details.short_description: A desktop companion idle auto-battler in isometric 3D that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things. Collect your loot, upgrade your tower and defeat endless waves of enemies.

details.title: Ranked Rock Paper Scissors
details.short_description: Win. Rip. Repeat. In this PvP Roguelike Deckbuilder. Face off in 1v1, 2v2, or 4v4 ranked matches and climb your way to the top of the Leaderboard. Show off your card drops in combat, on your profile, or trade them on the Steam Market. Master this battle of bluffs, counters, and calculated risks.

details.title: TIP or RIP
details.short_description: TIP or RIP is a fast-paced action roguelike where you serve hungry monsters before they lose patience and eat you. Dash between tables, throw food, build ridiculous serving abilities, survive three increasingly dangerous restaurants, and feed the final mega-boss.

details.title: Rebirth: Monarch of the Dead
details.short_description: WEBTOON's No. 1 Action Comic, now an Interactive Game! Become the world's strongest Necromancer, but you've lost everyone on your path to power. Now, fate grants you a second chance! Change your destiny and save your loved ones through choices and battles. Rise again as Rebirth: Monarch of the Dead!

details.title: Gravity Trials
details.short_description: Manipulate gravity, move objects, and solve handcrafted physics puzzles in a mysterious sci-fi facility. Discover new mechanics, explore strange environments, uncover secrets, and rethink space, direction, and movement.

details.title: Grow and Tell
details.short_description: Grow a garden, take care of your messenger bird and send anonymous letters to real people. Grow and Tell is an online incremental game that lives on your Windows desktop.

details.title: Pixel Sorter Factory
details.short_description: First day at the factory: extract pixels, sort them, sell them. Then let the machines take over, until the factory runs itself. A blend of clicker, incremental gameplay, and pixel art… with a touch of mystery: where do all those pixels go?

details.title: Tillow
details.short_description: Tillow is a cozy isometric farm builder that keeps working while you do. Lay out fields, keep animals, make your own wine or distil grappa, and let your workers take over. Docked as a narrow bar at the edge of your screen, it keeps you company while you do other things. No losing, no timers.

details.title: Tales of Weak People
details.short_description: The centennial ritual failed, trapping the United Army inside the Cataclysm. A dark visual novel with Point & Click elements. Explore locations and unite with survivors, gather clues, and make choices to forge a path to the epicenter through madness and death.

details.title: Shred Inc.
details.short_description: Welcome to the NSA — the National Shredding Agency. Your job: destroy classified files, one sheet at a time. Feed the shredder, hit your quota, climb the ranks. And whatever you do, don't read the paperwork. Some files were just meant to be destroyed.

details.title: Nephele
details.short_description: You are the first eukaryote of Nephele! You have nothing but wisdom! Use your wisdom, to survive in such a cell-eat-cell world, and construct your cell civilization!

details.title: Cyber Sweeper
details.short_description: A top-down action survivor set in cyberspace. Sweep virus swarms, stack explosive builds, and clear sector after sector as a firewall defense program.

details.title: SCRAP CROWN
details.short_description: In the junkyard arena, the winner rips the weapons off the loser. Bolt a hammer to a fridge and a rifle to a microwave, beat the scrap gangs one by one, rebuild your crew from what you take and climb to the Scrap King's crown. A voxel roguelite auto-battler.

details.title: Deadgate
details.short_description: Bir sözleşme al ve zombilerin istila ettiği karantina altındaki adaya gir. Ganimet topla, rakip takımlara karşı hayatta kal ve gece yarısından önce tahliye noktasına ulaş. Aksi takdirde yanında getirdiğin her şeyi kaybedersin. 32 oyunculu bir extraction shooter. Sözleşme yoksa çıkış da yok.

details.title: MEGAWATT
details.short_description: The electric roguelike. MEGAWATT is a deckbuilder where you wire up reckless machines, let a single spark loose, and chase outrageous power surges before the city goes dark. Then take the time machine back to 1871.

details.title: Not a Bug: Idle Defense
details.short_description: Not a Bug is a relaxing incremental idle defense game. You can’t lose, since every bug dies the moment it reaches the glitch. Install apps, feed the bugs and watch the chaos. Remember: it’s not a bug, it’s a feature.

details.title: Domino Tinkerer
details.short_description: Become a domino tinkerer in a physics-based sandbox! Fly through rooms, deploy gadgets like cannons and funnels, and trigger chain reactions to clear every checkpoint. Build the ultimate domino machine solo or team up with up to 4 friends online!

details.title: Motor Park Architect
details.short_description: Build and manage the motorsport park of your dreams. Choose from a variety of racing categories, manage your staff, and create a world-class motorsport destination hosting a wide range of competitions. Take on the fastest drivers from different championships and beat their lap records.

details.title: CTRL Chaos
details.short_description: 15 singleplayer minigames. Different rules. Total chaos. Blast hooligans with a water cannon, fight space swarms, solve cargo puzzles, build a tower, or grow a garden. Pick your next challenge or play a series.

details.title: Floor Show: Game Show Roguelike
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelike on a live TV game show. You are the contestant. Push rivals into spikes, lava and barrels to earn hype, your XP. Take sponsor deals, and face returning rivals made from whatever killed you last time.

details.title: The Gigglebone Gang: Pantsylvania
details.short_description: The Gigglebone Gang returns! In Pantsylvania, everybody's pants are serious business. Join the Gigglebone Gang across ten locales and 50 activities — sing-along songs, hidden-object hunts, silly science and interactive stories — in this fully restored 1995 point-and-click edutainment classic.

details.title: Spiral Scramble
details.short_description: A co-op obstacle course for you and your friends. Work your way around a spiral of creatures, traps and hazards to reach the center together. One touch knocks you down, and only a teammate can pick you back up. If everyone goes down at once, it's back to the start.

details.title: City Safety
details.short_description: City Safety is a game about taking your city back from the mass surveillance that has infected every street corner. Join your friends in riding around the city, wreaking havoc, and challenging authority.

details.title: The Last Warden
details.short_description: You are the last guardian of a city in a medieval post-apocalyptic world. An unknown plague has spread across the world, and every day is now a struggle for survival. Decide who may pass through the gates — and who must face the final sentence.

details.title: BOSSA BURGER
details.short_description: A burger-building roguelite where every ingredient plays a part in the song. Toast, squeeze, stack and foil-wrap to a bossa nova groove. The better you know your recipes, the stronger you get: beat 16 days of sales targets and HQ inspections.

details.title: Unextinct
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic online evolution game. Wake up as a cloned microbe at the bottom of a drowned world and evolve into a virus, a predator or something new. 180+ evolution paths, 90+ locations, riddle quests and real-time PvP with other players.

details.title: Arcana Autonoma: Fourteen Races
details.short_description: Twenty years after the War of Unification, Setsuna, daughter of the sky battleship's captain, descends to a land of fourteen races torn by blockades. Recruit the foes you beat, raise five cards and send them into auto battles - then decide where, and for whom, to spend your few skip tickets.

details.title: Flight Deck: Pacific 1942
details.short_description: Command a WWII carrier task force in real time. Find the enemy first, arm and launch your squadrons, plot their attack runs and survive the counterstrike. Fight six battles of 1942 by day and by night, design warships in the shipyard, share maps on the Steam Workshop and battle friends online.

details.title: Throw Weight: Fleet Doctrine
details.short_description: Hard sci-fi fleet command. No shields, no lasers — just missiles, point defense and electronic warfare.

details.title: ASHENSHIFT: Desktop RPG
details.short_description: ASHENSHIFT is a pixel-art RPG that lives on your desktop. Three heroes fight in a slim transparent window above the taskbar while you work. Talents, gear, the forge and a rule for every ability are yours to set. Enemies wind up in plain sight: break the cast or raise a shield.

details.title: Cubies
details.short_description: Find and collect Cubies in this cube-sized 3D puzzle-platformer!

details.title: Residential Phenomena Hotline
details.short_description: You're the night agent at a paranormal support hotline service. Callers contact you when something goes wrong in their homes and send photos, videos, and voice notes. Question them, search the company files, find what doesn't belong, and tell them what to do. Get it wrong, and face the consequences.

details.title: That's a lot of Zombies
details.short_description: Rain hell from an AC-130 as millions of zombies climb over each other to reach your squad’s rooftop. Deploy sentry guns, flamethrowers and claymores before each night. Call in A-10s, B-52s and every bit of firepower you can get. Hold the roof until the rescue helicopter lands.

details.title: Clash Pandemic: Forest Hell
details.short_description: You’re stuck in a gigantic forest. Chop wood, explore lost buildings, upgrade your swinging weapons, and spin your way through waves of zombies to a boss. Play alone or bring friends. Lots of blood. Much gore. Try not to die.

details.title: Foilage TCG : Collectors Edition
details.short_description: Foilage TCG: Collectors Edition is a single player fantasy trading card game. Build your ultimate deck, open booster packs, trade on the market, and hunt for rare Foil Refractors to take on your opponents. Collect and build your ultimate collection to load your binder and hard cases.

details.title: MimiCreate
details.short_description: Even aliens have exams! In MimiCreate, Mimics must learn to hide among humans before earning a license to visit Earth. Build disguises, blend in, and dodge the Inspectors in chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek.

details.title: SPATHA
details.short_description: A side-scrolling shooter flown from the cockpit. Read what's ahead through the canopy, the terrain in the side view and the lanes in the top view — all three on screen at once. Harvest magic stones from alien beasts, buy the weapons you want, and dive into seven worlds the Ordo turned into nests.

details.title: Arrowhead
details.short_description: ArrowHead is a single-player bullet hell game… where getting hit is the only way to hit back. Rotate around the battlefield to ensure that you get your fill of arrows to shoot back. Slo-mo dash to squash your way through enemies!

details.title: Jin Gambit
details.short_description: Your formation shapes the battle. JIN GAMBIT is a single-player roguelite auto battler where you position and merge units, then watch your strategy play out in automatic combat. Build on your formation with heroes, artifacts, training, and awakening as your expedition progresses.

name: 亲吻那片花瓣：米迦勒的少女们

details.title: 亲吻那片花瓣：米迦勒的少女们
details.short_description: 承接著名的《亲吻那片花瓣》系列作品，《米迦勒的少女们》在原有剧情基础上拓展了各位少女们的故事——这些情节跨越了数月时光，描绘了她们生活中的种种磨难。在少女们不断成长并相互扶持的过程中，百合终将绽放。

details.title: LFG Battles
details.short_description: Async PVP auto battler where you build a party of heroes and gear them up to fight other players. Craft synergizing combinations as you try to break the game with your build! Dominate the ranked leaderboard or explore absurd combos at your own pace in casual mode.

details.title: sons of infinite dawn
details.short_description: A medieval grand strategy game in a living, fair world. Play in real time with pause or turn based as every nation follows the same rules and adapts to changing needs. Choose your own path, see the consequences clearly, and uncover deeper strategy with every campaign.

details.title: Heidentor
details.short_description: Fantasy PvE/PvP MMORPG build around classic player based economy and gear based progression systems

details.title: Blind & Seek
details.short_description: The seeker is blind — they hunt by sound. Every footstep, every thrown stone and every word you say on the mic lights up their world for a moment. Stay quiet, sabotage your friends, and make sure you're not the one wearing the blindfold when time runs out.

details.title: Novaris
details.short_description: Divert all power to fun! Mothership brings tabletop fleet management, strategy, and thrilling combat into a seamless digital experience. Control a fleet of ships and charge through the galaxy, capturing planets, building defenses, and amassing powerful technologies.

details.title: Eternal Xiuzhen
details.short_description: This is a cultivation game! Play as a cultivator, hunt demon beasts, collect resources, and roam the cultivation world! With a unique battlefield size-changing mechanic, from small demons to colossal beasts, feel the thrill of hunting!

details.title: Incremental Raccoon Shooter
details.short_description: Merge powerful guns, ride unique pets, and unlock 300+ Skill Tree nodes in this chaotic incremental action game!

details.title: Ruleocard
details.short_description: Ruleocard is a story-driven logic puzzle game where cards become the rules of the world. Stranded on an island with no memory, arrange your cards, run them, fail and rearrange. Solve 260+ puzzles, master 15 systems, face unexpected events and make choices that change the story.

details.title: King of Highways
details.short_description: Race, ram and wreck your way across sixteen Malaysian cities after dark. You owe Along, the loan shark. Beat his seven drivers for their pink slips, cause million-ringgit pile-ups and burn nitro all the way to the summit of Kinabalu, where he waits.

details.title: Arid Frontiers
details.short_description: Build a frontier colony in this single-player survival sim. Assign settler duties, grow food, craft gear, manage weather and wildlife, research new skills, and explore a dangerous wilderness through expeditions, quests, and emergent stories.

details.title: The Black Below
details.short_description: Classic grid-based dungeon crawling, rebuilt: a 3D dungeon reduced to stylized one-bit art, a score synthesized live, automapping, skill trees, and a party whose dead stay on the roster. Under a city that lives off a hole in the ground, something is sleeping, and nobody agrees on what it is.

details.title: Polybarius
details.short_description: NEW from UMBRIA ELECTRONICA! The arcade sensation of 1981, now in your own home! Eight thrilling chapters, one mighty boss and a high score table just waiting for your initials. Each coin is one life. Maximum 3 credits per player. POLY was waiting for you.

details.title: Convoy Inc.
details.short_description: Build a freight empire on a watercolor-style map of the real world. Start in 1980, 2000 or 2030 with one truck and one driver, take jobs across 207 countries, weather storms, rivals and tired drivers, and grow a fleet where every risk is visible before you take it.

details.title: REISIR0b: PIZZA RUN
details.short_description: 🍕A fast-paced 2D Metroidvania about an elite combat android mercenary who shoots, tears across land, space, and water, opens boxes with random upgrades, and takes on the craziest job in the galaxy — ALL FOR PIZZA.

details.title: Games Mag Tycoon
details.short_description: You used to read the magazines. Now you make one: run your own games magazine from 1986 to 2010. Reviews, covers, cover discs, video, tips & tricks and an editorial team with moods. The deadline is ticking, and every month your readers tell you whether it was good enough.

details.title: SAIJAN: Dice Mahjong
details.short_description: A dice mahjong roguelite for riichi players. Roll tile dice, place Melds, stack Charms and send Fu × Han soaring. 22 Yaku from Riichi to Big Three Dragons, plus 10 SAIJAN Yaku for columns, diagonals and Pip totals. Beat every Boss to complete a 15–20 minute run. 2–4 player co-op with Steam friends.

details.title: Ash Company
details.short_description: A command-and-management game about running a mercenary company. Hire mercs, fit their gear, mark routes on the op map and send them into the ruins. During an op, the only way to intervene is by radio. Loot carried out by the squad pays wages and grows the base.

details.title: Bricked
details.short_description: Bricked is a city-building sandbox set on a tabletop above the clouds. Build a toy-brick city piece by piece, set kaiju, mechs and armies against each other, and watch every strike tear it apart. Put every brick back with one click, then fly, drive and ride through the city you made.

details.title: Last Embers : Fire Hero
details.short_description: Grab the hose, rookie. The city is on fire! Drown roaring flames, rescue a city full of characters, spend your coins on 90+ upgrades and race across town to answer every call... but something is lurking deep in the flames.

details.title: Sandgrave
details.short_description: Rise, Captain! Sandgrave is a pixel-art, top-down sandbox about big flying ships, real-time fleet combat and life between trading and fighting pirates across the vast desert! Design your vessel, fight by boarding, broadsides or bombardment! Play solo or in an online open world!

details.title: Night Shift: Grandma's Rules
details.short_description: You are the last night guard at a closed Thai hospital. Follow your grandmother's rules, solve what each night leaves behind, and find out why the building is still counting its dead.

name: Ah Sheep, Here We Go Again

details.title: Ah Sheep, Here We Go Again
details.short_description: An incremental game about a hungry flock that eats straight through the Earth, all the way to New Zealand. Sweep your cursor over the sheep and they bite the ground beneath them. Grow the flock, hire dogs and shepherds, and keep going down.

details.title: You Can’t Clock Out
details.short_description: You dozed off at your desk. Now your coworkers have horses’ heads. You Can’t Clock Out is a first-person horror game about escaping an office gone terribly wrong. Gather clues, solve puzzles, and follow company rules as you make your way downstairs. Don’t let your coworkers catch you.

details.title: Vector Rush
details.short_description: Sink into space and music in this neon sci-fi twin-stick shooter. Blast through swarms of vector enemies, take down the giants guarding each world, grow stronger with every run, and escape a collapsing star system.

details.title: Feudal Fall
details.short_description: The king burned your village to the ground. Raise your capital on its ashes, keep your people alive through the winters and muster armies hundreds strong. Bring down the lords of the feudal pyramid one by one, then lay siege to the king's own city. A real-time city builder and siege strategy game.

details.title: Arcane Reckoning
details.short_description: Skill-shot wizard battles for up to 12 players. Aim every spell by hand, knock rivals into lava and the void, and survive arenas guarded by ancient bosses. Free-for-all or 2–4 teams, a spell shop between rounds, and bots that fill every empty slot.

details.title: Neon Turf: Cyberpunk Auto-Battler
details.short_description: A cyberpunk auto-battler where you buy buildings, not units. Build noodle bars, clubs and clinics. They earn cash each round, and some send fighters to battle rival gangs. Buying the same building multiple times levels it up. Clubs draw police attention, which results in police raids on your base.

details.title: A Sheet-ton of Bingo
details.short_description: Fill one whole bingo sheet out of a thousand before the old regular across the hall yells BINGO. Call numbers, dab squares and buy auto-daubers in this incremental race to find the bingo in a sheet haystack. He has been doing this for decades. You have no idea how good he is.

details.title: Aldorian Saga:Farming Hero
details.short_description: You are the last survivor of the royal family, and the power the goddess gave you is... just farming? But you won't give up! Sell crops for gold, open up mines and forests to craft trade goods, brave dangerous trade routes, and earn the funds and raise the army to take your kingdom back!

details.title: Windwhisper Saga
details.short_description: Set out from Windbell as an adventurer in a pixel-art, side-scrolling action RPG. Explore dungeons, face bosses, and craft gear from the materials you bring home. Get to know the locals along the way, or take on a Demon Pact when you’re ready to risk more for better loot.

details.title: RE: Rags to Royalties
details.short_description: Build a web-novel empire in this incremental management game set in 2004. Tap, upgrade and unleash FEVER; win readers, sign contracts and run a busy studio. With AI-assisted creation, turn your own ideas into a novel you can actually read. Your cat is already on the keyboard.

details.title: Your Lovely Legs
details.short_description: Pinch the stocking, pull, let go: it snaps back with a slap. A game about legs and stockings and nothing else: touch them, tear them, get them wet. Dozens of stockings and five pairs of shoes in the wardrobe, a water gun and a camera at hand. She gets shy, she says ouch, and slowly warms to you.

details.title: Tick or Kick!
details.short_description: Grab them by the leg, check their ticket and throw the freeloaders off the bus. Or ride for free, blend into the crowd and blame someone else. A physics party game about tickets, chaos and flying passengers, for up to 16 friends.

details.title: GIGALANCE
details.short_description: Build a planet-shattering beam cannon from scratch. Combine reactors, accelerators, and cooling systems to unleash devastating firepower. But push too far, and your own weapon could melt or tear itself apart. Design, rebuild, and fire your ultimate creation to save Earth.

details.title: Corner Club
details.short_description: A tiny pixel nightclub living in the corner of your desktop. Put on any music and the dancers move on its beat!

details.title: The Atomic Mage
details.short_description: Mix hundreds of unique spells into thousands of wild builds! Mod wands and guns, link auto-casting crystals into chain reactions, and defend walls from tanks, jets and steel giants in a side-view defense Roguelite. Reunite with old friends and uncover a reborn Earthling's secrets across two worlds.

details.title: Idle Fish: Aquarium Legends
details.short_description: Build your own pixel aquarium! Open chests, collect rare fish, feed them to grow, and combine three into a higher rarity. Sell fish for pearls, decorate your tank, and assemble a team of three for automatic battles. Your next legendary discovery awaits.

details.title: Strawbie
details.short_description: They took the wrong cow's best friend. You're Strawbie, and a truck took Mallow in the night. Go after it by plane, by boat, by farmer - you're the engine of every one. Learn a trick from every animal you help, wreck what people left behind, and topple machines as tall as the sky.

name: You Don't Have to Be a Hero!

details.title: You Don't Have to Be a Hero!
details.short_description: A cozy raising sim inspired by Princess Maker. As homeroom teacher, spend three years beside one student at Sebit Academy: plan her weeks, share small everyday moments, and help her find a future of her own. She doesn't have to be a hero.

details.title: Find The Clover
details.short_description: Sweep a meadow of a million clovers. Upgrade your cursor, send bees and robots to harvest, catch leprechauns and hunt for the legendary rainbow clover.

details.title: Smash Arena
details.short_description: An online party game for up to 12 players: brick-built toys clash in wild, physics-driven challenges. Run, jump, shove, survive the glass bridge and Red Light… and climb onto the podium. Dress up your toy and challenge your friends!

details.title: GALLOP
details.short_description: Ride, explore and puzzle your way across a wild medieval land with your friends. Reach the far-off castle, rescue the queen and return her to the king – past bandit ambushes, untamed nature and the occasional friendly shove off a cliff.

details.title: Oath of the Huan
details.short_description: 100,000+ simulated soldiers on screen: Take the reins as the Son of Heaven in this massive stylized RTS with visuals inspired by Chinese traditional paintings and groundbreaking real time simulation. Titans, cataclysmic world-shattering events.

details.title: Prank Panda: Zoo Simulator
details.short_description: You are the zoo's worst-behaved panda. Prank visitors, raid food stands, outsmart the guard, and turn every enclosure into chaos — one mischievous mission at a time. A first-person comedy sandbox where being bad feels SO good.

name: 精灵星球：任务栏大冒险

details.title: 精灵星球：任务栏大冒险
details.short_description: Your desktop is now a tiny planet. MONOVA is a cozy auto-battler ARPG about collecting adorable creatures, building a trio of battlers, and hunting game-changing loot — all while your pets live right on your taskbar.

details.title: Scrap Flood
details.short_description: Thousands of robots flow across the map like water and crash against your turrets. Lost? Collect the scrap, upgrade and come back stronger. Blow up barrels, drop cliffs on the horde, repair old turrets mid-battle and turn the steel flood into scrap.

details.title: Into Ember Depths
details.short_description: A free online bullet-hell RPG where everyone shares one island. Its 41 bosses are built for groups, so whoever is nearby can jump in. When a hero dies, it is gone for good, and the foe that killed them may take their name. Below the island, the Descent has no bottom.

details.title: Piston & Co.
details.short_description: You spent years at someone else's bench. Now the sign carries your name. Diagnose the fault, choose the part, look the customer in the eye — then buy wrecks, hire a crew, build a plant and put your marque on the tank. No interest, no gambling: honest trade wins.

details.title: Incremon Story
details.short_description: A monster-battling incremental with a story and lots of humor. Hatch your monster, watch it evolve, catch new creatures and take on bosses that don't play fair. Saving the world is the easy part. Getting your mom to stop calling is another story.

details.title: Karanan: Gravebound
details.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based dungeon crawler where you descend beneath a cursed church, solve crypt puzzles, and survive brutal boss fights. Recruit optional companions, uncover hidden lore, and rebuild a forgotten graveyard to choose your own ending.

details.title: The Greedy Mimic
details.short_description: You are the chest. Heroes raid the dungeon, you eat them and keep their gold. Buy upgrades mid-run from 150 skills in 10 trees, set traps, summon minions and survive a threat that grows every minute. Die, ascend, get greedier.

details.title: Toyworks
details.short_description: A cosy first-person incremental about building a toy workshop that works for you. Drop shapes into funnels, catch the coins, and automate toy production with belts, arms and assemblers. Fill orders, unlock new rooms, and discover where your toys go.

details.title: Struggle of Empires
details.short_description: Write your orders, wait for the turn, then open your realm's newspaper to find out who betrayed whom. A play-by-email empire game in the old style: rule a fantasy realm, a steampunk power (1750 to 1914) or a real people from 5000 BC to today, against friends, strangers or the computer.

details.title: Sheep Siege
details.short_description: Humans betrayed the kingdom of rams. Now their cities are coming down. Catapult rams into battle. They hit the ground running, tearing through city streets. Raise a siege flock and take the war to humanity.

details.title: Fountain Finds
details.short_description: An incremental game about a forgotten garden whose fountains are buried under coins. Push them with a scraper, gather them with a magnet and a scoop, wash and melt them down, spend the take on better tools and bring the water back.

details.title: Generations Of Steel
details.short_description: The PvE and PvP Tank Battle game from WW1 to 1941. Fight in 30v30 battles over objectives and a career mode that you can customize yourself.

details.title: Popscraper
details.short_description: Pop one million balloons in a cartoon first-person incremental shooter. Ride the elevator up the tower as every floor holds ten times more, turn confetti into silly weapons and idle machines, and pop the King Balloon on each floor to reach the top.

details.title: Mortis Survivors: Blood Arena
details.short_description: Dark-Fantasy Horde Survivor & Action Roguelite: Conquer 6 fortress arenas, unlock 6 champions, evolve weapons into Mythic forms and Divine or Demonic fusions, forge 64 artifacts & 6 gear sets — solo or in 1–4 player Online & Local Co-op!

details.title: Cannonade
details.short_description: A stylized Napoleonic RTS: smoke, violins and blood. Micromanage everything or delegate to your trusted lieutenants. React and battle against an adaptive and smart AI opponent in multiple challenging campaigns.

details.title: Forged in Formation
details.short_description: Round up the scattered rebels of '98 on a Crown-held Caribbean island and lead them out past redcoat volleys, charging boars, alligators and one very angry gaoler. One button snaps your crowd into Column, Line or Square. Pick the right shape in time and the danger walks straight past you.

details.title: PaperKrieg
details.short_description: A real-time strategy game of paper soldiers and fantasy. Build brigades, arm them from your city, and choose formations that counter the enemy. Overwhelm them with trains, balloons, dragons, or tanks. Seize key points on the map, or hold out in endless defense against a paper horde.

details.title: Battle for Noalea
details.short_description: Battle for Noalea is a turn-based fantasy wargame for two players. Lead one of four factions and its hero, seize settlements and outmaneuver your rival in battles without dice and without hidden information. Play against real people online via Steam or in hotseat mode on one screen.

details.title: Trust Me, It's a Shortcut!
details.short_description: Buy a wreck in the Maun bazaar and drive it round the Kalahari for ten days with up to three friends. No GPS, a blank paper map, a budget that buys nothing good, and a friendly local who keeps saying: trust me, it's a shortcut.

details.title: Pinball Boss Quest
details.short_description: Pinball meets block breaker in a pixel-art fantasy quest. Bat the ball through minion waves, smash breakables and topple ten legendary bosses as a Sword, Bow, Javelin, Mage or Summoner, solo or in local co-op where you team up on the boss but compete for the top score.

details.title: OVERPULSE
details.short_description: OVERPULSE is a fast-paced neon roguelite shooter built around intense 20-minute runs. Choose a weapon, stack upgrades, unlock its Overpulse, and survive escalating swarms, minibosses, and a final boss as your build grows from simple to screen-filling chaos.

details.title: BoBOTs
details.short_description: BOUNCE against your friends in this frantic 4 player physics party game! Choose your Bobot and PUSH your way to victory in different chaotic game modes. Dominate the toybox and RULE THE WORLD! Or the couch ;)

details.title: The Cinderling
details.short_description: Run a rhythm-based forge and become a legendary blacksmith! Craft magical items to the music, serve quirky Nordic folklore creatures, and solve the mystery of the lost valley to break the Cinderling curse.

details.title: Super Empire
details.short_description: Build a supermarket from a corner store to a hypermarket. Stock shelves that really empty, staff real shifts, price against rival stores, and keep every shopper happy, from dawn delivery to closing time, through every season.

details.title: Cleared for Profit: Airline Management
details.short_description: Run an airline in one evening. Open routes across North America, set every fare and buy or lease every aircraft, then watch the month play out. Every number explains itself, Corvane Air fights back, and you can go broke. Buy once, no timers.

details.title: Cinema Together
details.short_description: Run a small neighborhood cinema with your friends. Sell tickets, pop the popcorn, keep the 3D and 4D halls running. Then rewrite a script next door, shoot your own movie, and screen it in your own theater. A PS1-style first-person cinema sim for up to 4 players.

details.title: Send More Squires
details.short_description: The King has been captured by another kingdom, and every letter ends the same way: "Send more squires." Train your squires, conquer region after region in an endless march, gather loot to grow your kingdom, and rescue His Majesty!

details.title: Matter of State
details.short_description: Boil, freeze, melt and condense matter on its way across small island boards, in as few parts as you can. 184 puzzles, a new one every day, and a level editor with Workshop sharing.

details.title: Revive The Beast
details.short_description: A short story-based active incremental game where you reanimate animals by drawing inscription patterns. Learn about the tragic past of the necromancer and become powerful once again.

details.title: CRUSHMINO
details.short_description: Crushmino combines roguelite and falling-block gameplay. Drop blocks to crush your enemies, then claim rewards to craft your own build. Keep your balance so the stack never reaches the top. Tricky enemies and trials await.

details.title: Dirty Kicker - A Foosball Game
details.short_description: Fast-paced arcade table football built around razor-sharp precision, tight angles, hard shots, and split-second reactions. Master manual rod control, thread lethal bank shots, and make reflex saves. Conquer solo tournament brackets with tactical upgrades or duel head-to-head in 1v1.

details.title: Archivist
details.short_description: You are the only clerk in an underground archive. The man at the counter describes a killer, and you find their file among the shelves. Get it wrong and someone dies. Behind the back door, something hungry is waiting, and the only thing it eats is files. No one has ever retired from this archive.

details.title: motor party
details.short_description: Customize your favorite ride and tear through mountain trails and open fields. Go wild in the arena, challenge friends or ride solo across a variety of game modes!

details.title: The King's Clerk
details.short_description: The King's laws are short, vague and badly written. As his Clerk for one year, you decide what they mean, and the whole kingdom reads your rulings very closely, looking for the loopholes you didn't mean to leave.

details.title: Bayani: Auto Ascent
details.short_description: A naked hero. A ten-floor tower. A Rival who drafts from the same cards you do. Build your hero piece by piece - gear, spells and fighting techniques - and watch the fights play out automatically. Take the card they need, or the card you need? At the top, you duel to the death.

details.title: CatCat Panic
details.short_description: CatCat Panic is a chaotic online party game for 3–4 players! Pick your cat and battle your friends in 14 crazy mini-games: rob Nazif’s house, escape the vacuum monster, hop on your skateboard and race. Only one cat takes the crown!

details.title: Royal Escort: Idle Battles
details.short_description: Escort your king on an epic journey to reclaim his kingdom! Upgrade and strengthen your army in this idle auto-battler. Recruit soldiers, discover powerful skills, collect valuable loot, and craft powerful equipment as you battle your way through a realm filled with danger.

details.title: Pay Up, Piggy
details.short_description: You're the kid who owes Finn the loan shark. Smash piggy banks, stack the coins and pay the Boss's weekly cut, or you're done. Upgrade your hammer, call in Favors, survive the Showdowns and climb Port Penny's mob.

details.title: Shaft Nine
details.short_description: Work the shift. Meet the quota. Go a little deeper. A 2D pixel art mining game about a job that gets stranger the further down you go: less automation, more discovery, and secrets that don't stay underground.

details.title: Mad Racer
details.short_description: Hit the gas and tear through the wasteland in this top-down incremental roguelite about a rusty car, a tiny fuel tank and a growing horde of raiders. Wreck, loot, upgrade your ride and climb all 18 wanted levels!

details.title: Consume p/pixelplace
details.short_description: Hack a fully simulated pixel canvas. Build your botnet, spread the Void, and watch fictional communities fight, rebuild, and complain on Pixxit. A single-player incremental game with active and Idle modes, territorial drama, and far too many crabs.

details.title: Necrowake: Bone Legion
details.short_description: Lead an undead army through waves of enemies in this action roguelite. Recruit elite minions, choose your formation, and combine equipment skills to build your legion. Pick your next battle through portals, defeat bosses, and spend your shards to grow stronger.

details.title: Idle Pop
details.short_description: A cozy balloon idler that lives on your desktop. Poppie bops along to your pops and typing. Try popping with crazy toys, unleashing multipliers and combos; play carnival minigames; climb 14 skies to Outer Space; and collect tradable Balloon Pals.

details.title: Doomsbell
details.short_description: An auto battler where every protocol plays by its own rules and your Commander fights beside your army. Choose your road through wagers, stories and bosses, merge and fit out your machines, then outbuild other players' armies, one turn at a time.

details.title: Coffinmaker
details.short_description: Inherit Velvet & Pine, a little coffin shop that has secretly served vampires for sixty years. Greet the night's customers, work out who casts no reflection, and build bespoke coffins by hand for the undead.

details.title: Ium Idle Companions Odyssey
details.short_description: Monster-collecting auto-battler desktop companion. Assemble, customize, strategize elemental synergies, craft powerful skill loadouts, and conquer regions as your squad fights autonomously in fast-paced real-time combat at the edge of your screen while you work, study, or play.

details.title: Aquarium Naturalist
details.short_description: An aquarium sim built in Unreal Engine 5 where equipment, feeding, and water chemistry interact like they do in real life. Hardy fish are as forgiving as the real thing; delicate ones demand real care. Crossbreed new morphs, or selectively breed delicate lines to handle tougher water.

details.title: SUNK COST
details.short_description: A co-op horror game for up to 6 players about ships that went missing in the Bermuda Triangle. Board them with your friends, carry out everything worth money, and pay the people who let you in before they decide you know too much.

details.title: KingG_RL
details.short_description: A fast-paced first-person action RPG with short, replayable runs, procedural levels and RNG-driven loot. Play with a random or fixed seed, adapt your build to the items you find, upgrade your gear and develop your own playstyle.

details.title: Slavic Legends
details.short_description: Build and manage your own underground dungeon, command creatures from Slavic mythology, prepare your defenses and survive relentless enemy invasions. Train, fight, explore secret rooms and even possess your creatures to join the battle yourself.

details.title: Curling Simulator
details.short_description: Call the shot, find your weight, and sweep it home. Take on AI opponents or play with friends online. Shape each delivery with mouse or controller, build an end with tactical shots, and watch your best moments again with saved replays.

details.title: Queen's Pact
details.short_description: A dark roguelite autobattler card game. Sacrifice, merge and scale your cards into loops that should not be allowed. You build. They fight. She judges. The Queen is not easily impressed. Break her game anyway.

details.title: Lord Of The Ants
details.short_description: Dig the rock. Raise the walls. Make the swarm walk your road into your guns. Lord Of The Ants is a top-down ant tower defense with rerouting enemy path mechanics. Boss fights, builds, active/passive skills and more.

details.title: Odd Rock Out
details.short_description: You're locked out, and your spare key is inside a fake pebble somewhere among 5,000 real ones. Pick them up, shake them by your ear and listen for the one that rattles. A short, quiet game about patience: no upgrades, no countdown. Solo or with up to four friends.

details.title: HELLFIGHTERS
details.short_description: A physics-driven co-op game for 4 players about goose firefighters tied together by one fire hose. On the way from a burning city down to Hell, stack into a wobbly tower, fly over pits on extinguisher recoil and haul your friends back up. But if one goose slips, everyone falls...

details.title: Scent of You
details.short_description: Inherit a quiet little perfume shop and blend scents for customers who can't quite say what they're looking for. Listen for what slips out, open their drawer of keepsakes and bottle a memory in three notes. No wrong answers — but everyone has one thing they'll never accept.

details.title: Depot Nine
details.short_description: Lead a squad of survivors on tactical extraction raids. Search the ruins, fight for every crate and make it to the exit, because the gear you lose out there stays lost. Build up your base, rescue the missing and find out what really happened at Depot 9.

name: Order Filled: A Trading Desk Story

details.title: Order Filled: A Trading Desk Story
details.short_description: A stock trading sim with a story mode and a free mode. Story mode: you start as a new trader on a US desk in 2010, with a tutorial week, client orders and an evening review of your fills. Free mode: open an account, pick your stake and trade a generated market, with margin and short selling.

details.title: 坠于浮华的赤色神女
details.short_description: 世人只知神女可召神，却不知神女每晚都能闯入神使的梦里，甜蜜与执念，旖旎情愫在此交织。穿越到架空神话里，和只属于你的神使们开启一段浪漫缱绻的故事。

details.title: GHOSTGRID
details.short_description: Take freelance hacking jobs in a port city. Break into fictional networks with real commands, investigate breaches, write the report, then go out and pay the rent. Everything you do leaves a record, and investigators read them. 153 real techniques, and the game checks that you did them.

details.title: Round One, Fight!
details.short_description: A laid-back incremental auto battler straight off a '90s video-store shelf. Build your fighter, let him throw the punches, and come back stronger after a beating. 25 opponents, 5 acts, a skill tree, and a little romance.

details.title: Liquidation Inc.
details.short_description: A co-op physics horror for 1-4 friends: buy out the contents of haunted, foreclosed homes and haul everything to your van before the timer runs out. Every scratch costs money - and something still lives there.

details.title: Rolitori
details.short_description: Roll the ball through increasingly complex stages and mechanics in this mind-bending 3D platformer!

details.title: Cave Saga
details.short_description: Explore the caves in this action-adventure platformer. Jump, dash, pick up, and throw objects or creatures to help escape the various complex cave systems. Each biome you explore contains unique mechanics and aesthetics. Play solo or with up to 4 players in local co-op!

details.title: Fishly: Desktop Aquarium
details.short_description: A tiny pixel-art aquarium that lives on your desktop. Your fish swim, eat, sleep at night and earn gold while you work. Breed rare colours, fill your album, decorate your tank or let them swim across your whole wallpaper

details.title: Sharktooth Bay
details.short_description: Dig for shark teeth, sift through the sand, and stock a seaside fossil shop with what you find. Set your prices, arrange your displays, and sell to visiting beachgoers. Keep your favorite finds for your own collection.

details.title: Seoul Night Bites
details.short_description: Run a tiny Korean street-food stall after midnight. Pick ingredient cards, cook 64 real Korean dishes and chain recipes into huge combos in this cozy roguelite deckbuilder. Pay the rent, then see how long you last in Endless Nights.

details.title: SkyAceBlitz
details.short_description: Top-down roguelike aerial shooter. Engage in realistic inertia dogfights, shoot down foes with machine guns and homing missiles. Gather random upgrades every run for distinct builds. Play with friends via Remote Play Together!

name: Drink Cola. Get a Fighter Jet!

details.title: Drink Cola. Get a Fighter Jet!
details.short_description: The fighter jet prize is no joke. This cola company actually delivers. Crack open colas, rack up points, and fight with powerful prizes. The ultimate goal: a fighter jet. A top-down shooter incremental where you grow endlessly stronger and collect dangerous prizes.

details.title: Rainfed
details.short_description: Build and run your own farm in a pixel-art management sim. Grow crops, breed livestock and turn your harvest into products to sell. Buy land and machinery, hire workers and set plans to keep the work moving. Expand the business, shape the farm and try not to go broke.

details.title: Breaking Protocol
details.short_description: Dodge bullets in a fast bullet hell boss rush against parodies of AI models. Every attack is telegraphed and you build your own playstyle from 64 exploits. Singleplayer, two players locally or online, plus 2 to 8 player raids.

details.title: Clickbait Arcade
details.short_description: You've seen the ads. Pull the pin, pick the door, run through the x3 gate. The games never existed... until now. Clickbait Arcade is 12 fake mobile-ad games made real, in a neon arcade, with no ads, no energy timers and no pay-to-win.

details.title: Captain's Wake
details.short_description: Loot, level, legend! Captain's Wake is a pirate action RPG on a cutthroat sea, where rival captains level up, loot and hunt just like you. Every ship has a captain with a fortune to chase and a long memory. Will you be friend or foe? Chart your own course and become a legendary pirate.

details.title: UNHOLY PEPPERONI
details.short_description: A tiny pizzeria. A sister you love. A tragedy you can't escape. Run a pizzeria where the nights are unsettling, and every slice comes with a side of something sinister. But no matter how hard you try to keep the business, some things refuse to stay buried.

details.title: Monsters & Banknotes
details.short_description: Open a backstreet monster shop on borrowed money. Buy, breed, raise and sell 141 species, build valuable bloodlines, prove them in the arena and trade at the grand auction. Pay the underworld tribute or defend your shop in this pixel-art management sim.

details.title: MAGICA☆REVERSI!
details.short_description: Reversi, but magical girls fire rocket launchers. Shuffle the board, flip every disc, warp in for a one-hit win. Fall behind and your comeback magic charges up. Lose the disc your character stands on and you lose on the spot. Every disc you're ahead is in-game prize money. 50 3D boards.

details.title: Streaming Raptae
details.short_description: A one-button platformer about a streamer trapped inside his own livestream. Your score is your viewers, your chat throws bombs at you and every death is clip-worthy. Jump, hold to jump higher, and never let the stream get boring.

details.title: Little Brigade: Desktop Battler
details.short_description: A relaxing (because apparently you're not involved) idle auto-battler that sits in the corner of your screen while you go about your day.

details.title: Moji Snake
details.short_description: Fight to survive this snake roguelike with quick adventures or endless runs.

details.title: Earn Your Stripes
details.short_description: A single-player WWII shooter where you start as a Private, rank up, and gain command of an entire army. Fight in battles of hundreds of soldiers on procedurally generated battlefields, from the Normandy beaches to the Rhine. Lead a squad, plan attacks on the map, crew tanks and call in bombers.

details.title: Realmwake
details.short_description: Recruit and merge an everchanging roster of combatants in this roguelike autobattler. Arrange your squad, discover powerful synergies, and venture through a world shattered by the four colliding realms.

details.title: Draw Death
details.short_description: Draw your path of death through hordes of enemies in a macabre gothic storybook survivor. Master drawn shapes, time brutal combos, and build ten strange hunters into crowd-cutting monsters, backed by an epic orchestral score.

details.title: Fever
details.short_description: Experience the beautiful horror of a hostile alien planet in this co-op survival FPS. Explore, mine resources, craft weapons, and fortify outposts with turrets and traps. When the sky rains blood, fight hundreds of creatures and survive the Fever.

details.title: NEON DESCENT
details.short_description: Half human, half machine, D dives into a neon cyberspace with J, the AI who refuses to leave his side. Fuse together, outsmart 12 bosses that each demand a different strategy, and descend to the Core to learn why the children vanished.

details.title: Kill the AI
details.short_description: An action roguelike set in a dystopian future where the tech titans who built the AI are sent to kill it. Gun down swarms of glitching machines, level up, hack terminals, build your loadout and transform your weapon mid-run. No permanent upgrades: every win is pure skill.

details.title: Ladder of Numbers
details.short_description: Ladder of Numbers turns arithmetic into combat skills: charge with addition, multiply into clones, fire with subtraction, divide to split. Climb its steps through thunderclouds and imaginary-number storms to the edge of the sky.

details.title: Folkwyrd
details.short_description: A fantasy colony sim and city builder where every villager has a life of their own. Build and customize a floating island settlement, manage a living population, shape generations, and explore a persistent multiplayer world where every choice leaves a mark.

details.title: They Are Zombies
details.short_description: Gather by day. Survive by night. Team up with friends, collect resources, and craft what you need before the zombies come. Survive 15 nights of attacks—and find out whether your brilliant plan can actually get you through to morning.

details.title: Math Combo Chain
details.short_description: A tower defense where ammo is limited and math is your reload.

details.title: Bukchon Anomaly
details.short_description: A first-person anomaly horror game on a looping street inspired by Seoul's Bukchon Hanok Village. You get one photo per passage. At the gate, report whether anything changed. Three wrong reports end your run, and some anomalies come for you before you get there.

details.title: PaleBlueRose
details.short_description: A free-to-play online medieval city builder. Start with a founding wagon and a little grain. Grow a town, build production chains, trade with thousands of players and go to war, all in one shared world. Win by holding 90% of the world's yearly economy.

details.title: Toque: Restaurant Tycoon
details.short_description: A restaurant tycoon where you are part of the crew. Work wherever you want, in the kitchen, at the register or on the floor, build your place yourself and pick one of four restaurant types. Grow your menu with cooks who know the dishes and rise above the city's rival restaurants.

details.title: Monster Hunting Supplies
details.short_description: A supernatural mystery game where customers bring disturbing rumors and strange encounters to your workshop. Ask questions, study your field guide, and prepare the right ammunition. Every story holds a clue, and some are connected.

details.title: Second On Ice
details.short_description: Fast, top-down ice hockey with a story-driven single-player career. Skate, pass, check, and score from snowy neighborhood rinks to pro arenas as you step out of your brother's shadow. Play quick matches, league seasons, and international tournaments in a pixel-art hockey world.

details.title: XenoTrax
details.short_description: Race powerful alien off-road vehicles across five extraordinary worlds. Choose your driver, tackle rugged tracks, compete in championships, and chase your own ghost. Take on computer rivals or race with friends in up to four-player local split-screen.

details.title: Ocean Dredgers
details.short_description: Dive solo or with up to 3 friends, dredge sunken wrecks for lost treasures, brush and rinse your finds, and display them in your shipboard museum to earn upgrades and explore deeper waters in first or third person.

details.title: Every Pixel Must Go
details.short_description: Every Pixel Must Go is an incremental destruction game where the goal is to clear every pixel from a dimension through upgrdes and automation. Break apart terrain made up of hundreds of thousands of pixels, pull them into your vortex.

details.title: MeteorMunch: Planet Eater
details.short_description: An incremental planet-eating game. Kidnapped by MunchCorp, you herd hungry animals across doomed worlds, click up the coins they drop and upgrade your herd until every last leaf is gone and the meteor hits. Pay off an absurd debt before your home planet goes boom.

details.title: Neothree: Confront the Providence
details.short_description: In the Three Kingdoms Preiod, the Providence corrupts warlords and changes history. As a general of the Han, you will command proud and sorrowful armies, reclaim the Jade Seal of Emperor, uncover the secret of the First Great Gate, and finally return the founder of Han to his untroubled rest.

details.title: 100 Bodies in the Grass
details.short_description: 100 Bodies in the Grass is a wave-based co-op defense game, set against the backdrop of the Third Mongol Invasion of Vietnam, combining elements of roguelikes and tower/hero defenses with the combat of an isometric ARPG.

details.title: Stop The Slime
details.short_description: A 3D platformer where standing still is deadly. Ground melts your slime, water heals it, and every coin doubles as ammo. Hop across floating islands, outsmart monsters, obstacles and traps and chase three stars on every level.

details.title: Cataract Quest
details.short_description: Cataract Quest is a first-person co-op adventure where your vision is failing. Play solo or team up with friends as an old man navigating a treacherous world with cataracts. Rely on walking sticks, unique abilities, and chaotic teamwork to find your way back home.

details.title: Zero G Nova Adventure
details.short_description: Zero G Nova Adventure is a free-to-play online space sandbox. Fly through galaxies of real stars, black holes and nebulae, mine and craft, build bases, trade with other pilots and fight in PvP. Host your own server or join friends with a code.

details.title: Tinymon Tactics
details.short_description: A cozy roguelite autobattler. Set sail for Verdantia, an archipelago where curious little creatures called Tinymon roam every island. Befriend them, help them evolve, and shape them into a team strong enough to challenge the arena leaders waiting at the end of each island.

details.title: Gladren
details.short_description: A physics-driven medieval melee arena for up to 8 players. Aim every swing with your mouse, block, kick and dodge, buy your weapons and armor each round, and settle it with friends in brutal duels and team battles where steel bites and limbs fly.

details.title: Drop Dead Lucky
details.short_description: Every bounce is a gamble. Make yours count. Drop Dead Lucky is a Plinko roguelite where you aim your drops, nudge fate in your favor, and combine charms, runes, and spirits to build huge scores and survive eight escalating antes.

details.title: Planet Sim
details.short_description: Land on procedurally generated planets and build factory colonies across the galaxy. Harvest, haul and produce without conveyor belts, launch rockets to orbit and the Moon, and wake your colonists. Terraform each world to make it home, and hold back the enemies infesting it.

details.title: EconoCity
details.short_description: A shared-world city builder and economy game. Buy land, lay roads, build block by block, sell power and water, and set your rent. Every rival is a real player, every price was set by one, and the city keeps running when you log off.

details.title: CRUMBKINS
details.short_description: A 1–4 player physics-based co-op heist comedy about tiny, hungry thieves. Climb giant furniture, steal food for picky clients, and decide: deliver the loot, throw it to a friend, or eat a pepper and shoot fireballs.

details.title: Dear Maid
details.short_description: I spent every penny I had and signed up for 60 monthly payments on a maid robot. Then the world ended.

details.title: Roll Call: Hero League Manager
details.short_description: Build your superhero dream team from 888 playable characters and take on 35 bosses. Negotiate transfers, brave dangerous missions, and keep clashing egos and the payroll under control. Outthink 49 rival clubs in a turn-based management game where every roll can change your season.

details.title: Too Angry to Clean
details.short_description: A co-op destruction game for 1-4 players where the best weapon against the undead is a falling house. Tear down walls, towers and castles with magic and bury undead hordes under the rubble. Level up and unlock new spells. Set records and find out who’s strongest in an arena you can wreck too.

details.title: SLASHER NIGHT
details.short_description: A single-player VR slasher simulator. Stalk targets through Redcastle, strike with hands-on weapons and face physical NPC reactions. Choose your approach and survive escalating resistance as witnesses flee and authorities respond.

details.title: Roadworn
details.short_description: Roadworn is a dark fantasy sandbox RPG. Lead a squad across a new world of rival states, wild factions and bandits, get drawn into intrigue around the thrones, fight turn-based hex battles and rise from nobody to legend

details.title: Deadline Detective
details.short_description: An offbeat retrofuturistic deduction game: build your career across hundreds of investigations. For each, you have 48 hours and one accusation. Question and confront suspects, rise through the ranks, and unlock new tools. The same mysterious signature keeps appearing: the Archivist’s.

details.title: Tiny Club Manager
details.short_description: Lead a tiny club from the Sunday League to the top of the world. Watch every match in a living pixel-art stadium, shout orders from the touchline, train your squad with cards earned from what went wrong, and grow your ground from a roped-off pitch into a roaring arena.

details.title: Boomside
details.short_description: A roguelike twist on Minesweeper. Dig up houses, signal towers and parks for points, chain power plants into huge multipliers, and read every hint to steer clear of the gas mains. Hire helpers, build your combo, and secure all eight key sites to redevelop the district.

details.title: Mini Hotel Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run your own hotel in a charming miniature world. Design rooms, arrange furniture, hire staff and care for your guests. Grow at your own pace, from your first hotel to new properties.

details.title: MALMORT
details.short_description: A first-person tower defense set in the Louisiana bayou, 1850. The dead are rising from the black water. Choose one of four heroes, build traps and turrets on stilted walkways, and fight the horde yourself to protect the last totem holding back the evil. Solo or 2-player co-op.

details.title: OUTIS
details.short_description: A 1–10 player PvE/PvP rules-horror game. Follow the rules of the urban legend—or deceive them—to survive and escape. The objects you bring back from inside the legend will be used to advance technology for humanity's survival.

details.title: Organic Mechanic
