details.short_description: Organic Mechanic is a bee-first automation, creature capturing, machine manufacturing game! Explore multiple vibrant biomes, build mechanical factories and play with your? friends? maybe? Catch, Built & Profit from BEES!

details.title: Pack Goblin
details.short_description: A cozy desktop companion and card collector. A little goblin lives above your taskbar. Your typing and clicks fill its meter, then it sneaks off and brings back booster packs. Rip them open, chase foil legendaries, fill your binder and decorate its yard

details.title: Hide and Freak
details.short_description: A goofy online ghost hunt, a seeker with a magic lantern, and a whole room of ghosts hiding in plain sight, posing, dancing and sneaking up behind you. Rainy graveyard, PS1 look, up to 16 players with room codes.

details.title: Blunderball
details.short_description: Arcade football where the ball sticks to whoever touches it. Dash to steal it, shoot it along the line you push it, and throw your character's magic: a hat that becomes a hole, a slowed-down world, two decoys. 1v1 or 3v3 with friends or bots. Three minutes, at least one blunder.

details.title: Hello Triangle: Build a GPU
details.short_description: Ever wonder how a GPU draws a triangle? In Hello Triangle, you build one yourself. Wire comparators, adders, and multipliers into graphics hardware, press Run, and watch your circuit draw the screen pixel by pixel—from a single triangle up to a rotating 3D cube.

details.title: Glimtide
details.short_description: A tiny island of jelly creatures that lives on its own, for everyone at once. Glims eat, sleep, fall in love, build villages and pass their skills to their babies. Watch them, bring a treat, adopt a favourite, design your own species, or drop a banana peel.

details.title: Joker's Wild
details.short_description: A blackjack roguelike deckbuilder. Build wild Joker combos, strike risky pacts with the House's Boss dealers and beat the House, one hand at a time.

details.title: Smoothie Chaos
details.short_description: A co-op slime restaurant game for 1 to 6 players. Raise slimes in your garden, feed them strange things to see what they evolve into, then blend them into smoothies for a dining room full of hungry humans and robots.

details.title: Gembound
details.short_description: Roguelite match-3 RPG where the board is dealt from your gem satchel. Build your deck, match gems, and cast spells.

details.title: HAZPIT
details.short_description: A top-down survival game where you work your way down zombie-infested high-rises, floor by floor from the roof. Lower floors mean more radiation and zombies, but better loot. Stay undetected when you can, and use what you bring back to repair your bunker and recruit survivors. Single-player only.

details.title: Tollmire
details.short_description: A dice roguelike in the bog. The witch demands eight tolls, each steeper than the last — you pay in rolls: points times mult. Between tolls you forge special faces onto your dice and gather talismans.

details.title: Massively Singleplayer
details.short_description: A predatorily monetized MMO turned singleplayer action roguelite. Choose your class and face six biomes filled with hordes of monsters. You have 20 minutes before the servers shut down, survive the onslaught or get banned. Gamble your way to glory and pay some guy in a bush to bless you.

details.title: WINNIE-THE-POOH: Honey Distortion
details.short_description: 🧸 WINNIE-THE-POOH: Honey Distortion 🍯 is a mystery visual novel with point-and-click mechanics, inspired by A. A. Milne's stories. Explore the Hundred Acre Wood, unravel secrets and make decisions that can change the course of events.

details.title: Abduct & Destroy
details.short_description: Pilot a UFO in a chaotic VR arcade game. Abduct humans, blast buildings apart, and take on ridiculous missions with your ship’s destruction and abduction cannons. Earth is having a very bad day.

details.title: Knitwork
details.short_description: A cozy casual puzzle woven with endless fun. Every button is held by its threads: label each one with how tightly it's knit into the network. Pull the loose threads first, work inward, and find the tight-knit core.

details.title: The Stable
details.short_description: The Stable is a sports management sim set in the world of professional boxing. Start up a gym, hire and train professional fighters across 6 different weight divisions, and watch them fight as you work towards the coveted title of world champion.

details.title: Just to Survive
details.short_description: A wasteland tactics game: explore a weathered desert, salvage what remains, and build a squad for precise, turn-based firefights.

details.title: Territorium
details.short_description: « Conquer the world, one border at a time. » Territorium is a real-time multiplayer grand strategy game for up to 128 players. Upgrade your facilities, unlock devastating nuclear arsenals, and dominate the map in solo, co-op survival, or exclusive team modes.

details.title: The Saga of Three Realms
details.short_description: A classic sandbox MMORPG. Tame animals and monsters to fight at your side. Plant your house right in the open world, no instances. Master any skill by using it, craft gear that matters, trade across the realm and carve your own legend. No pay to win, no cash shop.

details.title: Talero
details.short_description: Roll the dice, build your combo, and push your limits! Modify your dice, combine powerful Jokers, and create wildly overpowered builds in this roguelike where every roll can change everything.

details.title: The King Must Grow
details.short_description: A physics-based co-op incremental about overly loyal jesters, each with one very important job: Feed cute, entirely innocent slimes to the ever-hungry Slime King. Throw them by hand, then see if you can build systems that do it for you. Play solo, or be lazy and make a friend do the work.

details.title: Thank you,  Next please!
details.short_description: Run a local shop in an eastern totalitarian state. Provide rations, alcohol and medicine, but watch out for fake ration cards. Deny them goods or give them what they need to survive, knowing the Ministry is watching. Help the revolution, reunite families, and bring peace to the neighborhood.

details.title: Bloomtop
details.short_description: A cozy idle gardening game that lives at the bottom of your desktop. Water, harvest and cross-pollinate pixel-art plants while you work, discover 58 hybrids, and grow a flowering vine up your monitor's edges until it frames your whole screen.

details.title: Hoverwick: Village in the Sky
details.short_description: A cozy medieval village floating in the corner of your desktop. Peek in between emails, put up a new house, plant flowers or paint a river, then get back to work. The villagers take care of the rest: they bake bread, go fishing and build snowmen, even when the game is closed.

details.title: Photoncytosis
details.short_description: Photoncytosis is an idle desktop life simulation. A tiny organism feeds on the light of your screen, stores energy in its cells, and grows while you work. Shape its evolution, inspect it under the microscope, and help it survive a changing desktop ecosystem.

details.title: Kick4Two
details.short_description: Foosball for two. Grab the keyboard or a controller, pick a table and play head-to-head on the same screen, in split screen or over LAN. Real rod physics, a CPU opponent with four levels and five tables.

details.title: Spirit Mask
details.short_description: Reclaim the throne they tore from you! Spirit Mask is a pixel art horde roguelite set in a world of spirits under the pale light of the moon. Alone or in online co-op, forge your legend every night! Dodge what you can't fight, evolve your powers and face bosses that change mid-battle.

details.title: Elancia Replay Online
details.short_description: A free-to-play 2D MMORPG in development, with combat, gathering, crafting, and trading planned. Early Access is targeted for mid-to-late March 2027. Follow development and help shape the game through your feedback.

details.title: Mushrooooooom
details.short_description: A numerical incremental game about spreading spores. There are mushrooms aplenty here, giving you countless ways to take root and spread across procedurally generated planets. Cross the seas, burrow underground, climb into the clouds, and turn the entire map into your own color.

details.title: Tamagong
details.short_description: A monster-raising autobattler where you hatch, feed, and train your monsters, shape their builds, and discover powerful team synergies.

details.title: Weathard
details.short_description: In this cosy puzzle game, control the weather and clear your path. Switch between rainy, sunny and snowy weather to transform the environment and solve each puzzle.

details.title: Brumel: Fantasy Presidential Race
details.short_description: In this fantasy political simulation, you are the Hero Party’s presidential candidate, with 60 days to win an election. Defeat rivals from the Demon Party, the Spirit Party, and beyond to become president. The fate of your nation—and the world—rests on your choices.

details.title: TURACIN
details.short_description: Beautiful tunnel racing game.

details.title: Smash & Settle
details.short_description: A cozy idle game about smashing and settling. Break open trees, rocks and ore, build huts and kitchens, give every villager a job and let your islands run themselves. When the purple corruption creeps in, gather your soldiers and clear its dungeon.

details.title: Learn Abroad: Japanese
details.short_description: Learn Japanese through a cozy study-abroad simulation. Attend guided classes, practice with interactive activities, and complete homework to earn money. Explore Shibuya, recharge at cafés and ramen shops, and build a daily routine around learning something new.

details.title: Letters from the Springs
details.short_description: Run a cozy hot spring inn in a mountain valley. Read guest letters, plan menus, prepare tea and baths, and grow your own ingredients. Get to know your travelers, balance the books, and help your little inn flourish, one thoughtful stay at a time.

details.title: Boomerang Survivor Technoverses
details.short_description: An exhilarating action game where you defeat enemies with a boomerang! Enjoy a variety of wondrous experiences across numerous pixel-art "Technoverses"!

details.title: The Last Inn
details.short_description: Welcome to The Last Inn — become the innkeeper! Build a refuge on the Radiated Continent. By day, serve guests, farm and raise livestock; by night, hunt, scavenge and gather ingredients. Recruit companions as helpers or lovers. Build an oasis and unravel the mystery over three great shelters…

details.title: Deckwork
details.short_description: Build a six-card deck that fights for you. Draft, reorder and sacrifice cards to forge synergies, bend the rules with relics and lead three heroes through dungeons and fearsome bosses in this pixel-art fantasy auto-battler roguelite.

details.title: 6 VIEWS MYSTERY
details.short_description: 6 VIEWS MYSTERY is a mystery adventure where you explore closed spaces from six fixed viewpoints—north, east, south, west, ceiling, and floor. Find clues and items, operate mechanisms, and uncover new details by changing your point of view. Currently includes the short episode “Cell 214.”

details.title: The Wuslers
details.short_description: Build a cozy settlement where Wuslers keep your economy running, carrying all your goods on foot along the roads you lay. Feed your mines, expand your territory with Barracks and play solo, against the AI or with up to eight players on PC and Android.

details.title: Purification: Idle Defense
details.short_description: Purification merges Tower Defense with the exponential growth of an Incremental Idler. Harvest souls for talents and ancient relics to fortify your wall—and switch to a silent Desktop Companion bar to keep defending while you work or study.

details.title: Hungry Hoist
details.short_description: Hungry Hoist is a co-op dungeon-crawler sandbox about gathering and selling as much loot as possible. Dig deeper into the mine to discover darker, more twisted dungeons containing new enemies and puzzles, as well as shinier loot to sell or craft with. Mine, fight, and cook to evolve your panda!

details.title: CraBro 蟹霸
details.short_description: Fight through an underwater arena with two independent claws. Build weapons from scrap, learn martial techniques, parry deep-sea bosses, and unlock an online asynchronous ladder against other players' saved builds.

details.title: Island Escape
details.short_description: A single-player 3D survival crafting game. Shipwrecked in 1907 on a nameless island, you gather, build, and push your civilization from stone to electricity — then build a boat and gamble on the open sea. Even a raft can leave; arriving alive is another matter. Sink, and the island is still yours.

details.title: The Goodnight Potion
details.short_description: The Goodnight Potion! is a pixel-art fantasy puzzle game in which you help an old mage with a troubling potion addiction. Choose which potion to drink first, combine elemental reactions, and use spells and transformations to survive until the next night.

details.title: Ironclads 3
details.short_description: A hardcore historical naval combat sim set in the Age of Iron & Steam, built around meticulous historical detail. Command a warship and its specialist crew as they man guns, operate steam propulsion and shipboard machinery, keep the vessel battle-ready, and fight fires and flooding under enemy fire.

details.title: Purrfect Circuit
details.short_description: Purrfect Circuit is a roguelike training and racing simulation game centered around training your racers through a 3 year career run with automated races. Includes simultaneous Co-Op campaign and competitive multiplayer. See you on the track!

details.title: Inkfall
details.short_description: Draw anything on a blank page and stamp it awake. Draw wings and it flies, draw fire and it breathes fire. Even a tangle of lines or a single dot wakes up with a name and its own moves, then goes off to fight other players' drawings.

details.title: Touhou Minesweeper Night
details.short_description: Minesweeper meets Gensokyo! Touhou Minesweeper Night blends classic Minesweeper logic with roguelite builds. Read the numbers, flag dangers, and combine the girls' abilities with random items to tackle changing boards and unravel the incident shrouding Gensokyo.

details.title: Into The Nightwood
details.short_description: Lead a party of heroes into The Nightwood in this dark fantasy card battler. Recruit companions, combine abilities and equipment, and face powerful bosses across a series of runs. Experiment with new builds as you search for the source of a spreading darkness.

details.title: CombatBox: Reboot
details.short_description: A large-scale war with hundreds of soldiers on one map, on an ordinary PC. Smart AI fills your squad and the enemy's: they radio positions, flank and pull downed friends out. Tanks, helicopters, jets and bombers share the battlefield. Customize your soldiers and add anything with mods.

details.title: HELLFIRE OF DOOM
details.short_description: HELLFIRE OF DOOM is an incremental boomer shooter about Valera, an office worker who storms hell to avenge his beloved ficus. An imp peed in it. Blast through frantic runs, collect demon blood and spend it on 70+ upgrades until you're the scariest thing down there.

details.title: NECROTIDE
details.short_description: Your enemies are your next recruits. In this survivor roguelite, raise the fallen, pull your undead army into a wall to block incoming fire, and fuse your soldiers into monsters like the Bone Wyrm. Can your army bring down the Pale King?

details.title: OVERFIT
details.short_description: Fit geometric pieces to complete cards, combine Cores, and craft powerful synergies in this satisfying, minimalist puzzle roguelite. Trigger massive OVERFITS to overcome game-changing challenges before your actions run out.

details.title: The Long Run
details.short_description: A giant robot is hunting you, and the only way out is forward. The Long Run is an arcade racer meets run-and-gun on an endless road. Across wide and narrow platforms at full speed: drift, (double) jump, blast enemies, grab power-ups and collect scraps to upgrade your car.

details.title: Entropy - The Struggle Of Fate
details.short_description: Every eighty years, eight Ollutir warriors appear at the edge of the Frainnan village, sent by God, they believe, to fight and die. Varnel was meant to die with them. Instead, the man who defeated him let him live, and now a strange Frainnan girl keeps visiting his cell.

details.title: Lost In Trash
details.short_description: Explore a massive landfill as a small robot, collect resources, fight trash monsters and upgrade your equipment. Start with nothing and build your way up in a world where even garbage has value. Multiplayer is planned for the future!

name: Super Emoji Murder Death God Labyrinth

details.title: Super Emoji Murder Death God Labyrinth
details.short_description: I made a little turn-based puzzle game out of free emoji. Grab the gems, reach the exit, stay out of the guards’ way. Simple! Except something got into my levels, and it keeps moving things while you play. So I drew you some tools: Cut, Copy, Paste and Nudge. Edit them back.

details.title: Druzy Grotto
details.short_description: A cozy pixel-art idle game about collecting creatures in a cave. Crack a geode and flip four cards, one creature on each. Feed the babies tucked into the cave wall until they grow up and wander out, some with a rare shiny finish. Keep the best, sell the rest, and open seven caves of 210 species.

details.title: Keymancer: A Vim Roguelite
details.short_description: Every keystroke is a real Vim command. Move with hjkl, press i and type your attacks in Insert Mode, and when you're strong enough, dd deletes enemies off the map like lines of text. A pixel roguelite of short runs and long mastery. You'll learn Vim by accident.

details.title: Before the Pyre
details.short_description: Lead a secret coven through plague and witch hunts in this turn-based dark fantasy strategy game. Study forbidden magic, bargain with nobles and ancient spirits, and protect your witches. A spell can save a life—and leave the evidence that condemns you.

details.title: The Endless Museum
details.short_description: Wikipedia turned into a museum you can walk around, where every article is a room and every link is a doorway. You can wander wherever the links take you and read about each room as you go, race friends between articles, or look for the secret passages, puzzles and hidden rooms behind the bookcases.

details.title: Solaria Moon Remake
details.short_description: A 3D space adventure aboard the Taranis, a huge cargo ship, full of puzzles to solve and secrets to uncover. Already own Solaria Moon? The remake is free for you.

details.title: The Garden of Human-Shaped Organblooms
details.short_description: Harvest organs from “Organblooms”—plants that look like human children and grow transplantable organs—and manage Somnus Conservatory, the facility they call home, in this morally bankrupt facility-management simulation.
publishers: クリエイターのうえきばち

details.title: VOXHELL
details.short_description: You are the subject. He is the experiment. Forty-eight rooms of traps designed to test not your reflexes, but your behavior, while a smug narrator comments on every mistake. And when you need a break, there's a whole other game waiting on the computer.

details.title: Diceocracy: UK
details.short_description: Win a by-election, then survive the diary. Hard choices go to a physics d20 thrown against a difficulty class. Climb from the back benches to Number Ten in a House of Commons where the seats are real and every politician is invented.

details.title: The Final Ideology
details.short_description: Lead your faction through the Third Cold War in this turn-based grand strategy. Millennia after the destruction of Earth, survivors of the Communist and Capitalist superpowers have forged enormous multi-planetary factions that have recently re-discovered one another. Which side will you take?

details.title: Athletics Live: Track & Field
details.short_description: A skill-based athletics game where your hands decide who wins. Mash to sprint, clear the hurdles, hit the board and release at 45°. Every men's and women's event, relays, decathlon and heptathlon, and a World Tour from club meets to the Global Games. Race your friends online.

details.title: Hedge-Wizard Cocktail
details.short_description: A not-so-cozy apothecary simulator. Explore, gather reagents, craft wicked concoctions and haggle with adventurers, alone or with friends, in a dangerous, dark fantasy world. Complete quests and expand your alchemical expertise to grow your shop before the horrors of the Hedge destroy you.

name: Silicon Life: From Bedroom to Billion

details.title: Silicon Life: From Bedroom to Billion
details.short_description: September 1981. A bedroom, a workbench, a dream: build a computer empire. Assemble, repair and sell PCs in 3D through the real hardware of 1981 to 2025 under parodied names, from the garage to the factory, and aim for a billion.

details.title: Same Day Tycoon
details.short_description: Run a multi-layered delivery network across North America in this logistics tycoon. Design and automate warehouses, get the best supplier prices for a variety of products, and route vans, trucks and trains. Promise fast delivery, meet every tight deadline, and win customers city by city.

details.title: Cuddle Puddle
details.short_description: Cuddle Puddle is a short, cozy incremental game about calling cats together. No click-spamming: your paw's love zone goes pspsps on its own, cats pounce on each other and burst into hearts. Grow a conga line, raise your cat tree and fill five places with cuddles. :3

details.title: Payload Architect
details.short_description: An inventory-management auto-battler where your score grows exponentially. Arrange Code Blocks on a grid and let your program run itself. Find the loops and loopholes that push your Payload past every target.

details.title: Pig & Pup
details.short_description: Play as a pup with your friends in this online multiplayer party game. Carry toys home, guard your chests or steal from the other team. Bark to lure Pudding into their loot, but watch out: the pig can knock yours loose too.

details.title: KAESHI
details.short_description: A 2D beat 'em up built around Sekiro-style parrying. Attack with fast combos, parry enemy flurries to break their posture, then finish them with a Deathblow.

details.title: Pluralys: Exp.14
details.short_description: Discover Pluralys: Exp.14, a cozy indie adventure. Play as Elie on a day that seems ordinary... until his/her house fills up with friends and strangers. Why are they there, and how will you handle the situation? There's only one way to find out...

details.title: PATROL
details.short_description: Hunt insurgent leaders across procedurally generated warzones inspired by Mogadishu, Afghanistan and Iraq. Raid compounds quietly or loud, call in gunships and airstrikes, take your target alive, and bring every wounded soldier home. Solo or in two-player co-op.

details.title: KlemyCraft
details.short_description: Explore an endless voxel world made of building bricks: build brick by brick, gather resources, craft tools and brave caves, mines and strange dimensions – solo or in co-op with friends.

details.title: NEEDLEFALL
details.short_description: Equip your mechs, drop them from orbit and hold the line. NEEDLEFALL is a horde defense RTS for 1–4 players. Build pipes to carry Flux to the Core and your turrets, raise walls, command your mechs against swarms of hundreds of creatures and destroy the twelve hives.

details.title: I Just Wanted to Fish
details.short_description: A stranger, a fishing rod and an island full of closed paths. Fish, explore and help the townsfolk until every shore is yours to fish.

details.title: StackBBQ: Chinese Skewer Simulator
details.short_description: Run a Chinese BBQ Stall by Card Stack !

details.title: Prisoner Amber
details.short_description: [BL Visual Novel] Amber’s career as an agent ends in an explosion. Arrested and interrogated, he discovers a huge chunk of his memory is missing. Recover the memories, find the true culprit, and face—the final truth!

details.title: Fishermen League
details.short_description: A relaxing fishing simulator with real tension. Fish 89 spots across 12 waters, fight 152 species with up to three rods at once, build your tackle, complete daily quests and rise from rookie to master angler in online tournaments and clubs.

details.title: Sorcaw
details.short_description: Sorcaw is a spell-fusing action roguelite with bullet-hell combat. Combine any two spells into something stronger, find magical items that build into powerful synergies, level up and blaze your way through an ever-changing world.

details.title: AlpineFall
details.short_description: You came to learn to ski. The mountain had other plans. AlpineFall is a story-driven skiing adventure: start on the bunny hill, master real two-ski physics and uncover what Mount Oread buried beneath its snow.

details.title: Deck Drop
details.short_description: Perfect your deck or watch it burn! Deck Drop is a Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by Chinese Poker and Balatro. Can you beat the Tipping Point?

details.title: Cozymancer: Wizard Tower Restoration
details.short_description: Cozymancer is a chill organizing game where you restore a Wizard Tower. Learn spells, sort artifacts, clean up slime, restore furniture and bring the Tower back to its former glory!

details.title: Hex Party
details.short_description: 「Hex Party」 is a lighthearted company management × romance sim. A mysterious mark and a strange curse suddenly appear, while your company faces a crisis. As the CEO, can you save your company and break the curse? Make your choices and create your own story.

details.title: Resortful
details.short_description: Resortful is a cozy island management sim. Start with a harbour and a beach, then build bungalows, cafés, hotels and water parks for the guests who sail in each day. Balance prices, upkeep and reputation as your relaxing resort grows.

details.title: Monster Battle Master
details.short_description: Monster Battle Master is a character adventure game focused on creature collecting. You'll start by getting a unique field mouse and gradually embark on your own new adventure, challenge all the strong enemies in the region with your senior sister, and relive past memories along the journey.

details.title: Sus Chef
details.short_description: A chaotic first-person online multiplayer cooking and social deduction game for up to 12 players. Take orders, cook, serve and keep the restaurant clean to improve the rating while hidden saboteurs try to cause chaos and bring the restaurant to ruin!

details.title: Raccoocket
details.short_description: Raccoocket is a cheerful, ridiculous rocket-building flight game. Stack cola and Mentos, bottle rockets, old toilets and scrapped missiles into a rocket that looks impossible but pushes like crazy, and launch Xiao Huan the raccoon. Get it right: the Moon. Get it wrong: a short, loud fireworks show.

details.title: Our Hollow
details.short_description: The Crown has nailed an eviction notice to your Heart Tree: forty days to quit the wood. Lead a ragtag band on a turn-based d20 adventure through hand-made towns, haunted roads, a sun-scorched isle and frozen mountains, and find out who really holds the paper.

details.title: Idle Laps
details.short_description: An incremental racing game where you actually drive. Beat your best lap and turn it into ghosts that loop it endlessly, earning coins for you. Upgrade your ride, ascend, and master every circuit of an island racing festival.

details.title: OSAD
details.short_description: No combat, no jump scares, and no chase sequences: just you and a dying world with a mystery to uncover. Experience the end of the world in an alternate-history Poland. As a lone garbage collector, witness the final hours of reality as you know it. But don't forget to be a good citizen.

name: Fishing Company Tycoon: Harbor to Market

details.title: Fishing Company Tycoon: Harbor to Market
details.short_description: Build a fishing company from a single boat. Send your ships to the fishing grounds, truck the catch to the markets that pay the most, research better gear, and grow a fleet that works by itself. A relaxed management game on a living island.

details.title: Got More?
details.short_description: Fight monster hordes in a bullet heaven roguelite with automatic attacks, weapon evolutions and 18 bosses. Mix guns, melee weapons and skills, unlock companions, and upgrade your gear between runs to take on the next chapter.

details.title: Fusa
details.short_description: Pet Pochi, earn purrs and turn an empty room into a home full of cats. Fusa is a relaxing pixel-art incremental game: furnish with over 140 pieces, watch your cats nap, play and ask for food, and grow your colony up to thirty companions.

details.title: Varketh’s Prison
details.short_description: Varketh's Prison is a dark fantasy isometric action RPG dungeon crawler inspired by classic RPGs. Descend into the depths with procedurally generated dungeons, dangerous creatures, and handcrafted boss encounters.

details.title: Slow Mowing
details.short_description: Take it slow and make it yours. Mow overgrown meadows, build your own mowing machines, and uncover forgotten treasures in the English countryside. Turn a neglected farm into your own peaceful retreat, one freshly cut path at a time.

details.title: Tower Power: Wall Fall
details.short_description: Build your tower, reinforce its walls, and reduce your rival's to rubble in a turn-based fantasy card strategy. Master three resources, five distinct decks, and three paths to victory.

details.title: Rotland
details.short_description: A brutal zombie survival sandbox in an Earth-sized procedural world. Scavenge, craft, and build a home or mobile base. Drive cars, sail boats, pilot planes and helicopters, or take to the rails on a train. Survive alone or with friends.

details.title: The Governor's Hand
details.short_description: Govern a Roman frontier province for ten months, one card at a time. Raise soldiers, tax the markets, sign writs, and decide how hard a hand to rule with. Harsh measures might keep the province stable, but will go on the record you will answer for in Rome at the end of your term.

details.title: FootBall Idle: Ball Launcher
details.short_description: Build your squad from player card packs, idle through league matches, and climb the ranks. Grow the club — then trade spare packs with other players on Steam.

details.title: FOLDEAD
details.short_description: A first-person, turn-based roguelike in a dungeon folded from paper. Climb five elemental dungeons and the one above them, fight with every skill in hand every turn, and shape each skill by taking two of the five points on its star.

details.title: XenoTerra
details.short_description: Explore an open sci-fi world on foot, by jetpack and behind the wheel. Battle rogue machines, upgrade your arsenal and haul captured energy to settlements. Activate energy beams to power the rocket that will take you back to space.

details.title: ChessDeck
details.short_description: A tense chess roguelike deckbuilder. Draw cards to deploy pieces and move them with real chess moves, break the enemy garrison, and hold your back row against attacks you can see coming. Every piece you lose comes back to haunt your deck.

details.title: Taskbar Kingdom
details.short_description: A medieval idle kingdom that lives above your taskbar. Gather resources, raise your castle and defend it from raiders, then send troops on real-time expeditions, claim land and rise at court, all while you work.

details.title: Wicknick
details.short_description: A co-op heist for 1-4 thieves, online or on one screen. Break into Lowlight's vaults by the light of one lantern: hang it on the light-lock to crack the cage, carry the chest out two by two, then hold the lift while the alarm wakes the dark.

details.title: Grow It!
details.short_description: Cook weed, cook meth, make money, and try not to get cooked yourself. Hire tiny buddies to do the cooking, gamble your profits, and automate everything. Just remember: the dealer wants his money.

details.title: How to Save the Villainess
details.short_description: You've woken up as a novel's hero—but it's the doomed villainess you want to save! Make friends at a magic academy and build your own spell deck in this roguelite RPG meets visual novel. No matter how many times you start over, you're determined to give her a happy ending!

details.title: Crimson Ocean
details.short_description: Pilot an upgradeable combat boat against swarms of alien harvesting machines in this top-down naval action game. Dodge ramming hulls, unleash guns, missiles, and torpedoes, and turn wreckage into firepower. To them, you’re raw material.

details.title: Toss It
details.short_description: Don't like long, ugly conveyor belts? Neither do we. In Toss It, the machines just throw the crates at each other! Grow the factory & keep the trucks full. Totally safe!

details.title: Flying Disc League
details.short_description: The ultimate frisbee simulator. Competitive online multiplayer from 2v2 to 7v7: pick the throw, set the power, release it and the disc flies like it does in real life. Hit the open pass, fake out your defender, lay out for the catch. Play with friends, against rivals, or train vs bots.

details.title: The Gigglebone Gang: Infinity City
details.short_description: Hop in Zack's taxicab and tour Infinity City with the Gigglebone Gang! 50 stimulating, song-filled early math activities teach kids ages 4–8 counting, shapes, time, money, and problem-solving, and it all feels like play. A Headbone Interactive classic, back for a new generation.

details.title: FOCOM: Forward Operations Commander
details.short_description: Command your forces from a forward operating base in a land held by an insurgency. Order every soldier yourself, push patrol bases out, win over the towns and hunt down the camps the insurgents fight from. A real-time commander game on one living map that remembers what you do.

details.title: Apartment Empire
details.short_description: Build your own apartment empire, one floor at a time. Design flats, collect rent, manage tenants with very different needs, and try to keep everyone happy. Meet colourful characters, uncover their stories, and discover that some residents are not entirely from around here.
developers: I Was Supposed to Be Studying for My Exams and find an intern but Somehow I make a game and became a Game Developer and Accidentally Started My Own Studio Despite Having Absolutely No Experience, No Employees, No Budget, and No Idea How My Life Works, but Now I've Already Paid Steam $100 So I Guess I Have No Choice but to Finish This Game Before My Parents Find Out That I've Been Spending More Time Debugging Unity Than Studying for My Degree, and Even Though I Promised Myself I'd Go to Bed After Fixing Just One More Bug, It's Already 5 AM and the Bug Has Somehow Become a Feature.™
publishers: I Was Supposed to Be Studying for My Exams and find an intern but Somehow I make a game and became a Game Developer and Accidentally Started My Own Studio Despite Having Absolutely No Experience, No Employees, No Budget, and No Idea How My Life Works, but Now I've Already Paid Steam $100 So I Guess I Have No Choice but to Finish This Game Before My Parents Find Out That I've Been Spending More Time Debugging Unity Than Studying for My Degree, and Even Though I Promised Myself I'd Go to Bed After Fixing Just One More Bug, It's Already 5 AM and the Bug Has Somehow Become a Feature.™

details.title: The Hearth That Waits
details.short_description: Build your whole party around one shared dice roll. Every companion reads the same result through their own runes, then acts in turn to chain combos. Plan your team in town, then set out on a warm, light-hearted fantasy adventure.

details.title: Cursed Luck
details.short_description: The Devil owns your debt. The reels hold your fate. Cursed Luck is a dark fantasy roguelite where you build powerful symbol combinations, unleash explosive chain reactions, and bend luck in your favor. Chase massive wins, survive rising demands, and pay your debt before the Devil claims your soul.

details.title: Junk Mountain
details.short_description: Dig through mountains of junk for a hard drive holding 8,000 bitcoin. Find drives, test them on a computer and follow five clues from a backyard junkyard to orbit. Sell scrap, upgrade tools and hire workers to build a junkyard that runs itself.

details.title: Kixball
details.short_description: Kixball is top-down physics football where you are one player on the pitch. No animations, no auto-aim: just you, the ball and the walls. Train, earn transfer offers and rise from the lowest division in your career, or play with up to 3 friends on one screen.

details.title: Deep Rescue
details.short_description: Pilot a small rescue sub through a dark, glowing ocean. Gather schools of glowfish in your beam, outwit poachers, lead rare animals home and stay clear of the Gloam, the huge thing in the deep that hunts anything that glows.

details.title: Lost Subject
details.short_description: You are the result of a mysterious experiment, trapped in a dark underground facility. Solve puzzles, explore dangerous locations, unlock new characters, battle bosses, and find your way to freedom!

details.title: My Little Animal Care Center
details.short_description: Run a cozy little animal clinic in the heart of a colorful town! Treat hurt pets on the care table, pamper your boarders in their pens, welcome over a dozen species and grow your small center into a whole neighborhood of care.

details.title: Fish Gone Wild
details.short_description: Swallow smaller fish, grow into bigger ones, and chase the predator you were running from. Pick cards to change how you hunt and dive in solo or with up to three friends. Just watch who gets bigger: you can eat each other too.

details.title: NOSTRA: Crystalbound
details.short_description: An action roguelite from the world of NOSTRA. It is the year 860 of the Charter: crystal grows everywhere and no kingdom guards the roads. Take the merchants' coin as the Rune Warrior, etch runes into your abilities on every run and fight through three regions of a broken land.

details.title: Proviantmeister 1756
details.short_description: His Majesty’s army shall march – provided you keep it supplied! Manage depots, organize wagon trains, procure provisions, fodder and ammunition, and contend with weather and war. A historical military logistics simulation set during the Seven Years’ War, 1756–1763.

details.title: The Forgotten Workshop
details.short_description: A cozy alchemy idle game: brew potions, serve customers and hire little clay homunculi who keep the shop running, even while you're away. Explore the Grimoire, risk strange mixtures in the cauldron and bring three workshops full of surprises back to life.

details.title: Ex Simulacris
details.short_description: Challenge the Simulation in this sci-fi autobattler. Recruit a growing roster of unique Operators, design fireteams, deploy them into increasingly difficult battle sims, gather data, upgrade, and try again. Log in, Administrator – the Simulation awaits.

details.title: Toss-Up
details.short_description: Heads or tails? It's time for a Toss Up! Welcome to the dungeon where every toss matters. Strategically distribute your numbers and flip your coins to claim victory. Sometimes, you'll have to risk everything!

details.title: Silk Road Caravan: Desktop Idle
details.short_description: A little caravan, a long Silk Road. Trade 12 goods, open routes through 13 cities, collect illustrated travel memories and return home for lasting upgrades. Open your caravan journal when you have a moment; let the journey continue while you work.

details.title: Too Many Chickens
details.short_description: Too Many Chickens is a chaotic co-op game for 1-4 players. Chase, grab and throw runaway chickens, haul them to the barn, and turn deliveries into cash. Buy better tools, build chicken-catching contraptions, and pay off the farm’s debt. Your friends might help.

details.title: Puppet War
details.short_description: Puppet auto-battler. Shop, merge and arrange puppets, arm them with items and rings, and survive the boss at the end of each stage in the haunted theater. Play solo or with a friend.

details.title: Manes in Cadentia
details.short_description: A gothic narrative rhythm mystery inspired by Edgar Allan Poe. Follow a grieving woman through five theatrical acts where music, memory, and truth become one.

details.title: Juchetopia
details.short_description: Korea, 1953. The war is over and Moscow wants its money back. Rebuild the North, pay the Soviet installment every month, play the factions against each other with secret police files and decide whether the armistice line stays where it is

details.title: Cargocracy: Space Warfare and Trade
details.short_description: Run a spacefaring company from a strip on your desktop or play full screen. Trade, mine, salvage or raid in a living galaxy while you work: your captains haul, fight and explore on your orders. Grow from one ship to colonies and a faction of your own.

details.title: One More Wave: Tower Defense
details.short_description: A tower defense game where you build towers along a road and hold off one wave after another. There are 9 towers with two upgrade paths each, 17 enemy types, 5 final bosses, 7 hand-made maps plus random ones, and an Endless mode.

details.title: Frog Express
details.short_description: Collect frogs and upgrade your express in an active incremental game! Power up manual collection, install automated modules, or combine both. Merge hats, fill your frog album, and unlock permanent upgrades to travel further with every run.

details.title: StarRanger
details.short_description: Lead a field team in a story-driven sci-fi RPG with turn-based squad combat. Build your squad's skills, choose its equipment, and make difficult calls on assignments with the Star Rangers - all while searching for your missing brother.

details.title: Grief the Server
details.short_description: The admins are away. Grief a voxel server in this single-player incremental: sabotage builds, unlock outrageous cheats and become everyone's problem. Simulated players repair, fight back and unite against you. Play in first person or send a bot in Idle Mode.

details.title: Battle Winds
details.short_description: A galaxy of over 7,000 stars lives on without you: trading, waging war, and falling back before the Reapers. Take the helm, jump to any star, set your ship down on a planet, and step outside, rifle in hand. Every battle, deal, and sortie you make reshapes the map everyone sees.

details.title: Dopamine Cube
details.short_description: A fast-paced roguelite shooter where every level-up is a slot machine spin. Dodge bullet storms, stack wild upgrades, fuse synergies into your own abilities and merge your guns to see how far your build can go.

name: Curator: Tidy Up the Sleeping Gallery!

details.title: Curator: Tidy Up the Sleeping Gallery!
details.short_description: Become the curator of a vast, magical museum! In this relaxing game, find the right place for over 3,000 paintings, restore damaged works and uncover their fascinating stories. Upgrade your curator, work faster and unlock new galleries!

details.title: Voretsk
details.short_description: Voretsk is a 3D First Person Extraction Shooter where you play as civilians trapped in the middle of a war zone. Alone or with a friend venture into the cruel Voretsk Zone, fight or hide, scavenge and get back. Complete missions, uncover a way out, and leave the Zone behind and reclaim your life.

details.title: Fantasy Guild Manager
details.short_description: Your heroes handle the fighting. Everything else is your problem. Recruit and level up adventurers, send them into auto-battles before quest timers run out, and grow your Guild Town in real time while Chaos creeps across the land.

details.title: Just Like the Photo
details.short_description: Someone turned these homes upside down. Now it’s your job to put them back together. Play solo or with friends and use photos taken before the mess to return every item to its original spot.

name: Kiel & Kontor – Vom Stamm zum Stapellauf

details.title: Kiel & Kontor – Vom Stamm zum Stapellauf
details.short_description: Manage a historical shipyard: design ships for customers, organise materials and skilled workers, negotiate contracts and expand your business. From simple rowing boats to great sailing ships, craftsmanship, quality and smart business decisions determine your success.

name: Skeletal Heroes: Attack of the Slimes

details.title: Skeletal Heroes: Attack of the Slimes
details.short_description: Six skeleton heroes, one bony adventure. Slash, shoot, smash and cast through 16 story chapters overrun by slimes. Swap heroes mid-fight to hit each monster’s weakness, unleash a super for every hero and topple giant bosses in this colorful third-person action RPG.

details.title: Blobbardment
details.short_description: Blobbardment is a turn-based artillery party game where every fighter is a blob of jelly. Swallow a bomb and spit it back, split in two, freeze the sea into a bridge, then knock your friends off the map. Play online, on one screen, against bots or in a story campaign.

details.title: Incremental POP: Fishing
details.short_description: A hoop net, fifteen seconds, a lot of fish. Every round you buy something sillier: harpoons, depth charges, a sea serpent, a whale. Keep going until the screen is mostly fish and the numbers stop making sense.

details.title: Pocket Post.
details.short_description: Deliver the mail. Pocket Post is a minimal strategy game about managing post routes.

details.title: Jarlfall: Strandhögg
details.short_description: Strike the shore before the tide turns. Lead Viking raiders through tafl-style battles on sinking boards, grab loot village by village, and sail home to grow your Great Hall before luck runs out.

details.title: Cityterium
details.short_description: Cityterium is a multiplayer voxel sandbox where the real world becomes your canvas. Choose a city, build freely, tear things down, and reshape it with others, one block at a time.

details.title: PAIN(T)
details.short_description: You have one job: paint the wall yellow. All of it. PAIN(T) is a co-op dystopian comedy for 1-8 colleagues sharing one shaky lift, with proximity voice chat. Whoever drives it ruins everyone's stroke. Buy bigger rollers, and try not to ask what the doors are for.

details.title: Not Your Keys
details.short_description: Not Your Keys is a Bitcoin roguelike deckbuilder. Draft NFT cards, evolve them into stronger forms, and fight junk coins, frozen exchanges, and the Federal Reserve itself across a 21-block run to The Final Block.

details.title: SALUS Protocol
details.short_description: You and up to three friends are part of an independent contract crew in second-hand war surplus mechs, doing the dirty work for large corporations. SALUS Protocol is a co-op roguelite horde shooter. Fight against thousands of enemies, build reputation and unlock better parts.

details.title: RUGGED
details.short_description: RUGGED is first-person survival for one to four players. Fell trees, haul logs back to camp, craft tools, and hunt for food. Build a cabin on your own or host your existing world for friends through online or LAN co-op.

details.title: CANON CANON CANON
details.short_description: Stack cannons on your units, chain their effects and hold the line! Defend your garden against waves of furious animals in this roguelite lane defense.

details.title: Breach Inc.
details.short_description: 3:12 a.m. The medical practice is encrypted, the extortionists are very polite, and your admin went for coffee. Run a tiny IT security firm through the night shift: stop attacks, pay the ransom or don’t, and grow your basement office into your own SOC.

details.title: Tower vs Zombies
details.short_description: The horde never stops, and neither do you. Place turrets, tune every aim and grow your arsenal to hold the city's last base!

details.title: Driftworn
details.short_description: Lead a squad of drifters through a solar system still broken by a decade old war. Fight, trade, salvage and build across the planets and moons of Sol in an open-world sandbox where nobody is the chosen one, then buy a ship and start your adventure

details.title: Lost Firmament
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious world of floating islands in this 3D Action RPG. Fight strange creatures, discover forgotten secrets, and forge your path through a world falling into ruin.

details.title: Crown of Rust
details.short_description: One mech against an entire royal court. Bolt weapons onto every slot, fuse them into something far worse, and hold the throne hall against waves of knights, cultists and hounds that never stop coming. A horde-survival roguelite about building the perfect war machine.

details.title: Up to the Sky's
details.short_description: A city builder with the depth of a colony sim. Settle a real region of the Earth, lead named residents through hunger and hard winters, and grow from a single tent to an industrial town across seven eras.

details.title: Penguin Inc.
details.short_description: Will you take the job? With humanity gone, penguins hold the mineral rights to the solar system and they need a manager! Liquidate planetary assets, research new tech, harvest solar power, and satisfy the shareholders. All of that on planets that won't go down without a fight. Mine. Profit. Repeat.

details.title: Chicken Trophy: Cozy Coop
details.short_description: A cozy idle coop for your desktop. Dock a flock of happy hens along any screen edge to lay, preen and potter about while you work. Collect eggs, hatch over 400 breeds and dress them in tiny hats, or open up the whole farm for mini-games and friends.

name: renal spring: Focus as a Kidney

details.title: renal spring: Focus as a Kidney
details.short_description: Hello. You are a dog's kidney. When you get to work, so does the dog's kidney. renal spring: Focus as a Kidney is a cozy productivity game. Keep an old man and his dog's daily life on your desktop as you work or study. Their lives unfold in real time, and your work keeps the dog healthy.

details.title: Lantern Town
details.short_description: Light every street of a cozy night town with exactly the lamp posts it needs. A calm logic puzzle: each post lights its street in four directions until a house or tree stops it. 520 towns, no timers, and a lantern town of your own to grow.
developers: Enaayah Software Development and Services Private Limited
publishers: Enaayah Software Development and Services Private Limited

details.title: Not The Face!
details.short_description: A dodgeball career, from recess to the championship. Draft a team of weirdos, crush middle-schoolers for lunch money, climb five leagues and survive the bosses: Timmy's Mom, Nonna, your own coach. Every ball to the face gets a close-up. 1 to 4 players on the couch, co-op or versus.

details.title: 江湖藏锋
details.short_description: Jianghu: Hidden Edge is a hardcore turn-based Roguelike RPG blending deckbuilding and inventory management. Lead your martial artists through the perilous grid map—will you risk all for legendary gear or retreat with your haul? Uncover the conspiracy brewing in Songhe Town.

details.title: Dungeon Shop Simulator
details.short_description: By night, fight through dungeons solo or in 4-player online co-op. By day, sell the loot in your own medieval shop: set prices, haggle with customers, and pay the blacksmith to upgrade your gear for the next, deeper dungeon.

details.title: The Last Iron Sentinel
details.short_description: A first-person zombie roguelike shooter. Humanity is down to one last shelter, and you are its last sentinel robot. Mow through hordes of 100+ zombies, freeze time to draft upgrades, turn your bullets into fire, ice or lightning, and rip chainsaws and missile packs off elites to bolt onto yourself.

details.title: Stick Wars: The Laneborn
details.short_description: A 2D stickman strategy game on three lanes. Minions and waves push on their own while you decide gold, deployments and upgrades. Allied champions, bosses that switch lanes and a 10 level campaign. The free demo has 3 levels and online 1v1.

details.title: Regret & Rewind
details.short_description: Welcome to 1989. In this retro style first-person job simulator You work alone in a tiny yellow drive-thru photo kiosk somewhere in suburban America. Customers want cassettes, family portraits, questionable passport photos... and memories they probably shouldn't keep.

details.title: Goblin Kaboom
details.short_description: A fast-paced casual auto battler. Raise your army, fortify your base and watch invading monsters splatter upon your defenses.

details.title: Farm Factory
details.short_description: Farm Factory is a cozy farming automation game. Plant six empty fields by hand, then build sprinklers, harvesters, mills, bakeries and conveyor belts until your farm runs itself. Research, upgrade, raise animals, sell on a living market and grow Grandma's farm into a factory that feeds the world.

details.title: Crafty Idle
details.short_description: Crafty Idle is a Minecraft inspired idle RPG where every skill strengthens the rest. Mine and craft your way to the strongest gear, take down monsters that each have their own weakness to exploit, and optimize your farming by chasing down the best genes. Progress never stops, even offline.

details.title: The Understack Society
details.short_description: Build a society of misfits, one card at a time. Stack cards to gather food, craft equipment and expand your settlement in this dark fantasy survival game. Recruit citizens, open mysterious parcels and explore new districts. Keep everyone fed, armed and alive.

details.title: TowerCard: Digital Edition
details.short_description: Gather resources, raise your tower across five stages, and follow Thomas on his journey through five worlds full of unforgettable characters. Play the story mode or quick matches against the AI – multiplayer arrives soon in Arcade Mode.

details.title: Totally NOT a Game
details.short_description: A corporate spreadsheet idle game where you climb the ladder from Intern to C-Suite by generating KPIs, automating busywork, and satisfying a Board that demands exponential results. Totally NOT a Game.

details.title: KEDR
details.short_description: KEDR is an extraction horror game where you take on the role of a trader in a vast underground complex. Avoid direct confrontations with monsters, search dangerous areas and rooms with extreme caution, use the creatures’ weaknesses to your advantage, and make it out of the complex alive.

details.title: Marsfall: Origins
details.short_description: A desert RTS: lead an armored expedition, build a frontier base, harvest Emburrn, command combined arms, and survive sandworms.

details.title: Dragon Jump
details.short_description: One button, one dragon, one desire. Finish every level as fast as you can to regain your human body. Practice, build or cheat using machine learning. In Dragon Jump everything is permitted.

details.title: Odyssey of Elemental Elysium
details.short_description: Five elemental realms. Decades of lore. One of the largest RPGs ever made. Experience the Odyssey of Elemental Elysium.

details.title: Alpha Draconis
details.short_description: Three civilisations, three worlds, one abandoned human experiment. Command the desert Tali and their living planetary web, the Nerros and their steam-driven exosuits, or the Phobarian hive and its bred swarms in a fully 3D real-time strategy game built on asymmetry, not reskins.

details.title: Diet Survivor
details.short_description: Survive the first day of your diet in an action-packed survival roguelike where junk food comes alive. Run, dodge, collect fruits, grab power-ups, and face dangerously delicious enemies that grow bigger, faster, and harder to avoid.

details.title: Draught King
details.short_description: The world's first pub-like. A deckbuilder where your cards are the ingredients - serve drinks to customers to meet an ever-increasing target, featuring crazy combos and insane effects.

details.title: Brute Tusk : Feral
details.short_description: Play a wild boar in an open wilderness: click to run and forage, right-click to dodge or wind up a charge—smash obstacles and send wolves flying. Eat your fill, pick evolution upgrades, and fight through four seasons to topple each land’s apex predator.

details.title: MONSTERGOTCHI
details.short_description: Feed and grow your own monster in the virtual pet game MONSTERGOTCHI! 😀 The type of pet you get depends entirely on you!😮 Explore a dangerous world, find food, and give it to them! 😍 Hurry up, IT'S HUNGRY!

details.title: Arcane Beyond
details.short_description: Arcane Beyond is a living magical world where players rise from humble spellcasters to legendary mages. Every action pushes you toward Radiance or Umbra, unlocking unique abilities, transformations, and story paths.

details.title: Matchward
details.short_description: Tower defense empowered by match 3 puzzle strategy. Level up and unlock potentially game-breaking upgrades. Design your own levels and share them.

details.title: SHIFTMARE
details.short_description: Stock shelves. Get promoted. Hunt your coworkers. SHIFTMARE is a competitive online party game for 2–10 players. Race to stock a supermarket, become a boss with a bat, or run and hide from the coworkers who beat you to the promotion. Be the last employee standing.

details.title: Orbit Foundry
details.short_description: Turn a handful of machines into a bustling factory around a growing star. Orbit Foundry is a space incremental idle game where you reinvest your output, research upgrades, and automate your fleet. Watch production climb as your star changes color.

details.title: Test Cricket Manager
details.short_description: Take managerial control of the National cricket team (of your choice) and prepare to take them to Glory! YOU pick and train the players, YOU hire and fire the staff, YOU choose the tactics under pressure, YOU get the glory when things go right ... but YOU take the blame when things go wrong.

details.title: Mad Combo Squad
details.short_description: The maddest combos you’ve ever seen! Mad Combo Squad is a classic, tactical in-line auto-battler featuring charming pixel-art heroes. Assemble your ultimate squad to create the perfect build.

details.title: Plants One Shot!
details.short_description: 《Plants One Shot!》 is a party game for up to 4 players. Your sect has been attacked by villains. To revive your sect and uphold justice, you must kill monsters and obtain better spells and equipment so that you can gain enough power to defeat the villains!

details.title: 再跑亿遍
details.short_description: Change & Run is a 2D side-scrolling construction simulation game. There are no shortcuts here. With the help of Code Girls, each with her own distinct personality and abilities, you will place code blocks to rebuild shattered terrain
publishers: 上海苍星昂霄网络科技有限公司

details.title: AL-SARAB
details.short_description: A PSX-style psychological horror game inspired by Silent Hill set in a distorted Gulf neighborhood, where familiar places turn hostile and every alley hides something wrong.

details.title: DON’T CAMP ON BEAR ISLAND
details.short_description: DON'T CAMP ON BEAR ISLAND! JUST DON'T DO IT! Stranded with 1-3 friends in online co-op, you have to haul your scattered gear up the mountain and build camp. The tent is heavy, nobody agrees which way is left, and something out there is listening.

details.title: Mr. Panas
details.short_description: Mr. Panas is an asymmetric multiplayer game for 3 to 5 players, where one player is a grumpy old man and the rest are invisible Whispers turning his house upside down. They have until morning to finish their chores. He can only use sounds, shadows and their trail of mess to catch them.

details.title: Gnom
details.short_description: The largest RTS you've ever played, and it's about gnomes. Grow a colony in an enchanted forest, get through nights that get worse each time, turn gnomes into giants or into swarms of nano gnomes, then go take the rest of the forest. Online co-op for up to 4.

details.title: Red Rust
details.short_description: As a tough Soviet KGB agent you travel around the world fighting street gangs and giant mechanical monsters on direct order from Comrade Stalin.

details.title: Tiny Kitchen: Burger Edition
details.short_description: Stack, flip, and drop your way to burger glory in this cozy physics-based cooking game. Whether you’re actively grilling or letting orders wait, Tiny Kitchen is perfect for focused breaks and relaxed chaos.

details.title: Not a Trolley Problem!
details.short_description: A trolley-problem incremental where morals gave way to growing numbers. Instead of choosing whom to save, you throw people onto the tracks yourself, earn coins, grow an upgrade tree and hunt for rare residents.

details.title: Over or Under
details.short_description: You have one job: make all 10,000 toilet paper rolls in this endless restroom face the same way. Your fickle boss won't say whether he wants "over" or "under" until you finish. Plunge clogs, mop spills, and pray the final 50/50 goes your way. Get it wrong and the shift starts over.

details.title: Withstand The Horde
details.short_description: Withstand The Horde is a strategy and base-building game. Raise a walled city, recruit soldiers and hold off waves of enemies: 4,000 zombies simulated, up to 1,050 drawn on screen. Includes a guided tutorial. Build, defend, expand, and withstand the horde.

details.title: BlastMorph: Pinball
details.short_description: I took pinball and VIDEO-GAMIFIED it! Where else can you play video game bonus stages and play from INSIDE the pinball table!?

details.title: Gridpaper
details.short_description: If you're shooting more than once, you're doing it wrong. At the junction of the physical and informatic realms, Gridpaper is a high-precision FPS headshot speedrunning game where missed shots are punished. Destroy brains, harvest their Informatica for speed, and climb the global leaderboard.

details.title: Odyssey Bridge Quest
details.short_description: Command a starship on the edge of known space. Pick your bridge officers, keep the ship alive, and face first contacts, derelicts and diplomatic crises where every order has a cost. A text-driven captaincy sim with branching episodes and multiple endings. What kind of captain will you be?

details.title: Planetbase 2
details.short_description: Colonize the Solar System. Command a group of near-future humans trying to establish a base on Mars and beyond. Grow food, mine resources, manufacture goods and face the challenges these unforgiving worlds will throw at you.

details.title: Wonder Air: Lunara's Adventure
details.short_description: “Wonder Air: Lunara’s Adventure” is a fantasy flying action game where players can freely soar through a beautifully rendered 3D world.

details.title: Real Estate Investor
details.short_description: Real Estate Investor is a deep, turn-based economic simulation focused on realistic property investing. Hunt for bargains, haggle over the price, and turn run-down flats into a thriving portfolio. Sign the deed, collect the rent, quit the rat race and become a property millionaire.

details.title: Roller Coaster Park Simulator
details.short_description: Build and run your very own Roller Coaster Park! Play alone or with up to 8 friends in online co-op. Design your own coasters, hire staff and serve your guests... or just mess around. There’s plenty to break, crash and blow up!

details.title: Shot
details.short_description: Stand your ground in a Western shooting gallery roguelite. Hit weak spots, shoot down incoming attacks, and combine perks into powerful builds. Face varied enemies and bosses in combat where precision, quick reactions, and every reload matter.

name: Little Beast in the Big Maze

details.title: Little Beast in the Big Maze
details.short_description: A fantastical, atmospheric Metroidvania platformer where you jump, fight, and expand your abilities to escape your exile and confront the beastly Queen who banished you. But will this fairy-tale end with you becoming a hero, or a beast?

details.title: Headwaters
details.short_description: A short fishing game early in development :-). Collect fish population samples for WDOE as you rebuild a once great public transportation network with the help of your new REALLY REALLY cool bird friends. Also unlock a bunch of new areas, fishing rods and upgrades!

details.title: Neuroma
details.short_description: A fast-paced vertical shmup where a living brain controls a combat ship to battle grotesque alien creatures across biomechanical worlds filled with massive bosses and intense arcade action.

details.title: Kaiju Ace
details.short_description: Pilot fighter jets against colossal kaiju in this combat flight simulator. Fly from the cockpit or chase view, and defend cities and convoys. Purchase aircraft and weapons in a persistent career with generated missions.

details.title: Project BOTNET
details.short_description: An idle tycoon about running an illegal bot farm inside a fictional MMO. Boot bots on virtual machines, farm gold, sell it to whales for real cash and reinvest in rigs, proxies and scripts, all from your oldschool desktop. Just keep the GMs from noticing.

details.title: M.A.Y.A
details.short_description: Take on the role of sci-fi warrior Maya. Capture uplinks, master a complex move-set along with weapon upgrades, and survive on a hostile planet.

details.title: Stranded in the Abyss
details.short_description: Stranded in the abyss is a shoot-em-up in a unique sci-fi sci-environment where you command a massive squad of ships in an endless war Against an evil rebellion. Shoot command and bomb your way through hundreds of enemy fighters, capital ships, and skirmishes.

details.title: Congratulations, You Failed!
details.short_description: Pilot a rocket through tough training courses in a physics-based arcade game where failure comes with commentary. Dodge machinery, deliver swinging cargo, and upgrade your rocket while an unimpressed announcer keeps track of your mistakes. Prove them wrong, eventually.

details.title: 4D Builder
details.short_description: A spatial puzzle game about building, folding and exploring shapes in four dimensions. Start with familiar 3D ideas, then tackle gradually more mind-bending 4D challenges involving construction, folding and colouring - or experiment freely in the sandbox.

details.title: Blobituary
details.short_description: A 2D party game for 1-4 players, on the couch or online. Shove, brawl and betray your way through 26 mini-games in the world where cute blobs go to die.

details.title: Ink or Not
details.short_description: Ink or Not is a competitive score-attack game where a grid appears and on it some of the squares have ink and some don't. Click on whichever squares there are more of before the timer runs out. When you click on all the correct squares you go to the next round and you have slightly less time.

details.title: Blue Dynasty:Town Defense
details.short_description: Blue Dynasty is a Medieval ARPG blending fast-paced Hack & Slash combat with strategic Tower Defense. Upgrade your hero's equipment, master a massive passive tree, clear deadly dungeons, and build impenetrable defenses to protect your kingdom from relentless hordes.

details.title: Mytheria
details.short_description: Explore the wilds, free the Keepers and take back Mytheria. A satisfying action adventure with building, automation and lots of loot. Craft, gather, discover secrets and expand your base. For 1 to 4 players, on the couch or online.

details.title: GYRE Grazeline
details.short_description: A neon endless tube-runner where flying close pays. Pilot a ship down an accelerating luminous tunnel, threading gaps that arrive faster the longer you last. Distance builds your score, near misses add to it. Skim the edges, hold your nerve, and beat your own best line.

details.title: Fewer Mornings
details.short_description: A short first-person game about everything you do before you leave the house. Unpack, cook, do the dishes, feed Saki, answer your mom, leave by eight. Five days in one apartment across twelve years, and there's never time for all of it.

details.title: Scrivo: The World Maker
details.short_description: Scrivo is a tiny guy made of crumpled paper, in a cozy game, exploring the scraps of a world that vanished long ago. Use a magnet to collect scraps and create hex tiles, then snap them together to build your own floating island. Complete quests, discover forgotten relics as your little world grows.

details.title: EXODUS
details.short_description: Step forward into EXODUS™ — a cinematic, single-player action RPG set in a new, far-future sci-fi universe. Rise from salvager to Traveler, discover new worlds ravaged by the effects of time, and search for the key to humanity’s survival across the most dangerous reaches of space.

details.title: Make The Dead Dead Again
details.short_description: Lux is dealing with a paranormal outbreak, and every loot drop could be a gun, a jacket or maybe a fresh dye job. She’ll prioritize accordingly. Clear the streets, then make her drop-dead gorgeous. Because the apocalypse is no excuse for a bad outfit.

details.title: Danu: Rise of the Templars
details.short_description: Danu: Rise of the Templars is an open-world MMORPG & co-op action RPG set in a fantasy medieval world inspired by the legends of the Knights Templar. Explore dangerous lands filled with mystery, battle powerful enemies alongside friends, and earn rare gear through PvE adventures & 4–8 player raids.

details.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
details.short_description: The final battle to decide the fate of the world has begun. Take to the skies, chart your course, and stand with your companions against Sephiroth one last time. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

details.title: Night Run EX
details.short_description: Race your motorcycle through an endless neon night. Hit checkpoints fast to build your multiplier to 99x, weave through traffic, and chase the ghost of the rider one place above you on the leaderboards. Ride and vibe to the underground electronic soundtrack in this first person arcade racer.

details.title: Nothing Was Deleted
details.short_description: A used laptop, €180, never wiped. Its owner is in Portugal, supposedly. His mail, photos and chats are all still here – and at 3:12 am something starts typing back. Horror played entirely on a fake desktop: five nights, four endings, and a cursor that isn’t only yours.

details.title: Plausible Deniability - Cover Your Tracks
details.short_description: A satisfying incremental game about breaking boxes, shredding paperwork, and upgrading your operation to keep up with an endless flood of documents.

details.title: Stolen Frequencies
details.short_description: Run a pirate radio station in this open-world life and business sim set in 1980s England. Collect 59 playable songs, secretly record gigs and stay ahead of the police. Explore eight towns, repair radios, build businesses and work towards your own music venue.

details.title: Hushwell
details.short_description: Hushwell is an atmospheric 2D metroidvania. For a hundred years, nothing has been born. Something deep below has woken you, the last small spark near the surface. Go down through fourteen areas, past old things grown vast in the dark, and find out why the world went silent.

name: Suck It Dry! with Your Friends

details.title: Suck It Dry! with Your Friends
details.short_description: Your boss wants the ocean empty. You get a teaspoon. Scoop, schlep and sabotage your way through an impossible job with up to 16 friends – but one of you secretly works for NEPTUN Resorts and wants the sea to stay full.

details.title: MAD: Mutually Assured Destruction
details.short_description: Turn-based 3D artillery with real physics and cinematic free-fly cameras. Every dollar is a choice: a bigger bomb or a better bunker. Nukes, B-52 carpet bombing, deformable terrain and 25+ battlefields from the desert to the Moon. 1-8 players: online, LAN or couch. Biggest crater wins.

details.title: Little Bear`s Honey Shop
details.short_description: Little Bear's Honey Shop is an incremental game where you battle magical plants, gather flowers and ingredients, and craft sweet honey products. Build powerful combinations on a honeycomb skill tree, sell honey to customers, and grow a tiny shop into a bustling honey empire.

details.title: Money Sweeper
details.short_description: Minesweeper with powers. Money Sweeper is a nerve-wrackingly tense roguelike chipbuilder where every search counts. Unlock powerful chips, combine wild synergies, and detonate massive cascades of riches

details.title: REFLECT89
details.short_description: Turn enemy bullets into your weapons in REFLECT89, a fast-paced arcade shoot 'em up. Master Perfect Reflections, unleash the Pulse Cannon or Pulse Radial, and climb the global leaderboards. Try the free demo now!

details.title: Striders
details.short_description: Plunge into the sea trenches and command an army of summoned allies. Upgrade you and your team, stack devastating synergies, as you overwhelm the relentless HORDE. Transform from a lone diver into an unstoppable force backed by an ocean of allies in this Vampire Survivors–inspired action roguelike.

details.title: Godsever
details.short_description: Long ago, humanity rose against the gods - and learned they could bleed. Hunt ten colossal gods alone or with up to two friends as the last of the Order: bind them, bleed them, and sever them, piece by piece. Learn every god, survive its cataclysm, and climb to Rank III.

details.title: Tower Reborn
details.short_description: Zar’Keth’s hordes are sweeping over the kingdom. Build and specialize your towers, lead your heroes into the fray and rain down your powers on hundreds of enemies. Then be reborn, come back stronger, and take back the kingdom!

details.title: Desert Struggle
details.short_description: Desert Struggle is a fast paced real time strategy game. It is about base building, production timing and attack waves. Units are fully automated, so there are no standing armies. It is all about production capacities, expansions and timings! Play challenges against the AI or online in PvP matches.

details.title: Vapor Strange
details.short_description: Select a Universe to explore. Then jump into bizarre psychedelic worlds, encounter surreal creatures, while experience shifting rulesets, and mini-games for a wild and truly strange experience.

details.title: Gnomonatics
details.short_description: Gnomonatics is a third-person action-adventure game. Explore an open island, solve ancient puzzle dungeons, and battle corrupted creatures with sword and crossbow as the shadows transform everyone around you.

details.title: Mine Mage Minion
details.short_description: A mining game where you play as a mage digging deeper into the earth. Gather resources, craft weapons and armor for yourself and your minions, defend your operation from enemy waves and bosses, and protect your underground colony from creatures trying to sabotage your progress.

details.title: The Creator: Live Together
details.short_description: The Creator: Live Together — a world built for creativity. Take on jobs, build your career, or create freely in Sandbox Mode. Design dream homes, craft cozy spaces, and play with friends.

details.title: Unmasked Truths: Shattered Dreams
details.short_description: 10 world-renowned experts are trapped together and must cooperate to survive... until conflicts arise, and they discover the greatest threat to their lives isn't the system they're resisting: it's each other! Discover the truth of who's living a lie in this fully voiced murder mystery adventure.

details.title: Ridiculous Racing: Retro Arcade Racer
details.short_description: Floor it into the ’80s. Thread the traffic, throw your car into a smoky slide, and hit the turbo toward 600 km/h as bold pixel-art worlds rush at you. Take the other branch next run, or settle it on the couch in 2–4 player split screen.

details.title: Lostade
details.short_description: Lostade is an arcade style ARPG about robots, character building, mystery, and mass Monsters annihilation that Focuses arround an Endless mechanic where each time you finish the game, it extend with new lore, maps, quests, enemies, items, difficulty and random events !

details.title: Ammo Garden
details.short_description: Bullet-Hell Roguelite where you Grow and Defend the last Farm in a Post-Apocalyptic Wasteland. Farm Crops, Upgrade Weapons and Kill every Creature that tries to invade your Farm!

details.title: Beyond 90: A Footballer's Life
details.short_description: Live the life of a footballer. Play every match yourself but never control the team. Live a footballer’s career from your first contract at 16 to retirement: 100+ hours, 775 clubs. Chase fame, money and love and face the consequences that follow you beyond the 90 minutes.

details.title: Leon&Suharto
details.short_description: In the Slums, people kill for a drop of noble blood. And Leon has it. Lies, revenge, a connection that bleeds, and a game that stares back at you. A dark episodic novel about those who survived — and are still paying the price.

details.title: Fractokinesis
details.short_description: This tiny robot tears planets apart. Rip chunks out of the ground, charge them with ice, lava, gas and acid, and hurl them at the monsters of the darkness. Every throw reshapes the arena. Every run is a new galaxy.

details.title: Cat's Fish Stall
details.short_description: Discover dishes, open specialty shops, and connect them through customer flow. Combine up to 3 ingredients with a cooking method, choose facilities and timed events, balance traffic against profit, and clear 8 market scenarios—or test your own operating plan in Sandbox Mode from the start.

details.title: The Silver Witch
details.short_description: Dead, and now an angel—but Heaven's rules feel wrong. Jailed for forbidden Hell magic, Uriel escapes with Ailena, a girl met in prison, to start a second life in Hell, the Land of Demons. A two-person turn-based dark fantasy RPG in an afterlife where neither salvation nor judgment can be trusted.

details.title: NimerWorld: Shadows of a Promise
details.short_description: Welcome to Valdix, a kingdom consumed by darkness. Rescue the kingdom's ducks and put an end to the plague. As you progress, everything becomes stranger. Will you be able to reach the top and overcome this challenging journey?

details.title: How Much is Happiness?
