details.short_description: Cowboy lizard roguelike with jobs, cards, and creature management. Build a ragtag team of varmints from over 50 weird jobs such as Gunslinger, Cactus, and Hotel Manager. Your team is your deck: think hard and play cards before each round to turn the tide of battle!

details.title: SwingHard VR
details.short_description: Dodge with real footwork against challenging bosses. Move your arms as fast as you can to do damage. Swing hard, move often, you'll need to exercise your mind and body to win in this boss rush dark fantasy VR action game. Git Gud, Git fit, Workout guaranteed.

details.title: Tiny Queendom: An Ant Terrarium
details.short_description: A living ant colony on your desktop. Build a glass terrarium of sand, water and plants, add one queen, and watch her family dig tunnels, forage, learn from danger and raise new queens on its own. Keep it in a small window in the corner of your screen while you work.

name: Black Otaku 2: Taekwondo is in my Blood

details.title: Black Otaku 2: Taekwondo is in my Blood
details.short_description: Join Sahara B. Shabazz as she honours that Korean man's sacrifice by winning this martial arts tournament with the Taekwondo that flows in her veins.

details.title: Idle Isekai - An idle RPG
details.short_description: Idle Isekai is a strategic idle RPG with roguelite elements designed for players who love managing complex growth systems. Whether you are battling fearsome monsters or meticulously managing your character's progression, the path to power is yours to define.

details.title: Cluck Up!
details.short_description: Climb from a farm all the way to the moon, where one missed jump can undo it all. Dodge lava floors, leap between skyscrapers, ride rockets through space, then storm Clawrence's castle. Grab the stolen eggs and try not to fall. Play solo or with 4 friends.

details.title: Soul Dust
details.short_description: A third-person bullet-heaven roguelite where six factions wage war around you. Parry and brawl the horde, let your build do the killing, or mix both. Play hands-on, hands-off and break the game.

details.title: Star Shift Freelancers
details.short_description: In a galaxy where loyalty is tested and alliances shift like stars, Captain Max Triton and his crew find themselves embroiled in a sea of treachery. When their own government betrays them, Triton and his crew must forge their own path, or lose everything.

details.title: Cafe Simulator
details.short_description: Build and decorate your shop, diversify your products through alliances, and make the right investments to expand your business.

details.title: Epsylon - The Guardians of Xendron
details.short_description: A private eye mystery game where you decide how to solve the case. Use your detective skills to solve the case or rely on the abilities of your little dragon partner to see things from a new angle.

details.title: Super Bio-Man
details.short_description: Super Bio-Man is the ultimate gunslinger and the guardian of our galaxy. Using his arsenal and metal fist, he shows the invaders from outer space - who's the boss here.

details.title: Ibboran
details.short_description: The Empire is aflame! Lead your fantastical troops through a 15-battle, turn-based strategy campaign. Build your army by achieving objectives to fill your Treasury. Recruit mercenaries to tilt the battle in your favor and use your General to improve your units or blast the enemy. To war!

details.title: The Main Menu
details.short_description: The Main Menu is a psychological horror thriller where you wake up trapped in a room with only a corrupted main menu to interact with. Changing the menu physically changes the room around you. Manipulate its buttons and hidden systems to solve puzzles and uncover what controls the screen.

details.title: ジグソーローグ
details.short_description: A deck-building roguelite where jigsaw puzzle pieces are your weapons. Master the "placement" and "combination" of pieces with unique abilities to claim victory. The game system is simpler than it looks — easy to pick up and play.

details.title: PINZ
details.short_description: PINZ is a 1–4 player co-op Extraction Roguelite FPS where every run is a complete rescue expedition. Explore dangerous planets, rescue eggs, strengthen your team between missions, and defeat massive planetary bosses.

details.title: Choo Choo Defenders
details.short_description: Build your track, assemble your train and deliver cargo and carnage in equal amounts in this on-the-rails take on tower defense!

details.title: Chaos Orbit
details.short_description: Fight through a machine-controlled orbital station in this fast-paced action roguelite. Master precision mouse-aim combat, unlock powerful mutations, and battle deadly robotic enemies as you push deeper into the chaos.

details.title: Paradoxical
details.short_description: Portals are physical objects. In this mind-bending puzzle game, portals can be carried, repositioned, and used to create impossible connections through space. Uncover the fate of a desert world that sought salvation through portal technology.

details.title: City God Alice：城隍愛麗絲
details.short_description: Cursed with only a year left to live, serving her in this City God temple is the only way you can stay alive long enough to uncover the truth behind the curse.

details.title: Unfathomable Titans
details.short_description: A turn-of-the-century transportation management game in which you control the world's largest cargo shipping company. Connect ports, deliver cargo, cultivate relationships, and adapt your business all while trying to avoid getting fired.

details.title: Rampart
details.short_description: Build and upgrade towers, defend your fortress from the growing onslaught. With each wave, the challenges become more difficult, but a smart strategy and the right decisions will help you endure and prevail!

details.title: Retromine
details.short_description: Retromine is an ultra-satisfying tough-as-nails deckbuilding roguelike. Delve into the caves, mine resources, and escape before the caverns collapse! Spend your ore to buy new cards, upgrade your deck, and discover powerful combos on your way to the bottom of the world. Dig, die, learn, repeat!

details.title: Scattered
details.short_description: Scattered is a short adventure where you explore a tropical island as a cat in search of a litter of hidden kittens. Discover paths to remote locations, dig up pirate treasure, and seek out perfect sleeping spots. Upgrade your skills and show them the way back home.

details.title: Tales Of Eight
details.short_description: Tales of Eight is an action roguelite, naval battle game. As one of the last pirates you are fighting against the dreaded Feline Empire. Fight on the high seas with customizable magical canons, upgrade your ship, explore the ever-changing ocean, and trade with factions all to save Piratedom.

details.title: PERFECT SNAP: Ultimate Jigsaw Puzzles
details.short_description: Turn any image into a 3D jigsaw puzzle! Solve solo or with friends (co-op & PvP), display your masterpieces in a customizable 3D museum, and visit everyone else's. Personalize your character and take on the 100-level campaign, from easy puzzles all the way to 1000 pieces.

details.title: TOBARI and the Vampire Alchemist
details.short_description: I want to be your friend. But I want to eat you… Discover the end of a twisted friendship in this story driven adventure. Deep in the forest, an alchemist hides a monster: Tobari. Gather silver coins. Find a cure for an incurable disease.

details.title: Mine or Burn
details.short_description: Start with a basic mining ship and snowball into an asteroid-crushing powerhouse in this incremental bullet hell roguelite. Mine asteroids, battle rival miners, stack upgrades, create powerful builds, and survive escalating threats across dangerous star systems.

details.title: Melt Down
details.short_description: Melt Down is a slime racing game where you are on a clock to reach the finish line. You are melting: small is fast, big is slow, and you have to finish the race before you turn into a puddle. Dodge hazards, fight off your rival slimes with powerups, and finish before you perish.

details.title: Unwritten World
details.short_description: An MMORPG where every item matters and all systems connect. Encounter emergent events, a monster may steal your drop and attempt to flee, a slain monster drops a seed that instantly grows into a harvestable tree. Train life skills, hunt, craft and climb leaderboards that reshape the Unwritten World.

details.title: DRONES
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build the enemy's deck, not your own. In this physics-based auto battler, you choose which monsters invade and discard the ones you can't counter. Buy, equip, and position autonomous drones, then watch them fight. Find the synergies that save the solar system.

details.title: Cook The Dungeon
details.short_description: Cook the Dungeon is a first-person roguelike deckbuilder where every fight feeds the next. Descend through branching paths, forage for herbs, hunt strange creatures, and build a deck of Cuts, Preps, and Seasons. Land precise cuts, harvest monster parts, and cook meals for the battles ahead.

details.title: The Postman Cometh
details.short_description: Deliver mail in a strange little town in the middle of nowhere. Meet a colorful cast of villagers as you try to figure out what happened to the previous postman.

details.title: Refrain: Verse of Fate
details.short_description: A garden caught in eternal recurrence. A god who forgets everything. A witness without rest. In this narrative-driven 2D exploration game, walk, listen, and read your way through four cycles to piece together a truth hidden beneath the surface.

details.title: Strawberry Cafe
details.short_description: Build your own strawberry cafe and farm in this cozy, casual management sim. Grow strawberries for customers to pick, or harvest your homegrown strawberries to cook delicious strawberry-themed food and drinks. Complete missions and keep customers happy to unlock new furniture and recipes.

details.title: Exil Island
details.short_description: Rob a cartel that took over a whole island, in this top-down survival shooter. Play solo or online: scavenge, build a base, clear their checkpoints and fight soldiers, wolves and other players. No zombies. Just a cartel that always moves back in.

details.title: On Fighting Shadows
details.short_description: A narrative JRPG about fighting shadows outside and within.

details.title: Bus Station Simulator
details.short_description: In Bus Station Simulator, take over a forgotten bus station and bring it back to life - solo or in co-op! Take care of passengers, your fleet, and the infrastructure as you transform a rundown terminal into the beating heart of Winston Springs.

details.title: Super Robot Survivors
details.short_description: A Roguelite Bullet-Heaven where you rescue astronauts, repair reactors, and hack terminals while blasting hordes of robots in high-stakes, 10-minute showdowns. From the Creative Director of Destroy All Humans! 2 and co-creator of TY the Tasmanian Tiger.

details.title: Power Off One
details.short_description: You're Sparky, the smallest part inside a giant dying machine. Solve mechanical puzzles to keep its failing chambers alive, and uncover why you were really sent to save it.

details.title: WingsSimulations Flight Simulator 2027
details.short_description: Fly anywhere on Earth with realistic weather, detailed aircraft, and thousands of airports. Design your own planes, tackle landing challenges, and experience full-fidelity flight simulation without the usual performance cost.

details.title: Pigs On Wings
details.short_description: Pigs On Wings is an open-world cooperative flight sim featuring extraction mechanics and global guerrilla warfare. Work together to pilot a temperamental aircraft: battle ground forces, deliver cargo, repair systems, and upgrade your gear.

details.title: The Forgemage
details.short_description: An auto-battler roguelite of rune-forged magic. As a Forgemage, carve runes and chain their power into your spells until they break every law of magic. Walk into the horde alone and unleash what you forged.

details.title: Shattered Souls
details.short_description: Hell hath no fury like a woman scorned, and you will not forget the betrayals inflicted upon you. With a mark that ties your fate to seven men, you’re determined to lay waste those who tried to shatter you. Will you try again?

details.title: Bloody Shrine
details.short_description: Bloody Shrine is a twin-stick horde survivor roguelike where you build a growing Shrine on the battlefield, forge dark pacts and shape every run through cards, tokens, and blood.

details.title: Starry-巡星之旅
details.short_description: 为了打倒毁灭世界的大魔王，少年和少女们踏上长长的旅途，开启了一段跨越两个世界的恋爱、幻想奇谭。 本作品搭载了中日语的文本和配音，L2D动态立绘以及超过200张的基本CG；此外还有立绘触碰等独特系统。

details.title: Synthwave Dice TD
details.short_description: Roll the dice, defend your tower, build your deck! Synthwave Dice TD is a neon-drenched roguelike tower defense where every roll matters. Demo: Pure roguelike TD action. Full Game: Adds deckbuilding with 5 playable cards that manipulate your dice fate!

details.title: The Outcast Bloom
details.short_description: Build an ever-growing defense network, meet and level loyal companions and discover a deep loot system. Featuring many different enemy types, abilities, environmental affixes and card choices.

details.title: CHILDREN OF SATURN
details.short_description: A found footage coming-of-age story about a group of teenagers growing up under an orange sky.

details.title: Exofactory
details.short_description: Exofactory is a chill factory automation game where you play a forgotten AI on an alien world. Clear the forest or build around it. What you automate changes your tech, the world, and the AI's own voice.

details.title: Earth Parasite: Silo
details.short_description: Post-apocalyptic, underground mining adventure, exhilarating bullet-hell shooting, mild SAN loss, mild Cthulhu, hand-painted art style, casual action sci-fi game.Escape from the underground shelter and uncover the truth behind the fall of human civilization.

details.title: Dark Omen
details.short_description: Push back the encroaching darkness and the Architect's foul designs, then return to rebuild your village and reunite its people. Forge powerful artifacts and arrange mystical Omens to shape your next build as you battle relentless hordes and bosses in this low-poly Action RPG Roguelite.

details.title: Foodgitives
details.short_description: Foodgitives is a 1-4 player couch co-op physics arcade game where you're food on the run! Tilt and roll through restaurants as murderous utensils attack to the beat of 1930s big band jazz. Coordinate with friends to survive the chopping block or master the mayhem solo.

details.title: Disc Out!
details.short_description: Harness the power of magical discs to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles, and uncover secrets in this top-down Disc Golf adventure. Master your timing, level up your skills, and meet a colorful cast of characters as you help Cary, a talking bag, on his quest to save Paradisc Island!

details.title: Sakichan - Track Of Fury
details.short_description: Join Saki-chan, the fierce shark girl, on her wild ride to conquer Earth! Race through deadly tunnels, mow down Tentamons, and chase after rebellious traitors. Customize Saki-chan with cool costumes and relax in the interactive massage room. Ready to unleash her fury? The chase is on!

details.title: SPACEROCKS
details.short_description: Mine asteroids, find rare loot, upgrade & modify your ship, build space factories, and destroy your enemies!

details.title: Kanka
details.short_description: Kanka is a 1–4 player co-op sci-fi action RPG / third-person shooter. Complete missions on SP-01, fight hostile factions and alien creatures, explore its strange regions, loot and craft, shape your character build, and work together to find a way home.

details.title: Mandated Fate
details.short_description: You are a police inspector in a totalitarian state. Follow or subvert the rules without letting the state discover what you really believe. In this dystopian alternate history thriller, navigate a technocratic empire where loyalty is survival. Make brutal moral choices, save or sacrifice lives.

details.title: Vega Chronicle
details.short_description: Lead your civilization to galactic glory in this bite-sized 4X strategy game. Build, colonize, trade, and, by tact or might, overcome all who oppose you.

details.title: FMV - Full Motion Voyeur
details.short_description: Full Motion Voyeur is a dark FMV thriller where you're trapped in a nightmare of surveillance, obedience, and sacrifice. Guided by the mysterious ADMIN, Claire is ordered to investigate targets, uncover their secrets, and feed them to a Demon or her lover Mona pays the price.

details.title: Frogspin
details.short_description: A wind-up frogventure bursting with colorful platforming and roguelike surprises. Spin the slots, master precision jumps, and rack up points. Ready to leap into action? 🐸

details.title: Hermit Computer
details.short_description: Hermit Computer is a horror-puzzle game set in 2001. Deep within the Hermit Kingdom, you play as an outsider tasked with extracting critical intelligence using a secretive state-controlled computer operating system.

details.title: Neon Fragments
details.short_description: Neon Fragments is a first-person shooter set in a dystopian near future. In a world where humanity crumbled under its own weight, there is not much left but despair and loneliness. How far are you willing to go for your only glimmer of light in this cruel world.

details.title: Rhythm Rat Rampage
details.short_description: Rhythm Rat Rampage is rhythm-meets-bullet-heaven. Dodge to the beat and shred your enemies in a music-driven gauntlet of chaos, speed, and style. Fight your way to the leaderboards!

details.title: Dwelling on the Hill
details.short_description: A devout man built his house on top of something older than scripture. He tried to seal the passage. He failed. Now you are inside, and the door is locked.

details.title: Cluepuff Adventures
details.short_description: A cozy puzzle adventure across floating puzzle dimensions, with Cluepuff, a curious little companion you can talk to. Flip gravity, ride arks, open gates and find every puzzle piece, then build your own levels and share them with the Community.

details.title: Misnomers by Nick Oueijan
details.short_description: A preposterous word game where you create a recursive language, one word at a time! Laugh (or cry) as you define each word from other words and your decisions snowball beyond expectations. Decipher definitions, discover drawings, then use your save file to translate the internet!

details.title: Space Arcade
details.short_description: A 3D arcade space shooter where you defend your base against endless waves of enemy ships. Earn credits, buy upgrades and perks between waves and fight Boss Waves a every few waves. Play alone, in split screen with up to 4 players on one PC, or online with friends.

details.title: Tic Card Toe
details.short_description: A Turn Based Strategy Roguelike with Deckbuilding elements that transforms Tic-Tac-Toe into a High-Stakes Combat Tournament!

details.title: Wetter
details.short_description: Step into the paws of Luna and explore a rain-soaked archipelago. Uncover pieces of your forgotten past and decide which memories will shape who you become.

details.title: Saintess of the Golden Bow
details.short_description: Trapped in a time loop as the Saintess of the Golden Bow, every choice matters and every death is a second chance. Use knowledge from past timelines to unlock new paths and strengthen bonds in this otome visual novel. Can you rewrite fate, or are you bound to relive despair forever?

details.title: Tokyo Ramen Drifter
details.short_description: A driving roguelite inspired by Japan's 90s street racing scene. Deliver ramen, upgrade your car, and challenge rivals on mountain roads across Japan.

details.title: Velo Victory
details.short_description: Velo Victory is a new cycling management PC game. Build your legacy through scouting, transfers, facilities, staff, and tactics. Shape future champions, meet sponsor goals and lead your team to victory.

details.title: CyberZ: Energy Wars
details.short_description: CyberZ: Energy Wars is a fast-paced third-person shooter PvP. Every match drops you into a war zone where two things matter: your aim and your economy. At the start of each round, spend your earned credits on weapons and gear or save up for something devastating next round.

name: World of Dynasty: Shadows of Sagas

details.title: World of Dynasty: Shadows of Sagas
details.short_description: Dynasty World: Shadows of Tradition Epic MMO with survival elements and RPG. A fugitive from a destroyed dynasty, you enter the magical world through a flaming obelisk. Fight, solve the secrets of dungeons and create a new great dynasty in the harsh world of magic and warrior!

details.title: Cain & Iddo: Break Week
details.short_description: Join Cain & Iddo in this cartoony action platforming adventure! Traverse through 12 levels with 16 bosses on the quest to have the best Break Week ever, against all odds.

details.title: Legacy of Ashes
details.short_description: Dive into a horror adventure where you solve puzzles, explore a mysterious island, battle vicious dinosaurs, and escape terrifying chases—all while uncovering the hidden goals of Nova Corp. Secrets await at every turn.

details.title: Wild World: Online
details.short_description: A multiplayer third-person werewolf action game. Be the tank who guards and soaks up the damage, pull rivals in with Gravity, or vanish and strike from the shadows. Alone or with your pack, forge your own playstyle. So, how will you hunt?

details.title: Jigrift
details.short_description: You crash onto the shores of a long lost island! This strange land is a gigantic jigsaw puzzle that you must assemble to explore. Earn your place among a tribe of three-eye’d voodoo frogs and put the island back together. They’ll allow you to stay if you succeed!

details.title: Hats and Guns
details.short_description: Become a cardslinger in this roguelike deckbuilder with tactical elements. Fight, gather weapons and items, face unexpected events and upgrade your cards for hundreds of possibilities. Every run is unique and so are you, the best shot of the Far West looking for your upcoming revenge.

name: One Nation Under the Old Gods

details.title: One Nation Under the Old Gods
details.short_description: A Rogue-lite Deckbuilder set in early 1800s United States. Play as members of a secret organization that investigates occult activity in an effort to stop various cults from summoning Eldritch Gods. Acquire cards to create combos and synergies to defeat your enemies in turn-based combat!

details.title: We Need An Army
details.short_description: A tactical roguelike where your entire army moves as one! Shift your formation, line up powerful bonuses, and discover ridiculous combinations of units, relics, and battlefield upgrades.

details.title: Macaron Sickness
details.short_description: Welcome to a dreamlike world where gothic elegance meets sweet delights. This macaron tower balance game is made for lovers of all things gothic. When you're feeling down or need a little sweetness, build your own fragile and beautiful macaron tower—just for you.

details.title: Blotbarrow
details.short_description: Odin sacrificed the gods to thwart Ragnarök. Now you're what's left. Tear through the Nine Realms in this fast-paced, hack and slash roguelite. Wield legendary weapons. Gain the powers of the fallen gods. Die. Come back stronger. Die again. Storm the Blotbarrow and end the All-Father.

details.title: No Prospects
details.short_description: Build railways deep into monster-infested caves in this online co-op horror game. Work together to mine valuable ore, fill your minecart, and upgrade your equipment as you venture into increasingly dangerous depths.

details.title: Silent Hunt
details.short_description: Play as detective Jacques Renaud sent to a remote island in British Columbia. Investigate disappearances on Mist Island. Explore the island on foot or by car. Hide, fight and survive the threat that lurks in the forest. Protect the local population and put an end to predators that should not exist !

details.title: Dead Miles
details.short_description: Dead Miles is a 3D co-op horde shooter where your vehicle serves as a mobile base that you can equip with weapons and upgrades. Explore dangerous locations, fight massive hordes on foot and behind the wheel, and grow stronger through survivor-like character progression.

details.title: Desting Clash
details.short_description: "Desting Clash" is a roguelike card game similar to Monster Train, where you will control heroes from different countries and eras, build your deck and hero team, challenge numerous monster levels, and become the strongest Fatebearer!

details.title: Sliding Dungeons
details.short_description: Slide, survive, and escape a deadly dungeon full of traps, monsters, bosses, and weird villagers.

details.title: Timber trail
details.short_description: You take over as the new ranger overseeing the infamous Timber Trail, a trail known for mysterious disappearances and the Timber Trail Murders.

details.title: Artisan Acre
details.short_description: Artisanal Culinary Simulator: Craft aged cheeses, vintage wines, sourdough bread, and gourmet delicacies in your own workshop through manipulation of seasonal temperature and fermentation - to supply the newly annexed territory and help rebuild your nation after The Great War.

details.title: Mercy Incore
details.short_description: Solo indie character-action. You are a medieval knight in a techno-dimension. Become a jet-boosted vampire to survive. Follow a full-metal spaniel to escape

details.title: DesktopSaurs
details.short_description: Turn your desktop into a dinosaur battleground! Defeat waves of enemies, earn rewards, and create devastating builds in this idle RPG. Adapt your strategy, defeat powerful bosses, and conquer prehistoric eras. All while you relax, work, or browse the web!

details.title: Dark Horizon
details.short_description: Dark Horizon is a single-player survival FPS game that takes place in Russia. After a near-fatal accident, your squad-mates have been killed, and you are deserted in the middle of a deadly conflict fueled by the city's government. Will you escape, or choose to thrive in the city until it falls?

details.title: Beards vs. Claws
details.short_description: Dig tunnels, build bridges, and blast your way through walls towards victory in this highly dynamic arena first-person shooter - every obstacle is a potential door

details.title: Leaf Us Alone
details.short_description: Build a powerful army with synergistic abilities, and prove your strategic mastery in this unique deckbuilding roguelite. Command your forces in battle, triggering outrageous combo to defeat the invading Voidlings threatening to consume the world.

details.title: Stambria
details.short_description: Enter Castle Norstam as a young man searching for a cure for his sick father. Work in the stables, talk to the locals, complete favors, gather ingredients, and use alchemy to navigate a web of castle obligations and dependencies.

details.title: Pilot Tycoon
details.short_description: A pilot career sim-rpg where you climb from regional first officer to mainline captain. Bid for schedules by seniority, handle emergencies through quick-time events, manage finances and stress, and build your reputation with decisions that can make or break your career.

details.title: Car Crime Simulator
details.short_description: Steal cars, set up secret stashes, sell vehicles for big profits on demand, or strip them for parts. Build your criminal empire solo or team up with others in co-op mode.

details.title: UpperCart
details.short_description: UpperCart is a chaotic physics-based arena brawler where toy cars roll out of the drawer and fight for bedroom glory, solo or with up to 6 players. Punch, crash, wreck the other toys, and stay in one piece before the kid’s hand cleans up the mess.

details.title: TAKE THEM DOWN
details.short_description: Combine weapons and abilities in this fast-paced, violent action game to take down necromancers, demons, and betrayers while avoiding being cleaved and crushed by blades, traps, and mines sprawled across nightmarish, macabre levels. NOT A ROGUELIKE, game features handcrafted levels.

details.title: Become
details.short_description: Become is a short single-player third-person adventure where you embark on life's most fantastical journey, as one of millions of sperm. Survive the perilous microcosm, wiggle, dash, and outcompete rivals through the human reproductive system to create new life.

details.title: Annalynn MD
details.short_description: Annalynn MD is a falling block puzzle game that hearkens back to similar titles of the 16-bit era. Twist, turn, and take out germs in three different game modes as you help Annalynn make the world just a little bit healthier.

details.title: Returnless
details.short_description: Eyeball Gun is your weapon. Use it to fight shadow enemies, manipulate time, and escape a city consumed by black fog - no pause, no checkpoints. Progress is saved at the end of a run.

details.title: Kingsbane
details.short_description: Raid gothic fortresses in a 2D action-platformer RPG. Choose from heroes with distinct fighting styles, hunt for rare gear, and defeat the infernal kings. Replay stages to try new routes and builds. Play solo or team up with up to three friends in local or online co-op.

details.title: Pitfalls 64
details.short_description: Take on a brutal, platforming gauntlet in Pitfalls 64! Clamber upwardly as a homesick gnome in search of his way back home, butt proceed with caution; one careless slip could spell a hard bonk back to the bottom...

details.title: Hack Fate
details.short_description: Hack Fate is a fast-paced hack-and-slash game with Chinese cyberpunk pixel art. Manipulate the timeline, switch identities, and kill enemies in one hit. Turn traps and foes into weapons and find multiple routes through every level. Ancient myth meets cyberpunk, each choice defying fate.

details.title: SubDuctis
details.short_description: Traverse a puzzling metallic landscape by folding away space itself. Bypass obstacles, form conductive paths, and discover new areas by folding, unfolding, and folding again.

details.title: Cardinal Descent
details.short_description: Cardinal Descent is a card building roguelike where you craft elemental synergies and find game breaking sticker combos.

details.title: UNCRACKED
details.short_description: Crack your enemies with an arsenal of weapons and various tactics in this 2D egg-splosive, gore-filled, yet kid-friendly action platformer, teeming with splattering yolk and shattering eggshels and survive the fierce cage wars.

details.title: Rules: Motel Horizon
details.short_description: Work the night shift at a remote motel where monsters wear human faces. Check in suspicious guests, uncover hidden rules, and survive 14 nights where every decision could be your last.

name: Scavengers of Mars - Rover Survival Simulator

details.title: Scavengers of Mars - Rover Survival Simulator
details.short_description: Drive a damaged rover across Mars, scavenging wrecks and mining ore to upgrade it. Every find has to fit a tight cargo grid, and every trip runs on sunlight, so a dust storm or a cold night can decide whether you push on or head back to an outpost.

details.title: Lightyears of Fervent Warfare
details.short_description: Modern old school action with explosive firepower. Rack up kills to upgrade your ship. Use your tech skills wisely. Collect the best loot. And dominate the skies with space shotguns, homing swarm missiles and chain lightning! This is a work-in-progress passion project! ETA November '26!

details.title: NTD: New Tower Defense?!
details.short_description: Active tower defense fused with a twin-stick shooter. Build your defense grid & become the death machine that exterminates the B.O.R.C infestation, one roguelike run at a time.

details.title: Nocturnals: Cacti Coast
details.short_description: A narrative-driven, choose-your-own-adventure game where a young survivor must make difficult decisions in order to survive the foggy wasteland of Cacti Coast and find a community to call home.

details.title: Super Kart Blast
details.short_description: Super Kart Blast allows you to experience a unique way of kart racer with customizable karts, special combat maneuvers and powerups. Play with AI bots, friends or competitors!

details.title: Plush Time
details.short_description: Plush Time is a 1-6 player online and local multiplayer party game where cuddly meets chaos! Customize your adorable plush, then throw down with friends or AI in a wild board game packed with ridiculous minigames guaranteed to wreck friendships and spark hilarious mayhem.

details.title: IT BEGAN
details.short_description: IT BEGAN is a single-player tactical horror shooter set in a sunken world of cults, monsters, and your own fears — where escape is no longer an option.

details.title: Lost Hearts
details.short_description: A horror game inspired by the works of M.R. James. Explore Aswarby Hall to uncover your family’s secret history. Decide the fate of your ancestors by re-living each ghost’s last day on earth, with several endings for every story. Lift the family curse and save yourself… if you can.

details.title: Spider Dynasty
details.short_description: Play as a spider free from traditional platforming limits. Crawl across curved surfaces, web-swing through a web-woven aerial kingdom, battle corrupted creatures on uneven platforms, and uncover the secrets of two royal dynasties and the fall of the silk civilization.

details.title: The Way of the Ace
details.short_description: Compete for dominance of the court and experience the thrill of volleyball! Serve, receive, set, spike, and block your way to victory! Do you have what it takes to be the ace?

details.title: Mobile Phone Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Build and manage your own mobile phone shop! Buy, sell and expand your business in this detailed simulation game. Balance profits, manage your team, and become the best shop in town.

details.title: 天工骇客 Shadow Hacker
details.short_description: Tear through cyberpunk defenses with kung fu and tech in this 3D roguelike fighter with comic-book style! Play as a skilled "cyber-ghost" employee, tearing through the Penglai Corporation's defenses with traditional kung fu, high-tech weaponry, and ancient magic.

details.title: My Name Is Vincent Pogo
details.short_description: Play as Vincent Pogo, a famous performer who is sent on an adventure upwards to the Royal Kingdom. A physics-driven platformer where every jump counts as you bounce and balance your way through a hand-crafted world full of challenges and goofy characters.

details.title: Astropark
details.short_description: Astropark is a single-player VR game where you explore the Solar System through interactive, science-based missions. Adjust gravity, launch rockets, and discover real planets in a fun, educational, and non-violent space adventure.

details.title: World Tree Defender - Tower Defense
details.short_description: A mazing tower defense. Every tower is a tetromino-style hex piece that bends the path: rotate it, drop it on the grid, wind the swarm into a labyrinth and keep the World Tree alive. A campaign across biomes with ancient guardians, solo or with friends.

details.title: Chumaky
details.short_description: Chumaky is a game about traveling, trading, farming, and building your own homestead. Discover mysterious locations and enjoy atmospheric landscapes.

details.title: SMU News: Strange events recorded
details.short_description: In this game, play as Shenming University News Department members. Explore strange incidents—no need for truth. Write compelling reports from clues; eye-catching content excites readers. As for what really happened…do readers actually care? If you care, go find out yourself.

details.title: Blast Bebop
details.short_description: Blast Bebop is an easy-to-pick-up action-incremental game, combining dodging, shooting, collecting, and upgrades, set to retro pixel visuals and psychedelic music for a short, relaxing combat experience.

details.title: Autonomous Air Combat
details.short_description: Autonomous Air Combat is an arena action roguelite missile-heaven where you pilot a fighter jet in a digital combat simulation. Create synergistic builds featuring different projectiles, modifiers, and stackable passives as you fight off difficult waves of enemy forces.

details.title: Golgothian
details.short_description: Build a three-hero party in a dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Queue actions, read enemy intent, trigger class combos, equip survivors, and choose routes through doomed dungeon runs alone or in co-op.

details.title: Cascade
details.short_description: A real-time roguelike where every move starts a chain reaction. Push enemies, manipulate tiles, combine elements, and turn status effects into opportunities.

details.title: Tutorial Hell
details.short_description: Tutorial Hell is a first-person comedy game about a tutorial that wants you dead. I'm Nigel. I'm a chicken. I'm contractually required to teach you the controls. The first lesson is PRESS W TO MOVE FORWARD. Please press W. Nothing bad will happen. Trust me.

details.title: On The Ramp
details.short_description: Your rival is right there. A ramp. Dozens of meters of air. Suspension at its limit. Touching down at 140. You started with 120 horses and a cheap frame. Race to get noticed. Build the rest.

details.title: Rogue Wheels
details.short_description: Rogue Wheels is a turn based roguelike deckbuilder where your car is your character and timing driven combat defines every run. Build fun and crazy decks!

details.title: Trifoil
details.short_description: A puzzle game about drawing lines that cross, merge, and interact in unique ways. Uncover secrets, decipher symbols, and trace paths that satisfy every rule.

details.title: Gloom Punks
details.short_description: Not your average co-op roguelike. Where the price for power is death, and you’re trapped in a gloom-scape of fever dreams and fairytales gone feral, you can only rely on Punks like yourself. Cheat death, bounce back, and take on a world that so badly wants you dead!

details.title: Anachron
details.short_description: What if Joan of Arc fought alongside Blackbeard? In Anachron, you weave a dream team of 4 historical heroes to clash in a tactical, turn-based Arena. Build a custom deck for each champion from their unique abilities and unleash history-defying combos.

details.title: Pinetrail
details.short_description: Deliver packages across Pinetrail in an overloaded rusty rickshaw truck! Meet the locals, uncover mysteries, and explore beautiful hidden spots. Use your vehicle's unique abilities to cross rivers, glide over trees, and battle cargo-stealing boars!

details.title: Core!1!
details.short_description: Core Miner is a cozy incremental mining adventure where every swing takes you deeper into Earth. Break rock, collect ores, relics and pet eggs, upgrade your tools and build powerful loadouts on the journey toward the planet's core.

details.title: We Don't Exist
details.short_description: A single-player, first-person psychological horror game. You wake up in a facility where every room wants you dead and a voice records everything. The worst trap is the other subjects: trust them, betray them, sacrifice yourself? Training modes playable by two, online or in split screen.

details.title: Hellkick
details.short_description: One kick, one survivor. HELLKICK is an early 2000s inspired lightning-fast two-button fighter: divekick your way down the circles of Hell, snap spines in x-ray FATAL KICKS, and duel on arenas that fight back. No combos to memorize! Every single hit is death, yours or theirs.

details.title: Purrgeist
details.short_description: A cozy-spooky ghost-catching incremental. You're a little cat with a spectral vacuum: explore a haunted mansion room by room, suck up ghosts, harvest essences, sell your loot, and pour it into a massive talent tree. Short runs, satisfying progression, and always one more.

details.title: Derelict Planet
details.short_description: Derelict Planet is a retro-inspired top-down action RPG. Survive on a harsh alien planet, battle dungeon bosses, solve puzzles, complete quests, and search for new weapons and abilities.

details.title: Incremental Garden
details.short_description: A short incremental game about a magical garden. Grow wonderful flowers, earn money, buy upgrades, and roll the gacha to discover rarer plants! Over 30 unique plants are waiting for you!

details.title: Focus My Deer
details.short_description: Focus my Deer is a game that helps you stay focused on your real-life work! After every focus session, you gain energy which can be used to bring back plants and trees to the land. As the forest grows, animals will come to visit! Learn about the animals and help them on their quests.

details.title: When Two Roses Collide
details.short_description: A BL visual novel set during the War of the Roses. Will love prevail over honour?

details.title: The Ones Who Answered
details.short_description: When a catastrophic global anomaly known as "The Knocking" drags you into a nightmare dimension, you must fight to survive. Play as YouTuber Pisty and team up with an ally, Perm, to escape a four-layer hellscape. Solve puzzles, evade terrifying threats, and defeat the creator of this twisted world..

details.title: Fantasy Meat
details.short_description: Fantasy Meat is a stress-free cooking game where fantasy creatures are the main ingredient. Cut and assemble them on a skewer as you please, satisfy increasingly more demanding customers, and send out adventurers to find the tastiest creature: The Golden Drake!

details.title: Console Dealer
details.short_description: Run a secondhand games shop in 2003, where every sale is a negotiation. Read the customer, hold your price or fold, buy low across the counter and at auction, and keep a shelf that moves before the rent comes due. A first-person shop sim about haggling, stock and margins.

details.title: Tame or Conquered
details.short_description: Marry or die?! Isekai'd as a cursed saintess, choose between 7 yandere red flags or become a big tree! Watch them lose control over their ego & composure as they finally crack and turn into yanderes who ruin the world just to keep you.

details.title: Kayak Photography Sim
details.short_description: A meditative kayaking and photography sim. Open water, a slow boat, and nowhere you have to be. Paddle until you feel like stopping, photograph whatever catches your eye, dive underwater to explore what's down there. Nothing chases you. Nothing is timed. You're just chilling and exploring.

details.title: Sneaky Eraser
details.short_description: Class started… a bit boring. Wanna play Eraser War? Let’s go! Sneaky Eraser is a turn-based physics party brawler for 2–6 players. Take control of your eraser—aim, charge, and launch! Knock the others off the desk, and you win. It’s that simple~

details.title: BLASTARD!
details.short_description: Blast your way through walls, enemies, and your own friends! Grow absurdly powerful by placing kegs, kicking them, leveling up, and stacking loot into wild builds as you fight your way through each run!

details.title: Mall Security
details.short_description: Co-op physics comedy for 1–4 mall guards. X-ray shoppers, yell orders into your mic, chase shoplifters and throw them in the cell. Every broken window goes on your report, so try not to get fired. Or switch sides in Thieves vs Guards PvP.

details.title: Solitaire
details.short_description: Unwind with Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid and TriPeaks. Choose a deal by difficulty, take your time, and enjoy the simple pleasure of putting the cards in order, with hints and undo whenever you need a little help.

details.title: Ground Drone Operator: UGV Simulator
details.short_description: Co-op combat UGV simulator. One drone - several operators. Configure your ground drone for the mission and split roles between platform, weapon station, and equipment. Run robotic assaults, escorts, supply runs, evacuations and raids behind enemy lines.

details.title: The Nightmare Arena
details.short_description: The Ancients have awoken! Face their wrath in The Nightmare Arena, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Journey through the Realms collecting cards and facing endless waves of enemies.

details.title: Yolings
details.short_description: Yolings is a puzzle platformer about sacrificing some to save the rest. Possess individual characters, use self-sacrificing abilities and turn their deaths into puzzle solutions to save as many as possible for the highest score.

details.title: Tug-O-War Wrestling
details.short_description: Grab the rope and fight for control in a physics-based wrestling game where every move pulls your opponent with you. Master momentum through Season Mode or battle friends and random opponents locally and online.

details.title: Hollowtone
details.short_description: A game you can play BLIND from start to finish... Meet Serene™️'s newest digital therapy model: N.O.R.A.! Hollowtone is a first person audio-based navigation horror game. For possibly the first time ever, CHOOSE to play with graphics OR blindfold yourself for a unique audio experience.

details.title: Space Burger
details.short_description: Run a burger joint in zero gravity with your friends. Jetpack around a tiny spaceship, stack floating burgers, feed chatty aliens and keep the place in one piece while meteors, fires and hull breaches tear it apart.

details.title: GigaTroubleS
details.short_description: A unique giantess girl-themed exploration and puzzle work which integrating the depth of the plot and the diversity of gameplay. the past and present of the protagonist are pieced together. Three character storylines with completely different gameplay and multiple endings.

details.title: BLOCK13
details.short_description: Block13 is a first-person psychological horror exploration game. On a calm afternoon, you step into a weathered Hong Kong public housing estate. Wandering its hazy corridors, unsettling secrets emerge. The deeper you go, the more it entangles you. Unravel its mystery to break free.

details.title: Finnish middleschool simulator
details.short_description: In this simulation, you can live the life of dreams. The game is completely open world, and besides attending school, you can also customize your moped, drink alcohol, and enjoy the sauna. If you’re not in the mood for school, you can tell the teacher to fuck off and come to school drunk.

details.title: Cave Clicker
details.short_description: Mine rocks to collect rare ores to become the richest Mole alive, and looking good while doing it too!

details.title: Space Cat Digger
details.short_description: In Space Cat Digger, you will mine resources, build machines, upgrade your equipment, and try to get the highest score possible within a limited time. Play your own way, manage your resources, optimize, automate… while something strange begins to awaken

details.title: Jade Cutting Simulator
details.short_description: Your grandfather has retired. The jade workshop is yours to run. Guide the saw along your own line and rinse the cut to see what's inside. Sell a good stone to fund your next find, or keep that streak of green for a bangle customers will remember? The future of the shop is up to you.

details.title: Hellscums tactics
details.short_description: Hellscum Tactics features tactical turn-based combat. Party based gameplay with character progression, and dungeon crawling.

details.title: Momentigrade
details.short_description: A fast-paced 3D Metroidvania with a focus on stylish, momentum driven movement. Chain together jumps, dashes, wall kicks, and pole swings as you explore a colorful interconnected city and climb into the clouds. Fight creatures, discover secrets, and see how long you can keep the flow going.

details.title: The Fifth Name
details.short_description: A claustrophobic psychological mystery visual novel. On their high school graduation day, an anonymous message draws five friends back to their empty middle school. The doors won't open, and their memories refuse to agree. A complete 1-2 hour story with three endings, built to be read twice.

details.title: Stone to Stars
details.short_description: Stone to Stars is a colony sim and ruler simulator set at the dawn of civilization. Settle an uncharted continent, build a thriving settlement, discover new technologies, trade or wage war with your neighbors—and hold on to power as you guide your dynasty through the ages.

details.title: Sneaky Pig: Druid Hide & Seek
details.short_description: Scout the village as a bat, disguise yourself as an animal, and steal valuable treasures without breaking character. Outsmart rifle-wielding Hunters in a chaotic multiplayer twist on hide-and-seek.

details.title: Unyverse
details.short_description: Unyverse is an Afrofuturistic RPG With Fighting Game Mechanics Where Your Fists, Choices, and Inner Power Change the Fate of a Galaxy.

details.title: No Gasoline
details.short_description: Carry an Atom Bomb for the Union! Build your vehicle and battle your way to the Mountain of Basil. Scavenge for parts, solve puzzles, and deliver the last hope of the labor bots!

details.title: Wukong Survivors ：God Slayer
details.short_description: Wukong Survivors" is a TPS + ROGUE game where players control Sun Wukong and his friends, sweeping through all visible enemies and rescuing their captured master.

name: Story in the Dream World 1 -Volcano And Possession- Remake

details.title: Story in the Dream World 1 -Volcano And Possession- Remake
details.short_description: hello! I'm South Korean, One Man Game Creator Nuriverse! This game series is made up of many traditional stories from East Asia.(Mainly the Korean Peninsula.) Thank you for stopping by!

details.title: DDD: Dice, Dungeons, and Drakes
details.short_description: Master a unique tactical board-game battler! Roll to summon monsters and watch your dice disassemble into road-tiles to forge a path to the enemy Lord. Balance Summon and Action dice, manage crest inventories, and cast powerful spells to crush the rival Lord in DDD: Dice, Dungeons & Drakes.

details.title: The Legend of Wijaya
details.short_description: Experience a story-rich, classic 2D action RPG steeped in 13th-century Java. Play as Raden Wijaya using fluid hack-and-slash combat, archery, and magic. Outsmart the traitors and invading Mongols and forge the largest empire in Southeast Asia.

details.title: Are You Mental?
details.short_description: You are a night shift guard at the prestigious F.U. Asylum, check whether the patients are sane or not by talking to them and looking into their diary, just DO NOT LET THE INSANE OUT!!!!!!

details.title: AAA Island Hotline
details.short_description: AAA Island Hotline is a cozy desktop idle farming game. Create one-of-a-kind creatures through a magical crossbreeding system and build your own island world. Let it quietly keep you company on your screen.

details.title: JAMA POKER
details.short_description: JAMA POKER is a strategic deck-building card game. During each match, you can discover and arrange JAMA cards, and elevate your gameplay by mastering the unique interplay of the five elements—Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth—where each element generates or counters another.

details.title: Taverntasia
details.short_description: Manage your very own tavern as a wizard! Host guests from diverse races. Brew special magical drinks with potions and herbs, and serve delicious meals. Keep your customers happy with quick and quality service. Build your reputation, earn money, and take your tavern to the top!

details.title: Those UnderHex
details.short_description: A strategy roguelite about rebuilding the portal lands. Reveal dark hexes with beams of light and bring supplies home. Protect your workers, combine tower weapons and face successive monster waves. Each night, your people need food and shelter.

details.title: Torin's Greed
details.short_description: Torin’s Greed is a FPS dungeon crawler that combines mining mechanics with combat. Players navigate through underground environments, utilizing both a pickaxe and firearms to progress. Fight difficult bosses and get rich.

name: Haedong Bisa: Secret Records of the East

details.title: Haedong Bisa: Secret Records of the East
details.short_description: On a land in flames, whose fate will fall? Set in 1597, you are a warrior caught between invaders and court intrigue. Your choices decide your path—be a blade that saves lives, or walk a road of ruin. A Joseon martial arts narrative RPG.

details.title: Space Pizza Express
details.short_description: A funny arcade space-action game about delivering pizza across the galaxy, where the perks include zero-gravity working conditions and unlimited cheese snacks, and the risks include stolen pizzas, flying hazards, and unhappy intergalactic customers.

details.title: Obliteration Quest
details.short_description: Deliver utter obliteration through unique synergies, fully procedural and destructible environment and 4 unique characters in this hack&slash action roguelite. choose between 7 elemental power ups, lots of items and passive upgrades and destroy anything in your way.

details.title: Butterfly: Twisted Thread
details.short_description: Butterfly: Twisted Thread is a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania where you use a mystical butterfly to draw platforms, objects, and attack tools into the world. Explore interconnected areas, solve physics-based puzzles, fight enemies, and unlock new paths through creative drawing.

details.title: BlightMist Idle
details.short_description: Every drop feeds something. Ore becomes ingots becomes gear becomes power. Monster parts become permanent power. Seven classes, six life skills (just in Act 1 alone), talent trees, card collection, and much more — all compounding, while you're on and offline.

details.title: Off Tape: Welcome
details.short_description: Stock the shelves. Watch the cameras. Tell the humans from the things wearing their faces. Decide who to serve, and eliminate the rest. Off Tape: Welcome is a retro horror shop sim where you run the store for the Tobacconists, owners who don't know you exist.

details.title: Shadows of Beginnings
details.short_description: Explore fractured realms, battle fearsome enemies, and rebuild Novum in this dark fantasy action RPG. Gather resources, upgrade your gear, develop your class, and seamlessly switch between isometric and over-the-shoulder combat as you fight for a world on the brink of being swallowed by the void.

details.title: Trust me, Officer
details.short_description: Scissors, Stamps, and Signatures. You're a brilliant (possibly) forger who creates passports, visas, and official documents for people the system has turned away. Cut out stamps, forge signatures, retouch photos, and put every document to the test before handing it over.

details.title: Kuaiban!! Magical Girl
details.short_description: Your phone is the clapper — wave it, and the party starts. A motion party rhythm game: beat duels, photo-booth co-op, and a single-player story across China. Scan a QR code to play with friends — no app to download. Turn any screen into a party, magical-girl story and all.

details.title: TwinLock
details.short_description: TwinLock is a two-player cooperative puzzle adventure set in an abandoned gothic castle. Separated inside its halls, you and your partner have nothing but a walkie-talkie each. Every puzzle hides half its answer on the other side of the wall.

details.title: Lords of the World
details.short_description: Develop your city, expand your armies, and send your kingdom's elite agent across the world to complete dangerous missions.

details.title: Project Longshot
details.short_description: Build a space program that reaches the stars in this 1:1 scale spaceflight and colony sim. Design rockets and fly them with real orbital mechanics. Land anywhere in a procedural universe of over two million real star systems, then set up space stations, colonies and factories. How far can you go?

details.title: Out A Space
details.short_description: Out A Space is a fast-paced, top-down space roguelike combining arcade action with tactical fleet management. Deploy your fleet on a pre-battle grid, customize ship loadouts, and chain weapon effects to shatter enemy armadas from your flagship as you cross the galaxy to uncover an ancient secret.

details.title: Outspin Champions
details.short_description: Outspin Champions is a local competitive PvP / Co-op brawler where the spinning never stops. It blends party-game chaos with Souls-like precision, mastering physics-driven weapon weight to deflect foes. Outspin. Outsmart. Outlast.

details.title: For The Witch
details.short_description: For The Witch is a cute fantasy top-down tower-defense roguelite. Protect a sleeping witch from mosquito swarms, develop both the soldier and the witch, combine mechanic-changing items, and awaken them into new effects to hold out through each night.

details.title: Dyeversion
details.short_description: Dyeversion is a color-routing tower defense. Drag liquid hoses from color sources to your towers, mix colors to forge powerful COMBO towers, and route your pipes around the enemy path. Battle dozens of levels, earn tokens, and unlock a deep skill tree.

details.title: The Witch Simulator
details.short_description: Experience the life of a witch in a medieval village, co-op or solo! Gather ingredients, hunt monsters, brew potions to solve villagers' problems while keeping your magic hidden from the Inquisition. Build your reputation, earn passage into the kingdom, and overthrow the Grand Inquisitor.

details.title: Luck in the Dark
details.short_description: Luck in the Dark is a turn-based roguelike with slot machines and backpack management. Pack your bag to improve your odds, spin the reels, and find your way out of the dark.

details.title: REDHAND
details.short_description: A psychotic-horror (psychological, surreal survival horror) with dark, oppressive atmosphere, brutal action and grotesque creatures.

details.title: Hexing
details.short_description: Build a living dungeon one hex at a time. Place monster camps, shrines, and traps, grow a few goblins into an army, and hold back endless hero waves in this roguelite tower defense deckbuilder. Then gamble blood to hex your camps into monsters.

details.title: Chirp Chirp
details.short_description: One lost little bird, one big climb back home. Chirp Chirp is a lighthearted precision platformer where every jump, chirp, and butt stomp brings you one flap closer to the warmth of your cozy nest.

details.title: Souls on the Line
details.short_description: Become a Spirit Summoner and lead an army of Souls in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Collect strange entities with unique abilities and lead them in position- and sequence-based combat. Thwart the plans of a kingdom obsessed with dark magic by stealing their sinister Artifact.

details.title: LOOPFANG
details.short_description: A snake roguelite where your body is your arsenal. Collect weapon segments, fuse matching neighbors into higher tiers, and reorder them until they react with each other. Then close a loop with your own tail: everything trapped inside dies.

details.title: The Five Monks
details.short_description: A settlement simulation about five monks who survived a burning monastery and set out across the continent. Generate a world, gather scattered companions, and raise a new sanctuary from the ashes. Rebuild a broken world with the hands of those who survived.

details.title: GOLF TRIP
details.short_description: YOU ARE THE DRUG. Show off your accuracy while controlling an experimental substance designed to strip away human will. High skill, instant restarts, and zero room for error. DELIVER THE DOSE. DON'T FAIL. THIS IS GOLF TRIP.

details.title: BLIGHT SWARM
details.short_description: BLIGHT SWARM is horde-building action roguelite where you invade Earth as an alien hivemind and run a planetary infection campaign. Turn civilians into zombies, merge your minions into stronger abominations, evolve your Beast, and spread the Blight across the globe.

details.title: Hitflag
details.short_description: Arcade car chases on real city streets: grab the flag, ram whoever carries it and escape, on Istanbul's Taksim, New York's Times Square or any street you pick on the map. Then race, wreck or run down the dead. 2 to 8 cars, online or with bots.

details.title: Mechanized Wonder: Lost Unit
details.short_description: Fight across battlefields in the name of freedom from those who are bound and weighted down by gravity in this FPS simulation game, where you pilot a giant Mechanized Combat Vehicle from within an enclosed cockpit.

details.title: Solitary Singleplayer Offline MMORPG
details.short_description: Run an MMORPG guild in this incremental management game. Recruit new members, upgrade your guild, promote leaders to automate the busywork, and grind for the best gear. All to earn the Server-First achievements for every raid.

details.title: murmures
details.short_description: murmures is a narrative exploration game. Clara is doing everything she can to stay emotionally stable, but something is following her. Explore, search, roll your d20s and help her find a way out.

details.title: Survivor of the Meow Kingdom
details.short_description: Gameplay:​ A 3D pixel-art roguelike action-adventure game. In an endless sea of choices, discover powerful card-based upgrades, forge your own path, slay monsters, save the empire—or challenge yourself to the limit in endless mode.

details.title: Wild Boar Digging
details.short_description: A small relaxing game where you control a wild boar collecting resources. Upgrade the attributes of you wild boar and find a diversity of interesting animal cards. You can even recruit bees to help you!

details.title: Vanslinger
details.short_description: Fast-paced FPS with bullet time, short replayable levels and intense action-packed combat

details.title: Paint Me Back
details.short_description: A cozy narrative adventure set in a very particular museum, where the great masterpieces of art history have lost their colors and their protagonists. Help George restore the paintings, bring the missing characters back and discover what forced them to leave their paintings...

details.title: The Backrooms Experience
details.short_description: The Backrooms Experience is a cooperative exploration and survival-horror game built around observation, discovery, and the unknown. Enter liminal environments alone or with others, document what you learn, and survive encounters with the entities hidden within.

details.title: Juicy World
details.short_description: A high-octane 3D adventure crafted by a unique duo: a 3D artist and an AI programmer. Take control of a fierce grey rabbit and smash hordes of mutant vegetables in a vibrant stylized world. Pure action and hand-crafted visuals packed with heavy guitar riffs!

details.title: Keelhauled
details.short_description: Sink your friends in fast-paced top-down pirate combat. Line up devastating broadsides, dodge deadly hazards, and unleash game-changing powerups in chaotic sea arena battles for 2-6 players.

details.title: Not a Dog
details.short_description: What will the world look like on behalf of a cute little dog driven by a cherished wish? Will you follow your dream or stay with your beloved owner, find a new life, or greet the dawn with your loyal friend?

details.title: WarVara
details.short_description: A dark survival action game set in a world overrun by infection. Progress through story-driven levels, complete objectives, fight infected enemies in close combat, and use stealth to eliminate threats.

details.title: Headshot Holdout
details.short_description: BLAST NAZI ZOMBIE HEADS (with friends)! Headshot Holdout is a retro, roguelite, FPS where squads of 1-4 start with only a rifle and build into zombie killing machines. There are no automatic weapons and no bullet sponge enemies. Strategy and accuracy are key.

details.title: The Great Exhibition
details.short_description: You are the head curator of a museum. Gather ancient artifacts to expand your collection by raiding temples of long-lost civilizations with your friends.

details.title: Sand and Glory
details.short_description: Your father is dead. His gladiator school is yours, and so are his debts. Buy, train and arm a stable of fighters, and lead them through brutal real-time arena battles. You have 60 days to reach Rome’s Grand Games. Fail, and a senator takes everything.

details.title: XTREME PEACEKEEPER FORCE: OPERATION BLITZ
details.short_description: A retro-inspired top-down vehicular shooter where you weave through danger, unleash heavy weapons, rescue POWs, destroy enemy forces, and battle explosive bosses across fast-paced, arcade-style combat missions.

details.title: Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop
details.short_description: Build and run your own arcane workshop. Explore a dangerous fantasy world, gather rare ingredients, grow magical crops, craft powerful potions, manage your shop, and fight with blades, bows, and spells—alone or with friends in co-op.

details.title: Slumber Craft
details.short_description: Slumber Craft is a narrative deckbuilder about insomnia, pressure, and self-repair. Plan activities by day; build poker-style hands by night, from high card to full house, chain scores into Sleepiness. 21 nights, branching endings, and an Endless Mode asking how long you can keep weaving the dream.

details.title: Multincremental
details.short_description: Juggle interconnected minigames in a multitasking incremental where your performance in one affects all the others. Earn promotions, unlock new challenges and abilities, and climb from intern to the top as the whole office gets harder to manage.

details.title: WorldLoop
details.short_description: WorldLoop is a story-driven RPG about cycles, sacrifice, and irreversible choices.

details.title: A day at preschool
details.short_description: Welcome to A Day at Preschool. Care for the cutest yet most troublesome creatures—human toddlers. With strange requests and emotions that turn into tears, use light logic and simple puzzles to organize everything and guide them through a chaotic but adorable day.

details.title: Dawn of the West
details.short_description: Fight for control of the frontier in this competitive multiplayer Wild West FPS where precision gunplay, tactical movement, and class synergy decide every match. Capture objectives, master stamina-based traversal, and dominate the frontier through pure skill.

details.title: Falling Up
details.short_description: Falling Up is a 3D adventure game, your goal is to get to the top of the mountain. There will be a lot of challange duration your trip, you have to either beat them, or be sneaky. Don't be frustracted when you fall from the mountain, you are leveling up each time you fall.

details.title: RoRX
details.short_description: A competitive strategy game where both players plan in secret, then every order resolves at once. Build an army of Robots from over 200 cards, fight on hexagonal arenas and outthink your rival, not outclick them. Every card is earned by playing.

details.title: Drift
details.short_description: Drift is a narrative sci-fi horror adventure set on a desolate deep-space outpost. With your mission gone horrifically wrong, you face an unspeakable, monstrous foe. Explore the station's dark recesses, restore failing systems, survive terrifying encounters, and confront your own tormented past.

details.title: Moeblade Formula
details.short_description: Moeblade Formula is a turn-based tactical game. Command a cast of distinctive units and battle across multi-level terrain with elevation differences. Combine weapons and positioning to unleash stylish combos, defeat powerful enemies, and claim rich rewards.

name: 赝作 心灵推演 Others

details.title: 赝作 心灵推演 Others
details.short_description: 这是真冬工作室开发制作的第一部AVG游戏。你将在徽市的校园中，与各位少女邂逅，体验青春恋爱喜剧，并随着日常生活中的种种事件，逐渐探寻出这个世界最真实的一面。

details.title: Snowboard Rogues
details.short_description: The snowboarding roguelike. Master your riding skills to survive all threats in a procedurally generated ski resort. Inspired by 90s' FreeSki and modern Roguelikes.

details.title: Poopnauts
details.short_description: Four astronauts teamed up to fix spaceships using... poop? 1-4 players co-op. Every ship is different, so you never know what you will find inside. Finish the job, sell the scrap, and stay away from whatever else is on board. Get to work, poopnaut!

details.title: Jest Messters
details.short_description: A comedy-mystery otome (GxB) visual novel full of dad jokes, cringe puns, and an unexpected mystery! Come and join the pun!

details.title: School Guard
details.short_description: 💼 You took this job to save your family. Now you have to survive it. 🔍 Scan students. 🚫 Confiscate contraband. 🏗️ Build your empire. 🌙 Patrol the night. But when the sun goes down, the school reveals what it's been hiding—🧟 zombies, 🔥 fire, and 👻 a ghost that never left.

details.title: Blux
details.short_description: Engage in a non epic adventure of slimy goodness - Shoot, loot and level up your skills! Create your own weapons and play style by combining the heck out of all these skills we were too lazy to balance properly.

details.title: Doterra Industries
details.short_description: Doterra Industries is a 2D factory-building sandbox about exploring a strange mineral world, building production lines, and slowly turning a rough outpost into an automated industrial network.

details.title: Residue Of The Lost
details.short_description: A cursed spirit from your past life has slipped into the modern world with your reincarnation. As a sorcerer stripped of all memory, uncover the truth within a single house, reclaim your forgotten powers, and prepare for the confrontation awaiting you. The real fear begins here.

details.title: Democracy Manifest
details.short_description: Hijack the vote in this 3-7 player social deduction brawl! Juggle with ideologies to play your cards perfectly, rig elections through deals, bribery & manipulation and backstab your closest friends to get ahead.

details.title: Riftbound Survivors
details.short_description: Riftbound is a survivor-like bullet heaven focused on spell combinations and massive enemy waves. Defeat thousands of enemies, experiment with elemental chain reactions, and break the game with overlapping status effects. Play solo or in co-op.

details.title: DIVEBOMB: Weaponized Racing
details.short_description: Realistic driving meets weaponized vehicular combat. Shoot straight, lay traps, and drive fast to win. Fight for victory in this high-octane, high-stakes combat racer.

details.title: Crystal Vein
details.short_description: The "Crystallization" a disease where crystalline veins course through the body, eventually encasing it entirely in crystals. A girl, afflicted by this illness, embarks on a journey to find a place of salvation. A 2D action adventure game about loss and coming of age.

details.title: Undying War: Gate Of Pioneer
details.short_description: Undying War: Gate of Pioneer is a subculture-style multiplayer brawl action game where unique characters clash in real time. Enjoy fast-paced and thrilling battles that unfold within five minutes.

details.title: Call of Donuts
details.short_description: Race solo against the clock or challenge your friends in a hero shooter where you and your teammates share the same ammo pool while dodging traps and defeating minions. Join forces or face off in up to 8 teams of 1–3 players on a procedurally generated map where every match is a brand-new adventure.

details.title: 代号: Gabby's adventure
details.short_description: Gabby's Adventure is a 3D sandbox adventure game. In this game, uou will play as little Gabby who were brave and whimsical , embarking on an adventure to save your home.

details.title: みちくさワンダラー
details.short_description: The Demon Lord and the Hero are gone. With no mission to fulfill, no world to save, you hunt as you please, eat as you please, and travel as you please. It’s an RPG where you are free to do anything.

details.title: Rap Mogul
details.short_description: Sign artists. Negotiate deals. Build your empire. Manage a roster of unique artists, navigate turn-based contract battles, and watch every relationship evolve through a dialogue system where characters remember everything.

details.title: Aiyoe's Secret Room
details.short_description: Locked-room mystery meets sweet romance in this immersive visual novel! Solve tricky chamber puzzles and meet lively girls. Dynamic sprites, multiple endings shaped by your choices. Want more? The official anime adaptation is on Crunchyroll. Search X&Y for extra stories!

details.title: Dolls made here
details.short_description: You find yourself alone in an abandoned doll factory, assembling and inspecting dolls because you needed the money. Each order ends with the sense that they should never have been shipped, but leaving is no longer an option.

details.title: 遗物路：Relic Road
details.short_description: Relic Road is a roguelike turn-based tower-climbing game centered around equipment and relic building. As players continue to explore, they can recruit various heroes to expand their team, obtain equipment from heroes, encounter different events, and strengthen their forces.

details.title: Kundara: art of cards
details.short_description: Kundara is a frenetic and artistic elemental card roguelite game featuring combat against enemies in a theatrical kabuki adventure. Activate the power of cards, collect artifacts, and form alliances with spirits in an adventure across the five nations of Kundara.

details.title: 雨声 Rainy Days
details.short_description: Rainy Days is a short campus visual novel with 2+ original soundtracks, 10+ illustrations and a 30,000-word storyline. Play as the protagonist to encounter Yu, a mysterious girl, and start a sweet youthful campus rom-com. Make choices to alter the plot, unlock hidden stories.

details.title: Rings of Heaven
details.short_description: A multiplayer roguelike action platformer with a focus on teamwork and cooperation. Play as angel vtuber Amai Lilia and friends and take on heaven's deadliest gauntlet, the Rings of Heaven.

details.title: The Pink Robot
details.short_description: The Pink Robot is a fast-paced isometric action roguelite with deep build variety and fluid combat. Create powerful synergies through skills and mementos, and face relentless challenges that grow stronger with every run.

details.title: Valehands
details.short_description: A cozy incremental management sim about guiding dwarven crews through their daily work and bringing their valley to life.

details.title: The Lost Study
details.short_description: A forgotten study. Lost because no one remembers it. Solve puzzles, recover stories, and restore it — one chapter at a time. 14 stories, 14 worlds. Cozy, eerie, funny, and strange. They seem completely unrelated. Until they're not.

details.title: Crazy Islands
details.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where unpredictable events turn every round into pure madness.

details.title: SuperBird
details.short_description: SuperBird is a roguelike deckbuilder starring birds and bugs. our cards crawl, grow, and even devour one another. Learn each bug’s quirks, build around them with powerful trinkets, and time your plays to perfection under the arena spotlight. Climb your way to the top and claim the crown!

name: Car Wash Together: Prologue - Early Days

details.title: Car Wash Together: Prologue - Early Days
details.short_description: A free introduction to the full version of Car Cleaner Simulator is your chance to make dreams come true in a fabulously clean business. Run a car wash for Clever Emma in Winston Springs.

details.title: Heather's Haunted House Party
details.short_description: While trying to plan a party that’s to die for, a high school queen bee finds she has an uninvited guest that is much scarier than your average teenage girl. A Visual Novel about gossip, grief and ghosts.

details.title: Voidfall
details.short_description: Epic space strategy with 4X elements. Digital implementation of the printed board game by Mindclash Games. Base Game holds the competitive mode with 20 Scenarios and 14 playable factions. 1-4 players. AI opponent with 4 difficulty levels. Cross-platform and live and asynchronous gaming.

details.title: The Eternal Experiment
details.short_description: The Eternal Experiment is a first-person horror game set in a collapsing futuristic lab. A deadly creature hunts in total darkness. Survive by managing your inventory, crafting, and creative problem-solving as you navigate the lab and fight to escape with your life.

details.title: HandFoot
details.short_description: Inspired by 80s and 90s trash horror, HandFoot is a chaotic 3rd person action game where every gun is also a melee weapon. Shoot, smash, throw, climb, and sneak through gore-soaked battles with bullet-time, stealth gameplay, and puzzle-solving along the way.

details.title: Dominar Sanctum
details.short_description: Why just command your army when you can join the fight? Build your fortress, command your minions, and possess your hero to unleash third-person combat in this dark fantasy fusion of dungeon management, RTS and action.

details.title: Down Under Destruction
details.short_description: Down Under Destruction is a stylised first person action brawler with an Australian twist, featuring a vengeful bricklayer taking on a demonically influenced building corporation, one brick throw at a time.

details.title: Oxygen Survivors
details.short_description: Oxygen Survivors is a side-scrolling roguelite where you control a spaceship supported by up to 6 drones that follow your movement. Fuse your drones together, get upgrades, and survive the final boss before the oxygen runs out.

details.title: Kinmen Kill
details.short_description: Kinmen Kill (金門殺) is an FPV combat drone simulator. Scout, strike, and battle PLA forces as you defend Taiwan with realistic flight controls and advanced physics built for true-to-life handling.

details.title: Freelance Dead
details.short_description: A roguelite top‑down twin‑stick shooter. Rain, shine, or zombie outbreak—nothing stops a Courier on a deadline. Shoot, loot, and scoot through hordes of undead with ridiculous item synergies. Earn cash, unlock weapons, and grow from broke gig worker to a walking apocalypse.

details.title: Lesomor
details.short_description: Become Tsarevich Ivan, forced to forge atomic weapons in a fairy‑tale world. Otherwise you won’t stand a chance against foreign monsters and formidable warrior‑maidens on your path to the Princess of the Dead, Lady Yaga… And what you choose to do with her is entirely up to you.
