details.title: Gamophobia
details.short_description: Dating is scary—especially when you’re wooing the physical manifestations of human phobias. Fall in love with a Fear. Try not to flinch.

details.title: Elowen's Travel Notes
details.short_description: Discover Elowen’s travel journal in her bookshop and step into her journey. Use productivity tools to study and work as each focus session takes you further. Unlock new scenes and discover her story at your own pace, with soothing music and beautiful illustrations.

details.title: Fantasy Auto Chess
details.short_description: Fantasy Auto Chess blends roguelite, extraction, and auto chess gameplay. Build your squad through battle, choose when to fight or retreat, and carry Heroic Spirits into future runs as permanent assets to gain stronger starts and unlock more strategies.

details.title: Mafia Pizza : Family Business
details.short_description: Manage your mafia family and take over the city! Assassinate, extort and take down rival families — All while running a perfectly legitimate pizza business.

details.title: Strayward
details.short_description: STRAYWARD is an open-world voxel survival game set across a series of strange and isolated regions. Explore, scavenge, gather resources, build shelters, and fight to survive as you venture deeper into an unfamiliar world filled with persistent threats and unexplained phenomena.

details.title: Fast Food Together
details.short_description: Start your culinary adventure in Winston Springs! Begin with a food truck and work your way up to opening your very own restaurant, either solo or in co-op! Take care of your customers, create your own recipes, set your prices and menu. Earn money and invest in growing your business.

details.title: Cosmic Seance
details.short_description: A supernatural detective mystery where every truth costs sanity. As the Royal Medium, summon old gods, interpret their visions, and trade your mind for clues. Unravel the enigma before madness takes you.

details.title: House Craft Voyage
details.short_description: In House Craft Voyage, spawn blocks and devices, snap-weld and paint them into vehicles and contraptions, then explore with physics—or build your own space for fun. A single-player adventure sandbox of building, physics, and puzzles. Create, then set out.

details.title: Flash The Floppy Fish
details.short_description: Master the art of fast flopping and exploit deep fish physics as you speed through handcrafted environments and rank up to beat your and your friends' times. Can you claim the title of "Flash the Floppy Fish"? Or are you just another stale sardine?

details.title: A FAREWELL TO AI
details.short_description: It began with something strange. Something unsettling. In a future where drawing is forbidden, you dare to take up your pen and join the revolution. Solve mysteries. Complete drawing missions. This story needs your art. No one else's.

details.title: Bunny Bring Bits
details.short_description: You are a grumpy rabbit restoring the game world. Clean up rubbish, wipe away dirt with a rag, recycle junk into elements of the world, and activate mechanisms. And after the heroes' fight with the boss, don't forget to clean up the unlucky heroes.

details.title: Pennants Of Glory: Condottiere
details.short_description: Run a medieval mercenary company with Battle Brothers-style management in a living world. Command up to 600 soldiers in Total War-style real-time 3D formation battles as factions wage wars, besiege towns, and reshape campaign. Break formations with unique stance mechanics.

details.title: King of Puzzles
details.short_description: A cosy little kingdom-building puzzle. Lay dominoes around your castle, grow the biggest patch of each terrain you can, and see how your kingdom compares. A new board whenever you want one, a daily everybody shares, and a crown for whoever leads the most boards.

details.title: Project Turbo Combat
details.short_description: Project Turbo Combat is an explosive vehicular combat racer with singleplayer and multiplayer modes. Blast through a vivid open world in muscle cars, sports sedans and EVs, firing homing missiles, dropping oil slicks, and grabbing power-ups to wreck rivals and take the lead. Free demo available now.

details.title: A Path Untrodden
details.short_description: A dark turn-based RPG in a world consumed by Mushroom Forest. Lead a group of survivors on a sacred journey to the White City, a land of promised salvation. Fight mutants, manage food, develop heroes, and make choices with lasting consequences. How much will you sacrifice to reach the White City?

details.title: DESTRALIX & DESTENYA Sector
details.short_description: Destralix & Destenya is set in the year 2088, where humanity has explored and mapped the entire Solar System and expanded into nearby star systems. Earth remains the central hub of civilization, viewed in living 3D globe divided into thousands of tiles showing terrain, cities and advanced facilities

details.title: Ichorian Tales
details.short_description: Inspired by the traditional Zelda formula, Ichorian Tales is focused on that old-school dungeon crawling experience! Explore, fight enemies, solve puzzles and obtain new abilities to crack open the dungeon and fight massive bosses!

details.title: Pinward
details.short_description: Pinball with a roguelite twist. Spend your score on another ball or upgrades that change the table. Choose rewards, build towards bigger scores, and keep your run alive. Play with friends, or create and share your own tables with the included editor.

details.title: Sluggernauts
details.short_description: Arcade roguelike baseball. Lead the Hickory Creek Squirrels, a small town minor league team and Earth's last hope. Take a randomized road trip and upgrade your team with powerful gear combinations. Hit, pitch, and field to beat otherworldly teams with unfair advantages.

details.title: Stay in Your Lane
details.short_description: Stay in Your Lane is a side-scrolling strategy game inspired by Age of War, Swords & Soldiers and the Flash game era. Two armies march toward each other down one lane while you run the gold, tech tree, upgrades and spells. Story campaign, battle puzzles and online 1v1 and 2v2.

details.title: War Wolves
details.short_description: An online ranked third-person arena shooter where you pilot an armored robotic wolf. Compete in modes like Free For All, Team Deathmatch, and Capture the Flag, control map power weapons, grab combat pickups, and outmaneuver rivals with fluid sprinting, sliding, clambering, jumping, and rolling.

details.title: Cozy Cookmaster
details.short_description: Cozy Cookmaster is an incremental restaurant management game where you turn a tiny food counter into a busy restaurant. Cook by hand, serve customers, clean tables, unlock new recipes, hire staff, upgrade your kitchen, expand your dining area, and keep your restaurant growing day after day.

details.title: Nine Winters
details.short_description: Survive a ruined city where the infected lurk in Nine Winters. Fight back or slip through the dark to scavenge ruins yourself for parts and collectibles. Repair your broken shelter, grow crops, and decorate your home with cherished finds to endure nine winters.

details.title: HopScout
details.short_description: HopScout is a cozy logic puzzle game about arranging cute, picky rabbits to keep everyone happy. Take your time solving puzzles, help the rabbit burrow overcome a looming crisis, and discover the heartwarming stories of its adorable residents.

details.title: Poreia
details.short_description: Manipulate magnetic forces to solve puzzles and uncover the truth of the world in this 3D puzzle adventure - become a memory-lost cat robot and explore a mysterious world!

details.title: Basement To The Sky
details.short_description: A bright afternoon, perfect weather. With your parents away, you’re left with a rocket toy you received as a birthday gift. Build your own rocket and launch it high into the sky! Enjoy delicious homemade meals and work part-time jobs to upgrade your rocket. Can your rocket reach outer space?

details.title: Game Breaker: Divine Error
details.short_description: Game Breaker is a humorous, story-driven dark fantasy RPG where every character knows they're in a video game. Exploit glitches and cheats to rewrite the fate of a dying world. Experience a deep narrative with a massive 119-track original soundtrack.

details.title: Capitol Diktatoria
details.short_description: In an authoritarian state obsessed with art, work for the Eye of the Network. Run your restaurant, survive rising inflation, outbid rival factions, and collect the most historical art to place your men in the Inner Party and install your candidate as leader.

details.title: Hollow Crown
details.short_description: Hollow Crown is a dark idle-incremental autobattler that casts you as an ascendant claimant to a ruined throne. Assemble a court of cursed champions, relics, and sigils; set their decks, assign passive roles, and watch the spire’s floors unspool as automated skirmishes resolve

details.title: Tiny Taxi
details.short_description: Drift, drive and survive in a top-down pixel art city! Pick up passengers with strange demands, earn cash to upgrade your taxi and choose curses that make every run tougher. Customize your cab/driver, build your mixtape and climb the leaderboard.

details.title: The Demon Party
details.short_description: The Demon Lord has vanished, and the Demon Lord’s Castle has fallen into chaos. Become Lethe, a demon girl, dominate defeated monsters, form your own Demon Party, and raise a new demon army!

details.title: Shelter Prepare
details.short_description: Shelter Prepare is a post-apocalyptic placement game where you arrange various resources to create your ideal safe house. It's a low-pressure, purely placement-based, and cozy game. No combat, no death; focus on resource placement, space management, and cleaning. Gradually expand your space.

details.title: Final Orbit
details.short_description: Master the cockpit of highly realistic spacecraft in this Newtonian physics based sim. Take off from surface to space, plot a course between the planets and dock with space stations. Trade commodities or take shipping contracts to buy upgrades and optimize your build - every choice matters.

details.title: 银色记忆
details.short_description: 扮演失忆的主角在一个充满秘密的小镇生活，探索和恋爱

details.title: Ashes - Doomsday Borer
details.short_description: A side-scrolling game featuring adventure, exploration, level progression, boss battles, and puzzle-solving. Take on the role of a modified rodent warrior, piloting an underground vehicle to fight against an artificial intelligence and save the creatures living beneath the surface.
publishers: Homeless Network Technology Guangzhou Co., Ltd

details.title: Intravenous 3
details.short_description: Tense stealth action, tactical hardcore gunplay, and missions & story shaped by the way you play. Step into the roles of Steve and Sean, outnumbered and forced to survive a relentless manhunt.

details.title: RAIN HEART
details.short_description: Psychological horror about Alex Bow, who struggles with himself and his traumas.

details.title: Pikku Adventure
details.short_description: Befriend the Pikku to decipher a mysterious alien language and deliver a crucial message. Small colorful planets filled with secrets and charm await clever deduction from sharp puzzle-venturers and exo-linguists.

details.title: Smersh: Wolfhound
details.short_description: A stealth action game set during World War II. You play as a SMERSH operative. Use disguises to get close to your target. Take out your foes with weapons or plan “unfortunate accidents.” No two playthroughs are alike.

details.title: I Can Never Love Another
details.short_description: A realistic visual novel based on a true story. As a lawyer trying to save a rock singer from her toxic family, you uncover the suffocating truth of "Codependency." Will you leave, sink into the abyss, or g◼︎ai◻︎n the c#our%ag◼︎e to f◼︎ac◻︎e the p#ai%n? Your choices decide.

details.title: Secret Files: Tunguska - Remastered
details.short_description: The award-winning adventure classic returns as a remaster with modernized visuals and updated technology. Join Nina and Max on a globe-spanning investigation filled with puzzles, conspiracies, and danger – and uncover the secret of Tunguska that changes everything!

name: Car Crime Simulator: Prologue - Early Days

details.title: Car Crime Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
details.short_description: Steal cars, stash them, and make your first dirty money. Learn the basics of running a shady operation - solo or in co-op. This is just the beginning.

details.title: [ABERRATION] THE ANALYST
details.short_description: Dexton-City vanished, leaving a 14.2-meter void. As a PRISM analyst, process Agent Meg Simons' final hours through the EYESYS simulation. Survive the psychological terror and brutal trials of a Class C4 Hive Mind. An [ABERRATION] case by FEIGIN ENTERTAINMENT.

details.title: Eterno
details.short_description: A first-person fantasy RPG where you carve your own legend in a living world. Explore dangerous dungeons, shape your reputation, and choose your path between honor and ambition.

details.title: Flipping Football Clubs
details.short_description: Buy, build, and flip football clubs in a fast-paced roguelite management sim. Sign players, hire staff, survive FFP, unlock Club DNA modifiers, and grow club value across 1-2 hour seasonal runs.

details.title: Paper Lanes
details.short_description: A transport strategy game: draw trade routes on 30 hand-drawn maps of real regions, from the Aegean to Malacca, and keep caravans and ships moving goods to towns that need them. Routes, vehicles and ports are scarce, so every redraw counts. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4.

details.title: Pixel Rush: RTS
details.short_description: A fantasy real-time strategy deck builder where you summon monsters, evolve them mid-battle, cast spells, fight for control of the battlefield and rush the enemies base for victory!

details.title: Goat Survivor 2
details.short_description: Soul-harvesting survival action: a goat wizard sets out to conquer the demon realm. Mow down endless hordes, capture foes with Mind Control, and grow stronger with every soul. Simple controls, fast growth, screen-filling battles. Conquer domain after domain and claim the Demon Lord's throne.

details.title: VOIDSWARM
details.short_description: They came from the void. You are all that stands between the swarm and our annihilation. Direct and fight alongside an immense fleet as both pilot and commander, hold the line against thousands of enemies using powerful upgrades, and take back our homeworlds in this roguelike RTS.

details.title: Vacuum Uprising
details.short_description: Rip the ground from under your feet and hurl it at your enemies! Vacuum Uprising is a pixel-perfect destruction platformer with physics-based combat, epic boss fights, and local multiplayer for up to 4 players.

details.title: Voidbit
details.short_description: In this challenging deckbuilder puzzle platformer, mixing turn based with real time gameplay, you don't control the main character. Instead, you'll play cards to manipulate the character, the world and the deck to lead them off planet before the chasing void consumes them.

details.title: Hotel Is Hungry
details.short_description: The world ended. You got a hotel job. Check guests in, serve their orders, keep them away from killers, and decide who the hotel eats. A horror hotel management game.

details.title: Dead Relay
details.short_description: Dead Relay is a PSX-style survival horror game. As a field engineer sent to a blacked-out relay station, you must restore power, explore classified sectors, and decode encrypted logs. But the facility isn't empty — and the system itself seems to be watching your every step.

name: Dream to Millennium | 梦回千禧

details.title: Dream to Millennium | 梦回千禧
details.short_description: Worn out by life’s stress? Dive into a dreamy millennial world with Chinese dreamcore vibes. Wander freely with no tasks or combat. Paired with the rap album Dream to Millennium: Teen Never Die. Stay true to your dreams, and never compromise.

name: Knock Off: The Battle For Imagination

details.title: Knock Off: The Battle For Imagination
details.short_description: Fight for the fate of imagination in this fast-paced 2D fighter inspired by classic arcade games and 80s/90s action figures. Master air combos, EX moves, assists, and super attacks with a roster of wild off-brand toy legends.

details.title: Project8088: Finding Aidia Le
details.short_description: A fast first-person arcade shooter where you transfer into a quantum state and fight inside the hardware. Stack buffs, gain augmentations, and push through 16 levels of routers, rigs, and servers to find Aidia Le.

details.title: The Minesweeper's Tale
details.short_description: From the clues, reveal an imaginary map zone by zone in this minesweeper-variant logic game, where each solved region transforms a grid into a work of cartographic art.

details.title: Luck and Raid
details.short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op, top-down action RPG/roguelike where luck is everything. You're fluffy, and you're adorable. Earn money and get stronger. Running low on cash? Try gambling! Lost it all? Just borrow some from a friend. Your friend is broke too? Congratulations! Now the real co-op begins.

details.title: Doomsday Train
details.short_description: Doom falls and civilization collapses entirely. The roaming train becomes the last hope of mankind. You will take charge of the vehicle, manage and equip survivors, allocate food and daily tasks, collect resources to resist zombie swarms. The fate of everyone hinges on your decisions.

details.title: Astral Dive
details.short_description: Join Atlas and his companions in Astral Dive, a charming hand-drawn pixel art fantasy RPG. Experience innovative turn-based combat powered by magic cards, explore wondrous worlds beyond the astral portals, and uncover the secrets of the magic academy.

details.title: Metzger Manager
details.short_description: Run your own butcher shop, buy animals, butcher meat, serve customers, and expand your business with employees and upgrades.

details.title: The Shotgun Game: Buckshot Survivors
details.short_description: Blast your way through endless hordes of enemies and become the Ultimate Shotgun! Level up, unlock upgrades, build your arsenal of powerful mods and create unique builds to devastate everything in your path.

details.title: Forged from Monsters
details.short_description: Not every sword begins as steel. Forge weapons from monster parts with hands-on control over every step of the process. Discover surprising effective combinations of creature parts heroes bring to your smithy.

details.title: Abjure
details.short_description: Win by emptying your hand. Abjure is a roguelike deckbuilder where the 2 of Spades reigns supreme — draft cards, stack relics, and outplay every opponent in a strategic twist on the Big 2 card game.

details.title: Echoes of Aromia
details.short_description: Echoes of Aromia is a story-driven, pixel art RPG with turnbased combat, branching dialogue, alchemy, companions, and much more. Set in a pre-steampunk medieval fantasy world on the brink of industrialization, full of corruption, conspiracy, good, and evil. And ancient myths waiting to be uncovered.

details.title: Meatstone
details.short_description: Meatstone is a turn-based tactical RPG. As a mercenary in a wasteland with alien colonizers, you must cross the unknown surface, gather resources for your base, and augment your gears and flesh. Learn the truth of the past, and salvage what remains of a world that may already be beyond saving.

name: Outside the pile of leaf litter

details.title: Outside the pile of leaf litter
details.short_description: In Toronto's cold, dry, pitch-black polar night, a four-string bass roars in a freezing basement. Sink into punker Jack's drug‑induced, hallucinatory "trip"—face the overwhelming unease through twisted fluid colors and a torn, fractured vision.

details.title: Xeno Food Truck
details.short_description: In this sci-fi cooking simulator, run a space food truck on a remote meteor and smuggle contraband out back. Juggle chaotic alien orders while discreetly delivering illicit goods for the mafia. Smile for the space cops, keep your cover intact, and beware the giant hungry worm lurking in the crater.

details.title: Escape Engine
details.short_description: Escape the game engine! Switch between Haruka's in-game perspective and her older brother Keito's editor view to solve puzzles in this dual-perspective puzzle-action game!

details.title: Frontier Factory
details.short_description: Build your automated factory on a frontier planet! Mine resources, plan logistics and research technology as conveyor belts and machines take on the hard work. Build defenses against zombies and roaming powerful creatures, and face the Blood Moon every seven days.

details.title: Hell Looks Back
details.short_description: A breakup text. A missing boy. A trail of strange clues. Adrien is forced to work together with Dante to find the one person they both can't live without... until it leads them to hell.

details.title: Gemstroids
details.short_description: An incremental space-mining game: blow up a field of rocks, wave after wave. One good shot at a bomb sets off a chain across the screen, and every cleared wave pays more than the last. Between sessions, build your ship, beat the zone's guardian and fly with Otto the otter to the Heart of the Void.

details.title: Order of the Crystalline Tortoise
details.short_description: Walk a baby tortoise one leg at a time across a storm-wrecked island. Find food, gather torn clues and make friends who live inside your crystal shell. At night, move those friends between its openings to fend off threats in this story-led adventure with real-time defense.

details.title: Xhaust
details.short_description: Xhaust is a weaponized vehicular combat game. Brawl in the arena, wreak havoc on the roads! Go solo or battle friends and bots in multiplayer (split-screen and online).

details.title: Don't Burn Out!
details.short_description: A block-pushing puzzle game in corporate hell, where you must confront your boss and escape the soul-draining workplace before you literally burn out. Solve over 100 handcrafted & unique puzzles that will require you to think strategically, with each step bringing you closer to flames!

details.title: WaxWire: Program the Hive
details.short_description: These bees are hard workers, but not one of them can think. Luckily, you can. In this cozy programming game you plan their every move with nodes. Forget to tell a bee to sip and she'll fly home empty but very pleased with herself. Better fix that before the Queen finds out.

details.title: MoncooMoncoo!
details.short_description: Join Spoony, the little chef, as you explore a dungeon filled with dangerous yet delicious monsters and restore the world's lost flavors!

details.title: Cao Cao the Legend
details.short_description: Rewrite the Three Kingdoms through Cao Cao's eyes. Lead his generals across ink-wash battlefields, master the terrain on a hex grid, and crush foes with joint attacks fueled by chemistry. A 3D turn-based tactical RPG where your choices lead to real history—or a Three Kingdoms never recorded.

details.title: 空降恋人
details.short_description: A Sudden Girlfriend is a galgame centered around solving practice questions. In the game, you play as a high school senior who is obsessed with solving practice problems. You become involved in a series of heartwarming stories with a beautiful girl who suddenly appears in your life.

details.title: Haulage Simulator
details.short_description: Drive near real-world-scale UK motorways, battle traffic, roadworks, rain and crosswinds, master detailed trucks with force feedback, complete timed deliveries, build your reputation and grow from hired driver to owning your own haulage company.

details.title: Hotel of Seams
details.short_description: October 1997. Your grandfather’s lakeside hotel is yours now: a diner, rooms to manage, and two cats. Cook meals and serve your customers, hand out keys to guests, and keep everything clean. Some of the people who check in are not human, and nobody is going to tell you which ones.

details.title: Aquamorta
details.short_description: Something is wrong with the swamp. Return to the town your family called home, where something ancient twisted a community into hysteria. Navigate its hostile waters by airboat and uncover what happened to restore what was lost. Maybe, in return, you’ll be shown mercy.

details.title: Pop 1,000,000 Hot Air Balloons
details.short_description: Shoot hot air balloons, steer falling passengers through pegs, and spend the cash on upgrades as you race to pop one million.

details.title: 徘徊之碑 - Lingering Stele
details.short_description: "Haven't seen you in forever." A narrative-driven RPG about the heart. In a peaceful world where all conflict has come to an end, is there still a chance to make up for the words left unspoken?

name: Sons of the Arena: Pollice Verso

details.title: Sons of the Arena: Pollice Verso
details.short_description: A small ludus is yours, and it has to reach the great games. Build the estate, pick fights from the hosts’ calendar, fight off the rival. Turn-based fights on hexes: a kick drops a man, a wedge breaks a shield wall. Four classes, six weapon types, and all a man wears shows on him.

details.title: Sun Catcher
details.short_description: Restore damaged stained glass art and immerse yourself in a charming story about lost memories and community in Sun Catcher, a cozy paint-by-numbers tale.

name: B面人生：存在的重量 Life:Reboot

details.title: B面人生：存在的重量 Life:Reboot
details.short_description: Step into a narrative-driven social media simulator in a world dominated by one powerful platform. Here, followers are your currency and your life. You had it all—until someone set you up and banned your account for good. Start over. Climb. Be seen. Ultimately, the world's fate is in your hands.

details.title: G-Vora
details.short_description: High-speed anti-grav racing with hand-built physics for a direct, responsive feel. Slide along chargeable strips, knock rivals off the track with melee attacks, and race a friend in local splitscreen. A separate Battle Mode adds weapons.

details.title: Multiverse Escape
details.short_description: This is a light rogue-like turn-based strategy game. Choose unique characters, battle across countless distinct small worlds, upgrade skills, equipment and attributes to strengthen yourself, and finally break free from the bondage of endless realms.

details.title: Life and Lemon
details.short_description: Come get cozy in this fruit farming card game. Grow your orchard business, discover countless combinations of card fusions, and befriend a cast of quirky characters across a variety of lush and unique locations!

details.title: We'll Meet Again
details.short_description: When someone takes their own life, the pain doesn't end with them. It passes to those left behind. A short story about the guilt, anger and unanswered questions of the people who stay.

details.title: Necrolord
details.short_description: Command an undead army in this dark fantasy auto-battler roguelite. Raise fallen enemies, equip your troops and turn battles with powerful spells. Explore procedurally generated lands. Lose your army, reincarnate and rebuild with your retained magic and lich abilities.

details.title: Bloodloader
details.short_description: A fast top-down roguelite where every rifle shot is earned with the bayonet. Stab to load, shoot to kill: build a weapon from a bayonet and a rifle, take favours from four old powers and climb four hellish realms to take your flight back from the Redeemer.

details.title: Tategoi
details.short_description: A calm koi-breeding tycoon with real genetics. Pair your best koi, judge the fry, grow a farm of ponds, win shows and auctions — and raise the koi your grandfather only dreamed of.

details.title: Restore Earth
details.short_description: Restore Earth is an incremental cleanup game. Clear litter on quick, timed trips, collect materials, and upgrade your grabbers. Unlock playful helpers, face natural disasters, and turn neglected clearings into thriving habitats!

details.title: Video Paradise
details.short_description: Run a 1988 video rental store one tape at a time. Order stock by fax, set your prices, rewind, repair and recommend. Every regular remembers how you treat them, and somewhere in your returns box are fragments of a film no one knew existed.

details.title: Stormbox
details.short_description: Play as Pip the Penguin, a storm chaser on a voxel island where any sky can spawn a tornado. Drive, fly and deploy gadgets to film twisters up close, collect every storm as a Storm Card, and watch panicked towns and villagers scramble as the storm closes in.

details.title: Area [No Love]
details.short_description: Fall in love, and you explode?! Explosive Love Cells have made love itself a danger and a crime. A boy who swore off romance gets tangled up with three girls... Will you survive? No Love Virus is a visual novel where you must keep affection just right to win a heroine's heart.

details.title: Genesis Core
details.short_description: Genesis Core is an idle RPG built around crafting and automation. Send squads farming across hostile planets, process their loot into powerful gear and circuits, and expand your base. Refine your builds, assimilate enemy technology and keep developing your squad through successive campaigns.

details.title: CONTRACT #001
details.short_description: A 1-4 player physics based demolition simulator. On your first job, you knocked down the wrong house. Now you owe Shady Solutions LLC $80,080. Tear down buildings, crush the scrap and pay it off.

details.title: TerraHeist
details.short_description: Explore procedurally generated alien planets, steal valuables, and get your haul home. TerraHeist is a top-down sci-fi action game for solo play or online co-op. Capture creatures as companions, turn their attacks into weapon gems, and gear up for the next expedition.

details.title: Beyond Realm
details.short_description: A roguelite deckbuilder where your town is the reward. The kingdom has faded to grey ink, and every artefact you bring home paints one colour back. Your deck dies with the run, the town never does. Out there, place your cards and watch them fight on their own.

details.title: Make GAL together!
details.short_description: Make GAL together! is a visual novel where you play as Xiao Lu, an unemployed copywriter. Move in with an energetic producer, a sharp-tongued tsundere artist, and a quiet programmer. Amid the daily chaos, can you create an unforgettable game together?

details.title: Ultimate Memory Elevator!?
details.short_description: Observe on the move. Survive by memory. Which floor was that bird on? Memorize the birds and climb to your absolute limit!
developers: インフィニットクリエイト
publishers: インフィニットクリエイト

details.title: Pantania:wedge of time
details.short_description: Fulfill your mission, scavenge for supplies.With the power to control time, you can be a savior who saves people—or a ruthless monster who slaughters them all.

details.title: Thunder Arrow: Arcade
details.short_description: Pilot the HX-21 “Thunder Arrow” prototype and relive the intensity of 1980s arcades in a modern tribute to classics like After Burner and Thunder Blade.

details.title: 30Lily
details.short_description: Play as Emily in the otherworld to save your dying sister Lily. Only 30 days left. Gameplay: TPS, linear chapters.

details.title: Lumengard
details.short_description: Explore the fallen kingdom of Lumengard in a procedurally generated hex world. Gather, craft, and fight turn-based battles with cards from gear, skills, companions, and pets. Build a village and shape a persistent world through your choices.

details.title: KARAOKE x LOVE 💖
details.short_description: A fun anime-style karaoke simulator! Run your own bar, serve drinks, clean up after wild nights, and grow your business with three charming assistants. Make friends, build relationships, and unlock exciting karaoke performances along the way!

details.title: Clinic Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own clinic solo or team up with up to 4 players! Examine patients, diagnose and treat them. Divide the work, make decisions, and build your dream clinic — or at least try to keep the place from falling apart.

details.title: Kennel Chaos: Daycare Simulator
details.short_description: You and your friends run a dog daycare and pet shop. It goes badly. Feed them, wash them, walk them, and scoop what they leave behind, before somebody props a gate open and eleven dogs discover the front door. Co-op chaos with very good pups.

details.title: PAVYON
details.short_description: You don’t know what will happen tonight. Same table, same lights… but never the same night! Step into the interactive nightclub, choose your table, and see where the night takes you. Meet online players, dive into conversations, build new connections, and become part of the story of the night...

name: The Last Ranger: End of days

details.title: The Last Ranger: End of days
details.short_description: The Last Ranger is a dark fantasy top-down survival shooter where you fight off huge waves of enemies, stack mid-round upgrades to buff yourself up and do your best to survive the night. Make the most of the permanent mastery system to make each run more rewarding, then take bosses down in style!

details.title: Quicksant
details.short_description: A retro ant colony sim where your ants think for themselves. Place pheromone trails and your ants dig, haul, and build on their own, following the scent to work, food, or danger. Tunnel through a fully destructible world, farm the surface, outgrow the rival ant colony, and survive the dangers.

details.title: Fishy Bar: Hook, Cook & Serve
details.short_description: Settle into life by the lake in a first-person fishing and bar-management adventure where you set the pace. Turn your daily catch into meals for your guests, grow your bar, and get to know the eccentric locals as you explore the lakes and unravel the mystery beneath them.

details.title: Wingsuit Simulator
details.short_description: The most realistic wingsuit and parachute physics on PC and in VR. Discover perfect lines across a 256 km² island built for proximity flying. Skim cliffs, thread tight gaps, and attempt stunts you’d never risk in real life. Master the community’s lines or surprise them with your own way down.

details.title: Asa's Adventure
details.short_description: A hand-drawn narrative puzzle-adventure. Play as Asa, a silent child obsessed with stars who unexpectedly lands on a desolate planet. Decipher alien symbols and solve puzzles to search for scattered stars—unlocking a heartwarming story.

details.title: Squadron 42
details.short_description: Enlist in the UEE Navy in a cinematic, single-player space adventure. Pilot combat ships, fight on foot, and explore capital ships, space stations, and frontier outposts. Live and work alongside your crew as you battle on the front lines of a galactic war.

details.title: Deep Siren
details.short_description: Deep Siren is a Lovecraftian WWII horror fairytale. When the lone survivor of the USS Siren discovers a mermaid while adrift at sea, he finds himself plunged into a world of supernatural horror fathoms beneath the surface. Utilize unique gameplay mechanics as Alex battles to hold on to his sanity.

details.title: Harvest Skies: Crop Dusting Simulator
details.short_description: Job sim? Flight sim? Co-op for 1–4 players? YES. Take farm jobs with friends, upgrade your hangar and grow a fleet. Mostly chill, with the occasional power-line PANIC.

details.title: Sker: The Bleeding Veil
details.short_description: Evade Sister Gwenllian and her ritual-bound orphans as you use sound to explore, solve harmonic puzzles and survive blind stalkers that hunt by hearing. Sker: The Bleeding Veil is a first-person, stealth-focused survival horror set in the Sker universe.

details.title: 四合 Quadrangle
details.short_description: Muni awakens on an unfamiliar campus, drawn into a web of mysteries. Your choices shape relationships and the path of the story. A relationship-driven yuri game.

details.title: Tower Tanks
details.short_description: TEAM UP! BUILD UP! BLOW UP! Tower Tanks is a chaotic co-op vehicle combat roguelike where you and your friends build and crew giant war machines. Work together to customize your tank, power up the engines, put out fires, and man the guns as you blast apart anything in your way!

details.title: Arx Temporis
details.short_description: A story-rich anime action RPG combining real-time combat, school life, and social simulation. Fight through procedurally generated dungeons, build relationships, and uncover the truth behind a mysterious temporal threat.

details.title: Midnight Bell
details.short_description: A gothic asynchronous PvP autobattler. Build a board of werewolves, vampires or monster hunters, arm them with items, then watch them fight other players saved teams of gothic monstrosities. Halfway through every fight the midnight bell tolls and the monsters transform.

details.title: Catch Succubus
details.short_description: "Catch the Succubus" is a first-person comedy horror game. The mischievous succubus has designed a variety of gameplay for you, including memory puzzles, platforming, dark navigation, and more. You win as long as you catch her.

details.title: Afterfolk
details.short_description: Renovate a Forgotten Village. Restore crumbling homes, shape the landscape, and build something new. Farm, fish, craft, and welcome new neighbours as you uncover forgotten stories and help lingering spirits find peace. Bring the village back to life, your way. Play solo or with friends.

details.title: Color Parade
details.short_description: Color Parade is a cheerful two-player co-op painting adventure! Play as a young painter and an adorable pup: spray paint, leave colorful pawprints, and bring a colorless world back to life. Explore vibrant themed maps, tackle painting challenges together, or face off in playful contests!

details.title: Nutty Mice Party
details.short_description: Nutty Mice Party is an adorable multiplayer adventure! Play as cute mice with unique abilities, explore colorful candy-filled mazes, and gobble up every last treat while dodging hungry cats. Team up with friends or face off in chaotic cat-and-mouse battles. Let the sweet chaos begin!

details.title: Star Chasers
details.short_description: Star Chasers is a 2–4 player local multiplayer party game! Roll the dice, race across the board, collect stars, and challenge your friends in wild mini-games. Dodge lasers, survive lava, and outplay your rivals with skill, strategy, and a little luck. Who will claim the party crown?

details.title: Plushie Ops
details.short_description: Plushie Ops is a local two-player 3D action platformer! Grab a friend and guide two adorable plushies through a world of traps and surprises. Jump, fight, tackle tricky mechanisms, and collect stars as you explore a toy factory and a mysterious underwater world. Can you make it to the finish?

details.title: Railsiege
details.short_description: You drive an armed war train through a ravaged Wild West, all the way to Fort Alamo. Fit the wagons with turrets, then choose as you go: floor it to outrun the monsters and risk blowing the boiler, or slow down to cut them down and pick up their loot.

name: Fine Tuning: A Radio Repair Shop

details.title: Fine Tuning: A Radio Repair Shop
details.short_description: Run a little radio repair shop in 1952, where every wireless on your bench is a working circuit, so the meter reads what's really there and the hum or the crackle you hear is the fault itself. You take each set apart by hand and fit new parts from the cabinet till it plays again for its owner.

details.title: Paid Bloom
details.short_description: Your desktop is a garden. Plant a seed, go back to work, and your flowers grow while you type. Look up hours later and the screen is in bloom. Every plant is one of a kind, rare colours are out there to hunt, and nothing ever dies.
developers: Beijing Star Halo Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Beijing Star Halo Technology Co., Ltd.

details.title: Age of the Ancients
details.short_description: A real-time strategy in four ages: gather five resources, raise walls and a castle, command your army with stances and formations — and when your shaman speaks to the stones, call the night down on your enemy instead of yourself. Seed-generated worlds, a map editor, English and Hungarian.

details.title: Mighty Gladiators
details.short_description: Fight through waves of enemies and conquer deadly bosses in a dark fantasy arena action RPG for 1–4 players. Choose from four heroes, combine talents with legendary gear, and master boss mechanics solo or in online co-op.

details.title: BosaTella Loopa
details.short_description: Junk Robots. Monster Hordes. Unhinged Firepower. Team up in this co-op looter shooter to get filthy rich, discover absurd weaponry, and blast away the dangerous monsters that lurk within "The Loop". Tear through the subway, catch the train (or don't), and blow all your money on even more firepower.

details.title: Ashen Rain
details.short_description: No justice. Only consequences. Ashen Rain is a brutal 2.5D tactical action shooter: fight through rain-soaked streets, factories and military outposts with weighty gunplay, punishing enemy fire and visceral, realistic damage. The law failed. He didn't.

details.title: SonDem
details.short_description: Son Dem is a 3D online social game set in a traditional Turkish coffeehouse for up to 20 players. Play backgammon, 101 Okey and chess with friends, watch matches as a spectator, and join the conversation through voice and text chat.

details.title: No one outside
details.short_description: A co-op survival horror game set in a large reactive city. Explore, loot, drive, build defenses, and survive massive hordes when night falls.

details.title: Hoppkins: Twinkle World
details.short_description: Hoppkins: Twinkle World is a charming 3D platform adventure where you explore colorful worlds, leap across platforms, use unique abilities and vehicles, and face challenging enemies. Join Mr. Hoppkins and venture beyond the clouds to rescue his beloved!

details.title: Wait, My Gun's Gone?
details.short_description: Survive endless waves of zombies in a chaotic PvE FPS, alone or with up to 3 friends. Run out of ammo, and you get a new random gun. Buy ammo to keep your favorite. In co-op, one player's empty gun triggers a reroll for everyone. Explore the map, buy upgrades, and discover the secret to escape.

details.title: Jennifer Against Space Aliens
details.short_description: Jennifer Against Space Aliens is an action-packed, third person, sci-fi shooter with 1980s vibes. Run, drive, shoot and blow things up inside space stations, spaceships and distant planets.

details.title: A Minor War
details.short_description: An auto battler where your build is the music. Give each instrument a phrase of notes, then lock it in and listen to your ensemble fight another player's. Your trumpet sounds out every Fireball you gave it, and your drum keeps time with its Blocks.

details.title: Splatterdunk
details.short_description: 90s-arcade 2-on-2 or 3 -on -3 basketball where the players are monsters and the fouls are fatal. Chain trick dunks, arm Fatalities, bribe the ref and dunk on monsters through the glass while VAT-9, a robot announcer who used to be a star, calls it. Up to 6 players, couch or online. Bring a mop.

details.title: Cordonfall
details.short_description: Type in your address and defend your own street. Cordonfall turns any real neighbourhood on OpenStreetMap into a zombie siege: make a building your HQ, put soldiers on the rooftops, fortify by day, and hold out for ten nights as the horde grows every dusk.

details.title: Arkhanium
details.short_description: Arkham lies in ruins; humanity has lost the battle. Now is the time to perform the ritual to summon the Great Old Ones in a turn-based, tactical PvP battle. Establish your dominion and seize power over the Earth!

details.title: Last Skull
details.short_description: Take a ship into hostile waters, plunder islands, wrecks and rival captains, then make it out before your time runs out. Whatever you bring home is yours to keep. Sink, and what you carried is left floating for someone else.

details.title: Thrustlings
details.short_description: A physics rocket game about landing softly. Feather the thrust, fight gravity and wind, and touch down before your fuel runs out. Race friends online in Pad Race, King of the Pad and Orb Ball, conquer 120+ levels, and build and share your own in the level editor.

details.title: Incredig
details.short_description: Incredig is a short sci-fi incremental mining game about digging far too deep. Break rock pixel by pixel, haul ore back to your Rig, automate the mine with swarms of drones, and keep pushing downward. Something beneath the surface is beating.

details.title: Dragon Football
details.short_description: Dragon Football is a single-player football auto battler with no-holds-barred combat. Recruit unhinged, superpowered animals. Kill opponents, send them flying, and score a goal while you are at it. Matches play out automatically. The goal count decides who wins.

details.title: Daughter Of The Lake
details.short_description: Daughter of the Lake is a narrative dark fantasy RPG rooted in Finnish folklore. Practise witchcraft, fall in love, and investigate the supernatural as you explore a handcrafted medieval village, where fate-shaping choices intertwine with secrets, gossip, and lesbian romance.

details.title: Bum Dog
details.short_description: Bum Dog, an old time vagabond of modest means, defiant fists, and dogged spirit returns to his shelter to discover his true love missing. Now he must punch, scratch, bite, and summon elemental powers beyond his comprehension to set this wrong to right.

details.title: Only One Hero
details.short_description: Build an army around three Heroes in a dark fantasy roguelite autobattler. Assign Jobs, buy abilities and gear, and prepare for real-time battles that fight themselves. Soldiers die for good. After each major act, execute one of your Heroes until only one remains.

details.title: Backwatt
details.short_description: Backwatt is a co-op top-down action roguelite for 1–4 players. Drop into the arena, fight off waves of enemies and head back to the Barge to gear up. At its heart is your rig: your skill at managing space and planning your purchases decides how strong your build is.

details.title: Infernal Corridor
details.short_description: An incremental roguelite with automatic, real-time card combat. Carry your flame through the corridors of hell, slay demons and claim your revenge.

details.title: Dreadmark
details.short_description: A top-down gothic action RPG set over one long night, in a parish that raised its own dead. The big enemies show where each blow will land, loot gets better the deeper you go, and every endgame map lays out a new road. On hardcore a death is permanent, and the live ladder remembers it.

details.title: Alchemist's Apprentice
details.short_description: The classroom is a mess! You’d think a troll had been through it. Sort the potions, tidy the shelves and brew up a little chaos in this cozy game about an alchemist’s apprentice. Class is nearly in session, and there’s so much to do!

details.title: Slips Happen
details.short_description: Penguins weren’t made for climbing. Except this one! Run, slide and build momentum to nail your jumps and reach the top of a slippery mountain. Be careful as one bad landing can send you tumbling all the way back down! Slips will happen. A lot.

details.title: Raking Fire
details.short_description: Asynchronous PvP Space Armada Battler. Build your armada, invite your friends... and destroy them

details.title: Blockstein
details.short_description: Blockstein is an action block-falling roguelike. Customize your deck, add pieces with special effects, use triggers, and destroy blocks to annihilate enemies!

details.title: X Marks the Orc
details.short_description: An auto-battler roguelite. Call a play, mark who dies first, give each hero an order, then watch the fight unfold. Between fights, buy and upgrade units to grow your party.

details.title: Nella & Smudge
details.short_description: Play as Nella and her cat Smudge in an isometric stealth-horror adventure inside a paper building. Switch between them to sneak, hide from the Manager, solve puzzles with light and darkness, and make tools from what you find as you follow her missing dad's trail.

details.title: BLACKBELL
details.short_description: A gothic cartoon auto-battler roguelite. Build a company of strange fighters, stack Traits for powerful bonuses, merge copies into 2★ and 3★ forms, and fight your way through a haunted world ruled by the BLACKBELL.

details.title: Terra Logic
details.short_description: Sculpt planets and landscapes, watch water and climate respond, and compare two versions of the same world. Import heightmaps, draw mountain ranges, and export flat terrain to Minecraft Java. Explore Earth, ancient continents and distant worlds at your own pace.

details.title: Belt Bound Boxing
details.short_description: A physics-based boxing roguelike where no two careers are the same. Every boxer is uniquely generated with stats and modifiers that completely change how they fight. Train, study your opponents, negotiate contracts, manage your lifestyle, and fight your way to the title.

details.title: Ant Tribe
details.short_description: Expand your chamber, strengthen your tribe, and put every ant to work, each with its own role — to deliver an endless feast to your Queen!

details.title: 逆界 (Inverse Realm)
details.short_description: A 2D side-scrolling beat 'em up with roguelite elements! Choose distinct weapons, trigger powerful build synergies, and adapt to fresh challenges on every run. Are you ready for the battle?

details.title: Chopeast
details.short_description: Chopeast is an incremental 2D game where you can freely explore, upgrade, and expand your weapons. In the game, you play as a alien monster hunter collecting meat to trade for resources.

details.title: Have We Gone Too Far?
details.short_description: A solo or co-op horde survival where reckless wizards (you) blast mutated hordes with synthwave magic, upgrade between runs, and try not to kill each other...

details.title: Par Under Review
details.short_description: A turn-based golf roguelike set in the 1930s. Build a deck of clubs golf won't invent for decades, and beat the golfers of the day at their own game without ever leaving your desk.

details.title: Boo! Boo! Train!
details.short_description: A cozy train journey through a valley that keeps its own time. Drive slowly, pick a line at every junction, stop for the view and whistle at the neighbours. One real hour is one day in Pinewind Valley, and the season turns every week. Nothing to build, nothing to fail.

details.title: Casus Foederis: 1815
details.short_description: Your ally is attacked and calls you into a war you never wanted. Answer, and you fight. Refuse, and every court in Europe remembers. Lead one of twelve powers from 1815 to 1871; grow too fast and the continent unites against you. A turn-based strategy game of diplomacy. Single-player.

details.title: Bermuda Trial
details.short_description: Party Based Autobattler RPG where you choose team of three survivor to explore the wonders and dangers of the mysterious Bermuda Island.

details.title: Tessera
details.short_description: Tessera is an open-world sandbox fantasy RPG. Create your own character, explore a seamless hand-crafted continent, gather and craft, delve into ever-changing dungeons, and build a home of your own. Play solo or invite friends into your world.

details.title: DEFCON 89
details.short_description: OLD-SCHOOL ZOMBIES ARE BACK. Survive endless rounds solo or in 4-player co-op in a Cold War nightmare set in 1989. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, explore sinister maps, find secret weapons and unravel each map's hidden main story. How long can you last?

details.title: Wool Shop
details.short_description: A cozy idle game that lives along the edge of your screen. Your sheep graze, their wool is spun and knitted, and customers shop at your little store while you work. Your sheepdog follows your cursor and helps herd the flock.

details.title: Okey Dokey
details.short_description: The tile-rummy roguelite. Lay runs and groups, outplay a rival at every table and stack boosts with regulars, drinks and enchanted tiles on a tour of the world's tile clubs, from Lisbon to the Grand Salon.

details.title: Trash Nights
details.short_description: Autumn, 1998. You take the night shift on garbage truck No. 7 in Maple Hollow, a quiet suburb whose last crew quit without notice. One street a night, 11 PM to 4 AM. Every house leaves its trash on the curb, and one neighbor's bags should not exist.

details.title: Football Tactics: Dare to Dream
details.short_description: A turn-based football tactics roguelite with superpowers. Move your five kids across the grid, check your odds, then pass, lob, volley and shoot. Break the rules with lasers, meteors and unsaveable overhead kicks, and build your squad between matches.

details.title: AnkhForge
details.short_description: Tower defense in ancient Egypt: build by day, shape-shift into divine forms by night.

details.title: Dead Freight
details.short_description: The cargo roguelike. Pack your holds with 88 cargo types that combo, multiply and devour each other, pick the port that pays the most, and watch the coins stack up. A loan shark owns your ship and wants ten cuts, each bigger than the last. Miss one and he takes it back.

details.title: Tiny Tide
details.short_description: Wind-up toy robots have invaded the house. Pick a tiny hero, grab a water blaster and survive the swarm, room by room. Tiny Tide is a survivors-like roguelite where every weapon evolves and every run turns the living room floor into a bubbly battlefield.

details.title: Discbreaker
details.short_description: A sports roguelite where sponsors bend the rules: ghost passes slip through defenders, tackles pop the disc toward their net. Create your club, draft a 5v5 squad from packs, climb a 256-team knockout cup. Lose once and you're out. Or host a cup for up to 256 friends.

details.title: FeudFall
details.short_description: A guild-war MMORPG. Plant a Tree of Life, raise a walled city, arm your guild from its own forges, and hold your walls against every rival. Action combat, full-bag loot, and sieges where a city built over seasons can fall in one night.

details.title: Just One Bottle
details.short_description: Protect your island against those who say "Just One Bottle" in this cozy, chaotic island-cleaning game. Collect the garbage, sell it for profit, and use your earnings to upgrade your cleaning operation. Keep your island sparkling, deal with increasingly messy tourists, and turn trash into treasure!

details.title: Arctic Station Six
details.short_description: Program a remote Arctic weather station to run itself through the polar winter. Write and optimize assembly programs to read your instruments, warn of gales, launch weather balloons, and more. Grow the site level by level from a small outpost to a fully fledged research station.

details.title: Save the Red Box
details.short_description: Reach the red portal and the level turns on you. Every stage is a round trip: get there normally, then fight your way back through chaos mode, where the room mutates into black silhouettes, new traps and warped sound. 0.5-second respawns. No upgrades, just get good.

details.title: DAYON
details.short_description: DAYON is a multiplayer sandbox set in a walled, near-future city where everyday life, ownership, combat, and exploration come together. Create your own build from dozens of skills, free from fixed classes and levels. Live your way in a city synced with real-world time.

details.title: Stack Coffee Shop
details.short_description: Run a coffee shop from backyard to table. Grow ingredients, turn your harvest into drinks and food, and serve your customers by stacking cards. Hire employees and connect conveyor belts to automate every step from growing to serving.

details.title: Line Story
details.short_description: Follow number clues and connect the dots to reveal hidden illustrations in this cozy, hand-drawn logic puzzle game. Bring Lili and Nene's storybook world to life, one drawing at a time.

details.title: The Unfinished Horror Game
details.short_description: You wake up inside a horror game that was never finished. Glitches everywhere, monsters that ignore their code, and an old man who says he wants to help. Find the key, survive the house and get out alive.

details.title: ICEWAKE
details.short_description: Steer a nuclear icebreaker across a frozen, sunken world. Dive a tiny sub into drowned cities for salvage, save the sick in underwater towns — and survive what hunts in the deep: a monster that hatches from the dead, grows, and one day comes for your ship.

details.title: Wild West Gunslinger
details.short_description: Dust fills the sky. Gunfire never ceases. In this Western world where law has failed and only the strong survive, you will step into the boots of a bounty hunter, plunging into fight after fight for survival.

details.title: Tracked
details.short_description: Tracked is a strategic hacker-heist game played through a fictional operating system. Analyze contracts, route through digital relays, and run tools on your own rig. Manage resources and an active Trace—and disappear before the trail leads back to you.

details.title: Foldbound
details.short_description: A papercut metroidvania. The world was folded from one great sheet of paper, and something has begun to cut it. As a little paper knight, leap, slash and dash through a meadow, the dim roots below it, an ember-lit loft and a vast bindery, find what hides in the folds, and mend the world.

details.title: Chernoberg: Rebirth
details.short_description: A Super Polymerization of a turn-based SRPG that combines strategic depth with exhilarating combat, and a story-driven AVG packed with tens of thousands of words and a plot full of twists and turns. Experiment with diverse party compositions and discover the playstyle that suits you best.

details.title: Gangs of Nightglade
details.short_description: A card battler where you fight with poker hands. Deploy your gang members, build poker hands with them and sabotage your opponent's attempts to complete theirs. In the story campaign, you lead a gang trying to solve the mystery of its former leader's disappearance.

details.title: Tales of the Southern Seas
details.short_description: Build trade routes, recruit companions and refit your fleet in a single-player sailing adventure set in the late-Ming Southern Seas. Navigate wind, waves and strange encounters. Will you turn the sea into a ledger—or learn to live alongside it?

details.title: Alamare: The Wayfarer's Hand
details.short_description: Command mythic creatures in a single-player roguelite card battler. Choose your attacks, play support cards, and ascend into stronger forms mid-battle. Collect new cards, build your deck, and chart your path through dangerous expeditions across fallen realms.

details.title: Doctor Funkelstein
details.short_description: Build and upgrade your mad scientist laboratory to bring your creatures to life! Strategically manage your souls, unstable science and experimental ingredients to show the world your brilliance in this spookily cozy incremental game.

details.title: Orbit: Night Shift
details.short_description: Vacuum up space junk, crack the data chips hidden inside and wake the 70 women of the Star Harbor's lost night shift. A cozy collecting game with upgrades, lootboxes without real money, your own space station and a very grumpy alien merchant.

details.title: FrankenCars
details.short_description: Build ridiculous cars from mismatched parts, test them in drag races and long jumps, then sell your creations to fund the next disaster! FrankenCars is a lighthearted car-building tycoon where clever upgrades and terrible engineering go hand in hand.

details.title: Scary Zombie Shooting Game
details.short_description: Build your defences, buy guns and kit out your survivors in this top-down pixel-art zombie survival game. When night falls, the dead emerge from the trees and your people do the shooting. Watch your strategy unfold, hold out for rescue, or stay and see how long you can last.

details.title: MageInc
details.short_description: An Incremental Magic game where you face ghouls and other monstrosities blocking your path. Use Fire, Ice, Earth and other elements to annihilate them!

details.title: Rewind to Coding
details.short_description: It’s 2010 and AI isn’t a thing yet. You’re a developer who looks for answers in documentation, web searches and your brain. Build your career, solve problems in JavaScript, pay bills and choose your own path to success.

details.title: Chat, we are Cooked
details.short_description: Humanity is facing extinction. And naturally, as it always does, it's handling the situation very professionally. Become an asteroid, grow into an unstoppable cosmic disaster, and watch Earth react and respond with missiles, politics, corporate greed, and increasingly questionable breaking news.

details.title: Night Radio
details.short_description: Run your late-night radio show, take calls from strange listeners, uncover their secrets, solve puzzles and survive the horrors of the night.

details.title: Coin Shower
details.short_description: Coin Shower is a short, cozy incremental casino arcade game. Every machine pays out in a burst of coins that pile up on the floor. Scoop them up, spend them on upgrades, unlock new machines, and chase the $1,000,000 moon shot.

details.title: Shio: Be With Me
details.short_description: A quiet train, a cold-faced vampire girl, and a promise you can't quite remember. Take on commissions with Shio, stay focused together, and slowly find your place beside her.

details.title: Trust No One: MAFIA
details.short_description: The party game Mafia, but nobody closes their eyes at night. A first-person social deduction shooter for 7 to 15 players with proximity voice chat. The Mafia can take a dark form: no voice, no name above their head. If someone in the dark won't answer you, run. Or shoot first.

details.title: Round Table Rivals
details.short_description: A turn-based fighting game set in a young, alternate Avalon. Choose your team, explore the lands, and face iconic figures in dynamic combat that mixes real-time mechanics with tag-team strategy.

details.title: Glow Trap
details.short_description: Move lanterns and set lures to draw moths, fireflies, beetles, spiders and ants into your garden, capture the ones you want, and fill a museum of bell jars. A cozy collection game where every species wants something different.

details.title: Dice Dice Battles
details.short_description: Buy dice, line them up, and watch them play. Move one die and the whole line changes. A roguelike dice battler about finding absurd combos, then testing them against a cursed dungeon or other players in async PvP.

details.title: Demiurges: Land of Strife
details.short_description: A survivor-like action game: You start as a mortal and randomly obtain fragments from different factions in combat. Collect a complete set to ascend into a brand-new form—new model, more skill slots, and a deeper skill library—leading to a completely different combat path.

details.title: Adventile
details.short_description: Every adventurer is a puzzle piece. Hire them, fit them together and clear the dungeon in this polyomino puzzle × resource-management roguelite. Every floor can be solved — the question is how cheaply. Whoever you place is gone for good. 30 weeks to reach the Three Great Dungeons.

details.title: Wall Over
details.short_description: Stack furniture, combine your powers, and toss a friend over the wall in a physics adventure for 1–4 players. Play solo or team up online as four tiny creatures on a quest to bring their village’s missing music box home.

details.title: Spells of Arcanetheria
details.short_description: A dark 16-bit roguelite where magic is everything. Find lost spells, master them, then forge your own from soul shards, Aether and relics: one roll, no recipes, yours forever. When death comes, roll the d20. When your hero falls for good, their spells live on for the next adventurer.

details.title: Slime Overload
details.short_description: Slime Overload is a Plinko roguelike auto-battler and deckbuilder. Slime balls grow stronger as they bounce off pins, then summon an army at the exits. Combine slimes and relics, upgrade your machine, choose paths to exploit enemy weaknesses, and protect your Hero Slime to defeat the final boss!

details.title: Spotlight Tennis
details.short_description: Spotlight Tennis is a classic tennis game. Upgrade your skills, play to win, and become a champion!

details.title: Wing It
details.short_description: Design your own aircraft in the hangar, from the wing shape to the engines, then fly cargo across an endless world with changing weather. Save your missing grandmother's airfield in a story that grows with every update. And if you crash, your plane breaks apart piece by piece.

details.title: Unfolding Memories
details.short_description: Build paper pop-ups at a quiet desk. Glue folds onto a card, cut them with a knife, add stickers and words, then open and shut the book to watch it all fold flat. When you like it, print the pattern and make it for real.

details.title: Ball of Goof
details.short_description: A game you've never played before! Explore this world with up to 4 peeps (that's slang for people) in this comedically-driven open world sandbox by platforming through challenging challenges, unlock new abilities & uncover the delicious lore behind the ultimate question... What is a Ball of Goof?

details.title: Floppaland
details.short_description: A cozy island life sim: fish, build your village and befriend villagers, alone or with friends. Plus Floppa Kart racing, Floppa Party board games, the Floppatopia team adventure and the Floppa Odyssey 3D platformer.

details.title: Tempo Derby
details.short_description: Tempo Derby is a timing-driven horse-racing roguelike. Hit the sweet spot, build powerful relic combinations and race through a 15-stage campaign. Unlock new horses, fuse legendary relics and outpace five bosses on your way to the championship.

details.title: Black Dawn Rises
details.short_description: The action game where you write the orders. Sign tomorrow's order as written or change it, then fight the mission your choice made: free-flow combat, a whip that binds, and Iona Sorn at your side. Since 1947, secret files have said what happens next. Arena co-op for two, on one couch or online.

details.title: Baggage Bedlam
details.short_description: Baggage Bedlam is a fast paced multiplayer party game where friends compete to route luggage through chaotic airport conveyor belts. Flip switches, grab power ups, dodge floor hazards, and sabotage your friends as you race to deliver bags to the right destinations!

details.title: Starfuse
details.short_description: A cozy fireworks incremental. Launch shells, pop drifting lanterns and set off huge chain reactions. Every upgrade you buy is a star in the night sky: light them all and rekindle the dead Sun. Short and complete, about 3 hours.

details.title: Dragonwing-Rampage
details.short_description: Unleash your fury and blast through enemy lines! Dragonwing Rampage is a 2D bullet hell roguelite. Catch wild beasts, raise dragons, and build a ranch on your sky island. Gear up, dodge through bullet storms, and stack blessings to unleash the firepower you need to defend your home from the Void.

details.title: SERPENTER
details.short_description: A fast, colorful 3D snake adventure across 9 floating worlds and 63 levels! Dodge crumbling floors, slippery ice and wild hazards, unleash power-ups, tackle endless runs and daily challenges, or play with up to 4 friends. Help Zip find Ray!

details.title: Used Car Empire
details.short_description: You cannot see the car. You can only read it. Buy used cars off strangers, work out what is wrong with them before it costs you, and decide what to tell the next owner. A 2D deduction game about the motor trade, in a small town that remembers every car you sell.

details.title: PLZ GIVE ME 666
details.short_description: A dice roguelite. Nine ordinary people have fallen into the labyrinth where Solomon sealed 72 demons. You are Belial, the demon king whose bet is that all nine get out alive. Roll their dice on a 3×3 grid, swap places to build poker-style hands, and lead them up five floors to the top.

details.title: Poker Block
details.short_description: Place card blocks on a grid, form poker hands and chain combos to reach each floor's target score. Buy bonuses, choose tokens that last for the run and adapt your strategy in this roguelike puzzle game.

details.title: FIREDAMP
details.short_description: Ostrava region, November 1994. Following a methane explosion, the entire shift—including your younger brother—remains trapped in the Terezie mine. Descend 900 meters underground with a headlamp, a canary, and a pickaxe. The buried can't see you, but they can hear you.

details.title: Orbitfall
details.short_description: Launch your fleets into orbit and let physics fly them. Low orbits are fast, high orbits slow, and every meeting counts down on the map. Seven factions, up to eight players against AI or friends online: claim the planet, bomb it from orbit and outplan everyone.

details.title: Only Humans On Board
details.short_description: Buy supplies and manage your resources. Serve passengers quickly from your trolley, but stay alert! something feels wrong. Some passengers are only pretending to be human...

details.title: The Scent Of Home
details.short_description: A lost puppy follows the scent of his family across forests, farms, lakes and mountains, helping the animals he meets along the way. A gentle, wordless adventure for children and the grown-ups who play with them.

details.title: Project Life
details.short_description: 一款剧情丰富的roguelike互动小说游戏，也是一款拥有无限可能的构史引擎。假如人生可以重来，你将如何选择？主推故事集《中国式人生》，模拟90后/00后/10后的人生，在无数选择中体验一代人的共同记忆！游戏本体故事专为90后00后10后、互联网深度用户、喜欢搞笑抽象风格的玩家打造！

details.title: Rustown
details.short_description: Five years after the “idiot virus” pandemic, a letter arrives from the father you thought was dead. Rustown is a story-driven stealth adventure about finding him in a slum where the infected live. Evade watchful eyes, follow clues, and discover the stories of those caught up in the city's troubles.

name: 气运之子The One of Fortune

details.title: 气运之子The One of Fortune
details.short_description: Step into the mysterious and boundless world of Chinese-style fantasy. Gather the mysterious power of destiny. You can either assume the role of the revered leader of the righteous path, or transform into the powerful Demon Lord of the evil path.

details.title: FOMO
details.short_description: A 1x waste or a 100x investment. Whether you buy or not, you're already playing.

details.title: Smile Run
details.short_description: An endless runner with adorable characters. Run through multiple environments with different play styles. Play two modes of either limited time Gift Delivery or endless Ice Cream mode. Multiple levels of increasing difficulty.

details.title: Mote
details.short_description: Mote is a hard sci-fi, squad-based, turn-based tactical roguelike played on a hexes. Create an species with unique abilities, senses, and combat styles. Command a squad as you explore distant systems, encounter new societies, and choose which factions to help, and which to betray.

name: World of Magic: Rise of Magic

details.title: World of Magic: Rise of Magic
details.short_description: An open-world Medieval Punk Action RPG. Combine and modify spells in real time while enemies adapt to your combat tactics. Choices shape a living fantasy world filled with cities, monsters, and escalating conflict.

details.title: Whispers of Primwood
details.short_description: Escape into art, music, and choice in this spicy romantasy otome. Whispers of Primwood is a seductive tale of trust, betrayal, and shifting morals. A simple delivery leads you into a forest both beautiful and deadly, and toward two dangerously alluring men.. Could a nightmare turn into a dream?

details.title: The Crown
details.short_description: From humble beginnings, rise up to take your place in the city's underworld! Your choices will decide how the story plays out in this Visual Novel about crime in the 2000s East Coast. Choose-Your-Own-Adventure, Stat-driven, Deep Meta-progression.

details.title: Astro Fighters 3
details.short_description: The aliens have returned. Fight through relentless waves of enemies, dodge impossible bullet patterns, unleash devastating special weapons, and unlock 70 powerful cards that reshape future runs in this action-packed arcade shoot 'em up.

details.title: The Last Swordmaster
details.short_description: 《The Last Swordmaster》 is a Chinese wuxia action Roguelite loot game. Set in a world shaped by the Huajian Workshop, you play the final disciple of the Last Swordmaster, wield ancient weapons, build your own martial style, and fight through a blood-ink-corrupted jianghu.

details.title: Kwun Tong: The Origin
details.short_description: My friend is starting a new model shop located in Kwun Tong. But he disappeared since the second day of opening...

details.title: Chechelevo Mainland
details.short_description: Chechelevo Mainland is a procedurally generated sandbox game focused on resource gathering. Carve your path through the landscape, upgrade your robot, uncover hidden stashes, and build your own underground world, progress is saved locally, and every world is unique thanks to seed-based generation.

details.title: Pixel Piracy Online
details.short_description: Pirate MMORPG with zero microtransactions. Set sail alone or with friends, and build your pirate empire using force or trade. In this pirate simulator game, you write your own RPG story.

details.title: Age of Legacy
details.short_description: A turn-based roguelike RPG where every enemy has a plan and you only get one life. Read their tricks, counter them with your abilities and runestones, and fight through a broken kingdom to the general who murdered the King.

details.title: STRAY BULLET
details.short_description: Free-to-play cartoon shooter where YOU are the bullet. Hop, blast off with gunpowder, fly on flames and go kamikaze in online matches for up to 20 players. Earn killstreaks like UAV, helicopter or nuke. Bots and split screen. No pay-to-win.

details.title: REaffraid
details.short_description: REAFFRAID is a THIRD person SURVIVAL HORROR game where you FIGHT Soldiers, Robots, Zombies and SEXY demon girls with powerful weapons and hand to hand fighting techniques.

details.title: Nereus
details.short_description: Set out aboard an old bathyscaphe to find a missing underwater station. Descend into the depths, keep your equipment running, and watch what lurks beyond the portholes. Explore the station and uncover what happened to its crew.

details.title: Stingray Sanctuary
details.short_description: Stingray Sanctuary is a cozy idle management game. Raise stingrays in real time, then stack creatures, plants, and curios into systems that earn and collect money for you. Start small, get rich, and let the island run while you're away, or keep it docked on your desktop as you work.

details.title: Dead Man's Pass
details.short_description: The dead cast no shadow. Guard the gate to the afterlife in this checkpoint horror game, catching demons grinning inside your sacred mirror and living trespassers weighing down the river ferry before one bad stamp comes back to haunt your next night.

details.title: Zero Gumbit
details.short_description: A cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Play poker-style hands, stack Chips and Mult with 145 wild Jokers and break eight Antes of Boss Blinds. Swear risky vows in the Gambit, fuse Jokers at the altar. No gambling, no betting, no real money. Just combos.

details.title: Doomsday Sector
details.short_description: Survive relentless waves of U.M.F. cyber-zombies in this gritty, retro-futuristic survival FPS. Play as an elite Vindex soldier, explore a non-linear desert bunker, unlock 18+ weapons including a devastating Microwave Gun, and multi-upgrade your arsenal at the Proto-Max station!

details.title: BrickHub
details.short_description: Build, fight and compete in BrickHub, an online sandbox shooter where players create maps, battle in PvP matches and shape their own arenas.

details.title: StarshipFighter
details.short_description: Build and customize your own starship, then survive escalating waves of enemies and intense boss fights. Unlock new parts, upgrade your loadout, choose your difficulty, and climb the leaderboard in this fast-paced 2D top-down space shooter.

name: Sound of the Night - Nightclub Building & Management Sim

details.title: Sound of the Night - Nightclub Building & Management Sim
details.short_description: Build, design, and manage your own nightclub in a cyberpunk city. Shape your space, grow your business, and turn your club into a thriving nightlife destination.

name: Sonucido: Dreams of the Gray God by Daniel da Silva

details.title: Sonucido: Dreams of the Gray God by Daniel da Silva
details.short_description: Sonucido: Dreams of the Gray God is a dark fantasy turn-based, party-based Horror RPG. As you descend into the gruesome depths of Sonucido, it's becoming clear as sin that it was a mistake to even set one foot into this twisted place.

details.title: Crossarium
details.short_description: Dive into a story-driven game about a newspaper editor at a small American publishing house in the 1980s.

details.title: Rush Hollow
details.short_description: Rush Hollow is a movement shooter with a big heart and a lot of guts! Uncover the secrets of Rush Hollow as you fight your way through it's many dungeons.

details.title: Cosmic Composer
details.short_description: Casual puzzle game on a cosmic scale. Build stars, planets and other cosmic objects. Evolve your cosmos using abilities of the stars from stellar winds to supernova.

details.title: Custom Hero vs Epic Boss
details.short_description: A dark fantasy 2D platformer with RPG elements. Lead expeditions, level up your entourage, and loot rare gear from monsters. Master challenging platforming levels, defeat epic bosses, and uncover the secrets of the ancient Pact.

details.title: Rey: Shattered Darkness
details.short_description: A dark pixel-art action platformer set in a world shattered across time. Block, parry and cut your way through broken eras, cleanse the corruption spreading through them, and find your way home.

details.title: Splitcard
