details.short_description: The only way to save his beloved Jill from her death, is for Jack to shoot through hordes of Voodoo Dolls at the Witch's Halloween Party. Voodoo Dolls is an original FPS Video Game packed with fast paced action and non-linear 90s style dungeons.

details.title: Roguelike Story
details.short_description: A Strategy JRPG Story Driven Roguelike

details.title: Clown House: Lunacy
details.short_description: A narrative horror experience where violence is a trap. Unravel the secrets of a derelict mansion and its uncanny clown residents. Solve puzzles. Observe the clowns, deduct their needs and what angers them to survive. And never harm the residents of the Clown House. It has eyes.

details.title: TacBrain
details.short_description: TacBrain is a tactical strategy game focused on small-scale battles, an innovative command system, and realistically paced combat. Issue orders, coordinate your units, and use positioning, timing, and careful planning to outmaneuver your opponent.

details.title: Famine
details.short_description: Play as the new candidate chosen to participate in a deadly game. If you succeed, humanity will survive a few more days. If you lose, you die.

details.title: Bad Heroes
details.short_description: Save the world and romance misfit heroes in the first-ever dating sim and beat-em-up! When a crime wave grips Gloom City, you and your ragtag band of heroes-for-hire uncover shocking truths about the A-list supers at the top. Fight crime, punch mimes, and kiss six superheroes with supernatural abs!

details.title: Damned Dwellers
details.short_description: Play out your misery as entertainment for the all-seeing Dungeon that brought you to life in this hack-n'-slash rogue-lite. Delve uncharted rooms, puzzles, and fight monsters like yourself to learn what makes it tick, but DON'T let it grow bored...

details.title: Hotel Espir
details.short_description: Trapped overnight in a grand Alabama hotel built on plantation soil, you must outsmart the echo of a century-old killer. Use sound, stealth, and your instincts to survive the night and uncover the secret beneath Hotel Espir.

details.title: Peppermint Academy
details.short_description: A cute western bara visual novel with RPG combat, where you can build a party, collect monsters, and have a romance with hot guys. Peppermint Academy is a strange school that brings together humans, demons, and angels from many different worlds.

details.title: Badass Brad
details.short_description: They killed your wife. They killed your dog. Now it's your turn to kill them in this fast paced roguelike!

details.title: Load Path: Engineering Office Manager
details.short_description: Run your own engineering firm in this cozy office builder/automation game. You'll get to build your office floor by floor, automate the flow of projects, and play engineering themed mini-games, all whilst trying to not get buried in paperwork.

details.title: Song of Horror: Enhanced Edition
details.short_description: The Presence is watching. Enter this third-person psychological horror adventure and survive a paranormal entity you cannot fight, one that strikes when you least expect it. Uncover the story through multiple characters in an experience unique to every player.

details.title: Hollow Covenant
details.short_description: A grim dark-fantasy MMORPG in a world kept alive by corrupted gods. You are nobody: your father is buried and his killer is still walking. Level, craft, guild up, and decide how each fallen deity ends - purify, slay, or bind. No one chose you. You chose to cross.

details.title: LIMINOUS
details.short_description: An exploratory first-person survival horror story about travelling the gaps in our reality. Risking everything to keep the lab funded and the board members happy.

details.title: Hallow's Eve
details.short_description: Welcome to Hallow's Eve We follow Stingy Jack, on his adventure to possible redemption. Come and follow Jack to see where he will go.

details.title: Faceless Residence
details.short_description: Explore an abandoned mansion shrouded in mystery and danger. Face eerie creatures, solve challenging puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets that could be your key to escape – or something far darker.

details.title: ECHO_
details.short_description: ECHO is a stylized role-playing game. Play as a young woman returning from deep space, exploring a silent Earth,solving puzzles, and following a mysterious signal to find the people and memories she left behind.

details.title: Trillionaire Mercenaries of 21XX
details.short_description: In 21XX, humanity clings to the remains of a cyberpunk world consumed by the ocean. As corporations fight for what's left, you'll work as a mercenary for the ultra-rich, carrying out covert operations in a third-person stealth adventure that tips the balance of global power.

details.title: WORLDS: Anthropos
details.short_description: Embark on the only story ever told. You are Maya, marooned on a hostile world with no memory of the fall that put you there. Ammunition, healing and life share one meter — you replenish it only by surviving. Seven worlds stand between you and the truth. Anthropos is the first.

details.title: For God and For Profit
details.short_description: For God and For Profit is a Renaissance investigation game. Audit the ledgers, question the merchants, and uphold the truth...for God and for profit.

details.title: Liminality: Chapter 1
details.short_description: Liminality is a Singleplayer Liminal Horror Game That focuses on Liminal Environments, and has a bunch of lore that you have to uncover - Based on the web-series and movie created by Kane Parsons (The Backrooms) CAN YOU ESCAPE THE LIMINAL COMPLEX

details.title: Nav Singh's Poohopia
details.short_description: An open-world RPG adventure. More details coming soon.

details.title: Mars Era
details.short_description: Mars Era is a turn-based strategy game about Mars colonization. Build your base, welcome settlers, gather resources, research technologies, and overcome the harsh conditions of the Red Planet. Manage your settlers, develop infrastructure, and turn Mars into a new home for humanity! 🚀

name: Note Defender: A Sight Reading Arcade

details.title: Note Defender: A Sight Reading Arcade
details.short_description: Memorize the notes on the treble and bass staffs as well as 9 ledger lines above and below them. This covers every key of a standard 88 key piano and most instruments.

details.title: 持镣铐者#735
details.short_description: 《The Shackles Holder #735》 is a female-oriented text-based game set in a steampunk world. On November 30, 1875, Police Chief Temis, known for his 100% case clearance rate, was transferred to the crime-ridden city of Nineveh.

details.title: The Long Freeze
details.short_description: The world froze. Humanity changed. Explore the snow-buried remains of civilization, scavenge for food, fuel and supplies, fight those transformed by a failed vaccine, and do whatever it takes to stay warm. The storm never stopped. Will you?

details.title: Tidal Forces
details.short_description: Explore a galaxy of 300 systems as you control your fleet in a top-down 3D style, navigating through Star-lanes, Warp gates, and Black holes. Customize and upgrade your fleet, complete missions, trade, hire your crew, wage war and determine the fate of the galaxy in this grand sim saga.

details.title: Boundless world
details.short_description: Enter the vast forest of Boundless World , no traditional map boundaries, procedural random details/buildings make battles variable; battlefield has differentiated destruction (explodable procedural buildings as key variables); agile AI feels like real players, single-player has multiplayer tension.

details.title: Battle Scars Eternal Stars
details.short_description: This is a simulation game, made by an independent game developer, individual developers have limited energy, please don't have too high expectations. You play as a robot exploring a planet. You can freely drive vehicles, use weapons to attack, and more advanced weapons such as controllable missiles

details.title: Farming Mushroom
details.short_description: "Let's run a mushroom farm!" The story of novice farmers growing mushrooms begins.

details.title: Settle or Sweep
details.short_description: Settle or Sweep is a single-player Durak roguelike deckbuilder. Attack, defend, take tables into your hand, upgrade cards, and collect Rigs that change the rules. Chain multi-card combos and multipliers to push your score as high as possible.

details.title: Fantasy Cartographer
details.short_description: Fantasy Cartographer is a relaxing game about creating maps with hand‑drawn graphics. Build lands filled with seas, mountains, and forests, gather resources, develop cities and kingdoms, discover new drawings, complete quests, gain experience, and become a master of cartography.

details.title: Canyons
details.short_description: Canyons is a third-person action shooter set in a procedurally generated world. Fight mysterious Awakened alone or in co-op for up to 4 players, command giant Crawlers, build your haven, and survive a brutal living world.

details.title: Magic Animal TD
details.short_description: A cozy, tower defense adventure. Command two unique heroes and deploy a quirky squad of magical animals—like a pig, butterfly, and snail! Customize your defenders with powerful magic crystals to maximize their combat potential and repel enemies across vibrant worlds.

details.title: Echo Doodle
details.short_description: A fast-paced, hand-drawn 2D action roguelite set on the pages of a notebook. Fight through increasingly dangerous stages, choose and combine abilities to shape your build, master fast-paced movement and combat, and take on powerful bosses in every run.

details.title: Unsound
details.short_description: Unsound is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore unsettling environments, solve puzzles, and uncover a dark mystery. Things are not always as they seem, and the deeper you go, the stranger things become. Pay attention to your surroundings and piece together the clues.

details.title: Yeommae
details.short_description: Yeommae is a point-and-click game about traditional Korean shamanism. Investigate objects, witness past memories, and solve puzzles. Uncover the truth through the four senses and untangle the twins' twisted fate at the hands of the Mudang.

details.title: The Other Ear of Sock
details.short_description: An experience for little - and big - people who could use a bit of tenderness. Help the little bunny Sock find a place to hide from the cold winter night. What kinds of characters might he run into?

details.title: The LastShard
details.short_description: Make a life in the last world still lit. In this high-fantasy sandbox MMO, learn skills by using them, craft and trade with players, and build a home. Beyond guarded towns, open PvP puts everything you carry at risk.

details.title: Oathwood Realms
details.short_description: Oathwood Realms is a dark fantasy strategy card game focused on careful planning, tactical decisions, and calculated risk. Luck plays a role, but victory favors players who read the board and commit to their choices.

details.title: St. Nicholas Night
details.short_description: The Night of St. Nicholas is a night that rekindles the belief in miracles. Brave the snowstorm, wander through snow-covered streets, uncover hidden presents in a city fast asleep, and restore the magic of this heartwarming winter adventure.

details.title: Mama
details.short_description: An emotional narrative point-and-click about a daughter caring for her mother as dementia reshapes their bond. Explore heartfelt conversations, fragmented memories, and story-driven puzzles on a journey of caregiving and learning to let go.

details.title: Hopeless
details.short_description: HOPELESS is a first-person psychological horror game where players explore looping, distorted environments, observe subtle changes in reality, and survive an ever-shifting space.

name: KREIS AREN ashes of the uprising

details.title: KREIS AREN ashes of the uprising
details.short_description: A 2.5D action RPG where you play as an inventor-hero, battling invaders, crafting unique gear, and exploring a mysterious world. Your decisions determine the fate of your people and the outcome of the uprising.

details.title: The Great Tribes
details.short_description: Blending the best of classic and modern 4X strategy! Lead humanity from nomadic tribes to space conquest. Shape the land, mix cultures, and forge your own laws. Face a fair AI system, which learns and explores the world just as you do.

name: Nexus of the Dead God: The Microcosm

details.title: Nexus of the Dead God: The Microcosm
details.short_description: You will lead a squad—formed solely for the sake of survival—as you continuously push forward across a vast hexagonal map. Recruit companions, adjust your formation, devise tactics, and carve your way out of the Bone-strewn Continent through a series of automatically unfolding battles.

details.title: Skinscribing
details.short_description: SKINSCRIBING is a 2D hand-drawn and dual-handed cosmic folk horror game wherein you explore environments, grief, and bodies alike to interpret and tattoo the history of a dying world as the foundation for the Era to come.

details.title: O.T.B.R.O.S.: Haze of Kazantip
details.short_description: O.T.B.R.O.S.: Haze of Kazantip is a shooter about the Crimean Exclusion Zone in the style of OLR, Anomaly, and Lost Alpha mods, black humor and harsh social satire. Collect anomalies in jars, treat hemorrhoids, and fight evil spirits. Absurdity, hardcore, and complete freedom in the world await you.

details.title: Power of Desert (Quvvat ul-Sahro)
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of medieval Central Asia during the golden age of science, culture, and Islamic revival. Power of Desert is a story-driven, single-player RPG inspired by Uzbek folklore, Turkic legends, and the spirit of ancient warriors. A cinematic journey awaits!

details.title: Major Hoof
details.short_description: Check it out ! it’s pure action and chaos. Major Hoof is a fast-paced 2D shooter inspired by Metal Slug, combining intense bullet hell with environmental destruction and action-packed levels. Fight through hordes of enemies and uncover a dark story.

name: The World of Enemies with You

details.title: The World of Enemies with You
details.short_description: A Novel × Turn-Based RPG told through seven perspectives. Join Mahoru, a new Hunter of αh, and enter Outrealm, a world threatened by Enemies. Experience strategic battles and a story where each perspective reveals a different truth. Uncover the secrets of this world. これで約260〜280文字程度です。

details.title: Shatterlight
details.short_description: Shatterlight — survival horror platformer. Play as Agnes as you enter a Victorian mansion swallowed by the Dark World, where fears take physical form. Use light and a mirror shard to survive living darkness, uncover a family’s nightmare, and find your missing brother.

name: War of Light: Liberation of Aetherquill

details.title: War of Light: Liberation of Aetherquill
details.short_description: A 2.5D dark-fantasy action RPG with roguelike builds and a multi-ending story. Choose your hero, face unpredictable battles, draft items and equipment, and summon Roundtable allies. Shape Aetherquill’s fate through your decisions. Play solo or in two-player local co-op.

details.title: Send & Defend
details.short_description: Send & Defend is a competitive multiplayer tower defense game. Carve your own maze, build towers and send creeps to grow your income. Watch your rivals, steal their lives and be the last one standing.

details.title: Octopus City Blues
details.short_description: In a world of ice, the last human city is tearing itself apart. Explore the underbelly of a monstrous metropolis in a surreal adventure about everything and nothing.

details.title: Typhoon Unit ~ Butterfly Requiem
details.short_description: Squad up! Switch heroes on the fly, and chase down the Steel Butterfly in a world where magic and technology intertwine! Are you the right team for the job?

details.title: Killbot General
details.short_description: Satisfying roguelite tactics packed in 5-minute battles. Controller-friendly with emphasis on tactics, not speed (low APM), no micromanagement, all in a wild and irreverent roguelite campaign for solo or co-op. Put anything you want on your flag...

details.title: Neverlooted Dungeon
details.short_description: Venture deep into the Neverlooted Dungeon in search of its legendary treasure, and face its treacherous, deadly traps. Using your creativity and magical items in a highly interactive physics-based world, find your own ways to outsmart the dangers, and be the first to uncover its darkest secrets.

details.title: Adventures of Ruby Rabbit
details.short_description: "The Adventure of Ruby Rabbit" is a light action shooter adventure game. In the game, you can control Ruby the cute bunny, fight the bunny balls, and grow as she grows.

details.title: Former Future
details.short_description: Vaporize evil robots and reclaim Saturn’s cities in this strategic shooter. The path you choose shapes the enemy's strength, the tools at your disposal, and the final stand you'll face. Overcome adaptive AI in solo or co-op play where distinct characters and synergistic abilities reward teamwork.

details.title: The House In The Hollow
details.short_description: With graphics inspired by the 1920's Art Deco period, and a chilling soundtrack, the "House In The Hollow" will take you on a journey filled with mystery, horror, and magic, where you are the master of your own fate.

details.title: Food Industry
details.short_description: Build and expand in agriculture, industry and commerce. Evolve in the food industry sector, and weather the storms by helping your people build the new world.

details.title: Lost Viking: Kingdom of Women
details.short_description: While traveling to the East the Vikings fall into a trap. Ragnald is saved by the accompanying wolf and must find his loved ones. The Viking and his companion are forced not only to survive, but properly manage time, space and energy to achieve the goal.

details.title: Warden Tycoon
details.short_description: Build a prison from an empty plot into a four-level giant, then run it. A thousand inmates each have needs, moods, friends and grudges. Feed them, keep them busy and watch them closely, or they will fight, riot, smuggle, dig and climb their way out.

details.title: Star Shift Legacy
details.short_description: The year is 2357. Humans have explored the stars and colonized many worlds under the authority of the Earth Systems Alliance (ESA). Amidst the chaos of a civil war, what would be your legacy?

details.title: Treasure Islands
details.short_description: Take to the seas with Nick and Pippa on an exciting isle hopping adventure, as you search for new exhibits for their old Museum!

details.title: Legends of Astravia
details.short_description: Dynamic battles, twisting dungeons, and countless secrets await you in the magical world of Astravia. Journey alongside your companions as you unravel the mystery of your past and uncover the truth behind a mysterious trio’s plot... before the Cataclysm brings forth another age of ruin.

details.title: Come Bye: Sheepdog Simulator
details.short_description: Learn to herd sheep the way real shepherds do: with a whistle and a faithful sheepdog. Send your dog wide around the flock, then ease them down the lane and through the gate. Push too hard and fear spreads until they bolt; hang back and they wander off to graze. Bring every last one home.

details.title: Unsung Warriors
details.short_description: Unsung Warriors is a 2D action-adventure game. The game can be played solo or in couch co-op mode. Enjoy beautiful handcrafted levels. Fight against ferocious enemies and discover the many secrets of this ancient world.

details.title: Anchor
details.short_description: Anchor is a large-scale underwater multiplayer survival game. Build your base, craft tools and weapons, explore, loot and prepare for battle. Every player is a potential threat in a persistent world where bases can be raided, alliances broken, and the ocean itself hunts you.

details.title: Godsend
details.short_description: Godsend is a melee slasher set during the Crusades, where you must defend the grail against endless waves of enemies. You only pass the wave if you max your Fear meter out - which you can do by *rapidly* defeating enemies or using "Intimidator" items to help. Original Soundtrack by Shaun Finnegan.

details.title: Cyberdelic
details.short_description: Cyberdelic is an immersive FPS - Use a combination of weaponry to pierce hostile shields, armour and flesh. Swap out cybernetic components to best suit your combat encounters. Explore an interconnected environment acquiring additional tools to your arsenal.

details.title: Sandtable Engine
details.short_description: Welcome to the sandbox world full of creativity! With a free and open gameplay mode and a creative platform, whether you are a player or a developer, you can find highly scalable gameplay and game modes, or DIY your own game ideas here!

details.title: The Cabbage Effect
details.short_description: A cartoon-pop-surrealistic twin-stick shooter with brawl elements that takes place in an apocalyptic narrative.

details.title: Mike & Tyler
details.short_description: Investigate a mysterious murder with Mike and Tyler in a Miami Vice–inspired point-and-click adventure. Solve puzzles, analyze clues, and deduce suspects — all without a single line of dialogue.

details.title: Amethyst
details.short_description: Eight heroes. Infinite decisions. One winner. Amethyst is a deep 1v1 tactical strategy game — draft your team, level your heroes, contest objectives, and wager your matchmaking rating on your read of the game.

details.title: Hand Shadow
details.short_description: Challenge your mind with puzzles that are based on optical illusions. Find the perfect position and angle by rotating the hands until order is restored, and discover a story of protagonist Morgan with professional voicing.

details.title: Purrseus
details.short_description: Solve puzzles, evade traps, use magic, and even call on a friend to help in this epic tale of Purrseus, the ancient Greek hero tasked with proving to the Gods he has both brawn AND brains!

details.title: Crown Yer King
details.short_description: A 3-D precision platformer where you, The Crown, must hop and glide your way through challenging levels to reach your bald Kings head! Meet his requirements and don't make him angry!

details.title: Starlit Defender
details.short_description: Roguelike meets freely configurable tower defense!

details.title: 方舟军团 Ark Legion
details.short_description: A 2D adventure game that integrates gameplay such as exploration, trade, construction, and strategic battles. Drive a massive ark to explore the open world, equip your ark with different cabins and accessories, and build your own mobile fortress.

details.title: Generation Ship
details.short_description: Humanity's last hope is you. As its AI, build a generation ship, until the rotating ring can leave a dying Earth behind. Recycle everything your crew needs, keep them alive and fly supply missions in a realistic real-time colony and space simulation.

details.title: Bato Battō
details.short_description: Bato Battō is a 3D platformer-fighter set in classic arena-style multiplayer. Fight with unique direction based melee combat, athletic movement, and multi-chain combos using stylized physics. Compete a variety of game modes - Deathmatch, CTF, King of the Hill, Multi-Team and more!

details.title: Farwoods
details.short_description: A world of storybook roleplaying inspired by works like Redwall and Ironclaw. Join a player-driven living world of fantasy and adventure, contribute to the player-run economy, and help contribute to the organic narratives created by the community.

details.title: Rabbit's Tale
details.short_description: Rabbit’s Tale is a hand-drawn metroidvania where portals lead into roguelike runs, and every boss you beat brings back a new power for the open world. Hunt the oppressive Steam Order, search for your kidnapped family, and survive with a symbiotic companion.

details.title: Dungeons of the Amber Griffin
details.short_description: Play as a group of daredevils who explore the world of dark fantasy in search of fame, amber and gold. Experience the classic mechanics of the iconic ‘90s Dungeon Crawlers with a new twist. Solve the mystery of the ghost that haunted the ruins and discover a bestiary based on Kashubian beliefs.

details.title: Furcifer's Fungeon
details.short_description: An autoscrolling roguelike where everything you do impacts your talent options. Become a necromancer goose, or a berserker wielding a thunder blade! Collect legendary items in each run, and bring them back home for even more build options in the future.

details.title: The Wolf Is Dead
details.short_description: The Wolf is Dead is a murder mystery game. When the Big Bad Wolf is found murdered at a party for his biopic, you're called in. Interrogate suspects, investigate the scene of the crime and use this to travel back in time and reconstruct the events of the evening. Who killed Alexander Wolff?

details.title: Trailer Park Life
details.short_description: Build and manage your own trailer park to either become a peaceful haven or a pit of unruly partiers. Expand on services and amenities to keep tenants happy. Manage staff to keep your park safe and clean or let chaos run amuck and risk it all for higher gains.

details.title: Nokai
details.short_description: Sail north alone or with friends through dangerous waters, chart uncharted islands, and embark on an unforgettable voyage. The farther you venture, the stranger and deadlier the world becomes. The truth lies beyond the horizon.

details.title: Lo-Fi Life
details.short_description: Get up? Or stay in your bed just a few more minutes? A peaceful, small-scale life sim. Go through your mornings and forge your fate with the consequences of your everyday choices.

details.title: Potion Pals
details.short_description: A co-op witches’ shop game for up to 6 players where you brew potions for woodland critters and turn your friends into frogs. Chop, grind, and stir witchy ingredients, fill orders, and try not to blow up the shop. Drink your own stock to explore the woods and uncover forbidden recipes.

details.title: Greed Hunters
details.short_description: Collect artefacts. Trade them for power. Betray your friends. Greed Hunters is a chaotic roguelike for up to 8 players, where even the worst artifacts fuel your rise to dominance.

details.title: BOOOOST!!!!
details.short_description: BOOOOST!!!! is a skill-based, sci-fi themed action platformer with some narrative driven elements and some minor puzzle elements.

details.title: Cursed Dungeon Raider
details.short_description: Embark on an exploration adventure with spooky and horror elements, tasked with recovering real historical artifacts from excavation sites around the world. Beware of local traps and monsters inspired by the mythology of each region.

details.title: Tianfang Funland
details.short_description: After being stranded in a decaying amusement park, an elementary school student and his estranged older brother discover that the city they grew up in has been tampered with. Tianfang Funland is a surreal adventure game with retro game visuals that bring players to 2010s Beijing.

details.title: Beckon
details.short_description: Salvation lies deep beneath blood-soaked earth. Survive horrors born of Scottish folklore alone or with your friends - improve your camp, hunt and forge powerful weapons and find ancient, game-altering magic. From the dark, you hear her Beckon - eat a hearty meal and get ready to descend once again.

details.title: Hop Hop Delivery!
details.short_description: HOP HOP DELIVERY it's your little delivery company! Your goal is to find and deliver animals and objects in all genre, through crazy, creative and deformable levels, using different types of vehicles impacted by physics!

details.title: RogueVirus
details.short_description: Grid-based action roguelike where you face chaotic encounters against computer viruses. Build and upgrade your antivirus using a vast array of commands and add-ons in order to survive.

details.title: Catacombs Of The Yokai
details.short_description: Catacombs of the Yokai is an indie single player psychological survival horror game in which you must explore the twisted depths of randomly generated catacombs filled with enemies inspired by Japanese/Taiwanese urban legends and myths.

details.title: Void Soul Awakening
details.short_description: Void Soul Awakening is a hyper fast action roguelite blending hack and slash combat, third person gunplay, and sorcery. As a wandering soul trapped in an ever shifting cosmic prison, master a massive arsenal, swap between powerful classes, adapt to every run, and fight your way to the Keeper.

details.title: DEPRISION
details.short_description: DEPRISION is a first-person survival horror game where you are the subject of a classified mental manipulation experiment. Explore environments distorted by memories and trauma, survive a system that adapts to your personal fears, and endure traumatic threats.

details.title: Spellcraft
details.short_description: Spellcraft is a new type of strategy game: a Real-Time Battler where you actively command an entire team of heroes and cast spells to outplay your opponents. Wishlist now and play in Preseason 2!

details.title: Firearms Factory
details.short_description: A strategy-management game centered on weapons production and wartime logistics. Your candy factory is forced, by government order, to arm the military throughout both world wars. Set up production lines, supply the front lines, keep your workers alive, and determine the outcome of the war.

details.title: RECURSOR
details.short_description: An action rogue-lite inspired by platform fighters

details.title: Myrne 6313
details.short_description: Myrne 6313 is a mix between the extraction shooter genre and corporate life. Survive an hostile office space where each step can be your last. Help HR find their stapler, get chased by security dogs, clear your inbox, fight cultists in the parking lot, learn magic… And more!

details.title: Concerto on White
details.short_description: Rhythm Action? No, this is MUSICIAN SIMULATION! Concerto on White is a musician simulation game featuring classical music. Unlike any typical rhythm games, players are required to actually play the main melody. In the main story, you will experience adventurous campus life in the academy.

details.title: Hero Chest
details.short_description: In a role reversal in Hero Chest, take control of a chest tired of being looted and frighten the heroes back to their guilds! Create your way with the cards, ally with the monsters, save the chests and earn gold Have fun with the perfect combination of Roguelike, Dungeon Crawler and Card Game!

details.title: BATTLESAGE
details.short_description: Fly, dash and strike to save a kingdom in peril, in this fast third- person aerial action-fantasy where movement is your only weapon. Dive into a fight, break away, keep your flow, and grow from novice flyer into a true BattleSage.

details.title: Snowtracked
details.short_description: Feel like a kid again. The door is open to a beautiful winter landscape. Wrestle your way over rocks covered in thick snow. Build anything you want, stick by stick. Play solo or with your friends (1-4).

details.title: Badger Tactics
details.short_description: You stole and lost your sister's favorite figurines. Get them back or face her wrath! Fight, collect, and track down the missing figures before SHE finds you. In this retro turn-based tactical RPG, your fate is decided by the roll of the dice!

details.title: Deflectorium
details.short_description: Deflectorium: 2D sci-fi rogue-lite singleplayer. Deflect deadly shots back at your enemies to become unstoppable. With unique deflection system, you'll dominate battles while upgrading your skills and stats. Prepare for adrenaline experience where defense isn't just a tactic but an art.

details.title: 3 DAYS: Ghosts of War
details.short_description: In the heart of the Afghan wilderness, amidst the chaos of war, you awaken to the stark reality of your mission: three days to navigate the perilous landscape, uncover hidden truths, and confront the ghosts of the past.

details.title: The Walker
details.short_description: The Walker is a single player survival horror game. Peaceful days have passed, you no longer work to eat, but try to survive. Find out what's behind all this, hope you make it out alive.

details.title: Monomon: The Black Sun
details.short_description: In the city of Otnorot, a horrific sinkhole has appeared, destroying a part of the town. Follow Conner and Tallulah and see if they survive the destruction.

details.title: Abyss Fantasia
details.short_description: In the city of Cynthia, the young girl Eucaly, in order to find her lost past, steps into the abyss at the edge of the city. Along the way, she will experience complex and treacherous emotions, encounter various strange creatures, and finally uncover the deepest secrets of the Abyss.

details.title: Void Ledger
details.short_description: Board abandoned ships. Take what you can. Get out alive. Void Ledger is a solo or co-op space salvage game of cards, dice, and hard choices. Push deeper for a bigger haul, or escape while you still can. Sell salvage, upgrade your ship, and pay off your debt before it's too late.

details.title: Panic in Puzzle World
details.short_description: Panic in Puzzle World is an action-packed 2D platformer in the spirit of console classics. Play as Tide and breathe fire, slash with your claws, bounce on bad guys and glide with your wings to put a stop to the robot menace taking over the land, block by block!

details.title: 魔王3：新秩序
details.short_description: Falsemen 3 is a fantastic adventure game based on an independent world view. In the game, players will play a group of non-positive characters and experience the magnificent epic of the times in the story of struggling with the empire.

details.title: PROTOCOL: Requiem
details.short_description: Fight through the Hyperstructure in this Turn-based Tactical Roguelike. Using the Energy Deck and complex Characters, you must optimize every turn to have a chance at rescuing the last human DNA sample. Build your party of Replicas, customize them, and use your strategic mind to finish the mission.

details.title: Scratch The Cat
details.short_description: Grab your headphones and step up to the turntable in Scratch The Cat - a vibrant action-adventure 3D platformer. Play as DJ Scratch, explore a sprawling musical world, fight bosses, and reclaim your stolen records. Turn up the volume and set the stage for the purr-fect comeback.

details.title: Windwalkers: Below the Storm
details.short_description: Lead high-risk surface rescue operations across a storm-scarred Earth. Power your rover, tools, and modular pack with limited energy resources as you recover survivors, salvage critical supplies, and help reclaim the world above.

details.title: SCORCHED EARTH
details.short_description: SCORCHED EARTH is a chunky PS2 mecha-action game with massive amounts of customization, where you play as a mercenary taking on dirty jobs across a planetary war.

name: M.E.C.H.A.: Memory Erasure Control of Hover Attractor

details.title: M.E.C.H.A.: Memory Erasure Control of Hover Attractor
details.short_description: M.E.C.H.A. — an indie survival shooter in a dystopian cyberpunk world! Scavenge for resources, build your relationship with Rika, and upgrade your gear in the world of androids. Experience the gameplay mix of dating simulator and bloody action with all the consequences.

details.title: EREBUS
details.short_description: EREBUS is a third person element focused fighter, where players can face off in a free for all fight. Players will choose an element and utilize one of the four abilities specific to that element, each win is cataloged and the winning element will have the map change to showcase that change!

details.title: Amalga
details.short_description: You wake in a ring of purple light with no memory of who you are, and a voice that says you were chosen. A dark dungeon crawler with a hidden-intent card battler at its core: every blow aimed at a body part, every body a choice, and the strongest cards are what will change you.

details.title: Seclusion: Islesbury
details.short_description: Seclusion: Islesbury is a new horror point-and-click adventure in the vein of genre classics such as Scratches and Dark Fall. Can a decade-old murder case be solved? Is it safe to wander on these streets? Will anyone help you in this town? Find it out in this tale of personal tragedy.

details.title: Super Cucumber
details.short_description: Super Cucumber mixes Saturday morning cartoon charm with fast-paced action platforming. Play as Cucumber, an aardvark superhero, dashing, leaping, and comboing through 100+ handcrafted levels filled with new abilities, hidden secrets, and delightfully devious foes.

details.title: Brickhaven
details.short_description: Create your gang from nothing. Start off with just yourself and take it from a single member to a sprawling criminal empire. Extort businesses, deal drugs, sell guns, and much more. Customize your gang to partake in whatever crimes you want them to. What kind of boss will you be?

details.title: Isometria
details.short_description: Explore an isometric world solo or with friends. Battle goblins, giant crabs, mysterious machines, and powerful bosses to gain their powers. Build a community and help the locals take back their world!

details.title: Mononoke No Kuni
details.short_description: Restore villages, purify yokai, and reclaim a lost world in this Japanese-inspired action-adventure set in an otherworld inhabited by Mononoke. Journey through the corrupted Mononoke no Kuni, recover the stolen soul of Musashi the Shiba Inu, and set out on a grand adventure to return home.

details.title: Infernae
details.short_description: Where you walk, death follows. Duel those who resist in challenging, adrenaline-filled boss battles. In this hack-n-slash bullet hell, don't run from bullets — weaponize them. Fear is no shield.

details.title: Space Scum
details.short_description: Lead a band of mercenaries through battle after battle in this Sci-Fi, turn-based RPG. Fight your way across different planets, earning loot and equipment to outfit your team – and remember, no option is off the table when survival is on the line.

details.title: Foosball Manager
details.short_description: Foosball Manager is a table football management sim. Scout, sign, and train your squad. Set your tactics, then call the shots from the sideline as your players act on their own across a physics-driven table. Climb the divisions and become a foosball legend.

details.title: Phantasist
details.short_description: Phantasist is a game about a boy living with social anxiety!

details.title: Specters of the Sun
details.short_description: Specters of the Sun is a challenging 2D action platformer with action-packed levels. Take on the role of an elusive specter to reclaim your old corpse, now possessed at the heights of your former kingdom.

details.title: Nightborn
details.short_description: Fight, sneak, or charm your way through a gothic modern New Orleans as a Vampire detective of your creation. Unravel a vast centuries-old conspiracy involving Vampire factions, Werewolves, and far stranger horrors. Try to survive as a Nightborn without losing yourself to madness or damnation.

details.title: Eternal Summer
details.short_description: unmixing reality

details.title: Psychotic Bathtub
details.short_description: Have a psychotic episode in your bathtub. Argue with a rubber duck, flood your bathroom and drown Jesus. Find your very own ending – or all of them.

details.title: Eternal Wanderer
details.short_description: Live. Die. Reincarnate. Return decades later as a human, rat, dog, bird or other lifeform and face the world your choices created. Carry karma and knowledge across dozens of lives in a narrative RPG spanning centuries, where every life becomes part of your story.

details.title: Late Amusement
details.short_description: Late Amusement is a first-person psychological survival horror game from an independent studio. Play as Liam Snow, a young aspiring author who enters the derelict theme park alongside his girlfriend Hannah, and fight to survive as you unravel the dark history buried beneath the attractions.

details.title: AAS Mos Apocalypse
details.short_description: A small accident was occurred in the laboratory, which lead to an apocalypse. Not just an apocalypse, but a 'mos apocalypse'. What's a Mos? It's is a bigger version of a mosquito. Those mos are the reason many people have gone missing. Play as every member of the AAS team and stop the apocalypse!

details.title: Cosmorons
details.short_description: The Overlord demands you Conquer the Universe! Grab your friends in a 1-4 co-op roguelite shooter and deploy as grappling robot Drudges. Battle the alien swarms, complete missions and destroy the Cosmos! Stack outrageous upgrades to build the Ultimate Drudges or delve deeper into the Universe!

details.title: MEAT-GRINDER
details.short_description: Have a human MEATGRINDER with Obi the freelance hitman! Fulfill contracts all over the planet, open a beer, turn off your brain: it's time to kill and solve the financial problems of Obi and her peculiar family!

details.title: Winter of the Arbyen
details.short_description: 'Winter of the Arbyen' is a game that combines adventure and store manage simulation. In the world where the Ice Age has come, you must survive as a shopkeeper in a coal mine village. Find the missing father, chase the 'Firestone'. Various characters are waiting to help you or take advantage of you.

details.title: Apathic
details.short_description: Apathic is a first-person psychological horror game. Investigate your brother's disappearance in a mysterious facility. Shift gravity, decipher sounds, and explore underground ducts while evading a creature determined to capture you at all costs.

details.title: Peggy's Farm
details.short_description: Combine the cozy crafting of a farming sim with the satisfying physics of a pachinko game.

details.title: Rewind And Reclaim
details.short_description: REWIND and RECLAIM is a horror adventure where time moves when you move. Explore different outcomes for each movies by using your wits and your environment. Uncover their behind the scenes to unfold the story linking them all and protect your familly from the curse that took your mother's life.

details.title: Kelp Keeper
details.short_description: Take on a vital role in the ecosystem in this action-packed bullet hell. Control a charming sea otter and protect the kelp forest from an endless onslaught of devious sea critters. Skillfully dodge attacks, grab your prey, and eat them all at the surface for a huge satisfying snack.

details.title: The Hydra Experiment
details.short_description: Solve puzzles and fling flasks as a member of a mad scientist collective in this action-adventure RPG. Unlock prototypes and discover new mechanics, using them to explore deeper into 0-Laboratories. Build or burn bridges as you sculpt your persona with branching dialogue and consequences.

details.title: Dark Lessons
details.short_description: Trapped in your teacher's home, your only defense against the dark is a flickering candle. Unearth a family’s twisted history and solve puzzles in this Lovecraftian nightmare to find a way out. But be warned: Something else is lurking in the shadows ... and a voice is pleading for your help.

details.title: Teo Dove Am Skater 2
details.short_description: Skateboarding game in the spirit of THPS. Perform flip tricks, grabs, grinds. Insane lines. Level up your character and learn new tricks. Find hidden secrets. And challenge your rival to a classic game of skate HORSE!

details.title: Usurpator
details.short_description: USURPATOR is an EXTRACTION MELEE SLASHER. Rally your allies, clash with rival players, and battle the forces of evil. Master powerful weapons, unlock new talents, and carve your path to glory—then fight to make it out alive.

details.title: Little Monster
details.short_description: Little Monster is a hand-painted side scroller beat ‘em up where you play as Stormy, a monster under the bed who protects us from our nightmares. Protect the dream! Explore the realms! Rescue your friends!

details.title: Slimeception
details.short_description: Who's sus?! Work together to find out who's lying to you.

details.title: Eternity
details.short_description: Lead the last fleet of mankind across an abandoned star system. Ration life-support, weigh research against survival, and shape society through Fleet Council decisions you cannot undo. Every choice tightens the path to the next jump.

details.title: Crimson Crisis
details.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelike where skill beats firepower. Outmaneuver swarms, harness Poison/Inflame/Traumatize, and expand the game with mods & co-op.

details.title: Iron Slugs
details.short_description: Explosive, fast-paced 1-4 vehicular brawler. Shoot your friends, lay traps, explode almost everything you see on the screen going for elaborate environmental kills

details.title: We Stay Behind
details.short_description: We Stay Behind is a single-player third-person mystery between dreams and reality. A comet is on course to destroy a small town but its inhabitants refuse to leave. Interview the people of Laburnum Creek, explore a beautiful national park and unravel the secrets of this picturesque town.

details.title: BLACKOUT: Zero Point
details.short_description: Blackout is a hardcore co-op shooter for up to 4 players. Become a near-future special forces operative and eliminate infected creatures and monsters fused with machines. Complete missions through intense combat and teamwork, and escape the hellish battlefield.

details.title: Squiigee
details.short_description: Use your momentum to swing, launch and fly, cleaning cityscapes in record time to earn some sweet, sweet cash!

details.title: World War 2027 : Taiwan
details.short_description: When diplomacy collapsed, the world descended into chaos. Nations burned, alliances shattered, and every battlefield became a fight for survival. From the ruins of major cities to the flames of the Pacific, soldiers now fight not for victory — but for humanity’s last future.

details.title: Creej's Corruption
details.short_description: Creej's Corruption is a Combat Based First-Person Action RPG set in a pre-apocalyptic suburban town. When reuniting with your family, an ominous building in the distance suddenly collapses causing a massive chain of events. Your brother has been taken. You're the only one who can save him.

details.title: Devil Apartment
details.short_description: Hello, Jake. Welcome to the game.

details.title: Gravity Shift
details.short_description: Trapped in a space station, your only way out is to solve puzzles by manipulating gravity. In this game you will destroy destructible surfaces and go through non euclidean impossible spaces.

details.title: Legend of Hidden Flows
details.short_description: 《Legend of Hidden Flows》It is a sandbox Immortal cultivation game that combines strategy card construction, open world ,and role-playing.You can experience a different life in this world.

details.title: The Battle for Vega
details.short_description: Inspired by the classic Space Invaders, The Battle for Vega takes the old-school gameplay you know and love and adds new features that make it a fresh and exciting experience.

details.title: Crab Rhapsody
details.short_description: Earn Claw Coins and become unstoppable! Help Mr. Claw stop Crab-GPT and its agents from monopolizing music copyrights. Build your band, unlock ability dressup, and buy Claw Chips anytime, anywhere to upgrade weapons, trigger wild combos, and craft insane builds.🤘🦀🎸

details.title: Where is My Son?
details.short_description: Step into a story of mystery, drama and the supernatural as a father searches for his missing son. Solve puzzles, follow clues and uncover the hidden truth.

details.title: Convenient: Fiend
details.short_description: Quickly dig graves and run for your life while solving puzzles to solve the mystery of the Wendigo

name: 秘封最后旅 ~ Edge of Realm

details.title: 秘封最后旅 ~ Edge of Realm
details.short_description: A Touhou fan game and a 2D pixel shooting survival game, telling the story of Renko looking for her friend Merry in the destroyed Gensokyo, finding the truth about the destruction of Gensokyo and saving the world.

details.title: Hyper Tanks
details.short_description: Choose your tank and fight in neon-lit arenas where shots ricochet off walls! Beat challenging campaigns solo or in co-op, or battle your friends and bots in explosive multiplayer modes. Use powerups, special weapons and tank abilities to survive the mayhem of Hyper Tanks!

details.title: Simulacro
details.short_description: In this first-person philosophical journey, Poísis, an enthusiastic art student, explores a mysterious island in Greece. As she solves the local puzzles, she uncovers traces of its ancient inhabitants, leading her to question her own reality.

details.title: 嘉离代战
details.short_description: One Chariot. Thousands of Enemies. Fight numbers with speed. Break formations with precision.

details.title: Dead Meat
details.short_description: A murder mystery interrogation game - where you can ask the suspects literally ANYTHING! Dive into a macabre conspiracy of burgers and billionaires, getting up-close and personal with an eccentric cast of cold-blooded killers - using voice or keyboard.

details.title: Undermaze
details.short_description: Driven from the surface, your faction settles on the inner walls of spherical caverns and searches for the resource that will bring it back to the surface — before pollution catches up with it. But the next cavities are blocked by mazes: guide your heroes turn by turn and design your own maze.

details.title: BROODSAC
details.short_description: BROODSAC is a 2.5D survival management game where every visitor could save your community or destroy it. Manage your resources, interrogate strangers at your door, and decide who deserves your trust as an invisible threat spreads.

details.title: War Trigger
details.short_description: Destroy, smash and blast your way to victory! Use advanced weapons and vehicles to dominate the battlefield.

details.title: Fishing Echoes
details.short_description: Fishing Echoes is a fantasy fishing game where you catch elemental fish to save the realm from a world-devouring maelstrom.

details.title: The Wake of the Wyrm
details.short_description: A crown upon your head, danger all around. Rule, marry, scheme, raise heirs, wage wars, fulfill prophecies, and survive the waking Wyrm. An interactive text-based dark fantasy novel, 850,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

details.title: Five Day Detective
details.short_description: Five Day Detective is a point and click style adventure game featuring multiple murder cases and a twisted sense of humour.

details.title: Moons That Belong
details.short_description: Embark on a journey of strategy and domination in Moons That Belong, a 2D space strategy game that challenges your tactical prowess. Command your fleet, conquer planets, and outsmart your opponents in this visually captivating and intellectually engaging adventure.

details.title: Suspended Animation 💽
details.short_description: A sci-fi first person exploration game about a ship in danger, and the evil AI tasked with saving it: you.

details.title: Polyroll Pocket
details.short_description: An all new, Pocket-Sized adventure starring Polyroll! Kaiser Kiwi has landed on the moon with a diabolical plan to wipe out the Polyrolls. You'll need to uncover secrets, reclaim the stolen batteries from Kiwi's goons, and power up your rocket ship to blast off for the final confrontation!

details.title: October Nightmares | Cauchemars d'octobre
details.short_description: Explore a Montréal neighborhood in the 70s, investigate a supernatural phenomenon that inflicts nightmares on its residents, and delve into the depths of the world of dreams to save their lives. October Nightmares is a point & click cosmic horror game where exploration mixes with puzzle solving.

details.title: TouHou Legend of Fairy Souls
details.short_description: “TouHou Legend of Fairy Souls” is a TouHou fan game.In the game, because of someone's conspiracy, Reimu turned into Kedama and caused her power to weaken.Reimu then had to embark on an adventure to recover herself and finally uncover who was behind the scenes.

details.title: Fallen Symphony
details.short_description: The world of Fallen Symphony is full of heated battles, engaging puzzles, and fearsome dungeons. Prepare yourself for a unique battle system which is inspired by brawlers from late 90s and gameplay based on the JRPGs of old.

details.title: VICCP 2 Core
details.short_description: The Very Important Central Control Panel is back. Keeping the mysterious atmosphere and with even more mysteries. Control the omnipotence remote, experiment, and find many endings. Brainstorming in retro sci-fi style / Puzzle / Quest / Point Click.

details.title: AirBoost Airship Knight
details.short_description: the blonde Airship Knight Dorota, during a battle in the ruins, accidentally discovers an amnesiac girl, Agate. This also draws the attention of sky pirates, leading to fierce battles. The game offers rich levels and exciting battles, with many companions who will fight alongside you!

details.title: THE SUSPENSE
details.short_description: Discover the story of a man tortured by the hardships of life among “endless rusty walls”. Explore the world of a terrifying alternative future, overcome challenges, and maybe you'll be saved (or at least learn a hint of the truth).

details.title: NANOVOID
details.short_description: NANOVOID is a 2D tactical space shooter that puts you in command of your own modular spaceship. Engage in intense, physics-driven battles, strategize with ship customization, and outsmart your enemies

details.title: Magic Potion Liberators
details.short_description: A bullet heaven action game that gives you a comfortable feeling of being a warrioress. Knock down the onrushing monsters and push forward deep into the enemy territory! Create powerful builds with reinforce potions and crush the witch's servants!

details.title: Dungeon Cleaner
details.short_description: IT'S NOT CLEANING, IT'S SAVING THE WORLD. Grab your trusty detergent and join the bubble guy in this rogue-lite with unique mechanics. Bounce on walls doing acrobatic stunts, meet charismatic characters and dive into dungeons to clean up the chaos that plagues the world of Dungeon Cleaner.

details.title: Charon - Zhetan Chronicles
details.short_description: A turn-based pixel-art 2D Queer Magitech Fantasy (J)RPG where you overcome the chasm ordained by divine fate! An epic story with diverse characters, strategic battles and handmade artworks awaits you!

details.title: Goblin's Journey
details.short_description: Goblin's Journey is a humorous adventure game with a stupid plot and even more idiotic characters. You play as a greedy bastard goblin named Alastar. You are about to save you king's life - in exchange for gold of course! An adventure full of gold, mischief and innapropriate content.

details.title: Survivter
details.short_description: Arenas, dungeons, rooms, a huge amount of monsters and bosses. Roguelike + first-person autoshooter. Unique weapons, various modifiers for the character. All this is waiting for you in Survivter.

details.title: Murder on the Stella
details.short_description: It's a murder mystery. It's an adventure. It's a cruise vacation simulator. It's different each time you play.

details.title: The Last Exam
details.short_description: Dylan hasn't left his home since the pandemic. As he struggles to move forward, his dreams pull him back to one day from his youth: the day of his final exam. Explore his memories in a hand-painted watercolor point-and-click adventure, solve puzzles, and uncover why he can’t let that day go.

details.title: BLIGHTWRECK
details.short_description: Stuck at the bottom of the sea floor, escape a sunken ocean liner in this handcrafted 2D METROIDvania! Find powerful upgrades, and fight strange bosses. You may be isolated from your shipmates, but you're not alone...

details.title: DAO
details.short_description: DAO is a platform action adventure game. You travel back to a dark era. As the last Daoer of your sect, you set off on a journey of vengeance. Combine diverse weapons and talismans to fight numerous foes, and piece together the kingdom's lost memories from fragments.

details.title: Subway Outbreak
details.short_description: In Subway Outbreak, defend and rebuild your metro station against mutant hordes in this pixel strategy game. Manage tasks like fortifying defenses, launching assaults, and gathering resources to survive 30 days of increasingly fierce attacks. Lose by death or generator destruction.

details.title: Clown Meat
details.short_description: Clown Meat is a Precision Platformer with an emphasis on speedrunning and replayability. Tumble through a butchered world where humanity is barely a memory on your naïve journey to cheer up the monolithic clown that came from the Depths of Jupiter.

details.title: 9Cat Saga
details.short_description: 9Cat is a Co-op shooter/action game. Gather your friends to forage and extract in the procedurally-generated landscape. Nourish and furnish your collection of 9Cat, refine your combat styles and overcome various missions and defeat great enemies.

details.title: Choppy Waters
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build your cards, not just your deck. Combine ingredients, each with its own effect, into sushi, then serve it to hungry pirates in turn-based battles. Spend gold to grow stronger, but run out and your voyage is over.

details.title: XWarShooterVR
details.short_description: Dive into "XWarShooterVR": an amazing VR world that combines dynamic shooter, techno-magic and base-building strategy. Make your way to victory in tactical battles and attacks on other players' bases. Add to wishlist now and become a legend in the VR world.

details.title: Project Cradle
details.short_description: Save humanity in the blink of an eye! Project Cradle is a fast-paced action platformer. Pilot a nimble HelperBody drone, a robo kangaroo capable of all sorts of acrobatics! Zoom, burst, and grind through a maze of mysterious underground facilities as you search for the last remnants of humanity!

details.title: Upon Dusk
details.short_description: Welcome to the world of Upon Dusk, a new PvPvE survival shooter. Set in Avalon, you were sealed in a city that was left for dead while the government finds out what went wrong outside the walls. Will you survive?

name: Ordinary Stickman Goes For A Walk

details.title: Ordinary Stickman Goes For A Walk
details.short_description: Ordinary Stickman Goes For A Walk is a 2D platformer with lots of different mechanics and a little bit of humor down the road.

name: Consult Me Before Opening A Snack Shop

details.title: Consult Me Before Opening A Snack Shop
details.short_description: What, you want to open a snack shop? Better call me!

details.title: Trade Tales
details.short_description: Trade Tales is a cozy rags-to-riches life sim about building your dream business in a living fantasy town. Start with nothing as you forage, farm, craft, trade, and run your own shops, deciding what to sell while forming friendships, finding love, and helping your town flourish with your choices.

details.title: Feeling Death
details.short_description: A Game Where You're Killed for Becoming a Couple.

details.title: My Dear Neighbor, edition 404
details.short_description: My Dear Neighbor, edition 404 is a survival horror game that tells the story of your neighbor. Go to your neighbor's house and end up in a glitchy nightmare. Fight your way out of this glitched nightmare amid bugs and nightmarish visions in this psychological horror game.

details.title: The Neath
details.short_description: Beneath you go. Below the bones of the earth and lower into the darkness. Find your way through twisting passages past vile monsters. Explore, discover and conquer your way to greater depths and greater rewards.

details.title: Sanguinite
details.short_description: Sanguinite is a lunar-lander-meets-twin-stick-shooter action game with elements of resource management and exploration. Equip your remote drones and explore the dangerous surface of distant worlds. Bring resources and artifacts back to your ship. Investigate the origin of the aliens you encounter.

details.title: Last Patrol
details.short_description: You are an Orderlord — a mutating meatball cop battling cultists in a surreal post-human dystopia. Evolve your form, investigate an intergalactic conspiracy, and prevent cosmic annihilation in this top-down horror shooter.

details.title: A Ruthless World
details.short_description: Embark on an adventure through a ruthless, puzzle filled 80s-inspired world.

details.title: Throwing Hands
details.short_description: Jump and dash your way to victory in this vibrant side-scrolling platformer. Navigate through stunning environments and intricate puzzles on your quest to punch powerful enemies and save your kingdom.

details.title: Changer Seven
details.short_description: 3D Single-Player Action-Adventure! Explore a Vibrant World, Recruit Colorful Teammates, and Swap them during Combo-Driven Battles! ❤️ A Love Letter to the Toku-Sentai, Shounen Anime, Mahou Shoujo, and Classic Morning Cartoon Shows of our Childhood!

details.title: KVLT
details.short_description: Fight your way through armies of Nazi occultists, religious zealots, and unspeakable cosmic horrors to unveil the Eldritch secrets behind the war theatre in this 2000s-era-inspired grimdark singleplayer FPS where WW2 meets Cthulhu Mythos.

details.title: Red Rebellion
details.short_description: A sapphic fairy tale mashup as Robin Hood teams up with Red Riding Hood to save their town set in a historically accurate medieval England.

details.title: SUMMER ROAD 10-Minute Auto Roguelite
details.short_description: Dress them up, feed Mogmo, pick your path. A cozy roguelite RPG you can finish in 10 minutes a run. Battles play out on their own. Your choices shape the adventure.

details.title: BITGUN Survivors
details.short_description: The first of its kind open-world vampire-survivors game. Explore a dynamic environment, encounter random events, and adapt to survive a zombie outbreak. With upgrades and challenging gameplay, test your skills and adaptability to increase your chances of survival.

details.title: CountDown
details.short_description: CountDown is a casual, semi-idle, 2D tower-defense. Waves of enemies are advancing, it's your job to bolster your city, or rather, ammunition, and wipe them out. Will you rise to the challenge, or let your city crumble?

details.title: Icebreaker
details.short_description: Icebreaker is a co-op action roguelike for 1-3 players. Keep a watchful eye on the actions of your PROWLER units, as they deploy to complete endless missions in ever-changing and very hostile facilities.

details.title: Star Stitcher
details.short_description: The stars have disappeared from the night sky, and only you can stitch them back together. Journey through a top-down, grid-based roguelike to recover stolen Star Shards. Plan ahead, each thread of reality offers new layouts, fresh enemies, and unique twists for your builds and classes to overcome.

details.title: Citizen Life
details.short_description: Citizen Life is an immersive open-world city life simulator. Choose from over 30 jobs, engage with intelligent NPCs, and see how your actions impact the town. Build businesses, develop skills or dive into crime. Influence politics, buy a house and gather resources in a dynamic, interactive world.

details.title: Wänder OutWorld - Mount Hollow
details.short_description: ~"By the whims of Yargha. Her soul, etched in Chaos." Survive and explore absurd scenarios. Switch realities. Hunt powerful monsters for loot. Encounter horrors beyond your comprehension. An open world game filled with challenges to overcome, bosses, enemy encounters, puzzles and mysteries to solve.

details.title: Hexplorando
details.short_description: Take a trip around the world in this cozy hex-tile puzzle game. Rebuild iconic locations from New York to Sydney, unlock and collect landmarks with real photos and stories, and build landscapes of your own. 🗽🗿⛩️🕌

details.title: Horn of Balance
details.short_description: Explore an intricate new world of secrets and adventure. Features solid 2D Zelda-like gameplay, 12 vast non-linear dungeons and a wholesome story about the young golem Linden.

details.title: Soaked
details.short_description: Soaked is a multiplayer platforming sandbox. Push, grab, throw, dive, crawl, climb, spin, and dig into a variety of game modes!

details.title: Cut the Cards
details.short_description: Create your own cards in this roguelike deckbuilder by cutting and pasting throughout your deck! Journey to the chasms, fighting off dragons and Boviks alike as you manage scarce resources.

details.title: SOS: Forgotten Planet
details.short_description: A survival horror where Morse code is the key to everything. Tap it to open doors. Listen and decode it to crack open supply caches. Every run rebuilds the lab. And it hides a different truth to uncover. Survive it, and walk away actually knowing Morse.

details.title: Reclaim The Living
details.short_description: Reclaim The Living is a zombie horde-survivor roguelike where you play as Dr. J. Ferret, an eccentric scientist who developed a cure capable of turning the infected back to normal. Expand your laboratory and upgrade your arsenal of gadgets to save humanity!

details.title: Trizna
details.short_description: “Trizna” is a classic plot-driven 2.5D metroidvania filled with intense battles utilizing the unique features of weapons, evasions, parries, and counterattacks. Explore the mysterious and eerie realm deeply intertwined with pagan beliefs, with blade, magic and a keen mind.

details.title: All A Broadside
details.short_description: A free-form sandbox sailing RPG featuring a large open world, detailed sailing physics, and emergent NPC simulation. Make friends and enemies as you set sail with your goblin crew - but life at sea only ever ends in two ways... fortune or ruin.

details.title: CaraVanguard
details.short_description: A rogue-lite action RPG with co-op for up to 7 players. Choose from 7 classes, master 70+ weapons and 100+ skills, and battle through a world where elemental interactions can weaken—or empower—your enemies. Inspired by traditional action RPG's and classic titles.

details.title: LlamaRPG: Farm to Fable
details.short_description: A JRPG that brings you face to face with challenging combat, class customization, and tough choices. Trade items, create unique characters and fight other players. Bring your llama to greener pastures while never running out of things to explore or enemies to vanquish.

details.title: Kimekyawa♥GenkaiBeat-chan!!
details.short_description: Smash the cute monsters with fun! This is a rhythm game with easy controls!

details.title: Chikaro
details.short_description: A boy and an android girl wake up without their memories in a world where deadly robots roam the streets. With the boy's powers, they can leave their bodies to walk through walls or possess enemies. The two follow the trail of the intentions left behind by those who once perished above the ground.

details.title: Safo and The Moon Warriors
details.short_description: In a world where the sun no longer rises, Prince Safo must rescue his sister from Argus, a mysterious one-eyed monster. Joined by diverse companions, this adventure RPG features beautiful illustrations and a novel-like story as players uncover secrets in this sunless world.

details.title: Cozy Crest
details.short_description: Awaken ancient elemental powers, shape your home, and help villagers bring their island back to life. Settle into this cozy open-world life sim, solo or with up to three friends.

details.title: Wildforge Hero
details.short_description: Defend against waves of enemies in this minimalistic roguelite game with base building and RPG elements. Collect resources and Craft new gear! Build structures to gain bonuses and new perks!

details.title: Autofahrt
details.short_description: A storm is gathering and devouring everything. Drive for your life alone or with friends and escape the deadly storm. Repair and keep your vehicle intact, it's the only way to reach the bunker and survive.

details.title: A Short Odyssey
details.short_description: Discover a mysterious 17th century Caribbean island. Perfect your swordplay, take on giant bosses, cook tasty dishes, or take in the scenery, it's your choice in this 3rd Person RPG. Investigate the secrets of the island while you freely explore a detailed simulated world.

details.title: Marked For Mayhem
details.short_description: Enter a shattered world where dimensions collide in this competitive 4-player action dungeon runner. Defeat and leverage diverse bosses, win chaotic challenges, master your build around unique weapons, and sabotage your rivals to take the top spot. The mission is shared. The glory isn’t.

details.title: Trivia Deal
details.short_description: Trivia Deal is the world’s first trivia roguelike. Answer fast. Play smart. Use lifelines, swap cards, and relics to survive the Rainbow Reaper. Each run is unforgiving, one wrong answer can end it all. High-stakes strategy with random questions, categories, and rewards that keep every run fresh.

name: Academia Z: The beginning of the catastrophe

details.title: Academia Z: The beginning of the catastrophe
details.short_description: A third-person action video game set in a post-apocalyptic world of zombies in an anime style. Emilia, along with other students, will try to survive in a hostile environment full of difficulties and enemies they will have to face. Will anyone survive?

details.title: Escape Alliance
details.short_description: An addictive escape game in a low poly style. You will face waves of enemies and lots of obstacles that will try to stop you from reaching the the end. As you progress the difficulty increases. Choose between several maps with different terrain and obstacles. Play alone or with up to 12 friends.

details.title: Dream Runner
details.short_description: Soma is just a kid who doesn't want to grow up. Test your limits in this fast and whimsical platformer where new challenges wait around every corner! Master powerful abilities, solve puzzles, and catch butterflies, all while unearthing a dark conspiracy hidden just beneath the surface.

details.title: Starbump
details.short_description: Starbump combines fast-paced action, Third Person platforming and competitive modes in vibrants worlds. It’s designed for party nights where you and your friends battle it out for hours, packed into colorful arenas and quick-fire game modes. It's a pure cozy brawl !

details.title: Light Up the Dark
details.short_description: Light Up the Dark is a colony survival sim set in a dark world filled with unseen horrors. Collect, build, automate, research techs, and explore the procedural map. Manage three classes of colonists; keep them sane, or make use of their insanity. Solve endless interesting problems, your way.

details.title: Just A Shadow Game
details.short_description: Hear me, pitiful mortals, for I shall reveal to you the path to true power - a demonic fusion of deckbuilding, ritual duels, and roguelite! I speak of a realm shrouded in darkness, where only the most wicked may thrive. Behold my masterpiece, "Just A Shadow Game" .

details.title: Order of Renewal
details.short_description: Order of Renewal is a multiplayer fantasy indie RPG game with co-op and PvP. Detailed combat system with realistic swordsmanship, physical interaction, unusual, and fresh mechanics will require tactics and skill in every battle.

details.title: Keep Leapin'
details.short_description: A challenging yet satisfying parkour game about Harry, a heartbroken worm who wants to become more attractive to the ladies by mastering the art of Leapin'. Unfortunately for Harry, becoming a Leaper is tough business.

details.title: FLASHLOOP
details.short_description: Survive on a dreadful planet. Explore a large, interconnected world. Gain new abilities, upgrade your weapons, and uncover secrets. Defeat treacherous bosses and reveal the dark secrets of this dreadful planet.

details.title: Rage of the Elder Gods
details.short_description: Rage of the Elder Gods is a turn-based tactical game blending board game mechanics with RPG elements. Hunt down fanatical cults across the mythical locations of H.P. Lovecraft’s universe. Face cosmic horror and survive the madness!

details.title: Appa
details.short_description: Appa is a surreal narrative-driven card battler about two siblings dealing with the death of their father. Predict, counter, and outmaneuver manifestations of grief while uncovering a heartfelt story somewhere between dreams and reality.

details.title: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess
details.short_description: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess is a 2D action with metroidvania elements set in a 16th-century fantasy world, drawn with cozy pixels. Explore a mysterious realm, battle ruthless enemies, and uncover powerful weapons and abilities. And remember: beer is the best medicine in these grim times!

details.title: Skippy's Grand Escape
details.short_description: Escape increasingly complex mazes as fast as possible. Select skills tactically for each level. Optimize your path. Watch out for enemies, traps, anomalies and more in this space themed top down maze runner.

details.title: Lull: Rest After Crying
details.short_description: A horror action-adventure in which a young girl carrying a baby on her back attempts to escape a mysterious facility twisted by endless renovations.

details.title: Wandering Within
details.short_description: Wandering Within is a 2d solo survival game where you have to cross a hostile desert to unravel the mysteries of a legendary chest. Gather resources, find water and build tools to increase your chance of survival

details.title: Sonic Valkyria: KANON
details.short_description: "Every time you shoot an enemy, music is born." The heartbeat of rock becomes your aim. An impulse shooting game with anime song rock and lock-on! "Sonic Valkyria: KANON"

details.title: Eight Bells
details.short_description: A pixel-art naval roguelike in the spirit of FTL. Command a Navy warship room by room, crew it with humans, merfolk and stranger things, and hunt pirate captains in real-time-with-pause broadsides on a sea where 10+ monsters lurk. Keep your crew alive. Keep the sea outside.

details.title: Evolvania
details.short_description: Explore a colossal creature by blending in with the environment and enemies. Evolve and gain new powers in this hand-drawn metroidvania where you can experience a unique adventure or create your own with a special level editor.

details.title: VERISMO
details.short_description: A ghost and a carnival clown plot revenge on the man who ruined their lives. An operatic-tragedy visual novel set in 1920s Sicily.

details.title: Arjybeasts
details.short_description: Arjybeasts is a Turn-based RPG where colour means everything! Draw your own PNG, battle and delete other images, open chests and make space so that HE can install things. Combine creativity with strategy and uncover a mystery by viewing the computer from different perspectives.

details.title: Mirror Land
details.short_description: This is an optical illusion space puzzle game with an original core mechanism. It uses MAGIC MIRROR to GRAB and RELEASE characters and cooperate with moving the MAGIC MIRROR to complete incredible space puzzles.

details.title: Endless Samurai
details.short_description: A turn-based action RPG centered around parrying. Roguelite × Loot draws you into the Infinite.

details.title: Valley of the Old Masters
details.short_description: You are an inspiration-seeking wandering artist who mysteriously ends up in a faraway Valley. Will you find the inspiration you crave, or will you be lost to the mysteries of the Valley?

details.title: Mental: The Dark Night
details.short_description: Mental is a single-player exploration and psychological horror game with multiple stories and maps to uncover. Immerse yourself in a captivating visual and auditory experience as you take on the role of an investigator at a paranormal research company.

details.title: Loya
details.short_description: Command walking fortresses to battle giant monsters in this open world survival rpg! Play alone or bring your friends to explore, farm, fight, build and craft to unravel the mysteries of Loya!

details.title: Tower Builder
details.short_description: Tower Builder is online Co-op or single player building and design game.

details.title: QUADREMOR
details.short_description: A first-person shooter where you play as one of the last human mercenaries, driven by vengeance for the annihilation of humanity. Dive deep into a dark and unforgiving realm fueled by cruelty.

details.title: Rustwater
details.short_description: Rustwater is a cozy post-opocalyptic cleanup simulator. Pilot your boat across a flooded world, using immersive cutting mechanics to dismantle structures and rotting ships to gather resources. Sail through isolated settlements, repair homes, and trade goods to help survivors rebuild their lives.

details.title: Awakening: Into the Stars
details.short_description: Become the one and only Captain of the Colony Ship Oberon as it cruises towards the Planet Zaenus with a single goal in mind: to colonise it and make it into a brand-new home for humanity. Such a huge task might seem daunting, but don’t worry, for you are not alone on your journey...

details.title: Zehlar
details.short_description: Explore a world full of secrets and magic, inhabited by creatures with unique elemental abilities. Ally with them to embark on your adventure, and train alongside your creature companions to become stronger and conquer the challenges of the world.

details.title: Elite Rogue
details.short_description: Elite Rogue – BOUNTIES. CHAOS. BETRAYAL. Every contract is a high-stakes gamble in this unpredictable roguelike! Hunt alone or with up to 10 players, earn Darkmatter to unlock game-breaking powers, manipulate reality, and outsmart rivals. Adapt or be erased. WISHLIST NOW!

details.title: Bloody Horror Plant
details.short_description: Bloody Horror Plant – probably the bloodiest casual point and click adventure game ever! Help Horror Plant solve interesting and funny point and click puzzles, kill evil dwarfs, save the forest and its creatures!

details.title: Limbo Control
