details.short_description: Limbo Control is a 1v4 asymmetric horror game where a supernatural creature takes over the area in an attempt to anchor itself in our world, while four hunters fight to reclaim control before it’s too late.

details.title: Machina of the Farthest
details.short_description: "Wouldn't it be awesome to fly?" Travel to the world's end in this warping-boomerang adventure with its beautiful pixel art.

details.title: Lazy Jiangshi
details.short_description: A visual novel about lazy jiangshi Mao and her even lazier mistress.

details.title: Drone Operator Guerilla Warfare
details.short_description: Drone Operator is a game where you will use civilian drones to conduct military operations against an overwhelming occupying force. Use your technical skills to turn harmless flying toys into deadly weapons, and outsmart your enemy. But remember - stay vigilant.

details.title: LogiGolf
details.short_description: LogiGolf is a relaxing golf puzzle game where you place walls to guide the ball. Journey between islands to uncover new challenges and surprising discoveries.

details.title: Good Luck, Little Truck!
details.short_description: Good Luck, Little Truck! Is a genre-bending cozy navigation puzzler/narrative delivery sim. Set in a recovering post-collapse world where robots and humans coexist, help North Pacifica Island bounce back one delivery at a time!

details.title: Mind Vessel
details.short_description: An autobattler roguelike in which you are a Vessel formed by the unification of dead people's spirits. Dismember and graft them to customize their abilities, as you use them to find a way out of the void.

details.title: Silence of Elven Mage Rin
details.short_description: A puzzle game featuring a beautiful elven sorceress.

details.title: Arctic Unrest
details.short_description: Arctic Unrest is a quest driven experience of survival set in a hand-crafted frozen arctic world. Hunting, fishing, building, crafting, farming & fighting are all covered. Vehicles to explore by Land, Air or Sea. "Old School" Far Cry like Story driven quests. Wishlist Arctic Unrest today!

details.title: Phones not Allowed
details.short_description: School is too boring? The temptation of using your phone too strong? Be careful, teacher's watching! Like Social Media posts and collect awesome Anime Artworks while keeping an eye on your teacher & classmates. One slip... and you are suspended!

details.title: From_.
details.short_description: One morning, Makoto the postman opens his eyes to find a strange and inexplicable visitor standing at his bedside. Soon after, he learns of a grim rumor spreading through Aquaria. As the letters he delivers bring writer and reader together, a once-forgotten truth begins to resurface.

details.title: Blazing War World
details.short_description: 3D Apocalypse Level-Based Action Game. Players navigate radiation-ruined areas, using walking, jumping, shooting, exclusive ultimate skills to fight mutated zombies, wasteland thugs, agile creatures, elites. Core goals: defeat bosses or finish tasks to advance, with classic level challenges.

details.title: Fellowship of the Oak
details.short_description: Fellowship of the Oak is a cozy crafting sim where you gather a fellowship of heroes, providing them with everything they need to succeed on their adventures. Build cozy homes, craft gear, farm provisions and manage expeditions in order to collect powerful loot!

details.title: Exodus of Descent
details.short_description: Descend into an online third person PvE RPG dungeon looter inspired by RuneScape and Dark & Darker. Party up with your friends to solve escape-room type puzzles, collect over 150+ lootable items, level up your character, create unique classes and unlock new abilities. Escape Your Descent!

details.title: Lost Zone: Survival
details.short_description: You wake on a barren island with no memory - the newest contestant of a survival TV show. Feed the Pit to bring the island back to life, build a raft and row out to strange islands rising from the sea. Loot fast: every island has its own way of ending.

details.title: Starball Pachinko
details.short_description: Spend the night in a back-alley izakaya where a fox-masked owner pours the drinks and the regulars wear festival masks. Play the old pachinko machine in the corner, build your board, and win prizes that help them. A cozy pachinko roguelike.

details.title: Memoria Wake
details.short_description: Parry with precision and fight through shifting, surreal landscapes in this dream-like action-adventure. When reality turns into a living nightmare, you must ascend through a shattered realm to rescue a missing friend.

details.title: Bloodfly Keeper
details.short_description: Breed unruly bloodflies, craft forbidden cures, and rise from outcast to underground healer in a city ruled by a corrupt medical regime.

details.title: Evolized
details.short_description: Evolized is a fast-paced evolution roguelite where your creature changes in real time. Build your biology, push deeper into a storm that escalates the world every minute, and extract before you are wiped out.

details.title: Typewriter Monkeys
details.short_description: Infinite monkeys with infinite typewriters will eventually write Shakespeare... right? Find out in this cozy automation idler! Strategically place different kinds of monkeys with typewriters then level them up as you type longer and longer words!

details.title: Blackmail Directive
details.short_description: A gripping visual novel set in modern-day Japan, featuring cute anime-style heroines and branching storylines that lead to multiple endings. Every choice you make shapes the story—and determines Arisa's fate.

details.title: Fear Hour
details.short_description: Insane mistakes brought you to a life-or-death judgment. Fight off a terrifying Killer, or kill those who trespass on your territory in this tense (1v5) online experience. Where following your instincts might help you escape, or kill them all.

details.title: Sword of Mejor
details.short_description: A unique rpg experience where you follow the path of a sword, rather than 1 set character! Follow the Sword of Mejor as it travels the lands swapping hands through battles, trades, gifts and more! With more paths and endings to count, every playthrough is different!

details.title: With Dream
details.short_description: This is a story about two doctors who travel back in time to fulfill the last wish of a dying old man.

name: Chronicle of Innsmouth: Curse of Chaos

details.title: Chronicle of Innsmouth: Curse of Chaos
details.short_description: Chronicle of Innsmouth: Curse of Chaos is a Lovecraftian point-and-click adventure set in 500 AD Oman. Inspired by H.P. Lovecraft’s most enigmatic stories, including The Nameless City and Nyarlathotep, it pulls you into a chilling investigation of cosmic horror and creeping madness.

details.title: Battle Swap
details.short_description: Battle Swap is an auto-battler with a single player campaign and a unique twist: when you win a battle, you trade your deployed units for your enemy’s, rewarding you for using fewer units. Unlock upgrades, items, and spells as you go, and revisit past battles to improve solutions and reclaim units.

details.title: Swingin'!
details.short_description: Swingin’! is a physics-based action game where you stick a pole to your environment to control your character’s movement.

details.title: When Livia Disappeared
details.short_description: A fantasy visual novel set in the 1920s. Perform ritual magic, craft potions, and uncover the secrets of the Order that maintains the balance between worlds.

details.title: Lootspire
details.short_description: Co-op roguelite dungeon crawler for 1–4 players. Pick a class, choose abilities, gear up, and fight through a procedural spire that gets harder the higher you go. Gear and Hero Level reset every run, but Unlockables persist.

details.title: Scaledeep
details.short_description: Roguelike. Turn-based dungeon crawler featuring procedurally generated environments, over 200 unique monsters, and dynamic class customization. 20 different storylines. 6 professions. Countless deaths. Play solo or team up in local couch co-op and battle hordes of enemies.

details.title: Ismene
details.short_description: The story of Ismene, floating through space with her trusted robot companion, trying to figure out where she is going, and where she came from.

details.title: Taishō Romance Theater
details.short_description: A romance-suspense visual novel set in Taishō Japan. Amnesiac actor Kotori Sakuma grapples with a dear friend's bizarre death, the awakening of his magic, and the blood ties that haunt him. As the truth unravels, shape Kotori's final choice: return to his bloodline's embrace, or pursue true freedom?

details.title: 🎧 Yellowcake - The Audio Game 🎧
details.short_description: A first-person audio game, telling the tale of a blind yet gifted hero. Make your way through a 3D environment without receiving any visual cues. Put all your faith in your ears and help our hero in his quest to uncover the sinister secrets of these twisty uranium mines, which he calls his home.

details.title: Windwoven
details.short_description: You inherit forest edge land. Daily, till soil with your hoe grow radishes, rear chicks, bond with oddball neighbors. Spring seeds yield summer gardens; autumn's firelit pumpkins reveal woodland mysteries. Nighttime under trees, fireflies dance like starlit constellations, this is your idyllic life.

details.title: Feral Metaverse
details.short_description: Feral Metaverse is an Online Multiplayer Game, where players are dropped naked and voiceless into a bleak environment. Their only path to survival is kindness.

details.title: Quarter Lie
details.short_description: A narrative adventure game where you take on a role of a fake exorcist on a demon-ridden ship in a long sea voyage. Remember; you can’t lie your way out of everything!

details.title: Home Wars: Battlefield
details.short_description: Fight in an epic first/third-person battlefield with your friends! In this cooperative PvE game, there are 3 factions, all fully playable: Army, Insects, Dinosaurs. Hundreds of allied/enemy bots on screen! Old school fun, baby!

details.title: The Time Forgotten
details.short_description: The Time Forgotten is a highly immersive hardcore Battle Royale set on a massive forgotten Island, where YOU play as a dinosaur. Discover the story and fight for survival against other dinosaurs in a struggle for victory by gathering EVO points and making your dinosaur as strong as it can be.

details.title: Soul Trader
details.short_description: Welcome to the NecronomiCon! Choose two eccentric minions, combine their unique cards, and trade souls for power as you battle rival necromancers in this colourful roguelike deckbuilder.

details.title: Starlight Brigade
details.short_description: Starlight Brigade is a realistic space action-adventure game with a precise combat system and full 6DOF controls. You command the Wayfarer, an aging light cruiser centuries past her time. Plot missile salvos, hunt down your enemy, design munitions, manage your crew, and send engineers to fix damage.

details.title: THE HELMINTHS
details.short_description: The Helminths is a 2D pixel art platformer that pays homage to classic games and blending environmental puzzles, precision platforming, and fast-paced action. Confront the grim realities of exploitation in dystopian sci-fi world and embark on a dark journey of survival.

details.title: Liber Magus
details.short_description: Liber Magus is a magic extraction game where every dungeon run is a test of your magical talent. Build your own spells, push through dangerous dungeons and extract with your reward.

details.title: 能動的ダンジョン
details.short_description: This game is a simple, high-difficulty RPG for people who are tired of the same old turn-based command-based RPGs.

details.title: EverCastle
details.short_description: Evercastle is the story of a young girl who sets out on an adventure to the mysterious castle. In this magical action RPG, you must master various spells to overcome monsters and traps, defeat powerful enemies, and reach the castle's depths to rescue beloved family.

details.title: 天罚
details.short_description: A 3D xianxia RPG of spell duels. Explore a vast world to hone your cultivation, compete with fellow cultivators in martial arts, and duel to prove your Dao.

details.title: Frontier Control : Invasion
details.short_description: Frontier Control: Invasion is a Real-Time Strategy survival game in which you play the commander of a human space colony under the attack of outer space robots. Build your base, train your colony, and fight herds of enemies and bosses.

details.title: Dr.Mememe want to sleep
details.short_description: The lazy genius scientist "Dr. Mememe," who just wants to sleep forever, has invented Kawaii Sheep that induce sleep with their mysterious healing powers. An exponentially cute sheep-carrying game with expanding production × easy 3D action for casual enjoyment.

details.title: DebugDebut
details.short_description: A debugging simulation game in which you complete debugging requests from a game generation AI that suddenly appears. Debug games of various genres and aim to win high rewards.

details.title: Don't Forget the Phone
details.short_description: Experience a point & click time management game that puts your multi-tasking to the test. Complete all of your tasks before sunrise, but watch out for anything that may have escaped the lab below.

details.title: The Shadow Beneath
details.short_description: Rescue Akhenaten, the banished pharaoh, from an eternity beneath the sands. Wield the gifts of Aten's last disciples, unleash sacred techniques and battle the relentless guardians of the forgotten tombs in a fast-paced Action Roguelike.

details.title: Word To Angel
details.short_description: Play as five human heroes in this pacifist 2D RPG taking place in a world where some friendly (and not so friendly) angels conduct balance and harmony together... and where your only instruments for fighting are words and melodies.

details.title: Bake Until Done
details.short_description: Bake Until Done is a baking-themed, turn-based roguelite. Take control of a muffin as you battle devious desserts to break the spell of a magical bakery that is endangering your town. Fight back with your muffin’s morsels, but be careful not to lose too much…

details.title: Strider Arena
details.short_description: Strider Arena is a fast-paced mobility mech arena fighter designed to be played with a group of friends. Inspired by the likes of Titanfall 2, Armored Core, and Hawken, kit out your strider, drop into the arena, and make sure your team is the only one left standing once the smoke clears.

details.title: Infested
details.short_description: Infested is a simple First Person Shooter. You will encounter many zombies as you fight your way through the zombie-infested city. Will you make it to the hospital to find the first infected victim? Only with its DNA samples will science be able to create an antidote.

details.title: MachineCorps
details.short_description: Build factories, solve puzzles, and send robots to explore the desert planet of Drath. With each release comes a new planet with stranger challenges, smarter enemies, and more advanced tech. It will take a logical mind, cunning, and a yearning for adventure to succeed. Do you have what it takes?

details.title: COMING HOME
details.short_description: A retro slasher horror game, with a focus on home defense. In the dead of night, you hear someone lurking outside - but you are not defenseless. Watch the cameras, barricade your doors, and have your gun at the ready - anything to keep the Sundown Rippers from claiming their next victim.

details.title: Fio and the Doomed City
details.short_description: A “city-building” x “tower defense” SLG by a young girl, Fio. Fio and her guardians, the Flora Bears, are building a city in the last city of humanity. Increase facilities, residents, and resources, and prepare for battle. Withstand enemy attacks and defeat the boss with your big beam cannon!

details.title: RE:AKTOR
details.short_description: RE:AKTOR is a metroidvania about going fast and rewinding time. Race the clock, unlock new abilities and shortcuts, and solve temporal puzzles. Tear through walls and enemies with damage that scales with momentum, and punch ever deeper into a mysterious underground facility.

details.title: The shield of the Kingdom
details.short_description: "The Shield of The Kingdom" is a defense strategy game where player needs to protect their realm from enemies. Within the game, player controls 3 heroes and command troops in battle to repel invasions. Effective hero combinations and masterful tactical control are keys to achieving ultimate victory!

details.title: Cozy
details.short_description: Build your dream farm, make lifelong friends, and experience the joys of small-town living in Cozy Town. Plant crops, raise animals, fish, craft, and enjoy seasonal festivals. Escape the hustle and bustle—relax and live your best life in a charming countryside adventure.

details.title: Polly's Gone
details.short_description: Polly's Gone is an action-RTS with shoot'em up elements. Lead a team of sheep through challenging levels in Story Mode to find the missing Polly. Explore diverse environments, defeat enemies, and test your skills in Survival Mode.

name: Prolegomena To a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges

details.title: Prolegomena To a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges
details.short_description: This is a collaborative experiment between you and I. We will participate in a series of interchanges, each lasting three minutes. What will be revealed across our interfaces during that limited time?

details.title: 见诡
details.short_description: A single-player Chinese folk horror RPG puzzle game. As a photographer, you venture into mysterious places with two paranormal vloggers. Explore scenes, gather clues and reveal hidden truths through environmental interaction. Full playthrough takes 2 to 5 hours.

name: 紅茶とともに飲みこんで

details.title: 紅茶とともに飲みこんで
details.short_description: Is there something you wish to forget or remember? You are running a cafe, harboring a specific purpose within your heart. An ADV where you use tools like a pipette that extracts emotions and medicine that erases memories and feelings to select, manipulate emotions, and intervene in fate.

details.title: Work In Progress
details.short_description: It’s your first day in office and half of the staff is already on burnout... Here is your gun, your contract. Now go fire some people.

details.title: Waffles' Cranked Stories
details.short_description: Waffles' Cranked Stories is a selection of mini-games set in the same universe as Inspector Waffles, originally released exclusively on the Playdate console. This time, follow the adventures of Chance and Spike and discover new stories that expand on the previous ones!

details.title: Faraway Galaxy
details.short_description: Faraway Galaxy is a new roguelite deckbuilder framed as a bizarre tabletop adventure narrated by a battle-hardened space wolf. Master intense tactical battles and meaningful choices between them. Fight alien pirates, collect artifacts, and uncover new encounters!

details.title: A Trivia Roguelike
details.short_description: Your actions are dictated by trivia questions and answers in this roguelike RPG with a trivia twist. Collect loot and level up to impact your chances of survival, take down dangerous foes and defeat the evil Trivia Arch Lich.

details.title: SHROT
details.short_description: Welcome to SHROT! A fast, funny, and unapologetically stupid first-person boomer shooter where a Slavic trucker gets stuck in an alien apocalypse and handles it the only way he knows how: with beer, cigarettes, and unresolved anger issues.

name: Before the Silence Claims: In Absentia

details.title: Before the Silence Claims: In Absentia
details.short_description: "The truth is not found in what you see… but in what you tune into." Survive a deceased scientist's memories in a strange 1930s German town. Manipulate frequencies to reveal what is hidden, face unsettling entities, and keep an impossible promise in a tactile, HUD-less psychological survival horror.

details.title: From Ruins – A Detective Adventure
details.short_description: A new-gen detective adventure combining deduction gameplay with a gripping story full of twists and turns. Gather clues, establish connections, and solve a series of increasingly challenging cases. Will you uncover the feud that began at the end of the world?

details.title: Temple Siege TD
details.short_description: Relaxing 3D fantasy tower defense game with an RPG/MOBA vibe: Hero-towers, distinct roles, unique abilities, powerful combos and rising challenge.

name: 伴我同行 Walk alongside me

details.title: 伴我同行 Walk alongside me
details.short_description: "Walk Alongside Me" is a tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Command a dynamic duo, using seamless rotation and card synergy to build a unique combat system on your quest to rescue your family and save the world. Choose your heroes and begin your journey!

details.title: White Crow Castle: Loop
details.short_description: A fantasy mystery otome RPG with time loop mechanics. Explore a cursed castle, collect clues, solve puzzles, make critical choices, and experience branching storylines, emotional bonds, and life-or-death survival in an inescapable cycle.

details.title: BloodSpiller
details.short_description: Brutally blast through Dracula's minions and rescue your girl in this retro action platformer. Upgrade, discover, and destroy with retro flair and modern attitude.

details.title: Gardoon
details.short_description: The blackjack roguelite of the Persian Book of Kings. Beat the Deev at 21 to win the right to rule on a hero's prayer, then grant it or deny it. Five chapters of Rostam and Sohrab, four starting decks, and a demon that plays to win.

details.title: Sweatpants Savior: Worlds Beyond
details.short_description: Shipwrecked in Antarctica, survivors cross the frozen glaciers and step beyond an ice wall into the boundless Great Thousand Worlds. A sandbox RPG centered on exploration and experimentation, featuring deeper systems, a vastly expanded world, and long-term progression shaped by player choice.

details.title: Amazon Warrior
details.short_description: A Puzzle with Bossfights! Join Tayana and save the Amazon exploring amazing Scenarios, Enemies and Bosses! An Evil is haunting the heart of the Amazon! Among breathtaking landscapes, forge powerful alliances and unleash divine powers to survive deadly trials and shape the fate of the forest.

details.title: RTG
details.short_description: RTG is narrative sci-fi puzzle/platformer about a guy with no memories stranded inside strange world, where initially nothing makes sense. Solve gradually challenging puzzles and, piece by piece, unravel mystery behind what you see and experience.

details.title: Loco: Rails & Tails
details.short_description: Chaotic co-op for 1–4 players! Build rails, protect the train and deliver cargo on time. Pick your favourite animal hero and embark with your friends on wild west adventure!

details.title: Elemental Shifter
details.short_description: Elemental Shifter is a top-down 2D roguelite where you harness the power of 'Elemental Shifting' adapting your abilities based on the last damage you took. Choose your path, battle mages, grow stronger, discover new weapons and defeat powerful bosses on your way to the Mage King.

details.title: Astro Amigo
details.short_description: ASTRO AMIGO is a story-driven sci-fi adventure game where a bullied kid named Austin searches for his missing dog, Amigo. Explore a strange Wisconsin town, uncover its secrets, play nostalgic mini-games, and make story-shaping choices as the mystery unfolds.

details.title: SUPER ADVENTURE
details.short_description: Turn around to parry and block! Equipped with a shield on your back, jump your way through vivid levels, meet funny characters, and face challenging bosses. Fight using a quick-firing Alien Blaster or a melee-focused sword! Choose the path you want to go in this SUPER ADVENTURE!

details.title: Grapple Car
details.short_description: A car with a grappling hook! Twist and turn with tight driving controls around colorful tracks to complete challenges, customize your car, and race for a spot at the timed global online leaderboards.

details.title: Into the Rootforge
details.short_description: Into the Rootforge is a unique fusion of runner, roguelike and card-based action combat. Master customisable attacks to delve further with each attempt. Uncover the secrets of the Rootforge and grow your true power through the skill trees of The Garden.

details.title: Clawback: Police Corruption Simulator
details.short_description: A narrative-focused crooked cop game. Manipulate death investigations and file false evidence to reap ill-gotten gains in a dystopian future. Save yourself.

details.title: Miniature Painter Simulator
details.short_description: Take up the amazing hobby of miniature painting! Run your own online store selling your painted miniatures & handling various jobs from clients. Create the most amazing miniatures with minimal limitations and even import your own custom models! Take a seat, grab a brush and relax.

details.title: Hell Loop
details.short_description: A rogue-like dungeon crawler with Chinese mythic horror. Play as an ancient butcher, trapped in the cycles of the underworld. Seek redemption, gain the aid of heavenly gods, and fight for freedom—and for the wife you still love.

details.title: Full Steam Undead
details.short_description: OPEN WORLD STEAM TRAIN + ZOMBIE VR ACTION! Ride the rune train, explore Necropolis Island and slay the undead. For Queen Victoria, it's time to roll: all aboard for undead destruction!

details.title: Chakravyuh
details.short_description: A compact Indian mythological action game where you play as Abhimanyu and face three challenging handcrafted boss duels. Learn attack patterns, dodge bullet-hell barrages, break enemy poise, and master melee strikes, parries, ranged attacks, and Astra abilities to survive.

details.title: Eastwynne
details.short_description: A narrative-focused CRPG set in the grandiose city of Eastwynne, where magic is commonplace. It's 2021, and the start of a new college year. Follow the stories of a group of magical university students; how will your choices alter their lives?

details.title: Master of Cladia
details.short_description: Master a world of massive turn-based strategy. As an Alchemist, hatch powerful dragons, discover devastating spells, and manage your empire in a persistent world shared by hundreds of players. Will you bring peace through science or rule over the ashes? The throne awaits.

details.title: Piecekeeper
details.short_description: Draft cards, build synergies, and battle through a whimsical and fun roguelike deckbuilder where combining factions creates endlessly replayable experiences.

details.title: Hadvoron: The Godhunters
details.short_description: Find the way through the Shattered Cities while slaying numerous enemies and looting infinitely stacking items, in this Roguelike combining fast paced third person combat system and exploration. Playable Singleplayer or up to 4 players.

details.title: STAR FISH
details.short_description: Cast your line from your cozy asteroid home and reel in Space Fish, each with their own unique feel! Sell catches, upgrade gear, and tackle legendary fish with unique challenges when reeling them in. Customize your asteroid home! Because nothing says “Gone Space Fishin” like a well-furnished rock.

details.title: Hunger Lane
details.short_description: A story-driven horror platformer about a boy uncovering the secrets of a quiet city where monsters hunt humans after dark. Will you discover what lies behind the disappearances before it finds you?

details.title: Neon Dystopia
details.short_description: Raid the underbelly of Neon Dystopia with your crew. Grab all the loot and extract! Or die and lose it all... A co-op synthwave/cyberpunk extraction roguelike.

details.title: RogueBike GP
details.short_description: Race, rebuild, and adapt! create the optimal racing team and chase the world championship in this 2D Motorbike Roguelike.🏭🏍️🏁

details.title: Jerry the Zombie Slayer
details.short_description: Shoot, loot, craft, and explore in this absurdly funny roguelite against hordes of different zombies. Every death gives you the chance to build and upgrade your base… and your ego. How long can you survive?

details.title: southbound
details.short_description: A thousand years after collapse, the southern wilderness is the last frontier — and something is fracturing at its edge. Push deeper into a procedurally generated world of ruins, monsters, and growing strangeness. A survival roguelite where every run takes you further south, and further from normal.

details.title: No Death In Wild West
details.short_description: Play as time travelers wiping out cowboys with high-tech weapons. Overcome brutal terrain against an unforgiving timer. Master unique heroes with different movement styles to conquer the Wild West.

details.title: Brickstrike
details.short_description: Brickstrike is an online multiplayer first-person shooter set in a fully destructible and buildable voxel battlefield. Team up to dominate in a variety of competitive game modes. Featuring a variety of official and player-created maps. Enlist today!

details.title: Star Squadron
details.short_description: Star Squadron is a narrative-driven space combat simulator built for maximum immersion. Command your wing with freeform voice recognition and experience a dynamic campaign that calls you by name using our proprietary Voice Mimic System. Don't just play the game—live it.

name: Krodha: A Tale of Vikram & Betaal

details.title: Krodha: A Tale of Vikram & Betaal
details.short_description: Krodha is a Dice + Deck + Slot-building roguelike rooted in the Indian legend of Vikram and Betaal. Draft your deck, slot cards into a board, roll the dice and piece together a mystery told by three "very" unreliable narrators.

details.title: Cards of the Abyss
details.short_description: Cards of the Abyss is a roguelike deckbuilder where movement is your only defense. Move on a grid, dodge enemy attacks, trigger countless chain-reactions and unleash overpowered card combos as you dive deeper into the Abyss.

details.title: Battles of Chaos
details.short_description: Battles of Chaos is a medieval fantasy real time strategy and tactics hybrid game, blending the best elements of the two genres. Play great, realistic open-field battles or sieges in single-player, cooperative or PvP mode, where the emphasis is on combat, with base building elements.

details.title: Those Far Stars
details.short_description: Discover a vast, procedural galaxy as a lone pilot. Trade, fight and explore alien worlds with turn-based encounters. Upgrade your ship, gather relics, and uncover secrets lost to time and space.

details.title: Nova Assault
details.short_description: Step into Nova Assault, the first-person extraction shooter that blends immersive realism with strategic depth: extract valuable resources, survive high-risk missions, and amass wealth through a dynamic in-game economy and advanced progression system.

details.title: Coasteroid
details.short_description: Build stellar rollercoasters across alien worlds, carve tunnels through planets, and launch trains into orbit. Customize every track element, scenery decoration, and environment before subjecting riders to the forces of the universe! The galaxy is your theme park!

details.title: Lingering Soup
details.short_description: Lingering Soup is a deckbuilding and management roguelite. Unwilling to be reborn, you run a spicy hot pot stall for Meng Po, serving souls one last meal. Combine cooking cards and relics to help them let go of the past. Can you do the same?

details.title: Mimi's Restaurant Helper
details.short_description: Put on your chef's hat and make food, clean the dishes, take orders and more in Mimi's Restaurant Helper. Become a chef and serve beautiful, hand drawn dishes!

details.title: Cold Steel
details.short_description: A classic RTS with a major twist. Your units are fully autonomous drones. Every unit runs code which you design using an intuitive visual coding interface. Automate everything from mining, to combat, even unit production.

details.title: Path of the RNGesus
details.short_description: Play as literal reincarnations of the RNGesus in this curated rollathon experience. Hoard items and perks, manipulate RNG and optimize synergies to vanquish the unholy, non-deterministic chaos that plagues the land.

name: Journey To The Center Of The Lost Waterpark

details.title: Journey To The Center Of The Lost Waterpark
details.short_description: In this first and third-person experience you visit a waterpark unlike any others you have seen before. Your adventure leads you through eerie and beautiful surroundings with puzzles and obstacles while you uncover the secrets of The Lost Waterpark, driven by a Lovecraftian Story.

details.title: AEROCUBE
details.short_description: AEROCUBE is a Ski-Fi Roguelike + First-Person Boomer Shooter in a huge mysterious cube that always rotates randomly. Each room of AEROCUBE is different, but one thing stays the same: something’s always behind you, ready to kill.

details.title: The Little Ones
details.short_description: Join the little guardians of the earth in an adventure that adds a touch of strategy to the top-down shooter tradition. Plan every move, meet new allies, unlock weapons and abilities to hunt down evil humans and return these lands to their rightful owners.

details.title: The Last Raccoon
details.short_description: Survive as a raccoon in an abandoned mansion filled with zombies. Solve puzzles inspired by dark fairy tales and explore to uncover whether the world is worth saving.

details.title: Voidwatch
details.short_description: Voidwatch is a silky-smooth space shooter roguelike. Hop from planet to planet, facing off against the Cult of the Void as you fight to free the galaxy from their clutches. Collect new weapons and powerful modifications to improve your Voidhawk Infiltrator starship & lay waste to your foes!

details.title: Rodent Company
details.short_description: Battle enemy pests using randomly generated toy guns, powerful perks and unique abilities! Join with friends in up to 4-player couch co-op and gather the best arsenal to win!

details.title: Sin Hunter
details.short_description: An innovative roguelike deckbuilder with a fresh card combat system and character-driven relationship stories. Become a Sin Hunter, slay the Original Sins, meet four demon girls, uncover the secrets of Hell City, and become their salvation—you are this world’s “Hope.”

details.title: BioRogue
details.short_description: Grab a living cybernetic fish. Fire it. Mutate it. BioRogue is a 3D twin-stick roguelite bullet hell where 100+ mutagens let you splice together a build that's yours alone. Die, adapt, and go again, until the regime that built this island out of genetic exploitation finally falls.

details.title: Infinite Alliance
details.short_description: Heroes and villains from 17 Indie JRPGs collide, in this story rich Crossover Event! Chained Echoes, Jack Move, CrossCode, 8-Bit Adventures 2, Beloved Rapture, Quartet, and more unite for a totally FREE adventure!

details.title: FoldLoop
details.short_description: FoldLoop is a detective game that emphasizes logical reasoning. To escape the curse of endless cycles, you'll observe the sandbox from a higher dimension, analyze the rulebook, and deduce the secrets of the real world.

details.title: Pawcision
details.short_description: Pawcision is a 2D retro-style LITERAL Precision Platformer with an Interactive Music System. Play as a cat with one goal: climb as high as you can. Like a cat, every jump you make must be PRECISELY calculated. Customize your look and conquer challenging obstacles with pixel-perfect reflexes.

details.title: Frost Protocol
details.short_description: Fight your way through turn-based expeditions across Terminus. Restore abandoned mining outposts, extract Veyrite under mounting Nadir pressure, and fight your way back to extraction. At base, manage survivors, scarce resources, damaged robots, and your crew's mental strain.

details.title: Master of the Mow
details.short_description: Become the Master of the Mow. Cut grass, clear trash, and uncover buried treasures across the overgrown grounds of an old manor estate. Upgrade your tools and grow stronger with each trinket you sell and solve the mystery of why the grass grows back every morning. Rise and mow...again. And again.

details.title: Wish Of Hers
details.short_description: Wish of Hers is a round-based 2.5D roguelike about surviving in unstable dreams. Each run is shaped by unlocked abilities, combined aspects, and your decisions. Experiment, adapt, and break your own builds!

details.title: 徨恍 Aware
details.short_description: You will play a detective and go back to winter Peking more than seventy years ago. On the eve of the peaceful liberation of Peking, you will feel the cold, nothingness, exploration, pursuit, drama and gunshots in the process of searching for missing persons.

name: Talewarden: Riders of the New Day

details.title: Talewarden: Riders of the New Day
details.short_description: In this adventure visual novel, you travel across an alien planet stuck in an endless sunset. Shape the fates of 7 companions from different worlds. Uncover the truth about anomalous locations, hidden corridors, and a child who aged in a day. See what remains of a world abandoned by its creators.

details.title: TritonXR: Reality Warfare
details.short_description: TritonXR turns ANY space into a dynamic combat arena with your friends - duck behind your living room couch to reload, throw a grenade down your hallway or jump over your bed to avoid an attack. This is the world's most advanced XR FPS.

details.title: Melted Time
details.short_description: Candle, your path is full of puzzles. Can you handle it? Hurry, your time is already melting away.

details.title: Galaxy Frame
details.short_description: Galaxy Frame is a space Roguelite game players control their aircraft to survive the attacks of alien insects. By understanding the characteristics of aircraft, skills, and props, players can build their own decks and challenge stronger enemies. Arcade mode to challenge the world leaderboard.

name: 井底-与奇迹邂逅的井底之人

details.title: 井底-与奇迹邂逅的井底之人
details.short_description: 《井底》是一款2024年3月立项的文字类galgame，题材是“超能力悬疑推理故事”，画风是日系校园风格的 故事主要讲述了游戏女主王语韴作为一个业余“侦探”，遇到各种疑难问题，并在侦探事务所所长天翔及其妹妹天音的帮助下，解决案件的故事。 游戏主要使用鼠标点击来推进剧情

details.title: Far From The Darkness
details.short_description: A first-person multiplayer game inspired by the Werewolf concept. Depending on your role, investigate and hunt werewolves or betray your squad. Strategize, collaborate, and survive while communicating through proximity chat!

details.title: Mind The Trunk
details.short_description: Up to 4 friends. One abandoned station. Strip it. Launch it. Sell it. Keep breathing: your oxygen runs through a hose, and it runs out fast. Get back to the lobby or get nothing. Something else lives here. It doesn't want you dead. It wants to play.

details.title: Vagabones
details.short_description: Vagabones is a class-based roguelike action-adventure game for 1-4 players! Battle fierce foes, play minigames, solve puzzles, and collect treasures as you venture through the Shadowmoon Kingdom to defeat the Calico King!

details.title: Witchling Grove
details.short_description: Witchling Grove is an action-rpg, arena-shooting roguelike.

details.title: Digital Legacy of Zero
details.short_description: Battle with creatures you collect to defeat the evil Ruler of the Digital World. Hack and slash through enemy domains, upgrade your basement to achieve ultimate evolutions, and summon legendary beasts. Unlock powerful upgrades with devastating combos to conquer the Digital World.

details.title: Cambrox
details.short_description: Cambrox is an online co-op or single player creature-collection adventure with over 200 unique Cambros. Battle with your Cambros against other trainers and see what the world of Hoch has in store!

details.title: Battle Mutants
details.short_description: Experience arcade chaos! Smash through 12 explosive stages as badass mutants in this modern beat 'em up. Enjoy unique level mechanics, brutal bosses, and stylish pixel art. Grab a friend for epic co-op mayhem!

details.title: Nephelia: Through the Clouds
details.short_description: Take control of your own airship, hire people for your crew, help them on their personal stories, follow the trail of a whimsical inventor of the colonisation era, trade, fight, discover, and try to stay afloat.

details.title: Hoptale
details.short_description: Hoptale is a Roguelite adventure that fuses hopscotch with a slot machine. Play as Tuby, a rabbit whose only weapon is his jump, against the awakened God of Chaos. In battle the tiles below spin into reels — call the stop, line up attacks, strike. Collect tiles, build your run, outsmart chaos.

details.title: Infinium: A Spaceboy's Tale
details.short_description: Follow the journey of Leo in a classical 2D platformer. Where 2 different worlds come together uncover an intriguing story. Explore diverse lands, fight unique enemies, and unlock new skills.

details.title: Ashwood Conspiracy
details.short_description: Ashwood Conspiracy is a dark Slavic mystery adventure. Follow in your late uncle's footsteps to uncover the truth behind the town’s most devastating event. Find, collect, and combine items to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles. Will you dare to finish what your uncle started?

details.title: Warbound
details.short_description: Build a battlefield that evolves from Stone age battles into futuristic mechanised warfare. Demo is LIVE

details.title: A Totally Realistic Stealth Game
details.short_description: Become a stealth soldier fighting through enemy lines using whatever methods you see fit to stay undetected in this first-person shooter. Take a slow, methodical approach or go guns-blazing; as long as you remain undiscovered, any means to success is viable.

details.title: Recepta: Incarnation — Part I
details.short_description: A dark fantasy RPG where two rival faiths clash over humanity’s future. Experience a cinematic story inspired by comic books, with fast turn-based battles.

details.title: PACS - Post Apocalypse Courier Service
details.short_description: 1-4 players in the postiepocalypse! Drive across treacherous environments, customize your delivery vehicles, and secure 5 star reviews for corporate by supplying the apocalyptic miracle of a package delivered on time.

details.title: Farming and fighting on Island
details.short_description: When the Black Calamity falls, monsters hunt by night—devouring livestock and crops alike. Farm, fortify, hire mercenaries, and defend your remote island in Farming And Fighting On Island.

details.title: Best Laid Plans
details.short_description: An army building strategy game where you must embark on a campaign to retake The Household from an evil regime of unknown origin. As the Commander of your forces, collect units, establish bases, and deploy troops to turn back the enemy tide, exploring unique locations along the way.

details.title: Codename TCT
details.short_description: The battle for Crimson Tide has begun.

details.title: Gang of Frogs
details.short_description: Sail through the galaxy as a fearless outlaw frog. Plunder loot, upgrade weapons, eat flies and fight through hordes of monstrous bugs in an intense 1-4 player co-op shooter.

details.title: Detective of the Dead
details.short_description: You are a dead detective in the Mexican afterworld trying to find your killer. Undercover you prepare unique tacos to make suspects confess. Find clues and solve puzzles. Step into the shoes of your dog, Xolo, and do magical things. Save the Día de los Muertos.

details.title: SKYHELL
details.short_description: Travel through time in the elevator of an old murder house. To survive, avoid killers and place cameras in the right spots to track their movements.

details.title: Astrum Vanguard
details.short_description: Pilot your ship with thrust and rotation, and coast through gaps in enemy fire. Survive 20 waves in this space survivors-like arena shooter. Combine auto-firing weapons and shape your build in the shop between waves.

details.title: Gloomfall
details.short_description: Gloomfall is a dark fantasy Roguelike game. Explore a diverse, procedurally generated open world, unlock unique skills, fight, complete objectives, craft, and trade.. Become the strongest hero, by defeating the most powerful forces of evil in each region.

details.title: Kaguraden
details.short_description: A roguelike RPG set in procedurally generated 3D hex-grid dungeons. Start each run at Level 1, collect equipment and items, and decide how far to push before returning safely with your rewards. Join Kagura, a boy of human and oni blood, on a journey to recover the lost Sealing Blade.

details.title: QiuQiu Town
details.short_description: You have come to this new world, where you will start a new life, have many options, run the farm, scale up, and become a great agriculturist. Or run a store and become a business mogul. Or ordinary life every day, if you were given the chance to do it again, what would you choose?

details.title: Marvatten
details.short_description: Design your warship and take it to battle! In Marvatten you’re a warship architect and commander. It’s not just about size, but smart design. Your design choices directly impact combat performance. Ready to conquer the seas? Join Marvatten now!

details.title: Legend of the Corndog(s)
details.short_description: Finding yourself out of food, you decide to venture into the outdoors for the first time in an embarrassingly long time in order to satiate your growing hunger.

details.title: Race to Ruler
details.short_description: Race to Ruler is a deck-building roguelike where your cards are your army as you embark on a journey to defeat the ruler of an empire. Draft and train new units, summon epic beings, defeat your rivals, and claim the crown.

details.title: Boss Slayers
details.short_description: No game to play with a friend? Now you're a team of boss hunters. Challenge the most dangerous monsters! Dodge rains of projectiles, seize the right moment to attack and discover the weaknesses of cunning bosses.

details.title: L8R SK8R
details.short_description: L8R SK8R is a 3D platformer inspired by the classics of the fifth generation but with a unique twist that will make you feel like a speedrunner.

details.title: speak of my sin
details.short_description: Speak of My Sin is a word reasoning game - players are supposed to find the truth of the cases, restore the story in a number of interrelated cases and finally detect the identification of “me”, speaking out “my” sin.

details.title: Path to Perdition
details.short_description: Path to Perdition is a challenging roguelike auto-battler. Assemble and lead a party of adventurers through unforgiving lands. Equip them with items to unlock skills, modify those skills with relics to create unique effects, and combine those effects using tactical positioning to crush your enemies.

details.title: Savage Gears
details.short_description: Savage Gears is a violent, single-player alt-history Africa Cold War shooter. Armed with an Iron Fist and an arsenal of devastating weaponry, you play as Ero Lei'Bourne, a S.P.E.A.R. operative, in the middle of a dangerous conspiracy.

details.title: GRIDHACK
details.short_description: GRIDHACK is a sci-fi puzzle RPG where hacking = fighting nonogram battles. Chase a rogue program and chip away at the galaxy's strongest firewall to uncover the conspiracy about what happened to Earth!

details.title: Fateful Bullet
details.short_description: A third-person anime arena shooter where you can bring a sword to a gunfight. Wall-jump across the city, dash through the crossfire and win with a blade or a bullet. Build your own cute fighter and take on real players in fast online PvP.

details.title: Deck of Memories
details.short_description: Deck of Memories is a nostalgic deckbuilding adventure about the stories your grandfather left behind. Explore fragments of his life as a lighthouse keeper, manifested inside atmospheric dioramas. Craft and combine cards to restore these memories and discover the secrets they hold.

details.title: Neighbor's Wife
details.short_description: Your neighbor is always busy and doesn't have much time to spend with his wife, which makes her feel lonely and sad. You are the only one who can save their marriage!

details.title: Pote Pote Dream
details.short_description: Pote Pote Dream is an action RPG where Pote Pote, a timid teddy bear who cannot fight on his own, summons allies to battle. Set in the dream world of his owner, a girl, Pote Pote fights against her inner troubles to save her.

details.title: Travellin Cats in England
details.short_description: Find many cats hidden across England in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator! Can you find them all?

details.title: Effective Immediately
details.short_description: All intergalactic travel passes through the orbital relay checkpoint. Verify ID discrepancies, repair vehicle systems and struggle against ethical dilemmas as you negotiate a shifting political landscape. Report for duty, Effective Immediately.

details.title: Crownbreakers
details.short_description: Crownbreakers is a striking and snappy turn-based card brawler where magic meets punk and demonic billionaires rule the city. Crash through their districts, build your deck, and throw every card like a punch. Be the guillotine that frees Cascade from their soul-crushing rulers.

details.title: Meowmentum
details.short_description: Run, young Meowcolyte - finish the elders' speed trials and become a conduit of Meowmentum! Harness your paw-kour skills, dash through magic orbs, and race against the world!

details.title: Arcade Space Survivor
details.short_description: Fight against waves of enemies to become the ultimate space survivor. Arcade Space Survivor is an arcade-styled action-roguelike. The game offers an innovative and unique experience within the survivors-like genre.

details.title: Gravitee Wars
details.short_description: Battle across the galaxy in this turn-based space artillery game. Use the gravity of destructible planets to launch your shots at the enemy until only one team remains.Unlock new gear for your team members in the single player campaign and online multiplayer modes.

details.title: Don't Get Caught!
details.short_description: A stealth platformer where you control both the hero and the cameras. Evade security systems, manipulate switches and keycards, and outsmart the surveillance to escape a high-security lab.

details.title: END: Awakening
details.short_description: END: Awakening is a greek myth-inspired, action-adventure survival game that throws you and your friends into a terrifying zombie apocalypse. Fight to survive the relentless undead by scavenging, crafting, and building in an expansive co-op experience. Can you live through the END?

details.title: THREAT VECTOR
details.short_description: Battle across the solar system as annihilation looms over mankind in this action sci-fi horror FPS. Powered by id Tech, THREAT VECTOR delivers classic FPS combat throughout a suite of concise, potent levels infested with deadly horrors… and loaded with enough firepower to destroy them all.

details.title: Dignaut
details.short_description: Take on a peaceful mining mission that leads to something far more mysterious. Dig, upgrade your tools, and slowly awaken an ancient alien temple buried beneath the surface, bringing its forgotten music and light back to life.

name: 恋爱泡馍！青春老陕：Shannxi Love Story

details.title: 恋爱泡馍！青春老陕：Shannxi Love Story
details.short_description: Shannxi Love Story is a visual novel-style game set against the backdrop of university life in Shaanxi, infused with local cultural flavors. Discover Chinese culture through a brand-new lens, explore the youthful spirit of Xi'an, and discover the myriad possibilities life has to offer.

details.title: In Another World
details.short_description: In this Isekai Anime RPG. Enjoy a more realistic skills system. Bring a race to extinction. Or live the quiet life farming in a pocket dimension. Fast paced real-time combat. Mostly medieval ecstatic. Hope you enjoy and find all and more of what you are looking for in another world.

details.title: Threaded Dungeons
details.short_description: A world threaded in death. Can you cultivate a party of four that defies all odds? Make every action count in tactical turn-based combat. Choose your allegiances carefully. Scour dungeons in search of loot and secrets. Resist or acquiesce to tempting whispers in the darkness.

details.title: Les Nominés du Néombre
details.short_description: Les Nominés du Néombre is a cooperative and strategic card game where you play as a group of explorers embarking on a collective adventure. Each battle tests your strength in the Vermalian lands, which have turned hostile since the emergence of the Néombre Rift.

details.title: HOLE WAR -The Abyss-
details.short_description: 「今こそ語りましょう。『もしも』の物語を……！」本作は、「職」と「食」から力を得て戦う長編RPGの体験版です。時には職業を変えて新たなスキルや能力を得て、時には料理を食べて一時的なバフを得て冒険しましょう。

details.title: Warmongers: Empires Reborn
details.short_description: A single player RPG inspired by oldschool MMORPGs created by a Solo dev. Play as an Orc, Saurak or Human. Explore an open world, complete quests and fight your way through dungeons and raids. Master all of your gathering and crafting skills.

details.title: Flow of Fortune
details.short_description: Build fortunes in a digital board game of economy, strategy, and no violence. Manage time, expand businesses, and shape your success.

details.title: High Mountain Abbey
details.short_description: Do you dare to meddle with the mad god? High Mountain Abbey is a stop-motion point-and-click puzzle game that throws you into a strange space. Navigate hand-crafted and photographed dioramas and solve trippy mechanical challenges to contain the forces of madness that have swallowed the abbey.

details.title: Mindbreak
details.short_description: Mindbreak is an exploration driven tile-based puzzle adventure game about the escape from a corrupted insane asylum. Play as the supernaturally gifted asylum patients as you build and combine their unique abilities to explore and master the vast interconnected asylum.

details.title: Warlocks Maze
details.short_description: A Warlock has unleashed chaos upon the World of Eld! Lead a band of heroes into his shifting labyrinth in this brutal turn-based dungeon crawler. Outsmart deadly foes, conquer traps, and adapt to ever-changing challenges. Will you emerge victorious or be lost to the maze forever?

details.title: Void Martyrs
details.short_description: A grimdark survival horror about a nun in space. Scavenge amongst the drifting space-Basilica, balance your faith with survival, and craft the tools of your salvation.

details.title: ARMED FRAME
details.short_description: A fast-paced TPS & FPS where you control a mech in battle. Customize 12 parts: head, torso, arms, legs, booster, FCS, and 6 weapons. Weapon and frame colors are changeable. Use weapons, jump, boost up, run on walls, do rapid boosts, quick turns, and high boosts.

details.title: The Vow: Vampire's Curse
details.short_description: You are Sir Richard in a tactical card battler set in a dark fantasy roguelike. Master your cards, execute deadly combos, and survive cursed nights to rescue your fiancée from the vampire’s grasp.

details.title: UnderPath
details.short_description: UnderPath is a single-player horror FPS that takes you into a dark, dangerous world. Explore abandoned locations, fight zombies and demons, solve puzzles, and shape your fate in an atmospheric open world filled with challenges.

details.title: Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers
details.short_description: "Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers" is a Touhou fan-made roguelike action game.Due to a Kedama incident in Gensokyo, Flandre Scarlet eagerly takes the initiative to resolve it. Or rather, she's actually just causing chaos, definitely not trying to solve anything!

details.title: Häxeri
details.short_description: Häxeri is a grid-based first-person dungeon crawler DRPG with turn-based combat. Form your own party, explore and map the sprawling corridors of the dungeon, and battle the monsters therein. Gain extra turns by exploiting their weaknesses, but be careful or they will exploit yours!

details.title: Anemorie
details.short_description: A girl with a fragile heart. A gift to see forgotten memories. Dive into Anna’s world where every object holds a story—and one memory may change her life forever.

details.title: psy-relic
details.short_description: A cooperative horror game in which you collect "psy-relics" that have abnormalities caused by psychic phenomena.

details.title: The Ardron Universe
details.short_description: Your choices carve scars across realms. One universe. Multiple games. No second chances.

details.title: Curry Princess GOLD
details.short_description: A casual kawaii action game where you collect falling spices, earn gold, and cook delicious curry.Including Classic mode, Story mode, and 2P mode offers both competitive and cooperative play. There is also a curry catalog and leaderboards.

details.title: Zomb Zerro - 999
details.short_description: Psychological VR horror built around immersive physical interaction. Protocol 9-9-9 is compromised deep in a secret mountain facility. Science collided with occult rituals - something horrific awoke. Explore, scavenge scarce ammo, fight for survival, and uncover the truth.

details.title: The Dropouts
details.short_description: A spooky choices-matter mystery set in 2004 Switzerland. Many students have disappeared in Noirmont High over the past century. You're Lou, you just transferred here, and weird stuff immediately starts happening... will you be the next dropout?

details.title: Other World Strike: Helicopter Rescue
details.short_description: A third-person helicopter action shooter featuring realistic physics-based flight enhanced by alien technology. Extract stranded soldiers before hostile alien forces capture them across open maps set in three distinct biomes, with optional first-person gameplay and four selectable camera views.

details.title: Mindwarp: Island Detective
details.short_description: Up to 4 players in online co-op. Talk to characters, learn their stories, search for clues and pass judgment before sunset in this unique detective.

details.title: NO EXIT
details.short_description: No Exit is a small chapter based indie horror game. You'll have to face challenging enemies, and perhaps make some allies, as you try to escape the crooked dimension you're trapped in.

details.title: Space Diner Simulator
details.short_description: After buying a rundown diner, you need to repair it and bring it to its full glory. Manage, renovate and upgrade the diner to attract more customers, and meet their demands. Bring a piece of home to the edges of space with Earths best recipes.

details.title: Giggy Shangri-La
details.short_description: Welcome to [Giggy Shangri-La], an exhilarating staff music action x live house management simulation. With guitar in hand, conquer dungeons and experience being a bartender at a live music club visited only by monsters! Would you like to explore the cute and eerie world with Yu Furuiido?

details.title: Planetary Delivery Boys
details.short_description: A co-op horror comedy about delivering furniture with your friends across the galaxy! Up to 4 players must physically lift couches and chairs, handling them carefully to reach rogue planets.

details.title: Mitch
details.short_description: Mitch just landed! Will you help her begin her new life?

details.title: Buggy
details.short_description: BUGGY is a multiplayer insect catching game! Fill your collection book, hop on with your friends, Relax and Catch a LOT of critters! Personalize your character to your liking and grab some cool cosmetics for yourself!

details.title: Killing Baby Hitler
details.short_description: Stop fascism in the cradle. Travel through time and hunt down history’s most evil infant in this satirical old-school FPS.

details.title: Magic Scavenger
details.short_description: 《Magic Scavenger》 is a casual looting game. You arrive at an unfamiliar continent, free to explore this medieval land. While scavenging items across the map, you'll also encounter potential enemies

details.title: Purge Phalanx
details.short_description: Unleash heavy weaponry to exterminate the demonic horde alone or up to 4 players online and/or in splitscreen

details.title: Mica King
details.short_description: Mica King is an original top down action adventure game. Travel as an adventurer of variety skills to the once great and magical kingdom of Virrdale. Uncover the power of Mica and face the dark forces behind the bitter downfall of the king.

details.title: ココロトーカーズ
details.short_description: 舞台は廃校。記憶喪失の少年と、「モノ」を自身に宿すことができる「モノマネ」の力を持つ少女。 校舎内のあらゆる「モノ」と会話してモノだけが知っている情報を聞き出し、失われた記憶を取り戻そう！

details.title: Emberhold
details.short_description: An action adventure game where you explore fantastical floating islands, fight powerful enemies, and rebuild a long lost bastion of hope for a kingdom in disarray

details.title: Flashback Dream
details.short_description: "Hope leads to despair." Welcome to Lethia, a paradise where dreams are forbidden. Amnesiac Jin takes up his sword to uncover the truth hidden by the cult and find his way back home. A top-down 2D pixel art action-adventure. In this lonely world, the future is yours to choose.

details.title: CHI Project
details.short_description: Sci-fi fantasy visual novel, turn-based RPG, and murder mystery -- all in one!

details.title: Shadowbridge - The Genesis
details.short_description: Restore the balance in the dimensions! Help Ezra solve the biggest mystery of them all in this mind blowing point and click adventure.

details.title: I Need To Go
details.short_description: A naive metalhead wakes up in a strange, dreamlike cave with no idea how he got there, and no sign of his girlfriend. A fully voiced pixel art point-and-click adventure where humor meets the heart.

details.title: Leap Galaxy
details.short_description: Leap Galaxy is a 2D platformer with a minimalistic aesthetic and gameplay that puts speed and flow first. Take advantage of momentum and master the recoil of your shots to reach insane speeds and beat each level as fast as posible!

details.title: Desecrated Deck
details.short_description: Desecrated Deck is a first-person psychological horror card game where you face a spectral opponent in a forbidden occult ritual of Rock, Paper, Scissors, powerful Item Cards, and supernatural Perks. Win the game — or discover what happens when you don’t.

details.title: 咏唱魔女 witch's Aria
details.short_description: "Witch's Area" is an RPG game with a core gameplay mechanic centered around combining cards to create spells, featuring light strategic roguelike elements. Combine different cards to craft your unique spells and uncover the truth behind the little witch's cyclical dreams!

details.title: Monad Tachyon
details.short_description: Accelerate beyond the speed of sound! Monad Tachyon is the ultimate high-speed Metroidvania .

details.title: MESS
details.short_description: MESS is a multiplayer first-person jailbreak game where strategy, deception, and survival collide in a prison environment. Experience yourself in a role of Warden to maintain order, or Prisoner to try to break free and escape the prison.

details.title: CactusBandido
details.short_description: Love your friends? Too bad: in Thorn City, you're going to steal their loot. Face off with up to 6 players, outsmart the sheriff, and let the richest cactus win!

details.title: Mech Log Zero
details.short_description: Take control of a mechanized pilot and its Mech. Blast through Colossal Machines and secure the last remnants of life inside a dying God.

details.title: Arcadice
details.short_description: Play a top-down shooter on an arcade machine you’re handcuffed to. Buy vices between levels and abuse them to power up your run. Load dice like bullets and shoot dice-headed enemies. This is not a dice game.

name: Echoes of Shadows: The Last Jinyiwei

details.title: Echoes of Shadows: The Last Jinyiwei
details.short_description: A third-person stealth adventure set in the late Ming dynasty. Play as Jinyiwei agent Xie Guxian and travel with a mysterious girl. Observe patrols and connections between people. Use Threadweaving together to create openings for infiltration and rescue, and find a way through danger.

details.title: Cat Golf
details.short_description: Cat Golf is a fresh and exciting action-golf game where you can tee off in all sorts of unexpected places across a city! The star of the show? A round, adorable cat! The golf course is an Japanese town. Set off on a laid-back, carefree adventure as you and your cat zip freely through the city!

details.title: Battles For Glory
details.short_description: Battles for Glory is a free MMORPG where opposition of parties and control of the world map are combined.

details.title: AFTER 9PM
details.short_description: AFTER 9PM — a game where reality and nightmare merge into one. Your parents left you home alone. It’s already late. Every time they left you like this, you had strange nightmares. Each time, they became more and more real. And now you’re not sure… if it’s just a dream anymore.

name: Yami Kare - His mind trying to bind me mentally

details.title: Yami Kare - His mind trying to bind me mentally
details.short_description: This game is a confinement suspense & love romance escape game in which the main character, who has lost her memory, aims to regain her memory and escape from the room she was confined in.

details.title: Drone Armada
details.short_description: Pilot and command massive drone swarms in real-time action-strategy battles. Research powerful tech, upgrade your fleet, and adapt your tactics to push back the invasion spreading across Kaelisia.

details.title: Endwell
details.short_description: One determined cat, one big backpack, and a whole lot of deliveries to make! As a Cat Courier, it's your job to deliver packages across a cozy town on the eve of the world's end. Help residents find connection, hope, and meaning before the last sunset.

details.title: IN SILICO
details.short_description: In a distant future humanity is enslaved in a simulation. Now that you are awake, can you escape from reality too?

details.title: Gatekeeper's Week
details.short_description: Become a guard of the glorious kingdom of Cardenia! Your task is to let only law-abiding travelers into the city, while repelling bandit attacks and sending swindlers to jail! Be attentive and vigilant! For the glory of the King!

details.title: Taptron 1999
details.short_description: Taptron 1999 is a short roguelite clicker where you must prevent Y2K using the power of a mouse click.

details.title: Burger Rush Simulator
details.short_description: Burger Rush Simulator is a fast food simulator where you manage your fast food restaurant, order supplies, restock containers, take payments at checkout and drive-thru, prepare meals, hire staff, expand your kitchen and dining area, and unlock features like storage and touchscreen checkout.

details.title: Scratchcard Hero
details.short_description: Get to scratchin' in this realtime rogueli*e deckbuilder where all your cards are lottery scratch-off-micro-game tickets! Make your build of scratchcards and gadgets, and 1v1 battle other scratcher enthusiasts on your way to the source of your town's gambling problems.

details.title: Bloomcraft
details.short_description: Bloomcraft is a Garden Creation Simulator. The player's goal is to create a garden that pleases the Flower Queen. The more the Flower Queen likes the garden, the more money she pays for it every second.

details.title: UNRETURNING
details.short_description: No one is known to have reached the end of the abyss, but one thing is certain: something must be there, and it must be seen. Explore the depths of the abyss in a game that blends adventure, horror, and dark fantasy. This time, it’s not about the destination, it's about THE JOURNEY.

details.title: Path For The Seeker
details.short_description: Path For The Seeker is a detective adventure in which a young nun investigates the disappearance of a famous inventor in a city on the border of two worlds.

details.title: Silks & Glory
details.short_description: Build your racing legacy in a premium horse racing game with a full single-player career, direct jockey gameplay, deep stable management, worldwide competition, online leagues, 2–4 player split-screen, and LAN multiplayer.

name: Detective NEKKO - ディテクティブネッコ -

details.title: Detective NEKKO - ディテクティブネッコ -
details.short_description: Mystery adventure where no one dies. Use your “ability to see too much” to uncover an inconvenient truth.

details.title: Memoridian
details.short_description: Special knights and explorers that study and fight against the dangerous creatures called Memories. These are dangerous creatures that one day started showing up one by one. Uncover the truth about their origin while protecting your town.

details.title: Starcatcher
details.short_description: Wish upon the starry sky for the power to slay your enemies in this hack 'n' slash action roguelite.

details.title: Road To School
details.short_description: Road to School is a physics-based parkour platformer where you ride a bicycle up a treacherous mountain. Jump, balance, and explore hidden paths while tackling brutal challenges on your journey to school. Play alone or with friends in a co-op experience.

details.title: What Lies Within
details.short_description: What Lies Within is a co-op first person psychological horror. You and your team must work together to complete objectives within abandoned facilities owned by your employer, 'M-E-L'. A bioengineering company conducting top secret biological experimentation on aliens, humans and more...

details.title: Kkokko Industry
details.short_description: Kkokko Industry is a relaxing idle game where you manage a chicken farm. The game runs on one side of your monitor, allowing you to enjoy it comfortably while working on other tasks.

details.title: GOP POST
details.short_description: It's 2090. GOPPOST is a co-op Papers Please-style game about defending a MEGA-TOWER. You and your GOP-SQUAD must hold the stairwell check papers, keep the beer flowing, and stop whatever's crawling up from below. Will you survive the shift?

details.title: Tetrabonk
details.short_description: Tetrabonk is a 1–4 player co-op roguelike. Explore procedurally generated locations, fight with swords, bows, or firearms against hordes of enemies and powerful bosses, and build your character through upgrade cards — no run is ever the same.

details.title: Hot Stuff
details.short_description: Hot Stuff is a casual action oriented party game, with procedural elements and simple controls, suitable for different types of players to quickly pick up and play together, achieving cooperation within the chaos.

details.title: Master of Jewelry
details.short_description: Master of Jewelry is a detailed jewelry crafting simulator where you rise from apprentice to master, repairing and creating pieces in your own workshop. Immerse yourself in the delicate art of working with precious metals and gemstones in the cozy town of Diamond City.

details.title: Love Notes
details.short_description: Love Notes is a romance game that can be completed in ??? minutes.

details.title: STENCH
details.short_description: STENCH is a story-driven life-sim RPG set in the 80s. A strange diagnosis brings you to the city. Live day by day, make weird friends, earn money, roam the city, and fight clueless thugs, while a conspiracy grows in the shadows.

details.title: Above Land: Rhapsody
details.short_description: A chaotic 1-3 player co-op action roguelite above the clouds. Grab a toy. Save the world.

details.title: You Can't See Ghosts!
details.short_description: You Can't See Ghosts is a puzzle game about spatial awareness and deductive reasoning with a charming story where you play as an invisible ghost. Bump into walls, step on glass, and other clues to locate yourself and reach the exit. Perfect for both experienced players and newcomers alike.

details.title: Dragons Invade Scotland
details.short_description: Match-3 Tower Defense. Defend real Scottish castles from waves of dragons. Real Scottish stories and legends. Includes a full map of Scotland to scale where 1 tile is 19.5 meters.

details.title: Factories in Factories in Factories
details.short_description: Build a fractal world. Automate the automation of your automation. Put Factories in Factories in Factories.

details.title: Avante! Atlantis
details.short_description: Lead the world's greatest Strategists through a virtual war. Decide how humanity will approach the mysterious island of Atlantis.

details.title: WATERTRIX ONLINE
details.short_description: A Tetris-style puzzle game where you control water to battle enemies! It's a casual game featuring cute characters and beautiful water that will soothe you. You can compete in 1v1 online matches and challenge rivals from all over the country.

details.title: Epoch Reset
details.short_description: Unravel a narrative-driven 2.5D anime adventure as Hector, a dirt-poor genius and creator of the world’s first time machine. Travel between timelines, meet intriguing characters, and explore futuristic cityscapes as you seek to save reality from time-bending forces beyond imagination.

details.title: Sova
details.short_description: Descend into a surreal sci-fantasy world in this narrative-driven action roguelite, where every run reshapes your story. Sova’s expressive combat meets deeply branching dialogue and world-shifting decisions. Compose your violence, rewrite your past, and bend a crumbling realm to your will.

details.title: ZOMBIE KEBAB VR
details.short_description: Cook kebabs and fight zombies in this fast action game. Explore streets, gather ingredients, and feed survivors. Unlock new tools and recipes as you survive each night. Fast, funny, and brutal. Known online as the “4 a.m. fast-food simulator”

details.title: 机影：夏夜梦寻
details.short_description: "A Midsummer Night's Dream with the Android Girl" — As Deputy Director of the AI Oversight Bureau, navigate the cyber metropolis alongside your robot assistant, Dill. Investigate rogue AI cases, uncover the truth behind dreams, and unlock multiple endings.

details.title: Gorecam
details.short_description: GORECAM is a hardcore co-op horror survival game, designed after found-footage horror films. Play with up to 4 friends and try to escape with your life, and maybe some of your sanity.

details.title: Dreamcraft: Lumberjack
details.short_description: Chop the sick trees to purify the forests. Gather lumber, upgrade your axe, and improve stats. No rush, no stress, relax in cozy and beautiful lands, rescue animals, and unravel the secrets of the wilderness. Nature must be preserved so cut the shadow and restore the light!

details.title: 1992: Rasputie
details.short_description: Take a place of a politician in the post-Soviet space and immerse yourself in the struggle for power amid the ruins of the former empire. Your decisions will determine the path of the young state's development.

details.title: MaskuLand Survival
details.short_description: You are Masku, an explorer who crash-landed in an unknown world carrying a rare cure for your son! To breathe you need special Masks, each one grants you a unique ability! Repair your balloon and get supplies, fight you way back home! His life depends on you! You need to SURVIVE!

details.title: The Guiding Spirit
details.short_description: Mix and match hundreds of traits, flaws, and skills to design unique heroes with complex personalities and ambitions. Watch them love, hate, help, and hinder each other. Roll the dice and become the Guiding Spirit of your group of misfits in this story-rich fantasy campaign simulator!

details.title: Di Renjie:  The Legendary Investigator
details.short_description: Become a legendary detective of ancient China! In "Di Renjie: The Legendary Investigator", play as Di Renjie, solving thrilling cases across Bianzhou and Bingzhou in the Tang Dynasty and uncovering the truth.

details.title: Whist
details.short_description: Become a healer in Whist – a single-player turn-based RPG. Challenge cunning diseases. Learn the art of healing, brew and stock up on potions, and solve puzzles. Plan your moves ahead, allocate your talents, and don’t rush to reveal all your cards — illnesses are not as simple as they seem!

details.title: Everything is Gun!
details.short_description: Dominate in a brutal, lightning-fast old-school FPS. Modify yourself into the perfect weapon, unleash mass destruction, conquer runs, invade others, and ascend to global supremacy. Prisoner #11 18 1978, you now belong to A1KTRZ. Your survival is broadcast to billions. What will remain of your soul?

details.title: IZEA:10puzzle Rogue-Lite RPG!
details.short_description: "Make 10 is mightier than the sword!" IZEA is a fresh strategic battle game that fuses “Make 10” × Puzzle Calculation × RPG × Roguelite. Use number cards and arithmetic operators to calculate the enemy’s designated Weak Number and fight your way to victory!

details.title: ARTIUS: Pure Imagination
details.short_description: ARTIUS is a fast-paced, momentum-based 2D platformer where you play as artists battling to preserve creativity in a world on the verge of artistic extinction! Dash, swing, and smash your way through a vibrant, hand-drawn world in this adrenaline-fueled platformer where art is your strongest weapon.

details.title: Mooncrawler
details.short_description: Wield your magical lantern and survive the endless night in this 2,5D roguelike. While a cosmic entity is slowly corrupting the moon the world is drowning in darkness only you can overcome. Collect perks and fuel your lantern with light to grow stronger and to fight against the outwordly intruders.

details.title: The Black Bahr
details.short_description: The Black Bahr is a sandbox colony simulation RPG blending ocean exploration, crew management, and dynamic faction politics. Freely chart your course as a pirate, merchant, or honorable captain, shaping your destiny across the open seas.

details.title: Parabless
details.short_description: Explore life and spiritual warfare in Parabless card game. Grounded in a biblical moral code and driven by artistic expression, every card represents a facet of existence in a broken world.

details.title: The Hole Never Ends
