details.short_description: An intense VR adventure where you crawl through twisting caves, face unseen terrors, evade creatures, mine for relics, and upgrade your gear as you descend deeper into the hole.

details.title: Captain Contraption’s Safari Park
details.short_description: A pixel-art run based safari park sim. Clone lions, medieval knights and sentient trucks into a park with no fences, then route your visitors past the chaos. You control the paths, the buildings and your robot staff. The one thing you don’t control is the animals.

details.title: Sheep Counting
details.short_description: A recreational software for counting sheep, observing puzzles, and befriending an indoor air-conditioning unit.

details.title: ORK
details.short_description: One day, a mighty quake shakes the land — Colors fade away, this wasn’t planned! “This is bad!” cry five odd friends in stride, They gather, rise, and run side by side. Use their skills, push through each stage, Reach the goal in a 2D side-scrolling rage!

details.title: Kafka at the Station
details.short_description: I found myself at the station. The story unfolds as you type commands on your keyboard. As the days repeat, I keep wondering what I can do for her. A command-driven adventure steeped in nostalgic pixel art and sound.

details.title: The Element Of
details.short_description: The Element Of is an element bending roguelite dungeon crawler set in a strange fantasy world. Choose from a variety of elements all with their unique playstyles to fight through floors of enemies and gain rewards that make you and your element stronger.

details.title: Punk Runner
details.short_description: A flying-car racing game set in a cyberpunk city, with spontaneous open-world outruns, heavy car customization, and high-speed chases that test your build.

details.title: Golden Stables - Horse Racing
details.short_description: A realistic horse racing management simulation. Buy racehorses, train them, and send them to races with the right jockey. Hire staff, manage finances strategically, and fight your way up through authentic race classes with real distances and times.

details.title: Sisters of Solitude
details.short_description: Explore a haunted convent with your EMF detector, tape recorder, and camera. Uncover the fate of four ghostly sisters and the mystery behind the murder they commited. Every room hides a clue, every shadow a warning, and the truth waits for those who dare to seek it.

details.title: Indie GameDev Sim
details.short_description: Become an indie game developer. Take client orders, buy new assets, build your own 2D games in a simple level editor, playtest them and send the finished builds to your clients for feedback and payment.

details.title: HIIT: Stranded on Zaruma
details.short_description: Trapped on the mysterious planet Zaruma, use tools like the Drone, Scanner, and Hookshot to explore the ruins of an ancient civilization and uncover what happened before your arrival.

details.title: Happy Village: The Broken Timeline
details.short_description: A narrative RPG of three intertwined stories, hidden secrets, and a broken timeline only the player can repair. Every ending reveals new paths, if you know where to look.

details.title: Alchemist's Arcana
details.short_description: A narrative puzzle game where you return to your hometown as an Alchemists' Guild clerk and unexpectedly become the acting alchemist. Relearn forgotten alchemy, help the townsfolk, and survive with your companions in a world slowly falling apart.

name: BOKUKAN5 TOKYO (HND) I am an Air Traffic Controller

details.title: BOKUKAN5 TOKYO (HND) I am an Air Traffic Controller
details.short_description: The latest air traffic control puzzle is here! Set at Tokyo International Airport (HND/RJTT), experience two ways to enjoy the airport: Air Traffic Control Puzzle and the all-new Terminal Side. BOKUKAN evolves into a game where you can immerse yourself in the airport experience.

details.title: Forgotten
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. Shipwrecked on a remote island, Evelyn searches for the missing lighthouse keeper, her only way home. But the people of this island were forgotten long ago. Explore, solve puzzles and hide as you uncover who they were.

details.title: Chug It 🍺
details.short_description: Grow it. Brew it. Chug it. Run a cozy fantasy tavern, farm your own ingredients, cook food and drinks by hand, and serve a wide cast of customers. Play solo or in 4-player co-op, and let golem helpers handle the chores.

details.title: Wrongbots
details.short_description: Annihilate robot hordes and survive in this roguelite shooter. Hack or smash productive machinery. Grab resources and craft cool items. Swap body parts with glamour or extravaganza. Modify your weapons to absurdity. See how clever AI has become?

details.title: Ammo Station Simulator
details.short_description: Manage your gun shop in Ammo Station. By day, sell and repair weapons. By night, team up with friends to rob warehouses and smuggle illegal arms. Rise from a respectable shopkeeper to the city's ultimate gun baron in this first-person simulation.

details.title: Pray To The Darkness
details.short_description: Tread the path to redemption or cling to your past. Shape destinies or submit to strangers. New society. New secrets. New path. Pray To The Darkness is a narrative psychological horror exploring the complexity of human fate and the world around us.

details.title: Neidfyre
details.short_description: Neidfyre is a turn-based duel game forged in fire and steel. Step into a cursed land of no escape. Survive against those who stand in your way and fulfill your purpose.

details.title: Freak Accident
details.short_description: 1984. An off-duty deputy enters an overrun rural nightmare to rescue his sister Sarah. Survive tense over-the-shoulder gunplay, brutal melee crowd control, and scarce ammo inside an 8×5 hunting pack—where every shot and locked gate demands a choice.

details.title: 8-bitBot
details.short_description: 8-bitBot is a programming puzzle game where you place simple instructions in a program to make your bots transport objects in a factory environment.

details.title: Grove Bound
details.short_description: Grove Bound is a cozy incremental woodcutting RPG where you chop, fish, cook, mine, and craft to explore a dark forest. Manage fatigue, light your way with a lantern, and upgrade tools while meeting quirky NPCs and uncovering secrets at your own pace.

details.title: Underpond
details.short_description: Delve into the depths of the amphibian afterlife, the eponymous UNDERPOND, in this procedurally generated, hand-drawn, frog-hopping roguelite.

details.title: Enlighted
details.short_description: Enlighted is a dark fantasy, dungeon crawler game that shows no mercy for mistakes. Explore randomly generated dungeon levels, find a legendary equipment and manage your light - it protects you quick death.

details.title: I Saw a Flying Saucer
details.short_description: An interactive fiction about a man who lost his wife and goes in search of a UFO that shouldn't exist.

details.title: Puzzle Mage
details.short_description: Puzzle Mage is a top-down game where you replace traditional ARPG combat with spellcasting puzzles.

details.title: Gata Guressi
details.short_description: Learn to communicate with the people of Hierre by speaking their languages and understanding their cultures in this sci-fi translation game. Use your translation skills to navigate Kallay Tirridor, uncovering its dark secrets while solving the sudden disappearance of your brother.

details.title: Flutterfield
details.short_description: Flutterfield is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Buy butterflies and raise them in real time, or catch fully grown ones yourself. Unlock, upgrade, and customize habitats while filling your collection with real-life butterfly species!

name: Chrysanthemum: On the Way to Sweet Dreams

details.title: Chrysanthemum: On the Way to Sweet Dreams
details.short_description: A high school senior with superpowers longs to confess her feelings to her chemistry teacher, but the island’s mysterious anomalies turn her world upside down. A non-linear otome visual novel filled with sinister mysteries and complicated choices.

details.title: Fake World 2: Real World 1
details.short_description: Fake World 2: Real World 1 is a VR first-person shooter where weapon color matters. Match red and yellow weapons to enemy attacks while you grapple, jetpack, and teleport through surreal sci-fi environments in a fast-paced, atmospheric campaign.

details.title: Keep Crafting
details.short_description: Keep Crafting is an asymetrical cooperative party game : One player must guide the other players using a manual to craft complex items !

details.title: Drift Market
details.short_description: Destroy supermarkets, fight absurd bosses, and turn your trolley into a weapon of mass destruction! Drift through chaotic stores as a furious mutant fruit and unleash over-the-top, physics-driven mayhem in this ridiculous smash ‘em up.

details.title: SinsKiller
details.short_description: SinsKiller is an isometric action arcade shooter set in a Dante-inspired Hell. Play as a fallen battle-mage wielding arcane power to obliterate demonic hordes and face brutal bosses. Face your sins. Kill them. Earn your redemption.

details.title: Dead 4 Now: Extraction
details.short_description: Survive the outbreak or become it in a PvPvE FPS extraction shooter. Scavenge loot, use experimental stims, and fight to extract as a survivor. Or enter a raid as a zombie, hunt other players, and evolve into a monstrous boss.

details.title: Alien Colony
details.short_description: Lead a squad of four cloned marines through an infected mining colony where every death creates a new soldier, but slowly destroys what remains of your humanity.

details.title: Auto Arcana
details.short_description: Devise the ultimate spell rotation and watch it obliterate your foes in this roguelike auto-battler. Seek forbidden knowledge to craft overpowered spells, assemble devastating combos, and break the game.

details.title: QSO7
details.short_description: A space RPG with an insanely rich story line filled with mind-bending puzzles, deep philosophical conversations and gorgeous alien species. If you are the first person to unlock the game 100% you will gain access to a hidden cash prize.

details.title: Multi Class Quest
details.short_description: Traverse a forgotten fantasy world in this classic Beat Em Up hack and slash! Fight through hordes of unique monsters as one of five different classes...then, mix the skills you learned into another class to create your unique fighter!

details.title: Bread and Iron
details.short_description: A brutal medieval survival sandbox blending crafting, base building, and combat as players struggle against harsh environments and dangerous creatures.

details.title: Helenland
details.short_description: Helen finds a mysterious video game on her doorstep and starts playing it. But as she progresses, strange events begin to happen around her...

details.title: Siren's Wrath
details.short_description: A point-and-click adventure where you are trapped in a psychological loop, relive a tragic event, and return the cursed artifacts to escape the loop, before the curse claims you. But remember, she is watching.

details.title: The Other Order
details.short_description: A surreal tile-based roguelike where you build and reshape tile combinations to attack your enemies.

details.title: Gag Order
details.short_description: The Research laboratory's Guardian Unit faced with a hellish mission to exterminate invincible cephalopod creatures in this one-of-a-kind immersive co-operative Horror FPS.

details.title: Survive The Oasis
details.short_description: Survive The Oasis is a co-op open-world action RPG with survival elements, focused on exploration, combat, character progression, and a journey toward enlightenment.

details.title: REAL DEAL
details.short_description: Run your own electronics store chain. Buy phones, tablets, computers, fridges, and more in bulk, transport them with your truck, and sell them at prices you choose. Manage up to 4 stores with hired employees, but fail to plan well and you won’t be able to pay rent, bills, or salaries.

details.title: Pathways Lost: Reclaim
details.short_description: Send customised troops and your powerful mech into battle in this strategic auto battler. Spawn units, equip gear, unlock skills and reclaim lost worlds. Optimize your army and master ever increasing challenges. Fast-paced matches, endless depth.

details.title: ROGUE COLLECTOR
details.short_description: ROGUE COLLECTOR is a hex-grid tactical roguelike where you don't collect gear: you collect the Rogues. Rescue procedurally generated Rogues from dungeons, extract them in time, or lose them forever. Trade your Rogues on a live player-driven marketplace.

details.title: Fast Food Architect
details.short_description: At the dawn of American fast food, build and manage your fast-food restaurant. Create your burgers, coordinate service, and grow your establishment over the decades.

details.title: Death the Guitar
details.short_description: "Death the Guitar" is a pop and violent 2D Platformer action game. The player is a killer electric guitar whose owner was murdered, and the goal is to take revenge on the humans by manipulating "sound" and "electricity".
developers: トロヤマイバッテリーズフライド

details.title: Rise Of The General
details.short_description: 246 BCE. Pick one of 9 lives, from a slave in the headman's grain store to a kid raised by hill bandits. At 16, the levy takes you to war. Climb from conscript to general in a narrative war RPG with turn-based 5v5 battles, duels, and no plot armor.

details.title: Just in Crime
details.short_description: Just in Crime is a detective video game in which you play a detective dog and a wizard cat. With a twist; you are able to travel back in time and examine the crime scene a few seconds before it happened.

details.title: Dōbumon
details.short_description: Dōbumon is an RPG monster collecting/battling game. Experience tactical battles as you choose 4 Dōbumon to fight with on the battlefield. Grow, evolve, and customize your attacks while developing different strategies in order to win, as you fight and explore your way to become the Dōbumon champion.

details.title: Wandersky
details.short_description: Wandersky is a skybound top-down adventure with a single arrow and a flying house. Kuu and her companion Tama are on a mission to restore the land of Hyndara. Explore a huge world filled with puzzles, enemies and quests: the sky always carries those who dare to wander…

details.title: Jeller Fellers
details.short_description: Bounce, squish, and launch through a vibrant, stylized world in Jeller Fellers, where you *attempt* to control a wobbly jelly cube. Solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and explore diverse environments in this challenging, physics-based precision platformer

details.title: DollHouse: survive  or death
details.short_description: A stately, huge, beautiful mansion... Where is this?Opened the door of the mansion with a nervous heart, and the moment , I knew there was no turning back.

details.title: Bite Size Terrors: Speechless
details.short_description: Find what was taken from you at any cost in this Minimalistic Survival Horror.

details.title: Self Simulated
details.short_description: Self Simulated is a fast-paced precision platformer about a robotic copy of yourself, waking up with no memory of a severe accident. Dash, dodge, and double jump through 100+ handcrafted levels, reboot instantly on every fail, and uncover the truth behind your past.

details.title: Tribe Quest
details.short_description: Fight, craft, and survive. Swap between characters in your party as you navigate procedurally generated levels and complete quests. Rebuild your home from the rubble and hunt the warlord who destroyed it.

details.title: Paris Transylvania
details.short_description: A vampire-slaying pachinko roguelike deckbuilder. Collect a powerful deck of cards, strategize, aim, and pop pegs to power up and deal massive damage with relic synergies. Play as one of the unlikely heroes, conquer Transylvania, and free the people in this turn-based RPG.

details.title: Dice Captain
details.short_description: Dice Captain is pirate roguelike about managing luck. Roll dice, adapt and outsmart bad luck to win battles at sea. Build wild artifact combos and upgrade your dice faces between runs to turn pure chance into a strategy you control.

details.title: Penny Acres
details.short_description: Fence off farmland while farm animals bounce around. A cozy roguelike deckbuilder: play fence cards, wall off open pasture before an animal knocks your fence down, and chain bushels × mult combos through a year of seasons, bosses and farm helpers.

details.title: Unheeded Influences
details.short_description: A spiritual journey in the life of an elemental soul in our mythologies and legends. A unique adventure infused with 12 elements: fire, time, shadow, water... Unlock powerful spells and influence the game of other players. Fast travel through spirit realms, and try to survive in physical ones.

details.title: Poker Warlords
details.short_description: Poker but your cards fight to win the pot. Turn cards into armies, complete combos for more power, and claim victory on the battlefield and at the betting table! From the creators of a top-10 StarCraft II custom game, this is poker like you've never played before.

details.title: Glitch Hunt
details.short_description: Shoot > Loot > Hack > Die > Repeat. Glitch Hunt is a cyberpunk action-RPG roguelike. Capture droid enemies, equip and evolve them. Hack and control powerful turrets. Synergize skills and an abundance of gear to build your playstyle. Explore procedural maps and destroy SINUS, humanity's AI “saviour”.

details.title: Death Ring
details.short_description: Death Ring is a casual action roguelike in which you will have to force your way through hordes of undead in search of the human world’s main artefact. Numerous scenarios of each character’s development based on random dropping items will make your runs unique.

details.title: Beyond the Pier
details.short_description: Set sail for an uncharted New World. Explore unknown islands, build thriving colonies and compete with rival factions in a living world where every voyage, battle and decision spreads rumors that shape your reputation, economy and diplomacy.

details.title: The Mangust
details.short_description: The Mangust is a high octane action platformer. You play as the Mangust, a lone drifter with a loose grip on reality. Blitz through enemies with an arsenal of customizable guns and special abilities. Explore different environments, defeat iconic bosses, and stop the plans of the Evil Dr. Cassowary.

details.title: Dig Dig Boom
details.short_description: Dig Dig Boom is a strategic mining roguelite set in a fully destructible world where time moves only when you move. Dig, blast, explore and fight your way through procedurally generated caves using a wide selection of mining tools with unique effects.

details.title: Regen Protocol
details.short_description: Sci-fi progression/idler game with many unexpected twists. Build modules, set protocols and help your ship grow to get it back to it's desired destination after the ships Regen Protocol is initiated.

details.title: April '86
details.short_description: April ’86 is an atmospheric first-person psychological horror about returning to Pripyat, where the past never truly died. Explore the abandoned city, uncover the mystery behind the disappearance of children, and confront what was hidden behind the Chernobyl disaster.

details.title: Elidriel
details.short_description: Elidriel is a story-driven pixel-art RPG that combines reactive turn-based combat with character customisation, a range of non-combat activities and a mystery surrounding a lost love. Explore a world of wonders, crafting, cooking, fishing, playing songs and mining gems to upgrade your weapons.

details.title: Corridors
details.short_description: Explore an abandoned hospital, solve puzzles, and uncover a nonlinear story where your choices have consequences. A hardcore psychological horror game in pixel art.

details.title: DEATH A LIVE
details.short_description: Your rock band needs a crowd. Neon wants you all to herself. You've got 30 days to fill the venue in a cyberpunk rhythm-action adventure of love, madness and yandere psychological horror. Explore the city, take the stage, and watch what you say. One wrong answer could be your last.

details.title: Boing Boing Bros
details.short_description: Boing Boing Bros is a chaotic pinball-like action roguelike where you blast and boing your way through increasingly larger amounts of enemies. Use powerups, stat upgrades, and your boing skills to fight bosses, clear waves of enemies, and boing with your friends.

details.title: WitchOver
details.short_description: Watch the witches.Don't miss the anomalies.Despairing witches slowly lose themselves and become monsters. 12:00 AM – 6:00 AM.Your job is to manage the “witches.” As the caretaker of a facility, monitor the witches who possess dangerous powers and resolve any anomalies that occur within the facility.

details.title: Dungeon Chess
details.short_description: Dungeon Chess is a turn-based strategy game with roguelike elements where the setting simulates a chessboard.

details.title: TileShire
details.short_description: TileShire is a low-stakes, high-depth strategy game. Combine tiles on a living landscape to grow a home rich with life.

details.title: Wildlife Ballistics
details.short_description: Wildlife Ballistics is a fast-paced, tactical top-down shooter where you manage your team of 5 to kick down doors, clear rooms and neutralize threats. Fight tooth and claw to maintain order in the ever-decaying civilization of the forest.

details.title: Devilbreath: The First Seal
details.short_description: Devilbreath: The First Seal is a dark fantasy tactical RPG set in a medieval frontier, where an ordinary village boy follows a hell-born mist into a dying forest to find its source—and stop it before his village is lost.

details.title: Fables of the Kingdom 3
details.short_description: Fables of the Kingdom 3 is a new chapter in the fairy-tale time-management strategy series. Manage resources, construct buildings, and wield powerful spells to protect the Great Tree of Life and stop the mad sorcerer Balen.

details.title: Altalis
details.short_description: A puzzle Metroidvania game!

details.title: WESTLINE
details.short_description: You are the lone conductor of an aging freight train, hauling precious cargo across a dying desert. The world wants what you're carrying, and it will stop at nothing to take it. Keep your train running, fight off the nomads hunting you down, and push forward to the next station.

details.title: Fun World
details.short_description: Explore the Nightmares of Fun World — a once-cheerful children’s park that has fallen into ruin, now twisted and corrupted by dark forces beyond understanding. What was once filled with laughter and bright colors is now drenched in shadows, echoing with distant sounds you can’t quite explain.

details.title: Key Krusher
details.short_description: Krush the keys coming at you in this arcade-style typing game.

details.title: Failover
details.short_description: Take command of civil air defense under constant threat. Build radar networks, manage power and resources, and decide when to sound the sirens. Every choice has consequences. Hold your cities together as escalation turns survival into strategy.

details.title: Streamer vs. Chat
details.short_description: An interactive game with Twitch and Kick integration where every message matters. You vs. your Chat. Are you ready to fight against your viewers?

details.title: Burn-9
details.short_description: A spy thriller where you’re not the spy. Safe behind your screen, guide the last survivor of an elite black-ops team in a desperate attempt to salvage a mission gone horribly wrong. Caught between military command and your agent, information is your greatest weapon.

details.title: Tidy Up
details.short_description: A peaceful cleaning and organizing game where you explore different locations, collect trash, clean stains, and arrange items to turn mess into perfection.

details.title: Minesleeper
details.short_description: You wake up in a distant part of the universe 27.000 years after being deployed on an urgent mission to save humanity from extinction. A minesweeper gets a dangerous makeover in this hexagonal roguelite. Outsmart devious puzzles, bend the odds, and turn failures into triumph.

details.title: When I'm Not Drawing
details.short_description: In this cozy life-simulation RPG, you play as a young artist who moves to a new city to pursue your dreams. Plan your schedule, balance life and career, explore the city, and meet new friends! Live a fulfilling year on your own, at your own pace.

details.title: Adaptive Wilds
details.short_description: Learn the land. Make a life in it. Adaptive Wilds is a hardcore survival RPG with deep character progression, interacting physical and psychological states, and a wilderness you can reshape. Develop your skills, work with NPCs, experiment with nature, and explore dream realms.

details.title: Sky Pirates
details.short_description: Set sail with your friends aboard a flying pirate ship! Explore mysterious islands, plunder ships and treasures, and amass a fortune… But beware: the richer you get, the more you attract unwanted attention!

name: Castaway Diary: Portal to the Unknown Isles

details.title: Castaway Diary: Portal to the Unknown Isles
details.short_description: Castaway Diary is a bright and charming anime-style survival adventure. Are you ready to escape to a relaxing island life with a group of lovely girls?

details.title: Trip to the Core
details.short_description: Build three decks at once in a roguelike deckbuilder where 15 rebels fuse modular gear into broken combos across five shifting acts.

details.title: GraveDiggers
details.short_description: Online co-op horror for 1 to 6 undertaker cats. Every day, find the body, drag its coffin across a cursed Louisiana swamp and bury it before sunrise. Skeletons, Lazarites and the midnight mist will try to stop you. Eat cheese whenever you can.

details.title: PowerCorp
details.short_description: A space sim survival where each decision costs power. Every system drains your dying reactor. Pilot a crippled spacecraft across a real-scale solar system using true orbital mechanics, manage critical systems, scavenge for resources, while you try to uncover why humanity seems to have disappeared.

details.title: Quarantine
details.short_description: A co-op multiplayer survival game where players run a quarantine checkpoint together during an outbreak. Inspect survivors, manage shared resources, argue over decisions, and survive the consequences... or sabotage each other when panic sets in.

details.title: Crow Heist
details.short_description: The HOA have taken everything from Crowley... His nest, his ability to fly, and most important of all, his trinkets! Break into their homes as Crowley for revenge in this 2.5D Platform Comedy game. Unlock their drawers, break their belongings, and steal everything you can to rebuild the crow's home!

details.title: Please The Orb
details.short_description: Please The Orb is a roguelike puzzle deckbuilder about creating game-breaking chaos. Draft bizarre artifacts, arrange them on a grid, and trigger massive cascading chain reactions. Deceptively simple to play, but infinitely complex to master.

details.title: Nascentiar
details.short_description: A classic turn-based roguelike dungeon crawler with D20 dice combat. Three unique classes — a soul-projecting Cultivator, a monster-recruiting Mask Master, and a shadow-stalking Rogue. 117 monsters, randomized identification, and procedural dungeons make every run a new adventure.

details.title: Magic Store Simulator
details.short_description: Inherit an abandoned magic shop and bring the neighborhood back to life. Renovate, upgrade, and customize your shop to attract more customers. Unlock new workshops and expand your product range to meet their needs.

details.title: Eternal 4 Rounds
details.short_description: A dynamic low-poly Tower Defense. Command mobile squads and repel attacks from 4 factions. Collect gold from settlements during battle to craft equipment—the currency for hiring new troops. Defeat titanic bosses, upgrade your camp, and unlock elite tiers for your army!

details.title: Mythalia
details.short_description: Build your team and challenge the tower in this turn-based roguelite monster catching game. Unlock new beasts and upgrades as you play, discover mutations and champions in the 2v2 designed system.

details.title: After Hours
details.short_description: Survive until 6:00 AM in a cooperative asymmetric horror game. Watch cameras, control doors and lights, guide teammates, and complete deadly tasks inside a hostile facility. Communicate under pressure as systems fail, monsters adapt, and one mistake can get you killed. Finish the work. Repeat.

details.title: Settle
details.short_description: A cozy puzzle about decor and history. Explore different eras by arranging authentic items from diverse cultures. Restore harmony to interiors of the past and enjoy the meditative flow.

details.title: Belua
details.short_description: Build a team of monsters, plan your moves carefully, and escape this unjust prison. This unique mash-up of turn-based combat and auto-battlers requires strategy and wits. Every win unlocks a new cute or creepy creature to join your side.

details.title: The Last Ember
details.short_description: Fight endless hordes of enemies in a fast-paced roguelite bullet heaven while bringing life back to a dying wasteland. Capture territory, grow stronger, and discover powerful upgrades that transform you from a fragile spark into an unstoppable force.

details.title: GAS
details.short_description: A co-op road trip horror for 4 players from the fan of Spintires, MudRunner and SnowRunner. Loot by day. Survive the night. Defend your car from skeletons, monsters and bad decisions. Go GAS! Go FUN!

details.title: Project: Story about
details.short_description: An RPG where you live life after life in a constantly evolving world, and your choices and relationships influence future cycles.

details.title: In Vino Veritas
details.short_description: Explore a desecrated cathedral to find your missing wife in this psychological horror adventure. Uncover the dark truth behind the Elohim, solve ancient puzzles, and survive a chilling journey where faith and reality collide. The Bible was mistranslated; the truth is much darker

details.title: Codex Arcana: Grimoire of Monsters
details.short_description: Summon an army of Monster Girls to face your enemies in strategic battles! Defeat the Dark Lord's minions and expand your collection with cool, fierce and cute Monster Girls of all variety in this "Capsule Monsters" inspired game!

details.title: Darn Guy Adventures
details.short_description: Darn Guy Adventures is an RPG adventure following the titular Kishan "Darn Guy", Tinta and Norton as they are sent into a mission they are utterly underqualified for. Encounter verbose bushes, mathematical rocks and very loud wolfmen on the quest to save a town with an expiration date.

details.title: Revenant Maze
details.short_description: A first person, action-roguelite that centres around going fast. Enter a procedurally generated maze filled with prototypes and architects intent on defeating you. Create the strongest synergies and blitz all in sight.

details.title: Unlucky
details.short_description: A bullet-heaven wave-based survival gambler roguelike where gambling-powered abilities determine your fate. Survive endless waves in an open world, level up with randomised upgrades, and master the chaos with luck on your side... hopefully.

details.title: Astrolander
details.short_description: Astrolander is an action-packed modern take on retro platformers featuring innovative 2.5D+3D gameplay and unique optional local co-op chaos! Attack enemies with your CDjector, dodge cassette launching boomboxes, and more on your quest to save the Most Valuable Programs!

details.title: Ember Glimmer
details.short_description: This is an anime-styled 3D third-person shooter that seamlessly blends real-time combat with loot mechanics. It features a diverse weapon system including a wide range of distinctive firearms and melee weapons, with combat enhanced by characters' elemental specialty skills.

details.title: DHALMAN
details.short_description: DHALMAN is a single-player action adventure featuring Metroidvania exploration and fighting gameplay across countries, with curry restaurant management between battles. Join DHALMAN on a flavorful journey to face evolving bosses, discover new worlds, and build the world’s greatest curry restaurant.

details.title: VoxelForge
details.short_description: Build block by block. Furnish down to the smallest detail. VoxelForge is a single-player creative building game combining a cubic world, realistic materials and built-in interactive furniture. Design your home, shape its surroundings and explore your creations in first person.

details.title: Plunderfall
details.short_description: A co-op action-adventure where you sail a flying ship through floating islands and plunder loot for gold to meet the Captain's demands.

details.title: Before the Walls Break
details.short_description: Build your village, fortify your walls, and survive relentless waves of enemies in this strategy tower defense game with resource management and active battlefield abilities.

details.title: Ultra Paddle
details.short_description: A high-speed arcade roguelite where classic physics meet insane abilities. Deflect the ball, survive intense boss fights, and combine 100+ active and passive skills to break the game. Every run makes you stronger. Your goal? Become unstoppable.

details.title: Survindust
details.short_description: Pirates raid your tiny island for its riches. Hold them off, capture them and put them to work in your factory. Grow your land tile by tile, automate production and build a ship to escape with your captured crew.

details.title: Your Forever Friend
details.short_description: Your Forever Friend™ is the solution to never feeling alone again! Play video games, listen to music together, reminisce about buried memories... And there's absolutely nothing wrong with it. NOTHING ! <3

details.title: After Hours: Library
details.short_description: Survive a haunted library's overnight shift by balancing authentic librarian duties with stealth as a relentless supernatural entity hunts you. Uncover hidden secrets, survive until morning, and discover what waits between the shelves.

details.title: Stellar Mole
details.short_description: You will play a role of Agent Vanø—infiltrating an alien colonial corporation. Your mission: gather Earth intelligence for alien while weaponizing every dirty trick to torment your alien colleagues, dismantling their operations from within.

details.title: Liora's Price of Dignity
details.short_description: A fantasy RPG focusing on the concept of negotiating contracts. To save the love of her life from a deadly illness, Liora must ask for the help of Edgar, an ambitious mercenary who wields the power of magical contracts - once agreed upon, the absolute rules of these contracts cannot be disobeyed.

details.title: Quiet Express: Cabin 909
details.short_description: “Do you know anything about Cabin 909?” In Quiet Express: Cabin 909, you spend seven days on the titular train, journeying from one side of the continent to the other.

details.title: Desouled
details.short_description: How many times have you wished you could forget and simply sleep? Desouled forces you to look at what we avoid seeing: stories that are raw, cruel, at times inhuman. But real. In a relentless fight, dodging is your only defense. You can't win, only survive.

details.title: MMORPG NPC Simulator
details.short_description: Play as an NPC in a living MMORPG world. Run your shop, trade with players, give quests, and send raid parties after rare loot. Build your reputation, unlock Game Master abilities, and take control of the server from within.

details.title: BrokenLore: MIKI-CHAN
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a Japanese high school. Meet Miki-chan, your personal virtual assistant, and survive a nightmare where jealousy and obsession distort reality.

details.title: AZUR
details.short_description: AZUR is a fast-paced PvP survival FPS on the French island of Belmas. No crafting, no extraction: drop into persistent servers, complete missions, and secure rare gear via Black Drip drops, with the risk of losing everything.

details.title: Factomancer
details.short_description: The Order sends you on a mission. Armed with technology powered by magic, build production chains, plan, transform, optimize, and prepare for the unexpected. In this automation roguelite, the Eye of the Order watches your moves: failure is only a step toward perfection.

details.title: Burdenfall
details.short_description: Burdenfall is a story-rich roguelike deckbuilder about personal growth and inner struggle. Ascend a mysterious castle with your shapeshifting companion, whose transformations shape and evolve your deck. Survive the climb and uncover the truth behind the Weeping Crown’s message.

details.title: 我的灵气吸不完
details.short_description: "My Qi Is Unlimited"is a yuri-themed suspense puzzle game that combines 3D first-person exploration with 2D visual novel elements. Explore a secluded manor, solve mechanisms, and combine items. Shape relationships through choices, leading to vastly different endings.

name: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon

details.title: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon
details.short_description: You'd think that after 20+ cases, there'd be no crime left in Twin Lakes - but that's not how crime works, rookie. Six new mind-melting mysteries await Detective McQueen and Officer Dooley - just as soon as they get the mustard out of Dooley's gun.

details.title: King's Courier
details.short_description: King’s Courier is a free roam, party-based RPG. Carry out perilous quests for the King while exploring dungeons, enchanted forests, deadly swamps, and monster-filled caves. Build your party, learn magic, battle in real-time or turn-based, solve puzzles, and uncover the kingdom’s secrets.

details.title: THE JOY OF CREATION
details.short_description: The lines between creation and creator blur, in this first-person psychological horror game inspired by Five Nights At Freddy’s.

details.title: Shallow Pond
details.short_description: A cozy 3d platformer full of secrets where you explore vibrant worlds across land and water. Developed by solo developer Nimso.

details.title: PVKK: Planetenverteidigungskanonenkommandant
details.short_description: Operate your planetary defense cannon to fend off an interplanetary invasion from the comfort of your cozy bunker. You’re here to stay, so obey your superiors, press the right buttons, and sip your daily tea ration - it's good for you.

details.title: Blighted
details.short_description: Battle through a psychedelic Western nightmare in this Metroidvania action RPG from the creators of Guacamelee! and Nobody Saves the World.

details.title: Front Edge
details.short_description: The «Front edge» is a real-time multiplayer tactical game dedicated to a clash between the modern armies of the world’s leading countries. Great attention is paid to logistics and control of small groups of troops on various maps.

details.title: Noblemen: 1941
details.short_description: Noblemen: 1941 is a third-person shooter mixed with real time strategic elements. Set in a gritty, alternate reality World War 2, you will deploy units, build fortifications, capture and defend key locations, use powerful abilities, and manage resources across a vast multi-faction campaign.

details.title: Echoes From Below
details.short_description: Echoes From Below is a mystery dungeon tactical RPG. Lead four hunters into the dungeons, where every fortune you bring home comes at a price. Fight side by side as bonds grow into love, rivalry or grief that changes how they fight, and the dead never return. How many will you bring home?

details.title: Age of Transport - Blue Marble
details.short_description: Classification yards, waybills and live dispatch — on a 1:4-scale Earth. Build a multi-modal freight empire across rail, sea and air through twelve eras of transport history, in a persistent world shared by up to 255 companies.

details.title: Garden of Ants
details.short_description: Become the architect of a thriving ant colony in this real-time simulation. Establish and evolve your ant colony, grow specialized worker castes, cultivate fungus, and explore a living world above and below ground where day and night bring shifting challenges and resources.

details.title: Backrooms
details.short_description: Explore an abandoned liminal space. Uncover dark secrets through eerie exploration and environmental storytelling. Evade unpredictable supernatural entities and face psychological horror. Will you reveal the truth or become another lost soul?

details.title: MetalMercs
details.short_description: Destroy. Salvage. Upgrade. PROFIT! Command your own mercenary company in real-time-with-pause tactical mech combat. Hire pilots, customize your mechs, and take contracts across a war-torn universe filled with riches, glory, and bitter defeat.

details.title: Mutant Hunter
details.short_description: As the numbers of combat ready soldiers in the ranks of the remaining army continue to dwindle, High command devised a plan to use convicts as manpower via mind control. Now your task is to hunt mutants around the sector using this experimental technology.

details.title: Sea Sniffers
details.short_description: Dive! Punch! Catch! Sea Sniffers is a unique take on collecting fish where you play as a seal that throws a mean punch! Upgrade your gear, ship and companions to become the best Sea Sniffer!

details.title: Tailgate
details.short_description: Hyde, an aging labrador retriever, wakes up and realizes that Derek, his beloved Human has disappeared. The doggo reluctantly leaves the house to investigate, only to find himself in the middle of an ancient dog prophecy.

details.title: CLUTCH
details.short_description: CLUTCH is a cinematic open-world action-driving game where the worlds of professional and underground street racing collide across the French Riviera.

details.title: Rooted
details.short_description: In this solo and multiplayer survival game, explore an ancient overgrown world full of dangers. Salvage, build, craft, hunt,.. and try to survive alone or with your friends in an evolving and fascinating post-apocalyptic environment. Powered by Unreal Engine 5.

details.title: Luminous Nights
details.short_description: Embark on a HeartsLike action-RPG inspired by 1001 Arabian Nights. Master fast-paced melee combat and powerful magic, unlock new abilities and weapons, explore the mystical city of Noor through 3D platforming, and rally memorable allies against the Masked King.

details.title: The Lost Wild
details.short_description: True fear is primal. Embark on an evasion-based survival horror experience against nature’s ultimate hunters — dinosaurs. Explore overgrown research facilities nestled in a lush wilderness. Be resourceful as you evade, distract, survive, and unravel the mystery at the heart of the island.

details.title: Long Gone
details.short_description: Explore an abandoned suburban neighborhood decades after the outbreak. Solve environmental puzzles with your cat companion and uncover the secret lives of the people long gone through the belongings they left behind in this atmospheric 3D pixel narrative adventure. Oh, and watch out for the zombies.

details.title: Into The Unwell
details.short_description: Whack-and-slash your inner demons in this third-person roguelite, set in a rubber hose fuelled fever dream! Play 1-3 players as one of several flawed and heavily medicated misfits.
developers: She Was Such A Good Horse

details.title: Port Control
details.short_description: Build the port, on the water and on land. Run its traffic, from the open sea to the warehouse gate. Ships can't stop and the port never sleeps. You are Port Control. Automation management game from the author of Rail Route.

details.title: Bloody Hell Hotel
details.short_description: Renovate, upgrade and expand your hotel! Oh, by the way, you're a vampire, so hospitality isn't your strong suit.

details.title: Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino
details.short_description: "Where will their light lead them?" Kitsune is a fox girl who finds herself on Adashino Island and starts travelling with her Frog friend. Neon signs give light and color to the island with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere. Something is lurking in the shadows, inching ever closer...

details.title: My Time at Evershine
details.short_description: Be the Governor of a brand-new settlement on the fringes of the Free Cities, facing the almighty Duvos Empire. Recruit settlers, build infrastructure, tame the wilds, and lead your people to become a new cornerstone for the Alliance in this adventure-packed simulation RPG!

details.title: SACRATA
details.short_description: SACRATA is a Diablo-like roguelite looter with horde-survival combat. Fight through relentless hordes, create skill builds, unlock a roster of heroes, challenge formidable bosses, and claim ancient Relics. Experience the thrill of intense combat and ultimate destruction!

details.title: Golf With Your Friends 2
details.short_description: Golf With Your Friends is back, and this time it means fore. Up to 12 players, Chaos Mode, a new level editor, and enough questionable shots to end any friendship.

details.title: KINGDOM HEARTS IV
details.short_description: Our hero Sora awakes in the unfamiliar world of Quadratum. As he looks for a way to return to his world, his friends Donald and Goofy head for the Underworld to try to find him. Wield the Keyblade in fast-paced battles that match to your own play style.

details.title: 2 FAST 4 YOU
details.short_description: Race through challenging levels and annihilate killer bots. Master your movement to create your own fastest paths to the finish line. Use unique abilities to speedrun your way to the top of the leaderboards. Catch and banish the evil folder - your cat’s life depends on it!

details.title: Storm Settlers
details.short_description: A survival citybuilder set in a desert afflicted by relentless sandstorms. Build, farm, research, clear sand and protect your people from the storms. Will you find water or desolation? Will your settlement thrive or be buried in sand?

details.title: The Subminer: Deep Sea Mining
details.short_description: An atmospheric underwater drilling roguelite beneath the icy crust of Enceladus. Pilot your submarine, explore the depths, mine resources through procedural caves and upgrade your base. Each dive is darker and more dangerous, and you must face the terrors lurking in the shadows. Live. Dive. Repeat.

details.title: 异世轮回录：If
details.short_description: 诸君！这个世界很无趣。生为牛马，我只是一个行走的NPC。谁不想当主角？ 在地球OL已经不可能办到了。但至少在异世轮回录中，我们可以！《异世轮回录：If》是一款多结局多周目轮回式人生模拟团队卡牌肉鸽游戏。你被女神召唤来到剑与魔法的异世界，新的人生你要选择怎么样的天赋？本以为是一次王道转生，但没想到这个世界危机重重，选错一步就只能迎接死亡。无数次轮回，你一点点探寻这个世界的隐秘，在最后的世界线，或许就是所有人都能幸福的Happy End?

details.title: MAW
details.short_description: What's it like to be queer in a totalitarian regime? Explore your identity as a wolf detective working for the state. Sniff for clues. Interrogate or date other characters. Make lasting choices. Will you fight your instincts or embrace who you really are and face the consequences?

name: The War of the Worlds: Siberia

details.title: The War of the Worlds: Siberia
details.short_description: The War of the Worlds: Siberia tells a story of one young Student, running from law and martian invaders whose Incursion into Europe in 1896 threatens the entire civilisation and all that makes us human.

details.title: Precinct IX
details.short_description: Precinct IX is a cyberpunk police management and turn-based combat game. Receive visitors, manage cases and resources, dispatch unique officers to unstable scenes, and change case outcomes—and your relationships—through dialogue, command, and battle.

details.title: Worms: Galactic Tactics
details.short_description: Worms makes an explosive leap into tactical roguelike combat! Battle across destructible arenas, mod classic weapons and unleash devastating strategic combos as you fight for survival, riches and glory!

details.title: Hello World
details.short_description: A colony sim with turn-based tactical combat, set in a lush, living apocalypse. Build a community of humans and robots while a bioengineered jungle devours the world around you and rogue machines fight you for what's left.

name: 嘆きの七英雄 /Seven Heroes of Sorrow

details.title: 嘆きの七英雄 /Seven Heroes of Sorrow
details.short_description: Seven heroes bound by a destiny of ruin weave a moving tale. Winner of the Freegame Mugen Grand Prize, featuring a fully-voiced main story with 120+ voice actors—an epic JRPG is born! A must-play for all RPG fans!

details.title: Starhood
details.short_description: The space station is waiting for you, Captain. Turn by turn, build modules, gather resources, and expand your station to ensure survival and prosperity in the depths of space.

details.title: The Whispering Bones
details.short_description: The Whispering Bones is a roguelike psychological horror where you gamble with a mysterious stranger in the depths of a nebulous wood. Roll dice with full physics simulation, unravel the hermit's secrets, make bets and win a chance for a better life.

details.title: Orbit Run
details.short_description: Orbit Run is an arcade sci-fi game with roguelike elements, in which orbiting asteroids are your only weapons. Catch asteroids and combine them to unlock their run-altering abilities. Skillfully manoeuvre to dodge attacks and land massive asteroid strikes to defeat the ever-increasing waves of foes.

details.title: Third Wind
details.short_description: In this turn-based roguelite where magic is commonplace, YOU get to be the lucky coach of a brand-new team of Magefencers! Your story choices will determine what your captain of choice evolves into—so choose wisely. Draft teammates, help them grow, watch them bond, and try to become Champions!

details.title: AINUR
details.short_description: AINUR is an open-world survival and building game set in a fictional fantasy wasteland. Centered on the core themes of "survival and reconstruction," it utilizes an in-game "deep construction system" to alter the state of the game world, unlock storylines, and combat natural calamities.

details.title: Night Fantasy 夜色幻想
details.short_description: Night Fantasy is a turn-based strategy RPG about building a team of three adventurers. Enter the Demon Tower, shape your party with classes, skills, talents, and relics, and forge your own strategy through randomized runs to defeat the Demon King and restore the light.

details.title: Red Moon Cafe
details.short_description: Red Moon Cafe is a story-driven barista sim set in a rough Russian neighborhood. Survive on your paycheck, manage the protagonist's well-being, and save for the essentials. The authentic city and lifelike NPCs are so detailed that the atmosphere and daily grind feel almost like real life.

details.title: Filled Up
details.short_description: Filled Up is a first-person survival horror/comedy hybrid featuring LGBT characters and themes. After a horrific accident, you awaken in the town of Hunksville, alone. An ancient and corrupt evil has taken over the town - can you save not only your friends, but the town of Hunksville itself?

details.title: Havenreach: Last Refuge
details.short_description: Fight for your people’s survival in this turn-based strategy game as you compete against other refugees for land. Expand tile by tile, defend your borders, and sustain your people through gathering or force. A streamlined 4X experience designed to finish in one sitting.

details.title: Rust Born
details.short_description: Rust Born is a neo noir top-down shooter about survival, loss of self, and a city devoured by corporations. You are Detective Gabriel, trapped in a twisted dystopian city where every shot could be your last, and every decision changes the world. Atmosphere, plot, survival.

details.title: Mayfly
details.short_description: Mayfly is a first-person psychological horror game set aboard a narrowboat in Northern England. You wake alone to find your husband is missing as you weave through a shifting, unstable reality. Search your confined surroundings to unravel the mystery in this focused narrative horror game.

details.title: CrossSwords: FPS Crosswords
details.short_description: Solve the crossword and start shooting! Race your opponents to solve clues, earn ammo and power-ups, and then fight in an arena built from the crossword grid itself. Battle friends and players online!

details.title: VPetlings
details.short_description: Raise your own virtual pet right on your desktop. Choose your favorite, take care of your companion, play together, train for battle, and help them evolve! They will always be there, keeping you company while you work, play, or browse.

details.title: Zantar & Other Stories
details.short_description: Acclaimed artist and solo developer Mitchell F. Chan tells six funny, gripping, and heart-breaking stories about a fictional video game, the ambitious CEO driven to make it the most valuable platform in the world, and the would-be millionaires who are pulled into its orbit.

details.title: BoB - Battle of Bots
details.short_description: Welcome to BOB, a heavy metal bullet-heaven roguelike Mecha game where your skills are the only thing standing between humanity and endless waves of berserk bots! Survive as long as possible while obliterating waves of enemies, terrifying bosses and the megalomanical AI DAVE!

details.title: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure
details.short_description: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure is a charming 3D platformer collectathon full of adventure - and a hint of nostalgia! Play as Ponchyo the platypus and journey through a variety of vibrant worlds. Collect coins and discover new furniture to decorate your home.

details.title: Evelume
details.short_description: An atmospheric 2D adventure about a schoolkid in a small town where adults are stuck in a gray, monotonous life. Explore, fight, solve puzzles, and try to uncover the something that has drained people of joy.

details.title: Meowniverse
details.short_description: Merge endless cats on your desktop! Every cat you adopt becomes a unique part in your Collection. Evolve your cats, complete the Collection, and enjoy their company. They’ll embark on adventures, bringing you coins and fish! Get ready to huff cats and let their sweet meows lift your spirits!

details.title: Runic Prophecy
details.short_description: Runic Prophecy is a challenging third-person soulslike action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Explore Eyjusheim, unleash magic and a dragon in combat, battle supernatural creatures, and uncover the hidden lore of a shattered world.

details.title: The Exalted Descendant
details.short_description: Rebuild a fallen species in this dark sci-fi 4X strategy game. Extract and refine real elements, command drone swarms, and make tough choices as you guide The Exalted Descendant toward resurgence—or extinction—in a procedurally generated galaxy. No diplomacy. No mercy.

details.title: Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander
details.short_description: Set out on a grand adventure of exploration, strategy, and mystery in Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander. Immerse yourself in a handmade world as you craft armies to outwit your opponents in fully simulated autobattler combat.

details.title: Fishing Girl's Fantasy
details.short_description: In an enchanting and mystical world, a healing and delightful adventure awaits! Welcome to Fishing Girl's Fantasy, a casual game that seamlessly combines exploration, fishing, and restaurant management. Immerse yourself in this fantastical experience filled with wonder and charm.

details.title: Suspect None
details.short_description: Suspect None is a top-down open-world game where you explore the city by day and plan and pull off heists at night. Follow the story and take part in activities around the city.

details.title: EURGAVA™ - Pathforgers
details.short_description: Here's a challenge: In this simple, 2D-isometric hack'n'slash boss rush game, the Pilgrims need you to win against the Naga Cult in 100 weeks!

details.title: SlopTuber Simulator
details.short_description: SlopTuber Simulator is a short incremental adventure about filling the internet with worthless video content for fun and profit (Mostly for profit)!

details.title: Whispers of Elenrod
details.short_description: Deck-building meets strategy map exploration. Craft powerful decks. Discover mysterious artifacts on procedurally generated maps. Defeat enemies in turn-based combat and gain experience to evolve your hero. Create your best build…and find all the Whispers of Elenrod!

details.title: Gold Rush
details.short_description: Stake your claim on the frontier in this fast-paced Wild West RTS.

details.title: Atomic Age
details.short_description: Criminal case in the cabaret stage Atomic Age, a comedic, retro-futuristic 2D point & click adventure in the shape of the 50th and 60th years
developers: Matthias Huber, Jill Peeters, Chris Kohler

details.title: Doctor Dreams Simulator
details.short_description: A Simulator/Adventure game where you attend, craft, manage, and enter the nightmares of your patients. Each dream changes the rules and combines exploration, combat, and stealth.

details.title: Corban's Station
details.short_description: In this first-person puzzle exploration game, walk the liminal spaces of a long-abandoned service station. Reprogram aging computers, physically reroute damaged and fading connections and restore fragments of their waning memory.

details.title: MonstrousPark+
details.short_description: A workplace ensemble visual novel about sixteen cast members — monsters — working at a small amusement park that opens only at night.

details.title: Barge
details.short_description: Grow crops, raise animals, and harvest resources that you can sell in towns you pass as you and your barge float down an endless river in this top down, pixel art, farming sim.

details.title: Beerhouse Simulator
details.short_description: Brew beer your own way! First-person homebrewing simulator where every batch can go brilliantly wrong or surprisingly right — and clients might just notice the difference, or not. Brew, experiment or cause total beery mayhem.

details.title: Broom Broom
details.short_description: Grab your broom, fly over to people in need and brew them potions after a catastrophic snowstorm has hit your village! Talk to your lovely (but mostly grumpy) neighbours as you find your place in this short and cozy adventure.

details.title: Wall Street 1929
details.short_description: Wall Street 1929 is a business sim set in the Great Depression. Start before the crash and live through collapse and recovery. Found companies, acquire shares, buy real estate, run charities, and bid on collectibles to build your empire.

details.title: COCOBOY
details.short_description: Rediscover the lost ‘80s platformer COCOBOY in an alternate 2005! Hack a forgotten game with bizarre mods, decorate your bedroom with rare collectibles, and scour the forums of a budding fandom for clues to deeply puzzling secrets. Demo Disc is available now!

details.title: Omega Redux
details.short_description: An episodic sci-fi adventure where you explore doomed open worlds one hour before their destruction. As a relic hunter and his playable robot companion, search for strangely meaningful artifacts while cinematic catastrophe approaches with every passing second. Get out in time—or meet the end!

details.title: Reveniev: A Day in Nassiriyah
details.short_description: Get your revenge in REVENIEV!

details.title: Jet Birds
details.short_description: A challenging, physics-based, 3D platformer where you fly jetpack-powered birds through ring circuits suspended through nature. Not a casual flying game or a flight simulator, but a precision platformer that demands (and rewards) determination and practice.

details.title: Lecture Me Later
details.short_description: Just having a pleasant chat with one of the most popular guys in the University. Nothing weird about that, right? So why is he kinda... different than you've imagined?

details.title: The Labyrinth
details.short_description: Your brother entered the Labyrinth searching for a legendary weapon. He never returned. Follow his trail through a dark fantasy dungeon crawler filled with deadly creatures, ancient puzzles, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Nine lives. No map. No guarantee you'll make it out.

details.title: Scarlet Hunt
details.short_description: Dive into a world of fleeting hope in this thrilling dark romance visual novel! Feel the fear, survive the hunt and navigate through danger on a daunting quest for freedom.

details.title: Ecosystem Architect
details.short_description: What happens when an elephant shares its habitat with a Spinosaurus? Design ecosystems with nearly 50 species of plants and animals, shape the land, and balance predators and prey in a science-inspired simulation where every creature lives, hunts, and raises a family of its own.

details.title: Aspiel: Edge Of Chaos
details.short_description: Aspiel: Edge of Chaos is a third-person fantasy Action-RPG. Explore numerous locations ravaged by the dark power of Death, face various creatures consumed by Chaos, and harness the power of Life to save the continent of Aspiel.

details.title: Imperial Bureaucracy Hero
details.short_description: IBH is a rich role playing game at the end of time. You're a mid-level official in a dying sci-fi regime, given the impossible task of fixing a faltering machine; explore a vast world, define your mind, flex your authority, and become a sinner or a savior in countless other stories.

details.title: Salary-Mon | Hiro Versus His Demons
details.short_description: Help Japanese Salaryman Hiro overcome his inner demons by facing his fears head on, battling his worst traits, and becoming more powerful with each victory to ultimately take down his oppressive boss in this Poke-like JRPG adventure.

details.title: Surface Labyrinth KURUMABU
details.short_description: Neo-2D Action Puzzle Game !

details.title: Twinspell
details.short_description: Twinspell is a cooperative roguelike where two players explore procedural dungeons and face enemies in fast-paced, frenetic combat.

details.title: Sato
details.short_description: Manipulate space and time in this planetary puzzle-platformer. Learn the rules to unravel more of the world and the secrets within. Do you remember? 183 15.

details.title: Bulbo's Belief System
details.short_description: Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told, letting him see, move, and interact, but he can forget! Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity and manage conflicting beliefs to solve cute mind-bending challenges.

details.title: Heretic Red
details.short_description: In this story-rich detective game, uncover clues through a card-like system to solve a series of bizarre murders. Combine pieces of evidence to build your case against the most likely culprit from within an eclectic cast of unusual characters.

details.title: Fate's Masquerade: Otome Visual Novel
details.short_description: In this animated, manhwa-inspired otome, romance the princes you were meant to hate. First, earn their affection and try not to die. Then save the empire, or burn it to the ground. Fairytale romance or villainess revenge? You decide.

details.title: Yuki-Tundra
details.short_description: Build your store empire, help the local community and keep the shelves stocked in a bid to boost your stores reputation while you rise from the ashes. Yuki-Tundra blends the casual store management genre with classic RPG adventures.

details.title: Goblin God
details.short_description: Become the god of a chaotic goblin tribe. Raise a golem that learns from you, guide your followers as they build their village, and reach into the world with your divine hand. Protect what you have built, unleash miracles, and discover what kind of god you will become.

details.title: Stellar Raven
details.short_description: On a flying laser tank, fight the armed forces of the Empire and, after overcoming several planets, meet the Empress and fight her in a mortal battle.

details.title: MARINES VS GOD
details.short_description: One of you is God. Up to four friends are Marines on a mission. Finish the objective before time runs out while your friend summons monsters, drops meteors, and ruins your plans. Can the Marines outsmart God?

details.title: Escape Velocity
details.short_description: An explosive first-person puzzler!

details.title: Crow Boss
details.short_description: Feared for countless acts of brutality, the former warrior known only as Boss returns from the depths of Limbo. Betrayed by those he once served, he now walks among the living once more, driven by a single purpose: to take revenge on those responsible for his downfall.

details.title: Morphing
details.short_description: Morphing is a 2D adventure puzzle game where you possess the ability of morphing. This power allows you to transform and acquire the traits of certain objects or creatures. Use this unique skill to overcome challenges and explore the world.

details.title: Embers Of Spiritflame
details.short_description: Embers of Spiritflame is an Emotional Point & Click detective adventure about the exploration of an old abandoned house. Inside, you go through comic book-inspired levels and begin to uncover why everyone is missing. View events and memories of the place and piece the story together.

details.title: Scourge of the Reptiles
details.short_description: Command dinosaurs. Master tactical combat. Shape your fate. Scourge of the Reptiles is a party-based tactical RPG set in a prehistoric low-fantasy world, where a devastating meteor grants magical powers to humans, elves… and dinosaurs. The result? War. Chaos. And something far worse.

details.title: Wretch
details.short_description: Find the violent stalker hiding inside an abandoned school. Piece together broken lore and solve a long lost mystery. What happened here and who's to blame?

details.title: Project JS
details.short_description: You are the one chosen by Nezha. This time, you will carry out justice on behalf of Heaven. The player takes on the role of the next Jishen, successor to the novel’s protagonist Jay, becoming the chosen one of Nezha and using pog card to battle demons and spirits.

details.title: Dungeon Ward
details.short_description: Dungeon Ward revives old‑school grid‑based dungeon crawlers and focuses on fast‑paced combat with flexible character progression. Level up, master powerful skills, and defeat challenging bosses in this action‑packed RPG.

details.title: Rise of Lambs : Awakening
details.short_description: 《Rise of the Lambs: Awakening》 is a 3D Roguelike where you play as a young lamb. After a brutal coyote pack invades your peaceful sheep tribe, you must protect your home, uncover the truth, and awaken your powers to stop the war and save the world from apocalypse.

details.title: Rogue Battalion
details.short_description: Command your troops in Rogue Battalion, a WW2 auto-battler blending strategy and action! Build your forces, unlock upgrades, and use powerful abilities like airstrikes and artillery to survive relentless waves. With meta progression and endless tactics, every run brings new challenges.

details.title: Blitloop
details.short_description: A fast-paced, side-scrolling retro shooter where you play as “Blit" on a mission to rescue orb pods. Blast enemy swarms and face off against bosses in this bullet-hell shoot 'em up. Earn power-ups and get ready for fluid arcade action in a stylish world with an 80s synthwave soundtrack.

details.title: Take Me to the Ending!
details.short_description: Huh... umm...? Meet Yuu, our hero who just can't jump high enough to escape their tiny little world. But wait—here comes YOU, the super hacker extraordinaire! 💻✨ Hack Yuu's parameters, tweak the world itself, and guide them all the way to their happy ending! Let’s get hacking!

details.title: CE-III Protocol: Last Drop
details.short_description: Dozing off in class won't kill you… unless you wake up in a strange, creepy place surrounded by monsters. On the bright side, you're not alone, nor completely defenseless. But to escape this nightmare, you'll have to do more than just survive…

details.title: Mei tales
details.short_description: "Mei tales" is a narrative card game set in a Chinese fantasy world. In the game, you can choose one of several protagonists to seek out companions, make decisions, and accept the twists of fate, embarking on a legendary journey uniquely your own.

details.title: Quiz Hero Chinese Numbers
details.short_description: A cozy educational RPG where every action is powered by quizzes. Learn Chinese numbers as you explore, solve puzzles, battle corrupted creatures, and help purify the four Elemental Crystals - Earth, Water, Air, and Fire.

details.title: The Grand Praetor
details.short_description: As the seventh heir to the Empress, you have been appointed Grand Praetor to investigate a string of serial murders.Will you seek the truth and expose the conspiracy—or indulge in pleasure and power, doing as you please?

details.title: Tabletop Inc.
details.short_description: Start a tabletop game company in your bedroom workshop! Develop unique genres and themes, assemble the game boxes yourself, pay your bills, hire your friends, upgrade your workshop, and design even better games in this cozy management tycoon.

details.title: AKIBA LOVE
details.short_description: AKIBA LOVE is a dating simulation game, in other words, a G·A·L·G·A·M·E! During your half-year exchange at Japan's Inada University, as a hardcore otaku, you will meet, get to know, and fall in love with five heroines, experiencing a romantic comedy of your own!

details.title: Midnight Therapy
details.short_description: A fake therapist loses her magic and must face real patients with nothing but words. Manage appointments, money, and emotional collapse in a narrative RPG about lies, deduction, and cognitive dissonance. Are lies your weapon... or your redemption?

details.title: Cozy Rabbit Hole
details.short_description: Cozy Rabbit Hole is a 2D survival horror game. Explore the deep rabbit holes, fight or dodge monsters, gather resources, craft weapons and power-ups. Balance curiosity with caution, and find enough supplies to survive the harsh winter.

details.title: Cozy Forest
details.short_description: Restore a sleepy forest with adorable animals. Explore, craft, and decorate a cottage-core haven at your own rhythm—no timers, no hassle. Progress continues while you’re away!

details.title: My Dear Farm
details.short_description: Grow, decorate, and unwind in My Dear Farm for PC—a cozy farming sim with HD visuals, improved controls, exclusive PC events, and Steam Cloud. Build the farm of your dreams and show off your style!

details.title: New Rule
details.short_description: Président, the card game everyone knows, with a twist: after every game, the table votes a new rule. Bluff on your tax cards, snitch on a rival, gamble your jokers on a slot machine… The rules pile up game after game, and no two tables ever play the same game.

details.title: Fractured Library
details.short_description: An enchanted library - once bustling with life - now swirls with dangerous magic that is weakening barriers between worlds, causing some strange things to happen. Travel to the worlds within the pages to help the eccentric yet lovable librarian restore the library to its former glory.

details.title: Against All Skies
details.short_description: Uncover the true cost of power in this party-based RPG deckbuilder with roguelite storytelling. Navigate treacherous sky islands, build unique decks for a crew of unlikely heroes and breach the storm to deliver revolution to the skies.

details.title: Wander in Wonder
details.short_description: Help a little lost rabbit find its way home. Step into a short point-and-click adventure through a warm, hand-drawn world of flowers and plants.

details.title: Shrine Labyrinth
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op Japanese horror game. Beyond the torii gate lies an otherworldly labyrinth whose layout changes randomly. Work together to escape as you run from, hide from, and sometimes confront terrifying supernatural entities!

details.title: CitySpotter
details.short_description: Spot unique buildings hidden across large procedurally generated cities. Every map is different, with dynamic weather, animated streets, and relaxing sounds. Play at your own pace or challenge yourself to find every target faster each time.

details.title: Kankao in Action
details.short_description: Kankao in Action is a 2-player co-op adventure with local and online co-op, or solo, where teamwork, coordination, and chaotic fun are the only way forward.

name: ひとりだるま | HITORI DARUMA Alone Rite

details.title: ひとりだるま | HITORI DARUMA Alone Rite
details.short_description: A protagonist attempts to play "Daruma-san ga Koronda" (Red Light, Green Light) entirely alone. Driven by a ritual found online, they gather the necessary items and begin the ceremony. However, eerie phenomena begin to occur one after another.

details.title: Data Trader
details.short_description: Data Trader is a cyberpunk strategy game where information has become the world's most valuable resource. Buy archives, trade classified data, command agents, and uncover the truth about who you really were.

details.title: Yominosono
details.short_description: A first-person horror exploration where Japanese mythology meets thalassophobia. With no power to resist, observe and evade as you wander the otherworld of Yomi. Flee, or bear your karma and seek atonement—your choices shape the ending. Yomi sees all that you are.

details.title: NAIRI: Blinding Light
details.short_description: A hand-drawn adventure blending visual novel storytelling with point-and-click puzzles. Explore the lush Penguin Lagoon and descend into the ruins of ancient civilizations. Beneath the city’s foundations, a colossal beast stirs…

details.title: By the Dead
details.short_description: Explore the dark, fight the un-dead forces, gather valuable resources, craft for survival, build safe shelters, and survive the night in this eerie open world survival crafting game!

name: Three Axes Bar: Paid or Pain

details.title: Three Axes Bar: Paid or Pain
details.short_description: Three Axes Bar: Paid or Pain is a rogue-lite with elements of horror, at the center of which stands the story of a broken man. Modify your body, explore the bar, and break the rules! Your main task is to survive and remain human, whatever that may mean…

details.title: Sovereign's Enigma
details.short_description: Explore a vast underground world in a 2D side-scrolling survival adventure. Find survivors, build a team, and battle powerful bosses in the ruins of a forgotten civilization. Uncover the truth behind the Sovereign's Enigma.

details.title: Keepers of Umbrasil
details.short_description: A cozy sanctuary-building narrative adventure about befriending ancient spirits in a magical forest. Piece together clues to uncover their stories and memories. Rebuilding the sanctuary will take more than new buildings. You must rekindle hope. May the forest find all who are wild-called.

details.title: DeadStuck
details.short_description: Take on the role of a sinner fighting for absolution against hordes of the damned. Inspired by arcade light gun shooters and boomer shooters, use your quick reflexes tools of divine condemnation to come out victorious!

details.title: Risk & Responsibility
details.short_description: A corporate crisis management simulation where every decision has a cost, every audit has a deadline, and one wrong call can cost careers, compliance, and lives.

details.title: Near Nobit
details.short_description: Collision-triggered Card Combos. Near Nobit is a deckbuilding roguelike centered around an auto-activating card system. Perfect your deck’s sequence to trigger near-infinite combos, then witness the chaotic and unpredictable dance of nobits.

details.title: Cloud Infusion
details.short_description: Cloud Infusion is a casual social multiplayer game centered on free, rule-free play. With warm minimalist hand-drawn art and a unique “IV drip” recovery mechanic, it delivers a lighthearted, fun multiplayer experience that embodies gentle courage toward life, companionship, and overcoming hardship.

details.title: Out of Sync
details.short_description: Out of Sync is a classic survival horror game, inspired by the great horror hits but reimagined with a visual style inspired by the sci-fi comics of the 1960s. Guide Sara through this futuristic dystopian world on her mission to save her crew and discover the hidden truth.

details.title: StreamNet Alliance
details.short_description: A cyberpunk visual novel about chasing fame and losing yourself. 30 days. 100,000 followers. Daily choices that shape who Hoshino becomes — and what she's willing to sacrifice to get there.

details.title: Called Shot
details.short_description: Called Shot is a low-poly western battle royale inspired by Bang!. Cards pick your move, but you pull the trigger. Farm a deck, survive the plaza, duel atop a runaway train. Play dead, pass the dynamite, load silver bullets. No honest gunslingers here. Real aim meets hand-reading. Up to 8 online.

details.title: Stink Buddies
details.short_description: 4 dung beetles and one massive dung ball in this Physics based 4 player coop. Squad up and bring your turd home, get past predators and obstacles, because real buddies go through life together and just roll with it.

details.title: Deadtective Academy
details.short_description: At Mystery Academy, training detectives is routine. Dealing with a vampire? Not so much. As mysterious deaths begin to surface, questions begin to arise: is it all just pure coincidence? And who can you trust when danger might be right beside you?

details.title: The Great Beyond
details.short_description: Defeat the onslaught of aliens by building your own moon base, placing & upgrading tower defences, managing units, and mining resources!

details.title: Ivy‘s Dream Cafe
details.short_description: Run a magical cafe by day and step into surreal dreams by night. Use plant magic to uncover hidden clues, understand the emotions behind each story, and uncover the forgotten past behind Ivy’s own dreams.

details.title: Cards after Midnight
