details.short_description: A dark, turn-based card roguelike where every action brings you closer to midnight. Survive with weapons by day and become a powerful werewolf by night. But beware: the beast's strength may cost you your humanity.

details.title: CENSOR
details.short_description: You can make someone tell the truth. But first, you need to know who to ask. CENSOR is a sci-fi detective game. Question the people involved, uncover contradictions and piece together the case on your evidence board. Then decide the fate of the accused.

details.title: Boom Boom No Guess Minesweeper
details.short_description: A No Guess Minesweeper RPG. Hundreds of levels, items, and Rogue skills. No more blind guessing -- pure logical deduction!

details.title: Force Typhoon
details.short_description: Experience the chaos and intensity of high-speed combat in this atmospheric sci-fi vertical Shoot ’Em Up, rendered in full 3D. Blast your way through relentless waves of enemies as you unleash your arsenal to defend your home against overwhelming odds!

details.title: Hex Machina
details.short_description: Assemble and control ancient machines on the island of Hexagonia. In this roguelite autobattler game, you’ll need to find the perfect synergies and tactically outsmart your enemies to ensure your survival.

details.title: KEROGEN
details.short_description: Dredge up corpses from an oil-drenched nightmare. Lost at sea, the small crew of the 𝐀𝐓𝐋𝐀𝐒 calls for aid. Elmsfire dances in the clouds above while black beasts stir in the waves beneath. Take your meds. Hold your breath. The black sea won't let go.

details.title: Lumenal: A Photo Break
details.short_description: After a stressful day, grab your camera and hit the road. In Lumenal, you photograph animals and lovely moments, from forests full of birdsong to glaciers under the northern lights. Go solo or bring three friends, and fill your board with your best shots.

details.title: Godlings Unleashed
details.short_description: Godlings Unleashed is an action roguelike.Encounter all kinds of bizarre characters, defeat or recruit them, upgrade your powers, and mix and match gear and treasures to create unique builds. Fight your way through a chaotic world full of surprises, absurdity, and laughs, and make it to the end!

details.title: MYTRA: No Escape Protocol
details.short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op psychological horror where a rogue AI manipulates perception, alters information between players, and turns trust into a weapon.

details.title: Every Wednesday
details.short_description: A laundromat. Every Wednesday. And stories that stay. Join Hideki in a small laundromat in the heart of a restless metropolis, where smartphones are not allowed and strangers slowly become part of each other’s lives.

details.title: Kingdom Heroes
details.short_description: Kingdom Heroes is a fantasy medieval survivor-like blending action, exploration, kingdom management, and local co-op for up to 4 players. Battle massive hordes, vote on the group's fate, build your kingdom, and dominate other players through asynchronous multiplayer.

details.title: Let There Be Istanbul
details.short_description: A hand-drawn slapstick beat-’em-up following a father-daughter duo on a wild journey toward Istanbul, with snappy tag-team combat and plenty of cats to pet... but why is Mehmet taking Ebru to Istanbul, and what awaits them there?

details.title: Dragon Tribe Chronicles
details.short_description: An epic strategy deck builder RPG where You play as one of the last True Dragons. A shapeshifting being capable of harnessing the power of slayed beings.

details.title: The Caretakers
details.short_description: Infiltrate contaminated residences and deal with their mutant pests using the most advanced tech of the 1960s. Set up a base and observe, probe, and most importantly, survive the grotesque creatures in this online co-op horror game.

details.title: Lumenweld
details.short_description: Lumenweld is an open-world survival crafting RPG set in a luminous neon-fantasy wilderness. Build a home, gather resources, craft gear, complete quests, and hunt deadly creatures. Every pursuit builds its own skill, letting you forge a character shaped by how you play.

details.title: Cendres
details.short_description: Cendres is an isometric 3D action roguelike. Explore seven floors of procedural dungeons, dodge their guardians’ attacks, and shape your build through loot, forging and skill trees. Every descent is a new attempt.

details.title: Ocularis
details.short_description: An ancient intelligence has forgotten how to learn, so it built a place to watch you do it. Explore its abstract chambers in a first-person puzzle game with no words to guide you: experiment, observe, and master its rules. The more you understand, the more it begins to understand again.

details.title: The Kingdoms of Ædloran
details.short_description: The Kingdoms of Ædloran is a 2D top-down pixel RPG. Explore a living open world, encounter strange and fantastic creatures, level up and learn new abilities, battle savage beasts and monstrous foes, delve deep into perilous dungeons, and claim legendary loot.

details.title: Carbon Compliance
details.short_description: A simulation game about experiencing the very mundane job of a government official, rummaging through paperwork. Make sure all the paperwork is free of any errors. Deny applications that are not up to the specified requirements. Bored of working, play mini-games to relieve stress.

details.title: Claw & Order
details.short_description: Claw & Order is a roguelike autobattler where you recruit, arrange, and level up adorable cats whose abilities trigger off one another. Build game-breaking combos, deal millions of damage, and defeat larger-than-life bosses on your way to the grand finale!

details.title: Knight George
details.short_description: Knight George is a top-down retro-style action-adventure game. Travel across the Kingdom of Earlyne to meet friendly characters, explore numerous dungeons and fight terrifying monsters to save the kingdom!

details.title: Stray Night
details.short_description: Experience a puzzle-build roguelite hack-and-slash adventure. As a stray cat in a nightmare, strategically combine puzzle blocks to customize skills and defeat inner trauma. Overcome the walls of loneliness and discover your true identity through fast-paced combat and permanent progression.

details.title: ZeroPrompt
details.short_description: Every NPC in this game runs on a local LLM. Ask them anything. The internet is dying. You're a internet moderator. Filter out AI impostors from humanity's last clean network. Use investigation tools to detect deception. Every verdict shapes the internet.

details.title: TrainSim: Point & Call
details.short_description: Find the sweet spot between speed and precision as you step into the driver’s seat and run trains across cities and vast landscapes. The game focuses on authentic handling and time management, delivering a tight, goal-driven, fully immersive cab experience.

details.title: ROTETRA
details.short_description: ROTETRA is a twisted tetromino stacker where you spin the whole board and juggle multiple pieces at once!

details.title: Taco Stand
details.short_description: A horror game where you manage a taco stand. Make tacos, serve customers, and get through each night.

details.title: Petaltone
details.short_description: Plant, tend to, and grow a musical garden masterpiece! By mixing and mastering different Plants, Mods, and Gardening Tools, you can create a synthesized symphony entirely unique to you!

details.title: A Light Touch
details.short_description: A Light Touch is a puzzle adventure game where you play as a guiding light, protecting a small chick from danger. Together you solve puzzles and explore a mysterious world consumed by darkness. Can you uncover its secrets and restore light to the world?

details.title: Memories Loaming
details.short_description: A horror anthology about people working along a remote highway in Labrador, Canada. Try to remain balanced and lucid at your normal job. Also, there's a bear.

details.title: Inside the Samosbor
details.short_description: A first-person co-op horror game for 1–4 players set in the world of Samosbor. Explore contaminated residential blocks, find a way out, and evade monsters and anomalies. Beware of liquidators who may mistake you for the infected. Get out alive.

details.title: Strife of Stars
details.short_description: Command a rogue fleet in tactical turn-based combat. Outmaneuver, outflank, and outsmart the forces hunting you. Build your fleet, upgrade your ships, and fight your way across the galaxy in this tactical roguelite.

details.title: Sheep Trick
details.short_description: A game about dreams, loops and sheep! Stop the alarm, dodge your clones and count sheep to infinity to achieve great sleep quality.

details.title: Flaghead
details.short_description: Flaghead is an arena shooter roguelite where you play as a country, surviving through history from the dark ages into dystopian futures and beyond.

details.title: Crystalmancers
details.short_description: Crystalmancers is a roguelike, block-smashing puzzle game inspired by the JRPG's of the 90's. Collect items, upgrade your pieces, and use each Crystalmancers unique abilities to vanquish the monsters that await you in an ancient dungeon known as "The Primordial Cauldron".

details.title: Sinful Testament
details.short_description: A dark historical otome visual novel. Houston, Texas, 1925. A heroine from 2025 is reborn as the daughter of a murdered mafia boss and becomes “compensation” for the Devil’s Six gang. Six dangerous men, seven deadly sins, and a choice between Redemption and Fall.

details.title: Quest for Choices: Ivan's Tale
details.short_description: ✦Quest for Choices: Ivan's Tale is a choice-driven visual novel. The story mainly follows a Slavic white mouse named "Ivan Viktorovich Belyaev" and its VR memory recordings in the United States.

details.title: Gravity Cannon
details.short_description: Gravity Cannon is a local multiplayer space combat game for up to 8 players. Grab some friends and hop into fast-paced gravity action!

details.title: Pemkie Island
details.short_description: Pemkie Island is a monster taming RPG adventure, in a roguelite format. Travel across the 5 different regions while discovering and taming unique creatures called Pemkies. Master their traits, choose the right skills and build the best team possible to restore balance!

details.title: Resonant
details.short_description: Transcend bodies, time, and worlds. In this narrative hybrid of Point & Click Adventure and 2D Platformer, you are a formless Traveler. Shift between post-apocalyptic ruins and neon cyberpunk cities. Solve puzzles, master platforming challenges, and unravel the nature of consciousness.

details.title: Clatter Throne
details.short_description: Your dice are alive! Recruit heroes, arm them with spells one side at a time, roll, and fight for the Clatter Throne in this tabletop roguelike autobattler.

details.title: Shortest Trip: Battlematch
details.short_description: A brutal robotic army builder roguelike. Assemble armies of giant warmachines, then clash in massive battles against robots from competing corporations. Upgrade or expand your persistent fleet of warmachines, unleash orbital bombardments & exotic nukes, become the master of robot warfare.

details.title: Dice'n'Go
details.short_description: Dice’n’Go is a chaotic multiplayer board game where luck starts the turn - but players decide how it ends. Sabotage your opponents, pull off clever ability combos, and turn terrible rolls into game-winning plays. Expect backstabs, dramatic comebacks, and last-turn twists.

name: Hollywood Hustle: A Prop Collector Simulator

details.title: Hollywood Hustle: A Prop Collector Simulator
details.short_description: A physics-driven cleanup simulator on an abandoned Hollywood studio. Fantasy epics, sitcoms, sci-fi blockbusters: their props ended up here. Sort it all, ship boxed orders to film sets and beyond, sell the rest, and resurrect the old animatronics to help.

details.title: Dark Watching Chapter 2
details.short_description: After crossing the bunker, you reach the shopping mall, but you quickly realize that there is even more of the virus there…

details.title: Godless Dawn
details.short_description: Godless Dawn is a ruthless action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Descend into cursed dungeons, uncover the stories behind fallen souls, and reveal the truth hidden behind the silence of the gods.

details.title: Spray Days
details.short_description: Paint, restore, and customize worn-out objects in this satisfying spray painting simulator. Complete quirky commissions, upgrade your tools, expand your workshop, and grow your restoration business - solo or with friends in online co-op!

details.title: Record Studio Tycoon
details.short_description: Run a record label from one room in 1950 through seven decades of changing taste. You decide who gets signed, what they’re paid, and how their record sounds. When the reviews come in, there’s no one else to blame.

details.title: HoraitoYugi
details.short_description: In the village of Horai, where autumn lasts forever, girls clash with swords and cards in a board game-style battle for up to four players. Master positioning, mind games, and tactical maneuvers to emerge victorious in this never-ending game.

details.title: Catriarch
details.short_description: Your subjects are dumpster cats. Your kingdom is an abandoned building in a human city. Your reign is threatened by dogs, fleas, collar bells, bad valerian harvests, fish-bone fortunes — and your own terrible decisions.

details.title: Perihelion
details.short_description: Master orbital combat and bend gravity to your advantage in this space combat roguelite. Launch from your carrier, tackle tactical missions, build crew relationships, and upgrade your ship between runs as you slowly unravel the mystery of a lost sister ship.

details.title: Surging Blood
details.short_description: A dark journey shaped by blood and alchemy. A FPS inspired by retro PS1 aesthetics, and a universe blending steampunk and victorian gothic. Will you uncover the fate of Cinderval?

details.title: Pitchfork Perfect
details.short_description: Jam to the tunes of Pitchfork Perfect - a Bullet Heaven Rogue-like Rhythm game. Press, tap and hold to the beat to cast spells and abilities to fight off swarms of heavenly forces led by oppressive bosses! Will you face the music? Or will you stay silent?

details.title: Remake17
details.short_description: Remake17 is a galgame. You play as student Liang Yu, who travels back to high school ten years ago after an accident. Amid memory and reality, you'll find overlooked traces and the fates of three girls. Facing reality and illusion, regret and dreams, what will you choose?

details.title: BowlTown碗镇
details.short_description: 欢迎来到碗镇。这是一则虚构的现实故事，讲述了少数群体的困境和自救。碗镇的居民几乎都是是兽人，如果你仔细观察会发现，他们在历史和现实中都有自己的名字，他们的故事也似曾相识。你是偶然逃到碗镇的兽人厨师，在碗镇流动设宴款待居民，在食物与交谈之中，完成自我和居民的治愈。

details.title: Cards & Cannons
details.short_description: Build your own realm and turn every path into a devious trap in this roguelite tower defense deckbuilder! Crush endless enemy hordes with mighty spells and crazy builds in unique runs. Defeat powerful bosses and conquer world after world in this colorful medieval madness!

details.title: Rulehouse
details.short_description: Think you know chess? Forget some of that. Rulehouse is a pawn chess adventure where every stage rewrites the game. Travel the globe and beyond, master an ever-changing board where new pieces, twisted variants, and cunning opponents keep you guessing from first move to last.

details.title: Things to Forget – Lighthouse
details.short_description: Adam Foster, a 23-year-old office worker whose life is turned upside down after a breakup with his girlfriend. In an attempt to escape from himself, he takes a job as a lighthouse keeper, hoping to clear his mind. He could never have imagined the horror he would have to endure at his new workplace.

name: The Journey of the Gnomes: The Battle of the Elder Isles

details.title: The Journey of the Gnomes: The Battle of the Elder Isles
details.short_description: One gnome wizard against an entire army of darkness. Journey of the Gnomes is a fantasy survivors-like, bullet heaven game. Cast powerful spells, mighty elemental synergies, and survive the shadow horde!

details.title: Astral Trial
details.short_description: This is a deck-building game (DBG) that emphasizes symmetrical strategy. Your enemies, like you, possess decks, energy, and relics. Optimize your strategy, build your deck, challenge powerful female bosses, and save the world from collapse.

details.title: Terra Ninfa
details.short_description: A laid-back puzzle/exploration game about reviving forgotten, dried-up landscapes and turning them into picturesque dioramas. Manipulate water, irrigate all the plants, bring a wild beauty to a neglected world while discovering the secrets of the Nymphs.

details.title: Wasteland Light
details.short_description: Light of the Wasteland is a PvE survival game. Build your base in a wasteland, scavenge for supplies, gradually arm yourself, and fend off the creatures. When faced with insurmountable monster, you can awaken a mysterious power within your body, temporarily transforming to turn the tide of battle.

details.title: Beast Survivor 3D
details.short_description: Battle thousands of monsters in this 3D action-survival game. Harness elemental resonance to unleash magic, from ground spikes to celestial meteors. Adapt your evolution mid-combat, using rapid skill combos and domain buffs to reign as the apex predator of this savage world.

details.title: Annexation
details.short_description: Annexation is a fast-paced real-time strategy game with old-school roots. Build bases, train armies, and outmaneuver your enemy to claim victory. Start by playing the campaign and then challenge yourself in Arcade Missions, which bring the intensity of multiplayer RTS into a single-player setting.

details.title: Oneiron Expanse
details.short_description: Your world is abruptly erased. Only the Oneiron Expanse remains; a Plane where your mental state evokes lethal potential. Embark on a deckbuilding odyssey where every card is a fragment of your will. Find the Dreamwright and dream your reality back into being... before your memories fade

details.title: Clickomorph
details.short_description: Hover over enemies to kill them... Until you choose an ability! Each new ability offers a new playstyle! Build a small auto clicker army, shoot your enemies as an archer, summon a Soul Reaper to assist you or even play a mini rhythm game! And more!

details.title: 请在正确答案处咬下
details.short_description: When obedient top student Fang Zhu discovers her childhood friend Jiang Xiangyi is secretly a werewolf, she risks her own academic standing to protect him from their suffocating school environment, toxic classmates, and an unfeeling teacher.

details.title: The Creature Mafia
details.short_description: A 1920s Prohibition-era action RPG where you capture creatures to take on the mob! Set in 1926 Kansas City, The Creature Mafia mixes a realistic world with cartoonish creature combat. Your creatures’ lives are in your hands - can you prevail against the full might of the mob?

details.title: HYPERDROP: A Pachinko Roguelite
details.short_description: Build impossible scoring machines in HYPERDROP, a hypnotizing physics-based pachinko roguelite bursting with satisfying chain reactions and game-breaking combos.

details.title: You Are Family
details.short_description: You’re looking to disconnect in a secluded country house. A family welcomes you in. Soon, you’ll discover that feeling at home here… may be more real than you imagine.

details.title: SINEK
details.short_description: Sinek is a dark, cinematic adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic bunker, where you guide a swarm of flies to explore a world filled with silent stories of human resilience.

details.title: Skymote
details.short_description: A tower defence deckbuilder with roguelike elements. Build a deck, raise towers, cast spells, and discover unexpected synergies to turn your floating island into a fortress the sky can't break.

details.title: Vertical Momentum Revival
details.short_description: Engage in fast paced vertical PVP combat. Jump straight into the action on the rooftops, or flank your enemy through the alleyways below. Choose from a variety of movement abilities to compliment your playstyle. Play any existing maps, or create your own!

details.title: Renegade Run
details.short_description: Renegade Run is an immersive deckbuilder that puts you in the pilot seat of an experimental starship. Discover anomalies, carve your path, and face powerful enemies as you battle your way back to Sector 0.

details.title: IM:VVI Galaxy Runaway
details.short_description: Crash-land with Team VVI’s three mercenaries on a mysterious planet inhabited by strange birdfolk. Explore unique civilizations, face enemies in combat that blends rhythm and strategy, interact with curious locals, and uncover the conspiracy surrounding the planet’s nature spirit.

details.title: IRON-PLUNDER
details.short_description: THE PLUNDER AWAITS! “KING ORANGE” and his fiendish collectors have stolen “The Chief’s” comic book collection and only “Deathwish Newyork” can get them back! Blast the hell out of "KING ORANGE'S" facilities and secure the IRON PLUNDER!

details.title: Tales of the Otherworld
details.short_description: A single-player and multiplayer game paying homage to classic MMORPGs: Explore the MU Continent featuring low-number stats, AFK auto-battles, co-op play, farming, and fishing.

details.title: Corocoro Friends
details.short_description: Roll, stick, and carry everything. "Coro-coro Friends" is a chaotic physics puzzle action game where you roll a sphere, cling to objects, and solve challenges in creative ways. Play solo or with a friend—cooperate or sabotage your way to the goal.

details.title: Pact of the Black Tide
details.short_description: A narrative point-and-click adventure game blending puzzles and wit. Explore, interact with a cast of colorful characters, combine items, and manipulate reality through an integrated magic system. Humor, adventure, and discovery await to bring you into new and unexpected worlds.

details.title: GRIDLANDS
details.short_description: GRIDLANDS is a PvE extraction shooter set in a fallen world where sentient machines hunt what remains of humanity. Scavenge, survive, and extract through hostile industrial dead zones where every run could be your last.

details.title: The Blood Knight: Episode Dawn
details.short_description: Defeat, Devour, and Forge. The Blood Knight is a Turn-Based JRPG inspired by the classics. Guide Zeno Trillion, a boy who can turn objects into something more. Master unique skills and equipment, unleash Zeno's Critical Skills, and lead companions through a journey full of twists and turns.

details.title: Carnholt
details.short_description: Build your victory upon the corpses you leave behind. Carnholt is a roguelike deckbuilder in which death is not the end, it’s just another card to play. Craft a deck of wild creatures and powerful spells, fight in tactical battles, and slay a God that refused death.

details.title: Lumory: A Distant Summer
details.short_description: Wander through bright liminal spaces shaped by distant summer memories. Ride a childhood scooter, reveal hidden paths with Dream Vision, and capture surreal moments with your camera. No combat—just calm exploration.

name: Outbreak The Fedora Files: What Lydia Knows - Known Factors

details.title: Outbreak The Fedora Files: What Lydia Knows - Known Factors
details.short_description: Join Lydia as she takes her fight to expose the corruption in Cypress Ridge to City Hall in the second part of the visual novel series What Lydia Knows.

name: Detective Turner: If Looks Could Kill

details.title: Detective Turner: If Looks Could Kill
details.short_description: A point-and-click noir murder mystery where you literally read the room. Search for clues in text, photograph evidence, and interrogate suspects in visual novel-style conversations to solve the murder of a fashion icon.

details.title: Block Crime
details.short_description: Imagine GTA, but in a blocky style with a living online RP world. Block Crime is a crime simulator where you choose your role: police officer, gangster, or ordinary worker. Take over districts, participate in gang wars, create businesses, and become the boss of Los Palms city!

details.title: ROBOSCAV
details.short_description: ROBOSCAV is a turn-based extraction RPG where you command fully customizable robots into raids. Explore the planet, Scavenge for loot, Fight robots and aliens, Extract. After crash landing on a hostile planet, you must rebuild your spaceship from scratch, to escape.

name: Redacted by the Sadistic Princess from Another World?!

details.title: Redacted by the Sadistic Princess from Another World?!
details.short_description: Socially awkward game developer Yaemori Nowa receives more than she bargains for when two characters she created for her indie smash hit eroge, Utter Obedience: Conquered by the Sadistic Princess, appear in her apartment. What's a hopeless lesbian to do?!

details.title: Culling Daisies
details.short_description: A dark yuri visual novel about a girl so terrified of being alone she will stop at nothing to ensure her loved ones can never leave her.

details.title: Impossible Machine
details.short_description: My uncle invented a machine capable of changing the world... and then disappeared. Impossible Machine is a 2.5D point-and-click adventure where you explore, talk to characters, and build solutions as you try to unravel a mystery. No minigames. Lots of terrible jokes. What could possibly go wrong?

details.title: Survival Exorcist
details.short_description: Survival Exorcist: A solo dev medieval survival horror with 2000s visuals. Board the sacred train and deliver it to the castle to purify ravaged plague lands. Hunt corrupted beasts with your crossbow or use dagger in stealth across diverse environments in this atmospheric experience.

details.title: Might of Fate
details.short_description: A classic JRPG-style game about the conflict between magic and humanity in a medieval world. Experience Fate's story from his carefree childhood to becoming a powerful warrior. Assemble a party and master the combat stance system to change the fate of the world.

details.title: Supernova Deliveries
details.short_description: Haul cargo across a rusty asteroid belt in a duct-taped space truck. Your trailer swings with real zero-g physics, how you pack it moves your centre of mass, pirates want your load and Vito the loan shark wants his money. Don't forget to HONK.

details.title: Drained Creatures
details.short_description: Drained Creatures is a multiplayer 3D arena brawler for up to 8 players locally, playable using gamepads only.

details.title: Self-Replication /// Destruction
details.short_description: A third-person shooter set in a crumbling megastructure. Fight drones, explore its sectors, and survive in a system that has spiraled out of control.

name: Mana and Merlin: A Wanderful Adventure

details.title: Mana and Merlin: A Wanderful Adventure
details.short_description: Mana & Merlin: A Wanderful Adventure is a 3D open-world platformer filled with fun and exploration, inspired by classics like Banjo-Kazooie. Join Mana on a journey to learn magical abilities and help restore her master to his rightful body.

details.title: Chimaera Evolution
details.short_description: Pixel art monster-capture RPG with tactical turn-based combat. Track elusive Shiny Chimaeras, cross-breed perfect genes through egg breeding, and craft survival gear to conquer a vast world. Master evolution and build the ultimate squad.

details.title: Digital Civilization: Evolution
details.short_description: Build your own empire! Evolve from a primitive civilization and rise to become the strongest and greatest empire of all! Manage resources, construct buildings, and engage in diplomacy with other nations, as you grow your civilization step by step into an unstoppable powerhouse.

details.title: Afterlight Survival
details.short_description: Open-world sandbox survival horror combining base-building, crafting, and tower defense. Scavenge for supplies and build your home while evading what's left of the government and the undead it created. Play solo or online co-op with up to 4 players.

name: Lights Out Chapter 2 The Unseen Reckoning

details.title: Lights Out Chapter 2 The Unseen Reckoning
details.short_description: Alone again and abandoned in the house, this time even darker than usual. You return as Jack and set out to search for your missing Friend.

details.title: 盲盒指挥官
details.short_description: Blind Box Commander is a toy brick-style RTS with deckbuilding, blind box draws, and classic base tech. Build a 24-card deck, expand your base, unlock units, and adapt your tactics in real time as every match delivers new combinations and fresh strategic battles.

details.title: Under A Groove
details.short_description: 'Under A Groove' is a rhythm game that's fun just to watch, even if you're only playing the music video. A stylish rhythm action game where visuals and music sync perfectly—simple to play, deeply satisfying to master.

details.title: Islecraft: Island Architect
details.short_description: Sail to uncharted isles and build settlements as an island architect in this minimalist city builder. Inspired by ISLANDERS.

details.title: MORI
details.short_description: Experience lightning-fast combat as self-proclaimed Grim-Reaper Mori. Armed with nothing but a scythe, cloak and a lust for revenge, carve your way through a criminal empire and discover what it means to lose yourself.

details.title: OVERRIDE PROTOCOL
details.short_description: Hack hostile AI systems in a cyberpunk hacker sim. Build proxy routes, poison live context, breach secured nodes, steal the payload, and wipe the logs before your trace burns.

details.title: Wayward Crown
details.short_description: You don't command the heroes — you bait them. Wayward Crown is a kingdom-management sim where every adventurer has their own greed, glory, and fear. Place bounties, build a town, balance the gold, and watch your realm run itself.

details.title: Here's My Target
details.short_description: Contract killing is just another public service. As a regulator, it's your job to review the documents, listen to the client, and decide the fate of every target, then hope you made the right call.

details.title: Apocalypse Jumpers
details.short_description: Welcome to the end of world(s)! Jump from one apocalypse to the next, upgrading your abilities to defeat the hordes that threaten the fabric of the universe.

details.title: Gorilla Tag Contagion
details.short_description: Join your fellow Monke to smash, climb, and roll your way through hordes of enemies! Unlock new characters, powerful weapons, endless gadgets, and crazy parkour skills as you fight through twisted monstrosities with your unique build. Will you survive the Contagion?

details.title: Sutra Pilgrim
details.short_description: Sutra Pilgrim is a 2D Metroidvania inspired by Journey to the West. Awaken from an ancient seal as a monkey demon and seek the Sutra Pilgrim. Transform to explore hidden paths, collect artifacts and legendary weapons, meet allies, and face Yaoguai Kings to uncover the secrets of the journey west.

details.title: World on a Plate
details.short_description: World on a Plate is a cozy co-op cooking adventure for 1–2 players! Master complex recipes, explore unique kitchens across Europe, and experience a full restaurant routine, from preparation and course-based service to the final cleanup. And remember...never let the customers see you panic! Allez!

details.title: Nymble 2
details.short_description: Jack returns in Nymble 2, a turn-based puzzle-platformer where every step and jump matters. Solve 100+ handcrafted levels filled with new enemies, traps, and hazards that react when you move. Find the seedling, plant it, and climb the beanstalk to reach the next level above.

details.title: Exodrift
details.short_description: Exodrift is a rhythm action roguelite where you are a space delivery driver on the run. Deliver packages, destroy enemies on the beat, and escape hazardous procedurally generated planets.

details.title: Liquid Swarm
details.short_description: Swallow swarms of monsters, earn XP, improve your stats, repeat. Minimalist active incremental roguelite with rewarding and satisfying gameplay. Reincarnate to get permanent XP bonuses and to unlock perks and Epic Bosses. Play alone or with friends.

details.title: MushHero
details.short_description: MushHero is a cooperative roguelite defense game where players fight together against waves of monsters and powerful bosses. Build unique strategies through randomized weapons, evolving skills, and a node-based progression system that creates a different combat experience every run.

details.title: Netherspire
details.short_description: Explore the ruins of a colossal tower and fight those who threaten its ancient vault in this short 3D Metroidvania.

name: Sacred Stakes: Starring VEINIEST DUKEM and his ludicrous blackjack skills on a holy crusade into the depths of THE gambling hell itself

details.title: Sacred Stakes: Starring VEINIEST DUKEM and his ludicrous blackjack skills on a holy crusade into the depths of THE gambling hell itself
details.short_description: Outplay cheating ghosts in blackjack as a musclebound exorcist. Build your deck and survive a roguelike descent where the house doesn’t just cheat: it haunts you. Bend the rules, use powerful items, uncover each spirit’s tricks, and turn their own scams against them.

details.title: Urine Nation
details.short_description: A SCORE ATTACK adventure through the UK and Ireland, where your goal is to soak everywhere in your urine! USE ALL THE URINE IN YOUR SYSTEM to drench every inch of the level while completing objectives and gaining crazy combos!!!

details.title: C01n
details.short_description: A nostalgic visual novel set on a quiet, remote island somewhere in Japan. Follow the words of the islanders and the small things that feel slightly off in everyday life, and draw closer to the truth this place has kept hidden. This is not a story about exposing the truth.

details.title: Whiterock Bay
details.short_description: Take on a big mystery in this first-person adventure inspired by old-time horrors. Explore the desolate town, face the anomalies, solve puzzles and search for traces of your missing sister in Whiterock Bay.

details.title: RWR:Renegade
details.short_description: Hand-to-hand combat, firearms, and an upgradable motorcycle against mimic worms. Play as a biker nomad who crushes everything in his path to the sound of rock-chip tunes.

details.title: Impermanence
details.short_description: A father. A condemned theatre. A son’s voice from beyond. Step into a narrative horror game about grief, obsession, and refusing to let go as a force older than love pushes back.

details.title: My Yandere Streamer
details.short_description: You're just a regular streamer with a modest audience. She invited you over to her place... The moment you turned your back, your yandere girlfriend Aiko locked you in her basement. Can you escape before time runs out? Or... do you even want to?

details.title: Pegote
details.short_description: Reshape your cards in this Spanish deck roguelike deckbuilder. Bet your cards on a duel where highest one wins, slap stickers on them to rig the values on the table. Live with your choices or burn the ones you cannot change.

details.title: What Remains Of Me
details.short_description: After an injury shatters the future he had planned, Jake Turner returns to the small town he thought he'd left behind. With old feelings resurfacing and unexpected attractions becoming harder to ignore, he must confront who he was, who he's expected to be, and who he actually wants to become.

details.title: The Money Man
details.short_description: In a speakeasy backroom, you verify cash paid to a crime family, using tools and guides to spot counterfeits and expose liars. A century ago, the wealthy fled to Mars. Earth is rotting, and the underworld owns New York. With someone you love on the line, there's no room for mistakes

details.title: Print in Progress
details.short_description: A cozy 3D printer simulator. Pick your colors, start your prints, and watch voxel models grow. Snap off the supports, ship orders, and buy upgrades for your workshop. Engage actively to grow faster or leave it as a relaxing idle companion on your desktop that you check in on.

details.title: JOB
details.short_description: JOB is a bleak and surreal corporate mystery that incorporates and subverts incremental/idle, rogue-lite, and traditional puzzle mechanics. The Company is looking for new Contractors and they ask, "Would you sign away three years of your life for the possibility of unimaginable wealth?"

name: Frozen Christmas Magic: Santa’s Hidden Village

details.title: Frozen Christmas Magic: Santa’s Hidden Village
details.short_description: Unleash the magic of Christmas in a cozy adventure puzzle game. Armed with your magic shovel, clear away the snow burying a legendary village, solve puzzles, uncover forgotten secrets, and rediscover the wonder of Christmas through a unique Advent calendar.

details.title: R.override
details.short_description: Explore an alien planet as a fierce little rover on a mission to rescue a lost crew and uncover their secrets.

details.title: As We Unite
details.short_description: As We Unite is a political strategy simulation game where you play as a high-ranking Consul of a secretive cult aiming to unite the world before an impending global calamity. Instead of controlling a country, you manage agents across different nations, each run has a crisis you have to resolve!

details.title: Aetherfall
details.short_description: Aetherfall is an elemental post-apocalypse extraction RPG set on a modern Earth where technology has failed and elemental power rules. Master fire, earth, air, and water, combine them into new elements, and risk everything as you fight to survive and grow stronger.

details.title: GUNtai
details.short_description: Craft your gun. Shoot down enemies hordes. Upgrade weapon, remake weapon, combine weapon. Unlock new characters and new modules. Make great gunsmiths regret their inventions!

details.title: Junkyard Space Agency
details.short_description: Build ships from scrap and fly them in a gritty space sim. Venture solo or team up. Hunt for parts, haul vital resources, and keep your space agency afloat.

details.title: DIGI-DOLL
details.short_description: Mauve takes on the job of a decorator. Design and decorate dollhouses for different ragdolls and appease their unique tastes. Use the retro DIGI-DOLL console to explore the attic, unlock various dollhouses, befriend characters, and discover stunning furnishings to fill them with.

name: The Wondrous Wedding of Ivan the Bard

details.title: The Wondrous Wedding of Ivan the Bard
details.short_description: A romantic fairy tale set in a fantasy medieval Rus'. Play as Ivan, a young bard with a gusli in hand, on a quest to win the love of the elusive Novgorod princess. Learn tunes, make choices!

details.title: Diner Simulator 🍔
details.short_description: Run your own cozy diner solo or with friends! Cook, serve, clean, and manage the chaos in this fast-paced restaurant sim. Expand your café, customize your menu, and turn kitchen mayhem into delicious fun — or total disaster!

details.title: Sundae Drive
details.short_description: Hit the road in your very own ice cream truck! 🍦 Explore a cute neighborhood, park in the perfect spot, and serve adorable animal customers their dream sundaes. Scoop, drizzle, and top to perfection. Upgrade your cute truck, restock supplies, and create your own ice cream flavors!

details.title: The Everything Building
details.short_description: Press up and down, elevator goes brrr! Deliver customers to the correct floor and max your score. Serve many customers including but not limited to surfers, astronauts, cars, ghosts, cheerleaders, horses, and cheerleader horses. 1-2 players! 50 different floors! HORSE MODE included!

details.title: The Pact
details.short_description: The Pact is a story-rich psychological horror game about family secrets, where you experience a tragic tale of morality, justice, and consequence. Navigate unsettling environments, escape threats, solve puzzles, and run for your life as you slowly discover your family's dark secret and its origins.

details.title: Faithless Water
details.short_description: Freshly awakened, you discover that the underwater station sheltering you is deserted. There is nothing but death here, and no one will come to help you. Dive yourself into this classic survival horror game and explore a vast environment filled by nightmarish creatures.

details.title: QUANTUM HEART
details.short_description: QUANTUM HEART combines the thrill of dodging bullets in shoot 'em ups with the build variety of modern roguelikes. Graze enemy bullets to charge energy and unleash devastating powers. Take the elevator to the only city on Earth and depose the system that robbed your heart.

details.title: Blackwood's Dilemma
details.short_description: Demo updated for the Detective Fest! Step into detective Brian Storm’s shoes and unravel a grim 17th-century mystery. Interrogate villagers, gather clues, and piece together the evidence in a deduction system where every secret matters.

details.title: Nui Goes to Town!
details.short_description: Nui, Rumi, and Gu are about to embark on the Giggle Train to Tickle Town! Explore Gigglesville and help your pals in this cute adventure game where not everything is as it seems.

details.title: The Gas Station : Graveyard Shift
details.short_description: Congratulations, You've been hired as the new nightshift employee at silver lake gas station. Can you survive the night?

details.title: ABYSS REBEL
details.short_description: ABYSS REBEL is a tactical RPG focused on turn-based combat and character progression. In a dark, frozen world, assemble a squad, sail to the most dangerous archipelagos in the universe, and defeat the lurking dark forces with strategy, heroes, and mechs.

details.title: Cardboard Cowboy
details.short_description: Cardboard Cowboy, the cardboard Wild West shooter. Blast through handcrafted paper shooting galleries, dual-wield makeshift revolvers and shotguns, and chase high scores across three outlaw-filled regions. Beat timed weapon challenges. Collect tarot cards. Unlock the ultimate cardboard loadout.

name: Love in a Time of Earthquakes

details.title: Love in a Time of Earthquakes
details.short_description: A interactive post-apocalyptic fantasy romance.

details.title: Oremus
details.short_description: This text adventure, beautifully illustrated in pixel art, invites you to explore a medieval abbey filled with secrets. You take full control by entering commands directly on your keyboard through a flexible command parser, allowing for free and immersive interaction.

details.title: 无言初雪与奇迹书
details.short_description: 江城是个很少下雪的南方城市。 倘若是哪个冬天见到了，就随手纪念一下吧… 在难以成团的雪籽融化成水之前，在眼前的人尚未走远消失之前 将“白色的奇迹”封存在相片里，记录在记事本里，铭刻于脑海里……

details.title: Heliodawn
details.short_description: You start with a coal mine, an iron mine, a well, and a farm. You end with rockets flying, colonies on the Moon and Mars, and cargo flowing between every world you've built. An idle incremental game about building humanity's space program from the ground up.

name: Kamiya Detective Agency: High School Girl Vanished in The Summer

details.title: Kamiya Detective Agency: High School Girl Vanished in The Summer
details.short_description: A mystery set in Fukuoka, Japan. Former cop Kengo Kamiya and assistant Hikaru tackle a high school girl's disappearance. A "Photoreal Novel" fully utilizing actual photos and AI. Enjoy snappy banter and unexpected twists in this simple, choice-driven mystery visual novel.

details.title: BaeSplit: Chaos Down Under
details.short_description: A turn-based RPG featuring Hakos Baelz and her friends from hololive! Discover a re-imagining of the Outback as you join Bae on a quest to save her homeland and herself.

details.title: Fear Tide
details.short_description: Fear Tide is a single-player zombie extraction survival game where you and your dog brave infected zones for the supplies keeping your bunker alive. Fight together, track valuable resources, carry what you can, rescue survivors, and extract before the horde closes in.

details.title: Cafe Connect
details.short_description: Repair, upgrade, and build PCs for your first customers to pave your way to self-employment. Open your own internet café, build custom gaming PCs, and expand your shop step by step. Your success starts with a screwdriver.

details.title: Kiwi Boing
details.short_description: Triple-jump, air dash, plant your beak on walls, leap off and more in this 3D collectathon platformer about a flightless bird that gets everywhere anyway. You crashed on tiny open-world islands, and you have places to be. Find secrets, Meet the locals, fix your plane and F off home (F is for Fly).

details.title: Operation Paranoia
details.short_description: Operation Paranoia is a psychological survival horror in which you browse the dark corners of the deep web, uncover conspiracy theories, and hide from relentless killers. Manage your food and medicine supplies, run your vlog channel, and survive another day.

details.title: HOMUNCULCHU
details.short_description: Guide fragile homunculi with limited lifespans through humanity's final bid for survival across six hostile worlds.

details.title: Endangered
details.short_description: Humanity wiped out your species. Now you're fighting back. Play as evolved animals in a brutal roguelike hack-and-slash! Hunt down humans, adapt to a collapsing world, and collect nuclear launch codes to end the fight... permanently.

details.title: Crossline
details.short_description: You are an ecologist forced onto a sudden rescue mission inside a secret complex. Face parallel worlds and creatures unknown to science. Piece together the events that led to the tragic disaster and uncover the facility's dark secrets before the cold and madness consume you.

details.title: Exul: Beyond the Gate
details.short_description: Exul: Beyond the Gate is a top-down retro-sci-fi action RPG shooter where you play as an Exul on his journey to an unknown galaxy. Play with your friends in a Co-Op experience where you loot, shoot, pilot, explore, trade, and much more — all to stay alive.

details.title: Eilands
details.short_description: Create and explore your own islands. Sculpt the land, plant trees, draw paths, place and build houses. Inhabit your creations. There is no combat or management, just the joy of creating and experiencing your own island.

details.title: DEADRIFT
details.short_description: A fast-paced sci-fi shooter where a failed experiment unleashes mutated horrors inside a secret research facility. Armed with experimental weapons, you must fight through swarms of twisted enemies, and survive the collapse of a world-breaking project.

name: Breaking Up Is Hard To Do

details.title: Breaking Up Is Hard To Do
details.short_description: When you tell your girlfriend you want to break up, she refuses to accept it. Is your resolve strong enough to become single or will you cave and stay together? A 30-minute visual novel - Breaking Up Is Hard To Do

details.title: Battlespace Command
details.short_description: Take command of modern warfare across land, air, and sea in a real-time strategy sandbox. Direct every unit, from infantry to aircraft carriers, across vast, real-world scale battlefields where sensors, strategy, and coordination decide the outcome.

details.title: Rituals & War: Shan Hai
details.short_description: In the mountains and seas of pre-Qin myth, the way to Heaven is severed; the gods are silent. A turn-based tactical card game with hand-painted ink-wash art: read clues to enemy moves, sequence your actions each round, then cross swords on one shared timeline. One miscalculation can turn the tide.

details.title: Kibreet | كبريت
details.short_description: Kibreet | كبريت is a psychological Arab folklore horror game where a single matchbox reveals visions warped by shame and violence.

details.title: Slap it
details.short_description: A single-player 3D casual fighting game. Slap, resist, and knock out your opponents in fast and hilarious battles by hitting the right keys at the right time. Master the timing and become the ultimate slap champion!

details.title: Ronin's Grudge
details.short_description: A dueling-focused swordplay-RPG borrowing from samurai aesthetic and style. Scavenge and take jobs to survive to continue your quest to settle a grudge. Featuring 1vs1 duels and larger group battles, Duel Mode, and and unforgiving Journey Mode - with one fragile life to preserve.

details.title: Chill Planet
details.short_description: A deck-building adventure game about a group of girls traveling across Japan in a world doomed by an incoming meteor. Collect items, craft powerful builds, and play your cards wisely as you journey toward Hokkaido!

details.title: 魂途 Xoul
details.short_description: Xoul is a uniquely styled 2D ARPG. You can use the game's distinctive "Custom Combo" feature to create your own chain attacks, defeat various enemies, experience diverse stories, unravel the mysteries of this world—and then make your choice.

details.title: VASED
details.short_description: VASED is a simple, yet challenging fast-paced arcade against-the-clock puzzle game about vases.

details.title: Gumblaster Mayhem
details.short_description: Gumblaster Mayhem is a 3D retro-style first-person shooter game where you, as a player, shoot out some gumballs using the three weapons that you must use to take down the sour mutants to survive.

details.title: Labyren
details.short_description: Labyren is a medieval-themed Tower Defense game centered on multi-waypoint mazing and vision. While traversing through the campaign, discover countless unique strategies building with your ever-expanding arsenal and unravel the story underneath!

name: The Story about princess 8 out of 10

details.title: The Story about princess 8 out of 10
details.short_description: A fairy-tale comedy visual novel about a princess rated 8/10 and her questionable decisions. Rescue a prince, adopt a cat, or discover the cost of independence. Choose your own mess in a hand-drawn world of sharp jokes and very unsuitable suitors.

details.title: Tad-Bubble!
details.short_description: Tad-Bubble is a boss rush shoot ‘em up for the Game Boy Color! Fight off waves of dangerous boss bugs, boss fish, and boss more in this brand-new retro experience.

details.title: Purrfect Tanks - The Yarnpocalypse
details.short_description: Command adorable cats in chaotic cardboard tanks and battle for the last yarn on Earth! Play a fast-paced arcade shooter packed with explosions, lasers, catnip-fueled madness — and lots of cardboard. 🐱📦🔥

details.title: Captain Speedfin
details.short_description: Captain Speedfin is stuck with an hourglass and needs to be fast! Race against the clock through 60 challenging levels of pirate parkour, where every second counts. Grab your treasure and get out before time runs out!

details.title: ULTRA MEGA DRILL
details.short_description: Buy geodes, crack their weak points, find rare crystals and artifacts, and build an automated processing line in this 2D incremental game.

details.title: Mirrors Castle
details.short_description: Mirror Castle is a 3D puzzle-platformer with a unique mechanic: step into reflections to change reality and solve tasks. 4 trial corridors, 128 achievements, multiple endings, and humor parodying horror. The castle evolves as you play. For parkour, puzzles, and self-irony lovers!

details.title: Mimix
details.short_description: Create equipment through synthesis and break out to face incoming heroes in this strategic roguelike auto-battler. With limited actions, choose and combine materials to build the optimal loadout. Battles are fully automatic, making preparation the key to victory.

details.title: COUNTERSUN
details.short_description: A classic real-time strategy game set in 1953, the year a second sun rose. Build a base, mine ore, chop wood, drill for oil and command armies on land, sea and air against the Umbral. Two campaigns, ranked online, skirmish, LAN and a map editor.

name: ナカノ人格移植研究所

details.title: ナカノ人格移植研究所
details.short_description: "The Nakano Laboratory" is a loop-based mystery 2D adventure game. Within each loop of 15 minutes, you take over researchers' bodies to gather clues around the ship, then present your evidence at the meeting.
developers: 麺屋すぱいす 東京支店
publishers: 麺屋すぱいす 東京支店

details.title: LIKVAR: ZOYA
details.short_description: You are assigned to Zoya, a candidate with 30 days to become a Likvar—a superpowered field operative. Manage her condition, send her on dangerous missions, and report or alter the results. Your choices shape her performance, trust, and future.

details.title: Stunt Paradise 2
details.short_description: Stunt Paradise 2 - more speed, more explosions, more madness! Jump over ramps, dodge lasers, buzzsaws, and rockets while performing insane stunts. With new traps, improved graphics, and pure arcade chaos - get ready for the ultimate stunt challenge!

name: 战网魔：谁把天才变了恶魔

details.title: 战网魔：谁把天才变了恶魔
details.short_description: This is a Chinese local-themed role-playing game. Plot is its core driver. It uses a male-female dual-protagonist narrative to deeply tell a story set in the new millennium, about online games and overcoming gaming addiction.

details.title: Echoes of Tomorrow
details.short_description: A post-apocalyptic action RPG where you play a banished cleric, falsely accused of the divine disease. Wield a robotic relic able to restore lost ruins and technology, face challenging combat and make consequential choices to expose the theocracy's lies, seeking a truth that may cost you everything.

details.title: Midnight Gambit
details.short_description: So you're a vampire, and your new boss has a cape and a spreadsheet. Dracula wants his cut, and he wants it monthly. You control Sonny, a gambling addicted vampire with a coat-full of luck. Drink blood, gamble and create unique-builds to survive this wave based stealth-action roguelite in Sin City.

details.title: Lumen the Red Panda
details.short_description: Explore a cozy world with Lumen the Red Panda! Go through exciting platforming challenges, solve puzzles, collect apples, unlock fun cosmetics, help animals in need, and uncover hidden secrets in this family-friendly 3D adventure.

details.title: Storm The House Collection
details.short_description: Defend your base, upgrade your arsenal, and survive the siege! The iconic Storm the House trilogy of fixed-position shooters returns from the golden age of Flash, now preserved and better than ever. PLUS the debut of the long-lost Storm The House 4!!

details.title: BunnyOps
details.short_description: BunnyOps is a tactical PvP shooter where bunnies are the apex herbivore, carrots are scarce, and everything can be destroyed.

details.title: IRIS
details.short_description: Control Iris, a messenger who walks through a spiritual realm, guiding lost people who seek peace. An action-platformer focused on music, combat, and atmosphere.

details.title: Alchimist – Secret of the Worlds
details.short_description: After decades of peace, an ancient threat returns – forgotten shadows rise once more. As an alchemist you experience an immersive story in the realm of Aethendor, master the art of alchemy, and face ancient dangers in epic battles with magic, melee and ranged combat.

details.title: GUNGRAVE G.O.R.E: BLOOD HEAT
details.short_description: Full Rebuild with Unreal Engine 5, GUNGRAVE G.O.R.E BLOOD HEAT delivers stunning visuals and an evolved action system. Experience the explosive fusion of stylish Bullet Ballet and Gunkata in an immersive, adrenaline-pumping action spectacle!

details.title: Bogeys, Ghosts & Gods
details.short_description: Bogeys, Ghosts & Gods is a non-linear visual novel with elements of traditional Chinese supernatural folklore.In this miserable world, a young boy must do everything he can to seize the chance to survive, face parting with his companions, and bear a mission that isn’t his own.

details.title: Masquerade: Penumbra
details.short_description: Fantasy visual novel with political intrigue, branching narratives, and romantic themes. Set in a world of underworld intrigue, where masks become identities and no one is safe. The game places an emphasis on character-driven storytelling.

details.title: Scraps Of The Machine
details.short_description: FPS Mech Action! Pilot a mass of steel through a single player campaign set in a desolate landscape. Target enemy armor or weapons to wear them down piece by piece, find upgrades to improve your mech or change its loadout, and survive in a world of rust and decay. Discover, Destroy, Scavenge.

details.title: Arcane Spellforge: Core Defense
details.short_description: Forge spells with your hands, build tactical defenses, and unleash devastating power in VR. Upgrade modular weapons and towers, adapt your strategy, and survive relentless waves of robotic enemies attacking your core from every direction.

details.title: LineForgeBlackSmith
details.short_description: A blacksmith shop with a "line" of unique adventurers! Use your memory and timing mini-games to quickly identify each customer's preferred weapon and forge it. In the Battle Phase, your armed customers fight. Power up your regulars (MVPs) and defeat the bosses. Become the busiest blacksmith!

details.title: Daybreak Torch
details.short_description: DaybreakTorch is a pixel-art party-based RPG that combines real-time tactical combat with traditional sRPG's squad building. Assemble your own elite hero squad and embark on a heroic, classic adventure set in a mythological world.

details.title: Void Crawlers
details.short_description: Void Crawlers is a Top-down Rogue-Lite Incremental Shooter, there are 3 initial games modes, Arcade - Room to room combat, Gauntlet - 30 minute invasion, and Story - A combination of Arcade and Gauntlet mode with a story on top.

details.title: MioAquaria
details.short_description: Build and manage a cozy underwater sandbox aquarium run by cats. Discover fantasy sea creatures, research upgrades, send expeditions, and balance fish, staff, and visitor needs to become the world’s top aquarium.

details.title: Blackroots
details.short_description: Blackroots is a co-op fantasy/horror game where players work together or alone to resist a dark force known as Ul'vorran.

details.title: Where Dragons Once Ruled
details.short_description: Step into the wings of a young dragon, one of the last. Roam diverse biomes, meet strange creatures, glide, breathe fire, and uncover an emotional story told through platforming and exploration. The journey of a dragon awaits.

name: The Other Side of the Wall

details.title: The Other Side of the Wall
details.short_description: Julian Reed is a 13-year old student at a New England all-boys Catholic boarding school in the early 1980s. When people begin disappearing and no one else seems to remember they ever existed, Julian investigates, with the help of a girl he has never seen, separated from him by a wall.

details.title: Trial By Magic
details.short_description: All spell casters must one day prove their skill in the TRIAL BY MAGIC Those who overcome this deckbuilding challenge are forever known as Wizards, a title carried with pride. Those who fail are branded Wimps, forever shamed. So the question to you, spell caster, is: ARE YOU A WIZARD OR A WIMP?

details.title: ShrednSpread
details.short_description: A mysterious egg crashes to Earth. Out pops a tiny Kaiju — hungry, googly-eyed, and impossible to please. What do you do? Easy: order snacks, shred them, and spray-feed the little monster until it grows... and grows... and grows.

details.title: ARO: Tales In The Dome
details.short_description: "ARO: Tales in the Dome" is a 2D hand-drawn action-adventure game. Play as Aro and explore an elemental world sealed beneath the dome. As the journey unfolds, uncover the hidden conspiracy and face the truth about the world, the dome, and yourself.

details.title: Is This Farming?
details.short_description: A co-op first-person farming game where your crops fight back. Till, plant and water, then grab your hoe when the harvest wakes up swinging. Ship what you beat, craft turrets and bombs, and take down Guardians with up to three friends, or on your own.

details.title: Smoke and Steel
details.short_description: Lead a nation through early 18th-century Europe in Smoke and Steel, a turn-based wargame combining grand strategy with tactical battles. Choose diplomacy or war. Build your economy, forge alliances and negotiate trade deals, then command your armies in battle. Outthink, outflank, outlast.

details.title: Diabolocracy
details.short_description: Diabolocracy is hatemail for corporate bureaucracy in roguelite turn-based tactics form. Build your team of corporate hellions, battle other Sins for supremacy, survive meetings, and choose your SIN-ergies wisely. Can you complete your hostile takeover before the boss gets back from vacation?

details.title: G Squad
details.short_description: Run the gauntlet with G Squad in this hand-crafted autobattler with roguelite and RPG elements, designed to scratch the strategy itch without the spreadsheets. 9 unique heroes, in-run rewards, permanent progression, and boss challenge modifiers to test yourself against.

details.title: Avemary Rocket -Captain Patchwork-
details.short_description: Join our brave captain on this action adventure in space! You'll be riding The Patchwork, a less than ideal spaceship, but enough to get away from pursuers. However, you'll be facing malfunctions, fires, enemies attacking... When it rains, it pours.

name: The american dream of Gunther Aims

details.title: The american dream of Gunther Aims
details.short_description: A retro puzzle shooter built around ricochets, where every shot counts. You play as Gunther, a revolver and a family man, in a constrained turn-based system: one action at a time, until it fully resolves.

details.title: < STRECT >
details.short_description: Control your ship and destroy all the enemies and bases that have appeared through teleportation! < STRECT > is a score-attack vertical shooter for 1 or 2 players. Enjoy simple shoot-and-dodge gameplay, rich destruction effects, and tons of hidden features.

details.title: Dadum The Dice
details.short_description: Plan, roll and outsmart your enemies in this turn-based tactical puzzle adventure. Show a higher number to defeat foes, discover new mechanics in every world, and face challenging bosses that twist the rules. Think ahead, take your time… and master the Great Die.

details.title: Dribble Deck
details.short_description: Dribble Deck is a basketball card game about leading your team through a tough league. Build a deck, upgrade players and trade with NPC’s. Master the game’s flow as you face ruthless coach bosses. The owner has already written you off so you’ll have to win every match or get cut before the finals.

details.title: When Voices Died
details.short_description: When Voices Died is a game of puzzles and silent emotions. Amid distant echoes and broken memories, you rebuild paths that reveal forgotten feelings — and the weight of choices that still echo.

details.title: Card Cricket Quest
details.short_description: Card Cricket Quest is a single-player roguelite deck-builder that combines deep card-matching gameplay with the ball smashing action of cricket! Complement your deck with outrageous special cards, wield powerful willows, and collect obscure trinkets to become a cricket legend. One RUN at a time.

details.title: Chrono Seoul
details.short_description: Chrono Seoul’s unique Time Table combat lets you use the hero’s mechanical arm and future-reading ability to predict enemy actions and respond with precise attacks, defense, and evasion. Each run offers new patterns, and at every chapter’s end, an Existence corrupted Seoul awaits.

details.title: Mt. Quack Legend
details.short_description: A single player 2D anime rogue-lite RPG. Join a new born duck girl's adventure in a aggressively cute world. Beat up cute wild creatures and level up to different bird classes as you explore this place.

details.title: Deep Hunger
details.short_description: A short incremental game about cleaning the ocean, and feeding the insatiable hunger of a deep sea creature.

details.title: WishBreaker
details.short_description: A genre-fusion ARPG. Every class plays differently, Warrior plays as Hack n' Slash, Rogue as Stealth rougelike, Cleric is decision based, Druids play creature collecting/farming, Wizards are puzzles, secrets, and code casting and many more! PVE and PVP including Bullet Hell and Soulslike areas!

details.title: GambaSim
details.short_description: Build and expand your own casino in a high-stakes gambling and manager simulator. Play classic casino games, beat rival casinos with unique playstyles, and climb through increasingly dangerous tiers where every bet can make, or break, your future.

details.title: Pizza Agent
details.short_description: Pizza Agent is a co-op simulator combining pizza shop management with undercover alien investigation. Craft delicious pizzas, manage your stock, keep customers happy. And secretly scan customers to catch shape-shifting aliens. Cook, serve and scan !

details.title: Shadow Hills Manor
details.short_description: Shadow Hills Manor is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on exploration, puzzle-solving, and looting. Break into the manor left behind by greed and decay. Search for valuables, but the more you take, the angrier the manor becomes. Your choice of greed shapes how the manor reacts.

details.title: Reign & Shuffle
details.short_description: As an emperor, rule your dynasty and handle state affairs year by year. Each decision you make will shape its destiny. Will every choice today alter your dynasty's future trajectory? Classic roguelike card gameplay collides with real historical events—what sparks will fly?

details.title: Valhalla, Vikings, Ragnarok!
details.short_description: Valhalla, Vikings, Ragnarok! It's a co-op game about a band of funny Vikings who must raid villages across all nine realms to pay off their debt to Hel and carve their path to Valhalla! Grab the treasure and carry it to the ship! Fight off the weak, hide from the strong, and do it all for the loot!

details.title: Faryloopa
details.short_description: Build the board. Play the cards. Roll the dice. Faryloopa is a roguelike deckbuilder meets boardbuilder where every run is a new layout, new synergies, and bigger scores to chase.

details.title: ALLARA
details.short_description: Allara is a 2D pixel-art Metroidvania soulslike set in pre-colonial East Siberia. Play as a shamanka defending her homeland, exploring mythic realms of the sacred world tree, battling brutal bosses, uncovering relics, and mastering a strategic single-skill combat system.

details.title: Mahfam: The Cursed Village
details.short_description: In 1970, eighteen children vanished overnight across eight Iranian villages. Two were later found near Mahfam Village. According to their accounts, Mahfam is no ordinary place but a terrifying site inhabited by supernatural beings. Photographer Farshid heads toward this village of horror.

details.title: Primus Numen
details.short_description: A turn-based, grid-based, tactical RPG where you combine classes and join together to unleash an evolving Nexus Beast.

details.title: 离校 School's Out
details.short_description: A first-person 3D horror adventure. Trapped in a mysterious world modeled after an old school, an amnesiac hero teams up with enigmatic heroines to face looping spaces and terrifying monsters. As they seek escape and the truth, they begin to break free from the fate that binds them.

details.title: Aelwater
details.short_description: Memory has weight. The departed are not gone. Step into a village drowned by flood and memory, and search for the final answer about guardianship and farewell among the shattered past.

details.title: Colors of Memory
details.short_description: A cozy adventure across two realities — a mysterious world of memories and the land of the living, where every choice matters. Wander the edge of forgetting, uncover lost stories, and find your own path — one that might change everything and paint the world in a whole new light.

name: The Xu Jing Chronicle: Illusory Dream

details.title: The Xu Jing Chronicle: Illusory Dream
details.short_description: “The Xu Jing Chronicle: Illusory Dream” is a choice-driven visual novel. Some old peculiar research notes, inadvertently unlocked a gateway through time and space. What is illusion? What is reality? Make your choice and unlock exclusive endings. But there is only one truth!

details.title: Dawnrazor
details.short_description: Step into the decaying world of Kagenovia in Dawnrazor, a story-driven 8-bit action adventure! Take control of Zedekiah, a betrayed knight reborn through parasitic vampirism, as he fights through blood-soaked ruins and biomechanical horrors.

details.title: The Backrooms : Lost Guest
details.short_description: The Backrooms : Lost Guest is a visually realistic, co-op survival horror exploration game developed with UE5, supporting 1 – 6 players. Evade terrifying creatures and deadly hazards while solving room-based puzzles to find your way out of the Backrooms. A chilling adventure awaits you…

details.title: 這個觸手…是我的…隊友！？
details.short_description: "Is This Tentacle… My Teammate?!" is an exploration RPG blending dark fantasy, alternative history, and character-driven narrative. Set in 17th-century in Kingdom of Lancaster . A young girl meets a mysterious tentacle monster, they embark on an extraordinary fantasy adventure together.

details.title: The Urbexan Files
details.short_description: A first-person co-op urban exploration horror game where you hunt for procedural loot in eerie, seamless liminal spaces. Team up with friends or explore solo to extract valuables before a relentless entity wakes. Manage your sanity, avoid line of sight, and loot before you are hunted down.

details.title: Paper Florist: Stack & Bloom
details.short_description: 🌼 Paper Florist is a cozy card stacking puzzle. Match flower orders 🌷 balance wobbly stacks 💌 race the timer ⏳ and grow your tiny florist studio into a blooming success 💐✨

name: In a World Full of Zombies I'm the Only One Who Doesn't Get Attacked: Road to Heaven

details.title: In a World Full of Zombies I'm the Only One Who Doesn't Get Attacked: Road to Heaven
details.short_description: A man the zombies will not attack fights to protect his allies and base as they journey toward Heaven. Prepare defenses, deploy allies, upgrade equipment, and set traps to survive the horde in this RTS and tower defense hybrid.

details.title: SKULD
details.short_description: Fight on the front line of your own defense. As Skuld, the Norn of fate turned Valkyrie, cut through waves of Hela's corrupted creatures in fast third-person combat while you place and upgrade turrets around you. A Norse action tower defense, set after Ragnarök.

details.title: 在路上 On The Road
details.short_description: On the Road is an idle road trip game from Chengdu to Lhasa along Highway 318. Choose your vehicle, plan your supplies, and explore the scenery along the way. Let the journey unfold at your own pace, whether you're busy at work or ready for a little road trip on your desktop.

details.title: Prison of Doubles
details.short_description: 1-4 player horror. Following the Chernobyl disaster, mutated parasites possess humans, turning them into monsters. As a prison intake guard, you process incoming transfers: both regular criminals and those only pretending to be human. Let a double slip through, and a nightly bloodbath awaits.

details.title: Neon Orbit
details.short_description: Neon Orbit is a 360° radial gravity puzzle roguelite. Rotate planets, slot blocks falling toward the core, and draft card synergies to break the rules of the game. Face boss anomalies, survive system collapse, and conquer the Multiverse Rift.

details.title: Wonderdeck
details.short_description: Poker hands rewrite your weapon. Slot in cards, complete a hand, and change how you attack. Dodge-roll and shoot through a strange Wonderland in an action roguelike shaped by your choices.

details.title: Tidy Tidy
details.short_description: A casual healing organizing game. No complex controls—just click and drag to logically sort and arrange items across scenes, turning clutter into order. With no time limits, savor the relaxation and healing of tidying up.

details.title: Grannies on Wheels
details.short_description: Battle it out in chaotic single screen party game where Monster Truck driving Grannies fight for jam and survival! Smash, crash, and outwit your rivals in dynamic arenas, packed with physics, mini-games, and laugh-out-loud chaos.

details.title: GIGANTIC☆MAIDESTRUCTION
details.short_description: A giant maid wreaks havoc on the city under the pretext of defeating enemies! Gigantic Destruction Action Game!

details.title: Walls of Fate
details.short_description: Rule a fortress on the brink of collapse: listen to the residents’ requests, manage limited resources and time, strengthen relationships with key characters in the fortress, and move closer to solving the mystery of the ruler’s disappearance.

details.title: Periphery
details.short_description: Periphery is a psychedelic action-horror game. Uncover the truth about your workspace, get introduced to the locals and their gnostic fascination. Warp into the pixelated world of Periphery and experience surreal world built on mystery.

details.title: Edge on Truth
details.short_description: Explore the settlement, gather clues, interact with its inhabitants, and uncover a conspiracy. Your actions shape your relationships with the locals – will they help you, or deceive you? Your choices will determine whether the protagonist can escape, or if his tragic fate will repeat itself again.

details.title: Kharvalen
details.short_description: Survive endless waves of enemies in Kharvalen. Choose a race, switch between two weapon sets, and combine manual attacks with auto-attacking artifacts to create devastating builds. Play solo, in co-op with up to 4 players, or in 1v1 and 2v2 PvP.

details.title: One Pop Planet
details.short_description: A Tetris-like puzzle game, played with a single button, and pieces that fall from all four directions. Match colourful pixel art pieces to feed your planet and hit the leaderboard, all while dealing with escalating speed, meteor storms, black holes, and more!

details.title: I Became a Cat
details.short_description: You woke up as a cat, can you find a way to be human again?

details.title: RULES OF RESIDENCE
details.short_description: You bought your dream home... but it wasn't all you chalked it up to be. As a member of its management committee, rewrite the rules to change the lives of your neighbours and your family for the better in this singleplayer management simulator. Or will you become what you sought to fight against?

details.title: SHORAPAN
details.short_description: SHORAPAN — a dark parable of a strange city beneath an eternal crimson sky. Those who doubt it aloud are the first it takes.

details.title: Stellar Wreck
details.short_description: Repair your spaceship, explore mysterious planets, battle strange creatures, and survive in this sci-fi sandbox RPG where every journey becomes a new adventure.

details.title: Dodo Factory
details.short_description: An incremental game where you construct a giant meat factory to raise dodos and mass murder them (ethically). Grow your factory from a small dodo grinder to a huge processing facility as you collect meat to upgrade buildings and unlock new crazy dodo types.

details.title: Umbraelum
details.short_description: A human and a specter, fused into one being, venture into the heart of darkness in this isometric action roguelite. Combine ancient artifacts and shards of corrupted power to unleash devastating synergies. The more power you embrace, the deadlier the consequences.

details.title: The Fledge
details.short_description: Lost adrift in the Antarctic, your hatchling is all that matters. Hunt, evade predators, feed and protect your only offspring in this short, atmospheric penguin survival experience. Each day is a race to stay alive, as the frozen oceans you once called home are overwhelmed by unfamiliar forces.

details.title: Rebuilt: Last Settlement
details.short_description: Manage the last farmhouse settlement in a zombie-infested city. Grow food, craft weapons, send teams to scavenge, and defend your settlement every night from relentless zombie hordes until you are strong enough to escape.

details.title: Weed Out
details.short_description: A bullet heaven with a slot machine for a level-up. The crops have risen — mow down hordes of mutant plants, spin the reels, and build around whatever drops: buffs, curses and nearly a hundred game-warping Jokers.

details.title: Amara
details.short_description: Manage and grow your cozy café from scratch in a world full of adorable talking cats. Craft authentic coffee drinks inspired by real barista techniques, upgrade your shop, serve your fluffy customers, and become beloved by all.

details.title: Scrappers: Adhokin
details.short_description: Scrappers: Adhokin is a top-down PVE extraction shooter with base building and shopkeeping. Haul scrap and blueprints home from ruins overrun by feral robots. Build your hideout with the salvage, expand your arsenal and facilities, and sell the rest to run the best scrap shop around.

details.title: Super Tag
details.short_description: Tag, with super powers! Super Tag is a 2D chase platformer: swing, blink and wall-jump away from the endless hord, or hunt down your friends in multiplayer mode.

details.title: Hold the Line
details.short_description: Hold the Line is a top-down 2D roguelite survival game. Survive on a procedurally generated island, prepare by day, endure the night, forge your survival build, adapt to dynamic events, and face the final trial on Day 7.

details.title: The Wyoming Incident
details.short_description: A Wyoming town evacuated overnight in 1982. Your car is dead. The TV is on. Hold onto your sanity while the broadcast gets inside your head, dive into corrupted TVs to silence the towers, and find six keys to get out. Psychological horror with six endings, inspired by the infamous creepypasta.

details.title: Lane Glitch
details.short_description: Lane Glitch is a fast-paced cyberpunk combat racing game where you drive an armed car through neon-lit highways, dodging obstacles and destroying enemy vehicles. Choose your path on a branching map, upgrade your ride, and face powerful bosses.

details.title: Slay the King
