details.short_description: Chess, but you build an army, bolt game-breaking augments onto your pieces, and tear through realms of enemies. Exploding pawns, bishops that cleanse the board with holy fire, a king that ascends into a demon slaying god. Stack upgrades, ascend, get rich, Slay The King.

details.title: The Survival Show
details.short_description: Survive the deadliest future game show in The Survival Show! Jump over razor-sharp lasers, dodge killer robots, and hurl live bombs before the clock runs out. Test your reflexes in a top-down arena, entertain the crowd, and claim the billionaire grand prize!

details.title: Within The Experiments
details.short_description: A system-driven turn-based RPG bringing new strategy to the classic Wizardry-style formula. Cut in on enemy actions with the "Interrupt Timeline Battle" system. Lead a five-member party, strengthen your team through combat and item discovery, and explore the dungeon's depths.

details.title: Office Overlord
details.short_description: From Interns to CEOs, every coworker has a role to play. Build your team, discover unexpected synergies, and take on rival companies in a tactical RPG where every coworker can make a difference.

details.title: American Navy SEALs
details.short_description: Lead an elite Navy SEAL fireteam into a cinematic next-gen tactical shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Command your squad, master authentic weapons, and fight through deadly global missions where every order, every shot, and every life matters.

details.title: Send Forth the Brave
details.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilder where you run an Adventurers’ Guild. Combine heroes, weapons, and items into teams, fulfill quirky commissions, deal with difficult clients, and build the most powerful guild in the realm.

details.title: Alone: far from home
details.short_description: A psychological survival horror game on Mars. After a catastrophic expedition, you are left alone on the Red Planet. Rebuild your ruined base, restore contact with Earth, and find a way home while uncovering the truth behind the disaster, before isolation and the fight for survival break your mind..

details.title: 吾之半身乃纯白恶魔
details.short_description: 黑神露娜，是一名喜欢「中二幻想」的普通高中少女。 某一天，一场意外让她的日常彻底改变。一位与她有着不可思议联系的神秘少女突然出现，原本平静的校园生活，也随之卷入了一连串难以解释的事件。 当真相逐渐浮出水面，她们将如何面对彼此、面对命运，又将做出怎样的选择？

details.title: Beyond the Bars
details.short_description: Play as a prisoner, guard, or warden. Scheme, trade, and betray, or lock everything down. In this multiplayer social game of control and escape. The prison is yours to use… or break out of.

details.title: I’m A Food Delivery Guy
details.short_description: 送外卖，攒彩礼，目标 18 万 8！“想娶我女儿，彩礼必须 18 万 8，一分都不能少！”，丈母娘的一句话，让你决定离开电子厂，开始全职送外卖，努力奋斗，只为攒够彩礼，迎娶你的心上人。

details.title: Phone Booth
details.short_description: You are currently trapped inside a phone booth. When you pick up the receiver, the number “99” appears on the display, and a countdown begins. From among the vast number of flyers covering the walls on all four sides, find and peel off two flyers with exactly the same design that aren’t overlapping.

details.title: Core Module
details.short_description: In this cyberpunk themed Roguelike card game, you can build your own deck, connect the pathways between cards, and along those pathways cyclically trigger each card's unique abilities. This allows cards to continuously cooperate with each other and unleash powerful combined effects.

details.title: Summer Snow.
details.short_description: Escape the endless midsummer in this time-loop mystery visual novel. Find the "exit key," solve the cryptic MAZE app's missions, and reach the future with your childhood friends! A coming-of-age drama with stunning visuals, a 300k-character voiced script, diverse puzzle mechanics, and no bad ends.

details.title: Dig Dan Dig!
details.short_description: Dig for resources and trade them for powerful biological upgrades in this incremental mining adventure. Transform yourself beyond human limits to escape the underground!

details.title: Whazzy Whizmo
details.short_description: Unleash marble-fueled chaos onto the cosmos! Build zany contraptions that let your marbles soar across the stars. You have full creative freedom, so go wild.

details.title: Let 'Em Cast
details.short_description: Let 'Em Cast is an action roguelike for 1–4 players where wizards battle hordes of everyday junk brought to life. Craft your own devastating spell combinations and blast your way across the fragments of a shattered magical world.

details.title: Station Between
details.short_description: A cozy, small-scale, coffee shop and talking simulator. As a raccoon barista, you have a gift for warming people’s hearts: brew coffee, match flavours to your customers and discover their stories. Help travellers sort out their final errands before they catch their last train.

name: 追光探偵物語 FOLLOWSPOT — A Detective Story

details.title: 追光探偵物語 FOLLOWSPOT — A Detective Story
details.short_description: A retro-flavored, command-based detective adventure in the style of classic Japanese PC games. Set in the early 2000s.

details.title: Shadow Business
details.short_description: A single-player crime auto-battler: your gang against theirs. Drag your crew into the lanes and watch them punch through enemy lines. Wreck the rival limo before the cops arrive!

details.title: Antropico: Colonies
details.short_description: A large-scale space strategy game focused on building and maintaining power within a simulated galaxy. Build, develop, and survive in a galaxy shaped by history and consequences.

details.title: Arcane Souls
details.short_description: Enter a fantasy world full of magic in this action soulslike RPG. Master deadly combat, shape your own unique spells, and face colossal bosses. Survive the unforgiving challenges alone, or spill blood alongside a friend in full online co-op.

details.title: Project Substrata
details.short_description: Dig, build, connect—and watch your factory come to life. Shape the terrain, link mining and production lines, and manage power in a first-person base-building and automation game. Restoring a ruined planet is our long-term development goal.

details.title: Football Life
details.short_description: Beyond tactics and transfers, build and run your club as the manager—facility expansion and upgrades, staff, budgets, board relations, and youth recruitment and academy intake.

details.title: Legion Draft
details.short_description: An async PvP card auto-battler filled with dogs! Each card represents an ever-growing troop of soldiers. Draft, recruit, and build a powerful legion. Discover fantasy races reimagined as different dog breeds, explore unique synergies, and outsmart your opponents to become the ultimate strategist!

details.title: Intrigue Romance
details.short_description: Step into Asterhaven’s open world for a strategic RPG with boundless possibilities! Interact with 1,500+ rNPCs of diverse classes, ethnicities and personalities, forming a vast social network and branching storylines.Every decision triggers a butterfly effect, altering the world’s trajectory.

details.title: The Umbral Seal
details.short_description: WoW raid mechanics meet FTL's pause-and-plan combat. Command 5-20 heroes through 30+ tactical boss encounters. No grinding. No filler. Pure single-player boss-rush strategy.

details.title: Flavio The Ghost Clown
details.short_description: Battle challenging bosses in this Run & Gun action game. Generate resources in a tycoon-style workshop and upgrade your equipment in the shop to guide Flavio through these bizarre battles!

details.title: Quarantine Zombies 2: Day Zero
details.short_description: From the lead game designer of Quarantine Zone and Quarantine Zombies comes a new mix of inspection sim and open-world shooter in Chicago. Determine the stage of infection and transport infected refugees through hostile streets to the Captain before they turn. Continue Hank and his brother’s story.

details.title: Stillwell
details.short_description: Minesweeper meets horror. Deterministic grid puzzles with clear rules. Use your lantern, flashlight, and chalk to escape before your oxygen runs out.

details.title: Escape the Doom
details.short_description: A physics-based endless runner that demands precise vehicle control. Fly fast and dodge hazards as you race through time to escape the impending Doom.

details.title: Feudums
details.short_description: Lead your noble house through brutal wars, shifting allegiances and economic strife in an asynchronous multiplayer 4X strategy. Shape the narrative with or against real players in a medieval world where diplomacy isn't binding, there is NO pay-to-win, and only strategy determines your legacy.

details.title: Kalyskah
details.short_description: Fight as a vampire while exploring a dark fantasy open-world in this 3rd person RPG. Make choices to affect the betterment of humanity– or yourself; strengthen your vampiric skills to fight bandits, trolls, and undead; and entertain yourself in fully animated seductive scenes.

details.title: Witch Slide
details.short_description: Skate and explore a fantastical world of ice and snow on your own or team up with other witches. Carve spells into the snow, overcome challenges and race your friends! Singe-player and 2-4 player online co-op supported

details.title: Bunker Builder Simulator
details.short_description: Plan your work, dig a hole and build a bunker, that will survive anything! Manage safety, needs and moods of your clients, so you can become the best architect and earn a fortune. Will you be able to meet the expectations?

details.title: Multi Idle
details.short_description: An idle RPG featuring a large focus on the customization of your play style to make every run unique. Create unbreakable skill combinations and advance your fighter to the point that even boss monsters will fear their strength!

details.title: The Adventures Of Bryan Scott
details.short_description: "The Adventures of Bryan Scott" is a classic 2D point-and-click adventure game, inspired by masterpieces like "Broken Sword" and "Deponia".

details.title: Timeless Heart VR
details.short_description: Timeless Heart VR is a story-driven VR action adventure. Join Lycaena in battle, wield different weapons, and use your Chain Claw to race through four kingdoms frozen on the eve of ruin. Only by defying fate again can you reach the final answer.

details.title: Diode Arena
details.short_description: Design, build, and pilot bots with wildly varying movement abilities and weapons, then use them in online cross-platform PvP matches. Earn cash and advance through the tiers of the tech tree to unlock new parts and build better, faster, stronger bots.

details.title: They Speak From The Abyss
details.short_description: Lost in a cursed world. Surrounded by the tortured souls of the damned. Is the only way out truly a baptism in blood? Face demons head-on, talking or fighting your way through this surreal, psychological horror, dungeon crawling RPG.

details.title: My wife is a princess
details.short_description: A traitor appeared in the kingdom, and the seal of the demon king was lifted. In order to save the kingdom~the beautiful queen sent a rescue request to the brave...The price was to become the wife of the brave!

details.title: Mars Tactics
details.short_description: The Red Planet is at war. Lead either Capital’s corporate army or Labor’s worker revolutionaries and wage war across a vast strategic map, then assume direct control in turn-based tactical battles featuring artillery, vehicles, and fully-destructible environments.

details.title: Dstroy 2
details.short_description: Dstroy 2 is a bombermania local multiplayer game.

details.title: Bosslords
details.short_description: Gather an army of monsters and misfits to march on the Imperial Capital in this fantasy roguelite auto battler. Explore procedurally generated worlds filled with powerful weapons and artifacts as you gather new recruits to take to battle and show them who's boss!

details.title: Adrorium
details.short_description: Build your ship, defend against drone waves and explore hundreds of sectors filled with stations, asteroids and planets with lots of POIs. The ship systems can be controlled via consoles with several hundred buttons. Craft equipment and blocks, loot the POIs and disabled drones.

details.title: Alchemic Beasts
details.short_description: A monster-taming RPG where the social chemistry between your beasts shape how they bond, battle, and build. Join Zieg and Mioni to reclaim the wild paradise of Mizu, tame powerful monsters, and restore the resort to its former glory.

details.title: Wind Runners
details.short_description: Wind Runners is a high-speed bullet-hell dogfighting roguelite where you start as a lone pilot, turning each flight into a fight for freedom. Face the ruthless technotheist Realm, take on relentless fleets and colossal bosses, and let your victories ignite a growing resistance across the star system

details.title: Cyberlink Chaos
details.short_description: Cyberlink Chaos is a fast paced online multiplayer arena-slasher. Jack into your PMNCU and fight in the cybernetic forever war. Encased in metal, your soul is reborn - will you fight?

details.title: Urban Green
details.short_description: A romantic visual novel about love, life and loserdom. Take the role of Jack, a young man starting a new job at an environmental charity in search of a jumpstart to his stalled life. What he'll find, be it love, heartbreak, or just more of the same, is up to you.

details.title: DATUM: Rescue One
details.short_description: A single-player helicopter search and rescue game. Fly through storms and darkness, locate survivors with FLIR, confirm with your searchlight, and bring them home. No weapons. Only the sea, the night, and time.

details.title: Alice in BLUE
details.short_description: Alice in Blue is a deckbuilding roguelike strategy game featuring tactical roulette combat. Slot cards onto a spinning wheel, adjust their positions, and unleash powerful card synergies to overcome the dangers of a bizarre dream world.

details.title: Freeze, Dummy!
details.short_description: Freeze time, hang your bullets and grenades across a frozen world, shove enemies into each other's crossfire, then let time run and survive the chaos. A physics-driven FPS sandbox about directing explosions: chain reactions, style scoring, replays.

details.title: Mana Alchemy
details.short_description: An open-world bullet heaven RPG. Explore a cursed island, forge spells via alchemy, and arrange them in your grimoire like a puzzle. Mow down monster hordes and hunt your 7 ruling sisters. Your final choice—execute or forgive them—determines the ending of this dark fantasy.

details.title: CONQ: CROWN OF NO QUARTER
details.short_description: You were promised the heavens, but found only eternal purgatory -- unable to escape, unable to truly die. Gather your forces across sea and land, show no mercy, and give your enemies no quarter. It's time to bleed again.

details.title: CAPTIVE LOVE♡MELTY HOLIC
details.short_description: Ruito, a popular underground idol, is suddenly kidnapped and confined in an unfamiliar abandoned building. Blocked by tricky traps and relentlessly pursued by obsessive stans—can Ruito safely escape this building of madness...?

details.title: Anomaly Logistics
details.short_description: Entities, objects, and domains that defy the laws of physics to wield powers beyond human comprehension—these are collectively known as "Anomalies." Suppress these myriad Anomalies, strip them of their power, and harness it to descend into the deepest abyss. What truth lies waiting at the very end?

details.title: Stray Light
details.short_description: What the eye sees is a prison.” Lost in a cursed forest, ancient streetlights are your only escape. Shift seamlessly between a grim reality and beautiful memories to eliminate obstacles and solve dual-world puzzles. Remember: what blocks you here might not exist on the other side.

details.title: Coin to Crown
details.short_description: Build your adventuring career in a fantasy tactical RPG for 1–4 players. Take guild contracts, travel between towns, and master turn-based battles with timed blocks and dodges. Discover traits through your deeds, upgrade your gear, and rise through the ranks.

details.title: Observation Protocol: The Observed
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror where you wake, again and again, inside a facility that studies you. Each cycle the rooms change, the pattern deepens, and something begins to take shape. The longer you observe, the harder it becomes to tell where the simulation ends.

details.title: Slab Drifter
details.short_description: Slab Drifter is a space-based tactical physics destruction game. The Slab was fractured. The Lords were born. All that remains are corrupted machines and the drifters who scavenge among them. Pilot your drones to hunt the massive Lords and discover their weaknesses.

details.title: Virus Promoter
details.short_description: Welcome aboard, Virus Promoter! One card sparks a chain reaction. One Trinket bends the rules. One combo sends the numbers spiraling out of control! Build your outrageous deck and spread your viruses on an unprecedented scale! Your success is the world's catastrophe!

details.title: Last Drop Tavern
details.short_description: A psychological roguelite gambling game set in an oil-painted bar between this life and the next. You and a rival take turns dropping coins into a single glass; whoever makes it overflow loses their chance at the afterlife. No interface, no numbers, just the rising liquid and the coin in your hand.

details.title: FatCat Nexus
details.short_description: A challenging 2D action platformer featuring unique weapons, precise gameplay, and intense combat. Master your arsenal and defeat dangerous enemies in a world full of challenges.

details.title: Pnevmo-Capsula: Dieselnautica
details.short_description: Navigate a mail capsule to deliver a crucial letter to the Captain across a flying scrap-city. Collect lamps: the toll for passing Checkpoints - solve physics puzzles, dodge traps and fines. If you don’t have enough lamps, the hammers will crush you. A grim puzzle-platformer where every lamp counts.

details.title: Midwatch Engineer
details.short_description: You are a ship engineer, keep watch at night, build and repair stuff on a lathe and a milling machine by day. In this Game you will machine parts from raw metal instead of just combining items to craft. You directly control the axis of the lathe.

details.title: The Hanging Game
details.short_description: Hangman on paper is over. Here, you are in the noose. Explore a malevolent graveyard for letters while an eerie, deceptive voice whispers in your ear—learning from your mistakes and actively lying to you. Can you solve the word before the rope snaps?

details.title: Spell Breakers
details.short_description: Build your Spell Deck, defeat your rivals, and aim for the top of the mysterious tournament, Spell Breakers! This is a new kind of auto-battle roguelike game where collecting over 300 spells is the key to victory!

details.title: Pfand Raiders
details.short_description: Dash and ride through a rock festival in this absurd, music-driven co-op runner! Dodge obstacles to the beat, loot empty cans ("Pfand"), cash them in for beer and burp everything out of your way. Will you make it to The Butcher Sisters' show in time?

details.title: Deviled Dice
details.short_description: Beat the devil at his own game by cheating harder than he does in this tabletop-style roguelite dicebuilder. Rig your dice for suspicious luck, conveniently swap the rules mid-game, and cunningly combine relics from other tabletops to set the scorepad on fire!

details.title: Wēlandes
details.short_description: Solve ancient mysteries in the ethereal world of Anglo-Saxon Britain. You are the spel-wefa, use your magical translation devices to help the gods, beasts, and gentlefolk of Old English poetry. Journey the ageless chalk hills surrounding Wayland’s Smithy; unearth the stories that wander within.

details.title: Taxistanbul: Istanbul Taxi Simulator
details.short_description: Drive a yellow cab through a faithfully recreated Istanbul. Pick up fares on the real streets of the historic peninsula, pay your daily cut to the plate owner, cover fines, fuel and repairs, and try to end every shift in profit.

name: Grandma's Guide to the Grand Outside

details.title: Grandma's Guide to the Grand Outside
details.short_description: Grandma calls for aid! Well… she wants a visit, but she lives in the middle of nowhere. Pack wisely, step into the wilderness, and see if you can reach her!

details.title: Summon Defenders Now!
details.short_description: Eliminate opponents for resources, summon defenders to fend off waves of invaders across different regions in this lane-based tower defense game. Interact with your defenders, exploit the weakspots of enemies, and turn the tide of the battle.

details.title: Rose of Dragontail
details.short_description: Kick tail with tail! Enjoy blazing-fast beat-em-up action as Rose, the scrappy fishing village girl turned half-dragon hero. Kick, slam, tail slap, tackle, pile drive, spit fire, and throw whatever and whoever you get your claws on to a groovy surf rock soundtrack.

details.title: CHICKEN MINE
details.short_description: Chicken Mine is a 1-4 players co-op horror mining game where you are chickens trying to get rich with your friends.

details.title: Cartridge Survivors
details.short_description: Dash across a 5×7 grid, dodge enemy attacks, and mow down hordes of enemies! Collect Skill Chips and build up your loadout in this grid-based survivor action game!

details.title: Sizzling
details.short_description: Play a small rolling ball in a relaxing adventure incremental game. Enhance your ball and your world as you progress, discover its mysteries and push back its frontiers to learn why this world went blank !

details.title: Flailbo
details.short_description: Soar and dive through the world of Flailbo! Meet curious characters and restore happiness to the Frends by returning their missing belongings! Platform and explore colorful areas to help all thirty Frends!

details.title: Sneak Souls
details.short_description: A familiar cubic aesthetic, an extinct ancient underground civilization, and a living plant. Check out what awaits you!

details.title: Ode to War
details.short_description: A civilization MMO: from a single town to a galactic empire. The server ticks once an hour and keeps running while you sleep. You administer towns, not a nation, so each one holds its own stores and anything you need from a neighbor has to be traded for.

details.title: Ruminate: The First Oath
details.short_description: This is a dark fantasy where the world has been divided and cursed. Your party will go on adventures and have the chance to remove the curses from the kingdoms and unite them! The world depends on you. Will you be their saviour or their downfall?

name: Heroic Hop: The Colorful World of Blocks and the ChromaLords

details.title: Heroic Hop: The Colorful World of Blocks and the ChromaLords
details.short_description: Jump into a vibrant retro platforming adventure! Defeat the five Color Lords, conquer deadly traps, collect Enemy Badges, uncover hidden secrets, and restore the colorful Block Kingdom. Includes a playable demo!

details.title: Run Friend Run
details.short_description: A party game for 1–8 players where one races to the finish and everyone else tries to stop them! Hide traps where your friends least expect them, then send them flying when they get close.

details.title: Count My Coins, Coin Counter!
details.short_description: Count coins with a cast of silly characters as you add up currencies, convert their money, appraise jewels, and pick out forgeries.

details.title: Yuoh　～Escape from the Empire～
details.short_description: A sleek, fast-paced vertical bullet-hell shooter. Harness a vast arsenal of gear and shatter the tactics of the relentless enemies closing in.

details.title: Moonfeather
details.short_description: While searching for the truth behind the massacre of your home village, you unexpectedly encounter the fallen Moon Goddess; she chooses you and possesses your body, passing on her divine powers. Forced to accept her mission, you must battle your way through waves of monsters, fighting ever deeper.

details.title: Wyrdane
details.short_description: Wyrdane is a tactical online card game where every decision matters. Build unique decks, master strategic battles, collect powerful cards, and outplay your opponents in a dark fantasy world shaped by magic, mystery, and skill.

details.title: Pactum
details.short_description: Summon angels and demons, fuse them and watch them evolve on a floating island. A calm, relaxing incremental to unwind: upgrade without limits, watch your creatures grow, and enjoy the journey at your own pace.

details.title: Blooming Days
details.short_description: Grab your watering can, find some seeds and make the desert around you bloom. - No combat, no death, no timer. Just you, your animals and your garden.

details.title: Electric Noosphere
details.short_description: A story-driven sci-fi RTS. After the Third World War, flesh and machine became one: the Singularians. Following a signal from the Veil, their fleet is torn out of hyperspace and crashes near the source, a world that is already a nest. Two asymmetric factions, one campaign.

details.title: Space Crawlers
details.short_description: Clear out space battlefields using a physics-based grappling hook. Salvage wreckage, recycle it into resources, upgrade your equipment, and grow your salvage business to unlock increasingly lucrative contracts.

details.title: Hordia
details.short_description: Cut down endless hordes of monsters and become absurdly powerful! Loot, upgrade, and stack augments into wild builds. Hold the island with cannons and traps, hunt down the bosses waiting out on the map, and survive as long as you can. Solo or online co-op!

details.title: Heavenlode
details.short_description: The online scifi roguelike. Conquer planets, foil other players, create game-breaking builds, and secure the Heavenlode.

details.title: RUGS!
details.short_description: Grandpa left you his rug-cleaning shop. Grab up to three friends, haul filthy rugs across town in a beat-up pickup, then scrub, rinse, beat and dry them and get them back before the deadline. Slippery floors, flying carpets, police chases. Save up for a ticket to Mars.

details.title: The Edge of the Backrooms
details.short_description: After discovering a strange anomaly on Jupiter's moon, Europa, you find yourself in the outer reaches of a dangerous, uncanny complex.

details.title: Orbital Strike
details.short_description: A real-time strategy game of orbital warfare. Build satellites, launch them into chosen orbits, and fight for control of the sky. Your assets stay invisible until an enemy sensor finds them. Every strike depends on being overhead at the right moment.

details.title: A Week to Remember
details.short_description: Help Elliot recover his memories and unlock the truth of what happened before it's too late. A Mexican-American gothic, queer visual novel, featuring interactive spell crafting and point-and-click exploration.

details.title: Thorny Times
details.short_description: Lead a mercenary company through story-driven fantasy scenarios. Capture castles, manage scarce resources, evolve your fighters, and solve puzzle-like turn-based battles where positioning matters more than brute force.

details.title: Crescent County
details.short_description: Crash headfirst into this witch-tech world, drifting and driving on the back of your new motorbroom. Make deliveries, trick out your broom, and race your new friends (and crushes) as the sun sets. Get into gossip, sort your life out, and discover what it means to find home.

details.title: Color Lim
details.short_description: Set in a post-apocalyptic world, Color Lim follows Lim, a colorless slime on a quest to find his true color. Change colors to navigate, transform into enemies to use their abilities, and solve puzzles to shape Lim's unique journey.

details.title: Play Rough
details.short_description: PLAY ROUGH is a roleplaying game set in the surreal, post-apocalyptic wasteland of what was once California. It's a place where humans live side-by-side with living cartoons, twisted abominations of ink and flesh, and... Clowns...?

details.title: Mithrall
details.short_description: Mithrall: Realm of the Dwarves is a massive survival-sandbox MMO. Dig into the mountains, build kingdoms above and below ground, claim and tax the land, and fight from skirmish to siege in a vast realm shared by up to 15,000 players.

name: Mops & Mobs: A Sweeping Dungeon Adventure

details.title: Mops & Mobs: A Sweeping Dungeon Adventure
details.short_description: Mops & Mobs is a humorous dungeon adventure, spicing up storytelling with decoration quests and card-based battles. Befriend eccentric monsters and solve problems as the dungeon’s janitor. Clean, decorate, investigate, and eventually uncover dangers threatening the dungeon.

details.title: BUS: Bro u Survived
details.short_description: Ride through the apocalypse with your friends! BUS: Bro U Survived is a co-op story-driven adventure featuring your very own bus! Fight zombies, gather resources, help other survivors, and solve puzzles. Can you uncover the truth about the beginning of the epidemic and decide the fate of the island?

details.title: Sternly Worded Adventures
details.short_description: Sternly Worded Adventures is a roguelite word puzzle RPG inspired by Bookworm Adventures where you travel through a forested peninsula with Yorkshire-sounding place names fighting monsters with the power of words to uncover whatever dark secrets may be lurking beyond.

details.title: 梦之彼方-fate prologue
details.short_description: “一位名叫蓝原逸的少年，在多年之后重返家乡，转入了小镇唯一的学校。八年的时光，小镇的一切已经发生了翻天覆地的变化，那些遗失的美好，珍贵的回忆，慢慢苏醒……这就是所谓的奇迹吗？男孩显得有些疑惑。此后，他与自己的青梅竹马相逢，结识了文学部的众人，开始了一日日平凡的校园时光……”她，如此这样地说着。 片刻的沉默，少女已然整理好了头发，系上了心爱的蝴蝶结，努力挤出了一个微笑，望向窗外。 “至少现在，已经足够了哟~因为你已经很坚强的努力过了，所以，已经不用再逞强了哟~” “在这个充满着奇迹与希望的世界里，无论是快乐的事，还是欣喜的事，全部，都会再得到延续。” “所以，已经足够了哟~”

details.title: Beyond Astra
details.short_description: Lead your civilization in a galaxy brimming with life and intrigue. Seamlessly explore and expand across uncharted worlds, from their surfaces to the stars. Forge your destiny in this sci-fi 4X offering a unique blend of grand strategy, planetary city-building, and RTS combat.

details.title: Decrepit
details.short_description: Decrepit is a first-person action game with souls-like combat where every death drags you back into the depths. Learn the dungeon, master the combat, and find your way out of the forsaken castle.

details.title: NOIR BLOOM
details.short_description: NOIR BLOOM is a high-octane 2D Gun-Fu action game, where adrenaline-fueled gunfights and skull-crushing close combat collide in a neo-noir rhapsody. Embark on a deadly rampage to honor the vow—strike, disarm, and turn foes into weapons. Every move is a calculated ballet of bullets and blood.

name: Greed Realm: Hero from Another World & the Soul Tree

details.title: Greed Realm: Hero from Another World & the Soul Tree
details.short_description: Greed Realm is a Roguelike Deckbuilder fused with Monopoly elements. As Priestess Gladis, enter the "Soul Tree" to cure your mother. Master deck building, dice manipulation, and backpack management to survive the gap between desire and nightmare.

details.title: Floralis
details.short_description: You are born from a tree in a post-human world ruled by sentient plants. Hide from predators, reawaken machines, and outwit living traps as you search for your twin and the truth of your birth in this cinematic puzzle adventure.

details.title: Harbor
details.short_description: Harbor is a first-person PvP survival game in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Scavenge, craft and build a base you can upgrade and defend. Team up, raid other players and chase down the War Truck and Blackrail train. Harbor is the only safe zone. Die out there and you can lose everything you carry.

details.title: Elementum
details.short_description: Elementum is a spell-crafting roguelike with bullet-hell elements. Fight your way out by defeating a wide range of enemies and discover a variety of spells and items to customize your build and play style!

details.title: Netcode Warriors
details.short_description: ⁤Dive into the datascape of 'Netcode Warriors', an anime-style arena fighter designed from the ground up to take competitive play to its limits. Engage in intense 1-v-1 fights, master unique characters and playstyles, then take your skills to the arena. ⁤

details.title: Survival Code: Rebirth
details.short_description: “Survival Code: Rebirth” is a third-person open-world extraction shooter set in the aftermath of an artificial intelligence uprising. As a survivor in a post-apocalyptic world ruled by machines, you must do whatever it takes to stay alive.

details.title: Incline ~Railway of devil's valley~
details.short_description: An action adventure with a quirky battle system that uses an inclined railway to carry and seal devils to a sacred boundary. Robbed of his weapons, the unarmed hero must keep dodging devil attacks in the cargo bed of an inclined railway until he reaches the sacred boundary at top floor of village!

details.title: Do Not Buy This Game
details.short_description: Are you really reading this to find out more? ...FINE! If you DO buy this game, expect me to narrate in your ear for around 2 hours about your poor life choices, all while I'll try to create something resembling a game for you to walk around in.

details.title: ARIDA 2: Rise of the Brave
details.short_description: Journey through the 19th-century Brazilian backlands in this narrative, culturally rich adventure. Face the drought to explore arid biomes, craft and manage resources, complete quests, and guide Cícera to Canudos - the mythical village promising to change the story forever.

details.title: ARTIFICIAL
details.short_description: ARTIFICIAL is a physics based first-person puzzle platformer inspired by Portal & Half-Life series. Interact with the environment, pick up and throw objects, sneak around enemies, control intricate physics-based mechanisms and learn how to survive in the underground colony of the Asteroid 2031 XT

details.title: The Way of Wrath
details.short_description: Forge your path as a Bronze Age tribal chieftain in this epic strategy RPG. Lead your tribe in a fight for survival against all odds as the elements, time, and a relentless foe seek to wipe your people out.

details.title: Junxions
details.short_description: Answer your true calling as a traffic engineer in Junxions! Featuring comprehensive simulation, construction, and management tools, use careful planning to build roadways, railways, and walkways, and the complex interactions between them.

details.title: DRIFT BOOM BOOM
details.short_description: Chase criminals, dodge missiles, upgrade your car, and smash the competition. Chaotic Combat Racing with Eurobeat. 🚗💥💥

details.title: Fortune Guy
details.short_description: Fortune Guy combines traditional Monopoly and roguelike elements, use your luck and wisdom to become the wealthiest player!

details.title: Univoyager
details.short_description: Experience a 1:1 scale, procedurally generated universe with seamless exploration from planets to stars. Journey across the cosmos with zero loading screens and realistic Newtonian physics. Trade, fight, and survive in a post-apocalyptic galaxy where gravity is your only boundary.

details.title: Floatineer
details.short_description: The game is set in a world where lands have vanished beneath the waves. Players experience life as floating engineers, using modular architectural blocks to rebuild shelters that can withstand various disasters and fulfill villagers' aesthetic requirements within a given time limit.

details.title: Headlice
details.short_description: Headlice is a reverse horror game where you play as an escaped biological abomination fleeing an inept corporation. Embrace your parasitic nature and become the monster you were meant to be.

details.title: OCRPG
details.short_description: An Arcade Styled RPG with surprises, laughs and horrors at every turn.

details.title: Free Stars: Children of Infinity
details.short_description: Experience a stellar space adventure and the sequel to The Ur-Quan Masters. Travel through hyperspace, engage in fast-paced combat, discover weird worlds, and meet a unique cast of truly alien aliens as you uncover a mystery that threatens the galaxy.

details.title: Alonecats
details.short_description: Colorful mischief-makers have settled in this valley. Solve puzzles to find them all in a new unique game in the genre of animal search.

details.title: Not Waste Wood
details.short_description: Forge your path in True Men Ascend, a dark fantasy action RPG with cultivation-inspired progression. Choose from 20 classes, hunt loot, master relics and Inner Arts, and challenge dungeons and bosses solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

details.title: Slum Dweller
details.short_description: Slum Dweller is a physics-based fighting game about typical situations that slum dwellers encounters on a daily basis. Try on the role of a slum dweller trying to survive in a harsh criminal environment or a street fighter taking part in underground tournaments.

details.title: Neko's Rage
details.short_description: Neko's Rage is a pixel art rogue-lite platformer set in a post apocalyptic future overrun with dangerous biomechanical robots. Play as the cyber Neko-01 unit and collect always more loots to upgrade your Hub and character.

details.title: DOLOS: Your Best Future
details.short_description: A sci-fi political thriller. Live the life of an operator of DOLOS, a social regulation system predicting everyone's future. Analyze applicants' profiles and decide about their lifetime career. Apply DOLOS' logic or find how to counter it ... but don't get fired!

details.title: Dungeons of Edera 2
details.short_description: Return to the land of Edera, where you play as a sword-for-hire, exploring environments, competing for contracts, and waging guerrilla warfare to become a legendary mercenary, alone or with friends.

details.title: MOONSHIRE
details.short_description: Embark on a journey to save MOONSHIRE as you navigate through a mysterious world filled with dungeons, weapons, upgrades, and fast-paced combat!

details.title: Breach Signal
details.short_description: Breach Signal is a 1-6 player co-op cosmic horror game. As a recruit of the FNA, lead expeditions into strange places and investigate mysterious anomalies that threaten our reality.

details.title: Conquest of Eldinar
details.short_description: Conquest of Eldinar is a Action Combat / Real Time Strategy hybrid game where you choose from one of 16 different Factions to play as while you build your base, train an army, and engage in large scale battles. The game supports both single-player campaigns and online multi-player matches.

details.title: Nomad: Steppeborn Saga
details.short_description: Nomad: Steppeborn Saga is an open world co-op survival crafting adventure set in a vast, ever changing world of nomadic culture. Explore, trade, forge alliances, and face threats while packing up camp, migrating, and forging your legacy.

details.title: DRINKRIME
details.short_description: On the first day of a long weekend, you pick up a talking liquor bottle on a bridge. It's Jin, a demon judged by the Demon King. Cursed to stay by his side, you team up to Jinterrogate sinners hiding around town. A Fill-in-the-Crime Interrogation Adventure in retro, limited-palette pixel art.

details.title: Bestiario
details.short_description: Bestiario is an exciting turn-based combat JRPG based on Spanish mythology and folklore, full of surprises. Should we call it an ÑRPG?

details.title: GameChanger - Episode 1
details.short_description: Take on the challenge to close the Great Five Portals in this varied 2D-Action-Adventure with Twin-Stick-Shooter Gameplay! Explore the vast Interworld, solve tricky puzzles in complex dungeons, shoot your way through hordes of mysterious entities and stop the dragon!

details.title: Bagsy
details.short_description: Dive into the colorful and captivating world of Bagsy, an infiltration game where cunning and strategy are your best weapons! Take on the role of a daring thief whose goal is to steal carefully guarded treasures from a variety of shops and banks.

details.title: Neon Rush
details.short_description: Speed through a neon city in this 2D retro racing game. Outsmart cops and rivals with skillful maneuvers. Immerse yourself in illegal racing, fueled by synthwave beats, and dominate as the underworld's top racer!

details.title: Heptic Arena
details.short_description: Squad up, hunt monsters, and crush the competition! Chase fame and fortune in Heptic Arena - the galaxy’s deadliest game show where infamy is power and ratings are king. Step into the spotlight and make them watch!

details.title: EINS
details.short_description: Narrative focused 3rd Person Drama-Horror experience set in the near future! As Lauren begins her new job in the global tech company, she is about to learn what hides behind the mirror.

details.title: Imagisty Card Collection
details.short_description: You are playing a casual game “I want to spin more gachas!” “I achieved something more by collecting more things!” Have you ever wondered...? Imagisty Card Collection is a simple game that focuses on collecting cards by opening packs of cards like a trading card game!

details.title: REVENGE CRYSTAL
details.short_description: Awaken in a fallen knight’s body, kept alive by a mysterious living crystal. Explore a ruined world with top-down Soulslike combat, elemental magic, and Metroidvania progression. You are not the knight—you are the will driving him.

details.title: Xplorite
details.short_description: Explore, fight, and uncover the secrets of planet Nargal in Xplorite, a hand-drawn action-exploration Metroidvania. Battle enemies, discover powerful upgrades, and explore hidden paths. The research team disappeared. Now it’s your turn to find out why.

details.title: Hexistence
details.short_description: Hexistence is a Tower Defense Roguelike Deckbuilder. Expand a procedural map, build towers, and cast spells while managing your hand in real time. Optimize your resources to survive increasingly demanding waves!

details.title: Neon Extermination
details.short_description: In this cyberpunk FPS, players navigate a dystopian city corrupted by a malevolent computer virus. You, armed with weapons and skills, unravels the secrets behind CyberCorp's experiments.

details.title: Fraudulent Idols
details.short_description: Investigate the sprawling pharmaceutical mega-facility, STRATA, where every choice matters. Uncover hidden secrets, forge alliances, solve complex puzzles, and fight your way through a cyberpunk conspiracy in a true immersive sim where no two playthroughs are ever the same.

details.title: Isolation One
details.short_description: Exciting action with puzzle elements and an interesting plot, which takes place on the huge spaceship Transporter P18. In this game, players will encounter an incredible mixture of science fiction and horror. Immerse yourself in a dark world where you need to survive at any cost.

details.title: Herosbine : The Unknown Island
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious open world, battle hundreds of uniquely assembled Herosbines, and claim their Hero Parts to combine their powers and shape your own combat style. Guide Tim through a story-rich journey of grief, identity, and self-discovery.

details.title: Trivals
details.short_description: A team hero sport with one rule: no passes, no score. Pass to charge the Elderball, borrow your teammate’s power, and take down the enemy Guardian, a goal that fights back and evolves with every hit.

details.title: Small Kingdoms
details.short_description: Small Kingdoms is a streamlined grand strategy and RTS game with procedurally generated campaigns. Build up your cities and armies on the world map and command your troops on the battlefield. Rule a medieval fantasy kingdom and conquer your rivals.

details.title: triMIno
details.short_description: A tile-matching roguelike. triMIno is a satisfyingly strategic tile puzzler where you crack open booster packs, draft your perfect tile set, and connect colours and shapes to unleash huge scoring chains. Every tile counts. How far can you push your next run?

details.title: Micro Rogue
details.short_description: Fight, Upgrade, Repeat! Micro Rogue is an action roguelite where you battle room by room against enemies that upgrade just like you. Build your power, outsmart evolving foes, and see how far you can climb before either side breaks the game!

details.title: Heroes of Abyss
details.short_description: Heroes of Abyss - a rogue-like tactics army battler. Guide the heroes through rooms full of different creatures. Equip and sacrifice your heroes in procedural dungeons as you fight your enemies!

details.title: Arcane Arena
details.short_description: Arcane Arena is a fast-paced multiplayer action game where spellcasters clash in team-based combat. Choose your class, master powerful abilities, and dominate the arena. Manipulate time, summon creatures, wield the elements, and combine magic with your team to claim victory.

details.title: Starship Colony
details.short_description: A deep starship colony sim. Build your starship, manage air, water, food, fuel, energy, temperature and psychology to keep your crew alive across vast distances. Closed-loop system in space. Mining, wiring, plumbing, in-ship factory, (alien?) radio signals & translation, diplomacy, combat, and more.

details.title: Battle for the Void
details.short_description: You will annihilate your opponents with an arsenal of over 40 types of weapons across multiple online game modes. Strange creatures and the destructible environment will make each gaming session unique! Level up and obliterate everything around you! are you ready to survive in the void?

details.title: THE SONG OF THE NIGHTRIDER
details.short_description: Unravel the secrets of evil love with sword and song. Become a sound witch and break the Nightrider's curse!

details.title: Ark Odyssey
details.short_description: Ark Odyssey is a top-down arcade shooter that lets you command an army of starships to fight against the force of void! Gather your fleet into formations, and build your team of evolving synergistic compositions. Order your army of Starforce through space and protect the cosmos!

details.title: THUNDERBOLT
details.short_description: THUNDERBOLT is a Roguelike Deckbuilder played on a tactical grid. Position yourself carefully and fight enemies room-by-room to escape the alien-infested Thunderbolt!

details.title: K2-18b: Legacy
details.short_description: Immerse yourself in the mysterious atmosphere of exoplanet K2-18b. Traverse its unusual labyrinths, uncover a captivating story, and reveal the world's secrets - all set to an atmospheric original soundtrack.

details.title: MONji
details.short_description: A virtual companion that lives on your desktop and shares your clock. MONjis grow in real time, from an egg to a grown-up adult shaped by time-based events and small choices. Explore new places, loot parts and craft unique visual mods for your device to show your personality. MONji grows on you !

details.title: My Necromancer's Library
details.short_description: Manage a medieval library: collect books, arrange shelves, assist patrons, and host community events! Hire adventurers to delve into the depths of a dead Necromancer’s lair for rare tomes. Restore and customize books while uncovering a character-driven tale in this peculiar mining town.

details.title: 囚人カウンセリング
details.short_description: An interactive prison adventure. You play as a psychiatrist, working one-on-one with inmates who have committed crimes. Use case files to choose appropriate responses and hand out items from the drawer to maintain their trust. Your choices can either open up or close the inmates.

details.title: Siege of Incrementalia
details.short_description: Command an undead army and lay siege to a continent in this incremental strategy game. Build war machines, sacrifice minions and automate hellish magic in your quest to unite the lands of Incrementalia by force.

details.title: Dwarven Digging Machine
details.short_description: Command dwarves as they build a huge dwarven digging machine. Harvest resources, find powerful artifacts, defend against your foes and conquer the underground in this incremental strategy game.

details.title: Swords & Adventures Mythlands
details.short_description: Choose a powerful hero and embark on an adventure that will take you across unknown lands, facing countless enemies and uncovering the secrets hidden in every corner of Mythlands.

details.title: Labygoudene
details.short_description: Welcome to Labygoudène ! A cooperative game that will put your friendship to the test. Explore a shifting, unstable maze of menhirs filled with surprises, where every turn can bring you closer to the exit… or tear your team apart for good. Stick together !

details.title: Thym
details.short_description: Thym have to find all the plants who hide in the wild countrysides of the kingdom. To acomplish this mission, he can count on his plant-scrapping book, and his flying ship.

details.title: Holon
details.short_description: Build factories inside factories. Extract shapes, automate production, and deliver increasingly complex designs to the Hub. Enter a Nest to build its machinery, reuse it as a single building, then fit smaller Nests inside larger ones to take your factory further. About this game

details.title: Juicicora
details.short_description: Explore Elyndor in a colorful cozy co-op adventure for up to five players! Discover 25 magical fruits, press powerful juices, master playful movement, meet quirky Souls, make a home, and sail into exciting challenges. Adventure together, chase best times, or challenge friends to duels!

details.title: Peep
details.short_description: Peep is a psychological horror game that mixes the retro PSX-style 3D perspective with 2D point-and-click. You awaken trapped in an ever-changing room with peepholes looking into different realities. Use your wits to solve twisted puzzles to help strange individuals and you may just escape alive.

details.title: Reborn
details.short_description: Reborn - an atmospheric first-person survival horror. Explore a dark mansion, uncover its secrets, and survive among infected people. Use weapons, stealth, and limited resources to find your way to the truth.

details.title: Sand to Soil
details.short_description: Turn this desert planet into a lush green habitat! Find seeds, manage water, and improve the soil levels. Sadly, you were sent on this mission with woefully insufficient equipment, so you will have to harness the most potent resource on the planet: a flowery species of sheep, and their poop.

details.title: DO NOT MISS
details.short_description: DO NOT MISS is a fast-paced arena FPS where every missed shot adds an enemy to the next wave. Fight back, grab weapons and upgrades, and use bizarre vending machines. Don't let your own mistakes doom your run.

details.title: Iron Command
details.short_description: A classic base-building RTS in the spirit of Command & Conquer and Dune 2 - harvest, build, research, attack. Play it on your monitor, or put on a headset and command from inside the battlefield, with your orders on a tablet on your wrist.

name: Riggin Farm: Raw Land to Riches

details.title: Riggin Farm: Raw Land to Riches
details.short_description: A long-form farming and business management RPG where you transform raw land into a thriving farm. Grow crops, raise livestock, sell at markets, hire employees, expand your operation, manage finances, and survive the unpredictable realities of farming.

details.title: TALES UNFOLD
details.short_description: Explore different worlds, share clues, and change each other’s surroundings as you restore tangled tales. TALES UNFOLD is a two-player online co-op puzzle adventure inspired by Korean folklore.

details.title: War Mart
details.short_description: The apocalypse is here and the shelves are emptying fast. You and your friends must get that last toilet paper roll in this co-op mayhem. Steal carts, sabotage your rivals, and fight dirty to reach the checkout first. Get what you need by any means necessary.

details.title: Deadship Protocol
details.short_description: Co-op action for 1 to 4 players, online or on one screen. Fight through four areas of a dead ship full of monsters. Your guns fire on their own: you move, dash and use your skill. Pick an upgrade after every room and beat a boss in each area.

details.title: Looking for a Property?
details.short_description: Listen to your customers, find out what they really want, and search for the right property to recommend in this real estate simulation and story-driven adventure. Work alongside your boss, Hisui Odate, at a small neighborhood agency and help each customer find a place they can truly call home.

details.title: Cairnforge
details.short_description: A sandbox based fantasy survival game. Invent. Craft. Use. Flourish.

details.title: HIVEROT
details.short_description: HIVEROT is a hardcore round-based zombie FPS. Fight evolving hordes across 10 maps, build powerful loadouts, discover secrets, and stand your ground against a wide variety of enemy types that stumble, burn, break, and fly as you cut your way through them.

details.title: Pingorile 2
details.short_description: Pingorile is back! In this 2D platformer, explore new and bigger levels, overcome obstacles and discover new environments. Can you build a rocket and fly to the Moon?

details.title: Slasher Manager
details.short_description: Become the slasher in a darkly comic horror clicker set inside a killer’s hand-drawn notebook. Turn Screams into ridiculous upgrades, chain combos, and automate the hunt—then take on bosses that change the rules. Nine locations. One very questionable career.

name: There is no HERO: Desktop Quest

details.title: There is no HERO: Desktop Quest
details.short_description: In this comedic desktop companion RPG, let the villagers worship your woolly savior, gather resources, build and defend your town, all while you are being productive!

details.title: NIGHTSWEEPER
details.short_description: NIGHTSWEEPER is a 3D puzzle adventure about recovering ancient artifacts from an abandoned white desert, sweeping the scars from their spells with Minesweeper-inspired puzzles, and selling them.

name: You're Absolutely Right! Or: A lovehate game about technology

details.title: You're Absolutely Right! Or: A lovehate game about technology
details.short_description: The authentic AI industry experience. Answer stupid user questions, make ethical company decisions, and uh... cause nobody any harm! An apocaloptimist game about technology!

name: Mykyta Pylypovych and the antikythera of the steppe

details.title: Mykyta Pylypovych and the antikythera of the steppe
details.short_description: Mykyta Pylypovych, PhD, has a little secret, an inner voice guiding him through difficult situations. Use classic parser commands or advise Mykyta with a natural language, to aid his perilous research activities and, maybe, to save the whole free world!

details.title: He Was Here
details.short_description: A psychological horror game where you play as an unnamed employee of Tervex Industries. Navigate a 2000s-era computer to explore the fragmented memories of Alex Smith, a patient experiencing psychosis. Piece together her distorted memories and uncover disturbing family secrets.

details.title: Share the Load
details.short_description: A co-op adventure where the journey is everything. Travel alone or with friends, protect a powerful orb, and brave a world filled with peril on your quest to destroy it. Every challenge strengthens or breaks your party. Will you reach the end of the road?

details.title: I Hear the Forest
details.short_description: A slow-burn folk horror. You play as a forest ranger who finds himself surrounded by talking trees, flying witches' heads, and cursed dryads. You'll be very lucky if you make it out of the forest alive.

details.title: Job Burnout
details.short_description: Psychological horror game about your lovely work. Absurd humor, incompetent management, pointless tasks, weird coworkers, and monsters that show up in the office after the workday ends.

details.title: Saturn 94
details.short_description: You are the keeper of Orbita, a Soviet station orbiting Saturn. Keep the failing station alive, assemble cargo rockets, and supply the colonies. Supplies run short, and something aboard never made it into the reports. Obey orders, or defy the Party? Lives depend on you.

details.title: Hameldaeme
details.short_description: Hameldaeme is a real-time sandbox lifesim set in a little canalside village. Decorate indoors and outdoors, make friends with townsfolk, partake in year-round village events, collect trinkets, pick up litter, go fishing, and help a village on the backfoot return to being a cohesive community!

name: Chat, Should We Head Over There?

details.title: Chat, Should We Head Over There?
details.short_description: An extraction roguelite where you're not the player, you're a viewer. SIA, a rookie streamer with ten subscribers, heads into the Backrooms to grow her channel. Tell her where to go, what to grab and when to leave. Only what she carries out alive is hers. Use it to make her stronger and go deeper.

details.title: Cat Smash
details.short_description: Cat Smash – the prankster cat simulator! Smash! Break! Test! Explore! Chaos awaits!

details.title: Harvesys: Farming Factory
details.short_description: Automate everything from planting to shipping! Connect conveyors and pipes to build a flawless production line. The thrill of maximizing efficiency and watching profits explode is addictive. Unleash your ingenuity and engineer the world's ultimate farming factory!

details.title: Backrooms: Outpost 998
details.short_description: You are a member of the M.E.G., sent on a mission into the Backrooms. When the portal breaks after you enter, you become trapped. Explore the Backrooms, contact the M.E.G., and make your way to Outpost 998 for extraction — or venture deeper and discover what lies beyond. Based on Wikidot canon.

details.title: One more, please
details.short_description: You're a bartender in a port pub: keep the shift alive and answer for the advice you give from the counter. Your yes and no change your guests' fates, and the drink decides how they live this evening and, maybe, their life. An ironic pub sim on the Melancholy Shores, made by hand.

details.title: Bleach & Blood
details.short_description: A PS1-style, first-person slasher horror game. Work the night shift at a small-town laundromat as a killer stalks the streets. Serve strange customers, uncover a darkening mystery, and survive the nights ahead.

details.title: RAKKA: WAKE 02 - DECEIT
details.short_description: RAKKA: WAKE 02 – DECEIT is a gritty, 90s-inspired psychological mystery visual novel driven by character drama, branching choices and minigames. A chase across Europe pulls you into a mystery that only deepens into a web of lies, danger and deceit.

details.title: Gribble Space
details.short_description: A cube planet, a bubble gun and a pet shop to run. Catch the local wildlife alive, give every species the right pen, set your own prices and serve the aliens stepping out of the portal. Solo or up to four online.

details.title: Elf Shift
details.short_description: Only 4 real time days left until Christmas. Flawlessly pack 10,000 toys, unlock new products, and improve your skills to speed up the production line. Deliver the boxes on time, don't get too curious about the weird things happening around you, and most importantly... do not anger Santa.

details.title: Tairum
details.short_description: Slash, ram and blast through waves of corporate cops, goons, drones and mechs in this top-down cyberpunk arena auto-shooter roguelite. Pick your route and cut risky deals. Hunt smuggler's caches to fill 5 ability slots. Augment your operatives and upgrade your hideout. Solo or 2-player local co-op.

details.title: WHEN ARMIES WAVER
details.short_description: Break enemy morale and push the line. Command your whole army in a real-time medieval battle roguelite. Advance, defend, or retreat; choose one of three rewards to build your army; and weigh losses against risky routes to the final battle.

details.title: Beyond the Noise: Radio Observatory
details.short_description: Beyond The Noise: Radio Observatory is an indie project created by a radio astronomy enthusiast. Build and manage your own radio observatory. Operate powerful radio telescopes, explore the universe, detect realistic cosmic signals and uncover mysteries hidden beyond the noise.

details.title: Across Crime
details.short_description: A deduction game where every case challenges you to uncover who committed the murder, with what, and where. Step into the shoes of Leah Sharp, a detective working for an agency that uses neural synchronization to send its investigators into reconstructed crime scenes across time and space.

details.title: Shanhe Builders
details.short_description: Lead one to five companions in a Chinese-inspired 3D home-building survival sim. Gather and haul supplies, build timber, stone and adobe homes, and manage farming, cooking and rest. Command your group from above or take direct control as your camp grows into a home.

details.title: One More Sin
details.short_description: Become a demon summoner in this roguelike deckbuilder. Discover forgotten sorceries, cursed enchantments and powerful creatures as you craft the perfect deck to crush your enemies and serve your dark queen.

details.title: Shenanigans Party
details.short_description: A chaotic free-for-all party brawler for up to 16 players. Shove, launch and dash rivals off the map across a dozen fast-paced minigames, then roll the dice on the party board between rounds. Cute characters, absurd chaos, zero mercy. Solo with bots or online.

details.title: PAPER.VOID
details.short_description: Pilot a paper plane through an infinite monochrome dimension. Collect VOID Cubes, survive your own deadly trail, and face the END of reality.

details.title: Solaris
details.short_description: Solaris is an immersive first-person action game set in an alternate, post-apocalyptic Soviet satellite Poland. You are Irka: a skilled rooftop runner and courier. Sneak, run and climb the roofs of the destroyed city to find a cure for your grandma infected by a mysterious disease called Solaris.

details.title: Nascor Descent
details.short_description: Awaken in a tower beyond death, where five realms conceal unspeakable horrors. Fight your way through a labyrinth of deadly traps and monstrous foes, and let your morality shape your path to salvation. Will you reclaim your life, or be lost to the depths forever?

details.title: Pattern Ring
details.short_description: A roguelike alignment deck builder. Where you align your runes to cast spells to defeat enemies. Build your deck and craft your spells to meet the challenges ahead. Feed and grow your companion to aid in battle. Before it's too late, journey to the center of the maze and restore the Pattern Ring.

details.title: The Bestest Alchemist
details.short_description: Solve puzzles and brew potions in The Bestest Alchemist, a strategic puzzle roguelike! Freely arrange ingredients to create magical combinations, discover 100+ new recipes, and upgrade your collection to build powerful synergies. Your journey to becoming a master alchemist starts now!

details.title: Aetherion
details.short_description: Aetherion is a 2D action-adventure with exploration, combat and terraforming. Travel through five connected realms as Spark and reshape their landscapes. Your actions affect the Essence Light that holds the world together: where it fades, decay spreads.

details.title: Oby Adventure
details.short_description: Join Oby on an adventure inspired by the colorful platformers of the 1990s and 2000s. Jump, run and stomp enemies through playful levels packed with surprises. Defeat mighty bosses and restore peace to the Fruitimal Kingdom.

details.title: The Odd Cafe Case Files
details.short_description: Pick up “words” from conversations and combine them with evidence to uncover the truth behind the cases. A former detective turned coffee shop owner takes on a series of baffling cases. As you get closer to the truth, your own “lost memories of the past” begin to unravel—

details.title: Operation Purge
details.short_description: Operation Purge is a story-driven sci-fi survival game set on Titan, Saturn’s mysterious moon. Explore the terrain, manage limited resources, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath the surface. Will you survive long enough to find the truth?

details.title: Vintergard
details.short_description: Explore the mysterious castle Vintergard. Solve puzzles and unravel the mystery of why you were brought here. Make critical choices that will decide the fate of the castle inhabitants, in this first person point and click adventure inspired by the classics.

details.title: Victorian Pier Tycoon
details.short_description: Build and manage your own Victorian seaside pier in this nostalgic pixel-art tycoon game. Construct steam-powered rides, balance the delicate needs of the Aristocracy against the Working Class, and maintain structural integrity. Will your resort become a world wonder, or crumble into the sea?

details.title: TetraDice
details.short_description: Forget everything you know about falling blocks. TetraDice blends classic arcade strategy with Roguelite powers and dice-driven chaos. Bend gravity, unleash explosions, and use 50+ Perks to survive and beat the high score.

details.title: MEGAPAIN
details.short_description: A dynamic retro shooter with intense arena battles and co-op mode! Gear up with pistols, assault rifles, and rocket launchers to annihilate hordes of mutants solo or with friends. Every arena is a new challenge, every firefight is pure action! Inspired by the FPS shooter legends of the '90s-'00s.

details.title: Euphorbia Milii
details.short_description: A ruined research station reclaimed by nature. Days pass, resources disappear, and decisions leave lasting marks. Euphorbia Milii is a narrative, text-based roguelike RPG where existence costs more than survival. This is vegetation…

details.title: Music Business: Nightclubs & Festivals Simulator
details.short_description: Build your nightlife empire in this first-person management simulator. Physically manage your stock, set up your equipment, and serve customers in real-time. Can you turn your small local club into the city's hottest spot without spiraling into chaos?

details.title: Homo Sovieticus
details.short_description: Homo Sovieticus is a short, indie psychological horror that tells a story of a secret Soviet experiment that you are now a part of. Will you be strong enough not to break and let yourself slip into madness?

details.title: Project Prison: Prologue
details.short_description: Start as a small-time dealer in a prison full of the world’s most ruthless inmates. Push pills, craft contraband, smuggle it past drones, dogs and cops, and hire a crew. Then the gangs come for you. Fight to survive and build a criminal empire from behind bars.

details.title: Silent Click
details.short_description: A first-person psychological puzzle horror where you escape control using a TV remote. Explore surreal rooms filled with CRT televisions, switch channels to solve logic-based puzzles, and uncover a haunted smart home system that constantly observes you.

details.title: Creepy Horrors: Blood Cult 2
details.short_description: Build your roster of Creepy Horrors in this spooky occult creature-collector RPG. Crawl through crypts collecting cursed curios and ingredients, combining them to summon adorable Horrors, wielding them in strategic 3v3 battles against rival sects. The Crypts are calling. Will you answer?

details.title: The Last Shift
details.short_description: Psychological horror meets an old-school text adventure during a lonely night shift at a police station. Type commands and solve puzzles as sounds, lights and movement in the office echo what you read. How long can you keep your eyes on the screen?

details.title: Spikehead
details.short_description: Spike your friends from below in this fast-paced local multiplayer party game!

details.title: RUIN'S HOUSE
details.short_description: A unique fusion of "Lady" × "Haunted Mansion"—a 2.5D horror action experience emerges! Who is the lady? What happened in this place long ago? Collect the scattered Fragments of Memory throughout the mansion and uncover the truth!

details.title: VilaGod
details.short_description: VilaGod is a god simulator where you shape the destiny of civilizations on giant maps. Unlike other god games, every action generates dynamic chronicles: from political revolts to legendary discoveries, watch your world's history unfold in 14 different languages

details.title: Desktopper!
details.short_description: A multiplayer game that lives right on your taskbar. In Desktopper! you can customize your character, collect items from blind boxes, chat, and hang out with friends all while multitasking. Jump into a lobby and make new friends!

details.title: Shrouded Suns
details.short_description: In the midst of a seemingly hopeless war among the stars, take control of highly customizable spacefighters to experience classic space combat action throughout a story-driven campaign.

details.title: The Bold Bogey
details.short_description: The Bold Bogey is a 3D golf adventure that combines open exploration with satisfying platforming. Explore a vast world filled with dungeons to dive into, bosses to fight, and new ways to upgrade your ball in a golf game unlike any other. Do you have what it takes to become the Boldest Bogey?

details.title: Crim Ludus
details.short_description: Crim Ludus is a grim-dark PvPvE arena where enslaved mages are forced to battle in underground arenas in a world ruled by demons. Fight in deadly arena matches that combine real-time grid-based movement, strategic spellcasting, and relentless monster hordes in a brutal test of positioning and survival.

details.title: First
details.short_description: First-person exploration puzzle game set in quiet, liminal spaces. Minimal environments hide unconventional logic puzzles that unfold through observation, interaction, and experimentation.

details.title: Dominus Manager
details.short_description: Take the mantle of a Lanista in ancient Rome. Build your ludus, scout and train fierce gladiators, manipulate political factions, and schedule high-stakes arena battles in this deep management simulation. Blood entertains the crowd, but gold builds an empire.

details.title: Llamero: Incremental Herd
details.short_description: Run around herding magical llamas, gathering mountains of wool, and upgrading your skills to help a struggling wool village. A cozy, story-rich incremental game about a herder and the responsibility he carries.

details.title: Sumeeper
details.short_description: Sumeeper is a puzzle dungeon roguelike where Minesweeper logic meets monster hunting. Uncover tiles, deduce monster levels from hint numbers, battle them in auto-combat, cook their drops, and descend deeper — or die trying.

details.title: Motorsport Manager 2
details.short_description: Motorsport Manager returns after a decade. Build your racing team, develop faster cars, and make the calls that beat your rivals in reactive racing. Your decisions shape a living world of personalities and rivalries. Build your racing legacy.

details.title: Co-op Chaos in Berlin
details.short_description: 4-player co-op bullet-heaven Survivor-like set in robot-overrun Berlin: auto-fire ridiculous weapons and choice-of-3 your way to broken builds. Solo works. Friends recommended.

details.title: Hyperspin
details.short_description: Hyperspin is an experimental rhythm game where you control a circle that spins on a circle, and you tap circles. There are lots of circles.

details.title: Sunset Survival: Miami
details.short_description: Gear up, get out, and survive the neon-soaked apocalypse. Sunset Survival: Miami is a top-down PvE extraction shooter. Raid a mutant-infested Miami for vital supplies, blast your way through enemy hordes, upgrade your base, and unlock powerful skills. Can you make it out alive?

details.title: Undervalued
details.short_description: You didn't want a real job. So here you are. Run an antique shop in Vienna with your friends or on your own. Buy low, sell high, pretend you know what you're doing. Oh, and keep your mood up. That last part is kind of the whole game.

details.title: MilkCap@
details.short_description: This is a third-person milk delivery adventure where you take on active delivery challenges inside procedurally generated towers. * Please note that this game is currently under development; the description above outlines features that will be included in the final, completed version.

name: Red Spider2: Exiled Remastered donation ver.

details.title: Red Spider2: Exiled Remastered donation ver.
details.short_description: A cinematic Hong Kong Noir visual novel. In 2007, an assassin defies orders to kill her savior and becomes a fugitive. Explore her fate through 1,300+ visual cuts and 6 branching routes.(Full story is free via the demo version. This paid edition supports Steam Achievements and the creators.)

details.title: OmNomNom
details.short_description: A clever grid-based puzzler about thinking ahead: queue movement commands for a hungry animal, watch them execute, and debug your route when things go wrong. Each level introduces new mechanics like keys, switches, hazards, and jumps, turning simple paths into satisfying logic challenges.

details.title: Star Fable
details.short_description: Play as the last Star Princess in a magical Metroidvania adventure. Explore the quiet and strange aftermath of a land where every wish came true. Gain star powers, summon companion creatures, and listen to the world to set things right.

details.title: MobMower
details.short_description: Enter the chaos of MobMower! Shred through endless hordes of lethal monsters to claim back your land in this intense auto-shooter. Choose your hero, drift through enemy waves, and manage an arsenal of spellbooks and weapons. Rescue companions, rebuild your village, and unlock powerful synergies!

details.title: Crimson Grace
details.short_description: Crimson Grace is a supernatural Gothic horror RPG where your skills, dice rolls, and choices decide the terrible fate of the Blackwell household. Will you weave a web of lies and get away with murder, or will you give in to the otherworldly forces urging you to take your sweet, bloody revenge?

details.title: Monger Drop
details.short_description: Throw dwarves, unleash rats, and toss bombs as you dig ever deeper in this chaotic incremental mining adventure.

details.title: Bullets and Mods
details.short_description: Bullets and Mods is a fast-paced FPS with Roguelite mechanics. Collect bullets to build your magazine, equip mods to enhance your gun, and unleash your fury on your enemies!

name: Geolocation Case Files: Road Trip to Robert's Grave

details.title: Geolocation Case Files: Road Trip to Robert's Grave
details.short_description: A decades-old family story intertwined with a modern-day road trip. By identifying dashcam photos, you will reconstruct the route, discover who Robert was, and piece together past events. A real trip, real places, real geolocation.

details.title: Panic 64
details.short_description: Panic Porcupine returns in a high-speed 3D platformer that blends classic run n' jump mechanics with racing elements!

details.title: Redline Hero
details.short_description: Redline Hero is an arcade racer inspired by classic racing games of the 90s and 2000s that can be played solo or with friends! Explore an open world, compete in races, drift events, rally stages and side activities to unlock new cars and driving abilities.

details.title: Force Tilt
details.short_description: A 3D, First-Person, Physics based, Puzzle Platformer.

details.title: Novanoom
details.short_description: A colorful isometric sci-fi action-adventure. Explore handcrafted alien biomes with T.O.A.S.T.E.R., your companion drone, fight strange creatures in real time, and craft tools from what they drop to open hardlight bridges, shortcuts, and the way to the next biome.

details.title: Argosy
details.short_description: Buy low, sail far, sell high. A medieval trading sim with a living economy: build routes, factories and fleets, outwit rival merchants, and rise from humble trader to lord mayor and beyond. Play solo or online.

details.title: Go To Hell
details.short_description: Descend into hell, fight with mouse clicks, collect loot, die, and return stronger. A dark Incremental-RPG about permanent progression and one more attempt.

details.title: Shadows of Eldemir
details.short_description: Shadows of Eldemir is a retro-inspired, Victorian cosmic-horror, point-and-click adventure RPG, where a London schoolmaster travels to a remote Eastern European village searching for his missing fiancée, only to discover the archaeological expedition she joined may have disturbed something ancient.

details.title: Idle Resistance
details.short_description: The machines never stop attacking. So you must keep firing. Recruit gunners, unlock deadly weapons, and plan your way through a sprawling skill tree to break through the next wave.

details.title: Satellite Odyssey Online
details.short_description: Survive in a huge living world seen from above. Every rock and tree has real properties: gather, smelt and craft your way from a stone axe to a musket. Build a home, hunt wild animals, join a clan and claim your place on the official server.

details.title: Tiny Tenants
details.short_description: Tiny Tenants is cozy real estate management game about greed, trust and tiny lives. Bid on flawed properties, renovate homes, and keep your tenants happy while growing your business.

details.title: Lumen Nexus: Core
details.short_description: A sci-fi factory automation game where resources move as light instead of belts. Build production chains, expand across asteroid islands, trade your resources, research new systems, and keep your growing factory flowing under rising pressure.

details.title: Sheepping
details.short_description: Sheepping is a relaxing farm simulator in which you take care of your sheep, shear fluffy wool, spin it into yarn, and weave it into cozy clothing.

details.title: Sandbox Zombies
details.short_description: An action level editor. With zombies. Carefully set up your own elaborate scenarios, or revel in causing chaos. With no innate goal, Sandbox Zombies trusts you to find fun in creativity and mischief. Explore a depth of systems and share your levels with friends.

details.title: 世界不需要败犬 - ThEeNDoFMYwOrLd -
