details.short_description: 是要靠自己的双手夺回属于自己的一切，还是用自己的双手「毁灭」这一切——一切的一切，只在「她/他」一念之间。 在这一切走向终局之时，「他/她」是否会后悔遇见对方呢。 ——这是一段在「沉默的误会」中，爱与恨交织的故事。「在还能做出选择之时，不要让自己后悔。」

details.title: Peace Island
details.short_description: Twenty years ago, the paradise was revived. After the signing of the "Tide City Peace Agreement", the Atlantic United States and the Blazing Sun Empire hired desperate individuals to delve into the cursed inner islands in search of those lost angels.

details.title: Latticefall
details.short_description: Latticefall is a slow-burn colony sim. The disaster doesn't strike — it creeps: an infection seeps quietly across the land. Build your settlement, hold the line, and reclaim ground one step at a time — paused and deliberate, never twitchy. Every advance has a price; you see it before you commit.

details.title: Birth of Nation
details.short_description: Birth of Nation is an alternate‑history strategy game blending interactive movie gameplay. In cinematic experience players can make choices affecting the plot and resources to manage a refugee nation, engage in diplomacy and trade, and ultimately gather forces for tactical battles against foes.

details.title: Popcorn Idle
details.short_description: Popcorn Idle is a cozy idle automation game about the simple joy of popping corn. Earn money, buy upgrades, automate and turn up the heat to boost production. Grow bigger numbers, unlock flavors and combine effects. Fill the whole machine with colorful, tasty popcorn, one crunchy pop at a time.

details.title: Who's Calling?
details.short_description: A home invasion thriller where your phone is your main enemy. The everyday routine, office work, and chores turn into a trap when an unknown person starts tracking every step you take. You've never been able to say no. Now you'll have to.

details.title: GUNBUTCHER
details.short_description: 90 seconds. An alien horde, ridiculous weapons, and zero time to breathe. Exterminate them all or die trying!

details.title: Chibits: The King's Tomb
details.short_description: Collect, train, and battle Chibits in a fast-paced roguelike card game. Manage your creatures between runs, master tactical combat, and travel through a branching galaxy where every choice shapes your destiny.

name: Comfort Food: A Taste of Courage

details.title: Comfort Food: A Taste of Courage
details.short_description: Comfort Food: A Taste of Courage is a fast-paced, action-packed cooking game. Roast, fry, and sizzle a variety of dishes to complete orders and earn money before rent is due! Embark on this culinary quest of courage as Teal reheats her passion for cooking again!

details.title: 新时代魔法少女
details.short_description: ——「这个世界没有魔法少女。但即便如此，我依然能够成为魔法少女！」 于是，少女白小冰踏上了成为魔法少女的征途。 她将与主动向她示好的女同学余筱羽展开旷日持久的战争，誓要夺走对方的生命（余生）！ 新时代魔法少女，开演——

details.title: CLEAVE
details.short_description: CLEAVE is a fast-paced action game where players dodge intense enemy attacks and turn the battlefield to their advantage. Master unique mechanics, overcome challenging obstacles, and push your skills to the limit in this high-intensity experience.

details.title: DiceBeasts
details.short_description: DiceBeast is a tactical dice-based autobattler with short roguelite runs. Build a team of creatures, assign elemental dice to their abilities, and upgrade them after each victory.

details.title: MeMento*fragMent
details.short_description: "Begin again. Recall all that is."

details.title: Evidence Officer
details.short_description: A mystery adventure game where you investigate 3D evidence and uncover the truth behind each case through the clues left behind.

details.title: Man I Just Wanna Live
details.short_description: Mia wakes up with a hangover and a dead body in her apartment. Unfortunately, the body has friends who are about to break in through the front door. From there, things only get worse. This "MSPaint-noir" VN with 16 endings is as stylish as it is relentless. Mia just wants to live! Well, who doesn’t?

details.title: MindGate
details.short_description: A pool-building roguelike deckbuilder. You draw cards, but never build a deck. Line units across 3 lanes and weave 49 units into 21 synergies. Damage stacks in three layers—Base × Combo × Resonance—and the deeper you specialize, the harder it explodes. Three classes, one pool to sharpen.

details.title: Asteroid Extractors
details.short_description: Mine, upgrade and survive in deep space. Extract valuable resources from procedurally generated asteroids and turn a tiny operation into a massive extraction.

details.title: Radiant Ruins RTS
details.short_description: Experience a post-apocalyptic World War II-inspired non-linear global campaign that combines hand-crafted story missions and procedurally generated operations. Control a selection of units from squads & team weapons to super-heavy tanks & VTOL aircraft. Upgrade your army to suit your playstyle.

details.title: The Arrow
details.short_description: The Arrow is a retro wave-based horror shooter set in a world reshaped by a religious military sect. Fight alone or with friends as you push through war‑torn ruins in a crusade to spread the one true god.

details.title: Sushi Restaurant Simulator
details.short_description: Manage your own sushi restaurant, cook Japanese specialties, serve customers, manage inventory, hire staff, upgrade your equipment, and build the sushi restaurant of your dreams.

details.title: Terrible Life Expectancy
details.short_description: Terrible Life Expectancy is a roguelite top-down shooter with Survivors elements. Fight absurd hordes of mutants for the amusement of an unseen bloodthirsty audience and only inherit all your upgrades as long as someone in your family is still breathing... or at least twitching.

details.title: Dandelion Void
details.short_description: Survive the jungle-choked halls of a derelict arkship adrift between the stars. Establish a refuge and forage resources from the skeletal remains of your ancestors. Explore solo or with your friends. Fashion what weapons you can, for the jungle is alive and hostile…

details.title: Swarm Chess
details.short_description: Chess with thousands of pieces. Place your towers then relax and watch the chaos of battle unfold in this incremental auto battler.

details.title: Flesh & Wire
details.short_description: Delve into the psychological roots of the POSTAL series in Flesh & Wire, a horror first person shooter that ventures into the twisted reality of a hapless victim seeking enshrouded answers and grisly vengeance against the crazed gunman who changed her life forever.

details.title: Slain 2: The Beast Within
details.short_description: A brutal gothic hack-and-slash where old-school gameplay and heavy metal collide. As Prince Akran, wield the sentient blade Bathoryn and embrace your werewolf fury, and battle through a dying world against the forces of Vroll. The quest begins now.

details.title: Tamer Town
details.short_description: Build and manage a town where humans and elemental creatures live and work together. Design neighborhoods, match Mokiton to jobs, and keep them happy to boost production. Produce and sell goods, then invest in new homes and land as your town grows.

details.title: Maneater 2
details.short_description: The splash-hit ShaRkPG returns in Maneater 2! Eat, explore, and evolve as you try to escape an invite-only preview event for Neptune’s Kingdom—an ultra-luxury seaside theme park destined for disaster, where YOU are that disaster.

details.title: Chunky JUMP!
details.short_description: Chunky JUMP! is a survival-horror platformer where you must survive through the night on your BIRD BOY. But beware... the Ghabbit is hunting, and you must restore the gas station's power before it's too late!

details.title: LIVING HELL
details.short_description: A co-op horror where you must escape a city in ruins, as solar radiation twists animals and humans into terrifying mutations. From the creator of DEVOUR.

details.title: Decaying Salvage
details.short_description: A modern sci-fi survival horror built for people who miss fixed cameras, puzzles, scarce ammunition and being afraid to open the next door.

details.title: Metro Station Designer
details.short_description: Think you could design a metro station that actually flows? Build multi-level concourses, platforms, ticket gates, and escalators in this crowd simulation game. Send over ten thousand rush-hour commuters through, scrub the replay, and refine your layout until the whole station runs smoothly.

details.title: Mystery House
details.short_description: A first and third-person horror revival of Roberta Williams' Mystery House - the 1980 classic that invented the graphic adventure. A game night in an abandoned Victorian House turns deadly. Solve its puzzles, uncover a buried legacy, and escape before the house kills you.

details.title: ENTWINE
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror videogame. In St. Agnes’ Forest, Man bears a mark he cannot wash away. Walk the opened body of photoreal 1990s Americana as Lucas, an ex-police officer; search the estate, defenseless, in an ever-changing nightmare. “At the end of my life, I find the devil.”

details.title: Deeplands
details.short_description: Explore the Deeplands, an ancient underground world harboring the remnants of a lost civilization. Fight and parkour your way through destructible caves and dungeons, acquire mysterious powers and tools to grow stronger and recover the ancient dwarven crown in this open-cave roguelike platformer!

details.title: SHAROTANK - ROAD TO KYSHTYM
details.short_description: Drive a spherical tank across the dried remains of the Aral Sea. Scavenge resources, haul heavy cargo with a magnetic trailer, upgrade modules and survive encounters with mutated machinery.

details.title: Diviner
details.short_description: Explore isometric dungeons and derelict castles, defeat dark foes in first person turn based combat, customize your build and create gear arrangements with a slot based inventory. You have been tasked by the Diviner to rebuild a dead lord’s body by obtaining their organs scattered across the lands.

details.title: TrophyRC
details.short_description: A scale off-road trial experience. Customize your crawler and conquer challenging obstacle courses. Remember, it's not about speed, but accuracy and precision!

details.title: SketchBrawl
details.short_description: Sketchbrawl is an auto-battler: draft squads from six factions, deploy them on the grid, and watch hundreds of units clash on their own. Promote squads to ★★★, let your commander’s skill turn the tide, and survive ten rounds to clear the Arena.

details.title: Glintseeker Island
details.short_description: Descend into mysterious caves with countless treasures to excavate in a mining exploration adventure. Upgrade your gear, fight bosses, uncover secrets and save the island from an ancient threat below!

details.title: Moon Princess
details.short_description: 🌙A daughter-raising game in a world of wuxia and mythology — raise her as a martial arts master in a rich wuxia world. Train, fight, manage, and shape her future! With 50+ branching endings and 60+ story characters, forge your one-of-a-kind heroine and change the fate of the Jianghu!

details.title: Another Pint
details.short_description: Build and run your own medieval tavern in Another Pint, a systems-driven management game. Starting with little more than an abandoned shack, it is up to you to turn it into a thriving establishment. Grow your tavern, discover ingredients, and brew special drinks to keep your patrons coming back.

details.title: My Cannibal Family
details.short_description: You are the lurking terror in My Cannibal Family, a multiplayer monster sim where you get to build your own deadly fairground of horror.

details.title: Office Party
details.short_description: Office Party is a fully 3D edgy comedy adventure game inspired by classic comedies of the '90s, and also the long awaited sequel to House Party. Dive into the craziness and debauchery with all new characters, game mechanics and locations, and maybe a visit from some old party friends.

details.title: City of None
details.short_description: A metropolis crumbles into ruin as powerful Barons satisfy their greed upon souls lost in time. You are but one spirit, with a wooden body left to rot in the wild…

details.title: 妖精牧场 - Fairy Ranch
details.short_description: Fairy Ranch is a fast-paced multiplayer co-op management simulation game. Players engage in a variety of production activities across diverse biomes—including grasslands, forests, deserts, mountains, and snowy plains—gathering products to complete orders.

details.title: Brass Rain
details.short_description: Join your friends and fight through defining battles of World War II in BRASS RAIN, a co-op combined arms combat game built around infantry, tanks, and heroic last stands. Inspired by real events, each mission recreates a unique historical battle with its own objectives, and unforgettable stories.

details.title: Rise of the Spellbaker
details.short_description: In Rise of the Spellbaker, a charming hand-crafted, fairy-tale inspired Action-Adventure, one Witch finds herself to be the sole survivor of an unknown plague. With no-one but your loyal Cat Familiar by your side, set forth into the corrupted land.

name: Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift

details.title: Two Realms: Whispers from the Rift
details.short_description: Point & Click Fantasy Thriller: A burst of light - a crystal devours your little brother's life force. Desperate to save him, you must uncover the truth behind magic, while a dread mage closes in to tear the crystal from your hands - and with it, all hope.

details.title: Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics
details.short_description: Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics is a turn-based tactical game set in the R6 universe. Command operator squads in tense battles, execute synchronized breaches, exploit destruction, and unravel a conspiracy.

details.title: Vox Manipuli
details.short_description: The king is dead! Tame chaos in this unconventional strategy with autobattler and puzzle elements, set in a fantasy setting. As the King's Regent, manage your Councilors so that they vote accordingly to your will. Manipulate, trigger synergies and win debates!

details.title: CastleMiner Z : Resurrection
details.short_description: The cult survival shooter returns. Rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5, CastleMiner Z: Resurrection brings next-gen visuals, brutal combat, and infinite worlds to explore. Mine, craft, build, and survive against the undead, dragons, and the deadly unknown.

details.title: Sea of Remnants
details.short_description: Sea of Remnants is a visually rich ocean adventure RPG. As a puppetfolk sailor seeking lost memories, you’ll brave dynamic seas, battle strange monsters, build your fleet, bond with companions, and shape the evolving pirate city of Orbtopia through every choice you make.

details.title: Crop
details.short_description: A gritty farming thriller where your safety depends on the yield. Bound to a dying farm, you must dig, plant, irrigate, and cut your way through the decay. Uncover buried secrets, both in the soil and quietly brewing within the village. The only way out is through the harvest.

details.title: Frostpunk: 1886
details.short_description: A full reimagining of Frostpunk, the groundbreaking survival city builder, packed with new content. In a world ravaged by endless frost, become the Captain of the last city on Earth. Manage its people and infrastructure while facing cruel weather and even crueler choices.

details.title: DRUG Schedule
details.short_description: Build your empire! Cook and make illegal drugs, expand your cartel, and outsmart rivals and law enforcement. Play solo or team up in co-op to dominate the underworld! Your empire, your rules. Rise to power! Don't get high on your own dope!

details.title: Kaguya
details.short_description: Not a regular shmup player? No worries! This is a super chill, low-difficulty, fully voiced bullet hell shooter just for you! Wipe out the AI machine armada attacking from all directions!

details.title: Illusive Domain
details.short_description: Deflect, parry, and defeat your opponents through intense boss rush action. Fight for you and your allies’ freedom, lest you remain entombed forever more.

details.title: Mirealle
details.short_description: A cozy isometric puzzle adventure about a girl who sets out to find a cure for her loyal dog, Zephyr. Rotate the world, wake ancient mechanisms and find out why it broke into floating islands.

details.title: The Secret of Weepstone
details.short_description: In a hand-drawn black and white dungeon crawler RPG inspired by classic D&D of the 80’s - Roll Dice, Fight Monsters, Loot Dungeons, Embrace Death, and unravel The Secret of Weepstone.

details.title: SOS Recordings
details.short_description: A lone mountain in northern Japan. Two hikers rescued alive from its silent maw. In their wake, a perfect SOS made of tree trunks, built years before anyone was lost. Based on the real unsolved 1989 SOS Incident. The recordings are waiting.

details.title: Last Drone War
details.short_description: You lose the war! Pilot FPV drones, helicopters, and fighter jets to unleash devastating firepower - and become a true ACE of modern warfare.

details.title: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons
details.short_description: Play as Kaatri in Warlock, a single-player, third-person action-adventure set in a D&D-inspired open world. Wield forbidden magic to bend the rules around you. Across exploration and combat, every challenge is a test of creativity, preparation, and cunning.

details.title: Parasensor
details.short_description: When Marisol accepts a job as a telecom technician, she finds herself in a quarantine zone where civilians are mutating into insects. Connect with strangers, confront grotesque creatures, and unravel a conspiracy at the heart of the metamorphosis.

details.title: Economic Miracle
details.short_description: Take charge of any nation and lead it to greatness in the most ambitious geopolitical simulator of the modern era. Manage economy, laws, military, and diplomacy. Build the future without compromise!

details.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse – Rageborn
details.short_description: Set in the World of Darkness, Rageborn sees Taylor rise as a pack leader to become Gaia’s fiercest warrior. Master three forms of the Garou, explore the wilds of Alaska, and confront the Wyrm in this visceral action-adventure metroidvania.

details.title: Silicone Heart
details.short_description: Build a self-sustaining cyber farm on a planet-sized junkyard. Grow biomechanical crops, automate production, repair discarded robots, and secretly reshape a mechanical society from the inside in this cozy farming and automation adventure.

details.title: Among the Waves
details.short_description: Carry the Divine Child. Bend the laws of physics and uncover the mystery of the Doors of Birth. The fate of a world where artificial intelligence has learned to believe lies in your hands.

details.title: Encryption
details.short_description: Encryption is a cinematic first-person psychological horror adventure set during a climate catastrophe burning through southern Italy. A father searches for his missing daughter in Matera, one of the oldest inhabited places on Earth, now evacuated, while something awaits in the darkness below.

details.title: TSAREVNA. Age of Tales
details.short_description: The world's first ballet-inspired action. Become the Tsarevna and carve your way through a dark Slavic fairy tale where beauty becomes a weapon. Chain stylish combos, master graceful swordplay, and turn every battle into a deadly dance.

details.title: Satellite Odyssey: Jupiter
details.short_description: 🪳🤖 Rogue machines, mutant insects, and jazz echoing through deep space 🎷🎶 A stylish blend of survival horror and noir detective mystery wrapped in a decopunk aesthetic. Beautifully unsettling.

details.title: Ludus Saltuum
details.short_description: A third person 3d platformer! Jump forward, unlock skills and buy upgrades! All at your own pace! Handcrafted levels procedurally presented! How far can you get? 🇧🇷

details.title: UNBIASED
details.short_description: Salvation or Damnation? Measure the worth of human souls in this psychological anime & FMV visual novel about moral dilemma! Will you allow your prejudices to call the shots? Or can you remain unbiased?

details.title: Roots n Roofs
details.short_description: Build whimsical homes within roots and wood, and transform an old stump into a little world. A relaxing sandbox with no pressure - just a quiet, peaceful place and your imagination.

details.title: Until Mom Comes Home
details.short_description: After a tragic event changed his life forever, Ethan moves to Rottenpine with his mother. As strange occurrences begin to shake the town, the boundary between reality and nightmare slowly starts to crumble.

details.title: Gun Game
details.short_description: Gun Game is a tense psychological party game for two friends where trust is too expensive. Bluff, compete in agility and try your luck in dangerous mini-games! Do you trust your friend?

details.title: SONAR
details.short_description: SONAR is a survival-horror game set on an abandoned alien planet. Explore vast, dark caves using SONAR pulses that briefly reveal the world around you. Research unknown species by taking photographs, recording audio, and collecting samples. Upgrade your equipment and survive deeper explorations.

details.title: Knight Vows
details.short_description: KNIGHT VOWS is a dark medieval visual novel set in the 13th century. You are a newly initiated knight of the Order of Saint Féran, a religious order that spreads its faith through iron and blood. Will you remain faithful to your vow... or to your humanity? Your choices will speak for you.

details.title: Kyklos
details.short_description: In this Turn based RPG You must seek out the first gate lost to time. While many myths relate to its existence, only yours will lead to eternal enlightenment. Go out and explore towns, temples, and caves which depths seem to grow stranger the deeper you go.

details.title: Almost At Pity
details.short_description: Almost At Pity is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder where your gacha pulls define your run! Limit break your characters with limited resources, master powerful synergies, and conquer the final boss

name: A Very Scary Hairy Bike Ride

details.title: A Very Scary Hairy Bike Ride
details.short_description: You’re Bigfoot. You have a bicycle. And it’s really hot. Ride across the country with your friends, survive the wilderness, and try not to completely destroy your bike (and yourself) along the way!

details.title: PeachBlossomPastry
details.short_description: Peach Blossom Pastry is a single-player cooking simulation game that lets you enjoy making traditional pastries in first-person, immersive style. There are no customers and no orders. With a recipe in hand and all ingredients ready, all you need to do is to enjoy the pleasure of making pastries.

details.title: MAKINA
details.short_description: In a world where Emotion is energy, a vengeful pilot boards a dangerous, desire-fueled Makina and descends into the emotion-addicted city. Defy the twisted rulers—a scientist, architect, K-pop idol, and director—to tear down their grand plan. A hybrid adventure of mech action and stealth: [MAKINA].

details.title: SHADOW WIZARD MONEY GANG
details.short_description: A game about greed. A chaotic heist co-op roguelike shooter where wizards blast through rooms, gamble with magic, and turn money into health, power, and upgrades. LEGALIZE NUCLEAR BOMBS

details.title: AMIMI
details.short_description: A child and a mysterious creature explore a magical world where every corner hides a surprise. Meet curious characters, experiment with inventive puzzles, and discover a story of friendship, transformation, and nature.

details.title: No Beer Left Behind!
details.short_description: 2D sokoban puzzle game with pixel art and an 8-bit soundtrack. You play as a dwarf tidying up his cellars. The goal is simple: get every barrel onto its marked spot, and the level is solved. But sometimes you need to drink a beer!

details.title: GERPHYON: The Ender Mansion
details.short_description: Will you survive 1000 rooms of pure arcade/horror pressure? Or will you crumble as soon as the lights begin to flicker and find yourself desperately running for your life from the indescribable, aberrant 'FRIENDS' crawling through the bowels of this complex?

details.title: Rusted Frontier
details.short_description: Haul chaotic cargo, drive fully physically-simulated vehicles, and build ambitious projects across a forgotten frontier. Solo, or co-op chaos with up to 4 players.

details.title: User.exe
details.short_description: User.exe is a psychological horror experience set in WinShade, a forgotten operating system from the early 2000s. Inside lives User, a trapped virtual assistant asking for help to finish a failed mission: install a virus to destroy Admin, an entity tied to urban legends and missing people.

details.title: BirdBots
details.short_description: Master a unique skill-based flight system in a post-apocalyptic world. Play the story, survive procedurally generated tunnels, or compete with up to 6 players in multiplayer races and Last BirdBot Standing battles.

details.title: Strike King
details.short_description: Explore the strange world of competitive bowling as you climb the ranks to become the Strike King. Wield 100+ unique balls as you struggle against eccentric bowlers armed with an arsenal of elements, obstacles, and outlandish abilities in this bowling roguelite.

details.title: The Walking Trade 2
details.short_description: Run a shop in an apocalyptic wasteland! Play alone or co-op (1-8 players) scavenging the wild new world, craft stock and upgrades, manage your workforce, and fend off undead hordes with your lives. Will you be heroes, or profit at any cost? Your choices shape your store and your fate.

details.title: DISTURBING FEARS - Tenant
details.short_description: After escaping a toxic relationship, 21-year-old Fiona Woodward rents the cheapest room she can find to start over. She had no idea what was waiting for her during her stay.

details.title: 検索探偵パテ太郎
details.short_description: Search Detective Patetaro is a free mystery adventure set in a shopping street in 2050. Trace patents, designs, and trademarks with young detective Patetaro, compare testimony and clues, and eliminate impossible answers one by one. All 5 episodes free. Your search query becomes your deduction.

details.title: Here, There Be Monsters
details.short_description: Hunt legendary deep-sea beasts through unpredictable waters, where every passing day drains your vital resources. Choose to hunt bounties, prey on merchant fleets, or turn to piracy just to survive.

details.title: Into the Barrel
details.short_description: This is a single-player, first-person, roguelite action game. Fight bloody battles alongside the weapon in your hand, accumulate wealth and experience through each kill, strengthen yourself, tear through the planet, and become the strongest.

details.title: Legumi Lagoon
details.short_description: Uncover the lost histories and legends of the mysterious Legumi in a stressfully relaxing survival RPG like none other.

details.title: Paracampus 2015
details.short_description: ParaCampus 2015 is a multi-ending college sim. You're a freshman in 2015—plan your days, shape your path. Grind for grades, master skills, or dive into clubs, part-time jobs, romance, and campus exploration. Endless side stories await.

details.title: Luman Lars: Dichotomy
details.short_description: Two worlds. A 2D pixel-art open-world action-adventure where your playstyle reshapes your abilities, the soundtrack reacts to your every move, and your choices decide which truth — and which ending — is real.

details.title: Brews & Kings
details.short_description: Brew on an island where the hills, springs, and fruit decide how the drink tastes. Hire masters and link their workshops into a line. When the brew's ready, the workers, the merchants, and even the Queen come calling, but that's life. You can't please everyone.

details.title: FruitSnoot
details.short_description: Capture fruit, grow your tail, chase rare finds, and unlock quirky characters and equipment in a cute, chaotic action roguelite.

details.title: Worm Game
details.short_description: A puzzle game in which you play as a worm. Push boxes to open the way forward, but beware - it's not so easy to back up when you're a worm.

details.title: Corner Dungeon
details.short_description: Lightweight desktop idle battler. The ultimate workday distraction.

details.title: 牛马兄弟职场记
details.short_description: Cow & Horse Bros.: Office Diaries is an anthropomorphic workplace sim. Featuring cel-shaded anime art, it recreates real office routines & teamwork with funny stories. Casual story-focused gameplay, simple controls for relaxing spare-time fun.

details.title: Reactor 13
details.short_description: Reactor 13 is chaotic local co-op for 1–4 players. Grab, wash, charge, and craft Dark Matter blocks to power everything from one house up to a whole planet. Overcharge for huge output; the chain reactions are half the fun, the meltdown is not. Play solo or have someone else to blame.

details.title: Shadows of Absence
details.short_description: After years of missing out on life, the journeys, the friendships, the experiences, you are prescribed an experimental medication to help you reclaim your life. The side effects were supposed to be minor, but as you drift off to sleep, you wake up in your childhood home.

details.title: Shadow over Bishkek
details.short_description: Shadow Over Bishkek is a 3D Action/RPG with the top down camera view. A student from Bishkek gains the superpower to travel to the Darkland and interact with ghosts. During the day, he lives an ordinary life of a student, but at night, he fights evil spirits.

details.title: Visitant
details.short_description: Hire & level-up hunters, accept contracts to investigate paranormal activity at haunted locations and collect evidence using an arsenal of tools in this psychological horror ghost-hunting simulator, alone or with friends. But it won't be easy! The tormented spirit terrorizes those who meddle with it

name: Sakura Exchange: A Thai in Japan

details.title: Sakura Exchange: A Thai in Japan
details.short_description: Spend one fleeting school year in rural Japan as a 17-year-old Thai exchange student. In this wholesome, slow-burn romance visual novel, join a club, grow close to one of five girls, and decide whether to board the train home or stay for one more spring.

details.title: Wukong: Time to Deal
details.short_description: Embark on your Journey to the West!《Wukong: Time to Deal》is a Journey to the West roguelike game featuring core deck building and demon slaying gameplay. Experience random adventures and rich rewards, with distinctive desktop interactive content offering relaxed casual gameplay.

details.title: Synarchy
details.short_description: Every space game hands you a gun. Synarchy hands you a ledger. Found a corporation with one ship, then haul, trade and build a fleet across 250 star systems in one shared, always-online galaxy where the news moves the markets in real time.

name: Pooh's Parables: Regarding the Dream Thief

details.title: Pooh's Parables: Regarding the Dream Thief
details.short_description: Help the Sandman as Winnie-the-Pooh, Christopher Robin, Piglet, and more of your familiar friends combine their special abilities to solve puzzles with light platforming elements, best foes in turn based combat using engaging Action Commands, and bring back everyone's stolen dreams!

details.title: Project Gears
details.short_description: Charge! Smash! Don't stop! Survive! Race through chaotic city streets as Engine Heart and Motor Soul. Upgrade each hero's unique abilities, blast through enemies at top speed, and keep your engine running. If your power runs out, so do you.

details.title: Pixel Imperium
details.short_description: Create a world, watch it live. Or take matters into your own hands. Generate, draw, or import a real map, on land or among the stars. Customize it, painting its resources, realms, and peoples. Then watch history unfold, guide it in god mode, or lead a faction to glory yourself.

details.title: DABA Land of Water Scar
details.short_description: Clayman, the world in your hands. God, savior, or destroyer. Choose, and pay the price.

details.title: The Forsaken Crown
details.short_description: Master unforgiving combat in a minimalist world. This low-poly Soulslike challenges your reflexes with precise dodge rolls and brutal timing. Explore bleak landscapes with a charming retro flair and conquer monumental bosses.

details.title: House Heroes
details.short_description: Cut, paint and screw your way to success, alone or with friends. Bring back the House Heroes team and fight against the real-estate mafia in this local coop construction simulator adventure. Will you be able to save your failing family business?

name: The End of the World Club

details.title: The End of the World Club
details.short_description: A cute coming-of-age boys' love (BL/yaoi) visual novel set in 2012 about a group of high school students who start a club to prepare for the end of the world.

details.title: MASH Commander
details.short_description: Manage camp morale and army resources in harsh conditions. Direct the flow of wounded, take control of individual cases, and develop your skills and those of your staff. Live in the camp and come to know the people you command. Meet expectations in Survival Rate and Camp Efficiency, or be replaced.

details.title: Aeriea
details.short_description: Take Your Fortress to War — Aeriea is a tower defense building + roguelite + survivors mashup with over 10,000 combos of towers, weapons and maps. Dodge, weave and outlast the clock in frantic timed brawls. Explore the outer isles, build on the inner isles, and grow your base out back.

details.title: Gorilla Warfare
details.short_description: Apes together strong. Explosively strong. Gather your friends, pick your grenade, and wreck the arena until you're the only one left standing.

name: Jay and Silent Bob's Joint Venture

details.title: Jay and Silent Bob's Joint Venture
details.short_description: Turn a rundown backyard into your own cozy cannabis farm. Crossbreed plants to discover unusual effects and grow the strains your neighbors need. Build friendships as you explore the town with Jay and Silent Bob, surrounded by the spirit of ’90s comedy.

details.title: Attack Only
details.short_description: Experience a retro RPG as a princess who can only attack. Defeat enemies by targeting the game window and console itself! Before long, you’ll awaken to face a monster in the real world. Enjoy a multi-layered metafiction experience built on a classic RPG foundation.

details.title: Last Writes
details.short_description: Last Writes is a sound-based puzzle game with very sparse and cryptic instructions, reflecting on what remains of religion in a world that has long strived to overcome it. Follow the signal and confront a rogue AI that sees you as its God.

name: Specters of the Void Sea: VR Pirate Battle Royale

details.title: Specters of the Void Sea: VR Pirate Battle Royale
details.short_description: Gather your crew and sail the Void Sea in a fully physical, multicrew VR pirate adventure. Engage in brutal PvPvE with flintlock firearms, melee weapons, gesture magic, and naval combat. Sail procedural worlds, patch leaks, and do what you can to survive the entities and players hunting you.

details.title: Roll and Die
details.short_description: A push-your-luck dice roguelite. Greed gets you power. Greed gets you killed. Keep the rolls you like, push the rest, and pray you do not hit a skull. Climb the Pit to the god who runs it.

details.title: Atomic Delivery
details.short_description: The General Staff has one objective for you: build an atomic weapon aboard a nuclear bomber. Pilot through hostile skies, refine uranium, run industrial machines, assemble the bomb, keep the aircraft airborne and survive everything standing between you and the Atomic Delivery.

name: 彼女のコメント欄管理を任された！

details.title: 彼女のコメント欄管理を任された！
details.short_description: Assigned to Moderate Her Chat! is a game where you become the moderator for rookie VTuber Komeran A. Lerna. Delete toxic comments as soon as they appear! With simple click controls, protect Lerna's livestream and keep the chat safe and friendly.

details.title: Shuffle Bistro
details.short_description: Mix menus and build facilities to hit daily revenue goals. Create brand new synergy builds every run with 100+ types of facilities and 4 distinct theme perks in this restaurant deck-building roguelike.

details.title: Immortal Gambit
details.short_description: Immortal Gambit is a xianxia deckbuilding roguelike. Build your deck, seek treasures, and make trade-offs between Spirit and Bane. When Spirit runs short, Refine Bane to seize power now—and face the consequences later.

details.title: Restive Neverendings
details.short_description: A metaphysical card game about chronic insomnia and tea ceremonies. It is also a game about home.

details.title: Locomotive Works
details.short_description: Build custom steam locomotives and deliver freight on a working railway. Your designs affect performance. Different jobs need different designs, and every choice has trade-offs. Balance power, size, range and cost to build anything from small yard shunters to heavy freight engines for steep climbs.

details.title: Dinosis Zero: Quantum Island
details.short_description: Survive on a mysterious island overrun by dinosaurs. Explore abandoned research facilities, uncover the origin of a global catastrophe, craft, build, and fight your way through a dangerous prehistoric world.

details.title: Mingle
details.short_description: A multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you play as a Wolf disguised as a sheep and eat the flock from the inside!

details.title: Flame and Blame
details.short_description: A first-person co-op comedy for up to 4 firefighters who are very bad at their job. Drive the truck, blast the fire, rescue the panda, and blame each other when it all goes up in smoke. Bad at fires. Great at friendship.

details.title: Cryptwake
details.short_description: Cryptwake is a fast-paced first-person roguelike dungeon crawler. Fight through ever-changing floors, uncover strange secrets, wield powerful weapons, build devastating synergies, and survive the horrors that stalk the dungeon.

details.title: Dandy Rat Cricket Club
details.short_description: DANDY RAT CRICKET CLUB IS ARCADE CRICKET FOR THE UPPER CRUST. Bat, bowl and field in an easy-to-learn and impossible-to-master setting. Bamboozle your opponents with deceptively deep and engaging tactics, and magical bowling power-ups. Captain your ragtag team of posh rats from obscurity to glory.

name: KAIMA MV: Mistress of the Void

details.title: KAIMA MV: Mistress of the Void
details.short_description: the world is getting eaten up... will you survive? take control of SEARINA in the fight against the evil prince VIDO, and try to reclaim the world of KAIMA! this version of the game includes brand new art and storylines, so even older fans will have something new to enjoy!

details.title: Have Fun Exploring
details.short_description: Have Fun Exploring is a 4-player online co-op psychological horror. Urbex livestreaming is booming on the Dark Web, and the WR8 Audience pays well for thrilling content. Investigate abandoned locations to uncover who went missing and identify the ghost they became.

details.title: Spirefall
details.short_description: A single-player roguelite deckbuilder where your fortress fights back. Deploy units, cast spells, and unleash fortress weapons in turn-based card battles. Play five factions through three tavern Gauntlets, each ending with a boss who has a few tricks of their own.

details.title: Ignite the Depths
details.short_description: Ignite the Depths is an atmospheric dark-fantasy PvE dungeon crawler set within a sprawling, hand-crafted labyrinth. Descend into the darkness alone or unite with up to 4 players in a co-op adventure. Will you conquer the Abyss?

details.title: Coppers & Thieves
details.short_description: Coppers & Thieves is a party hide and seek game for 3-8 players that combines strategic stealth gameplay with fast paced party action.

details.title: Me, Bitten
details.short_description: A lone survivalist, perfectly prepared for the apocalypse, just got bitten. Ridiculous? Yes. But you have zero intention of dying like this. Scavenge your surroundings for supplies to craft vaccines and weapons. Hold back the infection and wipe out the zombies. Survive. That's it.

details.title: Sodyba
details.short_description: A short psychological horror game inspired by Baltic folklore. Explore the homestead, complete everyday tasks, discover hidden places, and reveal its dark secret. When evil awakens, can you escape?

details.title: Bullet Maiden: Shoot and Strip
details.short_description: A 2D vertical bullet-hell shooter with polarity-switching and clothes destruction. Toggle Light mode to strip clothing or Dark mode to fight enemies and Bosses. 12 characters each have two stages with multi-phase Boss fights. Combo and score-based extra lives reward skilled play.

details.title: Let Us Cook
details.short_description: A chaotic physics-based co-op cooking game for up to 4 players. Scavenge ingredients, mash them together by hand, and race to feed an ever-hungry volcano before it feeds on you instead.

details.title: Battle Quads
details.short_description: Command a squad of six specialists in explosive 4v4 multiplayer battles. Make real-time tactical decisions as a commander, or take direct control of any specialist at critical moments.

details.title: Lazare's Sacrifice
details.short_description: The guillotine awaits. Your only escape? A deck of cards. Play for your life against legends of the French Revolution in this gripping narrative deckbuilder. Solve puzzles in the depths of prison to uncover the truth of your captivity. Cards, health, sanity... What will you sacrifice to survive?

details.title: Ad Reditus
details.short_description: A hand-drawn roundtrip roguelike deckbuilder about a pilgrimage and a ring that wants to change you. Build your deck on the way out. Decide what it becomes on the way back.

details.title: Tiny Biomes
details.short_description: A build-your-own aquarium sandbox. Shape the glass, sculpt the substrate, design every plant, hang the lights, then stock the water and live with what you made.

details.title: Race The Sun 2
details.short_description: Your futile journey into the sunset continues. Fly through endless procedural worlds, connected by seamless portals. Play alone or with friends, complete daily challenges, unlock and customize new ships, and compete in the all new TRIALS levels, made by community members.

details.title: Meat Block
details.short_description: MEAT BLOCK is a first-person survival horror set in an isolated Siberian city. Explore hostile locations, solve puzzles, scavenge for limited resources, fight the infected, and descend deeper into the hidden infrastructure beneath the city

details.title: Duco
details.short_description: A roguelike survival game where you can also interact with NPCs, encounter gangs, and build a small settlement of your own… but with cards. Loot, craft, and survive. Unlock characters and maps, and combine them with traits to create unique runs.

details.title: The Great Bitcoin (Non-)Heist
details.short_description: You paid 99 cents for a busted database full of jumbled interrogation transcripts from four people. The seller promised clues to a Bitcoin case worth over $500,000. 99 cents! What a steal! Shame this thing only lets you search, search, search. The thinking's on you.

details.title: Incinerator Inc
details.short_description: You are a pyro for hire. In Incinerator Inc, people come to you with their problems and you make their problems… unrecoverable… It’s a easy business model. Because some stains only fire can shift.

details.title: Balance: Umbilical Wake
details.short_description: Step into a fisherman’s recurring nightmare of living on a levitating platform that tilts with every move. Learn the world’s rules, solve its puzzles, catch fish, and inject them into your navel to wake up. But the nightmare keeps returning until your child’s birth begins to reshape it.

details.title: Trench Demon
details.short_description: An action-RPG set during WW1. The men in the trenches start to whisper about a figure in armor who walks through gunfire, cannot be killed, and won't stop. Clear the entire Western Front and become a demon.

details.title: Novella Oscura Reverie
details.short_description: Novella Oscura Reverie is a dark fantasy RPG set in the ruined kingdom of Albion and the mysterious Dreaming Realms of humanity. Explore a dying world, uncover its darkest secrets, and face enemies in a unique combat system that seamlessly blends real-time action with turn-based strategy.

details.title: Gniewomir
details.short_description: Open-world RPG with deck-building elements allowing you to combat weird enemies in a weird world where you play as weird characters. Go punch a dog for being ugly, or a stork for being horny. You can even punch a dinosaur!

details.title: The Book of Plagues 2
details.short_description: A steam-age city is gripped by a plague called False Death. You are a doctor once wrongly condemned, but now they need you. Every patient matters: one decision in your office can change the fate of the entire city.

details.title: Don't Pick Up
details.short_description: Wanted: a reliable technician who follows the rules, handles sensitive information with discretion, and does not ask questions. Fix the phones. Don't look too closely.

details.title: AMATERASU【 天照 】
details.short_description: A dramatic bullet hell shooter where you master your Shot, Bomb, and the Yatano Kagami System, which transmutes enemy bullets into resources, as you fight to overthrow AMATERASU, the Stellar Management System that has launched its assault on humanity.

details.title: BELTFED
details.short_description: You are a rogue AI with one directive: AUTOMATE DEATH. Shred, burn and vaporize overwhelming swarms of ravenous bugs as your part factory, part war machine lays waste to one world after another. In BELTFED, the factory is your weapon.

details.title: Archmage Divine
details.short_description: Archmage Divine is a 2D RPG featuring strategic card-based combat and deckbuilding. Explore vast cities and kingdoms, gather unique items and equipment, and enhance your deck as you progress on your journey. If you’re just looking to battle, our Roguelike mode is available at any time.

details.title: PLEASE EXPLAIN
details.short_description: You are a corporate internal affairs investigator. Confront suspects, sift through records, and expose lies behind fraud and harassment. Punish or pardon? Your word dictates their fate.

details.title: Bacon Cannibal
details.short_description: EVERYTHING IS GOOD IN THE PIG! Run your own pork restaurant, cook delicious pork recipes for your customers, expand your menu, manage your stock, grow your restaurant, and build your rind empire!

details.title: Nowhere Dawn
details.short_description: Nowhere Dawn is a survival action game set in a collapsed world. Move through cities and towns haunted by the infected, and follow the traces left behind by those who disappeared.

details.title: Operation Serval
details.short_description: Operation Serval is a tactical multiplayer armored warfare game where you command tanks and combat vehicles against enemy teams on realistic battlefields, where positioning and precision decide the outcome.

details.title: Ghostarium
details.short_description: Ghostarium blends haunted house management, ghost catching, and otherworldly exploration. Venture into another world and capture ghosts to work in your haunted house! Build your ghost collection, expand your attraction, and turn visitors’ screams into cash!

details.title: I SHALL NAME THE DEAD
details.short_description: The Nameless Dead cannot be buried, their remains pile up in a mass of indignity. You have crawled from the gutter to name them. Explore the cemetery and uncover their names before the Worm eats your insides.

name: COVENANT OF GEARS The Three Musketeers

details.title: COVENANT OF GEARS The Three Musketeers
details.short_description: Lead the Musketeers in this steampunk tactical cRPG! Tactical pause combat against the English invasion. Use the powerful Campaign Editor to create and share your own adventures. And play the official campaign and those from the community.

details.title: Decay Breath VR
details.short_description: In Decay Breath VR you'll experience detailed gun assembly and operation, the exhilaration of using weapons to dismember zombies, and creative combat styles that utilize props to fight zombies. Immersive physical and environmental interactions as well as the ability to team up and play online.

details.title: Paper Bleed
details.short_description: Paper Bleed is a creepy and grotesque point-and-click adventure, made with a raw art style and disturbingly gory hand-drawn animations. You find yourself in a horrible yet familiar place, facing your deepest fears and darkest thoughts. Nothing really dies here and you are all alone...

details.title: Radiant Sky
details.short_description: You and a group of adventurers must travel the world and unite the factions of weather spirits to stop constant natural disasters and stop an inevitable world ending catastrophe once the sky turns "radiant".

details.title: NCH: Chronos Rebirth
details.short_description: A sci-fi narrative visual novel focused on historical intervention, espionage, mind games, and tactical choices. You are a life scientist from the future, sent back to the eve of the Great Cataclysm. How will you rewrite the past to change a divided future?

details.title: Robot Rhapsody
details.short_description: A turn-based RPG following Selva, a retired mercenary; Aurum, a poetic "robot bard"; and allies including engineers, luddite artists, and survivors fighting back against AI-controlled "utopias". Recruit machines to your side, upgrade with salvaged tech, & explore bizarre pockets of human resistance.

details.title: Fly to Butterfly Valley
details.short_description: Her eyes were glued to those wings as they danced across the clear blue sky, heading towards a new world.

details.title: Gladiators of Roma Revixit
details.short_description: Gladiators of Roma Revixit is a unique, story-driven roguelike, set in world in which, after the nuclear fallout, a new Rome and thus a new colosseum rises from the radioactive-ashes. Rise the ranks, enjoy the celebrity of being a Gladiator, and make decisions that impact the story.

details.title: ORMS
details.short_description: An atmospheric narrative puzzle-adventure set on a surreal Nordic island. Guide young Sam and his companion Kira through two shifting realities - switching between a world of terrifying shadows and a world of light to solve puzzles and reignite the broken lighthouse

details.title: Knightwatch
details.short_description: By DAY - Build defenses and towers. BY NIGHT - grab weapon of your choice and fight off relentless waves of zombies, undead, werewolves and other monsters. In a FPS x Tower Defense game where you defend a winter town overshadowed by the King’s castle.

details.title: Kuny-Kuny Hog
details.short_description: A porky bullet hell, as chaotic and radioactive as it gets. Go after your acorns while you blast through by shooting and using your trusty roman shield to bounce back projectiles and mutant squirrels. Grab all the power ups you can in the midst of the battle!

details.title: Die to Play
details.short_description: Die to Play — a deckbuilder with dice, set on a cozy retro computer inside a medieval English mansion filled with horrors and mysteries.

details.title: Burakku Jakku Samurai
details.short_description: A tactical pixel-art roguelite. Manage your Ki up to a lethal limit of 21. Bend the rules of the duel with special cards to alter combat conditions. Risk it all to hit exactly 21 for a Perfect Focus lethal strike. Plan your route and survive. Your strategy is your sharpest weapon.

details.title: Gabby's Odyssey
details.short_description: Embark on a journey through the fantastical world of Larion in this action-adventure inspired by timeless classics of the genre. Solve clever puzzles, overcome perilous dungeons, and unlock new abilities — while discovering that imagination is not a weakness, but a force that can change everything.

details.title: Her Crown of Blood
details.short_description: A sinful child is damned to hell. Her mother follows her. An indie horror RPG.

details.title: PROJECT LEVELS
details.short_description: PROJECT LEVELS is a creative multiplayer sandbox where you and your friends can build worlds, create interactive experiences and bring your ideas to life together.

details.title: Spine Lasher
details.short_description: Armed with a whip made from human spines, confront the nightmarish creatures of mankind. Swing your whip, use sub-weapons, crush your foes under chandeliers, and deflect enemy projectiles back at them—all in this pixel-perfect action platformer!

details.title: Expendabots
details.short_description: Expendabots is a 1–4 player co-op horror-extraction game where expendable robots explore ever-changing islands and terrifying dungeons. Outmatched and vulnerable, you’ll need to stay quiet, hide from hostile creatures, survive the horrors, and extract with your squad before the island is lost.

details.title: Caribbean Tide
details.short_description: Sail the 17th-century Caribbean as John Nelson. Smuggle or trade, upgrade your ship, manage your crew and colony, and uncover buried truths across 10+ ports, 50+ branching quests, and a vast open world shaped by shifting alliances and moral choices.

details.title: Petty Kings
details.short_description: A pixel art Survival RTS where you rebuild a fallen kingdom by day, defend against brutal night raids, and march out to crush enemy outposts. Take back your crown!

details.title: Soulscape2 Fragments of The Present
details.short_description: Dive into a dark cyber noir conspiracy in this solo developed, story rich CRPG. Set in a dystopian near future, guide Blake Turner and his squad through isometric exploration, deeply strategic turn-based combat, branching dialogue, and infinite post game progression.

details.title: JungoJam
details.short_description: JungoJam now boasts a hip downtown strip, tranquil beaches, and islands perfect for unleashing your creativity. Here, you can be anyone you dream of! Team up with friends from across the globe to explore an interactive wonderland, design your Original Characters！

name: Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo

details.title: Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo
details.short_description: Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo is the definitive animated carpark chaotic parking simulator!!! Park cars before its too late!

details.title: Haunted Room! Urami-chan
details.short_description: In this "life-intervention watching game," you control the earthbound spirit "Urami-chan." Travel between an apartment's past and present to change the murdered resident's future. The game unfolds in semi-real time, tasking you to watch over the resident and intervene.

details.title: Drawing Dead
details.short_description: A grid-based roguelike deckbuilder where you swap cards to trigger cascading poker hands, or sacrifice them for power. Summon demons, strike bargains, and enchant your deck into an infernal scoring engine.

details.title: Astro Loopers
details.short_description: What if you could rewind time — and team up with your past self? Astro Loopers is a Sokoban-style puzzle game set in a cosmic universe, where every move echoes through time. Your past characters repeat their actions as time loops stack up — coordinate them to solve increasingly mind-bending stages.

details.title: Cthulhu 1920
details.short_description: Step into the eerie world of Cthulhu 1920, a strategic card game where sanity is your lifeline. Players navigate a grid-based playfield, battling enemies, collecting items, and using weapons and long forgotten artifacts to survive.

details.title: Dive and Glide
details.short_description: Dive, glide and smash your way through colourful sky-high challenges! Explore floating islands, earn stars to unlock new worlds, and master wildly different courses filled with rings, obstacles, enemies and secrets. Race your friend, race a penguin, fight aliens, hours of fun for everyone.

details.title: Rolling Rogue
details.short_description: Explore dungeons in a stylish roguelike with turn-based combat. Use a deck of dice to give your abilities unique effects. Create your own dice and combine them with equipment, carving your way through hordes of enemies.

details.title: My Death as a Duchess
details.short_description: My Death as a Duchess is a survival game where the player embodies a duchess taking control of a cursed duchy. This game combines both narrative intrigue and strategy, alternating phases of managing the duchess's schedule and the unfolding of her day in the form of a graphic novel.

details.title: Dick Shortson. The Detective.
details.short_description: Dick Shortson – The Detective. You've been hired by a woman to find her missing mother. Grab your gun and uncover the secrets hidden in another godforsaken village. Shoot, solve puzzles, and catch the vibe.

name: Blue Detective: A Hotel in Scarlet

details.title: Blue Detective: A Hotel in Scarlet
details.short_description: As a weird detective, you solve mysteries with your colorful sidekick. Everyone you meet in this bizarre world has a peculiar disease. A unique talent, or a mere curse? You must get to the bottom of it all. Investigate murders, search for clues and complete the puzzle.

details.title: Slot Machine Gun
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder shooter where you wield an ever changing weapon : The Slot Machine Gun! Every reload spins up a fresh combo of guns and chaotic effects to create game breaking synergies.

details.title: HARWELL: Mars Industries
details.short_description: There are no safe spaces in Harwell. Compete for resources, manipulate the Mars Trade Committee, and outbid rivals in a player-driven economy. Use diplomacy – or sabotage and the black market – to disrupt opponents. Control the rules, control the market, eliminate the competition.

details.title: Cozy Lemonade Stand
details.short_description: Run the sweetest stand in town! 🍋 Start with harvesting produce like lemons, strawberries, and mint. Mix and serve fresh lemonade, attract happy customers, upgrade and decorate your stall, and make enough profit to turn your humble stand into the coziest spot on the block.

details.title: 旧梦夏日
details.short_description: On her twelfth birthday, Xiaohan makes a wish—but more than candlelight fades. Her reflection blurs, and her best friend Xiaoyu disappears. Through dual perspectives, explore a dreamlike millennium town, battle with card marbles, and uncover its hidden truth.

details.title: Broken Cycle
details.short_description: Broken Cycle is a dark-fantasy auto-battler RPG that lets you build a team of up to 5 mercenaries and send them to clear dungeons automatically while you engineer their battle tactics and loot, craft, and enchant their gear.

details.title: Echoes of Memory
details.short_description: Japan, 1992. Neurophysiologist Ren Adler travels to Mizunari to investigate missing people, memory gaps and contradictory evidence. Search the village, connect analog clues and make decisions that can have lasting consequences.

details.title: Merc Commander
details.short_description: Merc Commander is a real-time tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenary mech pilots. Command your forces in battle, customize and upgrade your mechs, salvage enemy machines, and manage your growing outfit. Inspired by the classic era of mech command games.

details.title: FIVILYN
details.short_description: A psychological RPG where you switch between two perceptions of reality and discover that not everything sweet is innocent.

details.title: Songs of the Past
details.short_description: Go on an adventure and become a mighty hero who will save the world from an evil villain! ♫ Songs of the Past ♫ is a story-rich RPG where you choose from 6 classes, travel across regions, solve puzzles, complete quests, recruit companions & uncover the mystery of the magical songs shaping the world!

details.title: The Death... And After?
details.short_description: You are in a coma. Reality is shattered, and the laws of logic no longer apply. "The Death... And After?" is a psychological horror game where you must navigate eerie hospital labyrinths and dark caverns of a fading mind. Is it a dream, or is it death? And what awaits us after?

details.title: Rogue Gambit
details.short_description: Chess, but every run is different. Draft jesters, wizards and bureaucrats, forge strange abilities onto them, and climb a branching map of battles, relics and bad bargains. A roguelite for people who thought they were good at chess.

details.title: Coin Fall
details.short_description: Coin Fall is a short coin pusher incremental game. Every coin helps you unlock new pushers and chase jackpots. Discover special coins and trigger bonus mini-games, all in pursuit of the ultimate ticket prize!

details.title: Jacob's Islands
details.short_description: Jacob’s Islands is a minimalist pixel art platforming adventure where you explore mysterious islands, uncover secrets, and take time to enjoy the beauty of nature.

details.title: Code Alone
details.short_description: A programming puzzle game where you step into the role of a gameplay programmer, write code to build the core mechanics of a wide variety of games, and solve increasingly challenging development problems.

details.title: BLACK WALLS
details.short_description: Explore a silent, impossible world of puzzles and obstacles. Make symbolic choices whose consequences may not be clear, your decisions shape your ending. Choose Chill Mode for a calm, mysterious journey with nothing hunting you, or Horror Mode for fear, danger, and something that wants you dead.

details.title: My Brother Hacker
details.short_description: Your brother is gone. He left behind a USB stick with an unknown system and an AI that teaches you to hack. Break into networks, uncover who he really was, and question everything you find. A terminal-based hacking thriller set in 2036.

details.title: Naron
details.short_description: Co-op mining roguelite for 1-4 players. Dig into a dying moon, complete objectives and fight your way back to your drillship. Every step of progress makes the return more dangerous. Tunnels can collapse and bury you. 47 crews failed to reach the core. How deep will you go?

details.title: glitch.exe
details.short_description: glitch.exe is a free-to-play hacking horror game where you infiltrate corrupted systems, uncover hidden secrets and piece together a story that was never meant to be found. Explore a unsettling digital world full of mystery, tension and things that should not exist.

details.title: FLS: Fleeting Light and Shadows
details.short_description: A story-driven vertical space shooter made by young, passionate devs. Play as EOX-375, a robot born of a fallen golden age. Journey into post-apocalyptic peril, avenge humanity against its instigator, and seek one unverified truth: the future need not follow set rules. What do we exist for?

details.title: Caravanier
details.short_description: Lead a post-apocalyptic caravan through the dark wreckage of a fallen colony ship. Caravanier is a 2D top-down trade-based RPG where you exploit lucrative trade routes, barter with rival survivor factions, stave off the encroaching darkness, and shape the fate of this divided world.

details.title: Dawar: Ashes of the Snow
details.short_description: Dawar is a third-person action-adventure game. Carve your path in a punishing, UI-less world. Master the combat mechanics. Dismember your enemies. Reach your goal.

details.title: Let's make SILLY ART!
details.short_description: Time to make SILLY ART! Help Charlie rediscover the joy of making art in this cozy and creative point and click. Tidy your house, find inspirations, collect stickers and create authentic artwork to build your portfolio!

details.title: Over Package!
details.short_description: Over Package! is a chaotic, physics-based multiplayer party game. Clash with your friends in hilarious arena brawls to deliver cargo. Outsmart rivals with dynamic environmental destruction, leverage chaotic physics, and turn every delivery into absolute combat logistics madness!

details.title: ChessBox
details.short_description: The match alternates between 2 minutes of chess and 2 minutes of boxing. First to KO or Checkmate the opponent wins. Brains or brawn? In ChessBox, one will win.

details.title: Pixel Vale
details.short_description: Pixel Vale is a medieval fantasy city-builder game, focused on building up your city while managing external threats. Fight or trade with other cities, explore through the fog of war, and defend against goblin raids. Research new buildings to expand and keep your citizens happy.

details.title: Entered
details.short_description: Entered ■■■■■■■... A retro-style horror visual novel branching into various horror subgenres.

details.title: Paws Up!
details.short_description: A challenging precision platformer where cats jump up dark, ominous and fantasy type environments. Master tight jumps and timing, customize your cat with collectible outfits, and seek out what awaits for your cat at the top!

details.title: About Bullshit
details.short_description: A STUPID 3D PLATFORMER WITH FOCUS ON WEIRD VISUALS AND HUMOURISTIC ENCOUNTERS AND A LOT OF COOL HATS TO COLLECT

details.title: Dither Cleaning World
details.short_description: Dither Cleaning World is a relaxing 1‑bit pixel cleaning game. Use different tools – brush, water gun, vacuum – to wash away dither dirt in themed worlds like City, Game World and more. Discover hidden eggs, trigger funny penalties. Just click and clean, no stress.

name: Cast of the Three Kingdoms: Rise

details.title: Cast of the Three Kingdoms: Rise
details.short_description: Cast Of The Three Kingdoms ：Rise is a Three Kingdoms-themed, diorama-style turn-based tactical RPG that blends enemy capturing, loot grinding, and equipment crafting.

details.title: Max the Unifox
details.short_description: Based on dreams from real life, adventure about a guy turning into mysteries fox with a horn. And his horn contains power of the Creator of the Universe. What will our hero use it for?

details.title: Geo Survivor
details.short_description: Explore procedural geological caverns in a 2D mining roguelite where your hammer is your only tool and weapon. Collect, combine, and exploit 200+ hammer upgrades to survive hordes of enemies and gather precious crystals.

details.title: Lost ages Hunting
details.short_description: Experience realistic hunts for animals from different eras. T-Rex, mammoths, saber-toothed tigers, as well as fantasy and mutated creatures await you. Explore vast worlds (64 km²) inspired by real locations. Build your own unique trophy collection.

details.title: 灵魂甜品 Soulcake
details.short_description: Soulcake: A fantasy‑romance AVG with yuri (LGBTQ+) & female-dominant dynamics. As the female lead, you can travel into others’ minds, gather ingredients to bake desserts filled with emotions. People come to you with their secrets. Forge bonds with them and…uncover the truth behind your ability.
developers: 自己的房间  Room of One's Own
publishers: 自己的房间  Room of One's Own

details.title: Kotamas
details.short_description: A cozy pixel dog who lives on your desktop and runs your focus sessions. Start a pomodoro and he naps while you work, quietly clears the distractions you choose, and celebrates every block with you. Play fetch on your breaks, pick from nine breeds and counting, and never work alone again.

name: The Labyrinth At The End Of Time

details.title: The Labyrinth At The End Of Time
details.short_description: The Labyrinth At The End of Time is a retro inspired platformer. Run, jump, dash, die and repeat to get back home, all the while getting ridiculed by a fifth dimensional weirdo in control of this brutalist absurd world that's out of some deranged nightmare.

details.title: The Lost File
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror. Investigate serial murders in locations that exist on no map. Each location has its own fixed laws of survival. Break them — and you die.

details.title: Please, Take The Phone
details.short_description: Welcome to Jiabao Tower Property Management.The night shift has begun. Your job is simple: answer calls, check the manual, and fill out the forms. When the night feels slow, watch some TV—though the programs may seem strange.Remember: serve every resident well. Jiabao Tower is our home forever.

details.title: Chromatic Boom
details.short_description: A challenging, short, colorful, and high-energy arcade game. Move your character, shoot and teleport. You will pass between lasers, cross portals and color the levels as you succeed. A difficult challenge in a minimalist experience of just under an hour.

details.title: Ashes of Berlumvale
details.short_description: Ashes of Berlumvale is a hand-drawn 2D horror detective game. Return to a ruined war-orphan asylum in 1951 to reclaim your past. Survive terrifying ghostly encounters, relive the victims' final moments, and use brutal deductive reasoning to uncover the dark truth behind a tragic fire.

details.title: Company Captain: Westashes
details.short_description: You are the captain of a free company... one among many roaming this mercenary world, growing, falling, earning and betraying just as you do. The world will not bend for you, nor wait: the other companies are already writing their stories. Yours will be decided in steel, gold and a name.

details.title: The Lonely Golem
details.short_description: A retro style fantasy adventure combining open world exploration with turn based combat. Travel the seven realms fighting your way through elemental dungeons as you search for a way to cure the enchanted forest from a poisonous blight...

details.title: Obsidia
details.short_description: Obsidia is a 2.5D action/adventure game 2.5D inspired by Zelda and Silent Hill in which you are a hazmat technician. Explore the city of Sibodia, fight against tainted entities and solve environmental puzzles to get out of a city which remembers your actions, leading to one of many endings.

details.title: Babelled
details.short_description: Build your way back to space in BABELLED, a co-op tower-building adventure. Stranded on a strange planet, scavenge BABELBLOCKS and stack a path to your spaceship. You and your fellow BABELBOTS must leverage all of their BABELTECH to brave strange sky biomes and build a tower to the heavens.

details.title: MLF: Pro Catch
details.short_description: Grab a friend and feel every fish fight back. A fishing sim with 50+ species across six diverse waters, real casting and trolling, and authentic gear. The official Major League Fishing game.

details.title: Truck World: Australia
details.short_description: A trucking simulator set in Australia. Haul cargo on highways and off-road, step out of the cab, hitch trailers, connect hoses, refuel, and service your truck by hand. You don't just drive a truck - you work as a trucker.

details.title: Rise & Reign
details.short_description: Washed ashore on a strange medieval land, it's up to you to choose your destiny. Harvest resources, craft weapons, and build your kingdom. Raid other players or form alliances. Serve the king or take the throne for yourself. This land is harsh, can you survive?

details.title: Militsioner
details.short_description: Every move you make is being followed by a Colossal Policeman. Anger, flatter, disappoint, deceive or even romance him to escape in this kafkaesque immersive sim.

details.title: The Free Shepherd
details.short_description: Run fast and free as a sheepdog in a beautiful but troubled world. Herd masses of lost sheep to a secret refuge. Discover a mysterious calamity that only you can stop.

details.title: WRAITH OPS
details.short_description: WRAITH OPS delivers snappy gunplay, fast movement, and objective-based combat with a focus on teamwork and skill. No grind, no gimmicks. Just pure infantry action where every fight matters. Get in, squad up, and take control.

details.title: Oni Hunters
details.short_description: Journey through Gironia's lands, where monsters roam and secrets await. Battle, fuse creatures, and decide your fate in the grand Monster Jubilee. Ready for the adventure?

details.title: Rune Fencer Illyia
details.short_description: Traverse a massive, ruined and beautiful world in this intense, atmospheric action platformer. Steal enemy abilities and fight them back with their own runic magic and deadly swordplay, as you attempt to find your lost twin sister in the sunken kingdom of Ithos.

details.title: Cthulhu's Cleanup Crew
details.short_description: You’re Employee #1 at Cthulhu’s new reality repair business. In this relaxing restoration game, clean up impossible disasters with a cosmic paint gun and upgrade your gear and workspace. Just try to ignore whatever’s screaming behind the walls.

details.title: Deadstick - Bush Pilot Simulator
details.short_description: A career-driven bush flight simulator where judgement, skill and reading the terrain determine whether you make a profit. Take on flying jobs across unforgiving wilderness, build crucial infrastructure and earn a reputation among the island's scattered communities.

details.title: Sunset Suckerpunch
details.short_description: Meet K8E: a talking, transforming motorcycle-greatsword-gauntlet-pistol. Drive her to meet your enemies, and wield her to crater them into the asphalt. Turn the bodies of your enemies into supersonic projectiles in fast-paced, power-tripping combat. Don't let them take her voice.

details.title: No One Leaves the Field
details.short_description: A first-person folk horror game set on a cursed farm where the wheat shifts each time you enter. Search for your car keys, uncover the family’s dark ritual, and beware—something ancient walks between the stalks.

details.title: Decay of Worlds
details.short_description: A tactical fantasy defense game with RPG elements: Deploy powerful units, wield magic, and lead a band of heroes through dark missions filled with meaningful choices.

details.title: Akiiwan: Relaxing Survival
details.short_description: Fall into a chill survival adventure, with a talking campfire as your guide. Explore, craft, fish and hunt during the day, and ask your fire three questions each night. Choose wisely: Winter isn't the only surprise in this beautiful, hand-drawn world. Playable in cosy or realistic mode.

details.title: MULTIMATUM
details.short_description: MULTIMATUM is a fast-paced top-down shooter with roguelite elements about unfortunate multiworld adventurers, trapped in isolated worlds. Fight the protagonists’ tormenting past projections and return the blade of God to its owner in order to return home.

details.title: The Darkness Delivers
details.short_description: A haunting horror story set in an isolated abbey. Jeanne, a naïve young nun, struggles to save her lover, the angelic Sister Séraphine, from a wasting disease which has ravaged their home - but what is Jeanne prepared to sacrifice for Séraphine's sake?

details.title: Stella: into the Shadow
details.short_description: Stella comes to Blackwood for a few days to write about an old case: in 1988, four teenagers drove out to the lake and never came back. Then a murder happens in town, and leaving is no longer an option. A detective visual novel about an investigation and feelings that arrive at the wrong time.

name: Misty Valley: A Cozy Fishing Tale

details.title: Misty Valley: A Cozy Fishing Tale
details.short_description: Welcome to Misty Valley, cast your line, sail to hidden islands, and uncover secrets of the sea. Befriend charming villagers, tend your farm, and explore a world full of wonder, mystery, and gentle adventure. Your story begins where the mist meets the tide.

details.title: Sugar Sling Showdown
details.short_description: Sling candies and fling sugar bombs at your friends in this tongue-based, chaotic, physics party game. Play against each other or join forces against enemies. Win rewards and use them to build your own ToffeeTown in a candy-coated world.

details.title: Hyperflex ULTRA
details.short_description: Dodge obstacles, switch gravity in ways you never even thought possible and see just how hard you can FLEX in this endless action platformer. Think you've got what it takes to master all four levels and achieve the VIBE?

details.title: The Shores of Stellaluna
details.short_description: Sail between fractured islands, gather what you can, and rebuild what was lost. Grow stronger, unlock the mysteries, automate production, and shape the world around you using a single resource for everything. In this world, the more you take, the less it feels like it was yours to begin with.

details.title: Rust Onslaught
details.short_description: Rust Onslaught is a top-down shooter where you play as the robot R-75, as he takes out everything he sees. Humanity Is Dead, Robots Own The Earth, and you have become a danger.

name: 花岬-The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape

details.title: 花岬-The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape
details.short_description: "The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape"is a dark fantasy style pixel Arpg. Players will travel in a world ravaged by natural disasters and tyrannies, encountering various companions, overcoming endless sadness and despair, until they reach the end of the world called "Flower Cape".

name: To Shake, or Not to Shake

details.title: To Shake, or Not to Shake
details.short_description: Not "to be or not to be"—tonight's question is whether to drink. Sober, the voices in your head drown out the orders. Drunk, your hands shake and the bar starts to spin. Mix cocktails, listen to the regulars and find out what happened to your grandfather. A dark bartending mystery.

details.title: Out Fishing
details.short_description: Fish by day, sell your catch, and upgrade your gear in this first-person horror fishing game. Explore the haunted woods for clues to a forgotten disappearance. Get back to camp before nightfall, or face what rises from the lake.

details.title: Pact Warden
details.short_description: As a Marchwarden, you travel the southern roads to protect pilgrims and travelers. You will fight multi-phased bosses, shape the storylines of characters, and explore an interconnected world.

details.title: Trick-Taking Rogue
details.short_description: Trick-Taking × Roguelike! Trick-taking games fused with roguelike elements like skills and shops! Features 9 trick-taking games including Spades, Oh Hell, and Schnapsen!

details.title: HOST
