details.short_description: Host is a multiplayer horror game where you and up to three friends compete to find out who is the most fearless, smart and agile. You play as prisoners taking part in a show that inculdes five different games.

details.title: Ultimate Arcade Overdrive
details.short_description: Master challenging 8-bit mini-games while the arcade world comes alive around you. Stay focused, maintain your hydration, overcome distractions, and prove you're the ultimate multitasker on the global leaderboards.

details.title: AlcheMice
details.short_description: A tarot roguelite deckbuilder. Play a card to move like a chess piece: the knight's jump clears traps and reaches high ground. Strike with action cards and brew alchemy into your deck. Three days, then the loop resets at dawn and you keep only your deck and whatever you locked in the chest.

details.title: KARATE ROGUE
details.short_description: A stance-driven, turn-based combo roguelike—turn defense into offense and fight your way out of the abyss.

details.title: SPRKLS.exe
details.short_description: ˚ ̴̡̢̛̼̬̠̰̀͟҉̢C͊͊ ༘⋆ ⟡̷͛ SPRKLS.exe is a cute, melancholic story-driven puzzle-platformer visual novel about friendship and apocalypse that unfolds entirely on YOUR desktop 𓂃˗ˏˋ⟢ 𓂅 ⋆. ˖𓏲ּ𝄢 ⟡̵̂ ִֶָ 𓂃⊹

details.title: Traceback
details.short_description: Traceback is a next-gen ultra-realistic bodycam shooter built with the power of Unreal Engine 5. Make every move count — your choices decide who survives. Prepare for intense bodycam firefights where precision matters, and every decision shapes the fate of your mission.

details.title: Abyssal Echo
details.short_description: Abyssal Echo is a stylized third-person adventure game. Players awaken in a world of absolute darkness, exploring their surroundings by emitting visualized sound waves. Players must evade horrible creatures, collect a sufficient number of items, and ultimately escape from the extraction point.

details.title: Mount Lomyst
details.short_description: You need to go up... but you cannot jump! Mount Lomyst is a 2D platformer where you must reach the summit using only a grappling hook and your climbing skills.

details.title: Street Shift
details.short_description: You are a professional racer who was set up right when you had your last chance to stay in the championship. The hero decided to enter the world of illegal racing, choosing between dirty and very dirty tactics — but keep in mind that the police aren't going to play fair either.

details.title: Road Valkyries
details.short_description: Rider Valkyries is an adventure game blending open-world riding, romance, life together, and motorcycle racing and combat. The neon never fades, and the engines are roaring. Welcome to a vertical city where every road climbs and every turn leads somewhere new — Cyber Chongqing.

details.title: Bloodfront
details.short_description: Bloodfront is a top-down dark fantasy survival game where you build a village by day and defend it from endless demonic hordes by night. There are no second chances. When the village falls, the run ends.

details.title: Tomebound
details.short_description: Rescue corrupted books from your library, harness their power and rally their forces to fight for you in this hexgrid tactics deckbuilder! Combine cards to create uniquely powerful spells. With thousands of permutations to explore every turn, no two battles will ever be the same.

details.title: Rogue Maze
details.short_description: Tower defense is reinvented in this maze-defense roguelike! Design devious labyrinths fit to exhaust the unfortunate souls that enter by using special tiles that act as both your "towers" and pathway. Deploy gadgets, distractions, and tools to stay a step ahead!

details.title: Tricky and the Dream Caster
details.short_description: A surreal, retro-inspired, free form 3D platformer that takes you through a world of dreams and nightmares!

details.title: Bite the Crown
details.short_description: In a world ruled by sugary tyrants, an unlikely hero rises from the shadows: Pom the Mold. Build your secret guild, gather rogue treats, lead the rebellion and battle through candy-coated chaos to topple the Candy Kingdom. The Sweet Revolution begins—bite back!

details.title: Clawsome
details.short_description: Help Clawby find unique friends in this wholesome adventure! Collect cute figurines with the help of Clawby to create colorful dioramas in this cozy claw machine game.

details.title: Roughly Crafted
details.short_description: Roughly Crafted is a laid-back crafting shop sim with a comedy story and creative freedom. Iron makes a fine sword. So do watermelons, zombie fingers and other things never meant to be weapons. Figure out what customers need, and haggle over every coin while your uncle runs his business schemes.

details.title: Cereal Reaper
details.short_description: Cereal Reaper is a top-down turn-based RPG with a heavy focus on exploration. Talk and fight your way into finding the greatest breakfast item of all time.

details.title: Clean
details.short_description: Every room has something to hide.

details.title: Ethereal: Clash of Souls
details.short_description: Ethereal is a 6v6 third-person MOBA featuring a first-of-its-kind class system and extreme vertical lane design. Fly, climb, teleport, and destroy as you push lanes to defeat the enemy Elder. Play Early Access for exclusive skins, premium currency, monthly patches, and direct dev feedback.

details.title: 拉斯普特的龙与魔女
details.short_description: 由蒸汽和魔法驱动的世界——人类创立的先进都市拉普斯特 肩负重任的落魄贵族之子于此邂逅龙与魔女 在友情与爱恋的迷宫不断回旋，指向出口的答案究竟为何？

details.title: 3Souls
details.short_description: A world at the crossroads of forgotten technology and magic, filled with grim guardians and anomalies. Guide three heroes through the mysteries of a floating archipelago, upgrade your camp, and unlock their potential in an isometric action RPG with immersive mechanics.

details.title: Trucker 2056
details.short_description: The year is 2056. Democracy is a memory. The highways of future Finland are controlled by the fascistic Institute. Embark on a perilous journey to find medicine for your dying daughter. A high-octane adventure inspired by classics such as X-COM, Space Rogue, and Pirates!

details.title: 不动列车StationaryTrain
details.short_description: " stationary Train" is a post-apocalyptic horror exploration pixel-style RPG. You will play as Luna, an adult woman and the last survivor of this world. you set out to recover your lost memories, and together with the conductor Diqiu, you return to a world ravaged by monsters and plague...

details.title: My Friend, Dysentery
details.short_description: A darkly comedic "Horribly Realistic Fantasy Travel Simulator" survival adventure roguelike inspired by Oregon Trail. Journey to the Promised Land to kill a dragon! Fight monsters, manage supplies & disasters, and learn that fantasy journeys are nothing heroic like the films, but cripplingly brutal.

details.title: Benson Bones
details.short_description: A top-down pixel art action RPG. You wake in a graveyard, a dog finds you, and then a portal takes him. Learn every enemy's tell, take down bosses that punish button-mashing, and cross hand-built realms to bring him home.

details.title: Blood Being 2
details.short_description: Work has ended. Something told you to find the tower. You can only get in by obliterating your brain. What comes next?

details.title: Far Away Kingdom
details.short_description: A fast-paced arcade gallery shooter inspired by Wild Guns and Cabal. Play solo or in local co-op, switch between fire and ice, dodge intense bullet patterns, and take down powerful bosses. Unlock hidden routes, discover secret encounters, and chase high scores.

details.title: Crowned Games
details.short_description: A party game collection for groups of 2–8. Six wildly different minigames, one shared lobby. Bring your own images, audio, and quizzes — or just jump in and play.

details.title: Arthur’s Tale
details.short_description: Guide Arthur through a world that’s out to get him! Sprint, leap, and faceplant your way through a vibrant adventure overflowing with devious traps, oversized bosses, and enough "Try Again" screens to last a lifetime. It’s colorful, it’s chaotic, and yes—you’re probably going to fail. A lot.

details.title: Whose Story (아무개전)
details.short_description: A Korean-style action roguelike set in a dark Joseon-inspired world. Fight supernatural enemies and survive ever-changing dungeons.

details.title: Flaming Fried Nutrition: Daydream
details.short_description: You raise a living hamburger as a pet. Adopt more hamburgers.

details.title: Rebel Talos
details.short_description: Pilot your TALOS mech to defend humanity’s last bastion in this high-speed action roguelite. Craft overpowered builds, crush the Automata Empire, and expand your arsenal every run.

details.title: Orbital Code: 2044
details.short_description: Become a top secret agent in VR and embark on a continent-spanning stealth action adventure. After Corp One's plan to seize New York City by force is leaked, a covert international taskforce of former special operations members sends you to infiltrate the megacorp's heavily guarded downtown HQ.

details.title: Trouble in Our Skies
details.short_description: A retro PS1-style action game set in a lo-fi cyberpunk metropolis, where fast-paced movement meets chaotic clean-up-and-combat gameplay. You are Lammy, a dormant caregiver bot revived to save a sky city from total collapse.

details.title: Line of Contact
details.short_description: A linear, story-driven first-person shooter focused on intense combat and a dark military narrative.

details.title: Poop Deck
details.short_description: Step onto the Poop Deck™ in this chaotic online co-op game! Collaborate with your crew to keep the dysfunctional ship moving. Repair engines, patch leaks, and manage crises as you race to the destination. Can your team survive before the vessel falls apart?

details.title: Portal Fall
details.short_description: Portal Fall is a turn-based roguelike where your skill set evolves mid-combat. Battle endless waves of enemies across fractured realities ruled by an ethereal Jester.

details.title: Burned Out!
details.short_description: Burned Out! is a chaotic office co-op game for 1-4 players where pointless computer tasks and paperwork spiral into full-blown workplace mayhem. Type, print, sign, stamp, staple, and deliver orders while the backlog keeps growing. Coordinate through workplaces designed to break you.

details.title: Thorner
details.short_description: Thorner is a horror visual novel with multiple endings. You attempt to escape your past by fleeing to the wilderness, but spilled blood can never be forgiven. The land knows what you did. The land judges. Thorner awaits.

details.title: Regicide: Chess Roguelike
details.short_description: Forget checkmate. Every capture scores in this chess roguelike deckbuilder. Gather powerful floppy disks, rig your pieces (and theirs), and ignite cascading combos as you chase scores you have no right to reach.

details.title: Torizon Telecom
details.short_description: Torizon Telecom is a text-based FPS game set in a vast world composed entirely of text. “Telecom”—a world where everything is text. “Telecom”... But does any other world exist beyond “Telecom”...? Or is “Telecom” the only one that exists...?

details.title: 魏识的夜晚
details.short_description: Wei Shi becomes your reflection in your senior year. Drifting without a fixed self, they set out into oblivion—or piece together fragments of an unfamiliar youth. With your friends, they tend each other's restless hearts and share what it takes to find happiness.

details.title: Rain98
details.short_description: Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

details.title: WILDERLOCKE
details.short_description: WILDERLOCKE is a tactical monster-taming roguelike. Build up a team of diverse & powerful monsters. Find the perfect combinations of moves, passives & stats to create devastating synergies. Triumph in increasingly challenging 2v2 turn-based battles and become unstoppable.

details.title: YAKOH SHINOBI OPS
details.short_description: Four ninjas speed through the darkness, moving as one to fulfill their mission. YAKOH: This is the way of the ninja—a mission undertaken by the shadows known as Shinobi. A new-generation cooperative Shinobi stealth action game brought by ACQUIRE Corp. and SHUEISHA GAMES.

details.title: Frostrail
details.short_description: Through the frost, death follows the tracks. Dive into a ruthless survival FPS, solo or co-op. Explore, scavenge, craft and fight to endure a frozen, corrupted world. Operate and upgrade your steam-powered train through an unforgiving wasteland, where every choice is a matter of survival.

details.title: 10hit
details.short_description: With the ability to hijack the minds of anyone who answers a phone call, "0" builds an army of remote controlled assassins to overthrow his twin brother, "1" as standing president.

details.title: POSTAL 2 VR
details.short_description: POSTAL 2 VR lets you loose in the most chaotic sandbox shooter ever, fully reimagined for VR. Survive a week in Paradise, Arizona—buy milk, return books, or go completely POSTAL with an arsenal of absurd weapons and unpredictable NPCs. The choice is yours…but good luck staying out of trouble.

details.title: JIAOHUN
details.short_description: Welcome to JIAOHUN. Today is Dec 31, 1999. Happy New Year. And a message from Fairy Town's end. Grab your pager and step into the strange night before the new millennium. Investigate the mysterious Fairy Town in Baishoi County. Explore deeper, uncover the townfolk's secrets, and find the dark truth.

details.title: Shadow of Backrooms
details.short_description: Shadow of Backrooms is a co-op horror game set in endless liminal rooms. Explore the Backrooms with up to 4 friends, solve puzzles and escape the entities before they catch you. But be warned: you are not alone.

details.title: Liquid Lungs
details.short_description: Liquid Lungs is a high-speed FPS blending fluid parkour with intense combat. Inspired by free-running action games and fast-paced shooters, it delivers a seamless mix of movement and marksmanship in a dystopian world. Run, jump, and fight in a nonstop adrenaline rush where every motion counts.

name: RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores

details.title: RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores
details.short_description: From a humble campfire to a multi-city kingdom, lead with grace in RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores: a unique kingdom builder where every decision shapes the fate of your fox citizens and the legacy of your continent-spanning kingdom. With a freeform building system, no grids, no limits.

details.title: Brew & Bottle
details.short_description: A cozy first-person alchemy game where every potion is made by hand. Crack a gem in the mortar, chop, press and stir - then decipher recipes written as riddles and sell what you brew to a village full of customers.

details.title: Gods of Pegana
details.short_description: A single-player pixel-art CRPG that feels like an MMORPG. Party with digital "Simmy" companions who level-up, find gear, and specialize on their own. Master tactical ATB combat, quest, run your guild, respond to world events, and hunt deep loot across the cosmic-fantasy world of the Gods of Pegana.

details.title: NecroMarch
details.short_description: Every corpse is a resource. Your necromancer fights on the battlefield: capture mana wells, cast spells, and animate fallen foes into a growing undead horde. A turn-based tactics campaign where you will serve the villain conquering the world, or find a way to rebel.

details.title: Burger Shooter
details.short_description: Your burger was stolen. Now everyone pays. Dash through fast-paced retro-inspired levels, chain kills to survive, unlock new weapons and upgrades, battle dangerous mafia enemies, and fight your way to the final boss in this adrenaline-fueled FPS.

details.title: IDUN Rogue
details.short_description: IDUN Rogue redefines roguelite shooters by putting an entire upgradeable army at your command. Survive against thousands of enemies physically piling up to eat you and your army on a fully destructible battlefield!

details.title: AROTA - Tire God
details.short_description: My friends and I grew up as simple creatures. See round object. See hill. Must roll object down hill. The first time we let it roll, we had only one thought: We need a bigger hill. If you are like us, you'll find yourself cheering for a tire to go just a little further.

details.title: Tiny Lords
details.short_description: Build your own army, command your soldiers, and join chaotic multiplayer medieval battles powered by physics-based combat. From massive castle sieges to intense arena fights, experience a unique blend of skill, strategy, and unforgettable action.

details.title: Noions
details.short_description: Your ship crashed and the Noions escaped! Explore 10 colorful worlds, stun the cheeky creatures with your club and catch them with your net. Every species gives you a new ability. Rebuild the ship piece by piece and face the Tigrão.

details.title: Kalamor
details.short_description: Kalamor is an action roguelike with strong Souls-like influences. During a run, you'll explore dark dungeons, face challenging enemies, and discover chests with random upgrades. Outside of a run, you can spend the experience you've earned to improve your character or unlock new weapons.

details.title: Decimate Drive 2
details.short_description: Fight back or escape an all-American mountain town where every vehicle is a ruthless killing machine. Supercars charge at breakneck speed, unmarked vans lurk in the shadows and heavy-duty trucks stop at nothing to hunt you down. Run like hell in this dark, terrifyingly fast-paced indie horror game.

details.title: X Killerz
details.short_description: A fast, bloody Y2K arena war built from three connected game types: hovercraft racing, close-quarters FPS, and a fortress-assault MOBA that run back to back in a single match. Nine stages at launch. Kills are both your score and your currency. LAN, online, or bots.

details.title: Palette Panic
details.short_description: A billiards defense game where you hit approaching enemies with balls of matching color. Mix and split colors to make the one you need, bank shots off the walls, and stop the enemies before they cross the board. Test your skills in over 100 levels.

details.title: Fox7: City Of Fighters
details.short_description: Build your fighter through boxing, kickboxing, wrestling and MMA, then battle using strategic cards, submissions and whatever the street puts within reach. Rise from bar fights and underground pits to become king of the cage.

details.title: Nyancrement
details.short_description: Clicker × Idle × Cat Story — an incremental game. Nyancrement follows a cat lost in the Between as it collects 10 billion Coins to return home. You click to charge the Wish Orb and level up Relics, helping the cat collect even more Coins.

details.title: DREAMSTAURANT
details.short_description: DREAMSTAURANT is a singleplayer game made in a charming low-poly style in which you start and manage your own dream restaurant! Build your own company by your own rules! Create your own custom dishes, design your own restaurant, master time managment and of course, satisfy your hungry customers!

details.title: YOGRAK
details.short_description: The world was ending, until Yograk's nap did. Play YOGRAK, LICH SUPREME. Battle endless hordes of demons, trolls, and piranha-mancers. Unlock 9 characters, armaments, doctrines, relics, and demonic candies. Freeze time. Unfold the FRACTAL DOMAIN. Your disciples are waiting.

name: Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio 2: Fox Sister

details.title: Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio 2: Fox Sister
details.short_description: Late Tang turmoil unleashes ghosts and fiends, turning the Sixteen Prefectures of Yan and Yun into a haunted wasteland. Play as a general’s second son, journeying south with your ghost elder sister and fox-spirit younger sister for the fabled paradise. Will you find it?

details.title: Spacetime Chronicles
details.short_description: From the Webby Award-winning studio behind paper stop-motion music videos for Pink Floyd and Motörhead: Fred and his mysterious cat accidentally break time. Explore a world built from real paper, where centuries collide and every detail hides a puzzle.

details.title: Rio Beachside
details.short_description: Team up with your friends to run a beach tent in Rio de Janeiro! Take orders, prepare food, manage supplies, help beachgoers, and deal with unexpected challenges as you grow your business and keep the beach thriving.

details.title: Last Ditch Effort
details.short_description: Enter a grimdark world consumed by endless war and join Igor on a desperate mission in Last-Ditch Effort, a pixel-art character-action game featuring fast-paced combat, handcrafted animation and stylized comic-book storytelling.

name: Give It Up for The Last Time!

details.title: Give It Up for The Last Time!
details.short_description: Go through rapid-fire seconds long microgames to uncover the mystery of Radio Valley in this visual novel take on the microgame genre!

details.title: ASTHENIA
details.short_description: Separated from his partner Eve, Adam is cast into a decaying world ruled by cosmic entities. To survive, he must fight distorted foes and unravel the mysteries of a brutal war and a ravaging disease, wielding a primordial gauntlet and tainted artifacts to escape before he is consumed by Asthenia.

details.title: Overpowered Tactics
details.short_description: The 'Nexus' stops time, giving you the power to predict every enemy move in advance. Outsmart their attacks and optimize your actions. Each turn becomes a tactical puzzle where planning and anticipation are key, rather than reaction.

details.title: Retro Game Store Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own Video Game Store in 1984. Everyday until the end of 1989 gives you the opportunity to stock shelves, cycle your inventory, manage your prices, and analyze historical trends to make your game store profitable. Use era-relevant technology and systems to prove that gaming is not dead!

details.title: Burnout Inferno Office Girl
details.short_description: Tokyo, 1992. Office worker Satomi endures one absurd day after another. When she hits her breaking point, she can download alternate versions of herself from other worlds. Borrow their unique personalities and abilities to fight back against work, relationships, and life's everyday nonsense.

details.title: High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel
details.short_description: Challenge your friends to high stakes arcade puzzle action in High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel! There's something for all types of players with a variety of solo, multiplayer and online modes.

details.title: SAIGAI
details.short_description: You wake from cryosleep aboard a drifting deep-space freighter. The crew is gone. The ship is dark. Something is moving through the corridors with you. Search the vessel, uncover what happened to the crew, and learn what this ship was never meant to carry before it finds you.

details.title: Mechs and Muskets
details.short_description: Mechs and Muskets is a 2D isometric tactical RPG set in an alternate Napoleonic era where mechs rule the battlefield. Customize your squad with unique mech parts and abilities, and lead them through turn-based strategic combat in a story-driven campaign

details.title: Club Defenders
details.short_description: Club Defenders is a co-op action tower defense game where music becomes humanity’s ultimate weapon. Build towers, control enemy paths and stop alien invasions inside vibrant nightclubs with weapons and instruments. Master four powerful music genres that shape every strategy and combat ability.

details.title: Re:VER PROJECT -TOKYO-
details.short_description: "Re:VER PROJECT TOKYO" co-developed by Toei Animation and indie developer Nestopi, is a survival suspense adventure game set in modern Tokyo depicted in pixel art. Yukinori Amane whos falsely accused of a crime, uses his survival skills to evade the police and uncover the real culprit.

details.title: Shaft 29
details.short_description: You are alone in Shaft 29...Descend into old, pitch-black, and hazardous labyrinth to restore the failing power grid. Scavenge the dark for scrap, repair components in safe room, and brave anomalies hiding in the depths. Keep the lights on, and keep moving down...

details.title: Rat Race Ritual
details.short_description: Poison your boss with your friends. Trap him, get him fired, and make him guess your next move. Or hide in cloak mode, sneaking through pipes and covers. Clocks that speed up time, tools to block paths, and 10 player lobbies!

details.title: Dracula: The Disciple
details.short_description: To cheat death, you must uncover the secrets hidden within Count Dracula’s castle. Only by mastering the occult arts and solving mystical puzzles can you save yourself. Eternal life comes at a price!

details.title: Perfect Sword
details.short_description: Create Your Very Own "Perfect Sword"! Immerse yourself in the life of a medieval blacksmith. Take charge of every step in the forging process. Every detail has been meticulously recreated to provide you with a truly immersive experience.

details.title: Death Fortress
details.short_description: "Death Fortress" is an action Rogue lite game. You wake up from the darkness and kill in the darkness. The super refreshing hack-and-slash experience brings endless fear to this desperate world.

details.title: Parthas
details.short_description: Parthas is a first-person survival adventure set in a reimagined mythological world inspired by european folklore.

details.title: Kaizen Kitchen: A Restaurant Simulator
details.short_description: Open a restaurant in the heart of a cozy little Japanese town. Cook authentic Japanese dishes, serve hungry customers, and decorate your restaurant however you like. Take part in local events and become the town’s most popular restaurant!

details.title: Super Magic Book
details.short_description: The legendary Grand Mage Jeruf is hailed as the most exceptional mage in history, with his masterpiece recognized as the ultimate grimoire in magical arts - the Super Magic Book. In the game, players will take on the role of Lucy to uncover the hidden secrets within the Super Magic Book.

details.title: Dungeon Roller
details.short_description: Roll into action with your snowman warrior as you journey through dungeons filled with enemies, traps, and challenges. Each new chapter brings more danger—can you survive them all?

details.title: Attractor K7
details.short_description: Solo & co-op PvE extraction shooter inside a grim Megastructure. Deep within these concrete walls, a terrifying anomaly has emerged: the Refracture. You are no hero here. You are just a disposable resource, a common liquidator.

details.title: War of Avareon
details.short_description: Conquer the lands of Avareon in a turn-based strategy game where battles are decided by preparation, not dice. Build an economy, field armies in which every unit has a counter, and recruit heroes with game-changing abilities. Join the free open beta now: campaign, skirmish and multiplayer.

details.title: Disciple
details.short_description: Peggle meets Vampire Survivors in this eldritch horror physics roguelite. Launch your disc into the Abyss, ricochet through swarms of cosmic horrors and forge powerful builds from ancient artefacts.

details.title: Kindred Kind
details.short_description: Kindred Kind is a hand-drawn 2D action RPG. Hunt eight powerful beasts across a branching world, master a two-weapon combat system, and save what remains of humanity. Explore, fight, and uncover ancient mysteries, in a world teetering on the edge of ruin.

details.title: Corrupt Receptionist Elina
details.short_description: A receptionist simulation set in a medieval fantasy Adventurers’ Guild, where you review documents and process rewards. You should pay for your sick sister’s medicine. Will you work honestly—or turn to bribery and embezzlement? Your paperwork and choices will shape your fate.

details.title: Penumbra
details.short_description: Penumbra is a minimalist color-theory puzzle game. Move lights and blocks around the screen to mix colors and cast shadows. Match the color-coded goal circles with the right shade of colored light to complete each level.

details.title: Ashes of Bronze
details.short_description: Bronze Ashes, a fantasy action roguelite inspired by Sanxingdui and Jinsha, conjures a cyclically reborn otherworld from ancient Shu's legends. Play alone or with friends: command shape-shifting arms, gather Golden Crow spells, and fight to save Shu from impending doom.

details.title: Sit Still
details.short_description: Sit Still is a first-person puzzle horror set in 1985. Bound to a rolling chair by a radio-obsessed killer, you must escape and survive while uncovering the truth behind a recurring cataclysmic storm that strikes the local town every 20 years.

details.title: I Herd Ewe
details.short_description: It's time for the sheep to head home! Will you command your team of dogs to round them up in as few turns as possible? Or will the sheep outsmart you with their wooly ways? Make use of each dog's unique ability to get the sheep home as efficiently as possible in this wholesome tactical puzzle game.

name: 三位一体！超異常混沌賭博遊戯～アルティメットカオスギャンブルバトル～

details.title: 三位一体！超異常混沌賭博遊戯～アルティメットカオスギャンブルバトル～
details.short_description: Welcome to ULTIMATE CHAOS GAMBLING BATTLE! Playing cards, mahjong, and hanafuda—all mixed together! Behold an unprecedented incremental gambling roguelike! In three completely different modes, watch your bankroll skyrocket at a breakneck pace!
developers: キザミレモントースト

details.title: Fluffy Spider
details.short_description: A fluffy spider. Tricky jumps. A web to call home. Explore a colourful 2D platformer, find secret worlds, then build a network of insect traps in your idle hub. Collect silk, unlock talents and characters, and fill your radio with original songs.

details.title: The Silent Fare
details.short_description: A psychological horror anomaly game where you observe your apartment, report strange changes, and uncover a disturbing story hidden in the environment.

details.title: GridLock
details.short_description: Command a 3-soldier squad against AXIOM, a rogue AI spreading across the battlefield. Every turn the Grid grows, buffing enemies and punishing your troops. Destroy every Node before 75% of the map is consumed. Fast, tight, tactical.

details.title: This Week
details.short_description: A hardcore parkour game that tells the story of Ania, a kid with mental health issues and a lot of stuff to go through in life. Meant to make you experience how someone feels in a weird, but familiar way.

details.title: LIMICORE
details.short_description: LIMICORE is a dark and narratively driven experience containing uncovered mysteries. Traverse the world through various realities and solve engaging puzzles to discover the truth behind the organization's objectives.

details.title: Drowning Dream
details.short_description: A first-person dreamcore exploration game. Wander tiled pools, empty towns and stations above the clouds. Take photos, ride the trams, play the guitar and the arcade cabinets, or just sit and listen. No enemies, no chases, no jump scares. Only you, lost in your own dream.

name: Death Line: Don’t Stop 斩杀线：极限生机

details.title: Death Line: Don’t Stop 斩杀线：极限生机
details.short_description: If life’s pressure were a physical shredder, could you outrun it? > Balance Health and Wealth on a razor’s edge in this minimalist survival-gambit. Utilize "Class-based Speed" to outsmart Death. Can you tear through the veil and reveal the truth behind the machine before your strength fails?

details.title: Veil of the Black Ark
details.short_description: A classic fixed-camera survival horror game set in a cursed medieval town. Search for your missing sister, solve puzzles, survive the roaming dead and unveil the secrets of the Black Ark.

details.title: Glitch Forest
details.short_description: A reverse bullet hell roguelite where weather reshapes the battlefield every 5 minutes! Combine active items, skills, and relics into game-breaking builds. Activate beacons, crush elites, and return to base stronger every run!

details.title: one more bottle
details.short_description: In ONE MORE BOTTLE, every cap you twist off hides a tiny puzzle, a prize, or a wish. Collect caps, build your shelf, and chase the rare one stamped 再来一瓶 — One More Bottle. A cozy solo puzzle-meets-gacha about luck, patience, and the hope that the next one will be the lucky one.

details.title: Bot.by.Bot
details.short_description: Build and program customizable robots using simple logic systems to overcome clever grid-based challenges and help Robby reunite with his friends.

details.title: Our Will
details.short_description: You are Astrid, a young girl tasked with leading a small company of warriors into an unknown and mystical land, in search of a cure to save your village. Be ready to face forces beyond human comprehension, titanic beasts and perhaps even the Gods themselves.

details.title: Raze The Realm
details.short_description: Lead massive armies in large-scale battles in this real-time tactics roguelite. Build your army, discover powerful relic synergies, and choose your path through a realm that grows more dangerous with every victory.

details.title: Floraison
details.short_description: Floraison is a cozy narrative game based on the language of flowers. Explore Heimat, meet its curious inhabitants, gather rare plants, and craft emotionally powerful bouquets to help them, shape the story, and convey the message of your choice.

details.title: 幽囚の魔法使い
details.short_description: “The Imprisoned Magician” is a fantasy BL visual novel that explores the bond between master and apprentice. Aim to become a fully-fledged magician under the tutelage of a master with a troubled past.

details.title: Polyzonia
details.short_description: An ecosystem sim set in the Amazon rainforest. Grow plants, create habitats for animals, and click to hunt prey, pollinate flowers, eat fruit, and poop to spread seeds. Unlock automation and make the rainforest grow and thrive on its own.

details.title: Grot
details.short_description: Leap in and out of your mine cart hat to survive deadly, ever-changing caves in this precision platformer. Steal powerful gems and push deeper into a mysterious loop.

details.title: Dice Shepherd: Incremental
details.short_description: A small incremental game about rolling d4 to d100 dice on a grassy field. Every roll pays gold and fodder. Spend it on promotions and skills that sinergize. Play it idle or hands-on, the numbers keep climbing.

details.title: Citizen Pain II
details.short_description: Citizen Pain II is a unique old-school first-person action RPG experience featuring insane challenge, fast gameplay intensity and instantly rewarding combat. Begin a dark journey and experience secret dungeons, hidden hazards and terrifyng enemy encounters.

details.title: The Back Door: Emergence
details.short_description: It's 2015. While urban exploring an abandoned building with your friends, you lose sight of them. Suddenly, you end up in a strange place consisting only of abnormal spaces and places that seem... strangely familiar. Is this all there is? Or most importantly... are you truly alone?

details.title: BRO GHOST
details.short_description: When you die, you don't leave the game. You become one of the deadliest things in it. A co-op horror for 4 players — return as a spirit, help your friends, or haunt them until they break.

details.title: Haunted Uni Love
details.short_description: Romance × Mystery × Ghost Story The heroine, who has just stepped into university life, never imagined she would soon find herself in a bizarre yet sweet campus life. With a series of haunting events happening, the heroine holds the key to solving everything.

details.title: 薪世录
details.short_description: Xin Shi Lu is a thrilling action-adventure RPG. Meet Fan Xin and start a new life. Explore a mysterious world, grow stronger in combat, and forge bonds with companions. Expand your influence and define your own legendary story.

details.title: Clickerite
details.short_description: Clickerite is an incremental mining game where you must collect materials, craft powerful tools, and battle evil monsters in a cube-dimensional world!

details.title: Nonsense Football Club
details.short_description: Nonsense Football Club is a 3D action football game where core football fundamentals become combat mechanics! Master the timing of slide tackles, precision passing, and skill moves to defeat defeat unconventional teams like robots, fantastical creatures, and insane bosses!

details.title: Everything MUST Fit!
details.short_description: In this puzzle game, transform, combine, and break items to arrange them to fit the grid. No matter what, everything MUST fit!

details.title: Insert Disc
details.short_description: A DVD screensaver inspired roguelike where you flick the logo inside your CRT TV and hit pegs to rack up tons of points. Endless bouncing among the stars and chill ambience combine for a mind-numbingly satisfying experience. Maybe this time, the logo will hit the corner!

details.title: Idle Squares
details.short_description: Claim tiles one by one in this cozy idle fantasy strategy game. Harvest resources, unlock upgrades, and prestige to grow stronger, then automate it all. No single path to victory. Click your way across each map or play hands-free. Clear every tile, complete every map, and conquer the whole Atlas.

details.title: INFECTED WARD
details.short_description: ANOMALY HUNTING MEETS EXTREME PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR. You are tasked with the night patrol of a strictly sealed hospital ward where countless lives were once lost. Can you survive the terrifying anomalies that await in the dark?

details.title: Project Haymaker
details.short_description: Build an unstoppable bulldozer in secret. Then prove it. A two-phase game about quiet nights in the workshop and one very loud morning.

details.title: Resurgis: Rise of the Dead
details.short_description: Resurgis is a 3D dark fantasy action game blending souls-like combat with rogue-lite dungeon crawling. Dismember your enemies with brutal finishers, draft cards in every room to build your unique playstyle, and master a relentless loop where death is only the beginning.

details.title: Ceraphic Requiem
details.short_description: Dive into a ruined world devastated by the gods. Ceraphic Requiem is a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania with a demanding combat system. Master elemental magic combos, unravel the mysteries of the decay, and impose your will in the final moments of a moribund world.

details.title: Project ROSS
details.short_description: Project ROSS is a horror/puzzle game where you play as Jason who is struggling to overcome the absence of his father. Explore the abandoned testing facility where he was supposedly last located and uncover the mystery of what really happened all those years ago. Just try to keep your head on!

details.title: Immerguest: The Veiled Inn
details.short_description: Immerguest: The Veiled Inn is a dark fantasy roguelite strategy RPG with turn-based tactical combat, active dodge timing, and powerful relic and mod builds. Choose your path, manage Mana and Overflow, and survive the cursed inn’s deadly loop.

details.title: Everbrink
details.short_description: Everbrink is the turn-based 4X roguelike deckbuilder where you shatter enemy strongholds to join floating islands, and survive. Every turn, the ground behind you collapses. Cards summon units and build structures that gather resources. Grow your deck at Events on the board and storm enemy lines.

details.title: Hamster Time
details.short_description: Your desktop hamsters run on their wheels in response to your keyboard and mouse input. Get things done with friends while collecting cute hamsters and stylish wheels. Enjoy a variety of multiplayer modes, plus a timer and to-do list.

details.title: Perry's Pizzeria
details.short_description: Build the ultimate pizza deck! Collect ingredient cards, create delicious pizzas, discover massive flavor combos, satisfy quirky customers, unlock new chefs, and upgrade your restaurant in this tasty deckbuilding roguelike.

details.title: Spellogger
details.short_description: A slow-paced, cozy fantasy RPG where you play as a Wizard Lumberjack. Take on daily tasks and upgrade your character in a relaxing work cycle similar to Stardew Valley, while setting out on Elder Scrolls-style quests and exploration.

details.title: Gravedigger
details.short_description: Game is about a gravedigger and funeral home owner. Your goal is to grow business by taking care of the cemetery and its residents. Serve you customers, upgrade your tools, and expand your business. If customers run out, you can always look for them in other ways...

details.title: Rolling Home: RV Survival
details.short_description: Rebuild a stripped camper van, then drive an endless highway and turn a worn-out RV into a home on wheels. Scavenge roadside stops, keep a 12-point check in shape and earn bigger RVs, alone or in local split-screen co-op.

details.title: Enemy Metal
details.short_description: 2.5D Roguelite Shooter with Unique Gameplay, Powerful Weapons and a Killer Soundtrack. Battle the dangerous enemies and defend the planets of the Sunstar System! Gather crystals and destroy turrets to level up and unlock exciting new Starships on each planet!

name: Steel Runner - VR Block Craft Sandbox

details.title: Steel Runner - VR Block Craft Sandbox
details.short_description: Steel Runner is a VR vehicle crafting sandbox game using physics. Create your own unique vehicle by combining various types of blocks, then ride it to enjoy free exploration, adventure, and combat in an open-world environment. Shape your ideal vehicle and explore this vast world!

details.title: Escape From The Past
details.short_description: A scientist is stranded in the Bronze Age with a dead time machine and a pocket knife. Raid the valley for materials, survive Scythian warriors and wild animals, and work through the history of technology, from a sharpened stick to the first battery, to get back home.

details.title: Paschalis TD
details.short_description: Build and upgrade towers to defend yourself against various enemies.

details.title: Critical Upload
details.short_description: Embark on a fast-paced action journey through space, discovering new weapons and abilities through acquisition and research to better each run. Invite friends to experience it with you!

details.title: Figure KnockOut
details.short_description: Prepare for an no-nonsense fighting experience in Figure KnockOut! Drawing inspiration from the Guilty Gear series and the Smash Bros series, this game combines the best of 2D fighting and platform fighting with innovative accessibility features to offer an intense, yet user-friendly combat system.

details.title: Angel
details.short_description: ANGEL imbues breakbeats with networked aesthetics in this rhythm/racing adventure. In a network devastated by digital climate change, what does it mean to be connected?

details.title: Fractured Mind
details.short_description: This is a PT inspired psychological horror game, with a bodycam style.

details.title: Cars and Guns: Paper Parts
details.short_description: The world is flat. Everything is cardboard. Your soul is like a car made of paper parts. No thing can reach the end. Can you make it to the Garage of the Queen of Ice? Drive, scrap, and find your way through a universe made of paper and ink.

details.title: Rummy Attack
details.short_description: "Rummy Attack" is a unique Roguelite Card Battler based on Rummy rules! Place cards on the field to create "Melds" (Sets or Runs) to unleash skills. Build your deck and overcome physical gimmicks like ground fissures to defeat the final boss. Choose between Tactical Move or High-Speed Time Mode!

details.title: Mind Mirror
details.short_description: A puzzle game set in a millennial-era household. Featuring immersive, retro-styled puzzles full of nostalgic vibes, alongside abundant dreamlike elements.

details.title: Intercept Course
details.short_description: Intercept Course is a tactical space auto battler where you command a starship caught in a temporal rift while chasing a tech thief. Recruit a crew, survive with limited resources, and modify your starship to face rival factions stuck in their own conflicts across every corner of the multiverse.

details.title: Upwell
details.short_description: The only way up is to blow yourself up. Rocket jump through a procedurally generated well full of rising lava and fleshy monsters in this chaotic physics-based FPS roguelike.

details.title: Restoraether
details.short_description: Restoraether is a cozy magical survival crafting game where you explore the isles of magic, mysteriously abandoned by their powerful Mage inhabitants, and restore the balance of aethers to bring magic back to the world.

details.title: In Perfection
details.short_description: A writer is trying to finish his "perfect work," but things keep getting in his way. He is poor and full of anxiety. In this retro lo-fi visual novel, fix the problems with point-and-click, explore the depths of consciousness. Forgive yourself? or stare into the dark and fall deeper? It's up to you.

details.title: We Believe in No Gods
details.short_description: Awaken as a forgotten deity in a post-apocalyptic wasteland ruled by staunch materialists. Listen to desperate prayers—bestow miracles or watch with cold indifference. Extract faith to survive, manipulate mortal minds, and shape the ultimate fate of a world where We Believe In No Gods.

details.title: His Last Film
details.short_description: What happened during the filming? Stan doesn't remember. Explore the decaying depths of an abandoned subway station, piece together a fragmented reality, and discover the horrifying truth behind his last film. Some memories are better left unmade.

details.title: Depth-Bound
details.short_description: 🌊 A physics-based underwater 2D platformer. 🚀 Propel yourself out of the water, chain trajectories, and dive always more deeply. 📸 Photograph strange creatures and follow an expedition whose outcome remains uncertain.

details.title: Nord
details.short_description: NORD is a story-driven survival game set in a flooded Swedish archipelago. Alone or with friends, engineer your raft to navigate a strange, petrifying ocean.

details.title: One Coin Museum
details.short_description: Explore, collect, and build your very own cozy museum! In One Coin Museum, travel across the seas and use your claw to grab hidden treasures. Display your finds to attract visitors, grow your reputation, and upgrade your boat to reach even more distant wonders.

details.title: Grey Heritage: Counter Gambit
details.short_description: Grey Heritage: Counter Gambit is the grand finale to the tactical RPG trilogy. Command a massive cast of returning heroes in the series’ most strategic entry yet. Master evolved turn-based combat, guide your army through tactical challenges, and witness the conclusion to every character's story.

details.title: Fall of the Days
details.short_description: Fall of the Days is a systemic isometric immersive sim where the world reacts to how you play — not just what you choose. A 3D action and stealth experience amplified by social interaction systems, where systems collide and every action has consequences.

details.title: The Undating Game
details.short_description: The first ever Undating Sim! A Visual Novel/Puzzle game where your main objective is to avoid the women throwing themselves at You. Navigate the halls of Valentine's Academy and the tangled hearts of your peers as you prepare for the final exams. And remember: Don't. Get. Distracted.

details.title: Time Jump
details.short_description: In this adventure comedy, you are a Wrestling Champion. A Kid. A Professor. A Rock. A Ghost. An Evil Maniac. Fight yourself or save yourself. Your choice, Time Jumper!

details.title: Typing Valley
details.short_description: Typing Valley is a cozy farming game powered by typing. Type to gather, plant, harvest, and run a cozy restaurant that brings warmth and happiness to the town. Start now, and let every keystroke become visible growth.

details.title: Pingbert's Snow Ride
details.short_description: Slide, soar, and deliver! Join Pingbert, the upbeat penguin mail carrier, in Pingbert’s Snow Ride—a fast-paced, endless platformer where you'll slide down snowy slopes to deliver mail at high speed!

details.title: Bloodstone Rising
details.short_description: Bloodstone Rising is a high-intensity co-op FPS roguelike. Gather your fellow space dwarves, mine resources, forge upgrades, and fight off relentless zombie hordes as you reclaim your ancestral kingdom.

name: アスクギア リブースト

details.title: アスクギア リブースト
details.short_description: A new, straightforward RPG! Hot scenarios and battles that go right to the heart of JRPGs. For those of you who still feel your youth in the RPGs of the PS1 and PS2 generations, this is the game for you.

details.title: Tale Of The Tape
details.short_description: Tale of the Tape is a visceral, high-impact boxing experience where every punch carries consequence.

details.title: Gift of the Primordials
details.short_description: A fantastical ecology puzzler. Balance soil nutrients by carefully arranging plants, and support a habitat for the local creatures! Uncover the mystery behind the crisis of the Kaanvell plateau!

details.title: Eldritch Horror: Digital Edition
details.short_description: Uncover ancient cults, battle horrific monsters and thwart the rise of unfathomable Ancient Ones in a 1920s-themed adventure. In this faithful adaptation of the classic board game, you must race against time to save humanity from ancient powers and dark secrets before all is lost.

details.title: 13 Germinal
details.short_description: A historical and narrative RPG set in the world of Emile Zola's novel. You are a young man in 1866, forced to work deep in the mines to survive. But every day, the work gets harder and the meals get smaller. Organize a strike, reignite the smoldering revolt, and try to change this unjust world.

details.title: Fossil Quest
details.short_description: You have always dreamt of creating your own dinosaur museum and now you finally have the space to do it! Dig for fossils, assemble your exhibits and create the museum of your dreams in this relaxing, wholesome life sim.

details.title: Aircraft Dispatcher: Ground Operations
details.short_description: Take charge of airport operations. Manage aircraft maintenance, ground support, equipment, and taxiway movements, then leave the office to inspect aircraft, investigate damage, clear FOD, respond to emergencies, and keep flights moving safely and on schedule.

details.title: Gate Guard Simulator
details.short_description: Step into the boots of the castle guard. Inspect seals, expose smugglers and reveal witches. You decide who enters and who’s turned away. Will you uphold the law, or break it for your own gain?

details.title: Inkblood
details.short_description: You're an Inquisitor following a trail of death. A cult is at work, your predecessor has vanished, and the region teeters on the edge of chaos. Find the truth. Uphold the Inquisition. Do not fail.

details.title: Your Painting, Sir
details.short_description: A puzzle game about forging paintings using newspaper cutouts. Fool your legally blind boss or lose your job!

details.title: Road to Jukai
details.short_description: You work the night shift as a taxi driver in a remote region of Japan. Not all of the odd passengers you pick up after sunset are what they seem. Sometimes it's safer to just keep your eyes on the road, especially when a fare leads to the strange, massive forest the locals whisper about.

details.title: Perceptum
details.short_description: A psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls.

name: ROTRDS - Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon and Snake

details.title: ROTRDS - Rat, Ox, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon and Snake
details.short_description: ROTRDS is a visual novel RPG inspired by traditional Korean mythology. Only half of the Twelve Zodiac guardians remain with fragmented memories. Gigi has less than a week to gather all the Oksae seals and save the world.

details.title: Elestrals Awakened
details.short_description: The elemental forces that once held balance have begun to unravel. Long ago, divine power was shattered across the stars, giving birth to the creatures now known as Elestrals. As darkness stirs and conflict brews, the Gods call upon new Champions to rise. Will you protect the world?

details.title: All Army Attack
details.short_description: Hold onto your clucks! All Army Attack is a chaotic large-scale roguelike auto-battler. Unite animals and plants, build an army that spills off the screen, gamble it all with every battle, and fight your way toward a formidable cosmic threat!

details.title: Motorsport Park Manager
details.short_description: Build and customize your own motorsports park in this classic tycoon simulation. Start with local go-kart tracks and grassroots circuits, and grow into a world-renowned racing destination.

details.title: Hack '95
details.short_description: Return to 1995, become a hacker, save the Internet. Take down an evil tech startup and shadowy government agency with a deck of illicit scripts and compromised servers. Meet freaks, geeks, and a virtual pug with a split personality and lack of bowel control.

details.title: THE LIFT: Supernatural Handyman Simulator
details.short_description: You are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. The Lift is an eerie first-person simulator with satisfying house-flipping gameplay, a mind-bending story, and a highly interactive world inspired by Soviet sci-fi and the SCP Foundation.

details.title: Magicians: The Devil's Deal
details.short_description: Magicians: The Devil’s Deal is a narrative driven FPS where stage magic becomes real. You play as Jacob Menteuro, a fallen illusionist bound by a pact with The Devil and cast into Hell. Master deadly tricks, steal the powers of rival magicians, and escape the infernal world of Theatreland.

details.title: Calame
details.short_description: In this turn-based tactical RPG, renown can change the course of a war. Lead Kenmare and the Panthers against the King of Light, shape the Chronicle through your choices, and wield the Legend to turn battles around.

details.title: Liminal Point
details.short_description: Classic Survival Horror. Drawn to Ashen Point by a cryptic voicemail, Lyra returns to the island where her band’s story ended in tragedy. Shrouded in fog and prowled by horrors, confront deadly creatures, explore the desolate town, and reveal the truth behind the night that changed everything.

details.title: Wild Terrain
details.short_description: You're a wild pig on a quest to find all of your missing piglets. Smash obstacles, forage through trash for food, discover special mushrooms, and poop flowers to restore balance as you grow closer to your piglet family and the wild around you.

details.title: Underground Security Inc
details.short_description: Defend your dungeon against relentless waves of “heroes”. Manage your minions, mine ores, construct traps and cast spells to strengthen your defenses. Each run brings new challenges in this roguelite dungeon defense game.

details.title: Unsound Love
details.short_description: Unsound Love is an open-world horror escape room where nothing is explained. You are born into a new world through the backseat of a wrecked car. Trapped in a time loop. Understand it — or stay trapped forever.

details.title: Conversations with My Imaginary Friends
details.short_description: A free collection of explorable scenes capturing conversations spanning two decades between the creator of To the Moon and the fictional characters they've created. About life, making games, and everything in between.

details.title: TANKLE
details.short_description: Tankle is an amazing action packed multiplayer or singleplayer top down shooter, you have to dodge bullets and defeat enemies to progress and grow stronger!

details.title: BUSINGO
details.short_description: BUSINGO is a first-person survival game for solo or co-op play in a dry, post-apocalyptic world. You travel in one bus, search for water and fuel, and customize the bus. Theft and violence affect your reputation with the factions along the road.

details.title: Word Hack
details.short_description: Word Hack is a roguelike deckbuilder where you hack your enemies by finding patterns in their names. Gain prestige, spend it, and trade programs to hack enemies and friends! All in a terminal user interface (TUI) style presentation.

details.title: Backpack Syndicate
details.short_description: Your backpack is your build. Explore first-person dungeons, take on enemies in this backpack auto-battler, and unlock new characters as your syndicate grows.

details.title: Editor Simulator
details.short_description: Go from a broke video editor to an industry icon working with top creators and making serious money. Land clients, improve your skills and upgrade your setup as you climb your way to the top of the industry.

details.title: Scindistella
details.short_description: Scindistella is a fast-paced space arcade game about a large-scale war between two powers. Take part in fighter battles, destroy cruisers and stations, fight in planetary orbits, and invade enemy systems.

details.title: Arc of Icarus
details.short_description: Build and lead your colony on a lost ringworld, where deadly conditions await on both sides while the world keeps turning! Progress through technological evolution, survive cultural revolution, and govern with a wise and steady hand!

details.title: Papaya Plaza
details.short_description: Rebuild a faded tourist town as its new mayor! Place shops and decorations, staff them with quirky villagers to earn cash each day, and help out with their favours. Every night the judges score your town, so rank up, unlock new buildings, and get that coveted 5-star rating. Peep peep!

details.title: Code Cross
details.short_description: A game where you must solve puzzles to see the full picture.

details.title: Endless Endless Ocean
details.short_description: Suddenly appearing in existence, clinging onto your fragile life, travel an endless ocean in a goal of finding out if you can escape. Survival isn't just about food and shelter, but you're bound to finding that out.

details.title: Sang-Je
details.short_description: Will you master the movement and techniques to infiltrate a crumbling research facility in the far future. In a race against time you must uncover the harrowing secrets that lie deep beneath. Something has awakened there, something that threatens to change the world forever.

details.title: Kolchanovo: The Manor
details.short_description: A journalist arrives to investigate a children’s sanatorium in an old merchant house that was reported burned down. But the building stands completely intact. Everything feels surreal and wrong. A little girl watching him from one of the windows might be the only one who knows the truth.

details.title: Withering State
details.short_description: Act as Premier Alexander Sants in a time of stagnation, division, and the falling of walls. Will you steer the brotherly nations of the People's Republic of Sudlivia toward the liberal West, reinforce the crumbling East, or forge a new path? Or even be ousted before becoming the General Secretary?

details.title: Ominous Gift
details.short_description: Escape this dungeon that's like a prison! Embark on an adventure through the remnants of an ancient kingdom, using unique weapons that define how you traverse the world, fight your way through hostile inhabitants as you find the path out of this dungeon that was once a great kingdom.

details.title: STEEL PRINCESS
details.short_description: Explore an open field, hunt powerful enemies, unlock and evolve skills, and choose which bosses to face first in this Souls-like 3D action RPG.

details.title: Hound Riders
details.short_description: A western post-apocalyptic roguelike deckbuilder where cards are bullets. Build your ammo, chain blood-magic combos, and target enemy aim spots in tactical turn-based duels. Explore a cursed wasteland in a nonlinear map where every route, shot, and choice matters.

details.title: Fragments of Self: Thoughts
details.short_description: My life has changed drastically: a new country, university, dormitory, work. Drowsiness and fatigue have become a habit, just like the silhouettes I’ve started seeing in my peripheral vision.

details.title: Syncron Arena
details.short_description: Reject mindless stat checks in this evolved Souls-like Auto Battler! Master Time Freeze, Parry, & Poise Break to dominate the battlefield. Use "Logic Bridging" to craft god-tier builds that defy common sense. You aren't just a spectator—conquer the broken world as a decisive ally.

details.title: Time Crack
details.short_description: A thriller and mystery visual novel about broken trust and the search for truth, when a high-school student is accused of his parents’ brutal murder. Every choice might bring you closer to the truth... or end in tragedy.

details.title: Campus Confidential
details.short_description: Campus Confidential is an LGBTQ slice-of-life dating sim with a supernatural subplot. Enjoy your campus experience, choose your subjects, study hard (or not), meet potential love interests of different genders... and try to uncover the mysteries shrouding the campus!

details.title: Quinquennial
details.short_description: An RPG adventure featuring real-time dungeon crawling, exploration, and turn-based tactics battles! Choose your character class. Fight, loot, level up, gain perks, improve stats and skills. All-original 3D voxel graphics, interactive environments, many different dungeon styles, crafting, and more.

details.title: Quill & Sword: Fate of Eryndor
details.short_description: A fantasy grand strategy game where you lead any realm you want, manage resources, forge alliances, and command armies across a hand-painted world. Plan, negotiate, and conquer to shape the balance of power in Quill & Sword: Fate of Eryndor.

details.title: Mooshie's Kitchen: Reheated
details.short_description: Mooshie's Kitchen was once a place of fun and joy for decades until it shut down in 2023. Since then, it's been surrounded in rumor and mystery. What could have happened on the day of Mooshie's Kitchen's closure?

details.title: Beyond the Doors
details.short_description: Explore an office building hiding a sinister lab underneath. Question reality as the world is warped and distorted around you. Every door leads to a new nightmare. What is real deep down in the recesses of your mind? Some demons cannot be defeated - you can only keep running.

details.title: Ishing
details.short_description: Ishing is a rogue-lite, top-down, action adventure. You'll sail through an ever-changing archipelago, slay sea monsters, and fish fish.

details.title: SCP: Rift Moles
details.short_description: Single-player and co-op survival horror game set in the SCP Universe. You are sent on a one-way mission into unstable parallel dimensions, armed only with a strange machine. Navigate unforgiving environments, evade hostile anomalies and survive for as long as you can while gathering resources.

details.title: Squid Hunt 1923
details.short_description: Experience a unique flow that echoes the early icons of the shooter genre. Captivated by grotesque atmosphere, driven by ever-growing numbers – you plunge into portals, eliminate aliens, collect loot and gather experience. At a pace you set yourself.

details.title: Motocon
details.short_description: The premiere unmanned motorsport - MOTOCON. Take home the most cash with your robo-motorcycle by destroying the opposition with gadgets and brute force.

details.title: Fowl Legacy 2: Heavenbound
details.short_description: What the cluck?! Ricardo was sent to... Heaven? Yeah, now he's mad. Travel across the weirdest places, leap gracefully over the abyss, discover mysterious and powerful secrets, and fight to escape this "heavenly" prison!

details.title: Alterfauna: A Weirdlife Park
details.short_description: Join Neli as she takes her first steps in the Alterfauna (super)natural preserve. Attract, tame, and photograph over 40 species of hand-painted creatures, fantastic monsters and ferocious beasts. Your new friends will accompany you as you discover a world full of magic.

details.title: Frankenstein's Monster
details.short_description: Solo, or online for 2-4 players. Compete to build the best monster, by collecting a matching set of monster parts, helped by whatever weird creature assistant you can design. Take on the single player campaign or go mad scientist against friends (with prox chat).

details.title: Sin or Suffer
details.short_description: Sin or Suffer is a brutal mix of survival-horror and JRPG. Locked in a medieval prison, you awake amidst a cold silence. The guards are gone; inmates and madness own the place. Something terrible lurks underground. But the only way to the truth is down.

details.title: Pakku Pony
details.short_description: Pakku Pony is a 2D virtual pet simulator where you raise your own pony! It’s a chill point-and-click game where you take care of your little garden, cook delicious dishes and relax with fun minigames. Oh, and don’t forget to look stylish with cosmetics and customization options!

details.title: Groove Defense
details.short_description: Tower defense meets music game. Your towers build the soundtrack, enemies move to the rhythm. Defend to the groove!

details.title: Family Reunion
details.short_description: Your typical incremental family dinner table simulator where you play as a very bored child trying to speedrun the evening.

details.title: Appetite of the Abyss
details.short_description: Appetite of the Abyss is a survival cooking roguelite about hunger, discovery, and consequences. Learn what an abyssal creature craves, prepare meals to satisfy it, and protect your tribe. Will you master its appetite, or suffer its wrath?

details.title: SongRunner
details.short_description: A puzzle platformer where the platforms are your own musical loops! Navigate handcrafted stages full of puzzly platforming challenges while creating platforms in time with a high energy original soundtrack!

details.title: No Critters Were Harmed!
details.short_description: No Critters were Harmed is a co-op dungeon-delving adventure for up to four players where players must rush against the clock to escape a collapsing dungeon with a powerful MacGuffin that works to thwart their escape. Treasure, glory, and really cool hats await those who make it out alive!

details.title: Very Disco, Disco Very!
details.short_description: Everyone locks in moves at once, then the simulation takes over. A dense, chaotic programming game for 1 to 8 players where pushes, cards, and chain reactions ensure nothing goes as intended.

details.title: Gravity Goblins
details.short_description: A gravity-bending roguelite collectathon where you ascend an ever-shifting tower. Manipulate geometry to your whims, snag some coins, and play the night away at the local arcade! You'll need all the upgrades and trinkets you can gather to discover the secret buried at the top of The Old Stipe...

details.title: Lulu Dimensional Leaper
details.short_description: Warp through the stage at high speed, dodge attacks, close the distance in an instant, and overwhelm powerful foes in this easy-to-play, exhilarating 2D action game! Enjoy the cool action of a cute girl, along with plenty of meta, lighthearted conversations!

details.title: Duckbound
details.short_description: Welcome to Duckbound, a light-hearted turn-based RPG where mischief meets quackery.

details.title: Carmagist
details.short_description: Civilization vs. the Demon Lord?! Carmagist is a deck-building strategy game set in a ruined world where the Demon Lord has shattered civilization. Lead a nation on the brink of extinction and build up Tech, Funds, and Population to reclaim the future — every choice shapes your nation’s fate.

details.title: Wild Shapers
details.short_description: Weaken enemies with Runes, then consume their weaknesses with a Heavy Attack to unleash chain reactions. Develop your Runes and your hero’s signature abilities to change how you fight in this fast-paced hack-and-slash action roguelite.

details.title: Dungeons & Meows: Hero Cats
details.short_description: Find hidden cats in a medieval fantasy setting. Use heroic skills to rescue kittens in a charming hand-drawn hidden object game.

details.title: Pollinate or Die
details.short_description: Master a variety of abilities to attack, evade and control waves of enemies and epic bosses. Pollinate beautiful flowers to receive strong buffs. Rejuvenate Earth by cleansing pollution, unlocking many fun special abilities. Save your friends and unite the bees.

details.title: ACCURSED
details.short_description: Investigate the cursed town of Midnight Falls in a roguelike horror RPG. Scavenge powerful relics, outlast vicious foes, and cut down the awakened Ancient Deity before it devours everything. Every run is different, and the town hides secrets in every shadow.

details.title: Tarnex Warfare
details.short_description: Command modern military units along a dynamic frontline, plan operations, and fight battles on maps based on real-world terrain.

details.title: You Remembered
details.short_description: Type letters that fall and become part of the world. Use their shape and attributes to navigate the puzzles and secrets.

details.title: King of Freshwater
details.short_description: "King of Freshwater " is a fish-themed Boss Rush action game featuring intense combat and knockback mechanics. Players control a small fish challenging dozens of larger aquatic predators in brutal battles.

details.title: Glider64
details.short_description: Collect, steal and blast your way through the Glider League! Build a massive chain, fight off your rivals and race to the Gate to score big.

details.title: Eclipse
details.short_description: Three friends known as The Ghost Hunters are documenting abandoned locations. What begins as a normal episode suddenly turns into a nightmare inside The Holloway Mansion. Something terrifying happens, leaving Jack to survive alone in the mansion and face the horrors.

details.title: Insanity Path
details.short_description: A plague spreads alongside a spree of sudden disappearances... You don't need more to get on with your adventure. Step into the world of an Auto-battler/Roguelite, where each of your mistakes will send you further down the path of Insanity. Will you be able to free the forest from this tragic curse?

details.title: Tafl Throne Breakers
details.short_description: Play like a Viking in this cunning game of strategy - help your Jarl escape the battlefield or capture them before they do. Endlessly enjoyable with multiple variations, AI and online opponents and regular events to determine who is the grand master of Tafl!

details.title: Hardcourt Balls
details.short_description: Hardcourt Balls is a fast-paced, turn-based adaptation of the real-world game of tennis. With just a few simple rules, the roll of dice, and tactical use of skill "cards", it manages to capture some of the nuances and excitement that make tennis such a great sport.

details.title: Blood Court
details.short_description: Blood Court is a Souls-like action RPG within a dark fantasy, horrifying world. Explore PSX styled Environments, battle blood hungry monsters, and piece together a story told through environments, and voiceless cinamatics.

details.title: Praxium
details.short_description: Praxium is a 2D precision platformer that blends fast-paced movement with strategic deckbuilding. Gain movement abilities, transform scoring rules, and even modify levels themselves to achieve the highest score possible while running, jumping, and sliding across 100 levels of pure platforming fun!

details.title: Mascot Mayhem (Asymmetrical Horror)
details.short_description: Asymmetrical Mascot Horror survival game where two mascots must team up to kill ALL the survivors. Featuring crossover characters from all across the mascot horror universe (and beyond!)

details.title: Black Mountain of Tlaltecuhtli
details.short_description: Third-person supernatural action-adventure in a living Aztec mountain. Climb collapsing ruins, shift dimensions to fight reality-warped enemies, and navigate Loop Zones where environments reset. The deeper you go, the closer you come to what the Aztecs sealed away.

details.title: Loafing Dungeon
details.short_description: Loafing Dungeon is a fully automatic desktop idle game. Build your hero team on the desktop, equip them with gear and skills, and then launch the adventure on auto-pilot. The game runs continuously in the background, ensuring your progression and rewards are always fight, whether you're busy or free

details.title: Bird Roll 64
details.short_description: This recovered copy of a lost 3D ball-rolling platformer from the 90s appears to have been created by eldritch forces from out of this world. Would you be able to find all its secrets and escape its surreal spaces?

details.title: NO PAROLE
details.short_description: Up to 16 players, one prison, friendly fire on. Raid a city where the dead get back up unless you burn them, haul the loot home and hold the walls when the government comes to bury the evidence. Then it sets the city on fire. Your crew dies for good. You don't. You just don't know why yet.

details.title: 4Born
details.short_description: A tactical roguelite RPG where every run forces you to adapt. Explore procedural dungeons under fog of war. Learn spells, gain items and forge each of your four heroes into one of many powerful classes. Build your team with what you get and break the game.

details.title: VOIMA
details.short_description: NO MORE BLOCKS. VOIMA is the next step in the sandbox survival genre. Multiplayer included.

details.title: Beachside Cafe Simulator
details.short_description: Run your own dessert restaurant in a French beach town! Cook crepes, waffles, ice cream and more. Serve tourists and locals, and expand your menu. Manage supplies, hire employees, upgrade your equipment, and grow your space to build your dream seaside dessert spot.

name: Night of her vanishing in fireworks

details.title: Night of her vanishing in fireworks
details.short_description: The Night She Disappeared in the Fireworks is a short visual novel set in a small Chinese city and centered on esports. You play as Liu Lan, a high school esports player, as he faces three life-changing matches and, together with two heroines, witnesses a fate rewritten by fireworks.

details.title: Necro Pop
details.short_description: Necro Pop is an all-new action genre platformer we lovingly refer to as Arcadevania. On your adventure, you will discover new abilities, upgrades, secrets. You can free your ghostly friends using multiple combat abilities, magics, and maybe even a minion across multiple re-playable dungeons!

details.title: RePair in the Space
details.short_description: RePair in the Space is a game where an alien and a robot must repair their ship. Whether playing with a friend or embarking on this journey alone, you’ll have to craft and use items to fix every sector of the ship, battling against time, haste... and sometimes against your friend or even yourself!

details.title: Farlane
details.short_description: Command a Nomad-class Frontier Runner and lead your crew on the edge of a fading galactic empire. Take on freelance contracts, explore unstable farlanes, upgrade your ship, and survive where civilization ends.

details.title: Slaughter of Luminance
details.short_description: Search for your love in this devastating, unforgiving world of SOL. Face the burnt dystopia in search of what you had but lost. Get lost in the desert, encounter, help and eliminate characters.

details.title: Snooze Control
details.short_description: An arcade driving game about mastering the art of the nap - while driving! Steer a brakeless truck through traffic on never-ending roads while skillfuly managing your Snooze-O-Meter - read the road, pick your moment, and keep the truck in control.

details.title: Becoming None
details.short_description: Becoming None is an RPG about the loss of identity and homogenization. Experience a story told through collectable memories you can view at your own pace, alongside deep turn-based combat, customizable classes, and countless secrets.

details.title: Divination & Survivors
details.short_description: Survive spirit hordes in an ink-wash bamboo grove. Toss three coins on level-up, pick an upgrade, and evolve five skills from 64 hexagrams. Face three bosses, then see how the hexagrams you formed shape a reading on the theme you chose.

details.title: Little Dao
details.short_description: Little Dao is a 3D eastern fantasy MMORPG where players explore a floating mainland shaped by the rivalry between Ru and Mo, battle otherworldly monsters in real-time combat, complete quests, improve gear and skills, and build guild power with friends.

details.title: City Party
details.short_description: Chase the crown across the board and finish with the most coins to win! Watch out for traps and lurking enemies. Use cards to turn the tide and recruit allies to help you out of tough spots. Play through levels solo or team up with a friend for ranked matches. Join the fun in City Party!

details.title: Mahou Shoujo Y
details.short_description: A visual novel that combines two popular genres: mahou shoujo and yuri. Help the girls fight evil in turn-based battles and nurture their relationship. Only you decide how the story ends.

details.title: Splashdown
details.short_description: Fend off hordes of evil floaties in treacherous lazy rivers with your trusty water gun!

details.title: Triglav Online
details.short_description: Real-time strategy meets MMO. Pick your faction – Elven Empire, Demon Cult, or Steampunk Dwarves – and command armies in massive PvP battles with hundreds of players. Build guilds, forge alliances, play politics. Session-based. Free to Play.

details.title: H.E.M.A.
details.short_description: In this four-player cooperative survival horror first-person shooter, you and your group must search for failed experiments, manage scarce loot, and escape the abandoned corporate facility before it's too late.

details.title: NOSTRA
