details.short_description: A dark fantasy RPG where side-view party battles turn on timing: build Boost, raise a Ward, parry on the frame and break the guard. Loot rolls with affixes, sets and runewords. Three kingdoms hold a fragile peace while something older stirs. Play the alpha demo now.

details.title: Mineral Zone
details.short_description: Build a factory by day, defend it by night. Mine ore, automate it over belts and keep the grid alive, then hold the line with towers your factory feeds and your own ship in the fight. Solo or online co-op for up to 4 players.

details.title: Finding Frankie 2
details.short_description: Trapped inside a deadly televised game show, you must parkour through a massive obstacle complex. Wall run, rail grind, and vault past twisted traps in the final season. Win the $10 million prize, or die trying. Frankie is waiting for you and he’s not holding back.

details.title: Null Signal
details.short_description: The machines won. You wake in a forsaken world where you must scavenge, build and explore to survive on your own or with friends. As nature encroaches due to humanity's absence, will you ally with it or use the technology that destroyed us to empower yourself?

details.title: Plumber Simulator
details.short_description: Become a plumber and restore water flow in suburban homes. Unclog toilets, replace sink traps, renovate bathrooms - the residents can only count on you during an emergency.

details.title: Mayhem À La Carte
details.short_description: Cook, fight, and serve under pressure in this chaotic 4-player co-op first-person cooking shooter. Prepare delicious meals, defend your kitchen from relentless enemies, and keep the orders flowing before everything falls apart.

details.title: Lethal Love
details.short_description: Turn your love lethal. Play as Kyoko, a yandere obsessed with her senpai. Eliminate rivals, make deadly choices and unlock multiple endings with cute arts. Now on PC with full controller support, enhanced graphics and constant updates. Currently in Early Access.

details.title: Varren's Expanse
details.short_description: Explore the wilderness using mice and badger legionnaires, rabbit scouts, and squirrel skirmishers. Every round builds your strength, every round brings new challenges, every round is a fresh expanse!

details.title: BODY COUNT
details.short_description: Drive to catch bodies, crash to rewind time. Road rage at your past selves in this physics-driven, arcade-style game!

details.title: Idol Manager: Virtual Venture
details.short_description: The management simulation game Idol Manager depicted the good and bad sides of the idol industry... another entry in the series is here! This time, the focus is on virtual streamers! Manage a new streaming agency and raise your staff to become the best agency in the industry.

details.title: Yani Again
details.short_description: Yani Again is a high-speed action game. Shift between reality and cyberspace, explore dangerous tracks hidden across the world, and overcome every challenge at extreme speed.

details.title: Money Trees
details.short_description: Punch trees, deposit coins, and buy upgrades until you're harvesting millions from this fortuitous world. But how much can you earn before your time is up...?

details.title: Agro Tycoon
details.short_description: In this management simulator with a charming isometric pixel art aesthetic, you are not just a farmer, but the CEO of your own operation. Start with a modest plot of land, invest your initial capital wisely, and transform a small plantation into a true agribusiness powerhouse.

details.title: Base Boomers
details.short_description: Fire cannons, blast holes through enemy walls and watch entire bases collapse in this chaotic physics-based destruction FPS for up to 4 players. Gather resources, build and defend your base. Play free-for-all or in teams. The last base standing wins!

details.title: Obscurium
details.short_description: Walk a darker Brazil and uncover the creatures its folklore keeps in the deep forest, monsters most players have never seen. A roguelite deckbuilder: sacrifice cards from your hand to summon onto a four-lane ritual board, and seal each one into your grimoire.

details.title: Bathory - Heritage of Blood
details.short_description: Play as Ursula Bathory, the vampire Princess, awakened from a centuries long slumber to claim her throne of blood in this Vampire Soulsvania inspired by Castlevania, Nosferatu and gothic victorian literature classics.

details.title: SMILEC++
details.short_description: This is an app, that allows you to program in C++, in a much more simple, and fast way. You can build your own apps, and games. Program by typing or with visual tools. You can choose how you program, and can choose among any IDE design you like the most. Export your app or game for commercial use.

details.title: Scholar Adventure: Lost Night
details.short_description: An ancient prophecy is about to awaken. Guided by a mysterious artifact, William ventures into Azig, where a secret society, ancient temples, and opposing forces await, trapped beneath the eternal sun. Uncover the truth that could change the fate of these lands.

details.title: Chicken Show
details.short_description: Play as chickens in a TV show for 2 to 4 players, where you must betray your friends to win! Peck, grab, and throw your rivals to gain the upper hand throughout your adventure. Outsmart your opponents and leave them featherless!

name: Mothville: A City of Hidden Things

details.title: Mothville: A City of Hidden Things
details.short_description: The residents of Mothville are always losing things and need the help of someone with eagle eyes! Explore the town’s diverse neighborhoods, talk to the animal residents, complete their quests, and find everything that’s gone missing in this wacky, story-driven hidden object game.

details.title: Chaincast
details.short_description: A PvP roguelike auto battler where you build a squad and arrange their skills into escalating combos. Battle rival squads and set off a chain reaction that grows stronger with every link.

details.title: Hole Punch Cocktail
details.short_description: "Drink. Kill. Drink. Kill." Enter the dream of Ms. Hangover, a young office worker with a slight alcohol dependency, fight against a twisted reality, and successfully finish your daily routine.

details.title: Dust till Dawn
details.short_description: A retro-paranormal powerwash simulator, where you're a maid restoring a quiet rural Japanese village. Dust, mop, squeegee to your heart's content...but don't stay too late!

details.title: RAT CITY: Ratocracy
details.short_description: Build and Manage a Rat City. Run it into the ground. Literally. Keep your Rats happy and productive. Create for them a glorious colony in the dirt! The never ending demand for the production of products to consume is all consuming. Wait, is this real life? No, it's RAT CITY!

details.title: DRIVE IN THE RAIN
details.short_description: A newly licensed boy drives a highway on a torrential night. In the back seat, his girlfriend is consumed by a "Paranormal Phenomenon" born of a social media firestorm. Beside him, a self-proclaimed expert in modern Paranormal Phenomena. A horror road-movie adventure by playwright Keisuke Tagawa.

details.title: Order 13 VR
details.short_description: A psychological horror VR experience where you work the night shift inside a mysterious warehouse while taking care of your cat. Fulfill orders, survive the darkness, and uncover what hides between the shelves.

details.title: Seaforge: Shores of Atlantis
details.short_description: Beneath the waves, the world of Atlantis awaits. Build your home base on sunlit Mediterranean shores, then dive into sunken ruins to uncover secrets of the deep. Get stronger, dive deeper, and battle dark forces with up to 3 friends in this underwater survival crafting odyssey!

details.title: Monster Fantasy
details.short_description: Hunt giant monsters and build a beautiful home! Monster Fantasy is an action RPG with cozy life-sim elements. As an amnesiac hero, explore Eldoras, battle monsters with companions, befriend villagers, and enjoy fishing, cooking, gathering, and crafting.

details.title: ACORN: Seed of Resistance
details.short_description: Exploration, party building, and against-all-odds heroism in 15-minute roguelike adventures. Shape your rodent companions into a formidable fighting force and unleash them in brutal auto battles to retake your woodland home.

details.title: Insomnia Club
details.short_description: A grounded emotional visual novel about urban insomnia, moral dilemmas, and intimacy. By day, you monetize insomniacs' pain and privacy. By night, you seek help at a real Insomnia Club and meet the women treated as collateral. Are you helping them—or turning them into a better product?

details.title: DesktopDaily
details.short_description: Ami Koharune and Tsukuyomi-chan live on your PC. Chat with voiced characters whose gestures match their words, or watch them cook, read and sleep in a shared home that doubles as a live wallpaper. Free to download, with trial credits for chat.

details.title: The Plague Lords: Black Death
details.short_description: A turn-based tactical party RPG with base building, set during the Black Death. Assemble peasants, craftsmen, and warriors, investigate the plague's mysterious origin, develop your settlement, and fight the infected as disease consumes medieval Europe.

details.title: Arcane Eats
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a delicious twist. Think like a master chef, balancing resources as you strategically combo ingredients to subdue hungry hordes. Recruit a legendary kitchen crew, and rise through the heroic cooking guilds—before The Hunger consumes us all!

details.title: The Whims of the Gods
details.short_description: The Whims of the Gods is a strategic, cooperative city-builder created for joint gameplay in online co-op mode. Build and protect the ancient city, face enemies, and manage resources together! 🏠

name: The Last Hour of an Epic TO THE MOON RPG

details.title: The Last Hour of an Epic TO THE MOON RPG
details.short_description: Jump straight into the very last hour of a 1000-hour RPG. The beginning and the end of the To the Moon series.

details.title: KEMURI
details.short_description: KEMURI is a Yokai-Possession Action Adventure set in KEMURI CITY, where the everyday and paranormal cross paths. Explore as a Yokai Hunter, uncover the unseen with the FOXWINDOW, and wear their powers. Run the streets, race across walls, and cut through the air to dive into the supernatural!

details.title: Grandma(88)
details.short_description: Of course Grandma loves you — but she loves it even more when you simply listen. Dive into her labyrinth of memories, challenge her stories and watch everything around you fall apart. Can you escape her version of the past?

details.title: CODE EXIT
details.short_description: Enter Pantheon, a futuristic city swallowed by darkness and ruled by a rogue AI. Team up with up to 4 players and survive an adaptive pursuer that learns from every mistake. Complete the mission, uncover Minerva’s secrets, and find a way out before the city consumes you.

details.title: Ecosphere
details.short_description: A Fantasy / Steampunk Visual Novel in which you'll make hearts skip a beat! You are Arane Kross, a talented engineer capable of controlling nature with a machine: the Ecosphere! What will be your impact?

details.title: The Hearth and Harbour
details.short_description: Transform a run-down restaurant and build a new life for yourself in this management RPG. Decide what kind of restaurant you want to create and what kind of person you want to be. As a storm brews outside, every choice you make has consequences.

details.title: The Last General
details.short_description: Lead thousands of units in this large scale modern war RTS as you manage economy and logistics, build your war machine, and fight across millions of procedurally generated scenarios, or jump into the battlefield controlling any unit in first or third person at any time.

details.title: HUMANKIND™ 2
details.short_description: Build a civilization that spans the ages in this historical turn-based strategy game. Combine evolving cultures, raise cities, command armies and expand your empire as a changing climate reshapes the world and your path through history.

details.title: UN:Me
details.short_description: UN:Me is a soul triage adventure. Four souls share one girl’s body, each certain it is the real one, yet only one can remain. Through dialogue you search a beautiful, unsettling world for its true owner, fleeing the traumas that surface as you go. When only one can stay, which will you keep?

details.title: PANLINE
details.short_description: Welcome to post-scarcity! But you’re not on the list. Deliver to make a living off-grid while PANLINE, the abundance engine that keeps the city endlessly supplied, begins to change. Earn currency, favors, kit upgrades and work the runner scene to unlock new contacts and fixers.

name: The Recipe for Life: A Horror About (not) Saving Lives

details.title: The Recipe for Life: A Horror About (not) Saving Lives
details.short_description: Travel across a quietly dying world in your RV, helping people with suicidal thoughts. Dive into the icebergs of their trauma and decide whether each of them deserves salvation — and whether you deserve it too.

details.title: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons
details.short_description: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons is a dungeon-crawler RPG where classic literature meets anime Girls! Assemble a party inspired by legendary characters such as Alice, Juliet, Dante, and Raven, then lead them into treacherous dungeons crawling with monsters, traps, treasure, and otherworldly horrors.

details.title: Karma Exorcist
details.short_description: The underworld lies in ruins, ravaged by evil karma. In this unknown and perilous realm of the dead, you must fight against demonic forces, collect mystical artifacts, face the Yama Kings and the Ghost Emperors, sever the Karma, and reforge the path of reincarnation.

details.title: Glimm&Grimm
details.short_description: Glimm&Grimm is a RTS | TD. Set in the far dark Future! Using Ones Glimms and their Unique Abilties, Defenses, and Powers against the Nightmares of the Grimm, that are longing for ones Soul! There are Many Areas, causing varied Strategies along with changing Wheather, Seasons and Obstacles over Time!

details.title: GlagStone
details.short_description: A 1-bit story-driven city builder inspired by late-80s Macintosh aesthetics. Rebuild a remote northern island settlement between warring nations and uncover the mystery at its heart.

details.title: Anhedonia: Sanctuary of Ash
details.short_description: A third-person medieval dark fantasy adventure RPG with survival horror elements. As Edgar, a former priest with a fractured memory, explore a ruined world, solve environmental puzzles and uncover its secrets. Face twisted creatures and perform exorcisms to free the possessed.

details.title: Forgotten Terror
details.short_description: Moving into a close senior's home, but nightmares follow. Terrifying ghostly figures, a senior who seems to be hiding something. What secret lies behind the door that cannot be opened?

details.title: Scavenger Survivors
details.short_description: In this 1-4 player top-down roguelite/survivors hybrid, the machines already won. Now, you scavenge! Play as fat scavengers hauling loot from the ruins of the world. Grab and throw anything that isn't bolted down, cram it into your armored RIG, and survive the robot swarm until extraction.

details.title: Ogre Stampede
details.short_description: Ogre Stampede is a physics-based bullet heaven with incremental upgrades set in a chaotic mosh pit. Waves of hopelessly stupid trolls and ogres are running wild and pushing and shoving each other around. Level up your strength and fight to be the last one standing and become the new chieftain!

details.title: MOLTYN
details.short_description: MOLTYN: Superhero destruction sandbox where every pixel is simulated: rock, water, lava, ice and metal melt, flood, freeze and collapse for real. Every power of the earth, 18 missions, kaiju fights, free-play worlds and CREATE, a level editor with level sharing. Early Access 12 Nov 2026.

details.title: ACT OUT
details.short_description: A chaotic online party game of 3D charades. Grab a floppy puppet, act out your secret word on a live theater stage, and race your friends to guess it before the clock runs out. Push-to-talk voice, custom Workshop maps, and a winner's podium. Best with 3+ friends.

details.title: Ship Happens: Pirates Wanted
details.short_description: A co-op game for 1–4 players where you and your friends dream of becoming fearsome pirates, but for now you're sailing in a leaky tub you call a ship. Patch holes, put out fires, raid weaker ships, flee from stronger ones, and upgrade your vessel. Work together, because at sea... Ship Happens!

details.title: Grampage: Life at 67
details.short_description: YOUR RETIREMENT ISN’T GOING TO FUND ITSELF! Pension not cutting it? No problem. Grab up to three fellow retirees, pull off outrageous heists, and steal your way to the retirement you deserve. Work together when you have to, but remember: only one of you gets to retire!

details.title: Documancy
details.short_description: An incremental management game where you use magical documents to empower an auto-battling warrior. Every victory unlocks a new document, introducing a new way to improve your warrior. What will the next one do?

details.title: Cat Stack
details.short_description: Kidnapped by cats! In this frantic physics-based roguelite, your goal is to balance an endless tower of kitties on your head. Dash back and forth to keep your balance, survive chaotic events, and use special cats with unique powers to keep the stack from collapsing under its own weight.

details.title: TILLY'S ROLL
details.short_description: A turn-based creature dice battler where every roll counts! Capture creatures, collect dice, and battle with strategy and luck to win THE CROWN JEWELS TOURNAMENT!

details.title: Abyss of Kings
details.short_description: A Dark-Fantasy Action-Adventure inspired by the Kingsfield series. Explore the remnants of an underground civilization and battle sentient chess pieces. Discover magical rings and use them to create your own spells. Meet the last inhabitants of a dead kingdom and escape the Abyss.

details.title: Spectral Report
details.short_description: Enter abandoned locations as Spectral Reporters to prove the existence of ghosts. But beware: sanity is fragile, and not everything you see is real. Cooperate with your team, investigate the place, take evidences, and finally prove that ghosts are real.

details.title: 红夏
details.short_description: 《红夏》是一款以剧情体验为主的视觉小说游戏。八月末的某天，二十多名师生被神秘地困在学校里，等待他们的将是一场自相残杀……

details.title: Architect Fray
details.short_description: A dramatic Deckbuilding RPG featuring artwork by Satoshi Matsuura. Carry only a few cards into the dungeon. Master preparation, time your Parries, and dive into a story where every skill holds a memory. A massive scenario awaits in this fusion of strategy and narrative.

details.title: Dungeon Treaders
details.short_description: A classic-style 3D dungeon crawler that blends nostalgic challenge with modern comfort. Enjoy flexible character creation and a classic world, now with streamlined, trial-and-error gameplay.

details.title: NORMA: Story of One Platform
details.short_description: Explore the secrets of this world and discover what the local government, working alongside powerful corporations, has planned in its pursuit of complete control over the population.

details.title: The Archaeologists
details.short_description: The Archaeologists is a single-player settlement builder. Establish multiple settlements through manufacturing and trade. Raise great structures across the mountain to link them into one interconnected economy. Dig into the rock to unearth valuable artifacts and uncover a forgotten past.

details.title: C6: Frontlines
details.short_description: C6: Frontlines is a bullet hell co-op roguelike where only YOU (and your friends) can bring the Azapall galaxy to peace. Wield 30+ weapons and gadgets of mass destruction to even the playing field, wave after wave, against a seemingly endless onslaught of evil!

details.title: PNEUMA Division
details.short_description: Pneuma is an online co-op sci-fi paranormal investigation game for up to 4 players. Operate advanced paranormal tech to investigate, analyze, and outmaneuver deadly ghosts before you are possessed. Speak rituals aloud with your own voice to bind, expose, or provoke what hunts you.

details.title: Forest Whiskers
details.short_description: Rescue kittens, care for your growing cat family, and watch new generations inherit their parents' traits. Explore, craft, train your cats, and bring the forest back to life.

details.title: One Last Push
details.short_description: Survive the horrors of WW1 in this intense PvE survival shooter. Scavenge supplies, earn your regiment’s respect, and fight for reinforcements before you become another name lost in the mud.

details.title: Ninja JaJaMaru: Yokai Night Parade
details.short_description: Ninja JaJaMaru-kun returns in a yokai-filled hack-and-slash action game! Stray into a dungeon party, defeat dancing yokai, master flashy Ninpo, and amass an arsenal of ninja gear! Clear special "Yokai Night Parade" rules for loot, decorate your base for stat boosts and save Princess Sakura!

details.title: Millennium Slumber
details.short_description: Survive 400,000 years on a planet infested with an alien calamity! Gather resources, build a base and defend against hordes of nocturnal monsters in this rogue-like with cryostasis mechanics.

details.title: Super Space Crystals
details.short_description: Flow through a glowing field of musical crystals in this relaxing and immersive zen bullet hell. Shatter the crystals to collect their magic and upgrade your powers. Fend off enemy spacecraft, and save the galaxy from The Fraternal Brotherhood of Evil Magic Space Robots - or just enjoy the vibes!

details.title: Beyond: Fire & Ice
details.short_description: A mythological action RPG where Fire and Ice collide. Play as Shangdi, the Emperor of Flames, and Skadi, the Ice Queen, as they battle through the war-torn world of Athos to uncover the dark force manipulating their kingdoms.

details.title: End of Eden
details.short_description: End of Eden is an open world RPG where you arrive unwanted on a cursed island and must earn every inch. Master tight melee, archery and magic. Join a faction, grow deep talents, craft gear, and explore a living world with real routines, tough bosses and meaningful quests.

details.title: Haamupeli: Wrath of the Iku-Turso
details.short_description: Haamupeli: Wrath of the Iku-Turso is a fantasy-themed action RPG adventure game about vanquishing an ancient threat. Recruit allies, find powerful items, develop your character and interact with the game world and its inhabitants to archieve your goals.

details.title: Crystalia
details.short_description: Crystalia is a first-person tower defense game mixing automation, management and exploration set in a utopian sci-fi world built on crystal extraction. Dig into caves, build autonomous defense zones and uncover the history of a civilization shaped around crystals.

name: Alice is Dead: Hearts and Diamonds

details.title: Alice is Dead: Hearts and Diamonds
details.short_description: A point and click noir mystery, set in a grim and corrupt Wonderland. Alice is Dead: Hearts and Diamonds is a complete remake of the classic Flash game trilogy, including all new art, added puzzles, expanded lore, and plenty of secrets for old and new fans alike.

details.title: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 3
details.short_description: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 3 is a wholly-new Dragon Ball experience, where you decide the hero you want to be in an unexplored Dragon Ball world: AGE 1000.

details.title: Beasts of Steel
details.short_description: Beasts of Steel is a WWII combined-arms game. Fight as a rifleman, tank crew or pilot in the same battle, on maps generated from real landscapes, or command the whole war in a turn-based campaign. Play online with up to 64 players, or offline with bots in battles of up to 128 soldiers.

details.title: Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement
details.short_description: Unravel the dark history of the Bloodstained universe and explore a hauntingly immersive 16th-century England steeped in a 2.5D gothic atmosphere, enthralling players in strategic battles, crafting, and exploration across a sprawling, cursed land.

details.title: Everbloom
details.short_description: Everbloom is a cute and cozy social farming sim set in a world of whimsy - grow buckets of popcorn right on the plant and make chocolate milk by feeding your cows candy bars. Grow, care, build, decorate, and explore the world of Everbloom solo or with your friends.

details.title: Light Odyssey
details.short_description: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

details.title: Espiocracy
details.short_description: Espiocracy is an espionage grand strategy game where you lead the intelligence agency of one of 74 playable countries. Rewrite history from the shadows as you influence ideologies, stage coups, and wage proxy wars. Subterfuge takes center stage as you establish a new world order.

details.title: Fragile Existence
details.short_description: Save humanity from the brink of extinction in this sci-fi strategy game of survival. Travel among the stars to seek out resources, establish and develop colonies to sustain civilization, and grow your military might to push back against an overwhelming threat.

name: 東方霊守祀 ~ Consciousness' Unity of Opposites

details.title: 東方霊守祀 ~ Consciousness' Unity of Opposites
details.short_description: Gensokyo, the sacred land of the forgotten, mysterious spirits whisper silently from every corner. Burning torii lintels, an uncanny full moon—where do these visions of the present world lead? Become a maiden within the barrier and uncover the truth behind the strange tale of the world of stillness.

details.title: IKUMA - The Frozen Compass
details.short_description: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

details.title: SPINE - This is Gun Fu
details.short_description: SPINE is a single-player action game about close-quarters gunfights with aesthetics of Gun Fu movies. Step into the stunning cyberpunk world with rebellious street artist Redline and her sentient combat implant Spine as they defy the autocratic AI regime in search of Redline's captured brother.

name: Lair Land Story 2: Mist of Sea

details.title: Lair Land Story 2: Mist of Sea
details.short_description: After traveling far to the southern end of Lair Land, seven knights have reached Chainch Bay. Settled in a small tropical fishing village surrounded by ruins, they will spend the next few years building a new life here while facing the most challenging quest they will ever meet.

details.title: ILL
details.short_description: A realistic first-person action horror game that takes you into a dark fort overtaken by a mysterious entity. Unpredictable monsters, a visceral dismemberment system, and realistic physics create an atmosphere of relentless terror.

details.title: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades
details.short_description: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades is a turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenaries in a medieval fantasy world. Try your hand at mercenary work, trading, or exploring, and keep your crew well stocked for brutal combat in a procedurally-generated open-world campaign.

details.title: Some Puzzles
details.short_description: A surreal, FMV puzzle adventure. "It's got some puzzles."

details.title: Lock In
details.short_description: An escape-the-room puzzle game. Solve locks to unlock locks. Unlock locks to unlock more locks. Lock in.

details.title: Element TD 3 - Tower Defense
details.short_description: Element TD 3 takes the tradition of combining powerful elements for unique towers and adds heroes. Infinitely replayable and endless, this is a Tower Defense that blends classic gameplay with modern additions. Play with up to 8 players cooperatively or competitively.

details.title: Chronoscript: The Endless End
details.short_description: “Chronoscript: The Endless End” is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its end—across 2D pages and a 3D manor.

name: Lufia I & II The Sinistrals Saga

details.title: Lufia I & II The Sinistrals Saga
details.short_description: Lufia and its sequel, Lufia II, return! In a love letter to JRPG fans, these two dramatic tales of love and loss, which moved countless players to tears, are back!

name: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart

details.title: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart
details.short_description: Fighting is hard, right? Let your party do it for you! Romance Monster Girls and traverse the Dungeon! Hopefully they'll all get along... right?

details.title: Laica
details.short_description: Live with Laica, a mysterious girl alone aboard a drifting space station, and explore the nightmare spreading beneath your quiet days together. A first-person sci-fi adventure that fuses survival horror with a slow-burn relationship. Is what waits ahead love, or despair?

details.title: Model Kit Studio
details.short_description: A rich and relaxing model-building simulator. Enjoy the meditative flow, meet fellow builders, and unwind to a soothing soundtrack as you build, pose, paint, and display your collection.

details.title: L'Agence - The Hearts of Paris
details.short_description: Paris, 1888. In debt after taking over her grandmother's marriage agency, Marie has 7 days to find a wife for her creditor's nephew. But everyone in this case is lying! In this Ace Attorney-style detective visual novel, unmask the client and the suitors, and let love triumph!

details.title: Jiří Kára Simulátor
details.short_description: Jiří Kára Simulátor is a retro FPS inspired by the 90s Czech legend. Explore various districts of post-communist Prague in a fast boomer shooter. Fight your way through pubs, dirty streets and defeat bosses. No common weapons, only street scrap, crowbar and gloomy wild atmosphere.

details.title: Ghost Node
details.short_description: Play as a freelance hacker breaking into high-security facilities to steal corporate secrets in this stealth game. Use your drone to scout ahead, hack and rewire systems to slip past security, grab the data and get out unseen.

details.title: Rift Fishing
details.short_description: Rift Fishing is a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game. Fish through rifts into other worlds to catch mysterious creatures and artifacts. Make friends worldwide, paint together, and jam by the cozy campfire.

details.title: Prospice: Anomalous Logistics
details.short_description: Haul cursed cargo across a haunted island, where the terrain can take your life and every road bears the scars of the past.

details.title: Capital Command
details.short_description: Take the helm of a state-of-the-art warship as you fight epic space battles in a sandbox campaign. Upgrade and customize your ship, master the art of maneuvering, and use a blend of tactical prowess and heavy firepower to overcome deadly threats.

details.title: No Signal: Chornobyl
details.short_description: No Signal is a strictly online co-op psychological horror game set in the abandoned Chornobyl Exclusion Zone. Explore decaying towns, solve tasks together, and question everything—because you and your partner may not be seeing the same reality.

details.title: Horu
details.short_description: Command hundreds of thousands of units across land and space in a galaxy-spanning RTS and 4X hybrid.

details.title: MegaGum
details.short_description: Play as Uja, an orphan searching for answers in this 3D action adventure platformer. Harness the properties of Gum to stick to walls, inflate, and make your way through the MegaGum factory. Face Mister Gum and his mysterious creations to uncover the secrets hidden behind its colorful facade.

details.title: What Floor?
details.short_description: What Floor? is a first-person analog horror game where you operate a sealed control room on Level −7. Monitor elevators descending from the surface, inspect passengers for signs of biological impostors, and decide who is allowed to reach the Colony below.

details.title: Unfair Dungeon
details.short_description: A cruel and simple movement clicker game. Starting with a 1-in-4 chance to move as planned, can you collect the Coin of Rehtaeh and escape in 10 steps? Rage, upgrade, persevere, and discover multiple endings.

details.title: Begraved
details.short_description: A cosy & dark first-person co-op dungeon crawler where you loot cursed crypts, dodge traps, and flee from things that should not move. Escape with treasures snatched from the dead. Decorate your hideout, uncover buried secrets, and remember: the Taxman always comes for his due.

details.title: ALL ADRIFT
details.short_description: A Cosmic Surgery RPG where fire gets wet and water burns. This universe is written in Declarations: operate on a sentence, and reality follows. Take your scalpel to species, creeds, even a planet's nature, and your doctored lines become scripture, then cosmic law. Just paperwork, Imperial Agent.

details.title: Golden Self
details.short_description: A fast paced action roguelike focused on precision combat and punishing boss fights. Embark on a mythic journey to discover your Golden Self.

details.title: Monarch: The Tainted Kingdom
details.short_description: Monarch: TTK is an Action Monster Taming RPG where strategy dictates the flow of combat. Capture monsters, gather their loot to build custom skillsets, and master an engaging Timeline-based combat system. Uncover the secrets of the Archs and break through the corruption plaguing the Continent!

details.title: Loaded Dice
details.short_description: Wager. Survive. Profit. Throw your friends around and bet against them to show who's faster, better, and smarter in this fast action-strategy party game.

details.title: The Jotun Queen
details.short_description: Embark on a journey to a land inspired by real world mythology and meet a cast of colourful characters. Fight tactical battles and save the world from the icy hatred of The Jotun Queen

details.title: Lethal Grace
details.short_description: Order received. Target identified. Proceed with elimination. Play as Grace, a killer android, in this dynamic shooter.

details.title: Legless
details.short_description: A co-op game where you have no legs. Search different maps and clear trials to appease Gods and earn your freedom - all while a giant, quirky pair of legs hunts you down.

details.title: A Dialogue Within
details.short_description: A psychological narrative experience where perception fades and reality unravels. Explore, observe, and feel the descent into the human mind.

details.title: Night Sentinel
details.short_description: Take the night shift as a museum guard in “Night Sentinel”. Complete tasks, investigate anomalies, and survive the growing horrors within. Play solo or co-op and uncover a dark mystery with multiple endings.

details.title: 小角色
details.short_description: 这是一个增加了移动维度的类杀戮尖塔卡牌DBGrogue游戏。构筑中的移动维度将发挥重要作用，你将扮演武士，刺客，猎人，法师等角色体验一段战胜心魔的故事。

details.title: Delete the World
details.short_description: Delete the World is a completely normal visual novel… unless you decide to help her kill everyone.

details.title: Math and Guns
details.short_description: Math and Guns is a top-down roguelite shooter where every right answer reloads your gun. Pick the problems you want, or bring your own flashcards, then fight through seven floors of the Necromancer’s base to rescue your captured squad.

details.title: Stroom
details.short_description: Stroom is a precision platformer built for speed. Master the dash, chain your moves and find the fastest path through 100 handcrafted levels across 5 worlds.

name: The Attic: Fear of the Dark

details.title: The Attic: Fear of the Dark
details.short_description: The Attic is a first-person psychological horror set in a haunted house. Explore forgotten rooms, solve challenging puzzles, and gradually uncover the family’s haunting story. The atmosphere is full of tension and psychedelic vision.. Don’t let fear and tormenting memories take control over you.

details.title: Envido
details.short_description: Grab your cards, play against wandering souls, unlock items at the pub and win all the matches to survive. Scheme your plays, perfect your bluffs and make strategic decisions based on your macumbas. Your match against Mandinga is about to begin!

details.title: Tavern Maid's Daily Life
details.short_description: In 'Tavern Maid’s Daily Life' you play as a maid working at the 'Red Fox Tavern', serving all kinds of customers and enjoying a cozy, eventful everyday life. Between casual chats and daily chores, you’ll gradually uncover the deeper stories and mysteries of the fantasy world around you.

details.title: Fix & Flick
details.short_description: Congratulations! You have been selected as this year's officer for the SICRED SYSTEMS Game Weeks. Your assignment is to buy, sell, and fix second-hand consoles while managing your shop. Serve customers. Uncover secrets. Complete your duties. We look forward to your outstanding service.

details.title: Warp Marked
details.short_description: Warp Marked is an incremental space exploration game. Explore a mysterious uncharted dimension, navigate around its dangers, learn its secrets, and return stronger with every launch!

details.title: Lethargy
details.short_description: Lethargy: Wake up or sleep forever! With the RAV drone, explore, run, escape, or destroy terrifying enemies. In this third-person shooter! Is it a nightmare or reality? Discover the truth before the line between sleep and wakefulness blurs.

details.title: The Pale Banner
details.short_description: Your Father, The king of all of Aldrain, was slain and his crown broken into five pieces by his betrayers when you were only a small child. After many years of training, you set out with your band of followers, The New Order of Light, to take back your throne.

details.title: Dustium
details.short_description: Dustium is a turn-based tactics roguelite where you analyze enemy actions and plan multiple moves for three characters in advance. You may know what the enemy will do, but predicting the outcome is up to you.

details.title: Hero Investor: Business Tycoon
details.short_description: Build an investment firm, trade fictional markets, acquire income-producing property, and create your own ETFs as you grow from a small office into a financial empire in this player-paced management simulation.

details.title: Drill Deep
details.short_description: A coalpunk idle clicker about digging the world's deepest hole. You start with a cozy incremental loop, descend into the madness of a haunted mine and end somewhere you shouldn't have gone

details.title: Bad Magpie
details.short_description: You are a magpie with one wing, a missing flock, and an unhealthy obsession with a fallen star. Steal shiny trinkets, cause chaos, and stick your beak where it doesn’t belong.

details.title: Where is my sword
details.short_description: A mismatched duo—a wicked demon god and a kind-hearted fox girl—is gathering followers!? Travel across many lands and survive hectic yet strategic real-time battles by rummaging through your bag for just the right item! Fight your foes or turn them into followers... What awaits at journey's end?

details.title: Wisword: The Calamitous Starfall
details.short_description: A classic dungeon-crawling RPG set in the fantasy world of Eutolant. Create your own party and face deadly traps and monsters in the depths of labyrinthine dungeons. When it's all over, will your name be written into legend — or onto a headstone?

details.title: Boing Boing Animals
details.short_description: Raise Tamagotchi-style pixel animal friends right on your desktop! Care for slimes from outer space and help them grow into bouncy 'Boing Boing' Earth animals. Feed and play with your adorable friends while completing the Codex! Your tiny companions will always be by your side.

details.title: Screams of the Abyss
details.short_description: Descend into the abyss, following the trail of a vanished expedition. Piece together their story through the recordings they left behind and uncover why none of them ever returned to the surface.

details.title: Wheat and Wrath
details.short_description: Guide a clan of strawfolk through the dawn of agriculture in this fantasy city-builder. Appease gods for favour and knowledge, while avoiding their wrath. Manage your economy, trade with neighbouring villages, and survive raider attacks. Will your village prosper, or wither, burn, and be forgotten?

details.title: Cursed Soulless Vagabonds
details.short_description: Master a dark fantasy rogue-incremental game. Steer your character through massive enemy hordes while your chosen build of floating swords fights for you autonomously. Survive intense, short runs without active skills or healing potions. Die often, keep your loot, and unlock permanent upgrades.

details.title: Buffet Simulator
details.short_description: Build your buffet empire! Grow your restaurant from the ground up and expand to become the biggest buffet by yourself or in co-op with up to 4 players. Handle the cooking, cleaning, customers, and staffing as you create the most expansive menu possible!

details.title: Foxwood Adventure
details.short_description: A cozy survival game designed to be relaxing and approachable. Explore, craft, and learn the basics of survival alone or with someone new to the genre.

details.title: Full Belly Breakout
details.short_description: Navigate the hidden dangers lurking within a wide variety of dishes, savor every bite, fill your stomach, and escape from a terrifying cell. An overwhelming dining experience where eyeballs crawl out of plain rice, sharks burst from soup, and entire universes unfold upon your plate.

details.title: hexGame: Hero Path
details.short_description: The world needs a hero — choose yours. Any NPC can become the chosen one. Explore a living, procedurally generated hex world, carve your own path, craft unique combinations of weapons, tools, and relics, and fight through relentless hordes in fast-paced combat. Every run is different.

details.title: Sit or Die
details.short_description: Music plays, chairs appear. Lie, cooperate, deceive. In a closed cylinder, up to 12 players face unpredictable survival rounds. Find a chair or be eliminated. It's more than a chair—it involves rules, order, perception, and lies. Who will you trust, and who is deceiving you?

details.title: Mutation
details.short_description: Upon waking, he finds a world transformed. Now, he must face the manor's horde of the undead alone and unearth the terrifying truth behind the nightmare.

details.title: Bub
details.short_description: A narrative adventure game about turning your memories into art while you still can. Made with slashes of ink and paint and thousands of cut paper pieces, Bub is a deeply personal, living, breathing game world.

details.title: Dead Star Prison
details.short_description: Dead Star Prison is a unique combination of Deck Building and strategy based Auto-Battling. Build you deck of prisoners and be sure to place them in the most strategic position on the battleground to conquer your enemies in either PVP mode or the single player story mode.

details.title: Curious Calvin
details.short_description: Join Calvin - a small, curious, and kind-hearted creature - on a quest for answers deep underground. Navigate treacherous tunnels, effortlessly swap between three unique forms, and aid other creatures in need along the way.

details.title: Used Car Dealer Simulator
details.short_description: Buy and sell used cars Find cars at the right price, add them to your dealership, and sell them for profit. Run your own car dealership Manage your car lot, organize your vehicles, and grow your business step by step.

name: Jesus Christ: A Gospel Visual Novel

details.title: Jesus Christ: A Gospel Visual Novel
details.short_description: Step into the age of the Gospels and witness the teachings, miracles, and redemption of Jesus Christ. This visual novel, centered on biblical stories, presents a journey of sacrifice and hope through dialogue and chapter-based storytelling.

details.title: Idiots 4 Order
details.short_description: Swipe deliveries, scream directions, juggle pizzas and drive like a maniac in this chaotic 2-4 player co-op delivery game. One moped, 4 idiots, infinite chaos.

details.title: ALONE TOGETHER
details.short_description: ALONE TOGETHER is a psychological survival horror game drawn entirely by hand. Explore strange and oppressive locations, solve puzzles, and try to find your missing sister. As you search, you’ll discover that something is trying to stop you.

details.title: GLITCHVERSE
details.short_description: GLITCHVERSE is a knowledge-lock Metroidvania puzzle game. You will explore this unknown and perilous world, acquire a variety of wondrous abilities, discover unexpected ways to use them, and ultimately unravel the secrets of this world.

details.title: Fox Wanderer
details.short_description: Fight, explore, and collect. Step into the role of a wandering fox in this Eastern-fantasy Metroidvania, braving a beautifully crafted world fraught with danger.

details.title: TINY ASTRONAUTS
details.short_description: Become a tiny astronaut and escape from an unknown planet where you crash-landed in a dream! A 2D vertical-scrolling action puzzle game where you use gravity to clear a path forward.

details.title: LootHold
details.short_description: Loot the day. Hold the night. LootHold throws you and up to three friends into a world the machines won. Strip the ruins by day, race the sun home, spend the loot on guns or defences. Then hold your bunker through the night against waves of bloodthirsty robots. Survive to take the fight to them.

details.title: Waifus VS Robots
details.short_description: They took the ones they loved. They brought guns. Fight through an army of robots in this action-packed 2.5D roguelite inspired by classic run-and-gun games. Shoot, explode, upgrade your weapons, and make the machines pay.

details.title: Last Frame
details.short_description: Last Frame is a free-to-play, first-person survival horror game set within an isolated West Virginia corporate facility. With no traditional inventory, explore your surroundings, manage what you carry in your hands, and uncover the secrets to discover your true purpose.​

details.title: Midnight Watch
details.short_description: It is a psychological horror survival game with a millennium-era Chinese dreamcore aesthetic. You play as a night guard in an old residential compound, defending against the "unspeakable things" that wander the late-night hours—all while staring at a flickering, snow-filled monitor.

details.title: Hellwake: Hordes of Styx
details.short_description: Intense first-person action roguelike. Grow stronger with every run: stack devastating spell invocations, unleash magic, and obliterate demon hordes. Lightning-fast gameplay, every second counts. Endless replayability with procedural levels. Stylized, visceral, addictive.

details.title: Halls of Jötunn
details.short_description: Halls of Jötunn is a first-person atmospheric dungeon crawler set in a forgotten Norse world after Ragnarök. Explore ancient ruins, survive brutal tactical combat, uncover lost True Names, and fight your way home to the family waiting beyond death.

details.title: She Hunts
details.short_description: She Hunts is an exploration focused narrative action-adventure game set in a fairy tale forest. Battle corrupted creatures with your trusty crossbow and lay clever traps for your foes. But beware the night, for the setting sun heralds the coming of the Beast...

details.title: Calculusmania
details.short_description: Use a calculator to change the world around you. Solve more than 60 puzzles by adjusting variables, unlock new keys, and discover increasingly ingenious solutions in this 2D puzzle game.

details.title: Revery Realm
details.short_description: Revery Realm is a Turn-based, DICE-building Roguelike where you lead a party of three through a mysterious fantasy world. Roll and customize your dice, discover powerful Sigils and Guardians, and combine their unique effects to create builds of your own.

name: Churrasco: Trying to Cook in Peace

details.title: Churrasco: Trying to Cook in Peace
details.short_description: Be the family BBQ master and try to grill in peace while your chaotic relatives turn everything upside down. Manage the grill, handle food orders, complete quests, and capture memories.

details.title: EverestBaseCamp
details.short_description: Manage Everest Base Camp, prepare climbers for dangerous expeditions, and guide your team from early route pushes toward an eventual summit attempt.

details.title: Click-A-Bao
details.short_description: Click the buns, catch the buns, don't eat the buns. A hidden objects game where you don't have to find everything. You'll unlock bun helpers that will search the pictures with you! Decorate your office, get new pictures, upgrade your buns and collect them all!

details.title: Aleph's Garden
details.short_description: A platform-puzzle Metroidvania where knowledge unlocks the garden—learn, open new paths, and solve mysteries in more than one way.

details.title: Cinema Deals
details.short_description: Play as a cashier in a cinema theater! Take orders, print movie tickets, prepare popcorn, drinks and more! And don't forget today's deals!

details.title: One-Time Trigger
details.short_description: Carefully observe the seven patients. Identify the one who doesn't belong, fire your one and only bullet, and complete the test. Shoot the wrong one and you die. You get only one chance.

details.title: Giantess Naval Defense
details.short_description: Giantess Naval Defense is a “Giant Girl vs. Kaiju Naval Artillery Defense Game” where you control Orca, the only giant beast humanity can rely on, and fight back against hordes of invading kaiju with devastating naval gunfire.

details.title: Cases from the Murder Wagon
details.short_description: Take control of the Murder Wagon investigation team and cooperate to solve the world’s strangest cases in this asymmetrical co-op horror game.

details.title: Astrobreaker
details.short_description: Astrobreaker is a short incremental game about making a spaceship faster and more powerful. Mine planets, gather resources, and upgrade your ship.

details.title: Infernal West
details.short_description: Infernal West is a first-person psychological horror puzzle game set in a Wild West saloon. Observe every detail, identify the anomalies warping reality, and unravel the mysteries hidden within an endless loop. Every decision may bring you closer to the exit... or trap you in the loop forever.

details.title: Just get the flag
details.short_description: In this puzzle game, you are RED, a little red square whose purpose is only to reach the flag. But be careful… it moves in the opposite direction of you. Will you manage to take the right path to finally capture that stupid flag?

details.title: Robot Crucible
details.short_description: Build a fighting robot in 5 minutes, or perfect it over 5 hours, then destroy your opponents! Sketch out a chassis, snap on some motors and wheels, choose a weapon, and throw it into the arena against the AI or friends in local multiplayer.

details.title: MISSING PLAY
details.short_description: MISSING PLAY is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where one player faces off against the rest. Play as a survivor, cooperate with your teammates, complete objectives, and escape… or become the monster and do everything you can to stop them. It's free and will remain free.

details.title: The Vestige
details.short_description: An action RPG where you play as a cyborg fighting rogue robots with melee combat and improvised weapons. Hack computers to recover your past and take down a tyrant AI.

details.title: The Arch-Enemy of Hy-Brasil
details.short_description: 勇者が敗北した世界で目醒めたあなたは、魔王を倒すために冒険に向かうことになる。停滞した世界で最後にあなたが選ぶのは再生？ それとも、破滅？

details.title: Cardboard Gladiators
details.short_description: A PvPvE inventory management autobattler with asynchronous multiplayer! Build a team of gladiators, craft and equip powerful items, discover game-breaking synergies, and outsmart opponents with clever battleplans.

details.title: Chronos Arena
details.short_description: Heavy armor meets modern ballistics: Battle it out in fast-paced 2D top-down PvP arena matches deep inside the dungeon. Upgrade your arsenal with modular attachments, stack devastating blessings, and master skill-based gunplay to dominate your enemies.

details.title: Humane Farm
details.short_description: Program an army of robots to automate your farm in the year 2049. Under the rule of Robot Overlords, you’ve been chosen for a unique cooperation experiment. Grow crops, care for animals, make ethical choices, and master a visual programming language to automate every task on your farm.

details.title: One Star Express
details.short_description: Cosmic teleportation is down, and no one is happy about going back to spaceship travel! Seat quirky aliens in ways that let you satisfy their quirks and demands throughout the journey. Navigate strange cosmic events, return lost items, earn passenger reviews, and make sure everyone arrives smiling.

details.title: Delta Neutral
details.short_description: The top-down space sim. Fly, trade, and fight in a galaxy shaped by history, where production, freight, and war reshape a living economy.

details.title: Zala
details.short_description: Zala is a roguelike about breaking bricks and catching thousands of gold coins. Combine 100+ game changing upgrades, destroy 1000+ unique stages and fight powerful bosses made of curse bricks. Make the right choices and you'll swim in gold.

details.title: Stackers
details.short_description: Stack it, craft it, explore it. Stackers is a tile-based crafting sim. Start small, experiment with all kinds of combinations, and grow. Journey through nine biomes, defeat the boss of each one, and uncover the secrets hidden in the world.

details.title: Oasis Bloom
details.short_description: Revive and terraform a dead alien planet in this sci-fi farming / life sim. Terraform the frozen wastes, grow rule-breaking mutant crops, team up with an alien AI to revive extinct alien creatures, and build a thriving colony of settlers to befriend and romance.

details.title: Night Mass
details.short_description: You’re a Priest defending your Church from the horrors that come each night. Gather resources, explore the forest, and build your defenses while the sun is still shining. When darkness falls, stand your ground, survive until dawn, and let the Night Mass begin!

details.title: Canal Tycoon
details.short_description: Canal Tycoon is a unique transport builder set in the canal’s golden age, with mechanics not seen elsewhere in the genre. Move industry’s goods across period-map landscapes, manage contested water, politics and rivals, automate operations to reduce grind, then survive the railroads.

details.title: Pale Cantons
details.short_description: A first-person sandbox RPG set in a secluded canton ringed by impassable mountains. Learn trades, fight, barter, earn the locals’ trust, and search for your missing sister but remember: the only way out leads through an ever-changing labyrinth.

details.title: RETROBOTS
details.short_description: The year is 2109, and RETROBOTS is the world's most chaotic sport. Select your Retrobot, customize and tune it to perfection, and enter the battle. Smash, slam, launch, and destroy your opponents in arenas across the world. Are you ready to KICK SOME BOT?

details.title: VeilRaun
details.short_description: Become an Explorer of fractured realities in Veil Raun, a third-person dark fantasy action RPG. Take expeditions beyond the Veil, battle Hollows, rise through the Explorer ranks, and uncover the mystery behind the Fracture.

name: Little Boy : Small Steps, Big Changes

details.title: Little Boy : Small Steps, Big Changes
details.short_description: Little Boy, a narrative game where you play as a robot assistant helping people find happiness!

details.title: Dimensional Breach
details.short_description: 4-player online co-op. The rifts are open, and every dimension hides a different threat. Dive in with your friends, tear the nightmare out by its roots and seal the breach or be lost to the dark.

details.title: Bury Us Together
details.short_description: A cooperative survival strategy game with heroes. Explore and expand by day, build your defenses, and hold the line against thousands of enemies by night. Enjoy as a solo player or with up to 3 friends!

details.title: Marrowood
details.short_description: Haunted by the suppressed memories of your childhood, you receive a letter from the town you grew up in. They need you to rebuild your family's farm. It's time to remember, welcome home.

details.title: Indian Paranormal Files - Sleepover
details.short_description: What starts as a normal sleepover quickly turns into a terrifying paranormal nightmare. Explore the house, investigate strange occurrences, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the haunting before it's too late.

details.title: Gnomes In Space
details.short_description: An online co-op adventure where Gnomes must pilot a starship through space to find a cure for their dying home world. Accept missions from the Elder Gnome, avoid danger, and upgrade your ship, weapons, and tools to keep your crew alive.

details.title: Contract Terminated
details.short_description: Lead your band of mercenaries and figure out a way to survive on a hostile planet in this oldschool 1980s-style party-based RPG with pixel graphics. Features a mix of grid-based movement, turn-based tactical combat, and first-person dungeon crawling just like the classics.

details.title: Churrolandia RPG Countdown
details.short_description: Two beings from the future threaten the fate of Churrolandia and the entire universe. Join Churro and his friends in this turn-based JRPG, master the Countdown System, explore a world full of magic, and prevent time from coming to an end.

details.title: Survive the Horde
details.short_description: Face overwhelming hordes of the undead in a hyper-realistic post-apocalyptic world. Build defenses, wield devastating weapons, and unleash powerful abilities as you tear through swarms of zombies in this adrenaline-fueled first-person survival shooter.

details.title: Rollgeon
details.short_description: Build your own collection of customizable dice and battle your way through the dungeon in this turn-based roguelike. Roll, reroll, and create powerful combos inspired by the classic dice game Generala. Enchant your dice, manipulate the odds, and discover new builds with every run.

details.title: The Door
details.short_description: The Door is a first-person horror adventure game. To escape from a dream, the protagonist must confront his past and continue moving forward. What lies beyond the red door? And what truth is hidden within the protagonist’s past?

details.title: Hexborne
details.short_description: Draw one unbroken path across a hex battlefield. Tiles you cross become attack, armor, healing and gold, and how you reach each foe picks your strike. Dark fantasy roguelite RPG. Chapter 1 demo.

details.title: DUSTCROW
details.short_description: DustCrow is a space-salvaging and exploration zero-G VR game where you strip derelict wrecks for scrap, manage your tools and equipment in a zero-G environment, and play in a live, player-driven economy. It's just industrial tools, tactile physics, and the daily grind in the vast emptiness of space.

details.title: Rogue Fortune
details.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelite where your treasure is your health bar. Gamble your gold for the power to survive a hostile temple that wants it back. Arrange geometric relics into a puzzle grid to build devastating synergies.

details.title: The Citadel Must Hold
details.short_description: Build and defend your Citadel in a fantasy survival RTS. Explore dangerous lands, conquer Places of Power for strategy-changing rewards, and rally your armies against the relentless Monster Tides. Every choice brings you closer to survival... or the fall of your Citadel.

details.title: ACCEPTED: Deposit Return Inspector
details.short_description: Congratulations, citizen. You have been appointed Deposit Return Inspector. Report to your assigned workstation. Inspect all containers, enforce the latest regulations, and keep the system running. Rules are subject to change without notice. The system is always right. Even when it's wrong.

details.title: Elf in Training
details.short_description: Elf in Training is a chaotic couch co-op game where Santa’s newest recruits sneak into homes to deliver presents, eat cookies, and stuff stockings. Dodge angry parents and Christmas folklore creatures as you race to finish each delivery and earn your place as one of Santa’s elves!

details.title: CHARNEL
details.short_description: Diablo, but with guns. Descend into the crypts, where darkness reigns, the dead linger, and your light only reaches so far. In this real-time ASCII roguelike you'll uncover an arsenal of weapons, battle hordes of the damned, and navigate an ever-changing labyrinth, with one life to reach the bottom.

details.title: Sogni d'Oro
details.short_description: Sogni d'Oro is a Japanese-style RPG with an Italian flavour.

details.title: A Witch's Husband
details.short_description: Scotland, the 1500s. You wake in your own blood. Your wife is gone, taken as a witch. Follow her over the Highland pass and face the men who took her, one sword duel at a time. Block and strike from three directions, parry at the last moment, and strike where their guard breaks open.

details.title: CastleWright
details.short_description: Rebuild ruined castles, manage resources and workers, raise your army, and conquer enemy outposts as you restore a fallen kingdom.

details.title: Survival Repacker
details.short_description: Leave the combat and survival struggle to those outside. Inside is a stress-free sanctuary. Tactile gear repair, meditative loot sorting, and packing kits for survivors. The cozy antithesis to hardcore survival games.

details.title: Beneath the Dying Sun
details.short_description: Beneath the Dying Sun is a cozy nautical delivery game set across the mysterious Nadir Sea. Haul cargo, take odd jobs, meet strange people, and try to make an honest living somewhere that really doesn't make it easy.

details.title: Dice Mafia
details.short_description: A debunker with two million subscribers takes a seat at the table where the fate of the world is settled with dice. 18 powers, five at the table, 12 bosses, online duels. Chance is theatre: learn to rig yours. Premium, no ads, no in-app purchases.

details.title: Regret
details.short_description: Regret is a stop-motion, top-down action roguelike where inventions from across history become your weapons. Battle through randomly generated dungeons in an entirely handmade world, craft powerful item combinations, and travel through time alone or with a friend in local co-op.

details.title: Greywake: Last Bell
details.short_description: Fight across a dark tabletop in a campaign-driven bullet heaven. Build a trio of survivors, forge persistent weapons and battle through forty stages before facing the repeatable Last Bell Vigil! Plus much, much more!!

details.title: Hex & Hunters
details.short_description: Hex & Hunters is a fast-paced action roguelite where you program your own dungeons and create complex projectiles to battle through rooms of various enemies, unlocking new biomes, items and foes.

details.title: PUNKCAKE BUFFET
details.short_description: The best pixel spaghetti of your life. Prepare them and fork them perfectly in this fresh new arcade puzzler. Delect yourself and others. Get 5-star reviews. But be quick! The people are hangry. Play this new and extended version of Spaghetti Celesti: Devour the Heavens, also known as Spaghettris.

details.title: INFRAMON
details.short_description: INFRAMON® is a first-person Lovecraftian horror game that combines adventure, exploration, combat and puzzles to tell a psychological horror story for adults set in the Cthulhu Mythos in the 1920s, near Barcelona.

details.title: Unstitched
details.short_description: A social deduction party game for 4–15 players set in a creepy dollhouse. Run minigame errands by night, accuse by day and unmask the Rag Doll. Play online, against bots or Face to Face: one copy on the PC, everyone else plays from their own phone.

details.title: Museum: Escape with Friends
details.short_description: A co-op adventure about a night in the living museum. Together, explore the halls, solve puzzles, and evade hostile exhibits. Your flashlight will guide you, but is it enough to escape?

details.title: Hello, Dr. Chamberlain
details.short_description: Hello, Dr. Chamberlain. You know BranchCorps’ computer systems better than anyone. Now the AI it once used for medical research is trying to break out. Scour company documents, dig into personnel files, and solve expert-level puzzles to shut down the AI. And to uncover who is trying to stop you.

details.title: LASTWORLD
details.short_description: LASTWORLD™ (Early Access) is an old-school inspired RTS, fast-paced, chaotic voxel fusion. Built for multiplayer and competitive play. Unlock generals, skins, and items. Build your own unique playstyle to wreak havoc on the battlefield!

details.title: Pounce Brigade
details.short_description: Recruit a brigade of cats, arrange them on the living-room rug, and combine their talents in this auto-battling roguelite. Protect a nap or take on enemy packs through twelve rounds, solo or in private two-player co-op.

details.title: Emergency Warp
details.short_description: Command a customizable Starship in this tactical space defense roguelite. Intercept missile swarms, deploy combat drone wings, and mine hostile asteroid belts. When your shields fail, do you risk everything for more loot—or initiate an Emergency Warp to escape with your haul?

details.title: Dark Dawn: Stellar Expanse
details.short_description: 《Dark Dawn: Stellar Expanse》 is an interstellar strategy game set in vast deep space. As explorers, players chart paths in a seamless universe: uncover secrets, fight battles, build stations, trade, and shape factions via diplomacy. You define the universe’s scale and destiny.

details.title: LAKESIDE HEAVEN
details.short_description: For every long story, there is also a short one.LAKESIDE HEAVEN is a short game rooted in dystopian science fiction, packed with a variety of gameplay experiences within its relatively brief runtime.

details.title: Hazard Shift
details.short_description: A third-person PvE extraction shooter for 1–4 players. Fight corrupted machines, scavenge gear, and reclaim city sectors. Harvest corruption to power your squad’s weapons and equipment, every shot drains your shared energy. Extract with your loot and build up your base for the next shift.

details.title: Frost 2 - Survival Roguelike Deckbuilder
details.short_description: Lead a tribe of survivors across a frozen wilderness, with only one step ahead of a deadly storm. Gather resources, improve your deck, and make difficult decisions as the journey slowly wears on your group.

details.title: Death Falls: Zombies Are Coming
details.short_description: Death Falls is a zombie tower defense game with you on the front line. By day, build towers and fences, scavenge weapons and recruit survivors. By night, fight beside your defenses as the horde closes in. Survive each stop, fix up your RV and drive on.

details.title: Little Mages 3D
details.short_description: Blast through undead hordes and build a devastating spell loadout in this retro first-person arena roguelite! Choose your mage, combine spells and perks, defeat bosses, and grow stronger between runs. Play solo or with up to 4 players in LAN co-op.

details.title: Community Kitchen Simulator: DayShift
details.short_description: Run a small community canteen. Buy food at the corner shop and carry it back, cook, serve people one plate at a time, wash up, and decide whether someone without a meal ticket gets fed. Then close for the night and do it again tomorrow.

details.title: Puddle Pond: Mouse Fishing
details.short_description: Chat, explore, and relax in a cute and colorful fishing spot with your fellow mice. Earn pumpkin seeds to buy better gear and catch more exotic fish, or unlock deeper customization for your mouse. Show off your catches to your friends, and otherwise enjoy a cozy social experience.

details.title: Dungeon Parkour Block Puzzle Adventure 2
details.short_description: Use blocks falling from the ceiling to build a path for the adventurer. Uncover the mystery why the blocks keep falling from the ceiling. Solve the puzzles and finally the mystery. The puzzle adventure continues.

details.title: Wrong Way Buddy
details.short_description: Drive the wrong way down a packed highway. Skim bumpers for CLOSE calls, fire BOOST to smash through traffic, or FREEZE time and slip through the gaps. Runs last seconds. Most end in a fireball. Retry is one key, and the ATTEMPT counter in the sky keeps count.

details.title: Indian Truck Simulator
details.short_description: Be the trucker India runs on. Drive a painted truck down the Grand Trunk Road and Delhi's expressways, on nearly 1,800 km of road built from the real map. Beat the deadline, mind your diesel and your sleep, and stop at a dhaba for chai.

details.title: Restora: A Poster Restoration Game
details.short_description: Step into your workshop and give vintage movie posters a second chance. In this calming restoration sim, restore as many posters as you can before the day ends. Inspect each poster, repair damage through mini games, and bring it back to glory. How many posters can you save in time?

details.title: Goblin Industries
details.short_description: Ever wanted to be a hard-working goblin? Me neither, but here we are. Every goblin dreams of the easy life on the surface, and to get there you’ve got to put in your shift. This is your chance. Come underground with us: mine, smelt, and get the factory running.

details.title: Bear’s Desktop Cake Shop
details.short_description: Run a cozy cake shop in a corner of your desktop! Grow ingredients, build automated production lines, and hire little bear couriers to deliver delicious cakes to adorable animal customers. Discover recipes and grow your shop while you work, study, or unwind.

details.title: 战国立志传
details.short_description: 《Warring States:Path of Power》 is a role-playing game set in ancient China’s Warring States period. Play as a historical figure and experience their story, or create your own character and begin life as an ordinary person.

details.title: Idle Wardens
details.short_description: A pixel-art fantasy idle RPG. Walk the Knight and Wizard paths as one Warden, turn your estate into a self-running production line, and push north through fog-covered lands toward the Abyssal Anchor. Progress keeps going while you are away.

details.title: Mikitti: Pirate Cats
details.short_description: Four cats, one pirate ship! Team up in 4-player co-op to steer, shoot, resupply and repair. Battle the navy and a giant Kraken. Grab more loot or sail home safe? Pick your skin, grow beautiful Cat Tower Island, and build new ships and weapons for bold adventures with friends!

details.title: 末日後書店
details.short_description: The perfect AI shut down without warning. Without its guidance, technology regressed, society crumbled, energy ran short, and the world fell into chaos. As a bookstore owner, listen to customers' stories with your android partner, offering food and the scent of books as a brief respite.

details.title: Curiopia: Fresh Finds Daily
details.short_description: Here is a tiny island on a shallow sea, where animals sail in for curious finds. Build your world and shop from voxels; fish, cook, and stock your shelves. Invite friends to build and live together. A slow, cozy island life in pen and wash.

details.title: 1999 Lockdown Unit
details.short_description: Autumn 1999: A rainy night, a sudden quarantine. As a virus mutates your neighbors, barricade your apartment, survive the lockdown routine, and outlast the nightmare.

details.title: Overflow: Roguelite Network Builder
details.short_description: A tense minimalist network roguelite. Draw Traces between Nodes, let your Runners carry Signals to your Hubs, and hold the system together as pressure escalates. One overloaded Node ends the run, instantly and permanently. Upgrade between Cycles, trigger emergency abilities, and delay the crash.

details.title: Engines of Hate
details.short_description: You're a mercenary space-ship captain. Drop war machines and infantry from orbit, call down orbital strikes, and micro every unit in slow motion. No base building, no mining, just combat. Every unit you lose costs Credits to replace.

details.title: Don't Give Up, Pal
details.short_description: So she won't die. So she won't break. So she can live just a little longer. I push her forward. Don't Give Up, Pal is a combat simulation where you upgrade and deploy, again and again.

details.title: Stick Desktop Expedition
details.short_description: A cozy desktop idle RPG where your stickman squad auto-battles! Train your companions, choose their weapons and skills, build your camp, and send them on adventures while you work or relax.

details.title: Medival Adventure
details.short_description: Gather resources, craft tools and build your settlement. Explore a medieval world with villages, wildlife and a day/night cycle. Medival Adventure is in early development: play solo or test experimental multiplayer with a trusted group.

details.title: Trench League
details.short_description: Punch your way to the spiked steel ball and smash it into the enemy cage. The side with the most breaches wins. Knock rivals out and the Reclaim drags them off. Face opponents from different planets of the Solar System and fight your way to the Solar Final! Test your skills against real opponents!

details.title: Hermetica
details.short_description: A world after a great war. Only one reference box survived, and you have it. The vendor sends robots in for inspection, but doesn't always tell the truth. You find where he lied and decide whether the robot goes into battle. Every shift starts at a desk. ...

details.title: Surfin' Landes
details.short_description: Welcome to Contis, a little beach in the Landes, southwest France. In this 100% co-op pixel art game, become lifeguards: one surfs, the other flies a parachute. On the menu: beer, rescues, giant fish, piranhas, dolphins, pelicans, bazookas, a dog… and ever more beer.

details.title: Thicker than Ichor
details.short_description: Blood is thicker than water. Ichor is thicker than both. Aliens spliced you by mistake, and now you're whipping, shooting and punching your way out of a mutated hotel in a totally fictional city in a first-person roguelite brawler.

details.title: Echo Sequence
details.short_description: An isometric, top-down roguelite shooter where your deaths are your squad. Die, and your last life fights on as an Echo, repeating every move and every shot. Die again and there are two. Plan across loops, split the work between your past selves, and clear each level together.

details.title: Master of Treasure
details.short_description: Sweep an endless procedural coastline with friends and dig up treasure no one has ever seen. Every coin, gem, relic and fossil is generated in 3D and is practically one of a kind. Level up, upgrade your gear, and see how far out you are willing to go for the rarest finds.

details.title: EX-Traterrestrial
details.short_description: EX-Traterrestrial is a Stealth Horror Game about sneaking into your ex's house in order to save her from her alien captor. Stay quiet, avoid the aliens hunting for noise, and hide under furniture to escape detection. Uncover the truth behind the abduction, if you dare.

details.title: Board Game Tycoon
details.short_description: Start your own board game publishing company! Combine themes and mechanics, name your games and customize their covers. Have your prototypes playtested, refine your ideas and publish your games. Invite creators, win over fans and critics, and create your first hit.

details.title: Hieroheart
details.short_description: Hieroheart is an action-adventure RPG set in an AI realm where ancient mythology meets living code. Master magical glyphs, nurture and evolve AnimAI companions, build your own camp, and uncover the mysteries of strange and beautiful worlds.

details.title: Marble Factory
details.short_description: A physics roguelite about building a machine, then losing control of it. Place machines on the board, take your shot, and let the marbles bounce. Every impact pays in Score, Gold and XP. Upgrade between waves, choose your element, and see how far your factory goes.

details.title: Bored to Depth
details.short_description: Drill against the core, against the odds, and against the bureaucracy.

details.title: Conan: The Black Pyramid
details.short_description: Sword & sorcery meets cosmic horror in a brutal Roguelite action RPG. Fight as Conan and other legendary heroes, forge devastating builds, and seek the truth inside an ever-changing labyrinth beyond time. Face the Black Pyramid alone or with a friend in online co-op.

details.title: The Anomaly Inspector : Hotel Anatolia
details.short_description: Congratulations, you have been hired as the new Anomaly Inspector for Hotel Anatolia. Good Luck!

details.title: Winter Batch
details.short_description: December 1988, Czechoslovakia. Your uncle ended up behind bars. Winter Batch is a first-person life simulator where you survive a brutal countryside winter, illegally make alcohol, and earn the money to get him out.

details.title: Metaversus
details.short_description: A round-based 4v4 competitive shooter. Build defenses and routes, buy weapons and gadgets, then fight for territory with one life per round. Surviving structures carry into the next build phase. Request playtest access below.

details.title: Baleful Tactics
details.short_description: You are a demon lord, using history’s famous dead to climb the ranks of Hell. Their traits determine your play style. Death leaves them with a wound.
