Decide who to save, star-up, gear up or sacrifice for more power. Achilles, Genghis Khan and Cleopatra, await your command!

details.title: Quiet Please
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where your microphone is your flashlight. You are the new night clerk at the Ashgrove Public Library, 1994. Something blind lives in the stacks and hears everything. Whisper, clap or shout to light up the dark, and it will know where you are.

details.title: Resign to Ascend
details.short_description: A xianxia adventure made by someone who'd had enough of work. Enter the immortal mountains of your childhood dreams. Learn spells, hunt mythical beasts, brew elixirs, forge gear, and raise your own soulbound treasure. Screw work. Let's go cultivate! Quit waiting and add it to your wishlist!

details.title: Dragonwynde
details.short_description: You're a dragon hatchling who can't fly. Not yet. Slide down the mountain on your belly, stretch every glide a little further, eat, and grow until your wings carry you. A handcrafted world without combat or death, where something old and mysterious sleeps, waiting for the first earthborn to wake it.

details.title: Pie Paw
details.short_description: Pie Paw is a cozy bag-building roguelite where you draw, upgrade, and combine dice to outscore animal rivals. Shape every roll with special dice, items, and companions as you travel a branching road in search of pies.

details.title: Dark Looter
details.short_description: Dark Looter is a browser-based hacking simulation game. Build your rig, steal files from virtual institutions, mine cryptocurrency, and climb the hacker ranks — all in a persistent online world.

details.title: The Stars Are Never Still
details.short_description: The Stars Are Never Still is a 2D space sandbox. Shape a galaxy and watch 16 unique races colonize, trade, ally, betray and wage war. Observe, or intervene with technology, aid, discord, disasters, new life—even black holes. Chronicle millennia of history. No set goals. No empire lasts forever.

details.title: Dream Within The Vessel
details.short_description: Dream Within the Vessel is a psychological horror visual novel. Follow Ze through six days in a seemingly peaceful town—where happiness feels arranged, and something alive is watching. Your choices will shape his final decision.

details.title: Sword Dancer
details.short_description: Inspired by Gongsun Daniang, the legendary sword dancer of Tang Dynasty China. Chart her blade-dance through enemy ranks—every step is set before the first strike. Route planning × roguelite building: choreograph the perfect dance, then watch it cut through the chaos.

details.title: Atlas Conquest
details.short_description: Assemble a deck of cards that become units on a physical battlefield. Duel other players in online competitive matches. Outmaneuver your rival, and conquer the map!

details.title: Excabyte
details.short_description: Excabyte is an incremental mining game where you start with a single miner and build your own mining empire. Extract valuable resources, purchase powerful machinery and avoid disasters.

details.title: It's Snow-Kei
details.short_description: Plow a whole town in a tiny kei truck. Clear driveways and lots one satisfying lane at a time, upgrade your truck, make friends (or enemies) and get paid. Keep on plowing, and don't ask too many questions.

details.title: Coin Frenzy
details.short_description: Coin Frenzy is an incremental game about launching coins and growing your rewards. Upgrade coin values, launch more coins, and boost your sectors. Earn skill points, rebirth into the skill tree, and unlock new ways to fill and collect your board

details.title: SilentCordon
details.short_description: SilentCordon is a 3D top-down tactical shooter. Enter a city under lockdown, alone or in 2–4 player co-op, to find your missing sister. Scout enemy positions, use cover and tactical gear, and complete rescue and escort missions. Face off against other players in deathmatch and bomb defusal.

details.title: Railmorrow
details.short_description: A first-person life and travel simulator set in an open world. Begin your journey in Tikhorechye: buy tickets, explore 20 stations, ride trains and buses, trade between cities, work, and buy cars and houses. Where will you go next?

details.title: Rush 60 Seconds
details.short_description: Innovating on the vampire survivor-like game type, instead of slowly spawning monsters endlessly, all monsters are generated at once on a large map. Within 60 seconds, the more monsters you kill, the more rewards you get.

details.title: Looooong Trip
details.short_description: Loooong trip is a physics-based co-op sandbox adventure for 1–4 players! Drive, loot, crash, upgrade your car, and cause absolute chaos on your way to Vegas.

details.title: Bloodrights
details.short_description: An unknown disease has wiped out half of the city's population. The main characters managed to survive the outbreak. However, it's not as if everything went without consequences

details.title: SideStamp
details.short_description: Roll, slide, and spin your way through this colorful 3D puzzle game. Explore over 100 handcrafted puzzles that reveal the essence of rotation as the fourth dimension.

details.title: Flarefall
details.short_description: Flarefall is a co-op horde RTS for 1–4 players. Land on the Florida coast, build one shared base by day and hold it by night against the horde, with present-day infantry, armour, boats, helicopters, air strikes and a destroyer's guns.

details.title: Márgalo
details.short_description: A first-person psychological survival horror adventure. Explore surreal liminal spaces, solve puzzles, and uncover what the true nightmare really is: your dreams or reality?

details.title: The Bastion Protocol
details.short_description: The Bastion Protocol is an idle tower defense game where a lone tower faces relentless enemy waves. Earn Entropy from kills, strengthen your build, and survive until your tower falls. Turn each run’s rewards into lasting upgrades and return stronger.

details.title: Abyssgate
details.short_description: The Abyssal Gate has opened. Abyssgate is a Wizardry-style dungeon crawler. Make a party of six and step into the dark one square at a time. Don't go easy on the monsters. If you do, you die.

details.title: Lost in the Post
details.short_description: Fly a rickety hot-air balloon with 2-4 friends and deliver the mail across a world that wants you dead. Work the burner, drop the ballast, catch the parcels, slap your crewmates, and try not to fall out. We always deliver. Mostly.

details.title: CastleBonk
details.short_description: Charge your jump, miss the ledge and fall hard. CastleBonk combines merciless Jump King climbing with Souls-like combat: parry, roll, defeat giant bosses and find out who you were before you woke up at the foot of the castle.

details.title: Star Han: Mech Generals
details.short_description: Three Kingdoms generals pilot war mechs in a turn-based roguelite where placement is power. Fit weapons, shields, thrusters and stratagem chips into your Module Grid, chain adjacency bonuses, and borrow Gold when you need it, if you can stay ahead of the interest.

details.title: Deadtone
details.short_description: Hold the last fortress against hundreds of thousands of zombies in Deadtone, an incremental tower defense game. Set your firing lines, call in air support and grow stronger with permanent upgrades. Take the world back, region by region.

name: Degrees of Love ~ Beyond Eternal Promise ~

details.title: Degrees of Love ~ Beyond Eternal Promise ~
details.short_description: This is a story about fulfilling a promise made before birth. A guidepost for the journey home—reclaiming the time lost by fulfilling the promise the two made in the past. At the end of a journey spanning countless years, with an eternal promise in their hearts.

name: Chop or Die: Axe of War

details.title: Chop or Die: Axe of War
details.short_description: The world is overrun by wood mutants! Chop trees, gather resources, upgrade turrets, fortify your base, and enhance your Cyber Dog. Fight off nightly mutant hordes and save the planet from a forest apocalypse!

name: プライマリ・ブルーム

details.title: プライマリ・ブルーム
details.short_description: 高度なAI技術の発展により、大きく変化した世界。主人公のザニアはただ一人、人の手から生み出された植物たちを取り戻すため、研究を続けています。部屋で植物を育て、咲いた花をSNSで世界に広めていく、ドット絵・横スクロールのSF×ガーデンシミュレーションです。

details.title: PROTECT MIEKO
details.short_description: Eat the barrage. Turn it into firepower. Pilot Tama, an invincible shield drone, dive into the hail of bullets, and keep Mieko's fighter alive. The more bullets you absorb, the harder her guns hit. A roguelike side-scrolling shooter.

details.title: Vroom Boom
details.short_description: Arcade car combat with big jumps and bigger booms. Launch off ramps, fire rockets, drop mines and set off your car's special. Fight a battle royale against 8 to 12 bots, survive waves and bosses to unlock new cars, or take on a friend in split screen or online.

name: Accrelis: A Game About Forging Planets

details.title: Accrelis: A Game About Forging Planets
details.short_description: Smash a protoplanetary disk with your cursor, choose what your new world is made of, and put it in orbit. Watch life appear, cities spread across its surface and your star system slowly fill up. A short incremental game about building planets.

details.title: Channel 666: Nightmare on Tape
details.short_description: Channel 666 is a Roguelite, Turn-Based Dungeon Crawler with endless challenges within. Choose your gang and see just how deep the horror classics go!

details.title: GUNBUTCHER: RELOADED
details.short_description: 90 seconds and a completely crazy card roulette! Pile up the chaos and try to get out alive.

details.title: By Your Name
details.short_description: BY YOUR NAME is a nonlinear psychological thriller about exploring a cursed mansion, recovering other people’s memories, and uncovering the lives of those whose names nearly vanished along with their past. Explore the house. Return the names. And decide how this story should end.

details.title: Grumble Burger
details.short_description: Grumble Burger is a first-person cooking thriller where you take over your late Uncle Frank's food truck. Frank believed the bond between cook and customer was paramount. However, you'll soon discover that orders are handled differently here. And the customers are not your typical diner patrons...

details.title: Keepguard
details.short_description: Keepguard is a medieval tower-defense roguelite where the map is your build. Expand and defend your kingdom: bind towers to powerful rites, uncover unusual relics and create game-breaking synergies to keep back the endless hordes.

details.title: MARY - メアリ姫の奪還
details.short_description: Add a single letter to a choice in this text adventure. Follow the original path, turn the odds in your favor, or create a completely ridiculous outcome. Shape the story with just one letter. *Japanese language only.

details.title: Sonar & Silence
details.short_description: Your sensors are your only eyes. Read sonar echoes to distinguish wrecks from mines and locate enemies in a tactical submarine exploration and combat game. Venture into hostile waters, mine resources, gather intelligence, and upgrade your submarine between dives.

details.title: ROUDO OF THE HERO
details.short_description: A time-attack-style 3D action game where you control a cast of unique characters as you race from the grasslands to the Demon King’s Castle. Will you fight the enemies, or ignore them and rush ahead? The ending changes depending on your route and the time it takes to complete the game.

details.title: The Lost Cape
details.short_description: The Lost Cape is a first-person survival game set on a mysterious tropical island. Explore, build, hunt, and uncover its secrets. When night falls, beware of a blind creature that hunts by sound. Play solo or in online co-op and find a way to escape.

details.title: Shadow Wake
details.short_description: Shadow Wake is a classic retro-arcade game with an 80s vibe. Lasers. Neon. Space. Battle hordes of aliens in fast-paced combat, manage your ship’s energy, and upgrade your gear.

details.title: Shouhon
details.short_description: Shouhon is a roguelike Metroidvania game. You play as a ghost who falls into an underground tomb and possesses the body of an abandoned jiangshi doll. Your goal is to escape the tomb by harnessing the powers of various talismans and relics.

details.title: Gilt & Grime
details.short_description: Cast out penniless, stripped of your name and your love, you come to Tradeshaven, a town that respects only money. Build the fortune to win it all back. Honest work is slow and never quite enough. The other kind pays better. A medieval life-sim about how high you'll climb, and what it costs you.

details.title: VOTUM
details.short_description: Votum is a turn-based roguelite inspired by Ancient Rome. In the ruins of Aeterna, champions chosen by the Sibyl face tactical battles and harsh choices as they venture into the temple to uncover the source of the Soul Affliction.

details.title: That Cozy Cat Game
details.short_description: A relaxing online co-op game where you and your friends explore a colorful island as customizable CATS. Go fishing, chat, find new discoveries, earn kibbles, and dress up your cat.

details.title: RIDGERUNNERS
details.short_description: RIDGERUNNERS is a first-person mountain racer. Build speed downhill and fly between checkpoints using gravity and your weapons. Find the fastest route, race ghosts and live players, and climb the global leaderboard.

details.title: HUEMON
details.short_description: A creature collector where your whole team fights at once. Field five HUEMON on a grid where one jumps over others, another anchors nearby enemies, and positioning beats raw power. Collect them across a world still learning to be colorful.

details.title: BoneHeads
details.short_description: BoneHeads is a physics-based sword-fighting party game where every swing is under your direct control. Fight locally or online with up to 4 players, and keep battling as every bone you lose becomes a weapon.

details.title: Immortal Loop: Doom Cycle
details.short_description: Transported to a cultivation world, you face apocalypse in one year. Every world‑ending catastrophe sends you back to the start. Keep resources and boost your aptitude across loops. Explore, uncover secrets, seek treasures, and survive doom in this real‑time action cultivation RPG.

details.title: Blue Blood Love Song
details.short_description: A multi-ending visual novel blending romance, sci-fi, and mystery. A perfect reunion gradually gives way to unsettling inconsistencies. As your relationship with him deepens, you must choose between trust and doubt—and every decision may change your bond and the ending that awaits you.

details.title: 野生机
details.short_description: Step into BIO: Wild Machine—a hand-drawn biopunk world created by the author, and explore the perilous "New Tower of Babel," a city once a milestone in human life technology, now in decline. You must reinvent yourself, battling powerful enemies and unknown fears in harsh turn-based combat.

details.title: Forgery Craft
details.short_description: Master the art of forgery in this story-driven simulation game. Start with altering documents by changing single signatures and dates. End up forging entire art pieces that could fool any museum expert.

details.title: BLACKFROST: The Long Dark 2
details.short_description: A year after the Aurora’s appearance & the world went dark, the people of Harmont & its vast wild environs struggle to survive the Quiet Apocalypse. Survive alone or with others against a host of new hazards & a fresh new survival sandbox from a pioneer of the genre. Live together. Die alone.

name: Pygmalion and the Kingdom of Rot

details.title: Pygmalion and the Kingdom of Rot
details.short_description: A strategy game that blends side-scrolling defense, deckbuilding, and light roguelite progression. Choose from different playable characters, deploy buildings, traps, and tactical cards against zombie hordes attacking from multiple entrances, hold your ground, and push ever deeper underground.

details.title: After School: Days Gone By
details.short_description: After School: Days Gone By is a collectible battle game about childhood corner-store duels. Challenge friends with marbles, round cards, and spinning tops; collect rare toys, build decks, customize tops, and relive the noisy fun of after-school play with light roguelite progression.

details.title: Starving Shadows
details.short_description: Dark fantasy RPG in which you are a resident of a starving dungeon. Eat your enemies, and every meal will change you. Try to get outside and see if the sun really exists...

details.title: Save Humanity.exe
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder based around designing a microchip from a pile of junk circuits to out compute incoming viruses trying to crash your system. Combo hardware with software programs to chain multipliers that overflow your FLOP meter before the glitches overwhelm you.

details.title: REtreeRS
details.short_description: REtreeRS is a tile-based rhythmic strategy game about connecting trees across the globe. Harmonize each planet to leave the world a little better than you found it.

details.title: Timeseeker: Hands of Fate
details.short_description: You have the cursed power of seeing when everyone around you will die. In a crumbling post-Soviet town full of secrets, every choice to save someone costs you something. A dark pixel art RPG where a simple act of compassion may have a price - how much are you willing to pay?

details.title: Galaxy Scavengers
details.short_description: Mine, build, upgrade, and extract. Scavenge planets in a base-building resource management sim. Gather materials, construct facilities, and order units to survive in a hostile galaxy. Launch your base to the next zone before planetary threats overwhelm you.

details.title: Omnicore
details.short_description: A 3D roguelike mining survival game where you dig for resources, upgrade your gear, and return to defend your base before the next enemy wave arrives.

details.title: Terminal Reign
details.short_description: Operate a remote armoured vehicle for the glory and whims of a dying empire. Undertake tactical missions, configure your command desk with an array of devices, and remain in favour to survive.

details.title: Galaxy Pilgrim
details.short_description: High-stakes physics platformer where you can't walk so you fly! Boost a reluctant engineer through chaotic pinball levels dodging deadly traps and collecting ore for his country.

details.title: Farming & Supermarket: Clicker
details.short_description: Click, harvest, and build your own retail empire! In Farming & Supermarket: Clicker, process raw crops into valuable goods, design your store, and sell to customers. Start with a simple click and grow into a massive supermarket tycoon!

details.title: Steinvar
details.short_description: Explore a mysterious, atmospheric world and cleanse creeping corruption using the power of light. Discover secrets, restore lost places, and shape your journey in a story-driven fantasy adventure.

details.title: Intersingles
details.short_description: A competitive fps for your best friend group. Up to 6 players can compete in the round-robin singles(1v1) format match. Play against your best friends or players around the globe.

details.title: Two & Two: Agents
details.short_description: Become a secret-agent duo in a two-player online co-op puzzle adventure. Investigate a strange experiment, exchange clues across different perspectives, and talk your way through puzzles neither agent can solve alone.

details.title: Endess Elo
details.short_description: where you are transported into a mysterious fantasy realm. Encounter a vibrant cast of characters, wield divine powers, vanquish insidious monsters, and explore distorted dimensions. Embark on a grand adventure to unravel the deep, forgotten secrets of this world.

details.title: ココロノカギ Chapter1
details.short_description: An exploration-based escape game about a girl who has lost her memories and finds herself trapped in a mysterious mansion. Collect the hidden “emotions” within the mansion and combine them to solve puzzles and uncover the truth behind her lost memories.

details.title: ANIMITE -Echoes of the Chasm-
details.short_description: Dive the Chasm: think, fight, scavenge, and get back out alive. A survival tactical RPG that switches between real-time exploration and turn-based combat. Your wolf, and the elemental reactions under your feet, are what get you out of a bad spot.

details.title: Because It's There
details.short_description: An engineering/survival game where you summit the tallest mountain in a vast, uncharted world. For the journey, carefully construct flying wooden bases with realistic structural failures. Brave thunderstorms, freezing temperatures, bears and wolves. Answer the call of the untamed wilderness.

details.title: Y2K
details.short_description: New Year's Eve, 1999. The Y2K bug is real, midnight fireworks turn on the crowd, chaos erupts. Erin is a hardware tech hacker, she can pick locks with bin scrap, hot-wire a dead mobile, reboot a generator and more. Get across the Harbour to Liam before the night is over.

details.title: Kat Domino: Agent of S.H.E.L.L.
details.short_description: Kat Domino is an agent of SHELL, the organization ruling the world. A routine mission will lead her where she doesn't belong, uncover things she was never meant to see, and unravel a conspiracy that could change everything she thought she knew. With a little luck, her trainee agent will survive.

details.title: SakuSaku Witch
details.short_description: A sharp-tongued, slightly clumsy little witch sets off on a big adventure to rescue her kidnapped little sister! Enjoy tight, responsive controls and plenty of nostalgic SNES-era charm in this cute, bunny-filled 2D platformer!

details.title: Ghostwriter
details.short_description: Write the songs. Hear them sung under her name. No one knows you’re behind the hits. Uncover what’s buried in the music until you're forced to choose what to sacrifice: her career or your own voice.

name: Zombie Wrap Simulator: Grill the Dead

details.title: Zombie Wrap Simulator: Grill the Dead
details.short_description: The apocalypse continues, and survivors still need to eat. In Zombie Wrap Simulator you run a kebab shop serving fresh veggies, smooth sauces and… questionable meat. Grill meals, deliver food to shelters and defend your place at night from furious Zomboners.

details.title: Cat Customs Simulator
details.short_description: Inspect adorable cats at the border! Check passports, verify luggage weight, scan suspicious suitcases, and uncover unallowed items. Spot mismatches, catch smugglers, and decide who gets through customs in this cozy cat inspection simulator.

details.title: One More Credit
details.short_description: A PvE roguelike autobattler about building cartridge combos. Spend credits between fights to buy, arrange, and upgrade cartridges, then beat arcade bosses before your lives run out.

details.title: VALTERION: THE LOST EARTH
details.short_description: VALTERION: THE LOST EARTH is a sci-fi colony-building strategy game. Lead 50 survivors on Elyra, build a thriving colony, develop its economy and research, return to the stars, and search for the lost path back to Earth.

name: Epica Primera: Guardians of the Forest

details.title: Epica Primera: Guardians of the Forest
details.short_description: Turn-based JRPG. Guide a group of cute girls through the forest and try to survive the horrors lurking inside using a language-based syntax spell system.

details.title: The Emperor Penguin Incident
details.short_description: "All Antarctic researchers dead. Cause of death: Emperor Penguin attack?" Log into the isolated 'Amundsen-4' server. Extract and combine [keywords] from fragmented emails, chats, and logs to uncover the truth behind the bizarre disaster.

details.title: One Button Sports
details.short_description: Sports disciplines with one button. The right moment is everything. Playable now: javelin only. Solo, with friends on the same screen, or online. More disciplines will follow. Demo — not the full game yet. From a solo developer.

name: Medieval Farm Simulator: Co-Op Farming, Harvesting & Building

details.title: Medieval Farm Simulator: Co-Op Farming, Harvesting & Building
details.short_description: Embrace the hands-on age of farming and go from rags to riches! Alone or in up to four-player co-op, cultivate land, grow, harvest and process crops. Head to the local marketplace to sell produce and earn coin! Can you build your dream medieval farm? Farm. Harvest. Sell. Build.

details.title: Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity
details.short_description: "Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity" is a Time-loop horror RTA stealth action adventure Game, Seira steps into the school at midnight to which seven mysteries and the brutal curse of the cursed doll, Aya await her there, Break free from this inescapable loop of death and escape this night of terror.

details.title: Demiourgos
details.short_description: A psychological horror game where you see and command the fate of living beings. Everything has an inevitable end, but who truly breaks the thread? What if your attempts to alter destiny are merely serving a far more terrifying design?

details.title: Mandragora Shinju
details.short_description: ある高校のスクールカウンセラーである主人公は、二人の少女が起こした心中事件に巻き込まれていく……。画面を二分割し、二人の少女を見比べながら進める「二画面同時進行」システムを採用。食い違う証言から事件の全体像が浮かび上がる。「rhizome village」が送るファナティックガールズトークADV。

details.title: Another 2D Platformer
details.short_description: A 2D platformer that starts simple, then keeps changing the rules with new mechanics, strange level gimmicks, and plenty of fourth-wall-breaking nonsense.

details.title: Late Night Check-In
details.short_description: A psychological horror game where you work the night shift as a hotel receptionist. Welcome uncanny guests, prepare delicious drinks to fulfill room-service requests, and watch your peaceful night job slowly turn into a living nightmare.

details.title: Brewhaven
details.short_description: Brew magic combat beers that power up your village. Discover hundreds of recipes, run the tavern each night to keep your villagers juiced and happy, then have them work in the village and defend the town from enemy raids, if they can still walk.

details.title: エンゼルモール
details.short_description: Four girls and an android awaken in the deserted "Angel Mall". Explore under a time limit across repeated attempts, piecing together clues and records left behind to uncover the mall’s secrets in this puzzle adventure.

details.title: Little Dive
details.short_description: Explore, poke around, find treasures… and take your time! Little Dive is a peaceful little underwater adventure where you use your tools and the environment to make your way forward, searching for memories of a vanished world… strangely familiar?

details.title: SkyAid
details.short_description: Pilot your aircraft and dive into the disaster zone. Flames, ruins, floods — every corner holds someone waiting to be saved. Fly. Scan. Locate. Find every survivor before the clock runs out. Heal the wounded, transport the rescued, use supplies — every choice you make decides their fate.

details.title: Countryside Big Catch
details.short_description: Our protagonist moves to a countryside island. Here, the rent is free as long as you can fish. On this mysterious little island, a good hand with a rod is all it takes to make all his wishes come true.
developers: サークル☆フェアリーフラワー

details.title: Condotta
details.short_description: Lead a fifteenth-century mercenary company in Condotta, a historical tactical roguelike. Hire fighters, command them in turn-based battles, and decide what trouble to take on as you travel. Fulfill your contract—and live to collect your pay.

details.title: DoBato: Coo Coo Collector
details.short_description: Fly over real Tokyo, from old downtown streets to the city center, as the leader of a pigeon flock. Land at pigeon spots, wait, and strays join you one by one. Gather white, brown, black and pied pigeons, each with its own perk, and race home with 1,000 birds. A heartwarming pigeon-gathering game.

details.title: Old Yon. New thief
details.short_description: The abandoned port of Old Yon. Bandits at the gates. You're a thief with no memory and a 200-mark debt. Pick pockets, sell to the fence before the loot goes stale, and save up for better gloves. Greed, Empathy and Paranoia argue in your head. Whatever you do, stay calm: anxiety draws the shadows.

details.title: Prospects
details.short_description: Strip the solar system of its bountiful resources, all for the betterment of mankind - and your corporation's bottom line. Build and command your fleet of industrial vessels, establish manufacturing outposts, and seek out the richest prospects to expand your mining empire.

details.title: Stay Extinct
details.short_description: The wall was built to keep something in. On a sealed dinosaur island only the hunters are infected: raptors, a T-rex and diving pterosaurs stalk the healthy herds, and you. Build and electrify a base, explore the tunnels below, alone or in 4-player online co-op. First-person retro survival horror.

details.title: Xoul:Sync
details.short_description: Xoul:Sync combines auto-battler combat with spatial inventory management. Assemble three Xouls, arrange items in the Sync Case, and choose your route to the next boss.

details.title: Trapout: Dungeon Run
details.short_description: A fast-paced first-person precision platformer where every millisecond counts. Run through deadly obstacle courses, race against player ghosts instantly, and create ANYTHING with the built-in level editor

details.title: With flowers, fringe of fondness
details.short_description: Life is suffocating. Almost crushed by the authority known as "normal." Tuyu, who spends their days asking themself, "Do I have a place in this society?", meets a certain friend at university. Those living on the margins find joy, suffer in their insignificant days—and attempt to resist the world.

details.title: Purpose of Visit
details.short_description: Their papers say one thing. Their answers say another. Staff a booth on a tense border, question every traveller, and drag the lie they just told onto the document it contradicts. One of them is a spy. Approve the wrong face and it makes the evening news.

details.title: Feudal Factory
details.short_description: Build your kingdom, automate your production chains, and defend your lands against relentless hordes! In Feudal Factory, combine rail and cart automation with strategic medieval-fantasy fortress management. Extract ores, forge your equipment, train your army, and hold off incoming enemy waves!

details.title: Starmax
details.short_description: Starmax is a base building roguelike bag-builder: a deck-builder where you draw from a bag instead of a deck. Shape your bag, build your base, and combine the two into one engine. Explore hostile planets in a sci-fi universe, scavenge for resources, and ship your cargo before your base is overrun.

details.title: Visceral
details.short_description: A turn-based horror roguelike where your flashlight is your best weapon. Awaken on a cursed farm, reveal the monsters hiding in the dark, and put them down with 51 weapons and 91 omens. Every run is randomly generated. Survive the night, or be torn apart trying.

details.title: SHOT EDIT
details.short_description: A rogue-lite nightmare in a shooting range! Hit the score quota with trick shots — or get cut from the film. For good.

details.title: PONK
details.short_description: Battle your way through thousands of mobs and bosses, in this modern rogue-like take on Pong. Build your run with hundreds of combinations and evolutions, unlock everything to become more powerful, and try to defeat the final boss!

details.title: Fleshwounds & Feathers
details.short_description: Enter a world of bird wielding knights! Fight your friends in this online, PvP, free for all, deathmatch, arena shooter. Explore the map, find new goofy weapons to help defeat your friends. You set the playtime and score to beat. Enjoy all this along with game adaptive medieval drum and bass!

details.title: Slacklord
details.short_description: Turn everyday typing into progress. Slacklord is an input-driven idle game with incremental progression, designed to run while you work - upgrade switches, keycaps, and accessories to build stronger scoring combinations.

details.title: BEAST NEGOTIATOR
details.short_description: Fighting isn't the only way. Explore dungeons, negotiate with the monsters you meet, and recruit them. Command your party in side-view turn-based battles - a 2D dungeon RPG built around befriending monsters.

details.title: Vector Front
details.short_description: Pilot a customizable starfighter into massive multiplayer fleet battles. Hunt enemy fighters, tear ships apart piece by piece, and lead assaults against enemy warships with your own customizable support fleet. Made for VR and PC.

details.title: Gunship Delta
details.short_description: A top-down gunship action game with destructible environments. The Cold War has turned into World War III. Fly over open battlefields, choose your targets and decide which to strike first. Take on varied missions, from destroying enemy bases to daring rescue operations.

name: Father Forgive Me: The Sins We Share

details.title: Father Forgive Me: The Sins We Share
details.short_description: A boys love / yaoi visual novel about a forbidden romance between a crossdressing nun and a devious priest. Can true love reform a messenger of God who has fallen from grace? (No.)

name: The Girl I Like Is a Freak Like Me?!

details.title: The Girl I Like Is a Freak Like Me?!
details.short_description: A cute and silly yuri visual novel about two closeted fujoshis who attend a prestigious all-girls boarding school. Let the BL brainrot commence ☆

details.title: Mosaic Moon
details.short_description: A nonlinear puzzle-platformer about decoding a mysterious language of logic. Determine the meaning of each symbol to find and place colored tiles correctly to progress. Explore at your own pace and unravel the mysteries of the an ancient, unknowable alien entity!

details.title: Test Your Luck: Gacha Simulator
details.short_description: Welcome to GachaOS, the premier gacha gaming platform for whales! Play a gauntlet of incremental gacha games with Moby, our helpful Gacha Assistant. Build your fortune, then burn it all pulling characters, ripping packs, or opening crates. Unlucky? With GachaOS, turn your misfortune into fortune!

details.title: SLICE SURPRISE
details.short_description: Throw a blade. Cut stuff in half. Like, exactly in half. Pumpkins, piggy banks, one very nervous dragon. Climb a tower where every floor has one little rule, keep every weapon you buy, and take down bosses who hit back. One more floor? Sure. Just one.

details.title: FragField
details.short_description: FragField is an FPS that wants you to actually have fun, not to buy a graphics card. Pick your class, head to the front with your team and hold the zones; sometimes the win is a revive at the right moment, not a kill. No pay-to-win. Formerly announced as Flick Frag.

details.title: Crappy Driver
details.short_description: Crappy Driver is a physics-based vehicle builder where you deliver passengers and packages, hoping you don’t lose them along the way. Build from weird parts, drive to the next stop without falling apart and make your vehicle stranger with every ride.

details.title: Project: Esper
details.short_description: A massively expansive traditional roguelike where literally anything is possible. Polymorph your foes into swords, mind control an aberration with five heads, or create your own pocket dimension. Break the rules, build the indomitable, and pray nothing finds a loose thread.

details.title: Trutzburg
details.short_description: Defend the Trutzburg from endless slime hordes. Build, upgrade and grow stronger with every run — solo or in 2-player online co-op.

details.title: Integration Test
details.short_description: A terminal game about surveillance, identity, and editing your own source. In development for PC/Steam Deck.

details.title: Meant to Bee
details.short_description: A goofy, fun, heartwarming dating sim - in Meant to Bee, you play as a drone bee, romancing one of eight princesses to help them become a Queen Bee by Hivecoming in 15 days.

details.title: Tiny Crimes
details.short_description: Who needs money when you can sneak your way into anywhere? Team up with your fellow rats, explore different stores, grab all the supplies, and fulfill your community’s peculiar requests… But watch out! Things can get out of paw pretty quickly.

details.title: Daylight Line
details.short_description: Daylight Line is a single-player card roguelite mixing three-person deckbuilding and city life. Take agency jobs with companions, explore changing zones, learn skills, and investigate anomalies around the city. Between investigations, return to Daylight City to run your shop and share everyday life.

details.title: FALLBREAKER HORIZON DEFENSE FRONT
details.short_description: Pilot your aircraft to smash falling blocks before they raise the sea! Use fuel to speed up, slow down, and turn. Land on your carrier to refuel, or keep smashing to boost LINK and your score multiplier. Game over if rising seas or a direct block hit sinks your carrier.

details.title: Barista
details.short_description: A cozy audio game. Be a barista in a wacky world and listen to your customers' funny stories. Designed to be fully playable without sight.

details.title: Arkforge-方舟锻造
details.short_description: A space sandbox game. Build your mobile factory ship to mine, smelt, produce, fight, and research in space. Design unique ships, equip them with various modules, and set up production lines to supply your fleet.

details.title: Chessboxing Arcade
details.short_description: Chess Boxing Arcade is a 2D arcade take on the real sport: alternate between timed chess rounds and fast-paced boxing rounds. Win by checkmate, knockout or the clock against adaptive AI, friends locally, or opponents online.

details.title: Evening, Boss.
details.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror about keeping a London cab firm located deep in the forest running after dark.

details.title: The Cardkov
details.short_description: Turn poker hands into weapons in this single-player, top-down extraction shooter. Collect discarded cards in the city's cold back alleys, build a hand, and use your new weapon to uncover the factory's secrets. Grab one more card, or make it back alive with the hand you've got.

name: QUIT! - The Japanese Art of Resignation

details.title: QUIT! - The Japanese Art of Resignation
details.short_description: Your boss won't let you quit. So this is a boss fight. Read the excuses, answer with strategy cards, and put the evidence on the table. A resignation-negotiation ADV.

details.title: SinEater
details.short_description: Climb and parkour through procedurally generated towers of memories in search of your own sins in this third-person exploration platformer. Survive in the world after the second great flood. Manage resources and needs, scavenge and trade with fellow sin-eaters.

details.title: Luminere: Final Light
details.short_description: In a world consumed by the Gloom, a group of survivors finds refuge among abandoned ruins. Assemble parties of heroes, set out on dangerous expeditions, and return with resources and new allies as you gradually transform the ruins into humanity’s last bastion.

details.title: I Am Plague
details.short_description: I Am Plague is a dark incremental roguelite with automatic combat and permanent progression. Lead a horde of rats, collect mutations, create powerful synergies, and devour your enemies as you climb 200+ floors of a vast underground fortress. Every death makes you stronger.

details.title: Late Stage Gambling
details.short_description: Here you don't pick up loot. You gamble for it. In this top-down shooter roguelike, you wager before every wave to get your gear. The higher the stakes, the stronger the rewards and the more it hurts when you lose. Fight through a blood-soaked casino to pay off a debt built to kill you.

details.title: Before The Meteor
details.short_description: A cinematic third-person adventure built around exploration and discovery. Travel through breathtaking landscapes, encounter dangerous creatures, and uncover the mysteries hidden across a vast and mysterious world.

details.title: My Dream Closet
details.short_description: My Dream Closet is a free retro dress up game inspired by the 2000's girl games! You'll have to create your perfect outfit for a night out! Discover the theme and follow your creativity to design the most incredible outfit! ☀️

details.title: Ruru & Lala: Wonder World Adventure!
details.short_description: Ruru & Lala is a 2D action-puzzle game where you control two characters simultaneously. After Ruru is pulled into a mysterious mirror, she meets Lala, another version of herself from the mirror world. Together, embark on a great adventure through a mysterious world!

details.title: No One Will Miss Me
details.short_description: An existential horror visual novel. Play as a voice inside a troubled mind. Identify her cognitive distortions, shift her perspective, and win the debate that decides whether she lives or dies.

details.title: Runic Conflux
details.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilder with 200+ cards/items. A unique elemental resource system and rune (status effect) combinations. Choose 3 of 5 heroes each run.

details.title: Calling
details.short_description: A short sci-fi adventure where you tune a damaged communications device, follow voices buried in the noise, and make choices to find your way forward.

details.title: Postal Bots
details.short_description: Fight hordes of robots in this roguelike twinstick shooter! As the last human run delivery company on Earth, it's your task to destroy AI delivery robots and keep a human face in the postal delivery service. Make deliveries and grab loot to upgrade your run and improve your robot smashing firepower.

details.title: BOLLWERK
details.short_description: A tower defense game where over 100,000 physically simulated units besiege your fort. Build guns and mortars. Rain down grenades. Let the dead pile up, and pray relief comes in time.

details.title: Berlingus Idle
details.short_description: An idle clicker and sandbox survival RPG where you click, build, mine, craft, and battle your way to mastering more than a dozen specialties and becoming master of your own empire.

details.title: Crawlgan
details.short_description: Turn-based dungeon crawling meets roguelike deckbuilding. Enemies telegraph their next move, so you have to think about where to stand and which card to play. Spend limited action points on cards to bring down the boss at the bottom of the dungeon.

details.title: Gniluha
details.short_description: Clear garages of anyone who doesn’t share your morals — in your trusty Gniluha.

details.title: Doodonia VS Zombies
details.short_description: A Sci-Fi Fantasy Lane Defense Game. Unlock little Doods (Doodonians) and then choose which to bring to battle. You select and place Doods on the battlefield where they are needed most. Strategy mixed with comedic physics makes for the one of the best ways to slay Zombies.

details.title: A Romance of Wind,Flowers,Snow,Moon
details.short_description: "If you could escape fate, what choice would you make?" By the shores of Cangshan and Erhai, you embark on a romance with several people of vastly different personalities. Only by finding the final truth can you restore peace to the restless Dali Kingdom.

details.title: Tread on the Dead
details.short_description: Paint the city with undead blood in a high-octane combat runner where stopping means death. Tear through low-poly hordes with guns, brute force and lethal abilities while pushing your body beyond human limits. The others died. You kept moving. Welcome to the program.

details.title: Atharia
details.short_description: A turn-based creature-collecting roguelite. Evolve real animals into fantastical Athars, each shaped by its nature and its type. Explore legendary places around the world, and defeat the mythical creature guarding each one to make it part of your team.

details.title: Overtime at Holiday's
details.short_description: Cleaners Bill and Jules land a weekend job at Max Holiday’s mansion - until they find him dead in the pool. Trapped in an endless overtime loop, they must move his body around while solving quirky puzzles. A darkly funny retro adventure where "Weekend at Bernie’s" meets "Groundhog Day"!

details.title: Malsort
details.short_description: An action MMO inspired by the classic ARPGs. A cursed world of ash and burning thrones, shared with every hero who dares. Hunt in parties, craft from what you slay, sell your finds in your own shop, and raid the world bosses to loot ancient relics.

details.title: We Have Lift Off
details.short_description: Gather resources, upgrade your rocket, and reach new heights in this casual incremental game. Put your little workers to work, research new technologies, and launch farther with every expedition.

details.title: Peppero and The Toad City
details.short_description: What on earth is happening in the toad world?! Help Peppero the mouse escape a dangerous underground city while managing his stress levels, and uncover the dark mystery behind twisted mutation experiments. A hand-drawn dark fantasy world with immersive first-person gameplay.

details.title: Stellmoor Stables: Cozy Horse Racing
details.short_description: Raise horses on a cozy farm, then race them. Your jockey rides and you call the race by playing cards. You got fired for refusing to race an injured mare, and now you want to beat the boss who fired you. Play solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players.

details.title: Beaked!
details.short_description: Beaked! is a tile-based puzzle-platformer about sound manipulation. Following a little Starling in an abstract world of wooden toys, players will learn to peck buttons, mimic noises and trick people -- all to reach the finish.

details.title: Build&Boom
details.short_description: Build&Boom is a chaotic competitive party game. Builders race to raise a structure from the blueprint while Saboteurs rain rocks, drones, tomatoes and traps down on them. Play three modes from 1v1 to 3v3, online with friends or in local split-screen.

details.title: Decayed Cases: Archive 22
details.short_description: The peaceful, familiar everyday life is completely turned upside down by the chaos that has erupted at the base. The silence of the archive is dissapear, leaving nothing but survival. Will I ever get to tell the story of everything I’ve been through, or will I, too, become a part of the archive?

details.title: Snake Draft
details.short_description: The fantasy football roguelike. Snake Draft is about finding synergies and building your dream team. With 100+ unique athletes shuffling between 22 in-world teams, each run offers a new puzzle to solve. Draft studs, find sleepers, and build a team that is locked in for a championship run.

details.title: Mountain Rescuers
details.short_description: A co-op zombie FPS for 1-4 mountain rescuers who are not very good at rescuing. Arrive by flying rowboat, find the one survivor on each peak and keep it quiet: noise brings the horde. Sell the bodies to the butcher, buy bigger guns, try not to shoot your friends.

details.title: Gnomes Go Boom
details.short_description: Garden gnomes vs. gardeners. Gnomes run screaming "lolololo", then freeze into a perfect ceramic statue among 300 identical ones. Gardeners hunt in first person with a water sprayer: statues drip, live gnomes steam. Spray the right one before it goes BOOM. 2–10 players online.

details.title: Mongle: Cozy Days
details.short_description: A cozy butler simulator where you serve Carrot, a bunny girl who likes things her way, and enjoy the simple pleasures of everyday life.

details.title: Modern Frankenstein
details.short_description: Experience the chilling survival horror reimagining of the Frankenstein legend set in a fictional modern time. Dr Frankenstein's experiments have led him to discover the secrets of life beyond death, a new reality. His monstrous creations roam the halls of his home, his only family.

details.title: STEELHOWL
details.short_description: Build your own mech and take it into battle. Boost to close the gap, take down enemies with a range of weapons, and send your repair companion to recover parts. Refit your mech for the next operation in this third-person mech action game.

details.title: VR PC Assembly
details.short_description: Build, fix, and upgrade PCs with your own hands in VR. Run your own workshop, one customer at a time, and build a thriving computer repair business in your very own room.

details.title: Dark Forest
details.short_description: Day 4. The tins are gone and help isn't coming. Step out into an endless first-person survival world: scavenge, craft, build, hunt and fish — alone, with up to five Steam friends or on your own server. At night, things come out of the dark. They don't knock.

details.title: SLAPPED SILLY
details.short_description: A game of tag with terrible manners. Chase, dodge, and slap your friends through a living 3D newspaper in this party game for up to 12 players. Get slapped and join the chase, dress to impress, and turn your finest moments—and worst falls—into front-page news.

details.title: Homeland Reclaim
details.short_description: A roguelike RTS where any warrior can wield any weapon! Build a deck of fantasy fighters, arm them with swords, spears and hammers, unleash mighty spells and win fast-paced battles where the whole battlefield fits on one screen.

details.title: 通魂纸 Tonghun Paper
details.short_description: Tonghun Paper is a first-person horror exploration game. Search for clues, read old letters, and piece together a hidden past while evading danger.

details.title: Terramiasma
details.short_description: Terramiasma is an extraction adventure game where you play as a Prospector exploring the dangerous regions of Terra, a planet covered in a toxic gas known as the Miasma. Gather resources, fight off numerous creatures, and above all... survive!

details.title: Backpack Jianghu 2
details.short_description: Start as a young martial artist. Seek legendary weapons and secret manuals, combine techniques to forge your own fighting style, and turn humble moves into devastating attacks! Fight your way to the summit of Mount Hua, claim the title of the greatest, or challenge real players in live PvP!

details.title: Tarmac Tycoon
details.short_description: Turn a tiny airfield into a roaring multi-runway hub. Draw blueprints and watch your crews build them tile by tile, then keep every passenger, suitcase and fuel truck moving, from a three-seat prop plane to a sky full of airliners. Contains high amounts of jet fuel.

details.title: Fogblower
details.short_description: Fogblower is an incremental game. Clear the fog with the fan on your little boat, discover treasures and strange creatures of the deep, and upgrade your boat until one day you can reach the mainland and earn your freedom.

details.title: Things Left Unsaid
details.short_description: A tiny, cozy, hand-drawn ASMR game. Every antique arrives in loose pieces: click them back together, brush away the dust, trace the cracks in gold lacquer, and press the wax seal. Then haggle with quirky collectors at your counter. Each piece holds a story left unsaid.

details.title: Babylumns
details.short_description: Babylumns is a fast-paced versus puzzle arcade inspired by 90s arcade and 16-bit classics. Match, combo, and unleash character abilities in tense, replayable battles.

name: Professor Mong Mong: The Window to the North

details.title: Professor Mong Mong: The Window to the North
details.short_description: Investigate a haunting mystery inspired by Nordic folklore in a story-rich 2D point-and-click adventure. Explore the remote Faroe Islands, uncover forgotten secrets, solve paranormal puzzles, and discover what lies beyond the Window to the North.

details.title: FATHOM
details.short_description: Send your crew deep into an alien ocean in this pixel-art desktop companion idler. Research strange creatures, harvest and refine resources, expand your deep-sea research platform, and discover the secrets lurking beneath the waves.

details.title: Solbound
details.short_description: Fight, salvage and trade across the moons and rings of a solar system nobody can leave. Take what you can carry. Read what the dead left behind. Everything you do is remembered.

details.title: Echoes of the Veil
details.short_description: Jack Graves has been invited to a mysterious mansion by a killer who has yet to finish their work. Investigate supernatural echoes, uncover the next victims, and stop the culprit before it’s too late.

details.title: Idle Misadventures
details.short_description: Recruit a party of classic RPG heroes and send them adventuring for levels and loot. Conquer the realm, then retire your heroes to unlock new classes, mechanics, and meta bonuses that make the next generation even stronger. Play actively to speed your progress, or idle your way to victory!

details.title: Falcons of the Red Planet
details.short_description: As part of a dedicated combat astro-fighter squadron of the Red Mars Space Force, you must defend the solar system from the oppression of the ruthless Alliance of Empires.

details.title: Boiler & Blood
details.short_description: Build and command a dieselpunk war train, manage its crew, and wield forbidden sorcery in a real-time-with-pause tactical roguelite. Destroy the enemy command train before the pursuing army catches you.

details.title: Songs of the Shoals
details.short_description: Cast a line, sail between islands, and bring your catch home in a single-player fishing adventure. Sell fish, take harbor commissions, upgrade your gear, and explore coastal villages under changing skies. Take a seaplane flight for a new view of the sea.

details.title: Night to Reticle +6
details.short_description: Nozomu follows his wife to Kyushu and meets the enigmatic KANA. Accept or refuse his nightly “invitations”? Replay the six-day story to uncover the truth. A choice-driven BL psychological adventure with a seme (top) protagonist. The complete edition of the free game Night to Reticle.

details.title: Three Kingdoms The Mainland
details.short_description: 在群雄割据的三国乱世中，从零开始建设村庄，发展势力、抵御敌军，最终统一天下。

details.title: KalshwK
details.short_description: Get aboard the Ghost Train and fight with 99 lives worth of hardship to forge your own destiny with the unnatural grasp of KalshwK Desert : Top-Down 2d Roguelite Shooter

details.title: Sceadu Eard
details.short_description: Sceadu Eard is a hardcore retro-style open-world dungeon crawler set in an eerie dark fantasy world. Craft gear at your base, gather resources, master methodical combat, unlock new paths and return safely from each expedition.

details.title: Hazardous Employment
details.short_description: Hire expendable heroes, arrange their formation, and send them into automated fantasy expeditions in this darkly comedic guild-management roguelite. Manage contracts, injuries, morale, payroll, and debt—then file the paperwork when your best employees fail to return.

details.title: Bad Ideas Game Jam Collection 2026
details.short_description: The Bad Ideas Game Jam Collection 2026 is a showcase of 50 short-form videos and single-player games that encompass a variety of genres from visual novels, platformers, rpgs shooters, rhythm, and puzzle games. Each following a theme of trying to make games that think Outside the Box!

details.title: Scrambled Ships
details.short_description: A Yacht Dice Roguelike set on a ship with a mysterious figure, trapped in an endless game night atop a sunset cruise. Think outside the box, buy items, and progress through the rounds, or fall to the ever-increasing score targets.

details.title: The Dangers of Liminality
details.short_description: A first person survival horror game set in The Backrooms. Explore and survive in this liminal expanse of many levels while maintaining your sanity, with realistic yet distinct graphics. You may attempt to run or fight, but how far will that really get you?

details.title: Walls Have Eyes
details.short_description: A racket. A ball. A court that fights back. A first-person adventure built on real squash, set at night in an old mansion turned squash club, where the creatures you face are part of the courts you play in.

details.title: PIO: A Robot’s Story
details.short_description: PIO: A Robot's Story is a story-driven action-adventure with Souls-lite combat. Journey from the retrofuturistic streets of Moscow to the remote islands of the North Pacific, where every battle, discovery, and step brings you closer to a truth that could change everything.

details.title: Brain Runner: Dreamcore Movement Shooter
details.short_description: Your time is running out. Kill to take it back. Sprint, wall-run, and shoot through shifting dream worlds in a fast-paced movement-shooter roguelite as Aina fights to wake humanity from the perfect dream.

details.title: World Resetter
details.short_description: World Resetter is a CRPG featuring real-time strategy controls and ARPG loot mechanics. Command a squad of up to 5 unique characters as you explore a vast world and interact with dynamic NPCs. Defeat powerful foes, craft deep attribute builds, and uncover the truth behind the world.

details.title: Sky Homestead
details.short_description: Sky Homestead is a cozy farming and automation game set on floating islands. Rebuild a shattered sky-kingdom: raise crops, chain machines into production lines, hire a crew who work while you explore, and sail cargo balloons between the isles you bring back to life.

details.title: BACKROOMS PINTEROI
details.short_description: BACKROOMS PINTEROI: Explore the endless Backrooms on your own or with your friends. Survive ‘terrifying’ entities, solve puzzles, manage your resources and find your way out. Each level features new puzzles, entities and things to discover. Two new levels are added every month :)

details.title: Ionic Drive
details.short_description: Plan your flight path, execute a perfect flip-and-burn manoeuvre and pray that your hull survives any impact in this space flight simulation/racing game. Can you avoid collision and finish your flight?

details.title: Hatched
details.short_description: Run. Fight. Eat. Repeat. In this creature evolution roguelite. Hunt with 100+ abilities and run-altering relics, pick your element and exploit theirs, every boss you beat evolves your body. Twenty minutes, one life, a different creature every run!

details.title: Reaching for The Star
details.short_description: Reaching For The Star is a modern entertainment industry life simulation where you play as a rising actress. Plan your weekly schedule, improve your skills, audition for new roles, build relationships, and shape your own journey from an unknown newcomer to a legendary star.

details.title: 银茧 Argent Cocoon
details.short_description: Humanity has fallen, the ruins a breeding ground for the Insecta. Through the Argent Cocoon, they rewrite genes. Evolution is the unquestioned law. You, a gifted Eularva, are meant to surrender your soul to the Great Collective Consciousness. But exploring deeper, you question that destiny.

details.title: Voxnap Party
details.short_description: Jump into the party as a Voxnap, a character built from voxels! Grab the parts scattered across the map and snap them on - arms, legs, torso - to power yourself up your own way. Knock the other guests flat and seize the win! Online play for up to 6.

details.title: TITAN'S CELL: NYMPH
details.short_description: Collect and breed quirky Nymphs inside a universe-sized Titan. Build a team of three for turn-based card battles, choose your route through roguelite expeditions, explore solo or in online co-op with up to 3 players, and test your strategy in real-time PvP.

details.title: Shift Knight
details.short_description: Shift Knight is a horror typing game and a supernatural mystery. Every night the dead rise from the graves along the only road home, each carrying a word. Type it before it reaches the truck. Nobody will say where they came from, and the Order keeps sending instructions.

details.title: Yeet Animals Gently
details.short_description: Flick a ball at a pen full of very cute animals. Each hit drains a stamina bar, and an empty bar sends one sailing over the fence to land on its feet. Every landing pays. Spend it on a skill tree, unlock new species, and move to a new arena.

details.title: Stone Gambit
details.short_description: Stone Gambit reimagines chess in an epic fantasy world. Assemble armies of diverse pieces, create your own formations, strike from afar, and crush your enemies. Lead the weakest of the Seven Clans, challenge the mighty, and prepare for ranked online battles.

details.title: Fedanheim
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror set in a factory that treats human bodies as equipment. Lose limbs, scavenge scrap, build crude prostheses, obey the factory’s rules, uncover what happened below, and stay quiet. Something is listening.

details.title: Implight
details.short_description: Type in what actions you want to take in this comedic text-adventure game inspired by choose-your-own-adventure books! Implight uses 3D visuals and absurdist humor to convey an entertaining and introspective story.

details.title: The Arena's Greatest
details.short_description: Fantasy Autobattler - Assemble a team, fight monsters to gain XP and loot, fight other players, and repeat.

details.title: Outblight
details.short_description: "Nothing down there is what the stories say." A turn-based clash roguelite where you operate skills against the enemy's in queue and manipulate of it's order. Between of catastrophe of the dying world, there lives Kirs, who is looking for creatures of the abyss in order to survive

name: סוד המדבר - Secret Of the Desert

details.title: סוד המדבר - Secret Of the Desert
details.short_description: A point-and-click pixel art adventure in the spirit of the old Sierra and LucasArts classics, set in the desert of southern Israel in the early 1990s.

details.title: Rasterfall
details.short_description: A falling-sand survival crafting game where every pixel is physically simulated and chemically reactive. Explore the world using a wide variety of materials, synthesize new substances, and build automated production lines. Multiplayer supported.

details.title: Eccentric Wander
details.short_description: Despite the genuinely horror-like atmosphere, the main characters are lighthearted, making it a stealth comedy horror!

details.title: Duskmont Files
details.short_description: The disappearance of a crooked politician with a taste for the bottle doesn't seem like much of a concern to private detective Ray Hardigan at first. But what appears to be a routine investigation in the perpetually overcast city of Duskmont quickly spirals into something far more dangerous...

details.title: Snakesweeper - minesweeper survival
details.short_description: A classic minesweeper variant, with some minimalist survival mechanisms. Reveal tiles to find resources to keep your thirst and hunger down, while avoiding the snake tiles. Game sessions take approx 10minutes to 1hour.

details.title: Terminal Swarm
details.short_description: A real-time space roguelite where your deck builds your warship mid-battle. Draw weapon blueprints, bolt railguns and missile racks onto your hull while the shots fly, then slow time to swat down the salvo. Every ship is built tile by tile and torn apart tile by tile. Yours too.

details.title: La Casa
details.short_description: A dice-rolling deckbuilding roguelike set in the Weird West of 1848. Fourteen days. One town. A warlock riding home to burn it down. Every card you play and every die you roll decides whether you survive the showdown. Go roll some dice.

details.title: Fury Drive
details.short_description: A lone traveler fights to survive a post-apocalyptic wasteland crawling with undead, mutants, and cultists. Drift, loot, and slaughter your way across the desert while building out your vehicle's arsenal.

details.title: HEAD FIRST, ROLL OUT!
details.short_description: Don’t control the head—control the floor. Dent the ground to create slopes, build momentum, and roll a disembodied head through obstacle-packed stages in this physics-driven 3D action game.

details.title: Clown Hole
details.short_description: There are clowns down there, in the hole. An incremental mining game where you mine clowns for profit.

details.title: SPARK//RUSH
details.short_description: SPARK//RUSH is a high-speed rhythm-action game. Shoot, slash, and dodge through intense rail stages driven by electronic music before facing colossal bosses.

details.title: One Last Fish
details.short_description: A cozy fishing idle game that sits anywhere on your desktop. Catch rare fish, buy upgrades and customize your island while you study, work or relax!

details.title: Apocalypse Machines
details.short_description: Four centuries ago, 12 billion humans were wiped out by AIs gone rogue. Now, through unbelievable stupidity or desperation, an unknown force may have revived those genocidal machines. As an elite mech pilot sent on a covert investigation, you'll face overwhelming odds — and an unsettling truth.

details.title: The 12 CZ: Final Battle
details.short_description: All The End and his followers were repelled but fled to the wilds to hide and plague the land. So the CZs united, ventured into enemy territory, slaying demons, collecting artifacts, and fighting together to grow stronger until All The End's utter defeat.

details.title: Rays of HOPE™
details.short_description: Step into the imagination of a child and play as their favorite superhero cowboy action figure brought to life as the world around you transforms into the adventures they always imagined.

details.title: The Deposition
details.short_description: The Deposition is a story-driven visual novel with fantasy elements, set in a fully fictional world inspired by the European Renaissance. You will follow Fascino, a young man of humble birth. Read the story, make your choices, and uncover the hidden side of the sacred order.
publishers: 北京皓凛科技有限公司

details.title: VtuberCompanySimulator
details.short_description: Take your place as the head of a VTuber agency, run the company, and guide your VTubers as they grow in this management simulation. Type what you want to say, choose how the company responds, and handle each crisis your way.

details.title: TALLY
details.short_description: A horror clicker set inside a census ledger. It's 1847, and the Vestry pays you a penny for every person you write into the book. Beside your count sits a second number: the clicks the room has heard. It is always a little higher.

details.title: Kipper: The Mountain Lizard
details.short_description: Kipper: The Mountain Lizard is a retro-styled 2D precision platformer. Help Kipper tidy the mountain by collecting every gem and balloon.

details.title: Ranchonauts
details.short_description: A slapstick co-op game about herding alien sheep across a dangerous frontier. Work solo or with up to 5 friends to keep your flock together through physics-fueled disasters, pay off your ship-repair debt, and get home in one piece.

details.title: Dode
details.short_description: Dode is an online creature-capture RPG on hex-voxel worlds. Tactical-combat focused, with a cozy side. Featuring endless unique loot, ability customization, and base creation. Explore, capture, train, battle, craft, farm, and build - as you quest aside the elemental Wardens in their Mana Wars.

details.title: Murmures
details.short_description: A retro psychological horror game where you decipher mysterious incantations and use forbidden spells to survive the creatures of the depths of time that relentlessly torment you.

details.title: Hallonys
details.short_description: Face the terrifying darkness with your fragile light and witness mysteries that refuse to be understood. What will you believe when reality fails? Can your senses still be trusted?

details.title: Highschool Heroes
details.short_description: Join Mike, Kyle, Littleboss, and Serena on an adventure against the bullies of Emerith. Each of them has their own fighting style.

details.title: Rest in Profit
details.short_description: An incremental dark fantasy tycoon: you are a shabby necromancer harvesting souls beneath a graveyard. Dig out endless crypt corridors, set collectors under the richest graves, then bounce every soul off your rune wall to multiply its value. Death is a growth industry.

details.title: Raid Haven
details.short_description: Build your haven and fortify it to withstand 100 waves of increasingly dangerous raids. Strategically place walls, traps, turrets, and defences, equip your pawns with powerful weapons and armour, and adapt your base as each wave pushes you closer to the breaking point.

details.title: Green Horizon
details.short_description: Green Horizon is a relaxing 2D cannabis-growing life sim. Take over your uncle’s old operation, grow new strains, complete orders, meet the locals, explore the town and build your business at your own pace.

details.title: Flight South: Northern Expedition
details.short_description: A clan-management and grand-strategy game set during the founding years of the Eastern Jin. Establish your house, settle your people, manage its manor, govern local territory, navigate court politics, and face Zu Ti's expedition and Wang Dun's rebellion.

details.title: Odyssée Stellaire 2
details.short_description: 2.5 million light-years separate you from a civilization sending a signal. This incremental space odyssey will take you across the universe, all the way to Andromeda. The adventure continues. Safe travels, Commander.

details.title: DARK MACHINE THE GAME
details.short_description: DARK MACHINE THE GAME is a team-based mecha action shooter where your custom machine evolves through three combat classes. Clash in up to 7v7 PvP or battle overwhelming hordes in PvE across destructible, ever-changing arenas.

details.title: More Minions
details.short_description: 100% hand-drawn by me! More Minions is a fantasy roguelike autobattler where you recruit and equip units, arrange small army cards, and watch them fight automatically. Let your plan play out or intervene with tactical item cards and mid-battle repositioning.

details.title: Freaky Wheels
details.short_description: Fight your way out of an isolated desert cult in a physics-driven vehicular combat roguelite. Drift, shoot, unleash abilities and upgrade a roster of weaponized rides as you uncover the alien secrets hidden within your former home.

details.title: Heroes Never Die
details.short_description: Choose your hero, rally your troops, and carve a path through hordes of foul creatures in a fast-paced fusion of strategy and survivor gameplay. Grow your army as you march, change your tactics on the fly, and lead soldiers, goblins, minotaurs and more into glorious, chaotic battle.

details.title: All That Glitters
details.short_description: Faites vos jeux! Step into the Gombling's Lair of Sin and push your luck to earn ludicrous amount of riches in a casino themed roguelike dungeon crawler! Go bling or go home, and remember that is not gold all that glitters!

name: AI Startup Manager: Race to AGI

details.title: AI Startup Manager: Race to AGI
details.short_description: Build an AI lab in a deep management sim about the race to AGI. Recruit researchers, train models, secure funding and outmaneuver rival labs. Balance growth against safety, manage your team and face the consequences of every launch.

details.title: NEARBY: 3 LIKES
details.short_description: A photoreal cinematic gay romance adventure set in Tokyo. Three men have liked Yuto's profile. Meet them in person, talk over coffee, walk by the river — and choose how close you get. Japanese voice, written choices, and three relationships.

details.title: The Dust Remembers
details.short_description: A fallen world. On the wasteland, survival is all that matters. You walked alone—until you met them. Together or against, Trust or doubt, Closer or apart. Every choice leaves a mark, changing the story and your ending. Your decisions define this journey.

details.title: THREADMILL
details.short_description: Write code that controls an entire robotic workforce. Start with one worker, then scale to 128. Share jobs, feed machines, and adapt when power fails. Test your code in new facilities, then tune it to do more with less.

details.title: Everyone Expire
details.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you're the Dungeon Master and the party trusts you completely. Bait the room, rig the dice, and keep them alive just long enough to die at the boss. The paladin can't swim. The bard licks things. You've taken notes.

name: Doc, I Don't Want to Die! Slice the Infection

details.title: Doc, I Don't Want to Die! Slice the Infection
details.short_description: Pilot a tiny ship in this 2D shooter, upgrade your weapons and battle a variety of bacterial enemies. Blast, dash and slice your way through the infection.

details.title: Locked In: The Ward
details.short_description: Locked In: The Ward is a first-person psychological horror set inside the abandoned Ravenrock Research Facility. Explore its medical ward, solve environmental puzzles, survive the darkness, and uncover the truth behind Subject #0012 as stress distorts your perception.

details.title: Desperatea
details.short_description: A dish-pushing, liquid-pouring puzzle game all about a strange substance known as 'tea'.

name: 供犠層 KYOGI STRATUM 操作員を募集しています

details.title: 供犠層 KYOGI STRATUM 操作員を募集しています
details.short_description: エネルギーが枯渇した日本社会。あなたは本日から操作手となる。 マウス操作で発電を行い、レバーを操作し、送電先を決める。時間制限が迫るなか、社会と自分に責任を持って供給先を判断しよう。謎の巨大装置を操作し、電力を供給するディストピア発電管理スリラー。

details.title: Asther
details.short_description: Asther is a 2D metroidvania action RPG where you play as a young witch. Explore a fantasy world, battle creatures and powerful bosses, develop your abilities, and unlock new paths in an adventure with fast-paced combat and an engaging story.

details.title: Midnight Callers
details.short_description: Spend an evening with friends in a regency-esque society with a monstrous twist! Supernatural suitors await a chance for romance, but family secrets, rumors, and your fellow players just might sabotage your prospects before the season comes to an end.

details.title: Mammoth
details.short_description: Guide a dawning civilization through the early stages of humanity in this RTS roguelite. Discover new technologies and face enemies that will try to destroy you before reaching your full potential. But every time your tribe dies, their sons grow stronger and more powerful.

details.title: Hot Human
details.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer parkour game for 2–12 players where hot potato works backwards. Pass the human before the timer runs out or explode.

details.title: Spellsanity: Wizard Survival
details.short_description: Cleanse five realms of an arcane corruption in this dark fantasy survivors roguelite. Draft a new set of spells every run, build around your playstyle and cut down hordes of corrupted foes. Hunt powerful items, forge game-breaking synergies and grow stronger with every death.

details.title: Together Forever!
details.short_description: Together Forever! is a fast-paced ricochet roguelite where pachinko physics meets backpack management. Launch bouncing balls with flipping gravity, discover crazy relic synergies, and help an angel and demon couple defend their forbidden love against the hordes of Heaven and Hell!

details.title: The Legend of Trump
details.short_description: Play as a raging businessman with a mission, take over the Cashlandia strip one hotel-casino at a time. Use bribes, gaudy furniture, and addicting games to keep people in your casinos and make the most cash. Take over the strip, building by building, and become the Legend.

details.title: A Monk's Quest
details.short_description: You’re a monk exploring a vast sandbox world with living, simulated villages, where everyone has a life and a story. Mine, craft, and fight corrupted spirits in the wild. Then return to the villages to build a home, make friends, and master the art of prayer to help them fulfill their dreams.

details.title: Steel Tide
details.short_description: Tanks, warships, jets and a nuclear silo. Rain blinds your scouts, night hides the enemy's assault, and one warhead can end it all. Fight through the Gulf War of 1990–91 under other flags, outwit four levels of AI, or face friends on PC, phone and browser in the same match.

details.title: Mad Rat Cafe
details.short_description: Top-down roguelite about a post-apocalyptic cafe where you cook orders and shoot your way through mutant waves. Fix broken kitchen machines and stack wild upgrades to survive every shift.

name: 迷宫：秘能探险 Maze: Arcane Adventure

details.title: 迷宫：秘能探险 Maze: Arcane Adventure
details.short_description: A top-down single-player game blending maze exploration and mechanism-based puzzles. Seek treasure chests with limited sight and fading memories of explored paths. Mix and match arcane items, solve puzzles along the way, and find a way to survive monsters and disasters.

details.title: Telluris
details.short_description: Become a waymaker on the frontier of Antaris. Fly a second-hand ship past the edge of the charted stars, dive from orbit through the clouds of a world nobody has named and land anywhere. Chart its rivers and species, name it, claim it… or go too far to ever come back.

details.title: Big Cock Inc.
details.short_description: A cozy farm sim where you arm your cocks with AK-47s and bet the rent on them in club fights. Breed the best chickens, steal and sell their eggs, send the rest down the conveyor to the fryer, and serve them through your own fried chicken drive-thru.

details.title: Yemen: The Lover
details.short_description: You travel to a remote village in Yemen to meet the woman you fell in love with online. But the locals warn you that nobody lives there anymore. So who has been waiting for you?

details.title: BloodBuild
details.short_description: BloodBuild is a roguelike deckbuilder built around build-crafting, where the challenge isn't collecting items - it's making them work together. You progress by fusing, enchanting and combining your loot into ever more powerful builds, against ever stronger enemies.

details.title: Fors Magika
details.short_description: Fors Magika is a strategic card game where your hand is your battlefield! Choose a wizard, cast elemental spells, use Blessings and Curses, and outsmart your opponents. Uncover the enemy wizard and defeat them in fast-paced battles where every card counts.

details.title: Ink And Table
