details.short_description: A cute action roguelike where you play a tiny doll defending a girl’s possessed home, one tabletop at a time. Dodge bullet-hell barrages with simple left-right movement as you command flying swords and fire ink bullets at haunted teacups, ink paintings, and even braised pork.

details.title: JK in RPG
details.short_description: An outgoing high school girl, Akemi, was summoned to Isekai after school! To find her way home, she embarked on a journey to save the world with a female warrior, Pina...

details.title: Double Trouble Delivery
details.short_description: A two-player online coop physics game. One of you drives, the other keeps the packages balanced. Solve mini-games, dodge obstacles, and find the right house before the dogs steal your cargo.

details.title: Manga Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Sales by day, loot hunting by night. Stock the shelves of your shop with fresh manga volumes and serve your customers. By night, open your eyes in a dungeon spilling off the page, defeat monsters and collect your loot. What will you find to display in your shop?

name: Circuit Depot - Retro Computer Shop Simulator

details.title: Circuit Depot - Retro Computer Shop Simulator
details.short_description: Run a small-town computer shop in 1999. Buy broken PCs for a few dollars, open them up, find the fault and repair them, build custom machines for customers, stock the shelves and grow the store. Then close up shop and play the games on the computers you saved.

details.title: ACID DROP DOWNHILL: WITH UZI
details.short_description: Downhill as far away as you can from a nuclear explosion on your skateboard // snowboard or surf while shooting it with uzi to do tricks. Hope you are faster than the nuke. ACID DROP DOWNHILL IS THE BEST YOU EVER FEEL

details.title: Sunderkin
details.short_description: Venture into a broken land and forge a hero strong enough to overthrow its tyrant. Loot gear, collect spells, and combine them into a build of your own. Then put it to the test in brutal turn-based duels where every blow counts.

details.title: Wainhold
details.short_description: A competitive economic strategy game in the spirit of the golden age of RTS. Every ware is carried by hand from flag to flag, seasons reshape your land, and borders move only by force. A deep economy, a living world and fair play against AI or rivals in one system.

details.title: Orbit Wreck
details.short_description: Blast through waves of enemies in OrbitWreck, a fast-paced 2D space shooter! Pilot unique ships, dodge deadly attacks, collect Scrap, and unleash powerful special abilities.

details.title: Pinwick
details.short_description: Every haunted house was built by someone. You build yours one room at a time: saw, glue, velvet, patience, a photograph of everything you finish. Each room is perfect when you latch the glass at night. Some mornings, there are improvements.

details.title: The Gilded Sprig
details.short_description: Build a cozy botanical shop, craft fragrant products, gather rare ingredients, grow plants, and discover new recipes. Hire helpers, delight your customers, and turn a little shop into a flourishing business.

details.title: Bad Dubs
details.short_description: You’ve moved out on your own! Now you have to pay rent, buy food, and survive by taking on dubbing jobs. Accept absurd projects, make money, and improve your skills until you achieve your dream: starting your own dubbing company. Because dreams are free. Rent isn’t.

details.title: Dokapon Kingdom: Connect 2
details.short_description: An all-new entry in the Dokapon series, the RPG-style board game you can enjoy with up to four players! Take on gigantic monsters together, and create your very own hero with the Character Creation system! Friendship or betrayal? Money or power? Sacrifice your friendships and seize victory!

details.title: RUNGEON: Auto Roguelike
details.short_description: Fight through 100 dungeon rooms in this roguelite RPG with automatic turn-based combat. Choose upgrades after every victory, build your hero, defeat powerful bosses, and see how far you can survive.

details.title: Travellin Cats in Canada
details.short_description: Find many cats hidden across Canada in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator! Can you find them all?

details.title: Tin Happens!
details.short_description: Tin Happens is a realistic squash game built by squash players. Master drives, crosscourts, drops and boasts, outplay challenging AI, compete locally or online, and experience the speed, tactics and pressure of the sport.

name: HOI! あっちむいてロケット

details.title: HOI! あっちむいてロケット
details.short_description: Lose at "look away" and you become the rocket. Once you're the rocket, crash into another player and pass it on. A party game for up to 4 players. Local, or online with friends.

details.title: Acorn Heist!
details.short_description: A rock-paper-scissors roguelike deckbuilder. See your opponent’s hand and read what they’ll throw next — a battle of wits, not luck. Build your deck, play after the reveal, force wins, and break the rules of rock-paper-scissors to steal acorns from the forest’s cute animal-eared girls.

details.title: Swaggerfall
details.short_description: Swaggerfall is a first-person open world fantasy RPG that plays in the terminal. The graphics are ascii based and limited to what the command line offers. Playable with keyboard or gamepad.

details.title: Beezarr
details.short_description: Endless insect swarms, over a dozen bosses, 16 weapon evolutions: fight through 4 worlds as a tiny bee, rescue eggs from guarded nests and hatch 39 pets that fight by your side – from a goldfish to a cat with a minigun. A honey-sweet survivors-like for PC & Steam Deck.

details.title: Monsterpiece!
details.short_description: Battle rogue art tools and splatter them with color as you work to recreate beautiful paintings in this fast-paced combat game. Dodge enemy attacks, navigate obstacles, and experiment with your own creative strategies to bring each chaotic canvas to life!

details.title: Oaks vs Orcs
details.short_description: A roguelike kingdom builder with fast runs & crazy builds. Draft cards to grow a stronghold of deadly plants. Route the river to chain powerful bonuses across your tiles. Survive the orc siege and watch your army crush the horde.

details.title: The Night Archive - Sable's
details.short_description: One night alone at the campground he loved as a kid. Closed for years, chained at the gate, rotting. A friend arrives at sunrise. Episode 2 of The Night Archive.

details.title: Tomb Zombies
details.short_description: Chaotic Republican-era China shrouded in dark fog. Play as a wandering Taoist with peachwood tools and cinnabar talismans, defeat ghosts and flying jiangshi to calm evil spirits.

details.title: I Think I Killed Someone
details.short_description: A non-linear psychological horror puzzle mystery where you suffer from dementia and wake up next to a dead body in your apartment. Piece together the seven days of your life in chronological order to uncover what really happened over the past week.

name: Last Wail of the Sea King

details.title: Last Wail of the Sea King
details.short_description: Explore the body of a dying sea beast in this first-person RPG with JRPG-inspired turn-based combat. Recruit bizarre companions, battle mutated creatures and uncover the secrets of the Sea King.

details.title: Temp Agency
details.short_description: Temp Agency is a chaotic office co-op game where you and a friend race against the clock to survive increasingly ridiculous office jobs through different levels and offices. Answer phones, deliver packages, brew coffee, and work together to keep the office running. Or at least try to.

details.title: Monochrome Rainbow
details.short_description: Monochrome Rainbow is a surrealist card game

details.title: Gacha The Frog
details.short_description: Collect and play with cute frogs in a cozy physics simulation. Use the machine to get new frogs, play mini-games to improve the odds of getting legendary frogs and manage your space so you can keep playing. Can you complete the album?

details.title: 塑时者Derealization
details.short_description: "Derealization" is a visual novel that combines Japanese campus youth, suspenseful loops, and supernatural combat. The main characters in this work are voiced by professional Japanese actors. Inserting original animation clips into the climactic scenes greatly enhances the impact of the plot.

details.title: Humbuggest
details.short_description: Ziggy wants the crown and will do anything to steal it, even if it means breaking the law by breaking the laws of physics. Manipulate time and solve fourth-wall-breaking riddles in this comedic 2D puzzle-platformer filled with classic pixel art.

details.title: Zorehrai: Space Formations
details.short_description: Start with your own character and a small ship in a world that lives independently of the player. Develop your skills, explore space, trade, build industry, and grow your fleet to survive real-time battles against hostile fleets—and something far more terrifying lurking in the darkness.

details.title: Catino Town
details.short_description: Raise cute creatures that can transform into over 150 unique evolutions! Play games, decorate their home, and explore their world!

details.title: Vacancy: Hotel Inspection Simulator
details.short_description: Every room needs your approval. Inspect hotel rooms and a presidential suite, uncover overlooked faults, photograph the evidence, and decide what happens next. Clear it for guests, send housekeeping, call maintenance, or close the room.

details.title: Save Some Princess
details.short_description: Survive the horde in this fun action RPG roguelike. Discover millions of build combinations with unique hero abilities, itemized loot, and procedurally generated levels. Play by yourself or with up to 3 friends. Are you ready to descend into hell to save some princess?

details.title: MOONHIDE
details.short_description: MOONHIDE is a dark fantasy card roguelite where every choice shapes your run. Fight turn-based battles, build powerful ring combinations, balance Blood and Humanity, and adapt to shifting moon rules as you push deeper into the night.

details.title: Autork
details.short_description: Aut’ork is a strategic auto-battler where you build an army from the ground up. Shape your composition, experiment with powerful combos, and lead your race to victory in PvE or PvP battles.

details.title: Chronicles of the Six Sages
details.short_description: This game is a Turn Based JRPG with real time mechanics in order to overcome the enemies attacks. The game features a fully unique gear system, allowing for the player to fully customize their party to their choosing

details.title: Banners & Frontlines
details.short_description: Hold the line in a single-player, turn-based card strategy game. Combine infantry, archers and cavalry, commit reserves and pull battered troops back to reform. Fight historical campaigns or keep a mercenary company alive through contracts, recruits and captured banners.

details.title: Gas Station Simulator
details.short_description: A gas station and convenience store tycoon. Stock shelves, pump fuel, and ring up sales. Grow from a humble roadside stall by pricing stock and unlocking licenses to upgrade your shop. Set out every product by hand, tidy up what customers leave behind, and grow a thriving business.

details.title: Pro Yakyu Front Office
details.short_description: Take charge of a fictional Japanese pro baseball club as general manager. Draft players on your scouts' judgment, set the lineup and the rotation, earn from sponsors and the ballpark, manage the payroll, and answer to the owner. The games play themselves; the decisions are yours.

details.title: LOVE alt delete
details.short_description: DATE. DESIGN. DESTROY. A psychological chat simulator between you and two digital personalities who desperately want to be people. Type keywords to control them, uncover their secrets, and choose their fates.

details.title: Wall of Symbols
details.short_description: A roguelite siege defense played on an alchemist's table. Spin, place, and let symbols ripen into forms your deck never held. Every neighbour feeds the next, and one transmute turns the whole board into damage.

details.title: Buns and Poops
details.short_description: A poop-collecting sim that turns your entire desktop into a bunny playground. Over 80 pixel-art bunnies hop across your screen as you work, settle into loaves, flop over, and leave poops behind. Trade the poops you collect for furniture and treats to make life with the bunnies even cozier.

details.title: Wadar and and: another dimension
details.short_description: Wadar and and is a 2d platformer where nothing is guaranteed

details.title: Mayonaka no Yaiba
details.short_description: After falling from the fourth floor of his school and losing nearly a year of memories, high school student Chenxing is caught between two conflicting romantic pasts. When a girl in white and the blade of light known as the Night Blade appear at 3 a.m., he must choose whose truth to face.

details.title: Boreal Steel
details.short_description: A physics-driven WWII tank game set in a fog-bound northern forest. Push pines over with your hull, and fight where every plate, module and track can be hit, and every HE shell can set the woods alight.

details.title: French Tax Simulator
details.short_description: Take on the role of a tax inspector and track down tax evaders! Your mission: to reduce the public deficit. Cross-check the supporting documents, uncover inconsistencies and decide who to audit. Your career in the civil service depends on it....

details.title: Between Us
details.short_description: You were just supposed to bring medicine home to your wife. Now you're trapped in a seemingly endless cornfield. In this first-person psychological horror, your only companion is your own voice in your head. Talk to your alter ego, step through portals into your dark past, and try to find a way out.

details.title: A Weird Village
details.short_description: Welcome to A Weird Village, a chaotic multiplayer game where little animals fight over territory, unlock ridiculous powers, destroy pretty much everything in sight, and eventually tear the enemy village to pieces. Pick your favorite little creature, grab a weapon, and join the mayhem.

details.title: Gleam Tavern
details.short_description: Hunt by day. Run a tavern by night. Venture into the wilds for unusual ingredients, turn your haul into hearty meals, and build a welcoming tavern in this fantasy action-and-management adventure. Grow crops, brew drinks, and get to know the people who keep coming back.

details.title: Battle to Go
details.short_description: A short incremental auto-battler where you build and command a growing army of tiny pixel soldiers. Unlock new troops, research powerful upgrades, and push through increasingly dangerous goblin armies in automatic battles.

details.title: MALATANG MASTER - Street Food Simulator
details.short_description: Run a neighborhood malatang shop where guests build their own bowls. Weigh their picks, simmer beef and mushrooms, then add the greens. Spend the day's takings on a better kitchen or one more table. Cook solo or share the shift in LAN co-op for up to 4.

details.title: Under One Roof
details.short_description: Under One Roof is a pixel-art apartment management sim. Furnish rooms, welcome tenants, collect rent, and help them grow. Watch them build careers, make friends, fall in love, and start families as you create your dream apartment, grow a lively community, and follow stories across generations.

name: The Hearts of War Avert 2: Furies Vengeance

details.title: The Hearts of War Avert 2: Furies Vengeance
details.short_description: Command your armies and conquer her heart! A new student joins a gaming club where friendships, rivalries, and possible romance unfold between actual real-time strategy matches. Get to know Lillian, Rina and Yara in a story-driven visual novel where the game at the table is only part of the story.

details.title: Scrub, Little Sub!
details.short_description: Scrub, Little Sub! Boost, bounce, and barrel roll your way through diverse aquatic biomes and flooded industrial structures as you clean up the ocean in this 90's-inspired collectathon adventure!

details.title: Uprooted: Meal Replacement Game
details.short_description: Don’t play with your food, fight with it! Build up your farm with different equipment, tools, and abilities, then grow powerful crops to throw at your opponents. Stop an evil tech start-up from destroying your farm in this turn-based battling twist on the classic farming game formula.

details.title: Snap out.
details.short_description: A doomscrolling adventure. Scroll a feed that never ends, answer the five people who keep asking, and take the X in the corner before it erodes away. However long you stay decides how dark the platformer you escape into gets.

details.title: Rescue the Celestia
details.short_description: Command a deep space rescue operation in this space management game, where you manage a fleet of ships, build bases, coordinate resources distribution, and explore uncharted planets to find and save the scattered crew of the ISS Celestia.

details.title: Prosecutor Absolution
details.short_description: You have been appointed Deputy Chief Prosecutor of Davelia. Your goal is to pay off your mortgage. Your tool is other people's prison sentences. Your conscience is your problem. The State of Davelia will not forget about you.

details.title: The Feather King
details.short_description: A match-3 RPG comedy roguelike. Combine runes to trigger spells, arrange them strategically, then blast down your opponents with a barrage of arcane fury. Discover a cast of colorful characters as you navigate through the Feather King's realm in this farcical, story driven adventure.

details.title: Nodus Attrition
details.short_description: Expand your base to reach the enemy threat. This is tower offense

details.title: The Final Showdown with AI!
details.short_description: A forum-battle game with bullet-hell combat. Su Shihe loves settling online disputes—until he finds himself against everyone. Caught between progress and salvation, what will he choose?

name: Catch A Pack: Incremental Card Game

details.title: Catch A Pack: Incremental Card Game
details.short_description: Open large packs of cards in this 90s nostalgia-steeped incremental game. Build your dream board with super duper rare cards, click frenetically and chain massive combos. Can you catch them all?

details.title: Mercenaries Grace
details.short_description: Mercenaries Grace is a tactical simulation RPG set in a fantasy world. Battles occur on quarter-view maps with height differences, where character positioning in the front, back, and side of enemy units may very well determine each battle’s outcome.

details.title: Gooboventure
details.short_description: A hand-pixeled platformer about a blob of goo. Ledges carry you up, ceilings don't drop you, narrow cracks are doors. Goo is both your health and your ammunition, and it comes from fighting. Find your scattered neighbours before winter.

details.title: Voluntary Consent
details.short_description: Your job is something between an autopsy and a survey. In this detective visual novel, you are an interrogation inspector who extracts information from still-living brains. Every day you analyze documents, gather evidence, and make a tough choice: to follow conscience, duty, or voices in own head.

details.title: Cargo Thieves
details.short_description: In this co-op multiplayer game, you run an ordinary supermarket, but instead of honestly ordering products for sale, you steal them from the docks while disguised as dockworkers. Use crowbars, lockpicks and trucks. Expand your store, outsmart the cops, steal & sell anything from food to supercars.

details.title: Voxel Dynasties
details.short_description: Lead a civilization from the first stone tool to the atomic bomb in one match. A voxel RTS where every block can break, fortresses fall block by block, and you can jump into any unit in third person mid-battle. Free demo with multiplayer out now. Solo-developed.

details.title: STAREDOWN
details.short_description: A stealth roguelite where a giant eye learns how you play. Gather essence to open the hatch, evade its watchtowers and scouts, and descend to the next floor. Change your habits as OKO changes the hunt. Every run, a new eye.

details.title: Triple Dice Monsters
details.short_description: Dice × Monster Raising × Party Building! Raise monsters through a board game-style adventure, then make them even stronger with the Inheritance System. A turn-based RPG where dice and strategy decide every battle. Challenge unique bosses!

details.title: Candleborne
details.short_description: Climb a tower consumed by darkness in this top-down action roguelite. Grow your flame, choose upgrades with dangerous tradeoffs, stay within the candlelight, and defeat each floor’s guardian to continue your ascent.

details.title: DiceBound
details.short_description: DiceBound is a dark fantasy dice-building roguelike where you roll dice, bind soul, and forge your run to create powerful combinations, overcome enemy-imposed rules, and survive a branching path of Trials.

details.title: Winner Takes Tea
details.short_description: Summon familiars with cards, seize lands, and repaint the board. Witches duel for the victor's cup of tea in a board game × card battler. All 180+ cards unlocked from the start. Build decks and play online with 2–4 players or against BOTs. No microtransactions, ever.

details.title: ADA
details.short_description: ADA is a platformer game in which you navigate through the dream of a young child. Explore mysterious environments, meet strange characters, and uncover the secrets hidden within ADA's colorful and unpredictable universe.

name: 烟雨山异闻 - The Mystery of Misty Mount

details.title: 烟雨山异闻 - The Mystery of Misty Mount
details.short_description: The Mystery of Misty Mount is a 2D mystery puzzle-adventure game. In order to save his father who has turned into a parrot, players take on the role of Wang Di and go into Misty Mount to uncover the truth of an accident that occurred fifteen years ago.

details.title: Ringwyrm
details.short_description: Ringwyrm is an immersive action horror game with survival elements. Explore a nonlinear interconnected world, meet a large cast of memorable characters, slay a huge cast of sickly monstrosities and avoid myriad diseases and ailments.

details.title: The Old Forge
details.short_description: Explore a open world inspired by 1990s Poland. Scavenge, build, craft and dig your way through forests, villages and industrial ruins surviving the zombies, harsh weather and the constant fight for food, warmth and safety.

details.title: Claim the Gods
details.short_description: Would you dare to defy the gods? Claim their power? Then battle in this roguelike deckbuilder where you can win new cards, power up and Claim the Gods! But be warned mortal, if you fail, there will be consequences!

details.title: Hollow Ones
details.short_description: Hide away from the end of the world in Hollow Ones, a mid-apocalypse narrative horror game.

details.title: Songkran Hazard: 4Lom
details.short_description: Lock, load, and stay dry! Step into the soaked slippers of Rookie Cop “Lee” in this high-octane survival “horror?”. Armed with water guns and wet powder, escort Anchan through Bangkok's chaotic Silom Road during the wildest Songkran outbreak ever. Can you survive the Songkran hazard?

details.title: Water's Bounty
details.short_description: Set across a vast global map, Water's Bounty thrusts you into a sea full of nonstop dangers. You'll navigate a world dominated by the ruthless Ronek Trading Company; a commercial empire branding all independent merchants as pirates to protect their monopoly.
publishers: Not Allowed to Die Gaming Studios

details.title: Padlova Street
details.short_description: Guide Kapo through an acid-soaked apocalypse of deadly traps, crawling foes and flying enemies. Padlova Street is a hardcore 2D platformer: time your jumps, risk it for stars and beat your best time. Learn the route with checkpoints in Light or climb the leaderboard in Hardcore.

details.title: MAGEKIN
details.short_description: Battle rival mages, collect spells, and build ridiculous combos in a third-person multiplayer arena. Grow stronger as you fight players and waves of monsters, grab powerful loot, and finish with the highest score to win.

details.title: House of 21
details.short_description: Fight cursed enemies in a blackjack roguelike deckbuilder set inside a phantom casino purgatory. Push your luck, upgrade your cards with unique badges, collect relics, and uncover strange events as you battle your way out of the House. If the House lets you…

details.title: Underground Sweeper
details.short_description: A side-scrolling exploration game with light looting and incremental progression. Explore underground ruins, defeat monsters, collect and sell loot, upgrade your gear and abilities, venture deeper, and pay off your debt.

details.title: Two Happy Geese
details.short_description: Two Happy Geese is a pixel-art 2D platformer about a white goose on a mission to rescue his kidnapped brother. Make your way through varied levels, battle enemies and bosses, and use every weapon you find along the way.

details.title: KANKERI: Can Kick Clash
details.short_description: Kick the can to start. Spotted? Race the Oni (the seeker) to the can and kick it first. That's kick-the-can, but this time it's a fight. Kick the can, level up for weapons and gadgets, take down rivals, and kick it again. Online asymmetric multiplayer: 2 Oni vs. 6 hiders, 5-minute rounds.

details.title: Yellow Noise
details.short_description: Dungeon Crawler Survival Horror where exploration is your greatest weapon. Explore a warping city, where reality is slowly unraveling. Survive terrifying creatures, manage your physical and mental condition, and find a way out of the maddening cosmic truth about the world around you.

details.title: ACCURSED
details.short_description: Bear your vows in ACCURSED, a 2D narrative-driven soulslike, hand-drawn in worn fantasy and shades of burning autumn. Bequeathed upon a fading world as a herald of Death, may you find your peace within what remains.

details.title: Crytter Crawlers
details.short_description: Crytter Crawlers is a 2.5d Creature-Collecting Bullet-Heaven Deckbuilding Roguelike where YOU play as Cryptids! Find dozens of Crytters! GROW your Crytters into several stronger forms, earn new weapons, discover new upgrades, and fight back against a multitude of post-apocalyptic threats!

details.title: Open Daily in NYC
details.short_description: Gloria is off to mind her grandkids, so the old shop is yours. How you make each coffee and run the kitchen decides who walks in, as strangers become regulars whose New York lives you uncover. Neighborhood shop, city hotspot, or a chain? Or skip work and buy what real life never let you afford!

details.title: Ragequit Royale
details.short_description: Dice luck meets ruthless card sabotage! Choose your fantasy miniature, steal played cards and send your rivals backwards. In Ragequit Royale, reaching the finish takes more than a lucky roll.

details.title: The Trial of Kharzoid
details.short_description: The Trial of Kharzoid is an arkanoidvania, that is, a brick-breaker set in a gothic world. Explore ancient ruins, fight huge bosses and eat chicken you find in walls!

details.title: Deadly Bloodline
details.short_description: Survive the horrors of Angel Hill as James K. Sam and his family. As they struggle to escape the city, they must face murderous demons and fight for their lives! In this pixel art survival horror adventure, will you help James and his family make it out of Angel Hill alive?

details.title: hooooook
details.short_description: Gold Miner + Roguelike — Classic hook-and-grab gameplay fused with roguelike building. Hooks with unique abilities ; hundreds of relics can be freely combined to forge your own playstyle. Venture deep into the earth — mines, swamps, tombs… each new zone hides its own mechanics and threats.

details.title: Portals and Ducks
details.short_description: Surf a ramp. Shoot a portal. Keep every bit of your speed. A first-person game where the surfing is forgiving and the depth is in your portals - put a boost on one, a jump on the other, and use both in the same run. Levels are short. Restarts are instant.

details.title: How to Chemistry
details.short_description: How to Chemistry is a first-person co-op chemistry simulator, where you run your own lab with no safety regulations. Get an order, use your chemistry skills and deliver.

details.title: Autobrawl Arena
details.short_description: BUILD A TEAM of autonomous nanobots from countless parts. COMBINE DNA to arm them with hybrid bioweapons. WATCH THEM FIGHT FOR YOU against rival teams in an ever-changing microscopic arena. Sign sponsors, defend towers, place bets, and win the grand tournament!

details.title: Factory Tour →
details.short_description: Factory Tour → is a 3D horror game where you explore a mysterious robot factory.

details.title: Five Star Crew
details.short_description: Run a tour boat with up to three friends through waters full of deadly sea life. Steer, cook, patch leaks and protect your guests on the way to the next dock. They paid for five-star service. Try to keep them alive long enough to leave a review.

details.title: SPP: Stream Party Pack
details.short_description: Up for a friendly challenge with your TikTok LIVE viewers? Pick one of three games. Deliver parcels, paint a canvas, or knock cubes into a pit. You set the effects for likes, follows, and gifts. Your viewers decide when to lend a hand and when to get in your way.

details.title: Tallymark
details.short_description: A third-person survival roguelite in an endless, overgrown city. One life: sneak, scavenge, craft on the move and fight with scarce bullets and brutal melee. Get inside before dark, hold out when the swarm comes every seventh night, and scratch one more mark on the wall.

details.title: NEXT CHALLENGER!
details.short_description: Start with a pair of fists and zero ratings. End as a screen-melting monster. NEXT CHALLENGER! is a fast first-person bullet heaven roguelite on a galactic TV game show: blast hordes of holograms, stack absurd upgrades, evolve your weapon and win the crowd.

details.title: The White Light
details.short_description: The White Light broke, and its shards fell into six cursed worlds. Go down after them in a dark co-op roguelike for 1-4 hunters: carve through hordes, fight bosses that strike on the beat and build your hunter from 300 cards. Stay together. Alone, the dark will eat you.

details.title: Nobody Survives
details.short_description: A psx/ps1-style horror game telling the story about Bane, a former construction worker whose brother has gone missing. As a sequel of the game "Error 2351", search through old case files, talk to the residents, face the so-called "test subjects" and uncover the truth about scientist Jake Kron.

details.title: Shield Operator 2
details.short_description: You are an air defense operator. Night falls, sirens wail, and radar detects drones, missiles, and bombers. Every miss costs a home or a power grid. Hold the line, save your missiles, then strike back: launch your jets and crush enemy positions. The city remembers every strike.

details.title: Frog Forage
details.short_description: Become a frog forager in a cozy incremental farming game. Explore four biomes, hire helpers, brew jam and power up your upgrade tree to make every run better than the last!

details.title: Making Ends Meet
details.short_description: Sandra is 40, her son speaks in memes, her dad sees flash mobs everywhere and she has $31.40 to make it to payday. A playable story in ASCII, with turn-based battles, where your health is your money, avocado toast is the enemy and your choices matter.* (*They do not.)

details.title: Hidden Archipelago 2 New Winds
details.short_description: Return to the peaceful islands in Hidden Archipelago 2, a charming hidden object adventure featuring relaxing puzzles, beautiful coastal scenery, and delightful mini-games.

details.title: No Zombies in New York
details.short_description: No Zombies in New York is a mystery comic adventure game: read manga-style chapters and answer multiple-choice quizzes to solve the mystery. In present-day New York, you wake in a hospital with no memory and read a tablet comic, The Food Eaters, to learn who you are.

details.title: Codex Suite Master
details.short_description: Codex Suite Master is the definitive workspace for preparing your RPG campaigns and settings. Manage NPCs, maps, encounters, quests, and more to play with your friends.

details.title: Bitnook
details.short_description: A cozy idle game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Tiny Bit Friends guard your desktop from mischievous bugs while you work: they fight, build and grow on their own, and parade out to tell you what they did when you come back.

details.title: Junction Zero
details.short_description: Junction Zero is a cyberpunk action roguelite where automatic weapon cycles meet manual twin-stick aiming as you choose a character, shape a tactical build with weapons and cyberware, and fight through escalating enemy hordes in the locked-down city of Palisade.

details.title: FLICK: Knockout
details.short_description: Every flick counts in FLICK: Knockout, a physics-driven competitive arena game. Aim your shot, knock rivals out, and turn precise hits into big plays. Build your puck lineup, master the angles, and switch things up in BOB mode. Small move. Big consequences.

details.title: Runic Cairn
details.short_description: A tower defense game where you build cairns to protect your mana orb against the shadows. Socket your runes of choice in the cairns and they can either be a full on damage dealer or a means to suppress the shadows.

details.title: Entangled
details.short_description: > A Survival Horror-Adventure RPG about coming to terms with futility. Run, hide, die, and repeat in order to keep your avatars alive. Please take care of them.

details.title: Torvane
details.short_description: Torvane is a skill-based online melee team game for PC. Take a role as tank, DPS or healer, read your opponent and win the duel with timing and spacing. Server-authoritative netcode, no pay-to-win. Your first fighter is the Khaedr, a warrior from an original sci-fi honor culture.

details.title: 忒修斯之女
details.short_description: You saved your daughter Xiaohe with an illegal operation. Now another girl's memories surface in her words and expressions. In this full-motion video adventure, trace the other side of the surgery and face a choice: bring back the girl you remember, or hold on to the one she is now?

details.title: CarCity
details.short_description: Run your own neighborhood car garage. Fix customers' cars, buy and customize your dream rides at the dealership, and race them down the drag strip. Grow from a single lift to the best shop in town, one job at a time.

details.title: 东方河城天下 ~Kawashiro Indie~
details.short_description: A chat with Hina Kagiyama gives Nitori Kawashiro an idea: turn everyday life across Gensokyo into her own Kawashiro Indie. Follow her from Youkai Mountain onward, reading prompts and tackling one fast-paced microgame after another.

details.title: BONK! The Mole Show
details.short_description: Whack-a-Mole, but one BONK can set off the whole machine. Move the hammer, pick the column and watch Tesla moles zap, bombs blast and golden chains roar. Build a wild combo engine in a pixel-art fairground roguelite.

details.title: ScrapHeads
details.short_description: Smash it all and get paid! ScrapHeads is a chaotic co-op game for up to 4 players. Scrap spaceships, mechs, and anything else that lands in your yard with ridiculous tools, explosive mayhem, and wild physics. Feed Panzarius and turn every shift into a disaster!

details.title: Barrowhold
details.short_description: A co-op roguelite for 1–4 players that blends dungeon crawling and tower defense. Descend into the dungeon, grow stronger fighting monsters and bosses, and turn your loot into a fortress that can hold back the goblin horde. Can you last 100 days, until the Archmagus comes for you?

details.title: Limbs for Lives
details.short_description: Co-op survival after a plane crash. Every survivor is missing something: legs, arms, sight. Nobody makes it alone, so build, hunt and call for rescue together

details.title: Em the Emissary
details.short_description: Join Em the Emissary in an adventure to restore the hearts of his friends, in a cute 3D platformer! After Dis the Disciple was given the Scales of Ma'at, the jackal began weighing everyone's hearts without any counterbalance, forcing beings into a state of unrest and in need of saving.

details.title: Beaver Kart
details.short_description: Race to save the zoo! Eight animal racers, eight homemade rides and an adventure beyond the finish line. Explore colorful hubs, stack power-ups and tackle Grand Prix and boss showdowns. Drift, boost and battle solo or race friends in 2–4 player local split-screen.

details.title: Sunflower Dance
details.short_description: Atlatonan is a 19 year old who starts her journey to Granda Oaso, the biggest commune in Gardesta, as part of the Cultural Exchange Program. Learn new things, make new friends, and find love~ This is a Solarpunk slice of life about learning stuff and enjoying whatever that makes you happy.

details.title: Pay to Think
details.short_description: An incremental game centered on intelligence as its core asset. Once, humanity became the master of the Earth by virtue of its intelligence; now, intelligence has found a new master. Intelligence no longer belongs to the smartest humans—it belongs to whoever possesses it.

details.title: Shameless Supreme
details.short_description: Shameless Supreme is a story-rich pixel RPG with turn-based combat and dark humor. Explore crumbling worlds, build your party, and combine status effects for deadly reactions. Use optional mic-powered trash talk to weaken enemies and break their defenses. Survive, and find your way home.

details.title: The Last Dry House
details.short_description: October 1999. The dam has failed, and yours is the last dry house on the hill. Each night strangers climb out of the floodwater and knock. Type any question you like through the door. Some are survivors. Some drowned days ago, and they don't know it yet.

details.title: New Hope
details.short_description: Post-apocalyptic colony survival where you give the orders and then hold the wall yourself. Build a fortified base, send squads on risky expeditions for supplies, and fight beside your settlers in third person when zombies and mutants come for the gates.

details.title: Dream Dwelling
details.short_description: Your aunt is gone, leaving you a cottage and a big debt. Little by little, paint it pink, add a desk by the window and pair furniture into Combos for maximum Charm. Then sell it as someone's dream home. Build houses, open shops and unwind in Dream Dwelling!

details.title: The Last Lesson
details.short_description: A first-person horror puzzle game where technical problems have physical consequences. Solve challenge rooms, navigate procedural corridors, and survive the Teacher hunting you through the school.

details.title: The Push West
details.short_description: Isometric stealth action in a forest village seized by modern soldiers. Sneak through moonlit camps, hide in tall grass, whistle guards away, then burn their ammo and cripple their trucks before dawn. Every raid is a freshly generated map. One hunter, a bow, a knife.

details.title: Mushroom Sweeper
details.short_description: First-person mushroom hunting in CryEngine. Sweep a procedurally generated forest, clear the forest floor, track mushrooms with the Sporevision and uncover whole mushroom patches in a Minesweeper-style minigame. Save your grandpa by recovering his mushroom inventions in exchange for prized specimens

details.title: RamiRami
details.short_description: A roguelite deck-building game where you fight with Rami. Be careful to choose wisely the cards you decide to add into your deck after each game ! Discover a strange path through a dreamlike world, collect cards and face bosses with twisted rules, alone or with a friend !

details.title: Wanderhearth
details.short_description: A cozy first-person camping and photography game. Load the car, drive through a portal, pitch your tent in another world, light a campfire and take film photos you develop and sell. One quiet night at a time.

details.title: Mirror
details.short_description: Mirror is a two player co-op puzzle platformer set in a split screen world where one's actions are reflected in the other's. As two lost souls, you complete each other. Find a friend and experience this meditative puzzle by ensuring both of you have always a path forward.

details.title: Looks Fine on Paper
details.short_description: Looks Fine on Paper is a spatial logic puzzle game. Deduce each room's shape and position from area requirements and clues. Resolve interconnected constraints involving rooms, doors, windows, and furniture. Every decision can affect the entire layout. Can you satisfy every condition at once?

details.title: Aesirbard
details.short_description: Aesirbard is a fantasy Norse-inspired Metroidvania of hard steel and old magic. Sent back from the gates of Hel, fight the corrupted and the restless dead, and rewire the hidden power that underpins the world to free a village trapped by its own ward.

details.title: Shockline
details.short_description: Play as a super-speed dog in a city facing disaster. Race through streets, rescue civilians, and disarm bombs before time runs out. Slow the action to make tight turns, dodge danger, and push for a better score across three modes and three districts.

details.title: Typers Combat 2: Type Harder
details.short_description: Every correct key is a punch. Out-type your rival to land the hits, then end the match with a brutal cinematic execution, X-ray bone breaks included. A 3D typing fighter with a first-person story mode, 10 bonus stages and a fighter you build yourself.

details.title: KINETIC SINGULARITY
details.short_description: Harness the raw power of a collapsing reactor core in this minimalist physics rogue-lite. Launch kinetic sondes into a dynamic matrix, trigger high-energy chain reactions, and balance the fatal risk of the Overcharge mode. Every shot counts. Can you survive the singularity?

details.title: Singing Attorney: Verdict by Midnight
details.short_description: Expose the contradictions. Deduce the lyrics to the truth. Find the holes in the testimony. Tear it apart with evidence. Amnesiac rookie lawyer Kanade must defend a star streamer accused of murder. Why was the dead man clutching an old handheld? A courtroom mystery where deductions become lyrics.

details.title: The Dig Show
details.short_description: The Dig Show is a cozy digging game about finding treasures on a fake TV stage. Use a metal detector, wash the dirt off your finds and show them on air. Viewers pay to watch. Upgrade your gear and dig a little deeper every day.

details.title: DWARKA
details.short_description: Dive beneath the waves in DWARKA, a first-person underwater exploration adventure in development. Prepare your gear, sail aboard SAMUDRA, manage oxygen, and investigate ocean mysteries. The full game is planned for solo play and online co-op for up to four players.

details.title: Carrot Kingdom!
details.short_description: A rabbit and carrot puzzle-platformer! Stretch your ears to grab the carrots!

details.title: Burnline Madness
details.short_description: Race, brawl and boost through traffic in Burnline Madness, a single-player motorcycle combat racer. Punch and kick rival riders, switch between unlockable weapons, chain takedowns and spend your earnings on bike upgrades across five distinct routes.

details.title: Rúnafall
details.short_description: A retro-styled co-op action roguelike in Viking-age Norway. Raid as one of five black-metal Vikings, carve through draugr, trolls and corpse-ravens, and topple the monsters who rule three cursed regions, to an original industrial metal score by Norway's Melt Motif. Solo or with up to three friends.

details.title: Flak Happy
details.short_description: Crew one B-17 with up to four mates. Fly it, bomb it, shoot it, and fix it while everything's on fire. A co-op WW2 bomber roguelite where you walk the fuselage, man the guns, and try to get everyone home alive.

name: 敲敲小镇：桌面锻造物语

details.title: 敲敲小镇：桌面锻造物语
details.short_description: Type to mine, smelt, and forge gear with random affixes. Welcome residents, battle monsters and village trials. Stronger residents mean faster automated production. Start with one blacksmith shop and grow your town!

details.title: Sports Founder
details.short_description: Sports Founder is a turn-based strategy game where you invent a sport and grow it from a backyard game into a global obsession. Write the rules, spread it around the world, run the flagship league and outmaneuver the established sports, who won't give up their fans without a fight.

details.title: Tea & Fae
details.short_description: In late-19th-century London, Rorenna runs the shabby little tea shop her parents left behind. Grow tea, serve your guests, and brew a cup worthy of the fairy kings to earn their approval and revive The Romance Tea Room. Based on the author's original novels, with multiple romance endings.

details.title: Fernweh
details.short_description: Plan and design expansive campsites, manage resources, accommodate travelers and enjoy organic growth toward the ultimate camping experience you’ve always dreamed of.

details.title: The Hollow Crown
details.short_description: A dark, emotionally intense, and occasionally peaceful story-rich RPG where every victory can change who you become. Absorb powerful enemies, build a broken but fiercely loyal party, and choose when power is worth the cost. Become The Devourer and decide what kind of monster, or man, you become.

details.title: Primetime Overkill
details.short_description: A top-down action roguelite on a death-game TV network. Four drones shoot for you, you handle the katana, and it never stops raining in the back streets where VOXZERO films its contestants. The chat votes to send in the hounds, and the black hole in your contract is billed by the second.

details.title: Trick or Mistreat?
details.short_description: On Halloween, monsters also dress up as humans, but they don’t have such a pleasant temperament. Trick or Mistreat? That is the law of the monsters.

details.title: SHOCKWAVE
details.short_description: An anti-gravity racer drawn in pure light. Seven wireframe tracks, eight ships and real racing physics — the desktop edition of a racing game built for the 1982 Vectrex, the console that drew with an electron beam.

details.title: Higanbana
details.short_description: A co-op souls-like, where a young Samurai and cursed Doll work together to traverse an abandoned land swarmed with Yokai. Together with a spear and magic, they must defeat the challenging foes and unforgiving bosses to restore the Dolls original body and save the Samurai’s village.

details.title: Saikei: A Zen Water Garden
details.short_description: A tiny voxel world in a glass jar that sits in the corner of your desktop, on top of your windows, while you work. It carries on without you: water flows, koi and crabs go about their day, and night falls when it does outside. Reach in to dig, pour and build whenever you like.

details.title: Ore Heads
details.short_description: Head Office is hiring! Dig through seven huge mines in co-op for up to 8 players, fight your way through sealed dungeons, build a home on your own plot and climb the company ladder from Intern Digger to Chairman of the Boulder in this cozy voxel mining game.

details.title: BAJAMAR
details.short_description: BAJAMAR is a first-person point-and-click mystery adventure on an abandoned lighthouse island. Explore, examine everything, combine what you find and solve logical puzzles to follow the trail your brother left for you alone. No combat. No hand-holding.

details.title: Valley of the Omen
details.short_description: A folk horror action platformer in which you play a boomerang-wielding warrior on a quest for revenge. As Aoife, an orphan raised to hunt monsters, you will face the demonic hordes of the sorceress Morrakhad across abandoned villages, cursed cathedrals, and flooded graveyards.

details.title: ENGINEBOUND
details.short_description: ENGINEBOUND is a first-person survival game about a train that is bound to your soul. Keep its fire burning, drive an endless procedurally generated line, craft your way up the engine bond, and hold off the monsters that hunt in the dark.

details.title: Her Little Witch
details.short_description: A cozy yuri visual novel with dual perspectives, choices, and multiple endings! An otherworldly witch ends up living with a socially anxious manga artist. Through misunderstandings, unspoken feelings, and ordinary days, two very different girls slowly become part of each other's lives.

details.title: Something Under
details.short_description: Dig, dodge falling rocks and collect gems in an underground action-puzzle game. Play solo at your own pace, or share the cave in split-screen and local co-op over WLAN. Read the terrain, plan your route and bring everyone back as the caves get stranger below.

details.title: Grunt
details.short_description: Medieval Grunt Simulator. Wage battles of thousands as a king and then survive them as a common footsolider.

details.title: Touhou Kourindou: Appraisal Records
details.short_description: Run Kourindou, Gensokyo's odd little curio shop. Dig up strange things from the Outside World, work out what they do, and sell them to Marisa, Reimu and the girls of Gensokyo, all while a scarlet mist creeps over the sky. A cozy Touhou Project fan game of appraisal puzzles and haggling.

details.title: Satellite Odyssey Horizons
details.short_description: Voxel survival in the Satellite Odyssey universe. Explore whole planets from 400 thousand to 40 million blocks: gather, craft and build, hunt, and beware of bandit camps and infected settlements. Free on official servers. The Full Version adds your own offline world and your own server.

details.title: Abyss at Hand
details.short_description: Form an adventuring party on your own or with friends, and set out to defeat this world’s Demon Lord! Abyss at Hand is a multiplayer action-adventure game for 1–4 players. Experience thrilling, adrenaline-pumping battles in a vast fantasy world!

details.title: Cripta
details.short_description: A co-op roguelike for up to five heroes. Descend a crypt that changes every run, pick gifts, curses and relics, level your skills at the anvil and face the Kings of six worlds, alone or with friends, all the way down to the Hollow Seraph.

details.title: Whispers of the Veil
details.short_description: Whispers of the Veil is a first-person stealth game. Blend into the shadows and use your wits and tools to navigate the city's dangerous streets. Uncover a secret plot that threatens to cause the city's downfall as you explore a world in upheaval, caught between tradition and emerging technology.

details.title: Seed & Deed
details.short_description: You rented a farm without reading the contract. Cut the weeds, plant, sell, automate and survive a landlord who keeps adding clauses. A cozy pixel-art incremental with a real ending: buy the deed before the fine print buys you.

details.title: Splash Bash: Hot Springs Party
details.short_description: A two-player party game! Team up or go head-to-head, and get this hot spring town buzzing again!

name: ロロりんご♪－オオカミさんと、おとぎのパズル－

details.title: ロロりんご♪－オオカミさんと、おとぎのパズル－
details.short_description: Make music with apples in a world of fairy tales. Connect different kinds of apples with a single stroke to create chains and complete challenges. Play puzzles like little pieces of sheet music, and wander through familiar stories. But something is strange… the characters are turning into wolves…?

details.title: Alchemist
details.short_description: Alchemist is a re-playable narrative game which puts you in the shoes of an Alchemist in a medieval fantasy world. Craft potions, earn Tarot Cards, and seek knowledge, taking what you learn into the next playthrough to unlock hidden secrets.

details.title: Islands Collide
details.short_description: Islands Collide is a bullet-heaven roguelite about ramming islands. Crash into other islands to weld them on for good, clear whoever lives there, and grow bigger with every crash, until the sea raises a living continent to swallow you.

details.title: Order Of The Jarl
details.short_description: Answer the Jarl's summons and wield magic and blades in shifting dungeons to rescue the Right Hand from the Archdruid. In this first-person dungeon crawler, delve into '90s-inspired combat, loot items, face strange creatures, and unforeseen danger in a roguelike world where death = starting over.

details.title: NPC Survey Team
details.short_description: NPC Survey Team is an information-verification simulation game. Cross-check employee credentials, uncover suspicious anomalies, and conduct in-depth investigations on non-compliant female employees.
developers: おいなりソフト(肩引こ）

details.title: CENTAVO
details.short_description: A city sim where money never comes from nowhere. Tens of thousands of residents, each with a name, a job and a pocket. You lay the streets, zone and set taxes; they buy the lots, open businesses and leave if work or food runs out. Grow a camp into a metropolis.

details.title: 無慈悲な笑顔Re
details.short_description: A remake of an exploration-based adventure game about gods and girls. Return once more to their story—and uncover the truths that were never told.

details.title: PEAK MALE FANTASY
details.short_description: Horde-survival action RPG with 1-4 player online co-op. Thousands of monsters on screen, heavy gore, massive bosses. Collect loot, socket gems, upgrade your gear and skills. All progression is persistent: every run makes you stronger. How long can you survive?

details.title: Your Complaint Has Been Received
details.short_description: A story-driven adventure about municipal maintenance. The pipes leak, the van's broken down, and you're the new boss. Explore courtyards and offices, deal with residents and coworkers, and choose how to solve their problems.

details.title: Hungry Dancing Wizards
details.short_description: Eat, dance, repeat! Get lost in a musical adventure where quick reactions meet rhythmic flow. Challenge your friends to ridiculous dance battles, chase high scores, and see who truly is the hungriest wizard!

details.title: Cursor Quest
details.short_description: Cursor Quest is an action RPG where your mouse cursor is the character. Swing weapons with your movement, dodge attacks, gather resources, train skills, craft gear, explore dungeons, and grow your cursor into a fantasy hero.

details.title: Veilreach
details.short_description: Descend into The Lost Temples of Veilreach, a roguelike deckbuilder where OSR dungeon crawling meets tactical poker-hand synergies. Master unique abilities and talents, and build a powerful deck to survive dungeons where every choice has a brutal consequence.

details.title: Starmadillo
details.short_description: You've crashed onto a planet populated with mechanical beasts! Luckily, you're equipped with a Mobile Defense Unit (MDU) to defend yourself from danger. But its abilities are limited, so you'll need to explore and puzzle your way through this alien landscape to get upgrades and uncover its mystery.

details.title: ABYSS CHRONICLES
details.short_description: Six bloodlines sealed in stone. An abyss that remembers. Wake your race, carve through living hordes and drowned giants, and chase build-defining loot down to 11,000 meters in a dark side-scrolling hack-and-slash ARPG.

details.title: Cozy Restoration Workshop
details.short_description: Give forgotten treasures a second life in a cozy restoration workshop. Take them apart, scrub away grime, remove rust, polish and rebuild them by hand. Restore 18 distinct objects, try them out, and display your work in a personal collection.

details.title: Cosmicon Plague
details.short_description: Fight against the evil bio-organic space armada known as the "Union" in this retro inspired , action packed horizontal shmup.

details.title: Take Care!!!
details.short_description: A chaotic co-op pharmacy sim for 1–4 players. Serve patients, fill prescriptions, hit your quotas—and pray nobody loses it. Turn mounting stress into a resource and somehow make it to closing time!

details.title: CABA Zero
details.short_description: Survive a devastated Buenos Aires in this third-person survival horror inspired by the PSX era. Explore subway stations, tunnels and city streets, manage scarce supplies and solve puzzles as you uncover the night that changed the city.

details.title: Hitch Happens
details.short_description: Hitch Happens is a story-driven hitchhiking simulator where every ride turns into a new adventure. Hitch rides, meet quirky drivers, make choices, and get caught up in unpredictable situations.

details.title: BombBazled
details.short_description: Your best friend is the most dangerous bomb in the room. BombBazled is an online co-op party game for 1–8 friends: bomb through monster dungeons, grab the gold and escape together – or break the pact at the gate and get branded JUDAS. Proximity voice chat included.

details.title: Chips and Chaos
details.short_description: Pull the lever and sweep stacks of chips off the felt in a pixel-art incremental game. Upgrade your slot machine and collector, hit nightly cash targets, and spend plaques on permanent VIP perks before taking on High Limit.

details.title: The Gunner’s Campaign
details.short_description: Command a Napoleonic artillery battery from Austerlitz to Waterloo. Lay your bearing, read the fall of shot, keep the gun drill going under counter-battery fire, and earn your promotions across twenty historical missions.

details.title: The End of Magic
details.short_description: Explore a world where magic is falling into wicked hands in this top-down action adventure. Cast spells to fight enemies, break barriers, and pull distant levers. Absorb magic from fallen foes, or rely on your staff when it runs dry.

details.title: Deadly Voyage
details.short_description: A multiplayer murder party set aboard 1930s ocean liners. Find and kill your target, but be careful. Another player is hunting you. Bonk your target with a champagne bottle, drop a chandelier on them, or slip them a wallet that goes bang. Just don't let security see.

details.title: NUMISMATOR
details.short_description: A cozy digging and coin-collecting game with the three felt puppets of the Balanzone Troupe. Dig to a rhythm while your companions race each coin to the bucket, or teleport it there. Every coin is real history, with a museum photo and its own story in the troupe's travel log.

name: Brick by Brick: Build and Play

details.title: Brick by Brick: Build and Play
details.short_description: Become a brick creator and bring your ideas to life, one brick at a time. Design custom models, working vehicles and moving dioramas. Build, test and play alone or with friends. Your imagination is the limit!

details.title: The Hollow Moors
details.short_description: Halloween, 1999. A camping trip on the Yorkshire moors, then the fog rolled in and your friends vanished. Chop wood, scavenge supplies and keep the fire burning through the night, because the boggarts and lampers want it out. Cozy folk horror survival, solo or with friends.

details.title: Log to Lodge: Carpentry Simulator
details.short_description: Turn a single tree into a whole house. Log to Lodge is a cozy woodworking and carpentry sim: fell trees, run your own sawmill, plane lumber into planks, build furniture for village customers and grow your workshop.

details.title: PUFF-N: Proto-Utility Flying Forager-Navigator
details.short_description: Fly around as PUFF-N, a robotic puffin designed to help restimulate a dying ecosytem. Explore a colorful, stylized open world, dive into the water to catch as many fish as you can, and learn more about the alternate future where PUFF-N lives.

details.title: The Last Of Morvein
details.short_description: You are an aristocrat, the last survivor of Morvein. Explore a dark metropolis of Gothic architecture and Victorian elegance. Battle hellish creatures and uncover the mystery behind the fall of a city where death was only the beginning of the nightmare.

details.title: Stay Tuned
details.short_description: A narrative broadcast-desk game: cut cameras, bleep swearing, and fill every second of live TV by day, then go home to your family by night. When the war starts on air, you decide what the country sees.

details.title: Starlock Arcana
details.short_description: Explore the star-cursed world of Starlock Arcana as an undead mage on a quest to vanquish the Star of Doom. Venture into ancient dungeons, discover powerful spells and battle fierce enemies! Grow ever stronger, choose the spells that suit your playstyle, and bring an end to the star curse!

details.title: You Can't Deliver
details.short_description: All you have to do is deliver a pizza. What could possibly go wrong? In this game, the entire environment stands in your way. Dodge nasty traps, fall victim to absurd surprises, and try again. A rage game with one simple mission: Get the damn pizza to its destination.

details.title: Little Desk Farm
details.short_description: Run a pixel farm on your desktop. Grow crops, hire farmers, raise chickens and arrange buildings your way. Assign farmers to sow, water and harvest, then sell crops to expand your land. Check in on the farm now and then while you work, study or take a break.

details.title: Baseline Boss: The Basketball Manager
details.short_description: Coach a pro basketball team from the bench: pick your starting five, sign talent and make the calls live on a tactics board that cuts to comic highlights. A bold cartoon manager with story mode, trash-talk duels, voiced commentary and a real simulation underneath.

details.title: His Umbrella Is Dry
details.short_description: Hong Kong, 1999. The rain won't stop. Your uncle says he'll be away a few days and leaves you his paper offerings shop. Write names for the dead, build paper cars, take the money, count the change. Tonight's customers come in from the rain. One umbrella is dry. Uncle's rule: dry umbrella, no name.

details.title: Undaria
details.short_description: Undaria is a co-op PvE extraction RPG about exploring a kingdom that dug too deep. Ride the Great Lift into vast stylized voxel caverns, fight the Blighted, and return with loot and survivors to rebuild the town, repair the Lift, and open the way to deeper layers.

details.title: Radar Shadow
details.short_description: Somewhere on the other half of the map is the enemy's base. You don't know which hex it's on, and they don't know where yours is. No soldiers to click on: you run a country's radars, air defence and drone strikes, and design every drone and missile yourself.

details.title: Hold Morale
details.short_description: Hold Morale is a turn-based tactics game with roguelite campaigns. Master classic grid battles on land, at sea, and in the air, customize your units with retrofit kits, and combine more than 80 modules. Keep your troops' morale up: if it hits zero, your front collapses.

details.title: Oreflow
details.short_description: A calm single-player automation game set in your hometown's abandoned mine. Mine ore by hand, build drills, crushers and conveyor lines, fix bottlenecks, and restore the deep lift to uncover what happened to your father.

details.title: Case 27: Noema
details.short_description: The architecture of the visible does not belong to material bodies, but to the numinous abyss we sculpt around them.

details.title: Me, a Robot?
details.short_description: You wake up in the body of a household robot. Explore endless rooms, uncover clues with your extendable arms and sensors, and discover why you became a robot. Look closely—everything in this mansion is a clue.
developers: ぬくもりロボット工房
publishers: ぬくもりロボット工房

details.title: Reliquance
details.short_description: Keep out a lurking monster while playing a game that seems strangely connected to reality. Open doors that hold your past hostage as you work together with a familiar face to fulfill a promise you once made.

details.title: NO SHELTER
details.short_description: Survive a relentless storm, escape a mysterious entity, and uncover the truth behind tornadoes that appear from nowhere. Explore a world between reality, nightmares, and forgotten memories.

details.title: Hell In Heaven
details.short_description: It's like a shmup bullet hell but with a third dimension, and a die and retry structure. Focused on mechanics, no grinding. Play through short intense levels, firing abilities with an emphasis on positioning to aim at enemies. Are you up to the challenge ?

details.title: Popping Off
details.short_description: An evolving bubble wrap simulator made of chain reactions and upgrades. Tune in, gear up, pop off.

details.title: ANOTHER MEDIUM
details.short_description: ANOTHER MEDIUM is a non-linear adventure featuring a mix of sci-fi, horror, drama, and thriller. Explore the world, make decisions, shape your psychological profile, remain a puppet in the hands of outside forces, or break the control, even if the price turns out to be too high.

details.title: Where Sinners Sleep
details.short_description: In this card-based management game, you run a hotel owned by the Devil. Serve your guests to uncover their secrets and write your own story. But don’t forget to pay your rent. The Devil asks for flesh, mind, and soul. Will you find a way to break your infernal pact?

details.title: Feltfall
details.short_description: Fluffy felt animals. A merciless time limit. Feltfall is a roguelite deckbuilder about pulling off a harvest festival on a tiny wool-felt island. Pick your route, gather materials, craft cards on the spot, survive the storm-night showdowns, then answer a flood of animal requests at the festival.

details.title: A Wizard's Hat
details.short_description: Become Hatty the wizard's hat. Possess creatures and learn new abilities, delve into the castle's basement, travel to deep forests and lava caves. Become powerful enough to save the wizard. Adventure awaits.

details.title: Hollowreach - Wasteland
details.short_description: A cinematic third-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Dmitry Sokolov crosses ruins and hostile territories, fighting the living and the dead in search of his father. Scarce ammunition and difficult choices mark every step through a city in decay.

details.title: Rock Wager Scissors
details.short_description: Rock Wager Scissors is a logic & gambling game, where you get rich by adapting to your opponent's playstyle in Rock Paper Scissors. Make bets, use perks, study past moves, figure out your opponent's playstyle, and go all in!

details.title: Mega Sokofox World
details.short_description: Help Sara, the fox, overcome anxiety and leave her comfy labyrinth, to visit her beloved vampire girlfriend in this 16-bit Sokoban Adventure for the Mega Drive!

details.title: Twinkle Seek
details.short_description: Go search for sparkles to the ends of the world!

details.title: Don't Lose Your Head
details.short_description: Destroy your friendship by playing this challenging co-op game about two skeletons sharing a single head. Help each other to get out of a deep cave, be mindful of your jumps and remember - DON'T LOSE YOUR HEAD!

details.title: Medium Chronicles: Room 644
details.short_description: You must speak to survive. But speaking might kill you. Whisper rituals into your microphone — while a demon hunts every sound you make.

details.title: Ironfall
details.short_description: A survivors-like roguelite in a fallen kingdom of rune-forged relics. Pick one of 20 heroes, cut through endless swarms, fuse weapons and items into powerful evolutions, and raise the Run Curse until the Reaper himself comes for you.

details.title: Glassbound
details.short_description: Tiny creatures grow in glass bottles at the bottom of your screen while you work. Summon and fuse 200+ beings. Befriend a town of animal folk, or snoop on them and steal their secrets. Every choice tilts your compass toward Light or Darkness.

details.title: Video Poker Infinite
details.short_description: A casino-style video poker based incremental game. Play classic Jacks-or-Better based video poker while building and upgrading your pay table. Unlock powerful abilities to boost your odds and payouts. Play minigames like blackjack and roulette to enhance your progression.

details.title: We Die Standing
details.short_description: Arcs, Rings, Power, Annihilation, Courage, Comradeship, Worlds, Earth, Humans, Creatures, Flood, Scourge, Starvation, Crisis. Through All, One Must Fight Unless He Dies Standing.

details.title: LittleHeartRiddle
details.short_description: A transformational magical girl RPG where you command beasts to clear dungeons."Kohaku," a girl who gave up on being "cute," awakens in a sweet yet eerie World of Sweets. Accepted by the mysterious Lucia, she transforms into a magical girl to conquer perilous dungeons and retrieve her lost memories.

details.title: Palimpsest: Where Magic Remembers
details.short_description: A hand-painted magical sky-world full of fantasy and adventure. Relive the memories in its ruins, befriend the fantastic beasts you are forced to fight, and decide the future of magic.

name: To Pee or Not to Pee: พี พี่ พี้ พี๊ ผี

details.title: To Pee or Not to Pee: พี พี่ พี้ พี๊ ผี
details.short_description: A cute Thai horror anomaly game where you explore dark hallways with your flashlight, spot ghosts, investigate strange anomalies, solve spooky puzzles, and try to make it to the toilet without an accident!

details.title: ColdCall: Telesales Sim
details.short_description: A dark-comedy telemarketing sim. You're 18/24/35, broke, and cold-calling strangers to sell them wealth products. Everything they say flies at you: dodge the insults, catch the agreement, drag the rope past the deal line and stamp it. Rent's due. Don't let them hang up. Partly inspired by Undertale.

details.title: Tactics to the devil dungeon
details.short_description: Build a party of companions who each carry a signature, shape their classes and skills, then choose every move and attack in a dark fantasy turn-based tactical RPG where range, elevation and terrain decide the fight.

details.title: NO EXIT
details.short_description: A survival horror FPS where you face hordes of zombies, explore abandoned environments, gather resources, and fight to survive.

details.title: Arctic Research: Dig Them Out!
details.short_description: Dig through snow and ice to uncover prehistoric fossils in an Arctic research simulator! Extract and clean bones, analyze DNA, reconstruct ancient skeletons, and customize dioramas. Explore the frozen wilderness, upgrade your research station, and uncover secrets buried since the Cold War.

details.title: GORAL: Highlander Simulator
details.short_description: Become a young shepherd in the 1930s Tatra Mountains. Herd sheep, make traditional cheese, and face wolves and unpredictable mountain weather. Start with no sheep of your own, earn your keep, survive each season, and build a flock of your own.

details.title: Starcore: Through the Void
details.short_description: Pilot a lone gunship on a desperate mission to save the rebellion in this fast-paced 2D space shooter. Dodge deadly bullet patterns, master multi-phase boss encounters, and fight across nearly 20 bite-sized stages. Do you have what it takes to survive the void, Commander?

details.title: Ambulads
details.short_description: Rescue accident victims in a physics-based co-op game where your patient’s health determines your payday. Expand your ambulance, improvise with absurd tools and sell loot on the side.

details.title: Shadow Princess: Crystalbound
details.short_description: A 2D platformer focused on midair movement where you can place crystals anywhere in any level to help you reach the end of the stage.

details.title: Realpolitiks 4: Back to the Roots
details.short_description: Realpolitiks 4 returns to its roots. Lead your chosen nation in an accessible real-time strategy game. Develop your economy, shape politics, forge alliances and plan military operations. Face the crises of the 21st century and chart your own path to power!

details.title: Somnium: Hypnagogia
details.short_description: Somnium: Hypnagogia is a psychological horror visual novel set on a night where dreams, nightmares, memories and reality bleed into one another. As you drift from dream to dream, your whispers will decide where the night ends up.

details.title: Wasteland Bites 2
details.short_description: Wasteland Bites is a horror-based food truck sim. You've expanded your operation with a decked-out caravan! Explore deeper into the wasteland in search of new delicacies. But be warned. The freaks only get more dangerous the further out you wander.

details.title: Burgerama Anomaly
details.short_description: Serve or die in a late-night pedestrian underpass kiosk. Prepare different burgers, fry ingredients, and manage your supplies - all while inspecting your customers for inhuman traits. Follow the night's rules, survive various hazards, and uncover the truth behind the mutations.

details.title: Trauma Room
details.short_description: Get ready for the most ridiculous (but also realistic) problems you can run into at the vet clinic. Today is the perfect day to help our furry and aquatic pals! And best of all, you can treat them all together with your friends in online co-op!

details.title: Black Zero
details.short_description: Fight rebels, mercenaries and the infected all at once in this top-down co-op shooter for 1–4 players. Play on the couch or online, and stop a weapon with no cure before anyone can use it.

details.title: Angela's eye
details.short_description: Angela is a blind young girl. Her only guide is the mystery of a ringing bell. Living as an adopted child of a noble family, Angela returns home to find an unsettling atmosphere. Hunted by an unknown enemy, her only reliance is the bell you ring. Run or hide to evade terror and escape.

details.title: Shelter for Stalkers
details.short_description: Lead a community of survivors in a post-apocalyptic bunker. Overcome scarcity, grow the economy, earn money, and choose your own path in politics and governance. Make your shelter thrive: money and influence are not the goal, but the means to fulfill your ultimate mission—saving the world

details.title: Tethered Dread: The Blind Spot
details.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where your fear gives you away. Search for an exit from a system that harvests human terror, resist an invisible tether, and use your imagination to outwit its faceless custodians. They will not kill you. But you can break.

details.title: Travelling to Woolokii
details.short_description: Solve cases, investigate mysteries, and explore the Island of Woolok in this chapter-based Point & Click / Visual Novel.

name: Wrong Ritual At The Toy Store

details.title: Wrong Ritual At The Toy Store
details.short_description: TOYSTORE is a survival horror game in which you must explore an underground shopping mall that was suddenly shut down for unknown reasons. The events take place in the early 90s, and you have been tasked with repairing the elevator that leads to the exit, in order to finalize the closure procedures.

details.title: Pale Like Lilacs
details.short_description: Pale Like Lilacs is a short visual novel about an alcoholic vending machine whose only customer is a robot girl who loves beer. Talk with her, serve her drinks, and help each other survive a rapidly evolving dystopian city.

details.title: Epiphora
details.short_description: An introspective exploration of the human condition conveyed through the work of a taxidermist. Your knowledge will be the blade with which to explore depths once stitched shut. A reinterpretation of the MetroidBrainia genre, where puzzles and perception intertwine with the eternity of flesh.

details.title: Heirs to the Realm
details.short_description: A classic real-time strategy game of mice, badgers, hares and rats. Gather and build on the ruins of a lost realm, advance from the Stone Age to the Iron Age, and raise an army to take the land your ancestors once shared.

details.title: Lumen Keeper
details.short_description: Build a fortress on a planet shrouded in fog. In this blend of tower defense and action roguelite, strengthen your defenses, wipe out hordes of aliens, and collect their energy to push back the fog.

details.title: Shimagurashi: Island Life
details.short_description: Move to a quiet island in southern Japan and take life at your own pace. Drive your little kei truck along the coast, go fishing, carry lumber to build a home, and shop at the corner store. A slow-life game about bringing the lights back to a fading island, one house at a time.

details.title: Swords & Sodas
details.short_description: Friday night, a basement card table, and nobody wants to run the campaign. A d20 picks tonight's Game Master, and everyone else brings a character to the arena. Fight turn-based battles on a grid, roll every die yourself, and try to keep your sheet in one piece.

details.title: Darkmere Dungeons
details.short_description: The dungeons of Darkmere await! Assemble a band of heroes, find epic loot, and discover powerful synergies as you lead your party through the corrupted hordes of Darkmere in this roguelike autobattler.

details.title: Tucklist
details.short_description: A backpack puzzle game about travel, choices, and saying goodbye. Follow an 18-year-old on a journey through Tokyo, Egypt, and New Zealand. Collect meaningful items, organize limited backpack space, and decide what to keep or leave behind. Every choice becomes part of your journey.

details.title: Lithari
details.short_description: A competitive PvP card battler where every card is unlocked from day one. Build your deck or hit Wildcard for a random one, pick a Helper, draft Augments mid-match and channel three veins of power (Mana, Fury and Will) to outplay your opponent.

details.title: House of Open Hands
details.short_description: Build and manage a temporary home for people facing difficult times. Hire and train a care team, get to know your residents, and make choices with lasting consequences in a social-care management game where progress takes many forms.

details.title: Faunavera Valley
